import { toastMsg } from '../../cor/store/toast';
import { HELP } from '../../shr/help/helpTexts';
import type { ComparableFlockMetric } from '../../cor/storage/historyArchive';

export interface ComparisonCandidate {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  metric: ComparableFlockMetric;
  isActive: boolean;
}

interface FlockComparisonPanelProps {
  candidates: ComparisonCandidate[];
  selectedIds: string[];
  onToggleFlock: (flockId: string) => void;
  onSelectPreset: (flockIds: string[], baselineId?: string) => void;
  baselineId: string;
  onChangeBaseline: (flockId: string) => void;
  activeFlockIds: Set<string>;
}

type CandidateFilter = 'all' | 'archived' | 'active';
type PickerMode = 'compare' | 'baseline' | null;
type BetterRule = 'higher' | 'lower';
type TagTone =
  | 'blue'
  | 'gray'
  | 'green'
  | 'purple'
  | 'red'
  | 'warn'
  | 'info'
  | 'accent'
  | 'danger'
  | 'amber'
  | 'dim';

interface MetricSpec {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  ruleText: string;
  better: BetterRule;
  unit: string;
  decimals: number;
}

const MIN_FLOCKS = 2;
const MAX_FLOCKS = 4;
const MAX_OTHER_FLOCKS = MAX_FLOCKS - 1;
const ARCHIVE_FILTER_THRESHOLD = 5;

const DEFAULT_COMPARISON_HELP =
  '**مقایسه گله‌ها (۲ تا ۴ گله):** ابتدا **گله مرجع** را انتخاب کنید و سپس حداکثر **۳ گله** دیگر را برای مقایسه با آن برگزینید.\n**امتیازدهی:** در هزینه، تلفات و ضریب تبدیل **کمتر بهتر** و در درآمد، زنده‌مانی و تخم **بیشتر بهتر** است. شاخص‌های ثبت‌نشده به پایین جدول منتقل می‌شوند.';

const COMPARISON_HELP_TEXT =
  (HELP as unknown as { arc?: { comparison?: { overview?: string } } }).arc?.comparison?.overview ??
  DEFAULT_COMPARISON_HELP;

const COMPARISON_METRICS: MetricSpec[] = [
  { key: 'epef', label: 'شاخص تولید', ruleText: 'بیشتر بهتر', better: 'higher', unit: '', decimals: 0 },
  { key: 'fcr', label: 'ضریب تبدیل', ruleText: 'کمتر بهتر', better: 'lower', unit: '', decimals: 2 },
  { key: 'livabilityPct', label: 'زنده‌مانی', ruleText: 'بیشتر بهتر', better: 'higher', unit: '٪', decimals: 1 },
  { key: 'brokenEggRatePct', label: 'تخم شکسته', ruleText: 'کمتر بهتر', better: 'lower', unit: '٪', decimals: 1 },
  { key: 'initialCost', label: 'هزینه اولیه', ruleText: 'کمتر بهتر', better: 'lower', unit: '', decimals: 0 },
  { key: 'recordedCost', label: 'هزینه تمام‌شده', ruleText: 'کمتر بهتر', better: 'lower', unit: '', decimals: 0 },
  { key: 'recordedRevenue', label: 'درآمد ثبت‌شده', ruleText: 'بیشتر بهتر', better: 'higher', unit: '', decimals: 0 },
  { key: 'totalMortality', label: 'کل تلفات', ruleText: 'کمتر بهتر', better: 'lower', unit: '', decimals: 0 },
  { key: 'totalFeedKg', label: 'کل دان', ruleText: 'کمتر بهتر', better: 'lower', unit: 'kg', decimals: 0 },
  { key: 'totalEggs', label: 'کل تخم', ruleText: 'بیشتر بهتر', better: 'higher', unit: '', decimals: 0 },
];

function cleanCandidateTitle(rawLabel: string, fallbackName: string): string {
  const withoutParens = rawLabel
    .replace(/\s*\[(?:فعال|آرشیو)\]\s*/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s*\([^)]*\)\s*/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
  return withoutParens || fallbackName || rawLabel;
}

function extractCandidateYear(metric: ComparableFlockMetric): string {
  const dateStr = metric.lastDate || metric.firstDate || '';
  if (dateStr) {
    const norm = normalizeDigits(dateStr).trim();
    const match = norm.match(/^(1[34]\d{2})[/-]/);
    if (match) return match[1];
    const parsed = new Date(dateStr);
    if (!Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
      const j = formatJalali(parsed);
      const jMatch = normalizeDigits(j).match(/^(1[34]\d{2})[/-]/);
      if (jMatch) return jMatch[1];
    }
  }
  if (typeof metric.archivedAt === 'number' && metric.archivedAt > 0) {
    const j = formatJalali(new Date(metric.archivedAt));
    const jMatch = normalizeDigits(j).match(/^(1[34]\d{2})[/-]/);
    if (jMatch) return jMatch[1];
  }
  return 'نامشخص';
}

function extractNumericMetric(metric: ComparableFlockMetric, key: string): number | null {
  const rec = metric as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
  const raw = rec[key];
  if (typeof raw === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(raw)) return raw;
  const fin = metric.financial as unknown as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  if (fin && typeof fin[key] === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(fin[key] as number)) {
    return fin[key] as number;
  }
  return null;
}

function formatNumFa(val: number | null, decimals: number, unit: string): string {
  if (val === null || Number.isNaN(val)) return 'ثبت نشده';
  const formatted = getGlobalFormat().num(Number(val));
  return unit ? `${formatted} ${unit}` : formatted;
}

function formatPctFa(pct: number): string {
  const sign = pct > 0 ? '+' : pct < 0 ? '-' : '';
  const formatted = getGlobalFormat().num(Math.abs(pct));
  return `${sign}${formatted}٪`;
}

export default function FlockComparisonPanel({
  candidates,
  selectedIds,
  onToggleFlock,
  onSelectPreset,
  baselineId,
  onChangeBaseline,
  activeFlockIds,
}: FlockComparisonPanelProps) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const [panelOpen, setPanelOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pickerMode, setPickerMode] = useState<PickerMode>(null);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<CandidateFilter>('all');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const showArchiveFilterControls = candidates.length > ARCHIVE_FILTER_THRESHOLD;

  const getTitle = (c: ComparisonCandidate) => cleanCandidateTitle(c.label, c.metric.flockName);
  const getIsActive = (c: ComparisonCandidate) => activeFlockIds.has(c.id) || c.isActive;
  const getDays = (c: ComparisonCandidate) => c.metric.durationDays ?? c.metric.logCount;

  const filteredCandidates = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    return candidates.filter((c) => {
      const active = getIsActive(c);
      if (filter === 'active' && !active) return false;
      if (filter === 'archived' && active) return false;
      const title = getTitle(c).toLowerCase();
      if (
        q &&
        !title.includes(q) &&
        !c.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) &&
        !c.metric.flockName.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      ) {
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [candidates, filter, searchQuery, activeFlockIds]);

  const selectedCandidates = useMemo(() => {
    const cappedIds = selectedIds.slice(0, MAX_FLOCKS);
    return candidates.filter((c) => cappedIds.includes(c.id));
  }, [candidates, selectedIds]);

  const effectiveBaselineId = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedCandidates.some((c) => c.id === baselineId)) return baselineId;
    return selectedCandidates[0]?.id ?? '';
  }, [selectedCandidates, baselineId]);

  const orderedCandidates = useMemo(() => {
    const refItem = selectedCandidates.find((c) => c.id === effectiveBaselineId) ?? null;
    if (!refItem) return [] as ComparisonCandidate[];
    const others = selectedCandidates.filter((c) => c.id !== refItem.id);
    return [refItem, ...others];
  }, [selectedCandidates, effectiveBaselineId]);

  const refCandidate = orderedCandidates[0] ?? null;
  const otherCandidates = useMemo(
    () => orderedCandidates.filter((c) => c.id !== refCandidate?.id),
    [orderedCandidates, refCandidate]
  );

  const selectedCount = orderedCandidates.length;
  const canCompare = selectedCount >= MIN_FLOCKS && selectedCount <= MAX_FLOCKS;

  const sortedMetrics = useMemo(() => {
    return COMPARISON_METRICS.map((spec, idx) => {
      const hasAnyValue = orderedCandidates.some(
        (c) => extractNumericMetric(c.metric, spec.key) !== null
      );
      return { spec, idx, hasAnyValue };
    })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.hasAnyValue === b.hasAnyValue) return a.idx - b.idx;
        return a.hasAnyValue ? -1 : 1;
      })
      .map((item) => item.spec);
  }, [orderedCandidates]);

  const groupedByYear = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, ComparisonCandidate[]>();
    for (const c of filteredCandidates) {
      const yr = extractCandidateYear(c.metric);
      const list = map.get(yr) ?? [];
      list.push(c);
      map.set(yr, list);
    }
    const entries = Array.from(map.entries());
    entries.sort(([a], [b]) => {
      if (a === 'نامشخص') return 1;
      if (b === 'نامشخص') return -1;
      return Number(b) - Number(a);
    });
    return entries;
  }, [filteredCandidates]);

  const handleOpenPicker = (mode: Exclude<PickerMode, null>) => {
    setSearchQuery('');
    setFilter('all');
    setPickerMode(mode);
  };

  const handleSetReference = (nextRefId: string) => {
    if (!candidates.some((c) => c.id === nextRefId)) return;
    if (!selectedIds.includes(nextRefId)) {
      if (selectedIds.length >= MAX_FLOCKS) {
        const removable = selectedIds.find((id) => id !== baselineId);
        const nextIds = removable
          ? [...selectedIds.filter((id) => id !== removable), nextRefId]
          : [nextRefId, ...selectedIds.slice(0, MAX_FLOCKS - 1)];
        onSelectPreset(nextIds, nextRefId);
        setPickerMode(null);
        return;
      }
      onSelectPreset([...selectedIds, nextRefId], nextRefId);
      setPickerMode(null);
      return;
    }
    onChangeBaseline(nextRefId);
    setPickerMode(null);
  };

  const handleToggleInPicker = (targetId: string) => {
    if (targetId === effectiveBaselineId) {
      toastMsg.info('این گله مرجع است');
      return;
    }
    const isAlreadySelected = selectedIds.includes(targetId);
    if (!isAlreadySelected && otherCandidates.length >= MAX_OTHER_FLOCKS) {
      toastMsg.warn(`علاوه بر گله مرجع، حداکثر ${fmt.count(MAX_OTHER_FLOCKS)} گله قابل انتخاب است`);
      return;
    }
    onToggleFlock(targetId);
  };

  const bestFlockInfo = useMemo(() => {
    if (!canCompare || !refCandidate) return null;
    const comparables = orderedCandidates.slice(1);

    const scored = comparables.map((item) => {
      let comparableCount = 0;
      let betterCount = 0;
      let worseCount = 0;
      let netAdvantagePct = 0;

      for (const spec of sortedMetrics) {
        const val = extractNumericMetric(item.metric, spec.key);
        const refVal = extractNumericMetric(refCandidate.metric, spec.key);
        if (val === null || refVal === null) continue;
        comparableCount += 1;

        const diff = val - refVal;
        if (Math.abs(diff) < 1e-9) continue;

        const isBetter = spec.better === 'lower' ? diff < 0 : diff > 0;
        const relPct = refVal !== 0 ? (diff / Math.abs(refVal)) * 100 : 0;
        netAdvantagePct += spec.better === 'lower' ? -relPct : relPct;

        if (isBetter) {
          betterCount += 1;
        } else {
          worseCount += 1;
        }
      }

      return {
        candidate: item,
        comparableCount,
        betterCount,
        worseCount,
        netAdvantagePct,
      };
    });

    const sorted = [...scored].sort((a, b) => {
      if (b.betterCount !== a.betterCount) return b.betterCount - a.betterCount;
      if (b.netAdvantagePct !== a.netAdvantagePct) return b.netAdvantagePct - a.netAdvantagePct;
      return a.worseCount - b.worseCount;
    });

    const winner = sorted[0] ?? null;
    if (!winner || winner.betterCount <= 0) {
      return {
        title: getTitle(refCandidate),
        badge: 'مرجع',
        tone: 'info' as TagTone,
        summary: 'هیچ گله مقایسه‌ای در شاخص‌های ثبت‌شده عملکرد بهتری نسبت به مرجع نداشته است.',
        ruleNote: 'معیار انتخاب: در هزینه، تلفات و ضریب تبدیل مقدار کمتر و در درآمد، زنده‌مانی و تخم مقدار بیشتر امتیاز مثبت می‌گیرد.',
      };
    }

    return {
      title: getTitle(winner.candidate),
      badge: 'برتر',
      tone: 'green' as TagTone,
      summary: `این گله در ${fmt.count(winner.betterCount)} شاخص از ${fmt.count(winner.comparableCount)} شاخص قابل مقایسه، نتیجه بهتری نسبت به گله مرجع (${getTitle(refCandidate)}) ثبت کرده است.`,
      ruleNote: 'معیار انتخاب: در هزینه، تلفات و ضریب تبدیل مقدار کمتر و در درآمد، زنده‌مانی و تخم مقدار بیشتر امتیاز مثبت می‌گیرد.',
    };
  }, [canCompare, refCandidate, orderedCandidates, sortedMetrics]);

  const handleExportCSV = () => {
    if (!canCompare || !refCandidate) return;
    const headers = ['شاخص', ...orderedCandidates.map((c) => getTitle(c))];
    const rows = sortedMetrics.map((spec) => [
      spec.label,
      ...orderedCandidates.map((c) => {
        const v = extractNumericMetric(c.metric, spec.key);
        return v !== null ? String(v) : 'ثبت نشده';
      }),
    ]);
    exportTableToCSV('مقایسه-گله‌ها', headers, rows);
  };

  const handleExportPDF = () => {
    if (!canCompare || !refCandidate) return;
    const headCells = orderedCandidates
      .map((c, idx) => `<th>${getTitle(c)}${idx === 0 ? ' (مرجع)' : ''}</th>`)
      .join('');
    const bodyRows = sortedMetrics.map((spec) => {
      const cells = orderedCandidates
        .map((c) => {
          const v = extractNumericMetric(c.metric, spec.key);
          return `<td>${formatNumFa(v, spec.decimals, spec.unit)}</td>`;
        })
        .join('');
      return `<tr><td>${spec.label}</td>${cells}</tr>`;
    }).join('');

    const htmlBody = `
      <div class="header">
        <div>
          <h1>گزارش مقایسه گله‌ها (${fmt.count(orderedCandidates.length)} گله)</h1>
          <div class="farm-info">مرجع: ${getTitle(refCandidate)} • ${fmt.code(new Date().toLocaleDateString('fa-IR'))}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th>شاخص</th>${headCells}</tr></thead>
        <tbody>${bodyRows}</tbody>
      </table>
    `;
    printHTML(printTemplate('گزارش مقایسه گله‌ها', htmlBody));
  };

  const otherSummaryText = useMemo(() => {
    if (otherCandidates.length === 0) return 'انتخاب گله‌های مقایسه';
    return otherCandidates.map((c) => getTitle(c)).join('، ');
  }, [otherCandidates]);

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        background: 'var(--card)',
        border: '1px solid var(--border)',
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)',
        padding: 'var(--pad-comfy)',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: 'var(--gap-sm)',
      }}
    >
      <div className="flex-between" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
          <div
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 4,
              fontWeight: 700,
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)',
              color: 'var(--text)',
            }}
          >
            <span>مقایسه گله‌ها</span>
            <HelpIcon text={COMPARISON_HELP_TEXT} />
          </div>
          {refCandidate && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
              مرجع: {getTitle(refCandidate)} • {fmt.count(orderedCandidates.length)} از {fmt.count(MAX_FLOCKS)} گله
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <Btn
          size="sm"
          variant={panelOpen ? 'primary' : undefined}
          onClick={() => setPanelOpen((v) => !v)}
        >
          {panelOpen ? 'بستن مقایسه' : 'نمایش مقایسه'}
        </Btn>
      </div>

      {panelOpen && (
        <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 'var(--gap-md)' }}>
          <CardSection title="انتخاب گله‌ها" first>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
              {candidates.length > 0 && (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
                  <label style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                    انتخاب گله مرجع
                  </label>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleOpenPicker('baseline')}
                    style={{
                      width: '100%',
                      padding: '8px 10px',
                      borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                      border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                      background: 'var(--card-solid)',
                      color: 'var(--text)',
                      fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
                      fontWeight: 600,
                      fontFamily: 'inherit',
                      textAlign: 'right',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'space-between',
                      gap: 8,
                    }}
                  >
                    <span style={{ overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                      {refCandidate ? getTitle(refCandidate) : 'انتخاب نشده'}
                    </span>
                    <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', flexShrink: 0 }}>▾</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
                <label style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                  انتخاب گله‌های مقایسه ({fmt.count(otherCandidates.length)} از {fmt.count(MAX_OTHER_FLOCKS)})
                </label>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleOpenPicker('compare')}
                  style={{
                    width: '100%',
                    padding: '8px 10px',
                    borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                    background: 'var(--card-solid)',
                    color: 'var(--text)',
                    fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    fontFamily: 'inherit',
                    textAlign: 'right',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    gap: 8,
                  }}
                >
                  <span style={{ overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                    {otherSummaryText}
                  </span>
                  <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', flexShrink: 0 }}>▾</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {orderedCandidates.length > 0 && (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                  {orderedCandidates.map((item, idx) => {
                    const isRef = idx === 0;
                    return (
                      <span
                        key={item.id}
                        style={{
                          display: 'inline-flex',
                          alignItems: 'center',
                          gap: 6,
                          padding: '4px 8px',
                          borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                          border: `1px solid ${isRef ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'}`,
                          background: isRef ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--card-solid)',
                          fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
                          fontWeight: 600,
                        }}
                      >
                        <span>{getTitle(item)}</span>
                        {isRef ? (
                          <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', fontSize: 10 }}>مرجع</span>
                        ) : (
                          orderedCandidates.length > MIN_FLOCKS && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              aria-label={`حذف ${getTitle(item)}`}
                              onClick={() => onToggleFlock(item.id)}
                              style={{
                                border: 'none',
                                background: 'transparent',
                                color: 'var(--muted)',
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                cursor: 'pointer',
                                padding: '0 2px',
                              }}
                            >
                              ×
                            </button>
                          )
                        )}
                      </span>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </CardSection>

          <CardSection title="عملکرد و جدول مقایسه">
            {!canCompare ? (
              <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                گله مرجع و حداقل {fmt.count(MIN_FLOCKS - 1)} تا حداکثر {fmt.count(MAX_OTHER_FLOCKS)} گله دیگر برای مقایسه انتخاب کنید.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 'var(--gap-sm)' }}>
                {bestFlockInfo && (
                  <div
                    style={{
                      background: 'var(--card-solid)',
                      border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                      borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                      padding: '8px 10px',
                      display: 'flex',
                      flexDirection: 'column',
                      gap: 4,
                    }}
                  >
                    <div className="flex-between" style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                      <span>بهترین عملکرد: {bestFlockInfo.title}</span>
                      <Tag tone={bestFlockInfo.tone}>{bestFlockInfo.badge}</Tag>
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                      {bestFlockInfo.summary}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                      {bestFlockInfo.ruleNote}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div
                  style={{
                    width: '100%',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                    borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                    overflowX: 'auto',
                    background: 'var(--card-solid)',
                  }}
                >
                  <table
                    style={{
                      width: '100%',
                      borderCollapse: 'collapse',
                      tableLayout: 'fixed',
                    }}
                  >
                    <thead>
                      <tr style={{ background: 'var(--card)' }}>
                        <th
                          style={{
                            width: 82,
                            padding: '5px 4px',
                            borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
                            borderLeft: '1px solid var(--border)',
                            textAlign: 'center',
                            fontSize: 11,
                          }}
                        >
                          <div>شاخص</div>
                          <div style={{ fontSize: 9.5, color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 400 }}>قاعده</div>
                        </th>
                        {orderedCandidates.map((c, idx) => {
                          const isRef = idx === 0;
                          return (
                            <th
                              key={c.id}
                              style={{
                                minWidth: 72,
                                padding: '5px 4px',
                                borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
                                borderLeft: '1px solid var(--border)',
                                textAlign: 'center',
                                fontSize: 11,
                              }}
                            >
                              <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, wordBreak: 'break-word' }}>{getTitle(c)}</div>
                              {isRef && (
                                <div style={{ marginTop: 2 }}>
                                  <Tag tone="info">مرجع</Tag>
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </th>
                          );
                        })}
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {sortedMetrics.map((spec, rIdx) => {
                        const refVal = refCandidate ? extractNumericMetric(refCandidate.metric, spec.key) : null;
                        return (
                          <tr
                            key={spec.key}
                            style={{
                              background: rIdx % 2 === 1 ? 'var(--card)' : 'transparent',
                            }}
                          >
                            <td
                              style={{
                                padding: '5px 4px',
                                borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
                                borderLeft: '1px solid var(--border)',
                                textAlign: 'center',
                              }}
                            >
                              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700 }}>{spec.label}</div>
                              <div style={{ fontSize: 9.5, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{spec.ruleText}</div>
                            </td>

                            {orderedCandidates.map((c, idx) => {
                              const isRef = idx === 0;
                              const val = extractNumericMetric(c.metric, spec.key);

                              if (val === null) {
                                return (
                                  <td
                                    key={c.id}
                                    style={{
                                      padding: '5px 4px',
                                      borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
                                      borderLeft: '1px solid var(--border)',
                                      textAlign: 'center',
                                      fontSize: 11,
                                      color: 'var(--muted)',
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    ثبت نشده
                                  </td>
                                );
                              }

                              if (isRef) {
                                return (
                                  <td
                                    key={c.id}
                                    style={{
                                      padding: '5px 4px',
                                      borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
                                      borderLeft: '1px solid var(--border)',
                                      textAlign: 'center',
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 11 }}>
                                      {formatNumFa(val, spec.decimals, spec.unit)}
                                    </div>
                                    <div style={{ fontSize: 9.5, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>—</div>
                                  </td>
                                );
                              }

                              if (refVal === null || refVal === 0) {
                                return (
                                  <td
                                    key={c.id}
                                    style={{
                                      padding: '5px 4px',
                                      borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
                                      borderLeft: '1px solid var(--border)',
                                      textAlign: 'center',
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 11 }}>
                                      {formatNumFa(val, spec.decimals, spec.unit)}
                                    </div>
                                    <div style={{ fontSize: 9.5, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>بدون مبنا</div>
                                  </td>
                                );
                              }

                              const diff = val - refVal;
                              const pct = (diff / Math.abs(refVal)) * 100;
                              const isEqual = Math.abs(diff) < 1e-9;
                              const isBetter = isEqual ? null : spec.better === 'lower' ? diff < 0 : diff > 0;
                              const tone: TagTone = isEqual ? 'gray' : isBetter ? 'green' : 'red';
                              const statusLabel = isEqual ? 'برابر' : isBetter ? 'بهتر' : 'ضعیف‌تر';

                              return (
                                <td
                                  key={c.id}
                                  style={{
                                    padding: '5px 4px',
                                    borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
                                    borderLeft: '1px solid var(--border)',
                                    textAlign: 'center',
                                  }}
                                >
                                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 11 }}>
                                    {formatNumFa(val, spec.decimals, spec.unit)}
                                  </div>
                                  <div style={{ fontSize: 9.5, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                                    {formatPctFa(pct)}
                                  </div>
                                  <div style={{ marginTop: 2 }}>
                                    <Tag tone={tone}>{statusLabel}</Tag>
                                  </div>
                                </td>
                              );
                            })}
                          </tr>
                        );
                      })}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>

                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                  شاخص‌های فاقد مقدار به‌صورت خودکار در پایین جدول قرار می‌گیرند.
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </CardSection>

          <CardSection
            title="خروجی گزارش"
            meta={`${fmt.count(orderedCandidates.length)} از ${fmt.count(MAX_FLOCKS)} گله`}
          >
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <Btn size="sm" variant="primary" disabled={!canCompare} onClick={handleExportCSV}>
                  خروجی CSV
                </Btn>
                <Btn size="sm" variant="primary" disabled={!canCompare} onClick={handleExportPDF}>
                  خروجی PDF
                </Btn>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardSection>
        </div>
      )}

      <SelectSheetShell
        open={pickerMode !== null}
        onClose={() => setPickerMode(null)}
        title={pickerMode === 'baseline' ? 'انتخاب گله مرجع' : 'انتخاب گله‌های مقایسه'}
        subtitle={
          pickerMode === 'baseline'
            ? `${fmt.count(filteredCandidates.length)} گله`
            : `${fmt.count(otherCandidates.length)} از ${fmt.count(MAX_OTHER_FLOCKS)} گله دیگر`
        }
        searchable={candidates.length > ARCHIVE_FILTER_THRESHOLD}
        onSearchClear={() => setSearchQuery('')}
        searchNode={
          <div style={{ padding: '4px 2px' }}>
            <input
              type="search"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="جستجوی نام گله..."
              style={{
                width: '100%',
                padding: '8px 12px',
                borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                background: 'var(--card-solid)',
                color: 'var(--text)',
                fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                fontFamily: 'inherit',
                boxSizing: 'border-box',
              }}
            />
          </div>
        }
        footer={
          <Btn size="sm" full onClick={() => setPickerMode(null)}>
            بستن
          </Btn>
        }
      >
        {showArchiveFilterControls && (
          <div
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              gap: 6,
              flexWrap: 'wrap',
              padding: '6px 8px',
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border)',
              background: 'var(--card)',
            }}
          >
            <TabButton active={filter === 'all'} onClick={() => setFilter('all')}>
              همه ({fmt.count(candidates.length)})
            </TabButton>
            <TabButton active={filter === 'active'} onClick={() => setFilter('active')}>
              فعال ({fmt.count(candidates.filter((c) => getIsActive(c)).length)})
            </TabButton>
            <TabButton active={filter === 'archived'} onClick={() => setFilter('archived')}>
              آرشیو ({fmt.count(candidates.filter((c) => !getIsActive(c)).length)})
            </TabButton>
          </div>
        )}

        {groupedByYear.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty icon="🐔" title="گله‌ای یافت نشد" desc="فیلتر یا جستجو را تغییر دهید." />
        ) : (
          groupedByYear.map(([yearLabel, yearItems]) => (
            <SheetGroup
              key={yearLabel}
              title={yearLabel === 'نامشخص' ? 'سال نامشخص' : `سال ${fmt.code(yearLabel)}`}
              count={yearItems.length}
            >
              {yearItems.map((c) => {
                const isRef = c.id === effectiveBaselineId;
                const isSelected = selectedIds.includes(c.id);
                const isActiveFlock = getIsActive(c);
                const statusText = isActiveFlock ? 'گله فعال' : 'آرشیو شده است';
                const daysText = `${fmt.day(getDays(c))} روز`;
                const checked = pickerMode === 'baseline' ? isRef : isSelected;

                return (
                  <button
                    key={c.id}
                    type="button"
                    aria-selected={checked}
                    onClick={() =>
                      pickerMode === 'baseline'
                        ? handleSetReference(c.id)
                        : handleToggleInPicker(c.id)
                    }
                    style={{
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'space-between',
                      gap: 10,
                      width: '100%',
                      padding: '10px 12px',
                      background: checked ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--card-solid)',
                      border: 'none',
                      borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
                      fontFamily: 'inherit',
                      textAlign: 'right',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                    }}
                  >
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 3, minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                      <span
                        style={{
                          fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)',
                          fontWeight: 700,
                          color: checked ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)',
                          overflow: 'hidden',
                          textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                          whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                        }}
                      >
                        {getTitle(c)}
                      </span>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                        {statusText} • {daysText}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {checked && (
                      <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 800, flexShrink: 0 }}>
                        ✓
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </SheetGroup>
          ))
        )}
      </SelectSheetShell>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/arc/FlockPickerModal.tsx

/**
 * FlockPickerModal.tsx — مودال انتخاب گله برای مقایسه و مرجع
 * (استخراج‌شده از FlockComparisonPanel.tsx — فاز رفکتور)
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Tag, Modal, Input, Empty } from '../../shr/components/ui';
import { IconSearch } from '../../shr/icons';
import { toFa } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { toastMsg } from '../../cor/store/toast';
import {
  type ComparisonCandidate,
  type CandidateFilter,
  type PickerMode,
  ARCHIVE_FILTER_THRESHOLD,
  MAX_FLOCKS,
  cleanCandidateTitle,
} from './comparisonHelpers';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  mode: PickerMode;
  candidates: ComparisonCandidate[];
  selectedIds: string[];
  effectiveBaselineId: string;
  activeFlockIds: Set<string>;
  onClose: () => void;
  onToggleFlock: (flockId: string) => void;
  onSetReference: (flockId: string) => void;
}

export default function FlockPickerModal({
  open,
  mode,
  candidates,
  selectedIds,
  effectiveBaselineId,
  activeFlockIds,
  onClose,
  onToggleFlock,
  onSetReference,
}: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<CandidateFilter>('all');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');

  const getTitle = (c: ComparisonCandidate) => cleanCandidateTitle(c.label, c.metric.flockName);
  const getIsActive = (c: ComparisonCandidate) => activeFlockIds.has(c.id) || c.isActive;
  const getDays = (c: ComparisonCandidate) => c.metric.durationDays ?? c.metric.logCount;

  const showFilterControls = candidates.length > ARCHIVE_FILTER_THRESHOLD;

  const filteredCandidates = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    return candidates.filter((c) => {
      const active = getIsActive(c);
      if (filter === 'active' && !active) return false;
      if (filter === 'archived' && active) return false;
      const title = getTitle(c).toLowerCase();
      if (
        q &&
        !title.includes(q) &&
        !c.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) &&
        !c.metric.flockName.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      ) {
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [candidates, filter, searchQuery, activeFlockIds]);

  const groupedCandidates = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, ComparisonCandidate[]>();
    filteredCandidates.forEach((c) => {
      const date = c.metric.firstDate || c.metric.lastDate || '';
      const year = date.slice(0, 4) || 'نامشخص';
      if (!map.has(year)) map.set(year, []);
      map.get(year)!.push(c);
    });
    return Array.from(map.entries()).sort((a, b) => b[0].localeCompare(a[0])); // نزولی
  }, [filteredCandidates]);

  const handleToggleInPicker = (targetId: string) => {
    if (targetId === effectiveBaselineId) {
      toastMsg.info('این گله هم‌اکنون مرجع است');
      return;
    }
    const isAlreadySelected = selectedIds.includes(targetId);
    if (!isAlreadySelected && selectedIds.length >= MAX_FLOCKS) {
      toastMsg.warn(`حداکثر ${fmt.count(MAX_FLOCKS)} گله در کل قابل مقایسه است`);
      return;
    }
    onToggleFlock(targetId);
  };

  const title = mode === 'baseline' ? 'انتخاب گله مرجع' : 'انتخاب گله‌های مقایسه';

  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title={title}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
        {candidates.length > ARCHIVE_FILTER_THRESHOLD && (
          <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
            <div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 10, top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
              <IconSearch size={16} />
            </div>
            <Input
              type="search"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="جستجوی نام گله..."
              mode="text"
              style={{ paddingRight: 32 }}
            />
          </div>
        )}

        {showFilterControls && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            {(['all', 'active', 'archived'] as CandidateFilter[]).map((f) => {
              const active = filter === f;
              const count = f === 'all'
                ? candidates.length
                : f === 'active'
                  ? candidates.filter(getIsActive).length
                  : candidates.filter((c) => !getIsActive(c)).length;
              const label = f === 'all' ? 'همه' : f === 'active' ? 'فعال' : 'آرشیو';
              return (
                <button
                  key={f}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setFilter(f)}
                  style={{
                    padding: '6px 12px',
                    borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                    border: `1px solid ${active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--border)'}`,
                    background: active ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--card-solid)',
                    color: active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontFamily: 'inherit',
                    fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                    fontWeight: active ? 700 : 600,
                  }}
                >
                  {label} ({fmt.count(count)})
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}

        {filteredCandidates.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty icon="🐔" title="گله‌ای یافت نشد" desc="فیلتر یا جستجو را تغییر دهید." />
        ) : (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
            {groupedCandidates.map(([year, items]) => (
              <div key={year} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--muted)', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)', paddingBottom: 4, marginBottom: 2 }}>
                  سال {fmt.code(year)}
                </div>
                {items.map((c) => {
              const isRef = c.id === effectiveBaselineId;
              const isSelected = selectedIds.includes(c.id);
              const isActiveFlock = getIsActive(c);

              if (mode === 'baseline') {
                return (
                  <button
                    key={c.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onSetReference(c.id)}
                    style={{
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'space-between',
                      gap: 8,
                      width: '100%',
                      padding: '10px',
                      background: isRef ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--card-solid)',
                      border: `1px solid ${isRef ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'}`,
                      borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      textAlign: 'right',
                      fontFamily: 'inherit',
                    }}
                  >
                    <div>
                      <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                        {getTitle(c)}
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 2 }}>
                        {isActiveFlock ? 'فعال' : 'آرشیو'} • {fmt.day(getDays(c))} روز
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <Tag tone={isRef ? 'info' : isActiveFlock ? 'green' : 'gray'}>
                      {isRef ? 'مرجع' : isActiveFlock ? 'فعال' : 'آرشیو'}
                    </Tag>
                  </button>
                );
              }

              return (
                <button
                  key={c.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleToggleInPicker(c.id)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    gap: 8,
                    width: '100%',
                    padding: '10px',
                    background: isSelected ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--card-solid)',
                    border: `1px solid ${isSelected ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'}`,
                    borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    textAlign: 'right',
                    fontFamily: 'inherit',
                  }}
                >
                  <div>
                    <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                      {getTitle(c)}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 2 }}>
                      {isActiveFlock ? 'فعال' : 'آرشیو'} • {fmt.day(getDays(c))} روز
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <Tag tone={isRef ? 'info' : isSelected ? 'green' : 'gray'}>
                    {isRef ? 'مرجع' : isSelected ? 'انتخاب‌شده' : 'انتخاب'}
                  </Tag>
                </button>
              );
                })}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/arc/comparisonHelpers.ts

/**
 * comparisonHelpers.ts — توابع کمکی و ثابت‌های مقایسه گله‌ها
 * (استخراج‌شده از FlockComparisonPanel.tsx — فاز رفکتور)
 */
import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { safeStorage } from '../../shr/utils/storage';
import { HELP } from '../../shr/help/helpTexts';
import type { ComparableFlockMetric } from '../../cor/storage/historyArchive';

export type CandidateFilter = 'all' | 'archived' | 'active';
export type PickerMode = 'compare' | 'baseline' | null;
export type BetterRule = 'higher' | 'lower';
export type TagTone =
  | 'blue' | 'gray' | 'green' | 'purple' | 'red' | 'warn'
  | 'info' | 'accent' | 'danger' | 'amber' | 'dim';

export interface ComparisonCandidate {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  metric: ComparableFlockMetric;
  isActive: boolean;
}

export interface MetricSpec {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  ruleText: string;
  better: BetterRule;
  unit: string;
  decimals: number;
}

export const MIN_FLOCKS = 2;
export const MAX_FLOCKS = 4;
export const ARCHIVE_FILTER_THRESHOLD = 5;

export const DEFAULT_COMPARISON_HELP =
  '**مقایسه گله‌ها (۲ تا ۴ گله):** یک گله را به عنوان **مرجع** (فعال یا آرشیو) انتخاب کنید و سایر گله‌ها را با آن بسنجید. ستون اول همیشه مرجع است و تکراری نمی‌آید.\n**امتیازدهی:** در هزینه، تلفات و ضریب تبدیل **کمتر بهتر** و در درآمد، زنده‌مانی و تخم **بیشتر بهتر** است. شاخص‌های ثبت‌نشده به پایین جدول منتقل می‌شوند.';

export const COMPARISON_HELP_TEXT =
  (HELP as unknown as { arc?: { comparison?: { overview?: string } } }).arc?.comparison?.overview ??
  DEFAULT_COMPARISON_HELP;

export const COMPARISON_METRICS: MetricSpec[] = [
  { key: 'epef', label: 'شاخص تولید', ruleText: 'بیشتر بهتر', better: 'higher', unit: '', decimals: 0 },
  { key: 'fcr', label: 'ضریب تبدیل', ruleText: 'کمتر بهتر', better: 'lower', unit: '', decimals: 2 },
  { key: 'livabilityPct', label: 'زنده‌مانی', ruleText: 'بیشتر بهتر', better: 'higher', unit: '٪', decimals: 1 },
  { key: 'brokenEggRatePct', label: 'تخم شکسته', ruleText: 'کمتر بهتر', better: 'lower', unit: '٪', decimals: 1 },
  { key: 'initialCost', label: 'هزینه اولیه', ruleText: 'کمتر بهتر', better: 'lower', unit: '', decimals: 0 },
  { key: 'recordedCost', label: 'هزینه تمام‌شده', ruleText: 'کمتر بهتر', better: 'lower', unit: '', decimals: 0 },
  { key: 'recordedRevenue', label: 'درآمد ثبت‌شده', ruleText: 'بیشتر بهتر', better: 'higher', unit: '', decimals: 0 },
  { key: 'totalMortality', label: 'کل تلفات', ruleText: 'کمتر بهتر', better: 'lower', unit: '', decimals: 0 },
  { key: 'totalFeedKg', label: 'کل دان', ruleText: 'کمتر بهتر', better: 'lower', unit: 'kg', decimals: 0 },
  { key: 'totalEggs', label: 'کل تخم', ruleText: 'بیشتر بهتر', better: 'higher', unit: '', decimals: 0 },
];

export function cleanCandidateTitle(rawLabel: string, fallbackName: string): string {
  const cleaned = rawLabel
    .replace(/\s*\[(?:فعال|آرشیو)\]\s*/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s*\((?:فعال|آرشیو)(?:\s*[•·-]\s*[^)]*)?\)\s*/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s*\(\d+\s*روز\)\s*/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
  return cleaned || fallbackName || rawLabel;
}

export function extractNumericMetric(metric: ComparableFlockMetric, key: string): number | null {
  const rec = metric as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
  const raw = rec[key];
  if (typeof raw === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(raw)) return raw;
  const fin = metric.financial as unknown as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  if (fin && typeof fin[key] === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(fin[key] as number)) {
    return fin[key] as number;
  }
  return null;
}

export function formatNumFa(val: number | null, decimals: number, unit: string): string {
  if (val === null || Number.isNaN(val)) return 'ثبت نشده';
  const formatted = getGlobalFormat().num(Number(val));
  return unit ? `${formatted} ${unit}` : formatted;
}

export function formatPctFa(pct: number): string {
  const sign = pct > 0 ? '+' : pct < 0 ? '-' : '';
  const formatted = getGlobalFormat().num(Math.abs(pct));
  return `${sign}${formatted}٪`;
}

export interface PeriodAlignmentInfo {
  durationDays: number | null;
  coveragePct: number | null;
  lowCoverage: boolean;
  isActive: boolean;
}

export function getPeriodAlignmentInfo(candidate: ComparisonCandidate): PeriodAlignmentInfo {
  const m = candidate.metric as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
  const rawDays =
    typeof m.durationDays === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(m.durationDays)
      ? m.durationDays
      : typeof m.ageDays === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(m.ageDays)
      ? m.ageDays
      : null;

  const rawCov =
    typeof m.logCoveragePct === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(m.logCoveragePct)
      ? m.logCoveragePct
      : null;

  return {
    durationDays: rawDays,
    coveragePct: rawCov,
    lowCoverage: rawCov !== null && rawCov < 80,
    isActive: candidate.isActive,
  };
}

import { createElement } from 'react';
import { useFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import type { Bird, Breed } from './store';
import { toFa } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { getKindInfo, getCategoryInfo } from './_display';
import { getBirdDisplayName, getBreedDisplayName } from './_display-name';
import { getBreedFcr, resolveStandard } from './_display-values';
import { getStandardFor } from '../set/standards/resolve';
import EntityLink from '../../shr/components/EntityLink';
import ExpandableCard from '../../shr/components/ExpandableCard';
import { Btn, Tag } from '../../shr/components/ui';
import { getBirdDeleteWarning } from './_deps';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../cor/store/dialog';
import { toastMsg } from '../../cor/store/toast';
import { logAction } from '../../cor/logger/auditLog';
import { CardActions } from '../../shr/components/ui';
import { ACTION_PRESETS } from '../../shr/constants/cardActions';
import StandardInfoBox from '../../shr/components/StandardInfoBox';

interface Props {
  bird: Bird;
  index: number;
  birdBreeds: Breed[];
  isOpen: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
  ms: any;
  customStandards: Record<string, any> | undefined;
  customOverrides?: Record<string, any>;
  onEdit: (b: Bird) => void;
  onDelete: (id: string, item: Bird) => void;
}

/** ردیف استاندارد نمایش label/value */
function StatRow({ label, value }: { label: React.ReactNode; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div style={{
      display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between',
      fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: 'var(--pad-tight)',
      background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
    }}>
      <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{label}:</span>
      <span style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{value}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function BirdCard({
  bird: b, index, birdBreeds, isOpen, onToggle, ms, customStandards, customOverrides, onEdit, onDelete,
}: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const kind = getKindInfo((b as any).birdKind);
  const stdKey = (b as any).standardKey;
  const stdData = (stdKey && resolveStandard(stdKey, customStandards, customOverrides))
    || getStandardFor(b.name, { customStandards: customStandards || {} })
    || null;
  const category = stdData?.category ? getCategoryInfo(stdData.category) : null;

  // 🆕 اگه پرنده خودش استاندارد نداره، از نژادهاش بگیر
  const breedStandards = birdBreeds
    .map(bd => {
      const k = (bd as any).standardKey;
      const std = k ? resolveStandard(k, customStandards, customOverrides) : null;
      return std ? { key: k, std, breedName: bd.name } : null;
    })
    .filter(Boolean) as Array<{ key: string; std: any; breedName: string }>;
  const hasAnyStandard = !!stdData || breedStandards.length > 0;
  // اگه پرنده استاندارد مستقیم نداره ولی نژاد داره، نمایش از نژاد
  const displayStd = stdData || (breedStandards[0]?.std || null);
  const displayLabel = stdData
    ? (stdData.nameFa || stdData.nameEn || stdKey)
    : breedStandards.length > 0
      ? `از نژاد: ${breedStandards.map(x => x.breedName).join('، ')}`
      : '';

  // 🆕 aggregate نژادها
  const aggregate = useMemo(() => {
    const total = birdBreeds.length;
    if (total === 0) return null;

    let nativeCount = 0;
    let industrialCount = 0;
    let fancyCount = 0;
    const purposesCount: Record<string, number> = {};
    let fcrMin: number | null = null;
    let fcrMax: number | null = null;

    for (const bd of birdBreeds) {
      const std = resolveStandard((bd as any).standardKey, customStandards, customOverrides);
      const cat = std?.category;
      if (cat === 'native') nativeCount++;
      else if (cat === 'fancy') fancyCount++;
      else industrialCount++;

      const ps: string[] = (bd as any).purposes || std?.purposes || [];
      for (const pr of ps) {
        if (pr === 'dual') continue;
        purposesCount[pr] = (purposesCount[pr] || 0) + 1;
      }

      const fcr = getBreedFcr(bd, customStandards, customOverrides);
      if (fcr != null) {
        if (fcrMin === null || fcr < fcrMin) fcrMin = fcr;
        if (fcrMax === null || fcr > fcrMax) fcrMax = fcr;
      }
    }

    return { total, nativeCount, industrialCount, fancyCount, purposesCount, fcrMin, fcrMax };
  }, [birdBreeds, customStandards, customOverrides]);

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    const warn = getBirdDeleteWarning([b.id]);
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync('تأیید حذف', `این پرنده حذف شود؟${warn}`, { danger: true });
    if (!ok) return;
    onDelete(b.id, b);
    logAction('delete', 'brd', 'حذف از پرنده و نژاد');
    toastMsg.deleted('پرنده');
  };

  return (
    <ExpandableCard
      id={b.id} ms={ms}
      accent="accent"
      index={fmt.count(index + 1)}
      iconEmoji={kind.emoji}
      title={getBirdDisplayName(b, customStandards)}
      subtitle=""
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onToggle={onToggle}
      badge={<Tag tone="blue">{fmt.count(birdBreeds.length)} نژاد</Tag>}
      stats={
        <>
                    {category && <span style={{
            padding: 'var(--pad-chip)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
            background: 'var(--accent-soft)', color: 'var(--accent)',
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', fontWeight: 700,
          }}>{category.emoji} {category.label}</span>}
        </>
      }
    >
      {aggregate && (
        <>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📊</span> خلاصه
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 4 }}>
            <StatRow label="🧬 کل نژاد" value={fmt.count(aggregate.total)} />
            {aggregate.nativeCount > 0 && (
              <StatRow label="🌾 بومی" value={fmt.count(aggregate.nativeCount)} />
            )}
            {aggregate.industrialCount > 0 && (
              <StatRow label="🏭 صنعتی" value={fmt.count(aggregate.industrialCount)} />
            )}
            {aggregate.fancyCount > 0 && (
              <StatRow label="🎨 تزئینی" value={fmt.count(aggregate.fancyCount)} />
            )}
            {aggregate.fcrMin != null && aggregate.fcrMax != null && (
              <StatRow
                label="📊 FCR"
                value={aggregate.fcrMin === aggregate.fcrMax
                  ? fmt.num(aggregate.fcrMin)
                  : `${fmt.num(aggregate.fcrMin)} - ${fmt.num(aggregate.fcrMax)}`}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {birdBreeds.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>🧬</span> نژادهای این پرنده
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 4 }}>
            {birdBreeds.map(bd => createElement(StatRow, {
              key: bd.id,
              label: createElement(EntityLink, { type: "breed", id: bd.id, label: getBreedDisplayName(bd, customStandards) }),
              value: bd.fcr ? `FCR ${fmt.num(bd.fcr)}` : "—"
            }))}
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {/* 📖 کادر استاندارد متصل */}
      {hasAnyStandard ? (
        <StandardInfoBox
          title={displayLabel}
          source={displayStd?.source}
          publishYear={displayStd?.publishYear}
          badge="متصل"
        />
      ) : null}

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, paddingTop: 4 }}>
        <CardActions actions={[
          { ...ACTION_PRESETS.EDIT, onClick: () => onEdit(b) },
          { ...ACTION_PRESETS.DELETE, onClick: handleDelete }
        ]} />
      </div>
    </ExpandableCard>
  );
}

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import type { Bird } from './store';
import BirdNameField, { type BirdPresetPick } from './BirdNameField';
import { Btn, BtnRow, Field, Modal, ErrorBox } from '../../shr/components/ui';
import { DEFAULT_STANDARDS } from '../set/standards/data';
import { resolveStandard } from './_display-values';
import { DEFAULT_SPECIES } from './species';
import { useSet } from '../set/store';

export interface BirdFormData {
  id?: string;
  name: string;
  standardKey?: string;
  birdKind?: string;
}

export const EMPTY_BIRD_FORM: BirdFormData = {
  name: '', standardKey: '',

interface Props {

  onClose: () => void;
  form: BirdFormData;

// ═══ کارت اطلاعات (2 ستونه) ═══
function StatBox({ icon, label, value }: { icon: string; label: string; value: string }) {

      padding: 'var(--pad-tight)',
      background: 'var(--input-bg)',
      borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',

          {label}
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function BirdForm({ open, onClose, form, setForm, error, showError, markTouched, birds, onSave, onErrorClear, openManageSignal }: Props) {
  const customSpecies = useSet((st: any) => st.customSpecies || []);
  const customStandards = useSet((st: any) => st.customStandards || {});
  const customOverrides = useSet((st: any) => st.customOverrides || {});

  // آمار runtime — بر اساس نام فعلی (نه birdKind قدیمی)
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const trimmed = form.name.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return null;

    // نام فعلی رو با species ها match کن
    const allSpecies = [...DEFAULT_SPECIES, ...customSpecies];
    const matched = allSpecies.find(
      (s: any) => s.nameFa.trim().toLowerCase() === trimmed.toLowerCase()
    );
    if (!matched) return null;

    const allKeys = [
      ...Object.keys(DEFAULT_STANDARDS),
      ...Object.keys(customStandards),
    ];
    const matching = allKeys
      .map(k => resolveStandard(k, customStandards, customOverrides))
      .filter((s) => s?.birdKind === matched.kind);

    if (matching.length === 0) return null;

    const native = matching.filter((s) => s.category === 'native').length;
    const industrial = matching.filter((s) => s.category === 'industrial').length;
    const fancy = matching.filter((s) => s.category === 'fancy').length;

    // بازه سن (cullDay)
    const culls = matching
      .map((s) => s.biology?.cullDay)
      .filter((c) => typeof c === 'number' && c > 0) as number[];

    const minAge = culls.length > 0 ? Math.min(...culls) : null;
    const maxAge = culls.length > 0 ? Math.max(...culls) : null;

    return {
      total: matching.length,
      native,
      industrial,
      fancy,
      minAge,
      maxAge,
    };
  }, [form.name, customSpecies]);

  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title={form.id ? 'ویرایش پرنده' : 'افزودن پرنده'} contentGap={14}
      footer={<BtnRow><Btn variant="primary" onClick={onSave}>ذخیره</Btn><Btn onClick={onClose}>لغو</Btn></BtnRow>}>
      <Field label="نام پرنده" required hint="انتخاب یا تایپ" error={showError?.('name')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('name')}>
        <BirdNameField
          value={form.name}
          onChange={v => {
            onErrorClear?.();
            setForm(f => ({ ...f, name: v }));
          }}
          onPick={(pick: BirdPresetPick) => {
            onErrorClear?.();
            setForm(f => ({
              ...f,
              name: pick.name,
              standardKey: pick.standardKey || f.standardKey,
              birdKind: pick.birdKind || f.birdKind,
            }));
          }}
          error={error || undefined}
          openManageSignal={openManageSignal}
        />
      </Field>

      {/* 🆕 کارت اطلاعات (پویا — فقط بعد از انتخاب پرنده) */}
      {stats && (
        <div style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
          <div style={{
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
            fontWeight: 700,
            color: 'var(--muted)',
            marginBottom: 6,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 4,
          }}>
            📊 اطلاعات {form.name}
          </div>
          <div style={{
            display: 'grid',
            gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr',
            gap: 6,
          }}>
            <StatBox icon="🧬" label="تعداد نژاد" value={`${stats.total} نژاد`} />
            <StatBox
              icon="⏱"
              label="بازه سن"
              value={
                stats.minAge != null
                  ? `${stats.minAge}–${stats.maxAge} روز`
                  : '—'
              }
            />
            <StatBox icon="🌾" label="بومی" value={`${stats.native} نژاد`} />
            <StatBox icon="🏭" label="صنعتی" value={`${stats.industrial} نژاد`} />
            {stats.fancy > 0 && (
              <StatBox icon="🎨" label="تزئینی" value={`${stats.fancy} نژاد`} />
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{
        fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
        color: 'var(--muted)',
        lineHeight: 1.7,
        padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
        background: 'var(--input-bg)',
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
        marginTop: 8,
      }}>
        💡 بعد از ذخیره، برو تب <b>نژادها</b> تا نژادهای این پرنده رو اضافه کنی.
      </div>
      <ErrorBox>{error}</ErrorBox>
    </Modal>
  );
}

/**
 * BirdNameField.tsx — انتخاب پرنده (گونه) با Bottom Sheet
 *
 * طبق FOUNDATION قانون ۱۶ (Master Data vs Operations):
 *   - Master: /set?tab=config (افزودن پرنده + نژاد)
 *   - Operations: /brd?tab=birds (فقط انتخاب)
 *
 * اگه پرنده نبود → پیام + دکمه به Master
 */
import { useMemo, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import AutocompleteSheet, { type AutoOption } from '../../shr/components/AutocompleteSheet';
import { Btn, BtnRow, Modal } from '../../shr/components/ui';
import { DEFAULT_SPECIES, type Species } from './species';
import { useSet } from '../set/store';
import { getMasterPath } from './data-ownership';

export interface BirdPresetPick {
  name: string;
  standardKey?: string;
  isCustom: boolean;
  birdKind?: string;
}

interface Props {
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  onPick: (pick: BirdPresetPick) => void;
  error?: string;
  openManageSignal?: number;
}

export default function BirdNameField({ value, onChange, onPick, error, openManageSignal }: Props) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const customSpecies = useSet((st: any) => st.customSpecies || []);
  const [notFound, setNotFound] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // signal از parent
  useEffect(() => {
    if (openManageSignal && openManageSignal > 0) {
      setNotFound(value || 'پرنده');
    }
  }, [openManageSignal, value]);

  const allSpecies: Species[] = useMemo(() => {
    return [...DEFAULT_SPECIES, ...customSpecies];
  }, [customSpecies]);

  const options: AutoOption[] = useMemo(() => {
    const opts: AutoOption[] = [];

    for (const sp of allSpecies) {
      opts.push({
        value: 'species:' + sp.kind,
        label: sp.nameFa,
        icon: sp.icon,
        group: sp.builtIn ? 'builtin' : 'custom',
        groupLabel: sp.builtIn ? 'پرنده‌های اصلی' : 'پرنده‌های سفارشی',
        groupIcon: sp.builtIn ? '🐔' : '⭐',
      });
    }

    return opts;
  }, [allSpecies]);

  const handleSelect = (opt: AutoOption) => {
    const kind = opt.value.replace('species:', '');
    const sp = allSpecies.find(s => s.kind === kind);
    if (!sp) return;

    onPick({
      name: sp.nameFa,
      standardKey: undefined,
      isCustom: !sp.builtIn,
      birdKind: sp.kind,
    });
  };

  const handleCustomText = (text: string) => {
    const trimmed = text.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return;

    // چک کن که قبلاً توی گونه‌ها هست یا نه
    const existing = allSpecies.find(
      s => s.nameFa.trim().toLowerCase() === trimmed.toLowerCase()
    );

    if (existing) {
      onPick({
        name: existing.nameFa,
        isCustom: !existing.builtIn,
        birdKind: existing.kind,
      });
      return;
    }

    // نیست → Master Data Modal
    setNotFound(trimmed);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Modal
        open={!!notFound}
        onClose={() => setNotFound(null)}
        title="پرنده پیدا نشد"
        footer={
          <BtnRow>
            <Btn variant="primary" onClick={() => {
              setNotFound(null);
              navigate(getMasterPath('species'));
            }}>رفتن به تنظیمات</Btn>
            <Btn onClick={() => setNotFound(null)}>بستن</Btn>
          </BtnRow>
        }
      >
        <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', lineHeight: 1.8, textAlign: 'center' }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '2em', marginBottom: 8 }}>⚠️</div>
          <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 8 }}>«{notFound}» توی استانداردها نیست</div>
          <div style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
            برای ساختنش برو تنظیمات → پیکربندی → استانداردها
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      <AutocompleteSheet
        value={value}
        onChange={onChange}
        onSelect={handleSelect}
        onSubmit={handleCustomText}
        hideCustom
        options={options}
        placeholder="مثلاً — مرغ یا بوقلمون"
        title="انتخاب پرنده"
        error={error}
        hideInternalError
      />
    </>
  );
}

import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';

import { useFocusParam } from '../../shr/hooks/useFocusParam';
import { useFormDraft } from '../../shr/hooks/useFormDraft';

import BirdForm, { EMPTY_BIRD_FORM, type BirdFormData } from './BirdForm';

import {
  Btn, Empty,
  PageContainer
} from '../../shr/components/ui';import { useMultiSelect } from '../../shr/multiSelect/useMultiSelect';
import MultiSelectBar from '../../shr/multiSelect/MultiSelectBar';
import { useFilterSort, FilterBar, getBrdBirdsConfig } from '../../shr/filter';
import HelpBanner from '../../shr/components/HelpBanner';
import { toFa } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import UndoBar from '../../cor/ui/UndoBar';
import { toastMsg } from '../../cor/store/toast';
import { getBirdDeleteWarning } from './_deps';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../cor/store/dialog';


export default function BirdsPage({ active = true }: { active?: boolean } = {}) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { birds: _birdsRaw, breeds, addBird, updateBird, deleteBird } = useBrd();
  const customStandards = useSet((st: any) => st.customStandards);
  const customOverrides = useSet((st: any) => st.customOverrides || {});
  const customSpecies = useSet((st: any) => st.customSpecies || []);
  const { redirect: masterRedirect, MasterRedirectModal } = useMasterRedirect();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<BirdFormData>(EMPTY_BIRD_FORM);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const { errors: vErrors } = useValidation(
    BirdSchema,
    { name: form.name || '', standardKey: form.standardKey || undefined, birdKind: form.birdKind || undefined },
  );
  const { showError, markTouched, attemptSave, reset: resetErrors } = useFormErrors(vErrors);
  const [openManageSignal, setOpenManageSignal] = useState(0);
  const [undoData, setUndoData] = useState<{ item: any } | null>(null);
  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const draft = useFormDraft('brd-bird', form, (v: any) => setForm(v));
  useFocusParam();

  // فیلتر تکرارها تو render
  const birds = useMemo(() => {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    return _birdsRaw.filter(b => {
      const k = (b.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (seen.has(k)) return false;
      seen.add(k);
      return true;
    });
  }, [_birdsRaw]);

  // ─── گروه‌بندی نژادها بر اساس birdId (رفع N+1) ───
  const breedsByBird = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, typeof breeds>();
    for (const bd of breeds) {
      const arr = map.get(bd.birdId) || [];
      arr.push(bd);
      map.set(bd.birdId, arr);
    }
    return map;
  }, [breeds]);

  // ─── فیلتر/مرتب (از config مرکزی) ───
  const config = useMemo(() => getBrdBirdsConfig({ breeds }), [breeds]);
  const { filtered: list, filters, setFilter, clearFilter, sort, setSort, toggleSort,
          resetAll, hasActiveFilters, total, count } = useFilterSort<Bird>({
    items: birds,
    filters: config.filterDefs,
    sorts: config.sortDefs,
    persistKey: config.persistKey,
    initialSort: config.initialSort,
  });

  // ─── Multi-Select ───
  const ms = useMultiSelect({
    items: list,
    getId: (b: any) => b.id,
    onDelete: async (ids: string[]) => {
      const warn = getBirdDeleteWarning(ids);
      const ok = await showConfirmAsync('حذف گروهی', fmt.count(ids.length) + ' پرنده حذف شوند؟' + warn, { danger: true });
      if (!ok) return;
      const backups: any[] = [];
      for (const id of ids) {
        const item = birds.find(b => b.id === id);
        if (!item) continue;
        backups.push(item);
        deleteBird(id);
      }
      if (backups.length > 0) {
        const removedBreeds = breeds.filter(br => ids.includes(br.birdId));
        setUndoData({ item: backups, breeds: removedBreeds } as any);
        setTimeout(() => setUndoData((cur: any) => cur && Array.isArray(cur.item) && cur.item.length === backups.length ? null : cur), 6000);
      }
      toastMsg.deletedBulk(backups.length, 'پرنده')
    },
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (ms.selectionMode) setExpandedId(null);
  }, [ms.selectionMode]);


  const openNew = () => { if (!draft.hasDraft) setForm(EMPTY_BIRD_FORM); setError(''); resetErrors(); setOpen(true);  };
  const openEdit = (b: Bird) => {
    setForm({ id: b.id, name: b.name, standardKey: (b as any).standardKey || '', birdKind: (b as any).birdKind });
    
    setError(''); setOpen(true);
  };
  useFab(active && birds.length > 0 ? { label: 'افزودن پرنده', onClick: openNew } : null);
  const save = () => {
    attemptSave();
    if (!form.name.trim()) return;

    // 🔒 جلوگیری قاطع از نام تکراری پرنده
    if (!form.id) {
      const _trimmed = form.name.trim();
      const _dup = birds.find((x) => x.name.trim() === _trimmed);
      if (_dup) {
        setError(`نام «${_dup.name}» تکراریه — یا ویرایشش کن یا اسم دیگه بذار`);
        return;
      }
    }

    // 🆕 lookup species — همیشه بر اساس نام فعلی
    const trimmed = form.name.trim();
    const allSpecies = [...DEFAULT_SPECIES, ...customSpecies];

    // آیا نام فعلی با species قبلی match می‌کنه؟
    const currentKindSpecies = form.birdKind
      ? allSpecies.find((s) => s.kind === form.birdKind)
      : null;
    const nameMatchesCurrentKind = currentKindSpecies &&
      currentKindSpecies.nameFa.trim().toLowerCase() === trimmed.toLowerCase();

    let birdKind: string;
    if (nameMatchesCurrentKind) {
      // نام و birdKind هر دو درستن → قبول
      birdKind = form.birdKind!;
    } else {
      // نام عوض شده — از نو lookup کن
      const existing = allSpecies.find(
        (s: any) => s.nameFa.trim().toLowerCase() === trimmed.toLowerCase()
      );

      if (!existing) {
        setOpenManageSignal(Date.now());
        return;
      }
      birdKind = existing.kind;
    }

    // اعتبارسنجی با Zod
    const result = BirdSchema.safeParse({
      ...form,
      birdKind,
    });
    if (!result.success) {
      return;   // inline errors shown by useFormErrors
    }
    const payload = result.data as any;
    if (form.id) updateBird(form.id, payload); else addBird(payload);
    draft.clear();
    setForm(EMPTY_BIRD_FORM);
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const undoDelete = () => {
    const item = undoData;
    if (!item) return;
    try {
      const arr = Array.isArray(item.item) ? item.item : [item.item];
      const brArr = Array.isArray((item as any).breeds) ? (item as any).breeds : [];
      useBrd.setState((st) => ({
        birds: [...st.birds, ...arr.filter((b: any) => !st.birds.some(x => x.id === b.id))],
        breeds: [...st.breeds, ...brArr.filter((br: any) => !st.breeds.some(x => x.id === br.id))],
      }));
      toastMsg.restored('پرنده')
    } catch (err) {
      toastMsg.error('بازگردانی ناموفق')
    }
    setUndoData(null);
  };

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      <MasterRedirectModal />
      {undoData && (
        <UndoBar
          label="حذف شد"
          onUndo={undoDelete}
          onDismiss={() => setUndoData(null)}
        />
      )}

      <HelpBanner
        id="brd-birds-intro"
        icon="🐔"
        title="پرنده‌ها"
        description="پرنده‌های اصلی (مرغ، بوقلمون، اردک، بلدرچین، غاز و...) را اینجا تعریف کنید."
        tone="info"
      />
      <FilterBar
        filterDefs={config.filterDefs}
        sortDefs={config.sortDefs}
        filterState={filters}
        sortState={sort}
        setFilter={setFilter}
        clearFilter={clearFilter}
        setSort={setSort}
        toggleSort={toggleSort}
        resetAll={resetAll}
        hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
        total={total}
        count={count}
      />

      {!ms.selectionMode && list.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--dim)', textAlign: 'center', paddingBottom: 2 }}>
          برای انتخاب چندتایی، روی یک کارت نگه دارید
        </div>
      )}

      {ms.selectionMode && list.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 6 }}>
          <button type="button"
            aria-label={ms.selectedIds.size === list.length ? 'لغو انتخاب همه' : 'انتخاب همه'}
            onClick={ms.selectedIds.size === list.length ? ms.clearSelection : ms.selectAll}
            style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-btn-sm)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
            {ms.selectedIds.size === list.length ? 'لغو انتخاب همه' : 'انتخاب همه'}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {list.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty
          icon={<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round"><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/><path d="M3 21v-2a4 4 0 0 1 4-4h4a4 4 0 0 1 4 4v2"/></svg>}
          title="هنوز پرنده‌ای اضافه نکرده‌اید"
          desc="اولین پرنده‌ی خود را بسازید — مثلاً «مرغ». بعد از آن می‌توانید نژادهایش را اضافه کنید."
          action={<Btn variant="primary" onClick={openNew}>+ افزودن پرنده</Btn>}
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          {list.map((b, i) => {
            const birdBreeds = breedsByBird.get(b.id) || [];
            const isOpen = !ms.selectionMode && expandedId === b.id;
            return (
              <BirdCard
                key={b.id}
                bird={b}
                index={i}
                birdBreeds={birdBreeds}
                isOpen={isOpen}
                onToggle={() => setExpandedId(isOpen ? null : b.id)}
                ms={ms}
                customStandards={customStandards}
                customOverrides={customOverrides}
                onEdit={openEdit}
                onDelete={(id, item) => {
                  const removedBreeds = breeds.filter(br => br.birdId === id);
                  setUndoData({ item, breeds: removedBreeds } as any);
                  setTimeout(() => setUndoData((cur: any) => cur && cur.item?.id === item.id ? null : cur), 6000);
                  deleteBird(id);
                }}
              />
            );
          })}
          
        </>
      )}

      <MultiSelectBar ms={ms} deleteLabel="حذف" />

      {ms.selectionMode && <div style={{ height: 90 }} />}

      <BirdForm
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        form={form}
        setForm={setForm}
        error={error}
        onErrorClear={() => setError('')}
        openManageSignal={openManageSignal}
        birds={birds}
        onSave={save}
        showError={showError}
        markTouched={markTouched}
      />
    </PageContainer>
  );
}
