import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { collectEvents, type EventType, type CalEvent } from './store';
import MonthView from './MonthView';
import DayView from './DayView';
import AddEventModal from './AddEventModal';
import { toFa } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { useFab } from '../../shr/hooks/useFab';

const FILTERS: { id: EventType | 'all'; label: string; icon: string }[] = [
  { id: 'all', label: 'همه', icon: '📋' },
  { id: 'hatch', label: 'جوجه‌کشی', icon: '🐣' },
  { id: 'vaccine', label: 'واکسن', icon: '💉' },
  { id: 'herbal', label: 'گیاهی', icon: '🌿' },
  { id: 'payment', label: 'مالی', icon: '💰' },
  { id: 'daily', label: 'روزانه', icon: '📋' }
];

export default function Cal() {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<EventType | 'all'>('all');
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [addOpen, setAddOpen] = useState(false);
  useFab({ label: 'رویداد جدید', onClick: () => setAddOpen(true) });
  const [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] = useState(0);

  // جمع‌آوری رویدادها — هر بار با refreshKey از نو
  const events = useMemo<CalEvent[]>(() => {
    try {
      return collectEvents();
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [refreshKey]);

  const handleAddClose = () => {
    setAddOpen(false);
    setRefreshKey(k => k + 1);
  };

  // اگر روز انتخاب شد، DayView نشان بده
  if (selectedDate) {
    return (
      <>
        <DayView
          date={selectedDate}
          events={events}
          onBack={() => setSelectedDate(null)}
          onChanged={() => setRefreshKey(k => k + 1)}
        />
        <AddEventModal
          open={addOpen}
          onClose={handleAddClose}
          prefillDate={selectedDate}
        />
      </>
    );
  }

  // شمارش هر نوع برای فیلتر
  const counts: Record<string, number> = { all: events.length };
  events.forEach(e => {
    counts[e.type] = (counts[e.type] || 0) + 1;
  });

  return (
    <div>
      {/* فیلترها */}
      <div style={{
        display: 'flex',
        gap: 6,
        padding: '12px',
        overflowX: 'auto',
        scrollbarWidth: 'none',
        background: 'var(--header-bg)',
        borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
        position: 'sticky',
        top: 52,
        zIndex: 11
      }}>
        {FILTERS.map(f => {
          const count = counts[f.id] || 0;
          const active = filter === f.id;
          return (
            <button
              key={f.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilter(f.id)}
              style={{
                padding: '7px 12px',
                fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                background: active ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--btn-bg)',
                border: '1px solid ' + (active ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'),
                borderRadius: 8,
                color: active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
                fontWeight: active ? 700 : 500,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                fontFamily: 'inherit',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 5,
                whiteSpace: 'nowrap'
              }}
            >
              <span>{f.icon}</span>
              <span>{f.label}</span>
              {count > 0 ? (
                <span style={{
                  fontSize: 12,
                  background: active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--input-bg)',
                  color: active ? 'var(--avatar-text)' : 'var(--dim)',
                  padding: '1px 5px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  minWidth: 16,
                  textAlign: 'center'
                }}>{getGlobalFormat().count(count)}</span>
              ) : null}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* نمای ماه */}
      <MonthView
        events={events}
        onDayClick={(d) => setSelectedDate(d)}
        filter={filter}
      />

      {/* FAB */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setAddOpen(true)}
        style={fabStyle}
      >
        <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round">
          <path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14" />
        </svg>
      </button>

      <AddEventModal
        open={addOpen}
        onClose={handleAddClose}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

const fabStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  position: 'fixed',
  bottom: 90,
  left: 16,
  width: 52,
  height: 52,
  borderRadius: 16,
  background: 'var(--accent)',
  color: 'var(--avatar-text)',
  border: 'none',
  cursor: 'pointer',
  display: 'flex',
  alignItems: 'center',
  justifyContent: 'center',
  boxShadow: 'var(--shadow)',
  zIndex: 30
};

FILE: ./src/mod/cal/manual.ts

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { persist } from 'zustand/middleware';
import { v4 as uuid } from 'uuid';
import type { EventType } from './store';

export interface ManualEvent {
  id: string;
  date: string;      // 1405/07/15
  time: string;      // 08:30 یا خالی
  title: string;
  notes: string;
  type: EventType;
  done: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
}

interface State {
  events: ManualEvent[];
  add: (e: Omit<ManualEvent, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'done'>) => void;
  update: (id: string, patch: Partial<ManualEvent>) => void;
  remove: (id: string) => void;
  toggleDone: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useManual = create<State>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      events: [],
      add: (e) => set({
        events: [...get().events, {
          ...e,
          id: uuid(),
          done: false,
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
        }]
      }),
      update: (id, patch) => set({
        events: get().events.map(x => x.id === id ? { ...x, ...patch } : x)
      }),
      remove: (id) => set({
        events: get().events.filter(x => x.id !== id)
      }),
      toggleDone: (id) => set({
        events: get().events.map(x => x.id === id ? { ...x, done: !x.done } : x)
      })
    }),
    { name: 'pm-cal-manual' }
  )
);

export const TYPE_OPTIONS: { id: EventType; label: string; icon: string }[] = [
  { id: 'daily', label: 'کار روزانه', icon: '📋' },
  { id: 'vaccine', label: 'واکسن / دارو', icon: '💉' },

  { id: 'payment', label: 'مالی', icon: '💰' },
  { id: 'finance', label: 'یادآور', icon: '🔔' }
];

FILE: ./src/mod/cal/store.ts

import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { useInc, daysToHatch } from '../inc/store';
import { useDlg } from '../dlg/store';
import { useTra, remaining } from '../tra/store';
import { useWhs, daysToExpiry } from '../whs/store';
import { useBrd } from '../brd/store';
import { useFlk, getEffectiveStartDate } from '../flk/store';
import { getSchedule } from './vaccineSchedules';
import { useSet } from '../set/store';
import { toEn } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { format, parse, differenceInDays, format as formatJ, startOfDay, addDays} from 'date-fns-jalali';

export type EventType = 'hatch' | 'vaccine' | 'herbal' | 'payment' | 'daily' | 'finance';
export type EventStatus = 'past' | 'today' | 'future' | 'overdue';

export interface CalEvent {
  id: string;
  date: string;       // 1405/07/15
  type: EventType;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  status: EventStatus;
  icon: string;
  refId: string;
}

/** تاریخ امروز شمسی */
import { todayJalali as _tj } from '../../shr/date/jalali';
export const todayJalali = _tj;

/** تبدیل شمسی به Date */
export function jalaliToDate(s: string): Date | null {
  if (s === '' || s == null) return null;
  try {
    const d = parse(toEn(s), 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
  } catch { return null; }
}

/** تاریخ شمسی → ISO برای مقایسه */
export function jalaliToKey(s: string): string {
  if (s === '' || s == null) return '';
  const p = toEn(s).split('/');
  if (p.length !== 3) return '';
  return p[0] + String(p[1]).padStart(2, '0') + String(p[2]).padStart(2, '0');
}

/** اختلاف روز از امروز */
export function daysFromToday(s: string): number {
  const d = jalaliToDate(s);
  if (d === null) return 999;
  return differenceInDays(startOfDay(d), startOfDay(new Date()));
}

/** تعیین وضعیت */
export function statusOf(date: string): EventStatus {
  const diff = daysFromToday(date);
  if (diff < 0) return 'past';
  if (diff === 0) return 'today';
  if (diff <= 30) return 'future';
  return 'future';
}


/** اضافه n روز به تاریخ شمسی */
function addDaysJalali(dateStr: string, days: number): string {
  const d = jalaliToDate(dateStr);
  if (!d) return '';
  return format(addDays(d, days), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
}

/** جمع‌آوری همه‌ی رویدادها از همه‌ی storeها */
export function collectEvents(): CalEvent[] {
  const events: CalEvent[] = [];
  const today = todayJalali();

  // ============ ۱. جوجه‌کشی ============
  try {
    const eggEntries = useInc.getState().eggEntries || [];
    const birds = useBrd.getState().birds || [];

    eggEntries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.status === 'done' || entry.status === 'hatched') return;

      const bird = birds.find((b: any) => b.id === entry.birdId);
      const birdName = bird ? bird.name : '—';
      const days = daysToHatch(entry.expectedHatchDate);

      // هچ نهایی
      if (days >= 0) {
        events.push({
          id: 'hatch-' + entry.id,
          date: entry.expectedHatchDate,
          type: 'hatch',
          title: 'هچ ' + birdName,
          subtitle: (entry.count || 0) + ' تخم — ' + days + ' روز مانده',
          status: days === 0 ? 'today' : (days < 0 ? 'past' : 'future'),
          icon: '🐣',
          refId: entry.id
        });
      }

      // پنجره‌ی هچ (۲ روز قبل)
      if (days <= 2 && days >= 0) {
        const wd = new Date();
        wd.setDate(wd.getDate() + (days - 2));
        const wdStr = formatJ(wd, 'yyyy/MM/dd');
        events.push({
          id: 'hatchwin-' + entry.id,
          date: wdStr,
          type: 'hatch',
          title: '🐣 پنجره‌ی هچ',
          subtitle: (entry.count || 0) + ' تخم',
          status: 'today',
          icon: '🐣',
          refId: entry.id
        });
      }

      // Lock-down (روز ۱۸)
      const age = daysToHatch(entry.entryDate) * -1;
      if (age === 18) {
        events.push({
          id: 'lock-' + entry.id,
          date: today,
          type: 'hatch',
          title: '🔒 Lock-down',
          subtitle: (entry.count || 0) + ' تخم — چرخش قطع',
          status: 'today',
          icon: '🔒',
          refId: entry.id
        });
      }
    });
  } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }

  // ============ ۲. واکسن و دارو ============
  const vaccineEnabled = (useSet.getState() as any).features?.vaccine !== false;
  if (vaccineEnabled) try {
    const logs = useDlg.getState().logs || [];
    logs.forEach((log: any) => {
      const vaccines = log.vaccines || [];
      vaccines.forEach((v: any, i: number) => {
        if (v.name) {
          events.push({
            id: 'vac-' + log.id + '-' + i,
            date: log.date,
            type: 'vaccine',
            title: '💉 ' + v.name,
            subtitle: (v.dose || '') + ' — ' + (v.method || ''),
            status: statusOf(log.date),
            icon: '💉',
            refId: log.id
          });
        }
      });
    });

    // واکسن‌های انبار نزدیک انقضا
    const whsItems = useWhs.getState().items || [];
    whsItems.forEach((item: any) => {
      if ((item.category === 'vaccine' || item.category === 'medicine') && item.expireDate) {
        const days = daysToExpiry(item.expireDate);
        if (days !== null && days >= 0) {
          events.push({
            id: 'vac-exp-' + item.id,
            date: item.expireDate,
            type: 'vaccine',
            title: '⏰ انقضای ' + item.name,
            subtitle: days + ' روز مانده',
            status: days <= 30 ? 'today' : 'future',
            icon: '⏰',
            refId: item.id
          });
        }
      }
    });
  } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }

  // ============ ۲.۵ واکسن‌های گله (برنامه واکسن) ============
  if (vaccineEnabled) try {
    const flocks = useFlk.getState().flocks || [];
    flocks.forEach((f: any) => {
      if (f.status !== 'active') return;
      if (!f.vaccineScheduleId) return;
      const sch = getSchedule(f.vaccineScheduleId);
      if (!sch) return;
      const startDate = getEffectiveStartDate(f);
      if (!startDate) return;
      const startD = jalaliToDate(startDate);
      if (!startD) return;

      sch.items.forEach((item, i) => {
        const targetD = addDays(startD, item.day);
        const targetStr = formatJ(targetD, 'yyyy/MM/dd');
        const daysLeft = daysFromToday(targetStr);
        events.push({
          id: 'vac-sched-' + f.id + '-' + i,
          date: targetStr,
          type: 'vaccine',
          title: '💉 ' + item.name,
          subtitle: f.name + ' — ' + item.method + (daysLeft >= 0 ? ' • ' + daysLeft + ' روز مانده' : ' • گذشته'),
          status: daysLeft === 0 ? 'today' : (daysLeft < 0 ? 'past' : 'future'),
          icon: '💉',
          refId: f.id,
        });
      });
    });
  } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }

  // ============ ۳. مالی — سرسید ============
  try {
    const invoices = useTra.getState().invoices || [];
    invoices.forEach((inv: any) => {
      const rem = remaining(inv);
      if (rem > 0) {
        // سرسید
        if (inv.dueDate) {
          events.push({
            id: 'due-' + inv.id,
            date: inv.dueDate,
            type: 'payment',
            title: inv.type === 'sale' ? '📥 دریافت از مشتری' : '📤 پرداخت به فروشنده',
            subtitle: getGlobalFormat().money(rem) + ' — فاکتور ' + (inv.number || '—'),
            status: daysFromToday(inv.dueDate) < 0 ? 'overdue' : statusOf(inv.dueDate),
            icon: '💰',
            refId: inv.id
          });
        }

        // چک‌ها
        const payments = inv.payments || [];
        payments.forEach((p: any) => {
          if (p.method === 'check' && p.dueDate) {
            events.push({
              id: 'check-' + inv.id + '-' + p.id,
              date: p.dueDate,
              type: 'payment',
              title: '🏦 سرسید چک',
              subtitle: getGlobalFormat().money(p.amount) + (p.bank ? ' — ' + p.bank : ''),
              status: daysFromToday(p.dueDate) < 0 ? 'overdue' : statusOf(p.dueDate),
              icon: '🏦',
              refId: inv.id
            });
          }
        });
      }
    });
  } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }

  // ============ ۴. کار روزانه — پیش‌فرض ============
  // اگر ثبت روزانه امروز انجام نشده، یادآور
  try {
    const logs = useDlg.getState().logs || [];
    const hasToday = logs.some((l: any) => l.date === today);
    if (!hasToday) {
      events.push({
        id: 'daily-' + today,
        date: today,
        type: 'daily',
        title: '📋 ثبت روزانه امروز',
        subtitle: 'ثبت نشده — یادآور',
        status: 'today',
        icon: '📋',
        refId: today
      });
    }
  } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }

  // ============ ۵. رویدادهای دستی کاربر ============
  try {
    const manualRaw = localStorage.getItem('pm-cal-manual');
    if (manualRaw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(manualRaw);
      const manual = (parsed.state && parsed.state.events) || [];
      manual.forEach((m: any) => {
        if (m.done) return; // انجام‌شده‌ها را نشان نده

        events.push({
          id: 'manual-' + m.id,
          date: m.date,
          type: m.type || 'daily',
          title: m.title,
          subtitle: (m.time ? '⏰ ' + m.time + ' — ' : '') + (m.notes || 'رویداد دستی'),
          status: statusOf(m.date),
          icon: '📌',
          refId: m.id
        });
      });
    }
  } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }

  // مرتب‌سازی بر اساس تاریخ
  events.sort((a, b) => jalaliToKey(a.date).localeCompare(jalaliToKey(b.date)));


  // ============ ۵. واکسن‌های قالب گله ============
  try {
    const flocks = useFlk.getState().flocks || [];
    flocks.forEach((flock: any) => {
      if (flock.status !== 'active') return;
      if (!flock.vaccineScheduleId) return;

      const schedule = getSchedule(flock.vaccineScheduleId);
      if (!schedule) return;

      const startDate = getEffectiveStartDate(flock);
      if (!startDate) return;

      schedule.items.forEach((item, idx) => {
        const date = addDaysJalali(startDate, item.day);
        if (!date) return;
        const diff = daysFromToday(date);
        // فقط رویدادهای آینده یا ۱۴ روز گذشته
        if (diff < -14) return;

        events.push({
          id: 'vac-sched-' + flock.id + '-' + idx,
          date,
          type: 'vaccine',
          title: '💉 ' + item.name,
          subtitle: flock.name + ' — روز ' + item.day + ' • ' + item.method,
          status: diff < 0 ? 'past' : diff === 0 ? 'today' : 'future',
          icon: '💉',
          refId: flock.id,
        });
      });
    });
  } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }

  // ============ ۶. مصرف دارو گیاهی (از ثبت روزانه) ============
  try {
    const whsItems = useWhs.getState().items || [];
    const herbalNames = new Set(
      whsItems
        .filter((it: any) => it.category === 'herbal')
        .map((it: any) => it.name)
    );

    if (herbalNames.size > 0) {
      const logs = useDlg.getState().logs || [];
      logs.forEach((log: any) => {
        const meds = log.medications || [];
        meds.forEach((m: any, i: number) => {
          if (!m.name) return;
          if (!herbalNames.has(m.name)) return;
          events.push({
            id: 'herbal-log-' + log.id + '-' + i,
            date: log.date,
            type: 'herbal',
            title: '🌿 ' + m.name,
            subtitle: (m.dose || '') + (m.method ? ' — ' + m.method : ''),
            status: statusOf(log.date),
            icon: '🌿',
            refId: log.id,
          });
        });
      });
    }
  } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }

  return events;
}

/** رویدادهای یک روز خاص */
export function eventsOfDay(all: CalEvent[], date: string): CalEvent[] {
  const key = jalaliToKey(date);
  return all.filter(e => jalaliToKey(e.date) === key);
}

import { useAutoCenterTab } from '../../shr/hooks/useAutoCenterTab';
/**
 * ContactsPage — مخاطبین (carousel tabs مثل hal)
 */
import { useFormat, getGlobalFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useCtc, type Person, type Role, type Gender, type BankAccount, CUSTOMER_TYPES } from './store';
import { useCarousel } from '../../shr/hooks/useCarousel';
import { useFocusParam } from '../../shr/hooks/useFocusParam';
import { toFa, toEn } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../cor/store/dialog';
import ContactFormModal from './components/ContactFormModal';
import ContactTabPanel from './components/ContactTabPanel';
import HelpBanner from '../../shr/components/HelpBanner';

interface F {
  id?: string; name: string; phone: string; phone2: string; email: string;
  address: string; city: string; nationalId: string; roles: Role[]; notes: string;
  customerType: string;
  customerTypes: string[]; trustScore: string; defaultDiscount: string;
  supplierTypes: string[]; position: string; startDate: string; salaryType: string; salaryAmount: string; insurance: boolean;
  creditLimit?: number | null;
  gender?: Gender;
  bankAccount?: BankAccount;
}

const empty: F = {
  name: '', phone: '', phone2: '', email: '', address: '', city: '', nationalId: '', roles: ['customer'], notes: '',
  customerType: 'wholesale', customerTypes: [], trustScore: '', defaultDiscount: '', supplierTypes: [],
  position: '', startDate: '', salaryType: 'monthly', salaryAmount: '', insurance: false,
  creditLimit: null,
  gender: 'unspecified',
  bankAccount: {},
};

type TabId = 'all' | 'customer' | 'supplier' | 'worker';

export default function ContactsPage() {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { contacts, add, update } = useCtc();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<TabId>('all');
  useFocusParam();
  const tabsBarRef = useAutoCenterTab(tab);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<F>(empty);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');

  const openNew = () => { setForm(empty); setErr(''); setOpen(true); };

  const openEdit = (p: Person) => {
    setForm({
      creditLimit: p.creditLimit ?? null,
      id: p.id, name: p.name, phone: p.phone, phone2: p.phone2, email: p.email,
      address: p.address, city: p.city, nationalId: p.nationalId, roles: p.roles, notes: p.notes,
      customerType: p.customerType || 'wholesale',
      customerTypes: p.customerTypes || (p.customerType ? [p.customerType] : []),
      trustScore: p.trustScore ? getGlobalFormat().code(p.trustScore) : '',
      defaultDiscount: p.defaultDiscount ? getGlobalFormat().code(p.defaultDiscount) : '',
      supplierTypes: p.supplierTypes || [],
      position: p.position, startDate: p.startDate,
      salaryType: p.salaryType || 'monthly',
      salaryAmount: p.salaryAmount ? getGlobalFormat().code(p.salaryAmount) : '',
      insurance: p.insurance,
      gender: p.gender || 'unspecified',
      bankAccount: p.bankAccount || {},
    });
    setErr(''); setOpen(true);
  };

  const num = (s: string) => s ? parseFloat(toEn(s).replace('٫', '.')) || null : null;

  const save = async () => {
    if (!form.name.trim()) { setErr('نام را وارد کنید'); return; }
    if (form.roles.length === 0) { setErr('حداقل یک نقش انتخاب کنید'); return; }

    if (!form.id) {
      const trimmedName = form.name.trim();
      const trimmedPhone = form.phone.trim();
      const nameDup = contacts.find(c => c.name.trim() === trimmedName);
      const phoneDup = trimmedPhone ? contacts.find(c => c.phone.trim() === trimmedPhone) : null;

      if (nameDup && phoneDup && nameDup.id === phoneDup.id) {
        const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
          `شخصی با همین نام و شماره تلفن قبلاً ثبت شده («${nameDup.name}»). باز هم اضافه شود؟`,
          '⚠️ تکرار کامل',
        );
        if (!ok) return;
      } else if (nameDup) {
        const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
          `شخصی با نام «${nameDup.name}» قبلاً ثبت شده. باز هم اضافه شود؟`,
          '⚠️ نام تکراری',
        );
        if (!ok) return;
      } else if (phoneDup) {
        const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
          `شخصی با این شماره تلفن قبلاً ثبت شده («${phoneDup.name}»). باز هم اضافه شود؟`,
          '⚠️ تلفن تکراری',
        );
        if (!ok) return;
      }
    }

    const data: Omit<Person, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'> = {
      name: form.name.trim(), phone: form.phone.trim(), phone2: form.phone2.trim(), email: form.email.trim(),
      address: form.address.trim(), city: form.city.trim(), nationalId: form.nationalId.trim(),
      roles: form.roles, notes: form.notes.trim(), customerType: form.customerTypes[0] || '',
      customerTypes: form.customerTypes,
      trustScore: form.trustScore ? parseInt(toEn(form.trustScore)) || null : null,
      defaultDiscount: num(form.defaultDiscount), supplierTypes: form.supplierTypes,
      position: form.position.trim(), startDate: form.startDate.trim(), salaryType: form.salaryType,
      salaryAmount: num(form.salaryAmount), insurance: form.insurance,
      creditLimit: form.creditLimit ?? null,
      gender: form.gender || 'unspecified',
      bankAccount: (() => {
        const bk = form.bankAccount;
        if (!bk) return undefined;
        if (!bk.bank && !bk.accountHolder && !bk.accountNumber && !bk.cardNumber && !bk.shaba) return undefined;
        const result: BankAccount = {
          bank: bk.bank,
          accountHolder: bk.accountHolder?.trim() || undefined,
          accountNumber: bk.accountNumber || undefined,
          cardNumber: bk.cardNumber || undefined,
          shaba: bk.shaba || undefined,
        };
        return result;
      })(),
    };
    if (form.id) update(form.id, data); else add(data);
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const tabIds: TabId[] = ['all', 'customer', 'supplier', 'worker'];
  const { containerRef, trackRef, setInstant } = useCarousel(
    tabIds,
    tab,
    (id) => setTab(id as TabId),
  );

  const tabCount = (t: TabId) => t === 'all' ? contacts.length : contacts.filter(c => c.roles.includes(t as Role)).length;

  const tabs: { id: TabId; label: string }[] = [
    { id: 'all', label: 'همه' },
    { id: 'customer', label: 'مشتریان' },
    { id: 'supplier', label: 'فروشندگان' },
    { id: 'worker', label: 'کارگران' },
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Tab Bar */}
      <div ref={tabsBarRef} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 0, borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
        padding: '0 12px', background: 'var(--header-bg)', position: 'sticky',
        top: 52, zIndex: 11, overflowX: 'auto', scrollbarWidth: 'none',
      }}>
        {tabs.map(t => (
          <div
            key={t.id}
            data-tab-id={t.id}
            onClick={() => { setInstant(); setTab(t.id); }}
            style={{
              padding: '11px 12px',
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)',
              fontWeight: 600,
              color: tab === t.id ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              position: 'relative',
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 5,
            }}
          >
            {t.label}
            <span style={{
              fontSize: 12,
              background: tab === t.id ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--input-bg)',
              color: tab === t.id ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
              padding: '1px 5px',
              borderRadius: 8,
              fontWeight: 700,
            }}>{fmt.count(tabCount(t.id))}</span>
            {tab === t.id && (
              <div style={{
                position: 'absolute', bottom: 0,
                right: 12, left: 12, height: 3,
                background: 'var(--accent)',
                borderRadius: '3px 3px 0 0',
              }} />
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Carousel */}
      <div
        ref={containerRef}
        style={{
          overflow: 'hidden',
          overflowX: 'hidden',
          width: '100%',
          isolation: 'isolate',
          touchAction: 'pan-y',
        }}
      >
        <div
          ref={trackRef}
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            direction: 'ltr',
            willChange: 'transform',
            touchAction: 'pan-y',
            width: '100%',
            minWidth: 0,
          }}
        >
          {tabIds.map(id => (
            <div
              key={id}
              style={{
                flex: '0 0 100%',
                width: '100%',
                minWidth: 0,
                maxWidth: '100%',
                direction: 'rtl',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                boxSizing: 'border-box',
                isolation: 'isolate',
              }}
            >
              <ContactTabPanel
                tab={id}
                active={tab === id}
                onEdit={openEdit}
                onAdd={openNew}
              />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <ContactFormModal
        open={open}
        setOpen={setOpen}
        form={form}
        setForm={setForm}
        err={err}
        onSave={save}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * ContactFormModal — فرم افزودن/ویرایش مخاطب
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { Btn, BtnRow, DigitField, Field, Grid2, Input, Modal, PhoneField, Select, Textarea, ErrorBox } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import SmartSelect from '../../../shr/components/SmartSelect';
import { ROLE_LABEL, CUSTOMER_TYPES, BANKS_BY_GROUP, BANKS, isBankCode, findBankByShabaCode, findBankByCardBin, type Role, type Gender, type BankAccount , useCtc} from '../store';
import { toEn , toFa} from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { cardValidation, shabaValidation, accountValidation } from '../validators';

const GENDER_OPTIONS: { value: Gender; label: string; icon: string }[] = [
  { value: 'unspecified', label: 'بی‌طرف', icon: '—' },
  { value: 'male', label: 'مرد', icon: '♂️' },
  { value: 'female', label: 'زن', icon: '♀️' },
];

interface F {
  id?: string; name: string; phone: string; phone2: string; email: string;
  address: string; city: string; nationalId: string; roles: Role[]; notes: string;
  customerType: string; customerTypes: string[]; trustScore: string; defaultDiscount: string;
  supplierTypes: string[]; position: string; startDate: string; salaryType: string; salaryAmount: string; insurance: boolean;

  creditLimit?: number | null;
  gender?: Gender;
  bankAccount?: BankAccount;
}

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (v: boolean) => void;
  form: F;
  setForm: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<F>>;
  err: string;
  onSave: () => void;
}

export default function ContactFormModal({ open, setOpen, form, setForm, err, onSave }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { contacts } = useCtc();
  const toggleRole = (r: Role) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, roles: f.roles.includes(r) ? f.roles.filter(x => x !== r) : [...f.roles, r] }));

  return (
      <Modal open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title={form.id ? 'ویرایش مخاطب' : 'افزودن مخاطب'}
          footer={<BtnRow><Btn variant="primary" onClick={onSave}>ذخیره</Btn><Btn onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>لغو</Btn></BtnRow>}>
          <Field label="نقش‌ها" required hint="یک شخص می‌تواند چند نقش داشته باشد">
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              {(['customer', 'supplier', 'worker'] as Role[]).map(r => (
                <button key={r} onClick={() => toggleRole(r)} style={{
                  padding: '6px 12px', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                  background: form.roles.includes(r) ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--btn-bg)',
                  border: `1px solid ${form.roles.includes(r) ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'}`,
                  borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', color: form.roles.includes(r) ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
                  fontWeight: form.roles.includes(r) ? 600 : 500, cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit'
                }}>{ROLE_LABEL[r]}</button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </Field>

          {form.roles.includes('customer') && (
            <Field label="نوع مشتری" hint="می‌تواند چند مورد باشد">
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                {CUSTOMER_TYPES.map(([v, l]) => (
                  <button key={v} type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setForm(f => ({
                        ...f,
                        customerTypes: f.customerTypes.includes(v)
                          ? f.customerTypes.filter(x => x !== v)
                          : [...f.customerTypes, v]
                      }));
                    }}
                    style={{
                      padding: '6px 12px', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                      background: form.customerTypes.includes(v) ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--btn-bg)',
                      border: `1px solid ${form.customerTypes.includes(v) ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'}`,
                      borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                      color: form.customerTypes.includes(v) ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
                      fontWeight: form.customerTypes.includes(v) ? 600 : 500,
                      cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit'
                    }}>
                    {l}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </Field>
          )}
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="نام" required><Input placeholder="..." value={form.name} onChange={e => setForm({...form, name: e.target.value})} /></Field>
            <Field label="تلفن"><PhoneField placeholder="۰۹..." value={form.phone} onChange={e => setForm({...form, phone: e.target.value})} /></Field>
            {(form.roles || []).includes('customer') && (
              <Field label="سقف اعتبار (تومان)" hint="خالی = بدون سقف">
                <Input
                  mode="number"
                  placeholder="مثلاً ۵۰٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰"
                  value={form.creditLimit != null && form.creditLimit > 0 ? String(form.creditLimit) : ''}
                  onChange={e => {
                    // 🆕 حذف همه کاراکترهای غیرعددی (شامل ٬ U+066C که formatNumWhileTyping اضافه می‌کند)
                    const cleaned = String(e.target.value).replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d))).replace(/[^\d]/g, '');
                    const v = parseInt(cleaned, 10) || 0;
                    setForm({ ...form, creditLimit: v > 0 ? v : null });
                  }}
                  unit="تومان"
                />
              
                {form.id && (() => {
                  const _c = contacts.find(c => c.id === form.id);
                  const _debt = Math.max(0, -(_c?.creditBalance || 0));
                  const _credit = Math.max(0, (_c?.creditBalance || 0));
                  const _limit = form.creditLimit || 0;
                  if (_debt === 0 && _credit === 0 && _limit === 0) return null;
                  return (
                    <div style={{ marginTop: 6, fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                      {_debt > 0 && (
                        <span>📊 بدهی فعلی: <b style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>{fmt.money(_debt)}</b></span>
                      )}
                      {_credit > 0 && (
                        <span>⚡ پیش‌پرداخت: <b style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }}>{fmt.money(_credit)}</b></span>
                      )}
                      {_limit > 0 && (
                        <span>✅ فضای باقی‌مانده: <b style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }}>{fmt.money(Math.max(0, _limit - _debt))}</b></span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })()}</Field>
            )}
          </Grid2>
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="کد ملی"><DigitField maxLength={10} placeholder="..." value={form.nationalId} onChange={e => setForm({...form, nationalId: e.target.value})} /></Field>
            <Field label="آدرس"><Input placeholder="..." value={form.address} onChange={e => setForm({...form, address: e.target.value})} /></Field>
          </Grid2>

          <Field label="جنسیت" hint="برای پیام‌های محترمانه (یادآوری، صورت‌حساب)">
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              {GENDER_OPTIONS.map(opt => {
                const active = (form.gender || 'unspecified') === opt.value;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={opt.value}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setForm({ ...form, gender: opt.value })}
                    style={{
                      padding: '6px 12px', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                      background: active ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--btn-bg)',
                      border: `1px solid ${active ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'}`,
                      borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                      color: active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
                      fontWeight: active ? 600 : 500,
                      cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit',
                    }}
                  >
                    {opt.icon} {opt.label}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </Field>

          <div style={{ paddingTop: 8, marginTop: 4, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)', letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>🏦 اطلاعات بانکی (اختیاری)</div>

          <Grid2>
            <Field label="بانک" hint={(() => {
              const card = form.bankAccount?.cardNumber || '';
              if (card.length < 4) return undefined;
              const det = findBankByCardBin(card);
              const current = form.bankAccount?.bank;

              if (det.bank) {
                const bank = BANKS.find(b => b.key === det.bank);
                if (current && current !== det.bank) {
                  const selected = BANKS.find(b => b.key === current);
                  return `انتخاب شما: ${selected?.label || current}`;
                }
                return `✓ تشخیص از کارت: ${bank?.label || det.bank}`;
              }
              if (det.possibleBanks && det.possibleBanks.length > 0) {
                const names = det.possibleBanks.map(b => BANKS.find(x => x.key === b)?.shortLabel || b).join(' / ');
                return `ممکن: ${names}`;
              }
              return undefined;
            })()}>
              <SmartSelect
                value={form.bankAccount?.bank || ''}
                onChange={v => {
                  if (v === '') {
                    setForm(f => ({ ...f, bankAccount: { ...f.bankAccount, bank: undefined } }));
                  } else if (isBankCode(v)) {
                    setForm(f => ({ ...f, bankAccount: { ...f.bankAccount, bank: v } }));
                  }
                }}
                options={[
                  ...BANKS_BY_GROUP.gov.map(b => ({
                    value: b.key,
                    label: b.label,
                    subtitle: `کد شبا: ${b.code}`,
                    group: 'gov',
                  })),
                  ...BANKS_BY_GROUP.private.map(b => ({
                    value: b.key,
                    label: b.label,
                    subtitle: `کد شبا: ${b.code}`,
                    group: 'private',
                  })),
                  ...BANKS_BY_GROUP.other.map(b => ({
                    value: b.key,
                    label: b.label,
                    group: 'other',
                  })),
                ]}
                groupLabels={{ gov: 'دولتی', private: 'خصوصی', other: 'سایر' }}
                groupIcons={{ gov: '🏛', private: '🏦', other: '📋' }}
                placeholder="— انتخاب بانک —"
                modalTitle="انتخاب بانک"
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label="نام صاحب حساب" hint="اگر با نام مخاطب فرق دارد">
              <Input
                placeholder="..."
                value={form.bankAccount?.accountHolder || ''}
                onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, bankAccount: { ...f.bankAccount, accountHolder: e.target.value } }))}
              />
            </Field>
          </Grid2>

          <Grid2>
            <Field label="شماره حساب" hint={(() => {
              const v = accountValidation(form.bankAccount?.accountNumber || '');
              if (v.state === 'invalid') return v.message;
              if (v.state === 'partial') return v.message;
              return undefined;
            })()}>
              <Input
                dir="ltr"
                inputMode="tel"
                maxLength={20}
                placeholder="۱۰-۲۰ رقم"
                value={form.bankAccount?.accountNumber || ''}
                onChange={e => {
                  const v = toEn(e.target.value).replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 20);
                  setForm(f => ({ ...f, bankAccount: { ...f.bankAccount, accountNumber: v } }));
                }}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label="شماره کارت" hint={(() => {
              const card = form.bankAccount?.cardNumber || '';
              const v = cardValidation(card);
              if (v.state === 'invalid') return v.message;
              if (v.state === 'partial') return v.message;
              if (v.state === 'valid') return '✓ شماره کارت معتبر است';
              return '۱۶ رقم';
            })()}>
              <Input
                dir="ltr"
                inputMode="tel"
                maxLength={16}
                placeholder="۶۰۳۷..."
                value={form.bankAccount?.cardNumber || ''}
                onChange={e => {
                  const v = toEn(e.target.value).replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 16);
                  const det = findBankByCardBin(v);
                  setForm(f => ({
                    ...f,
                    bankAccount: {
                      ...f.bankAccount,
                      cardNumber: v,
                      bank: det.bank || f.bankAccount?.bank,
                    },
                  }));
                }}
              />
            </Field>
          </Grid2>

          <Field
            label="شماره شبا"
            hint={(() => {
              const v = shabaValidation(form.bankAccount?.shaba || '');
              if (v.state === 'invalid') return v.message;
              if (v.state === 'partial') return v.message;
              if (v.state === 'valid') return '✓ شماره شبا معتبر است (MOD-97)';
              return 'IR + ۲۴ رقم — با ورود، بانک خودکار تشخیص داده می‌شود';
            })()}
          >
            <Input
              dir="ltr"
              maxLength={26}
              placeholder="IR..."
              value={form.bankAccount?.shaba || ''}
              onChange={e => {
                const raw = toEn(e.target.value).toUpperCase();
                const v = raw.replace(/[^IR0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 26);
                const digits = v.replace(/\D/g, '');
                let detectedBank = form.bankAccount?.bank;
                if (digits.length >= 5) {
                  const bankCode = digits.slice(2, 5);
                  const found = findBankByShabaCode(bankCode);
                  if (found) detectedBank = found.key;
                }
                setForm(f => ({ ...f, bankAccount: { ...f.bankAccount, shaba: v, bank: detectedBank } }));
              }}
            />
          </Field>

          <Field label="یادداشت">
            <Textarea placeholder="..." value={form.notes} onChange={e => setForm({...form, notes: e.target.value})} />
          </Field>
          <ErrorBox>{err}</ErrorBox>
        </Modal>
  );
}

 * ContactTabPanel — محتوای یک تب از مخاطبین (carousel)

import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useFab } from '../../../shr/hooks/useFab';
import { useCtc, type Person, type Role, ROLE_LABEL, CUSTOMER_TYPES, SUPPLIER_TYPES, SALARY_TYPES, avatarLetter } from '../store';
import { Btn, Empty, PageContainer, Tag } from '../../../shr/components/ui';

import { Row } from '../helpers';

type TabId = 'all' | 'customer' | 'supplier' | 'worker';

interface Props {
  tab: TabId;
  active: boolean;
  onEdit: (p: Person) => void;
  onAdd: () => void;

function CopyBtn({ text }: { text: string }) {
  if (!text) return null;
  return (
    <button type="button"
      onClick={async (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const ok = await copyText(text);
        if (ok) toastMsg.success('کپی شد');
        else toastMsg.error('کپی نشد');
      }}
      title="کپی"
      aria-label="کپی"
      style={{ background: 'transparent', border: 'none', color: 'var(--muted)', cursor: 'pointer', padding: '4px', fontFamily: 'inherit', display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center' }}
    >
      <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">
        <rect x="9" y="9" width="13" height="13" rx="2" ry="2" />
        <path d="M5 15H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v1" />
      </svg>
    </button>
  );
}

function ShareBtn({ title, text }: { title: string; text: string }) {
  if (!text) return null;
  return (
    <button type="button"
      onClick={async (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const result = await shareText({ title, text });
        if (result.status === 'shared') toastMsg.success('ارسال شد');
        else if (result.status === 'copied') toastMsg.info('کپی شد — در اپ دیگر paste کنید');
        else if (result.status === 'failed') toastMsg.error('اشتراک ناموفق');
      }}
      title="اشتراک"
      aria-label="اشتراک"
      style={{ background: 'transparent', border: 'none', color: 'var(--muted)', cursor: 'pointer', padding: '4px', fontFamily: 'inherit', display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center' }}
    >
      <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
        <path d="M18 16.08c-.76 0-1.44.3-1.96.77L8.91 12.7c.05-.23.09-.46.09-.7s-.04-.47-.09-.7l7.05-4.11c.54.5 1.25.81 2.04.81 1.66 0 3-1.34 3-3s-1.34-3-3-3-3 1.34-3 3c0 .24.04.47.09.7L8.04 9.81C7.5 9.31 6.79 9 6 9c-1.66 0-3 1.34-3 3s1.34 3 3 3c.79 0 1.5-.31 2.04-.81l7.12 4.16c-.05.21-.08.43-.08.65 0 1.61 1.31 2.92 2.92 2.92s2.92-1.31 2.92-2.92-1.31-2.92-2.92-2.92z"/>
      </svg>
    </button>
  );
}

export default function ContactTabPanel({ tab, active, onEdit, onAdd }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { contacts, add, remove } = useCtc();
  const [undoData, setUndoData] = useState<{ item: Person | Person[] } | null>(null);
  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<string | null>(null);


  // مرحله ۱: tab
  const tabFiltered = useMemo(() => {
    if (tab === 'all') return contacts;
    return contacts.filter(c => c.roles.includes(tab as Role));
  }, [contacts, tab]);

  useFab(active && tabFiltered.length > 0 ? { label: 'افزودن مخاطب', onClick: onAdd } : null);

  // مرحله ۲: FilterBar
  const config = useMemo(() => getCtcContactsConfig(), []);
  const { filtered: list, filters, setFilter, clearFilter, sort, setSort, toggleSort,
          resetAll, hasActiveFilters, total, count } = useFilterSort<Person>({
    items: tabFiltered,
    filters: config.filterDefs,
    sorts: config.sortDefs,
    persistKey: config.persistKey,
    initialSort: config.initialSort,
  });

  const ms = useMultiSelect({
    items: list,
    getId: (p: Person) => p.id,
    onDelete: async (ids) => {
      const ok = await showConfirmAsync('حذف گروهی', fmt.count(ids.length) + ' مخاطب حذف شوند؟', { danger: true });
      if (!ok) return;
      const backups: Person[] = [];
      for (const id of ids) {
        const item = contacts.find(c => c.id === id);
        if (!item) continue;
        backups.push(item);
        try { remove(id); } catch { /* silent */ }
      }
      if (backups.length > 0) {
        setUndoData({ item: backups });
        setTimeout(() => setUndoData((cur) => cur && Array.isArray(cur.item) && cur.item.length === backups.length ? null : cur), 8000);
      }
      toastMsg.deletedBulk(backups.length, 'مخاطب');
    },
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (ms.selectionMode) setExpandedId(null);
  }, [ms.selectionMode]);

  const undoDelete = () => {
    const item = undoData;
    if (!item) return;
    try {
      const arr = Array.isArray(item.item) ? item.item : [item.item];
      arr.forEach(p => add(p));
      toastMsg.restoredBulk(arr.length, 'مخاطب');
    } catch {
      toastMsg.error('بازگردانی ناموفق');
    }
    setUndoData(null);
  };

  if (!active) return null;

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      <HelpBanner
        id="ctc-intro"
        icon="👥"
        title="مخاطبین"
        description="مشتریان، تأمین‌کنندگان و کارگران را اینجا ثبت کنید. هر مخاطب می‌تواند نقش‌های مختلف داشته باشد."
        tone="info"
      />
      {undoData && (
        <UndoBar label="مخاطب حذف شد" onUndo={undoDelete} onDismiss={() => setUndoData(null)} />
      )}

      <FilterBar
        filterDefs={config.filterDefs}
        sortDefs={config.sortDefs}
        filterState={filters}
        sortState={sort}
        setFilter={setFilter}
        clearFilter={clearFilter}
        setSort={setSort}
        toggleSort={toggleSort}
        resetAll={resetAll}
        hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
        total={total}
        count={count}
      />

      {!ms.selectionMode && list.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: 'var(--dim)', textAlign: 'center', paddingBottom: 2 }}>
          برای انتخاب چندتایی، روی یک کارت نگه دارید
        </div>
      )}

      {ms.selectionMode && list.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 6 }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={ms.selectedIds.size === list.length ? ms.clearSelection : ms.selectAll}
            style={{
              padding: '4px 10px',
              background: 'var(--input-bg)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border)',
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
              color: 'var(--muted)',
              fontFamily: 'inherit',
              fontSize: '10px',
              fontWeight: 600,
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            {ms.selectedIds.size === list.length ? 'لغو انتخاب همه' : 'انتخاب همه'}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {list.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty
          icon={<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><polygon points="22 3 2 3 10 12.46 10 19 14 21 14 12.46 22 3" /></svg>}
          title={hasActiveFilters ? 'نتیجه‌ای پیدا نشد' : 'هنوز مخاطبی ثبت نشده'}
          desc={hasActiveFilters ? 'فیلترها را تغییر دهید یا پاک کنید.' : 'اولین مخاطب خود را بسازید.'}
          action={!hasActiveFilters ? <Btn variant="primary" onClick={onAdd}>+ افزودن مخاطب</Btn> : undefined}
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          {list.map((p, i) => {
            const primaryRole: Role = p.roles.includes('supplier') ? 'supplier' : p.roles.includes('worker') ? 'worker' : 'customer';
            const accent = primaryRole === 'worker' ? 'purple' : primaryRole === 'supplier' ? 'accent' : 'info';
            const isOpen = !ms.selectionMode && expandedId === p.id;
            return (
              <ExpandableCard
                key={p.id}
                id={p.id}
                ms={ms}
                accent={accent as 'accent' | 'info' | 'purple'}
                index={fmt.count(i + 1)}
                iconEmoji={avatarLetter(p.name)}
                title={p.name}

                    ))}
                  </div>
                }
                stats={<>
                  {p.roles.includes('customer') && p.trustScore ? <span>اعتبار: <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.num(p.trustScore)}/۱۰</b></span> : null}
                  {p.roles.includes('worker') && p.position ? <span>سمت: <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{p.position}</b></span> : null}

import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { BANKS, ROLE_LABEL, type Person, type Role } from './store';
import { toFa } from '../../shr/utils/fa';

function group4(digits: string): string {
  return digits.replace(/(.{4})/g, '$1 ').trim();
}

export function formatPhone(p: string): string {
  return p ? getGlobalFormat().code(p) : '';
}

export function formatCard(c: string): string {
  if (!c) return '';
  return getGlobalFormat().code(group4(c));
}

export function formatShaba(s: string): string {
  if (!s) return '';
  const withIR = s.startsWith('IR') ? s : `IR${s}`;
  return group4(withIR);
}

export function formatContactSection(p: Person): string {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  if (p.phone) lines.push(`📞 تلفن: ${formatPhone(p.phone)}`);
  if (p.phone2) lines.push(`📞 تلفن دوم: ${formatPhone(p.phone2)}`);
  if (p.email) lines.push(`📧 ایمیل: ${p.email}`);
  return lines.join('\n');
}

export function formatAddressSection(p: Person): string {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  if (p.city) lines.push(`📍 شهر: ${p.city}`);
  if (p.address) lines.push(`📍 آدرس: ${p.address}`);
  return lines.join('\n');
}

export function formatBankSection(p: Person): string {
  const bk = p.bankAccount;
  if (!bk) return '';
  const lines: string[] = [];
  if (bk.bank) {
    const bank = BANKS.find(b => b.key === bk.bank);
    lines.push(`🏦 بانک: ${bank?.label || bk.bank}`);
  }
  if (bk.accountHolder) lines.push(`👤 صاحب حساب: ${bk.accountHolder}`);
  if (bk.cardNumber) lines.push(`💳 کارت: ${formatCard(bk.cardNumber)}`);
  if (bk.accountNumber) lines.push(`🔢 حساب: ${getGlobalFormat().code(bk.accountNumber)}`);
  if (bk.shaba) lines.push(`🔗 شبا: ${formatShaba(bk.shaba)}`);
  return lines.join('\n');
}

export function formatNationalId(p: Person): string {
  return p.nationalId ? `🆔 کد ملی: ${getGlobalFormat().code(p.nationalId)}` : '';
}

export function formatNotes(p: Person): string {
  return p.notes ? `📝 ${p.notes}` : '';
}

export function formatFullContact(p: Person): string {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  const prefix = p.gender === 'male' ? 'جناب آقای' : p.gender === 'female' ? 'سرکار خانم' : '';
  lines.push(`👤 ${prefix} ${p.name}`.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim());
  lines.push('────────────────');

  const contact = formatContactSection(p);
  if (contact) lines.push(contact);

  const addr = formatAddressSection(p);
  if (addr) lines.push(addr);

  const nid = formatNationalId(p);
  if (nid) lines.push(nid);

  const bank = formatBankSection(p);
  if (bank) {
    lines.push('────────────────');
    lines.push(bank);
  }

  if (p.roles.length > 0) {
    lines.push('────────────────');
    lines.push(`🎭 ${p.roles.map(r => ROLE_LABEL[r as Role] || r).join('، ')}`);
  }

  const notes = formatNotes(p);
  if (notes) {
    lines.push('────────────────');
    lines.push(notes);
  }

  return lines.join('\n');
}

/** جدول BIN → BankCode (برای lookup سریع) */
const BIN_MAP: Record<string, BankCode> = (() => {
  const map: Record<string, BankCode> = {};
  for (const [bank, bins] of Object.entries(CARD_BINS)) {
    if (bins) for (const bin of bins) map[bin] = bank as BankCode;
  }
  return map;
})();

/** پیشوندهای ۴ رقمی → بانک‌های ممکن (برای hint وقتی ۶ رقم ناقصه) */
const PREFIX4_MAP: Record<string, BankCode[]> = (() => {
  const map: Record<string, BankCode[]> = {};
  for (const [bin, bank] of Object.entries(BIN_MAP)) {
    const p4 = bin.slice(0, 4);
    if (!map[p4]) map[p4] = [];
    if (!map[p4].includes(bank)) map[p4].push(bank);
  }
  return map;
})();

export interface CardDetectionResult {
  /** بانک تشخیص‌داده‌شده (فقط وقتی ۶ رقم کامل و یکتا) */
  bank?: BankCode;
  /** پیشوند فعلی */
  prefix: string;
  /** اگر ۴-۵ رقم داشت و مبهم بود، لیست بانک‌های ممکن */
  possibleBanks?: BankCode[];
}

export function findBankByCardBin(cardNumber: string): CardDetectionResult {
  const digits = toEn(cardNumber || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  const prefix = digits.slice(0, 6);
  if (digits.length < 4) return { prefix };
  if (digits.length >= 6) {
    const bank = BIN_MAP[prefix];
    if (bank) return { bank, prefix };
    return { prefix };
  }
  // ۴ یا ۵ رقم — ambiguous
  const p4 = digits.slice(0, 4);
  const possible = PREFIX4_MAP[p4];
  if (possible && possible.length > 0) {
    return { prefix: digits, possibleBanks: possible };
  }
  return { prefix: digits };
}

export function isGender(v: string): v is Gender {
  return v === 'male' || v === 'female' || v === 'unspecified';
}

export function isBankCode(v: string): v is BankCode {
  return BANKS.some(b => b.key === v);
}

export function findBankByShabaCode(code: string): BankInfo | undefined {
  return BANKS.find(b => b.code !== '' && b.code === code);
}

interface State {
  contacts: Person[];
  add: (c: Omit<Person, 'id'|'createdAt'|'updatedAt'>) => void;
  update: (id: string, patch: Partial<Person>) => void;
  remove: (id: string) => void;

  /** 🆕 وضعیت لود داده‌ها از IndexedDB */
  isLoading: boolean;
}

const now = () => new Date().toISOString();

export const useCtc = create<State>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      isLoading: true,
      contacts: [],
      add: (c) => set({ contacts: [...get().contacts, {...c, id: uuid(), createdAt: now(), updatedAt: now()}] }),
      update: (id, patch) => set({ contacts: get().contacts.map(x => x.id === id ? {...x, ...patch, updatedAt: now()} : x) }),
      remove: (id) => {
        // 🆕 guard: چک استفاده در گله‌ها (شریک، امانت‌دهنده، موجر)
        const flkState = useFlk.getState();
        const linked = flkState.flocks.filter((f: any) =>
          f.dealData?.partnerId === id ||
          f.dealData?.consignorId === id ||
          f.dealData?.lessorId === id
        );
        if (linked.length > 0) {
          showToast('این مخاطب ' + linked.length + ' گله دارد — ابتدا گله را ویرایش کنید', 'error');
          return;
        }
        set({ contacts: get().contacts.filter(x => x.id !== id) });
      }
    }),
    {
      name: 'pm-ctc',
      storage: createJSONStorage(() => zustandHybridStorage),
      partialize: (state) => {
        const { isLoading, ...rest } = state;
        return rest as any;
      },
      onRehydrateStorage: () => {
        return (state, error) => {
          if (error) {
            console.error('[ctc] Hydration failed:', error);
          }
          useCtc.setState({ isLoading: false });
        };
      },      version: 2,
      migrate: (persisted: any, version: number) => {
        if (version < 2 && persisted?.people) {
          persisted.people = persisted.people.map((p: any) => ({
            ...p,
            customerTypes: p.customerTypes || (p.customerType ? [p.customerType] : []),
          }));
        }
        return persisted;
      }
    }
  )
);

/**
 * validators.ts — اعتبارسنجی شماره کارت، شبا، حساب
 *
 * الگوریتم‌ها:
 * - شماره کارت: Luhn (ISO/IEC 7812) — همه کارت‌های شتاب این رو رعایت می‌کنن
 * - شبا: MOD-97-10 (ISO 13616) — IBAN ایران
 * - شماره حساب: فقط طول (۱۰-۲۰) — الگوریتم ریاضی نداره
 */
import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { toFa, toEn } from '../../shr/utils/fa';

export type ValidationState = 'empty' | 'partial' | 'invalid' | 'valid';
export interface ValidationResult {
  state: ValidationState;
  message?: string;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
// Luhn (ISO/IEC 7812) — شماره کارت
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
export function isValidCardNumber(card: string): boolean {
  const digits = toEn(card).replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (digits.length !== 16) return false;
  let sum = 0;
  let double = false;
  for (let i = digits.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    let d = parseInt(digits[i], 10);
    if (double) {
      d *= 2;
      if (d > 9) d -= 9;
    }
    sum += d;
    double = !double;
  }
  return sum % 10 === 0;
}

export function cardValidation(card: string): ValidationResult {
  const digits = toEn(card || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (digits.length === 0) return { state: 'empty' };
  if (digits.length < 16) return { state: 'partial', message: `${getGlobalFormat().count(digits.length)}/۱۶ رقم` };
  if (digits.length === 16) {
    if (isValidCardNumber(digits)) return { state: 'valid' };
    return { state: 'invalid', message: 'شماره کارت معتبر نیست (Luhn)' };
  }
  return { state: 'invalid', message: 'شماره کارت باید ۱۶ رقم باشد' };
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
// MOD-97-10 (ISO 13616) — شبا
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
export function isValidShaba(shaba: string): boolean {
  const clean = toEn(shaba || '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').toUpperCase();
  if (!clean.startsWith('IR')) return false;
  if (clean.length !== 26) return false;
  const rearranged = clean.slice(4) + clean.slice(0, 4);
  let numeric = '';
  for (const ch of rearranged) {
    const code = ch.charCodeAt(0);
    if (code >= 65 && code <= 90) numeric += String(code - 55);
    else numeric += ch;
  }
  let remainder = 0;
  for (const ch of numeric) {
    remainder = (remainder * 10 + parseInt(ch, 10)) % 97;
  }
  return remainder === 1;
}

export function shabaValidation(shaba: string): ValidationResult {
  const clean = toEn(shaba || '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').toUpperCase();
  if (clean.length === 0) return { state: 'empty' };
  if (!clean.startsWith('IR')) return { state: 'invalid', message: 'شبا باید با IR شروع شود' };
  if (clean.length < 26) return { state: 'partial', message: `${getGlobalFormat().count(clean.length)}/۲۶ کاراکتر` };
  if (clean.length === 26) {
    if (isValidShaba(clean)) return { state: 'valid' };
    return { state: 'invalid', message: 'شماره شبا معتبر نیست (MOD-97)' };
  }
  return { state: 'invalid', message: 'شماره شبا باید ۲۶ کاراکتر باشد' };
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
// شماره حساب — فقط طول
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
export function isValidAccountNumber(account: string): boolean {
  const digits = toEn(account || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  return digits.length >= 10 && digits.length <= 20;
}

export function accountValidation(account: string): ValidationResult {
  const digits = toEn(account || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (digits.length === 0) return { state: 'empty' };
  if (digits.length < 10) return { state: 'partial', message: `${getGlobalFormat().count(digits.length)}/۱۰ رقم` };
  if (digits.length <= 20) return { state: 'valid' };
  return { state: 'invalid', message: 'شماره حساب حداکثر ۲۰ رقم است' };
}

  const totalActiveLogs = logs.filter(l => (l.status || 'active') === 'active').length;
  const tabs: { id: TabId; label: string }[] = [
    { id: 'today', label: 'امروز' },
    { id: 'history', label: 'تاریخچه' },
    ...(archivedLogs.length > 0 ? [{ id: 'archive' as TabId, label: 'آرشیو' }] : []),
    { id: 'aggregate', label: 'جمع‌بندی' },
  ];

  // اگه در تب آرشیو بودیم و خالی شد، برگرد به «امروز»
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab === 'archive' && archivedLogs.length === 0) setTab('today');
  }, [tab, archivedLogs.length]);

  return (
    <div>
      <Tabs
        tabs={tabs}
        activeTab={tab}
        onTabChange={(id: TabId) => { setInstant(); setTab(id); }}
      />

      {/* Carousel */}
      <div
        ref={containerRef}
        style={{
          overflow: 'hidden', overflowX: 'hidden', width: '100%',
          isolation: 'isolate', touchAction: 'pan-y',
        }}
      >
        <div
          ref={trackRef}
          style={{
            display: 'flex', direction: 'ltr',
            touchAction: 'pan-y', width: '100%', minWidth: 0,
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ flex: '0 0 100%', width: '100%', minWidth: 0, maxWidth: '100%', direction: 'rtl', overflow: 'hidden', boxSizing: 'border-box', isolation: 'isolate' }}>
            <DlgTabPanel
              tab="today"
              active={tab === 'today'}
              logs={todaysLogs}
              flocks={flocks}
              birds={birds}
              config={config}
              activeFlocks={activeFlocks}
              onApplyCorrection={applyCorrectionAtomic}
              onRevokeCorrection={revokeCorrectionAtomic}
              vaccineEnabled={vaccineEnabled}
              medicineEnabled={medicineEnabled}
              onEdit={openEdit}
              onAdd={openNew}
              onDeleteLog={handleDeleteLog}
              onRestoreLogFull={restoreLogFull}
            />
          </div>
          <div style={{ flex: '0 0 100%', width: '100%', minWidth: 0, maxWidth: '100%', direction: 'rtl', overflow: 'hidden', boxSizing: 'border-box', isolation: 'isolate' }}>
            <DlgTabPanel
              tab="history"
              active={tab === 'history'}
              logs={historicalLogs}
              flocks={flocks}
              birds={birds}
              config={config}
              activeFlocks={activeFlocks}
              onApplyCorrection={applyCorrectionAtomic}
              onRevokeCorrection={revokeCorrectionAtomic}
              vaccineEnabled={vaccineEnabled}
              medicineEnabled={medicineEnabled}
              onEdit={openEdit}
              onAdd={openNew}
              onDeleteLog={handleDeleteLog}
              onRestoreLogFull={restoreLogFull}
            />
          </div>
          {archivedLogs.length > 0 && (
            <div style={{ flex: '0 0 100%', width: '100%', minWidth: 0, maxWidth: '100%', direction: 'rtl', overflow: 'hidden', boxSizing: 'border-box', isolation: 'isolate' }}>
              <DlgTabPanel
                tab="archive"
                active={tab === 'archive'}
                logs={archivedLogs}
                flocks={flocks}
                birds={birds}
                config={config}
                activeFlocks={activeFlocks}
                onApplyCorrection={applyCorrectionAtomic}
                onRevokeCorrection={revokeCorrectionAtomic}
                vaccineEnabled={vaccineEnabled}
                medicineEnabled={medicineEnabled}
                onEdit={openEdit}
                onAdd={openNew}
                onDeleteLog={handleDeleteLog}
                onRestoreLogFull={restoreLogFull}
              />
            </div>
          )}
          <div style={{ flex: '0 0 100%', width: '100%', minWidth: 0, maxWidth: '100%', direction: 'rtl', overflow: 'hidden', boxSizing: 'border-box', isolation: 'isolate' }}>
            <AggregateTabPanel
              active={tab === 'aggregate'}
              logs={logs}
              flocks={activeFlocks}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <FormModal
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        form={form}
        setForm={setForm}
        save={handleSave}
        saving={saving}
        err={err}
        vErrors={vErrors}
        showError={showError}
        markTouched={markTouched}
        selectedFlock={selectedFlock}
        flockAliveCount={flockAliveCount}
        isLayerFlock={isLayerFlock}
        isLayerType={isLayerType}
        isFlockMature={isFlockMature}
        vaccineEnabled={vaccineEnabled}
        medicineEnabled={medicineEnabled}
        onFlockChange={onFlockChange}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * applyCorrections — مقدار effective لاگ پس از اعمال corrections
 *
 * قواعد:
 * - corrections لغوشده نادیده گرفته می‌شوند
 * - ترتیب: قدیمی → جدید (آخرین برنده)
 * - لاگ اصلی دست‌نخورده می‌ماند (immutable)
 * - فیلدهای مشتق پس از اعمال corrections recompute می‌شوند:
 *     temperature  ← (min+max)/2 اگر min یا max تغییر کرد
 *     humidity     ← (min+max)/2 اگر min یا max تغییر کرد
 *     feedConsumed ← delivered - remaining (approximation)
 *     deaths       ← همگام با deathsCount (تک‌رکورد) یا از sum (چند‌رکورد)
 */
import type { DailyLog } from '../store';

/** مشتق: temp = (min+max)/2 اگر هر دو موجود، وگرنه مقدار تکی */
function recomputeTemperature(log: DailyLog): number | null {
  if (log.temperatureMin !== null && log.temperatureMax !== null) {
    return Math.round(((log.temperatureMin + log.temperatureMax) / 2) * 10) / 10;
  }
  return log.temperature;
}

/** مشتق: humidity = (min+max)/2 اگر هر دو موجود، وگرنه مقدار تکی */
function recomputeHumidity(log: DailyLog): number | null {
  if (log.humidityMin !== null && log.humidityMax !== null) {
    return Math.round(((log.humidityMin + log.humidityMax) / 2) * 10) / 10;
  }
  return log.humidity;
}

/**
 * مشتق: feedConsumed = delivered - remaining (approximation)
 *
 * ⚠️ source of truth دقیق در buildData (calculateFeedMetrics) است.
 * اینجا فقط برای همگام‌سازی سریع بعد از correction استفاده می‌شود.
 */
function recomputeFeedConsumed(log: DailyLog): number | null {
  if (log.feedDelivered === null || log.feedDelivered === undefined) {
    return log.feedConsumed ?? null;
  }
  const remaining = log.feedRemaining ?? 0;
  const consumed = log.feedDelivered - remaining;
  return consumed >= 0 ? Math.round(consumed * 100) / 100 : null;
}

/** مشتق: deathsCount = sum(deaths[].count) */
function sumDeathsCount(deaths: DailyLog['deaths']): number {
  return (deaths || []).reduce((a, x) => a + (x.count || 0), 0);
}


/** نرمال‌سازی ایمن آرایه‌های مصرفی DailyLog بدون تغییر در داده خام یا محاسبات */
export function normalizeDailyLog(log: DailyLog): DailyLog {
  const deaths = Array.isArray(log.deaths) ? log.deaths : [];
  const vaccines = Array.isArray(log.vaccines) ? log.vaccines : [];
  const medications = Array.isArray(log.medications) ? log.medications : [];
  const feedMovementIds = Array.isArray(log.feedMovementIds) ? log.feedMovementIds : [];
  const weightSamples = Array.isArray(log.weightSamples) ? log.weightSamples : [];

  if (
    log.deaths === deaths &&
    log.vaccines === vaccines &&
    log.medications === medications &&
    log.feedMovementIds === feedMovementIds &&
    log.weightSamples === weightSamples
  ) {
    return log;
  }

  return {
    ...log,
    deaths,
    vaccines,
    medications,
    feedMovementIds,
    weightSamples,
  };
}


const warnedMissingArrays = new Set<string>();

function warnMissingArrayOnce(logId: string, field: string): void {
  if (!import.meta.env.DEV) return;
  const key = `${logId || "unknown"}:${field}`;
  if (warnedMissingArrays.has(key)) return;
  warnedMissingArrays.add(key);
  console.warn(`[dlg:normalize] Non-array "${field}" on log "${logId || "unknown"}"`);
}

/**
 * خواندن ایمن آرایه‌های سلامت در لایه مصرف بدون دست‌زدن به داده خام یا محاسبات.
 */
export function getSafeHealthArrays(log: DailyLog): {
  deaths: DailyLog["deaths"];
  vaccines: DailyLog["vaccines"];
  medications: DailyLog["medications"];
} {
  const deaths = Array.isArray(log.deaths)
    ? log.deaths
    : (warnMissingArrayOnce(log.id, "deaths"), []);

  const vaccines = Array.isArray(log.vaccines)
    ? log.vaccines
    : (warnMissingArrayOnce(log.id, "vaccines"), []);

  const medications = Array.isArray(log.medications)
    ? log.medications
    : (warnMissingArrayOnce(log.id, "medications"), []);

  return { deaths, vaccines, medications };
}

export function applyCorrections(log: DailyLog): DailyLog {
  if (!log.corrections || log.corrections.length === 0) return normalizeDailyLog(log);

  let effective: DailyLog = { ...log };
  for (const corr of log.corrections) {
    if (corr.revoked) continue;
    effective = { ...effective, ...corr.changes };
  }

  // ═══ Recompute فیلدهای مشتق ═══

  // ۱. دما
  const tempChanged =
    effective.temperatureMin !== log.temperatureMin ||
    effective.temperatureMax !== log.temperatureMax;
  if (tempChanged) {
    effective = { ...effective, temperature: recomputeTemperature(effective) };
  }

  // ۲. رطوبت
  const humChanged =
    effective.humidityMin !== log.humidityMin ||
    effective.humidityMax !== log.humidityMax;
  if (humChanged) {
    effective = { ...effective, humidity: recomputeHumidity(effective) };
  }

  // ۳. feedConsumed
  const feedChanged =
    effective.feedDelivered !== log.feedDelivered ||
    effective.feedRemaining !== log.feedRemaining;
  if (feedChanged) {
    effective = { ...effective, feedConsumed: recomputeFeedConsumed(effective) };
  }

  // ۴. deaths ↔ deathsCount
  const deathsCountChanged = effective.deathsCount !== log.deathsCount;
  const deathsArrayChanged = (effective.deaths?.length || 0) !== (log.deaths?.length || 0);

  if (deathsCountChanged && !deathsArrayChanged) {
    const currentDeaths = effective.deaths || [];
    if (currentDeaths.length === 1) {
      // تک‌رکورد: count را همگام کن
      effective = {
        ...effective,
        deaths: [{ ...currentDeaths[0], count: effective.deathsCount }],
      };
    } else if (currentDeaths.length > 1) {
      // چند‌رکورد: از sum recompute (safety — invariant حفظ شود)
      effective = { ...effective, deathsCount: sumDeathsCount(currentDeaths) };
    }
    // currentDeaths.length === 0: مقدار corrected کاربر را حفظ کن (بدون تغییر)
  } else if (deathsArrayChanged) {
    effective = { ...effective, deathsCount: sumDeathsCount(effective.deaths) };
  }

  return effective;
}

/**
 * buildCorrectionEvents.ts — ساخت DlgEvent از تغییرات ویرایش
 * خالص (الگوی extractEvents)
 *
 * استاندارد: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e) — همه فیلدهای قابل اصلاح باید Audit Trail داشته باشند
 */
import type { DailyLog } from '../store';
import type { DlgEvent } from '../types-events';

/** لیست کامل فیلدهای قابل اصلاح — همگام با CORRECTABLE_FIELDS در CorrectionModal.tsx */
const CORRECTABLE_FIELDS = [
  // محیط
  'temperature', 'temperatureMin', 'temperatureMax',
  'humidity', 'humidityMin', 'humidityMax',
  // تغذیه و آب
  'feedDelivered', 'feedRemaining', 'feedWaste',
  'waterAmount', 'waterFillCount', 'waterFillVolume',
  // تولید
  'deathsCount',
  'eatingEggs', 'fertileEggs', 'brokenEggs', 'otherEggs',
  'weightGender',
] as const;

export function buildCorrectionEvents(
  oldLog: DailyLog,
  newData: Partial<DailyLog>,
  reason: string,
): Omit<DlgEvent, 'id' | 'logId' | 'createdAt'>[] {
  const out: Omit<DlgEvent, 'id' | 'logId' | 'createdAt'>[] = [];
  const base: any = {
    logId: oldLog.id,
    date: oldLog.date,
    entryTime: oldLog.entryTime,
    type: 'correction' as const,
    reason,
    reasonCode: 'data_entry_error' as const,
    version: 16,
  };
  for (const field of CORRECTABLE_FIELDS) {
    const before = (oldLog as any)[field] ?? null;
    const after = (newData as any)[field] ?? null;
    // skip اگر هیچ تغییری نبوده (جلوگیری از رکوردهای بی‌معنی)
    if (before === after) continue;
    if (before !== null || after !== null) {
      out.push({ ...base, field, before, after });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * api/buildData.ts — ساخت آبجکت DailyLog از فرم
 *
 * تابع خالص — همه‌چیز رو پارامتر می‌گیره.
 */
import type { DailyLog, Vaccine, Medication } from '../store';
import type { F } from '../types';
import { calculateFeedMetrics } from '../../../shr/calc/formulas/feed';

export interface BuildDataInput {
  form: F;
  processedVaccines: Vaccine[];
  processedMedications: Medication[];
  feedMovementIds: string[];
  birdAgeDays?: number | null;
  previousRemainingKg?: number | null;
  flockAliveCount?: number | null;
}

/** تبدیل رشته‌ی فارسی به عدد اعشاری */
function num(s: string): number | null {
  if (!s) return null;
  const v = parseFloat(String(s).replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d))).replace('٫', '.'));
  return isNaN(v) ? null : v;
}

/** تبدیل رشته‌ی فارسی به عدد صحیح */
function int(s: string): number | null {
  if (!s) return null;
  const v = parseInt(String(s).replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d))));
  return isNaN(v) ? null : v;
}

/** مجموع آب از تعداد × حجم */
function calcTotalWater(count: number | null, volume: number | null): number | null {
  if (count === null || volume === null) return null;
  return Math.round(count * volume * 100) / 100;
}

export function buildLogData(input: BuildDataInput): Omit<DailyLog, 'id' | 'status' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'> {
  const { form, processedVaccines, processedMedications, feedMovementIds, birdAgeDays, previousRemainingKg, flockAliveCount } = input;

  const feedAmt = num(form.feedDelivered);

  // محاسبه feedConsumed (simple یا precision بر اساس feedMethod)
  // form.feedMethod حالا 5 مقدار calc است — نیازی به cast نیست
  const feedMethod = form.feedMethod || 'scoop';
  const feedRemainingNum = num(form.feedRemaining);
  const feedCalc = calculateFeedMetrics({
    feedMethod,
    feedDeliveredKg: feedAmt ?? 0,
    feedRemainingKg: feedRemainingNum,
    previousRemainingKg: previousRemainingKg ?? null,
    feedWasteKg: num(form.feedWaste),
    aliveCount: flockAliveCount && flockAliveCount > 0 ? flockAliveCount : 1,
  });
  const feedConsumed = feedCalc.feedConsumedKg > 0 ? feedCalc.feedConsumedKg : null;

  // آب: اگه manual و تعداد/حجم داریم، از اون حساب کن
  const calcWater = form.waterMethod === 'manual'
    ? calcTotalWater(int(form.waterFillCount), num(form.waterFillVolume)) ?? num(form.waterAmount)
    : num(form.waterAmount);

  // دما/رطوبت: میانگین از min/max یا مقدار تکی
  const tMin = num(form.temperatureMin);
  const tMax = num(form.temperatureMax);
  const hMin = num(form.humidityMin);
  const hMax = num(form.humidityMax);
  const calcTemp = (tMin !== null && tMax !== null)
    ? Math.round(((tMin + tMax) / 2) * 10) / 10
    : num(form.temperature);
  const calcHumidity = (hMin !== null && hMax !== null)
    ? Math.round(((hMin + hMax) / 2) * 10) / 10
    : num(form.humidity);

  const dCount = form.deaths.reduce((a, x) => a + (x.count || 0), 0);

  return {
    flockId: form.flockId,
    date: form.date,
    entryTime: form.entryTime,
    birdAgeDays: birdAgeDays ?? null,
    temperature: calcTemp,
    temperatureMin: tMin,
    temperatureMax: tMax,
    humidity: calcHumidity,
    humidityMin: hMin,
    humidityMax: hMax,
    ventilation: form.ventilation,
    litter: form.litter,
    behavior: form.behavior,
    distribution: form.distribution,
    appearance: form.appearance.trim(),
    sound: form.sound,
    feedType: form.feedType.trim(),
    feedDelivered: feedAmt,
    feedConsumed,
    feedRemaining: num(form.feedRemaining),
    feedWaste: num(form.feedWaste),
    feedSourceType: form.feedSourceType,
    feedSourceId: form.feedSourceId,
    feedSources: form.feedSources && form.feedSources.length > 0 ? form.feedSources.filter(x => x.refId || x.quantity > 0) : undefined,
    feedMovementIds,
    feedMethod: form.feedMethod,
    waterMethod: form.waterMethod,
    feedMethodSource: form.feedMethodSource,
    waterMethodSource: form.waterMethodSource,
    feedMethodFromHall: form.feedMethodFromHall,
    waterMethodFromHall: form.waterMethodFromHall,
    waterAmount: calcWater,
    waterFillCount: int(form.waterFillCount),
    waterFillVolume: num(form.waterFillVolume),
    eatingEggs: int(form.eatingEggs),
    fertileEggs: int(form.fertileEggs),
    brokenEggs: int(form.brokenEggs),
    otherEggs: int(form.otherEggs),
    weightSamples: form.weightSamples
      .map(w => ({ id: w.id, weight: num(w.weight) || 0 }))
      .filter(w => w.weight > 0),
    weightGender: form.weightGender,
    deathsCount: dCount,
    deaths: form.deaths.filter(d => (d.count ?? 0) > 0 || Boolean(d.cause) || Boolean(d.notes?.trim())),
    vaccines: processedVaccines,
    medications: processedMedications,
    notes: form.notes.trim(),
  };
}
