/**
 * api/checkStock.ts — چک موجودی انبار برای ثبت روزانه
 *
 * تابع خالص (pure) — بدون وابستگی به React یا store.
 */
import type { Item } from '../../whs/store';
import { UNIT_LABEL } from '../../whs/store';
import { toEn } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';

export interface StockShortage {
  name: string;
  need: number;
  have: number;
  unit: string;
}

const parseNum = (s: string | number | null | undefined): number | null => {
  if (s === null || s === undefined || s === '') return null;
  if (typeof s === 'number') return s;
  const n = parseFloat(toEn(String(s)).replace('٫', '.'));
  return isNaN(n) ? null : n;
};

interface CheckStockInput {
  vaccines: { itemId?: string; quantity?: number | null }[];
  medications: { itemId?: string; quantity?: number | null }[];
  feedSourceType: string;
  feedSourceId: string;
  feedDelivered: string | number | null;
  whsItems: Item[];
  formulas?: { id: string; name: string; lines: { ingredientId: string; percent: number }[] }[];
  ingredients?: { id: string; stockItemId: string; name: string }[];
}

export function checkStock(params: CheckStockInput): StockShortage[] {
  const { vaccines, medications, feedSourceType, feedSourceId, feedDelivered, whsItems, formulas, ingredients } = params;
  const list: StockShortage[] = [];

  const check = (itemId: string | undefined, qty: number | null | undefined) => {
    if (!itemId || !qty || qty <= 0) return;
    const it = whsItems.find(x => x.id === itemId);
    if (!it) return;
    if (it.currentStock < qty) {
      list.push({
        name: it.name,
        need: qty,
        have: it.currentStock,
        unit: UNIT_LABEL[it.unit] || '',
      });
    }
  };

  vaccines.forEach(v => check(v.itemId, v.quantity));
  medications.forEach(m => check(m.itemId, m.quantity));

  if (feedSourceType === 'item' && feedSourceId) {
    check(feedSourceId, parseNum(feedDelivered));
  }

  if (feedSourceType === 'formula' && feedSourceId) {
    const formula = formulas?.find(f => f.id === feedSourceId);
    const delivered = parseNum(feedDelivered);
    if (formula && delivered && delivered > 0) {
      for (const line of formula.lines) {
        const ing = ingredients?.find(i => i.id === line.ingredientId);
        if (!ing || !ing.stockItemId) continue;
        const qty = (line.percent / 100) * delivered;
        check(ing.stockItemId, qty);
      }
    }
  }

  return list;
}

/**
 * extractEvents.ts — استخراج DlgEvent[] از یک DailyLog
 * خالص — id/createdAt رو از بیرون می‌گیره (الگوی buildData)
 */
import type { DailyLog } from '../store';
import type { DlgEvent, DlgEventType, DlgReadingField, DlgEggField } from '../types-events';

type WithoutId = Omit<DlgEvent, 'id' | 'logId' | 'createdAt'>;

export function extractEvents(log: DailyLog): WithoutId[] {
  const out: WithoutId[] = [];
  const base = {
    logId: log.id,
    date: log.date,
    entryTime: log.entryTime,
    version: 16,
  };

  // create — همیشه
  out.push({ ...base, type: 'create' as DlgEventType });

  // reading: دما/رطوبت
  const readings: { field: DlgReadingField; value: number | null }[] = [
    { field: 'temperature',    value: log.temperature },
    { field: 'temperatureMin', value: log.temperatureMin },
    { field: 'temperatureMax', value: log.temperatureMax },
    { field: 'humidity',       value: log.humidity },
    { field: 'humidityMin',    value: log.humidityMin },
    { field: 'humidityMax',    value: log.humidityMax },
  ];
  for (const r of readings) {
    if (r.value !== null && r.value !== undefined) {
      out.push({ ...base, type: 'reading', field: r.field, value: r.value });
    }
  }

  // feed
  if (log.feedDelivered !== null && log.feedDelivered !== undefined) {
    out.push({ ...base, type: 'feed', amount: log.feedDelivered, unit: 'kg' });
  }

  // water
  if (log.waterAmount !== null && log.waterAmount !== undefined) {
    out.push({ ...base, type: 'water', amount: log.waterAmount, unit: 'L' });
  }

  // death
  for (const d of log.deaths || []) {
    if ((d.count ?? 0) > 0) {
      out.push({ ...base, type: 'death', count: d.count as number, cause: d.cause, notes: d.notes });
    }
  }

  // egg
  const eggs: { field: DlgEggField; value: number | null | undefined }[] = [
    { field: 'eatingEggs',  value: log.eatingEggs },
    { field: 'fertileEggs', value: log.fertileEggs },
    { field: 'brokenEggs',  value: log.brokenEggs },
    { field: 'otherEggs',   value: log.otherEggs },
  ];
  for (const e of eggs) {
    if (e.value !== null && e.value !== undefined && e.value > 0) {
      out.push({ ...base, type: 'egg', field: e.field, value: e.value });
    }
  }


  // vaccine
  for (const v of log.vaccines || []) {
    out.push({ ...base, type: 'vaccine', notes: v.name });
  }

  // medication
  for (const m of log.medications || []) {
    out.push({ ...base, type: 'medication', notes: m.name });
  }

  // weight
  for (const w of log.weightSamples || []) {
    if (w.weight > 0) {
      out.push({ ...base, type: 'weight', value: w.weight, unit: 'kg' });
    }
  }

  return out;
}

/**
 * api/toEgg.ts — sync تولید تخم از ثبت روزانه به ماژول egg
 *
 * توابع خالص (pure) — caller وظیفه داره add/update/delete رو صدا بزنه.
 */
import type { EggProduction } from '../../egg/store';

export interface EggSyncInput {
  logId: string;
  flockId: string;
  date: string;
  isLayerFlock: boolean;
  eatingEggs: number;
  fertileEggs: number;
  brokenEggs: number;
  otherEggs: number;
}

export interface EggSyncData {
  flockId: string;
  date: string;
  eatingCount: number;
  fertileCount: number;
  totalCount: number;
  brokenCount: number;
  softCount: number;
  dirtyCount: number;
  avgWeight: number | null;
  notes: string;
  sourceLogId: string;
  sourceType: 'dlg' | 'manual' | 'inc' | 'unknown';
}

/** آیا این log نیاز به egg.production داره؟ */
export function shouldSyncToEgg(input: EggSyncInput): boolean {
  if (!input.isLayerFlock) return false;
  const total = input.eatingEggs + input.fertileEggs + input.brokenEggs + input.otherEggs;
  return total > 0;
}

/** ساخت داده‌ی egg.production از ورودی dlg */
export function buildEggProductionData(input: EggSyncInput): EggSyncData {
  const { logId, flockId, date, eatingEggs, fertileEggs, brokenEggs, otherEggs } = input;
  return {
    flockId,
    date,
    eatingCount: eatingEggs,
    fertileCount: fertileEggs,
    totalCount: eatingEggs + fertileEggs + brokenEggs + otherEggs,
    brokenCount: brokenEggs,
    softCount: 0,
    dirtyCount: otherEggs,
    avgWeight: null,
    notes: '',
    sourceLogId: logId,
    sourceType: 'dlg',
  };
}

/** تصمیم‌گیری sync: نوع عمل (add/update/delete/noop) */
export type SyncAction =
  | { type: 'add'; data: EggSyncData }
  | { type: 'update'; id: string; data: EggSyncData }
  | { type: 'delete'; id: string }
  | { type: 'noop' };

export function decideEggAction(params: {
  input: EggSyncInput;
  existing: EggProduction | undefined;
}): SyncAction {
  const { input, existing } = params;
  const should = shouldSyncToEgg(input);

  if (should) {
    const data = buildEggProductionData(input);
    if (existing) return { type: 'update', id: existing.id, data };
    return { type: 'add', data };
  }
  // نباید sync بشه — اگه قبلاً بود، پاک کن
  if (existing) return { type: 'delete', id: existing.id };
  return { type: 'noop' };
}

/**
 * api/toWhs.ts — ساخت movementهای انبار از ثبت روزانه
 *
 * توابع خالص (pure) — هیچ وابستگی به React یا store ندارن.
 * caller وظیفه داره addMovement رو صدا بزنه و ID برگشتی رو ذخیره کنه.
 */
import type { Vaccine, Medication } from '../store';

export interface NewMovementData {
  itemId: string;
  quantity: number;
  notes: string;
  /** 🆕 ردیابی: از کدوم جیره */
  formulaId?: string;
  /** 🆕 ردیابی: نسخهٔ جیره */
  formulaVersion?: number;
}

interface FormulaLine { ingredientId: string; percent: number }
interface FormulaLike {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  lines: FormulaLine[];
  version?: number;
}
interface IngredientLike {
  id: string;
  stockItemId: string;
  name: string;
}

/** دان: ساخت لیست movementها از فرمول یا کالای انبار */
export function buildFeedMovements(params: {
  feedSourceType: 'formula' | 'item' | '';
  feedSourceId: string;
  feedDelivered: number | null;
  flockName: string;
  formulas: FormulaLike[];
  ingredients: IngredientLike[];
}): NewMovementData[] {
  const {
    feedSourceType, feedSourceId, feedDelivered,
    flockName, formulas, ingredients,
  } = params;
  if (!feedSourceId || !feedDelivered || feedDelivered <= 0) return [];

  const result: NewMovementData[] = [];

  if (feedSourceType === 'formula') {
    const formula = formulas.find(f => f.id === feedSourceId);
    if (formula) {
      formula.lines.forEach(line => {
        const ing = ingredients.find(i => i.id === line.ingredientId);
        if (!ing || !ing.stockItemId) return;
        const qty = (line.percent / 100) * feedDelivered;
        result.push({
          itemId: ing.stockItemId,
          quantity: Math.round(qty * 1000) / 1000,
          notes: `ثبت روزانه — جیره ${formula.name}`,
          formulaId: formula.id,
          formulaVersion: formula.version ?? 1,
        });
      });
    }
  } else if (feedSourceType === 'item') {
    result.push({
      itemId: feedSourceId,
      quantity: feedDelivered,
      notes: `ثبت روزانه — ${flockName}`,
    });
  }

  return result;
}

/** واکسن: ساخت movement از یک آیتم واکسن (یا null) */
export function buildVaccineMovement(v: Vaccine): NewMovementData | null {
  const finalQty = (v.quantity || 0) * (v.factor || 1);
  if (!v.itemId || finalQty <= 0) return null;
  return {
    itemId: v.itemId,
    quantity: finalQty,
    notes: `ثبت روزانه — واکسن ${v.name || ''}`,
  };
}

/** دارو: ساخت movement از یک آیتم دارو (یا null) */
export function buildMedicationMovement(m: Medication): NewMovementData | null {
  const finalQty = (m.quantity || 0) * (m.factor || 1);
  if (!m.itemId || finalQty <= 0) return null;
  return {
    itemId: m.itemId,
    quantity: finalQty,
    notes: `ثبت روزانه — دارو ${m.name || ''}`,
  };
}

FILE: ./src/mod/dlg/components/AggregateTabPanel.tsx

/**
 * AggregateTabPanel.tsx — تب «جمع‌بندی» در /dlg
 *
 * نمایش جدول تجمیع هفتگی/ماهانه از لاگ‌های فعال.
 * خواندن-فقط — بدون ویرایش.
 * applyCorrections روی هر لاگ اعمال می‌شود.
 */
import { useFormat, getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';
import { applyCorrections } from '../api/applyCorrections';
import type { DailyLog } from '../store';
import type { Flock } from '../../flk/store';
import { Empty } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { toCSV } from '../../../shr/utils/export';

type Period = 'week' | 'month';

interface Props {
  active: boolean;
  logs: DailyLog[];
  flocks: Flock[];
}

interface Bucket {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  rangeStart: string;
  rangeEnd: string;
  logCount: number;
  deaths: number;
  feed: number;
  water: number;
  eggsTotal: number;
  tempSum: number;
  tempCount: number;
  humSum: number;
  humCount: number;
  avgTemp: number | null;
  avgHumidity: number | null;
  waterToFeed: number | null;
}

function toEnDigits(str: string): string {
  return str
    .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d) => String(d.charCodeAt(0) - 1776))
    .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => String(d.charCodeAt(0) - 1632));
}

function jalaliMonthDays(year: number, month: number): number {
  if (month <= 6) return 31;
  if (month <= 11) return 30;
  const leapRemainders = [1, 5, 9, 13, 17, 22, 26, 30];
  return leapRemainders.includes(year % 33) ? 30 : 29;
}

function parseJalaliDate(date: unknown): { y: number; m: number; d: number } | null {
  if (typeof date !== 'string' || !date.trim()) return null;
  const parts = toEnDigits(date.trim()).split('/');
  if (parts.length !== 3) return null;
  const y = parseInt(parts[0] ?? '', 10);
  const m = parseInt(parts[1] ?? '', 10);
  const d = parseInt(parts[2] ?? '', 10);
  if (Number.isNaN(y) || Number.isNaN(m) || Number.isNaN(d)) return null;
  if (y < 1 || m < 1 || m > 12 || d < 1 || d > 31) return null;
  return { y, m, d };
}

function jalaliToJdn(y: number, m: number, d: number): number {
  const epbase = y - (y >= 0 ? 474 : 473);
  const epyear = 474 + (epbase % 2820);
  return (
    d +
    (m <= 7 ? (m - 1) * 31 : (m - 1) * 30 + 6) +
    Math.floor((epyear * 682 - 110) / 2816) +
    (epyear - 1) * 365 +
    Math.floor(epbase / 2820) * 1029983 +
    1948320
  );
}

function jdnToJalali(jdn: number): { y: number; m: number; d: number } {
  const depoch = jdn - jalaliToJdn(475, 1, 1);
  const cycle = Math.floor(depoch / 1029983);
  const cyear = depoch % 1029983;
  let ycycle = 0;
  if (cyear === 1029982) {
    ycycle = 2820;
  } else {
    const aux1 = Math.floor(cyear / 366);
    const aux2 = cyear % 366;
    ycycle = Math.floor(((2134 * aux1) + (2816 * aux2) + 2815) / 1028522) + aux1 + 1;
  }
  const y = ycycle + cycle * 2820 + 474;
  const yf = y >= 0 ? y : y + 1;
  const yearStart = jalaliToJdn(yf, 1, 1);
  const dayOfYear = jdn - yearStart + 1;
  const m = dayOfYear <= 186 ? Math.ceil(dayOfYear / 31) : Math.ceil((dayOfYear - 186) / 30) + 6;
  const monthStart = jalaliToJdn(yf, m, 1);
  const d = jdn - monthStart + 1;
  return { y: yf, m, d };
}

function pad2(n: number): string {
  return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
}

function fmtJalali(y: number, m: number, d: number): string {
  return `${String(y).padStart(4, "0")}/${pad2(m)}/${pad2(d)}`;
}

// در تقویم ایرانی JDN % 7 === 2 برابر با شنبه است؛ شروع هفته 7 روزه را روی شنبه قرار می‌دهیم
function weekStartJdn(jdn: number): number {
  const saturdayOffset = (((jdn - 2) % 7) + 7) % 7;
  return jdn - saturdayOffset;
}

function bucketKey(date: unknown, period: Period): string | null {
  const parsed = parseJalaliDate(date);
  if (!parsed) return null;
  const yStr = String(parsed.y).padStart(4, "0");
  const mStr = pad2(parsed.m);
  if (period === "month") return `${yStr}/${mStr}`;
  const jdn = jalaliToJdn(parsed.y, parsed.m, parsed.d);
  const startJdn = weekStartJdn(jdn);
  const start = jdnToJalali(startJdn);
  // کلید شامل سال/ماه شروع هفته + شمارنده روز پیوسته برای مرتب‌سازی و یکتایی بدون تداخل ماه
  return `${String(start.y).padStart(4, "0")}/${pad2(start.m)}/W${startJdn}`;
}

function bucketLabel(key: string, period: Period): string {
  const parts = key.split("/");
  const y = parts[0] ?? "";
  const m = parts[1] ?? "";
  if (period === "month") {
    return `${getGlobalFormat().code(y)}/${getGlobalFormat().code(m)}`;
  }
  const wToken = parts[2] ?? "";
  const startJdn = parseInt(wToken.replace(/^W/, ""), 10);
  if (Number.isFinite(startJdn)) {
    const start = jdnToJalali(startJdn);
    const yearStartJdn = jalaliToJdn(start.y, 1, 1);
    const weekOfYear = Math.max(1, Math.floor((startJdn - yearStartJdn) / 7) + 1);
    return `${getGlobalFormat().code(String(start.y).padStart(4, "0"))}/${getGlobalFormat().code(pad2(start.m))} · هفتهٔ ${getGlobalFormat().code(weekOfYear)}`;
  }
  return `${getGlobalFormat().code(y)}/${getGlobalFormat().code(m)} · هفته`;
}

function bucketRange(date: string, period: Period): { start: string; end: string } {
  const parsed = parseJalaliDate(date);
  if (!parsed) return { start: date, end: date };
  const yStr = String(parsed.y).padStart(4, "0");
  const mStr = pad2(parsed.m);
  const maxDays = jalaliMonthDays(parsed.y, parsed.m);
  if (period === "month") {
    return {
      start: `${yStr}/${mStr}/01`,
      end: `${yStr}/${mStr}/${pad2(maxDays)}`,
    };
  }
  const jdn = jalaliToJdn(parsed.y, parsed.m, parsed.d);
  const startJdn = weekStartJdn(jdn);
  const sDate = jdnToJalali(startJdn);
  const eDate = jdnToJalali(startJdn + 6);
  return {
    start: fmtJalali(sDate.y, sDate.m, sDate.d),
    end: fmtJalali(eDate.y, eDate.m, eDate.d),
  };
}

function fmtNum(val: number, decimals = 1): string {
  if (typeof val !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(val)) return getGlobalFormat().num(0);
  const factor = Math.pow(10, decimals);
  const rounded = Math.round(val * factor) / factor;
  return getGlobalFormat().code(rounded);
}

function fmtFixed(val: number, decimals = 1): string {
  if (typeof val !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(val)) return getGlobalFormat().num(0);
  return getGlobalFormat().code(val.toFixed(decimals));
}

function renderPeriodCell(label: string) {
  const parts = label.split('·').map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length >= 2) {
    return (
      <span
        style={{
          display: 'inline-flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center',
          gap: 2,
          lineHeight: 1.25,
        }}
      >
        <bdi style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>{parts[0]}</bdi>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 'calc(var(--fs-xs) - 1px)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 500 }}>
          {parts.slice(1).join(' · ')}
        </span>
      </span>
    );
  }
  return <bdi style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>{label}</bdi>;
}

export default function AggregateTabPanel({ active, logs, flocks }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<Period>('week');
  const [flockFilter, setFlockFilter] = useState<string>('');
  const [showAllCols, setShowAllCols] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [visibleCount, setVisibleCount] = useState<number>(12);
  const [selectedPeriodKeys, setSelectedPeriodKeys] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [periodPickerOpen, setPeriodPickerOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [pickerYearFilter, setPickerYearFilter] = useState<string>("");
  const [pickerQuery, setPickerQuery] = useState<string>("");

  const buckets: Bucket[] = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, Bucket>();

    for (const raw of logs) {
      if ((raw.status || 'active') !== 'active') continue;
      if (flockFilter && raw.flockId !== flockFilter) continue;

      const log = applyCorrections(raw);
      const key = bucketKey(log.date, period);
      if (!key) continue;

      let b = map.get(key);
      if (!b) {
        const range = bucketRange(log.date, period);
        b = {
          key,
          label: bucketLabel(key, period),
          rangeStart: range.start,
          rangeEnd: range.end,
          logCount: 0,
          deaths: 0,
          feed: 0,
          water: 0,
          eggsTotal: 0,
          tempSum: 0,
          tempCount: 0,
          humSum: 0,
          humCount: 0,
          avgTemp: null,
          avgHumidity: null,
          waterToFeed: null,
        };
        map.set(key, b);
      }

      b.logCount++;
      b.deaths += Number(log.deathsCount) || 0;
      b.feed += Number(log.feedConsumed ?? log.feedDelivered ?? 0) || 0;
      b.water += Number(log.waterAmount) || 0;
      b.eggsTotal +=
        (Number(log.eatingEggs) || 0) +
        (Number(log.fertileEggs) || 0) +
        (Number(log.brokenEggs) || 0) +
        (Number(log.otherEggs) || 0);

      if (typeof log.temperature === 'number' && Number.isFinite(log.temperature)) {
        b.tempSum += log.temperature;
        b.tempCount++;
      }
      if (typeof log.humidity === 'number' && Number.isFinite(log.humidity)) {
        b.humSum += log.humidity;
        b.humCount++;
      }
    }

    const list = Array.from(map.values())
        .map((b) => ({
          ...b,
          avgTemp: b.tempCount > 0 ? b.tempSum / b.tempCount : null,
          avgHumidity: b.humCount > 0 ? b.humSum / b.humCount : null,
          waterToFeed: b.feed > 0 && b.water > 0 ? b.water / b.feed : null,
        }))
        .sort((a, b) => {
          const byStart = (b.rangeStart || "").localeCompare(a.rangeStart || "", "en", { numeric: true });
          if (byStart !== 0) return byStart;
          const byEnd = (b.rangeEnd || "").localeCompare(a.rangeEnd || "", "en", { numeric: true });
          if (byEnd !== 0) return byEnd;
          return (b.key || "").localeCompare(a.key || "", "en", { numeric: true });
        });

    // مرتب‌سازی دقیق زمانی (جدیدترین دوره در بالا)
    return list.sort((a, b) => b.key.localeCompare(a.key));
  }, [logs, period, flockFilter]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const years = Array.from(new Set(buckets.map((b) => b.key.split("/")[0]).filter(Boolean)));
    if (pickerYearFilter && !years.includes(pickerYearFilter)) {
      setPickerYearFilter("");
    }
    const validSet = new Set(buckets.map((b) => b.key));
    setSelectedPeriodKeys((prev) => {
      const next = prev.filter((k) => validSet.has(k));

  const visibleBuckets = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedPeriodKeys.length === 0) return buckets;
    const picked = new Set(selectedPeriodKeys);

  }, [buckets, selectedPeriodKeys]);

  const totals = useMemo(() => {

    let deaths = 0;
    let feed = 0;
    let water = 0;
    let eggsTotal = 0;
    let tempSum = 0;
    let tempCount = 0;
    let humSum = 0;
    let humCount = 0;

    for (const b of visibleBuckets) {
      logCount += b.logCount;
      deaths += b.deaths;
      feed += b.feed;
      water += b.water;
      eggsTotal += b.eggsTotal;
      tempSum += b.tempSum;
      tempCount += b.tempCount;
      humSum += b.humSum;
      humCount += b.humCount;
    }

    return {
      logCount,
      deaths,
      feed,
      water,
      eggsTotal,
      avgTemp: tempCount > 0 ? tempSum / tempCount : null,
      avgHumidity: humCount > 0 ? humSum / humCount : null,
      waterToFeed: feed > 0 && water > 0 ? water / feed : null,
    };

      'دوره', 'از', 'تا', 'تعداد لاگ', 'تلفات',

    ]);
    const rawCsv = toCSV(headers, rows);
    const csv = rawCsv.startsWith('\uFEFF') ? rawCsv : `\uFEFF${rawCsv}`;
    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `dlg-aggregate-${period}-${Date.now()}.csv`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();

  const opaqueCardBg = 'var(--card-solid, #fff)';

  ).sort((a, b) => b.localeCompare(a));

    return hay.includes(normalizedQuery);

  const togglePeriodKey = (key: string) => {
    setSelectedPeriodKeys((prev) =>
      prev.includes(key) ? prev.filter((k) => k !== key) : [...prev, key]
    );
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
      {/* هدر کنترل‌ها: تک‌ردیفه، غیرفشرده و قابل اسکرول افقی */}
      <div
        style={{
          width: '100%',
          boxSizing: 'border-box',
          background: 'var(--card)',
          border: '1px solid var(--border)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg, 12px)',
          padding: 6,
          boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)',

          <div
            role="group"
            aria-label="بازه جمع‌بندی"
            style={{
              ...CTRL_BASE,

            }}
          >
            <button
              type="button"

              هفتگی

            <button
              type="button"
              aria-pressed={period === 'month'}
              onClick={() => setPeriod('month')}
              style={{ ...periodBtn(period === 'month'), padding: '0 10px' }}
            >
              ماهانه
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* ۲. فیلتر گله */}
          {showFlockSelect && (
            <div style={{ position: 'relative', flexShrink: 0, height: 36 }}>
              <select
                value={flockFilter}
                onChange={(e) => setFlockFilter(e.target.value)}
                aria-label="فیلتر گله"
                style={{
                  ...CTRL_BASE,
                  width: 'auto',
                  minWidth: 96,
                  maxWidth: 145,
                  paddingInlineStart: 10,
                  paddingInlineEnd: 24,
                  appearance: 'none',
                  WebkitAppearance: 'none',
                  textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                  overflow: 'hidden',
                }}
              >
                <option value="">همه گله‌ها</option>
                {activeFlocks.map((f) => (
                  <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                    {f.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <svg
                aria-hidden="true"
                width="12"
                height="12"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="var(--muted)"
                strokeWidth="2.2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  insetInlineEnd: 8,
                  top: '50%',
                  transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                  pointerEvents: 'none',
                }}
              >
                <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" />
              </svg>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ۳. انتخاب چند ماه یا هفته */}
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-expanded={periodPickerOpen}
            disabled={buckets.length === 0}
            onClick={() => setPeriodPickerOpen((o) => !o)}
            style={{
              ...CTRL_BASE,
              width: 'auto',
              flexShrink: 0,
              padding: '0 11px',
              opacity: buckets.length === 0 ? 0.45 : 1,
              cursor: buckets.length === 0 ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
              background:
                activePickedCount > 0 || periodPickerOpen
                  ? 'var(--accent-soft, rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.10))'
                  : 'var(--card)',
              color:
                activePickedCount > 0 || periodPickerOpen
                  ? 'var(--accent)'
                  : 'var(--text)',
              border:
                activePickedCount > 0 || periodPickerOpen
                  ? '1px solid var(--accent)'
                  : '1px solid var(--border)',
            }}
          >
            {activePickedCount > 0 ? `${fmt.count(activePickedCount)} دوره` : 'انتخاب دوره'}
          </button>

          {/* ۴. تغییر تعداد ستون‌ها */}
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-pressed={showAllCols}
            onClick={() => setShowAllCols((v) => !v)}
            style={{
              ...CTRL_BASE,
              width: 'auto',
              flexShrink: 0,
              padding: '0 11px',
              background: showAllCols
                ? 'var(--accent-soft, rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.10))'
                : 'var(--card)',
              color: showAllCols ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)',
              border: showAllCols
                ? '1px solid var(--accent)'
                : '1px solid var(--border)',
            }}
          >
            {showAllCols ? 'ستون‌های کمتر' : 'همه ستون‌ها'}
          </button>

          {/* ۵. خروجی CSV */}
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={visibleBuckets.length === 0}
            onClick={handleExportCSV}
            style={{
              ...CTRL_BASE,
              width: 'auto',
              flexShrink: 0,
              padding: '0 11px',
              opacity: visibleBuckets.length === 0 ? 0.45 : 1,
              cursor: visibleBuckets.length === 0 ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            خروجی CSV
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* پنل انتخاب چند ماه یا هفته دلخواه (سازگار با داده‌های کم و چندساله) */}
      {periodPickerOpen && buckets.length > 0 && (
        <div
          style={{
            background: 'var(--card)',
            border: '1px solid var(--border)',
            borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg, 12px)',
            padding: '8px 10px',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            gap: 8,
            boxShadow: '0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)',
          }}
        >
          <div
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              gap: 8,
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
            }}
          >
            <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 600 }}>
              {activePickedCount > 0
                ? `${fmt.count(activePickedCount)} دوره از ${fmt.count(buckets.length)} انتخاب شده`
                : `همه دوره‌ها نمایش داده می‌شوند (${fmt.count(buckets.length)} دوره)`}
            </span>
            <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              {filteredPickerBuckets.length > 0 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    const targetKeys = filteredPickerBuckets.map((b) => b.key);
                    setSelectedPeriodKeys((prev) =>
                      Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...targetKeys]))
                    );
                  }}
                  style={{
                    padding: '3px 8px',
                    fontSize: 'calc(var(--fs-xs) - 0.5px)',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    fontFamily: 'inherit',
                    borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                    background: 'var(--card)',
                    color: 'var(--text)',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  انتخاب نمایش‌داده‌شده‌ها
                </button>
              )}
              {activePickedCount > 0 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedPeriodKeys([])}
                  style={{
                    padding: '3px 8px',
                    fontSize: 'calc(var(--fs-xs) - 0.5px)',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    fontFamily: 'inherit',
                    borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--accent)',
                    background: 'var(--accent-soft, rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.10))',
                    color: 'var(--accent)',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  همه دوره‌ها
                </button>
              )}
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label="بستن انتخاب دوره"
                onClick={() => setPeriodPickerOpen(false)}
                style={{
                  width: 22,
                  height: 22,
                  padding: 0,
                  fontSize: '13px',
                  lineHeight: 1,
                  fontFamily: 'inherit',
                  borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                  border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                  background: 'var(--card)',
                  color: 'var(--muted)',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  display: 'inline-flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                }}
              >
                ×
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {(availableYears.length > 1 || buckets.length > 10) && (
            <div
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                flexWrap: 'wrap',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
              }}
            >
              {availableYears.length > 1 && (
                <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 4 }}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setPickerYearFilter("")}
                    style={{
                      padding: '2px 7px',
                      fontSize: 'calc(var(--fs-xs) - 0.5px)',
                      fontWeight: pickerYearFilter === "" ? 700 : 500,
                      fontFamily: 'inherit',
                      borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                      border: pickerYearFilter === "" ? '1px solid var(--accent)' : '1px solid var(--border)',
                      background: pickerYearFilter === "" ? 'var(--accent-soft, rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.10))' : 'var(--card)',
                      color: pickerYearFilter === "" ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                    }}
                  >
                    همه سال‌ها
                  </button>
                  {availableYears.map((yr) => {
                    const activeYr = pickerYearFilter === yr;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={yr}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setPickerYearFilter(activeYr ? "" : yr)}
                        style={{
                          padding: '2px 7px',
                          fontSize: 'calc(var(--fs-xs) - 0.5px)',
                          fontWeight: activeYr ? 700 : 500,
                          fontFamily: 'inherit',
                          borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                          border: activeYr ? '1px solid var(--accent)' : '1px solid var(--border)',
                          background: activeYr ? 'var(--accent-soft, rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.10))' : 'var(--card)',
                          color: activeYr ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)',
                          cursor: 'pointer',
                        }}
                      >
                        {fmt.code(yr)}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}

              {buckets.length > 10 && (
                <input
                  type="search"
                  value={pickerQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setPickerQuery(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="جستجوی ماه یا هفته..."
                  aria-label="جستجوی ماه یا هفته"
                  style={{
                    flex: '1 1 130px',
                    minWidth: 110,
                    height: 24,
                    padding: '0 8px',
                    fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
                    fontFamily: 'inherit',
                    color: 'var(--text)',
                    background: 'var(--input-bg, var(--card))',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                    borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                    boxSizing: 'border-box',
                  }}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          <div
            style={{
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))',
              gap: 6,
              maxHeight: 168,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              paddingInlineEnd: 2,
            }}
          >
            {filteredPickerBuckets.length === 0 ? (
              <div
                style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  padding: '10px 6px',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
                  color: 'var(--muted)',
                }}
              >
                دوره‌ای با این فیلتر پیدا نشد.
              </div>
            ) : (
              filteredPickerBuckets.map((b) => {
                const isSelected =
                  activePickedCount === 0 ? false : selectedPeriodKeys.includes(b.key);
                return (
                  <button
                    key={b.key}
                    type="button"
                    aria-pressed={isSelected}
                    onClick={() => togglePeriodKey(b.key)}
                    style={{
                      padding: '5px 6px',
                      fontSize: 'calc(var(--fs-xs) - 0.5px)',
                      fontWeight: isSelected ? 700 : 500,
                      fontFamily: 'inherit',
                      borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                      border: isSelected ? '1px solid var(--accent)' : '1px solid var(--border)',
                      background: isSelected ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--card)',
                      color: isSelected ? 'white' : 'var(--text)',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                      overflow: 'hidden',
                      textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                      textAlign: 'center',
                    }}
                  >
                    {b.label}
                  </button>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* حالت خالی */}
      {buckets.length === 0 && (
        <Empty
          icon={
            <svg
              width="30"
              height="30"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="1.7"
              strokeLinecap="round"
            >
              <path d="M3 3v18h18" />
              <path d="m7 12 4-4 4 4 4-4" />
            </svg>
          }
          title="داده‌ای برای جمع‌بندی نیست"
          desc="پس از ثبت اولین لاگ روزانه، خلاصه هفتگی یا ماهانه اینجا نمایش داده می‌شود."
        />
      )}

      {/* جدول داده‌ها */}
      {buckets.length > 0 && (
        <div
          style={{
            background: 'var(--card)',
            border: '1px solid var(--border)',
            borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg, 12px)',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            boxShadow: '0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ width: '100%', maxHeight: 460, overflow: 'auto', WebkitOverflowScrolling: 'touch' }}>
            <table
              style={{
                width: '100%',
                minWidth: showAllCols ? 540 : '100%',
                tableLayout: showAllCols ? 'auto' : 'fixed',
                borderCollapse: 'separate',
                borderSpacing: 0,
                fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums',
              }}
            >
              {!showAllCols && (
                <colgroup>
                  <col style={{ width: '20%' }} />
                  <col style={{ width: '10%' }} />
                  <col style={{ width: '12%' }} />
                  <col style={{ width: '17%' }} />
                  <col style={{ width: '15%' }} />
                  <col style={{ width: '13%' }} />
                  <col style={{ width: '13%' }} />
                </colgroup>
              )}

              <thead style={{ position: 'sticky', top: 0, zIndex: 5 }}>
                <tr style={{ background: 'var(--surface-2, var(--input-bg, var(--card-solid, #fff)))' }}>
                  <th
                    style={{
                      ...TH,
                      textAlign: 'center',
                                            width: showAllCols ? '1%' : undefined, minWidth: showAllCols ? 64 : 74, whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                      position: 'sticky',
                      insetInlineStart: 0,
                      zIndex: 4,
                      background: 'var(--surface-2, var(--input-bg, var(--card-solid, #fff)))',
                      paddingInline: showAllCols ? 4 : 6, borderInlineEnd: stickyDivider,
                    }}
                  >
                    دوره
                  </th>
                  <th style={TH}>ثبت</th>
                  <th style={TH}>تلفات</th>
                  <th style={TH}>دان</th>
                  <th style={TH}>آب</th>
                  {showAllCols && <th style={TH}>آب/دان</th>}
                  <th style={TH}>تخم</th>
                  <th style={{ ...TH, paddingInlineEnd: 8 }}>دما</th>
                  {showAllCols && (
                    <th style={{ ...TH, paddingInlineEnd: 8 }}>رطوبت</th>
                  )}
                </tr>
              </thead>

              <tbody>
                {visibleBuckets.slice(0, visibleCount).map((b) => (
                  <tr key={b.key} style={{ background: 'var(--card-solid, #fff)' }}>
                    <td
                      style={{
                        ...TD,
                        textAlign: 'center',
                                              width: showAllCols ? '1%' : undefined, minWidth: showAllCols ? 64 : 74, whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                      position: 'sticky',
                        insetInlineStart: 0,
                        zIndex: 3,
                        background: opaqueCardBg,
                        paddingInline: showAllCols ? 4 : 6, borderInlineEnd: stickyDivider,
                        borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18))',
                      }}
                    >
                      {renderPeriodCell(b.label)}
                    </td>

                    <td
                      style={{
                        ...TD,
                        borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18))',
                        color: b.logCount > 0 ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--muted)',
                        fontWeight: b.logCount > 0 ? 600 : 400,
                      }}
                    >
                      {fmt.count(b.logCount)}
                    </td>

                    <td
                      style={{
                        ...TD,
                        borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18))',
                        color: b.deaths > 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--muted)',
                        fontWeight: b.deaths > 0 ? 700 : 400,
                      }}
                    >
                      {fmt.count(b.deaths)}
                    </td>

                    <td style={{ ...TD, borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18))' }}>
                      <span
                        dir="ltr"
                        style={{
                          display: 'inline-flex',
                          alignItems: 'baseline',
                          gap: 3,
                          whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                          color: b.feed > 0 ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--muted)',
                          fontWeight: b.feed > 0 ? 600 : 400,
                        }}
                      >
                        <bdi style={unitCell}>{fmtNum(b.feed)}</bdi>
                        <span style={unitTag}>kg</span>
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    <td style={{ ...TD, borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18))' }}>
                      <span
                        dir="ltr"
                        style={{
                          display: 'inline-flex',
                          alignItems: 'baseline',
                          gap: 3,
                          whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                          color: b.water > 0 ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--muted)',
                          fontWeight: b.water > 0 ? 600 : 400,
                        }}
                      >
                        <bdi style={unitCell}>{fmtNum(b.water)}</bdi>
                        <span style={unitTag}>L</span>
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    {showAllCols && (
                      <td
                        style={{
                          ...TD,
                          borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18))',
                          color: b.waterToFeed !== null ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--muted)',
                          fontWeight: b.waterToFeed !== null ? 600 : 400,
                        }}
                      >
                        {b.waterToFeed !== null ? (
                          <bdi>{fmtFixed(b.waterToFeed, 2)}</bdi>
                        ) : (
                          '—'
                        )}
                      </td>
                    )}

                    <td
                      style={{
                        ...TD,
                        borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18))',
                        color: b.eggsTotal > 0 ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--muted)',
                        fontWeight: b.eggsTotal > 0 ? 600 : 400,
                      }}
                    >
                      {fmt.count(b.eggsTotal)}
                    </td>

                    <td
                      style={{
                        ...TD,
                        paddingInlineEnd: 8,
                        borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18))',
                        color: b.avgTemp !== null ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--muted)',
                        fontWeight: b.avgTemp !== null ? 600 : 400,
                      }}
                    >
                      {b.avgTemp !== null ? (
                        <bdi>{fmtFixed(b.avgTemp, 1)}°</bdi>
                      ) : (
                        '—'
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {showAllCols && (
                      <td
                        style={{
                          ...TD,
                          paddingInlineEnd: 8,
                          borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18))',
                          color: b.avgHumidity !== null ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--muted)',
                          fontWeight: b.avgHumidity !== null ? 600 : 400,
                        }}
                      >
                        {b.avgHumidity !== null ? (
                          <bdi>{fmtFixed(b.avgHumidity, 1)}٪</bdi>
                        ) : (
                          '—'
                        )}
                      </td>
                    )}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>

              <tfoot style={{ position: 'sticky', bottom: 0, zIndex: 5 }}>
                <tr
                  style={{
                    background: 'var(--surface-2, var(--input-bg, var(--card-solid, #fff)))',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                  }}
                >
                  <td
                    style={{
                      ...TD,
                      textAlign: 'center',
                                            width: showAllCols ? '1%' : undefined, minWidth: showAllCols ? 64 : 74, whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                      position: 'sticky',
                      insetInlineStart: 0,
                      zIndex: 4,
                      background: 'var(--surface-2, var(--input-bg, var(--card-solid, #fff)))',
                      paddingInline: showAllCols ? 4 : 6, borderInlineEnd: stickyDivider,
                      borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',
                      color: 'var(--text)',
                      fontWeight: 700,
                    }}
                  >
                    {showAllCols ? (
                      <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', lineHeight: 1.2, fontSize: 'calc(var(--fs-xs) - 1px)' }}>
                        <span>جمع /</span>
                        <span>میانگین</span>
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      'جمع کل'
                    )}
                  </td>

                  <td
                    style={{
                      ...TD,
                      borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',
                      color: totals.logCount > 0 ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--muted)',
                      fontWeight: 700,
                    }}
                  >
                    {fmt.count(totals.logCount)}
                  </td>

                  <td
                    style={{
                      ...TD,
                      borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',
                      color: totals.deaths > 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--muted)',
                      fontWeight: 700,
                    }}
                  >
                    {fmt.count(totals.deaths)}
                  </td>

                  <td style={{ ...TD, borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)' }}>
                    <span
                      dir="ltr"
                      style={{
                        display: 'inline-flex',
                        alignItems: 'baseline',
                        gap: 3,
                        whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                        color: totals.feed > 0 ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--muted)',
                        fontWeight: totals.feed > 0 ? 700 : 400,
                      }}
                    >
                      <bdi style={unitCell}>{fmtNum(totals.feed)}</bdi>
                      <span style={unitTag}>kg</span>
                    </span>
                  </td>

                  <td style={{ ...TD, borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)' }}>
                    <span
                      dir="ltr"
                      style={{
                        display: 'inline-flex',
                        alignItems: 'baseline',
                        gap: 3,
                        whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                        color: totals.water > 0 ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--muted)',
                        fontWeight: totals.water > 0 ? 700 : 400,
                      }}
                    >
                      <bdi style={unitCell}>{fmtNum(totals.water)}</bdi>
                      <span style={unitTag}>L</span>
                    </span>
                  </td>

                  {showAllCols && (
                    <td
                      style={{
                        ...TD,
                        borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',
                        color: totals.waterToFeed !== null ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--muted)',
                        fontWeight: totals.waterToFeed !== null ? 700 : 400,
                      }}
                    >
                      {totals.waterToFeed !== null ? (
                        <bdi>{fmtFixed(totals.waterToFeed, 2)}</bdi>
                      ) : (
                        '—'
                      )}
                    </td>
                  )}

                  <td
                    style={{
                      ...TD,
                      borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',
                      color: totals.eggsTotal > 0 ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--muted)',
                      fontWeight: totals.eggsTotal > 0 ? 700 : 400,
                    }}
                  >
                    {fmt.count(totals.eggsTotal)}
                  </td>

                  <td
                    style={{
                      ...TD,
                      paddingInlineEnd: 8,
                      borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',
                      color: totals.avgTemp !== null ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--muted)',
                      fontWeight: totals.avgTemp !== null ? 700 : 400,
                    }}
                  >
                    {totals.avgTemp !== null ? (
                      <bdi>{fmtFixed(totals.avgTemp, 1)}°</bdi>
                    ) : (
                      '—'
                    )}
                  </td>

                  {showAllCols && (
                    <td
                      style={{
                        ...TD,
                        paddingInlineEnd: 8,
                        borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',
                        color: totals.avgHumidity !== null ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--muted)',
                        fontWeight: totals.avgHumidity !== null ? 700 : 400,
                      }}
                    >
                      {totals.avgHumidity !== null ? (
                        <bdi>{fmtFixed(totals.avgHumidity, 1)}٪</bdi>
                      ) : (
                        '—'
                      )}
                    </td>
                  )}
                </tr>
              </tfoot>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

const CTRL_BASE: CSSProperties = {
  height: 36,
  minHeight: 36,
  width: '100%',
  minWidth: 0,
  boxSizing: 'border-box',
  background: 'var(--card-solid, var(--card))',
  border: '1px solid var(--border)',
  borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
  fontFamily: 'inherit',
  fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
  fontWeight: 600,
  lineHeight: 1.2,
  color: 'var(--text)',

  display: 'inline-flex',
  alignItems: 'center',
  justifyContent: 'center',
  transition: 'background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease',
};

function periodBtn(active: boolean): CSSProperties {

    height: '100%',

    color: active ? '#fff' : 'var(--text)',
    border: 'none',
    borderRadius: 'calc(var(--r-md) - 3px)',
    cursor: 'pointer',
    fontFamily: 'inherit',
    fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
    fontWeight: 600,
    lineHeight: 1.2,
    whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
    display: 'inline-flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    boxShadow: active ? '0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14)' : 'none',
    transition: 'background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease',
  };
}

FILE: ./src/mod/dlg/components/CorrectionModal.tsx

/**
 * CorrectionModal.tsx — modal ثبت اصلاح چند-فیلدی
 * استاندارد: ALCOA+ / 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e)
 * - چند فیلد را هم‌زمان می‌توان اصلاح کرد (یک correction واحد)
 * - یک دلیل مشترک برای همه
 * - Audit Trail برای هر فیلد جداگانه (در buildCorrectionEvents)
 * - کادر دو-قسمتی: راست = ورودی جدید (خالی)، چپ = مقدار قبلی (خواندنی)
 * - خالی کردن = برگشت به حالت تغییر نیافته (به جز weightGender)
 * - چیدمان دو ستونه برای فیلدهای هم‌خانواده (مثل ثبت روزانه)
 */
import { useFormat, getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Modal, Btn, BtnRow, Field, Select, Input, Grid2 } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import type { DailyLog } from '../store';
import { toEn, toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { v4 as uuid } from 'uuid';
import { applyCorrections } from '../api/applyCorrections';

const CORRECTABLE_FIELDS = [
  { key: 'temperatureMin', label: '🌡 حداقل دما',    unit: '°C' },
  { key: 'temperatureMax', label: '🌡 حداکثر دما',   unit: '°C' },
  { key: 'humidityMin',    label: '💧 حداقل رطوبت',  unit: '٪' },
  { key: 'humidityMax',    label: '💧 حداکثر رطوبت', unit: '٪' },
  { key: 'feedDelivered',  label: '🌾 دان داده',     unit: 'kg' },
  { key: 'feedRemaining',  label: '🌾 دان باقی',     unit: 'kg' },
  { key: 'waterAmount',    label: '💧 آب',           unit: 'L' },
  { key: 'deathsCount',    label: '💀 تلفات',        unit: '' },
  { key: 'eatingEggs',     label: '🥚 خوراکی',       unit: 'عدد' },
  { key: 'fertileEggs',    label: '🌱 نطفه‌دار',     unit: 'عدد' },
  { key: 'brokenEggs',     label: '💔 شکسته',        unit: 'عدد' },
  { key: 'otherEggs',      label: '📦 سایر',         unit: 'عدد' },
  { key: 'feedWaste',      label: '🌾 هدر رفته',     unit: 'kg' },
  { key: 'waterFillCount', label: '💧 دفعات آب',     unit: 'نوبت' },
  { key: 'waterFillVolume',label: '💧 حجم هر نوبت',  unit: 'L' },
  { key: 'weightGender',   label: '⚖️ جنسیت وزن',   unit: '' },
] as const;

const FIELD_GROUPS = [
  { title: '🌡 محیط',  keys: ['temperatureMin', 'temperatureMax', 'humidityMin', 'humidityMax'] },
  { title: '🌾 تغذیه', keys: ['feedDelivered', 'feedRemaining', 'feedWaste', 'waterAmount', 'waterFillCount', 'waterFillVolume'] },
  { title: '🥚 تولید', keys: ['deathsCount', 'eatingEggs', 'fertileEggs', 'brokenEggs', 'otherEggs', 'weightGender'] },
] as const;

type CorrectableKey = typeof CORRECTABLE_FIELDS[number]['key'];

// هم‌خانواده‌ها (مثل ثبت روزانه)
const PAIRS: [CorrectableKey, CorrectableKey][] = [
  ['temperatureMin', 'temperatureMax'],
  ['humidityMin', 'humidityMax'],
  ['eatingEggs', 'fertileEggs'],
  ['brokenEggs', 'otherEggs'],
  ['feedRemaining', 'feedWaste'],
  ['waterFillCount', 'waterFillVolume'],
];

function hasMultiDeaths(log: DailyLog | null): boolean {
  return (log?.deaths?.length || 0) > 1;
}

const REASONS = [
  'اشتباه شمارش',
  'اشتباه خواندن سنسور',
  'تایپ اشتباه',
  'فراموشی ثبت',
  'سایر',
];

const WEIGHT_GENDER_OPTS = [
  { value: '', label: '— نامشخص —' },
  { value: 'male', label: 'نر' },
  { value: 'female', label: 'ماده' },
  { value: 'mixed', label: 'مخلوط' },
];

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  log: DailyLog | null;
  onSave: (logId: string, changes: Partial<DailyLog>, reason: string, notes?: string) => void | Promise<void>;
}

function stripEmoji(str: string): string {
  return str
    .replace(/[\u{1F300}-\u{1F9FF}\u{2600}-\u{26FF}\u{2700}-\u{27BF}\u{1F600}-\u{1F64F}\u{1F680}-\u{1F6FF}\u{1F1E6}-\u{1F1FF}]/gu, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

function formatOldValue(key: CorrectableKey, val: any): string {
  if (val == null || val === '') return '';
  if (key === 'weightGender') {
    return WEIGHT_GENDER_OPTS.find(o => o.value === val)?.label || String(val);
  }
  return getGlobalFormat().code(String(val));
}

export default function CorrectionModal({ open, onClose, log, onSave }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<CorrectableKey>>(new Set());
  const [values, setValues] = useState<Partial<Record<CorrectableKey, string>>>({});
  const [reason, setReason] = useState<string>(REASONS[0]);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<string>('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setSelected(new Set());
      setValues({});
      setReason(REASONS[0]);
      setNotes('');
    }
  }, [open]);

  const effectiveLog = useMemo(() => (log ? applyCorrections(log) : null), [log]);

  if (!log || !effectiveLog) return null;

  const isChanged = (key: CorrectableKey): boolean => {
    if (!selected.has(key)) return false;
    const cur = (effectiveLog as any)[key];
    const nv = values[key];

    if (key === 'weightGender') {
      if (nv === undefined) return false;
      return nv !== (cur || '');
    }

    if (nv === undefined || nv.trim() === '') return false;

    const num = parseFloat(toEn(nv).replace('٫', '.'));
    if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return false;
    return num !== cur;
  };

  const toggle = (key: CorrectableKey) => {
    if (selected.has(key)) {
      setSelected(prev => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        next.delete(key);
        return next;
      });
      setValues(prev => {
        const next = { ...prev };
        delete next[key];
        return next;
      });
    } else {
      setSelected(prev => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        next.add(key);
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  const setVal = (key: CorrectableKey, v: string) => {
    setValues(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: v }));
  };

  const changedCount = Array.from(selected).filter(isChanged).length;
  const multiDeathsBlocked = selected.has('deathsCount') && hasMultiDeaths(log);

  const buildChanges = (): Partial<DailyLog> | null => {
    if (selected.size === 0) return null;
    const changes: Partial<DailyLog> = {};
    let deathsCountNew: number | null = null;

    for (const key of selected) {
      if (key === 'weightGender') {
        const nv = values[key];
        if (nv === undefined) continue;
        const cur = (effectiveLog as any).weightGender || '';
        if (nv === cur) continue;
        (changes as any).weightGender = nv;
        continue;
      }

      const trimmed = (values[key] ?? '').trim();
      if (trimmed === '') continue;

      if (key === 'deathsCount') {
        const num = parseFloat(toEn(trimmed).replace('٫', '.'));
        if (!Number.isFinite(num) || !Number.isInteger(num) || num < 0) continue;
        (changes as any).deathsCount = num;
        deathsCountNew = num;
        continue;
      }

      const num = parseFloat(toEn(trimmed).replace('٫', '.'));
      if (!Number.isFinite(num)) continue;
      (changes as any)[key] = num;
    }

    if (deathsCountNew !== null) {
      if (log.deaths?.length === 1) {
        changes.deaths = [{ ...log.deaths[0], count: deathsCountNew }];
      } else if ((log.deaths?.length || 0) === 0 && deathsCountNew > 0) {
        changes.deaths = [{
          id: uuid(),
          count: deathsCountNew,
          cause: 'unknown',
          notes: 'اصلاح خودکار',
        }];
      }
    }

    if (Object.keys(changes).length === 0) return null;
    return changes;
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (multiDeathsBlocked) return;
    const changes = buildChanges();
    if (!changes) return;
    await onSave(log.id, changes, reason, notes || undefined);
  };

  const saveDisabled = changedCount === 0 || multiDeathsBlocked;

  // ─── ساخت گروه‌های دو ستونه ───
  const pairedKeys = new Set<string>();
  const groups: CorrectableKey[][] = [];

  for (const [a, b] of PAIRS) {
    const sel = [a, b].filter(k => selected.has(k));
    if (sel.length > 0) {
      groups.push(sel);
      sel.forEach(k => pairedKeys.add(k));
    }
  }

  for (const key of Array.from(selected)) {
    if (!pairedKeys.has(key)) {
      groups.push([key]);
    }
  }

  const renderField = (key: CorrectableKey) => {
    const field = CORRECTABLE_FIELDS.find(f => f.key === key);
    if (!field) return null;
    const oldVal = (effectiveLog as any)[key];
    const isCh = isChanged(key);

    return (
      <div
        key={key}
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: 'var(--sp-2)',
          padding: 'var(--sp-1) 0',
          minHeight: 48,
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
          <span style={{
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
            fontWeight: 700,
            color: 'var(--text)',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
          }}>
            {stripEmoji(field.label)}
          </span>
          {isCh && (
            <span style={{
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs, 10px)',
              color: 'var(--accent)',
              background: 'var(--accent-soft, rgba(59,130,246,0.15))',
              padding: '1px 6px',
              borderRadius: '999px',
              fontWeight: 700,
              alignSelf: 'flex-start',
              lineHeight: 1.4,
            }}>
              تغییر کرد
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'stretch',
            height: 36,
            width: 180,
            flexShrink: 0,
            border: `1px solid ${isCh ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--border)'}`,
            borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            background: 'var(--card)',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', padding: '0 6px', minWidth: 0 }}>
            {key === 'weightGender' ? (
              <select
                value={values[key] || ''}
                onChange={e => setVal(key, e.target.value)}
                style={{ width: '100%', border: 'none', outline: 'none', background: 'transparent', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--text)', textAlign: 'center', cursor: 'pointer' }}
              >
                {WEIGHT_GENDER_OPTS.map(o => <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</option>)}
              </select>
            ) : (
              <>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  inputMode="decimal"
                  value={fmt.code(values[key] || '')}
                  onChange={e => setVal(key, toEn(e.target.value))}
                  placeholder=""
                  style={{ flex: 1, border: 'none', outline: 'none', background: 'transparent', fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--text)', textAlign: 'center', minWidth: 0, fontWeight: 700 }}
                />
                {field.unit && (
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs, 10px)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 600, marginRight: 4, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                    {field.unit}
                  </span>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>
          <div
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              borderRight: `1px solid ${isCh ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--border)'}`,
              background: 'transparent',
              color: (oldVal != null && oldVal !== '') ? 'var(--danger)' : 'transparent',
              fontFamily: 'monospace',
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
              fontWeight: 700,
              minWidth: 0,
              padding: '0 4px',
            }}
            title="مقدار قبلی"
          >
            {formatOldValue(key, oldVal)}
          </div>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => toggle(key)}
          title="حذف از انتخاب"
          style={{
            width: 24,
            height: 24,
            flexShrink: 0,
            border: '1px solid var(--border)',
            borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
            background: 'var(--card)',
            color: 'var(--muted)',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            fontFamily: 'inherit',
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs, 10px)',
          }}
        >
          ✕
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="ثبت اصلاح"
      footer={
        <BtnRow>
          <Btn variant="primary" onClick={handleSave} disabled={saveDisabled}>
            ✓ ثبت اصلاح{changedCount > 0 ? ` (${fmt.count(changedCount)})` : ''}
          </Btn>
          <Btn onClick={onClose}>انصراف</Btn>
        </BtnRow>
      }
    >
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
          فیلدهای مورد نظر را انتخاب کنید، سپس مقدار جدید را وارد کنید. می‌توانید چند فیلد را هم‌زمان اصلاح کنید.
        </div>

        {FIELD_GROUPS.map(group => (
          <div key={group.title} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>
              {group.title}
            </span>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
              {group.keys.map(k => {
                const key = k as CorrectableKey;
                const f = CORRECTABLE_FIELDS.find(x => x.key === key);
                if (!f) return null;
                const isSel = selected.has(key);
                const isCh = isChanged(key);
                return (
                  <button
                    key={f.key}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => toggle(key)}
                    style={{
                      padding: '6px 12px',
                      background: isCh
                        ? 'var(--accent)'
                        : isSel
                          ? 'var(--accent-soft, rgba(59,130,246,0.12))'
                          : 'var(--card)',
                      color: isCh ? 'white' : isSel ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
                      border: `1px solid ${isSel ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--border)'}`,
                      borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                      fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                      fontWeight: 600,
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      fontFamily: 'inherit',
                      display: 'inline-flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      gap: 4,
                    }}
                  >
                    {f.label}
                    {isCh && <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs, 11px)' }}>●</span>}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}

        {multiDeathsBlocked && (
          <div style={{
            padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
            background: 'var(--warn-soft)',
            border: '1px dashed var(--warn)',
            borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
            color: 'var(--warn)',
            lineHeight: 1.7,
          }}>
            ⚠ این لاگ {fmt.count(log.deaths.length)} رکورد تلفات دارد.
            اصلاح تعداد کل روی مجموع اعمال نمی‌شود.
            برای اصلاح، ابتدا از ویرایش لاگ رکوردها را تغییر دهید.
          </div>
        )}

        {selected.size > 0 && (
          <div style={{
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            gap: 'var(--sp-2)',
            padding: 'var(--sp-3)',
            border: '1px solid var(--border)',
            borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
            background: 'var(--card)'
          }}>
            <div style={{
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
              fontWeight: 700,
              color: 'var(--text)',
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              alignItems: 'center',
              marginBottom: 'var(--sp-1)'
            }}>
              <span>ویرایش فیلدهای انتخاب‌شده ({fmt.count(selected.size)})</span>
              {changedCount > 0 && (
                <span style={{
                  fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs, 11px)',
                  color: 'var(--accent)',
                  background: 'var(--accent-soft, rgba(59,130,246,0.12))',
                  padding: '2px 8px',
                  borderRadius: '999px',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                }}>
                  {fmt.count(changedCount)} فیلد تغییر کرده
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--sp-2)' }}>
              {groups.map((group, idx) => {
              const fields = group.map(key => renderField(key));
              if (group.length > 1) {
                return <Grid2 key={idx}>{fields}</Grid2>;
              }
              return <div key={idx}>{fields}</div>;
            })}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <Field label="دلیل (مشترک برای همه فیلدها)">
          <Select value={reason} onChange={e => setReason(e.target.value)}>
            {REASONS.map(r => <option key={r} value={r}>{r}</option>)}
          </Select>
        </Field>

        <Field label="توضیح (اختیاری)">
          <Input value={notes} onChange={e => setNotes(e.target.value)} placeholder="..." />
        </Field>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

const FIELD_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  temperature: 'دما (°C)', temperatureMin: 'حداقل دما (°C)', temperatureMax: 'حداکثر دما (°C)',
  humidity: 'رطوبت (٪)', humidityMin: 'حداقل رطوبت (٪)', humidityMax: 'حداکثر رطوبت (٪)',
