const VISIBLE_LIMIT = 10;

interface Props { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; log: DailyLog | null; }

type TimelineItem =
  | { kind: 'event'; time: string; event: DlgEvent }
  | { kind: 'merged-reading'; time: string; events: DlgEvent[] }
  | { kind: 'merged-health'; time: string; events: DlgEvent[] }
  | { kind: 'merged-nutrition'; time: string; events: DlgEvent[] }
  | { kind: 'correction'; time: string; correction: NonNullable<DailyLog['corrections']>[number] };

export default function DlgHistoryModal({ open, onClose, log }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const [showAll, setShowAll] = useState(false);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [filterSheetOpen, setFilterSheetOpen] = useState(false);
  const { revokeEvent, revokeCorrection } = useDlg();

  // 🆕 محاسبه وضعیت لاگ دقیقاً قبل از هر اصلاح (برای رفع باگ ریاضی تاریخچه)
  const corrBefores = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, any>();
    if (!log) return map;
    let current = { ...log };
    for (const corr of log.corrections || []) {
      map.set(corr.id, { ...current });
      current = { ...current, ...corr.changes };
    }
    return map;
  }, [log]);


  const items: TimelineItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!log) return [];
    const list: TimelineItem[] = [];
    const readingByTime = new Map<string, DlgEvent[]>();
    const healthByTime = new Map<string, DlgEvent[]>();
    const nutritionByTime = new Map<string, DlgEvent[]>();
    for (const ev of log.events || []) {
      if (ev.type === 'reading') {
        const k = ev.entryTime || ev.createdAt || '';
        if (!readingByTime.has(k)) readingByTime.set(k, []);
        readingByTime.get(k)!.push(ev);
      } else if (['vaccine', 'medication', 'death', 'activity'].includes(ev.type)) {
        const k = ev.entryTime || ev.createdAt || '';
        if (!healthByTime.has(k)) healthByTime.set(k, []);
        healthByTime.get(k)!.push(ev);
      } else if (['feed', 'water'].includes(ev.type)) {
        const k = ev.entryTime || ev.createdAt || '';
        if (!nutritionByTime.has(k)) nutritionByTime.set(k, []);
        nutritionByTime.get(k)!.push(ev);
      } else {
        list.push({ kind: 'event', time: ev.createdAt || '', event: ev });
      }
    }
    for (const [time, evs] of readingByTime.entries()) {
      if (evs.length > 1) list.push({ kind: 'merged-reading', time, events: evs });
      else list.push({ kind: 'event', time, event: evs[0] });
    }
    for (const [time, evs] of healthByTime.entries()) {
      if (evs.length > 1) list.push({ kind: 'merged-health', time, events: evs });
      else list.push({ kind: 'event', time, event: evs[0] });
    }
    for (const [time, evs] of nutritionByTime.entries()) {
      if (evs.length > 1) list.push({ kind: 'merged-nutrition', time, events: evs });
      else list.push({ kind: 'event', time, event: evs[0] });
    }
    for (const corr of log.corrections || []) list.push({ kind: 'correction', time: corr.timestamp || '', correction: corr });
    return list.sort((a, b) => b.time.localeCompare(a.time));
  }, [log]);

  const typeCounts = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const it of items) {
      const k = it.kind === 'event' ? it.event.type
              : it.kind === 'merged-reading' ? 'reading'
              : it.kind === 'merged-health' ? 'health'
              : it.kind === 'merged-nutrition' ? 'nutrition'
              : 'correction';
      m.set(k, (m.get(k) || 0) + 1);
    }
    return m;
  }, [items]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (filter === 'all') return items;
    return items.filter(it => {
      const k = it.kind === 'event' ? it.event.type
              : it.kind === 'merged-reading' ? 'reading'
              : it.kind === 'merged-health' ? 'health'
              : it.kind === 'merged-nutrition' ? 'nutrition'
              : 'correction';
      return k === filter;
    });
  }, [items, filter]);

  const groups = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, TimelineItem[]>();
    for (const it of filtered) {
      const d = it.kind === 'event' ? it.event.date : (it.kind === 'correction' ? (log?.date || '') : it.events[0].date);
      const t = it.kind === 'event' ? it.event.entryTime : (it.kind === 'correction' ? (log?.entryTime || '') : it.events[0].entryTime);
      const key = `${d}|${t || ''}`;
      if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, []);
      map.get(key)!.push(it);
    }
    const sortedKeys = Array.from(map.keys()).sort((a, b) => b.localeCompare(a));
    return sortedKeys.map(k => {
      const [date, time] = k.split('|');
      return { label: date, time, items: map.get(k)! };
    });
  }, [filtered, log]);

  const visibleData = useMemo(() => {
    if (showAll) return { items: groups, hidden: 0 };
    let total = 0;
    const out: typeof groups = [];
    for (const g of groups) {
      if (total >= VISIBLE_LIMIT) break;
      out.push(g);
      total += g.items.length;
    }
    const allTotal = groups.reduce((s, g) => s + g.items.length, 0);
    return { items: out, hidden: allTotal - total };
  }, [groups, showAll]);

  // شناسه آخرین رویداد — فقط این قابل لغو است
  const latestItemId = useMemo(() => {
    let latest: { ts: number; id: string } | null = null;
    const toTs = (val?: string) => {
      if (!val) return 0;
      const parsed = Date.parse(val);
      if (Number.isFinite(parsed)) return parsed;
      const parts = val.split(":").map(Number);
      if (parts.length >= 2 && Number.isFinite(parts[0]) && Number.isFinite(parts[1])) {
        return (parts[0] * 3600 + parts[1] * 60 + (parts[2] || 0)) * 1000;
      }
      return 0;
    };
    for (const ev of log?.events || []) {
      const ts = toTs(ev.createdAt || ev.entryTime);
      if (!latest || ts >= latest.ts) latest = { ts, id: ev.id };
    }
    for (const corr of log?.corrections || []) {
      const ts = toTs(corr.createdAt || corr.timestamp);
      if (!latest || ts >= latest.ts) latest = { ts, id: corr.id };
    }
    return latest?.id || null;
  }, [log]);

  const handleExport = () => {
    if (!log) return;
    try {
      const headers = ['زمان', 'نوع', 'فیلد', 'قبل', 'بعد', 'دلیل', 'لغو شده'];
      const rows = items.flatMap(it => {
        if (it.kind === 'merged-reading') {
          return it.events.map(ev => {
            const m = TYPE_META[ev.type] || { label: ev.type || 'رویداد', tone: 'var(--muted)' };
            return [ev.entryTime || ev.createdAt, m.label, ev.field || '', ev.value ?? '', '', ev.reason || ev.notes || '', ev.revoked ? 'بله' : 'خیر'];
          });
        }
        if (it.kind === 'merged-nutrition') {
          return it.events.map(ev => {
            const m = TYPE_META[ev.type] || { label: ev.type || 'رویداد', tone: 'var(--muted)' };
            return [ev.entryTime || ev.createdAt, m.label, '', ev.amount ?? '', '', '', ev.revoked ? 'بله' : 'خیر'];
          });
        }
        if (it.kind === 'merged-health') {
          return it.events.map(ev => {
            const m = TYPE_META[ev.type] || { label: ev.type || 'رویداد', tone: 'var(--muted)' };
            return [ev.entryTime || ev.createdAt, m.label, ev.notes || '', '', '', ev.reason || '', ev.revoked ? 'بله' : 'خیر'];
          });
        }
        if (it.kind === 'event') {
          const m = TYPE_META[it.event.type] || { label: it.event.type || 'رویداد', tone: 'var(--muted)' };
          return [[it.event.entryTime || it.event.createdAt, m.label, it.event.field || '', it.event.before ?? '', it.event.after ?? it.event.value ?? it.event.amount ?? it.event.count ?? '', it.event.reason || it.event.notes || '', it.event.revoked ? 'بله' : 'خیر']];
        }
        const c = it.correction;
        const fields = Object.keys(c.changes).map(k => `${FIELD_LABEL[k] || k}: ${(log as any)[k] ?? '—'}→${(c.changes as any)[k] ?? '—'}`).join(' • ');
        return [[c.timestamp, 'اصلاح', fields, '', '', c.reason, c.revoked ? 'بله' : 'خیر']];
      });
      const csv = [headers.join(','), ...rows.map(r => r.map(x => `"${String(x).replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(','))].join('\n');
      downloadCSV(`dlg-${log.id}.csv`, '\uFEFF' + csv);
      toastMsg.success('CSV دانلود شد');
    } catch { toastMsg.error('دانلود ناموفق'); }
  };

  const handleRevokeEvent = async (ev: DlgEvent) => {
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync('لغو رویداد', 'این رویداد لغو شود؟');
    if (!ok) return;
    revokeEvent(log!.id, ev.id);
  };

  const handleRevokeCorrection = async (corrId: string) => {
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync('لغو اصلاح', 'این اصلاح لغو شود؟');
    if (!ok) return;
    revokeCorrection(log!.id, corrId);
  };

  if (!log) return null;

  return (
    <HistoryModalShell
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={`تاریخچه — ${log.entryTime ? fmt.code(log.entryTime) + ' • ' : ''}${fmt.date(log.date)}`}
      onExport={handleExport}
    >
      {/* ═══ هدر خلاصه سبز ═══ */}
      <div style={{
        padding: '4px 4px',
        background: 'var(--accent-soft)',
        border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)',
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
        marginBottom: 10,
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: 6,
      }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <b style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>خلاصه ثبت روزانه</b>
          <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
            {fmt.count(items.length)} رویداد
          </span>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--text)' }}>
          <span>تاریخ: <b>{fmt.date(log.date)}</b></span>
          <span>ساعت: <b>{fmt.code(log.entryTime || '—')}</b></span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ═══ دکمه فیلتر فشرده ═══ */}
      {items.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginBottom: 10 }}>
          <Btn
  size="sm"
  variant={filter === 'all' ? 'outline' : 'primary'}
  onClick={() => setFilterSheetOpen(true)}
>
  <span>فیلتر:</span>
  <b>{filter === 'all' ? 'همه' : (TYPE_META[filter as DlgEventType]?.label || 'اصلاح')}</b>
  <span style={{ opacity: 0.6, marginRight: 4 }}>▾</span>
</Btn>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ═══ Sheet فیلتر ═══ */}
      <Sheet open={filterSheetOpen} onClose={() => setFilterSheetOpen(false)} title="فیلتر رویدادها">
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
          <Btn
  variant={filter === 'all' ? 'primary' : 'outline'}
  onClick={() => { setFilter('all'); setFilterSheetOpen(false); }}
  style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}
>
  <span>همه</span>
  <span>({fmt.count(items.length)})</span>
</Btn>
          {Array.from(typeCounts.entries()).map(([type, count]) => {
            const meta = TYPE_META[type as DlgEventType] || { label: 'اصلاح', tone: 'var(--warn)' };
            const isActive = filter === type;
            return (
              <Btn
  key={type}
  variant={isActive ? 'primary' : 'outline'}
  onClick={() => { setFilter(type); setFilterSheetOpen(false); }}
  style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}
>
  <span>{meta.label}</span>
  <span>({fmt.count(count)})</span>
</Btn>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </Sheet>

      {/* ═══ محتوا ═══ */}
      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 24, textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--muted)' }}><div style={{ fontSize: 40, marginBottom: 8 }}>📜</div><div>هنوز رویدادی ثبت نشده</div></div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {visibleData.items.map(group => (
            <div key={group.label + group.time} style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--muted)', paddingBottom: 6, marginBottom: 6, borderBottom: '1px dashed var(--border)' }}>
                <span>📅 {fmt.code(group.label)}</span>
                {group.time && <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>{fmt.code(group.time)}</span>}
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
                {group.items.map((it) => {
                  if (it.kind === 'merged-reading') {
                    return <MergedReadingRow key={it.events[0].id} events={it.events} />;
                  }
                  if (it.kind === 'merged-health') {
                    return <MergedHealthRow key={it.events[0].id} events={it.events} />;
                  }
                  if (it.kind === 'merged-nutrition') {
                    return <MergedNutritionRow key={it.events[0].id} events={it.events} />;
                  }
                  if (it.kind === 'event') {
                    const isTrulyLatest = it.event.id === latestItemId;
                    return <EventRow key={it.event.id} ev={it.event} isLatest={isTrulyLatest} onRevoke={() => handleRevokeEvent(it.event)} />;
                  }
                  const isTrulyLatest = it.correction.id === latestItemId;
                  return <CorrectionRow key={it.correction.id} corr={it.correction} log={log} beforeLog={corrBefores.get(it.correction.id)} isLatest={isTrulyLatest} onRevoke={() => handleRevokeCorrection(it.correction.id)} />;
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
          {visibleData.hidden > 0 && <div style={{ marginTop: 10 }}><ShowMoreButton count={visibleData.hidden} onClick={() => setShowAll(true)} /></div>}
        </>
      )}
    </HistoryModalShell>
  );
}

function EventRow({ ev, isLatest, onRevoke }: { ev: DlgEvent; isLatest: boolean; onRevoke: () => void }) {
  if (ev.type === 'death' && (!ev.count || ev.count === 0)) return null;
  if (ev.type === 'create') return null;

  const meta = TYPE_META[ev.type];
  const isRevoked = ev.revoked === true;
  
  // استخراج مقدار برای نمایش در یک خط
  let valueStr: string | React.ReactNode = '';
  if (ev.before !== undefined && ev.after !== undefined) {
    valueStr = (
      <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                  <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }}>{getGlobalFormat().code(String(ev.after ?? '—'))}</span>
                  <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', margin: '0 4px' }}>→</span>
                  <span style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>{getGlobalFormat().code(String(ev.before ?? '—'))}</span>
                </span>
    );
  } else if (ev.type === 'water' && ev.amount !== undefined) {
    valueStr = `${getGlobalFormat().num(ev.amount)} لیتر`;
  } else if (ev.type === 'feed' && ev.amount !== undefined) {
    valueStr = `${getGlobalFormat().num(ev.amount)} کیلوگرم`;
  } else if (ev.type === 'death' && ev.count !== undefined) {
    valueStr = `${getGlobalFormat().num(ev.count)} عدد`;
  } else if (ev.type === 'vaccine' || ev.type === 'medication') {
    valueStr = ev.notes || ev.reason || 'ثبت شده';
  } else if (ev.field) {
    valueStr = getGlobalFormat().num(ev.value ?? 0);
  } else if (ev.value !== undefined && ev.value !== null) {
    valueStr = getGlobalFormat().num(ev.value);
  }

  return (
    <div style={{
      padding: '8px 10px',
      background: 'var(--input-bg)',
      borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
      border: '1px solid var(--border)',
      opacity: isRevoked ? 0.7 : 1,
      display: 'flex',
      flexDirection: 'column',
      gap: 4,
    }}>
      {/* Header: نوع + زمان */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
          <b style={{ color: meta.tone, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700 }}>{meta.label}</b>
          {ev.field && ev.type !== 'water' && ev.type !== 'feed' && ev.type !== 'death' && ev.type !== 'vaccine' && ev.type !== 'medication' && (
            <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)' }}>({FIELD_LABEL[ev.field] || ev.field})</span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Body: مقدار + دلیل + دکمه لغو */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginTop: 2 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: meta.tone }}>
            {valueStr}
          </span>
          {ev.reason && (
            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>({ev.reason})</span>
          )}
        </div>
        
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center' }}>
          {isRevoked && <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--danger)' }}>لغو شده</span>}
          {isLatest && !isRevoked && (
            <Btn size="sm" variant="danger-outline" onClick={onRevoke} style={{ padding: '2px 8px', height: 24, minHeight: 'unset', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)' }}>لغو</Btn>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function CorrectionRow({ corr, log, beforeLog, isLatest, onRevoke }: { corr: NonNullable<DailyLog['corrections']>[number]; log: DailyLog; beforeLog?: DailyLog; isLatest: boolean; onRevoke: () => void }) {
  const isRevoked = corr.revoked === true;
  return (
    <div style={{
      padding: '8px 10px',
      background: 'var(--input-bg)',
      borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
      border: '1px solid var(--border)',
      opacity: isRevoked ? 0.7 : 1,
      display: 'flex',
      flexDirection: 'column',
      gap: 4,
    }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <b style={{ color: 'var(--warn)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700 }}>اصلاح دستی</b>
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2, marginTop: 2 }}>
        {Object.keys(corr.changes).map(k => {
          const before = (beforeLog || log as any)[k];
                    const after = (corr.changes as any)[k];
                    return (
                      <div key={k} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
                        <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{FIELD_LABEL[k] || k}:</span>
                        <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                          <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }}>{getGlobalFormat().code(String(after ?? '—'))}</span>
                          <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', margin: '0 4px' }}>→</span>
                          <span style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>{getGlobalFormat().code(String(before ?? '—'))}</span>
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    );
        })}
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginTop: 2 }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
          {corr.reason ? `دلیل: ${corr.reason}` : ''}
        </span>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
          {isRevoked && <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--danger)' }}>لغو شده</span>}
          {isLatest && !isRevoked && (
            <Btn size="sm" variant="danger-outline" onClick={onRevoke} style={{ padding: '2px 8px', height: 24, minHeight: 'unset', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)' }}>لغو</Btn>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


function MergedReadingRow({ events }: { events: DlgEvent[] }) {
  return (
    <div style={{
      padding: '10px 12px',
      background: 'var(--input-bg)',
      borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
      border: '1px solid var(--border)',
      display: 'flex',
      flexDirection: 'column',
      gap: 6,
    }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <b style={{ color: 'var(--info)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700 }}>اندازه‌گیری محیط</b>
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
        {events.map(ev => (
          <Row
            key={ev.id}
            l={FIELD_LABEL[ev.field || ''] || ev.field || 'مقدار'}
            v={<span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', color: 'var(--info)' }}>{getGlobalFormat().num(ev.value ?? 0)}</span>}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function MergedHealthRow({ events }: { events: DlgEvent[] }) {
  return (
    <div style={{
      padding: '10px 12px',
      background: 'var(--input-bg)',
      borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
      border: '1px solid var(--border)',
      display: 'flex',
      flexDirection: 'column',
      gap: 6,
    }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <b style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700 }}>سلامت (واکسن / دارو / تلفات / فعالیت)</b>
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
        {events.map(ev => {
          let l = '', v = '';
          if (ev.type === 'vaccine') { l = 'واکسن'; v = ev.notes || 'ثبت شده'; }
          else if (ev.type === 'medication') { l = 'دارو'; v = ev.notes || 'ثبت شده'; }
          else if (ev.type === 'death') { l = 'تلفات'; v = `${getGlobalFormat().num(ev.count || 0)} عدد`; }
          else if (ev.type === 'activity') { l = 'فعالیت'; v = ev.notes || 'ثبت شده'; }
          return <Row key={ev.id} l={l} v={<span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', color: 'var(--accent)' }}>{v}</span>} />;
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function MergedNutritionRow({ events }: { events: DlgEvent[] }) {
  return (
    <div style={{
      padding: '10px 12px',
      background: 'var(--input-bg)',
      borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
      border: '1px solid var(--border)',
      display: 'flex',
      flexDirection: 'column',
      gap: 6,
    }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <b style={{ color: 'var(--warn)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700 }}>تغذیه و آب</b>
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
        {events.map(ev => {
          let l = '', v = '';
          if (ev.type === 'feed') { l = 'مصرف دان'; v = `${getGlobalFormat().num(ev.amount || 0)} کیلوگرم`; }
          else if (ev.type === 'water') { l = 'مصرف آب'; v = `${getGlobalFormat().num(ev.amount || 0)} لیتر`; }
          return <Row key={ev.id} l={l} v={<span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', color: 'var(--warn)' }}>{v}</span>} />;
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const formatColdDateFa = (rawDate?: string): string => {
  if (!rawDate) return "—";
  const trimmed = rawDate.trim();
  if (/^1[34]\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{2}$/.test(trimmed)) {
    return fmt.code(trimmed);
  }
  const parsed = new Date(trimmed);
  if (!Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
    return fmt.date(formatJ(parsed, "yyyy/MM/dd"));
  }
  return fmt.code(trimmed);
};

const summarizeColdLogFa = (log?: DailyLog): string => {
  if (!log) return "";
  const parts: string[] = [];
  const anyLog = log as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;

  const feed = anyLog.feedKg ?? anyLog.feedConsumed ?? anyLog.feed;
  const water = anyLog.waterL ?? anyLog.waterConsumed ?? anyLog.water;
  const deaths = anyLog.deaths ?? anyLog.deathsCount ?? anyLog.mortality;
  const eggs = anyLog.eggs ?? anyLog.eggCount;
  const temp = anyLog.temp ?? anyLog.temperature;
  const humidity = anyLog.humidity;

  if (typeof feed === "number" && feed > 0) parts.push(`دان: ${fmt.num(feed)} کیلوگرم`);
  if (typeof water === "number" && water > 0) parts.push(`آب: ${fmt.num(water)} لیتر`);
  if (typeof deaths === "number" && deaths > 0) parts.push(`تلفات: ${fmt.num(deaths)}`);
  if (typeof eggs === "number" && eggs > 0) parts.push(`تخم: ${fmt.num(eggs)}`);
  if (typeof temp === "number" && temp > 0) parts.push(`دما: ${fmt.num(temp)}°`);
  if (typeof humidity === "number" && humidity > 0) parts.push(`رطوبت: ${fmt.num(humidity)}٪`);

  return parts.join(" • ");
};

const getMonthKeyFa = (dateStr?: string): string => {
  if (!dateStr) return "نامشخص";
  const match = dateStr.trim().match(/^(1[34]\d{2})\/(\d{2})/);
  if (!match) return "نامشخص";
  return `${fmt.code(match[1])}/${fmt.code(match[2])}`;
};

const getMonthLabelFa = (dateStr?: string): string => {
  if (!dateStr) return "تاریخ نامشخص";
  const match = dateStr.trim().match(/^(1[34]\d{2})\/(\d{2})/);
  if (!match) return fmt.code(dateStr);
  return `${fmt.code(match[1])}/${fmt.code(match[2])}`;
};

function sliceUpToDayBoundary<T extends { date?: string }>(
  sortedLogs: T[],
  minLimit = 100
): T[] {
  if (sortedLogs.length <= minLimit) return sortedLogs;

  const result: T[] = [];
  let boundaryDate: string | undefined;

  for (let i = 0; i < sortedLogs.length; i++) {
    const item = sortedLogs[i];
    if (i < minLimit) {
      result.push(item);
      boundaryDate = item.date;
    } else if (item.date && item.date === boundaryDate) {
      result.push(item);
    } else {
      break;
    }
  }

  return result;
}

function groupLogsByMonth<T extends { date?: string }>(logs: T[]) {
  const map = new Map<
    string,
    { key: string; label: string; items: T[] }
  >();

  for (const item of logs) {
    const key = getMonthKeyFa(item.date);
    const label = getMonthLabelFa(item.date);
    const existing = map.get(key);
    if (existing) {
      existing.items.push(item);
    } else {
      map.set(key, {
        key,
        label,
        items: [item],
      });
    }
  }

  return Array.from(map.values());
}

interface Props {
 form: F;

export default function EggsWeightSection({ form, setForm, vErrors, flockAliveCount, showError, markTouched }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();

 const selectedFlock = flocks.find(f => f.id === form.flockId);
 const flockAge = selectedFlock ? getAgeDays(selectedFlock) : null;

 const renderSummary = () => {
  const samples = form.weightSamples
   .map(w => ({ id: w.id, weight: num(w.weight) || 0 }))
   .filter(w => w.weight > 0);

  if (samples.length >= 3) {

    const avgG = Math.round(result.avgWeightG * 10) / 10;

    return (
     <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', lineHeight: 1.7 }}>

     </div>
    );
   }
  }

  if (samples.length >= 2) {
   const avg = avgWeight(form.weightSamples.map(w => ({ id: w.id, weight: num(w.weight) || 0 })));
   const cv = cvWeight(form.weightSamples.map(w => ({ id: w.id, weight: num(w.weight) || 0 })));
   const lbl = cvText(cv);
   return (
    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', lineHeight: 1.7 }}>
     <div>میانگین: <b>{fmt.num(avg)} گرم</b></div>
     <div style={{ color: lbl.color, fontWeight: 700 }}>CV {fmt.num(cv)}٪ — {lbl.text}</div>
    </div>
   );
  }

  return <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>💡 حداقل ۲ نمونه اضافه کن تا میانگین محاسبه شود</div>;
 };

 return (
  <>
     <Grid2>

       <Field label="🥚 تخم خوراکی" error={showError('eatingEggs')}>
        <NumField placeholder="۰" value={form.eatingEggs} onChange={e => setForm({...form, eatingEggs: e.target.value})} unit="عدد" min={0} max={flockAliveCount || undefined} />
       </Field>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0, minWidth: 0 }}>

با ثبت حداقل ۲ نمونه وزن، میانگین محاسبه می‌شود. برای محاسبه دقیق‌تر (CV و یکنواختی) حداقل به ۳ نمونه نیاز است.
**راهنمای CV (ضریب تغییرات):**
- **CV ≤ ۸٪:** عالی (گله همگن)
- **۸٪ < CV ≤ ۱۰٪:** خوب (مطلوب صنعت)
- **۱۰٪ < CV ≤ ۱۲٪:** متوسط (نیاز به پایش)
- **CV > ۱۲٪:** ضعیف (مشکل غذایی یا بیماری)`} /></div>

  const hall = useHal(s => flock?.hallId ? s.halls.find(h => h.id === flock.hallId) : undefined);
  const breedStd = useBreedStandard();
  const flockAge = flock ? getAgeDays(flock) : null;
  const hallStd = hall?.breedId ? breedStd.byBreedId(hall.breedId) : null;
  const dynStd = hallStd?.env && flockAge ? findInRange(hallStd.env, flockAge) : null;
  const targetTemp = (dynStd as any)?.temp?.target ?? hall?.targetTemp ?? null;
  const targetHumidity = (dynStd as any)?.humidity?.target ?? (dynStd as any)?.humidity?.min ?? hall?.targetHumidity ?? null;

  // 🆕 context برای anomaly detection
  const envCtx = {
    ageDays: flockAge ?? undefined,
    flockType: flock?.type as 'broiler' | 'layer' | 'breeder' | 'ornamental' | undefined,
  };

  return (
    <>

      <Grid2>

import { useFormat, getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import ExpandableCard from '../../../shr/components/ExpandableCard';

import SmartSelect from '../../../shr/components/SmartSelect';
import { UNIT_LABEL } from '../../whs/store';
import { toFa, toEn } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';

import { FieldHint } from '../../../shr/intelligence/FieldHint';

interface Props {
 form: F;
 setForm: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<F>>;
 vErrors: Record<string, string>;
 showError: (field: string) => string | undefined;
 markTouched: (field: string) => void;

function getFeedUnitOpts(src: FeedSource, feedItems: any[]): UnitOption[] {
  if (src.type === 'formula') {
    return [{ value: 'kg', label: 'کیلوگرم', factor: 1 }];
  }
  const it = feedItems.find((x: any) => x.id === src.refId);
  if (!it) return [{ value: 'kg', label: 'کیلوگرم', factor: 1 }];
  const baseUnit = it.unit as string;
  const opts: UnitOption[] = [{ value: baseUnit, label: (UNIT_LABEL as any)[baseUnit] || baseUnit, factor: 1 }];
  (it.subUnits || []).forEach((su: any) => {
    opts.push({ value: su.name, label: su.name, factor: su.factor });
  });
  return opts;
}

export default function FeedSection({ form, setForm }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
 const { formulas, ingredients } = useFed();
 const isFeedAuto = ['semi_auto', 'auto_sensor', 'auto_chain'].includes(form.feedMethod || '');
 const isWaterAuto = ['nipple', 'trough', 'tank'].includes(form.waterMethod || '');
 const [hallSheetOpen, setHallSheetOpen] = useState(false);
 const [expandedSourceId, setExpandedSourceId] = useState<string | null>(null);
 const FEED_METHOD_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'scoop', label: 'قیفی (سطل)' },
  { value: 'bag', label: 'کیسه‌ای' },
  { value: 'semi_auto', label: 'نیمه‌اتومات' },
  { value: 'auto_sensor', label: 'اتومات با سنسور' },
  { value: 'auto_chain', label: 'اتومات زنجیری' },
 ];
 const WATER_METHOD_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'manual', label: 'دستی (سطل/مخزن)' },
  { value: 'nipple', label: 'نیپل اتومات' },
  { value: 'trough', label: 'کانالی' },
  { value: 'tank', label: 'مخزن اتومات' },
 ];
 const [editFeedMethod, setEditFeedMethod] = useState(false);
 const [editWaterMethod, setEditWaterMethod] = useState(false);
 const { items: whsItems } = useWhs();
 const customStandards = useSet(s => (s as any).customStandards) || {};
 const feedItems = useMemo(() => whsItems.filter(x => x.category === 'feed'), [whsItems]);
 const num = (s: string) => s ? parseFloat(toEn(s).replace('٫','.')) || null : null;
 const int = (s: string) => s ? parseInt(toEn(s)) || null : null;

 const { flocks } = useFlk();
 const { breeds } = useBrd();
 const selectedFlock = flocks.find(f => f.id === form.flockId);
 const flockSize = selectedFlock?.currentCount || selectedFlock?.initialCount || 0;

 const sources: FeedSource[] = form.feedSources && form.feedSources.length > 0
  ? form.feedSources
  : (form.feedSourceId
   ? [{ id: 'legacy', type: (form.feedSourceType || 'item') as 'formula' | 'item', refId: form.feedSourceId, quantity: num(form.feedDelivered) || 0 }]
   : []);

 const totalFeed = sources.reduce((s, x) => s + (x.quantity || 0), 0);
 const remainingNum = num(form.feedRemaining) || 0;
 const consumedFeed = Math.max(0, totalFeed - remainingNum);
 const feedPerBirdG = flockSize > 0 && consumedFeed > 0 ? (consumedFeed * 1000) / flockSize : 0;

 // 🆕 استاندارد نژاد → انتظار دان/پرنده
 let expectedPerBirdG: number | null = null;
 try {
  const breedObj = breeds.find((b: any) => b.id === selectedFlock?.breedId);
  const bName = breedObj?.name || (selectedFlock as any)?.breedLabel || '';
  if (bName) {
   const std = getStandardFor(bName, { customStandards });
   if (std) {
    // 🆕 استفاده از تاریخ لاگ برای سن دقیق (آپدیت آنی)
    const ag = selectedFlock 
     ? (form.date ? getBirdAgeAt(selectedFlock, form.date) : getAgeDays(selectedFlock)) 
     : 0;
    const rng = findInRange(std.feed, ag);
    expectedPerBirdG = rng?.feedG ?? null;
   }
  }
 } catch { /* silent */ }

 


 // debug info برای نمایش موقت در UI

 const syncSources = (newSources: FeedSource[]) => {
  const total = newSources.reduce((s, x) => s + (x.quantity || 0), 0);
  const first = newSources[0];
  setForm(prev => ({
   ...prev,
   feedSources: newSources,
   feedSourceType: first?.type || '',
   feedSourceId: first?.refId || '',
   feedDelivered: total > 0 ? String(total) : '',
  }));
 };

 const updateSource = (idx: number, patch: Partial<FeedSource>) => {
  syncSources(sources.map((s, i) => i === idx ? { ...s, ...patch } : s));
 };
 const removeSource = (idx: number) => {
  syncSources(sources.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
 };
   const addSource = () => {
    const newId = crypto.randomUUID();
    syncSources([...sources, { id: newId, type: 'item', refId: '', quantity: 0 }]);
    setExpandedSourceId(newId);

    }, 150);
  };

 // ─── محاسبه وضعیت کارت خلاصه ───
 let cardHasShortage = false;
 sources.forEach(src => {
  if (src.type === 'formula') {
   const f = formulas.find(x => x.id === src.refId);
   if (f) {
    f.lines.forEach(line => {
     const ing = ingredients.find(i => i.id === line.ingredientId);
     if (ing) {
      const stockItem = whsItems.find(x => x.id === ing.stockItemId);
      const need = src.quantity > 0 ? (line.percent / 100) * src.quantity : 0;
      if (stockItem && stockItem.currentStock - need < 0) cardHasShortage = true;
     }
    });
   }
  } else if (src.type === 'item') {
   const it = feedItems.find(x => x.id === src.refId);
   if (it && Number(it.currentStock) - Number(src.quantity) < 0) cardHasShortage = true;
  }
 });
 const dailyNeedKg = expectedPerBirdG && flockSize > 0
  ? (expectedPerBirdG * flockSize) / 1000
  : 0;
 const totalAvailable = totalFeed + (Number(form.feedRemaining) || 0);
 const daysAvailable = dailyNeedKg > 0 ? totalAvailable / dailyNeedKg : 0;
 const formatDays = (d: number) => {
  if (d <= 0) return '۰ ساعت';
  if (d < 1) return `${fmt.num(Math.round(d * 24))} ساعت`;
  const wd = Math.floor(d);
  const rh = Math.round((d - wd) * 24);
  if (rh === 0) return `${fmt.num(wd)} روز`;
  if (rh === 24) return `${fmt.num(wd + 1)} روز`;
  return `${fmt.num(wd)} روز و ${fmt.num(rh)} ساعت`;
 };
 const isUnderfed = daysAvailable > 0 && daysAvailable < 0.8;
 const finalSummaryTone = isUnderfed ? 'warn' : 'accent';


 return (

   {(formulas.length > 0 || feedItems.length > 0) && (
      <Btn full onClick={addSource}>
       + افزودن منبع دیگر
      </Btn>
    )}

   {sources.map((src, idx) => {
    const f = src.type === 'formula' ? formulas.find(x => x.id === src.refId) : null;
    const it = src.type === 'item' ? feedItems.find(x => x.id === src.refId) : null;
    const isExpanded = expandedSourceId === src.id;
    const title = f?.name || it?.name || 'منبع جدید';
    const subtitle = f ? 'جیره آماده' : it ? 'دان تکی' : 'هنوز منبعی انتخاب نشده';
    const unitLabel = UNIT_LABEL['kg'] || 'کیلوگرم';

    return (
     <ExpandableCard
       key={src.id}
       data-focus-id={'feed-src-' + src.id}
       variant="inner"
       accent="accent"
       title={title}
       subtitle={subtitle}
       isOpen={isExpanded}
       onToggle={() => setExpandedSourceId(isExpanded ? null : src.id)}
       onDelete={() => removeSource(idx)}
      >
      
      {/* Header */}
      

      {/* Body */}
      {isExpanded && (
       <>
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1.5fr 1fr 1fr', gap: 8, alignItems: 'end' }}>
         <Field label={<>انتخاب منبع <HelpIcon text="**منطق انتخاب منبع:** شما می‌توانید در یک وعده، هم از **جیره آماده** و هم از **دان تکی** (مثل ذرت یا کنجاله) استفاده کنید. اگر جیره انتخاب کنید، سیستم به‌طور خودکار مواد اولیه آن جیره را بر اساس درصدهایش از انبار کسر می‌کند. اگر دان تکی انتخاب کنید، فقط همان آیتم از انبار کم می‌شود." /></>}>
          <SmartSelect
           value={src.refId ? (src.type === 'formula' ? 'f:' : 'i:') + src.refId : ''}
           onChange={val => {
            if (val.startsWith('f:')) updateSource(idx, { type: 'formula', refId: val.slice(2), displayUnit: undefined, displayValue: undefined });
            else if (val.startsWith('i:')) updateSource(idx, { type: 'item', refId: val.slice(2), displayUnit: undefined, displayValue: undefined });
            else updateSource(idx, { type: 'item', refId: '', displayUnit: undefined, displayValue: undefined });
           }}
           options={[
            ...formulas.map(f => ({ value: 'f:' + f.id, label: f.name, subtitle: `${fmt.count(f.lines.length)} ماده`, group: 'formula' })),
            ...feedItems.map(it => ({ value: 'i:' + it.id, label: it.name, subtitle: `موجودی ${fmt.num(it.currentStock)} ${UNIT_LABEL[it.unit]}`, group: 'item' })),
           ]}
           groupLabels={{ formula: 'جیره‌ها', item: 'دان تکی' }}
           groupIcons={{ formula: '📋', item: '🌾' }}
           placeholder="انتخاب..."
           modalTitle="انتخاب منبع"
          />
         </Field>
         <QuantityUnitInput layout="grid"
            label="مقدار"
            value={src.displayValue !== undefined ? src.displayValue : (src.quantity > 0 ? src.quantity : '')}
            unit={src.displayUnit || 'kg'}
            options={getFeedUnitOpts(src, feedItems)}
            onChange={val => {
              const numVal = parseFloat(toEn(val).replace('٫','.')) || 0;
              const opts = getFeedUnitOpts(src, feedItems);
              const factor = opts.find(o => o.value === (src.displayUnit || 'kg'))?.factor || 1;
              updateSource(idx, { displayValue: numVal, quantity: numVal * factor });
            }}
            onUnitChange={u => {
              const opts = getFeedUnitOpts(src, feedItems);
              const factor = opts.find(o => o.value === u)?.factor || 1;
              const qtyKg = src.quantity;
              updateSource(idx, { displayUnit: u, displayValue: factor > 0 ? qtyKg / factor : qtyKg });
            }}
          />
        </div>

        {f && (
         <div style={{ padding: 8, background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 2 }}>مواد اولیه جیره:</div>
          {f.lines.length === 0 && <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--warn)' }}>⚠️ این جیره خطی ندارد</div>}
          {f.lines.map((line, lineIdx) => {
           const ing = ingredients.find(i => i.id === line.ingredientId);
           if (!ing) return null;
           const stockItem = whsItems.find(x => x.id === ing.stockItemId);
           const need = src.quantity > 0 ? (line.percent / 100) * src.quantity : 0;
           const after = stockItem ? stockItem.currentStock - need : 0;
           const unavailable = stockItem && after < 0;
           const unitLabelIng = UNIT_LABEL[stockItem?.unit || 'kg'] || 'کیلوگرم';
           const isLast = lineIdx === f.lines.length - 1;

           return (
            <div key={line.id} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', padding: '6px 0', borderBottom: isLast ? 'none' : '1px dashed var(--border)' }}>
             <span style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>
              • {ing.name} <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>({fmt.num(line.percent)}٪)</span>
             </span>
              <span style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, alignItems: 'center' }}>
               {stockItem && (
                <span style={{ padding: '2px 6px', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', background: unavailable ? 'var(--danger-soft)' : 'var(--success-soft)', color: unavailable ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--success)', border: unavailable ? '1px solid var(--danger-border)' : '1px solid var(--success-border)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', fontWeight: 700, minWidth: 70, textAlign: 'center' }}>
                 موجودی: {fmt.num(stockItem.currentStock)}
                </span>
               )}
               <span style={{ color: unavailable ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, minWidth: 60, textAlign: 'left' }}>
                {need > 0 ? `${fmt.code(need.toFixed(1))} ${unitLabelIng}` : '—'}
               </span>
              </span>
            </div>
           );
          })}
         </div>
        )}

        {it && (() => {
         const remaining = it.currentStock - src.quantity;
         const warn = remaining < it.minStock;
         const unitLabelIng = UNIT_LABEL[it.unit] || '';
         return (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4, padding: '8px 12px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', border: '1px solid var(--border)' }}>
           <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)' }}>
            <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>موجودی انبار:</span>
            <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.num(it.currentStock)} {unitLabelIng}</span>
           </div>
           {src.quantity > 0 && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)' }}>
             <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>مانده پس از مصرف:</span>
             <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: warn ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--accent)' }}>
              {fmt.code(remaining)} {unitLabelIng}
             </span>
            </div>
           )}
           {warn && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--warn)', marginTop: 2 }}>
             ⚠️ موجودی کافی نیست
            </div>
           )}
          </div>
         );
        })()}
       </>
      )}
     </ExpandableCard>
    );
   })}

   



   <Grid2>
    <Field label={<>دان باقی‌مانده <HelpIcon text="**دان باقی‌مانده:** مقداری از دانی که در دانخوری سالن باقی مانده و پرنده‌ها آن را نخورده‌اند. با وارد کردن این عدد، سیستم مصرف واقعی دان را دقیق‌تر محاسبه می‌کند." /></>}>
     <NumField placeholder="۰" value={form.feedRemaining} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, feedRemaining: e.target.value })} unit="kg" min={0} />
    </Field>
    <Field label={<>هدر رفته <HelpIcon text="**هدر رفته:** مقداری از دانی که در مسیر یا دانخوری ریخته شده، یا فاسد شده و توسط پرنده مصرف نشده است. این مقدار از مجموع مصرف کسر می‌شود." /></>}>
     <NumField placeholder="۰" value={form.feedWaste} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, feedWaste: e.target.value })} unit="kg" min={0} />
    </Field>
   </Grid2>

   {sources.length > 0 && (
    <SummaryCard tone={finalSummaryTone}>
     <SummaryRow label="مجموع مصرف:" value={`${fmt.code(totalFeed.toFixed(1))} کیلوگرم`} />
     {dailyNeedKg > 0 && <SummaryRow label="نیاز روزانه:" value={`${fmt.code(dailyNeedKg.toFixed(1))} کیلوگرم`} />}
     {daysAvailable > 0 && <SummaryRow label="دوام دانخوری:" value={isUnderfed ? `⚠️ ${formatDays(daysAvailable)}` : formatDays(daysAvailable)} />}
     {expectedPerBirdG !== null && <SummaryRow label="استاندارد روزانه نژاد:" value={`${fmt.num(expectedPerBirdG)} گرم/پرنده`} />}
    </SummaryCard>
   )}

   {form.waterMethod === 'manual' && (
    <>
     <Grid2>
      <Field label="دفعات آبدهی">
       <NumField placeholder="۵" value={form.waterFillCount} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, waterFillCount: e.target.value })} unit="نوبت" min={0} />
      </Field>
      <Field label="مقدار هر نوبت">
       <NumField placeholder="۲۰" value={form.waterFillVolume} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, waterFillVolume: e.target.value })} unit="L" min={0} />
      </Field>
     </Grid2>
     {(form.waterFillCount && form.waterFillVolume) && (
      <SummaryCard tone="info">
       <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 8 }}>
       <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700 }}>مجموع آب مصرفی:</span>
       <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.num((int(form.waterFillCount) || 0) * (num(form.waterFillVolume) || 0))} لیتر</span>
     </div>
      </SummaryCard>
     )}
    </>
   )}

   {form.waterMethod !== 'manual' && form.waterMethod !== '' && (
    <>
     <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--info-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--info)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--info)', fontWeight: 600 }}>
      💡 سیستم {WATER_SYSTEM_LABEL[form.waterMethod as 'nipple' | 'trough' | 'tank']} — مقدار تخمینی روزانه را وارد کنید
     </div>
     <Field label="مقدار آب مصرفی (تخمینی)" required={isWaterAuto}>
      <NumField placeholder="۱۰۰" value={form.waterAmount} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, waterAmount: e.target.value })} unit="L" min={0} />
     </Field>
     <FieldHint fieldPath="dlg.waterAmount" value={form.waterAmount} context={{ flockSize: flockSize || undefined }} />
     {form.waterAmount && (
      <SummaryCard tone="info">
       <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 8 }}>
       <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700 }}>مجموع آب مصرفی:</span>
       <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.num(int(form.waterAmount) || 0)} لیتر</span>
     </div>
      </SummaryCard>
     )}
    </>
   )}
  </>
 );
}

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
/**
 * FlockPickerSheet.tsx — انتخاب‌گر گله برای ثبت امروز
 * استاندارد: Batch-Centric + ExpandableCard (L10)
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Sheet, Tag } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import ExpandableCard from '../../../shr/components/ExpandableCard';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { useBrd } from '../../brd/store';
import { getAgeDays, type Flock } from '../../flk/store';
import type { DailyLog } from '../store';

const TYPE_LABEL: Record<string, { icon: string; label: string }> = {
  layer:   { icon: '🥚', label: 'تخم‌گذار' },
  broiler: { icon: '🍗', label: 'گوشتی' },
  breeder: { icon: '🧬', label: 'مادر' },
};

const ACCENT_MAP: Record<string, 'accent' | 'warn' | 'purple'> = {
  layer: 'accent', broiler: 'warn', breeder: 'purple',
};

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  flocks: Flock[];
  logs: DailyLog[];
  todayStr: string;
  onEdit: (log: DailyLog) => void;
  onAdd: (flockId: string) => void;
}

export default function FlockPickerSheet({ open, onClose, flocks, logs, todayStr, onEdit, onAdd }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const nav = useNavigate();
  const { breeds } = useBrd();
  const [expandedFlockId, setExpandedFlockId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const items = useMemo(() => {
    return flocks.map(f => {
      const existingLogs = logs.filter(l =>
        l.flockId === f.id && l.date === todayStr && (l.status || 'active') === 'active'
      );
      const deathsToday = existingLogs.reduce((a, l) => a + (l.deathsCount || 0), 0);
      const breed = f.breedKind === 'mixed' ? (f.breedLabel || 'مختلط') : (breeds.find(b => b.id === f.breedId)?.name || '');
      const age = getAgeDays(f);
      const alive = f.currentCount || 0;
      return { flock: f, existingLogs, deathsToday, breed, age, alive };
    });
  }, [flocks, logs, todayStr, breeds]);

  const pending = items.filter(s => s.existingLogs.length === 0).length;

  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onClose={onClose} title="ثبت امروز — انتخاب گله">
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4, padding: '4px 0', maxHeight: '60vh', overflowY: 'auto' }}>
        {items.length > 0 && (
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: 8 }}>
            {fmt.count(pending)} گله از {fmt.count(flocks.length)} منتظر ثبت
          </div>
        )}
        {items.length === 0 && (
          <div style={{ padding: '24px 16px', textAlign: 'center', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 28 }}>🐔</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>
              هنوز گله فعالی ثبت نشده است
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', lineHeight: 1.6, maxWidth: 280 }}>
              برای ثبت گزارش روزانه (دما، دان، آب، تلفات و تخم)، ابتدا یک گله جدید ایجاد یا فعال کنید.
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => { onClose(); nav('/flk'); }}
              style={{
                marginTop: 6,
                padding: '10px 18px',
                borderRadius: 10,
                border: 'none',
                background: 'var(--accent)',
                color: '#fff',
                fontWeight: 700,
                fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              + رفتن به بخش گله‌ها
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
        {items.map(({ flock, existingLogs, deathsToday, breed, age, alive }) => {
          const typeInfo = TYPE_LABEL[flock.type] || { icon: '🐔', label: flock.type };
          const showBreed = !!breed && breed !== flock.name;
          const hasLogs = existingLogs.length > 0;
          const isExpanded = expandedFlockId === flock.id;
          const metaParts = [
            showBreed ? breed : null,
            typeInfo.label,
            `${fmt.num(age)} روز`,
            `${fmt.count(alive)} زنده`,
            deathsToday > 0 ? `💀 ${fmt.count(deathsToday)}` : null,
          ].filter(Boolean) as string[];

          return (
            <ExpandableCard
              key={flock.id}
              accent={ACCENT_MAP[flock.type] || 'accent'}
              iconEmoji={typeInfo.icon}
              title={flock.name || '—'}
              subtitle={metaParts.join(' • ')}
              badge={
                hasLogs
                  ? <Tag tone="accent">{fmt.count(existingLogs.length)} ثبت</Tag>
                  : <Tag tone="warn">ثبت نشده</Tag>
              }
              isOpen={isExpanded}
              onToggle={() => {
                if (!hasLogs) { onAdd(flock.id); onClose(); }
                else setExpandedFlockId(isExpanded ? null : flock.id);
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 6, paddingTop: 8 }}>
                {/* دکمه ثبت جدید در سمت راست */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => { onAdd(flock.id); onClose(); }}
                  style={{
                    flex: '1 1 calc(50% - 6px)', minWidth: 110,
                    padding: '8px 10px', background: 'var(--accent)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--accent)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                    color: '#fff', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                    fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  ➕ ثبت جدید
                </button>

                {/* دکمه‌های ویرایش در سمت چپ */}
                {existingLogs.map(log => (
                  <button
                    key={log.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => { onEdit(log); onClose(); }}
                    style={{
                      flex: '1 1 calc(50% - 6px)', minWidth: 110,
                      padding: '8px 10px', background: 'var(--card)',
                      border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                      color: 'var(--text)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                      cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 600,
                    }}
                  >
                    ✏️ {fmt.code(log.entryTime || '—')}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </ExpandableCard>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

/**
 * FormModal — فرم افزودن/ویرایش ثبت روزانه
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import type { Dispatch, SetStateAction } from 'react';
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useFlk } from '../../flk/store';
import type { F } from '../types';
import type { Flock } from '../../flk/store';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { FEED_SYSTEM_LABEL, WATER_SYSTEM_LABEL } from '../../../shr/utils/systemType';
import SmartSelect from '../../../shr/components/SmartSelect';
import { Btn, BtnRow, Field, Grid2, Modal, ErrorBox, SectionTitle, AlertBox, Textarea } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import DatePicker from '../../../shr/components/DatePicker';
import TimePicker from '../../../shr/components/TimePicker';
import { getAgeDays } from '../../flk/store';
import EnvironmentSection from './EnvironmentSection';
import FeedSection from './FeedSection';
import EggsWeightSection from './EggsWeightSection';
import HealthSection from './HealthSection';

export interface FormModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  form: F;
  setForm: Dispatch<SetStateAction<F>>;
  save: () => void;
  saving: boolean;
  err: string;
  vErrors: Record<string, string>;
  selectedFlock: Flock | undefined;
  flockAliveCount: number;
  isLayerFlock: boolean;
  isLayerType: boolean;
  isFlockMature: boolean;
  vaccineEnabled: boolean;
  medicineEnabled: boolean;
  onFlockChange: (id: string) => void;
  showError: (field: string) => string | undefined;
  markTouched: (field: string) => void;
}

export default function FormModal(props: FormModalProps) {
  const {
    open, onClose, form, setForm, save, err, vErrors,
    showError, markTouched,
    selectedFlock, flockAliveCount, isLayerFlock, isLayerType,
    isFlockMature, vaccineEnabled, medicineEnabled, onFlockChange,
  } = props;

  const { flocks } = useFlk();
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const activeFlocks = useMemo(() => flocks.filter(f => f.status === 'active' && !f.paused && !f.hidden), [flocks]);

  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title={form.id ? 'ویرایش ثبت روزانه' : 'ثبت روزانه جدید'}
      footer={<BtnRow><Btn variant="primary" onClick={save}>ذخیره</Btn><Btn onClick={onClose}>لغو</Btn></BtnRow>}>
      <Grid2>
        <Field label="تاریخ" required error={showError('date')} onTouch={() => markTouched('date')}>
          <DatePicker value={form.date} onChange={v => setForm({ ...form, date: v })} autoToday />
        </Field>
        <Field label="ساعت ورود" required>
          <TimePicker value={form.entryTime} onChange={v => setForm({ ...form, entryTime: v })} placeholder="انتخاب ساعت" />
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      <Field
          label={form.id ? <span>گله <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--warn)' }}>🔒</span></span> : 'گله'}
          hint={form.id ? 'در حالت ویرایش امکان تغییر گله نیست' : undefined}
          required
          error={showError('flockId')}
          onTouch={() => markTouched('flockId')}
        >
        <SmartSelect
          value={form.flockId}
          onChange={onFlockChange}
          options={activeFlocks.map(f => ({
            value: f.id, label: f.name,
            subtitle: f.currentCount ? `${fmt.count(f.currentCount)} پرنده` : undefined,
          }))}
          placeholder="— انتخاب گله —"
          modalTitle="انتخاب گله"
            disabled={Boolean(form.id)}
        />
      </Field>


      <SectionTitle>🌡 محیط و پرنده</SectionTitle>
      <EnvironmentSection form={form} setForm={setForm} vErrors={vErrors} showError={showError} markTouched={markTouched} />

      <SectionTitle>🍽 تغذیه و آب</SectionTitle>
      <FeedSection form={form} setForm={setForm} vErrors={vErrors} showError={showError} markTouched={markTouched} />

      {isLayerType && !isFlockMature && selectedFlock && (
        <AlertBox tone="warn" variant="dashed" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>گله هنوز به سن تخم‌گذاری نرسیده ({fmt.int(getAgeDays(selectedFlock))} از {fmt.int(selectedFlock.layingStartDay)} روز)؛ فرم پس از بلوغ فعال می‌شود.</AlertBox>
      )}

      {isLayerFlock && (
        <>
          <SectionTitle>🥚 تخم و وزن</SectionTitle>
          <EggsWeightSection form={form} setForm={setForm} vErrors={vErrors} flockAliveCount={flockAliveCount} showError={showError} markTouched={markTouched} />
        </>
      )}

      <SectionTitle>🏥 سلامت</SectionTitle>
      <HealthSection
        form={form} setForm={setForm} vErrors={vErrors}
        flockAliveCount={flockAliveCount}
        vaccineEnabled={vaccineEnabled}
        medicineEnabled={medicineEnabled} showError={showError} markTouched={markTouched} />

      <SectionTitle>📝 یادداشت روز</SectionTitle>
      <Field label="یادداشت">
        <Textarea
          rows={3}
          placeholder="توضیحات، شرایط جوی، رفتار گله..."
          value={form.notes}
          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, notes: e.target.value }))}
        />
      </Field>


      {err && <ErrorBox>{err}</ErrorBox>}
    </Modal>
  );
}

import type { HealthRoute } from '../../../shr/calc/types';

function getDoseUnit(u: string | undefined): string {
  if (!u) return 'ml';
  const lu = u.toLowerCase();
  if (lu === 'vial') return 'دوز';
  if (lu === 'ml' || lu === 'l') return 'ml';
  if (lu === 'g' || lu === 'kg') return 'g';
  return u;
}

function getDoseUnitForMethod(method: string | undefined, baseUnit: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  const u = getDoseUnit(baseUnit);
  if (!method) return u;  // ← fallback: اگر روش مصرف انتخاب نشده، واحد پایه را نشان بده
  if (method === 'drinking_water') return `${u}/L`;
  if (method === 'feed') return `${u}/kg`;
  if (method === 'injection' || method === 'oral') return `${u}/پرنده`;
  return u;
}

interface Props {
 form: F;
 setForm: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<F>>;
 vErrors: Record<string, string>;
 flockAliveCount: number;
 vaccineEnabled: boolean;
 medicineEnabled: boolean;
 showError: (field: string) => string | undefined;
 markTouched: (field: string) => void;
}

function getAllowedMethods(item: any): typeof VET_METHOD_OPTIONS {
  if (!item) return VET_METHOD_OPTIONS;
  const raw: string[] = item.usageTypes || (item.usageType ? [item.usageType] : []);
  if (raw.length === 0) return VET_METHOD_OPTIONS;
  const normalize = (k: string) => k === 'water' ? 'drinking_water' : k === 'injectable' ? 'injection' : k;
  const normalized = raw.map(normalize);
  return VET_METHOD_OPTIONS.filter(o => normalized.includes(o.value));
}

        const mCalcMsg = mCalc ? (
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: mCalc.hasData ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 600, marginTop: 8, textAlign: 'center' }}>
            {mCalc.hasData ? `💡 نیاز محاسبه‌شده: ${fmt.num(mCalc.requiredMl ?? 0)} میلی‌لیتر (${mCalc.reason})` : !m.method ? 'ℹ️ لطفاً برای محاسبه خودکار، روش مصرف را انتخاب کنید.' : `ℹ️ ${mCalc.reason}`}
          </div>
        ) : null;

        if (!qtyField) return <><Grid2>{doseField}{withdrawalField}</Grid2>{mCalcMsg}</>;
        if (hasSub) return <>{qtyField}<Grid2>{doseField}{withdrawalField}</Grid2>{mCalcMsg}</>;
        return <><Grid2>{qtyField}{doseField}</Grid2>{withdrawalField}{mCalcMsg}</>;
      })()}
    </>)}
     </ExpandableCard>
     );
    })}
   </>)}

   {(form.deaths.length > 0 || form.vaccines.length > 0 || form.medications.length > 0) && (() => {
    const totalDeaths = form.deaths.reduce((a, x) => a + (x.count || 0), 0);
    const exceeds = flockAliveCount > 0 && totalDeaths > flockAliveCount;
    const vaccineCount = form.vaccines.length;
    const medsTotal = form.medications.length;
    const medsHerbal = form.medications.filter(m => medicineItems.find(w => w.id === m.itemId)?.category === 'herbal').length;
    const medsChem = medsTotal - medsHerbal;

    const medParts = [];
    if (medsChem > 0) medParts.push(`${fmt.count(medsChem)} 💊`);
    if (medsHerbal > 0) medParts.push(`${fmt.count(medsHerbal)} 🌿`);
    const medSummary = medParts.join(' + ');
    
    const deathCauses = form.deaths.map(d => d.cause ? causeLabel(d.cause) : '').filter(Boolean).join('، ');

    return (
      <SummaryCard>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', textAlign: 'right', width: '100%' }} dir="rtl">
          {totalDeaths > 0 && (
            <SummarySection
              title="تلفات:"
              meta={
                <>
                  <span style={{ color: exceeds ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--warn)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    {fmt.count(totalDeaths)} پرنده
                  </span>
                  {flockAliveCount ? ` از ${fmt.count(flockAliveCount)}` : ''} {exceeds && '⚠️'}
                </>
              }
              first={true}
            >
              <SummaryRow label="علت" value={deathCauses || 'نامشخص'} />
            </SummarySection>
          )}

          {vaccineCount > 0 && (
            <SummarySection title="واکسن‌ها:" meta={`${fmt.count(vaccineCount)} مورد`} first={totalDeaths === 0}>
              {form.vaccines.map((v, idx) => (
                <SummaryRow
                  key={v.id || idx}
                  label={v.name || 'بدون نام'}
                  value={v.dose ? `دوز: ${fmt.code(v.dose)}` : ''}
                  detail={v.quantity ? `مقدار: ${fmt.num(v.quantity)} ${v.unit || ''}` : ''}
                />
              ))}
            </SummarySection>
          )}

          {medsTotal > 0 && (
            <SummarySection title="داروها:" meta={`${fmt.count(medsTotal)} مورد`} first={totalDeaths === 0 && vaccineCount === 0}>
              {form.medications.map((m, idx) => (
                <SummaryRow
                  key={m.id || idx}
                  label={m.name || 'بدون نام'}
                  value={m.dose ? `دوز: ${fmt.code(m.dose)}` : ''}
                  detail={m.quantity ? `مقدار: ${fmt.num(m.quantity)} ${m.unit || ''}` : ''}
                />
              ))}
            </SummarySection>
          )}
        </div>
      </SummaryCard>
    );
   })()}

  </>
 );
}

/**
 * LogCard.tsx — کارت نمایش یک ثبت روزانه
 *
 * تمام JSX کارت اینجاست. کامپوننت خالص نمایشی با callback ها.
