import { useFormat, getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import type { DailyLog } from '../store';
import type { Flock } from '../../flk/store';
import {
  VENTILATION_LABEL, LITTER_LABEL, BEHAVIOR_LABEL,
  DISTRIBUTION_LABEL, SOUND_LABEL, causeLabel,
  avgWeight, sumWeight, cvWeight,
} from '../store';
import { calculateEnvironmentWarnings } from '../../../shr/calc';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { format as formatJ, parse as parseJ, differenceInCalendarDays } from 'date-fns-jalali';
import { getEffectiveEnv, getMortalityRange } from '../../set/standards/resolve';
import { useSet } from '../../set/store';
import { getAgeDays } from '../../flk/store';
import { Btn, Tag } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { BadgeOverflow, type BadgeItem } from '../../../shr/components/ui/BadgeOverflow';
import ExpandableCard from '../../../shr/components/ExpandableCard';
import { LogSection, Row, LogGroup, LogSubSection, LogItem } from '../helpers';
import { VET_METHOD_LABEL } from '../../../shr/constants/vetMethods';
import { GENDER_LABEL, formatWeightGrams, cvText } from '../../../shr/utils/weightHelpers';
import { calculateWeightMetrics } from '../../../shr/calc';
import { applyCorrections, getSafeHealthArrays } from '../api/applyCorrections';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../../cor/store/dialog';
import { Grid2, Grid3 } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { CardActions } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { ACTION_PRESETS } from '../../../shr/constants/cardActions';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';

export interface LogCardProps {
  log: DailyLog;
  index: number;
  flock: Flock | undefined;
  birdName: string | undefined;
  isOpen: boolean;
  selectionMode: boolean;
  vaccineEnabled: boolean;
  medicineEnabled: boolean;
  ms: any;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onArchive: () => void;
  onRestore: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
  onCorrect: () => void;
  onHistory?: () => void;
  onRevokeCorrection: (correctionId: string) => void;
}

const FIELD_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  temperature: 'دما',
  temperatureMin: 'حداقل دما',
  temperatureMax: 'حداکثر دما',
  humidity: 'رطوبت',
  humidityMin: 'حداقل رطوبت',
  humidityMax: 'حداکثر رطوبت',
  feedDelivered: 'دان داده‌شده',
  feedRemaining: 'دان باقی‌مانده',
  feedConsumed: 'دان مصرفی',
  feedWaste: 'دان هدر رفته',
  waterAmount: 'آب مصرفی',
  waterFillCount: 'دفعات آب',
  waterFillVolume: 'حجم هر نوبت',
  deathsCount: 'تلفات',
  eatingEggs: 'تخم خوراکی',
  fertileEggs: 'تخم نطفه‌دار',
  brokenEggs: 'تخم شکسته',
  otherEggs: 'تخم سایر',
  weightGender: 'جنسیت وزن',
};

export default function LogCard(props: LogCardProps) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const {
    log: rawLog, index: i, flock, birdName,
    isOpen, selectionMode, vaccineEnabled, medicineEnabled, ms,
    onToggle, onEdit, onArchive, onRestore, onDelete, onCorrect, onRevokeCorrection, onHistory,
  } = props;

  // 🆕 مقدار effective = با corrections اعمال‌شده
  const l = applyCorrections(rawLog);
  const hasCorrections = (rawLog.corrections || []).some(c => !c.revoked);
  const hasAnyCorrections = (rawLog.corrections || []).length > 0;

  // 🆕 خواندن محدوده استاندارد بر اساس پرنده و سن
  const customStandards = useSet((s: any) => s.customStandards) || {};
  let stdTempMin: number | null = null;
  let stdTempMax: number | null = null;
  let stdTempTarget: number | null = null;
  let stdHumMin: number | null = null;
  let stdHumMax: number | null = null;

  let mortalityStd: any = null;
  if (flock && birdName) {
      try {
        const age = getAgeDays(flock);
        const env = getEffectiveEnv(birdName, age, null, { customStandards });
        stdTempMin = env.temp?.min ?? null;
        stdTempMax = env.temp?.max ?? null;
        stdTempTarget = env.temp?.target ?? null;
        stdHumMin = env.humidity?.min ?? null;
        stdHumMax = env.humidity?.max ?? null;
        mortalityStd = getMortalityRange(birdName, l.birdAgeDays ?? age, { customStandards });
      } catch { /* silent */ }
  }

  // 🆕 BUG-2 fix: اولویت بازه کاربر بر استاندارد نژاد
  const effTempMin = l.temperatureMin ?? stdTempMin;
  const effTempMax = l.temperatureMax ?? stdTempMax;
  const effHumMin = l.humidityMin ?? stdHumMin;
  const effHumMax = l.humidityMax ?? stdHumMax;

  const envWarn = calculateEnvironmentWarnings({
    tempC: l.temperature,
    tempMin: effTempMin,
    tempMax: effTempMax,
    tempTarget: stdTempTarget,
    humidityPct: l.humidity,
    humidityMin: effHumMin,
    humidityMax: effHumMax,
  });

  // 🆕 BUG-2: هشدار تناقض بازه کاربر با استاندارد نژاد
  const humMismatch = l.humidityMin !== null && l.humidityMax !== null && stdHumMin !== null && stdHumMax !== null
    && (l.humidityMin < stdHumMin - 10 || l.humidityMax > stdHumMax + 10);
  const tempMismatch = l.temperatureMin !== null && l.temperatureMax !== null && stdTempMin !== null && stdTempMax !== null
    && (l.temperatureMin < stdTempMin - 3 || l.temperatureMax > stdTempMax + 3);
  const tWarn = envWarn.tempTone;
  const hWarn = envWarn.humidityTone;
  const tIsBad = tWarn === 'warn' || tWarn === 'danger';
  const hIsBad = hWarn === 'warn' || hWarn === 'danger';
  const baseCount = (flock?.currentCount || 0) + (l.deathsCount || 0);
  const mortalityPct = baseCount > 0 ? ((l.deathsCount || 0) / baseCount) * 100 : 0;
  const isMortalityHigh = l.deathsCount > 0 && mortalityStd && mortalityPct > mortalityStd.maxPct;

  const hasProblem = tIsBad || hIsBad || isMortalityHigh;
  const accent: any = hasProblem ? 'warn' : 'accent';

  // 🆕 محاسبه روزهای گذشته از تاریخ لاگ (منطق ۳ روز)
  const daysSinceLog = (() => {
    try {
      const logDate = parseJ(l.date, 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
      const today = new Date();
      return differenceInCalendarDays(today, logDate);
    } catch {
      return 0;
    }
  })();
  const isEditLocked = daysSinceLog > 3;


  // 🆕 BadgeOverflow badges
  const allBadges: BadgeItem[] = [];
  if (hasCorrections) allBadges.push({ key: 'corrections', node: <Tag tone="blue">اصلاح‌شده</Tag> });
  if (l.deathsCount > 0) {
    allBadges.push({ key: 'deaths', node: <Tag tone={isMortalityHigh ? "amber" : "blue"}>{fmt.count(l.deathsCount)} تلفات</Tag> });
  }

  return (
    <ExpandableCard
      id={l.id} ms={ms} accent={accent}
      index={fmt.count(i + 1)} iconEmoji="📋"
      title={flock?.name || '—'}
      subtitle={`${fmt.date(l.date)}${l.entryTime ? ` • ${fmt.code(l.entryTime)}` : ''}${l.birdAgeDays !== null && l.birdAgeDays > 0 ? ` • ${fmt.num(l.birdAgeDays)} روز` : ''}${birdName ? ` • ${birdName}` : ''}`}
      isOpen={isOpen} onToggle={onToggle}
      badge={<BadgeOverflow badges={allBadges} max={2} modalTitle={`برچسب‌های «${flock?.name || 'لاگ'}»`} />}
      stats={<>
        {l.temperature !== null && <span>🌡 {fmt.num(l.temperature)}°</span>}
        {l.humidity !== null && <span>💧 {fmt.num(l.humidity)}٪</span>}
        {l.feedDelivered !== null && <span>🌾 {fmt.num(l.feedDelivered)} کیلوگرم</span>}
        {l.waterAmount !== null && <span>💧 {fmt.num(l.waterAmount)} لیتر</span>}
      </>}
    >
      <LogSection title="🌡 محیط">
        <Grid2>
          {l.temperature !== null && <Row l="دما" v={`${fmt.num(l.temperature)} °C`} warn={tIsBad} />}
          {l.humidity !== null && <Row l="رطوبت" v={`${fmt.num(l.humidity)} ٪`} warn={hIsBad} />}
          {(l.temperatureMin !== null || l.temperatureMax !== null) && (
            <Row l="بازه دما" v={`${l.temperatureMin !== null ? fmt.num(l.temperatureMin) : '—'} تا ${l.temperatureMax !== null ? fmt.num(l.temperatureMax) : '—'} °C`} warn={tempMismatch} />
          )}
          {(l.humidityMin !== null || l.humidityMax !== null) && (
            <Row l="بازه رطوبت" v={`${l.humidityMin !== null ? fmt.num(l.humidityMin) : '—'} تا ${l.humidityMax !== null ? fmt.num(l.humidityMax) : '—'} ٪`} warn={humMismatch} />
          )}
          {l.ventilation !== 'ok' && <Row l="تهویه" v={VENTILATION_LABEL[l.ventilation] || '—'} />}
          {l.litter !== 'dry' && <Row l="بستر" v={LITTER_LABEL[l.litter] || '—'} />}
        </Grid2>
      </LogSection>

      {(l.behavior !== 'active' || l.distribution !== 'uniform' || l.sound !== 'normal' || l.appearance) && (
        <LogSection title="🐔 مشاهده پرنده">
          <Grid3>
            {l.behavior !== 'active' && <Row l="رفتار" v={BEHAVIOR_LABEL[l.behavior] || '—'} />}
            {l.distribution !== 'uniform' && <Row l="توزیع" v={DISTRIBUTION_LABEL[l.distribution] || '—'} />}
            {l.sound !== 'normal' && <Row l="صدا" v={SOUND_LABEL[l.sound] || '—'} />}
          </Grid3>
          {l.appearance && <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', lineHeight: 1.7 }}>{l.appearance}</div>}
        </LogSection>
      )}

      {(l.feedDelivered !== null || l.waterAmount !== null) && (
        <LogSection title="🌾 تغذیه و آب">
          <Grid2>
            {l.feedType && <Row l="جیره/دان" v={l.feedType} />}
            {l.feedDelivered !== null && <Row l="دان داده‌شده" v={`${fmt.num(l.feedDelivered)} کیلوگرم`} />}
            {l.feedConsumed !== null && l.feedConsumed !== undefined && l.feedConsumed !== l.feedDelivered && (
              <Row l="دان مصرف‌شده" v={`${fmt.num(l.feedConsumed)} کیلوگرم`} />
            )}
            {l.feedConsumed !== null && l.feedConsumed > 0 && flock && (flock.currentCount || 0) > 0 && (() => {
              const g = (l.feedConsumed * 1000) / (flock.currentCount || 1);
              const isWarn = g < 5 || g > 300;
              return <Row l="دان/پرنده" v={`${fmt.code(g.toFixed(1))} گرم`} warn={isWarn} />;
            })()}
            {l.feedRemaining !== null && <Row l="باقیمانده" v={`${fmt.num(l.feedRemaining)} کیلوگرم`} />}
            {l.waterAmount !== null && <Row l="آب" v={`${fmt.num(l.waterAmount)} لیتر`} />}
            {l.waterFillCount !== null && l.waterFillVolume !== null && (
              <Row l="روش آب" v={`${fmt.num(l.waterFillCount)} بار × ${fmt.num(l.waterFillVolume)} لیتر`} />
            )}
            {(() => {
              const effectiveFeed = (l.feedConsumed && l.feedConsumed > 0) ? l.feedConsumed : l.feedDelivered;
              if (!l.waterAmount || !effectiveFeed || effectiveFeed <= 0) return null;
              return <Row l="نسبت آب/دان" v={fmt.code((l.waterAmount / effectiveFeed).toFixed(2))} />;
            })()}
          </Grid2>
        </LogSection>
      )}

      {((l.eatingEggs || 0) + (l.fertileEggs || 0) + (l.brokenEggs || 0) + (l.otherEggs || 0)) > 0 && (
        <LogSection title="🥚 تخم">
          <Grid2>
            {l.eatingEggs ? <Row l="خوراکی" v={fmt.count(l.eatingEggs)} /> : null}
            {l.fertileEggs ? <Row l="نطفه‌دار" v={fmt.count(l.fertileEggs)} /> : null}
          </Grid2>
          <Grid2>
            {l.brokenEggs ? <Row l="شکسته" v={fmt.count(l.brokenEggs)} /> : null}
            {l.otherEggs ? <Row l="سایر" v={fmt.count(l.otherEggs)} /> : null}
          </Grid2>
          <Row l="مجموع" v={fmt.num((l.eatingEggs||0)+(l.fertileEggs||0)+(l.brokenEggs||0)+(l.otherEggs||0))} />
        </LogSection>
      )}

      {l.weightSamples && l.weightSamples.length > 0 && (() => {
        const parseW = (s: string | number): number => {
          const str = String(s).replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d))).replace('٫', '.');
          return parseFloat(str) || 0;
        };
        const weights = l.weightSamples.map(w => parseW(w.weight)).filter(w => w > 0);
        if (weights.length === 0) return null;
        const hasThree = weights.length >= 3;
        const metrics = hasThree ? calculateWeightMetrics({
          samples: weights.map((w, i) => ({ id: String(i), weight: w })),
          previousAvgWeightG: null,
          ageDays: l.birdAgeDays ?? 0,
          standardWeightG: null,
        }) : null;
        const avg = metrics && metrics.hasData ? metrics.avgWeightG : (weights.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / weights.length);
        const cv = metrics && metrics.hasData ? metrics.cvPct : cvWeight(l.weightSamples);
        const cvLbl = cvText(cv);
        return (
          <LogSection title="⚖️ وزن‌کشی">
            <Grid2>
              <Row l="تعداد نمونه" v={fmt.count(weights.length)} />
              <Row l="میانگین" v={formatWeightGrams(avg)} />
            </Grid2>
            <Grid2>
              {l.weightGender ? (
                <Row l="جنسیت" v={GENDER_LABEL[l.weightGender] || l.weightGender} />
              ) : <div />}
              <Row l="ضریب تغییرات" v={`${fmt.num(cv)}٪`} />
            </Grid2>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: cvLbl.color, fontWeight: 600, paddingRight: 4, marginTop: 2 }}>
              {cvLbl.text}
            </div>
            {metrics && metrics.hasData && (
              <Row l="یکنواختی" v={`${fmt.num(metrics.uniformityPct)}٪`} accent={metrics.uniformityPct >= 80} />
            )}
          </LogSection>
        );
      })()}

      {(() => {
        const { deaths, vaccines, medications } = getSafeHealthArrays(l);
        const hasDeaths = deaths.length > 0;
        const hasVaccines = vaccineEnabled && vaccines.length > 0;
        const hasMeds = medicineEnabled && medications.length > 0;
        if (!hasDeaths && !hasVaccines && !hasMeds) return null;
        return (
          <LogSection title="🏥 سلامت">
            {hasDeaths && (
              <Grid2>
                {deaths.map(d => (
                  <Row key={d.id} l="تلفات" v={`${fmt.num(d.count)} پرنده`} warn={isMortalityHigh} />
                ))}
              </Grid2>
            )}

            {hasVaccines && (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4, marginTop: hasDeaths ? 8 : 0 }}>
                {vaccines.map(v => {
                  const methodLabel = v.method ? (VET_METHOD_LABEL[v.method] || v.method) : null;
                  const detail = [
                    v.name || 'بدون نام',
                    v.dose ? `دوز ${fmt.code(v.dose)}` : null,
                    methodLabel,
                    v.quantity ? `مقدار ${fmt.num(v.quantity)} ${v.unit || ''}` : null,
                  ].filter(Boolean).join(' • ');
                  return <Row key={v.id} l="واکسن" v={detail} />;
                })}
              </div>
            )}

            {hasMeds && (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4, marginTop: (hasDeaths || hasVaccines) ? 8 : 0 }}>
                {medications.map(m => {
                  const methodLabel = m.method ? (VET_METHOD_LABEL[m.method] || m.method) : null;
                  const detail = [
                    m.name || 'بدون نام',
                    m.dose ? `دوز ${fmt.code(m.dose)}` : null,
                    methodLabel,
                    m.quantity ? `مقدار ${fmt.num(m.quantity)} ${m.unit || ''}` : null,
                    m.withdrawalDays ? `پرهیز ${fmt.num(m.withdrawalDays)} روز` : null,
                  ].filter(Boolean).join(' • ');
                  return <Row key={m.id} l="دارو" v={detail} />;
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </LogSection>
        );
      })()}

      {l.notes && (
        <LogSection title="📝 یادداشت">
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', lineHeight: 1.7, padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>{l.notes}</div>
        </LogSection>
      )}

      {hasAnyCorrections && (
        <LogSection title="📝 تاریخچه اصلاحات">
          {(rawLog.corrections || []).map(corr => {
              const changeKeys = Object.keys(corr.changes);
              const pairedKeys = new Set<string>();
              const groupedChanges: string[][] = [];
              const PAIRS: [string, string][] = [
                ['temperatureMin', 'temperatureMax'],
                ['humidityMin', 'humidityMax'],
                ['eatingEggs', 'fertileEggs'],
                ['brokenEggs', 'otherEggs'],
                ['feedRemaining', 'feedWaste'],
                ['waterFillCount', 'waterFillVolume'],
              ];

              for (const [a, b] of PAIRS) {
                const sel = [a, b].filter(k => changeKeys.includes(k));
                if (sel.length > 0) {
                  groupedChanges.push(sel);
                  sel.forEach(k => pairedKeys.add(k));
                }
              }
              for (const k of changeKeys) {
                if (!pairedKeys.has(k)) groupedChanges.push([k]);
              }

              return (
                <div
                  key={corr.id}
                  style={{
                    padding: 'var(--pad-tight)',
                    background: 'var(--card)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                    borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                    opacity: corr.revoked ? 0.6 : 1,
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    gap: 6,
                    marginBottom: 8,
                  }}
                >
                  {/* Header */}
                  <div style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 8,
                    borderBottom: '1px dashed var(--border)',
                    paddingBottom: 6,
                  }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 6, textDecoration: corr.revoked ? 'line-through' : 'none' }}>
                      <span style={{
                        fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
                        color: 'var(--muted)',
                      }}>{fmt.code(corr.timestamp)}</span>
                      <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)' }}>({corr.reason})</span>
                    </div>
                    {corr.revoked ? (
                      <span style={{
                        background: 'var(--danger-soft)',
                        color: 'var(--danger)',
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        padding: '2px 8px',
                        borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                        fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs, 10px)',
                      }}>لغو شده</span>
                    ) : (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={async (e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
                            'لغو اصلاح',
                            `اصلاح ${fmt.code(corr.timestamp)} لغو شود؟ (مقادیر به حالت قبل برمی‌گردند)`
                          );
                          if (ok) onRevokeCorrection(corr.id);
                        }}
                        style={{
                          padding: '2px 8px',
                          background: 'transparent',
                          border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                          borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                          fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs, 10px)',
                          color: 'var(--muted)',
                          cursor: 'pointer',
                          fontFamily: 'inherit',
                        }}
                      >↩️ لغو</button>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Body */}
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
                    {groupedChanges.map((group, gIdx) => {
                      const content = group.map(k => {
                          const oldVal = (rawLog as any)[k];
                          const newVal = (corr.changes as any)[k];
                          const label = FIELD_LABEL[k] || k;

                          const formatFieldVal = (v: any) => {
                            if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return '—';
                            if (k === 'weightGender') {
                              const opts: any = { '': 'نامشخص', 'male': 'نر', 'female': 'ماده', 'mixed': 'مخلوط' };
                              return opts[v] || v;
                            }
                            return fmt.code(String(v));
                          };

                          return (
                            <Row
                              key={k}
                              l={
                                <span style={{
                                  fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                                  color: corr.revoked ? 'var(--muted)' : 'var(--text)',
                                  textDecoration: corr.revoked ? 'line-through' : 'none',
                                  wordBreak: 'break-word',
                                }}>
                                  {label}
                                </span>
                              }
                              v={
                                <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, textDecoration: corr.revoked ? 'line-through' : 'none', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                                  {/* مقدار جدید (سبز) سمت راست */}
                                  <span style={{ color: corr.revoked ? 'var(--muted)' : 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700 }}>{formatFieldVal(newVal)}</span>
                                  {/* فلش به سمت مقدار جدید */}
                                  <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)' }}>→</span>
                                  {/* مقدار قبلی (قرمز) سمت چپ */}
                                  <span style={{ color: corr.revoked ? 'var(--muted)' : 'var(--danger)' }}>{formatFieldVal(oldVal)}</span>
                                </span>
                              }
                            />
                          );
                      });
                      if (group.length > 1) {
                        return <Grid2 key={gIdx}>{content}</Grid2>;
                      }
                      return <div key={gIdx} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>{content}</div>;
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
        </LogSection>
      )}

      <CardActions actions={[
        { ...ACTION_PRESETS.EDIT, onClick: onEdit, hidden: (l.status || 'active') !== 'active', disabled: isEditLocked },
        { ...ACTION_PRESETS.CORRECT, onClick: onCorrect, hidden: (l.status || 'active') !== 'active' },
        { ...ACTION_PRESETS.HISTORY, onClick: () => onHistory?.(), hidden: onHistory === undefined },
        { ...ACTION_PRESETS.RESTORE, onClick: onRestore, hidden: (l.status || 'active') === 'active' },
        { ...ACTION_PRESETS.DELETE, onClick: onDelete, hidden: (l.status || 'active') === 'active' },
      ]} />
    </ExpandableCard>
  );
}

/**
 * useDlgForm — مدیریت state و منطق فرم ثبت روزانه
 */
import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { DailyLog } from '../store';
import type { F } from '../types';
import type { Flock } from '../../flk/store';
import type { Hall } from '../../hal/store';
import { isLayingReady } from '../../flk/store';
import { useFed } from '../../fed/store';
import { useDlg } from '../store';
import { toFa, toEn } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { feedSystemFromHall, waterSystemFromHall } from '../../../shr/utils/systemType';
import { showAlert } from '../../../cor/store/dialog';
import { showToast } from '../../../cor/store/toast';

export function newLog(flockId = ''): F {
  return {
    flockId, date: '', entryTime: '',
    temperature: '', temperatureMin: '', temperatureMax: '',
    humidity: '', humidityMin: '', humidityMax: '',
    ventilation: 'ok', litter: 'dry',
    behavior: 'active', distribution: 'uniform', appearance: '', sound: 'normal',
    feedType: '', feedDelivered: '', feedRemaining: '', feedWaste: '',
    feedSourceType: '', feedSourceId: '', feedSources: [], feedMovementIds: [], feedMethod: '',
    waterMethod: '', waterAmount: '', waterFillCount: '', waterFillVolume: '',
    weightSamples: [], weightGender: '',
    eatingEggs: '', fertileEggs: '', brokenEggs: '', otherEggs: '',
    deaths: [], vaccines: [], medications: [],
    notes: '',
  };
}

export interface UseDlgFormParams {
  activeFlocks: Flock[];
  halls: Hall[];
  todayStr: string;
}

export function dailyLogToForm(l: DailyLog): F {
  return {
      id: l.id, flockId: l.flockId, date: l.date, entryTime: l.entryTime,
      temperature: l.temperature != null ? getGlobalFormat().code(l.temperature) : '',
      temperatureMin: l.temperatureMin != null ? getGlobalFormat().code(l.temperatureMin) : '',
      temperatureMax: l.temperatureMax != null ? getGlobalFormat().code(l.temperatureMax) : '',
      humidity: l.humidity != null ? getGlobalFormat().code(l.humidity) : '',
      humidityMin: l.humidityMin != null ? getGlobalFormat().code(l.humidityMin) : '',
      humidityMax: l.humidityMax != null ? getGlobalFormat().code(l.humidityMax) : '',
      ventilation: l.ventilation, litter: l.litter,
      behavior: l.behavior, distribution: l.distribution,
      appearance: l.appearance, sound: l.sound,
      feedType: l.feedType,
      feedDelivered: l.feedDelivered !== null ? getGlobalFormat().code(l.feedDelivered) : '',
      feedRemaining: l.feedRemaining !== null ? getGlobalFormat().code(l.feedRemaining) : '',
      feedWaste: (l.feedWaste != null) ? getGlobalFormat().code(l.feedWaste) : '',
      feedSourceType: l.feedSourceType || '',
      feedSourceId: l.feedSourceId || '',
      feedSources: l.feedSources && l.feedSources.length > 0
        ? l.feedSources.map(s => ({ ...s }))
        : (l.feedSourceId
          ? [{ id: crypto.randomUUID(), type: (l.feedSourceType || 'item') as 'formula' | 'item', refId: l.feedSourceId, quantity: l.feedDelivered || 0 }]
          : []),
      feedMovementIds: l.feedMovementIds || [],
      feedMethod: l.feedMethod || '',
      waterMethod: l.waterMethod || '',
      feedMethodSource: l.feedMethodSource,
      waterMethodSource: l.waterMethodSource,
      feedMethodFromHall: l.feedMethodFromHall,
      waterMethodFromHall: l.waterMethodFromHall,
      waterAmount: l.waterAmount !== null ? getGlobalFormat().code(l.waterAmount) : '',
      waterFillCount: l.waterFillCount !== null ? getGlobalFormat().code(l.waterFillCount) : '',
      waterFillVolume: l.waterFillVolume !== null ? getGlobalFormat().code(l.waterFillVolume) : '',
      weightSamples: (l.weightSamples || []).map(w => ({ id: w.id, weight: getGlobalFormat().code(w.weight) })),
      eatingEggs: l.eatingEggs != null ? getGlobalFormat().code(l.eatingEggs) : '',
      fertileEggs: l.fertileEggs != null ? getGlobalFormat().code(l.fertileEggs) : '',
      brokenEggs: l.brokenEggs != null ? getGlobalFormat().code(l.brokenEggs) : '',
      otherEggs: l.otherEggs != null ? getGlobalFormat().code(l.otherEggs) : '',
      weightGender: l.weightGender || '',
      deaths: l.deaths || [], vaccines: l.vaccines || [],
      medications: l.medications || [],
      notes: l.notes,
    };
}

export function useDlgForm({ activeFlocks, halls, todayStr }: UseDlgFormParams) {
  const { formulas } = useFed();
  const dlgLogs = useDlg(s => s.logs);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<F>(newLog());
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');

  const num = (s: string): number | null => {
    if (!s.trim()) return null;
    const value = parseFloat(toEn(s).replace('٫', '.'));
    return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
  };
  const int = (s: string): number | null => {
    if (!s.trim()) return null;
    const value = parseInt(toEn(s), 10);
    return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
  };

  const detectSystems = useCallback((flockId: string) => {
    const flock = activeFlocks.find(f => f.id === flockId);
    const hall = halls.find(h => h.id === flock?.hallId);
    return {
      feedMethod: feedSystemFromHall(hall?.feederType || ''),
      waterMethod: waterSystemFromHall(hall?.drinkerType || ''),
    };
  }, [activeFlocks, halls]);

  const currentTime = () => {
    const now = new Date();
    return `${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  const openNew = (flockId?: string) => {
    if (activeFlocks.length === 0) { showToast('اول یک گله بسازید', 'warn'); return; }
    const flock = flockId ? (activeFlocks.find(f => f.id === flockId) || activeFlocks[0]) : activeFlocks[0];
    const sys = detectSystems(flock.id);
    // 🆕 اگر فقط یک فرمول active هست، خودکار انتخاب شه
    const activeFormulas = formulas.filter((f) => f.status === 'active');
    const autoFormula = activeFormulas.length === 1 ? activeFormulas[0] : null;
    const feedDefault = autoFormula
      ? {
          feedSourceType: 'formula' as const,
          feedSourceId: autoFormula.id,
          feedType: autoFormula.name || '',
          feedSources: [{ id: crypto.randomUUID(), type: 'formula' as const, refId: autoFormula.id, quantity: 0 }],
        }
      : {};
    const sourceDefault = {
      feedMethodSource: 'hall' as const,
      waterMethodSource: 'hall' as const,
      feedMethodFromHall: sys.feedMethod,
      waterMethodFromHall: sys.waterMethod,
    };
    setForm({ ...newLog(flock.id), date: todayStr, entryTime: currentTime(), ...sys, ...feedDefault, ...sourceDefault });
    setErr(''); setOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (l: DailyLog) => {
    setForm(dailyLogToForm(l));
    setErr(''); setOpen(true);
  };

  const onFlockChange = (flockId: string) => {
    if (form.id) return;
    const sys = detectSystems(flockId);
    setForm(f => ({
      ...f,
      flockId,
      feedMethod: sys.feedMethod,
      waterMethod: sys.waterMethod,
      feedMethodSource: 'hall',
      waterMethodSource: 'hall',
      feedMethodFromHall: sys.feedMethod,
      waterMethodFromHall: sys.waterMethod,
    }));
  };

  const selectedFlock = activeFlocks.find(f => f.id === form.flockId);
  const isLayerType = selectedFlock?.type === 'layer' || selectedFlock?.type === 'breeder';
  const isFlockMature = selectedFlock ? isLayingReady(selectedFlock) : false;
  const isLayerFlock = isLayerType && isFlockMature;
  const flockAliveCount = selectedFlock?.currentCount || selectedFlock?.initialCount || 0;

  return {
    form, setForm, open, setOpen, saving, setSaving, err, setErr,
    num, int, detectSystems,
    openNew, openEdit, onFlockChange,
    selectedFlock, isLayerType, isFlockMature, isLayerFlock, flockAliveCount,
  };
}

/** افزودن N روز به تاریخ شمسی YYYY/MM/DD */
function findPreviousRemaining(
  logs: DailyLog[],
  form: { flockId: string; date: string; entryTime: string; id?: string },
): number | null {
  const candidates = logs.filter(
    (l) =>
      l.flockId === form.flockId &&
      l.id !== form.id &&
      (l.date < form.date ||
        (l.date === form.date && l.entryTime < form.entryTime)),
  );
  if (candidates.length === 0) return null;
  const latest = candidates.sort((a, b) => {
    const d = b.date.localeCompare(a.date);
    if (d !== 0) return d;
    return b.entryTime.localeCompare(a.entryTime);
  })[0];
  return latest.feedRemaining;
}

function addJalaliDays(dateStr: string, days: number): string {
  if (!dateStr) return '';
  try {
    const en = dateStr.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d: string) => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));
    const base = parseJ(en, 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    if (isNaN(base.getTime())) return '';
    return formatJ(addDays(base, days), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
  } catch { return ''; }
}

/**
 * B4-Recalc — recompute activeWithdrawal از همه لاگ‌های فلک
 *
 * قبلاً (B1c-minimal): activeWithdrawal از max(existing, new) محاسبه می‌شد.
 * باگ: logId اشتباه + پاک نشدن در حذف.
 *
 * این تابع: از همه لاگ‌های فلک max(until) را حساب می‌کند و ownerLogId را ست می‌کند.
 */
function recomputeActiveWithdrawal(
  logs: DailyLog[],
  flockId: string,
): void {
  if (!flockId) return;
  const flk = useFlk.getState();
  const flock = flk.flocks.find(f => f.id === flockId);
  if (!flock) return;

  const whsItems = useWhs.getState().items;
  const flockLogs = logs.filter(l => l.flockId === flockId);

  let maxUntil = '';
  let ownerLogId = '';
  let ownerMedName = '';
  let ownerDays = 0;
  let ownerStartedAt = '';

  for (const log of flockLogs) {
    for (const med of log.medications || []) {
      const days = med.withdrawalDays || 0;
      if (days <= 0) continue;
      // 🆕 herbal safety: گیاهی پرهیز ندارد (اگرچه فیلد مخفی است، ولی داده قدیمی ممکن است)
      if (med.itemId) {
        const __medItem = whsItems.find(x => x.id === med.itemId);
        if (__medItem?.category === 'herbal') continue;
      }
      const until = addJalaliDays(log.date, days);
      if (!until) continue;
      if (until > maxUntil) {
        maxUntil = until;
        ownerLogId = log.id;
        ownerMedName = med.name || 'دارو';
        ownerDays = days;
        ownerStartedAt = log.date;
      }
    }
  }

  if (maxUntil) {
    flk.update(flockId, {
      activeWithdrawal: {
        until: maxUntil,
        medicine: ownerMedName,
        days: ownerDays,
        startedAt: ownerStartedAt,
        logId: ownerLogId,
      },
    });
  } else if (flock.activeWithdrawal) {
    flk.update(flockId, { activeWithdrawal: undefined });
  }
}


function hasMeaningfulData(form: F): boolean {
  if (form.temperature || form.temperatureMin || form.temperatureMax) return true;
  if (form.humidity || form.humidityMin || form.humidityMax) return true;
  if (form.feedDelivered || form.feedRemaining || form.feedType || form.feedSourceId) return true;
  if (form.waterAmount || form.waterFillCount || form.waterFillVolume) return true;
  if (form.eatingEggs || form.fertileEggs || form.brokenEggs || form.otherEggs) return true;
  if (form.deaths && form.deaths.length > 0) return true;
  if (form.vaccines && form.vaccines.length > 0) return true;
  if (form.medications && form.medications.length > 0) return true;
  if (form.weightSamples && form.weightSamples.length > 0) return true;
  if (form.notes) return true;
  if (form.appearance) return true;
  if (form.weightGender) return true;
  return false;
}

export function useDlgSave(params: UseDlgSaveParams) {
  const {
    form, saving, setSaving, setOpen,
    selectedFlock, flockAliveCount, isLayerFlock, num, int,
  } = params;

  const { logs, add, update, remove } = useDlg();
  const { items: whsItems, addMovement, deleteMovement } = useWhs();
  const { formulas, ingredients } = useFed();
  const { addProduction, updateProduction, deleteProduction, findByLogId } = useEgg();

  const _doSave = async (form: F, reason?: string): Promise<boolean> => {
    if (saving) return false;

    // 🆕 جلوگیری از ثبت لاگ خالی (برای فرم‌های جدید)
    if (!form.id && !hasMeaningfulData(form)) {
      toastMsg.error('هیچ داده‌ای وارد نشده است. حداقل یک فیلد (دما، دان، تلفات، ...) را پر کنید.');
      return false;
    }
    setSaving(true);

    // D5.5/B1b — flockId/date قفل در ویرایش
    if (form.id) {
      const oldLog = logs.find(l => l.id === form.id);
      if (oldLog) {
        if (oldLog.flockId !== form.flockId) {
          toastMsg.error('گله در ویرایش قابل تغییر نیست — لاگ را حذف و مجدد ثبت کنید');
          setSaving(false);
          return false;
        }
        if (oldLog.date !== form.date) {
          toastMsg.error('تاریخ در ویرایش قابل تغییر نیست — لاگ را حذف و مجدد ثبت کنید');
          setSaving(false);
          return false;
        }
      }
    }

    // Phase 1 — Pre-flight (بدون mutation)
    const shortages = checkStock({
      vaccines: form.vaccines,
      medications: form.medications,
      feedSourceType: form.feedSourceType,
      feedSourceId: form.feedSourceId,
      feedDelivered: form.feedDelivered,
      whsItems,
      formulas,
      ingredients,
    });
    if (shortages.length > 0) {
      const txt = shortages.map(s => `• ${s.name}: نیاز ${getGlobalFormat().num(s.need)} ${s.unit}، موجودی ${getGlobalFormat().num(s.have)} ${s.unit}`);
      const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
        'موجودی انبار کافی نیست',
        txt.join('\n') + '\n\nاگه ادامه بدی، موجودی صفر می‌شه ولی کمبود ثبت نمی‌شه.',
        { danger: true },
      );
      if (!ok) { setSaving(false); return false; }
    }

    // Pre-compute (pure)
    const feedAmt = num(form.feedDelivered);
    const birdAgeDays = selectedFlock ? getBirdAgeAt(selectedFlock, form.date) : null;
    const previousRemainingKg = findPreviousRemaining(logs, form);
    const oldLogSnapshot = form.id ? (logs.find(l => l.id === form.id) || null) : null;

    let finalData: Omit<DailyLog, 'id' | 'status' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'> | null = null;

    // Phase 2-6 — Execute atomic
    const result = await atomicTransaction<string>({
      stores: [dlgStore, whsStore, eggStore, flkStore],
      execute: () => {
        // ۳) حذف movementهای قدیمی دان
        if (form.feedMovementIds.length > 0) {
          form.feedMovementIds.forEach(id => deleteMovement(id));
        }

        // ۴) ساخت movementهای جدید دان
        const newMovementIds: string[] = [];
        if (form.feedSourceId && feedAmt && feedAmt > 0) {
          // 🆕 IDEA-25: پشتیبانی از چند منبع (اگر feedSources پر است)
          let feedData: ReturnType<typeof buildFeedMovements> = [];
          if (form.feedSources && form.feedSources.length > 0) {
            for (const src of form.feedSources) {
              if (src.quantity > 0 && src.refId) {
                feedData.push(...buildFeedMovements({
                  feedSourceType: src.type,
                  feedSourceId: src.refId,
                  feedDelivered: src.quantity,
                  flockName: selectedFlock?.name || '',
                  formulas,
                  ingredients,
                }));
              }
            }
          } else {
            feedData = buildFeedMovements({
              feedSourceType: form.feedSourceType,
              feedSourceId: form.feedSourceId,
              feedDelivered: feedAmt,
              flockName: selectedFlock?.name || '',
              formulas,
              ingredients,
            });
          }
          feedData.forEach(d => {
            const item = whsItems.find(x => x.id === d.itemId);
            const price = Number(item?.lastPrice) || Number(item?.avgPrice) || 0;
            const mid = addMovement({
              itemId: d.itemId, type: 'out',
              quantity: d.quantity, unitPrice: price, reason: 'consumption',
              date: form.date, partyId: '',
              notes: d.notes,
              flockId: form.flockId || undefined,
              formulaId: d.formulaId,
              formulaVersion: d.formulaVersion,
            });
            if (!mid) throw new Error(`حرکت انبار برای "${d.notes}" ساخته نشد`);
            newMovementIds.push(mid);
          });
        }

        // ۵) حذف movementهای قدیمی واکسن/دارو
        if (form.id && oldLogSnapshot) {
          oldLogSnapshot.vaccines?.forEach(v => {
            if (v.movementId) deleteMovement(v.movementId);
          });
          oldLogSnapshot.medications?.forEach(m => {
            if (m.movementId) deleteMovement(m.movementId);
          });
        }

        // ۶) ساخت movementهای جدید واکسن/دارو
        const processedVaccines = form.vaccines.map(v => {
          const d = buildVaccineMovement(v);
          if (!d) return { ...v, movementId: '' };
          const vacItem = whsItems.find(x => x.id === d.itemId);
          const vacPrice = Number(vacItem?.lastPrice) || Number(vacItem?.avgPrice) || 0;
          const mid = addMovement({ ...d, type: 'out', unitPrice: vacPrice, reason: 'consumption', date: form.date, partyId: '', flockId: form.flockId || undefined });
          if (!mid) throw new Error('حرکت واکسن ساخته نشد');
          return { ...v, movementId: mid };
        });
        const processedMedications = form.medications.map(m => {
          const d = buildMedicationMovement(m);
          if (!d) return { ...m, movementId: '' };
          const medItem = whsItems.find(x => x.id === d.itemId);
          const medPrice = Number(medItem?.lastPrice) || Number(medItem?.avgPrice) || 0;
          const mid = addMovement({ ...d, type: 'out', unitPrice: medPrice, reason: 'consumption', date: form.date, partyId: '', flockId: form.flockId || undefined });
          if (!mid) throw new Error('حرکت دارو ساخته نشد');
          return { ...m, movementId: mid };
        });

        // ۷) ساخت داده نهایی + ذخیره
        const data = buildLogData({
          form,
          processedVaccines,
          processedMedications,
          feedMovementIds: newMovementIds,
          birdAgeDays,
          previousRemainingKg,
          flockAliveCount,
        });
        finalData = data;

        let logId: string;
        if (form.id) {
          const oldLog = logs.find(l => l.id === form.id);
          update(form.id, data);
          logId = form.id;
          // 🆕 Audit Trail — ثبت رویداد ویرایش
          if (oldLog) {
            const evts = buildCorrectionEvents(oldLog, data, reason || 'ویرایش مستقیم');
            for (const ev of evts) {
              const eventId = useDlg.getState().addEvent(logId, ev);
              if (!eventId) throw new Error('ثبت تاریخچهٔ ویرایش انجام نشد');
            }
          }
        } else {
          logId = add(data);
          // 🆕 v16 — رویدادهای اولیه (الگوی FlockEvent)
          const initialEvents = extractEvents({ ...data, id: logId } as any);
          for (const ev of initialEvents) {
            const eventId = useDlg.getState().addEvent(logId, ev);
            if (!eventId) throw new Error('ثبت تاریخچهٔ اولیه انجام نشد');
          }
        }

        // ۸) activeWithdrawal — recompute از همه لاگ‌ها (B4-Recalc)
        if (form.flockId) {
          const freshLogs = useDlg.getState().logs;
          recomputeActiveWithdrawal(freshLogs, form.flockId);
        }

        // ۹) sync با egg
        const action = decideEggAction({
          input: {
            logId,
            flockId: form.flockId,
            date: form.date,
            isLayerFlock,
            eatingEggs: int(form.eatingEggs) || 0,
            fertileEggs: int(form.fertileEggs) || 0,
            brokenEggs: int(form.brokenEggs) || 0,
            otherEggs: int(form.otherEggs) || 0,
          },
          existing: findByLogId(logId),
        });
        if (action.type === 'add') addProduction(action.data);
        else if (action.type === 'update') updateProduction(action.id, action.data);
        else if (action.type === 'delete') deleteProduction(action.id);

        return logId;
      },
      // Phase 7 — Commit (فقط بعد از موفقیت ۱۰۰٪)
      onSuccess: (logId) => {
        if (finalData) {
          void outbox.publish('dlg:deaths:recorded', {
            logId,
            flockId: finalData.flockId,
            date: finalData.date,
            count: finalData.deathsCount || 0,
            deaths: (finalData.deaths || []).filter(d => typeof d.count === 'number' && d.count > 0) as Array<{ id: string; count: number; cause: string; notes: string }>,
            isEdit: !!form.id,
            prevCount: oldLogSnapshot?.deathsCount || 0,
            prevFlockId: oldLogSnapshot?.flockId,
          });

          // 🅰️ Phase F-A — 4 events (publish-only، بدون consumer فعلی)
          if (finalData.feedSourceId && (finalData.feedDelivered || 0) > 0) {
            void outbox.publish('dlg:feed:consumed', {
              logId,
              flockId: finalData.flockId,
              date: finalData.date,
              itemId: finalData.feedSourceId,
              quantity: finalData.feedDelivered || 0,
              isFormula: finalData.feedSourceType === 'formula',
            });
          }

          const __eggTotal = (finalData.eatingEggs || 0) + (finalData.fertileEggs || 0) + (finalData.brokenEggs || 0) + (finalData.otherEggs || 0);
          if (__eggTotal > 0) {
            void outbox.publish('dlg:egg:recorded', {
              logId,
              flockId: finalData.flockId,
              date: finalData.date,
              eating: finalData.eatingEggs || 0,
              fertile: finalData.fertileEggs || 0,
              broken: finalData.brokenEggs || 0,
              other: finalData.otherEggs || 0,
            });
          }

          for (const v of finalData.vaccines || []) {
            if (v.itemId && v.quantity && v.quantity > 0) {
              void outbox.publish('dlg:vaccine:given', {
                logId,
                flockId: finalData.flockId,
                date: finalData.date,
                itemId: v.itemId,
                quantity: v.quantity,
                name: v.name || '',
              });
            }
          }

          for (const m of finalData.medications || []) {
            if (m.itemId && m.quantity && m.quantity > 0) {
              void outbox.publish('dlg:medication:given', {
                logId,
                flockId: finalData.flockId,
                date: finalData.date,
                itemId: m.itemId,
                quantity: m.quantity,
                name: m.name || '',
              });
            }
          }
        }

        toastMsg.saved('ثبت روزانه');

        try {
          const ctxIntel = { flockSize: flockAliveCount, currentCount: flockAliveCount, femaleCount: selectedFlock?.femaleCount ?? undefined };
          const recN = (p: string, v: number | null) => {
            if (v !== null && Number.isFinite(v) && v > 0) recordHistory(p, v, ctxIntel);
          };
          recN('dlg.feedDelivered', num(form.feedDelivered));
          recN('dlg.feedRemaining', num(form.feedRemaining));
          recN('dlg.waterAmount', num(form.waterAmount));
          recN('dlg.waterFillCount', num(form.waterFillCount));
          recN('dlg.waterFillVolume', num(form.waterFillVolume));
          if (finalData) {
            recN('dlg.temperature', typeof finalData.temperature === 'number' ? finalData.temperature : null);
            recN('dlg.humidity', typeof finalData.humidity === 'number' ? finalData.humidity : null);
            recN('dlg.deathsCount', Number(finalData.deathsCount) || null);
          }
          recN('dlg.temperatureMin', num(form.temperatureMin));
          recN('dlg.temperatureMax', num(form.temperatureMax));
          recN('dlg.eatingEggs', int(form.eatingEggs));
          recN('dlg.fertileEggs', int(form.fertileEggs));
          recN('dlg.brokenEggs', int(form.brokenEggs));
          recN('dlg.otherEggs', int(form.otherEggs));
          recN('egg.eatingCount', int(form.eatingEggs));
          recN('egg.fertileCount', int(form.fertileEggs));
          recN('egg.brokenCount', int(form.brokenEggs));
        } catch { /* silent */ }
      },
      onError: (err) => {
        toastMsg.error('خطا در ذخیره — همه تغییرات لغو شد: ' + err.message);
      },
    });

    setSaving(false);

    if (!result.ok) return false;

    setOpen(false);
    return true;
  };

  /** منطق حذف */
  const deleteLog = async (
    l: DailyLog,
    opts: { skipConfirm?: boolean } = {},
  ): Promise<{
    ok: boolean;
    undoData: DailyLog | null;
    hadCascades: boolean;
    snapshot?: DeleteSnapshot;
  }> => {
    // D5.5/B3 — تأیید (در bulk delete skip می‌شود)
    if (!opts.skipConfirm) {
      const ok = await showConfirmAsync('تأیید حذف', 'این ثبت روزانه و داده‌های مرتبط حذف شوند؟', { danger: true });
      if (!ok) return { ok: false, undoData: null, hadCascades: false };
    }

    const log = logs.find(x => x.id === l.id);
    if (!log) return { ok: false, undoData: null, hadCascades: false };

    const hadCascades =
      (log.feedMovementIds?.length || 0) > 0 ||
      (log.vaccines || []).some(v => !!v.movementId) ||
      (log.medications || []).some(m => !!m.movementId) ||
      !!findByLogId(log.id);

    // E.4b — snapshot قبل از حذف
    const snapshot: DeleteSnapshot | undefined = hadCascades ? (() => {
      const movementsMap = new Map(useWhs.getState().movements.map((m: Movement) => [m.id, m]));
      const feedMovements = (log.feedMovementIds || [])
        .map((id) => movementsMap.get(id))
        .filter((m): m is Movement => !!m);
      const vaccineMovements = (log.vaccines || [])
        .filter((v) => !!v.movementId)
        .map((v) => ({ vaccineId: v.id, movement: movementsMap.get(v.movementId!) }))
        .filter((x): x is { vaccineId: string; movement: Movement } => !!x.movement);
      const medicationMovements = (log.medications || [])
        .filter((m) => !!m.movementId)
        .map((m) => ({ medicationId: m.id, movement: movementsMap.get(m.movementId!) }))
        .filter((x): x is { medicationId: string; movement: Movement } => !!x.movement);
      return { feedMovements, vaccineMovements, medicationMovements, production: findByLogId(log.id) || null };
    })() : undefined;

    // D5.5/B3 — atomic (cascade + remove + outbox)
    const result = await atomicTransaction<string>({
      stores: [dlgStore, whsStore, eggStore, flkStore],
      execute: () => {
        // حذف movement‌های دان
        if (log.feedMovementIds) {
          log.feedMovementIds.forEach(id => deleteMovement(id));
        }

        // حذف movement‌های واکسن/دارو
        log.vaccines?.forEach(v => {
          if (v.movementId) deleteMovement(v.movementId);
        });
        log.medications?.forEach(m => {
          if (m.movementId) deleteMovement(m.movementId);
        });

        // حذف production تخم
        const prod = findByLogId(log.id);
        if (prod) deleteProduction(prod.id);

        // حذف خود لاگ (D5.5/B3 — داخل atomic)
        remove(log.id);

        // B4-Recalc — recompute activeWithdrawal بعد از حذف
        const freshLogs = useDlg.getState().logs;
        recomputeActiveWithdrawal(freshLogs, log.flockId);

        return log.id;
      },
      onSuccess: (logId) => {
        const prod = findByLogId(logId);
        void outbox.publish('dlg:log:deleted', {
          logId,
          flockId: log.flockId,
          date: log.date,
          deathsCount: log.deathsCount || 0,
          feedMovementIds: log.feedMovementIds || [],
          eggProductionId: prod?.id,
        });
      },
      onError: (err) => {
        toastMsg.error('خطا در حذف — همه‌چیز لغو شد: ' + err.message);
      },
    });

    if (!result.ok) return { ok: false, undoData: null, hadCascades };
    return { ok: true, undoData: log, hadCascades, snapshot };
  };

  const restoreLogFull = async (log: DailyLog, snapshot: DeleteSnapshot): Promise<boolean> => {
    const result = await atomicTransaction<string>({
      stores: [dlgStore, whsStore, eggStore, flkStore],
      execute: () => {
        const newFeedIds: string[] = [];
        for (const mv of snapshot.feedMovements) {
          const { id: _oid, createdAt: _oc, ...mvData } = mv;
          const nid = addMovement(mvData);
          if (nid) newFeedIds.push(nid);
        }
        const vacMap = new Map<string, string>();
        for (const vm of snapshot.vaccineMovements) {
          const { id: _oid, createdAt: _oc, ...mvData } = vm.movement;
          const nid = addMovement(mvData);
          if (nid) vacMap.set(vm.vaccineId, nid);
        }
        const medMap = new Map<string, string>();
        for (const mm of snapshot.medicationMovements) {
          const { id: _oid, createdAt: _oc, ...mvData } = mm.movement;
          const nid = addMovement(mvData);
          if (nid) medMap.set(mm.medicationId, nid);
        }
        const updatedLog: DailyLog = {
          ...log,
          feedMovementIds: newFeedIds,
          vaccines: (log.vaccines || []).map((v) => ({ ...v, movementId: vacMap.get(v.id) || '' })),
          medications: (log.medications || []).map((m) => ({ ...m, movementId: medMap.get(m.id) || '' })),
        };
        const newLogId = add(updatedLog);
        if (snapshot.production) {
          const { id: _oid, createdAt: _oc, sourceLogId: _os, ...prodData } = snapshot.production;
          addProduction({ ...prodData, sourceLogId: newLogId });
        }
        const freshLogs = useDlg.getState().logs;
        recomputeActiveWithdrawal(freshLogs, log.flockId);
        return newLogId;
      },
      onError: (err) => {
        toastMsg.error('خطا در بازگردانی: ' + err.message);
      },
    });
    return result.ok;
  };

  const save = (opts?: { overrideForm?: F; reason?: string }): Promise<boolean> => {
    return _doSave(opts?.overrideForm ?? form, opts?.reason);
  };

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Correction Atomic (رویکرد ۲ — Immutable Log + Event Sourcing)
  // استاندارد: ALCOA+ / 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e)
  // - لاگ اصلی دست‌نخورده می‌ماند (فقط corrections[] + فیلدهای مشتق)
  // - Revoke = رویداد جبرانی (revoked:true)، نه حذف
  // - Audit Trail برای هر تغییر
  // - event جبرانی به flk برای deathsCount
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /** ثبت اصلاح اتمیک — لاگ اصلی immutable */
  const applyCorrectionAtomic = async (
    logId: string,
    changes: Partial<DailyLog>,
    reason: string,
    notes?: string,
  ): Promise<boolean> => {
    const log = useDlg.getState().logs.find(l => l.id === logId);
    if (!log) {
      toastMsg.error('لاگ پیدا نشد');
      return false;
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const timestamp = `${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    const newCorr: DailyLogCorrection = {
      id: uuid(),
      timestamp,
      reason,
      changes,
      notes,
      revoked: false,
      createdAt: now.toISOString(),
    };

    const effectiveBefore = applyCorrections(log);
    const withNewCorr: DailyLog = {
      ...log,
      corrections: [...(log.corrections || []), newCorr],
    };
    const effectiveAfter = applyCorrections(withNewCorr);

    const derivedPatch = {
      temperature: effectiveAfter.temperature,
      humidity: effectiveAfter.humidity,
      feedConsumed: effectiveAfter.feedConsumed,
      deaths: effectiveAfter.deaths,
    };

    const result = await atomicTransaction<string>({
      stores: [dlgStore, whsStore, eggStore, flkStore],
      execute: () => {
        update(logId, {
          corrections: withNewCorr.corrections,
          ...derivedPatch,
        });

        const events = buildCorrectionEvents(effectiveBefore, effectiveAfter, reason);
        for (const ev of events) {
          const eventId = useDlg.getState().addEvent(logId, ev);
          if (!eventId) throw new Error('ثبت تاریخچهٔ اصلاح انجام نشد');
        }

        return logId;
      },
      onSuccess: (id) => {
        toastMsg.saved('اصلاح');

        const beforeCount = effectiveBefore.deathsCount || 0;
        const afterCount = effectiveAfter.deathsCount || 0;
        if (beforeCount !== afterCount) {
          void outbox.publish('dlg:deaths:recorded', {
            logId: id,
            flockId: log.flockId,
            date: log.date,
            count: afterCount,
            deaths: (effectiveAfter.deaths || []).filter(d => typeof d.count === 'number' && d.count > 0) as Array<{ id: string; count: number; cause: string; notes: string }>,
            isEdit: true,
            prevCount: beforeCount,
            prevFlockId: log.flockId,
          });
        }
      },
      onError: (err) => {
        toastMsg.error('خطا در ثبت اصلاح — همه تغییرات لغو شد: ' + err.message);
      },
    });

    return result.ok;
  };

  /** لغو اصلاح اتمیک — رویداد جبرانی */
  const revokeCorrectionAtomic = async (logId: string, correctionId: string): Promise<boolean> => {
    const log = useDlg.getState().logs.find(l => l.id === logId);
    if (!log) return false;
    const targetCorr = (log.corrections || []).find(c => c.id === correctionId);
    if (!targetCorr || targetCorr.revoked) return false;

    const effectiveBefore = applyCorrections(log);
    const revokedCorrections = (log.corrections || []).map(c =>
      c.id === correctionId ? { ...c, revoked: true } : c
    );
    const withRevoke: DailyLog = { ...log, corrections: revokedCorrections };
    const effectiveAfter = applyCorrections(withRevoke);

    const derivedPatch = {
      temperature: effectiveAfter.temperature,
      humidity: effectiveAfter.humidity,
      feedConsumed: effectiveAfter.feedConsumed,
      deaths: effectiveAfter.deaths,
    };

    const result = await atomicTransaction<string>({
      stores: [dlgStore, whsStore, eggStore, flkStore],
      execute: () => {
        update(logId, {
          corrections: revokedCorrections,
          ...derivedPatch,
        });

        const events = buildCorrectionEvents(effectiveBefore, effectiveAfter, `لغو: ${targetCorr.reason}`);
        for (const ev of events) {
          const eventId = useDlg.getState().addEvent(logId, ev);
          if (!eventId) throw new Error('ثبت تاریخچهٔ لغو انجام نشد');
        }

        return logId;
      },
      onSuccess: (id) => {
        toastMsg.saved('لغو اصلاح');

        const beforeCount = effectiveBefore.deathsCount || 0;
        const afterCount = effectiveAfter.deathsCount || 0;
        if (beforeCount !== afterCount) {
          void outbox.publish('dlg:deaths:recorded', {
            logId: id,
            flockId: log.flockId,
            date: log.date,
            count: afterCount,
            deaths: (effectiveAfter.deaths || []).filter(d => typeof d.count === 'number' && d.count > 0) as Array<{ id: string; count: number; cause: string; notes: string }>,
            isEdit: true,
            prevCount: beforeCount,
            prevFlockId: log.flockId,
          });
        }
      },
      onError: (err) => {
        toastMsg.error('خطا در لغو اصلاح — همه تغییرات لغو شد: ' + err.message);
      },
    });

    return result.ok;
  };

  return { save, deleteLog, restoreLogFull, applyCorrectionAtomic, revokeCorrectionAtomic };
}

/**
 * useFormGroups — مدیریت state گروه‌های باز/بسته فرم
 */
import { useState } from 'react';

export function useFormGroups(initial: Record<string, boolean>) {
  const [groups, setGroups] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>(initial);
  const toggle = (id: string) => setGroups(g => ({ ...g, [id]: !g[id] }));
  const openOnly = (id: string) => setGroups(g => {
    const next: Record<string, boolean> = {};
    for (const k of Object.keys(g)) next[k] = k === id;
    next[id] = true;
    return next;
  });
  const closeAll = () => setGroups({});
  const openAll = (ids: string[]) => setGroups(Object.fromEntries(ids.map(i => [i, true])));
  return { groups, toggle, openOnly, closeAll, openAll };
}

/**

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { persist, createJSONStorage } from 'zustand/middleware';
import { zustandHybridStorage } from '../../cor/storage/hybridStorage';
import { v4 as uuid } from 'uuid';
import type { DlgEvent } from './types-events';

export interface Death {
  id: string;
  count: number | null;
  cause: string;
  notes: string;
  /** 🆕 جنسیت تلفات — undefined = unknown (قبل از تفکیک) */
  sex?: 'male' | 'female' | 'unknown';
}

export type LogStatus = 'active' | 'archived';

export interface WeightSample {
  id: string;
  weight: number; // kg
}

export interface Vaccine {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  dose: string;
  method: string;
  reaction: string;
  itemId?: string;
  quantity?: number | null;
  unit?: string;
  factor?: number;
  movementId?: string;
}

export interface Medication {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  dose: string;
  method: string;
  withdrawalDays: number | null;
  itemId?: string;
  quantity?: number | null;
  unit?: string;
  factor?: number;
  movementId?: string;
}


/** 🆕 منبع دان (چندگانه) — برای پشتیبانی چند نوع دان در یک لاگ */
export interface FeedSource {
  id: string;
  type: 'formula' | 'item';
  refId: string;
  /** مقدار مصرفی به کیلوگرم (واحد پایه — همیشه) */
  quantity: number;
  /** 🆕 واحد نمایشی (فقط UI) */
  displayUnit?: string;
  /** 🆕 مقدار نمایشی (فقط UI) */
  displayValue?: number;
}

export interface DailyLogCorrection {
  id: string;
  /** ساعت اصلاح (HH:MM) */
  timestamp: string;
  /** دلیل (از dropdown) */
  reason: string;
  /** فقط فیلدهای تغییرکرده */
  changes: Partial<DailyLog>;
  /** توضیح آزاد */
  notes?: string;
  /** لغو شده توسط کاربر */
  revoked?: boolean;
  /** زمان ثبت اصلاح */
  createdAt: string;
}

export interface DailyLog {
  id: string;
  flockId: string;
  date: string;
  entryTime: string;

  // محیط
  temperature: number | null;
  temperatureMin: number | null;
  temperatureMax: number | null;
  humidity: number | null;
  humidityMin: number | null;
  humidityMax: number | null;
  ventilation: string; // ok | low | high
  litter: string; // dry | wet | clumped

  // پرنده
  behavior: string; // active | lethargic | excited
  distribution: string; // uniform | cornered
  appearance: string;
  sound: string; // normal | cough | sneeze

  // تغذیه
  feedType: string;
  feedDelivered: number | null;    // kg (دان داده‌شده)
  feedConsumed: number | null;     // kg (دان مصرف‌شده — مشتق)
  feedRemaining: number | null; // kg
  /** 🆕 هدر رفته (ریخته‌شده یا خراب) — برای محاسبه دقیق‌تر feedConsumed */
  feedWaste: number | null;
  feedSourceType: 'formula' | 'item' | '';
  feedSourceId: string;
  /** 🆕 منابع دان چندگانه (اختیاری — برای سازگاری با داده‌های قدیمی) */
  feedSources?: FeedSource[];
  feedMethod: 'scoop' | 'bag' | 'semi_auto' | 'auto_sensor' | 'auto_chain' | '';
  feedMovementIds: string[];

  // آب
  waterAmount: number | null;   // L
  waterMethod: 'manual' | 'nipple' | 'trough' | 'tank' | '';
  /** 🆕 منبع feedMethod: از سالن یا override دستی */
  feedMethodSource?: 'hall' | 'manual';
  /** 🆕 منبع waterMethod: از سالن یا override دستی */
  waterMethodSource?: 'hall' | 'manual';
  /** 🆕 مقدار اصلی feedMethod در سالن (برای ممیزی) */
  feedMethodFromHall?: string;
  /** 🆕 مقدار اصلی waterMethod در سالن (برای ممیزی) */
  waterMethodFromHall?: string;
  waterFillCount: number | null;
  waterFillVolume: number | null;

  // وزن‌کشی
  weightSamples: WeightSample[];
  weightGender: '' | 'male' | 'female' | 'mixed';

  // تخم‌گذاری (اختصاصی layer/breeder)
  brokenEggs: number | null;
  // 🆕 تخم - تفکیک جدید
  eatingEggs?: number | null;
  fertileEggs?: number | null;
  otherEggs?: number | null;

  // تلفات
  deathsCount: number;
  deaths: Death[];

  // سلامت
  vaccines: Vaccine[];
  medications: Medication[];

  // فعالیت‌ها

  // یادداشت
  notes: string;

  // 🆕 v16 — رویدادهای ثبت روزانه (الگوی FlockEvent)
  events?: DlgEvent[];

  // متادیتا
  status: LogStatus;
  /** 🆕 اصلاحات اعمال‌شده (append-only، قابل لغو) */
  corrections?: DailyLogCorrection[];

  birdAgeDays: number | null;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

interface State {
  logs: DailyLog[];
  add: (l: Omit<DailyLog, 'id' | 'status' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>) => string;
  update: (id: string, patch: Partial<DailyLog>) => void;
  remove: (id: string) => void;
  archive: (id: string) => void;
  restore: (id: string) => void;
  /** 🆕 اصلاح یک لاگ (append-only) */
  addCorrection: (
    logId: string,
    changes: Partial<DailyLog>,
    reason: string,
    notes?: string,
  ) => string | null;
  /** 🆕 لغو یک اصلاح (idempotent) */
  revokeCorrection: (logId: string, correctionId: string) => boolean;
  addEvent: (logId: string, ev: Omit<DlgEvent, 'id'|'logId'|'createdAt'>) => string;
  revokeEvent: (logId: string, eventId: string) => boolean;
  /** 🆕 وضعیت لود داده‌ها از IndexedDB (دروازه لودینگ) */
  isLoading: boolean;
  /** 🆕 لایه ۳ — آرشیو سرد: لاگ‌های قدیمی‌تر از آستانه را جابه‌جا می‌کند (حذف نمی‌کند) */
  archiveOldLogs: (months?: number) => Promise<number>;
  /** 🆕 بازگردانی یک لاگ از آرشیو سرد به hot */
  restoreArchived: (id: string) => Promise<boolean>;
  /** 🆕 تعداد رکوردهای آرشیو */
  countArchivedLogs: () => Promise<number>;
  /** 🆕 سطح ۱ — آرشیو فوری همهٔ لاگ‌های یک گلهٔ بسته‌شده */
  archiveFlockLogs: (flockId: string) => Promise<number>;
  /** 🆕 بازگردانی آبشاری — لاگ‌های گله در یک تراکنش برمی‌گردند */
  restoreFlockLogs: (flockId: string) => Promise<number>;
}

// ═══ ۴-ب — آینه‌سازی IDB (منبع حقیقت) ═══
// RAM کش خواندن است؛ IDB مرجع. هر نوشتن در RAM، رکورد را در IDB هم می‌نویسد.
const _idb = () => import('../../cor/storage/idbStorage');

const syncOne = (log: DailyLog | undefined) => {
  if (!log) return;
  _idb().then(m => m.idbPutRecord('pm-dlg', log)).catch(() => {});
};

const syncRemove = (id: string) => {
  _idb().then(m => m.idbDeleteRecord('pm-dlg', id)).catch(() => {});
};

export const useDlg = create<State>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      logs: [],
      isLoading: true,
      add: (l) => {
        const newLog = {
          ...l,
          id: uuid(),
          status: 'active',
          feedConsumed: (l as any).feedConsumed ?? null,
          birdAgeDays: (l as any).birdAgeDays ?? null,
          brokenEggs: (l as any).brokenEggs ?? null,
          eatingEggs: (l as any).eatingEggs ?? null,
          fertileEggs: (l as any).fertileEggs ?? null,
          otherEggs: (l as any).otherEggs ?? null,
          corrections: (l as any).corrections ?? [],
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        } as DailyLog;
        set({ logs: [...get().logs, newLog] });
        return newLog.id;
      },
      update: (id, patch) => {
      set({
        logs: get().logs.map(x => x.id === id
          ? { ...x, ...patch, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }
          : x)
      });
      syncOne(get().logs.find(x => x.id === id));
    },
      addCorrection: (logId, changes, reason, notes) => {
        const target = get().logs.find(x => x.id === logId);
        if (!target) return null;
        const now = new Date();
        const timestamp = `${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
        const correction: DailyLogCorrection = {
          id: uuid(),
          timestamp,
          reason,
          changes,
          notes,
          revoked: false,
          createdAt: now.toISOString(),
        };
        set({
          logs: get().logs.map(x => x.id === logId
            ? {
                ...x,
                corrections: [...(x.corrections || []), correction],
                updatedAt: now.toISOString(),
              }
            : x)
        });
        syncOne(get().logs.find(x => x.id === logId));
        return correction.id;
      },
      revokeCorrection: (logId, correctionId) => {
        const target = get().logs.find(x => x.id === logId);
        if (!target) return false;
        const correction = (target.corrections || []).find(c => c.id === correctionId);
        if (!correction) return false;
        if (correction.revoked) return false;
        set({
          logs: get().logs.map(x => x.id === logId
            ? {
                ...x,
                corrections: (x.corrections || []).map(c =>
                  c.id === correctionId ? { ...c, revoked: true } : c
                ),
                updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
              }
            : x)
        });
        syncOne(get().logs.find(x => x.id === logId));
        return true;
      },
      addEvent: (logId, ev) => {
        const event: DlgEvent = { ...ev, id: uuid(), logId, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() };
        set({
          logs: get().logs.map(x => x.id === logId
            ? { ...x, events: [...(x.events || []), event], updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }
            : x)
        });
        syncOne(get().logs.find(x => x.id === logId));
        return event.id;
      },
      revokeEvent: (logId, eventId) => {
        const target = get().logs.find(x => x.id === logId);
        if (!target) return false;
        const event = (target.events || []).find(e => e.id === eventId);
        if (!event) return false;
        if (event.revoked) return false;
        set({
          logs: get().logs.map(x => x.id === logId
            ? {
                ...x,
                events: (x.events || []).map(e =>
                  e.id === eventId ? { ...e, revoked: true, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : e
                ),
                updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
              }
            : x)
        });
        syncOne(get().logs.find(x => x.id === logId));
        return true;
      },
      remove: (id) => {
        set({ logs: get().logs.filter(x => x.id !== id) });
        syncRemove(id);
      },
      archive: (id) => {
        set({
          logs: get().logs.map(x => x.id === id
            ? { ...x, status: 'archived' as LogStatus, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }
            : x)
        });
        syncOne(get().logs.find(x => x.id === id));
      },
      restore: (id) => {
        set({
          logs: get().logs.map(x => x.id === id
            ? { ...x, status: 'active' as LogStatus, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }
            : x)
        });
        syncOne(get().logs.find(x => x.id === id));
      },

      // ═══ لایه ۳ — آرشیو سرد ═══
      archiveOldLogs: async (months) => {
        const mod = await import('../../cor/storage/historyArchive');
        const hot = get().logs;
        if (hot.length === 0) return 0;

        // ── سطح ۲: آستانهٔ دوگانه (OR) — Elastic ILM / S3 Lifecycle / Azure Blob
        // ۱) سنّی: قدیمی‌تر از maxAgeMonths
        // ۲) شمارشی: بیش از maxHotLogs → تا trimTo پایین بیا (هیسترزیس)
        const overCount = hot.length > mod.ARCHIVE_POLICY.maxHotLogs;
        const effMonths = overCount ? 0 : (months ?? mod.ARCHIVE_POLICY.maxAgeMonths);

        const res = await mod.archiveLogs(hot, {
          months: effMonths,
          reason: overCount ? 'count-threshold' : 'age',
        });

        const movedIds = new Set(res.archivedIds);
        let next = hot.filter(l => !movedIds.has(l.id));

        // هیسترزیس: اگر پس از برش هنوز بالای trimTo است، قدیمی‌ترین‌ها را هم بفرست
        if (next.length > mod.ARCHIVE_POLICY.trimTo) {
          const sorted = [...next].sort((a, b) => (a.date < b.date ? -1 : a.date > b.date ? 1 : 0));
          const extra = sorted.slice(0, next.length - mod.ARCHIVE_POLICY.trimTo);
          const res2 = await mod.archiveLogs(extra, { months: 0, reason: 'count-threshold' });
          const moved2 = new Set(res2.archivedIds);
          next = next.filter(l => !moved2.has(l.id));
          for (const id of res2.archivedIds) movedIds.add(id);
        }

        if (movedIds.size === 0) return 0;

        set({ logs: next });
        for (const id of movedIds) syncRemove(id);
        return movedIds.size;
      },
      archiveFlockLogs: async (flockId) => {
        const mod = await import('../../cor/storage/historyArchive');
        const hot = get().logs.filter(l => l.flockId === flockId);
        if (hot.length === 0) return 0;
        const res = await mod.archiveLogs(
          hot,
          { months: 0, reason: 'flock-closed' },
          mod.ARCHIVE_STORES.dlg,
        );
        if (res.archivedCount === 0) return 0;
        const moved = new Set(res.archivedIds);
        set({ logs: get().logs.filter(l => !moved.has(l.id)) });
        for (const id of res.archivedIds) syncRemove(id);
        return res.archivedCount;
      },
      restoreFlockLogs: async (flockId) => {
        const mod = await import('../../cor/storage/historyArchive');
        const rows = await mod.listArchived(
          { flockId, limit: 100000 },
          mod.ARCHIVE_STORES.dlg,
        );
        if (rows.length === 0) return 0;
        // اتمیک: خواندن + حذف از آرشیو در یک تراکنش
        const restored = await mod.restoreManyFromArchive(
          rows.map(r => r.id),
          mod.ARCHIVE_STORES.dlg,
        );
        if (restored.length === 0) return 0;
        const existingIds = new Set(get().logs.map(x => x.id));
        const uniqueRestored = restored.filter(x => !existingIds.has(x.id));
        set({ logs: [...get().logs, ...uniqueRestored] });
        for (const l of restored) syncOne(l);
        return restored.length;
      },
      restoreArchived: async (id) => {
        const mod = await import('../../cor/storage/historyArchive');
        const restored = await mod.restoreManyFromArchive([id], mod.ARCHIVE_STORES.dlg);
        const log = restored[0];
        if (!log) return false;
        const exists = get().logs.some(x => x.id === log.id);
        if (!exists) set({ logs: [...get().logs, log] });
        syncOne(log);
        return true;
      },
      countArchivedLogs: async () => {
        const mod = await import('../../cor/storage/historyArchive');
        return mod.countArchived();
      },

    }),
    {
      name: 'pm-dlg',
      storage: createJSONStorage(() => zustandHybridStorage),
      // 🆕 isLoading ذخیره نشود تا در هر لود، با true شروع شود
      partialize: (state) => {
        const { isLoading, ...rest } = state;
        return rest as any;
      },
      // 🆕 پس از اتمام لود داده‌ها از IndexedDB، دروازه لودینگ باز می‌شود
      onRehydrateStorage: () => {
        return (state, error) => {
          if (error) {
            console.error('[dlg] Hydration failed:', error);
          }
          // ═══ ۴-ب — IDB رکورد-محور = منبع حقیقت ═══
          // اگر IDB داده دارد، آرایه RAM از آن پر می‌شود (نه از snapshot قدیمی key-value).
          _idb()
            .then(async m => {
              const rows = await m.idbGetAllRecords<DailyLog>('pm-dlg');
              if (rows.length > 0) {
                useDlg.setState({ logs: rows });
              } else if (state?.logs?.length) {
                // اولین بار پس از ارتقا: snapshot موجود را به IDB منتقل کن
                await Promise.all(state.logs.map(l => m.idbPutRecord('pm-dlg', l)));
              }
            })
            .catch(e => console.error('[dlg] IDB load failed:', e))
            .finally(() => useDlg.setState({ isLoading: false }));
        };
      },
      version: 16,
      migrate: (persisted: any, version: number) => {
        // ═══ v16 — events[] (الگوی FlockEvent) ═══
        if (version < 16 && persisted?.logs) {
          persisted.logs = persisted.logs.map((l: any) => ({
            ...l,
            events: l.events ?? [],
          }));
        }

        // ═══ v15 — corrections[] (اختیاری، backward-compat) ═══
        if (version < 15 && persisted?.logs) {
          persisted.logs = persisted.logs.map((l: any) => ({
            ...l,
            corrections: l.corrections ?? [],
          }));
        }

        if (version < 2 && persisted?.logs) {
          persisted.logs = persisted.logs.map((l: any) => ({
            ...l,
            feedSourceType: l.feedItemId ? 'item' : '',
            feedSourceId: l.feedItemId || '',
            feedMovementIds: l.feedMovementId ? [l.feedMovementId] : [],
          }));
        }
        if (version < 3 && persisted?.logs) {
          persisted.logs = persisted.logs.map((l: any) => ({
            ...l,
            feedMethod: l.feedMethod || '',
            waterMethod: l.waterMethod || '',
            waterFillCount: l.waterFillCount ?? null,
            waterFillVolume: l.waterFillVolume ?? null,
            weightSamples: l.weightSamples || [],
            weightGender: l.weightGender || '',
          }));
        }
        if (version < 4 && persisted?.logs) {
          persisted.logs = persisted.logs.map((l: any) => ({
            ...l,
            createdAt: l.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
            updatedAt: l.updatedAt || new Date().toISOString(),
          }));
        }
        if (version < 5 && persisted?.logs) {
          persisted.logs = persisted.logs.map((l: any) => ({
            ...l,
            status: l.status || 'active',
          }));
        }
        // ═══ FIXED ORDER: v6 before v7 ═══
        if (version < 6 && persisted?.logs) {
          persisted.logs = persisted.logs.map((l: any) => ({
            ...l,
            eggsCount: l.eggsCount ?? null,
            brokenEggs: l.brokenEggs ?? null,
            dirtyEggs: l.dirtyEggs ?? null,
          }));
        }
        if (version < 7 && persisted?.logs) {
          persisted.logs = persisted.logs.map((l: any) => ({
            ...l,
            eatingEggs: l.eatingEggs ?? l.eggsCount ?? null,
            fertileEggs: l.fertileEggs ?? null,
            otherEggs: l.otherEggs ?? l.dirtyEggs ?? null,
            brokenTarget: l.brokenTarget === 'eating' ? 'lost' : 'saleable',
            otherTarget: l.otherTarget === 'eating' ? 'lost' : 'saleable',
          }));
        }
        // ═══ v10 — A1 (shift + birdAgeDays + target rename + legacy removal) ═══
        if (version < 10 && persisted?.logs) {
          persisted.logs = persisted.logs.map((l: any) => {
            const { eggsCount, dirtyEggs, ...rest } = l;
            // Map target: old ('consumption'/'eating') and new ('saleable'/'lost') both OK
            const mapTarget = (v: any): 'saleable' | 'lost' => {
              if (v === 'eating' || v === 'lost') return 'lost';
              return 'saleable';
            };
            return {
              ...rest,
              shift: l.shift || 'morning',
              birdAgeDays: l.birdAgeDays ?? null,
              // Defensive: if v7 failed for any reason
              eatingEggs: l.eatingEggs ?? eggsCount ?? null,
              otherEggs: l.otherEggs ?? dirtyEggs ?? null,
              brokenTarget: mapTarget(l.brokenTarget),
              otherTarget: mapTarget(l.otherTarget),
            };
          });
        }
        // ═══ v11 — A2b (rename feedAmount → feedDelivered + feedConsumed) ═══
        if (version < 11 && persisted?.logs) {
          persisted.logs = persisted.logs.map((l: any) => {
            const delivered = l.feedDelivered ?? l.feedAmount ?? null;
            const consumed = l.feedConsumed ?? delivered;
            const { feedAmount: _oldFeedAmount, ...rest } = l;
            return {
              ...rest,
              feedDelivered: delivered,
              feedConsumed: consumed,
            };
          });
        }
        // ═══ v12 — A2d (feedMethod: 'manual'|'auto' → 5 مقدار calc) ═══
        if (version < 12 && persisted?.logs) {
          persisted.logs = persisted.logs.map((l: any) => {
            const mapMethod = (m: any): string => {
              if (m === 'manual' || m === '' || m == null) return 'scoop';
              if (m === 'auto') return 'auto_chain';
              // از قبل 5 مقدار
              if (['scoop', 'bag', 'semi_auto', 'auto_sensor', 'auto_chain'].includes(m)) return m;
              return 'scoop';
            };
            return {
              ...l,
              feedMethod: mapMethod(l.feedMethod),
            };
          });
        }
        // ═══ v14 — حذف lightHours (فیلد مرده، صفر مصرف‌کننده در UI) ═══
        if (version < 14 && persisted?.logs) {
          persisted.logs = persisted.logs.map((l: any) => {
            const { lightHours: _lh, ...rest } = l;
            return rest;
          });
        }

        // ═══ v13 — حذف shift + brokenTarget/otherTarget ═══
        if (version < 13 && persisted?.logs) {
          persisted.logs = persisted.logs.map((l: any) => {
            const { shift: _s, brokenTarget: _bt, otherTarget: _ot, ...rest } = l;
            return rest;
          });
        }
        return persisted;
      }
    }
  )
);
