export function causeLabel(key: string): string {
  const normalized = CAUSE_ALIAS[key] ?? key;
  return DEATH_CAUSES.find(x => x[0] === normalized)?.[1] || '—';
}


// === کمک‌کننده‌ها برای وزن‌کشی ===

/** میانگین وزن نمونه‌ها (kg) */
export function avgWeight(samples: WeightSample[]): number {
  if (samples.length === 0) return 0;
  const sum = samples.reduce((a, x) => a + x.weight, 0);
  return Math.round((sum / samples.length) * 1000) / 1000;
}

/** مجموع وزن نمونه‌ها (kg) */
export function sumWeight(samples: WeightSample[]): number {
  return Math.round(samples.reduce((a, x) => a + x.weight, 0) * 1000) / 1000;
}

/** ضریب تغییرات (CV%) */
export function cvWeight(samples: WeightSample[]): number {
  if (samples.length < 2) return 0;
  const mean = samples.reduce((a, x) => a + x.weight, 0) / samples.length;
  if (mean === 0) return 0;
  const variance = samples.reduce((a, x) => a + Math.pow(x.weight - mean, 2), 0) / samples.length;
  const std = Math.sqrt(variance);
  return Math.round((std / mean) * 10000) / 100;
}

/** 🆕 محاسبه کل دان مصرفی (کیلوگرم) از فرم — منبع واحد (قانون ۲۶) */
export function getTotalFeedKg(form: { feedSources?: Array<{ quantity?: number } | null | undefined>; feedSourceId?: string; feedDelivered?: string | number | null }): number {
  if (form.feedSources && form.feedSources.length > 0) {
    return form.feedSources.reduce((sum, s) => sum + (Number(s?.quantity) || 0), 0);
  }
  const legacy = parseFloat(String(form.feedDelivered ?? '').replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d))).replace('٫', '.'));
  return Number.isFinite(legacy) && legacy > 0 ? legacy : 0;
}

import { addFile, fileCategory, CATEGORY_LABEL, LINKED_TYPE_LABEL, formatSize, type DocCategory } from './store';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onUploaded: () => void;
  prefillType?: string;
  prefillId?: string;
}

const ACCEPT = 'image/*,application/pdf,audio/*,video/*,.xlsx,.xls,.csv';

export default function UploadModal({ open, onClose, onUploaded, prefillType, prefillId }: Props) {
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<DocCategory>('image');
  const [linkedType, setLinkedType] = useState(prefillType || 'none');
  const [linkedId, setLinkedId] = useState(prefillId || '');
  const [tags, setTags] = useState('');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);

  const reset = () => {
    setFile(null);
    setCategory('image');
    setLinkedType(prefillType || 'none');
    setLinkedId(prefillId || '');
    setTags('');
    setNotes('');
    setErr('');
    setUploading(false);
    if (fileRef.current) fileRef.current.value = '';
  };

  const handleSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const f = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (f) {
      setFile(f);
      setCategory(fileCategory(f.type, f.name));
      setErr('');
    }
  };

  const handleUpload = async () => {
    if (file === null) { setErr('لطفاً یک فایل انتخاب کنید'); return; }
    if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
      setErr('حجم فایل بیشتر از ۱۰ مگابایت است');
      return;
    }

    setUploading(true);
    try {
      const tagList = tags.split(',').map(t => t.trim()).filter(t => t.length > 0);
      await addFile(file, category, linkedType, linkedId, tagList, notes);
      reset();
      onUploaded();
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      setErr('خطا در ذخیره‌ی فایل');
    }
    setUploading(false);
  };

  const handleCancel = () => {
    reset();
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={handleCancel}
      title="📎 افزودن فایل"
      footer={
        <BtnRow>
          <Btn variant="primary" onClick={handleUpload} disabled={uploading || file === null}>
            {uploading ? 'در حال ذخیره...' : 'ذخیره'}
          </Btn>
          <Btn onClick={handleCancel}>لغو</Btn>
        </BtnRow>
      }
    >
      {/* انتخاب فایل */}
      <input
        ref={fileRef}
        type="file"
        accept={ACCEPT}
        style={{ display: 'none' }}
        onChange={handleSelect}
      />

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}
        style={{
          padding: '24px 16px',
          background: 'var(--input-bg)',
          border: '2px dashed var(--accent-border)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)',
          cursor: 'pointer',
          fontFamily: 'inherit',
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: 8
        }}
      >
        {file === null ? (
          <>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-hero)' }}>📎</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--accent)' }}>
              برای انتخاب فایل بزنید
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
              تصویر، PDF، صدا، ویدیو یا Excel — حداکثر ۱۰ مگابایت
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-hero)' }}>
              {category === 'image' ? '🖼' : category === 'pdf' ? '📄' : category === 'audio' ? '🎵' : category === 'video' ? '🎬' : category === 'excel' ? '📊' : '📎'}
            </div>
            <div style={{
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)',
              maxWidth: '100%', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap'
            }}>
              {file.name}
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
              {formatSize(file.size)} • {CATEGORY_LABEL[category]}
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--accent)', marginTop: 4 }}>
              برای تغییر، دوباره بزنید
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </button>

      {/* دسته */}
      <Field label="دسته‌ی فایل">
        <Select value={category} onChange={e => setCategory(e.target.value as DocCategory)}>
          {(Object.keys(CATEGORY_LABEL) as DocCategory[]).map(c => (
            <option key={c} value={c}>{CATEGORY_LABEL[c]}</option>
          ))}
        </Select>
      </Field>

      {/* اتصال به رکورد */}
      <Field label="اتصال به" hint="اختیاری — فایل را به یک رکورد وصل کن">
        <Select value={linkedType} onChange={e => setLinkedType(e.target.value)}>
          {Object.entries(LINKED_TYPE_LABEL).map(([k, v]) => (
            <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>
          ))}
        </Select>
      </Field>

      {linkedType !== 'none' ? (
        <Field label="شناسه‌ی رکورد" hint="اگر نمی‌دانید خالی بگذارید">
          <Input
            value={linkedId}
            onChange={e => setLinkedId(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="شناسه رکورد"
            dir="ltr"
          />
        </Field>
      ) : null}

      {/* برچسب‌ها */}
      <Field label="برچسب‌ها" hint="با کاما جدا کن — فاکتور، رسید، ۱۴۰۵">
        <Input value={tags} onChange={e => setTags(e.target.value)} placeholder="فاکتور، آذر ۱۴۰۵" />
      </Field>

      {/* یادداشت */}
      <Field label="یادداشت">
            <Textarea value={notes} onChange={e => setNotes(e.target.value)} placeholder="..." />
          </Field>

      <ErrorBox>{err}</ErrorBox>
    </Modal>
  );
}

import { openDB, type IDBPDatabase } from 'idb';

const DB_NAME = 'pm-docs';
const DB_VERSION = 1;
const STORE_NAME = 'files';

export interface DocFile {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: string;        // MIME type
  size: number;        // bytes
  blob: Blob;
  category: DocCategory;
  linkedType: string;  // flk | hal | ctc | inc | whs | tra | null
  linkedId: string;    // شناسه‌ی رکورد
  tags: string[];
  notes: string;
  uploadedAt: string;  // ISO
}

export type DocCategory = 'image' | 'pdf' | 'audio' | 'video' | 'excel' | 'other';

export const CATEGORY_LABEL: Record<DocCategory, string> = {
  image: 'تصویر',
  pdf: 'PDF',
  audio: 'صدا',
  video: 'ویدیو',
  excel: 'Excel',
  other: 'سایر'
};

export const CATEGORY_ICON: Record<DocCategory, string> = {
  image: '🖼',
  pdf: '📄',
  audio: '🎵',
  video: '🎬',
  excel: '📊',
  other: '📎'
};

export const LINKED_TYPE_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  flk: 'گله',
  hal: 'سالن',
  ctc: 'مخاطب',
  inc: 'جوجه‌کشی',
  whs: 'انبار',
  tra: 'معامله',
  none: 'بدون اتصال'
};

let dbPromise: Promise<IDBPDatabase> | null = null;

function getDB() {
  if (dbPromise === null) {
    dbPromise = openDB(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION, {
      upgrade(db) {
        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
          const store = db.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME, { keyPath: 'id' });
          store.createIndex('linkedType', 'linkedType');
          store.createIndex('linkedId', 'linkedId');
          store.createIndex('category', 'category');
          store.createIndex('uploadedAt', 'uploadedAt');
        }
      }
    });
  }
  return dbPromise;
}

/** تبدیل MIME به دسته */
export function fileCategory(mime: string, name: string): DocCategory {
  if (mime.startsWith('image/')) return 'image';
  if (mime === 'application/pdf') return 'pdf';
  if (mime.startsWith('audio/')) return 'audio';
  if (mime.startsWith('video/')) return 'video';
  if (mime.includes('excel') || mime.includes('spreadsheet') || name.endsWith('.xlsx') || name.endsWith('.csv')) return 'excel';
  return 'other';
}

/** فرمت حجم */
export function formatSize(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < 1024) return bytes + ' B';
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';
  return (bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2) + ' MB';
}

/** افزودن فایل */
export async function addFile(
  file: File,
  category: DocCategory,
  linkedType: string,
  linkedId: string,
  tags: string[],
  notes: string
): Promise<DocFile> {
  const db = await getDB();
  const doc: DocFile = {
    id: crypto.randomUUID(),
    name: file.name,
    type: file.type,
    size: file.size,
    blob: file,
    category,
    linkedType: linkedType || 'none',
    linkedId: linkedId || '',
    tags: tags || [],
    notes: notes || '',
    uploadedAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };
  await db.put(STORE_NAME, doc);
  return doc;
}

/** لیست همه فایل‌ها */
export async function listFiles(): Promise<DocFile[]> {
  const db = await getDB();
  const all = await db.getAll(STORE_NAME);
  return (all as DocFile[]).sort((a, b) => b.uploadedAt.localeCompare(a.uploadedAt));
}

/** فایل‌های یک رکورد */
export async function filesOfLinked(linkedType: string, linkedId: string): Promise<DocFile[]> {
  const db = await getDB();
  const all = await listFiles();
  return all.filter(f => f.linkedType === linkedType && f.linkedId === linkedId);
}

/** حذف فایل */
export async function deleteFile(id: string): Promise<void> {
  const db = await getDB();
  await db.delete(STORE_NAME, id);
}

/** حذف چند فایل */
export async function deleteFiles(ids: string[]): Promise<void> {
  const db = await getDB();
  const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
  await Promise.all(ids.map(id => tx.store.delete(id)));
  await tx.done;
}

/** حجم کل مصرفی */
export async function totalSize(): Promise<number> {
  const files = await listFiles();
  return files.reduce((a, f) => a + f.size, 0);
}

/** دانلود فایل (ذخیره در گوشی) */
export function downloadFile(doc: DocFile): void {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(doc.blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = doc.name;
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 5000);
}

/** باز کردن فایل در تب جدید (پیش‌نمایش) */
export function openFile(doc: DocFile): void {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(doc.blob);
  window.open(url, '_blank');
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 10000);
}

/** ایجاد URL برای پیش‌نمایش */
export function fileURL(blob: Blob): string {
  return URL.createObjectURL(blob);
}

                    <MiniStat

                    <MiniStat

                      value={fcr}

                    />
                    <MiniStat
                      label="آب/دان"
                      value={waterFeedRatio}

                    />

                {weightMetrics.hasData && (

                    />

                )}

                {/* ============ ۴. مالی ============ */}
                <SectionTitle><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>💰</span> مالی این ماه</SectionTitle>
                <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 4 }}>
                  <KpiCard
                    icon="📥"
                    label={`فروش ماه ${momComparison.salesChange !== 0 ? (momComparison.salesChange > 0 ? '📈' : '📉') : ''}`}
                    value={salesThisMonth}
                    unit={`تومان${momComparison.salesChange !== 0 ? ` • ${momComparison.salesChange > 0 ? '+' : ''}${fmt.num(momComparison.salesChange)}٪` : ''}`}
                    color="accent"
                    onClick={() => nav('/tra')}
                  />
                  <KpiCard
                    icon="📤"
                    label={`خرید ماه ${momComparison.purchaseChange !== 0 ? (momComparison.purchaseChange > 0 ? '📈' : '📉') : ''}`}
                    value={purchasesThisMonth}
                    unit={`تومان${momComparison.purchaseChange !== 0 ? ` • ${momComparison.purchaseChange > 0 ? '+' : ''}${fmt.num(momComparison.purchaseChange)}٪` : ''}`}
                    color="warn"
                    onClick={() => nav('/tra')}
                  />
                  <KpiCard
                    icon={profit >= 0 ? '📈' : '📉'}
                    label={profit >= 0 ? 'سود ماه' : 'زیان ماه'}
                    value={Math.abs(profit)}
                    unit="تومان"
                    color={profit >= 0 ? 'accent' : 'danger'}
                    onClick={() => nav('/rep')}
                  />
                  <KpiCard
                    icon="📦"
                    label="ارزش انبار"
                    value={inventoryValue}
                    unit="تومان"
                    color="info"
                    onClick={() => nav('/whs')}
                  />
                </div>

                {receivables > 0 ? (
                  <div role="button" tabIndex={0}
                    onClick={() => nav('/tra')}
                    style={{
                      padding: 'var(--pad-inner)',
                      background: 'var(--accent-soft)',
                      border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)',
                      borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                      display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center',
                      cursor: 'pointer'
                    }}
                  >
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                      📥 طلب از مشتریان
                    </span>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' }}>
                      {fmt.money(receivables)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/dsh/BenchmarkCard.tsx
==========================================
import { useFormat, getGlobalFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useFlk, getAgeDays } from '../flk/store';
import { useDlg } from '../dlg/store';
import { applyCorrections } from '../dlg/api/applyCorrections';
import { toFa } from '../../shr/utils/fa';

export default function BenchmarkCard() {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { flocks } = useFlk();
  const { logs } = useDlg();

  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    return flocks.map(f => {
      const fLogs = logs.filter(l => l.flockId === f.id);
      const totalFeed = fLogs.map(applyCorrections).reduce((a, l) => a + (l.feedConsumed || l.feedDelivered || 0), 0);
      const totalDeaths = fLogs.map(applyCorrections).reduce((a, l) => a + (l.deathsCount || 0), 0);
      const initial = f.initialCount || 0;
      const alive = f.currentCount || initial;
      const mortality = initial > 0 ? (totalDeaths / initial) * 100 : 0;
      const feedPerBird = initial > 0 ? totalFeed / initial : 0;
      const age = getAgeDays(f);
      const status = f.status;
      return { id: f.id, name: f.name, status, age, mortality, feedPerBird, initial };
    }).filter(r => r.initial > 0);
  }, [flocks, logs]);

  if (rows.length < 2) return null;

  const active = rows.filter(r => r.status === 'active');
  const archived = rows.filter(r => r.status !== 'active');

  const avg = (arr: number[]) => arr.length ? arr.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / arr.length : 0;
  const activeAvgMort = avg(active.map(r => r.mortality));
  const archAvgMort = avg(archived.map(r => r.mortality));
  const activeAvgFeed = avg(active.map(r => r.feedPerBird));
  const archAvgFeed = avg(archived.map(r => r.feedPerBird));

  const cmpMort = archAvgMort > 0 ? ((activeAvgMort - archAvgMort) / archAvgMort) * 100 : 0;
  const cmpFeed = archAvgFeed > 0 ? ((activeAvgFeed - archAvgFeed) / archAvgFeed) * 100 : 0;

  const Row = ({ label, active, arch, cmp, lowerBetter }: any) => {
    const good = lowerBetter ? cmp < 0 : cmp > 0;
    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 'var(--pad-inner)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
        <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>{label}</span>
        <span style={{ direction: 'ltr', width: 70, textAlign: 'center', fontWeight: 600 }}>{getGlobalFormat().code(active.toFixed(1))}</span>
        <span style={{ direction: 'ltr', width: 70, textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{getGlobalFormat().code(arch.toFixed(1))}</span>
        <span style={{ direction: 'ltr', width: 70, textAlign: 'center', fontWeight: 700, color: good ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--danger)' }}>
          {cmp > 0 ? '+' : ''}{getGlobalFormat().code(cmp.toFixed(0))}٪
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-card)', background: 'var(--card)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', fontWeight: 700 }}><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📈</span> Benchmark — مقایسه گله‌ها</div>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', lineHeight: 1.7 }}>
        فعال ({getGlobalFormat().count(active.length)}) vs آرشیو ({getGlobalFormat().count(archived.length)})
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '0 10px', fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>
        <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>متریک</span>
        <span style={{ width: 70, textAlign: 'center' }}>فعال</span>
        <span style={{ width: 70, textAlign: 'center' }}>آرشیو</span>
        <span style={{ width: 70, textAlign: 'center' }}>تغییر</span>
      </div>
      <Row label="تلفات ٪" active={activeAvgMort} arch={archAvgMort} cmp={cmpMort} lowerBetter />
      <Row label="دان/پرنده (kg)" active={activeAvgFeed} arch={archAvgFeed} cmp={cmpFeed} lowerBetter />
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * EquipmentCard — کارت خلاصه تجهیزات در Dashboard
 * نمایش ارزش کل، تعداد فعال/تعمیر/اسقاط و تفکیک سالن
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useWhs } from '../whs/store';
import { useHal } from '../hal/store';
import { SectionTitle, KpiCard, MiniStat, MiniEmpty } from './cards';
import { toFa } from '../../shr/utils/fa';

interface Props {
  nav: (p: string) => void;
}

export default function EquipmentCard({ nav }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { items } = useWhs();
  const { halls } = useHal();

  const equipment = useMemo(() => items.filter(i => i.category === 'equipment'), [items]);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    let totalValue = 0;
    let active = 0, repair = 0, scrapped = 0, broken = 0;
    let warrantySoon = 0;
    const byHall: Record<string, { count: number; value: number }> = {};

    const today = new Date();
    equipment.forEach(eq => {
      const v = (eq.purchasePrice || 0);
      totalValue += v;
      const st = eq.equipmentStatus || 'active';
      if (st === 'broken') broken++;
      else if (st === 'repair' || st === 'repairing' || st === 'maintenance') repair++;
      else if (st === 'scrapped' || st === 'retired') scrapped++;
      else active++;

      if (eq.warrantyUntil) {
        try {
          const en = eq.warrantyUntil.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d: string) => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));
          const parts = en.split('/');
          if (parts.length === 3) {
            const wd = new Date(parseInt(parts[0]), parseInt(parts[1]) - 1, parseInt(parts[2]));
            const diff = Math.ceil((wd.getTime() - today.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
            if (diff >= 0 && diff <= 30) warrantySoon++;
          }
        } catch { /* ignore */ }
      }

      const hallId = eq.hallId || '__none__';
      if (!byHall[hallId]) byHall[hallId] = { count: 0, value: 0 };
      byHall[hallId].count++;
      byHall[hallId].value += v;
    });

    return { totalValue, active, repair, scrapped, broken, warrantySoon, byHall, total: equipment.length };
  }, [equipment]);

  if (equipment.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
        <SectionTitle>🔧 تجهیزات</SectionTitle>
        <MiniEmpty icon="🔧" title="تجهیزی ثبت نشده" hint="از بخش انبار → اقلام، تجهیزات رو ثبت کن" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const hallRows = Object.entries(stats.byHall)
    .map(([id, v]) => ({ id, ...v }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);

  return (
    <div style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
      <SectionTitle>🔧 تجهیزات</SectionTitle>

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
        <KpiCard
          icon="💰"
          label="ارزش تجهیزات"
          value={stats.totalValue}
          unit="تومان"
          color="accent"
          onClick={() => nav('/whs/items')}
        />
        <KpiCard
          icon="🔧"
          label="تعداد اقلام"
          value={stats.total}
          unit="قلم"
          color="info"
          onClick={() => nav('/whs/items')}
        />
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr 1fr', gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
        <MiniStat label="✅ فعال" value={stats.active} suffix="" color="accent" />
        <MiniStat label="🔧 تعمیر" value={stats.repair} suffix="" color="warn" />
        <MiniStat label="❌ اسقاط" value={stats.scrapped} suffix="" color="danger" />
      </div>

      {stats.broken > 0 && (
        <div style={{
          marginTop: 8, padding: '8px 12px', background: 'var(--danger-soft)',
          color: 'var(--danger)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
          fontWeight: 700, textAlign: 'center',
        }}>
          🔴 {fmt.count(stats.broken)} تجهیز خراب — بررسی کنید
        </div>
      )}

      {stats.warrantySoon > 0 && (
        <div style={{
          marginTop: 8, padding: '8px 12px', background: 'var(--warn-soft)',
          color: 'var(--warn)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
          fontWeight: 700, textAlign: 'center',
        }}>
          ⏰ {fmt.count(stats.warrantySoon)} تجهیز — گارانتی نزدیک پایان (کمتر از ۳۰ روز)
        </div>
      )}

      {hallRows.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{ marginTop: 10, background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', padding: '8px 10px' }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 6 }}>
            📍 تفکیک بر اساس سالن
          </div>
          {hallRows.map(row => {
            const hall = row.id === '__none__' ? null : halls.find(h => h.id === row.id);
            const label = hall ? hall.name : 'بدون سالن';
            return (
              <div key={row.id} style={{
                display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between',
                fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: '3px 0',
              }}>
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{label}</span>
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                  {fmt.count(row.count)} قلم • {fmt.money(row.value)}
                </span>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * ListCards — coordinator چهار بخش Dashboard
 */
import { MiniEmpty } from './cards';
import AlertList from './sections/AlertList';
import FlockList from './sections/FlockList';
import ActiveIncubations from './sections/ActiveIncubations';
import StockAlertCard from './sections/StockAlertCard';
import type { AlertLevel } from '../alt/store';

interface Props {
  active: Array<{ level: AlertLevel; [k: string]: any }>;
  counts: Record<string, number>;
  activeFlocks: any[];
  birds: any[];
  productions: any[];
  activeEntries: any[];
  stockAlerts: number;
  nav: (p: string) => void;
}

export default function ListCards({
  active, counts, activeFlocks, birds, productions,
  activeEntries, stockAlerts, nav,
}: Props) {
  const isEmpty = active.length === 0 && activeFlocks.length === 0
                  && activeEntries.length === 0 && stockAlerts === 0;

  if (isEmpty) {
    return (
      <MiniEmpty
        icon="✅"
        title="همه‌چیز مرتبه"
        hint="هیچ هشدار، گله فعال، یا جوجه‌کشی در جریان نیست"
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <AlertList active={active} counts={counts} nav={nav} />
      <FlockList activeFlocks={activeFlocks} birds={birds} productions={productions} nav={nav} />
      <ActiveIncubations activeEntries={activeEntries} birds={birds} nav={nav} />
      <StockAlertCard stockAlerts={stockAlerts} nav={nav} />
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * SexingWidget.tsx — کارت «🕐 زمان تفکیک» در Dashboard
 * فاز ۷.۱ — نمای گله‌های breeder unsplit که به sexingAge رسیده‌اند
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useBrd } from '../brd/store';
import { getStandardFor } from '../set/standards/resolve';
import { SectionTitle } from './cards';
import { toFa } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { computeSexingStats } from './sexingWidgetLogic';

interface Props {
  nav: (p: string) => void;
  activeFlocks: any[];
}

export default function SexingWidget({ nav, activeFlocks }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const brd = useBrd();

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const getStdSexingAge = (breedName: string): number | null => {
      try {
        const std = getStandardFor(breedName, {});
        return std?.sexingAgeDay ?? null;
      } catch { return null; }
    };
    return computeSexingStats(activeFlocks, brd.breeds, getStdSexingAge);
  }, [activeFlocks, brd.breeds]);

  if (stats.total === 0) return null;

  const items = [
    { count: stats.overdue, label: 'گذشته از موعد', color: 'danger' as const, icon: '🔴' },
    { count: stats.thisWeek, label: 'این هفته', color: 'warn' as const, icon: '🟠' },
    { count: stats.twoWeeks, label: '۲ هفته آینده', color: 'info' as const, icon: '🟡' },
  ].filter(x => x.count > 0);

  return (
    <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
      <SectionTitle>🕐 زمان تفکیک جنسیت</SectionTitle>
      <div
        role="button"
        tabIndex={0}
        onClick={() => nav('/flocks')}
        style={{
          background: 'var(--card)',
          border: '1px solid var(--border)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
          padding: '12px',
          cursor: 'pointer',
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {items.map(it => (
            <div key={it.label} style={{
              flex: '1 1 100px',
              padding: '8px 10px',
              background: `var(--${it.color}-soft)`,
              border: `1px solid var(--${it.color})`,
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
              textAlign: 'center',
              minWidth: 90,
            }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-lg)', fontWeight: 700, color: `var(--${it.color})` }}>
                {it.icon} {fmt.count(it.count)}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 2 }}>{it.label}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div style={{ marginTop: 8, fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--muted)', textAlign: 'center' }}>
          {fmt.count(stats.total)} گله breeder بدون تفکیک — کلیک برای مشاهده
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * TodayCard — بخش «امروز در یک نگاه»: Benchmark گله + 9 KpiCard
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { KpiCard, SectionTitle, MiniEmpty } from './cards';
import { toFa } from '../../shr/utils/fa';

interface Props {
  benchmarkData: any;
  activeFlocks: any[];
  selectedFlockId: string;
  setSelectedFlockId: (v: string) => void;
  eggsToday: number;
  deathsToday: number;
  feedToday: number;
  tempToday: number;
  feedPerBirdGrams: number;

/**
 * useDashboardData — state و محاسبات Dashboard
 */
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { getBreedFcr } from '../../brd/_display-values';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { parse as parseJ, differenceInDays as diffDaysJ, format as formatJ } from 'date-fns-jalali';
import { useTra, remaining } from '../../tra/store';
import { useCtc } from '../../ctc/store';
import { useEgg, healthyCount } from '../../egg/store';
import { useFlk, getAgeDays } from '../../flk/store';
import { useInc, daysToHatch } from '../../inc/store';
import { useWhs, stockWarning, expiryWarning } from '../../whs/store';
import { useAlt, activeAlerts, countByLevel } from '../../alt/store';
import { runRules } from '../../alt/rules';
import { useBrd } from '../../brd/store';
import { useDlg, avgWeight as avgWeightFn, cvWeight as cvWeightFn } from '../../dlg/store';
import { applyCorrections } from '../../dlg/api/applyCorrections';
import { monthKey, currentMonth, todayJalali, dateDiffDays } from '../utils';
import { aggregateEggMetrics } from '../../../shr/calc/formulas/egg';
import { calculateWaterMetrics } from '../../../shr/calc/formulas/water';

function fcrBorder(diff: number): string {
  if (diff <= 0) return 'var(--accent-border)';
  if (diff <= 10) return 'var(--warn)';
  return 'var(--danger)';
}

function moneyUnit(change: number): string {
  if (change === 0) return 'تومان';
  const sign = change > 0 ? '+' : '';
  return `تومان • ${sign}${change}٪`;
}

// 🆕 استاندارد چرخه تخم‌گذاری (SAP)
const START_WINDOW_DAYS = 14;   // ۱۴ روز قبل از شروع تخم‌گذاری
const END_WINDOW_DAYS = 30;     // ۳۰ روز قبل از پایان چرخه
const FALLBACK_END_DAYS = 550;  // پایان پیش‌فرض breeder اگر کاربر تعریف نکرده

export function useDashboardData() {
  const nav = useNavigate();
const [, _setTick] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setInterval(() => _setTick(x => x + 1), 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, []);
  const [selectedFlockId, setSelectedFlockId] = useState<string>('');
  const [trendDays, setTrendDays] = useState<7 | 30 | 90>(7);

  const { invoices } = useTra();
  const { contacts } = useCtc();
  const { productions } = useEgg();
  const { flocks } = useFlk();
  const { eggEntries } = useInc();
  const { items: whsItems } = useWhs();
  const { alerts } = useAlt();
  const { birds, breeds } = useBrd();
  const rawLogs = useDlg(s => s.logs);
  const logs = useMemo(() => rawLogs.map(applyCorrections), [rawLogs]);

  useEffect(() => { runRules(); }, []);

  const today = todayJalali();
  const thisMonth = currentMonth();

  // ============ گله‌های فعال ============
  const activeFlocks = useMemo(() => flocks.filter(f => f.status === 'active' && !f.paused), [flocks]);

  // انتخاب خودکار اولین گله فعال
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedFlockId && activeFlocks.length > 0) {
      setSelectedFlockId(activeFlocks[0].id);
    }
    if (selectedFlockId && !activeFlocks.find(f => f.id === selectedFlockId) && activeFlocks.length > 0) {
      setSelectedFlockId(activeFlocks[0].id);
    }
  }, [activeFlocks, selectedFlockId]);

  // ============ ۱. امروز در یک نگاه ============
  const todayProd = useMemo(() => productions.filter(p => p.date === today), [productions, today]);
  const eggsToday = todayProd.reduce((a, p) => a + (p.totalCount || 0), 0);
  const brokenToday = todayProd.reduce((a, p) => a + (p.brokenCount || 0), 0);

  const todayLogs = useMemo(() => logs.filter(l => l.date === today), [logs, today]);
  const effectiveTodayLogs = useMemo(() => todayLogs.map(applyCorrections), [todayLogs]);
  const deathsToday = effectiveTodayLogs.reduce((a, l) => a + (l.deathsCount || 0), 0);
  const feedToday = effectiveTodayLogs.reduce((a, l) => a + (l.feedDelivered || 0), 0);
  const waterToday = effectiveTodayLogs.reduce((a, l) => a + (l.waterAmount || 0), 0);
  const tempToday = effectiveTodayLogs.length > 0 ? (effectiveTodayLogs[0].temperature || 0) : 0;
  const humidToday = effectiveTodayLogs.length > 0 ? (effectiveTodayLogs[0].humidity || 0) : 0;

  // ============ سرسیدهای نزدیک ============
  const daysUntilDue = useCallback((dueDate: string): number | null => {
    if (!dueDate) return null;
    try {
      const en = dueDate.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d: string) => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));
      const d = parseJ(en, 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
      if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
      return diffDaysJ(d, new Date());
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }, []);

  const upcomingDues = useMemo(() => {
    return invoices
      .filter(i => remaining(i) > 0 && i.dueDate && !i.remindersMuted && i.disputeStatus !== 'open')
      .map(i => ({ inv: i, days: daysUntilDue(i.dueDate) }))
      .filter(x => x.days !== null && x.days <= 7)
      .sort((a, b) => (a.days ?? 0) - (b.days ?? 0))
      .slice(0, 5);
  }, [invoices, daysUntilDue]);

  const pendingChecks = useMemo(() => {
    const list: { inv: any; pay: any }[] = [];
    invoices.filter(i => remaining(i) > 0).forEach(inv => {
      (inv.payments || []).forEach((p) => {
        if (p.method === 'check' && (!p.status || p.status === 'pending')) {
          list.push({ inv, pay: p });
        }
      });
    });
    return list.sort((a, b) => (a.pay.dueDate || '').localeCompare(b.pay.dueDate || '')).slice(0, 5);
  }, [invoices]);


  // ============ ۲. سلامت گله ============
  const aliveCount = useMemo(() =>
    activeFlocks.reduce((a, f) => a + (f.currentCount || f.initialCount || 0), 0),
    [activeFlocks]
  );

  // 🆕 C3a — laying count: فقط layer/breeder + femaleCount برای گله sexed
  const layingAliveCount = useMemo(() =>
    activeFlocks
      .filter(f => f.type === 'layer' || f.type === 'breeder')
      .reduce((a, f) => {
        if (f.femaleCount && f.femaleCount > 0) return a + f.femaleCount;
        return a + (f.currentCount || f.initialCount || 0);
      }, 0),
    [activeFlocks]
  );

  const totalInitial = useMemo(() =>
    activeFlocks.reduce((a, f) => a + (f.initialCount || 0), 0),
    [activeFlocks]
  );

  const survivalRate = totalInitial > 0 ? (aliveCount / totalInitial) * 100 : 100;
  const cumulativeMortality = totalInitial > 0 ? ((totalInitial - aliveCount) / totalInitial) * 100 : 0;

  // Hen-Day + Broken Rate — ۷ روز، از aggregateEggMetrics (orphan connected)
  const eggMetrics7d = useMemo(() => {
    const last7 = productions.filter(p => dateDiffDays(p.date) <= 7);
    const days = Math.max(1, new Set(last7.map(p => p.date)).size);
    const healthy = last7.reduce((a, p) => a + healthyCount(p), 0);
    const broken = last7.reduce((a, p) => a + (p.brokenCount || 0), 0);
    const dirty = last7.reduce((a, p) => a + (p.softCount || 0) + (p.dirtyCount || 0), 0);
    return aggregateEggMetrics(
      days, healthy, broken, dirty,
      layingAliveCount, totalInitial, null, null
    );
  }, [productions, layingAliveCount, totalInitial]);

  const henDay7 = eggMetrics7d.henDayPct;
  const brokenRate7 = eggMetrics7d.brokenRatePct;

  // ============ ۳. عملکرد تولیدی ============
  // روند ۷ روزه تخم
  const eggTrend = useMemo(() => {
    const days: { label: string; value: number }[] = [];
    for (let i = trendDays - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = new Date();
      d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
      const key = formatJ(d, 'yyyy/MM/dd');
      const prods = productions.filter(p => p.date === key);
      const total = prods.reduce((a, p) => a + (p.totalCount || 0), 0);
      days.push({ label: formatJ(d, 'dd'), value: total });
    }
    return days;
  }, [productions, trendDays]);

  // ─── FCR ماه — تفکیک بر اساس نوع گله (قانون: broiler ≠ layer) ───
  // FCR گوشتی: دان ÷ افزایش وزن بدن
  const fcrBroiler = useMemo(() => {
    const broilerFlocks = flocks.filter(f => f.type === 'broiler');
    if (broilerFlocks.length === 0) return 0;
    const broilerIds = new Set(broilerFlocks.map(f => f.id));
    const monthLogs = logs.filter(l => monthKey(l.date) === thisMonth && broilerIds.has(l.flockId));
    if (monthLogs.length === 0) return 0;
    const feed = monthLogs.map(applyCorrections).reduce((a, l) => a + (l.feedConsumed || l.feedDelivered || 0), 0);
    let totalGain = 0;
    for (const f of broilerFlocks) {
      const lastLog = [...monthLogs].reverse().find(l => l.flockId === f.id && l.weightSamples && l.weightSamples.length > 0);
      if (lastLog && lastLog.weightSamples) {
        const avgW = avgWeightFn(lastLog.weightSamples.map((w: any) => ({ id: w.id, weight: Number(w.weight) || 0 })));
        const chickW = (f.chickWeight ?? 40) / 1000;
        totalGain += (avgW - chickW) * (f.currentCount || 0);
      }
    }
    return totalGain > 0 ? Math.round((feed / totalGain) * 100) / 100 : 0;
  }, [logs, flocks, thisMonth]);

  // FCR تخم‌گذار/مادر: دان ÷ وزن تخم
  const fcrLayer = useMemo(() => {
    const layerFlocks = flocks.filter(f => f.type === 'layer' || f.type === 'breeder');
    if (layerFlocks.length === 0) return 0;
    const layerIds = new Set(layerFlocks.map(f => f.id));
    const monthLogs = logs.filter(l => monthKey(l.date) === thisMonth && layerIds.has(l.flockId));
    const monthProd = productions.filter(p => monthKey(p.date) === thisMonth && layerIds.has(p.flockId));
    const feed = monthLogs.map(applyCorrections).reduce((a, l) => a + (l.feedConsumed || l.feedDelivered || 0), 0);
    const eggsWeight = monthProd.reduce((a, p) => a + (p.totalCount || 0) * 0.06, 0);
    return eggsWeight > 0 ? Math.round((feed / eggsWeight) * 100) / 100 : 0;
  }, [logs, productions, flocks, thisMonth]);

  // فیلد قدیمی — سازگاری (اولویت به غیرصفر)
  const fcr = fcrBroiler > 0 ? fcrBroiler : fcrLayer;

  // نسبت آب به دان — از calculateWaterMetrics (orphan connected)
  const waterMetrics7d = useMemo(() => {
    const last7 = logs.filter(l => dateDiffDays(l.date) <= 7);
    const water = last7.reduce((a, l) => a + (l.waterAmount || 0), 0);
    const feed = last7.map(applyCorrections).reduce((a, l) => a + (l.feedConsumed || l.feedDelivered || 0), 0);
    return calculateWaterMetrics({
      waterAmountL: water,
      feedConsumedKg: feed,
      aliveCount,
      standardWaterFeedRatio: null,
    });
  }, [logs, aliveCount]);

  const waterFeedRatio = waterMetrics7d.waterFeedRatio;
  const waterFeedTone = waterMetrics7d.waterFeedTone;
  const waterFeedWarning = waterMetrics7d.warning;

  // ============ ۴. مالی ============
  const salesThisMonth = useMemo(() =>
    invoices.filter(i => i.type === 'sale' && monthKey(i.date) === thisMonth)
      .reduce((a, i) => a + (i.total || 0), 0),
    [invoices, thisMonth]
  );

  const purchasesThisMonth = useMemo(() =>
    invoices.filter(i => i.type === 'purchase' && monthKey(i.date) === thisMonth)
      .reduce((a, i) => a + (i.total || 0), 0),
    [invoices, thisMonth]
  );

  const profit = salesThisMonth - purchasesThisMonth;

  const receivables = useMemo(() =>
    invoices.filter(i => i.type === 'sale' && i.disputeStatus !== 'open').reduce((a, i) => a + remaining(i), 0),
    [invoices]
  );

  const inventoryValue = useMemo(() =>
    whsItems.reduce((a, i) => a + ((i.currentStock || 0) * (i.lastPrice || 0)), 0),
    [whsItems]
  );

  // هزینه هر تخم این ماه
  const costPerEgg = useMemo(() => {
    if (salesThisMonth === 0) return 0;
    const monthProd = productions.filter(p => monthKey(p.date) === thisMonth);
    const eggs = monthProd.reduce((a, p) => a + (p.totalCount || 0), 0);
    if (eggs === 0) return 0;
    return Math.round(purchasesThisMonth / eggs);
  }, [productions, purchasesThisMonth, thisMonth, salesThisMonth]);

  // ============ ۵. هشدارها ============
  // ============ KPIهای جهانی ============
  // مصرف دان/پرنده/روز (گرم)
  const feedPerBirdGrams = useMemo(() => {
    if (aliveCount === 0) return 0;
    const last7 = logs.filter(l => dateDiffDays(l.date) <= 7);
    if (last7.length === 0) return 0;
    const totalFeed = last7.reduce((a, l) => a + (l.feedDelivered || 0), 0);
    const days = 7;
    // totalFeed (kg) / aliveCount / days * 1000 (گرم)
    return Math.round((totalFeed / aliveCount / days) * 1000);
  }, [logs, aliveCount]);

  // مصرف آب/پرنده/روز (میلی‌لیتر)
  const waterPerBirdMl = useMemo(() => {
    if (aliveCount === 0) return 0;
    const last7 = logs.filter(l => dateDiffDays(l.date) <= 7);
    if (last7.length === 0) return 0;
    const totalWater = last7.reduce((a, l) => a + (l.waterAmount || 0), 0);
    const days = 7;
    // totalWater (L) / aliveCount / days * 1000 (ml)
    return Math.round((totalWater / aliveCount / days) * 1000);
  }, [logs, aliveCount]);

  // ADG و CV% از آخرین وزن‌کشی
  const weightMetrics = useMemo(() => {
    const lastWeightLog = [...logs]
      .filter(l => l.weightSamples && l.weightSamples.length > 0)
      .sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date))[0];

    if (!lastWeightLog || !lastWeightLog.weightSamples) {
      return { avgWeight: 0, cv: 0, adg: 0, hasData: false };
    }

    const samples = lastWeightLog.weightSamples;
    const weights = samples.map(s => s.weight).filter(w => w > 0);
    if (weights.length === 0) return { avgWeight: 0, cv: 0, adg: 0, hasData: false };

    // 🆕 یکسان‌سازی با dlg/store (calc orphan connected)
    const weightSamples = weights.map((w, i) => ({ id: `w${i}`, weight: w }));
    const avgKg = avgWeightFn(weightSamples);
    const cvPct = cvWeightFn(weightSamples);

    // ADG: میانگین وزن / سن گله (روز) — semantic متفاوت از calc.adgG
    const mean = weights.reduce((a, w) => a + w, 0) / weights.length;
    const flockId = lastWeightLog.flockId;
    const flock = activeFlocks.find(f => f.id === flockId);
    const ageDays = flock ? getAgeDays(flock) : 0;
    const adg = ageDays > 0 ? (mean * 1000) / ageDays : 0; // گرم در روز

    return {
      avgWeight: avgKg,
      cv: cvPct,
      adg: Math.round(adg * 10) / 10,
      hasData: true,
    };
  }, [logs, activeFlocks]);

  // مقایسه ماه قبل
  const momComparison = useMemo(() => {
    const d = new Date();
    const prevMonth = d.getMonth() === 0
      ? `${d.getFullYear() - 1}/12`
      : `${d.getFullYear()}/${String(d.getMonth()).padStart(2, '0')}`;

    const prevSales = invoices.filter(i => i.type === 'sale' && i.date && i.date.startsWith(prevMonth)).reduce((a, i) => a + (i.total || 0), 0);
    const prevPurchases = invoices
      .filter(i => i.type === 'purchase' && i.date && i.date.startsWith(prevMonth))
      .reduce((a, i) => a + (i.total || 0), 0);

    const salesChange = prevSales > 0 ? ((salesThisMonth - prevSales) / prevSales) * 100 : 0;
    const purchaseChange = prevPurchases > 0 ? ((purchasesThisMonth - prevPurchases) / prevPurchases) * 100 : 0;

    return {
      salesChange: Math.round(salesChange),
      purchaseChange: Math.round(purchaseChange),
    };
  }, [invoices, salesThisMonth, purchasesThisMonth]);

  // ============ Benchmark نژاد ============
  const benchmarkData = useMemo(() => {
    const flock = activeFlocks.find(f => f.id === selectedFlockId);
    if (!flock) return null;

    const bird = birds.find(b => b.id === flock.birdId);
    const breed = breeds.find(b => b.id === flock.breedId);

    // استاندارد: FCR پویا (override > standard)
    const fcrStandard = getBreedFcr(breed) || 0;

    // داده‌های این گله
    const flockLogs = logs.filter((l) => l.flockId === flock.id);
    const flockProd = productions.filter((p) => p.flockId === flock.id);

    const totalFeed = flockLogs.reduce((a, l) => a + (l.feedDelivered || 0), 0);
    const totalEggs = flockProd.reduce((a, p) => a + (p.totalCount || 0), 0);

    // 🆕 FCR بر اساس نوع گله (قانون: broiler = وزن بدن، layer/breeder = وزن تخم)
    let fcrActual = 0;
    if (flock.type === 'broiler') {
      // FCR گوشتی: دان ÷ افزایش وزن بدن
      const lastWeightsLog = [...flockLogs]
        .filter((l: any) => l.weightSamples && l.weightSamples.length > 0)
        .sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date))[0] as any;
      const weights = lastWeightsLog?.weightSamples || [];
      const avgW = weights.length > 0
        ? weights.reduce((a: number, w: any) => a + (Number(w.weight) || 0), 0) / weights.length
        : 0;
      const chickW = (flock.chickWeight ?? 40) / 1000; // گرم → کیلوگرم
      const currentCount = flock.currentCount || flock.initialCount || 0;
      const totalGain = (avgW - chickW) * currentCount;
      fcrActual = totalGain > 0 ? totalFeed / totalGain : 0;
    } else {
      // FCR تخم‌گذار/مادر: دان ÷ وزن تخم
      const eggMass = totalEggs * 0.06; // kg (میانگین ۶۰ گرم)
      fcrActual = eggMass > 0 ? totalFeed / eggMass : 0;
    }

    // Hen-Day این گله
    const aliveCount = flock.currentCount || flock.initialCount || 0;
    const flockHenDay = (() => {
      const last7 = flockProd.filter((p) => dateDiffDays(p.date) <= 7);
      if (last7.length === 0 || aliveCount === 0) return 0;
      const sum = last7.reduce((a, p) => a + (p.totalCount || 0), 0);
      const days = 7;
      return (sum / aliveCount / days) * 100;
    })();

    // مقایسه
    const fcrDiff = fcrStandard > 0 && fcrActual > 0
      ? ((fcrActual - fcrStandard) / fcrStandard) * 100
      : 0;

    return {
      flock,
      bird,
      breed,
      fcrStandard,
      fcrActual: Math.round(fcrActual * 100) / 100,
      fcrDiff: Math.round(fcrDiff),
      henDay: Math.round(flockHenDay * 10) / 10,
      hasData: fcrStandard > 0 && fcrActual > 0,
    };
  }, [selectedFlockId, activeFlocks, birds, breeds, logs, productions]);

  // ============ هشدارهای تجمیعی ============
  const aggregatedAlerts = useMemo(() => {
    const list: { icon: string; label: string; count: number; tone: string; route: string }[] = [];

    // ۱. انبار: انقضا
    const expiring = whsItems.filter(i => {
      const w = expiryWarning(i);
      return w === 'soon' || w === 'expired';
    }).length;
    if (expiring > 0) list.push({ icon: '💊', label: 'قلم نزدیک انقضا', count: expiring, tone: 'danger', route: '/whs' });

    // ۲. انبار: زیر حد
    const lowStock = whsItems.filter(i => {
      const w = stockWarning(i);
      return w === 'low' || w === 'critical';
    }).length;
    if (lowStock > 0) list.push({ icon: '🌾', label: 'قلم زیر حد موجودی', count: lowStock, tone: 'warn', route: '/whs' });

    // ۳. جوجه‌کشی: هچ نزدیک
    const nearHatch = eggEntries.filter(e => {
      const d = daysToHatch(e as any);
      return d !== null && d !== undefined && d >= 0 && d <= 3 && e.status !== 'done' && e.status !== 'hatched';
    }).length;
    if (nearHatch > 0) list.push({ icon: '🐣', label: 'هچ در ۳ روز آینده', count: nearHatch, tone: 'info', route: '/inc' });

    // ۴. هشدارهای بحرانی
    const critical = activeAlerts(alerts).filter(a => a.level === 'critical').length;
    if (critical > 0) list.push({ icon: '🚨', label: 'هشدار بحرانی', count: critical, tone: 'danger', route: '/alt' });

    // ۵. چرخه تخم‌گذاری (SAP 4-stage lifecycle)
    const layerBreeds = activeFlocks.filter(f =>
      (f.type === 'layer' || f.type === 'breeder') && f.status === 'active'
    );
    let startingSoon = 0;
    let endingSoon = 0;
    let stopped = 0;
    for (const f of layerBreeds) {
      const age = getAgeDays(f);
      const start = f.layingStartDay || 140;
      const end = f.endOfCycleDay || FALLBACK_END_DAYS;
      if (age > end) {
        stopped++;
      } else if (age >= end - END_WINDOW_DAYS) {
        endingSoon++;
      } else if (age >= start - START_WINDOW_DAYS && age < start) {
        startingSoon++;
      }
    }
    if (stopped > 0) {
      list.push({ icon: '⏹', label: 'تخم‌گذاری متوقف', count: stopped, tone: 'muted', route: '/flk' });
    }
    if (endingSoon > 0) {
      list.push({ icon: '🔚', label: 'پایان چرخه نزدیک', count: endingSoon, tone: 'danger', route: '/flk' });
    }
    if (startingSoon > 0) {
      list.push({ icon: '⏰', label: 'شروع تخم‌گذاری نزدیک', count: startingSoon, tone: 'warn', route: '/flk' });
    }

    return list;
  }, [whsItems, eggEntries, alerts, activeFlocks]);

  const active = useMemo(() => {
    const list = activeAlerts(alerts);
    const order: any = { critical: 0, important: 1, info: 2 };
    return list.sort((a, b) => order[a.level] - order[b.level]).slice(0, 4);
  }, [alerts]);

  const counts = countByLevel(alerts);

  const stockAlerts = useMemo(() =>
    whsItems.filter(i => stockWarning(i) !== 'ok' || expiryWarning(i) !== 'ok').length,
    [whsItems]
  );

  const activeEntries = useMemo(() =>
    eggEntries.filter(e => e.status !== 'done' && e.status !== 'hatched'),
    [eggEntries]
  );

  const hasData = aliveCount > 0 || invoices.length > 0 || productions.length > 0;

  // رنگ تلفات
  const survivalTone: 'accent' | 'warn' | 'danger' = survivalRate >= 95 ? 'accent' : survivalRate >= 90 ? 'warn' : 'danger';
  const henDayTone: 'accent' | 'warn' | 'danger' = henDay7 >= 80 ? 'accent' : henDay7 >= 60 ? 'warn' : 'danger';
  const brokenTone: 'accent' | 'warn' | 'danger' = brokenRate7 <= 3 ? 'accent' : brokenRate7 <= 6 ? 'warn' : 'danger';

  return {
    nav,
    selectedFlockId, setSelectedFlockId, trendDays, setTrendDays,
    invoices, contacts, productions, flocks, eggEntries, whsItems, alerts, birds, breeds, logs,
    today, thisMonth,
    activeFlocks, todayProd, eggsToday, brokenToday, todayLogs, deathsToday, feedToday, waterToday, tempToday, humidToday,
    daysUntilDue, upcomingDues, pendingChecks,
    aliveCount, totalInitial, survivalRate, cumulativeMortality,
    henDay7, brokenRate7, eggTrend, fcr, fcrBroiler, fcrLayer, waterFeedRatio, waterFeedTone, waterFeedWarning,
    salesThisMonth, purchasesThisMonth, profit, receivables, inventoryValue, costPerEgg,
    feedPerBirdGrams, waterPerBirdMl, weightMetrics, momComparison,
    benchmarkData, aggregatedAlerts, active, counts, stockAlerts, activeEntries, hasData,
    survivalTone, henDayTone, brokenTone,
  };
}

/**
 * ActiveIncubations — لیست جوجه‌کشی‌های فعال
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { Tag } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { daysToHatch, isLockdown, isHatchWindow } from '../../inc/store';

interface Props {
  activeEntries: any[];
  birds: any[];
  nav: (p: string) => void;
}

export default function ActiveIncubations({ activeEntries, birds, nav }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  if (activeEntries.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <>
{/* ============ ۷. جوجه‌کشی فعال ============ */}
            {activeEntries.length > 0 ? (
              <>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', padding: '4px 4px 8px' }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                    🥚 جوجه‌کشی فعال ({fmt.count(activeEntries.length)})
                  </span>
                  <span onClick={() => nav('/inc')} style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--accent)', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                    مشاهده ←
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div style={{
                  background: 'var(--card)',
                  border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                  borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)',
                  overflow: 'hidden'
                }}>
                  {activeEntries.slice(0, 2).map((e, i) => {
                    const days = daysToHatch(e.expectedHatchDate);
                    const locked = isLockdown(e);
                    const window = isHatchWindow(e);
                    const bird = birds.find(b => b.id === e.birdId);

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={e.id}
                        onClick={() => nav('/inc')}
                        style={{
                          padding: 'var(--pad-card)',
                          borderBottom: i < Math.min(activeEntries.length, 2) - 1 ? '1px solid var(--border)' : 'none',
                          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10,
                          cursor: 'pointer'
                        }}
                      >
                        <div style={{
                          width: 36, height: 36, borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                          background: window ? 'var(--purple-soft)' : locked ? 'var(--warn-soft)' : 'var(--accent-soft)',
                          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                          fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', flexShrink: 0
                        }}>🥚</div>
                        <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                          <div style={{
                            fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 600,
                            whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis'
                          }}>
                            {fmt.count(e.count || 0)} تخم — {bird?.name || '—'}
                          </div>
                          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 2 }}>
                            {window ? '🐣 پنجره هچ' : locked ? '🔒 Lock-down' : fmt.day(days) + ' روز مانده'}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        {window ? <Tag tone="purple">هچ</Tag> : locked ? <Tag tone="amber">قفل</Tag> : <Tag tone="blue">{fmt.day(days)} روز</Tag>}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </>
            ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * AlertList — لیست هشدارهای فعال Dashboard
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { Tag } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { LEVEL_ICON, LEVEL_LABEL } from '../../alt/store';
import type { AlertLevel } from '../../alt/store';

interface Props {
  active: Array<{ level: AlertLevel; [k: string]: any }>;
  counts: Record<string, number>;
  nav: (p: string) => void;
}

export default function AlertList({ active, counts, nav }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  if (active.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <>
{/* ============ ۵. هشدارها ============ */}
            {active.length > 0 ? (
              <>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', padding: '4px 4px 8px' }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                    🔔 هشدارهای فعال ({fmt.count(counts.total)})
                  </span>
                  <span onClick={() => nav('/alt')} style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--accent)', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                    مشاهده همه ←
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div style={{
                  background: 'var(--card)',
                  border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                  borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)',
                  overflow: 'hidden'
                }}>
                  {active.map((a, i) => (
                    <div
                      key={a.id}
                      onClick={() => nav('/alt')}
                      style={{
                        padding: 'var(--pad-card)',
                        borderBottom: i < active.length - 1 ? '1px solid var(--border)' : 'none',
                        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10,
                        cursor: 'pointer'
                      }}
                    >
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', flexShrink: 0 }}>{LEVEL_ICON[a.level]}</span>
                      <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                        <div style={{
                          fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 600,
                          whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis'
                        }}>
                          {a.title}
                        </div>
                        <div style={{
                          fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 2,
                          whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis'
                        }}>
                          {a.message}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <Tag tone={a.level === 'critical' ? 'red' : a.level === 'important' ? 'amber' : 'blue'}>
                        {LEVEL_LABEL[a.level]}
                      </Tag>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </>
            ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * FlockList — لیست گله‌های فعال Dashboard
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { Tag } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { getAgeDays, getLifecycle } from '../../flk/store';
import { healthyCount } from '../../egg/store';
import { dateDiffDays } from '../utils';

const CYCLE_MILESTONES: Record<string, { day: number; label: string }[]> = {
  layer:    [{ day: 7, label: 'جوجه' }, { day: 90, label: 'نیمچه' }, { day: 120, label: 'پولت' }, { day: 140, label: 'پیش‌تخم‌گذار' }],
  breeder:  [{ day: 7, label: 'جوجه' }, { day: 90, label: 'نیمچه' }, { day: 120, label: 'پولت' }, { day: 140, label: 'پیش‌تخم‌گذار' }],
  broiler:  [{ day: 7, label: 'آغازین' }, { day: 21, label: 'رشد' }],
};

interface Props {
  activeFlocks: any[];
  birds: any[];
  productions: any[];
  nav: (p: string) => void;
}

export default function FlockList({ activeFlocks, birds, productions, nav }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  if (activeFlocks.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <>
{/* ============ ۶. گله‌ها ============ */}
            {activeFlocks.length > 0 ? (
              <>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', padding: '4px 4px 8px' }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                    🐔 گله‌های فعال
                  </span>
                  <span onClick={() => nav('/flk')} style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--accent)', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                    مشاهده همه ←
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div style={{
                  background: 'var(--card)',
                  border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                  borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)',
                  overflow: 'hidden'
                }}>
                  {activeFlocks.slice(0, 3).map((f, i) => {
                    const age = getAgeDays(f);
                    const bird = birds.find(b => b.id === f.birdId);
                    const lc = getLifecycle(f.type, age, f.endOfCycleDay ?? null, bird?.cycleDays ?? null);
                    const flockCount = f.currentCount || f.initialCount || 0;
                    const flockProds = productions.filter(p => p.flockId === f.id && dateDiffDays(p.date) <= 7);
                    const flockHenDay = flockProds.length > 0 && flockCount > 0
                      ? (flockProds.reduce((a, p) => a + healthyCount(p), 0) / (flockCount * flockProds.length)) * 100
                      : 0;

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={f.id}
                        onClick={() => nav('/flk')}
                        style={{
                          padding: 'var(--pad-card)',
                          borderBottom: i < Math.min(activeFlocks.length, 3) - 1 ? '1px solid var(--border)' : 'none',
                          cursor: 'pointer'
                        }}
                      >
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                          <div style={{
                            width: 36, height: 36, borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                            background: 'var(--accent-soft)',
                            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                            fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', flexShrink: 0
                          }}>🐔</div>
                          <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                            <div style={{
                              fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700,
                              whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis'
                            }}>
                              {f.name}
                            </div>
                            <div style={{
                              fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 3,
                              display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,
                              whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden'
                            }}>
                              <span>{bird?.name || '—'}</span>
                              <span style={{ color: 'var(--border)' }}>|</span>
                              <span>{fmt.day(age)} روز</span>
                              <span style={{ color: 'var(--border)' }}>|</span>
                              <span>🐔 {fmt.count(flockCount)}</span>
                              {flockHenDay > 0 && (<>
                                <span style={{ color: 'var(--border)' }}>|</span>
                                <span>{fmt.code(flockHenDay.toFixed(0))}٪</span>
                              </>)}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <Tag tone={lc.color === 'green' ? 'green' : lc.color === 'amber' ? 'amber' : 'blue'}>
                            {lc.label}
                          </Tag>
                        </div>
                        {/* نوار پیشرفت چرخه */}
                        {lc.progress > 0 && (() => {
                          const cycleDays = f.endOfCycleDay || bird?.cycleDays || 0;
                          if (!cycleDays) return null;
                          
                          const stageMilestones = (CYCLE_MILESTONES[f.type] || []).filter(m => m.day > 0 && m.day < cycleDays);
                          const progressColor = lc.progress >= 95 ? 'var(--danger)' : lc.progress >= 80 ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--accent)';
                          const markerPct = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, lc.progress));
                          const visibleMilestones: Array<{ mk: typeof stageMilestones[0]; pct: number }> = [];
                          { let ld = -1;
                            for (const mk of stageMilestones) {
                              if (ld < 0 || (mk.day - ld) >= cycleDays * 0.1) {
                                visibleMilestones.push({ mk, pct: (mk.day / cycleDays) * 100 });
                                ld = mk.day;
                              }
                            }
                          }
                          
                          return (
                            <div style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
                              {/* اعداد دو سر — بالای نوار */}
                              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'baseline', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 12, paddingRight: 2, paddingLeft: 2 }}>
                                <span>۱</span>
                                <span>{fmt.day(cycleDays)} روز</span>
                              </div>

                              {/* نوار + بج متحرک */}
                              <div style={{ position: 'relative', paddingTop: 26, paddingBottom: 18 }}>
                                {/* نوار اصلی */}
                                <div style={{
                                  position: 'relative',
                                  height: 14,
                                  background: 'var(--input-bg)',
                                  borderRadius: 5,
                                  border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                                  overflow: 'hidden',
                                }}>
                                  <div style={{
                                    height: '100%',
                                    width: markerPct + '%',
                                    background: progressColor,
                                    borderRadius: 5,
                                    transition: 'width .3s',
                                  }} />
                                </div>

                                {/* دات‌های نقاط عطف — روی نوار */}
                                {visibleMilestones.map(({ mk, pct }, idx) => {
                                  const passed = age >= mk.day;
                                  return (
                                    <div
                                      key={idx}
                                      title={mk.label + ' • روز ' + fmt.day(mk.day)}
                                      style={{
                                        position: 'absolute',
                                        top: 29,
                                        right: `calc(${pct}% - 3px)`,
                                        width: 8,
                                        height: 8,
                                        borderRadius: '50%',
                                        background: passed ? progressColor : 'var(--input-bg)',
                                        border: '2px solid ' + (passed ? progressColor : 'var(--border)'),
                                        zIndex: 1,
                                      }}
                                    />
                                  );
                                })}

                                {/* نقطه متحرک (نقطه فعلی) */}
                                <div style={{
                                  position: 'absolute',
                                  top: 26,
                                  right: `calc(${markerPct}% - 6px)`,
                                  width: 14,
                                  height: 14,
                                  borderRadius: '50%',
                                  background: progressColor,
                                  border: '2.5px solid var(--card-solid)',
                                  boxShadow: '0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.2)',
                                  zIndex: 2,
                                  transition: 'right .3s',
                                }} />

                                {/* بج سن — بالای نوار */}
                                <div style={{
                                  position: 'absolute',
                                  top: 0,
                                  right: `calc(${markerPct}% - 20px)`,
                                  width: 40,
                                  height: 20,
                                  display: 'flex',
                                  alignItems: 'center',
                                  justifyContent: 'center',
                                  background: progressColor,
                                  color: 'var(--avatar-text, #fff)',
                                  borderRadius: 5,
                                  fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
                                  fontWeight: 700,
                                  whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                                  boxShadow: '0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.2)',
                                  zIndex: 3,
                                  transition: 'right .3s',
                                }}>{fmt.day(age)}</div>

                                {/* خط اتصال بج به نقطه */}
                                <div style={{
                                  position: 'absolute',
                                  top: 20,
                                  right: `calc(${markerPct}% - 1px)`,
                                  width: 2,
                                  height: 6,
                                  background: progressColor,
                                  opacity: 0.6,
                                  zIndex: 2,
                                  transition: 'right .3s',
                                }} />

                                {/* درصد پایین-راست نوار */}
                                <div style={{
                                  position: 'absolute',
                                  bottom: 0,
                                  right: 2,
                                  fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
                                  color: progressColor,
                                  fontWeight: 700,
                                }}>{fmt.int(Math.round(lc.progress))}٪</div>
                              </div>

                              {/* Legend مراحل */}
                              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '6px 14px', marginTop: 6 }}>
                                {stageMilestones.map((mk, idx) => {
                                  const passed = age >= mk.day;
                                  return (
                                    <div key={idx} style={{
                                      display: 'flex',
                                      alignItems: 'center',
                                      gap: 6,
                                      fontSize: '13px',
                                      color: passed ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
                                      fontWeight: passed ? 700 : 500,
                                    }}>
                                      <span>{mk.label}</span>
                                      <span style={{ opacity: 0.6 }}>{fmt.day(mk.day)}</span>
                                    </div>
                                  );
                                })}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })()}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </>
            ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * sexingWidgetLogic.ts — منطق خالص widget «زمان تفکیک»
 * فاز ۷.۱ — تست‌پذیر، بدون UI
 */
import { getAgeDays } from '../flk/store';

export interface SexingStats {
  overdue: number;
  thisWeek: number;
  twoWeeks: number;
  total: number;
}

/**
 * computeSexingStats — گروه‌بندی گله‌های breeder بدون genderSplitAt
 * طبق FlockCard.tsx:247: badge فقط برای breeder + !genderSplitAt
 */
export function computeSexingStats(
  activeFlocks: any[],
  breeds: any[],
  getStdSexingAge: (breedName: string) => number | null,
): SexingStats {
  let overdue = 0, thisWeek = 0, twoWeeks = 0;

  for (const f of activeFlocks) {
    if (f.type !== 'breeder') continue;
    if (f.genderSplitAt) continue;

    const breed = breeds.find((b: any) => b.id === f.breedId);
    if (!breed) continue;

    let sexingAge: number | null = null;
    if (f.sexingAgeOverride != null) sexingAge = f.sexingAgeOverride;
    else sexingAge = getStdSexingAge(breed.name);
    if (sexingAge == null) continue;

    let ageDays = 0;
    try { ageDays = getAgeDays(f); } catch { continue; }

    const daysUntil = sexingAge - ageDays;
    if (daysUntil < 0) overdue++;
    else if (daysUntil <= 7) thisWeek++;
    else if (daysUntil <= 14) twoWeeks++;
  }

  return { overdue, thisWeek, twoWeeks, total: overdue + thisWeek + twoWeeks };
}

// utils.ts — توابع کمکی Dashboard
import { format as formatJ, parse as parseJ } from 'date-fns-jalali';

export function toEnNum(s: string): number {
  return parseInt(s.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)))) || 0;
}


export function monthKey(date: string): string {
  if (date === '' || date == null) return '';
  const parts = date.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d))).split('/');
  if (parts.length !== 3) return '';
  return parts[0] + '/' + String(parts[1]).padStart(2, '0');
}


import { currentMonth as _cm } from '../../shr/date/jalali';
export const currentMonth = _cm;


import { todayJalali as _tj } from '../../shr/date/jalali';
export const todayJalali = _tj;


export function dateDiffDays(jalaliDate: string): number {
  if (jalaliDate === '' || jalaliDate == null) return 999;
  const en = jalaliDate.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));
  const d = parseJ(en, 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return 999;
  return Math.floor((Date.now() - d.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
}



export function fcrBg(diff: number): string {
  if (diff <= 0) return 'var(--accent-soft)';
  if (diff <= 10) return 'var(--warn-soft)';
  return 'var(--danger-soft)';
}
