interface F {
  id?: string;
  flockId: string;
  date: string;
  eatingCount: string;
  fertileCount: string;
  brokenCount: string;
  softCount: string;
  dirtyCount: string;
  avgWeight: string;
  notes: string;
}

const empty = (): F => ({
  flockId: '', date: '',
  eatingCount: '', fertileCount: '',
  brokenCount: '', softCount: '', dirtyCount: '',
  avgWeight: '', notes: '',
});

export default function ProductionsPage({ active = true }: { active?: boolean } = {}) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { productions, addProduction, updateProduction, deleteProduction, addDiscard } = useEgg();
  const { flocks } = useFlk();
  const { birds } = useBrd();

  const activeFlocks = flocks.filter(f => f.status === 'active' && !f.paused && (f.type === 'layer' || f.type === 'breeder'));

  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<F>(empty());
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [undoData, setUndoData] = useState<{ item: any | any[] } | null>(null);
  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [openDiscard, setOpenDiscard] = useState(false);
  const [discardForm, setDiscardForm] = useState<{ date: string; type: 'broken' | 'soft' | 'dirty'; count: string; reason: 'rotten' | 'broken_handling' | 'expired' | 'contaminated' | 'other'; notes: string }>({ date: '', type: 'broken', count: '', reason: 'rotten', notes: '' });
  const [discardErr, setDiscardErr] = useState('');

  // فیلتر/مرتب
  const config = useMemo(
    () => getEggProductionsConfig({
      flocks: activeFlocks.map(f => ({ id: f.id, name: f.name })),
    }),
    [activeFlocks]
  );
  const { filtered: list, filters, setFilter, clearFilter, sort, setSort, toggleSort,
          resetAll, hasActiveFilters, total, count } = useFilterSort<EggProduction>({
    items: productions,
    filters: config.filterDefs,
    sorts: config.sortDefs,
    persistKey: config.persistKey,
    initialSort: config.initialSort,
  });

  // ─── Multi-Select ───
  const ms = useMultiSelect({
    items: list,
    getId: (p: any) => p.id,
    onDelete: async (ids: string[]) => {
      const ok = await showConfirmAsync('حذف گروهی', fmt.count(ids.length) + ' ثبت تخم‌گذاری حذف شوند؟', { danger: true });
      if (!ok) return;
      const backups: any[] = [];
      const { productions: __prevProds } = useEgg.getState();
      const __prevWhsItems = useWhs.getState().items;
      const __prevWhsMovs = useWhs.getState().movements;
      try {
        for (const id of ids) {
          const it = productions.find(p => p.id === id);
          if (!it) continue;
          backups.push(it);
          deleteProduction(id);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        useEgg.setState({ productions: __prevProds });
        useWhs.setState({ items: __prevWhsItems, movements: __prevWhsMovs });
        showToast('خطا در حذف گروهی — همه تغییرات لغو شد: ' + (e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)), 'error');
        return;
      }
      if (backups.length > 0) {
        setUndoData({ item: backups });
        setTimeout(() => setUndoData((cur: any) => cur && Array.isArray(cur.item) && cur.item.length === backups.length ? null : cur), 8000);
      }
      toastMsg.deletedBulk(backups.length, 'ثبت')
      logAction('delete', 'egg', 'حذف گروهی تخم‌گذاری: ' + backups.length);
    },
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (ms.selectionMode) setExpandedId(null);
  }, [ms.selectionMode]);

  const undoDelete = () => {
    const item = undoData;
    if (!item) return;
    const arr = Array.isArray(item.item) ? item.item : [item.item];
    const { productions: __prevProdsR } = useEgg.getState();
    const __prevWhsItemsR = useWhs.getState().items;
    const __prevWhsMovsR = useWhs.getState().movements;
    try {
      for (const it of arr) addProduction(it);
      toastMsg.restoredBulk(arr.length, 'ثبت')
    } catch (e) {
      useEgg.setState({ productions: __prevProdsR });
      useWhs.setState({ items: __prevWhsItemsR, movements: __prevWhsMovsR });
      toastMsg.error('بازگردانی ناموفق: ' + (e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)));
    }
    setUndoData(null);
  };

  const openNew = () => {
    if (activeFlocks.length === 0) { showToast('اول یک گله تخم‌گذار بسازید', 'warn'); return; }
    setForm({ ...empty(), flockId: activeFlocks[0].id });
    setErr(''); setOpen(true);
  };
  const openDiscardNew = () => {
    const today = formatJ(new Date(), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
    setDiscardForm({ date: today, type: 'broken', count: '', reason: 'rotten', notes: '' });
    setDiscardErr('');
    setOpenDiscard(true);
  };

  const handleSaveDiscard = () => {
    const count = parseInt(discardForm.count) || 0;
    if (count <= 0) { setDiscardErr('تعداد باید بیشتر از ۰ باشد'); return; }
    if (!discardForm.date) { setDiscardErr('تاریخ را انتخاب کنید'); return; }
    addDiscard({ date: discardForm.date, type: discardForm.type, count, reason: discardForm.reason, notes: discardForm.notes });
    toastMsg.saved('دور ریخت تخم');
    setOpenDiscard(false);
  };

  useFab(active && productions.length > 0 ? { label: 'ثبت تخم‌گذاری', onClick: openNew } : null);

  const openEdit = (p: EggProduction) => {
    setForm({
      id: p.id, flockId: p.flockId, date: p.date,
      eatingCount: p.eatingCount ? fmt.code(p.eatingCount) : '',
      fertileCount: p.fertileCount ? fmt.code(p.fertileCount) : '',
      brokenCount: p.brokenCount ? fmt.code(p.brokenCount) : '',
      softCount: p.softCount ? fmt.code(p.softCount) : '',
      dirtyCount: p.dirtyCount ? fmt.code(p.dirtyCount) : '',
      avgWeight: p.avgWeight !== null && p.avgWeight !== undefined ? fmt.code(p.avgWeight) : '',
      notes: p.notes || '',
    });
    setErr(''); setOpen(true);
  };

  const int = (s: string) => s ? parseInt(toEn(s)) || 0 : 0;
  const num = (s: string) => s ? parseFloat(toEn(s).replace('٫','.')) || 0 : 0;

  const selectedFlock = activeFlocks.find(f => f.id === form.flockId) || flocks.find(f => f.id === form.flockId);
  const flockCount = selectedFlock ? (selectedFlock.currentCount || selectedFlock.initialCount || 0) : 0;

  /* liveErrorApplied */
  // اعتبارسنجی زنده
  const liveErrors = (() => {
    const errs: { field: string; msg: string }[] = [];
    const e = int(form.eatingCount);
    const f = int(form.fertileCount);
    const b = int(form.brokenCount);
    const s = int(form.softCount);
    const d = int(form.dirtyCount);
    if (e < 0 || f < 0 || b < 0 || s < 0 || d < 0) errs.push({ field: 'all', msg: 'مقادیر منفی مجاز نیست' });
    if (flockCount > 0 && (e + f) > flockCount) errs.push({ field: 'healthy', msg: `مجموع سالم (${fmt.count(e + f)}) از تعداد گله (${fmt.count(flockCount)}) بیشتره` });
    if (e > 0 && e > flockCount) errs.push({ field: 'eating', msg: 'تخم خوراکی از تعداد گله بیشتره' });
    if (f > 0 && f > flockCount) errs.push({ field: 'fertile', msg: 'تخم نطفه‌دار از تعداد گله بیشتره' });
    return errs;
  })();
  const healthySum = int(form.eatingCount) + int(form.fertileCount);
  const totalSum = healthySum + int(form.brokenCount) + int(form.softCount) + int(form.dirtyCount);

  const totalEggs = int(form.eatingCount) + int(form.fertileCount) + int(form.brokenCount) + int(form.softCount) + int(form.dirtyCount);
  const healthy = int(form.eatingCount) + int(form.fertileCount);
  const liveRate = flockCount > 0 && healthy > 0 ? ((healthy / flockCount) * 100).toFixed(1) : '0';
  const fertilePercent = healthy > 0 ? Math.round((int(form.fertileCount) / healthy) * 100) : 0;
  const eatingPercent = healthy > 0 ? Math.round((int(form.eatingCount) / healthy) * 100) : 0;

  const save = () => {
    if (form.flockId === '') { setErr('گله را انتخاب کنید'); return; }
    if (form.date.trim() === '') { setErr('تاریخ را وارد کنید'); return; }
    const eating = int(form.eatingCount);
    const fertile = int(form.fertileCount);
    const broken = int(form.brokenCount);
    const soft = int(form.softCount);
    const dirty = int(form.dirtyCount);
    const total = eating + fertile + broken + soft + dirty;
    if (total === 0) { setErr('حداقل یک عدد وارد کنید'); return; }
    if (flockCount > 0 && (eating + fertile) > flockCount) {
      setErr('تخم سالم (' + fmt.count(eating + fertile) + ') نمی‌تواند از تعداد گله (' + fmt.count(flockCount) + ') بیشتر باشد');
      return;
    }
    // Duplicate check (فقط برای ثبت جدید — نه ویرایش)
    if (form.id === undefined) {
      const dup = productions.find(
        (p) => p.flockId === form.flockId &&
               p.date === form.date.trim() &&
               (p.sourceType === 'manual' || (!p.sourceType && !p.sourceLogId)),
      );
      if (dup) {
        setErr('برای این گله و تاریخ قبلاً ثبت دستی شده. از ویرایش استفاده کنید.');
        return;
      }
    }

    const data = {
      flockId: form.flockId,
      date: form.date.trim(),
      eatingCount: eating,
      fertileCount: fertile,
      totalCount: total,
      brokenCount: broken,
      softCount: soft,
      dirtyCount: dirty,
      avgWeight: form.avgWeight ? num(form.avgWeight) : null,
      notes: form.notes.trim(),
      sourceType: 'manual' as const,
    };
    if (form.id === undefined) { addProduction(data); }
    else { updateProduction(form.id, data); }
    setOpen(false);
  };

  // ═══ اعتبارسنجی زنده ═══
  const validationContext = {
    flockCount: selectedFlock?.initialCount || 0,
    flockCurrentCount: selectedFlock?.currentCount || flockCount,
    flockType: selectedFlock?.type,
  };
  const { errors: vErrors } = useValidation(
    createEggSchema(validationContext),
    {
      flockId: form.flockId || '',
      date: form.date || '',
      eatingCount: int(form.eatingCount),
      fertileCount: int(form.fertileCount),
      brokenCount: int(form.brokenCount),
      softCount: int(form.softCount),
      dirtyCount: int(form.dirtyCount),
      avgWeight: form.avgWeight ? num(form.avgWeight) : null,
      notes: form.notes || '',
    },
  );



  return (
    <PageContainer>
      {undoData && (
        <UndoBar
          label="حذف شد"
          onUndo={undoDelete}
          onDismiss={() => setUndoData(null)}
        />
      )}
      <HelpBanner
        id="egg-prod-intro"
        icon="🥚"
        title="ثبت تخم‌گذاری روزانه"
        description="هر روز تعداد تخم‌ها را بین خوراکی، نطفه‌دار و مصرفی تقسیم کنید."
        tone="info"
      />
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, padding: '0 8px 8px' }}>
        <Btn size="sm" onClick={openDiscardNew}>🗑 ثبت دور ریخت</Btn>
      </div>
      <FilterBar
        filterDefs={config.filterDefs}
        sortDefs={config.sortDefs}
        filterState={filters}
        sortState={sort}
        setFilter={setFilter}
        clearFilter={clearFilter}
        setSort={setSort}
        toggleSort={toggleSort}
        resetAll={resetAll}
        hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
        total={total}
        count={count}
      />
      {!ms.selectionMode && list.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: 'var(--dim)', textAlign: 'center', paddingBottom: 2 }}>
          برای انتخاب چندتایی، روی یک کارت نگه دارید
        </div>
      )}

      {ms.selectionMode && list.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 6 }}>
          <button type="button"
            onClick={ms.selectedIds.size === list.length ? ms.clearSelection : ms.selectAll}
            style={{ padding: '4px 10px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: '10px', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
            {ms.selectedIds.size === list.length ? 'لغو انتخاب همه' : 'انتخاب همه'}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}


      {list.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty
          icon={<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round"><ellipse cx="12" cy="14" rx="7" ry="9"/></svg>}
          title="تخم‌گذاری ثبت نشده"
          desc={activeFlocks.length === 0 ? 'اول یک گله تخم‌گذار بسازید.' : 'اولین تخم‌گذاری امروز را ثبت کنید.'}
          action={<Btn variant="primary" onClick={openNew}>+ ثبت تخم‌گذاری</Btn>}
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          {list.map((p, i) => {
            const flock = flocks.find(f => f.id === p.flockId);
            const bird = flock ? birds.find(b => b.id === flock.birdId) : null;
            const healthy2 = healthyCount(p);
            const flockCount2 = flock ? (flock.currentCount || flock.initialCount || 0) : 0;
            const rate = henDayRate(p, flockCount2);
            const brokenPct = brokenRate(p);
            const isOpen = !ms.selectionMode && expandedId === p.id;
            const ageDays = flock ? getAgeDays(flock) : 0;

            let accent: 'accent' | 'warn' = 'accent';
            let tone: 'green' | 'amber' | 'red' = 'green';
            if (rate > 0 && rate < 60) { accent = 'warn'; tone = 'amber'; }

            return (
              <ExpandableCard
                key={p.id}
                id={p.id}
                ms={ms}
                accent={accent}
                index={fmt.count(i + 1)}
                iconEmoji="🥚"
                title={fmt.count(healthy2) + ' تخم سالم — ' + (flock?.name || '—')}
                subtitle={fmt.date(p.date) + (bird ? ' • ' + bird.name : '') + (ageDays > 0 ? ' • ' + fmt.day(ageDays) + ' روز' : '')}
                isOpen={isOpen}
                onToggle={() => setExpandedId(isOpen ? null : p.id)}
                badge={rate > 0 ? <Tag tone={tone}>{fmt.code(rate.toFixed(1))}٪</Tag> : undefined}
                stats={
                  <>
                    <span>کل: <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.count(p.totalCount)}</b></span>
                    {p.brokenCount > 0 ? <span style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>شکسته: <b>{fmt.count(p.brokenCount)}</b></span> : null}
                    {brokenPct > 0 ? <span>شکسته: <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.code(brokenPct.toFixed(1))}٪</b></span> : null}
                  </>
                }
              >
                <SectionTitle>📊 آمار تخم‌گذاری</SectionTitle>
                {p.eatingCount > 0 && <Row l="🥚 تخم خوراکی" v={fmt.count(p.eatingCount)} />}
                {p.fertileCount > 0 && <Row l="🌱 تخم نطفه‌دار" v={fmt.count(p.fertileCount)} />}
                <Row l="تخم سالم" v={fmt.count(healthy2)} />
                <Row l="تخم شکسته" v={fmt.count(p.brokenCount)} />
                {p.softCount > 0 ? <Row l="تخم نرم" v={fmt.count(p.softCount)} /> : null}
                {p.dirtyCount > 0 ? <Row l="تخم کثیف" v={fmt.count(p.dirtyCount)} /> : null}
                <Row l="جمع کل" v={fmt.count((p.totalCount || 0) + (p.brokenCount || 0) + (p.softCount || 0) + (p.dirtyCount || 0))} />

                {rate > 0 ? (
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--accent-soft)', color: 'var(--accent)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    <span>نرخ تخم‌گذاری (Hen-Day):</span>
                    <span>{fmt.code(rate.toFixed(1))}٪</span>
                  </div>
                ) : null}

                {p.avgWeight ? (
                  <>
                    <SectionTitle>⚖ وزن</SectionTitle>
                    <Row l="وزن میانگین" v={fmt.num(p.avgWeight) + ' گرم'} />
                  </>
                ) : null}

                {p.notes ? (
                  <>
                    <SectionTitle>📝 یادداشت</SectionTitle>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', lineHeight: 1.7, padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>{p.notes}</div>
                  </>
                ) : null}

                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, paddingTop: 4 }}>
                  <Btn size="sm" onClick={() => openEdit(p)} style={{ flex: 1 }}>ویرایش</Btn>
                  <Btn size="sm" onClick={async () => {
                    const ok = await showConfirmAsync('تأیید حذف', 'این تخم‌گذاری حذف شود؟', { danger: true });
                    if (!ok) return;
                    setUndoData({ item: p });
                    setTimeout(() => setUndoData((cur: any) => cur && cur.item.id === p.id ? null : cur), 6000);
                    deleteProduction(p.id);
                    logAction('delete', 'egg', 'حذف از تخم‌ها');
                    toastMsg.deleted('تخم‌گذاری ' + (p.date || ''))
                  }} style={{ flex: 1 }}>حذف</Btn>
                </div>
              </ExpandableCard>
            );
          })}
          
        </>
      )}

      <MultiSelectBar ms={ms} deleteLabel="حذف" />

      {ms.selectionMode && <div style={{ height: 90 }} />}

      <ProductionFormModal
        open={open}
        setOpen={setOpen}
        form={form}
        setForm={setForm}
        err={err}
        vErrors={vErrors}
        activeFlocks={activeFlocks}
        flockCount={flockCount}
        onSave={save}
      />

      <DiscardFormModal
        open={openDiscard}
        setOpen={setOpenDiscard}
        form={discardForm}
        setForm={setDiscardForm}
        err={discardErr}
        onSave={handleSaveDiscard}
      />

    </PageContainer>
  );
}

import { AlertBox } from '../../shr/components/ui';
import { useFormat, getGlobalFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { MiniStat } from '../../shr/components/ui/MiniStat';
import { KpiCard } from '../../shr/components/ui/KpiCard';
import HelpBanner from '../../shr/components/HelpBanner';
/**
 * StatsPage — آمار و تحلیل تخم‌گذاری
 */
import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useEgg } from './store';
import { useFlk } from '../flk/store';
import { PageContainer, Select, Empty, Btn } from '../../shr/components/ui';
import { exportTableToCSV } from '../../shr/utils/export';
import { toFa } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { BarChart, LineChart, DualBarChart, PieChart } from '../../shr/components/Charts';
import SmartSelect from '../../shr/components/SmartSelect';

type Range = '7' | '30' | '90' | 'all';
type ChartType = 'bar' | 'line' | 'dual' | 'pie';

function toEnDate(d: string): string {
  return d.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (x: string) => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(x)));
}

function cutOff(days: number): string {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - days);
  return `${d.getFullYear()}/${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}/${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function shortDate(d: string): string {
  const p = (d || '').split('/');
  if (p.length !== 3) return d;
  return `${p[1]}/${p[2]}`;
}

export default function StatsPage({ active = true }: { active?: boolean } = {}) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { productions } = useEgg();
  const { flocks } = useFlk();
  const [filterFlock, setFilterFlock] = useState('');
  const [range, setRange] = useState<Range>('30');
  const [chartType, setChartType] = useState<ChartType>('bar');

  const activeFlocks = flocks.filter(f => f.status === 'active' && !f.paused && (f.type === 'layer' || f.type === 'breeder'));

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let arr = [...productions];
    if (filterFlock) arr = arr.filter(p => p.flockId === filterFlock);
    if (range !== 'all') {
      const cut = cutOff(parseInt(range));
      arr = arr.filter(p => toEnDate(p.date || '') >= cut);
    }
    return arr.sort((a, b) => (b.date || '').localeCompare(a.date || ''));
  }, [productions, filterFlock, range]);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    let eating = 0, fertile = 0, broken = 0, other = 0;
    for (const p of filtered) {
      eating += p.eatingCount || 0;
      fertile += p.fertileCount || 0;
      broken += p.brokenCount || 0;
      other += (p.softCount || 0) + (p.dirtyCount || 0);
    }
    const healthy = eating + fertile;
    const total = healthy + broken + other;
    const pct = (n: number) => total > 0 ? Math.round((n / total) * 1000) / 10 : 0;
    const brokenPct = pct(broken);
    const fertilePct = pct(fertile);
    const eatingPct = pct(eating);
    const otherPct = pct(other);
    const dayCount = new Set(filtered.map(p => p.date)).size;
    const avgHealthy = dayCount > 0 ? Math.round(healthy / dayCount) : 0;
    return { eating, fertile, broken, other, healthy, total, brokenPct, fertilePct, eatingPct, otherPct, dayCount, avgHealthy };
  }, [filtered]);

  const rangeLabel = range === '7' ? '۷ روز' : range === '30' ? '۳۰ روز' : range === '90' ? '۹۰ روز' : 'کل';

  const coverage = useMemo(() => {
    if (range === 'all') {
      const allDates = new Set(productions.map(p => p.date).filter(Boolean));
      return { days: allDates.size, rangeDays: 0, insufficient: false };
    }
    const rangeDays = parseInt(range);
    const allDates = new Set(filtered.map(p => p.date).filter(Boolean));
    return { days: allDates.size, rangeDays, insufficient: allDates.size < Math.min(3, rangeDays) };
  }, [filtered, range, productions]);

  const canAvg = coverage.days >= 2;
  const canWeekly = coverage.days >= 7;

  // توده تخم
  const eggMassKg = useMemo(() => Math.round((stats.healthy * 60) / 100) / 10, [stats.healthy]);

  // رتبه‌بندی گله‌ها
  const flockRank = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, { name: string; total: number; healthy: number; broken: number; days: number }>();
    for (const p of filtered) {
      const flock = flocks.find(f => f.id === p.flockId);
      if (!flock) continue;
      if (!map.has(p.flockId)) map.set(p.flockId, { name: flock.name, total: 0, healthy: 0, broken: 0, days: 0 });
      const r = map.get(p.flockId)!;
      const h = (p.eatingCount || 0) + (p.fertileCount || 0);
      r.total += h + (p.brokenCount || 0) + (p.softCount || 0) + (p.dirtyCount || 0);
      r.healthy += h;
      r.broken += p.brokenCount || 0;
      r.days += 1;
    }
    return [...map.values()].sort((a, b) => b.healthy - a.healthy);
  }, [filtered, flocks]);

  // روند روزانه
  const trend = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, { healthy: number; broken: number }>();
    for (const p of filtered) {
      const d = p.date || '';
      if (!map.has(d)) map.set(d, { healthy: 0, broken: 0 });
      const r = map.get(d)!;
      r.healthy += (p.eatingCount || 0) + (p.fertileCount || 0);
      r.broken += p.brokenCount || 0;
    }
    const sorted = [...map.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0])).slice(-30);
    const days = sorted.map(([date, v]) => ({ date, healthy: v.healthy, broken: v.broken }));
    const max = Math.max(...days.map(d => d.healthy), 1);
    const min = days.length > 0 ? Math.min(...days.map(d => d.healthy)) : 0;
    const avg = days.length > 0 ? Math.round(days.reduce((a, d) => a + d.healthy, 0) / days.length) : 0;
    return { days, max, min, avg };
  }, [filtered]);

  // هشدار افت
  const alert = useMemo(() => {
    if (trend.days.length < 6) return null;
    const last3 = trend.days.slice(-3);
    const prev3 = trend.days.slice(-6, -3);
    const avgLast = last3.reduce((a, d) => a + d.healthy, 0) / last3.length;
    const avgPrev = prev3.reduce((a, d) => a + d.healthy, 0) / prev3.length;
    if (avgPrev === 0) return null;
    const drop = ((avgLast - avgPrev) / avgPrev) * 100;
    if (drop < -10) return { drop: Math.round(drop), avgLast: Math.round(avgLast), avgPrev: Math.round(avgPrev) };
    return null;
  }, [trend]);

  // بهترین روزها
  const dayRank = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const p of filtered) {
      const h = (p.eatingCount || 0) + (p.fertileCount || 0);
      map.set(p.date || '', (map.get(p.date || '') || 0) + h);
    }
    return [...map.entries()].map(([date, healthy]) => ({ date, healthy })).sort((a, b) => b.healthy - a.healthy).slice(0, 5);
  }, [filtered]);

  // بهترین روزهای هفته
  const byWeekday = useMemo(() => {
    const names = ['شنبه', 'یک‌شنبه', 'دوشنبه', 'سه‌شنبه', 'چهارشنبه', 'پنج‌شنبه', 'جمعه'];
    const map = new Map<number, { total: number; days: number }>();
    for (const p of filtered) {
      const d = toEnDate(p.date || '');
      const parts = d.split('/');
      if (parts.length !== 3) continue;
      const dt = new Date(parseInt(parts[0]), parseInt(parts[1]) - 1, parseInt(parts[2]));
      const day = (dt.getDay() + 1) % 7;
      if (!map.has(day)) map.set(day, { total: 0, days: 0 });
      const r = map.get(day)!;
      r.total += (p.eatingCount || 0) + (p.fertileCount || 0);
      r.days += 1;
    }
    const arr: { name: string; avg: number; total: number }[] = [];
    for (const [day, v] of map.entries()) {
      if (v.days === 0) continue;
      arr.push({ name: names[day], avg: Math.round(v.total / v.days), total: v.total });
    }
    arr.sort((a, b) => b.avg - a.avg);
    return arr;
  }, [filtered]);

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      <HelpBanner
        id="egg-stats-guide"
        icon="📊"
        title="راهنمای آمار تولید تخم"
        description="روند تولید روزانه و تفکیک تخم‌های خوراکی، نطفه‌دار و مصرفی را در بازه‌های زمانی مختلف بررسی و مقایسه کنید."
        tone="info"
      />
      {/* فیلترها */}
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 8 }}>
        <Select value={range} onChange={e => setRange(e.target.value as Range)}>
          <option value="7">۷ روز اخیر</option>
          <option value="30">۳۰ روز اخیر</option>
          <option value="90">۹۰ روز اخیر</option>
          <option value="all">همه</option>
        </Select>
        <SmartSelect
          value={filterFlock}
          placeholder="همه گله‌ها"
          modalTitle="انتخاب گله"
          options={activeFlocks.map((f) => ({ value: String(f.id), label: String(f.name) }))}
          onChange={(val: string) => setFilterFlock(val)}
        />
      </div>

      {stats.total === 0 ? (
        <Empty
          icon={<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7"><path d="M3 3v18h18"/><path d="M7 14l4-4 4 4 5-5"/></svg>}
          title="آماری موجود نیست"
          desc="هنوز تخم‌گذاری در این بازه ثبت نشده."
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* هشدارها */}
          {alert && (
            <div style={{ padding: '10px 14px', background: 'var(--danger-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--danger)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--danger)', fontWeight: 600, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '1.3em' }}>⚠️</span>
              <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>افت {fmt.num(Math.abs(alert.drop))}٪ تولید — ۳ روز اخیر {fmt.num(alert.avgLast)} تخم (قبلاً {fmt.num(alert.avgPrev)})</span>
            </div>
          )}
          {coverage.insufficient && range !== 'all' && (
            <div style={{ padding: '10px 14px', background: 'var(--warn-soft)', border: '1px dashed var(--warn)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--warn)', fontWeight: 600, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '1.3em' }}>💡</span>
              <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>فقط {fmt.day(coverage.days)} روز از {fmt.day(coverage.rangeDays)} روز داده دارید</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* خلاصه */}
          <StatsCard icon="📊" title={`خلاصه ${rangeLabel}`} />
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 8 }}>
            <KpiCard size="lg" icon="🥚" label="کل تخم" value={fmt.count(stats.total)} sub={`در ${fmt.day(coverage.days)} روز`} tone="accent" />
            <KpiCard size="lg" icon="📅" label="میانگین روزانه" value={canAvg ? fmt.num(stats.avgHealthy) : '—'} sub={canAvg ? 'تخم سالم' : 'داده کم'} tone="info" />
            <KpiCard size="lg" icon="⚖️" label="توده تخم" value={`${fmt.num(eggMassKg)} kg`} sub="میانگین ۶۰ گرم" tone="purple" />
            <KpiCard size="lg" icon="⭐" label="نرخ نطفه‌دار" value={`${fmt.num(stats.fertilePct)}٪`} sub={`${fmt.count(stats.fertile)} تخم`} tone="purple" />
          </div>

          {/* کیفیت تخم */}
          <StatsCard icon="⭐" title="کیفیت تخم" extra={rangeLabel} />
          <div style={{ padding: '14px 16px', background: 'var(--card)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
            <QualityBar icon="🌱" label="نطفه‌دار" pct={stats.fertilePct} count={stats.fertile} total={stats.total} color="var(--purple)" />
            <QualityBar icon="🥚" label="خوراکی" pct={stats.eatingPct} count={stats.eating} total={stats.total} color="var(--accent)" />
            <QualityBar icon="💔" label="شکسته" pct={stats.brokenPct} count={stats.broken} total={stats.total} color="var(--warn)" />
            {stats.other > 0 && (
              <QualityBar icon="📦" label="سایر" pct={stats.otherPct} count={stats.other} total={stats.total} color="var(--muted)" />
            )}
          </div>

          {/* روند روزانه */}
          {trend.days.length >= 2 && (
            <>
              <StatsCard icon="📈" title="روند روزانه" extra={`${fmt.day(trend.days.length)} روز`} />
              <div style={{ padding: '14px 16px', background: 'var(--card)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>

                {/* انتخاب نوع نمودار */}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
                  <ChartTab active={chartType === 'bar'} onClick={() => setChartType('bar')} icon="📊" label="میله‌ای" />
                  <ChartTab active={chartType === 'line'} onClick={() => setChartType('line')} icon="📈" label="خطی" />
                  <ChartTab active={chartType === 'dual'} onClick={() => setChartType('dual')} icon="📉" label="دو-ستونی" />
                  <ChartTab active={chartType === 'pie'} onClick={() => setChartType('pie')} icon="🥧" label="دایره‌ای" />
                </div>

                {/* نمودار */}
                {chartType === 'bar' && (
                  <BarChart data={trend.days.map(d => ({ label: shortDate(d.date), value: d.healthy }))} color="var(--accent)" height={150} />
                )}
                {chartType === 'line' && (
                  <LineChart data={trend.days.map(d => ({ label: shortDate(d.date), value: d.healthy }))} color="var(--accent)" height={150} />
                )}
                {chartType === 'dual' && (
                  <DualBarChart data={trend.days.map(d => ({ label: shortDate(d.date), a: d.healthy, b: d.broken }))} colorA="var(--accent)" colorB="var(--warn)" labelA="سالم" labelB="شکسته" height={150} />
                )}
                {chartType === 'pie' && (
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', padding: '8px 0' }}>
                    <PieChart
                      data={[
                        { label: 'خوراکی', value: stats.eating, color: 'var(--accent)' },
                        { label: 'نطفه‌دار', value: stats.fertile, color: 'var(--purple)' },
                        { label: 'شکسته', value: stats.broken, color: 'var(--warn)' },
                        { label: 'سایر', value: stats.other, color: 'var(--muted)' },
                      ].filter(x => x.value > 0)}
                      size={170}
                    />
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* خلاصه روند */}
                <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr 1fr', gap: 8, paddingTop: 10, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)' }}>
                  <MiniStat variant="plain" label="بیشترین" value={fmt.count(trend.max)} color="var(--accent)" />
                  <MiniStat variant="plain" label="میانگین" value={fmt.num(trend.avg)} color="var(--text)" />
                  <MiniStat variant="plain" label="کمترین" value={fmt.count(trend.min)} color="var(--muted)" />
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {/* مقایسه گله‌ها */}
          {flockRank.length >= 2 && (
            <>
              <StatsCard icon="🏆" title="رتبه‌بندی گله‌ها" />
              <div style={{ padding: '12px 14px', background: 'var(--card)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
                {flockRank.map((r, i) => {
                  const brokenPct = r.total > 0 ? Math.round((r.broken / r.total) * 1000) / 10 : 0;
                  const medal = i === 0 ? '🥇' : i === 1 ? '🥈' : i === 2 ? '🥉' : `${fmt.count(i + 1)}.`;
                  return (
                    <div key={r.name} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '10px 12px', background: i === 0 ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', border: i === 0 ? '1px solid var(--accent-border)' : '1px solid transparent' }}>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: '1.2em', minWidth: 28, textAlign: 'center' }}>{medal}</span>
                      <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)', marginBottom: 2 }}>{r.name}</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{fmt.day(r.days)} روز ثبت</div>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--accent)' }}>{fmt.count(r.healthy)}</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>سالم{brokenPct > 0 ? ` • ${fmt.num(brokenPct)}٪ شکسته` : ''}</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {/* الگوی روزهای هفته */}
          {byWeekday.length >= 3 && (
            <>
              <StatsCard icon="📆" title="الگوی روزهای هفته" />
              <div style={{ padding: '12px 14px', background: 'var(--card)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
                {byWeekday.map((d, i) => (
                  <div key={d.name} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '8px 12px', background: i === 0 ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>
                    <span style={{ flex: 1, fontWeight: i === 0 ? 700 : 600, color: i === 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>{d.name}</span>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{fmt.count(d.total)} کل</span>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: i === 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)', minWidth: 60, textAlign: 'left' }}>{fmt.num(d.avg)}/روز</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {/* بهترین روزها */}
          {dayRank.length > 0 && (
            <>
              <StatsCard icon="🌟" title="بهترین روزها" />
              <div style={{ padding: '12px 14px', background: 'var(--card)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
                {dayRank.map((d, i) => (
                  <div key={d.date} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '8px 12px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>
                    <span style={{ minWidth: 26, color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', textAlign: 'center', fontWeight: 600 }}>{fmt.count(i + 1)}</span>
                    <span style={{ flex: 1, color: 'var(--text)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>{fmt.date(d.date)}</span>
                    <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>{fmt.count(d.healthy)}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </>
      )}
          <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
        <Btn full variant="primary" onClick={() => {
          const headers = ['تاریخ', 'گله', 'خوراکی', 'نطفه‌دار', 'شکسته', 'نرم', 'کثیف', 'کل'];
          const rows = filtered.map(p => [
            p.date,
            p.flockId,
            p.eatingCount || 0,
            p.fertileCount || 0,
            p.brokenCount || 0,
            p.softCount || 0,
            p.dirtyCount || 0,
            p.totalCount || 0,
          ]);
          exportTableToCSV('آمار-تخم', headers, rows);
        }}>دانلود CSV</Btn>
      </div>
</PageContainer>
  );
}

// ============ Helpers ============

function StatsCard({ icon, title, extra }: { icon: string; title: string; extra?: string }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', paddingTop: 8 }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: '1.15em' }}>{icon}</span>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>{title}</span>
      </div>
      {extra && <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{extra}</span>}
    </div>
  );
}

function QualityBar({ icon, label, pct, count, total, color }: { icon: string; label: string; pct: number; count: number; total: number; color: string }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 5 }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
        <span>{icon}</span>
        <span style={{ color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 600, flex: 1 }}>{label}</span>
        <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: '10px' }}>{getGlobalFormat().count(count)}/{getGlobalFormat().count(total)}</span>
        <span style={{ color, fontWeight: 700, minWidth: 48, textAlign: 'left', fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' }}>{getGlobalFormat().num(pct)}٪</span>
      </div>
      <div style={{ height: 7, background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 4, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <div style={{ height: '100%', width: `${Math.min(100, pct)}%`, background: color, borderRadius: 4, transition: 'width 250ms ease' }} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ChartTab({ active, onClick, icon, label }: { active: boolean; onClick: () => void; icon: string; label: string }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      style={{
        flex: 1, padding: '8px 4px',
        background: active ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--btn-bg)',
        border: '1px solid ' + (active ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'),
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
        color: active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
        fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 700,
        cursor: 'pointer',
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 4,
      }}
    >
      <span>{icon}</span>
      <span>{label}</span>
    </button>
  );
}

/**
 * DiscardFormModal — فرم ثبت دور ریخت تخم
 *
 * برای تخم‌هایی که فروخته نمی‌شوند و دور ریخته می‌شوند:
 * شکسته/نرم/کثیف
 */
import { Btn, BtnRow, Field, Grid2, Modal, NumField, Select, Textarea, ErrorBox } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import DatePicker from '../../../shr/components/DatePicker';
import type { EggDiscard, EggDiscardType, EggDiscardReason } from '../store';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (v: boolean) => void;
  form: {
    date: string;
    type: EggDiscardType;
    count: string;
    reason: EggDiscardReason;
    notes: string;
  };
  setForm: (f: any) => void;
  err: string;
  onSave: () => void;
}

const TYPE_LABELS: Record<EggDiscardType, string> = {
  broken: 'شکسته',
  soft: 'نرم',
  dirty: 'کثیف',
};

const REASON_LABELS: Record<EggDiscardReason, string> = {
  rotten: 'فاسد شده',
  broken_handling: 'شکستن در جابجایی',
  expired: 'تاریخ گذشته',
  contaminated: 'آلوده',
  other: 'سایر',
};

export default function DiscardFormModal(props: Props) {
  const { open, setOpen, form, setForm, err, onSave } = props;

  const num = (s: string) => parseInt(s || '0') || 0;

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
      title="🗑 ثبت دور ریخت تخم"
      footer={
        <BtnRow>
          <Btn variant="primary" onClick={onSave}>ذخیره</Btn>
          <Btn onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>لغو</Btn>
        </BtnRow>
      }
    >
      <Grid2>
        <Field label="تاریخ" required>
          <DatePicker
            value={form.date}
            onChange={v => setForm({ ...form, date: v })}
            autoToday
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label="نوع" required>
          <Select
            value={form.type}
            onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, type: e.target.value as EggDiscardType })}
          >
            {(['broken', 'soft', 'dirty'] as const).map(t => (
              <option key={t} value={t}>{TYPE_LABELS[t]}</option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      <Grid2>
        <Field label="تعداد" required>
          <NumField
            placeholder="۰"
            value={form.count}
            onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, count: e.target.value })}
            unit="عدد"
            min={0}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label="دلیل" required>
          <Select
            value={form.reason}
            onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, reason: e.target.value as EggDiscardReason })}
          >
            {(['rotten', 'broken_handling', 'expired', 'contaminated', 'other'] as const).map(r => (
              <option key={r} value={r}>{REASON_LABELS[r]}</option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      <Field label="یادداشت">
        <Textarea
          rows={2}
          placeholder="..."
          value={form.notes}
          onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, notes: e.target.value })}
        />
      </Field>

      {num(form.count) > 0 && (
        <div style={{
          padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
          background: 'var(--warn-soft)',
          border: '1px solid var(--warn)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
          color: 'var(--warn)',
          fontWeight: 600,
        }}>
          ⚠️ {num(form.count)} تخم {TYPE_LABELS[form.type]} از موجودی کم می‌شود
        </div>
      )}

      {err && <ErrorBox>{err}</ErrorBox>}
    </Modal>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/egg/components/ProductionFormModal.tsx

/**
 * ProductionFormModal — فرم افزودن/ویرایش تولید تخم
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { Btn, BtnRow, Field, Grid2, Modal, NumField, Select, Textarea, ErrorBox } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { SectionTitle } from '../helpers';
import { FieldHint } from '../../../shr/intelligence';
import DatePicker from '../../../shr/components/DatePicker';
import { toFa, toEn } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import SmartSelect from '../../../shr/components/SmartSelect';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (v: boolean) => void;
  form: any;
  setForm: any;
  err: string;
  vErrors: Record<string, string>;
  activeFlocks: any[];
  flockCount: number;
  onSave: () => void;
}

export default function ProductionFormModal(props: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { open, setOpen, form, setForm, err, vErrors, activeFlocks, flockCount, onSave } = props;

  const num = (s: string) => s ? parseFloat(toEn(s).replace('٫','.')) || null : null;
  
  const int = (s: any) => { const v = parseInt(toEn(String(s || ''))); return isNaN(v) ? 0 : v; };
  const healthy = int(form.eatingCount) + int(form.fertileCount);
  const totalEggs = healthy + int(form.brokenCount) + int(form.softCount) + int(form.dirtyCount);
  const selectedFlock = activeFlocks.find((f) => f.id === form.flockId);
  const liveRate = flockCount > 0 ? Math.round((healthy / flockCount) * 100) : 0;
  const liveErrors = (() => {
    const errs: { field: string; msg: string }[] = [];
    const e = int(form.eatingCount);
    const f = int(form.fertileCount);
    const b = int(form.brokenCount);
    const s = int(form.softCount);
    const d = int(form.dirtyCount);
    if (e < 0 || f < 0 || b < 0 || s < 0 || d < 0) errs.push({ field: 'all', msg: 'مقادیر منفی مجاز نیست' });
    if (flockCount > 0 && (e + f) > flockCount) errs.push({ field: 'healthy', msg: `مجموع سالم از تعداد گله بیشتره` });
    if (e > 0 && e > flockCount) errs.push({ field: 'eating', msg: 'تخم خوراکی از تعداد گله بیشتره' });
    if (f > 0 && f > flockCount) errs.push({ field: 'fertile', msg: 'تخم نطفه‌دار از تعداد گله بیشتره' });
    return errs;
  })();
  const fertilePercent = healthy > 0 ? Math.round((int(form.fertileCount) / healthy) * 100) : 0;
  const eatingPercent = healthy > 0 ? Math.round((int(form.eatingCount) / healthy) * 100) : 0;

  return (
      <Modal
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        title={form.id ? 'ویرایش تخم‌گذاری' : 'ثبت تخم‌گذاری'}
        footer={<BtnRow><Btn variant="primary" onClick={onSave}>ذخیره</Btn><Btn onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>لغو</Btn></BtnRow>}
      >
        <Grid2>
          <Field label="گله" required>
            <SmartSelect
              value={form.flockId}
              placeholder="— انتخاب گله —"
              modalTitle="انتخاب گله"
              options={activeFlocks.map((f) => ({ value: String(f.id), label: String(f.name) }))}
              onChange={(val: string) => setForm({ ...form, flockId: val })}
            />
          </Field>
          <Field label="تاریخ" required>
            <DatePicker value={form.date} onChange={v => setForm({ ...form, date: v })}  autoToday />
          </Field>
        </Grid2>

        {flockCount > 0 ? (
          <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 600, textAlign: 'center' }}>
            تعداد گله: {fmt.count(flockCount)} پرنده
          </div>
        ) : null}

        <SectionTitle>🥚 تخم‌گذاری</SectionTitle>

        <Grid2>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Field label="🥚 تخم خوراکی">
              <NumField placeholder="مثلاً — ۴۰" value={form.eatingCount} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, eatingCount: e.target.value })} unit="عدد" min={0} integer />
            </Field>
            {!vErrors.eatingCount && <FieldHint fieldPath="egg.eatingCount" value={form.eatingCount} context={{ femaleCount: (selectedFlock as any)?.femaleCount ?? flockCount }} />}
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Field label="🌱 تخم نطفه‌دار" error={vErrors.fertileCount}>
              <NumField placeholder="مثلاً — ۱۰" value={form.fertileCount} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, fertileCount: e.target.value })} unit="عدد" min={0} integer />
            </Field>
            {!vErrors.fertileCount && <FieldHint fieldPath="egg.fertileCount" value={form.fertileCount} context={{ femaleCount: (selectedFlock as any)?.femaleCount ?? flockCount }} />}
          </div>
        </Grid2>

        {(int(form.eatingCount) > 0 || int(form.fertileCount) > 0) && (
          <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--accent-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 600, lineHeight: 1.7, textAlign: 'center' }}>
            📊 ترکیب سالم: <b>{fmt.num(eatingPercent)}٪ خوراکی</b> • <b>{fmt.num(fertilePercent)}٪ نطفه‌دار</b>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* خطاهای زنده */}
        {liveErrors.length > 0 && (
          <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--danger-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--danger)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
            {liveErrors.map((er: any, i: number) => (
              <div key={i} style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--danger)', fontWeight: 600, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                <span>⚠️</span>
                <span>{er.msg}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

                <Grid2>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Field label="تخم شکسته" error={vErrors.brokenCount}>
              <NumField placeholder="مثلاً — ۵" value={form.brokenCount} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, brokenCount: e.target.value })} unit="عدد" min={0} integer />
            </Field>
            {!vErrors.brokenCount && <FieldHint fieldPath="egg.brokenCount" value={form.brokenCount} context={{ femaleCount: (selectedFlock as any)?.femaleCount ?? flockCount }} />}
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Field label="تخم نرم" error={vErrors.softCount}>
              <NumField placeholder="مثلاً — ۲" value={form.softCount} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, softCount: e.target.value })} unit="عدد" min={0} integer />
            </Field>
            {!vErrors.softCount && <FieldHint fieldPath="egg.softCount" value={form.softCount} context={{ femaleCount: (selectedFlock as any)?.femaleCount ?? flockCount }} />}
          </div>
        </Grid2>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <Field label="تخم کثیف" error={vErrors.dirtyCount}>
            <NumField placeholder="مثلاً — ۳" value={form.dirtyCount} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, dirtyCount: e.target.value })} unit="عدد" min={0} integer />
          </Field>
          {!vErrors.dirtyCount && <FieldHint fieldPath="egg.dirtyCount" value={form.dirtyCount} context={{ femaleCount: (selectedFlock as any)?.femaleCount ?? flockCount }} />}
        </div>

        {totalEggs > 0 ? (
          <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--accent-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>🥚 تخم سالم:</span>
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.count(healthy)}</span>
            </div>
            {int(form.brokenCount) > 0 ? (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>💔 شکسته:</span>
                <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--danger)' }}>{fmt.count(int(form.brokenCount))}</span>
              </div>
            ) : null}
            {int(form.softCount) > 0 ? (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>⚪ نرم:</span>
                <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--warn)' }}>{fmt.count(int(form.softCount))}</span>
              </div>
            ) : null}
            {int(form.dirtyCount) > 0 ? (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>🧹 کثیف:</span>
                <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--warn)' }}>{fmt.count(int(form.dirtyCount))}</span>
              </div>
            ) : null}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', borderTop: '1px solid var(--accent-border)', paddingTop: 6, marginTop: 2 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700 }}>جمع کل:</span>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700 }}>{fmt.count(totalEggs)} عدد</span>
            </div>
            {flockCount > 0 && healthy > 0 ? (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                <span>نرخ تخم‌گذاری:</span>
                <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--accent)' }}>{fmt.code(liveRate)}٪</span>
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        ) : null}

        {(int(form.eatingCount) > 0 || int(form.fertileCount) > 0 || (int(form.brokenCount) + int(form.softCount) + int(form.dirtyCount)) > 0) && (
          <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--accent-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 600, lineHeight: 1.7 }}>
            {int(form.eatingCount) > 0 && <div>✓ {fmt.count(int(form.eatingCount))} تخم مرغ خوراکی → انبار</div>}
            {int(form.fertileCount) > 0 && <div>✓ {fmt.count(int(form.fertileCount))} تخم نطفه‌دار → انبار</div>}
            {(int(form.brokenCount) + int(form.softCount) + int(form.dirtyCount)) > 0 && (
              <div>✓ {fmt.count(int(form.brokenCount) + int(form.softCount) + int(form.dirtyCount))} تخم مصرفی → انبار مصرفی</div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        <SectionTitle>⚖ وزن (اختیاری)</SectionTitle>
        <Field label="وزن میانگین تخم" hint="اختیاری" error={vErrors.avgWeight}>
          <NumField placeholder="مثلاً — ۱.۵" value={form.avgWeight} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, avgWeight: e.target.value })} unit="گرم" min={0} />
        </Field>
        {!vErrors.avgWeight && <FieldHint fieldPath="egg.avgWeight" value={form.avgWeight} context={{ species: (selectedFlock as any)?.birdKind }} />}

        <Field label="یادداشت">
            <Textarea placeholder="..." value={form.notes} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, notes: e.target.value })} />
          </Field>

        <ErrorBox>{err}</ErrorBox>
      </Modal>
  );
}

/**
 * store.ts — Zustand store تخم
 */
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { bus } from '../../cor/events';
import { persist, createJSONStorage } from 'zustand/middleware';
import { zustandHybridStorage } from '../../cor/storage/hybridStorage';
import { v4 as uuid } from 'uuid';
import { useWhs } from '../whs/store';

export type EggType = 'eating' | 'fertile' | 'broken';

export interface EggProduction {
  id: string;
  flockId: string;
  date: string;
  eatingCount: number;
  fertileCount: number;
  totalCount: number;
  brokenCount: number;
  softCount: number;
  dirtyCount: number;
  avgWeight: number | null;
  notes: string;
  sourceType?: 'dlg' | 'manual' | 'inc' | 'unknown';
  sourceLogId?: string;
  eatingMovementId?: string;
  fertileMovementId?: string;
  consumptionMovementId?: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

export type EggDiscardType = 'broken' | 'soft' | 'dirty';
export type EggDiscardReason = 'rotten' | 'broken_handling' | 'expired' | 'contaminated' | 'other';

export interface EggDiscard {
  id: string;
  date: string;
  type: EggDiscardType;
  count: number;
  reason: EggDiscardReason;
  notes: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

export interface EggStock {
  eating: number;
  fertile: number;
  broken: number;
}

export interface EggSale {
  id: string;
  date: string;
  type: EggType;
  count: number;
  unit: 'piece' | 'shikan' | 'box' | 'carton';
  unitPrice: number;
  totalPrice: number;
  customerId: string;
  paymentType: 'cash' | 'card' | 'debt';
  notes: string;
  /** 🆕 شناسه فاکتور مبدأ (tra) */
  sourceInvoiceId?: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

interface State {
  productions: EggProduction[];
  sales: EggSale[];
  discards: EggDiscard[];
  packShikan: number;
  packBox: number;
  packCarton: number;
  addProduction: (p: Omit<EggProduction, 'id' | 'createdAt'>) => string;
  findByLogId: (logId: string) => EggProduction | undefined;
  updateProduction: (id: string, patch: Partial<EggProduction>) => void;
  deleteProduction: (id: string) => void;
  addSale: (s: Omit<EggSale, 'id' | 'createdAt'>) => void;
  deleteSale: (id: string) => void;
  addDiscard: (d: Omit<EggDiscard, 'id' | 'createdAt'>) => string;
  deleteDiscard: (id: string) => void;
  /** 🆕 وضعیت لود داده‌ها از IndexedDB */
  isLoading: boolean;
}


const now = () => new Date().toISOString();

export const useEgg = create<State>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      isLoading: true,
      productions: [],
      sales: [],
      discards: [],
      packShikan: 0,
      packBox: 0,
      packCarton: 0,

      addProduction: (p) => {
        const id = uuid();
        const newProd: any = { ...p, eatingMovementId: '', fertileMovementId: '', consumptionMovementId: '', id, createdAt: now() };
        const prevProds = get().productions;
        const prevWhsItems = useWhs.getState().items;
        const prevWhsMovs = useWhs.getState().movements;
        set({ productions: [...prevProds, newProd] });
        try {
          bus.emitSync('egg:production:created', { prodId: id, production: newProd }, { source: 'egg' });
        } catch (e) {
          set({ productions: prevProds });
          useWhs.setState({ items: prevWhsItems, movements: prevWhsMovs });
          throw e;
        }
        return newProd.id;
      },
      findByLogId: (logId) => get().productions.find(x => x.sourceLogId === logId),
      updateProduction: (id, patch) => {
        const prev = get().productions.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (!prev) return;
        const merged: any = { ...prev, ...patch };
        const prevProds = get().productions;
        const prevWhsItems = useWhs.getState().items;
        const prevWhsMovs = useWhs.getState().movements;
        set({ productions: get().productions.map(x => x.id === id ? merged : x) });
        try {
          bus.emitSync('egg:production:updated', { prodId: id, production: merged, prevProduction: prev }, { source: 'egg' });
        } catch (e) {
          set({ productions: prevProds });
          useWhs.setState({ items: prevWhsItems, movements: prevWhsMovs });
          throw e;
        }
      },
      deleteProduction: (id) => {
        const prev = get().productions.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (!prev) return;
        const prevProds = get().productions;
        const prevWhsItems = useWhs.getState().items;
        const prevWhsMovs = useWhs.getState().movements;
        set({ productions: get().productions.filter(x => x.id !== id) });
        try {
          bus.emitSync('egg:production:deleted', { prodId: id, production: prev }, { source: 'egg' });
        } catch (e) {
          set({ productions: prevProds });
          useWhs.setState({ items: prevWhsItems, movements: prevWhsMovs });
          throw e;
        }
      },

      addSale: (s) => set({ sales: [...get().sales, { ...s, id: uuid(), createdAt: now() }] }),
      deleteSale: (id) => set({ sales: get().sales.filter(x => x.id !== id) }),
      addDiscard: (d) => {
        const id = uuid();
        set({ discards: [...get().discards, { ...d, id, createdAt: now() }] });
        return id;
      },
      deleteDiscard: (id) => set({ discards: get().discards.filter(x => x.id !== id) })
    }),
    {
      name: 'pm-egg',
      storage: createJSONStorage(() => zustandHybridStorage),
      partialize: (state) => {
        const { isLoading, ...rest } = state;
        return rest as any;
      },
      onRehydrateStorage: () => {
        return (state, error) => {
          if (error) {
            console.error('[egg] Hydration failed:', error);
          }
          useEgg.setState({ isLoading: false });
        };
      },
      version: 3,
      migrate: (persisted: any, version: number) => {
        if (version < 2 && persisted?.productions) {
          persisted.productions = persisted.productions.map((p: any) => ({
            ...p,
            sourceType: p.sourceType ?? (p.sourceLogId ? 'dlg' : 'unknown'),
          }));
        }
        if (version < 3 && persisted) {
          persisted.discards = persisted.discards ?? [];
        }
        return persisted;
      },
    }
  )
);

export const EGG_TYPE_LABEL: Record<EggType, string> = {
  eating: 'خوراکی',
  fertile: 'نطفه‌دار',
  broken: 'شکسته'
};

export const UNIT_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  piece: 'عدد',
  shikan: 'شانه (۳۰ عدد)',
  box: 'جعبه (۱۰ عدد)',
  carton: 'کارتن (۳۶۰ عدد)'
};

export const PAYMENT_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  cash: 'نقدی',
  card: 'کارت',
  debt: 'نسیه'
};

/** محاسبه‌ی تعداد سالم */
export function healthyCount(p: EggProduction): number {
  return Math.max(0, (p.totalCount || 0) - (p.brokenCount || 0) - (p.softCount || 0) - (p.dirtyCount || 0));
}

/** نرخ تخم‌گذاری Hen-Day — درصد */
export function henDayRate(p: EggProduction, flockCount: number): number {
  if (flockCount <= 0) return 0;
  return Math.round((healthyCount(p) / flockCount) * 10000) / 100;
}

/** درصد شکسته */
export function brokenRate(p: EggProduction): number {
  // totalCount شامل همه‌ی تخم‌ها (سالم + شکسته + نرم + کثیف) است
  const total = p.totalCount || 0;
  if (total === 0) return 0;
  return ((p.brokenCount || 0) / total) * 100;
}

/** محاسبه‌ی موجودی انبار */
export function calcStock(productions: EggProduction[], sales: EggSale[], discards: EggDiscard[] = []): EggStock {
  let eating = 0, fertile = 0, broken = 0;

  // اضافه‌ی تخم‌گذاری
  productions.forEach(p => {
    eating += healthyCount(p);
    broken += (p.brokenCount || 0) + (p.softCount || 0);
  });

  // کم کردن فروش
  sales.forEach(s => {
    const pieces = toPieces(s.count, s.unit);
    if (s.type === 'eating') eating -= pieces;
    else if (s.type === 'fertile') fertile -= pieces;
    else if (s.type === 'broken') broken -= pieces;
  });

  // کم کردن دور ریخت
  discards.forEach(d => {
    if (d.type === 'broken' || d.type === 'soft' || d.type === 'dirty') broken -= d.count;
  });

  return {
    eating: Math.max(0, eating),
    fertile: Math.max(0, fertile),
    broken: Math.max(0, broken)
  };
}

/** تبدیل واحد به تعداد عدد */
export function toPieces(count: number, unit: string): number {
  if (unit === 'piece') return count;
  if (unit === 'shikan') return count * 30;
  if (unit === 'box') return count * 10;
  if (unit === 'carton') return count * 360;
  return count;
}

/** محاسبه‌ی قیمت کل */
export function saleTotal(count: number, unitPrice: number): number {
  return (count || 0) * (unitPrice || 0);
}

/** قیمت تخم بر اساس واحد */
export function pricePerPiece(count: number, unitPrice: number, unit: string): number {
  const pieces = toPieces(count, unit);
  if (pieces === 0) return 0;
  const total = count * unitPrice;
  return total / pieces;
}

import { useFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { useState, useMemo , useEffect } from 'react';

import { format as formatJalali } from 'date-fns-jalali';
import { emptyForm as empty, type F } from './types-formulas';
import FormulaFormModal from './components/FormulaFormModal';
import { useFed, formulaTotal, calcNutrients, formulaValid, type Formula, type FormulaLine } from './store';
import { Btn, Empty, Grid2, PageContainer, Tag } from '../../shr/components/ui';

import { useMultiSelect } from '../../shr/multiSelect/useMultiSelect';

export default function FormulasPage({ active = true }: { active?: boolean }) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { ingredients, requirements, formulas, addFormula, updateFormula, deleteFormula } = useFed();

  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<F>(empty());
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [undoData, setUndoData] = useState<{ item: any | any[] } | null>(null);
  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // فیلتر/مرتب
  const config = useMemo(
    () => getFedFormulasConfig({
      requirements: requirements.map(r => ({ id: r.id, name: r.name, stage: r.stage })),
    }),
    [requirements]
  );
  const { filtered: list, filters, setFilter, clearFilter, sort, setSort, toggleSort,
          resetAll, hasActiveFilters, total: totalFiltered, count } = useFilterSort<Formula>({
    items: formulas,
    filters: config.filterDefs,
    sorts: config.sortDefs,
    persistKey: config.persistKey,
    initialSort: config.initialSort,
  });

  // ─── Multi-Select ───
  const ms = useMultiSelect({
    items: list,
    getId: (x: any) => x.id,
    onDelete: async (ids: string[]) => {
      const ok = await showConfirmAsync('حذف گروهی', fmt.count(ids.length) + ' فرمول حذف شوند؟', { danger: true });
      if (!ok) return;
      const backups: any[] = [];
      for (const id of ids) {
        const it = formulas.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (!it) continue;
        backups.push(it);
        try { deleteFormula(id); } catch {}
      }
      if (backups.length > 0) {
        setUndoData({ item: backups });
        setTimeout(() => setUndoData((cur: any) => cur && Array.isArray(cur.item) && cur.item.length === backups.length ? null : cur), 8000);
      }
      toastMsg.deletedBulk(backups.length, 'فرمول')
    },
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (ms.selectionMode) setExpandedId(null);
  }, [ms.selectionMode]);

  const openNew = () => {
    if (ingredients.length === 0) { toastMsg.error('اول مواد اولیه بسازید'); return; }
    const lastF = formulas
      .filter(x => x.requirementId)
      .sort((a, b) => (b.date || '').localeCompare(a.date || ''))[0];
    setForm({
      ...empty(),
      date: formatJalali(new Date(), 'yyyy/MM/dd'),
      ...(lastF?.requirementId ? { requirementId: lastF.requirementId } : {}),
    });
    setErr(''); setOpen(true);
  };
  useFab(active && formulas.length > 0 ? { label: 'افزودن فرمول', onClick: openNew } : null);

  const openEdit = (f: Formula) => {
    setForm({
      id: f.id, name: f.name, requirementId: f.requirementId,
      lines: f.lines || [], date: f.date,
      status: f.status, notes: f.notes || ''
    });
    setErr(''); setOpen(true);
  };

  const total = useMemo(() => formulaTotal(form.lines), [form.lines]);
  const nutrients = useMemo(() => calcNutrients(form.lines, ingredients), [form.lines, ingredients]);
  const validation = useMemo(() => formulaValid(form.lines, ingredients), [form.lines, ingredients]);

  const selectedReq = requirements.find(r => r.id === form.requirementId);

  const addLine = () => {
    const usedIds = form.lines.map(l => l.ingredientId);
    const available = ingredients.find(i => !usedIds.includes(i.id));
    if (available === undefined) { toastMsg.error('همه مواد اضافه شده‌اند'); return; }
    setForm(f => ({
      ...f,
      lines: [...f.lines, { id: crypto.randomUUID(), ingredientId: available.id, percent: 0 }]
    }));
  };

  const updateLine = (id: string, patch: Partial<FormulaLine>) => {
    setForm(f => ({
      ...f,
      lines: f.lines.map(x => x.id === id ? { ...x, ...patch } : x)
    }));
  };

  const removeLine = (id: string) => {
    setForm(f => ({ ...f, lines: f.lines.filter(x => x.id !== id) }));
  };

  const autoBalance = () => {
    // هر خط را به صورت مساوی تقسیم می‌کند (کمک ساده)
    if (form.lines.length === 0) return;
    const each = Math.floor((100 / form.lines.length) * 100) / 100;
    const newLines = form.lines.map((l, idx) => ({
      ...l,
      percent: idx === form.lines.length - 1
        ? Math.round((100 - each * (form.lines.length - 1)) * 100) / 100
        : each
    }));
    setForm(f => ({ ...f, lines: newLines }));
  };

  // ═══ اعتبارسنجی زنده ═══
  const { errors: vErrors } = useValidation(
    createFormulaSchema({}),
    {
      name: form.name || '',
      requirementId: form.requirementId || '',
      date: form.date || '',
      status: form.status || 'active',
      lines: (form.lines || []).map(l => ({
        id: l.id,
        ingredientId: l.ingredientId || '',
        percent: Number(l.percent) || 0,
      })),
      notes: form.notes || '',
    },
  );

  const save = () => {
    // 🔒 جلوگیری قاطع از نام تکراری جیره
    if (!form.id) {
      const _trimmed = form.name.trim();
      const _dup = formulas.find((x) => x.name.trim() === _trimmed);
      if (_dup) {
        toastMsg.error(`جیرهای با نام «${_dup.name}» قبلاً ثبت شده. لطفاً نام دیگری انتخاب کنید یا همان را ویرایش کنید.`);
        return;
      }
    }

    if (form.name.trim() === '') { setErr('نام جیره را وارد کنید'); return; }
    if (form.lines.length === 0) { setErr('حداقل یک ماده اضافه کنید'); return; }
    const v = formulaValid(form.lines, ingredients);
    if (!v.valid) { setErr(v.errors[0]); return; }

    const data = {
      name: form.name.trim(),
      requirementId: form.requirementId,
      lines: form.lines,
      date: form.date.trim(),
      status: form.status,
      notes: form.notes.trim()
    };

    if (form.id === undefined) {
      addFormula(data);
    } else {
      updateFormula(form.id, data);
    }
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const undoDelete = () => {
    if (!undoData) return;
    const raw = (undoData as any).item;
    const arr: any[] = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : [raw];
    try {
      for (const it of arr) {
        try { addFormula(it); } catch {}
      }
      toastMsg.restoredBulk(arr.length, 'مورد')
    } catch { toastMsg.error('بازگردانی ناموفق') }
    setUndoData(null);
  };

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      <HelpBanner
        id="fed-formulas-guide"
        icon="🧪"
        title="راهنمای فرمول‌های جیره"
        description="ترکیب اقلام خوراکی و نسبت‌های جیره را بسازید و ارزش غذایی نهایی را با نیازهای دوره مقایسه کنید."
        tone="info"
      />
      {undoData && (
        <UndoBar
          label="حذف شد"
          onUndo={undoDelete}
          onDismiss={() => setUndoData(null)}
        />
      )}
      <FilterBar
        filterDefs={config.filterDefs}
        sortDefs={config.sortDefs}
        filterState={filters}
        sortState={sort}
        setFilter={setFilter}
        clearFilter={clearFilter}
        setSort={setSort}
        toggleSort={toggleSort}
        resetAll={resetAll}
        hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
        total={totalFiltered}
        count={count}
      />
      {!ms.selectionMode && list.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: 'var(--dim)', textAlign: 'center', paddingBottom: 2 }}>
          برای انتخاب چندتایی، روی یک کارت نگه دارید
        </div>
      )}

      {ms.selectionMode && list.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 6 }}>
          <button type="button"
            onClick={ms.selectedIds.size === list.length ? ms.clearSelection : ms.selectAll}
            style={{ padding: '4px 10px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: '10px', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
            {ms.selectedIds.size === list.length ? 'لغو انتخاب همه' : 'انتخاب همه'}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {list.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty
          icon={<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round"><path d="M12 2v20M5 8h14M5 16h14"/></svg>}
          title="جیره‌ای ساخته نشده"
          desc="اولین جیره‌ی خود را بسازید — ترکیب مواد اولیه با درصد."
          action={<Btn variant="primary" onClick={openNew}>+ ساخت جیره</Btn>}
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          {list.map((f, i) => {
            const isOpen = !ms.selectionMode && expandedId === f.id;
            const req = requirements.find(r => r.id === f.requirementId);
            const n = calcNutrients(f.lines, ingredients);
            const statusLabel = f.status === 'active' ? 'فعال' : f.status === 'archived' ? 'آرشیو' : 'پیش‌نویس';
            const statusTone: 'green' | 'gray' | 'amber' = f.status === 'active' ? 'green' : f.status === 'archived' ? 'gray' : 'amber';

            return (
              <ExpandableCard
                key={f.id}
                id={f.id}
                ms={ms}
                accent={f.status === 'active' ? 'accent' : f.status === 'archived' ? 'dim' : 'warn'}
                index={fmt.count(i + 1)}
                iconEmoji="🌾"
                title={f.name}
                subtitle={`${req ? req.name : '—'} • ${fmt.date(f.date)}`}
                isOpen={isOpen}
                onToggle={() => setExpandedId(isOpen ? null : f.id)}
                badge={<Tag tone={statusTone}>{statusLabel}</Tag>}
                stats={
                  <>
                    <span>پروتئین: <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.num(n.protein)}٪</b></span>
                    <span>انرژی: <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.num(n.energy)}</b></span>
                    {n.price > 0 ? <span>قیمت: <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.money(n.price)} ت/kg</b></span> : null}
                  </>
                }
              >
                <SectionTitle>🥗 مواد تشکیل‌دهنده</SectionTitle>
                {f.lines.map(line => {
                  const ing = ingredients.find(x => x.id === line.ingredientId);
                  if (ing === undefined) return null;
                  return (
                    <div key={line.id} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between',
                       fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: 'var(--pad-tight)', background: 'var(--input-bg)',
                       borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>
                      <span>{ing.name}</span>
                      <span style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{fmt.num(line.percent)}٪</span>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}

                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between',
                   fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--accent-soft)',
                   color: 'var(--accent)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                   fontWeight: 700 }}>
                  <span>مجموع:</span>
                  <span>{fmt.num(total)}٪</span>
                </div>

                <SectionTitle><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📊</span> مواد مغذی</SectionTitle>
                <Grid2>
                  <Row l="پروتئین" v={`${fmt.num(n.protein)} ٪`} />
                  <Row l="انرژی" v={`${fmt.num(n.energy)} kcal`} />
                </Grid2>
                <Grid2>
                  <Row l="کلسیم" v={`${fmt.num(n.calcium)} ٪`} />
                  <Row l="فسفر" v={`${fmt.num(n.phosphorus)} ٪`} />
                </Grid2>
                <Grid2>
                  <Row l="متیونین" v={`${fmt.num(n.methionine)} ٪`} />
                  <Row l="لیزین" v={`${fmt.num(n.lysine)} ٪`} />
                </Grid2>

                {n.price > 0 ? (
                  <>
                    <SectionTitle><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>💰</span> مالی</SectionTitle>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between',
                       fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--accent-soft)',
                       color: 'var(--accent)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                       fontWeight: 700 }}>
                      <span>هزینه هر کیلوگرم:</span>
                      <span>{fmt.money(n.price)} ت</span>
                    </div>
                  </>
                ) : null}

                {f.notes ? (
                  <>
                    <SectionTitle><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📝</span> یادداشت</SectionTitle>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', lineHeight: 1.7,
                       padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--input-bg)',
                       borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>{f.notes}</div>
                  </>
                ) : null}

                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, paddingTop: 4 }}>
                  <Btn size="sm" onClick={() => openEdit(f)} style={{ flex: 1 }}>ویرایش</Btn>
                  <Btn size="sm" onClick={async () => {
                          const ok = await showConfirmAsync('تأیید حذف', 'این فرمول حذف شود؟', { danger: true });
                          if (!ok) return;
                          deleteFormula(f.id);
                          logAction('delete', 'fed', 'حذف از جیره‌نویسی');
                          toastMsg.deleted(f.name)
                        }} style={{ flex: 1 }}>حذف</Btn>
                </div>
              </ExpandableCard>
            );
          })}
        </>
      )}

      <MultiSelectBar ms={ms} deleteLabel="حذف" />

      {ms.selectionMode && <div style={{ height: 90 }} />}

      <FormulaFormModal
        open={open}
        setOpen={setOpen}
        form={form}
        setForm={setForm}
        err={err}
        vErrors={vErrors}
        ingredients={ingredients}
        requirements={requirements}
        total={total}
        nutrients={nutrients}
        selectedReq={selectedReq}
        addLine={addLine}
        updateLine={updateLine}
        removeLine={removeLine}
        autoBalance={autoBalance}
        save={save}
      />
    </PageContainer>
  );
}


==========================================
FILE: ./src/mod/fed/IngredientsPage.tsx
