/**
 * api/hallCapacity.ts — چک ظرفیت سالن/بخش برای گله
 *
 * منطق:
 *  ۱. گله با بخش + بخش ظرفیت داره → چک ظرفیت بخش
 *  ۲. گله بدون بخش → چک ظرفیت باقی‌مونده سالن (منهای بخش‌ها)
 *  ۳. اگه سالن area داره و ظرفیت عددی نداره → چک area
 */
import type { Flock } from '../store';
import type { Hall, Zone } from '../../hal/store';
import type { useBreedStandard } from '../../../shr/hooks/useBreedStandard';

type BreedStd = ReturnType<typeof useBreedStandard>;

export interface ZoneBreakdown {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  capacity: number;
  used: number;
  remaining: number;
  isCurrent: boolean;
}

export interface HallCapacityResult {
  ok: boolean;
  capacity: number;
  current: number;
  total: number;
  over: number;
  remaining: number;
  mode: 'count' | 'area';
  scope: 'hall' | 'zone';
  scopeName: string;
  /** 🆕 تقسیم‌بندی ظرفیت به بخش‌ها */
  breakdown?: {
    hallName: string;
    hallCapacity: number;
    /** ظرفیت بخش‌های رزرو‌شده */
    zones: ZoneBreakdown[];
    /** ظرفیت باقی‌مونده برای گله‌های بدون بخش */
    noZone: {
      capacity: number;
      used: number;
      remaining: number;
      isCurrent: boolean;
    };
  };
  note?: string;
}

export function checkHallCapacity(
  hallId: string,
  zoneId: string | undefined,
  newCount: number,
  flocks: Flock[],
  halls: Hall[],
  zones: Zone[],
  breedStd: BreedStd,
  excludeFlockId?: string,
  newBreedId?: string,
): HallCapacityResult | null {
  if (!hallId || !newCount || newCount < 0) return null;
  const hall = halls.find(h => h.id === hallId);
  if (!hall) return null;

  const zone = zoneId ? zones.find(z => z.id === zoneId) : null;
  const activeFlocks = (flocks || []).filter(
    f => f.hallId === hallId && f.status === 'active' && f.id !== excludeFlockId,
  );
  const hallZones = zones.filter(z => z.hallId === hallId && !z.archived);

  // ═══════════ ۱. گله با بخش + بخش ظرفیت عددی داره ═══════════
  if (zone && zone.capacity && zone.capacity > 0) {
    const inZone = activeFlocks.filter(f => f.zoneId === zone.id);
    const current = inZone.reduce((sum, f) => sum + (f.currentCount ?? f.initialCount ?? 0), 0);
    const total = current + newCount;
    const over = total - zone.capacity;

    return {
      ok: over <= 0,
      capacity: zone.capacity,
      current,
      total,
      over: over > 0 ? over : 0,
      remaining: Math.max(0, zone.capacity - total),
      mode: 'count',
      scope: 'zone',
      scopeName: zone.name,
      breakdown: buildBreakdown(hall, hallZones, activeFlocks, zone.id),
    };
  }

  // ═══════════ ۲. گله بدون بخش → کل ظرفیت سالن ═══════════
  // 🆕 منطق hal: بخش‌های خالی از سالن کم نمی‌کنن
  //    → کل hall.capacity در دسترس ئه (فقط گله‌های بدون بخش)
  const hallCap = hall.capacity || 0;

  if (hallCap > 0) {
    // 🆕 بخش‌های اشغال‌شده ظرفیتشون رزرو شده
    //    بخش‌های خالی رزرو نمی‌شن (Smart Capacity)
    const occupiedZonesCap = hallZones
      .filter(z => activeFlocks.some(f => f.zoneId === z.id) || z.id === zoneId)
      .reduce((sum, z) => sum + (z.capacity || 0), 0);
    const availableForNoZone = Math.max(0, hallCap - occupiedZonesCap);

    const withoutZone = activeFlocks.filter(f => !f.zoneId);
    const current = withoutZone.reduce((sum, f) => sum + (f.currentCount ?? f.initialCount ?? 0), 0);
    const total = current + newCount;
    const over = total - availableForNoZone;

    return {
      ok: over <= 0,
      capacity: availableForNoZone,
      current,
      total,
      over: over > 0 ? over : 0,
      remaining: Math.max(0, hallCap - total),
      mode: 'count',
      scope: 'hall',
      scopeName: hall.name,
      breakdown: buildBreakdown(hall, hallZones, activeFlocks, undefined),
    };
  }

  // ═══════════ ۳. سالن area داره (بدون ظرفیت عددی) ═══════════
  const area = (hall.length || 0) * (hall.width || 0);
  if (area > 0) {
    let usedArea = 0;
    let hasUnknownDensity = false;

    for (const f of activeFlocks) {
      const std = breedStd.byBreedId(f.breedId);
      const density = std?.space?.densityMax;
      const count = f.currentCount || f.initialCount || 0;
      if (density && density > 0) {
        usedArea += count / density;
      } else {
        hasUnknownDensity = true;
      }
    }

    const newStd = newBreedId ? breedStd.byBreedId(newBreedId) : null;
    const newDensity = newStd?.space?.densityMax;
    if (newDensity && newDensity > 0) {
      usedArea += newCount / newDensity;
    } else {
      hasUnknownDensity = true;
    }

    const over = usedArea - area;
    return {
      ok: over <= 0 && !hasUnknownDensity,
      capacity: Math.round(area),
      current: Math.round(usedArea - (newDensity && newDensity > 0 ? newCount / newDensity : 0)),
      total: Math.round(usedArea),
      over: over > 0 ? Math.round(over) : 0,
      remaining: Math.max(0, Math.round(area - usedArea)),
      mode: 'area',
      scope: 'hall',
      scopeName: hall.name,
      note: hasUnknownDensity ? 'بعضی نژادها تراکم تعریف نشده — دقیق نیست' : undefined,
    };
  }

  return null;
}

/** 🆕 ساخت breakdown — تقسیم ظرفیت سالن به بخش‌ها */
function buildBreakdown(
  hall: Hall,
  hallZones: Zone[],
  activeFlocks: Flock[],
  currentZoneId: string | undefined,
): HallCapacityResult['breakdown'] {
  // 🆕 fallback به مجموع بخش‌ها
  const hallCap = (hall.capacity && hall.capacity > 0)
    ? hall.capacity
    : hallZones.reduce((sum, z) => sum + (z.capacity || 0), 0);
  if (hallCap <= 0) return undefined;

  const zonesBreakdown: ZoneBreakdown[] = hallZones
    .filter(z => (z.capacity || 0) > 0)
    .map(z => {
      const used = activeFlocks
        .filter(f => f.zoneId === z.id)
        .reduce((sum, f) => sum + (f.currentCount ?? f.initialCount ?? 0), 0);
      const cap = z.capacity || 0;
      return {
        id: z.id,
        name: z.name,
        capacity: cap,
        used,
        remaining: Math.max(0, cap - used),
        isCurrent: currentZoneId === z.id,
      };
    });

  // 🆕 فقط بخش‌های اشغال‌شده رزرو می‌شن
  const occupiedZonesCap = hallZones
    .filter(z => (z.capacity || 0) > 0 && (
      activeFlocks.some(f => f.zoneId === z.id) || z.id === currentZoneId
    ))
    .reduce((sum, z) => sum + (z.capacity || 0), 0);
  const noZoneCap = Math.max(0, hallCap - occupiedZonesCap);
  const noZoneUsed = activeFlocks
    .filter(f => !f.zoneId)
    .reduce((sum, f) => sum + (f.currentCount ?? f.initialCount ?? 0), 0);

  return {
    hallName: hall.name,
    hallCapacity: hallCap,
    zones: zonesBreakdown,
    noZone: {
      capacity: noZoneCap,
      used: noZoneUsed,
      remaining: Math.max(0, noZoneCap - noZoneUsed),
      isCurrent: currentZoneId === undefined,
    },
  };
}

/**
 * pickHandlers.ts — منطق auto-fill فرم گله از فاکتور خرید / هچ
 * جدا شده از FlocksModal برای تست‌پذیری.
 */
import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import type { Invoice, InvoiceItem } from '../../tra/store';
import type { HatchResult, EggEntry } from '../../inc/store';
import { toFa, toEn } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { parse as parseJ, format as formatJ, subDays, isValid } from 'date-fns-jalali';
import type { F } from '../types-flocks';

export function applyInvoiceToForm(form: F, inv: Invoice): Partial<F> | null {
  const birdItems = (inv.items || []).filter((it: InvoiceItem) => it.birdId);
  if (!birdItems.length) return null;

  const totalQty = birdItems.reduce((s, it) => s + (it.quantity || 0), 0);
  const firstBird = birdItems[0];
  const updates: Partial<F> = {
    initialCount: getGlobalFormat().raw.digits(String(totalQty), getGlobalFormat().units.numberFormat),
    currentCount: getGlobalFormat().raw.digits(String(totalQty), getGlobalFormat().units.numberFormat),
    purchaseDate: inv.date || '',
    birdId: firstBird.birdId || '',
    breedId: firstBird.breedId || '',
    sourceInvoiceId: inv.id,
  };
  if (firstBird.unitPrice) updates.purchasePrice = getGlobalFormat().raw.digits(String(firstBird.unitPrice), getGlobalFormat().units.numberFormat);
  if (firstBird.maleCount != null) updates.maleCount = getGlobalFormat().raw.digits(String(firstBird.maleCount), getGlobalFormat().units.numberFormat);
  if (firstBird.femaleCount != null) updates.femaleCount = getGlobalFormat().raw.digits(String(firstBird.femaleCount), getGlobalFormat().units.numberFormat);
  if (firstBird.unknownCount != null) updates.unknownCount = getGlobalFormat().raw.digits(String(firstBird.unknownCount), getGlobalFormat().units.numberFormat);
  // 🆕 هزینه حمل از فاکتور
  if (inv.shipping && inv.shipping > 0) updates.deliveryCost = getGlobalFormat().raw.digits(String(inv.shipping), getGlobalFormat().units.numberFormat);
  // 🆕 تاریخ شروع = تاریخ فاکتور
  // 🆕 فیکس: hatchDate از فاکتور (3 سطح fallback)
  if (firstBird.hatchDate) {
    updates.hatchDate = firstBird.hatchDate;
  } else if (firstBird.eggDate) {
    updates.hatchDate = firstBird.eggDate;
  } else if (firstBird.ageDays != null && firstBird.ageDays >= 0 && inv.date) {
    // 🆕 محاسبه hatchDate از ageDays + invoice.date
    try {
      const invDate = parseJ(toEn(inv.date), 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
      if (isValid(invDate)) {
        const hatch = subDays(invDate, firstBird.ageDays);
        updates.hatchDate = formatJ(hatch, 'yyyy/MM/dd');
      }
    } catch {}
  }
  if (inv.date) updates.startDate = inv.date;
  // 🆕 فیکس: اگه هیچ‌کدوم از counts ست نشد → همه در unknownCount
  if (firstBird.maleCount == null && firstBird.femaleCount == null && firstBird.unknownCount == null) {
    updates.maleCount = '';
    updates.femaleCount = '';
    updates.unknownCount = getGlobalFormat().raw.digits(String(totalQty), getGlobalFormat().units.numberFormat);
  }

  return updates;
}

export function applyHatchToForm(form: F, h: HatchResult, entry: EggEntry | null): Partial<F> {
  const updates: Partial<F> = {
    initialCount: getGlobalFormat().raw.digits(String(h.hatched || 0), getGlobalFormat().units.numberFormat),
    currentCount: getGlobalFormat().raw.digits(String(h.hatched || 0), getGlobalFormat().units.numberFormat),
    hatchDate: h.date || '',
    hatchId: h.id,
  };
  if (entry?.birdId) updates.birdId = entry.birdId;
  if (entry?.breedId) updates.breedId = entry.breedId;
  if (h.maleCount != null) updates.maleCount = getGlobalFormat().raw.digits(String(h.maleCount), getGlobalFormat().units.numberFormat);
  if (h.femaleCount != null) updates.femaleCount = getGlobalFormat().raw.digits(String(h.femaleCount), getGlobalFormat().units.numberFormat);
  if (h.unknownCount != null) updates.unknownCount = getGlobalFormat().raw.digits(String(h.unknownCount), getGlobalFormat().units.numberFormat);

  // 🆕 اگه همه null → همه در unknownCount
  if (h.maleCount == null && h.femaleCount == null && h.unknownCount == null) {
    updates.maleCount = '';
    updates.femaleCount = '';
    updates.unknownCount = getGlobalFormat().raw.digits(String(h.hatched || 0), getGlobalFormat().units.numberFormat);
  }
  if (entry?.unitPrice && entry.unitPrice > 0) updates.purchasePrice = getGlobalFormat().raw.digits(String(entry.unitPrice), getGlobalFormat().units.numberFormat);
  return updates;
}

import type { Flock } from './store';

export interface FlockSplitResult {
  toArchive: Flock[];
  keep: Flock[];
  skipped: Flock[];
}

/**
 * تفکیک خالص گله‌ها پیش از انتقال به مخزن flk_closed.
 * - گله‌های فعال یا ادغام‌شده (merged / mergedInto) برای حفظ توازن و unmerge قفل می‌مانند.
 * - گله‌های بسته (archived / sold) بدون وابستگی ادغام وارد toArchive می‌شوند.
 */
export function splitFlocksForArchive(flocks: Flock[]): FlockSplitResult {
  const toArchive: Flock[] = [];
  const keep: Flock[] = [];
  const skipped: Flock[] = [];

  for (const f of flocks) {
    if (!f || !f.id) {
      skipped.push(f);
      continue;
    }

    const isMerged = f.status === 'merged' || Boolean(f.mergedInto);
    if (isMerged) {
      keep.push(f);
      continue;
    }

    if (f.status === 'archived' || f.status === 'sold') {
      toArchive.push(f);
    } else {
      keep.push(f);
    }
  }

  return { toArchive, keep, skipped };
}

export default function ConsumptionFormModal({ open, onClose, flock }: Props) {
  const [type, setType] = useState<'feed' | 'water'>('feed');

  const [amount, setAmount] = useState('');
  const [sex, setSex] = useState<'' | 'male' | 'female' | 'mixed'>('');

  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
  const add = useFlk(s => s.addConsumptionEvent);

  const num = parseFloat(toEn(amount).replace('٫', '.')) || 0;
  const unit = type === 'feed' ? 'kg' : 'L';

      toastMsg.error('تاریخ را وارد کنید');
      return;
    }
    add({
      flockId: flock.id,
      type,
      date,
      amount: num,
      unit,
      sex: type === 'feed' && hasSplit ? sex : '',
      source,
      confidence,
      notes: notes.trim(),
    });
    toastMsg.success(type === 'feed' ? 'دان ثبت شد' : 'آب ثبت شد');
    setAmount('');
    setNotes('');
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title={'ثبت دان/آب — ' + flock.name}>

      {/* ═══ داده اصلی — دو ستونه ═══ */}

      <Grid2>
        <Field label="تاریخ" required>
          <DatePicker value={date} onChange={setDate} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="نوع" required>
          <Select value={type} onChange={e => setType(e.target.value as 'feed' | 'water')}>
            <option value="feed">🍽️ دان</option>
            <option value="water">💧 آب</option>
          </Select>
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      <Grid2>
        {type === 'water' ? (
          <Field label="جنسیت" hint="آب بین همه مشترک است">
            <Select value="" disabled>
              <option value="">— بدون تفکیک —</option>
            </Select>
          </Field>
        ) : hasSplit ? (
          <Field label="جنسیت">
            <Select value={sex} onChange={e => setSex(e.target.value as '' | 'male' | 'female' | 'mixed')}>
              <option value="">کل گله</option>
              <option value="male">♂ نر</option>
              <option value="female">♀ ماده</option>
              <option value="mixed">مخلوط</option>

        ) : (

            <Select value="" disabled>
              <option value="">— ابتدا تفکیک کنید —</option>

        )}
        <Field label={`مقدار (${unit})`} required>
          <NumField
            value={amount}
            onChange={e => setAmount(e.target.value)}

          />

      {/* ═══ جزئیات — تک ستونه ═══ */}
      <div style={GROUP_TITLE}>📝 جزئیات — اختیاری</div>

      <Field label="روش توزیع" help={HELP.flk.consumptionSource}>
        <Select value={source} onChange={e => setSource(e.target.value as any)}>
          <option value="bulk_manual">🍽️ پر کردن سطل</option>
          <option value="daily_manual">📝 روزانه دستی</option>
          <option value="sensor_scale">⚖️ سنسور وزن</option>
          <option value="sensor_level">📊 سنسور سطح</option>
          <option value="auto_feeder">🤖 اتومات هوشمند</option>
        </Select>
      </Field>

      <Field label="یادداشت">
        <Textarea
          value={notes}
          onChange={e => setNotes(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="مثلاً پر کردن سطل ۱ و ۲ — یا هر توضیح دیگر"
          rows={2}
        />
      </Field>

      {source === 'sensor_level' && (
        <div style={{
          fontSize: 10,
          color: 'var(--warn)',

        }}>
          ⚠️ سنسور سطح — مقدار به‌عنوان «تخمینی» ثبت می‌شود
        </div>
      )}

      <BtnRow>
        <Btn variant="primary" onClick={handleSave}>ثبت</Btn>
        <Btn onClick={onClose}>لغو</Btn>
      </BtnRow>
    </Modal>
  );
}

/**
 * FlockCapacityCard.tsx — کارت ظرفیت سالن + breakdown بخش‌ها
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import type { HallCapacityResult, ZoneBreakdown } from '../api/hallCapacity';

interface Props {
  hallCapacity: HallCapacityResult | null | undefined;
}

export default function FlockCapacityCard({ hallCapacity }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  if (!hallCapacity) return null;

  return (
    <div style={{
      padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
      background: hallCapacity.ok ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--warn-soft)',
      border: '1px solid ' + (hallCapacity.ok ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--warn)'),
      borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
      fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
      color: hallCapacity.ok ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--warn)',
      fontWeight: 600,
      lineHeight: 1.7,
      direction: 'rtl',
    }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--sp-2)', marginBottom: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
        <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
          {hallCapacity.ok ? '✅ ظرفیت کافیه' : '⚠️ اضافه‌بار ' + fmt.count(hallCapacity.over) + ' پرنده'}
        </span>
        <span style={{ opacity: 0.85 }}>سالن {hallCapacity.scopeName} · {fmt.count(hallCapacity.capacity)} ظرفیت</span>
      </div>

      {hallCapacity.breakdown && (
        <div style={{ paddingTop: 6, borderTop: '1px dashed currentColor', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--sp-2)', fontWeight: hallCapacity.breakdown.noZone.isCurrent ? 700 : 500 }}>
            <span>{hallCapacity.breakdown.noZone.isCurrent ? '👉 بدون بخش' : 'بدون بخش'}</span>
            <span style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--sp-3)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
              {hallCapacity.breakdown.noZone.used > 0 ? (
                <>
                  <span>{fmt.count(hallCapacity.breakdown.noZone.used)} پرنده</span>
                  <span style={{ opacity: 0.75, minWidth: 60, textAlign: 'left' }}>({fmt.count(hallCapacity.breakdown.noZone.remaining)} خالی)</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <span style={{ opacity: 0.6 }}>خالی</span>
                  <span style={{ opacity: 0.75, minWidth: 60, textAlign: 'left' }}>({fmt.count(hallCapacity.breakdown.noZone.capacity)} ظرفیت)</span>
                </>
              )}
            </span>
          </div>

          {hallCapacity.breakdown.zones.map((z: ZoneBreakdown) => {
            const isOccupied = z.used > 0 || z.isCurrent;
            return (
              <div key={z.id} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--sp-2)', fontWeight: z.isCurrent ? 700 : 500 }}>
                <span>{'📦'} {z.name}{isOccupied ? ' 🔒' : ''}</span>
                <span style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--sp-3)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                  {z.used > 0 ? (
                    <>
                      <span>{fmt.count(z.used)} از {fmt.count(z.capacity)}</span>
                      <span style={{ opacity: 0.75, minWidth: 60, textAlign: 'left' }}>({fmt.count(z.remaining)} خالی)</span>
                    </>
                  ) : z.isCurrent ? (
                    <>
                      <span>این گله اینجا</span>
                      <span style={{ opacity: 0.75, minWidth: 60, textAlign: 'left' }}>({fmt.count(z.capacity)} ظرفیت)</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <span style={{ opacity: 0.6 }}>خالی</span>
                      <span style={{ opacity: 0.75, minWidth: 60, textAlign: 'left' }}>({fmt.count(z.capacity)} ظرفیت)</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </span>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{ paddingTop: 6, marginTop: 6, borderTop: '1px dashed currentColor', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--sp-2)', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
        <span>این گله: <b>{fmt.count(hallCapacity.total - hallCapacity.current)}</b> پرنده</span>
        <span style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
          مجموع {fmt.count(hallCapacity.total)} از {fmt.count(hallCapacity.capacity)}
          {' · '}
          {hallCapacity.over > 0
            ? <span style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>اضافه {fmt.count(hallCapacity.over)}</span>
            : <span>{fmt.count(hallCapacity.remaining)} خالی</span>}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * FlockCard.tsx — کارت نمایش یک گله
 * طراحی: Grid2 برای فیلدهای کوتاه + EntityLink بین‌ماژولی
 */
import { useFormat, getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';



import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../../cor/store/dialog';
import {
  type Flock, SOURCE_LABEL, getAgeDays, getLifecycle,
  sexRatio, daysUntilLaying, isLayingReady, calcCosts,
  DEFAULT_LAYING_START,
} from '../store';
import { getSchedule } from '../../cal/vaccineSchedules';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { Btn, Tag } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import ExpandableCard from '../../../shr/components/ExpandableCard';

import LifecycleBar from './LifecycleBar';
import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { BadgeOverflow } from '../../../shr/components/ui/BadgeOverflow';

import FlockHistoryModal from './FlockHistoryModal';
import type { Bird, Breed } from '../../brd/store';
import type { Hall, Zone } from '../../hal/store';
import type { MultiSelectState } from '../../../shr/multiSelect/useMultiSelect';
import { CardActions } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { ACTION_PRESETS } from '../../../shr/constants/cardActions';
import FlockValueSection from './FlockValueSection';
import { useWhs } from '../../whs/store';
import { HelpIcon } from '../../../shr/components/ui/HelpIcon';
import { HELP } from '../../../shr/help/helpTexts';
import UnmergeFlocksModal from './UnmergeFlocksModal';
import MergedEditBlockModal from './MergedEditBlockModal';
import SexingModal from './SexingModal';
import SexingHistoryModal from './SexingHistoryModal';
import ConsumptionFormModal from './ConsumptionFormModal';
import { useBreedStandard } from '../../../shr/hooks/useBreedStandard';

type Fmt = ReturnType<typeof useFormat>;

const GROUP_ICON: Record<FlockGroupType, string> = {
  season: '🗓', breed: '🧬', cohort: '👥', farm: '🏭', owner: '👤', custom: '📁', smart: '🤖',
};

const GROUP_COLORS: Record<FlockGroupType, { bg: string; fg: string; border: string }> = {
  breed:   { bg: 'var(--purple-soft)', fg: 'var(--purple)', border: 'var(--purple)' },
  cohort:  { bg: 'var(--accent-soft)', fg: 'var(--accent)', border: 'var(--accent-border)' },
  smart:   { bg: 'var(--info-soft)',   fg: 'var(--info)',   border: 'var(--info)' },
  farm:    { bg: 'var(--warn-soft)',   fg: 'var(--warn)',   border: 'var(--warn)' },
  owner:   { bg: 'var(--purple-soft)', fg: 'var(--purple)', border: 'var(--purple)' },
  season:  { bg: 'var(--info-soft)',   fg: 'var(--info)',   border: 'var(--info)' },
  custom:  { bg: 'var(--input-bg)',    fg: 'var(--muted)',  border: 'var(--border)' },
};

const GROUP_PRIORITY: Record<FlockGroupType, number> = {
  breed: 1, cohort: 2, smart: 3, farm: 4, owner: 5, season: 6, custom: 7,
};

const DEAL_BADGE: Record<string, { label: string; emoji: string }> = {
  partnership: { label: 'شراکتی', emoji: '🤝' },
  consignment: { label: 'امانی', emoji: '📦' },
  rent: { label: 'اجاره', emoji: '📋' },
};

export interface FlockCardProps {
  flock: Flock;
  index: number;
  bird: Bird | null | undefined;
  breed: Breed | null | undefined;
  hall: Hall | null | undefined;
  zone: Zone | null | undefined;
  invoiceRevenue: number;
  vaccineEnabled: boolean;
  isOpen: boolean;
  ms: MultiSelectState<Flock>;
  fmt: Fmt;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onArchive: (reason: string) => void;
  onRestore: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
  onToggleHidden: () => void;
  onTogglePaused: () => void;
  onOpenGroups: () => void;
}

export default function FlockCard(props: FlockCardProps) {
  const {
    flock: f, index: i, bird, breed, hall, zone,
    invoiceRevenue, vaccineEnabled, isOpen, ms, fmt,
    onToggle, onEdit, onArchive, onRestore, onDelete,
    onToggleHidden, onTogglePaused, onOpenGroups,
  } = props;

  const [historyOpen, setHistoryOpen] = useState(false);
  const [unmergeOpen, setUnmergeOpen] = useState(false);
  const [sexingOpen, setSexingOpen] = useState(false);
  const [sexingHistoryOpen, setSexingHistoryOpen] = useState(false);
  const [consumptionOpen, setConsumptionOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editBlockOpen, setEditBlockOpen] = useState(false);

  const isMerged = f.status === 'merged' || (f.mergedInfo?.sources?.length || 0) >= 2;

  const handleEditGuard = () => {
    if (isMerged) {
      setEditBlockOpen(true);
      return;
    }
    onEdit();
  };

  const getGroupsForFlock = useFlk(s => s.getGroupsForFlock);
  const whsMovements = useWhs(s => s.movements);
  const whsItems = useWhs(s => s.items);
  const flockGroups = getGroupsForFlock(f.id).slice().sort(
    (a, b) => (GROUP_PRIORITY[a.type] || 99) - (GROUP_PRIORITY[b.type] || 99)
  );
  // 🆕 emoji بر اساس گونه پرنده
  const speciesEmoji = bird?.birdKind === 'duck' ? '🦆' :
                       bird?.birdKind === 'turkey' ? '🦃' :
                       bird?.birdKind === 'quail' ? '🐦' :
                       bird?.birdKind === 'goose' ? '🦢' :
                       bird?.birdKind === 'chicken' ? '🐔' :
                       '🐔';
  const breedStd = useBreedStandard();
    const ageDays = getAgeDays(f);
  const lc = getLifecycle(f.type, ageDays, f.endOfCycleDay ?? null, null, f.layingStartDay ?? null);
  const isArchived = f.status === 'archived' || f.status === 'sold';
  const ready = isLayingReady(f);
  const untilLay = daysUntilLaying(f);
  const costs = calcCosts(f);
  // 🆕 بهای تمام‌شده شامل مصرف انبار (دان + دارو + گیاهی + واکسن)
  const consumption = computeFlockConsumption(f.id, whsMovements, whsItems);
  const totalCost = (costs.grandTotalOwed || 0) + (consumption.totalCost || 0);
  // 🆕 deal display helpers
  const dealData = (f as any).dealData || {};
  const dealType = (f as any).dealType || 'own';
  const rentAmount = Number(dealData.rentAmount) || 0;
  const rentPeriodLabel: Record<string, string> = { monthly: 'ماهانه', season: 'فصلی', total: 'کل دوره' };
  const partnerShare = Number(dealData.partnerShare) || 0;
  const myShare = Math.max(0, 100 - partnerShare);
  const accentColor: 'accent' | 'dim' = isArchived ? 'dim' : 'accent';

  // 🆕 N Counter: ساخت آرایه badge با اولویت
  const deals = useTra(s => s.deals);
  const consignmentCount = useMemo(() => {
    let total = 0;
    for (const deal of deals) {
      if (deal.status === 'cancelled') continue;
      for (const good of deal.goods || []) {
        if (good.existingFlockId !== f.id) continue;
        const dvs = (deal.deliveries || []).filter((dv: any) => dv.goodId === good.id);
        const out = dvs.filter((dv: any) => dv.type === 'out').reduce((s: number, dv: any) => s + (dv.quantity || 0), 0);
        const ret = dvs.filter((dv: any) => dv.type === 'return').reduce((s: number, dv: any) => s + (dv.quantity || 0), 0);
        const loss = dvs.filter((dv: any) => dv.type === 'loss').reduce((s: number, dv: any) => s + (dv.quantity || 0), 0);
        const sold = (deal.sales || []).filter((s: any) => s.goodId === good.id).reduce((s: number, x: any) => s + (x.quantity || 0), 0);
        total += Math.max(0, out - ret - loss - sold);
      }
    }
    return total;
  }, [f.id, deals]);

  // آیا این گله امانی، تلفات از محل طرف داره؟
  const hasConsignmentLosses = useMemo(() => {
    if (dealType !== 'consignment') return false;
    let totalLoss = 0;
    for (const deal of deals) {
      if (deal.status === 'cancelled') continue;
      for (const good of deal.goods || []) {
        if (good.existingFlockId !== f.id) continue;
        const dvs = (deal.deliveries || []).filter((dv: any) => dv.goodId === good.id && dv.type === 'loss');
        totalLoss += dvs.reduce((s: number, dv: any) => s + (dv.quantity || 0), 0);
      }
    }
    return totalLoss > 0;
  }, [f.id, deals, dealType]);

  const allBadges: Array<{ key: string; node: React.ReactNode }> = [];

  if (!isArchived && !f.sourceInvoiceId && !f.hatchId) {
    allBadges.push({
      key: 'no-source',
      node: (
        <Tag
          tone="warn"
          onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); void handleEditGuard(); }}
          title="این گله به هیچ سند لینک نیست — کلیک برای اتصال"
          ariaLabel="اتصال گله به سند"
        >
          بدون سند
        </Tag>
      ),
    });
  }

  if (isArchived) {
    allBadges.push({ key: 'archived', node: <Tag tone="gray">آرشیو</Tag> });
  } else {
    allBadges.push({
      key: 'lifecycle',
      node: <Tag tone={lc.color === 'green' ? 'green' : lc.color === 'amber' ? 'amber' : 'blue'}>{lc.label}</Tag>,
    });
  }

  if (f.hidden) allBadges.push({ key: 'hidden', node: <Tag tone="gray">پنهان</Tag> });
  if (f.paused) allBadges.push({ key: 'paused', node: <Tag tone="amber">متوقف</Tag> });

  if (DEAL_BADGE[f.dealType || 'own']) {
    allBadges.push({
      key: 'deal',
      node: <Tag tone="purple">{DEAL_BADGE[f.dealType || 'own'].label}</Tag>,
    });
  }

  // 🆕 badge «ادغام‌شده» برای گله‌های ساخته‌شده از ادغام
  const _mergedSourcesCount = f.mergedInfo?.sources?.length || 0;
  if (_mergedSourcesCount >= 2) {
    allBadges.push({
      key: 'merged',
      node: (
        <Tag tone="purple">
          ادغام‌شده ({fmt.count(_mergedSourcesCount)})
        </Tag>
      ),
    });
  }

  // 🆕 badge ⏰ زمان تفکیک (breeder بدون genderSplitAt که سن به sexingAge رسیده)
  if (f.type === 'breeder' && !f.genderSplitAt) {
    const _sexingAge = f.sexingAgeOverride ?? breedStd.byBreedId(f.breedId)?.sexingAgeDay;
    if (_sexingAge != null && ageDays >= _sexingAge) {
      allBadges.push({
        key: 'sexing-reminder',
        node: <Tag tone="amber">زمان تفکیک</Tag>,
      });
    }
  }

  flockGroups.forEach(g => {
    const c = GROUP_COLORS[g.type] || GROUP_COLORS.custom;
    allBadges.push({
      key: 'group-' + g.id,
      node: (
        <Tag
          onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onOpenGroups(); }}
          title={g.description || g.name}
          style={{ background: c.bg, color: c.fg }}
        >
          {g.name}
        </Tag>
      ),
    });
  });



  return (
    <>
      <ExpandableCard
      id={f.id}
      data-focus-id={f.id}
      ms={ms}
      accent={accentColor}
      index={fmt.count(i + 1)}
      iconEmoji={speciesEmoji}
      title={f.name}
      subtitle={[bird?.name || '—', breed?.name || (f.breedKind === 'mixed' ? f.breedLabel : ''), hall?.name].filter(Boolean).join(' • ')}
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onToggle={onToggle}
      badge={<BadgeOverflow badges={allBadges} max={2} modalTitle={`برچسب‌های «${f.name}»`} />}
      stats={<>
        {ageDays > 0 && <span>🎂 <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.int(ageDays)} روز</b></span>}
        {f.currentCount != null && <span>🐔 <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.int(f.currentCount)}</b></span>}
        {consignmentCount > 0 && <span style={{ color: 'var(--purple)', fontWeight: 600 }} title="در دست طرف">📤 <b>{fmt.int(consignmentCount)}</b></span>}
        {f.initialCount != null && f.currentCount != null && (() => {
          const events = ((f as any).events || []).filter((e: any) => !e.revoked);
          const eventSales = events.filter((e: any) => e.type === 'sell').reduce((s: number, e: any) => s + (e.count || 0), 0);
          const eventDeaths = events.filter((e: any) => e.type === 'death' || e.type === 'cull').reduce((s: number, e: any) => s + (e.count || 0), 0);
          const deaths = eventDeaths;
          const deathsPct = (f.initialCount ?? 0) > 0 ? (deaths / (f.initialCount ?? 1)) * 100 : 0;
          const danger = deathsPct > 5;
          if (eventSales === 0 && deaths === 0) return null;
          return (
            <>
              {eventSales > 0 && (
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--purple)', fontWeight: 500 }} title="تعداد فروخته‌شده">
                  🏷 <b>{fmt.int(eventSales)}</b>
                </span>
              )}
              {deaths > 0 && (
                <span style={{ color: danger ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--warn)', fontWeight: danger ? 700 : 500 }} title="تلفات">
                  💀 <b>{fmt.int(deaths)}</b>{deathsPct > 0 ? ` (${fmt.num(deathsPct)}٪)` : ''}
                </span>
              )}
            </>
          );
        })()}
        
      </>}
    >

      {!isArchived && (
        <LifecycleBar
          type={f.type}
          ageDays={ageDays}
          endOfCycleDay={f.endOfCycleDay ?? null}
          layingStartDay={f.layingStartDay ?? null}
        />
      )}

      

      {(bird || breed) && (
        <>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>🐔 پرنده و نژاد</div>
          <RowGrid>
            {bird && <Row l="پرنده" v={<EntityLink type="bird" id={bird.id} label={bird.name} />} />}
            {breed && <Row l="نژاد" v={<EntityLink type="breed" id={breed.id} label={breed.name} badge badgeBg="var(--purple-soft)" />} />}
            {!breed && f.breedKind === 'mixed' && f.breedLabel && (
              <Row l="نژاد" v={<span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, padding: '3px 8px', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', background: 'var(--dim-soft, var(--input-bg))', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>🔀 {f.breedLabel} <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 400, color: 'var(--dim)' }}>(مختلط)</span></span>} />
            )}
          </RowGrid>
        </>
      )}

      {(hall || zone) && (
        <>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>📍 مکان</div>
          <RowGrid>
            {hall && <Row l="سالن" v={<EntityLink type="hall" id={hall.id} label={hall.name} />} />}
            {zone && <Row l="بخش" v={<EntityLink type="zone" id={zone.id} label={zone.name} />} />}
          </RowGrid>
        </>
      )}

      <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>📊 مشخصات</div>
      <RowGrid>
        {f.initialCount != null && <Row l="تعداد اولیه" v={getGlobalFormat().count(f.initialCount)} />}
        {f.initialCount != null && (() => {
          const evs = ((f as any).events || []).filter((e: any) => !e.revoked);
          const evSales = evs.filter((e: any) => e.type === 'sell').reduce((s: number, e: any) => s + (e.count || 0), 0);
          const evDeaths = evs.filter((e: any) => e.type === 'death' || e.type === 'cull').reduce((s: number, e: any) => s + (e.count || 0), 0);
          const unmatched = Math.max(0, (f.initialCount ?? 0) - (f.currentCount ?? 0) - evSales - evDeaths - consignmentCount);
          return (
            <>
              {evDeaths > 0 && <Row l="تلفات" v={`${fmt.int(evDeaths)} (${getGlobalFormat().num((evDeaths / (f.initialCount || 1)) * 100)}٪)`} />}
              {evSales > 0 && <Row l="فروش" v={fmt.int(evSales)} />}
              {consignmentCount > 0 && <Row l="در دست طرف" v={fmt.int(consignmentCount)} />}
              {unmatched > 0 && <Row l="تعدیل نامشخص" v={`${fmt.int(unmatched)} (بررسی کنید)`} accent />}
            </>
          );
        })()}
        {f.type === 'breeder' && ((f.maleCount ?? 0) + (f.femaleCount ?? 0) + (f.unknownCount ?? 0) > 0) && (
          <>
            {(f.maleCount ?? 0) > 0 && <Row l="تعداد نر" v={fmt.int(f.maleCount)} />}
            {(f.femaleCount ?? 0) > 0 && <Row l="تعداد ماده" v={fmt.int(f.femaleCount)} />}
            {(f.unknownCount ?? 0) > 0 && <Row l="جنسیت نامشخص" v={fmt.int(f.unknownCount)} />}
            {f.maleCount != null && f.femaleCount != null && f.maleCount > 0 && f.femaleCount > 0 && (
              <Row l="نسبت نر/ماده" v={sexRatio(f.maleCount, f.femaleCount)} />
            )}
          </>
        )}
        <Row l="منبع" v={SOURCE_LABEL[f.source] || '—'} />
        {f.endOfCycleDay && <Row l="چرخه زندگی" v={`${fmt.int(f.endOfCycleDay)} روز`} />}
        {(() => {
          if (f.type !== 'layer' && f.type !== 'breeder') return null;
          const layStart = f.layingStartDay || DEFAULT_LAYING_START;
          const fromStd = !f.layingStartDay;
          return <Row l="سن تخم‌گذاری" v={`${fmt.int(layStart)} روز${fromStd ? ' (استاندارد)' : ''}`} />;
        })()}
        {vaccineEnabled && f.vaccineScheduleId && (() => {
          const sch = getSchedule(f.vaccineScheduleId);
          if (!sch) return null;
          return <Row l="برنامه واکسن" v={`${sch.label} • ${getGlobalFormat().count(sch.items.length)} مرحله`} />;
        })()}
      </RowGrid>

      {(f.hatchDate || f.purchaseDate || f.startDate) && (
        <>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>📅 تاریخ‌ها</div>
          <RowGrid>
            {f.hatchDate && <Row l="هچ" v={getGlobalFormat().date(f.hatchDate)} />}
            {f.purchaseDate && <Row l="خرید" v={getGlobalFormat().date(f.purchaseDate)} />}
            {f.startDate && <Row l="شروع" v={getGlobalFormat().date(f.startDate)} />}
          </RowGrid>
        </>
      )}

      {(costs.total > 0 || consumption.totalCost > 0) && (
        <>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>💰 هزینه‌ها</div>
          <RowGrid>
            {costs.birdCost > 0 && <Row l="قیمت پرنده‌ها" v={fmt.money(costs.birdCost)} />}
            {costs.delivery > 0 && <Row l="هزینه حمل" v={fmt.money(costs.delivery)} />}
            {costs.other > 0 && <Row l="سایر" v={fmt.money(costs.other)} />}
            {dealType === 'rent' && costs.rentOwed > 0 && (
              <>
                <Row l={`اجاره انباشته (${rentPeriodLabel[dealData.rentPeriod || 'monthly'] || 'ماهانه'})`} v={fmt.money(costs.rentOwed)} />
                {costs.rentInfo.paid > 0 && (
                  <Row l="پرداخت‌شده" v={fmt.money(costs.rentInfo.paid)} />
                )}
                {costs.rentInfo.outstanding > 0 && (
                  <Row l="بدهی اجاره" v={fmt.money(costs.rentInfo.outstanding)} />
                )}
              </>
            )}
            {consumption.totalCost > 0 && (
              <>
                <Row l="هزینه ثابت" v={fmt.money(costs.grandTotalOwed)} />
                <Row l="مصرف انبار" v={fmt.money(consumption.totalCost)} />
              </>
            )}
            {costs.rentOwed > 0 ? (
              <>
                <Row l="جمع خرید" v={fmt.money(costs.purchaseTotal)} />
                <Row l="هزینه کل (با اجاره)" v={fmt.money(totalCost)} accent />
              </>
            ) : (
              <Row l={consumption.totalCost > 0 ? "هزینه کل" : "جمع کل"} v={fmt.money(totalCost)} accent />
            )}
            {totalCost > 0 && !hasConsignmentLosses && (f.currentCount || 0) > 0 && <Row l="هر پرنده" v={fmt.money(Math.round(totalCost / (f.currentCount || 1)))} accent />}
          </RowGrid>
        </>
      )}

      {(() => {
        const revenue = invoiceRevenue;
        if (revenue === 0) return null;
        const profit = revenue - totalCost;
        const roi = totalCost > 0 ? (profit / totalCost) * 100 : 0;
        const isProfit = profit >= 0;
        const color = isProfit ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--danger)';
        return (
          <>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>📈 درآمد و سود</div>
            <RowGrid>
              {f.sourceInvoiceId && (
                <Row l="فاکتور خرید" v={<EntityLink type="invoice" id={f.sourceInvoiceId} label="مشاهده" />} />
              )}
              <Row l="فروش کل" v={fmt.money(revenue)} />
              <Row l="هزینه ثابت" v={fmt.money(costs.grandTotalOwed)} />
              {consumption.totalCost > 0 && (
                <Row l="مصرف انبار" v={fmt.money(consumption.totalCost)} />
              )}
              <Row l="هزینه کل" v={fmt.money(totalCost)} />
              <Row l={isProfit ? 'سود خالص' : 'زیان'} v={fmt.money(Math.abs(profit))} accent={isProfit} />
              {totalCost > 0 && <Row l="ROI" v={`${getGlobalFormat().num(roi)}٪`} />}
              {dealType === 'partnership' && partnerShare > 0 && (
                <>
                  <Row l={`سهم شریک (${getGlobalFormat().count(partnerShare)}٪)`} v={fmt.money(Math.round(profit * partnerShare / 100))} />
                  <Row l={`سهم شما (${getGlobalFormat().count(myShare)}٪)`} v={fmt.money(Math.round(profit * myShare / 100))} accent={isProfit} />
                </>
              )}
            </RowGrid>
          </>
        );
      })()}

      <FlockValueSection flock={f} />

      {f.mergedInfo && (f.mergedInfo.sources?.length || 0) >= 2 && (() => {
        const _all = f.mergedInfo.sources || [];
        const _total = _all.reduce((s: number, x: any) => s + (x.count || 0), 0);
        const _count = _all.length;
        return (
          <>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', width: '100%' }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>گله ادغام‌شده</span>
                <HelpIcon text={HELP.flk.merged} />
                <span style={{
                  fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)',
                  color: 'var(--muted)',
                  background: 'var(--input-bg)',
                  border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                  padding: '1px 6px',
                  borderRadius: 4,
                  fontWeight: 600,
                }}>از {getGlobalFormat().count(_count)} گله</span>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setUnmergeOpen(true)}
                title="بازگردانی گله"
                style={{
                  width: 28, height: 28,
                  background: 'var(--btn-bg)',
                  border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                  borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                  fontSize: 14, color: 'var(--text)',
                  fontFamily: 'inherit', padding: 0,
                }}
              >♻️</button>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
              {_all.map((s: any) => (
                <Row key={s.flockId} l={s.flockName} v={`${fmt.int(s.count || 0)} پرنده`} />
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        );
      })()}

      {(() => {
        const cons = computeFlockConsumption(f.id, whsMovements, whsItems);
        const hasAnyQty = cons.feed.total > 0 || cons.medicine.total > 0 || cons.vaccine.total > 0 || cons.other.total > 0;
        if (!hasAnyQty && cons.totalCost === 0) return null;
        return (
          <>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
              📦 مصرف انبار
              <HelpIcon text={HELP.flk.consumption} />
            </div>
            <RowGrid>
              {cons.feed.total > 0 && <Row l="دان" v={`${fmt.int(cons.feed.total)} کیلو`} />}
              {cons.medicine.total > 0 && <Row l="دارو" v={cons.medicine.cost > 0 ? fmt.money(cons.medicine.cost) : `${fmt.int(cons.medicine.total)}`} />}
              {cons.herbal.total > 0 && <Row l="دارو گیاهی" v={cons.herbal.cost > 0 ? fmt.money(cons.herbal.cost) : `${fmt.int(cons.herbal.total)}`} />}
              {cons.vaccine.total > 0 && <Row l="واکسن" v={cons.vaccine.cost > 0 ? fmt.money(cons.vaccine.cost) : `${fmt.int(cons.vaccine.total)}`} />}
              {cons.other.total > 0 && <Row l="سایر" v={cons.other.cost > 0 ? fmt.money(cons.other.cost) : `${fmt.int(cons.other.total)}`} />}
              {cons.totalCost > 0 && <Row l="جمع هزینه" v={fmt.money(cons.totalCost)} accent />}
              {cons.totalCost === 0 && hasAnyQty && (
                <Row l="جمع مصرف" v="قیمت‌ها در انبار ثبت نشده" accent />
              )}
            </RowGrid>
          </>
        );
      })()}

      {isArchived && f.archivedReason && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--warn-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--warn)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', color: 'var(--warn)' }}>
          <b>دلیل آرشیو:</b> {f.archivedReason}
        </div>
      )}

      {f.notes && (
        <>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>📝 یادداشت</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', lineHeight: 1.7, padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>{f.notes}</div>
        </>
      )}

      {isArchived ? (
        <CardActions actions={[
          { ...ACTION_PRESETS.RESTORE, onClick: onRestore },
          { ...ACTION_PRESETS.DELETE, onClick: onDelete }
        ]} />
      ) : (
        <>
          <CardActions actions={[
            { ...ACTION_PRESETS.EDIT, onClick: handleEditGuard, priority: 10 },
            { label: 'تفکیک جنسیت', onClick: () => setSexingOpen(true), variant: 'outline', hidden: f.type === 'broiler', group: 'sexing', priority: 20 },
            { label: 'سابقه تفکیک', onClick: () => setSexingHistoryOpen(true), variant: 'outline', hidden: (f.sexingEvents?.length || 0) === 0, group: 'sexing', priority: 20 },
            { label: 'ثبت دان/آب', onClick: () => setConsumptionOpen(true), variant: 'outline', priority: 30 },
            { ...ACTION_PRESETS.HISTORY, onClick: () => setHistoryOpen(true), priority: 40 },
            { label: 'گروه‌ها', onClick: onOpenGroups, variant: 'outline', priority: 70 },
            { label: f.hidden ? 'نمایان' : 'پنهان', onClick: onToggleHidden, variant: 'outline', priority: 80 },
            { label: f.paused ? 'فعال' : 'غیرفعال', onClick: onTogglePaused, variant: 'outline', priority: 90 }
          ]} />
        </>
      )}

      <FlockHistoryModal
        open={historyOpen}
        onClose={() => setHistoryOpen(false)}
        flock={f}
      />
          <UnmergeFlocksModal open={unmergeOpen} onClose={() => setUnmergeOpen(false)} targetFlockId={f.id} />
      <SexingModal open={sexingOpen} onClose={() => setSexingOpen(false)} flock={f} />
      <SexingHistoryModal open={sexingHistoryOpen} onClose={() => setSexingHistoryOpen(false)} flock={f} />
      <ConsumptionFormModal open={consumptionOpen} onClose={() => setConsumptionOpen(false)} flock={f} />
      <MergedEditBlockModal open={editBlockOpen} onClose={() => setEditBlockOpen(false)} onUnmerge={() => setUnmergeOpen(true)} flockName={f.name} />
    </ExpandableCard>
    
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * FlockCreateStandalone — wrapper مستقل برای FlocksModal
 * فقط برای ساخت گله جدید از ماژول‌های دیگر (tra, inc, ...)
 * همه hookها و validation داخلی مدیریت می‌شن — تنها open/onClose/onSaved از بیرون.
 */
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { useFlk } from '../store';
import { useBrd } from '../../brd/store';
import { useHal } from '../../hal/store';
import { useTra } from '../../tra/store';
import { useSet } from '../../set/store';
import { useFlocksForm } from '../hooks/useFlocksForm';
import { useBreedStandard } from '../../../shr/hooks/useBreedStandard';
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units';
import { useValidation } from '../../../shr/validation/useValidation';
import { useFormErrors } from '../../../shr/hooks/useFormErrors';
import { createFlkSchema } from '../../../shr/validation/rules/flk';
import { toEn } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import FlocksModal from './FlocksModal';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSaved: (flockId: string) => void;
}

export default function FlockCreateStandalone({ open, onClose, onSaved }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const breedStd = useBreedStandard();
  const { flocks, add } = useFlk();
  const vaccineEnabled = useSet(s => s.features?.vaccine !== false);
  const { birds: _birdsRaw, breeds } = useBrd();
  const { halls: _hallsRaw, zones } = useHal();
  const { invoices } = useTra();

  // dedupe پرنده/سالن (مثل FlocksPage)
  const birds = useMemo(() => {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    return _birdsRaw.filter(b => {
      const k = (b.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (seen.has(k)) return false;
      seen.add(k);
      return true;
    });
  }, [_birdsRaw]);

  const halls = useMemo(() => {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    return _hallsRaw.filter(h => {
      const k = (h.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (seen.has(k)) return false;
      seen.add(k);
      return true;
    });
  }, [_hallsRaw]);

  const {
    setOpen: setFormOpen, form, setForm, layingFromStd, setLayingFromStd, err,
    openNew, save,
  } = useFlocksForm({ birds, halls, flocks, breedStd, add, update: () => {} });

  // وقتی open شد → فرم را ریست کن (فقط بار اول)
  const prevOpenRef = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open && !prevOpenRef.current) {
      openNew();
    }
    prevOpenRef.current = open;
  }, [open, openNew]);

  const num = (s: string) => (s ? parseFloat(toEn(s).replace('٫', '.')) || null : null);
  const int = (s: string) => (s ? parseInt(toEn(s)) || null : null);

  const existingNames = useMemo(
    () => flocks
      .filter(f => f.id !== form.id)
      .map(f => f.name.trim().toLowerCase())
      .filter(Boolean),
    [flocks, form.id],
  );

  const flkSchema = useMemo(() => createFlkSchema({ existingNames }), [existingNames]);

  const { errors: vErrors } = useValidation(flkSchema, {
    name: form.name || '',
    type: form.type,
    birdId: form.birdId || '',
    breedId: form.breedId || '',
    hallId: form.hallId || '',
    zoneId: form.zoneId || '',
    initialCount: form.initialCount ? int(form.initialCount) : undefined,
    currentCount: form.currentCount ? int(form.currentCount) : undefined,
    maleCount: int(form.maleCount) ?? 0,
    femaleCount: int(form.femaleCount) ?? 0,
    layingStartDay: form.layingStartDay ? int(form.layingStartDay) : undefined,
    endOfCycleDay: form.endOfCycleDay ? int(form.endOfCycleDay) : undefined,
    vaccineScheduleId: form.vaccineScheduleId || '',
    hatchDate: form.hatchDate || '',
    purchaseDate: form.purchaseDate || '',
    startDate: form.startDate || '',
    source: form.source,
    purchasePrice: form.purchasePrice ? num(form.purchasePrice) : undefined,
    deliveryCost: form.deliveryCost ? num(form.deliveryCost) : undefined,
    otherCosts: form.otherCosts ? num(form.otherCosts) : undefined,
    status: form.status,
    notes: form.notes || '',
    dealType: (form.dealType || 'own') as any,
    rentAmount: form.rentAmount ? num(form.rentAmount) : undefined,
    rentStartDate: form.rentStartDate || '',
    rentEndDate: form.rentEndDate || '',
    rentPeriod: (form.rentPeriod || 'monthly') as any,
    rentPayments: (form.rentPayments || []).map(p => ({
      id: p.id,
      date: p.date,
      amount: Number(p.amount) || 0,
      notes: p.notes || '',
    })),
  });

  const { showError, markTouched, isValid, attemptSave } = useFormErrors(vErrors);

  const breedsForBird = useMemo(() => breeds.filter(b => b.birdId === form.birdId), [breeds, form.birdId]);
  const zonesForHall = useMemo(() => zones.filter(z => z.hallId === form.hallId), [zones, form.hallId]);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    attemptSave();
    if (Object.keys(vErrors).length > 0) return;
    const result = await save();
    if (result?.isNew) {
      onSaved(result.id);
    }
    onClose();
    setFormOpen(false);
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    onClose();
    setFormOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <FlocksModal
      open={open}
      onClose={handleClose}
      form={form}
      setForm={setForm}
      layingFromStd={layingFromStd}
      setLayingFromStd={setLayingFromStd}
      err={err}
      vErrors={vErrors}
      showError={showError}
      markTouched={markTouched}
      isValid={isValid}
      hallCapacity={null}
      birds={birds}
      breedsForBird={breedsForBird}
      halls={halls}
      zonesForHall={zonesForHall}
      breedStd={breedStd}
      vaccineEnabled={vaccineEnabled}
      fmt={fmt}
      onSave={handleSave}
    />
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/flk/components/FlockDealSection.tsx

/**
 * FlockDealSection.tsx — مدل بهره‌برداری (مالکیت، شراکت، امانی، اجاره)
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { Field, Grid2, MoneyField, NumField, Select } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { toFa, toEn } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { useCtc } from '../../ctc/store';
import { useTra } from '../../tra/store';
import type { F } from '../types-flocks';
import { HELP } from '../../../shr/help/helpTexts';
import DatePicker from '../../../shr/components/DatePicker';
import { FieldHint } from '../../../shr/intelligence';
import { parse as parseJ, addDays, format as formatJ } from 'date-fns-jalali';
import { todayJ } from '../api/flocksCalc';
import SmartSelect from '../../../shr/components/SmartSelect';

interface Props {
  form: F;
  setForm: (updater: F | ((prev: F) => F)) => void;
  showError?: (field: string) => string | undefined;
  markTouched?: (field: string) => void;
}

const DEAL_TYPE_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  own: '🏠 مالکیت کامل (خودم)',
  partnership: '🤝 شراکتی',
  consignment: '📦 امانی',
  rent: '📋 اجاره‌ای',
  barter: '🔄 تهاتر',
};

const DIVIDER = {
  paddingTop: 8,
  fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)',
  fontWeight: 700,
  color: 'var(--text)',
  letterSpacing: '.3px',
  borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)',
} as const;

const DISABLED_FIELD = {
  height: 38,
  display: 'flex',
  alignItems: 'center',
  justifyContent: 'flex-end',
  padding: '0 12px',
  background: 'var(--input-bg)',
  border: '1px solid var(--border)',
  borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
  fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)',
  fontWeight: 700,
  color: 'var(--muted)',
} as const;

export default function FlockDealSection({ form, setForm, showError, markTouched }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const rawContacts = useCtc((s: { contacts: Array<{ id: string; name: string; roles?: string[] }> }) => s.contacts) || [];
  const contacts = rawContacts.filter(c => (c.roles || []).includes('customer') || (c.roles || []).includes('supplier'));
  const deals = useTra((s: { deals: Array<{ id: string; type: string; date: string }> }) => s.deals) || [];

  const partnerShare = parseInt(toEn(form.partnerShare || '')) || 0;
  const rentAmountNum = parseFloat(toEn(form.rentAmount).replace('٫', '.').replace(/[,٬]/g, '')) || 0;
  const rentPaidTotal = (form.rentPayments || []).reduce((a, p) => a + (Number(p.amount) || 0), 0);
  
  const calcDays = (() => {
    if (!form.rentStartDate || !form.rentEndDate) return 0;
    try {
      const s = parseJ(toEn(form.rentStartDate), 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
      const e = parseJ(toEn(form.rentEndDate), 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
      if (!isNaN(s.getTime()) && !isNaN(e.getTime())) {
        return Math.max(0, Math.floor((e.getTime() - s.getTime()) / 86400000));
      }
    } catch {}
    return 0;
  })();

  const totalRentAmount = (() => {
    if (form.rentPeriod === 'total') return rentAmountNum;
    if (!calcDays) return rentAmountNum;
    if (form.rentPeriod === 'season') return rentAmountNum * Math.max(1, Math.ceil(calcDays / 90));
    return rentAmountNum * Math.max(1, Math.ceil(calcDays / 30));
  })();

  const rentOutstanding = totalRentAmount - rentPaidTotal;

  // 🆕 سقف داینامیک پرداخت‌ها
  const maxPayments = (() => {
    let days = 0;
    if (form.rentStartDate && form.rentEndDate) {
      try {
        const s = parseJ(toEn(form.rentStartDate), 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
        const e = parseJ(toEn(form.rentEndDate), 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
        if (!isNaN(s.getTime()) && !isNaN(e.getTime())) {
          days = Math.max(0, Math.floor((e.getTime() - s.getTime()) / 86400000));
        }
      } catch {}
    }
    if (!days) return form.rentPeriod === 'total' ? 10 : 20;
    if (form.rentPeriod === 'total') return 10;
    if (form.rentPeriod === 'season') return Math.min(60, Math.max(8, Math.ceil(days / 90) * 3 + 2));
    return Math.min(60, Math.max(12, Math.ceil(days / 30) * 2 + 2));
  })();
  const paymentCount = (form.rentPayments || []).length;
  const canAddPayment = paymentCount < maxPayments;
  const nearLimit = paymentCount >= Math.floor(maxPayments * 0.8);
  const cycleEnd = (() => {
    try {
      if (!form.hatchDate || !form.endOfCycleDay) return '';
      const hatch = parseJ(toEn(form.hatchDate), 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
      if (isNaN(hatch.getTime())) return '';
      const days = parseInt(toEn(form.endOfCycleDay)) || 0;
      if (days <= 0) return '';
      return formatJ(addDays(hatch, days), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
    } catch { return ''; }
  })();
  const rentEndWarn = !!(cycleEnd && form.rentEndDate && form.rentEndDate > cycleEnd);
  const myShare = Math.max(0, 100 - partnerShare);

  const relevantDeals = deals.filter((d) => {
    if (form.dealType === 'partnership') return d.type === 'partnership';
    if (form.dealType === 'consignment') return d.type === 'consignment';
    if (form.dealType === 'barter') return d.type === 'barter';
    if (form.dealType === 'conditional') return d.type === 'conditional';
    return false;
  });

  return (
    <>
      <div style={DIVIDER}>💼 مدل بهره‌برداری</div>

      <Field label="نوع مالکیت" help={HELP.flk.ownership.type}>
        <Select value={form.dealType || 'own'} onChange={e => {
              const newType = e.target.value;
              const patch: any = { dealType: newType };
              if (newType === 'rent' && !form.rentStartDate && form.startDate) {
                patch.rentStartDate = form.startDate;
              }
              setForm({ ...form, ...patch });
            }}>
          {Object.entries(DEAL_TYPE_LABEL).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}
        </Select>
      </Field>

      {form.dealType === 'partnership' && (
        <>
          <Field label="شریک" error={showError?.('partnerId')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('partnerId')} required help={HELP.flk.ownership.partner}>
            <SmartSelect
              value={form.partnerId || ''}
              placeholder="— انتخاب —"
              modalTitle="انتخاب شریک"
              options={contacts.map((c) => ({ value: String(c.id), label: String(c.name) }))}
              onChange={(val: string) => setForm({ ...form, partnerId: val })}
            />
          </Field>
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="سهم شریک" error={showError?.('partnerShare')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('partnerShare')} help={HELP.flk.ownership.partnerShare}>
              <NumField value={form.partnerShare || ''} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, partnerShare: e.target.value })} unit="٪" min={0} max={100} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="سهم من" hint="خودکار">
              <div style={DISABLED_FIELD}>{fmt.count(myShare)}٪</div>
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
        </>
      )}

      {form.dealType === 'consignment' && (
        <Field label="امانت‌دهنده" error={showError?.('consignorId')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('consignorId')} required help={HELP.flk.ownership.consignor}>
          <SmartSelect
              value={form.consignorId || ''}
              placeholder="— انتخاب —"
              modalTitle="انتخاب امانت‌دهنده"
              options={contacts.map((c) => ({ value: String(c.id), label: String(c.name) }))}
              onChange={(val: string) => setForm({ ...form, consignorId: val })}
            />
        </Field>
      )}

      {form.dealType === 'barter' && (
        <>
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="طرف تهاتر" error={showError?.('barterPartyId')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('barterPartyId')} required>
              <SmartSelect
              value={form.barterPartyId || ''}
              placeholder="— انتخاب —"
              modalTitle="انتخاب طرف تهاتر"
              options={contacts.map((c) => ({ value: String(c.id), label: String(c.name) }))}
              onChange={(val: string) => setForm({ ...form, barterPartyId: val })}
            />
            </Field>
            <Field label="ارزش ریالی تهاتر" error={showError?.('barterValue')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('barterValue')}>
              <MoneyField placeholder="مبلغ معادل" value={form.barterValue || ''} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, barterValue: e.target.value })} />
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
          <Field label="شرح کالا/خدمات معاوضی">
            <input type="text" value={form.barterDescription || ''} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, barterDescription: e.target.value })} placeholder="مثلاً: ۵ تن دان" style={{ width: '100%', height: 38, padding: '0 12px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontFamily: 'inherit', textAlign: 'right', boxSizing: 'border-box' }} />
          </Field>
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="تاریخ شروع تهاتر" error={showError?.('barterStartDate')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('barterStartDate')}>
              <DatePicker value={form.barterStartDate || ''} onChange={v => setForm({ ...form, barterStartDate: v })} placeholder="از چه تاریخی؟" autoToday />
            </Field>
            <Field label="تاریخ پایان تهاتر" error={showError?.('barterEndDate') || (form.barterStartDate && form.barterEndDate && form.barterStartDate >= form.barterEndDate ? 'باید بعد از شروع باشد' : undefined)} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('barterEndDate')}>
              <DatePicker value={form.barterEndDate || ''} onChange={v => setForm({ ...form, barterEndDate: v })} placeholder="تا چه تاریخی؟" min={form.barterStartDate} />
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
        </>
      )}

      {form.dealType === 'rent' && (
        <>
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="موجر (اجاره‌دهنده)" error={showError?.('lessorId')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('lessorId')} required help={HELP.flk.ownership.lessor}>
              <SmartSelect
              value={form.lessorId || ''}
              placeholder="— انتخاب —"
              modalTitle="انتخاب موجر"
              options={contacts.map((c) => ({ value: String(c.id), label: String(c.name) }))}
              onChange={(val: string) => setForm({ ...form, lessorId: val })}
            />
            </Field>
            <Field label="مبلغ اجاره" required help={HELP.flk.ownership.rentAmount} error={showError?.('rentAmount')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('rentAmount')}>
              <MoneyField placeholder={form.rentPeriod === 'total' ? 'مبلغ کل دوره' : 'مبلغ هر دوره'} value={form.rentAmount || ''} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, rentAmount: e.target.value })} />
              {rentAmountNum > 0 && !showError?.('rentAmount') && <FieldHint fieldPath="flk.rentAmount" value={rentAmountNum} />}
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
          {rentAmountNum > 0 && form.rentPeriod !== 'total' && calcDays > 0 && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 4, paddingRight: 2 }}>
              مبلغ کل دوره ({fmt.count(Math.max(1, Math.ceil(calcDays / (form.rentPeriod === 'season' ? 90 : 30))))} {form.rentPeriod === 'season' ? 'فصل' : 'ماه'}): {fmt.money(totalRentAmount)}
            </div>
          )}
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="دوره" error={showError?.('rentPeriod')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('rentPeriod')} help={HELP.flk.ownership.rentPeriod}>
              <Select value={form.rentPeriod || 'monthly'} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, rentPeriod: e.target.value })}>
                <option value="monthly">ماهانه</option>
                <option value="season">فصلی</option>
                <option value="total">کل دوره</option>
              </Select>
            </Field>
            <Field label="شروع اجاره" error={showError?.('rentStartDate')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('rentStartDate')} required help={HELP.flk.ownership.rentStartDate}>
              <DatePicker placeholder="از چه تاریخی؟" value={form.rentStartDate || ''} onChange={v => setForm({ ...form, rentStartDate: v })} autoToday />
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
          {form.rentPeriod === 'total' && (
            <Field label="پایان قرارداد" required help={HELP.flk.ownership.rentEndDate} error={showError?.('rentEndDate') || (form.rentStartDate && form.rentEndDate && form.rentStartDate >= form.rentEndDate ? 'باید بعد از شروع باشد' : undefined)} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('rentEndDate')}>
              <DatePicker placeholder="تا چه تاریخی؟" value={form.rentEndDate || ''} onChange={v => setForm({ ...form, rentEndDate: v })} min={form.rentStartDate} />
              {rentEndWarn && (
                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--warn)', paddingRight: 2, marginTop: 4 }}>
                  ⚠️ پایان اجاره بعد از پایان چرخه گله ({cycleEnd}) — مطمئن شو قرارداد رو تمدید می‌کنی
                </div>
              )}
            </Field>
          )}

          <div style={DIVIDER}>💳 پرداخت‌های اجاره</div>
          {(form.rentPayments || []).length === 0 ? (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', textAlign: 'center', padding: '6px 0' }}>
              هنوز پرداختی ثبت نشده
            </div>
          ) : (
            (form.rentPayments || []).map((p, idx) => (
              <div key={p.id} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                  <DatePicker value={p.date} min={form.rentStartDate || undefined} max={form.rentEndDate || undefined} onChange={v => {
                    const updated = (form.rentPayments || []).map((x, i) => i === idx ? { ...x, date: v } : x);
                    setForm({ ...form, rentPayments: updated });
                  }} />
                </div>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                  <MoneyField placeholder="مبلغ پرداخت" value={p.amount > 0 ? fmt.raw.digits(String(p.amount), fmt.units.numberFormat) : ''} onChange={e => {
                    const raw = parseFloat(toEn(e.target.value).replace('٫','.')) || 0;
                    const updated = (form.rentPayments || []).map((x, i) => i === idx ? { ...x, amount: raw } : x);
                    setForm({ ...form, rentPayments: updated });
                  }} />
                  {p.amount > 0 && totalRentAmount > 0 && (
                    <FieldHint fieldPath="flk.rentPayments.amount" value={p.amount} context={{ rentAmount: totalRentAmount }} />
                  )}
                </div>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => {
                  const updated = (form.rentPayments || []).filter((_, i) => i !== idx);
                  setForm({ ...form, rentPayments: updated });
                }} style={{ background: 'var(--danger-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--danger)', color: 'var(--danger)', cursor: 'pointer', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', width: 32, height: 38, padding: 0, fontFamily: 'inherit', fontWeight: 700, flexShrink: 0 }}>✕</button>
              </div>
            ))
          )}
          {rentAmountNum > 0 && (canAddPayment ? (
            <button type="button" onClick={() => {
              const newP = { id: crypto.randomUUID(), date: todayJ(), amount: 0, notes: '' };
              setForm({ ...form, rentPayments: [...(form.rentPayments || []), newP] });
            }} style={{ width: '100%', height: 38, background: 'transparent', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', color: 'var(--text)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              + افزودن پرداخت {nearLimit && <span style={{ color: 'var(--warn)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)' }}>({paymentCount}/{maxPayments})</span>}
            </button>
          ) : (
            <div style={{ width: '100%', height: 38, background: 'var(--bg)', border: '1px dashed var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 600, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              🔒 حداکثر {maxPayments} پرداخت
            </div>
          ))}
          {nearLimit && canAddPayment && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--warn)', textAlign: 'center' }}>
              ⚠️ {paymentCount} از {maxPayments} پرداخت — نزدیک به حداکثر
            </div>
          )}
          {(form.rentPayments || []).length > 0 && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', textAlign: 'center', marginTop: 8 }}>
              جمع پرداخت‌ها: {fmt.money(rentPaidTotal)}
              {totalRentAmount > 0 && (
                rentPaidTotal === totalRentAmount ? ' · ✅ تسویه شده' :
                rentPaidTotal > totalRentAmount ? ' · ❌ مازاد: ' + fmt.money(rentPaidTotal - totalRentAmount) :
                ' · باقیمانده: ' + fmt.money(totalRentAmount - rentPaidTotal)
              )}
              {rentPaidTotal > totalRentAmount && (
                <div style={{ marginTop: 6, color: 'var(--danger)', fontWeight: 700, background: 'var(--danger-soft)', padding: '6px', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>
                  ⚠️ مجموع پرداخت‌ها از مبلغ کل اجاره بیشتر است!
                </div>
              )}
              {showError && showError('rentPayments') && (
                <div style={{ marginTop: 6, color: 'var(--danger)', fontWeight: 600 }}>⚠️ {showError('rentPayments')}</div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {relevantDeals.length > 0 && (
        <Field label="لینک به قرارداد (اختیاری)" hint="قرارداد مالی موجود در tra">
          <SmartSelect
            value={form.dealId || ''}
            placeholder="— بدون لینک —"
            modalTitle="انتخاب قرارداد"
            options={relevantDeals.map((d) => ({
              value: String(d.id),
              label: `#${String(d.id).slice(0, 6)} · ${d.date || ''}`,
            }))}
            onChange={(val: string) => setForm({ ...form, dealId: val })}
          />
        </Field>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * FlockGroupsModal.tsx — انتخاب گروه برای یک گله
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Modal, Btn, BtnRow } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { useFlk, type Flock, type FlockGroupType } from '../store';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  flock: Flock;
}

const TYPE_ICON: Record<FlockGroupType, string> = {
  season: '🗓', breed: '🧬', cohort: '👥', farm: '🏭', owner: '👤', custom: '📁', smart: '🤖',
};

export default function FlockGroupsModal({ open, onClose, flock }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const groups = useFlk(s => s.groups);
  const groupMembers = useFlk(s => s.groupMembers);
  const addToGroup = useFlk(s => s.addToGroup);
  const removeFromGroup = useFlk(s => s.removeFromGroup);

  const availableGroups = useMemo(
    () => groups.filter(g => !g.archived).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'fa')),
    [groups]
  );

  const memberSet = useMemo(() => {
    return new Set(
      groupMembers
        .filter(m => m.flockId === flock.id && !m.leftAt)
        .map(m => m.groupId)
    );
  }, [groupMembers, flock.id]);

  const [localSelected, setLocalSelected] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set(memberSet));

  const toggle = (groupId: string) => {
    setLocalSelected(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(groupId)) next.delete(groupId);
      else next.add(groupId);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    // اضافه‌ها
    for (const gid of localSelected) {
      if (!memberSet.has(gid)) addToGroup(gid, flock.id);
    }
    // حذف‌ها
    for (const gid of memberSet) {
      if (!localSelected.has(gid)) removeFromGroup(gid, flock.id);
    }
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title={'گروه‌های «' + flock.name + '»'}>
      {availableGroups.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 32, textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 13 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 40, marginBottom: 8 }}>📁</div>
          <div>هنوز گروهی نساخته‌ای</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, marginTop: 4, opacity: 0.7 }}>
            از منوی گله‌ها → «گروه‌ها» گروه بساز
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
          {availableGroups.map(g => {
            const isSmart = g.type === 'smart';
            const checked = localSelected.has(g.id);
            return (
              <label
                key={g.id}
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 'var(--sp-2)',
                  padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
                  background: isSmart
                    ? 'var(--purple-soft)'
                    : (checked ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--input-bg)'),
                  border: '1px solid ' + (
                    isSmart
                      ? 'var(--purple)'
                      : (checked ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--border)')
                  ),
                  borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                  cursor: isSmart ? 'default' : 'pointer',
                  opacity: isSmart ? 0.9 : 1,
                }}
              >
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={checked}
                  onChange={() => !isSmart && toggle(g.id)}
                  disabled={isSmart}
                  style={{ accentColor: isSmart ? 'var(--purple)' : 'var(--accent)' }}
                />
                <span style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>{TYPE_ICON[g.type]}</span>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
                    {g.name}
                    {isSmart && (
                      <span style={{
                        marginRight: 6, fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 700,
                        color: 'var(--purple)', background: 'rgba(168,85,247,.15)',
                        padding: '1px 6px', borderRadius: 4,
                      }}>🤖 خودکار</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  {g.description && (
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{g.description}</div>
                  )}
                  {isSmart && (
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--purple)', fontStyle: 'italic', marginTop: 2 }}>
                      بر اساس قوانین گروه به‌صورت خودکار
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
                {checked && !isSmart && <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700 }}>✓</span>}
              </label>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      <BtnRow>
        <Btn variant="primary" onClick={handleSave}>
          ذخیره ({fmt.count(localSelected.size)} انتخاب)
        </Btn>
        <Btn onClick={onClose}>لغو</Btn>
      </BtnRow>
    </Modal>
  );
}
