import type { Hall, Zone } from '../../hal/store';
import type { useBreedStandard } from '../../../shr/hooks/useBreedStandard';

type BreedStd = ReturnType<typeof useBreedStandard>;
type Fmt = ReturnType<typeof useFormat>;

export interface FlocksModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  form: F;
  setForm: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<F>>;
  layingFromStd: boolean;
  setLayingFromStd: (v: boolean) => void;
  err: string;
  vErrors: Record<string, string>;
  /** 🆕 تابع نمایش خطا (بر اساس touched/saveAttempted) */
  showError: (field: string) => string | undefined;
  /** 🆕 علامت‌گذاری لمس فیلد */
  markTouched: (field: string) => void;
  /** 🆕 آیا فیلد معتبر ئه؟ */
  isValid: (field: string) => boolean;
  /** 🆕 ظرفیت سالن/بخش (inline) */
  hallCapacity?: import('../api/hallCapacity').HallCapacityResult | null;
  // داده
  birds: Bird[];
  breedsForBird: Breed[];
  halls: Hall[];
  zonesForHall: Zone[];
  breedStd: BreedStd;
  vaccineEnabled: boolean;
  fmt: Fmt;
  // actions
  onSave: () => void;
  onArchive?: () => void;
  onRestore?: () => void;
  saving?: boolean;
}

export default function FlocksModal(props: FlocksModalProps) {

  // 🆕 Picker modals
  const [invoicePickerOpen, setInvoicePickerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [hatchPickerOpen, setHatchPickerOpen] = useState(false);


  const handleInvoiceSelect = async (inv: Invoice) => {
    const linkedFlock = useFlk.getState().flocks.find(f => f.sourceInvoiceId === inv.id);
    if (linkedFlock && (linkedFlock.status === 'archived' || linkedFlock.status === 'sold')) {
      const wantRestore = await showConfirmAsync(
        'گله آرشیو شده یافت شد',
        `از فاکتور ${inv.number || inv.id} قبلاً گله‌ای به نام «${linkedFlock.name}» ساخته شده که در آرشیو است. آیا می‌خواهید آن گله را بازیابی کنید یا یک گله جدید بسازید؟`,
        { confirmText: '♻️ بازیابی گله قبلی', cancelText: '➕ ساخت گله جدید' }
      );
      if (wantRestore) {
        useFlk.getState().restore(linkedFlock.id);
        onClose();
        return;
      }
    }
    
    const updates = applyInvoiceToForm(form, inv);
    if (!updates) return;
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, ...updates }));
  };

  const handleHatchSelect = (h: HatchResult, entry: EggEntry | null) => {
    const updates = applyHatchToForm(form, h, entry);
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, ...updates }));
  };

  const {
    open, onClose, form, setForm, layingFromStd, setLayingFromStd,
    err, vErrors, showError, markTouched, isValid, hallCapacity, birds, breedsForBird, halls, zonesForHall,
    breedStd, vaccineEnabled, fmt, onSave, onArchive, onRestore,
  } = props;
  const allFlocks = useFlk(st => st.flocks);


  const formStd = breedStd.byBreedId(form.breedId);
  const formLaying = formStd?.biology?.layingStartDay ?? DEFAULT_LAYING_START;

  const liveCosts = (() => {
    const num = (s: string) => s ? parseFloat(toEn(s).replace('٫', '.')) || 0 : 0;
    const int = (s: string) => s ? parseInt(toEn(s)) || 0 : 0;
    const bird = int(form.initialCount) * num(form.purchasePrice);
    const del = num(form.deliveryCost);
    const oth = num(form.otherCosts);
    const total = bird + del + oth;
    const per = int(form.initialCount) ? total / (int(form.initialCount) || 1) : 0;
    return { bird, del, oth, total, per };
  })();

  // 🆕 اگه فاکتور یا هچ لینک شده، فیلدهای منبع قفل می‌شن
  const isSourceLinked = !!(form.sourceInvoiceId || form.hatchId);

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={form.id ? 'ویرایش گله' : 'افزودن گله'}
      footer={
        <BtnRow>
          {form.id && form.status === 'archived' && onRestore && (
            <Btn onClick={onRestore} style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }}>📦 بازگردانی</Btn>
          )}
          {form.id && form.status !== 'archived' && onArchive && (
            <Btn onClick={onArchive}>آرشیو</Btn>
          )}
          <Btn variant="primary" onClick={onSave} disabled={props.saving}>ذخیره</Btn>
          <Btn onClick={onClose}>لغو</Btn>
        </BtnRow>
      }
    >
      <div style={{ paddingTop: 8, fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)', letterSpacing: '.3px', borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)' }}>🏷 هویت</div>
      <Grid2>
  <Field label="نام گله" required error={showError('name')} onTouch={() => markTouched('name')}>
    <Input
      placeholder={
        form.source === 'hatch' ? 'مثلاً — جوجه‌های تفریخ مرداد'
        : form.source === 'purchase'
          ? (form.type === 'broiler' ? 'مثلاً — گله گوشتی پاییز'
            : form.type === 'breeder' ? 'مثلاً — گله مادر مرندی'
            : 'مثلاً — گله تخم‌گذار بهار')
          : 'مثلاً — گله اصلی'
      }
      value={form.name}
      onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })}
    />
  </Field>
        <Field label="نوع گله" required error={showError('type')} onTouch={() => markTouched('type')}>
          <Select value={form.type} onChange={async e => {
            const newType = e.target.value as 'layer' | 'broiler' | 'breeder';
            if (form.id) {
              const original = allFlocks.find(f => f.id === form.id);
              const hasEvents = (original?.events?.length || 0) > 0;
              const hasCountChange = original ? (original.currentCount !== original.initialCount) : false;
              if ((hasEvents || hasCountChange) && newType !== original?.type) {
                const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
                  'تغییر نوع گله',
                  'این گله داده دارد (رویدادها یا تغییر موجودی). تغییر نوع ممکنه گزارش‌های گذشته رو مختل کنه. ادامه؟'
                );
                if (!ok) return;
              }
            }
            setForm({ ...form, type: newType });
          }}>
            <option value="layer">تخم‌گذار</option>
            <option value="broiler">گوشتی</option>
            <option value="breeder">مادر (تخم نطفه‌دار)</option>
          </Select>
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      <Grid2>
        <Field label="منبع">
          <Select value={form.source} onChange={e => {
            const newSource = e.target.value;
            const today = todayJ();
            setForm(f => {
              if (newSource === 'hatch') {
                return { ...f, source: newSource, hatchDate: f.hatchDate || today, purchaseDate: '', purchasePrice: '', deliveryCost: '' };
              }
              if (newSource === 'purchase') {
                return { ...f, source: newSource, purchaseDate: f.purchaseDate || today, purchasePrice: f.purchasePrice, deliveryCost: f.deliveryCost };
              }
              return { ...f, source: newSource };
            });
          }}>
            {Object.entries(SOURCE_LABEL).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}
          </Select>
        </Field>
  <FlockSourcePickers
    form={form}
    setForm={setForm}
    onOpenInvoicePicker={() => setInvoicePickerOpen(true)}
    onOpenHatchPicker={() => setHatchPickerOpen(true)}
  />
      </Grid2>

      <FlockDealSection form={form} setForm={setForm} showError={showError} markTouched={markTouched} />

            <div style={{ paddingTop: 8, fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)', letterSpacing: '.3px', borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)' }}>🐔 پرنده و نژاد</div>
      <Grid2>
        <Field label={isSourceLinked ? <span>🔒 پرنده</span> : "پرنده"} required error={isSourceLinked ? undefined : showError('birdId')} onTouch={() => !isSourceLinked && markTouched('birdId')}>
          <SmartSelect
            value={form.birdId}
            onChange={v => !isSourceLinked && setForm(f => ({ ...f, birdId: v, breedId: '' }))}
            options={birds.map(c => ({ value: c.id, label: c.name }))}
            placeholder="— انتخاب کنید —"
            modalTitle="انتخاب پرنده"
            disabled={isSourceLinked}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label={isSourceLinked ? <span>🔒 نژاد</span> : "نژاد"} error={isSourceLinked ? undefined : (form.breedKind === 'mixed' ? undefined : showError('breedId'))} onTouch={() => !isSourceLinked && markTouched('breedId')}>
          {form.breedKind === 'mixed' ? (
            <Input
              value={form.breedLabel || ''}
              onChange={e => !isSourceLinked && setForm(f => ({ ...f, breedLabel: e.target.value }))}
              placeholder="مثلاً: مرندی محلی"
            disabled={isSourceLinked && !!form.breedId}
            />
          ) : (
            <DependentSelect
              hideInternalError={true}
              disabled={isSourceLinked && !!form.breedId}
              value={form.breedId}
              onChange={v => { if (isSourceLinked) return;
                const std = breedStd.byBreedId(v);
                const layStart = std?.biology?.layingStartDay;
                if (layStart != null) {
                  setForm(f => ({ ...f, breedId: v, layingStartDay: String(layStart) }));
                  setLayingFromStd(true);
                } else {
                  setForm(f => ({ ...f, breedId: v }));
                  setLayingFromStd(false);
                }
              }}
              parentValue={form.birdId}
              parentLabel="پرنده"
              options={breedsForBird.map(b => {
                const dupes = breedsForBird.filter(x => x.name === b.name);
                let suffix = '';
                if (dupes.length > 1) {
                  const labels: Record<string, string> = { layer: 'تخم‌گذار', broiler: 'گوشتی', breeder: 'مادر', ornamental: 'تزئینی' };
                  const purposeStr = b.purposes && b.purposes.length > 0 ? b.purposes.map((p: string) => labels[p] || p).join('، ') : '';
                  if (purposeStr) suffix = ` (${purposeStr})`;
                }
                return { value: b.id, label: `${b.name}${suffix}` };
              })}
              emptyListMessage="این پرنده هنوز نژادی ندارد — از بخش «پرنده و نژاد» اضافه کنید"
              placeholder="— انتخاب نژاد —"
              modalTitle="انتخاب نژاد"
            />
          )}
        </Field>
      </Grid2>
        {form.birdId && !isSourceLinked && (
          <div style={{ textAlign: 'right', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', marginTop: 4 }}>
            {form.breedKind === 'mixed' ? (
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setForm(f => ({ ...f, breedKind: 'standard', breedLabel: '' }))} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: 'var(--accent)', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0, fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'inherit', textDecoration: 'underline' }}>
                بازگشت به انتخاب نژاد استاندارد
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setForm(f => ({ ...f, breedKind: 'mixed', breedId: '' }))} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: 'var(--dim)', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0, fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'inherit', textDecoration: 'underline' }}>
                نژاد مورد نظر نیست؟ ثبت گله مختلط
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

      <div style={{ paddingTop: 8, fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)', letterSpacing: '.3px', borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)' }}>📍 مکان</div>
      <Grid2>
        <Field label="سالن (اختیاری)" hint="قابل تخصیص بعداً" error={showError('hallId')} onTouch={() => markTouched('hallId')}>
          <SmartSelect
            value={form.hallId}
            onChange={v => setForm(f => ({ ...f, hallId: v, zoneId: '' }))}
            options={halls.map(c => ({ value: c.id, label: c.name }))}
            placeholder="— انتخاب کنید —"
            modalTitle="انتخاب سالن"
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label="بخش">
          <DependentSelect
            hideInternalError={true}
            value={form.zoneId || ''}
            onChange={v => setForm(f => ({ ...f, zoneId: v }))}
            parentValue={form.hallId}
            parentLabel="سالن"
            options={zonesForHall.map(z => ({ value: z.id, label: z.name }))}
            emptyListMessage="این سالن هنوز بخشی ندارد — از تب «بخش‌ها» اضافه کنید"
            emptyMode="select"
            placeholder="— بدون بخش —"
            modalTitle="انتخاب بخش"
          />
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      <div style={{ paddingTop: 8, fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)', letterSpacing: '.3px', borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)' }}>📊 تعداد</div>

      {(form.type === 'layer' || form.type === 'breeder') && (
        <Grid2>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Field
              label="سن شروع تخم‌گذاری (روز)" error={showError('layingStartDay')} onTouch={() => markTouched('layingStartDay')}
              autoFrom={layingFromStd && formStd?.biology?.layingStartDay ? 'استاندارد نژاد (' + fmt.count(formStd.biology.layingStartDay) + ' روز)' : undefined}
            >
              <NumField
                value={form.layingStartDay || (formLaying ? String(formLaying) : '')}
                onChange={e => { setForm({ ...form, layingStartDay: e.target.value }); setLayingFromStd(false); }}
                placeholder={fmt.int(formLaying)}
                unit="روز"
                max={250}
                min={100}
              />
            </Field>
            {!showError('layingStartDay') && <FieldHint fieldPath="flk.layingStartDay" value={form.layingStartDay || formLaying} context={{ expected: formLaying || undefined }} />}
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: (parseInt(toEn(form.initialCount)) || 0) > 0 ? 'contents' : 'none' }}>
<div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Field
              label="سن پایان چرخه (روز)" error={showError('endOfCycleDay')} onTouch={() => markTouched('endOfCycleDay')}
              hint={form.endOfCycleDay ? undefined : 'خالی = از استاندارد نژاد'}
            >
              <NumField
                value={form.endOfCycleDay || ''}
                onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, endOfCycleDay: e.target.value })}
                placeholder={formStd?.biology?.endOfCycleDay ? fmt.int(formStd.biology.endOfCycleDay) : '—'}
                unit="روز"
                max={600}
                min={100}
              />
            </Field>
            {!showError('endOfCycleDay') && <FieldHint fieldPath="flk.endOfCycleDay" value={form.endOfCycleDay} context={{ expected: formStd?.biology?.endOfCycleDay ?? undefined }} />}
          </div>
</div>
        </Grid2>
      )}

      <Grid2>
        <Field
          label={isSourceLinked ? <span>تعداد اولیه <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--warn)' }}>🔒</span></span> : 'تعداد اولیه'}
          required
          hint={isSourceLinked ? 'برای تغییر، فاکتور را ویرایش کنید' : undefined}
          error={showError('initialCount')}
          onTouch={() => markTouched('initialCount')}
        >
          <NumField placeholder="۸۵۰" disabled={isSourceLinked} value={form.initialCount} onChange={e => {
            if (isSourceLinked) return;
            const v = e.target.value;
            setForm(f => ({
              ...f,
              initialCount: v,
              currentCount: (!f.currentCount || f.currentCount === f.initialCount) ? v : f.currentCount,
            }));
          }} unit="پرنده" min={1} max={100000} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="تعداد فعلی" hint="اگه خالی بمونه = تعداد اولیه" error={showError('currentCount')} onTouch={() => markTouched('currentCount')}>
          <NumField placeholder="۸۳۲" value={form.currentCount} onChange={e => {
            const ccStr = e.target.value;
            const cc = parseInt(toEn(ccStr)) || 0;
            const m = parseInt(toEn(form.maleCount || '0')) || 0;
            const fe = parseInt(toEn(form.femaleCount || '0')) || 0;
            const newUnknown = Math.max(0, cc - m - fe);
            setForm({ ...form, currentCount: ccStr, unknownCount: cc > 0 ? String(newUnknown) : form.unknownCount });
          }} unit="پرنده" min={1} max={100000} />
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      <FlockCapacityCard hallCapacity={hallCapacity} />

      {form.type === 'breeder' && (
        <DepBox title="اطلاعات گله مادر">
          <Grid3>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0, minWidth: 0 }}>
              <Field label="تعداد نر">
                <NumField placeholder="۸۰" value={form.maleCount} onChange={e => {
                  const maleRaw = parseInt(toEn(e.target.value || '0')) || 0;
                  const female = parseInt(toEn(form.femaleCount || '0')) || 0;
                  const cc = parseInt(toEn(form.currentCount || form.initialCount || '0')) || 0;
                  const newUnknown = cc > 0 ? Math.max(0, cc - maleRaw - female) : (parseInt(toEn(form.unknownCount || '0')) || 0);
                  setForm({
                    ...form,
                    maleCount: e.target.value,
                    unknownCount: cc > 0 ? String(newUnknown) : form.unknownCount,
                  });
                }} min={0} max={100000} unit="پرنده" />
              </Field>
              {!showError('maleCount') && <FieldHint fieldPath="flk.maleCount" value={form.maleCount} context={{ initialCount: form.initialCount }} />}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0, minWidth: 0 }}>
              <Field label="تعداد ماده" error={showError('femaleCount')} onTouch={() => markTouched('femaleCount')}>
                <NumField placeholder="۸۰۰" value={form.femaleCount} onChange={e => {
                  const femaleRaw = parseInt(toEn(e.target.value || '0')) || 0;
                  const male = parseInt(toEn(form.maleCount || '0')) || 0;
                  const cc = parseInt(toEn(form.currentCount || form.initialCount || '0')) || 0;
                  const newUnknown = cc > 0 ? Math.max(0, cc - male - femaleRaw) : (parseInt(toEn(form.unknownCount || '0')) || 0);
                  setForm({
                    ...form,
                    femaleCount: e.target.value,
                    unknownCount: cc > 0 ? String(newUnknown) : form.unknownCount,
                  });
                }} min={0} max={100000} unit="پرنده" />
              </Field>
              {!showError('femaleCount') && <FieldHint fieldPath="flk.femaleCount" value={form.femaleCount} context={{ initialCount: form.initialCount }} />}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Field label="تعداد نامشخص" error={showError('unknownCount')} onTouch={() => markTouched('unknownCount')}>
              <NumField placeholder="۰" value={form.unknownCount || ''} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, unknownCount: e.target.value })} min={0} max={100000} unit="پرنده" />
            </Field>
            {!showError('unknownCount') && <FieldHint fieldPath="flk.unknownCount" value={form.unknownCount} context={{ initialCount: form.initialCount }} />}
          </div>
          </Grid3>
          <FlockIntegrityWarning form={form} setForm={setForm} />
          {form.maleCount && form.femaleCount && (() => {
            const male = parseInt(toEn(form.maleCount)) || 0;
            const female = parseInt(toEn(form.femaleCount)) || 0;
            const unknown = parseInt(toEn(form.unknownCount || '0')) || 0;
            const init = parseInt(toEn(form.initialCount)) || 0;
            const sum = male + female + unknown;
            const mismatch = init > 0 && sum !== init;
            return (
              <>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                  نسبت نر به ماده: {sexRatio(male, female)}
                </div>
              </>
            );
          })()}
        </DepBox>
      )}


      <FlockDetailsSection
        form={form}
        setForm={setForm}
        showError={showError}
        markTouched={markTouched}
        liveCosts={liveCosts}
        vaccineEnabled={vaccineEnabled}
        isSourceLinked={isSourceLinked}
      />

      {err && <ErrorBox>{err}</ErrorBox>}
    
      <PickInvoiceModal
        open={invoicePickerOpen}
        onClose={() => setInvoicePickerOpen(false)}
        onSelect={handleInvoiceSelect}
        currentBirdId={form.birdId}
      />
      <PickHatchModal
        open={hatchPickerOpen}
        onClose={() => setHatchPickerOpen(false)}
        onSelect={handleHatchSelect}
      />
      </Modal>
  );
}

/**
 * GroupComparisonModal.tsx — مقایسه ۲-۳ گروه
 */
import { useFormat, getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Modal, Btn, BtnRow, Select } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { useFlk, type FlockGroupType } from '../store';
import { useMultiGroupKpi } from '../hooks/useGroupKpi';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import SmartSelect from '../../../shr/components/SmartSelect';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const TYPE_ICON: Record<FlockGroupType, string> = {
  season: '🗓', breed: '🧬', cohort: '👥', farm: '🏭', owner: '👤', custom: '📁', smart: '🤖',
};

function fmtMoney(n: number): string {
  if (Math.abs(n) >= 1_000_000) return getGlobalFormat().num(n / 1_000_000) + 'M';
  if (Math.abs(n) >= 1_000) return getGlobalFormat().count(Math.round(n / 1_000)) + 'K';
  return getGlobalFormat().count(Math.round(n));
}

interface KpiRow {
  label: string;
  values: { display: string; raw: number; better?: 'low' | 'high' }[];
}

export default function GroupComparisonModal({ open, onClose }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const groups = useFlk(s => s.groups);
  const [ids, setIds] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const availableGroups = groups.filter(g => !g.archived);

  // KPIs for all groups (single hook call — hooks-safe)
  const allKpis = useMultiGroupKpi(ids);
  const kpis = ids.map(id => {
    const g = groups.find(x => x.id === id);
    const kpi = allKpis[id];
    return { group: g, kpi };
  }).filter(x => x.group && x.kpi);

  const rows: KpiRow[] = [
    {
      label: 'گله',
      values: kpis.map(({ kpi }) => ({ display: fmt.count(kpi.flockCount), raw: kpi.flockCount })),
    },
    {
      label: 'پرنده فعلی',
      values: kpis.map(({ kpi }) => ({ display: fmt.count(kpi.totalCurrent), raw: kpi.totalCurrent })),
    },
    {
      label: 'تلفات',
      values: kpis.map(({ kpi }) => ({
        display: fmt.count(kpi.totalDeaths) + ' (' + fmt.num(kpi.mortalityRate) + '٪)',
        raw: kpi.mortalityRate,
        better: 'low',
      })),
    },
    {
      label: 'هزینه',
      values: kpis.map(({ kpi }) => ({ display: fmtMoney(kpi.totalCost), raw: kpi.totalCost })),
    },
    {
      label: 'فروش',
      values: kpis.map(({ kpi }) => ({ display: fmtMoney(kpi.totalRevenue), raw: kpi.totalRevenue, better: 'high' })),
    },
    {
      label: 'سود',
      values: kpis.map(({ kpi }) => ({ display: fmtMoney(kpi.totalProfit), raw: kpi.totalProfit, better: 'high' })),
    },
  ];

  const addGroup = (id: string) => {
    if (!id || ids.includes(id) || ids.length >= 3) return;
    setIds([...ids, id]);
  };

  const removeGroup = (id: string) => {
    setIds(ids.filter(x => x !== id));
  };

  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title="🔍 مقایسه گروه‌ها">
      {/* انتخاب گروه‌ها */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        {ids.map(id => {
          const g = groups.find(x => x.id === id);
          if (!g) return null;
          return (
            <span
              key={id}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4,
                padding: '4px 10px',
                background: 'var(--accent-soft)',
                border: '1px solid var(--accent)',
                borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--accent)',
              }}
            >
              {TYPE_ICON[g.type]} {g.name}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => removeGroup(id)}
                style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: 'var(--danger)', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0, fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 1 }}
              >✕</button>
            </span>
          );
        })}
        {ids.length < 3 && (
          <SmartSelect
            value=""
            placeholder="+ افزودن گروه..."
            modalTitle="انتخاب گروه برای مقایسه"
            options={availableGroups
              .filter((g) => !ids.includes(g.id))
              .map((g) => ({ value: String(g.id), label: String(g.name) }))}
            onChange={(val: string) => {
              if (val) addGroup(val);
            }}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {ids.length < 2 ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 32, textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 12 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 40, marginBottom: 8 }}>🔍</div>
          <div>حداقل ۲ گروه انتخاب کن</div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
          <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', fontSize: 12 }}>
            <thead>
              <tr style={{ borderBottom: '2px solid var(--border)' }}>
                <th style={{ textAlign: 'right', padding: 6, color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 600 }}>KPI</th>
                {kpis.map(({ group }) => (
                  <th key={group!.id} style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 6, color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    {TYPE_ICON[group!.type]} {group!.name}
                  </th>
                ))}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {rows.map(row => {
                // پیدا کردن برنده برای این row
                let bestIdx = -1;
                if (row.values[0].better) {
                  const vals = row.values.map(v => v.raw);
                  const target = row.values[0].better === 'high' ? Math.max(...vals) : Math.min(...vals);
                  bestIdx = vals.indexOf(target);
                }
                return (
                  <tr key={row.label} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)' }}>
                    <td style={{ padding: 6, fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{row.label}</td>
                    {row.values.map((v, i) => (
                      <td key={i} style={{
                        padding: 6, textAlign: 'center',
                        fontWeight: i === bestIdx ? 700 : 500,
                        color: i === bestIdx ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)',
                        background: i === bestIdx ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'transparent',
                      }}>
                        {v.display} {i === bestIdx && '🏆'}
                      </td>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}

      <BtnRow>
        <Btn variant="primary" onClick={onClose}>بستن</Btn>
      </BtnRow>
    </Modal>
  );
}

/**

import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';



import type { FlockGroup } from '../store';
import { useGroupKpi } from '../hooks/useGroupKpi';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';

export interface GroupKpiRowProps {
  group: FlockGroup;
  onOpen: () => void;
}

export function GroupKpiRow({ group, onOpen }: GroupKpiRowProps) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const kpi = useGroupKpi(group.id);
  if (kpi.flockCount === 0) return null;

  const profitTone = kpi.totalProfit > 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : kpi.totalProfit < 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--muted)';
  const mortalityTone = kpi.mortalityRate > 5 ? 'var(--danger)' : kpi.mortalityRate > 3 ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--accent)';

  return (
    <div
      onClick={onOpen}
      style={{
        marginTop: 8,
        paddingTop: 8,
        borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)',
        display: 'flex',
        gap: 14,
        flexWrap: 'wrap',
        fontSize: 11,
        color: 'var(--muted)',
        alignItems: 'center',
        cursor: 'pointer',
      }}
      title="کلیک برای گزارش کامل"
    >
      <span>🐔 <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.count(kpi.totalCurrent)}</b></span>
      {(kpi.totalMale > 0 || kpi.totalFemale > 0) && (
        <span title="نر / ماده">♂ {fmt.count(kpi.totalMale)} / ♀ {fmt.count(kpi.totalFemale)}</span>
      )}
      {kpi.totalDeaths > 0 && (
        <span>💀 <b style={{ color: mortalityTone }}>{fmt.count(kpi.totalDeaths)}</b> ({fmt.num(kpi.mortalityRate)}٪)</span>
      )}
      {kpi.totalCost > 0 && <span>💰 <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.num(kpi.totalCost / 1_000_000)}M</b></span>}
      {kpi.totalRevenue > 0 && <span>📈 <b style={{ color: profitTone }}>{fmt.num(kpi.totalProfit / 1_000_000)}M</b></span>}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';

interface Props {

}

const TYPE_ICON: Record<FlockGroupType, string> = {
  season: '🗓', breed: '🧬', cohort: '👥', farm: '🏭', owner: '👤', custom: '📁', smart: '🤖',
};

const TYPE_LABEL: Record<FlockGroupType, string> = {
  season: 'فصلی', breed: 'نژادی', cohort: 'هم‌دوره', farm: 'مزرعه', owner: 'مالک', custom: 'سفارشی', smart: 'هوشمند',
};

const STATUS_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  active: 'فعال', archived: 'آرشیو', sold: 'فروخته‌شده', merged: 'ادغام‌شده',
};

function fmtMoney(n: number): string {
  if (Math.abs(n) >= 1_000_000) {
    return getGlobalFormat().num(n / 1_000_000) + 'M';
  }
  if (Math.abs(n) >= 1_000) {
    return getGlobalFormat().count(Math.round(n / 1_000)) + 'K';
  }
  return getGlobalFormat().count(Math.round(n));
}

function fmtPerBird(v: number): string {
  const sign = v < 0 ? '−' : '';
  return sign + fmtMoney(Math.abs(v));
}

export default function GroupReportModal({ open, onClose, groupId }: Props) {

      a.href = url;
      a.download = 'group-' + group.name.replace(/\s+/g, '_') + '.csv';
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      toastMsg.success('CSV دانلود شد');

  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/flk/components/GroupTimeline.tsx

/**
 * GroupTimeline.tsx — Gantt تاریخچه عضویت گله‌ها در گروه
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useFlk, jalaliToDate } from '../store';
import { todayJ } from '../api/flocksCalc';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';

interface Props {
  groupId: string;
}

interface TimelineRow {
  flockId: string;
  flockName: string;
  joinedAt: string;
  leftAt?: string;
  startOffset: number;
  endOffset: number;
  isActive: boolean;
}

function daysDiff(from: string, to: string): number {
  const d1 = jalaliToDate(from);
  const d2 = jalaliToDate(to);
  if (!d1 || !d2) return 0;
  return Math.round((d2.getTime() - d1.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
}

export default function GroupTimeline({ groupId }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const groups = useFlk(s => s.groups);
  const groupMembers = useFlk(s => s.groupMembers);
  const flocks = useFlk(s => s.flocks);

  const today = todayJ();

  const rows = useMemo<TimelineRow[]>(() => {
    const group = groups.find(g => g.id === groupId);
    if (!group) return [];

    const members = groupMembers
      .filter(m => m.groupId === groupId)
      .map(m => {
        const flock = flocks.find(f => f.id === m.flockId);
        if (!flock) return null;
        const joined = m.joinedAt?.slice(0, 10) || '';
        const left = m.leftAt?.slice(0, 10);
        const isActive = !left;
        const endDate = left || today;
        const startOffset = daysDiff(today, joined);
        const endOffset = daysDiff(today, endDate);
        return {
          flockId: m.flockId,
          flockName: flock.name,
          joinedAt: joined,
          leftAt: left,
          startOffset,
          endOffset,
          isActive,
        };
      })
      .filter(Boolean) as TimelineRow[];

    return members.sort((a, b) => a.startOffset - b.startOffset);
  }, [groupId, groups, groupMembers, flocks, today]);

  if (rows.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div style={{ padding: 24, textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 32, marginBottom: 8 }}>📅</div>
        <div>هیچ تاریخچه‌ای برای این گروه نیست</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const minOffset = Math.min(...rows.map(r => Math.min(r.startOffset, r.endOffset)));
  const maxOffset = Math.max(...rows.map(r => Math.max(r.startOffset, r.endOffset, 0)));
  const range = Math.max(1, maxOffset - minOffset);
  const todayPos = ((0 - minOffset) / range) * 100;

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--muted)', paddingBottom: 4 }}>
        <span>قدیمی‌ترین</span>
        <span>امروز</span>
        <span>جدیدترین</span>
      </div>

      <div style={{ position: 'relative', padding: '8px 0' }}>
        <div style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          top: 0, bottom: 0,
          right: `${todayPos}%`,
          width: 2,
          background: 'var(--danger)',
          opacity: 0.4,
          zIndex: 1,
        }} />

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
          {rows.map(r => {
            const start = ((r.startOffset - minOffset) / range) * 100;
            const end = ((r.endOffset - minOffset) / range) * 100;
            const width = Math.max(2, end - start);
            const isActive = r.isActive;

            return (
              <div
                key={r.flockId}
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 8,
                  position: 'relative',
                  height: 28,
                }}
              >
                <span style={{
                  width: 90,
                  fontSize: 11,
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  color: 'var(--text)',
                  overflow: 'hidden',
                  textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                  whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                  flexShrink: 0,
                }}>
                  {r.flockName}
                </span>
                <div style={{ position: 'relative', flex: 1, height: 20 }}>
                  <div style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: 0, bottom: 0,
                    right: `${start}%`,
                    width: `${width}%`,
                    background: isActive ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
                    opacity: isActive ? 0.8 : 0.5,
                    borderRadius: 4,
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    fontSize: 9,
                    color: 'white',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    overflow: 'hidden',
                    whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                  }}>
                    {fmt.count(Math.abs(r.endOffset - r.startOffset))} روز
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ width: 110, fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--muted)', flexShrink: 0, textAlign: 'left' }}>
                  {fmt.date(r.joinedAt)} {r.leftAt ? '→ ' + fmt.date(r.leftAt) : '→ امروز'}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ marginTop: 8, paddingTop: 8, borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)', fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
        🟢 فعال (هنوز در گروه) · ⚪ خارج شده · خط قرمز = امروز
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


==========================================
FILE: ./src/mod/flk/components/GroupsPage.tsx

/**
 * GroupsPage.tsx — مدیریت گروه‌های گله
 */
import { useFormat, getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { Modal, Btn, BtnRow, Field, Input, Select, Textarea, Grid2, ErrorBox } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { IconX, IconSearch } from '../../../shr/icons';
import { useFlk, type FlockGroup, type FlockGroupType, type FlockGroupRule } from '../store';
import { useBrd } from '../../brd/store';
import { useHal } from '../../hal/store';
import { useGroupKpi } from '../hooks/useGroupKpi';
import { SmartRuleEditor } from './SmartRuleEditor';
import { GroupKpiRow } from './GroupKpiRow';
import GroupReportModal from './GroupReportModal';
import GroupComparisonModal from './GroupComparisonModal';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../../cor/store/dialog';
import { toastMsg } from '../../../cor/store/toast';
import { logAction } from '../../../cor/logger/auditLog';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { TYPE_LABEL, TYPE_DESC, TYPE_OPTIONS, TYPE_ICON_MAP, NAME_PLACEHOLDER } from '../api/groupsConstants';
import HelpBanner from '../../../shr/components/HelpBanner';
import SmartSelect from '../../../shr/components/SmartSelect';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

interface FormState {
  name: string;
  type: FlockGroupType;
  description: string;
  color: string;
  parentGroupId: string;
  rule: FlockGroupRule;
}

const EMPTY_FORM: FormState = {
  name: '', type: 'custom', description: '', color: '', parentGroupId: '', rule: {},
};

interface Node extends FlockGroup {
  children: Node[];
  memberCount: number;
}

export default function GroupsPage({ open, onClose }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const groups = useFlk(s => s.groups);
  const groupMembers = useFlk(s => s.groupMembers);
  const addGroup = useFlk(s => s.addGroup);
  const updateGroup = useFlk(s => s.updateGroup);
  const deleteGroup = useFlk(s => s.deleteGroup);
  const archiveGroup = useFlk(s => s.archiveGroup);
  const { breeds } = useBrd();
  const { halls } = useHal();

  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [form, setForm] = useState<FormState>(EMPTY_FORM);
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [showSearch, setShowSearch] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [reportGroupId, setReportGroupId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [comparisonOpen, setComparisonOpen] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleExport = () => {
    try {
      const exportData = {
        version: 1,
        exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        groups,
        groupMembers: useFlk.getState().groupMembers,
      };
      const json = JSON.stringify(exportData, null, 2);
      const blob = new Blob([json], { type: 'application/json;charset=utf-8' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = 'flk-groups-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + '.json';
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      toastMsg.success('گروه‌ها export شد (' + groups.length + ' گروه)');
    } catch (e) {
      toastMsg.error('Export ناموفق');
    }
  };

  const handleImport = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    try {
      const text = await file.text();
      const data = JSON.parse(text);
      if (!data.groups || !Array.isArray(data.groups)) {
        toastMsg.error('فایل نامعتبر — groups[] نداره');
        return;
      }
      const msg = data.groups.length + ' گروه در فایل موجود است. جایگزین گروه‌های فعلی کنیم؟ (لغو = ادغام)';
      const replace = await showConfirmAsync('ایمپورت گروه‌ها', msg);
      
      const flkStore = useFlk.getState();
      const existingNames = new Set(flkStore.groups.map(g => g.name));
      const imported: typeof data.groups = [];
      const skipped: string[] = [];
      
      for (const g of data.groups) {
        if (!replace && existingNames.has(g.name)) {
          skipped.push(g.name);
          continue;
        }
        imported.push(g);
      }
      
      if (replace) {
        flkStore.groups.forEach(g => flkStore.deleteGroup(g.id));
      }
      
      for (const g of imported) {
        flkStore.addGroup({
          name: g.name,
          type: g.type,
          description: g.description || '',
          color: g.color || '',
          parentGroupId: g.parentGroupId,
          rule: g.rule,
          archived: g.archived || false,
          sortOrder: g.sortOrder || 0,
        });
      }
      
      if (data.groupMembers && Array.isArray(data.groupMembers)) {
        for (const m of data.groupMembers) {
          flkStore.addToGroup(m.groupId, m.flockId, {
            role: m.role,
            weight: m.weight,
            notes: m.notes,
          });
        }
      }
      
      logAction('import', 'flk', 'ایمپورت گروه‌ها: ' + imported.length + ' مورد');
      toastMsg.success(imported.length + ' گروه ایمپورت شد' + (skipped.length > 0 ? ' (' + skipped.length + ' رد شد)' : ''));
      
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      toastMsg.error('ایمپورت ناموفق — فایل JSON معتبر نیست');
    }
  };

  const tree = useMemo(() => {
    const build = (parentId: string | undefined): Node[] => {
      return groups
        .filter(g => (g.parentGroupId || undefined) === parentId && !g.archived)
        .sort((a, b) => (a.sortOrder || 0) - (b.sortOrder || 0))
        .map(g => ({
          ...g,
          children: build(g.id),
          memberCount: groupMembers.filter(m => m.groupId === g.id && !m.leftAt).length,
        }));

    };
    return build(undefined);
  }, [groups, groupMembers]);

  const visibleTree = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return tree;
    const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    const filterTree = (nodes: Node[]): Node[] =>
      nodes
        .map(n => ({ ...n, children: filterTree(n.children) }))
        .filter(n => n.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || n.children.length > 0);
    return filterTree(tree);
  }, [tree, searchQuery]);

  const handleNew = () => {
    setEditingId(null);
    setForm(EMPTY_FORM);
    setShowForm(true);
    setErr('');
  };

  const handleEdit = (g: FlockGroup) => {
    setEditingId(g.id);
    setForm({
      name: g.name,
      type: g.type,
      description: g.description || '',
      color: g.color || '',
      parentGroupId: g.parentGroupId || '',
      rule: g.rule || {},
    });
    setShowForm(true);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.name.trim()) {
      setErr('نام گروه را وارد کنید');
      return;
    }
    const data = {
      name: form.name.trim(),
      type: form.type,
      description: form.description.trim(),
      color: form.color,
      parentGroupId: form.parentGroupId || undefined,
      rule: form.type === 'smart' ? form.rule : undefined,
      archived: false,
      sortOrder: 0,
    };
    if (editingId) {
      updateGroup(editingId, data);
      toastMsg.saved(form.name);
      logAction('update', 'flk', 'ویرایش گروه: ' + data.name);
    } else {
      addGroup(data);
      toastMsg.added(form.name, 'گروه');
      logAction('add', 'flk', 'افزودن گروه: ' + data.name + ' (' + data.type + ')');
    }
    setShowForm(false);
    setForm(EMPTY_FORM);
    setEditingId(null);
    setErr('');
  };

  const handleArchive = async (g: FlockGroup) => {
    const childCount = groups.filter(c => c.parentGroupId === g.id).length;
    const msg = childCount > 0
      ? 'گروه «' + g.name + '» ' + getGlobalFormat().count(childCount) + ' زیرگروه دارد. آرشیو شود؟'
      : 'گروه «' + g.name + '» آرشیو شود؟';
    const okA = await showConfirmAsync('آرشیو گروه', msg, {});
    if (!okA) return;
    archiveGroup(g.id);
    toastMsg.saved(g.name);
    logAction('update', 'flk', 'آرشیو گروه: ' + g.name);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (g: FlockGroup) => {
    const childCount = groups.filter(c => c.parentGroupId === g.id).length;
    const msg = childCount > 0
      ? 'گروه «' + g.name + '» ' + getGlobalFormat().count(childCount) + ' زیرگروه دارد. با حذف، زیرگروه‌ها یتیم می‌شن. ادامه؟'
      : 'گروه «' + g.name + '» حذف شود؟';
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync('حذف گروه', msg, { danger: true });
    if (!ok) return;
    deleteGroup(g.id);
    toastMsg.deleted(g.name);
    logAction('delete', 'flk', 'حذف گروه: ' + g.name);
  };

  const renderNode = (node: Node, depth: number = 0) => (
    <div key={node.id} style={{ marginRight: depth * 20, marginBottom: 8 }}>
      <div style={{
        background: 'var(--card)',
        border: '1px solid var(--border)',
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)',
        padding: '12px 14px',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: 10,
      }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
          <div style={{
            width: 36, height: 36, borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
            background: node.type === 'smart' ? 'var(--info-soft)' :
                        node.type === 'season' ? 'var(--warn-soft)' : 'var(--purple-soft)',
            color: node.type === 'smart' ? 'var(--info)' :
                   node.type === 'season' ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--purple)',
            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontSize: 18,
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}>{TYPE_ICON_MAP[node.type] || '📁'}</div>
          <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700 }}>{node.name}</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 2, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              <span style={{ padding: '1px 6px', borderRadius: 4, background: 'var(--input-bg)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700 }}>{TYPE_LABEL[node.type]}</span>
              <span>·</span>
              <span>{fmt.count(node.memberCount)} گله عضو</span>
              {node.description && (
                <>
                  <span>·</span>
                  <span style={{ overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', maxWidth: 140 }}>{node.description}</span>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, paddingTop: 8, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)' }}>
          <Btn size="sm" onClick={() => handleEdit(node)} style={{ flex: 1 }}>ویرایش</Btn>
          <Btn size="sm" onClick={() => handleArchive(node)} style={{ flex: 1 }}>آرشیو</Btn>
          <Btn size="sm" onClick={() => handleDelete(node)} style={{ flex: 1, color: 'var(--danger)' }}>حذف</Btn>
        </div>
        <GroupKpiRow group={node} onOpen={() => setReportGroupId(node.id)} />
      </div>
      {node.children.map(child => renderNode(child, depth + 1))}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="📁 مدیریت گروه‌های گله"
      headerAction={
        showForm ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setShowForm(false); setEditingId(null); }}
            aria-label="بازگشت به لیست گروه‌ها"
            title="بازگشت"
            style={{
              width: 36, height: 36, borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer',
              color: 'var(--muted)',
              display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
            }}
          >
            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.4" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <line x1="19" y1="12" x2="5" y2="12" />
              <polyline points="12 19 5 12 12 5" />
            </svg>
          </button>
        ) : (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setShowSearch(v => !v); if (showSearch) setSearchQuery(''); }}
            aria-label="جستجو"
            style={{
              width: 36, height: 36, borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
              background: showSearch ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'transparent',
              border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer',
              color: showSearch ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
              display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
            }}
          >
            <IconSearch size={18} />
          </button>
        )
      }
    >
      {!showForm ? (
        <>
          <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
            {showSearch && (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', padding: '0 12px', height: 40, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                <IconSearch size={16} style={{ color: 'var(--dim)', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="جستجوی گروه..."
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  style={{ flex: 1, border: 'none', background: 'transparent', outline: 'none', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', height: '100%' }}
                  autoFocus
                />
                {searchQuery && (
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0, color: 'var(--muted)', display: 'flex' }} aria-label="پاک کردن">
                    <IconX size={14} />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <input
            ref={fileInputRef}
            type="file"
            accept="application/json,.json"
            onChange={handleImport}
            style={{ display: 'none' }}
          />

          {tree.length === 0 ? (
            <div style={{ padding: 32, textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 13 }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 40, marginBottom: 8 }}>📁</div>
              <div>هنوز گروهی نساخته‌ای</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, marginTop: 4, opacity: 0.7 }}>
                گروه‌ها برای گزارش‌گیری و فیلتر استفاده می‌شن
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
              {visibleTree.map(node => renderNode(node))}
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: 6, color: 'var(--muted)', textAlign: 'center' }}>
            {editingId ? 'ویرایش گروه' : 'گروه جدید'}
          </div>

          <Field label="نام گروه" required>
            <Input
              value={form.name}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })}
              placeholder={NAME_PLACEHOLDER[form.type]}
            />
          </Field>

          <Grid2>
<Field label="نوع گروه" hint={TYPE_DESC[form.type]}>
            <Select value={form.type} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, type: e.target.value as FlockGroupType })}>
              {(Object.keys(TYPE_LABEL) as FlockGroupType[]).map(t => (
                <option key={t} value={t}>{TYPE_LABEL[t]}</option>
              ))}
            </Select>
          </Field>

<Field label="گروه والد (اختیاری)" hint="برای ساختار تودرتو">
            <SmartSelect
              value={form.parentGroupId}
              placeholder="— بدون والد —"
              modalTitle="انتخاب گروه والد"
              options={groups
                .filter((g) => g.id !== editingId && !g.archived)
                .map((g) => ({ value: String(g.id), label: String(g.name) }))}
              onChange={(val: string) => setForm({ ...form, parentGroupId: val })}
            />
          </Field>
          </Grid2>

          {form.type === 'smart' && (
            <SmartRuleEditor
              rule={form.rule}
              onChange={(rule) => setForm({ ...form, rule })}
              breeds={breeds.map(b => ({ id: b.id, name: b.name, birdId: b.birdId }))}
              halls={halls.map(h => ({ id: h.id, name: h.name }))}
            />
          )}


          <Field label="توضیحات (اختیاری)" hint="چی این گروه رو از بقیه جدا می‌کنه؟">
            <Textarea value={form.description} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })} placeholder="مثلاً: گروه گله‌های ممتاز نژاد مرندی" rows={2} />
          </Field>

          {err && <ErrorBox>{err}</ErrorBox>}
          <BtnRow>
            <Btn variant="primary" onClick={handleSave}>{editingId ? 'ذخیره' : 'ایجاد'}</Btn>
            <Btn onClick={() => { setShowForm(false); setForm(EMPTY_FORM); setEditingId(null); }}>لغو</Btn>
          </BtnRow>
        </>
      )}
    
      <GroupReportModal
        open={reportGroupId !== null}
        onClose={() => setReportGroupId(null)}
        groupId={reportGroupId}
      />
    
      <GroupComparisonModal
        open={comparisonOpen}
        onClose={() => setComparisonOpen(false)}
      />
          {!showForm && (
        <div style={{ position: 'sticky', bottom: 0, padding: '12px 4px', borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--card-solid)', display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'stretch', marginTop: 12 }}>
        <Btn variant="primary" onClick={handleNew} style={{ flex: 1, height: 40 }}>+ گروه جدید</Btn>
        <div style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()} title="Import JSON" aria-label="Import" style={{ flex: 1, height: 40, borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--btn-bg)', color: 'var(--muted)', cursor: 'pointer', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontSize: 15 }}>📥</button>
          <button type="button" onClick={handleExport} disabled={groups.length === 0} title="Export JSON" aria-label="Export" style={{ flex: 1, height: 40, borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--btn-bg)', color: 'var(--muted)', cursor: groups.length === 0 ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer', opacity: groups.length === 0 ? 0.4 : 1, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontSize: 15 }}>📤</button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setComparisonOpen(true)} disabled={groups.length < 2} title="مقایسه" aria-label="مقایسه" style={{ flex: 1, height: 40, borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--btn-bg)', color: 'var(--muted)', cursor: groups.length < 2 ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer', opacity: groups.length < 2 ? 0.4 : 1, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontSize: 15 }}>📊</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

interface Props {
  onManualAdd: () => void;
}

export default function GuidedEmptyState({ onManualAdd }: Props) {
  const nav = useNavigate();

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', padding: 'var(--sp-3)', textAlign: 'center', width: '100%' }}>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 36, marginBottom: 'var(--sp-1)', lineHeight: 1 }} aria-hidden="true">🐔</div>
      <h2 style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-lg)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)', marginBottom: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
        هنوز گله‌ای ندارید
      </h2>
      <p style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        اولین گله خود را از یکی از این سه راه بسازید.
      </p>

      <div style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: '480px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        {/* کادر خرید */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => nav('/tra')}
          aria-label="ایجاد از معاملات (خرید)"
          style={{
            background: 'var(--card)',
            border: '1px solid var(--border)',
            borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)',
            padding: 'var(--sp-2) var(--sp-3)',
            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--sp-3)',
            cursor: 'pointer', textAlign: 'right', width: '100%', fontFamily: 'inherit'
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ width: 36, height: 36, borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', background: 'var(--bg)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontSize: 16, flexShrink: 0 }} aria-hidden="true">🛒</div>
          <div style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text)' }}>از معاملات (خرید)</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>تعداد، قیمت و تاریخ خودکار پر می‌شود</div>
          </div>

          </div>
          <div style={{ color: 'var(--border)', fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 300, marginLeft: 'var(--sp-1)' }} aria-hidden="true">‹</div>

        {/* کادر دستی */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onManualAdd}
          aria-label="ایجاد دستی"
          style={{
            background: 'var(--card)',

            borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)',
            padding: 'var(--sp-2) var(--sp-3)',
            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--sp-3)',

          }}

          <div style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>

FILE: ./src/mod/flk/components/LifecycleBar.tsx

/**
 * LifecycleBar — نوار چرخه زندگی گله
 * Progress Fill: پس‌زمینه سفید + فیلد رنگی تا موقعیت فعلی
 * رنگ فیلد = رنگ مرحله فعلی • خط تیره = موقعیت
 */
import type { FlockType } from '../store';

interface Props {
  type: FlockType;
  ageDays: number;
  endOfCycleDay: number | null;
  layingStartDay?: number | null;
}

export default function LifecycleBar({ type, ageDays, endOfCycleDay, layingStartDay }: Props) {
  const cycle = endOfCycleDay && endOfCycleDay > 0
    ? endOfCycleDay
    : (type === 'broiler' ? 42 : 700);

  const start = layingStartDay && layingStartDay > 0 ? layingStartDay : 140;
  const stages = type === 'broiler'
    ? [
        { color: 'var(--info)',   endDay: 7 },
        { color: 'var(--warn)',   endDay: 21 },
        { color: 'var(--accent)', endDay: 42 },
      ]
    : [
        { color: 'var(--accent)', endDay: 28 },          // جوجه: سبز
        { color: 'var(--info)',   endDay: start - 14 },  // نیمچه: آبی
        { color: 'var(--warn)',   endDay: start },       // پیش‌تخم‌گذار: نارنجی
        { color: 'var(--accent)', endDay: cycle },       // تخم‌گذار: سبز
      ];

  // مرحله فعلی
  let currentIdx = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < stages.length; i++) {
    if (ageDays <= stages[i].endDay) {
      currentIdx = i;
      break;
    }
    currentIdx = i;
  }

  const currentColor = stages[currentIdx].color;

  // موقعیت دقیق بر اساس سن (نه مرکز مرحله)
  const pos = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (ageDays / cycle) * 100));

  return (
    <div
      role="progressbar"
      aria-valuenow={Math.round(pos)}
      aria-valuemin={0}
      aria-valuemax={100}
      aria-label={`سن گله: روز ${ageDays} از ${cycle}`}
      style={{
        position: 'relative',
        height: 16,
        background: 'var(--bg)',
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        border: '1px solid var(--border)',
      }}
    >
      {/* فیلد رنگی — از راست تا موقعیت فعلی (RTL) */}
      <div
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          top: 0,
          bottom: 0,
          right: 0,
          width: `${pos}%`,
          background: currentColor,
          transition: 'width 200ms ease-out',
        }}
      />

      {/* خط نشانگر موقعیت — نازک و تیره */}
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          top: 0,
          bottom: 0,
          right: `${pos}%`,
          width: 2,
          background: 'var(--text)',
          transform: 'translateX(50%)',
          pointerEvents: 'none',
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/flk/components/MergeFlocksModal.tsx

/**
 * MergeFlocksModal.tsx — ادغام گروهی با انتخاب درون‌گروه
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Modal, Btn, BtnRow } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { toastMsg } from '../../../cor/store/toast';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../../cor/store/dialog';
import { useFlk, getAgeDays, type Flock } from '../store';
import { useBrd } from '../../brd/store';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';

const _KIND_LBL: Record<string, string> = { chicken: 'مرغ', duck: 'اردک', turkey: 'بوقلمون', quail: 'بلدرچین', goose: 'غاز' };
const _TYPE_LBL: Record<string, string> = { layer: 'تخم‌گذار', broiler: 'گوشتی', breeder: 'مادر' };

const GROUP_COLORS = [
  { soft: 'var(--accent-soft)', border: 'var(--accent-border)', text: 'var(--accent)' },
  { soft: 'var(--info-soft, rgba(2,132,199,.08))', border: 'var(--info, #0284c7)', text: 'var(--info, #0284c7)' },
  { soft: 'var(--purple-soft, rgba(147,51,234,.08))', border: 'var(--purple, #9333ea)', text: 'var(--purple, #9333ea)' },
  { soft: 'var(--warn-soft)', border: 'var(--warn)', text: 'var(--warn)' },
];

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  flockIds: string[];
  onMergeGroup: (targetId: string, sourceIds: string[]) => void;
}

interface Group {
  key: string;
  flocks: Flock[];
  label: string;
  color: typeof GROUP_COLORS[0];
}

export default function MergeFlocksModal({ open, onClose, flockIds, onMergeGroup }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const allFlocks = useFlk(s => s.flocks);
  const breeds = useBrd((s: any) => s.breeds);
  const [showAll, setShowAll] = useState(false);
  const [targets, setTargets] = useState<Map<string, string>>(new Map());
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Map<string, Set<string>>>(new Map());
  const [groupEnabled, setGroupEnabled] = useState<Map<string, boolean>>(new Map());

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setShowAll(false);
      setTargets(new Map());
      setSelected(new Map());
      setGroupEnabled(new Map());
    }
  }, [open]);

  const breedKindMap = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, string>();
    (breeds || []).forEach((b: any) => {
      if (b.id && b.birdKind) m.set(b.id, b.birdKind);
    });
    return m;
  }, [breeds]);

  const getKindOf = (f: Flock): string => breedKindMap.get((f as any).breedId || '') || '';

  const activeFlocks = useMemo(() => allFlocks.filter(f => f.status === 'active'), [allFlocks]);

  const candidates = useMemo(() => {
    if (showAll) return activeFlocks;
    return flockIds.map(id => allFlocks.find(f => f.id === id)).filter(Boolean) as Flock[];
  }, [showAll, activeFlocks, allFlocks, flockIds]);

  const groups: Group[] = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, Flock[]>();
    for (const f of candidates) {
      const kind = getKindOf(f) || 'unknown';
      const key = `${kind}|${f.type}`;
      if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, []);
      map.get(key)!.push(f);
    }
    return Array.from(map.entries()).map(([key, flocks], idx) => {
      const f0 = flocks[0];
      const kindLbl = _KIND_LBL[getKindOf(f0)] || 'نامشخص';
      const typeLbl = _TYPE_LBL[f0.type] || f0.type;
      return {
        key, flocks,
        label: `${kindLbl} — ${typeLbl}`,
        color: GROUP_COLORS[idx % GROUP_COLORS.length],
      };
    });
  }, [candidates, breedKindMap]);

  const multiGroups = groups.filter(g => g.flocks.length >= 2);

  const isGroupEnabled = (key: string): boolean => groupEnabled.get(key) ?? true;

  const getSelectedSet = (g: Group): Set<string> => {
    const stored = selected.get(g.key);
    if (stored) return stored;
    return new Set(g.flocks.map(f => f.id));
  };

  const getTargetId = (g: Group): string => {
    const sel = getSelectedSet(g);
    const stored = targets.get(g.key);
    if (stored && sel.has(stored)) return stored;
    return Array.from(sel)[0] || g.flocks[0].id;
  };

  const setGroupTarget = (key: string, flockId: string) => {
    setTargets(prev => { const n = new Map(prev); n.set(key, flockId); return n; });
  };

  const toggleGroup = (key: string) => {
    setGroupEnabled(prev => { const n = new Map(prev); n.set(key, !(prev.get(key) ?? true)); return n; });
  };

  const toggleFlock = (g: Group, flockId: string) => {
    const current = new Set(getSelectedSet(g));
    if (current.has(flockId)) current.delete(flockId);
    else current.add(flockId);
    setSelected(prev => { const n = new Map(prev); n.set(g.key, current); return n; });
    if (current.size > 0 && !current.has(getTargetId(g))) {
      setGroupTarget(g.key, Array.from(current)[0]);
    }
  };

  const enabledGroups = multiGroups
    .filter(g => isGroupEnabled(g.key))
    .map(g => {
      const sel = getSelectedSet(g);
      return { g, sel, targetId: getTargetId(g) };
    })
    .filter(x => x.sel.size >= 2 && x.sel.has(x.targetId));

  const handleMerge = async () => {
    if (enabledGroups.length === 0) return;
    const toMerge = enabledGroups.map(({ g, sel, targetId }) => {
      const target = g.flocks.find(f => f.id === targetId)!;
      const sourceIds = Array.from(sel).filter(id => id !== targetId);
      return { targetId, sourceIds, target, groupSize: sel.size };
    });
    const totalFlocks = toMerge.reduce((s, x) => s + x.groupSize, 0);
    const msg = enabledGroups.length === 1
      ? `${fmt.count(toMerge[0].groupSize)} گله در «${toMerge[0].target.name}» ادغام می‌شود.`
      : `${fmt.count(enabledGroups.length)} گروه (${fmt.count(totalFlocks)} گله) ادغام می‌شود.`;
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync('تأیید ادغام', msg + ' از طریق 🔓 بازگردانی قابل بازگشت است.', { confirmText: 'ادغام' });
    if (!ok) return;
    try {
      for (const m of toMerge) onMergeGroup(m.targetId, m.sourceIds);
      toastMsg.success(`${fmt.count(totalFlocks)} گله ادغام شد`);
      onClose();
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); toastMsg.error('خطا در ادغام'); }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="🔗 ادغام گله‌ها"
      footer={
        enabledGroups.length > 0 ? (
          <BtnRow>
            <Btn variant="primary" onClick={handleMerge}>
              🔗 {enabledGroups.length === 1 ? `ادغام ${fmt.count(enabledGroups[0].sel.size)} گله` : `ادغام ${fmt.count(enabledGroups.length)} گروه`}
            </Btn>
            <Btn onClick={onClose}>لغو</Btn>
          </BtnRow>
        ) : (
          <BtnRow><Btn onClick={onClose}>بستن</Btn></BtnRow>
        )
      }
    >
      <div dir="rtl" style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--info-soft, rgba(2,132,199,.08))', border: '1px solid var(--info, #0284c7)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', marginBottom: 12, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
        <div>گله‌ها خودکار گروه‌بندی می‌شوند. با تیک هر گله، آن را به ادغام اضافه یا حذف کنید.</div>
        {!showAll ? (
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowAll(true)} style={{ alignSelf: 'flex-start', padding: '4px 10px', background: 'var(--accent-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', color: 'var(--accent)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit' }}>
            + نمایش همه گله‌های فعال ({fmt.count(activeFlocks.length)})
          </button>
        ) : (
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowAll(false)} style={{ alignSelf: 'flex-start', padding: '4px 10px', background: 'var(--btn-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit' }}>
            − فقط انتخاب‌شده‌ها ({fmt.count(flockIds.length)})
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {multiGroups.map(g => {
        const enabled = isGroupEnabled(g.key);
        const sel = getSelectedSet(g);
        const targetId = getTargetId(g);
        const total = g.flocks.filter(f => sel.has(f.id)).reduce((s, f) => s + (f.currentCount || 0), 0);
        const targetFlock = g.flocks.find(f => f.id === targetId);
        const isValid = sel.size >= 2;
        return (
          <div key={g.key} dir="rtl" style={{
            marginBottom: 12, padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
            background: 'var(--card)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)',
            border: '1px solid var(--border)',
            borderRight: `3px solid ${g.color.border}`,
            boxShadow: '0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)',
            opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5,
            transition: 'opacity 150ms',
          }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--sp-2)', marginBottom: 8, paddingBottom: 6, borderBottom: `1px dashed ${g.color.border}` }}>
              <input type="checkbox" checked={enabled} onChange={() => toggleGroup(g.key)} style={{ accentColor: g.color.text, cursor: 'pointer', flexShrink: 0 }} />
              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: g.color.text }}>
                {g.label}
              </div>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: g.color.text, fontWeight: 600 }}>
                {fmt.count(sel.size)} از {fmt.count(g.flocks.length)}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
              {g.flocks.map(f => {
                const isIncluded = sel.has(f.id);
                const isTarget = f.id === targetId && isIncluded;
                const age = getAgeDays(f);
                return (
                  <div key={f.id} style={{
                    display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--sp-2)',
                    padding: 'var(--pad-tight)',
                    background: isTarget ? g.color.soft : 'var(--input-bg)',
                    border: `1px solid ${isTarget ? g.color.border : 'var(--border)'}`,
                    borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                    opacity: isIncluded ? 1 : 0.4,
                  }}>
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={isIncluded}
                      onChange={() => toggleFlock(g, f.id)}
                      disabled={!enabled}
                      style={{ accentColor: g.color.text, cursor: enabled ? 'pointer' : 'not-allowed', flexShrink: 0 }}
                    />
                    <div
                      onClick={() => { if (enabled && isIncluded) setGroupTarget(g.key, f.id); }}
                      style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, cursor: (enabled && isIncluded) ? 'pointer' : 'default' }}
                    >
                      <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                        {f.name}
                        {isTarget && (
                          <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: g.color.text, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                            ● هدف
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                        {fmt.count(f.currentCount || 0)} پرنده · {fmt.count(age)} روز
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            {enabled && isValid && (
              <div style={{
                marginTop: 6,
                padding: 'var(--pad-tight)',
                background: g.color.soft,
                borderRight: `3px solid ${g.color.border}`,
                borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
                color: 'var(--text)',
                fontWeight: 600,
              }}>
                ℹ️ نتیجه: {fmt.count(total)} پرنده در «{targetFlock?.name}»
              </div>
            )}
            {enabled && !isValid && (
              <div style={{ marginTop: 6, padding: 'var(--pad-tight)', background: 'var(--danger-soft)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--danger)', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                ⚠️ حداقل ۲ گله برای ادغام لازم است
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}

      {multiGroups.length === 0 && (
        <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--warn-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--warn)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--warn)', textAlign: 'center', marginTop: 12 }}>
          {showAll
            ? '⚠️ هیچ گروهی با ۲ گله یا بیشتر وجود ندارد — ادغام ممکن نیست.'
            : 'ℹ️ برای ادغام، حداقل ۲ گله از یک پرنده و نوع انتخاب کنید.'}
        </div>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}

/**
 * PickHatchModal.tsx — انتخاب هچ از inc
 * auto-fill: تعداد اولیه، تاریخ هچ، پرنده، نژاد
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';


import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Modal, Btn, BtnRow } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { useInc } from '../../inc/store';
import type { HatchResult, EggEntry } from '../../inc/store';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSelect: (hatch: HatchResult, eggEntry: EggEntry | null) => void;
}

export default function PickHatchModal({ open, onClose, onSelect }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const hatches = useInc(s => s.hatches);
  const eggEntries = useInc(s => s.eggEntries);
  const devices = useInc(s => s.devices);

  // هچ‌های تبدیل‌نشده به گله
  const availableHatches = useMemo(() => {
    return (hatches || [])
      .filter((h: HatchResult) => !h.generatedFlockId && (h.hatched || 0) > 0)
      .slice()
      .sort((a: HatchResult, b: HatchResult) => (b.date || '').localeCompare(a.date || ''));
  }, [hatches]);

  const handlePick = (h: HatchResult) => {
    const entry = (eggEntries || []).find((e: EggEntry) => e.id === h.eggEntryId);
    onSelect(h, entry || null);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title="🐣 انتخاب هچ (جوجه‌کشی)">
      {availableHatches.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 'var(--sp-8)', textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 13 }}>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>

            const entry = (eggEntries || []).find((e: EggEntry) => e.id === h.eggEntryId);

                key={h.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handlePick(h)}
                style={{
                  padding: 'var(--sp-3)',
                  background: 'var(--card)',
                  border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                  borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                  display: 'flex',
                  flexDirection: 'column',
                  alignItems: 'flex-start',
                  gap: 3,
                  textAlign: 'right',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontFamily: 'inherit',
                  color: 'var(--text)',
                  width: '100%',
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', width: '100%', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--accent)' }}>
                    {fmt.count(h.hatched || 0)} جوجه
                  </span>
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                    {fmt.date(h.date)}
                  </span>
                </div>

                  {device && <span>· {device.name}</span>}
                  {entry && entry.count && <span>· از {fmt.count(entry.count)} تخم</span>}
                </div>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      <BtnRow>
        <Btn variant="primary" onClick={onClose}>بستن</Btn>
      </BtnRow>

  );
