import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { Tag } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
/**
 * PickInvoiceModal.tsx — انتخاب فاکتور خرید پرنده از tra
 * نمایش کامل: طرف حساب، نوع پرنده، نژاد، تاریخ هچ، وضعیت اتصال
 */
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Modal, Btn, BtnRow } /* Tag */ from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { useTra } from '../../tra/store';
import { useBrd } from '../../brd/store';
import { useCtc } from '../../ctc/store';
import { useFlk } from '../../flk/store';
import type { Invoice, InvoiceItem } from '../../tra/types';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSelect: (invoice: Invoice) => void;
  currentBirdId?: string;
}

interface FlockLite {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  sourceInvoiceId?: string;
}

export default function PickInvoiceModal({ open, onClose, onSelect, currentBirdId }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const invoices = useTra(s => s.invoices);
  const { contacts } = useCtc();
  const { flocks } = useFlk();

  const birdInvoices = useMemo(() => {
    return (invoices || [])
      .filter((inv: Invoice) => {
        if (inv.type !== 'purchase') return false;
        const hasBird = inv.items?.some((it: InvoiceItem) => {
          if (!it.birdId) return false;
          if (currentBirdId && it.birdId !== currentBirdId) return false;
          return true;
        });
        return hasBird;
      })
      .slice()
      .sort((a: Invoice, b: Invoice) => (b.date || '').localeCompare(a.date || ''));
  }, [invoices, currentBirdId]);

  const flocksByInvoice = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, FlockLite>();
    for (const f of (flocks || []) as FlockLite[]) {
      if (f.sourceInvoiceId) map.set(f.sourceInvoiceId, f);
    }
    return map;
  }, [flocks]);

  const handlePick = (inv: Invoice) => {
    onSelect(inv);
    onClose();
  };

  const getBirdName = (id?: string): string | undefined => {
    if (!id) return undefined;
    return (useBrd.getState().birds || []).find((b: { id: string; name: string }) => b.id === id)?.name;
  };
  const getBreedName = (id?: string): string | undefined => {
    if (!id) return undefined;
    return (useBrd.getState().breeds || []).find((b: { id: string; name: string }) => b.id === id)?.name;
  };
  const getPartyName = (id?: string): string | undefined => {
    if (!id) return undefined;
    const list = (contacts || []) as { id: string; name: string }[];
    return list.find(c => c.id === id)?.name;
  };

  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title="📄 انتخاب فاکتور خرید پرنده">
      {birdInvoices.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 'var(--sp-8)', textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)' }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 48, marginBottom: 8 }}>📄</div>
          <div>هیچ فاکتور خرید پرنده‌ای پیدا نشد</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', marginTop: 4, opacity: 0.7 }}>ابتدا از بخش معاملات، فاکتور خرید پرنده ثبت کنید</div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
          {birdInvoices.map((inv) => {
            const birdItems = (inv.items || []).filter((it: InvoiceItem) => it.birdId);
            const totalQty = birdItems.reduce((s: number, it: InvoiceItem) => s + (it.quantity || 0), 0);
            const firstBird: InvoiceItem = birdItems[0] || ({} as InvoiceItem);
            const linkedFlock = flocksByInvoice.get(inv.id);
            const isLinked = !!linkedFlock;
            const birdName = getBirdName(firstBird.birdId);
            const breedName = getBreedName(firstBird.breedId);
            const partyName = getPartyName(inv.partyId);
            const isChick = (firstBird.category || inv.category) === 'chick';

            return (
              <button
                key={inv.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handlePick(inv)}
                style={{
                  padding: '10px 12px',
                  background: 'var(--card)',
                  border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                  borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                  display: 'flex',
                  flexDirection: 'column',
                  alignItems: 'stretch',
                  gap: 6,
                  textAlign: 'right',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontFamily: 'inherit',
                  color: 'var(--text)',
                  width: '100%',
                }}
              >
                {/* ردیف ۱: طرف حساب + وضعیت اتصال */}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                    {partyName || '—'}
                  </span>
                  {isLinked ? (
                    <Tag tone="accent">{linkedFlock.name}</Tag>
                  ) : (
                    <Tag tone="gray">بدون گله</Tag>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* ردیف ۲: نوع پرنده + نژاد + شماره فاکتور */}
                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                  <span style={{ color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                    {isChick ? '🐣' : '🐔'} {birdName || '—'}
                  </span>
                  {breedName && <span>· {breedName}</span>}
                  {inv.number && <span>· #{inv.number}</span>}
                </div>

                {/* ردیف ۳: تعداد + مبلغ + تاریخ هچ + تاریخ فاکتور */}
                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                  <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    {fmt.count(totalQty)} پرنده
                  </span>
                  {inv.total > 0 && <span>· {fmt.money(inv.total)}</span>}
                  {firstBird.hatchDate && <span>· هچ: {fmt.date(firstBird.hatchDate)}</span>}
                  <span style={{ marginInlineStart: 'auto' }}>{fmt.date(inv.date)}</span>
                </div>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      <BtnRow>
        <Btn variant="primary" onClick={onClose}>بستن</Btn>
      </BtnRow>
    </Modal>
  );
}

/**
 * SexingHistoryModal — تاریخچه تفکیک جنسیت گله
 * تاریخ سمت راست (بدون کادر) + یک wrapper برای کل گروه + جداکننده بین کارت‌ها
 */
import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';


import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Tag } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { HistoryModalShell } from '../../../shr/components/history/HistoryModalShell';
import { useFlk, type Flock } from '../store';
import { toFa, formatNumWhileTyping } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { todayJ } from '../api/flocksCalc';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  flock: Flock | null;
}

type Tone = 'green' | 'amber' | 'blue' | 'gray';

const SRC_LABEL: Record<string, { label: string; tone: Tone }> = {
  purchase: { label: 'اولیه', tone: 'green' },
  partial: { label: 'جزئی', tone: 'amber' },
  final: { label: 'تکمیل', tone: 'green' },
  correction: { label: 'اصلاح', tone: 'blue' },
};

const VISIBLE_LIMIT = 10;

function fmt(n: number | undefined | null): string {
  return formatNumWhileTyping(String(n || 0)) || '۰';
}

function deltaTone(d: number): string {
  if (d === 0) return 'var(--text)';
  return d > 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--danger)';
}

function deltaLabel(d: number): string {
  return (d > 0 ? '+' : '') + getGlobalFormat().count(d);
}

export default function SexingHistoryModal({ open, onClose, flock }: Props) {
  const [showAll, setShowAll] = useState(false);

  const events = useMemo(() => {
    if (!flock) return [];
    return [...(flock.sexingEvents || [])].sort((a, b) => {
      const da = a.date || '';
      const db = b.date || '';
      if (da !== db) return da.localeCompare(db);
      return (a.createdAt || '').localeCompare(b.createdAt || '');
    });
  }, [flock]);

  const eventsWithMeta = useMemo(
    () => events.map((ev, idx) => ({ ev, prev: idx > 0 ? events[idx - 1] : null })),
    [events],
  );

  const groups = useMemo(() => {
    const today = todayJ();
    const map = new Map<string, typeof eventsWithMeta>();
    const order: string[] = [];
    for (const item of eventsWithMeta) {
      const key = item.ev.date === today ? 'امروز' : (item.ev.date || 'نامشخص');
      if (!map.has(key)) { map.set(key, []); order.push(key); }
      map.get(key)!.push(item);
    }
    return order.map(k => ({ label: k, items: map.get(k)! }));
  }, [eventsWithMeta]);

  const { visibleGroups, hiddenCount } = useMemo(() => {
    if (showAll) return { visibleGroups: groups, hiddenCount: 0 };
    let total = 0;
    const out: typeof groups = [];
    for (const g of groups) {
      if (total >= VISIBLE_LIMIT) break;
      out.push(g);
      total += g.items.length;
    }
    const visibleCount = out.reduce((s, g) => s + g.items.length, 0);
    const totalCount = groups.reduce((s, g) => s + g.items.length, 0);
    return { visibleGroups: out, hiddenCount: totalCount - visibleCount };
  }, [groups, showAll]);

  if (!flock) return null;

  return (
    <HistoryModalShell
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="📅 تاریخچه تفکیک جنسیت"
      size="md"
    >
      {groups.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
          هنوز تفکیکی برای این گله ثبت نشده است.
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
          {visibleGroups.map(g => (
            <div key={g.label}>
              {/* تاریخ سمت راست، بدون کادر */}
              <div style={{
                textAlign: 'right',
                fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                fontWeight: 700,
                color: 'var(--muted)',
                paddingBottom: 6,
                marginBottom: 6,
              }}>
                📅 {getGlobalFormat().raw.digits(String(g.label), getGlobalFormat().units.numberFormat)}
              </div>

              {/* wrapper کل گروه */}
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 7 }}>
                {g.items.map(({ ev, prev }) => {
                  const dM = prev ? ev.male - prev.male : 0;
                  const dF = prev ? ev.female - prev.female : 0;
                  const dU = prev ? ev.unknown - prev.unknown : 0;
                  const srcInfo = SRC_LABEL[ev.source] || { label: ev.source, tone: 'gray' as const };
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={ev.id}
                      style={{
                        padding: '6px 8px',
                        background: 'var(--input-bg)',
                        borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                        border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                      }}
                    >
                      <div style={{
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        gap: 8,
                        paddingBottom: 4,
                        marginBottom: 4,
                        borderBottom: '1px dashed var(--border)',
                      }}>
                        <Tag tone={srcInfo.tone}>{srcInfo.label}</Tag>
                      </div>

                      <div style={{
                        display: 'grid',
                        gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(3, 1fr)',
                        gap: 6,
                        textAlign: 'center',
                      }}>
                        <div>
                          <div style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', marginBottom: 1 }}>نر</div>
                          <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: deltaTone(dM) }}>
                            {fmt(ev.male)}
                            {dM !== 0 && (
                              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', marginRight: 4 }}>
                                ({deltaLabel(dM)})
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <div style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', marginBottom: 1 }}>ماده</div>
                          <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: deltaTone(dF) }}>
                            {fmt(ev.female)}
                            {dF !== 0 && (
                              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', marginRight: 4 }}>
                                ({deltaLabel(dF)})
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <div style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', marginBottom: 1 }}>نامشخص</div>
                          <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: deltaTone(dU) }}>
                            {fmt(ev.unknown)}
                            {dU !== 0 && (
                              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', marginRight: 4 }}>
                                ({deltaLabel(dU)})
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {ev.note && (
                        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 4, paddingTop: 3, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)' }}>
                          📝 {ev.note}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
          {hiddenCount > 0 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowAll(true)}
              style={{
                padding: '10px',
                background: 'var(--input-bg)',
                border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                color: 'var(--accent)',
                fontWeight: 600,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                fontFamily: 'inherit',
              }}
            >
              📜 نمایش {getGlobalFormat().count(hiddenCount)} رویداد بیشتر
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </HistoryModalShell>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/flk/components/SexingModal.tsx

/**
 * SexingModal — تفکیک جنسیت گله (اولین یا بازشماری)
 * فیلدهای نر، ماده، نامشخص همه editable.
 * Invariant: male + female + unknown === currentCount
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';


import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Modal, Btn, BtnRow, Field, Grid2, NumField, Input } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { HelpIcon } from '../../../shr/components/ui/HelpIcon';
import DatePicker from '../../../shr/components/DatePicker';
import { HELP } from '../../../shr/help/helpTexts';
import { useFlk, type Flock } from '../store';
import { toastMsg } from '../../../cor/store/toast';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../../cor/store/dialog';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  flock: Flock | null;
}

function todayJalali(): string {
  try {
    const d = new Date();
    const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-u-ca-persian-nu-latn', {
      year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit',
    }).formatToParts(d);
    const y = parts.find(p => p.type === 'year')?.value || '';
    const m = parts.find(p => p.type === 'month')?.value || '';
    const dd = parts.find(p => p.type === 'day')?.value || '';
    return `${y}/${m}/${dd}`;
  } catch { return ''; }
}

function toEnNum(s: string): number {
  const en = s.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));
  const n = parseInt(en.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''), 10);
  return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
}

export default function SexingModal({ open, onClose, flock }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const recordSexing = useFlk(s => s.recordSexing);

  const [maleStr, setMaleStr] = useState('');
  const [femaleStr, setFemaleStr] = useState('');
  const [unknownStr, setUnknownStr] = useState('');
  const [date, setDate] = useState(todayJalali());
  const [note, setNote] = useState('');
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');

  const currentCount = flock?.currentCount ?? 0;
  const maleRaw = toEnNum(maleStr);
  const femaleRaw = toEnNum(femaleStr);
  const unknownRaw = toEnNum(unknownStr);

  const isMaleEmpty = maleStr.trim() === '';
  const isFemaleEmpty = femaleStr.trim() === '';
  const isUnknownEmpty = unknownStr.trim() === '';

  // 🆕 Smart Total: سه‌فیلد هوشمند
  const remaining = Math.max(0, currentCount - maleRaw - femaleRaw - unknownRaw);
  let maleNum = maleRaw;
  let femaleNum = femaleRaw;
  let unknownNum = unknownRaw;

  let autoFillField: 'male' | 'female' | 'unknown' | null = null;
  let autoFillValue = 0;

  const userFilledCountPre = (!isMaleEmpty ? 1 : 0) + (!isFemaleEmpty ? 1 : 0) + (!isUnknownEmpty ? 1 : 0);
  if (userFilledCountPre === 2 && remaining > 0) {
    if (isUnknownEmpty) {
      unknownNum = remaining; autoFillField = 'unknown'; autoFillValue = remaining;
    } else if (isMaleEmpty) {
      maleNum = remaining; autoFillField = 'male'; autoFillValue = remaining;
    } else if (isFemaleEmpty) {
      femaleNum = remaining; autoFillField = 'female'; autoFillValue = remaining;
    }
  }

  const totalInput = maleNum + femaleNum + unknownNum;
  const diff = totalInput - currentCount;
  const mismatch = diff !== 0;
  const userFilledCount = (!isMaleEmpty ? 1 : 0) + (!isFemaleEmpty ? 1 : 0) + (!isUnknownEmpty ? 1 : 0);
  const isIncomplete = userFilledCount < 3;
  const noInput = userFilledCount === 0;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open && flock) {
      setMaleStr(flock.maleCount ? String(flock.maleCount) : '');
      setFemaleStr(flock.femaleCount ? String(flock.femaleCount) : '');
      setUnknownStr(flock.unknownCount ? String(flock.unknownCount) : '');
      setDate(todayJalali());
      setNote('');
      setErr('');
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [open, flock?.id]);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!flock) return;
    if (isIncomplete) {
      setErr('هر سه فیلد نر، ماده و نامشخص باید پر باشند');
      return;
    }
    if (mismatch) {
      setErr(`جمع (${totalInput}) با تعداد زنده (${currentCount}) برابر نیست — اختلاف: ${diff}`);
      return;
    }

    // 🆕 کانفرم قبل از ثبت (فاز ۳ تکمیلی)
    const _isFirst = !flock.genderSplitAt;
    const _before = {
      m: flock.maleCount ?? 0,
      f: flock.femaleCount ?? 0,
      u: flock.unknownCount ?? 0,
    };
    const _msg = _isFirst
      ? `تفکیک اولیه گله «${flock.name}»:\n♂ ${maleNum} · ♀ ${femaleNum} · ? ${unknownNum}\nجمع: ${totalInput} = زنده: ${currentCount}`
      : `تغییر تفکیک گله «${flock.name}»:\nاز: ♂ ${_before.m} · ♀ ${_before.f} · ? ${_before.u}\nبه: ♂ ${maleNum} · ♀ ${femaleNum} · ? ${unknownNum}\n\nتاریخچه قبلی حفظ می‌شود.`;
    const _ok = await showConfirmAsync('تأیید تفکیک جنسیت', _msg, {
      confirmText: _isFirst ? 'ثبت تفکیک' : 'اعمال تغییر',
    });
    if (!_ok) return;

    try {
      recordSexing(flock.id, {
        male: maleNum,
        female: femaleNum,
        unknown: unknownNum,
        date: date || todayJalali(),
        note: note.trim() || undefined,
      });
      toastMsg.success('تفکیک جنسیت ثبت شد');
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      setErr(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'خطا در ثبت');
    }
  };

  if (!flock) return null;

  const isFirst = !flock.genderSplitAt;
  const isFinal = unknownNum === 0;

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="📋 تفکیک جنسیت"
      size="md"
      footer={
        <BtnRow>
          <Btn variant="primary" onClick={handleSave} disabled={mismatch || isIncomplete}>
            ✓ ثبت تفکیک
          </Btn>
          <Btn onClick={onClose}>انصراف</Btn>
        </BtnRow>
      }
    >
      <div style={{
        padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
        background: 'var(--accent-soft)',
        border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)',
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
        display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4,
        fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', marginBottom: 12,
      }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
          <span style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{flock.name}</span>
          <HelpIcon text={HELP.flk.sexing} />
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
          تعداد زنده: <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.count(currentCount)}</b> پرنده
        </div>
      </div>

      <Grid2>
        <Field label="تعداد نر" required>
          <NumField
            value={maleStr}
            onChange={e => setMaleStr(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="۰"
            unit="پرنده"
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label="تعداد ماده" required>
          <NumField
            value={femaleStr}
            onChange={e => setFemaleStr(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="۰"
            unit="پرنده"
          />
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      <Grid2>
        <Field label="تعداد نامشخص">
          <NumField
            value={unknownStr}
            onChange={e => setUnknownStr(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="۰"
            unit="پرنده"
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label="جمع کل">
          <div style={{
            padding: '10px 12px',
            background: 'var(--card)',
            border: `1px solid ${isIncomplete ? 'var(--border)' : mismatch ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--accent)'}`,
            borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
            fontWeight: 700,
            color: isIncomplete ? 'var(--muted)' : mismatch ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--accent)',
            textAlign: 'center',
          }}>
            {isIncomplete
              ? `— / ${fmt.count(currentCount)}`
              : mismatch
                ? `✗ ${fmt.count(totalInput)} / ${fmt.count(currentCount)}`
                : `✓ ${fmt.count(totalInput)} = ${fmt.count(currentCount)}`}
          </div>
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      {/* 🆕 Smart Guide — یک خط، بدون تکرار */}
      {isIncomplete && noInput ? (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: 8, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>
          تعداد نر یا ماده را وارد کنید
        </div>
      ) : isIncomplete && userFilledCount === 1 ? (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: 8, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>
          یک فیلد دیگر وارد کنید
        </div>
      ) : isIncomplete && autoFillField ? (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--info)', marginBottom: 8, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>
          {autoFillField === 'male' ? 'نر' : autoFillField === 'female' ? 'ماده' : 'نامشخص'} = {fmt.count(autoFillValue)} (خودکار — وارد کنید)
        </div>
      ) : mismatch ? (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--danger)', marginBottom: 8, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>
          {fmt.count(Math.abs(diff))} پرنده {diff > 0 ? 'بیشتر' : 'کمتر'} از موجودی ({fmt.count(currentCount)})
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <Field label="تاریخ تفکیک">
        <DatePicker value={date} onChange={setDate} />
      </Field>

      <Field label="یادداشت (اختیاری)">
        <Input value={note} onChange={e => setNote(e.target.value)} placeholder="مثلاً بازشماری دقیق" />
      </Field>

      <div style={{
        marginTop: 12, padding: 'var(--pad-tight)',
        background: 'var(--input-bg)',
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
        fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
        color: 'var(--muted)',
      }}>
        {isFirst
          ? 'این اولین تفکیک است. پس از ثبت، گله به‌عنوان «تفکیک‌شده» علامت می‌خورد.'
          : isFinal && flock.unknownCount && flock.unknownCount > 0
            ? 'تکمیل تفکیک — همه پرنده‌ها تعیین جنسیت می‌شوند.'
            : 'تفکیک مجدد — تاریخچه قبلی حفظ می‌شود.'}
      </div>

      {err && (
        <div style={{
          marginTop: 8, padding: 'var(--pad-tight)',
          background: 'var(--danger-soft)',
          border: '1px solid var(--danger)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--danger)',
        }}>
          {err}
        </div>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/flk/components/SmartRuleEditor.tsx

/**
 * SmartRuleEditor.tsx — ویرایشگر قانون گروه هوشمند
 * چیدمان ۲ ستونه + مرحله زندگی (preset) + hint هوشمند
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Select, Field, Input, Grid2 } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import type { FlockGroupRule, FlockGroupType, FlockStatus } from '../store';
import { toEn, toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import SmartSelect from '../../../shr/components/SmartSelect';

export interface SmartRuleEditorProps {
  rule: FlockGroupRule;
  onChange: (rule: FlockGroupRule) => void;
  breeds: Array<{ id: string; name: string; birdId: string }>;
  halls: Array<{ id: string; name: string }>;
}

export function SmartRuleEditor({ rule, onChange, breeds, halls }: SmartRuleEditorProps) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const update = (patch: Partial<FlockGroupRule>) => {
    const next: FlockGroupRule = { ...rule, ...patch };
    Object.keys(next).forEach(k => {
      const v = (next as Record<string, unknown>)[k];
      if (v === '' || v === undefined || v === null || (typeof v === 'number' && isNaN(v))) {
        delete (next as Record<string, unknown>)[k];
      }
    });
    onChange(next);
  };

  const parseAge = (s: string): number | undefined => {
    if (!s) return undefined;
    const n = parseInt(toEn(s).replace(/[^0-9-]/g, ''), 10);
    if (isNaN(n)) return undefined;
    // 🆕 حداکثر ۶۰۰ روز (سن واقعی مرغ)
    return Math.min(600, Math.max(0, n));
  };

  const ageConflict =
    typeof rule.minAge === 'number' &&
    typeof rule.maxAge === 'number' &&
    rule.minAge >= rule.maxAge;

  type AgeStage = 'all' | 'chick' | 'pullet' | 'adult' | 'old' | 'custom';
  const STAGES: Array<{ key: AgeStage; label: string; min?: number; max?: number }> = [
    { key: 'all', label: 'همه' },
    { key: 'chick', label: 'جوجه (۰-۶۰ روز)', min: 0, max: 60 },
    { key: 'pullet', label: 'نیمچه (۶۰-۱۴۰ روز)', min: 60, max: 140 },
    { key: 'adult', label: 'بالغ (۱۴۰-۵۰۰ روز)', min: 140, max: 500 },
    { key: 'old', label: 'پیر (۵۰۰+ روز)', min: 500 },
    { key: 'custom', label: 'سفارشی' },
  ];

  const detectStage = (): AgeStage => {
    if (forceCustom) return 'custom';
    const { minAge, maxAge } = rule;
    if (typeof minAge !== 'number' && typeof maxAge !== 'number') return 'all';
    if (minAge === 0 && maxAge === 60) return 'chick';
    if (minAge === 60 && maxAge === 140) return 'pullet';
    if (minAge === 140 && maxAge === 500) return 'adult';
    if (minAge === 500 && typeof maxAge !== 'number') return 'old';
    return 'custom';
  };

  const [forceCustom, setForceCustom] = useState(false);

  const currentStage = detectStage();

  const applyStage = (stageKey: AgeStage) => {
    if (stageKey === 'custom') {
      setForceCustom(true);
      return;
    }
    setForceCustom(false);
    if (stageKey === 'all') {
      update({ minAge: undefined, maxAge: undefined });
      return;
    }
    const st = STAGES.find(x => x.key === stageKey);
    if (!st) return;
    update({ minAge: st.min, maxAge: st.max });
  };

  return (
    <div style={{
      padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
      background: 'var(--card)',
      border: '1px solid var(--border)',
      borderRight: '4px solid var(--purple)',
      borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
      display: 'flex',
      flexDirection: 'column',
      gap: 10,
    }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--purple)' }}>
        🤖 قوانین خودکار
        <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 400, opacity: 0.7 }}>
          (فقط گله‌های منطبق عضو می‌شن)
        </span>
      </div>

      <Grid2>
        <Field label="نوع گله" hint={!rule.type ? 'مثلاً: تخم‌گذار — خالی = همه' : undefined}>
          <Select value={rule.type || ''} onChange={e => update({ type: e.target.value as FlockGroupRule['type'] || undefined })}>
            <option value="">همه</option>
            <option value="layer">تخم‌گذار</option>
            <option value="broiler">گوشتی</option>
            <option value="breeder">مادر</option>
          </Select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="نژاد" hint={!rule.breedId ? 'نژاد خاص — خالی = همه' : undefined}>
          <SmartSelect
            value={rule.breedId || ''}
            placeholder="همه"
            modalTitle="انتخاب نژاد"
            options={breeds.map((b) => {
              const purposeMap: Record<string, string> = {
                layer: "🥚 تخم‌گذار",
                breeder: "🐣 مادر",
                broiler: "🍗 گوشتی",
                ornamental: "🌸 زینتی",
              };
              const rawPurposes = Array.isArray(Reflect.get(b, "purposes"))
                ? (Reflect.get(b, "purposes") as unknown[]).filter((x): x is string => typeof x === "string")
                : [];
              const purposeLabels = rawPurposes.map((p) => purposeMap[p] || p);
              return {
                value: String(b.id),
                label: String(b.name),
                subtitle: purposeLabels.length > 0 ? purposeLabels.join("، ") : undefined,
              };
            })}
            onChange={(val: string) => update({ breedId: val || undefined })}
          />
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      <Grid2>
        <Field label="سالن" hint={!rule.hallId ? 'محل نگهداری — خالی = همه' : undefined}>
          <SmartSelect
            value={rule.hallId || ''}
            placeholder="همه"
            modalTitle="انتخاب سالن"
            options={halls.map((h) => ({ value: String(h.id), label: String(h.name) }))}
            onChange={(val: string) => update({ hallId: val || undefined })}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label="وضعیت" hint={!rule.status ? 'وضعیت گله — خالی = همه' : undefined}>
          <Select value={rule.status || ''} onChange={e => update({ status: e.target.value as FlockGroupRule['status'] || undefined })}>
            <option value="">همه</option>
            <option value="active">فعال</option>
            <option value="archived">آرشیو</option>
            <option value="sold">فروخته‌شده</option>
          </Select>
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      <Grid2>
        <Field label="منبع" hint={!rule.source ? 'گله‌ها از کجا اومدن — خالی = همه' : undefined}>
          <Select value={rule.source || ''} onChange={e => update({ source: e.target.value || undefined })}>
            <option value="">همه</option>
            <option value="purchase">خریداری</option>
            <option value="hatch">جوجه‌کشی خودم</option>
            <option value="gift">اهدا</option>
          </Select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="مرحله زندگی" hint={currentStage === 'all' ? 'بدون محدودیت سنی — همه گله‌ها' : undefined}>
          <Select value={currentStage} onChange={e => applyStage(e.target.value as AgeStage)}>
            {STAGES.map(s => (
              <option key={s.key} value={s.key}>{s.label}</option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      {currentStage === 'custom' && (
        <Grid2>
          <Field label="سن از (روز)" hint={!rule.minAge ? 'حداقل سن (حداکثر ۶۰۰) — مثلاً: ۱۴۰' : undefined}>
            <Input
              value={typeof rule.minAge === 'number' ? fmt.raw.digits(String(rule.minAge), fmt.units.numberFormat) : ''}
              onChange={e => update({ minAge: parseAge(e.target.value) })}
              placeholder="—"
              inputMode="numeric"
              min={0}
              max={600}
              showWords={false}
            />
          </Field>
          <Field label="سن تا (روز)" hint={!rule.maxAge ? 'حداکثر سن (حداکثر ۶۰۰) — مثلاً: ۲۰۰' : undefined}>
            <Input
              value={typeof rule.maxAge === 'number' ? fmt.raw.digits(String(rule.maxAge), fmt.units.numberFormat) : ''}
              onChange={e => update({ maxAge: parseAge(e.target.value) })}
              placeholder="—"
              inputMode="numeric"
              min={0}
              max={600}
              showWords={false}
            />
          </Field>
        </Grid2>
      )}

      {ageConflict && (
        <div style={{
          padding: '6px 10px',
          background: 'var(--danger-soft)',
          border: '1px solid var(--danger)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
          color: 'var(--danger)',
          fontWeight: 600,
        }}>
          ⚠️ سن از ({rule.minAge}) باید کمتر از سن تا ({rule.maxAge}) باشه
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--purple)', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
        {Object.keys(rule).length === 0
          ? '⚠️ هیچ شرطی تعریف نشده — همه گله‌ها عضو می‌شن'
          : ageConflict
            ? '🔴 بازه سنی نامعتبر ئه (سن از باید کمتر از سن تا باشه)'
            : '✅ گله‌هایی که با همه شرط‌های بالا منطبق باشن، خودکار عضو می‌شن'}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/flk/components/UnmergeFlocksModal.tsx

/**
 * UnmergeFlocksModal — بازگردانی گله از ادغام
 * سلسله‌مراتب:
 *   ۱. گله اصلی (🏠) — target
 *   ۲. منابع ادغام‌شده (📦) — با مرتب‌سازی در header
 *   ۳. پیش‌بینی (📊) — نتیجه
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';


import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Modal, Btn, BtnRow } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { toastMsg } from '../../../cor/store/toast';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../../cor/store/dialog';
import { toFa, formatNumWhileTyping } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { useFlk, getAgeDays } from '../store';
import { format as formatJ } from 'date-fns-jalali';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  targetFlockId: string;
}

const fmtInt = (n: number | undefined | null): string => formatNumWhileTyping(String(n || 0)) || '۰';

interface SourceInfo {
  flockId: string;
  flockName: string;
  count?: number;
  initialCount?: number;
  maleCount?: number;
  femaleCount?: number;
  unknownCount?: number;
  ageDays?: number;
  isTarget: boolean;
}

function normalizeGender(item: SourceInfo): SourceInfo {
  const c = item.count || 0;
  const m = item.maleCount || 0;
  const f = item.femaleCount || 0;
  let u = item.unknownCount || 0;
  if (m + f + u !== c) {
    u = Math.max(0, c - m - f);
  }
  return { ...item, unknownCount: u };
}

const cell = (label: string, value: React.ReactNode) => (
  <div style={{
    display: 'flex',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    alignItems: 'center',
    fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
    gap: 6,
    padding: '3px 0',
    borderBottom: '1px dashed var(--border)',
  }}>
    <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', flexShrink: 0 }}>{label}:</span>
    <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text)', textAlign: 'left', fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' }}>{value}</span>
  </div>
);

export default function UnmergeFlocksModal({ open, onClose, targetFlockId }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const allFlocks = useFlk(s => s.flocks);
  const unmergeFlocks = useFlk(s => s.unmergeFlocks);

  const target = allFlocks.find(f => f.id === targetFlockId);

  const targetItem: SourceInfo | null = useMemo(() => {
    if (!target) return null;
    return normalizeGender({
      flockId: target.id,
      flockName: target.name,
      count: (target as any).currentCount || 0,
      initialCount: (target as any).initialCount || 0,
      maleCount: (target as any).maleCount || 0,
      femaleCount: (target as any).femaleCount || 0,
      unknownCount: (target as any).unknownCount || 0,
      ageDays: getAgeDays(target),
      isTarget: true,
    });
  }, [target]);

  const sourceItems: SourceInfo[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!target?.mergedInfo?.sources) return [];
    return (target.mergedInfo.sources as any[])
      .filter(s => s.flockId !== targetFlockId)
      .map(s => normalizeGender({
        ...s,
        count: s.count || 0,
        initialCount: s.initialCount !== undefined ? s.initialCount : (s.count || 0),
        maleCount: s.maleCount || 0,
        femaleCount: s.femaleCount || 0,
        unknownCount: s.unknownCount || 0,
        isTarget: false,
      }));
  }, [target, targetFlockId]);

  // مرتب‌سازی ثابت: بزرگ‌ترین تعداد اول
  const sortedSources = useMemo(() => {
    const arr = [...sourceItems];
    arr.sort((a, b) => (b.count || 0) - (a.count || 0));
    return arr;
  }, [sourceItems]);

  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string>('');
  const effectiveSelectedId = sortedSources.some(s => s.flockId === selectedId)
    ? selectedId
    : (sortedSources[0]?.flockId || '');
  const selectedSrc = sortedSources.find(s => s.flockId === effectiveSelectedId);

  const prediction = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedSrc || !targetItem) return null;
    const srcCount = selectedSrc.count || 0;
    return {
      sourceAfter: srcCount,
      targetAfter: Math.max(0, (targetItem.count || 0) - srcCount),
      remainingSources: sourceItems.length - 1,
    };
  }, [selectedSrc, targetItem, sourceItems.length]);

  const handleConfirm = async () => {
    if (!selectedSrc) return;
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
      'تأیید بازگردانی',
      `گله «${selectedSrc.flockName}» با ${fmt.count(selectedSrc.count || 0)} پرنده به حالت فعال بازمی‌گردد.`,
      { confirmText: 'بازگردانی' }
    );
    if (!ok) return;
    try {
      unmergeFlocks(targetFlockId, effectiveSelectedId);
      toastMsg.success('گله بازگردانده شد');
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[UnmergeFlocksModal]', e);
      toastMsg.error('خطا در بازگردانی');
    }
  };

  const mergeDate = (() => {
    if (!target?.mergedInfo?.mergedAt) return '';
    try {
      return formatJ(new Date(target.mergedInfo.mergedAt), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
    } catch {
      return target.mergedInfo.mergedAt.slice(0, 10);
    }
  })();

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="بازگردانی گله ادغام‌شده"
      size="lg"
      footer={
        sortedSources.length > 0
          ? <BtnRow><Btn variant="primary" onClick={handleConfirm} disabled={!effectiveSelectedId}>بازگردانی</Btn><Btn onClick={onClose}>انصراف</Btn></BtnRow>
          : <BtnRow><Btn onClick={onClose}>بستن</Btn></BtnRow>
      }
    >
      {sourceItems.length === 0 && !targetItem ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
          هیچ گله‌ای برای بازگردانی نیست.
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>

          {/* ═══ بخش ۱: گله اصلی ═══ */}
          {targetItem && (
            <div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginBottom: 6 }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>🏠 گله اصلی (فعلی)</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--info, #0284c7)', background: 'var(--info-soft, rgba(2,132,199,.08))', padding: '1px 6px', borderRadius: 4, fontWeight: 600 }}>فعال</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)' }}>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', marginBottom: 8 }}>{targetItem.flockName}</div>
                <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', columnGap: 12 }}>
                  {cell('تعداد فعلی', `${fmtInt(targetItem.count)} پرنده`)}
                  {cell('سن فعلی', `${fmtInt(Math.round(targetItem.ageDays || 0))} روز`)}
                  {target?.mergedInfo?.avgAgeDays != null && cell('سن میانگین وزنی', `${fmtInt(Math.round(target.mergedInfo.avgAgeDays))} روز`)}
                  {cell('نر', fmtInt(targetItem.maleCount))}
                  {cell('ماده', fmtInt(targetItem.femaleCount))}
                  {cell('نامشخص', fmtInt(targetItem.unknownCount))}
                  {mergeDate && cell('تاریخ ادغام', fmt.date(mergeDate))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ═══ بخش ۲: منابع ═══ */}
          {sourceItems.length > 0 && (
            <div>
              <div style={{ marginBottom: 8, paddingBottom: 6, borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)' }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)', marginBottom: 2 }}>
                  📦 منابع ادغام‌شده ({fmt.count(sourceItems.length)} گله)
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
                  این گله از ادغام {fmt.count(sourceItems.length)} گله ساخته شده. برای بازگردانی یکی را انتخاب کنید.
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ maxHeight: 280, overflowY: 'auto', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8, paddingRight: 2 }}>
                {sortedSources.map((src) => {
                  const isSelected = src.flockId === effectiveSelectedId;
                  const c = src.count || 0;
                  const m = src.maleCount || 0;
                  const f = src.femaleCount || 0;
                  const u = src.unknownCount || 0;
                  const genderStatus = c === 0 ? '—'
                    : (m === 0 && f === 0 && u === c) ? 'همه نامشخص'
                    : (u === 0 && (m + f === c)) ? 'تفکیک‌شده'
                    : 'ترکیبی';
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={src.flockId}
                      onClick={() => setSelectedId(src.flockId)}
                      style={{
                        padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
                        background: isSelected ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--input-bg)',
                        border: '1px solid ' + (isSelected ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--border)'),
                        borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                        cursor: 'pointer',
                      }}
                    >
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                        <input
                          type="radio"
                          name="unmerge-source"
                          checked={isSelected}
                          onChange={() => setSelectedId(src.flockId)}
                          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                          style={{ accentColor: 'var(--accent)', flexShrink: 0 }}
                        />
                        <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', flex: 1 }}>{src.flockName}</span>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', background: 'var(--bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', padding: '1px 6px', borderRadius: 4, fontWeight: 600 }}>قبل از ادغام</span>
                        {isSelected && <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700 }}>انتخاب‌شده</span>}
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', columnGap: 12 }}>
                        {cell('تعداد', `${fmtInt(src.count)} پرنده`)}
                        {cell('سن', `${fmtInt(Math.round(src.ageDays || 0))} روز`)}
                        {cell('اولیه', fmtInt(src.initialCount))}
                        {cell('نامشخص', fmtInt(src.unknownCount))}
                        {cell('نر', fmtInt(src.maleCount))}
                        {cell('ماده', fmtInt(src.femaleCount))}
                        <div style={{ gridColumn: '1 / -1', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', paddingTop: 4 }}>
                          <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', background: 'var(--bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', padding: '1px 6px', borderRadius: 4, fontWeight: 600 }}>{genderStatus}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ═══ بخش ۳: پیش‌بینی ═══ */}
          {prediction && (
            <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--accent-soft)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)' }}>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--accent)', marginBottom: 4 }}>📊 پیش‌بینی بازگردانی:</div>
              <div style={{ color: 'var(--text)', lineHeight: 1.7 }}>
                • <b>{selectedSrc?.flockName}</b> ← فعال با <b>{fmtInt(prediction.sourceAfter)}</b> پرنده
                <br />
                • <b>{targetItem?.flockName}</b> ← <b>{fmtInt(prediction.targetAfter)}</b> پرنده ({fmtInt(targetItem?.count)} − {fmtInt(prediction.sourceAfter)})
                {prediction.remainingSources > 0 && (
                  <><br /><span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>• {fmt.count(prediction.remainingSources)} منبع دیگر همچنان در گله اصلی باقی می‌ماند</span></>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

        </div>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}

/**
 * UpcomingFlocks — گله‌های نزدیک به شروع تخم‌گذاری
 * طراحی: رینگ دایره‌ای + responsive (۱-۳ تک‌ستونه • ۴+ دو‌ستونه)
 * الگو: FOUNDATION-PATTERNS ب۲۲ (KPI Cards)
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';


import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { DEFAULT_LAYING_START, getAgeDays, getLayingStartDay } from '../store';
import type { Flock } from '../store';
import type { TabId } from '../types-flocks';
import type { useBreedStandard } from '../../../shr/hooks/useBreedStandard';

type BreedStd = ReturnType<typeof useBreedStandard>;
type Fmt = ReturnType<typeof useFormat>;

export interface UpcomingFlocksProps {
  flocks: Flock[];
  breedStd: BreedStd;
  fmt: Fmt;
  tab?: TabId;
}

interface RingProps {
  pct: number;
  color: string;
  size?: number;
}

function Ring({ pct, color, size = 40 }: RingProps) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const r = (size / 2) - 4;
  const c = 2 * Math.PI * r;
  const offset = c - (Math.min(100, pct) / 100) * c;
  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox={`0 0 ${size} ${size}`} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>
      <circle cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={r} fill="none" stroke="var(--border)" strokeWidth={4} />
      <circle
        cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={r} fill="none"
        stroke={color} strokeWidth={4}
        strokeDasharray={c} strokeDashoffset={offset}
        transform={`rotate(-90 ${size / 2} ${size / 2})`}
        strokeLinecap="round"
      />
      <text x={size / 2} y={size / 2 + size * 0.09} textAnchor="middle"
        fontSize={size * 0.26} fontWeight="700" fill={color}>
        {fmt.count(Math.round(pct))}٪
      </text>
    </svg>
  );
}

export default function UpcomingFlocks({ flocks, breedStd, fmt, tab }: UpcomingFlocksProps) {
  const upcoming = flocks
    .filter(f => {
      if (f.status !== 'active') return false;
      if (f.paused) return false;
      if (f.type !== 'layer' && f.type !== 'breeder') return false;
      // 🆕 فیلتر بر اساس tab
      if (tab === 'layer' && f.type !== 'layer') return false;
      if (tab === 'breeder' && f.type !== 'breeder') return false;
      const std = breedStd.byBreedId(f.breedId);
      const startDay = getLayingStartDay(f, std?.biology?.layingStartDay ?? DEFAULT_LAYING_START);
      const age = getAgeDays(f);
      return age < startDay && age >= startDay - 60;
    })
    .sort((a, b) => getAgeDays(b) - getAgeDays(a))
    .slice(0, 12);

  if (upcoming.length === 0) return null;

  const isMulti = upcoming.length >= 4;

  const items = upcoming.map(f => {
    const age = getAgeDays(f);
    const std = breedStd.byBreedId(f.breedId);
    const startDay = getLayingStartDay(f, std?.biology?.layingStartDay ?? DEFAULT_LAYING_START);
    const remain = startDay - age;
    const pct = Math.min(100, (age / startDay) * 100);
    return { f, age, startDay, remain, pct };
  });

  return (
    <div style={{
      background: 'var(--accent-soft)',
      border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)',
      borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)',
      padding: '8px 10px',
    }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '4px', marginBottom: '6px' }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }} aria-hidden>⏳</span>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--accent)', flex: 1 }}>
          نزدیک به شروع تخم‌گذاری
        </span>
        <span style={{
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', fontWeight: 700,
          background: 'var(--accent)', color: 'var(--avatar-text, #fff)',
          padding: '1px 7px', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
        }}>{fmt.count(items.length)}</span>
      </div>

      {/* Grid / List */}
      <div style={{
        display: isMulti ? 'grid' : 'flex',
        gridTemplateColumns: isMulti ? '1fr 1fr' : undefined,
        flexDirection: isMulti ? undefined : 'column',
        gap: '6px',
      }}>
        {items.map(({ f, age, startDay, remain, pct }) => {
          const isWarn = remain <= 14;
          const color = isWarn ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--accent)';

          if (isMulti) {
            return (
              <div key={f.id} style={{
                background: 'var(--card)',
                border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                padding: '6px 8px',
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: '4px',
                minWidth: 0,
                textAlign: 'center',
              }}>
                <Ring pct={pct} color={color} size={36} />
                <div style={{
                  fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700,
                  whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                  width: '100%',
                }}>{f.name}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color, lineHeight: 1.1 }}>
                  {fmt.int(remain)}
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 1 }}>روز مانده</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          }

          return (
            <div key={f.id} style={{
              background: 'var(--card)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border)',
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
              padding: '8px 10px',
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: '8px',
              minWidth: 0,
            }}>
              <Ring pct={pct} color={color} size={36} />
              {/* (رینگ اول توی DOM = راست توی RTL) */}
              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <div style={{
                  fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 4,
                  whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                }}>{f.name}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', display: 'flex', gap: '8px', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                  <span>سن: <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.count(age)}</b> روز</span>
                  <span aria-hidden>·</span>
                  <span>شروع: <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.count(startDay)}</b> روز</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{
                flexShrink: 0, textAlign: 'center', lineHeight: 1.1, color,
              }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xl)', fontWeight: 700, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' }}>{fmt.int(remain)}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 2 }}>روز مانده</div>

/**

 * فقط-خواندنی. برای ویرایش از «ثبت روزانه» استفاده می‌شود.
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';


import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Modal, Btn, BtnRow, Tag, Empty } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { useFlk, type Flock } from '../store';
import { parse as parseJ, differenceInCalendarDays as diffCalDays, startOfDay } from 'date-fns-jalali';

function daysUntil(dateStr: string | undefined): number | null {
  if (!dateStr) return null;
  try {
    const en = dateStr.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d: string) => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));
    const target = parseJ(en, 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    if (isNaN(target.getTime())) return null;
    return diffCalDays(startOfDay(target), startOfDay(new Date()));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

type Item = { flock: Flock; aw: NonNullable<Flock['activeWithdrawal']>; daysLeft: number };

export default function WithdrawalModal({ open, onClose }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const flocks = useFlk(s => s.flocks);

  const items: Item[] = useMemo(() => {
    const result: Item[] = [];
    for (const f of flocks) {
      if (!f.activeWithdrawal || !f.activeWithdrawal.until) continue;
      const d = daysUntil(f.activeWithdrawal.until);
      if (d === null || d < 0) continue;
      result.push({ flock: f, aw: f.activeWithdrawal, daysLeft: d });
    }
    result.sort((a, b) => a.daysLeft - b.daysLeft);
    return result;
  }, [flocks]);

  const urgentCount = items.filter(x => x.daysLeft <= 3).length;
  const nearestDays = items.length > 0 ? items[0].daysLeft : null;

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="🩺 مدیریت دوره پرهیز"
      size="md"
      footer={<BtnRow><Btn onClick={onClose} full>بستن</Btn></BtnRow>}
    >
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--sp-3)' }}>
        {items.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty
            icon={
              <svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                <polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12" />
              </svg>
            }
            title="هیچ دوره پرهیز فعالی وجود ندارد"
            desc="همه گله‌ها آزاد هستند و می‌توانید بدون محدودیت بفروشید."
            tone="accent"
          />
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* KPI Cards */}
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 'var(--sp-2)' }}>
              <div style={{
                padding: 'var(--sp-3)',
                background: 'var(--danger-soft)',
                border: '1px solid var(--danger)',
                borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2,
                alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center',

                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xl)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--danger)', lineHeight: 1.2 }}>
                  {fmt.count(urgentCount)}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                  گله فوری (≤ ۳ روز)

              </div>

                alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center',
              }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xl)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--warn)', lineHeight: 1.2 }}>

            }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>

/**
 * consumptionEventsCalc.ts — محاسبات aggregate دان/آب
 * فاز ۸a — helper مشترک برای FCR engine
 */
import type { ConsumptionEvent, ConsumptionConfidence, ConsumptionType } from './types-store';

export interface ConsumptionAggregate {
  totalFeedKg: number;
  totalWaterL: number;
  byType: { feed: number; water: number };
  bySource: Record<string, number>;
  bySex: { male: number; female: number; mixed: number; unknown: number };
  confidence: 'exact' | 'estimated' | 'standard' | 'mixed';
  eventCount: number;
  hasData: boolean;
}

const EMPTY: ConsumptionAggregate = {
  totalFeedKg: 0,
  totalWaterL: 0,
  byType: { feed: 0, water: 0 },
  bySource: {},
  bySex: { male: 0, female: 0, mixed: 0, unknown: 0 },
  confidence: 'standard',
  eventCount: 0,
  hasData: false,
};

/**
 * aggregateConsumptionEvents — جمع دان/آب در یک بازه
 * - typeFilter: اگر تعریف شود، فقط همان type جمع می‌شود
 * - range: '1405/08/01' <= date <= '1405/08/10' (string compare on jalali works)
 */
export function aggregateConsumptionEvents(
  events: ConsumptionEvent[] | undefined,
  windowStart: string,
  windowEnd: string,
  typeFilter?: ConsumptionType,
): ConsumptionAggregate {
  if (!events || events.length === 0) return EMPTY;

  let totalFeedKg = 0;
  let totalWaterL = 0;
  const bySource: Record<string, number> = {};
  const bySex = { male: 0, female: 0, mixed: 0, unknown: 0 };
  const confSet = new Set<ConsumptionConfidence>();
  let count = 0;

  for (const e of events) {
    if (e.date < windowStart || e.date > windowEnd) continue;
    if (!(e.amount > 0)) continue;
    if (typeFilter && e.type !== typeFilter) continue;

    if (e.type === 'feed') totalFeedKg += e.amount;
    else totalWaterL += e.amount;

    count++;
    bySource[e.source] = (bySource[e.source] || 0) + e.amount;

    // sex فقط برای feed معنی دارد
    if (e.type === 'feed') {
      if (e.sex === 'male') bySex.male += e.amount;
      else if (e.sex === 'female') bySex.female += e.amount;
      else if (e.sex === 'mixed') bySex.mixed += e.amount;
      else bySex.unknown += e.amount;
    }
    confSet.add(e.confidence);
  }

  if (count === 0) return EMPTY;

  let confidence: ConsumptionAggregate['confidence'];
  if (confSet.size === 1) {
    confidence = confSet.values().next().value as ConsumptionConfidence;
  } else {
    confidence = 'mixed';
  }

  const r = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100;
  return {
    totalFeedKg: r(totalFeedKg),
    totalWaterL: r(totalWaterL),
    byType: { feed: r(totalFeedKg), water: r(totalWaterL) },
    bySource,
    bySex: {
      male: r(bySex.male),
      female: r(bySex.female),
      mixed: r(bySex.mixed),
      unknown: r(bySex.unknown),
    },
    confidence,
    eventCount: count,
    hasData: true,
  };
}

import { bus } from '../../cor/events';
import { useFlk } from './store';

export function registerFlkHandlers(): () => void {
  const off1 = bus.on('dlg:deaths:recorded', (data, meta) => {
    try {
      const flkState = useFlk.getState();
      const { flockId, date, count, deaths, isEdit, prevCount, prevFlockId } = data;

      if (isEdit && prevFlockId && prevFlockId !== flockId && (prevCount || 0) > 0) {
        const oldFlock = flkState.flocks.find(f => f.id === prevFlockId);
        if (oldFlock) {
          flkState.update(prevFlockId, {
            currentCount: (oldFlock.currentCount ?? 0) + (prevCount || 0),
          });
        }
      }

      const sameFlock = isEdit && prevFlockId === flockId;
      const delta = sameFlock ? (count - (prevCount || 0)) : count;
      if (delta === 0) return;

      const flock = flkState.flocks.find(f => f.id === flockId);
      if (!flock) return;

      if (delta < 0) {
      flkState.update(flockId, {
        currentCount: (flock.currentCount ?? 0) - delta,
      });
      }

      if (delta > 0) {
        const causeMap: Record<string, string> = {
          disease_respiratory: 'بیماری تنفسی',
          disease_digestive: 'بیماری گوارشی',
          disease_other: 'بیماری دیگر',
          heat: 'گرمازدگی',
          cold: 'سرمازدگی',
          suffocation: 'خفگی',
          cannibalism: 'پرنده‌خواری',
          predator: 'شکارچی',
          injury: 'آسیب',
          weak: 'ضعف',
          deformity: 'نقص مادرزادی',
          old_age: 'پیری',
          unknown: 'نامشخص',
        };
        const causes = (deaths || [])
          .map((d) => causeMap[d.cause] || d.cause)
          .filter((x: string) => x && x !== '—')
          .join('، ');

        // 🆕 Sex-aware: اگر non-edit و deaths دارای sex → چند رویداد
        const _hasSex = !isEdit && deaths && (deaths as any[]).some((d: any) => d.sex);
        if (_hasSex) {
          const _bySex: Record<'male' | 'female' | 'unknown', number> = { male: 0, female: 0, unknown: 0 };
          for (const _d of (deaths as any[])) {
            const _s = ((_d.sex || 'unknown') as 'male' | 'female' | 'unknown');
            _bySex[_s] += Number(_d.count) || 0;
          }
          const _sum = _bySex.male + _bySex.female + _bySex.unknown;
          if (_sum === delta && (_bySex.male > 0 || _bySex.female > 0)) {
            if (_bySex.male > 0) flkState.addEvent(flockId, { date, type: 'death', count: _bySex.male, sex: 'male', reason: causes || undefined, notes: 'ثبت روزانه (نر)' });
            if (_bySex.female > 0) flkState.addEvent(flockId, { date, type: 'death', count: _bySex.female, sex: 'female', reason: causes || undefined, notes: 'ثبت روزانه (ماده)' });
            if (_bySex.unknown > 0) flkState.addEvent(flockId, { date, type: 'death', count: _bySex.unknown, sex: 'mixed', reason: causes || undefined, notes: 'ثبت روزانه (نامشخص)' });
          } else {
            flkState.addEvent(flockId, { date, type: 'death', count: delta, sex: 'mixed', reason: causes || undefined, notes: 'ثبت روزانه' });
          }
        } else {
          flkState.addEvent(flockId, { date, type: 'death', count: delta, sex: 'mixed', reason: causes || undefined, notes: 'ثبت روزانه' });
        }
      }

      if (meta.traceId) {
        try { console.debug(`[flk] deaths cascade: delta=${delta}`, meta.traceId); } catch {}
      }
    } catch (e) {
      try { console.error('[flk] handler failed:', e); } catch {}
    }
  });

  const off2 = bus.on('dlg:log:deleted', (data) => {
    try {
      const { flockId, deathsCount } = data;
      if (!flockId || !deathsCount || deathsCount <= 0) return;
      const flkState = useFlk.getState();
      const flock = flkState.flocks.find(f => f.id === flockId);
      if (!flock) return;
      flkState.update(flockId, {
        currentCount: (flock.currentCount ?? 0) + deathsCount,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      try { console.error('[flk] delete handler failed:', e); } catch {}
    }
  });

  return () => { off1(); off2(); };
}

/**

import type { FlockSexBalanceEvent } from './store';

export type SexAuditType = FlockSexBalanceEvent['type'];

export const SEX_AUDIT_META: Record<SexAuditType, { icon: string; label: string; tone: string }> = {
  sexing:                 { icon: '🧬', label: 'تفکیک جنسیت',        tone: 'var(--accent)' },
  death:                  { icon: '💀', label: 'تلفات',               tone: 'var(--danger)' },
  sale:                   { icon: '💰', label: 'فروش',                tone: 'var(--purple)' },
  return:                 { icon: '↩️', label: 'برگشت',              tone: 'var(--info)' },
  correction:             { icon: '✏️', label: 'اصلاح',              tone: 'var(--warn)' },
  merge:                  { icon: '🔗', label: 'ادغام',               tone: 'var(--info)' },
  unmerge:                { icon: '🔓', label: 'بازگردانی',          tone: 'var(--info)' },
  pre_sexing_observation: { icon: '👁',  label: 'مشاهده قبل تفکیک', tone: 'var(--muted)' },
};

/** formatSexDelta — متن کوتاه از delta */
export function formatSexDelta(d: FlockSexBalanceEvent['delta']): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (d.male !== 0) parts.push(`♂ ${d.male > 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.male}`);
  if (d.female !== 0) parts.push(`♀ ${d.female > 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.female}`);
  if (d.unknown !== 0) parts.push(`? ${d.unknown > 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.unknown}`);
  return parts.join(' · ');
}

// فاز ۷.۲ — نرخ تلفات به تفکیک جنسیت
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export interface DeathRate {
  male: { deaths: number; initial: number; rate: number };
  female: { deaths: number; initial: number; rate: number };
  unknown: { deaths: number };
  hasData: boolean;
}

/**
 * aggregateDeathsBySex — جمع تلفات از sexBalanceEvents (type='death')
 * then compute rate based on initialMaleCount / initialFemaleCount
 */
export function aggregateDeathsBySex(
  sexBalanceEvents: FlockSexBalanceEvent[] | undefined,
  initialMale: number | null | undefined,
  initialFemale: number | null | undefined,
): DeathRate {
  const deaths = sexBalanceEvents || [];
  const deathOnly = deaths.filter(e => e.type === 'death');

  const maleDeaths = deathOnly.reduce((s, e) => s + Math.abs(Math.min(0, e.delta.male)), 0);
  const femaleDeaths = deathOnly.reduce((s, e) => s + Math.abs(Math.min(0, e.delta.female)), 0);
  const unknownDeaths = deathOnly.reduce((s, e) => s + Math.abs(Math.min(0, e.delta.unknown)), 0);

  const im = initialMale ?? 0;
  const iff = initialFemale ?? 0;

  const hasData = im > 0 || iff > 0;

  return {
    male: { deaths: maleDeaths, initial: im, rate: im > 0 ? (maleDeaths / im) * 100 : 0 },
    female: { deaths: femaleDeaths, initial: iff, rate: iff > 0 ? (femaleDeaths / iff) * 100 : 0 },
    unknown: { deaths: unknownDeaths },
    hasData,
  };
}

/** toneFromRate — رنگ بر اساس نرخ */
export function toneFromRate(rate: number): string {
  if (rate >= 20) return 'var(--danger)';
  if (rate >= 10) return 'var(--warn)';
  return 'var(--text)';
}

// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// فاز ۷.۴ — وزن به تفکیک جنسیت
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export interface SexWeightStat {
  avg: number;
  count: number;
  cv: number;
  hasData: boolean;
}

export interface WeightBySex {
  male: SexWeightStat;
  female: SexWeightStat;
  mixed: SexWeightStat;
  delta: number | null;
  hasData: boolean;
}

/**
 * weightBySexFromLogs — جمع وزن‌سنجی‌های یک گله به تفکیک جنسیت
 * منبع: dlg logs — هر log دارای weightSamples[] + weightGender
 */
export function weightBySexFromLogs(logs: any[], flockId: string): WeightBySex {
  const male: number[] = [];
  const female: number[] = [];
  const mixed: number[] = [];

  for (const log of logs || []) {
    if (log.flockId !== flockId) continue;
    if (!log.weightSamples || log.weightSamples.length === 0) continue;
    const gender = log.weightGender || 'mixed';
    const ws = (log.weightSamples as any[])
      .map(s => Number(s.weight))
      .filter(w => w > 0);
    if (gender === 'male') male.push(...ws);
    else if (gender === 'female') female.push(...ws);
    else mixed.push(...ws);
  }

  const stat = (arr: number[]): SexWeightStat => {
    if (arr.length === 0) return { avg: 0, count: 0, cv: 0, hasData: false };
    const mean = arr.reduce((a, w) => a + w, 0) / arr.length;
    const variance = arr.reduce((a, w) => a + Math.pow(w - mean, 2), 0) / arr.length;
    const std = Math.sqrt(variance);
    const cv = mean > 0 ? (std / mean) * 100 : 0;
    return {
      avg: Math.round(mean * 1000) / 1000,
      count: arr.length,
      cv: Math.round(cv * 10) / 10,
      hasData: true,
    };
  };

  const m = stat(male);
  const f = stat(female);
  const mx = stat(mixed);
  const hasData = m.hasData || f.hasData || mx.hasData;
  const delta = m.hasData && f.hasData
    ? Math.round((m.avg - f.avg) * 1000) / 1000
    : null;

  return { male: m, female: f, mixed: mx, delta, hasData };
}

// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// فاز ۸d — FCR engine
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
import type { ConsumptionAggregate } from './consumptionEventsCalc';

export interface FCRResult {
  fcr: number | null;
  confidence: 'exact' | 'standard' | 'insufficient';
  totalFeedKg: number;
  feedPerBird: number;
  totalLiveWeightKg: number | null;
  /** 🆕 افزایش وزن = وزن زنده − وزن اولیه جوجه‌ها (مبنای صحیح FCR) */
  totalGainKg?: number | null;
  source: string;
  note: string;
}

export function calculateFCR(
  consumption: ConsumptionAggregate,
  weightBySex: WeightBySex | null,
  flock: {
    currentCount?: number | null;
    maleCount?: number | null;
    femaleCount?: number | null;
    unknownCount?: number | null;
    /** 🆕 وزن اولیه جوجه (kg) — پیش‌فرض 0.04 */
    chickWeight?: number | null;
  },
  standardFCR?: number | null,
): FCRResult {
  const totalFeedKg = consumption.totalFeedKg || 0;
  const currentCount = flock.currentCount || 0;
  const feedPerBird = currentCount > 0 ? totalFeedKg / currentCount : 0;
  const r2 = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100;

  if (totalFeedKg <= 0) {
    return {
      fcr: null, confidence: 'insufficient', totalFeedKg: 0,
      feedPerBird: 0, totalLiveWeightKg: null,
      source: 'بدون ثبت دان', note: '',
    };
  }

  // try exact from weight
  let totalLiveWeight = 0;
  let weightComplete = false;
  if (weightBySex && weightBySex.hasData) {
    const m = flock.maleCount ?? 0;
    const f = flock.femaleCount ?? 0;
    const u = flock.unknownCount ?? 0;
    if (weightBySex.male.hasData && m > 0) totalLiveWeight += weightBySex.male.avg * m;
    if (weightBySex.female.hasData && f > 0) totalLiveWeight += weightBySex.female.avg * f;
    if (weightBySex.mixed.hasData && u > 0) totalLiveWeight += weightBySex.mixed.avg * u;
    const okM = m === 0 || weightBySex.male.hasData;
    const okF = f === 0 || weightBySex.female.hasData;
    const okU = u === 0 || weightBySex.mixed.hasData;
    weightComplete = okM && okF && okU && totalLiveWeight > 0;
  }

  if (weightComplete) {
    // 🆕 FCR استاندارد: دان ÷ افزایش وزن (نه وزن زنده)
    const initialTotalKg = (flock.chickWeight ?? 0.04) * currentCount;
    const totalGainKg = totalLiveWeight - initialTotalKg;

    if (totalGainKg <= 0) {
      return {
        fcr: null,
        confidence: 'insufficient',
        totalFeedKg: r2(totalFeedKg),
        feedPerBird: r2(feedPerBird),
        totalLiveWeightKg: r2(totalLiveWeight),
        totalGainKg: 0,
        source: 'افزایش وزن صفر یا منفی',
        note: 'وزن فعلی کمتر از وزن اولیه جوجه‌ها — FCR قابل محاسبه نیست',
      };
    }

    return {
      fcr: r2(totalFeedKg / totalGainKg),
      confidence: 'exact',
      totalFeedKg: r2(totalFeedKg),
      feedPerBird: r2(feedPerBird),
      totalLiveWeightKg: r2(totalLiveWeight),
      totalGainKg: r2(totalGainKg),
      source: 'دان + وزن واقعی',
      note: `FCR = ${r2(totalFeedKg)}kg دان ÷ ${r2(totalGainKg)}kg افزایش وزن`,
    };
  }

  if (standardFCR && standardFCR > 0) {
    return {
      fcr: r2(standardFCR),
      confidence: 'standard',
      totalFeedKg: r2(totalFeedKg),
      feedPerBird: r2(feedPerBird),
      totalLiveWeightKg: null,
      source: 'استاندارد نژاد',
      note: 'وزن واقعی موجود نیست — FCR استاندارد نمایش داده می‌شود',
    };
  }

  return {
    fcr: null, confidence: 'insufficient',
    totalFeedKg: r2(totalFeedKg),
    feedPerBird: r2(feedPerBird),
    totalLiveWeightKg: null,
    source: 'دان فقط',
    note: 'وزن و استاندارد هر دو غایب',
  };
}

/**
 * helpers-sex.ts — helperهای مشترک فاز ۴b
 * استخراج منطق ساخت event فروش با sex صحیح
 */
import type { FlockEvent } from './types-store';
import type { FlockSexBalanceEvent } from './store';

export interface SaleEventInput {
  delta: number;
  maleCount?: number | null;
  femaleCount?: number | null;
  unknownCount?: number | null;
  flockId: string;
  invoiceId: string;
  invoiceNumber?: string;
  partyId?: string;
  date: string;
  notes?: string;
  unitPrice?: number;
  totalPrice?: number;
}

/**
 * deriveSaleEvents — ساخت ۱ تا ۳ event فروش با sex صحیح
 *
 * منطق (مطابق ROADMAP Invariant #2 + sexBalanceEvents):
 * - اگر maleCount/femaleCount/unknownCount داده شده: تا ۳ event جدا
 * - اگر هیچ‌کدام داده نشده (unsplit): ۱ event با sex='mixed'
 * - sum(events.count) === delta
 * - اولویت fallback: male → female → unknown → mixed (مطابق pre-flight B1)
 */
export function deriveSaleEvents(input: SaleEventInput): FlockEvent[] {
  const { delta } = input;
  if (delta <= 0) return [];

  const mD = Number(input.maleCount || 0);
  const fD = Number(input.femaleCount || 0);
  const uD = Number(input.unknownCount || 0);
  const gSum = mD + fD + uD;

  const common = {
    flockId: input.flockId,
    date: input.date,
    type: 'sell' as const,
    direction: -1 as const,
    buyerId: input.partyId,
    unitPrice: input.unitPrice,
    totalPrice: input.totalPrice,
    invoiceId: input.invoiceId,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  // unsplit → ۱ event mixed
  if (gSum === 0) {
    return [{
      id: `sell-${input.invoiceId}-${input.flockId}-mixed-${Date.now()}`,
      ...common,
      count: delta,
      sex: 'mixed',
      notes: input.notes || `فروش از فاکتور ${input.invoiceNumber || ''} (بدون تفکیک)`,
    } as FlockEvent];
  }

  // split → تا ۳ event جدا
  const events: FlockEvent[] = [];
  const safeM = Math.min(mD, delta);
  const safeF = Math.min(fD, delta - safeM);
  const safeU = Math.min(uD, delta - safeM - safeF);
  const rem = delta - safeM - safeF - safeU;

  const push = (sex: 'male' | 'female' | 'mixed', count: number) => {
    if (count <= 0) return;
    events.push({
      id: `sell-${input.invoiceId}-${input.flockId}-${sex}-${Date.now()}-${events.length}`,
      ...common,
      count,
      sex,
      notes: input.notes || `فروش از فاکتور ${input.invoiceNumber || ''} (${sex})`,
    } as FlockEvent);
  };

  push('male', safeM);
  push('female', safeF);
  push('mixed', safeU + rem);

  return events;
}

/**
 * sumSexForFlock — جمع sex از items فاکتور برای یک flock مشخص
 */
export function sumSexForFlock(items: any[], flockId: string) {
  let m = 0, f = 0, u = 0;
  for (const it of items || []) {
    if (it.flockId !== flockId) continue;
    m += Number(it.maleCount || 0);
    f += Number(it.femaleCount || 0);
    u += Number(it.unknownCount || 0);
  }
  return { male: m, female: f, unknown: u };
}


// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// B3 — audit helper (sexBalanceEvents)
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export interface SaleAuditInput {
  flockBefore: { male: number; female: number; unknown: number };
  flockAfter: { male: number; female: number; unknown: number };
  date: string;
  note?: string;
}

export function buildSaleAudit(params: SaleAuditInput): FlockSexBalanceEvent {
  return {
    id: `sale-audit-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`,
    date: params.date,
    type: 'sale',
    before: params.flockBefore,
    after: params.flockAfter,
    delta: {
      male: params.flockAfter.male - params.flockBefore.male,
      female: params.flockAfter.female - params.flockBefore.female,
      unknown: params.flockAfter.unknown - params.flockBefore.unknown,
    },
    note: params.note,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

/**
