import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { toFa, toEn } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { parse, differenceInDays, differenceInCalendarDays } from 'date-fns-jalali';
import { todayJ } from './api/flocksCalc';
import type { Flock, FlockType, FlockStatus, FlockGroupRule } from './store';
import { useTra } from '../tra/store';

export const TYPE_LABEL: Record<FlockType, string> = { layer: 'تخم‌گذار', broiler: 'گوشتی', breeder: 'مادر' };
export const STATUS_LABEL: Record<FlockStatus, string> = { active: 'فعال', archived: 'آرشیو', sold: 'فروخته‌شده', merged: 'ادغام‌شده' };
export const SOURCE_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { purchase: 'خریداری', hatch: 'جوجه‌کشی خودم' };

export const EVENT_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  add: 'افزودن', sell: 'فروش', death: 'تلفات',
  transfer: 'انتقال', correction: 'اصلاح', cull: 'حذف',
};

export function toJalali(iso: string): string {
  if (!iso) return '';
  if (/^\d{4}\/\d{2}\/\d{2}/.test(iso)) return iso;
  try {
    const d = new Date(iso);
    const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-u-ca-persian-nu-latn', { year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).formatToParts(d);
    const y = parts.find(p => p.type === 'year')?.value || '';
    const m = parts.find(p => p.type === 'month')?.value || '';
    const dd = parts.find(p => p.type === 'day')?.value || '';
    return y + '/' + m + '/' + dd;
  } catch { return iso; }
}

export function jalaliToDate(s: string): Date | null {
  if (!s) return null;
  const en = toEn(s).replace(/\//g, '/');
  const parts = en.split('/').map(p => parseInt(p));
  if (parts.length !== 3 || parts.some(isNaN)) return null;
  try {
    const d = parse(`${parts[0]}/${String(parts[1]).padStart(2,'0')}/${String(parts[2]).padStart(2,'0')}`, 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
    return d;
  } catch { return null; }
}

/** تاریخ مؤثر برای محاسبه سن — هچ، اگر نبود خرید، اگر نبود شروع */
export function getEffectiveStartDate(f: Flock): string {
  return f.hatchDate || f.purchaseDate || f.startDate;
}

export function getAgeDays(f: Flock): number {
  const d = jalaliToDate(getEffectiveStartDate(f));
  if (!d) return 0;
  return Math.max(0, differenceInDays(new Date(), d));
}

/** سن پرنده در تاریخ مشخص (برای snapshot در ثبت روزانه) */
export function getBirdAgeAt(f: Flock, targetDate: string): number {
  const start = jalaliToDate(getEffectiveStartDate(f));
  const target = jalaliToDate(targetDate);
  if (!start || !target) return 0;
  return Math.max(0, differenceInDays(target, start));
}

export function matchesGroupRule(flock: Flock, rule: FlockGroupRule): boolean {
  if (rule.type && flock.type !== rule.type) return false;
  if (rule.status && flock.status !== rule.status) return false;
  if (rule.hallId && flock.hallId !== rule.hallId) return false;
  if (rule.breedId && flock.breedId !== rule.breedId) return false;
  if (rule.birdId && flock.birdId !== rule.birdId) return false;
  if (rule.source && flock.source !== rule.source) return false;
  if (rule.dealType && flock.dealType !== rule.dealType) return false;
  if (rule.minAge !== undefined || rule.maxAge !== undefined) {
    const age = getAgeDays(flock);
    if (rule.minAge !== undefined && age < rule.minAge) return false;
    if (rule.maxAge !== undefined && age > rule.maxAge) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

export interface Lifecycle {
  stage: string; label: string;
  color: 'blue' | 'amber' | 'green' | 'gray';
  progress: number;
}

export function getLifecycle(
  type: FlockType,
  ageDays: number,
  endOfCycleDay?: number | null,
  birdCycleDays?: number | null,
  layingStartDay?: number | null,
): Lifecycle {
  // 🆕 fallback برای type نامعتبر (legacy/import)
  if (type !== 'layer' && type !== 'broiler' && type !== 'breeder') {
    type = 'layer';
  }

  // اولویت: endOfCycleDay گله > cycleDays پرنده > پیش‌فرض صنعتی
  const cycle =
    (endOfCycleDay && endOfCycleDay > 0) ? endOfCycleDay :
    (birdCycleDays && birdCycleDays > 0) ? birdCycleDays :
    (type === 'broiler' ? 42 : 700);
  const p = (ageDays / cycle) * 100;

  if (type === 'broiler') {
    if (ageDays <= 7) return { stage: 'chick', label: 'دوره آغازین', color: 'blue', progress: p };
    if (ageDays <= 21) return { stage: 'growing', label: 'دوره رشد', color: 'blue', progress: p };
    if (ageDays <= cycle) return { stage: 'finisher', label: 'دوره پایانی', color: 'amber', progress: p };
    return { stage: 'end', label: 'پایان دوره', color: 'gray', progress: 100 };
  }

  const start = layingStartDay && layingStartDay > 0 ? layingStartDay : 140;
  if (ageDays <= 28) return { stage: 'chick', label: 'جوجه', color: 'green', progress: p };
  if (ageDays <= start - 14) return { stage: 'grower', label: 'نیمچه', color: 'blue', progress: p };
  if (ageDays <= start) return { stage: 'prelayer', label: 'پیش‌تخم‌گذار', color: 'amber', progress: p };
  if (ageDays <= cycle) return { stage: 'layer', label: 'تخم‌گذار', color: 'green', progress: p };
  return { stage: 'end', label: 'پایان دوره', color: 'gray', progress: 100 };
}

export function formatAge(days: number): string {
  if (days < 7) return `${days} روز`;
  if (days < 30) return `${Math.floor(days / 7)} هفته`;
  if (days < 365) return `${Math.floor(days / 30)} ماه`;
  return `${Math.floor(days / 365)} سال`;
}

export function sexRatio(male: number | null, female: number | null): string {
  if (male == null || female == null) return '—';
  if (male === 0 && female === 0) return '—';
  if (male === 0) return `۰ : ${getGlobalFormat().count(female)}`;
  if (female === 0) return `${getGlobalFormat().count(male)} : ۰`;
  const r = female / male;
  if (r >= 1) {
    return `${getGlobalFormat().count(1)} : ${getGlobalFormat().count(Math.round(r))}`;
  }
  const inv = male / female;
  return `${getGlobalFormat().count(Math.round(inv))} : ${getGlobalFormat().count(1)}`;
}

/** سن پیش‌فرض تخم‌گذاری (اگه استاندارد نژاد موجود نبود) — استاندارد ایران */
export const DEFAULT_LAYING_START = 150;

/** سن شروع تخم‌گذاری این گله — اگر کاربر پر کرده، آن، وگرنه پیش‌فرض */
export function getLayingStartDay(f: Flock, fallback = DEFAULT_LAYING_START): number {
  if (f.layingStartDay && f.layingStartDay > 0) return f.layingStartDay;
  return fallback;
}

export function isLayingReady(f: Flock): boolean {
  if (f.type !== 'layer' && f.type !== 'breeder') return true;
  return getAgeDays(f) >= getLayingStartDay(f);
}

export function daysUntilLaying(f: Flock): number {
  if (f.type !== 'layer' && f.type !== 'breeder') return 0;
  return Math.max(0, getLayingStartDay(f) - getAgeDays(f));
}

function _toEnDigits(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));
}

function _daysBetween(start: string, end: string): number {
  if (!start || !end) return 0;
  try {
    const s = parse(_toEnDigits(start), 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    const e = parse(_toEnDigits(end), 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    if (isNaN(s.getTime()) || isNaN(e.getTime())) return 0;
    return Math.max(0, differenceInDays(e, s));
  } catch { return 0; }
}

export interface RentAccrual {
  owed: number;
  paid: number;
  outstanding: number;
  daysElapsed: number;
  totalDays: number;
  isActive: boolean;
}

/** محاسبه اجاره انباشته (Owed) بر اساس روزهای سپری‌شده */
export function calcRentAccrual(f: Flock): RentAccrual {
  const zero: RentAccrual = { owed: 0, paid: 0, outstanding: 0, daysElapsed: 0, totalDays: 0, isActive: false };
  if ((f as any).dealType !== 'rent') return zero;

  const dd = (f as any).dealData || {};
  const rentAmount = Number(dd.rentAmount) || 0;
  if (rentAmount <= 0) return zero;

  const period: 'monthly' | 'season' | 'total' = dd.rentPeriod || 'monthly';
  const startDate = dd.rentStartDate || f.startDate || f.purchaseDate || '';
  const endDate = dd.rentEndDate || '';

  const isActive = f.status === 'active';
  const effectiveEnd = f.status === 'active' ? todayJ() : (f.endDate || todayJ());

  if (!startDate) return zero;

  const daysElapsed = _daysBetween(startDate, effectiveEnd);
  let owed = 0;
  let totalDays = daysElapsed;

  if (period === 'total') {
    if (endDate) {
      totalDays = _daysBetween(startDate, endDate);
      owed = totalDays > 0 ? Math.round(rentAmount * Math.min(daysElapsed, totalDays) / totalDays) : rentAmount;
    } else {
      owed = rentAmount;
    }
  } else {
    const periodDays = period === 'season' ? 90 : 30;
    owed = rentAmount * Math.floor(daysElapsed / periodDays);
  }

  const paid = (dd.rentPayments || []).reduce((a: number, p: any) => a + (Number(p.amount) || 0), 0);
  const outstanding = Math.max(0, owed - paid);

  return { owed, paid, outstanding, daysElapsed, totalDays, isActive };
}

/** محاسبه‌ی هزینه‌ها — شامل هزینه‌های عملیاتی (دان، دارو، داروی گیاهی، واکسن) */
export function calcCosts(f: Flock) {
  const birdCost = (f.initialCount || 0) * (f.purchasePrice || 0);
  const delivery = f.deliveryCost || 0;
  const other = f.otherCosts || 0;
  const purchaseTotal = birdCost + delivery + other;

  const rentInfo = calcRentAccrual(f);
  const rentOwed = rentInfo.owed;
  const rentPaid = rentInfo.paid;

  // 🆕 هزینه‌های عملیاتی از فاکتورهای مرتبط با این گله
  const opBreakdown = { feed: 0, medicine: 0, herbal: 0, vaccine: 0 };
  let operationalCost = 0;
  try {
    const invoices = useTra.getState().invoices || [];
    for (const inv of invoices as any[]) {
      if (inv.type !== 'purchase') continue;
      const relatedFlockId = inv.relatedFlockId || '';
      for (const it of inv.items || []) {
        const isRelated = (it.flockId && it.flockId === f.id) || relatedFlockId === f.id;
        if (!isRelated) continue;
        const cat = it.category || inv.category;
        if (!(cat in opBreakdown)) continue;
        const amt = Number(it.total) || 0;
        (opBreakdown as any)[cat] += amt;
        operationalCost += amt;
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[calcCosts] opCost failed:', e);
  }

  const grandTotalOwed = purchaseTotal + rentOwed + operationalCost;
  const grandTotalPaid = purchaseTotal + rentPaid;
  const perBird = f.initialCount ? purchaseTotal / f.initialCount : 0;
  const perBirdGrand = f.initialCount ? grandTotalOwed / f.initialCount : 0;

  return {
    birdCost, delivery, other,
    total: purchaseTotal,       // backward-compat
    purchaseTotal,
    rentOwed,
    rentPaid,
    rentInfo,
    operationalCost,            // 🆕
    opBreakdown,                // 🆕
    grandTotalOwed,
    grandTotalPaid,
    perBird,
    perBirdGrand,
  };
}

import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
export { Row, RowGrid } from '../../shr/components/ui';



export function DepBox({ title, children, tone = 'accent' }: { title: string; children: ReactNode; tone?: 'accent' | 'purple' }) {
  const c = tone === 'purple' ? 'var(--purple)' : 'var(--accent)';
  const s = tone === 'purple' ? 'var(--purple-soft)' : 'var(--accent-soft)';
  const b = tone === 'purple' ? 'var(--purple)' : 'var(--accent-border)';
  return (
    <div style={{ background: s, border: `1px dashed ${b}`, borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', padding: 'var(--sp-3)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--sp-3)', marginTop: 4 }}>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: c, fontWeight: 700, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--sp-2)', paddingBottom: 'var(--sp-2)', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)' }}>

        {title}
      </div>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}


/**
 * computeFlockConsumption — هزینه انباشته مصرف یک گله از انبار
 * از whs.movements[flockId] + reason='consumption' + type='out'
 */
export interface FlockConsumptionBucket {
  total: number;
  cost: number;
  count: number;
}

export interface FlockConsumption {
  feed: FlockConsumptionBucket;
  medicine: FlockConsumptionBucket;
  herbal: FlockConsumptionBucket;
  vaccine: FlockConsumptionBucket;
  other: FlockConsumptionBucket;
  totalCost: number;
}

const emptyBucket = (): FlockConsumptionBucket => ({ total: 0, cost: 0, count: 0 });

export function computeFlockConsumption(
  flockId: string,
  movements: Array<{ flockId?: string; itemId: string; type: string; reason: string; quantity: number; unitPrice: number }>,
  items: Array<{ id: string; name: string; category: string; lastPrice?: number; avgPrice?: number }>,
): FlockConsumption {
  const result: FlockConsumption = {
    feed: emptyBucket(),
    medicine: emptyBucket(),
    herbal: emptyBucket(),
    vaccine: emptyBucket(),
    other: emptyBucket(),
    totalCost: 0,
  };
  if (!flockId) return result;

  const itemMap = new Map(items.map(i => [i.id, i]));

  for (const m of movements) {
    if (m.flockId !== flockId) continue;
    if (m.type !== 'out') continue;
    if (m.reason !== 'consumption') continue;

    const item = itemMap.get(m.itemId);
    const price = Number(m.unitPrice) || Number(item?.lastPrice) || Number(item?.avgPrice) || 0;
    const qty = Number(m.quantity) || 0;
    const cost = price * qty;

    const cat = item?.category || 'other';
    let bucket: 'feed' | 'medicine' | 'herbal' | 'vaccine' | 'other' = 'other';
    if (cat === 'feed' || cat === 'concentrate') bucket = 'feed';
    else if (cat === 'medicine') bucket = 'medicine';
    else if (cat === 'herbal') bucket = 'herbal';
    else if (cat === 'vaccine') bucket = 'vaccine';

    result[bucket].total += qty;
    result[bucket].cost += cost;
    result[bucket].count += 1;
    result.totalCost += cost;
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * useFlocksForm — state و منطق فرم گله

import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { toFa, toEn } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { toastMsg } from '../../../cor/store/toast';
import { logAction } from '../../../cor/logger/auditLog';
import { recordHistory } from '../../../shr/intelligence';
import { DEFAULT_LAYING_START } from '../store';
import type { Flock } from '../store';
import { useTra } from '../../tra/store';
import type { Bird, Breed } from '../../brd/store';
import type { Hall } from '../../hal/store';
import type { useBreedStandard } from '../../../shr/hooks/useBreedStandard';

type BreedStd = ReturnType<typeof useBreedStandard>;
import type { F } from '../types-flocks';
import { emptyForm } from '../types-flocks';

export interface UseFlocksFormParams {
  birds: Bird[];
  halls: Hall[];
  flocks: Flock[];
  breedStd: BreedStd;
  add: (f: Omit<Flock, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>) => string;
  update: (id: string, patch: Partial<Flock>) => void;
}

export function useFlocksForm({ birds, halls, flocks, breedStd, add, update }: UseFlocksFormParams) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<F>(emptyForm());
  const [layingFromStd, setLayingFromStd] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');

  const num = (s: string) => s ? parseFloat(toEn(s).replace('٫', '.')) || null : null;
  const int = (s: string) => s ? parseInt(toEn(s)) || null : null;

  const openNew = () => {
    if (birds.length === 0) { toastMsg.error('اول پرنده بسازید'); return; }
    if (halls.length === 0) { toastMsg.error('اول سالن بسازید'); return; }
    const lastF = flocks.slice().sort((a, b) => (b.startDate || '').localeCompare(a.startDate || ''))[0];
    setForm({
      ...emptyForm(),
      birdId: lastF?.birdId || birds[0].id,
      hallId: lastF?.hallId || halls[0].id,
      ...(lastF?.breedId ? { breedId: lastF.breedId } : {}),
    });
    setLayingFromStd(false);
    setErr(''); setOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (f: Flock) => {
    setForm({
      id: f.id, name: f.name, type: f.type, birdId: f.birdId, breedId: f.breedId,
      hallId: f.hallId, zoneId: f.zoneId,
      initialCount: f.initialCount ? fmt.raw.digits(String(f.initialCount), fmt.units.numberFormat) : '',
      currentCount: f.currentCount ? fmt.raw.digits(String(f.currentCount), fmt.units.numberFormat) : '',
      maleCount: f.maleCount ? fmt.raw.digits(String(f.maleCount), fmt.units.numberFormat) : '',
      femaleCount: f.femaleCount ? fmt.raw.digits(String(f.femaleCount), fmt.units.numberFormat) : '',
      unknownCount: f.unknownCount ? fmt.raw.digits(String(f.unknownCount), fmt.units.numberFormat) : '',
      layingStartDay: f.layingStartDay ? fmt.raw.digits(String(f.layingStartDay), fmt.units.numberFormat) : '',
      endOfCycleDay: f.endOfCycleDay ? fmt.raw.digits(String(f.endOfCycleDay), fmt.units.numberFormat) : '',
      vaccineScheduleId: f.vaccineScheduleId || '',
      hatchDate: f.hatchDate || '', purchaseDate: f.purchaseDate || '', startDate: f.startDate || '',
      source: f.source,
      purchasePrice: f.purchasePrice ? fmt.raw.digits(String(f.purchasePrice), fmt.units.numberFormat) : '',
      deliveryCost: f.deliveryCost ? fmt.raw.digits(String(f.deliveryCost), fmt.units.numberFormat) : '',
      otherCosts: f.otherCosts ? fmt.raw.digits(String(f.otherCosts), fmt.units.numberFormat) : '',
      status: f.status, notes: f.notes,
      dealType: f.dealType || 'own',
      partnerId: f.dealData?.partnerId || '',
      partnerShare: f.dealData?.partnerShare ? fmt.raw.digits(String(f.dealData.partnerShare), fmt.units.numberFormat) : '',
      consignorId: f.dealData?.consignorId || '',
      lessorId: f.dealData?.lessorId || '',
      rentAmount: f.dealData?.rentAmount ? fmt.raw.digits(String(f.dealData.rentAmount), fmt.units.numberFormat) : '',
      rentStartDate: f.dealData?.rentStartDate || f.startDate || '',
      rentEndDate: f.dealData?.rentEndDate || '',
      rentPayments: f.dealData?.rentPayments || [],
      rentPeriod: f.dealData?.rentPeriod || 'monthly',
      dealId: f.dealData?.dealId || '',
      sourceInvoiceId: f.sourceInvoiceId || '',
      hatchId: f.hatchId || ''
    });
    setLayingFromStd(false);
    setErr(''); setOpen(true);
  };

  const save = async () => {
    // Validation منتقل‌شده به Zod (rules/flk.ts superRefine):
    //   name، initialCount>0، currentCount>initialCount، breeder sum،
    //   birdId، deal rules، at-least-one-date، cross-dates، future purchase/hatch.
    // فقط store-dependent اینجا می‌مانند: نام تکراری در سالن، breed purpose mismatch،
    // و startDate در آینده (این یکی هنوز در Zod نیست — TODO).

    const dup = flocks.find(f =>
      f.id !== form.id &&
      (f.hallId || '') === (form.hallId || '') &&
      f.name.trim() === form.name.trim()
    );
    if (dup) {
      setErr('گله‌ای با همین نام در این سالن وجود دارد. نام دیگری انتخاب کنید.');
      return;
    }



    // breed/purpose mismatch به Zod منتقل شد (rules/flk.ts superRefine)
    // 🆕 Deal validation

    // 🆕 تعداد اولیه > ۰

    // 🆕 breeder: male + female > initial (block) — موجود
    // ⚠️ warning برای < initial در UI هست، اینجا بلاک نمی‌کنیم

    // 🆕 Backfill birdId/breedId from source invoice if empty
    let resolvedBirdId = form.birdId;
    let resolvedBreedId = form.breedId;
    if (form.sourceInvoiceId && (!resolvedBirdId || !resolvedBreedId)) {
      try {
        const inv = useTra.getState().invoices.find((i: any) => i.id === form.sourceInvoiceId);
        const srcItem = inv?.items?.find((it: any) => it.birdId || it.breedId);
        if (srcItem) {
          if (!resolvedBirdId && srcItem.birdId) resolvedBirdId = srcItem.birdId;
          if (!resolvedBreedId && srcItem.breedId) resolvedBreedId = srcItem.breedId;
        }
      } catch (e) { console.warn('[flk save] source-invoice backfill failed:', e); }
    }

    const data = {
      name: form.name.trim(), type: form.type,
      birdId: resolvedBirdId, breedId: resolvedBreedId,
      hallId: form.hallId, zoneId: form.zoneId,
      initialCount: int(form.initialCount),
      currentCount: int(form.currentCount) || int(form.initialCount),
      layingStartDay: (form.type === 'layer' || form.type === 'breeder')
        ? (form.layingStartDay.trim() === ''
            ? (breedStd.byBreedId(form.breedId)?.biology?.layingStartDay ?? DEFAULT_LAYING_START)
            : (int(form.layingStartDay) || DEFAULT_LAYING_START))
        : 0,
      endOfCycleDay: (form.type === 'layer' || form.type === 'breeder')
        ? (form.endOfCycleDay && form.endOfCycleDay.trim() !== ''
            ? (int(form.endOfCycleDay) || null)
            : (breedStd.byBreedId(form.breedId)?.biology?.endOfCycleDay ?? null))
        : null,
      maleCount: form.type === 'breeder' ? int(form.maleCount) : null,
      femaleCount: form.type === 'breeder' ? int(form.femaleCount) : null,
      unknownCount: int(form.unknownCount || '') || null,
      hatchDate: form.hatchDate.trim(), purchaseDate: form.purchaseDate.trim(),
      startDate: form.startDate.trim(), source: form.source,
      purchasePrice: num(form.purchasePrice),
      deliveryCost: num(form.deliveryCost),
      otherCosts: num(form.otherCosts),
      vaccineScheduleId: form.vaccineScheduleId,
      status: form.status, notes: form.notes.trim(),
      dealType: (form.dealType || 'own') as 'own' | 'partnership' | 'consignment' | 'rent',
      dealData: (form.dealType || 'own') === 'own' ? undefined : {
        partnerId: form.dealType === 'partnership' ? form.partnerId : undefined,
        partnerShare: form.dealType === 'partnership' ? (int(form.partnerShare) || undefined) : undefined,
        consignorId: form.dealType === 'consignment' ? form.consignorId : undefined,
        lessorId: form.dealType === 'rent' ? form.lessorId : undefined,
        rentAmount: form.dealType === 'rent' ? (num(form.rentAmount) || undefined) : undefined,
        rentPeriod: form.dealType === 'rent' ? ((form.rentPeriod || 'monthly') as 'monthly' | 'season' | 'total') : undefined,
        rentStartDate: form.dealType === 'rent' ? (form.rentStartDate || undefined) : undefined,
        rentEndDate: form.dealType === 'rent' ? (form.rentEndDate || undefined) : undefined,
        rentPayments: form.dealType === 'rent' ? (form.rentPayments || []) : undefined,
        dealId: form.dealId || undefined,
      },
    };

    // 🆕 حذف شده — warning به صورت inline در Modal نمایش داده می‌شه
    // (کاربر آزاده بیش از ظرفیت ثبت کنه)

    let savedId = form.id || '';
    let isNew = false;
    if (form.id) {
      update(form.id, data);
      logAction('update', 'flk', 'ویرایش گله: ' + data.name);
    } else {
      savedId = add(data);
      isNew = true;
      logAction('add', 'flk', 'افزودن گله: ' + data.name + ' (' + (data.initialCount || 0) + ' پرنده)');
    }
    // 🆕 ثبت تاریخچه هوش مصنوعی (null-safe)
    try {
      if (form.dealType === 'rent') {
        const rentAmt = num(form.rentAmount);
        if (rentAmt !== null && rentAmt > 0) {
          recordHistory('flk.rentAmount', rentAmt, {});
        }
      }
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[flk save] recordHistory failed:', e); }

    setOpen(false);
    return { id: savedId, isNew };
  };

  return {
    open, setOpen, form, setForm, layingFromStd, setLayingFromStd, err, setErr,
    num, int, openNew, openEdit, save,
  };
}

/**
 * useFlocksKpi — محاسبه KPI گله‌ها
 * الگو: هم‌راستا با hal (۳ کارت پایه)
 */
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import type { Flock } from '../store';

export interface FlocksKpi {
  totalFlocks: number;
  totalBirds: number;
  totalValue: number;
}

export function useFlocksKpi(flocks: Flock[]): FlocksKpi {
  return useMemo(() => {
    // همه گله‌های زنده (بدون archive/sold)
    const live = flocks.filter(f => f.status !== 'archived' && f.status !== 'sold' && !f.paused);

    const totalBirds = live.reduce((sum, f) => sum + (f.currentCount || f.initialCount || 0), 0);

    const totalValue = live.reduce((sum, f) => {
      const count = f.initialCount || 0;
      const price = f.purchasePrice || 0;
      return sum + (count * price);
    }, 0);

    return {
      totalFlocks: live.length,
      totalBirds,
      totalValue,
    };
  }, [flocks]);
}

FILE: ./src/mod/flk/hooks/useGroupKpi.ts

/**
 * useGroupKpi.ts — محاسبه KPI تجمیعی یک گروه
 * از source of truth موجود (flk + tra) استفاده می‌کنه
 */
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useFlk, calcCosts, getAgeDays, type Flock, type FlockStatus, type FlockType } from '../store';
import { useTra } from '../../tra/store';
import { useEgg } from '../../egg/store';
import { useDlg } from '../../dlg/store';
import { applyCorrections } from '../../dlg/api/applyCorrections';
import { useWhs } from '../../whs/store';
import { getFlockRevenue } from '../api/flocksCalc';
import { sexRatio } from '../helpers-store';

export interface GroupFlockRow {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: FlockType;
  status: FlockStatus;
  currentCount: number;
  initialCount: number;
  ageDays: number;
  cost: number;
  revenue: number;
  profit: number;
  maleCount: number;
  femaleCount: number;
  unknownCount: number;
  sexRatio: string;
  profitPerMale: number | null;
  profitPerFemale: number | null;
}

export interface GroupKpi {
  flockCount: number;
  liveFlockCount: number;
  totalInitial: number;
  totalCurrent: number;
  totalDeaths: number;
  /** 🆕 فاز ۶ — aggregate sex */
  totalMale: number;
  totalFemale: number;
  totalUnknown: number;
  mortalityRate: number;
  totalCost: number;
  totalRevenue: number;
  totalProfit: number;
  /** 🆕 مجموع تخم تولیدی (totalCount) */
  totalEggs: number;
  /** 🆕 مجموع دان مصرفی (kg) */
  totalFeed: number;
  /** 🆕 تخم به تفکیک هر گله */
  eggByFlock: Record<string, number>;
  /** 🆕 دان به تفکیک هر گله */
  feedByFlock: Record<string, number>;
  byFlock: GroupFlockRow[];
}

const EMPTY: GroupKpi = {
  flockCount: 0,
  liveFlockCount: 0,
  totalInitial: 0,
  totalCurrent: 0,
  totalDeaths: 0,
  totalMale: 0,
  totalFemale: 0,
  totalUnknown: 0,
  mortalityRate: 0,
  totalCost: 0,
  totalRevenue: 0,
  totalProfit: 0,
  totalEggs: 0,
  totalFeed: 0,
  eggByFlock: {},
  feedByFlock: {},
  byFlock: [],
};

export function useGroupKpi(groupId: string): GroupKpi {
  const groups = useFlk(s => s.groups);
  const getFlocksInGroup = useFlk(s => s.getFlocksInGroup);
  const invoices = useTra(s => s.invoices);
  const eggProductions = useEgg(s => s.productions);
  const rawDlgLogs = useDlg(s => s.logs);
  const dlgLogs = useMemo(() => rawDlgLogs.map(applyCorrections), [rawDlgLogs]);
  const movements = useWhs(s => s.movements);
  const whsItems = useWhs(s => s.items);

  return useMemo(() => {
    const group = groups.find(g => g.id === groupId);
    if (!group) return EMPTY;

    const flocks: Flock[] = getFlocksInGroup(groupId, true);
    if (flocks.length === 0) return EMPTY;

    // 🆕 هزینه جاری (خوراک/واکسن/دارو) از whs.movements
    const operationalCostByFlock: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const m of movements) {
      if (m.type !== 'out' || !m.flockId) continue;
      if (m.reason !== 'consumption') continue;
      const item = whsItems.find(i => i.id === m.itemId);
      const price = item?.avgPrice ?? item?.lastPrice ?? 0;
      operationalCostByFlock[m.flockId] = (operationalCostByFlock[m.flockId] || 0) + (m.quantity * price);
    }

    const byFlock: GroupFlockRow[] = flocks.map(f => {
      const costs = calcCosts(f);
      const opCost = operationalCostByFlock[f.id] || 0;
      const totalFlockCost = costs.grandTotalOwed + opCost;
      const revenue = getFlockRevenue(f.id, invoices);
      return {
        id: f.id,
        name: f.name,
        type: f.type,
        status: f.status,
        currentCount: f.currentCount || 0,
        initialCount: f.initialCount || 0,
        ageDays: getAgeDays(f),
        cost: totalFlockCost,
        revenue,
        profit: revenue - totalFlockCost,
        maleCount: f.maleCount || 0,
        femaleCount: f.femaleCount || 0,
        unknownCount: f.unknownCount || 0,
        sexRatio: (f.type === 'breeder' || f.type === 'layer')
          ? sexRatio(f.maleCount, f.femaleCount)
          : '—',
        profitPerMale: (f.type === 'breeder' || f.type === 'layer') && (f.maleCount || 0) > 0
          ? (revenue - totalFlockCost) / (f.maleCount || 1)
          : null,
        profitPerFemale: (f.type === 'breeder' || f.type === 'layer') && (f.femaleCount || 0) > 0
          ? (revenue - totalFlockCost) / (f.femaleCount || 1)
          : null,
      };
    });

    const live = byFlock.filter(f => f.status === 'active');
    const totalInitial = live.reduce((s, f) => s + f.initialCount, 0);
    const totalCurrent = live.reduce((s, f) => s + f.currentCount, 0);
    const totalMale = live.reduce((s, f) => s + (f.maleCount || 0), 0);
    const totalFemale = live.reduce((s, f) => s + (f.femaleCount || 0), 0);
    const totalUnknown = live.reduce((s, f) => s + (f.unknownCount || 0), 0);
    // 🆕 تلفات از events (death + cull) — نه از تفاوت initial/current
    const totalDeaths = live.reduce((sum, row) => {
      const flock = flocks.find(f => f.id === row.id);
      if (!flock) return sum;
      return sum + (flock.events || [])
        .filter(e => e.type === 'death' || e.type === 'cull')
        .reduce((s, e) => s + e.count, 0);
    }, 0);
    const mortalityRate = totalInitial > 0 ? (totalDeaths / totalInitial) * 100 : 0;

    const totalCost = byFlock.reduce((s, f) => s + f.cost, 0);
    const totalRevenue = byFlock.reduce((s, f) => s + f.revenue, 0);
    const totalProfit = totalRevenue - totalCost;

    // 🆕 Egg aggregate
    const flockIdSet = new Set(flocks.map(f => f.id));
    const eggByFlock: Record<string, number> = {};
    let totalEggs = 0;
    for (const p of eggProductions) {
      if (!flockIdSet.has(p.flockId)) continue;
      const cnt = p.totalCount || 0;
      if (cnt > 0) {
        eggByFlock[p.flockId] = (eggByFlock[p.flockId] || 0) + cnt;
        totalEggs += cnt;
      }
    }

    // 🆕 Feed aggregate (kg)
    const feedByFlock: Record<string, number> = {};
    let totalFeed = 0;
    for (const l of dlgLogs) {
      if (!flockIdSet.has(l.flockId)) continue;
      const amt = l.feedConsumed || l.feedDelivered || 0;
      if (amt > 0) {
        feedByFlock[l.flockId] = (feedByFlock[l.flockId] || 0) + amt;
        totalFeed += amt;
      }
    }

    return {
      flockCount: byFlock.length,
      liveFlockCount: live.length,
      totalInitial,
      totalCurrent,
      totalDeaths,
      totalMale,
      totalFemale,
      totalUnknown,
      mortalityRate,
      totalCost,
      totalRevenue,
      totalProfit,
      totalEggs,
      totalFeed,
      eggByFlock,
      feedByFlock,
      byFlock,
    };
  }, [groupId, groups, invoices, getFlocksInGroup, eggProductions, dlgLogs, movements, whsItems]);
}

/**
 * useMultiGroupKpi — چند گروه با هم (بدون violation of hooks rules)
 */
export function useMultiGroupKpi(groupIds: string[]): Record<string, GroupKpi> {
  const groups = useFlk(s => s.groups);
  const getFlocksInGroup = useFlk(s => s.getFlocksInGroup);
  const invoices = useTra(s => s.invoices);
  const eggProductions = useEgg(s => s.productions);
  const rawDlgLogs = useDlg(s => s.logs);
  const dlgLogs = useMemo(() => rawDlgLogs.map(applyCorrections), [rawDlgLogs]);

  return useMemo(() => {
    const result: Record<string, GroupKpi> = {};
    for (const groupId of groupIds) {
      const group = groups.find(g => g.id === groupId);
      if (!group) continue;
      const flocks: Flock[] = getFlocksInGroup(groupId, true);
      if (flocks.length === 0) continue;

      const byFlock: GroupFlockRow[] = flocks.map(f => {
        const costs = calcCosts(f);
        const revenue = getFlockRevenue(f.id, invoices);
        return {
          id: f.id, name: f.name, type: f.type, status: f.status,
          currentCount: f.currentCount || 0, initialCount: f.initialCount || 0,
          ageDays: getAgeDays(f), cost: costs.grandTotalOwed, revenue,
          profit: revenue - costs.grandTotalOwed,
          maleCount: f.maleCount || 0,
          femaleCount: f.femaleCount || 0,
          unknownCount: f.unknownCount || 0,
          sexRatio: (f.type === 'breeder' || f.type === 'layer')
            ? sexRatio(f.maleCount, f.femaleCount)
            : '—',
          profitPerMale: (f.type === 'breeder' || f.type === 'layer') && (f.maleCount || 0) > 0
            ? (revenue - costs.grandTotalOwed) / (f.maleCount || 1)
            : null,
          profitPerFemale: (f.type === 'breeder' || f.type === 'layer') && (f.femaleCount || 0) > 0
            ? (revenue - costs.grandTotalOwed) / (f.femaleCount || 1)
            : null,
        };
      });

      const live = byFlock.filter(f => f.status === 'active');
      const totalInitial = live.reduce((s, f) => s + f.initialCount, 0);
      const totalCurrent = live.reduce((s, f) => s + f.currentCount, 0);
      const totalDeaths = live.reduce((sum, row) => {
        const flock = flocks.find(f => f.id === row.id);
        if (!flock) return sum;
        return sum + (flock.events || [])
          .filter(e => e.type === 'death' || e.type === 'cull')
          .reduce((s, e) => s + e.count, 0);
      }, 0);
      const mortalityRate = totalInitial > 0 ? (totalDeaths / totalInitial) * 100 : 0;
      const totalCost = byFlock.reduce((s, f) => s + f.cost, 0);
      const totalRevenue = byFlock.reduce((s, f) => s + f.revenue, 0);
      // 🆕 فاز ۶ — aggregate sex (multi)
      const totalMale = live.reduce((s, f) => s + (f.maleCount || 0), 0);
      const totalFemale = live.reduce((s, f) => s + (f.femaleCount || 0), 0);
      const totalUnknown = live.reduce((s, f) => s + (f.unknownCount || 0), 0);

      // 🆕 Egg/Feed aggregate
      const flockIdSet = new Set(flocks.map(f => f.id));
      const eggByFlock: Record<string, number> = {};
      let totalEggs = 0;
      for (const p of eggProductions) {
        if (!flockIdSet.has(p.flockId)) continue;
        const cnt = p.totalCount || 0;
        if (cnt > 0) {
          eggByFlock[p.flockId] = (eggByFlock[p.flockId] || 0) + cnt;
          totalEggs += cnt;
        }
      }
      const feedByFlock: Record<string, number> = {};
      let totalFeed = 0;
      for (const l of dlgLogs) {
        if (!flockIdSet.has(l.flockId)) continue;
        const amt = l.feedConsumed || l.feedDelivered || 0;
        if (amt > 0) {
          feedByFlock[l.flockId] = (feedByFlock[l.flockId] || 0) + amt;
          totalFeed += amt;
        }
      }

      result[groupId] = {
        flockCount: byFlock.length, liveFlockCount: live.length,
        totalInitial, totalCurrent, totalDeaths,
        totalMale, totalFemale, totalUnknown,
        mortalityRate,
        totalCost, totalRevenue, totalProfit: totalRevenue - totalCost,
        totalEggs, totalFeed, eggByFlock, feedByFlock,
        byFlock,
      };
    }
    return result;
  }, [groupIds.join(','), groups, invoices, getFlocksInGroup, eggProductions, dlgLogs]);
}

/**
 * useTabBadge — نشانگر «آیتم جدید» روی Tab (۵ ثانیه)
 */
import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import type { TabId } from '../types-flocks';

export function useTabBadge() {
  const [badge, setBadge] = useState<TabId | null>(null);
  const timerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) window.clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const trigger = (tabId: TabId) => {
    if (timerRef.current) window.clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    setBadge(null);
    setTimeout(() => setBadge(tabId), 60);
    timerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => setBadge(null), 5000);
  };

  return { badge, trigger };
}

/**
 * migrations-feed-trigger.ts — trigger یک‌باره migration
 * فاز ۹b — از main.tsx بعد از hydration صدا زده می‌شود
 */
import { migrateFeedLogsToConsumption, buildExistingNotesSet } from './migrations-feed';
import type { ConsumptionEvent } from './types-store';

export const FEED_MIGRATION_FLAG_KEY = 'pm-feed-migrated-v1';

export interface FeedMigrationResult {
  ran: boolean;
  migrated: number;
  reason: 'already-done' | 'no-data' | 'success' | 'error';
}

export interface FeedMigrationDeps {
  getLogs: () => any[];
  getExistingEvents: () => ConsumptionEvent[];
  addEvent: (ev: Omit<ConsumptionEvent, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>) => string;
  getFlag: (key: string) => string | null;
  setFlag: (key: string, value: string) => void;
}

/**
 * runFeedMigrationIfNeeded — migration یک‌باره با flag
 * - اگر flag ست است → skip
 * - اگر داده‌ای نبود → flag ست می‌شود (جلوگیری از اجرای تکراری)
 * - روی خطا → rollback نمی‌شود (idempotent — اجرای بعدی aday خواهد بود)
 */
export function runFeedMigrationIfNeeded(deps: FeedMigrationDeps): FeedMigrationResult {
  try {
    if (deps.getFlag(FEED_MIGRATION_FLAG_KEY)) {
      return { ran: false, migrated: 0, reason: 'already-done' };
    }
    const logs = deps.getLogs() || [];
    const existing = deps.getExistingEvents() || [];
    const markers = buildExistingNotesSet(existing);
    const candidates = migrateFeedLogsToConsumption(logs, markers);

    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      deps.setFlag(FEED_MIGRATION_FLAG_KEY, new Date().toISOString());
      return { ran: true, migrated: 0, reason: 'no-data' };
    }

    for (const c of candidates) {
      deps.addEvent(c);
    }
    deps.setFlag(FEED_MIGRATION_FLAG_KEY, new Date().toISOString());
    return { ran: true, migrated: candidates.length, reason: 'success' };
  } catch (e) {
    try { console.error('[feed-migration] error:', e); } catch { /* double-catch */ }
    return { ran: false, migrated: 0, reason: 'error' };
  }
}

/**
 * migrations-feed.ts — migration یک‌باره DailyLog.feedDelivered → ConsumptionEvent
 * فاز ۹a — تابع خالص، بدون دست‌زدن به store
 */
import type { ConsumptionEvent } from './types-store';

export interface DlgLogLite {
  id: string;
  flockId?: string;
  date?: string;
  feedDelivered?: number | null;
}

export type FeedMigrationCandidate = Omit<ConsumptionEvent, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>;

export const MIGRATED_NOTES_PREFIX = '[migrated:';

/**
 * migrateFeedLogsToConsumption — تبدیل logs قدیمی به candidateها
 * - فقط logs با feedDelivered > 0 و flockId و date
 * - دکدوب: existingNotes حاوی "[migrated:<logId>]" → skip
 * - واحد: kg (فرض پایه)
 * - source: daily_manual (ثبت روزانه قدیمی)
 * - confidence: exact (کاربر خودش وارد کرده)
 */
export function migrateFeedLogsToConsumption(
  logs: DlgLogLite[],
  existingNotes: Set<string>,
): FeedMigrationCandidate[] {
  const out: FeedMigrationCandidate[] = [];

  for (const log of logs || []) {
    if (!log || !log.id) continue;
    if (!log.flockId || !log.date) continue;
    const amt = Number(log.feedDelivered);
    if (!(amt > 0)) continue;

    const marker = `${MIGRATED_NOTES_PREFIX}${log.id}]`;
    if (existingNotes.has(marker)) continue;

    out.push({
      flockId: log.flockId,
      type: 'feed',
      date: log.date,
      amount: Math.round(amt * 100) / 100,
      unit: 'kg',
      sex: '',
      source: 'daily_manual',
      confidence: 'exact',
      notes: marker,
    });
  }

  return out;
}

/**
 * buildExistingNotesSet — استخراج markerها از ConsumptionEventهای موجود
 */
export function buildExistingNotesSet(events: ConsumptionEvent[] | undefined): Set<string> {
  const s = new Set<string>();
  for (const e of events || []) {
    if (e.notes && e.notes.startsWith(MIGRATED_NOTES_PREFIX)) s.add(e.notes);
  }
  return s;
}

/**
 * migrations.ts — migrate flk store
 * جدا شده از store.ts
 */

import type { State } from './store';
import { toJalali } from './helpers-store';

// 🆕 types برای migrate (داده legacy — تایپ دقیق معلوم نیست)
type LegacyEvent = {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  date: string;
  count: number;
  reason?: string;
  linkedEventId?: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt?: string;
  version?: number;
  revoked?: boolean;
  revokedBy?: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
};

type LegacyFlock = {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  initialCount: number | null;
  currentCount: number | null;
  events?: LegacyEvent[];
  layingStartDay?: number | null;
  endOfCycleDay?: number | null;
  maleCount?: number | null;
  femaleCount?: number | null;
  dealType?: string;
  dealData?: Record<string, unknown>;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
};

type PersistedFlk = {
  state?: { flocks?: LegacyFlock[] };
  flocks?: LegacyFlock[];
};

export function flkMigrate(persistedInput: unknown, version: number): State {

  // 🆕 v13 — fix missing initialMaleCount/initialFemaleCount for split flocks
  // علت: applyInvoiceFlocks و FlockCreateStandalone این فیلدها را ست نمی‌کردند
  if (version < 13) {
    const p = persistedInput as any;
    if (p && Array.isArray(p.flocks)) {
      for (const f of p.flocks) {
        if (f.genderSplitAt && f.initialMaleCount === undefined) {
          const sortedEvents = (f.sexBalanceEvents || []).slice().sort((a: any, b: any) =>
            (a.createdAt || '').localeCompare(b.createdAt || '')
          );
          const firstEv = sortedEvents[0];
          if (firstEv && firstEv.before) {
            f.initialMaleCount = firstEv.before.male ?? 0;
            f.initialFemaleCount = firstEv.before.female ?? 0;
          } else {
            f.initialMaleCount = f.maleCount ?? 0;
            f.initialFemaleCount = f.femaleCount ?? 0;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const persisted = persistedInput as PersistedFlk;
  const state: { flocks?: LegacyFlock[] } = (persisted && persisted.state ? persisted.state : persisted) as { flocks?: LegacyFlock[] };
  if (!state || !state.flocks) return persistedInput as State;

  // 🆕 v14 — ترمیم خودکار گله‌هایی که به علت باگ قبلی فاکتور، hatchDate > purchaseDate یا startDate دارند
  if (version < 14) {
    state.flocks = state.flocks.map((f: LegacyFlock) => {
      const hd = typeof f.hatchDate === 'string' ? f.hatchDate : '';
      let pd = typeof f.purchaseDate === 'string' ? f.purchaseDate : '';
      let sd = typeof f.startDate === 'string' ? f.startDate : '';
      if (hd && pd && hd > pd) pd = hd;
      const minStart = [hd, pd].filter(Boolean).sort().pop() || '';
      if (minStart && sd && sd < minStart) sd = minStart;
      return { ...f, purchaseDate: pd, startDate: sd };
    });
  }

  // ─── v0 → v1: نسخه‌گذاری رویدادها ───
  if (version < 1) {
    state.flocks = state.flocks.map((f: LegacyFlock) => ({
      ...f,
      events: (f.events || []).map((e: LegacyEvent) => ({
        ...e,
        version: 1,
        updatedAt: e.updatedAt || e.createdAt,
      })),
    }));
  }

  // ─── v1 → v2: تبدیل تاریخ ISO به شمسی ───
  if (version < 2) {
    state.flocks = state.flocks.map((f: LegacyFlock) => ({
      ...f,
      events: (f.events || []).map((e: LegacyEvent) => ({
        ...e,
        date: toJalali(e.date),
      })),
    }));
  }

  // ─── v2 → v3: پاکسازی متن رویدادها ───
  if (version < 3) {
    state.flocks = state.flocks.map((f: LegacyFlock) => ({
      ...f,
      events: (f.events || []).map((e: LegacyEvent) => {
        let reason = e.reason || '';
        reason = reason.replace(/لغو correction \(افزودن\)/g, 'لغو اصلاح');
        reason = reason.replace(/لغو correction \(کسر\)/g, 'لغو اصلاح');
        reason = reason.replace(/لغو death \(افزودن\)/g, 'لغو تلفات');
        reason = reason.replace(/لغو death \(کسر\)/g, 'لغو تلفات');
        reason = reason.replace(/لغو sell \(افزودن\)/g, 'لغو فروش');
        reason = reason.replace(/لغو sell \(کسر\)/g, 'لغو فروش');
        reason = reason.replace(/لغو transfer \(افزودن\)/g, 'لغو انتقال');
        reason = reason.replace(/لغو transfer \(کسر\)/g, 'لغو انتقال');
        reason = reason.replace(/لغو add \(افزودن\)/g, 'لغو افزودن');
        reason = reason.replace(/لغو add \(کسر\)/g, 'لغو افزودن');
        reason = reason.replace(/\(افزودن\)/g, '').trim();
        reason = reason.replace(/\(کسر\)/g, '').trim();
        return { ...e, reason };
      }),
    }));
  }

  // ─── v3 → v4: پاکسازی کامل + بازسازی currentCount ───
  if (version < 4) {
    state.flocks = state.flocks.map((f: LegacyFlock) => {
      const initial = f.initialCount || 0;
      const events = (f.events || []).slice().sort((a: LegacyEvent, b: LegacyEvent) =>
        (a.createdAt || '').localeCompare(b.createdAt || '')
      );

      // پیدا کردن event های لغو شده (originalIds که correction دارن)
      const revokedMap = new Map<string, string>(); // originalId -> revokeEventId
      const seenRevokes = new Set<string>();
      events.forEach((e: LegacyEvent) => {
        if (e.linkedEventId && !seenRevokes.has(e.linkedEventId)) {
          revokedMap.set(e.linkedEventId, e.id);
          seenRevokes.add(e.linkedEventId);
        }
      });

      // حذف لغوهای تکراری (فقط اولین لغو باقی بمونه)
      const dedupedEvents = events.filter((e: LegacyEvent) => {
        if (!e.linkedEventId) return true;
        return revokedMap.get(e.linkedEventId) === e.id;
      });

      // بازمحاسبه currentCount از اول
      let computed = initial;
      dedupedEvents.forEach((e: LegacyEvent) => {
        const isRevoke = !!e.linkedEventId;
        if (e.type === 'death' || e.type === 'sell' || e.type === 'cull') {
          computed -= e.count;
        } else if (e.type === 'add' || e.type === 'transfer') {
          computed += e.count;
        } else if (e.type === 'correction') {
          // correction معکوس
          if (isRevoke) {
            // علامت رو از event اصلی می‌گیریم
            const orig = dedupedEvents.find((x: LegacyEvent) => x.id === e.linkedEventId);
            if (orig) {
              if (orig.type === 'death' || orig.type === 'sell' || orig.type === 'cull') {
                computed += e.count;
              } else if (orig.type === 'add' || orig.type === 'transfer') {
                computed -= e.count;
              } else if (orig.type === 'correction') {
                // اگه اصلاح بود، معکوسش
                computed -= e.count;
              }
            }
          } else {
            // correction دستی — علامت رو از reason متوجه نمی‌شیم، پس نگه‌داریم
            // ولی چون قبلاً currentCount ثبت شده بود، اینجا فقط نگه‌داری می‌کنیم
            // برای این حالت، currentCount اصلی رو نگه می‌داریم (نه بازمحاسبه)
          }
        }
      });

      // ⚠️ نکته: بازمحاسبه‌ی کامل ممکنه با currentCount قبلی تطابق نکنه
      // برای safety، اختلاف بین computed و f.currentCount رو چک می‌کنیم
      const oldCurrent = f.currentCount || 0;
      // فقط اگه اختلاف زیاد بود، از computed استفاده کن
      // (چون event های قدیمی ممکنه ناقص باشن)
      const finalCurrent = oldCurrent;

      // برچسب‌گذاری: event هایی که لغو شدن
      const marked = dedupedEvents.map((e: LegacyEvent) => ({
        ...e,
        ...(revokedMap.has(e.id) ? { revoked: true, revokedBy: revokedMap.get(e.id) } : {}),
      }));

      return {
        ...f,
        currentCount: finalCurrent,
        events: marked,
      };
    });
  }


  // ─── v4 → v5: clean-up فیلدهای یتیم ───
  if (version < 5) {
    state.flocks = state.flocks.map((f: LegacyFlock) => ({
      ...f,
      layingStartDay: (f.type === 'layer' || f.type === 'breeder') ? (f.layingStartDay ?? 0) : 0,
      endOfCycleDay: (f.type === 'layer' || f.type === 'breeder') ? (f.endOfCycleDay ?? null) : null,
      maleCount: f.type === 'breeder' ? (f.maleCount ?? null) : null,
      femaleCount: f.type === 'breeder' ? (f.femaleCount ?? null) : null,
    }));
  }

  // ─── v5 → v6: default dealType ───
  if (version < 6) {
    state.flocks = state.flocks.map((f: LegacyFlock) => ({
      ...f,
      dealType: f.dealType || 'own',
      dealData: f.dealData || {},
    }));
  }

  // ─── v6 → v7: groups + groupMembers ───
  if (version < 7) {
    const s = state as Partial<State>;
    if (!s.groups) s.groups = [];
    if (!s.groupMembers) s.groupMembers = [];
  }

  // ─── v7 → v8: breedKind + breedLabel (گله مختلط) ───
  if (version < 8) {
    state.flocks = state.flocks.map((f: LegacyFlock) => ({
      ...f,
      breedKind: f.breedKind || 'standard',
      breedLabel: f.breedLabel || '',
    }));
  }

  // ─── v8 → v9: unknownCount ───
  if (version < 9) {
    state.flocks = state.flocks.map((f: LegacyFlock) => ({
      ...f,
      unknownCount: f.unknownCount ?? null,
    }));
  }

  // ─── v9 → v10: rent dates + payments ───
  if (version < 10) {
    state.flocks = state.flocks.map((f: any) => {
      if (f.dealType !== 'rent') return f;
      const dd = f.dealData || {};
      return {
        ...f,
        dealData: {
          ...dd,
          rentStartDate: dd.rentStartDate || f.startDate || f.purchaseDate || '',
          rentEndDate: dd.rentEndDate || '',
          rentPayments: dd.rentPayments || [],
        },
      };
    });
  }

  // ─── v10 → v11: genderSplitAt ───
  if (version < 11) {
    state.flocks = state.flocks.map((f: any) => {
      const hasSplit = ((f.maleCount ?? 0) > 0) || ((f.femaleCount ?? 0) > 0);
      return {
        ...f,
        genderSplitAt: hasSplit ? (f.updatedAt || f.createdAt || new Date().toISOString()) : null,
      };
    });
  }

  // 🆕 v12: Fix inconsistent flocks (male + female + unknown > currentCount)
  if (version < 12) {
    const state = persistedInput as State;
    if (state && state.flocks) {
      let fixed = 0;
      state.flocks = state.flocks.map((f) => {
        const m = f.maleCount ?? 0;
        const fe = f.femaleCount ?? 0;
        const u = f.unknownCount ?? 0;
        const cc = f.currentCount ?? 0;
        const sum = m + fe + u;
        if (sum > cc && cc > 0) {
          const newM = Math.min(m, cc);
          const newF = Math.min(fe, cc - newM);
          const newU = Math.min(u, cc - newM - newF);
          fixed++;
          return { ...f, maleCount: newM, femaleCount: newF, unknownCount: newU };
        }
        return f;
      });
      if (fixed > 0) console.log(`[migration v12] fixed ${fixed} inconsistent flocks`);
    }
  }

  return persistedInput as State;
}

  female: number;
  unknown: number;
  /** منبع تفکیک: خرید اولیه / جزئی / اصلاح / نهایی */

/** 🆕 رکورد تغییر تعادل جنسیتی (audit trail) */
export interface FlockSexBalanceEvent {
  id: string;
  date: string;

  before: { male: number; female: number; unknown: number };

  delta: { male: number; female: number; unknown: number };
