  note?: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

export interface Flock {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: FlockType;
  birdId: string;
  breedId: string;
  /** 🆕 standard یا mixed — خالی = standard برای سازگاری */
  breedKind?: 'standard' | 'mixed';
  /** 🆕 نام محلی برای گله مختلط */
  breedLabel?: string;
  hallId: string;
  zoneId: string;
  initialCount: number | null;
  currentCount: number | null;
  maleCount: number | null;
  femaleCount: number | null;
  /** 🆕 پرنده‌های با جنسیت نامشخص (مخلوط) */
  unknownCount?: number | null;
  layingStartDay: number; // سن شروع تخم‌گذاری (روز) — قابل ویرایش کاربر
  endOfCycleDay: number | null;
  endDate?: string; // سن پایان چرخه (از استاندارد نژاد لحظه ساخت)
    vaccineScheduleId: string; // شناسه قالب واکسن (اختیاری)
  hatchDate: string;      // تاریخ هچ (اگر از جوجه‌کشی خودت)
  purchaseDate: string;   // تاریخ خرید
  startDate: string;      // تاریخ شروع نگهداری
  source: string;
  purchasePrice: number | null;    // قیمت هر پرنده
  deliveryCost: number | null;     // هزینه حمل
  otherCosts: number | null;       // سایر هزینه‌ها
  status: FlockStatus;
  /** پنهان از لیست اصلی */
  hidden?: boolean;
  /** غیرفعال موقت (توی آمار و هشدارها نمیاد) */
  paused?: boolean;
  /** دلیل آرشیو (اجباری هنگام بستن) */
  archivedReason?: string;
  /** 🆕 تاریخ اولین تفکیک جنسیت — null = هیچ‌وقت split نشده */
  genderSplitAt?: string | null;
  notes: string;
  /** رویدادهای دستی گله */
  events?: FlockEvent[];
  mergedInto?: string;
  mergedInfo?: FlockMergeInfo;
  sourceInvoiceId?: string;
  hatchId?: string;
  sourceCategory?: string;
  /** شماره بچ هچری (اگر از خرید جوجه ساخته شده) */
  /** وزن اولیه جوجه به گرم */
  chickWeight?: number | null;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  // 💼 مدل بهره‌برداری
  dealType?: FlockDealType;
  dealData?: FlockDealData;
  // 🆕 دوره پرهیز دارو (اختیاری — نمایش فقط اگر features.withdrawal = true)
  activeWithdrawal?: {
    until: string;        // تاریخ شمسی پایان دوره پرهیز
    medicine: string;     // نام داروی اصلی
    days: number;         // تعداد روز پرهیز
    startedAt: string;    // تاریخ شروع دوره
    logId: string;        // شناسه لاگ ثبت روزانه مبدأ
  };
  /** 🆕 سن تفکیک override (روز) — null → از استاندارد نژاد */
  sexingAgeOverride?: number | null;
  /** 🆕 تاریخچه تفکیک‌ها */
  sexingEvents?: FlockSexingEvent[];
  /** 🆕 تاریخچه تغییرات تعادل جنسیتی (audit trail) */
  sexBalanceEvents?: FlockSexBalanceEvent[];
  /** 🆕 تعداد اولیه نر (لحظه خرید/تفکیک) */
  initialMaleCount?: number;
  /** 🆕 تعداد اولیه ماده */
  initialFemaleCount?: number;
}

export interface State {
  flocks: Flock[];
  groups: FlockGroup[];
  groupMembers: FlockGroupMember[];
  consumptionEvents: ConsumptionEvent[];
  addEvent: (flockId: string, ev: Omit<FlockEvent, 'id'|'flockId'|'createdAt'>) => void;
  // 🆕 فاز ۸a — ConsumptionEvent
  addConsumptionEvent: (ev: Omit<ConsumptionEvent, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>) => string;
  updateConsumptionEvent: (id: string, patch: Partial<ConsumptionEvent>) => void;
  removeConsumptionEvent: (id: string) => void;
  listConsumptionEvents: (flockId: string) => ConsumptionEvent[];
  /** 🆕 ثبت تفکیک جنسیت (تعادل پیوسته) */
  recordSexing: (flockId: string, params: {
    male: number;
    female: number;
    unknown: number;
    date: string;
    note?: string;
  }) => void;
  addCorrection: (flockId: string, delta: number, reasonCode: FlockEventReasonCode, reasonLabel: string, notes: string) => void;
  revokeEvent: (flockId: string, eventId: string) => void;
  removeEvent: (flockId: string, eventId: string) => void;
  mergeFlocks: (targetId: string, sourceId: string, opts: { targetAgeDays: number; sourceAgeDays: number; hatchDate?: string }) => void;
  unmergeFlocks: (targetId: string, sourceId?: string) => void;
  add: (f: Omit<Flock, 'id'|'createdAt'|'updatedAt'>) => string;
  update: (id: string, patch: Partial<Flock>) => void;
  remove: (id: string) => void;
  archive: (id: string, reason?: string) => Promise<number>;
  restore: (id: string) => Promise<number>;
  toggleHidden: (id: string) => void;
  togglePaused: (id: string) => void;

  // 🆕 Groups
  addGroup: (g: Omit<FlockGroup, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>) => string;
  updateGroup: (id: string, patch: Partial<FlockGroup>) => void;
  archiveGroup: (id: string) => void;
  restoreGroup: (id: string) => void;
  deleteGroup: (id: string) => void;
  moveGroup: (groupId: string, newParentId: string | null) => void;

  // 🆕 Group Members
  addToGroup: (groupId: string, flockId: string, opts?: { role?: 'primary' | 'secondary'; weight?: number; notes?: string }) => void;
  removeFromGroup: (groupId: string, flockId: string) => void;
  getFlocksInGroup: (groupId: string, includeDescendants?: boolean) => Flock[];
  getGroupsForFlock: (flockId: string) => FlockGroup[];
  getGroupPath: (groupId: string) => FlockGroup[];

  /** 🆕 وضعیت لود داده‌ها از IndexedDB (دروازه لودینگ) */
  isLoading: boolean;
}

const now = () => new Date().toISOString();

export const useFlk = create<State>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      isLoading: true,
      flocks: [],
      groups: [],
      groupMembers: [],
      consumptionEvents: [],
      add: (f) => {
        const id = uuid();
        // 🆕 فیکس: auto genderSplitAt
        const hasSplit = ((f.maleCount ?? 0) > 0) || ((f.femaleCount ?? 0) > 0);
        const patch: any = { ...f };
        if (hasSplit && !patch.genderSplitAt) {
          patch.genderSplitAt = now();
        }
        // 🆕 فیکس: اگر split ولی initialMaleCount ست نشده (فاکتور خرید / ساخت دستی)
        if (patch.genderSplitAt && patch.initialMaleCount === undefined) {
          patch.initialMaleCount = patch.maleCount ?? 0;
          patch.initialFemaleCount = patch.femaleCount ?? 0;
        }
        set({ flocks: [...get().flocks, { ...patch, id, createdAt: now(), updatedAt: now() }] });
        return id;
      },
      update: (id, patch) => set({
        flocks: get().flocks.map(x => {
          if (x.id !== id) return x;
          const merged: any = { ...x, ...patch, updatedAt: now() };
          const m2 = merged.maleCount ?? 0;
          const fe = merged.femaleCount ?? 0;
          const cc = merged.currentCount ?? 0;
          if ((m2 > 0 || fe > 0) && !merged.genderSplitAt) merged.genderSplitAt = now();
          if (m2 === 0 && fe === 0 && merged.genderSplitAt) {
            merged.genderSplitAt = null;
            merged.unknownCount = cc;
          }
          const sum = m2 + fe + (merged.unknownCount ?? 0);
          if (sum !== cc && m2 + fe <= cc) merged.unknownCount = cc - m2 - fe;
          return merged;
        }),
      }),
      remove: (id) => {
        // 🆕 حذف مستقیم — تأیید و هشدار لینک‌ها در UI گرفته می‌شه
        set({ flocks: get().flocks.filter(x => x.id !== id) });
      },
      archive: async (id, reason) => {
        const prevFlock = get().flocks.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (!prevFlock || prevFlock.status === 'merged' || prevFlock.mergedInto) {
          const { useDlg } = await import('../dlg/store');
          return useDlg.getState().archiveFlockLogs(id);
        }
        const closedFlock: Flock = {
          ...prevFlock,
          status: 'archived',
          endDate: prevFlock.endDate || now(),
          archivedReason: reason || '',
          updatedAt: now(),
        };
        const { ARCHIVE_STORES, putArchiveRecord } = await import('../../cor/storage/historyArchive');
        await putArchiveRecord({
          id: closedFlock.id,
          flockId: closedFlock.id,
          date: closedFlock.endDate || closedFlock.updatedAt,
          archivedAt: Date.now(),
          reason: 'flock-closed' as const,
          log: closedFlock as any,
        });
        set({ flocks: get().flocks.map(x => x.id === id ? closedFlock : x) });
        const { useDlg } = await import('../dlg/store');
        const archivedLogsCount = await useDlg.getState().archiveFlockLogs(id);
        try {
          const { computeFlockSummary, saveFlockSummary } = await import('../../cor/storage/historyArchive');
          const { useBrd } = await import('../brd/store');
          const flockLogs = useDlg.getState().logs.filter((l) => l.flockId === id);
          const brdState = useBrd.getState();
          const breedName = brdState.breeds.find((b) => b.id === closedFlock.breedId)?.name;
          const initCount = Number(closedFlock.initialCount) || 0;
          const currCount =
            typeof closedFlock.currentCount === 'number'
              ? closedFlock.currentCount
              : initCount;
          const livabilityPct =
            initCount > 0 && currCount >= 0
              ? Number(Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (currCount / initCount) * 100)).toFixed(2))
              : null;

          const summary = computeFlockSummary(
            closedFlock.id,
            flockLogs,
            {
              flockName: closedFlock.name,
              breedName,
              productionType: (closedFlock.type as any) || undefined,
              livabilityPct,
              recordedCost: (closedFlock as any).totalCost,
              recordedRevenue: (closedFlock as any).totalRevenue,
            },
          );
          await saveFlockSummary(summary);
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('[flk] Failed to save flock archive summary:', e);
        }
        return archivedLogsCount;
      },
      restore: async (id) => {
        const { ARCHIVE_STORES, getArchived, purgeArchiveIds } = await import('../../cor/storage/historyArchive');
        const rec = await getArchived(id, ARCHIVE_STORES.flk) as { log?: Flock } | null;
        const archivedFlock = rec?.log;
        const current = get().flocks.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (archivedFlock || current) {
          const restoredFlock: Flock = {
            ...(archivedFlock ?? current!),
            status: 'active',
            endDate: '',
            archivedReason: '',
            updatedAt: now(),
          };
          set({
            flocks: current
              ? get().flocks.map(x => x.id === id ? restoredFlock : x)
              : [...get().flocks, restoredFlock],
          });
          if (archivedFlock) {
            await purgeArchiveIds([id], ARCHIVE_STORES.flk);
          }
          try {
            const { deleteFlockSummary } = await import('../../cor/storage/historyArchive');
            await deleteFlockSummary(id);
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[flk] Failed to delete flock archive summary on restore:', e);
          }
        }
        const { useDlg } = await import('../dlg/store');
        return useDlg.getState().restoreFlockLogs(id);
      },
      toggleHidden: (id) => set({ flocks: get().flocks.map(x => x.id === id ? {...x, hidden: !x.hidden, updatedAt: now()} : x) }),
      togglePaused: (id) => set({ flocks: get().flocks.map(x => x.id === id ? {...x, paused: !x.paused, updatedAt: now()} : x) }),

      // ═══ 🆕 Groups ═══
      addGroup: (g) => {
        const id = uuid();
        set({ groups: [...get().groups, { ...g, id, createdAt: now(), updatedAt: now() }] });
        return id;
      },
      updateGroup: (id, patch) => set({
        groups: get().groups.map(x => x.id === id ? { ...x, ...patch, updatedAt: now() } : x),
      }),
      archiveGroup: (id) => set({
        groups: get().groups.map(x => x.id === id ? { ...x, archived: true, updatedAt: now() } : x),
      }),
      restoreGroup: (id) => set({
        groups: get().groups.map(x => x.id === id ? { ...x, archived: false, updatedAt: now() } : x),
      }),
      deleteGroup: (id) => set({
        groups: get().groups.filter(x => x.id !== id),
        groupMembers: get().groupMembers.filter(m => m.groupId !== id),
      }),
      moveGroup: (groupId, newParentId) => {
        if (newParentId) {
          let cur: string | undefined = newParentId;
          const seen = new Set<string>();
          while (cur) {
            if (cur === groupId) {
              showToast('گروه نمی‌تواند والد خودش باشد', 'error');
              return;
            }
            if (seen.has(cur)) break;
            seen.add(cur);
            cur = get().groups.find(g => g.id === cur)?.parentGroupId;
          }
        }
        set({
          groups: get().groups.map(x => x.id === groupId ? { ...x, parentGroupId: newParentId || undefined, updatedAt: now() } : x),
        });
      },

      // ═══ 🆕 Group Members ═══
      addToGroup: (groupId, flockId, opts) => {
        const exists = get().groupMembers.some(m => m.groupId === groupId && m.flockId === flockId && !m.leftAt);
        if (exists) return;
        const member: FlockGroupMember = {
          groupId, flockId, joinedAt: now(),
          role: opts?.role, weight: opts?.weight, notes: opts?.notes,
        };
        set({ groupMembers: [...get().groupMembers, member] });
      },
      removeFromGroup: (groupId, flockId) => set({
        groupMembers: get().groupMembers.map(m =>
          m.groupId === groupId && m.flockId === flockId && !m.leftAt
            ? { ...m, leftAt: now() }
            : m
        ),
      }),
      getFlocksInGroup: (groupId, includeDescendants) => {
        const state = get();
        const group = state.groups.find(g => g.id === groupId);
        
        // 🆕 Smart groups — همیشه live computed
        if (group?.type === 'smart' && group.rule) {
          const matched = state.flocks.filter(f => matchesGroupRule(f, group.rule!));
          if (!includeDescendants) return matched;
          const children = state.groups.filter(g => g.parentGroupId === groupId && !g.archived);
          const all = [...matched];
          for (const child of children) {
            all.push(...state.getFlocksInGroup(child.id, true));
          }
          const seen = new Set<string>();
          return all.filter(f => {
            if (seen.has(f.id)) return false;
            seen.add(f.id);
            return true;
          });
        }
        
        // Manual groups — از groupMembers
        const directIds = state.groupMembers
          .filter(m => m.groupId === groupId && !m.leftAt)
          .map(m => m.flockId);
        let allIds = directIds;
        if (includeDescendants) {
          const children = state.groups.filter(g => g.parentGroupId === groupId && !g.archived);
          for (const child of children) {
            const cf = state.getFlocksInGroup(child.id, true);
            allIds = [...allIds, ...cf.map(f => f.id)];
          }
        }
        return state.flocks.filter(f => allIds.includes(f.id));
      },
      getGroupsForFlock: (flockId) => {
        const state = get();
        const flock = state.flocks.find(f => f.id === flockId);
        if (!flock) return [];
        const gids = state.groupMembers
          .filter(m => m.flockId === flockId && !m.leftAt)
          .map(m => m.groupId);
        return state.groups.filter(g => {
          if (g.archived) return false;
          if (g.type === 'smart' && g.rule) return matchesGroupRule(flock, g.rule);
          return gids.includes(g.id);
        });
      },
      getGroupPath: (groupId) => {
        const path: FlockGroup[] = [];
        let cur: string | undefined = groupId;
        const seen = new Set<string>();
        while (cur) {
          if (seen.has(cur)) break;
          seen.add(cur);
          const g = get().groups.find(x => x.id === cur);
          if (!g) break;
          path.unshift(g);
          cur = g.parentGroupId;
        }
        return path;
      },

      recordSexing: (flockId, params) => {
        const flock = get().flocks.find(f => f.id === flockId);
        if (!flock) return;

        const currentCount = flock.currentCount ?? 0;
        const before = {
          male: flock.maleCount ?? 0,
          female: flock.femaleCount ?? 0,
          unknown: flock.unknownCount ?? 0,
        };

        const newMale = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(params.male) || 0));
        const newFemale = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(params.female) || 0));
        const newUnknown = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(params.unknown) || 0));
        const total = newMale + newFemale + newUnknown;

        if (total !== currentCount) {
          throw new Error(`جمع (${newMale} + ${newFemale} + ${newUnknown} = ${total}) باید برابر تعداد زنده (${currentCount}) باشد — اختلاف: ${total - currentCount}`);
        }
        if (newMale + newFemale === 0) {
          throw new Error('حداقل یکی از نر یا ماده باید بیشتر از صفر باشد');
        }

        const after = { male: newMale, female: newFemale, unknown: newUnknown };
        const delta = {
          male: after.male - before.male,
          female: after.female - before.female,
          unknown: after.unknown - before.unknown,
        };

        const today = params.date;
        const isFirst = !flock.genderSplitAt;
        const isFinal = newUnknown === 0;

        let source: 'purchase' | 'partial' | 'correction' | 'final';
        if (isFirst && isFinal) source = 'purchase';
        else if (isFirst) source = 'partial';
        else if (isFinal && before.unknown > 0) source = 'final';
        else source = 'correction';

        const sexingEvent: FlockSexingEvent = {
          id: uuid(),
          date: today,
          male: newMale,
          female: newFemale,
          unknown: newUnknown,
          source,
          note: params.note,
          createdAt: now(),
        };

        const balanceEvent: FlockSexBalanceEvent = {
          id: uuid(),
          date: today,
          type: 'sexing',
          before,
          after,
          delta,
          note: params.note,
          createdAt: now(),
        };

        set({
          flocks: get().flocks.map(f => {
            if (f.id !== flockId) return f;
            return {
              ...f,
              maleCount: newMale,
              femaleCount: newFemale,
              unknownCount: newUnknown,
              genderSplitAt: f.genderSplitAt || today,
              sexingEvents: [...(f.sexingEvents || []), sexingEvent],
              sexBalanceEvents: [...(f.sexBalanceEvents || []), balanceEvent],
              initialMaleCount: f.initialMaleCount ?? newMale,
              initialFemaleCount: f.initialFemaleCount ?? newFemale,
              updatedAt: now(),
            };
          }),
        });
      },
      addEvent: (flockId, ev) => set({
        flocks: get().flocks.map(f => {
          if (f.id !== flockId) return f;
          const newEvent: FlockEvent = { ...ev, id: uuid(), flockId, createdAt: now() };
    const cur = f.currentCount ?? 0;
    let delta = 0;
    if (ev.type === 'death' || ev.type === 'cull' || ev.type === 'sell') delta = -ev.count;
    else if (ev.type === 'add' || ev.type === 'transfer') delta = +ev.count;
    const next = Math.max(0, cur + delta);
    // 🆕 audit: capture before
    const _before = {
      male: f.maleCount ?? 0,
      female: f.femaleCount ?? 0,
      unknown: f.unknownCount ?? 0,
    };
    const patch: any = { currentCount: next };
    const hasSplit = !!f.genderSplitAt;
    if (!hasSplit) {
      if (delta > 0 && (ev.sex === 'male' || ev.sex === 'female')) {
        patch.genderSplitAt = now();
        patch.maleCount = ev.sex === 'male' ? ev.count : 0;
        patch.femaleCount = ev.sex === 'female' ? ev.count : 0;
        patch.unknownCount = cur;
      } else {
        patch.unknownCount = next;
      }
    } else {
      if (delta >= 0) {
        // adding
        if (ev.sex === 'male') patch.maleCount = (f.maleCount ?? 0) + delta;
        else if (ev.sex === 'female') patch.femaleCount = (f.femaleCount ?? 0) + delta;
        else patch.unknownCount = (f.unknownCount ?? 0) + delta;
      } else {
        // subtracting — با redistribution برای حفظ invariant
        const want = Math.abs(delta);
        if (ev.sex === 'male') {
          const availM = f.maleCount ?? 0;
          const takeM = Math.min(availM, want);
          patch.maleCount = availM - takeM;
          const rem = want - takeM;
          if (rem > 0) {
            const availU = f.unknownCount ?? 0;
            const takeU = Math.min(availU, rem);
            patch.unknownCount = availU - takeU;
            const rem2 = rem - takeU;
            if (rem2 > 0) {
              patch.femaleCount = Math.max(0, (f.femaleCount ?? 0) - rem2);
            }
          }
        } else if (ev.sex === 'female') {
          const availF = f.femaleCount ?? 0;
          const takeF = Math.min(availF, want);
          patch.femaleCount = availF - takeF;
          const rem = want - takeF;
          if (rem > 0) {
            const availU = f.unknownCount ?? 0;
            const takeU = Math.min(availU, rem);
            patch.unknownCount = availU - takeU;
            const rem2 = rem - takeU;
            if (rem2 > 0) {
              patch.maleCount = Math.max(0, (f.maleCount ?? 0) - rem2);
            }
          }
        } else {
          // mixed → unknown first, then larger sex
          const availU = f.unknownCount ?? 0;
          const takeU = Math.min(availU, want);
          patch.unknownCount = availU - takeU;
          const rem = want - takeU;
          if (rem > 0) {
            const m = f.maleCount ?? 0;
            const fe = f.femaleCount ?? 0;
            if (fe >= m) patch.femaleCount = Math.max(0, fe - rem);
            else patch.maleCount = Math.max(0, m - rem);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    // 🆕 audit: capture after + delta
    const _after = {
      male: patch.maleCount ?? _before.male,
      female: patch.femaleCount ?? _before.female,
      unknown: patch.unknownCount ?? _before.unknown,
    };
    const _sdelta = {
      male: _after.male - _before.male,
      female: _after.female - _before.female,
      unknown: _after.unknown - _before.unknown,
    };
    const _hasChange = _sdelta.male !== 0 || _sdelta.female !== 0 || _sdelta.unknown !== 0;
    const _bType: 'death' | 'sale' | 'correction' = ev.type === 'death' ? 'death' : ev.type === 'sell' ? 'sale' : 'correction';
    const _newBalanceEvents = _hasChange
      ? [...(f.sexBalanceEvents || []), {
          id: uuid(),
          date: ev.date,
          type: _bType,
          before: _before,
          after: _after,
          delta: _sdelta,
          reason: ev.reason,
          note: ev.notes,
          createdAt: now(),
        }]
      : (f.sexBalanceEvents || []);
    return { ...f, ...patch, events: [...(f.events || []), newEvent], sexBalanceEvents: _newBalanceEvents, updatedAt: now() };
        })
      }),
      // 🆕 فاز ۸a — ConsumptionEvent
      addConsumptionEvent: (ev) => {
        const id = uuid();
        const nowTs = now();
        const newEv: ConsumptionEvent = {
          ...ev,
          id,
          createdAt: nowTs,
          updatedAt: nowTs,
        };
        set({ consumptionEvents: [...get().consumptionEvents, newEv] });
        return id;
      },
      updateConsumptionEvent: (id, patch) => set({
        consumptionEvents: get().consumptionEvents.map(e =>
          e.id === id ? { ...e, ...patch, updatedAt: now() } : e
        ),
      }),
      removeConsumptionEvent: (id) => set({
        consumptionEvents: get().consumptionEvents.filter(e => e.id !== id),
      }),
      listConsumptionEvents: (flockId) => {
        return get().consumptionEvents
          .filter(e => e.flockId === flockId)
          .sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date));
      },
      addCorrection: (flockId, delta, reasonCode, reasonLabel, notes) => set({
        flocks: get().flocks.map(f => {
          if (f.id !== flockId) return f;
          const oldCount = f.currentCount || 0;
          const newCount = Math.max(0, oldCount + delta);
          const actualDelta = newCount - oldCount;
          if (actualDelta === 0) return f;
          const newEvent: FlockEvent = {
            id: uuid(),
            flockId,
            date: todayJ(),
            type: 'correction',
            count: Math.abs(actualDelta), direction: actualDelta > 0 ? 1 : -1,
            sex: 'mixed',
            reasonCode,
            reason: reasonLabel,
            notes,
            createdAt: now(),
            updatedAt: now(),
            version: 7,
          };
          const patch: any = { currentCount: newCount };
          // 🆕 قدم ۳: sync gender
          const hasSplit = !!f.genderSplitAt;
          if (!hasSplit) {
            patch.unknownCount = newCount;
          } else {
            const nextU = (f.unknownCount ?? 0) + actualDelta;
            if (nextU >= 0) {
              patch.unknownCount = nextU;
            } else {
              const rem = -nextU;
              patch.unknownCount = 0;
              const m = f.maleCount ?? 0;
              const fe = f.femaleCount ?? 0;
              if (fe >= m) {
                patch.femaleCount = Math.max(0, fe - rem);
              } else {
                patch.maleCount = Math.max(0, m - rem);
              }
            }
          }
          return {
            ...f,
            ...patch,
            events: [...(f.events || []), newEvent],
            updatedAt: now(),
          };
        }),
      }),
      revokeEvent: (flockId, eventId) => set({
        flocks: get().flocks.map(f => {
          if (f.id !== flockId) return f;
          const ev = (f.events || []).find(e => e.id === eventId);
          if (!ev) return f;
          // اگه این event قبلاً توسط یه correction لغو شده → دوباره لغو نکن
          const alreadyRevoked = (f.events || []).some(x => x.linkedEventId === eventId);
          if (alreadyRevoked) return f;
          // محاسبه‌ی معکوس
          let sign = 0;
          if (ev.type === 'correction') {
            const dir = ev.direction ?? ((ev.reason || '').includes('افزودن') ? 1 : -1);
            sign = -dir;
          } else if (ev.type === 'death' || ev.type === 'cull' || ev.type === 'sell') {
            sign = 1; // برگشت به تعداد
          } else if (ev.type === 'add' || ev.type === 'transfer') {
            sign = -1;
          } else {
            return f;
          }
          const cur = f.currentCount || 0;
          const newCount = Math.max(0, cur + sign * ev.count);
          if (newCount === cur) return f;
          const revokeEv: FlockEvent = {
            id: uuid(),
            flockId,
            date: todayJ(),
            type: 'correction',
            count: Math.abs(sign * ev.count),
            direction: sign as 1 | -1,
            sex: ev.sex,
            reasonCode: 'data_entry_error',
            reason: 'لغو ' + (EVENT_LABEL[ev.type] || ev.type),
            notes: 'لغو رویداد ' + ev.id.slice(0, 8),
            linkedEventId: eventId,
            createdAt: now(),
            updatedAt: now(),
            version: 1,
          };
          const patch: any = { currentCount: newCount };
          // 🆕 قدم ۴: sync gender (بر اساس ev.sex اصلی)
          const hasSplit = !!f.genderSplitAt;
          if (!hasSplit) {
            patch.unknownCount = newCount;
          } else {
            const actualDelta = newCount - cur;
            if (ev.sex === 'male') {
              patch.maleCount = Math.max(0, (f.maleCount ?? 0) + actualDelta);
            } else if (ev.sex === 'female') {
              patch.femaleCount = Math.max(0, (f.femaleCount ?? 0) + actualDelta);
            } else {
              const nextU = (f.unknownCount ?? 0) + actualDelta;
              if (nextU >= 0) {
                patch.unknownCount = nextU;
              } else {
                const rem = -nextU;
                patch.unknownCount = 0;
                const m = f.maleCount ?? 0;
                const fe = f.femaleCount ?? 0;
                if (fe >= m) {
                  patch.femaleCount = Math.max(0, fe - rem);
                } else {
                  patch.maleCount = Math.max(0, m - rem);
                }
              }
            }
            // اگه male و female صفر شدن → un-split
            const finalMale = patch.maleCount ?? f.maleCount ?? 0;
            const finalFemale = patch.femaleCount ?? f.femaleCount ?? 0;
            if (finalMale === 0 && finalFemale === 0) {
              patch.genderSplitAt = null;
              patch.unknownCount = newCount;
            }
          }
          return {
            ...f,
            ...patch,
            events: [...(f.events || []), revokeEv],
            updatedAt: now(),
          };
        }),
      }),
      removeEvent: (flockId, eventId) => set({
        flocks: get().flocks.map(f =>
          f.id === flockId
            ? { ...f, events: (f.events || []).filter(e => e.id !== eventId), updatedAt: now() }
            : f
        )
      }),
      mergeFlocks: (targetId, sourceId, opts) => {
        const _st = get();
        const _t = _st.flocks.find(f => f.id === targetId);
        const _s = _st.flocks.find(f => f.id === sourceId);
        if (!_t || !_s) throw new Error('گله پیدا نشد');
        if ((_t as any).birdKind && (_s as any).birdKind && (_t as any).birdKind !== (_s as any).birdKind) throw new Error('پرنده متفاوت');
        if (_t.type !== _s.type) throw new Error('نوع گله متفاوت');
        set({
          flocks: get().flocks.map(f => {
            if (f.id === sourceId) return { ...f, status: 'merged' as FlockStatus, mergedInto: targetId, currentCount: 0, maleCount: 0, femaleCount: 0, unknownCount: 0, updatedAt: now() };
            if (f.id !== targetId) return f;
            const target = f;
            const source = get().flocks.find(x => x.id === sourceId);
            if (!source) return f;
            const mkSrc = (fl: any, age: number) => ({
              flockId: fl.id, flockName: fl.name,
              count: fl.currentCount || 0, ageDays: age,
              maleCount: fl.maleCount || 0, femaleCount: fl.femaleCount || 0,
              unknownCount: fl.unknownCount || 0, initialCount: fl.initialCount || 0,
              initialMaleCount: fl.initialMaleCount, initialFemaleCount: fl.initialFemaleCount,
              genderSplitAt: fl.genderSplitAt, sexingAgeOverride: fl.sexingAgeOverride,
              sexingEvents: fl.sexingEvents || [], sexBalanceEvents: fl.sexBalanceEvents || [],
            });
            const targetSources: any[] = (target as any).mergedInfo?.sources || [mkSrc(target, opts.targetAgeDays)];
            const newSources: any[] = [...targetSources, mkSrc(source, opts.sourceAgeDays)];
            const totalCount = newSources.reduce((s2, x) => s2 + x.count, 0);
            const weightedAge = newSources.reduce((s2, x) => s2 + x.count * x.ageDays, 0);
            const avgAgeDays = totalCount > 0 ? Math.round(weightedAge / totalCount) : 0;
            const _mb = { male: target.maleCount ?? 0, female: target.femaleCount ?? 0, unknown: target.unknownCount ?? 0 };
            const _ma = { male: _mb.male + (source.maleCount ?? 0), female: _mb.female + (source.femaleCount ?? 0), unknown: _mb.unknown + (source.unknownCount ?? 0) };
            const mergeAudit = {
              id: uuid(), date: todayJ(), type: 'merge' as const,
              before: _mb, after: _ma,
              delta: { male: _ma.male - _mb.male, female: _ma.female - _mb.female, unknown: _ma.unknown - _mb.unknown },
              note: 'ادغام ' + source.name, createdAt: now(),
            };
            return {
              ...target,
              initialCount: (target.initialCount || 0) + (source.initialCount || 0),
              currentCount: (target.currentCount || 0) + (source.currentCount || 0),
              maleCount: (target.maleCount || 0) + (source.maleCount || 0),
              femaleCount: (target.femaleCount || 0) + (source.femaleCount || 0),
              unknownCount: (target.unknownCount || 0) + (source.unknownCount || 0),
              genderSplitAt: (() => {
                const dates = [target.genderSplitAt, source.genderSplitAt].filter(Boolean) as string[];
                return dates.length > 0 ? dates.sort()[0] : null;
              })(),
              hatchDate: opts.hatchDate || target.hatchDate,
              mergedInfo: { sources: newSources, avgAgeDays, mergedAt: now() },
              sexBalanceEvents: [...(target.sexBalanceEvents || []), mergeAudit],
              updatedAt: now(),
            };
          }),
        });
      },
      unmergeFlocks: (targetId: string, sourceId?: string) => {
        const state = get();
        const target = state.flocks.find(f => f.id === targetId);
        if (!target || !target.mergedInfo || !target.mergedInfo.sources || target.mergedInfo.sources.length < 2) return;
        const srcs: any[] = (target.mergedInfo!.sources as any[]);
        const sourceToRestore: any = sourceId ? srcs.find((s: any) => s.flockId === sourceId) : srcs[srcs.length - 1];
        if (!sourceToRestore) return;
        const remainingSources = srcs.filter((s: any) => s.flockId !== sourceToRestore.flockId);
        const snap = {
          count: sourceToRestore.count || 0,
          initialCount: sourceToRestore.initialCount || sourceToRestore.count || 0,
          maleCount: sourceToRestore.maleCount || 0,
          femaleCount: sourceToRestore.femaleCount || 0,
          unknownCount: sourceToRestore.unknownCount !== undefined ? sourceToRestore.unknownCount : (sourceToRestore.count || 0),
          initialMaleCount: sourceToRestore.initialMaleCount,
          initialFemaleCount: sourceToRestore.initialFemaleCount,
          genderSplitAt: sourceToRestore.genderSplitAt,
          sexingAgeOverride: sourceToRestore.sexingAgeOverride,
          sexingEvents: sourceToRestore.sexingEvents || [],
          sexBalanceEvents: sourceToRestore.sexBalanceEvents || [],
        };
        const _ub = { male: target.maleCount ?? 0, female: target.femaleCount ?? 0, unknown: target.unknownCount ?? 0 };
        const _ua = { male: Math.max(0, _ub.male - snap.maleCount), female: Math.max(0, _ub.female - snap.femaleCount), unknown: Math.max(0, _ub.unknown - snap.unknownCount) };
        const unmergeAudit = {
          id: uuid(), date: todayJ(), type: 'unmerge' as const,
          before: _ub, after: _ua,
          delta: { male: _ua.male - _ub.male, female: _ua.female - _ub.female, unknown: _ua.unknown - _ub.unknown },
          note: 'بازگردانی ' + sourceToRestore.flockName, createdAt: now(),
        };
        set({
          flocks: state.flocks.map(f => {
            if (f.id === sourceToRestore.flockId) return {
              ...f, status: 'active' as FlockStatus, mergedInto: undefined,
              currentCount: snap.count, initialCount: snap.initialCount,
              maleCount: snap.maleCount, femaleCount: snap.femaleCount, unknownCount: snap.unknownCount,
              initialMaleCount: snap.initialMaleCount, initialFemaleCount: snap.initialFemaleCount,
              genderSplitAt: snap.genderSplitAt, sexingAgeOverride: snap.sexingAgeOverride,
              sexingEvents: snap.sexingEvents, sexBalanceEvents: snap.sexBalanceEvents, updatedAt: now(),
            };
            if (f.id !== targetId) return f;
            return {
              ...f,
              currentCount: Math.max(0, (f.currentCount || 0) - snap.count),
              initialCount: Math.max(0, (f.initialCount || 0) - snap.initialCount),
              maleCount: Math.max(0, (f.maleCount || 0) - snap.maleCount),
              femaleCount: Math.max(0, (f.femaleCount || 0) - snap.femaleCount),
              unknownCount: Math.max(0, (f.unknownCount || 0) - snap.unknownCount),
              mergedInfo: remainingSources.length > 1 ? { ...f.mergedInfo!, sources: remainingSources } : undefined,
              sexBalanceEvents: [...(f.sexBalanceEvents || []), unmergeAudit],
              updatedAt: now(),
            };
          }),
        });
      },
    }),
    {
      name: 'pm-flk',
      storage: createJSONStorage(() => zustandHybridStorage),
      partialize: (state) => {
        const { isLoading, ...rest } = state;
        return rest as any;
      },
      onRehydrateStorage: () => {
        return (state, error) => {
          if (error) {
            console.error('[flk] Hydration failed:', error);
          }
          useFlk.setState({ isLoading: false });
        };
      },
      version: 14,
      migrate: flkMigrate,
    }
  )
);

/**
 * validateSexBalance — بررسی Invariant تعادل جنسیتی
 * قانون: maleCount + femaleCount + unknownCount === currentCount
 *
 * @returns true اگر معتبر، false اگر نقض شده
 */
export function validateSexBalance(f: {
  currentCount?: number | null;
  maleCount?: number | null;
  femaleCount?: number | null;
  unknownCount?: number | null;
}): boolean {
  const c = f.currentCount ?? 0;
  const m = f.maleCount ?? 0;
  const fe = f.femaleCount ?? 0;
  const u = f.unknownCount ?? 0;
  return m + fe + u === c;
}

/**
 * types-store.ts — تایپ‌های store گله
 * جدا شده از store.ts
 */

export type FlockType = 'layer' | 'broiler' | 'breeder';
export type FlockStatus = 'active' | 'archived' | 'sold' | 'merged';

export type FlockEventType = 'add' | 'sell' | 'death' | 'transfer' | 'correction' | 'cull';

export type FlockEventReasonCode =
  | 'data_entry_error'
  | 'found_stock'
  | 'disease'
  | 'predator'
  | 'heat_stress'
  | 'equipment_failure'
  | 'unknown';
export type FlockEventSex = 'male' | 'female' | 'mixed';

export interface FlockEvent {
  id: string;
  flockId: string;
  date: string;
  type: FlockEventType;
  count: number;
  sex: FlockEventSex;
  direction?: 1 | -1;
  origin?: 'purchase' | 'hatch' | 'transfer';
  buyerId?: string;
  reason?: string;
  unitPrice?: number;
  totalPrice?: number;
  invoiceId?: string;
  hatchId?: string;
  notes: string;
  createdAt: string;
  /** کد دلیل استاندارد (برای correction/recount) */
  reasonCode?: FlockEventReasonCode;
  /** اگر این رویداد اصلاح یه رویداد دیگه‌ست */
  linkedEventId?: string;
  /** آخرین ویرایش */
  updatedAt?: string;
  /** نسخه (آینده optimistic locking) */
  version?: number;
  /** آیا این رویداد لغو شده؟ */
  revoked?: boolean;
  /** شناسه correction ای که این رویداد رو لغو کرده */
  revokedBy?: string;
}

export interface FlockMergeSource {

  maleCount?: number;

  initialCount?: number;
  initialMaleCount?: number;
  initialFemaleCount?: number;

  sexingEvents?: any[];
  sexBalanceEvents?: any[];
}

export interface FlockMergeInfo {

  mergedAt: string;
}

export type FlockDealType = 'own' | 'partnership' | 'consignment' | 'rent' | 'barter';

export interface FlockDealData {

  partnerShare?: number;
  consignorId?: string;
  lessorId?: string;
  rentAmount?: number;
  rentPeriod?: 'monthly' | 'season' | 'total';
  dealId?: string;
  /** 🆕 شروع اجاره (ممکنه ≠ startDate گله) */
  rentStartDate?: string;
  /** 🆕 پایان قرارداد اجاره */
  rentEndDate?: string;
  /** 🆕 پرداخت‌های واقعی اجاره */
  rentPayments?: Array<{ id: string; date: string; amount: number; notes: string }>;
}

export type FlockGroupType = 'season' | 'breed' | 'cohort' | 'farm' | 'owner' | 'custom' | 'smart';

// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ConsumptionEvent — مدل universal ثبت دان/آب
// فاز ۸a — از Equipment موجود استفاده می‌کند (category='feeding'|'drinking')
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export type ConsumptionType = 'feed' | 'water';

export type ConsumptionSource =
  | 'daily_manual'      // ثبت روزانه دستی
  | 'bulk_manual'       // پر کردن سطل/دانخوری
  | 'sensor_scale'      // سنسور وزن روی سیلو
  | 'sensor_level'      // سنسور سطح
  | 'auto_feeder'       // دانخوری/آبخوری هوشمند
  | 'inferred';         // محاسبه‌شده از اختلاف

export type ConsumptionConfidence = 'exact' | 'estimated' | 'standard';

export interface ConsumptionEvent {
  id: string;
  flockId: string;
  type: ConsumptionType;       // 'feed' | 'water'
  date: string;
  endDate?: string;
  amount: number;              // عدد (kg یا L)
  unit: 'kg' | 'L';
  sex: '' | 'male' | 'female' | 'mixed';
  source: ConsumptionSource;
  confidence: ConsumptionConfidence;
  equipmentId?: string;        // FK → Equipment (category='feeding'|'drinking')
  notes?: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

import { getGlobalFormat } from "../../shr/units/useFormat";
/**

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';

/** دسته‌های مجاز برای هر نوع دارایی */
export default function EquipmentPage({ active = true }: { active?: boolean } = {}) {
  const { halls, zones, equipment, addEquip, updateEquip, deleteEquip } = useHal();
  const breedStd = useBreedStandard();
  const { flocks } = useFlk();
  const { contacts: allContacts } = useCtc();
  const supplierNames = useMemo(() => new Map(allContacts.map((c: Person) => [c.id, c.name || ''])), [allContacts]);
  const { invoices } = useTra();
  const { items: whsItems } = useWhs();
  const invoiceNumbers = useMemo(() => new Map(invoices.map((i: Invoice) => [i.id, i.number || '—'])), [invoices]);
  const whsItemNames = useMemo(() => new Map(whsItems.map((i: Item) => [i.id, i.name || ''])), [whsItems]);
  const suppliers = allContacts.filter((c: Person) => (c.roles || []).includes('supplier'));
  const { options: allCustomOpts } = useCustomOptions();
  const {
    open, setOpen, form, setForm, draft, err, setErr,
    autoFields, markAuto, clearAuto,
    buildPayload, openNew, openEdit, save: saveForm,
  } = useEquipmentForm();
  const __selectedHall = halls.find(h => h.id === form.hallId);
  const hallVolume = __selectedHall
    ? (__selectedHall.length || 0) * (__selectedHall.width || 0) * (__selectedHall.height || 0)
    : null;
  const hallArea = __selectedHall
    ? (__selectedHall.length || 0) * (__selectedHall.width || 0)
    : 0;
  const activeHallFlocks = useMemo(
    () => (flocks || []).filter((f) => f.hallId === form.hallId && f.status === 'active' && !f.paused),
    [flocks, form.hallId]
  );
  const activeBirdCount = useMemo(
    () => activeHallFlocks.reduce((sum, f) => sum + (f.currentCount || 0), 0),
    [activeHallFlocks]
  );
  const activeFlockBreedId = activeHallFlocks.find((f) => !!f.breedId)?.breedId || __selectedHall?.breedId;
  const selectedBreedStd = activeFlockBreedId ? breedStd.byBreedId(activeFlockBreedId) : null;
  const equipNeed = calcEquipNeed(form.type, form.hallId, flocks || [], breedStd, hallArea, __selectedHall?.capacity || 0);
  const [transferEq, setTransferEq] = useState<Equipment | null>(null);
  const [retireEq, setRetireEq] = useState<Equipment | null>(null);
  const [undoData, setUndoData] = useState<{ item: Equipment | Equipment[] } | null>(null);
  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [saveAttempted, setSaveAttempted] = useState(false);
  const [dupError, setDupError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const handleOpenNew = () => { setSaveAttempted(false); setDupError(null); openNew(); };
  const handleOpenEdit = (e: Equipment) => { setSaveAttempted(false); setDupError(null); openEdit(e); };
  const handleSave = () => {
    setSaveAttempted(true);
    if (Object.keys(vErrors).length > 0) return;   // inline errors shown
    if (!form.id) {
      const _dup = equipment.find((x: Equipment) => x.hallId === form.hallId && x.name.trim() === form.name.trim());
      if (_dup) { setDupError(`تجهیزی با نام «${_dup.name}» توی این سالن هست`); return; }
    }
    saveForm(equipment, addEquip, updateEquip);
  };

  useFab(active && halls.length > 0 && equipment.length > 0 ? { label: 'افزودن تجهیز', onClick: handleOpenNew } : null);


  // ═══ اعتبارسنجی زنده ═══
  const num = (s: string) => s ? parseFloat(toEn(s).replace('٫','.')) || 0 : 0;
  const int = (s: string) => s ? parseInt(toEn(s)) || 0 : 0;

  const { errors: vErrors } = useValidation(
    EquipmentSchema,
    {
      hallId: form.hallId || '',
      // kind حذف
      category: form.category || 'auxiliary',
      type: form.type || '',
      name: form.name || '',
      count: form.count ? parseInt(toEn(form.count)) || undefined : undefined,
      unit: form.unit || 'pcs',
      unitPrice: form.unitPrice ? parseFloat(toEn(form.unitPrice).replace('٫','.')) || undefined : undefined,
      purchasedAt: form.purchasedAt || '',
      warranty: form.warranty ? parseInt(toEn(form.warranty)) || undefined : undefined,
      capacity: form.capacity ? parseFloat(toEn(form.capacity).replace('٫','.')) || undefined : undefined,
      efficiency: form.efficiency ? parseFloat(toEn(form.efficiency).replace('٫','.')) || undefined : undefined,
      consumeRate: form.consumeRate || undefined,
      sourceInvoiceId: '',
      warehouseItemId: '',
      notes: form.notes || '',
    },
  );

  // فیلتر/مرتب
  // 🆕 برندهای یونیک از تجهیزات
  const brands = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    equipment.forEach((e: Equipment) => { if (e.brand) set.add(e.brand); });
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [equipment]);

  // 🆕 تأمین‌کننده‌ها از مخاطبین
  const supplierList = useMemo(() => {
    return (allContacts || [])
      .filter((c: Person) => (c.roles || []).includes('supplier'))
      .map((c: Person) => ({ id: c.id, name: c.name }));
  }, [allContacts]);

  const config = useMemo(
    () => getHalEquipmentConfig({ halls, suppliers: supplierList, brands }),
    [halls, supplierList, brands],
  );
  const { filtered: _listRaw, filters, setFilter, clearFilter, sort, setSort, toggleSort,
          resetAll, hasActiveFilters, total, count } = useFilterSort<Equipment>({
    items: equipment,
    filters: config.filterDefs,
    sorts: config.sortDefs,
    persistKey: config.persistKey,
    initialSort: config.initialSort,
  });

  // ─── فیلتر آرشیو هوشمند ───
  //   - اگه کاربر «آرشیو» رو فیلتر کرد → فقط آرشیوها
  //   - در غیر این صورت → آرشیوها مخفی
  const list = useMemo(() => {
    const sf = filters.status as string | string[] | undefined;
    // کاربر می‌خواد اسقاط‌شده‌ها یا آرشیو رو ببینه؟
    const wantsHidden = Array.isArray(sf)
      ? sf.some(s => s === 'archived' || s === 'retired')
      : (sf === 'archived' || sf === 'retired');
    if (wantsHidden) return _listRaw;
    // پیش‌فرض: اسقاط و آرشیو مخفی (استاندارد SAP/Odoo)
    return _listRaw.filter(e => e.status !== 'archived' && e.status !== 'retired');
  }, [_listRaw, filters.status]);

  // ─── KPI Cards ───
  const kpiData = useMemo(() => {
    const cats = new Set<string>();
    let value = 0;
    let repair = 0;
    for (const e of equipment) {
      if (e.category) cats.add(e.category);
      value += calcEquipValue(e);
      if (e.status === 'maintenance' || e.status === 'broken') repair++;
    }
    return { total: equipment.length, categories: cats.size, totalValue: value, needRepair: repair };
  }, [equipment]);

  // ─── Multi-Select ───
  const ms = useMultiSelect({
    items: list,
    getId: (e: Equipment) => e.id,
    onDelete: async (ids) => {
      const ok = await showConfirmAsync('حذف گروهی', `${getGlobalFormat().count(ids.length)} تجهیز حذف شوند؟`, { danger: true });
      if (!ok) return;
      const backups: Equipment[] = [];
      for (const id of ids) {
        const item = equipment.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (!item) continue;
        backups.push(item);
        try { deleteEquip(id); } catch {}
      }
      if (backups.length > 0) {
        setUndoData({ item: backups });
        setTimeout(() => setUndoData((cur) => cur && Array.isArray(cur.item) && cur.item.length === backups.length ? null : cur), 8000);
      }
      toastMsg.deletedBulk(backups.length, 'تجهیز')
      logAction('delete', 'hal', 'حذف گروهی تجهیزات: ' + backups.length);
    },
    onArchive: async (ids) => {
      for (const id of ids) {
        try { updateEquip(id, { status: 'archived' }); } catch {}
      }
      toastMsg.archivedBulk(ids.length, 'تجهیز');
      logAction('update', 'hal', 'آرشیو گروهی تجهیزات: ' + ids.length);
    },
  });
  const totalValue = list.reduce((acc, e) => acc + calcEquipValue(e), 0);

  if (halls.length === 0) {
  const undoDelete = () => {
    const item = undoData;
    if (!item) return;
    try {
      const items = Array.isArray(item.item) ? item.item : [item.item];
      items.forEach(e => {
        const { id, createdAt, updatedAt, ...rest } = e;
        addEquip(rest);
      });
      toastMsg.restored(items.length > 1 ? 'تجهیزات' : 'تجهیز');
    } catch (err) {
      toastMsg.error('بازگردانی ناموفق');
    }
    setUndoData(null);
  };
    return (
      <PageContainer>
      {undoData && (
        <UndoBar
          label="حذف شد"
          onUndo={undoDelete}
          onDismiss={() => setUndoData(null)}
        />
      )}
        <Empty
          icon={<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/></svg>}
          title="اول یک سالن بسازید"
          desc="تجهیزات داخل سالن قرار می‌گیرند. اول از تب «سالن‌ها» استفاده کنید."
        />
      </PageContainer>
    );
  }


  return (
    <PageContainer>
      <HelpBanner
        id="hal-equip-intro"
        icon="⚙️"
        title="مدیریت تجهیزات"
        description="تجهیزات هر سالن (فن، لامپ، آبخوری، دانخوری، بستر و...) را اینجا ثبت کنید. با انتخاب نوع دارایی و دسته، زیرنوع‌های مربوطه نمایش داده می‌شوند."
        tone="info"
      />

      <EquipmentKpiCards
        total={kpiData.total}
        categories={kpiData.categories}
        totalValue={kpiData.totalValue}
        needRepair={kpiData.needRepair}
      />

      <FilterBar
        filterDefs={config.filterDefs}
        sortDefs={config.sortDefs}
        filterState={filters}
        sortState={sort}
        setFilter={setFilter}
        clearFilter={clearFilter}
        setSort={setSort}
        toggleSort={toggleSort}
        resetAll={resetAll}
        hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
        total={total}
        count={count}
      />

      {!ms.selectionMode && list.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: 'var(--dim)', textAlign: 'center', paddingBottom: 2 }}>
          برای انتخاب چندتایی، روی یک کارت نگه دارید
        </div>
      )}

      {ms.selectionMode && list.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 6 }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={ms.selectedIds.size === list.length ? ms.clearSelection : ms.selectAll}
            style={{
              padding: '4px 10px',
              background: 'var(--input-bg)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border)',
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
              color: 'var(--muted)',
              fontFamily: 'inherit',
              fontSize: '10px',
              fontWeight: 600,
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            {ms.selectedIds.size === list.length ? 'لغو انتخاب همه' : 'انتخاب همه'}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {list.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty
          icon={<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round"><path d="M14.7 6.3a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.4l1.6 1.6a1 1 0 0 0 1.4 0l3.77-3.77a6 6 0 0 1-7.94 7.94l-6.91 6.91a2.12 2.12 0 0 1-3-3l6.91-6.91a6 6 0 0 1 7.94-7.94l-3.76 3.76z"/></svg>}
          title="تجهیزی ثبت نشده"
          desc="لامپ، فن، هیتر، آبخوری، دانخوری، دوربین و سنسور را اضافه کنید."
          action={<Btn variant="primary" onClick={handleOpenNew}>+ افزودن تجهیز</Btn>}
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          {list.map((e, i) => {
            const hall = halls.find(h => h.id === e.hallId);
            const isOpen = expandedId === e.id;
            return (
              <EquipmentCard
                key={e.id}
                e={e}
                i={i}
                hall={hall}
                allCustomOpts={allCustomOpts}
                isOpen={isOpen}
                ms={ms}
                onToggle={() => setExpandedId(isOpen ? null : e.id)}
                onEdit={() => handleOpenEdit(e)}
                onDelete={deleteEquip}
                onRetire={(eq) => setRetireEq(eq)}
                onTransfer={(eq) => setTransferEq(eq)}
                onRestore={(id) => updateEquip(id, { status: 'active', saleInfo: undefined })}
                onUndo={(item) => {
                  setUndoData({ item });
                  setTimeout(() => setUndoData((cur) => cur && !Array.isArray(cur.item) && cur.item.id === item.id ? null : cur), 6000);
                }}
                supplierNames={supplierNames}
                invoiceNumbers={invoiceNumbers}
                whsItemNames={whsItemNames}
              />
            );
          })}

        </>
      )}

      {/* نوار شناور Multi-Select */}
      <MultiSelectBar ms={ms} deleteLabel="حذف" archiveLabel="آرشیو" />

      {/* فاصله‌ی پایین برای نوار شناور */}
      {ms.selectionMode && <div style={{ height: 90 }} />}

      <EquipmentFormModal
        open={open}
        setOpen={setOpen}
        form={form}
        setForm={setForm}
        err={err}
        onErrorClear={() => { setErr(''); setDupError(null); }}
        vErrors={{ ...(saveAttempted ? vErrors : {}), ...(dupError ? { name: dupError } : {}) }}
        halls={halls}
        zones={zones}
        equipment={equipment}
        autoFields={autoFields}
        clearAuto={clearAuto}
        markAuto={markAuto}
        categoriesForKind={categoriesForKind}
        typesForCategory={typesForCategory}
        equipNeed={equipNeed}
        stdForDefaults={selectedBreedStd}
        activeBirdCount={activeBirdCount}
        activeFlockCount={activeHallFlocks.length}
        save={handleSave}
      />
          <RetireEquipModal
        open={!!retireEq}
        onClose={() => setRetireEq(null)}
        equipment={retireEq}
        onConfirm={(eq, info, opts) => {
          const totalCount = Math.max(1, eq.count || 1);
          const qty = Math.min(totalCount, Math.max(1, opts.qty || totalCount));
          let saleInvoiceId: string | undefined;

          if (info.reason === 'sale' && opts.createInvoice && info.partyId) {
            try {
              const unitSalePrice = Math.round(info.salePrice / qty);
              saleInvoiceId = useTra.getState().addInvoice({
                type: 'sale',
                date: info.soldAt,
                partyId: info.partyId,
                category: 'equipment',
                items: [{
                  id: crypto.randomUUID(),
                  category: 'equipment',
                  description: `فروش تجهیز: ${eq.name}`,
                  quantity: qty,
                  unit: eq.unit || 'pcs',
                  unitPrice: unitSalePrice,
                  total: info.salePrice,
                  brand: eq.brand,
                  model: eq.model,
                }],
                total: info.salePrice,
                payments: [],
                dueDate: info.soldAt,
                relatedFlockId: '',
                relatedEntryId: '',
                sourceType: 'manual',
                notes: info.note ? `فروش تجهیز (${eq.name}) — ${info.note}` : `فروش تجهیز (${eq.name})`,
              });
            } catch (err) {
              console.error('[HAL→TRA] create sale invoice failed:', err);
            }
          }

          const finalInfo = saleInvoiceId ? { ...info, saleInvoiceId } : info;

          if (qty < totalCount) {
            const remainCount = totalCount - qty;
            updateEquip(eq.id, { count: remainCount });
            if (eq.warehouseItemId) {
              try { useWhs.getState().updateItem(eq.warehouseItemId, { currentStock: remainCount }); } catch {}
            }
            const { id: _id, createdAt: _c, updatedAt: _u, warehouseItemId: _w, ...rest } = eq;
            addEquip({
              ...rest,
              count: qty,
              status: 'retired',
              saleInfo: finalInfo,
            });
          } else {
            updateEquip(eq.id, { status: 'retired', saleInfo: finalInfo });
            if (eq.warehouseItemId) {
              try { useWhs.getState().updateItem(eq.warehouseItemId, { currentStock: 0 }); } catch {}
            }
          }

          logAction('update', 'hal', `${info.reason === 'sale' ? 'فروش' : 'اسقاط'} (${qty} عدد): ${eq.name} — ${info.reason === 'sale' ? getGlobalFormat().money(info.salePrice) : 'بدون مبلغ'}`);
          toastMsg.success(
            info.reason === 'sale'
              ? (saleInvoiceId ? 'فروش و فاکتور معاملات ثبت شد' : 'فروش ثبت شد')
              : 'تجهیز اسقاط شد'
          );
          setRetireEq(null);
        }}
      />

      <TransferEquipModal
        open={!!transferEq}
        onClose={() => setTransferEq(null)}
        equipment={transferEq}
        halls={halls}
        zones={zones}
        onConfirm={(eq, toHallId, toZoneId, qty, date, note) => {
          const totalCount = Math.max(1, eq.count || 1);
          const moveQty = Math.min(totalCount, Math.max(1, qty || totalCount));
          const fromHall = halls.find(h => h.id === eq.hallId);
          const toHall = halls.find(h => h.id === toHallId);
          const fromZone = zones.find(z => z.id === eq.zoneId);
          const toZone = zones.find(z => z.id === toZoneId);

          const log: TransferLog = {
            id: crypto.randomUUID(),
            fromHallId: eq.hallId || '',
            fromHallName: fromHall?.name || '—',
            fromZoneId: eq.zoneId || undefined,
            fromZoneName: fromZone?.name || undefined,
            toHallId,
            toHallName: toHall?.name || '—',
            toZoneId: toZoneId || undefined,
            toZoneName: toZone?.name || undefined,
            count: moveQty,
            date,
            note,
            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          };

          const targetDup = equipment.find(x =>
            x.id !== eq.id &&
            (x.status || 'active') === (eq.status || 'active') &&
            x.hallId === toHallId &&
            (x.zoneId || '') === (toZoneId || '') &&
            x.name.trim() === eq.name.trim() &&
            (x.type || '') === (eq.type || '') &&
            (x.brand || '') === (eq.brand || '') &&
            (x.unitPrice || 0) === (eq.unitPrice || 0)
          );

          if (moveQty < totalCount) {
            const remainCount = totalCount - moveQty;
            updateEquip(eq.id, {
              count: remainCount,
              transferHistory: [...(eq.transferHistory || []), log],
            });
            if (eq.warehouseItemId) {
              try { useWhs.getState().updateItem(eq.warehouseItemId, { currentStock: remainCount }); } catch {}
            }
            if (targetDup) {
              const newTargetCount = (targetDup.count || 0) + moveQty;
              updateEquip(targetDup.id, {
                count: newTargetCount,
                transferHistory: [...(targetDup.transferHistory || []), log],
              });
              if (targetDup.warehouseItemId) {
                try { useWhs.getState().updateItem(targetDup.warehouseItemId, { currentStock: newTargetCount }); } catch {}
              }
            } else {
              const { id: _id, createdAt: _c, updatedAt: _u, warehouseItemId: _w, ...rest } = eq;
              addEquip({
                ...rest,
                hallId: toHallId,
                zoneId: toZoneId || undefined,
                count: moveQty,
                transferHistory: [...(eq.transferHistory || []), log],
              });
            }
          } else if (targetDup) {
            const newTargetCount = (targetDup.count || 0) + moveQty;
            updateEquip(targetDup.id, {
              count: newTargetCount,
              transferHistory: [...(targetDup.transferHistory || []), log],
            });
            if (targetDup.warehouseItemId) {
              try { useWhs.getState().updateItem(targetDup.warehouseItemId, { currentStock: newTargetCount }); } catch {}
            }
            deleteEquip(eq.id);
          } else {
            updateEquip(eq.id, {
              hallId: toHallId,
              zoneId: toZoneId || undefined,
              transferHistory: [...(eq.transferHistory || []), log],
            });
          }

          const destLabel = toZone ? `${toHall?.name} (${toZone.name})` : (toHall?.name || '—');
          logAction('update', 'hal', `جابجایی (${moveQty} عدد): ${eq.name} → ${destLabel}`);
          toastMsg.success('جابجایی ثبت شد');
        }}
      />
    </PageContainer>
  );
}

/** HallEquipSection — تجهیزات سالن (بازطراحی تک‌خطی) */
import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useBodyScrollLock } from '../../shr/hooks/useBodyScrollLock';
import { getCategoryLabel } from './_typedLabels';
import HallEquipModals from './components/HallEquipModals';
import CategoryPicker from './components/CategoryPicker';
import HallEquipCatCard from './components/HallEquipCatCard';
import { CATEGORY_COLORS } from '../../shr/icons/equipment';
import { LITTER_LABELS, VENT_SYS_LABELS, FEEDER_LABELS, DRINKER_LABELS } from './_labels';
import {
  useHal,
  CATEGORY_LABELS,
  type Equipment,
  type EquipmentCategory } from './store';
import { toFa, toEn } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { useFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { toastMsg } from '../../cor/store/toast';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../cor/store/dialog';
import { NEED_CALCULATORS, type NeedInput } from './needs';
import {
  typesForCategory, unitForCategory, calcInstalled,
  ALL_CATS,
} from './_equipHelpers';
import { getEquipUnit } from './equipUnits';

interface Props {
  hallId: string;
  needInput?: NeedInput;
  legacy?: {
    ventilationSystem?: string;
    feederType?: string;
    drinkerType?: string;
    litterType?: string;
  };
}

type Tone = 'ok' | 'low' | 'very-low' | 'over' | 'none';

const TONE_COLOR: Record<Tone, string> = {
  'ok': 'var(--accent)',
  'low': 'var(--warn)',
  'very-low': 'var(--danger)',
  'over': 'var(--purple)',
  'none': 'var(--dim)',
};
const TONE_EMOJI: Record<Tone, string> = {
  'ok': '🟢',
  'low': '🟡',
  'very-low': '🔴',
  'over': '🟣',
  'none': '⚪',
};
const TONE_LABEL: Record<Tone, string> = {
  'ok': 'کافی',
  'low': 'کم',
  'very-low': 'خیلی کم',
  'over': 'اضافه',
  'none': 'ثبت نشده',
};

export function HallEquipSection({ hallId, needInput, legacy }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { equipment, addEquip, updateEquip, deleteEquip } = useHal();

  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [detailCat, setDetailCat] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [catPicker, setCatPicker] = useState(false);

  // Picker state
  const [picker, setPicker] = useState(false);
  const [pickerCat, setPickerCat] = useState<string>('ventilation');
  const [pickerType, setPickerType] = useState<string>('fan_tunnel');
  const [pickerCount, setPickerCount] = useState<string>('');
  const [pickerCap, setPickerCap] = useState<string>('');
  const [pickerName, setPickerName] = useState<string>('');
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');

  // Edit state
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editCount, setEditCount] = useState<string>('');
  const [editCap, setEditCap] = useState<string>('');

  // 🆕 قفل کامل scroll بدن وقتی هر modal بازه
  useBodyScrollLock(catPicker || picker || detailCat !== null || editId !== null);

  // ═══ محاسبات ═══
  const hallEquips = useMemo(
    () => equipment.filter(e => e.hallId === hallId),
    [equipment, hallId],
  );

  const grouped = useMemo(() => {
    const g: Record<string, Equipment[]> = {};
    hallEquips.forEach(e => {
      const cat = e.category || 'auxiliary';
      if (!g[cat]) g[cat] = [];
      g[cat].push(e);
    });
    return g;
  }, [hallEquips]);

  const needByCategory = useMemo(() => {
    const m: Record<string, { value: number; unit: string } | null> = {};
    if (needInput) {
      Object.entries(NEED_CALCULATORS).forEach(([cat, calc]) => {
        try { m[cat] = calc(needInput); } catch { m[cat] = null; }
      });
    }
    return m;
  }, [needInput]);

  function toneFor(cat: string): Tone {
    const installed = calcInstalled(cat, grouped[cat] || []);
    const need = needByCategory[cat]?.value || 0;
    if (installed === 0 && need === 0) return 'none';
    if (installed === 0 && need > 0) return 'very-low';
    if (need === 0) return 'ok';
    const pct = (installed / need) * 100;
    if (pct < 50) return 'very-low';
    if (pct < 90) return 'low';
    if (pct <= 150) return 'ok';
    return 'over';
  }

  function pctFor(cat: string): number | null {
    const installed = calcInstalled(cat, grouped[cat] || []);
    const need = needByCategory[cat]?.value || 0;
    if (installed === 0 || need === 0) return null;
    return (installed / need) * 100;
  }

  // ═══ دسته‌های قابل نمایش (فقط اونایی که تجهیز دارن یا نیاز دارن) ═══
  const displayCats = useMemo(() => {
    return ALL_CATS.filter(cat => {
      const hasItems = (grouped[cat] || []).length > 0;
      const hasNeed = (needByCategory[cat]?.value || 0) > 0;
      return hasItems || hasNeed;
    });
  }, [grouped, needByCategory]);

  const issueCount = useMemo(() => {
    return displayCats.filter(cat => {
      const t = toneFor(cat);
      return t === 'very-low' || t === 'low';
    }).length;
  }, [displayCats, grouped, needByCategory]);

  const headerDots = useMemo(() => {
    return displayCats.map(cat => toneFor(cat)).slice(0, 5);
  }, [displayCats, grouped, needByCategory]);

  // ═══ Handlers ═══
  const openPicker = (cat: string) => {
    setCatPicker(false);  // 🆕
    setDetailCat(null);   // 🆕
    const types = typesForCategory(cat);
    setPickerCat(cat);
    setPickerType(types[0] || 'other');
    setPickerCount('');
    setPickerCap('');
    setPickerName('');
    setErr('');
    setPicker(true);
  };

  const saveNewEquip = () => {
    if (!pickerName.trim()) { setErr('نام تجهیز را وارد کنید'); return; }
    const name = pickerName.trim();
    const dup = hallEquips.find((x) => x.type === pickerType && x.name.trim() === name);
    if (dup) { setErr('این تجهیز قبلاً در همین سالن ثبت شده'); return; }
    const def = getEquipUnit(pickerType);
    const capValue = pickerCap
      ? parseFloat(toEn(pickerCap).replace('٫', '.')) || null
      : (def.secondary?.defaultValue || null);
    addEquip({
      hallId,
      category: pickerCat as EquipmentCategory,
      type: pickerType,
      name,
      count: pickerCount ? parseInt(toEn(pickerCount)) || null : null,
      unit: 'pcs',
      unitPrice: null,
      purchasedAt: '',
      warranty: null,
      notes: '',
      capacity: capValue,
      efficiency: null,
      consumeRate: undefined,
    });
    toastMsg.added(name);
    setPicker(false);
  };

  const openEdit = (e: Equipment) => {
    setEditId(e.id);
    setEditCount(e.count ? fmt.raw.digits(String(e.count), fmt.units.numberFormat) : '');
    setEditCap(e.capacity ? fmt.raw.digits(String(e.capacity), fmt.units.numberFormat) : '');
  };

  const saveEdit = () => {
    if (!editId) return;
    const cur = hallEquips.find(x => x.id === editId);
    if (!cur) return;
    const newCount = editCount ? parseInt(toEn(editCount)) || null : null;
    const newCap = editCap ? parseFloat(toEn(editCap).replace('٫', '.')) || null : null;
    updateEquip(editId, { count: newCount, capacity: newCap } as Partial<Equipment>);
    toastMsg.saved(cur.name);
    setEditId(null);
  };

  const removeEquip = async (id: string, name: string) => {
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync('حذف تجهیز', '«' + name + '» از این سالن حذف شود؟', { danger: true });
    if (!ok) return;
    deleteEquip(id);
    toastMsg.deleted(name);
    setDetailCat(null);
  };

  // 🆕 Escape key
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!catPicker) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') setCatPicker(false); };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [catPicker]);

  // ═══ Detail modal data ═══
  const detailList = detailCat ? (grouped[detailCat] || []) : [];
  const detailCatLabel = detailCat ? (getCategoryLabel(detailCat)?.name || detailCat) : '';
  const detailColor = detailCat ? (CATEGORY_COLORS[detailCat] || 'var(--cat-auxiliary)') : 'var(--cat-auxiliary)';
  const detailInstalled = detailCat ? calcInstalled(detailCat, detailList) : 0;
  const detailNeed = detailCat ? (needByCategory[detailCat]?.value || 0) : 0;
  const detailTone = detailCat ? toneFor(detailCat) : 'none';
  const detailPct = detailCat ? pctFor(detailCat) : null;
  const detailNeedUnit = detailCat ? (needByCategory[detailCat]?.unit || unitForCategory(detailCat, detailList)) : '';
  const detailUnit = detailCat ? unitForCategory(detailCat, detailList) : '';
  const currentEdit = editId ? hallEquips.find(e => e.id === editId) : null;

  return (
    <>
      <div style={{ borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', overflow: 'hidden', border: '1px solid var(--border)' }}>
        {/* ═══ هدر ═══ */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setOpen(o => !o)}
          aria-expanded={open}
          style={{
            width: '100%', padding: '10px 12px',
            background: 'var(--bg)', border: 'none',
            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10,
            fontFamily: 'inherit', cursor: 'pointer', textAlign: 'right',
          }}
        >
          <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)' }}>⚙️</span>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>
            تجهیزات سالن
          </span>
          <span style={{
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', fontWeight: 600, padding: 'var(--pad-chip-xs)',
            borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', background: 'var(--card-solid)', color: 'var(--muted)',
          }}>{fmt.count(hallEquips.length)} مورد</span>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, marginRight: 'auto' }}>
            {headerDots.map((t, i) => (
              <span key={i} style={{
                width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: '50%',
                background: TONE_COLOR[t],
              }} />
            ))}
          </div>
          <span style={{
            color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
            transform: open ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'none',
            transition: 'transform .25s',
          }}>▾</span>
        </button>

        {/* ═══ خلاصه (بسته) ═══ */}
        {!open && (
          <div style={{
            padding: '0 12px 10px', background: 'var(--bg)',
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)',
          }}>
            {issueCount > 0 ? (
              <>
                ⚠️ <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--warn)' }}>
                  {fmt.count(issueCount)} دسته
                </span>{' '}
                نیاز به توجه داره
              </>
            ) : displayCats.length > 0 ? (
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700 }}>✓ همه تجهیزات کافی هستن</span>
            ) : (
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>تجهیزی ثبت نشده</span>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ═══ محتوای باز — تک‌خطی ═══ */}
        {open && (
          <div>
            {displayCats.length === 0 ? (
              <div style={{
                padding: 'var(--sp-6)', textAlign: 'center',
                fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)',
                background: 'var(--card-solid)',
              }}>
                تجهیزی ثبت نشده — با دکمه پایین اضافه کن
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div style={{
                display: 'grid',
                gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr',
                gap: 'var(--sp-2)',
                padding: 'var(--sp-3)',
                background: 'var(--card-solid)',
              }}>
                {displayCats.map(cat => (
                  <HallEquipCatCard
                    key={cat}
                    cat={cat}
                    count={(grouped[cat] || []).length}
                    tone={toneFor(cat)}
                    pct={pctFor(cat)}
                    onClick={() => setDetailCat(cat)}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

            <div style={{ padding: 'var(--sp-3)', background: 'var(--card-solid)' }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setCatPicker(true)}
                style={{
                  width: '100%', padding: 'var(--sp-3)', minHeight: 40,
                  borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', border: '1px dashed var(--accent-border)',
                  background: 'var(--accent-soft)', color: 'var(--accent)',
                  fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                  fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer',
                }}
              >+ افزودن دسته‌ی تجهیز</button>
            </div>

            {/* legacy pills */}
            {legacy && (legacy.ventilationSystem || legacy.feederType || legacy.drinkerType || legacy.litterType) && (
              <div style={{
                padding: '0 12px 10px',
                background: 'var(--card-solid)',
                display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 4,
              }}>
                {legacy.ventilationSystem && <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', padding: 'var(--pad-chip)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>تهویه: {VENT_SYS_LABELS[legacy.ventilationSystem] || legacy.ventilationSystem}</span>}
                {legacy.feederType && <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', padding: 'var(--pad-chip)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>دان: {FEEDER_LABELS[legacy.feederType] || legacy.feederType}</span>}
                {legacy.drinkerType && <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', padding: 'var(--pad-chip)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>آب: {DRINKER_LABELS[legacy.drinkerType] || legacy.drinkerType}</span>}
                {legacy.litterType && <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', padding: 'var(--pad-chip)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>بستر: {LITTER_LABELS[legacy.litterType] || legacy.litterType}</span>}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <CategoryPicker
        open={catPicker}
        onClose={() => setCatPicker(false)}
        onPick={openPicker}
        grouped={grouped}
      />

      <HallEquipModals
        detailCat={detailCat} setDetailCat={setDetailCat}
        detailCatLabel={detailCatLabel} detailInstalled={detailInstalled}
        detailTone={detailTone} detailPct={detailPct}
        detailNeed={detailNeed} detailUnit={detailUnit} detailNeedUnit={detailNeedUnit}
        detailList={detailList} detailColor={detailColor}
        openPicker={openPicker} openEdit={openEdit} removeEquip={removeEquip}
        picker={picker} setPicker={setPicker} pickerCat={pickerCat}
        pickerType={pickerType} setPickerType={setPickerType}
        pickerName={pickerName} setPickerName={setPickerName}
        err={err} setErr={setErr}
        pickerCount={pickerCount} setPickerCount={setPickerCount}
        pickerCap={pickerCap} setPickerCap={setPickerCap}
        saveNewEquip={saveNewEquip} typesForCategory={typesForCategory}
        equipment={equipment}
        editId={editId} setEditId={setEditId} currentEdit={currentEdit}
        editCount={editCount} setEditCount={setEditCount}
        editCap={editCap} setEditCap={setEditCap}
        saveEdit={saveEdit}
      />
    </>
  );
}

/**

import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import HallCard from './components/HallCard';
import HallsFormModal from './components/HallsFormModal';

import { useFormDraft } from '../../shr/hooks/useFormDraft';
