/**
 * useHallsCascade — وقتی سالنی حذف می‌شه، گله‌های یتیم رو آزاد می‌کنه
 */
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

export function useHallsCascade(
  hallsRaw: { id: string }[],
  flocks: { id: string; hallId: string }[],
  updateFlock: (id: string, patch: { hallId: string; zoneId: string }) => void,
) {
  const prevHallIdsRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());

  useEffect(() => {
    const currentIds = new Set(hallsRaw.map((h) => h.id));
    const prevIds = prevHallIdsRef.current;

    if (prevIds.size > 0) {
      const removedIds: string[] = [];
      prevIds.forEach(id => { if (!currentIds.has(id)) removedIds.push(id); });

      if (removedIds.length > 0) {
        removedIds.forEach(hallId => {
          flocks.filter((f) => f.hallId === hallId).forEach((f) => {
            try { updateFlock(f.id, { hallId: '', zoneId: '' }); } catch {}
          });
        });
      }
    }

    prevHallIdsRef.current = currentIds;
  }, [hallsRaw, flocks, updateFlock]);
}

FILE: ./src/mod/hal/needs.ts

/**
 * needs.ts — محاسبه نیاز تجهیزات بر اساس استاندارد و گله
 */
import type { BirdStandard } from '../set/standards/types';

/** درون‌یابی وزن پرنده بر اساس سن (روز) */
function interpolateWeight(std: BirdStandard | null, ageDays: number): number {
  if (!std?.growth?.weightByAge?.length) return 1500;
  const pts = [...std.growth.weightByAge].sort((a, b) => a.dayFrom - b.dayFrom);
  if (pts.length === 0) return 1500;
  if (ageDays <= pts[0].dayFrom) return pts[0].weightG;
  if (ageDays >= pts[pts.length - 1].dayTo) return pts[pts.length - 1].weightG;
  for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
    if (ageDays >= pts[i].dayFrom && ageDays <= pts[i].dayTo) {
      return pts[i].weightG;
    }
    if (ageDays > pts[i].dayTo && ageDays < pts[i + 1].dayFrom) {
      const t = (ageDays - pts[i].dayTo) / (pts[i + 1].dayFrom - pts[i].dayTo);
      return pts[i].weightG + t * (pts[i + 1].weightG - pts[i].weightG);
    }
  }
  return pts[pts.length - 1].weightG;
}

export interface NeedInput {
  birdCount: number;
  ageDays: number;
  areaM2: number;
  volumeM3: number;
  standard: BirdStandard | null;
  /** 🆕 نوع بستر انتخاب‌شده سالن */
  litterType?: string | null;
}

export interface CategoryNeed {
  value: number;
  unit: string;
  formula: string;
}

/** نیاز تهویه (m³/h) */
export function needVentilation(inp: NeedInput): CategoryNeed | null {
  if (!inp.standard || inp.birdCount <= 0) return null;
  const weightG = interpolateWeight(inp.standard, inp.ageDays);
  const weightKg = weightG / 1000;
  const totalKg = inp.birdCount * weightKg;
  const coef = inp.standard.equipment?.fanM3PerKg || 4.5;
  return {
    value: Math.ceil(totalKg * coef),
    unit: 'm³/h',
    formula: `${inp.birdCount} × ${weightKg.toFixed(2)}kg × ${coef}`,
  };
}

/** نیاز روشنایی (W) */
export function needLighting(inp: NeedInput): CategoryNeed | null {
  if (!inp.standard || inp.areaM2 <= 0) return null;
  const wPerM2 = inp.standard.equipment?.lampWattPerM2 || 3;
  return {
    value: Math.ceil(inp.areaM2 * wPerM2),
    unit: 'W',
    formula: `${inp.areaM2} m² × ${wPerM2} W/m²`,
  };
}

/** نیاز آبخوری (تعداد) */
export function needDrinker(inp: NeedInput): CategoryNeed | null {
  if (!inp.standard || inp.birdCount <= 0) return null;
  // 🆕 به‌جای تعداد تجهیز، ظرفیت پرنده برمی‌گردونیم تا با calcInstalled هم‌واحد باشه
  return {
    value: inp.birdCount,
    unit: 'پرنده',
    formula: `${inp.birdCount} پرنده`,
  };
}

/** نیاز دانخوری (تعداد) */
export function needFeeder(inp: NeedInput): CategoryNeed | null {
  if (!inp.standard || inp.birdCount <= 0) return null;
  // 🆕 ظرفیت پرنده
  return {
    value: inp.birdCount,
    unit: 'پرنده',
    formula: `${inp.birdCount} پرنده`,
  };
}

/** نیاز بستر (kg) — بر اساس مساحت × kg/m² (بسته به ماده) */
export function needLitter(inp: NeedInput): CategoryNeed | null {
  if (inp.areaM2 <= 0) return null;
  const std = inp.standard?.litter;
  const kgMap = std?.kgPerM2ByMaterial;

  // 🆕 نگاشت Equipment type → Standard key
  const LITTER_KEY_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
    'litter_wood_shavings': 'wood_shavings',
    'wood_shavings': 'wood_shavings',
    'litter_roll': 'paper_roll',
    'paper_roll': 'paper_roll',
    'litter_sand': 'sand',
    'sand': 'sand',
    'litter_rice_hull': 'rice_hull',
    'rice_hull': 'rice_hull',
    'litter_straw': 'straw',
    'straw': 'straw',
    'litter_sawdust': 'sawdust',
    'sawdust': 'sawdust',
    'litter_peat': 'peat',
    'peat': 'peat',
  };
  const rawType = inp.litterType;
  const litterType = rawType ? (LITTER_KEY_MAP[rawType] || rawType) : null;

  let kgPerM2 = 0;
  let materialName = '—';
  if (kgMap && litterType && (kgMap as Record<string, number>)[litterType] !== undefined) {
    kgPerM2 = (kgMap as Record<string, number>)[litterType];
    materialName = litterType;
  } else if (kgMap && std?.recommended?.[0]) {
    kgPerM2 = (kgMap as Record<string, number>)[std.recommended[0]] || 0;
    materialName = std.recommended[0];
  }

  if (kgPerM2 <= 0) return null;

  return {
    value: Math.ceil(inp.areaM2 * kgPerM2 * 10) / 10,
    unit: 'kg',
    formula: `${inp.areaM2} m² × ${kgPerM2} kg/m² (${materialName})`,
  };
}

/** نیاز گرمایش (kW) — استاندارد صنعتی: ۰.۱-۰.۲ kW/m² */
export function needHeating(inp: NeedInput): CategoryNeed | null {
  if (inp.areaM2 <= 0) return null;
  const kwPerM2 = 0.15;
  return {
    value: Math.ceil(inp.areaM2 * kwPerM2 * 10) / 10,
    unit: 'kW',
    formula: `${inp.areaM2} m² × ${kwPerM2} kW/m²`,
  };
}

export const NEED_CALCULATORS: Record<string, (inp: NeedInput) => CategoryNeed | null> = {
  ventilation: needVentilation,
  heating: needHeating,
  lighting: needLighting,
  drinking: needDrinker,
  feeding: needFeeder,
  litter: needLitter,
};

// ═══ Sync بین Equipment و Hall (Single Source of Truth) ═══
/** نگاشت دسته تجهیز → فیلد Hall */
const HALL_FIELD_BY_CAT: Record<string, keyof Hall | null> = {
  ventilation: 'ventilationSystem',
  feeding: 'feederType',
  drinking: 'drinkerType',
  litter: 'litterType',
  lighting: null,
  heating: null,
  power: null,
  auxiliary: null,
  water_treatment: null,
  safety: null,
  cleaning: null,
  hand_tools: null,
  weighing: null,
  cooling: null,
};

/**
 * محاسبه patch برای Hall بر اساس Equipment های موجود
 * آخرین تجهیز هر دسته = مقدار Hall (اولویت آخری که اضافه/ویرایش شده)
 */
function computeHallPatch(hallId: string, equipment: Equipment[], hall: Hall | null): Partial<Hall> {
  const hallEquip = equipment.filter(e => e.hallId === hallId && e.status !== 'retired' && e.status !== 'archived');
  const patch: Partial<Hall> = {};
  // ── فیلدهای string (نوع تجهیز) ──
  Object.entries(HALL_FIELD_BY_CAT).forEach(([cat, field]) => {
    if (!field) return;
    const items = hallEquip.filter(e => e.category === cat);
    const last = items.length > 0 ? items[items.length - 1] : null;
    (patch as Record<string, string>)[field as string] = last?.type || '';
  });
  // ── 🆕 تهویه (m³/h) — مجموع ظرفیت فن‌ها ──
  const totalAirflow = hallEquip
    .filter(e => isFanLike(e.type))
    .reduce((a, e) => a + ((e.count || 0) * (e.capacity || 0)), 0);
  patch.ventilation = totalAirflow > 0 ? totalAirflow : null;
  // ── 🆕 روشنایی (lux) — مجموع لومن / مساحت ──
  if (hall) {
    const area = (hall.length || 0) * (hall.width || 0);
    if (area > 0) {
      const lampLumensPerW = (type: string) => {
        if (type === 'lamp_led') return 100;
        if (type === 'lamp_fluorescent') return 60;
        return 15;
      };
      const totalLumens = hallEquip
        .filter(e => isLampLike(e.type))
        .reduce((a, e) => a + ((e.count || 0) * (e.capacity || 0) * lampLumensPerW(e.type)), 0);
      patch.light = totalLumens > 0 ? Math.round(totalLumens / area) : null;
    }
  }
  return patch;
}

interface State {
  halls: Hall[];
  zones: Zone[];
  equipment: Equipment[];
  addHall: (h: Omit<Hall, 'id'|'createdAt'|'updatedAt'>) => void;
  updateHall: (id: string, patch: Partial<Hall>) => void;
  deleteHall: (id: string) => void;
  addZone: (z: Omit<Zone, 'id'|'createdAt'|'updatedAt'>) => void;
  updateZone: (id: string, patch: Partial<Zone>) => void;
  deleteZone: (id: string) => void;
  addEquip: (e: Omit<Equipment, 'id'|'createdAt'|'updatedAt'>) => string;
  updateEquip: (id: string, patch: Partial<Equipment>) => void;
  deleteEquip: (id: string) => void;

  /** 🆕 وضعیت لود داده‌ها از IndexedDB */
  isLoading: boolean;
}

const now = () => new Date().toISOString();

export const useHal = create<State>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      isLoading: true,
      halls: [], zones: [], equipment: [],
      addHall: (h) => set({ halls: [...get().halls, {...h, id: uuid(), createdAt: now(), updatedAt: now()}] }),
      updateHall: (id, patch) => set({ halls: get().halls.map(x => x.id === id ? {...x, ...patch, updatedAt: now()} : x) }),
      deleteHall: (id) => set({ halls: get().halls.filter(x => x.id !== id), zones: get().zones.filter(x => x.hallId !== id), equipment: get().equipment.filter(x => x.hallId !== id) }),
      addZone: (z) => set({ zones: [...get().zones, {...z, id: uuid(), createdAt: now(), updatedAt: now()}] }),
      updateZone: (id, patch) => set({ zones: get().zones.map(x => x.id === id ? {...x, ...patch, updatedAt: now()} : x) }),
      deleteZone: (id) => set({
        zones: get().zones.filter(x => x.id !== id),
        equipment: get().equipment.map(e =>
          e.zoneId === id ? { ...e, zoneId: '' } : e
        )
      }),
      addEquip: (e) => {
        const id = uuid();
        const eq = { ...e, id, createdAt: now(), updatedAt: now() } as Equipment;
        const nextEquipment = [...get().equipment, eq];
        const hall = get().halls.find(h => h.id === eq.hallId) || null;
        const hallPatch = computeHallPatch(eq.hallId, nextEquipment, hall);
        set({
          equipment: nextEquipment,
          halls: get().halls.map(h => h.id === eq.hallId ? { ...h, ...hallPatch, updatedAt: now() } : h),
        });
        // 🆕 سینک با انبار
        try {
          const whsId = ensureWhsItem(eq);
          if (whsId) set({ equipment: get().equipment.map(x => x.id === id ? { ...x, warehouseItemId: whsId } : x) });
        } catch (err) { console.error('[HAL] whs sync:', err); }
        return id;
      },
      updateEquip: (id, patch) => {
        const prev = get().equipment.find(x => x.id === id);
        const nextEquipment = get().equipment.map(x => x.id === id ? {...x, ...patch, updatedAt: now()} : x);
        const updated = nextEquipment.find(x => x.id === id);
        // halls تحت تأثیر: قبلی + جدید
        const affected = new Set<string>();
        if (prev?.hallId) affected.add(prev.hallId);
        if (updated?.hallId) affected.add(updated.hallId);
        const patches: Record<string, Partial<Hall>> = {};
        affected.forEach(hid => {
          const hall = get().halls.find(h => h.id === hid) || null;
          patches[hid] = computeHallPatch(hid, nextEquipment, hall);
        });
        set({
          equipment: nextEquipment,
          halls: get().halls.map(h => patches[h.id] ? { ...h, ...patches[h.id], updatedAt: now() } : h),
        });
        const eq = get().equipment.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (eq) try { syncWhsItem(eq); } catch {}
      },
      deleteEquip: (id) => {
        const eq = get().equipment.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (eq) try { removeWhsItem(eq); } catch {}
        const nextEquipment = get().equipment.filter(x => x.id !== id);
        if (!eq?.hallId) {
          set({ equipment: nextEquipment });
          return;
        }
        const hall = get().halls.find(h => h.id === eq.hallId) || null;
        const hallPatch = computeHallPatch(eq.hallId, nextEquipment, hall);
        set({
          equipment: nextEquipment,
          halls: get().halls.map(h => h.id === eq.hallId ? { ...h, ...hallPatch, updatedAt: now() } : h),
        });
      }
    }),
    {
      name: 'pm-hal',
      storage: createJSONStorage(() => zustandHybridStorage),
      partialize: (state) => {
        const { isLoading, ...rest } = state;
        return rest as any;
      },
      onRehydrateStorage: () => {
        return (state, error) => {
          if (error) {
            console.error('[hal] Hydration failed:', error);
          }
          useHal.setState({ isLoading: false });
        };
      },      version: 5,
      // ═══ Migration: داده‌های نسخه‌های قدیمی ═══
      // FOUNDATION استثنا — اینجا any مجاز ئه چون:
      //   ۱. داده از localStorage نسخه‌های قبلی میاد (ساختار ناشناخته)
      //   ۲. مشابه JSON.parse — نمی‌تونیم دقیق تایپ کنیم
      //   ۳. بعد از migration، داده به تایپ دقیق تبدیل می‌شه
      // forEach داخلی: هر رکورد legacy، شکل متفاوتی داره
      migrate: (persistedData: unknown, version: number) => {
        // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
        const persisted = persistedData as any;
      // 🆕 migration: kind 'system' → 'asset'
      if (Array.isArray(persisted.equipment)) {
        persisted.equipment.forEach((e: any) => {
          if (e.kind === 'system') e.kind = 'asset';
        });
      }

        if (!persisted?.state?.halls) return persisted;
        if (version < 2) {
          persisted.state.halls = persisted.state.halls.map((h: any) => {
            const waterSources = h.waterSources || (h.drinkerType ? [{
              id: 'legacy-w-' + h.id,
              type: h.drinkerType,
              count: null,
              notes: '',
            }] : []);
            const feedSources = h.feedSources || (h.feederType ? [{
              id: 'legacy-f-' + h.id,
              type: h.feederType,
              count: null,
              notes: '',
            }] : []);
            const ventSources = h.ventSources || (h.ventilationSystem ? [{
              id: 'legacy-v-' + h.id,
              type: h.ventilationSystem,
              count: null,
              notes: '',
            }] : []);
            const litterSections = h.litterSections || (h.litterType ? [{
              id: 'legacy-l-' + h.id,
              type: h.litterType,
              count: h.length && h.width ? h.length * h.width : null,
              notes: '',
            }] : []);
            return {
              ...h,
              waterSources,
              feedSources,
              ventSources,
              litterSections,
              systemNotes: h.systemNotes || '',
            };
          });
        }
        if (version < 3) {
          persisted.state.equipment = (persisted.state.equipment || []).map((e: any) => {
            const map: Record<string, { kind: string; category: string; unit: string }> = {
              lamp:    { kind: 'asset', category: 'lighting',    unit: 'pcs' },
              fan:     { kind: 'asset', category: 'ventilation', unit: 'pcs' },
              cooler:  { kind: 'asset', category: 'ventilation', unit: 'pcs' },
              heater:  { kind: 'asset', category: 'heating',     unit: 'pcs' },
              drinker: { kind: 'asset', category: 'drinking',    unit: 'pcs' },
              feeder:  { kind: 'asset', category: 'feeding',     unit: 'pcs' },
              camera:  { kind: 'asset', category: 'auxiliary',   unit: 'pcs' },
              sensor:  { kind: 'asset', category: 'auxiliary',   unit: 'pcs' },
              other:   { kind: 'asset', category: 'auxiliary',   unit: 'pcs' },
            };
            const m = map[e.type] || map.other;
            return {
              ...e,
              kind: e.kind || m.kind,
              category: e.category || m.category,
              unit: e.unit || m.unit,
            };
          });
        }
        if (version < 4) {
          const typeMap: Record<string, string> = {
            chain: 'feeder_chain',
            pan: 'feeder_pan',
            tube: 'feeder_tube',
            tunnel: 'fan_tunnel',
            longitudinal: 'fan_tunnel',
            transverse: 'fan_ceiling',
            natural: 'air_inlet',
            wood_shavings: 'litter_wood_shavings',
            straw: 'litter_roll',
            sand: 'litter_sand',
            manual: 'feeder_manual',
          };
          const fixSources = (arr: any[]) => (arr || []).map((src: any) => ({
            ...src,
            type: typeMap[src.type] || src.type,
          }));
          persisted.state.halls = (persisted.state.halls || []).map((h: any) => ({
            ...h,
            waterSources: fixSources(h.waterSources),
            feedSources: fixSources(h.feedSources),
            ventSources: fixSources(h.ventSources),
            litterSections: fixSources(h.litterSections),
          }));
        }
        if (version < 5) {
          persisted.state.halls = (persisted.state.halls || []).map((h: any) => {
            const { waterSources, feedSources, ventSources, litterSections, systemNotes, ...rest } = h;
            return rest;
          });
        }
        return persisted;
      },
    }
  )
);

/**
 * useEquipmentForm — state و logic فرم تجهیزات
 */
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useFormDraft } from '../../shr/hooks/useFormDraft';
import { toEn } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { toastMsg } from '../../cor/store/toast';
import type { Equipment, EquipmentCategory, EquipmentStatus, EquipmentUnit } from './store';


/** 🆕 تایپ دقیق فرم تجهیزات (همه چیز string بجز enum ها) */
export interface EquipmentFormData {
  id: string;
  hallId: string;
  zoneId: string;
  category: EquipmentCategory;
  type: string;
  name: string;
  count: string;
  unit: EquipmentUnit;
  unitPrice: string;
  purchasedAt: string;
  warranty: string;
  notes: string;
  capacity: string;
  efficiency: string;
  consumeRate: '' | 'once' | 'per-cycle';
  status: EquipmentStatus;
  brand: string;
  supplierId: string;
}

export const EQUIP_FORM_DEFAULTS: EquipmentFormData = {
  id: '', hallId: '', zoneId: '', category: 'ventilation', type: '', name: '',
  count: '', unit: 'pcs', unitPrice: '', purchasedAt: '',
  warranty: '', notes: '', capacity: '', efficiency: '', consumeRate: '',
  status: 'active', brand: '', supplierId: '',
};

export function useEquipmentForm() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<EquipmentFormData>(EQUIP_FORM_DEFAULTS);
  const draft = useFormDraft<EquipmentFormData>('hal-equip', form, setForm);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [autoFields, setAutoFields] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  const markAuto = (field: string) => setAutoFields(s => new Set(s).add(field));
  const clearAuto = (field: string) => setAutoFields(s => { const n = new Set(s); n.delete(field); return n; });

  const buildPayload = (validZoneIds?: Set<string>) => ({
    ...(validZoneIds && form.zoneId && !validZoneIds.has(form.zoneId) ? { zoneId: undefined } : {}),
    hallId: form.hallId,
    zoneId: (validZoneIds && form.zoneId && !validZoneIds.has(form.zoneId)) ? undefined : (form.zoneId || undefined),
    category: form.category || 'auxiliary',
    type: form.type,
    name: form.name.trim(),
    count: form.count ? parseInt(toEn(form.count)) || null : null,
    unit: form.unit || 'pcs',
    unitPrice: form.unitPrice ? parseFloat(toEn(form.unitPrice).replace('٫','.')) || null : null,
    purchasedAt: form.purchasedAt.trim(),
    warranty: form.warranty ? parseInt(toEn(form.warranty)) || null : null,
    notes: form.notes.trim(),
    capacity: form.capacity ? parseFloat(toEn(form.capacity).replace('٫','.')) || null : null,
    efficiency: form.efficiency ? parseFloat(toEn(form.efficiency).replace('٫','.')) || null : null,
    consumeRate: (form.consumeRate === 'once' || form.consumeRate === 'per-cycle') ? form.consumeRate : undefined,
    status: form.status || 'active',
    brand: (form.brand || '').trim(),
    supplierId: (form.supplierId || '').trim() || undefined,
  });

  const openNew = () => {
    draft.clear();
    setAutoFields(new Set());
    setForm({ ...EQUIP_FORM_DEFAULTS });
    setErr('');
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (e: Equipment) => {
    setForm({
      id: e.id, hallId: e.hallId, zoneId: e.zoneId || '',
      category: e.category || 'lighting',
      type: e.type || '',
      name: e.name,
      count: e.count ? String(e.count) : '',
      unit: e.unit || 'pcs',
      unitPrice: e.unitPrice ? String(e.unitPrice) : '',
      purchasedAt: e.purchasedAt || '',
      warranty: e.warranty ? String(e.warranty) : '',
      notes: e.notes || '',
      capacity: e.capacity ? String(e.capacity) : '',
      efficiency: e.efficiency ? String(e.efficiency) : '',
      consumeRate: (e.consumeRate === 'once' || e.consumeRate === 'per-cycle') ? e.consumeRate : '',
      status: e.status || 'active',
      brand: e.brand || '',
      supplierId: e.supplierId || '',
    });
    setErr('');
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const save = (equipment: Equipment[], addEquip: (e: Omit<Equipment, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>) => string, updateEquip: (id: string, patch: Partial<Equipment>) => void) => {
    if (!form.id) {
      const _dup = equipment.find((x) =>
        x.hallId === form.hallId && x.name.trim() === form.name.trim()
      );
      if (_dup) {
        setErr(`تجهیزی با نام «${_dup.name}» توی این سالن هست`);
        return;
      }
    }
    if (!form.name.trim()) { setErr('نام تجهیز را وارد کنید'); return; }

    const data = buildPayload();
    if (form.id) updateEquip(form.id, data); else addEquip(data);
    draft.clear();
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const saveAndNext = (addEquip: (e: Omit<Equipment, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>) => string) => {
    if (!form.name.trim()) { setErr('نام تجهیز را وارد کنید'); return; }
    addEquip(buildPayload());
    toastMsg.added(form.name || 'تجهیز');
    setForm((f) => ({
      ...f,
      id: '', name: '', count: '', unitPrice: '', purchasedAt: '',
      warranty: '', notes: '', capacity: '', efficiency: '',
    }));
    draft.clear();
  };

  return {
    open, setOpen, form, setForm, draft, err, setErr,
    autoFields, markAuto, clearAuto,
    buildPayload, openNew, openEdit, save, saveAndNext,
  };
}

/**
 * CandlingsPage — کندلینگ با Multi-select و تجمیع
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useFab } from '../../shr/hooks/useFab';
import { useInc, type Candling } from './store';
import { useBrd } from '../brd/store';
import { Btn, Empty, PageContainer } from '../../shr/components/ui';
import { toFa, toEn } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { toastMsg } from '../../cor/store/toast';
import { useFilterSort, FilterBar, getIncCandlingsConfig } from '../../shr/filter';
import { todayJalali } from './helpers';
import { useIncubationProfile } from './hooks';
import { aggregateCandlings, calcSummary } from './api/calc';
import { useCandlingForm, type EntryData, emptyData } from './hooks/useCandlingForm';
import CandlingCard from './components/CandlingCard';
import CandlingFormModal from './components/CandlingFormModal';
import { useMemo as _useMemoV } from 'react';
import HelpBanner from '../../shr/components/HelpBanner';

const INFERTILE_REASONS: [string, string][] = [
  ['', '—'], ['season', 'فصل'], ['rooster_age', 'سن خروس'], ['nutrition', 'تغذیه'], ['genetics', 'ژنتیک'], ['storage', 'نگهداری تخم']
];
const DEAD_REASONS: [string, string][] = [
  ['', '—'], ['temp_fluctuation', 'نوسان دما'], ['humidity', 'رطوبت نامناسب'], ['ventilation', 'تهویه ضعیف'], ['genetics', 'ژنتیک'], ['infection', 'عفونت']
];





export default function CandlingsPage({ initialEntry = '', onGoTo, active = true }: { initialEntry?: string; onGoTo?: (t: any, payload?: { entry?: string }) => void; active?: boolean } = {}) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { devices, eggEntries, candlings, addCandling, updateCandling, deleteCandling } = useInc();
  const { birds } = useBrd();

  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // ⭐ hook فرم کندلینگ
  const {
    open, modalDevice, modalDay, modalDate, selectedIds, entriesData, err, editingId,
    setOpen, setModalDevice, setModalDay, setModalDate, setSelectedIds, setEntriesData, setErr,
    openNew, openEdit, toggleEntry, updateEntryData, save, close,
  } = useCandlingForm({ eggEntries, devices, candlings, addCandling, updateCandling });
  const [undoData, setUndoData] = useState<{ candling: any } | null>(null);

  // profile پرنده انتخاب‌شده اول
  const _firstSelectedBirdName = (() => {
    const firstId = Array.from(selectedIds)[0];
    if (!firstId) return undefined;
    const entry = eggEntries.find(x => x.id === firstId);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    return birds.find(b => b.id === entry.birdId)?.name;
  })();
  const _profile = useIncubationProfile(_firstSelectedBirdName);

  // ═══ Performance: lookup maps ═══
  const _entriesById = useMemo(() => {
    const m: Record<string, any> = {};
    (eggEntries || []).forEach(e => { m[e.id] = e; });
    return m;
  }, [eggEntries]);

  // ⭐ wrapperها — چون _entriesById لازمه
  const handleOpenNew = (preEntryId?: string) => openNew(preEntryId, _entriesById);
  const handleSave = () => {
    const result = save(_entriesById);
    if (result.ok && result.savedCount > 0 && !editingId) {
      toastMsg.success(fmt.count(result.savedCount) + ' کندلینگ ثبت شد');
    }
  };

  const _birdsById = useMemo(() => {
    const m: Record<string, any> = {};
    (birds || []).forEach(b => { m[b.id] = b; });
    return m;
  }, [birds]);

  const _devicesById = useMemo(() => {
    const m: Record<string, any> = {};
    (devices || []).forEach(d => { m[d.id] = d; });
    return m;
  }, [devices]);

  const _candlingsByEntry = useMemo(() => {
    const m: Record<string, any[]> = {};
    (candlings || []).forEach(cc => {
      if (!m[cc.eggEntryId]) m[cc.eggEntryId] = [];
      m[cc.eggEntryId].push(cc);
    });
    return m;
  }, [candlings]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialEntry) {
      const entry = _entriesById[initialEntry];
      if (entry) {
        setModalDevice(entry.deviceId);
        setSelectedIds(new Set([initialEntry]));
        setEntriesData({ [initialEntry]: emptyData() });
        const stages = candlings.filter(c => c.eggEntryId === initialEntry).map(c => c.stage);
        const nextDay = stages.length > 0 ? Math.max(...stages) + 3 : 7;
        setModalDay(String(nextDay));
        setModalDate(todayJalali());
        setOpen(true);
      }
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [initialEntry]);

  const undoDeleteCandling = () => {
    if (!undoData) return;
    try { addCandling(undoData.candling); } catch {}
    setUndoData(null);
  };

  useFab(active && candlings.length > 0 ? { label: 'ثبت کندلینگ', onClick: () => handleOpenNew() } : null);

  const availableEntries = useMemo(() => {
    const dayNum = parseInt(toEn(modalDay)) || 0;
    const editing = editingId;
    return eggEntries
      .filter(e => !modalDevice || e.deviceId === modalDevice)
      .filter(e => e.status !== 'failed')
      .filter(e => {
        // در حالت ویرایش، ورودی خودمون رو نشون بده
        if (editing) {
          const editingCand = candlings.find(c => c.id === editing);
          if (editingCand && editingCand.eggEntryId === e.id) return true;
        }
        // ورودی که قبلاً در این مرحله کندلینگ شده رو نشون نده
        const hasThisStage = candlings.some(c => c.eggEntryId === e.id && c.stage === dayNum);
        return !hasThisStage;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => String(b.entryDate).localeCompare(String(a.entryDate)));
  }, [eggEntries, modalDevice, modalDay, editingId, candlings]);



  // ═══ اعتبارسنجی زنده ═══
  const vErrors = _useMemoV(() => {
    const errs: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const [entryId, d] of Object.entries(entriesData || {})) {
      const alive = parseInt(toEn(d.alive || '0')) || 0;
      const infertile = parseInt(toEn(d.infertile || '0')) || 0;
      const dead = parseInt(toEn(d.dead || '0')) || 0;
      const broken = parseInt(toEn(d.broken || '0')) || 0;
      if (alive < 0 || infertile < 0 || dead < 0 || broken < 0) {
        errs['neg_' + entryId] = 'مقادیر منفی مجاز نیست';
      }
    }
    return errs;
  }, [entriesData]);



  // فیلتر/مرتب
  const config = useMemo(
    () => getIncCandlingsConfig({
      devices: devices.map(d => ({ id: d.id, name: d.name })),
      birds: birds.map(b => ({ id: b.id, name: b.name })),
      eggEntriesById: _entriesById,
    }),
    [devices, birds, _entriesById]
  );
  const { filtered: filteredCandlings, filters, setFilter, clearFilter, sort, setSort, toggleSort,
          resetAll, hasActiveFilters, total, count } = useFilterSort<Candling>({
    items: candlings,
    filters: config.filterDefs,
    sorts: config.sortDefs,
    persistKey: config.persistKey,
    initialSort: config.initialSort,
  });

  // ═══ گروه‌بندی + تجمیع + درصد ═══
  const grouped = useMemo(() => {
    const byEntry: Record<string, Candling[]> = {};
    filteredCandlings.forEach(c => {
      if (!byEntry[c.eggEntryId]) byEntry[c.eggEntryId] = [];
      byEntry[c.eggEntryId].push(c);
    });
    return Object.entries(byEntry).map(([entryId, list]) => {
      const agg = aggregateCandlings(list);
      const total = agg.alive + agg.infertile + agg.dead + agg.broken;
      const entry = _entriesById[entryId];
      const entryTotal = entry?.count || 0;
      const fertilePercent = total > 0 ? (agg.alive / total * 100) : 0;
      const lossPercent = entryTotal > 0 ? ((total - agg.alive) / entryTotal * 100) : 0;
      const deadPercent = total > 0 ? ((agg.dead + agg.infertile) / total * 100) : 0;
      return { entryId, list: list.sort((a, b) => a.stage - b.stage), agg, total, entryTotal, fertilePercent, lossPercent, deadPercent };
    }).sort(({ entryId: a }, { entryId: b }) => {
      const ea = _entriesById[a];
      const eb = _entriesById[b];
      return String(eb?.entryDate || '').localeCompare(String(ea?.entryDate || ''));
    });
  }, [filteredCandlings, _entriesById]);

  // ═══ خلاصه کل ═══
  const summary = useMemo(() => {
    const totalEntries = eggEntries.filter(e => e.status !== 'failed').length;
    const totalCandlings = candlings.length;
    const entryTotalMap: Record<string, number> = {};
    eggEntries.forEach(e => { entryTotalMap[e.id] = e.count || 0; });
    const s = calcSummary(candlings, entryTotalMap);
    return { totalEntries, totalCandlings, ...s };
  }, [eggEntries, candlings]);

  const dataFor = (id: string): EntryData => entriesData[id] || emptyData();

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      <HelpBanner
        id="inc-candlings-guide"
        icon="🔦"
        title="راهنمای کندلینگ"
        description="تعداد تخم‌های بارور، بی‌نطفه و حذف‌شده یا تلفات جنینی را در هر مرحلهٔ کندلینگ ثبت کنید تا درصد باروری و هچ به‌روز بماند."
        tone="info"
      />
      {undoData && (
        <div style={{
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
          padding: '10px 14px', marginBottom: 8,
          background: 'var(--warn-soft)',
          border: '1px solid var(--warn)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
        }}>
          <span>کندلینگ حذف شد</span>
          <button type="button" onClick={undoDeleteCandling} style={{
            background: 'none', border: 'none',
            color: 'var(--warn)', fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer',
            fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: '4px 10px',
          }}>بازگردانی</button>
        </div>
      )}
      {/* ═══ خلاصه کل ═══ */}
      {summary.totalCandlings > 0 && (
        <div style={{
          padding: '10px 12px',
          background: 'var(--card)',
          border: '1px solid var(--border)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
          display: 'grid',
          gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr',
          gap: 6,
        }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>🧬</span> نطفه‌داری کل</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-lg)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--accent)' }}>{fmt.code(summary.fertilePercent.toFixed(1))}٪</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>📉 تلفات کل</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-lg)', fontWeight: 700, color: summary.lossPercent > 50 ? 'var(--danger)' : summary.lossPercent > 20 ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--muted)' }}>{fmt.code(summary.lossPercent.toFixed(1))}٪</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', gridColumn: '1 / -1', paddingTop: 8, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>
            <span><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📥</span> {fmt.count(summary.totalEntries)} ورودی</span>
            <span>🔍 {fmt.count(summary.totalCandlings)} کندلینگ</span>
            <span>✅ {fmt.count(summary.totalAlive)} سالم</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <FilterBar
        filterDefs={config.filterDefs}
        sortDefs={config.sortDefs}
        filterState={filters}
        sortState={sort}
        setFilter={setFilter}
        clearFilter={clearFilter}
        setSort={setSort}
        toggleSort={toggleSort}
        resetAll={resetAll}
        hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
        total={total}
        count={count}
      />

      {candlings.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty icon={<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg>}
          title="کندلینگی ثبت نشده"
          desc="کندلینگ در روزهای دلخواه انجام می‌شود."
          action={<Btn variant="primary" onClick={() => handleOpenNew()}>+ ثبت کندلینگ</Btn>} />
      ) : (
        <>
          {grouped.map(({ entryId, list, agg, total, entryTotal, fertilePercent, lossPercent }) => {
            const entry = _entriesById[entryId];
            const bird = entry ? _birdsById[entry.birdId] : null;
            const dev = entry ? _devicesById[entry.deviceId] : null;
            const isOpen = expandedId === entryId;
            return (
              <CandlingCard
                key={entryId}
                entryId={entryId}
                list={list}
                agg={agg}
                total={total}
                entryTotal={entryTotal}
                fertilePercent={fertilePercent}
                lossPercent={lossPercent}
                birdName={bird?.name}
                deviceName={dev?.name}
                entryDate={entry?.entryDate}
                isOpen={isOpen}
                onToggle={() => setExpandedId(isOpen ? null : entryId)}
                onEdit={openEdit}
                onNew={handleOpenNew}
                onDelete={deleteCandling}
              />
            );
          })}
          
        </>
      )}

      <CandlingFormModal
        open={open}
        onClose={close}
        editingId={editingId}
        modalDay={modalDay}
        setModalDay={setModalDay}
        modalDate={modalDate}
        setModalDate={setModalDate}
        modalDevice={modalDevice}
        setModalDevice={setModalDevice}
        selectedIds={selectedIds}
        setSelectedIds={setSelectedIds}
        setEntriesData={setEntriesData}
        toggleEntry={toggleEntry}
        updateEntryData={updateEntryData}
        entriesData={entriesData}
        devices={devices}
        availableEntries={availableEntries}
        birdsById={_birdsById}
        candlings={candlings}
        firstSelectedBirdName={_firstSelectedBirdName}
        profile={_profile}
        onSave={handleSave}
        saving={false}
        err={err}
        vErrors={vErrors}
      />

    </PageContainer>
  );
}

/**

import { useFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useFab } from '../../shr/hooks/useFab';

export default function DevicesPage({ active = true }: { active?: boolean } = {}) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { devices, eggEntries, addDevice, updateDevice, deleteDevice } = useInc();
  const settings = useSet();
  const { birds } = useBrd();

  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<F>(empty);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [maintErr, setMaintErr] = useState('');
  const [undoDevice, setUndoDevice] = useState<{ device: any | any[] } | null>(null);
  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useFocusParam();
  const [maintDeviceId, setMaintDeviceId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [maintForm, setMaintForm] = useState({ date: '', type: '', cost: '', description: '' });

  // ═══ Performance: pre-compute device stats ═══
  const deviceStats = useMemo(() => {
    const map: Record<string, { totalEggs: number; activeCount: number }> = {};
    eggEntries.forEach(e => {
      if (!map[e.deviceId]) map[e.deviceId] = { totalEggs: 0, activeCount: 0 };
      map[e.deviceId].totalEggs += (e.count || 0);
      if (e.status === 'incubating' || e.status === 'candled' || e.status === 'locked') {
        map[e.deviceId].activeCount += 1;
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [eggEntries]);

  const num = (s: string) => s ? parseFloat(toEn(s).replace('٫', '.')) || null : null;

  // ═══ اعتبارسنجی زنده ═══
  const [chartMetric, setChartMetric] = useState<'temp' | 'humidity' | 'est' | 'co2' | 'o2'>('temp');
  const { errors: vErrors } = useValidation(
    createDeviceSchema(),
    {
      name: form.name || '',
      mode: form.mode,
      status: form.status,
      temp: num(form.temp),
      humidity: num(form.humidity),
      purchasedAt: form.purchasedAt || '',
      price: num(form.price),
      warranty: num(form.warranty),
      racks: num(form.racks),
      trays: num(form.trays),
      fans: num(form.fans),
      tempSensors: num(form.tempSensors),
      humiditySensors: num(form.humiditySensors),
      motorPower: num(form.motorPower),
      extraCost: num(form.extraCost),
      notes: form.notes || '',
    },
  );
  const int = (s: string) => s ? parseInt(toEn(s)) || null : null;

  const openNew = () => { setForm(empty); setErr(''); setOpen(true); };

  const openEdit = (d: Device) => {
    setForm({
      id: d.id, name: d.name,
      capacityByBird: d.capacityByBird || [],
      mode: d.mode, status: d.status,
      temp: d.temp ? fmt.code(d.temp) : '',
      humidity: d.humidity ? fmt.code(d.humidity) : '',
      purchasedAt: d.purchasedAt,
      price: d.price ? fmt.code(d.price) : '',
      warranty: d.warranty ? fmt.code(d.warranty) : '',
      racks: d.racks ? String(d.racks) : '',
      trays: d.trays ? String(d.trays) : '',
      fans: d.fans ? String(d.fans) : '',
      tempSensors: d.tempSensors ? String(d.tempSensors) : '',
      humiditySensors: d.humiditySensors ? String(d.humiditySensors) : '',
      motorPower: d.motorPower ? String(d.motorPower) : '',
      extraCost: d.extraCost ? fmt.code(d.extraCost) : '',
      notes: d.notes,
      estCurrent: d.estCurrent ? fmt.code(d.estCurrent) : '',
      co2Current: d.co2Current ? fmt.code(d.co2Current) : '',
      o2Current: d.o2Current ? fmt.code(d.o2Current) : '',
      turningCurrent: d.turningCurrent || 'auto',
    });
    setErr(''); setOpen(true);
  };
  const recordReading = (d: Device) => {
    const reading = {
      id: 'r-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6),
      date: todayJalali(),
      temp: d.temp,
      humidity: d.humidity,
      est: d.estCurrent ?? null,
      co2: d.co2Current ?? null,
      o2: d.o2Current ?? null,
    };
    const currentReadings = d.readings || [];
    const next = [...currentReadings, reading].slice(-200);
    updateDevice(d.id, { readings: next } as any);
    toastMsg.saved('قرائت');
  };

  useFab(active && devices.length > 0 ? { label: 'افزودن دستگاه', onClick: openNew } : null);






  const save = () => {
    setErr('');
    if (!form.id) {
      const dup = devices.find((x: any) => x.name.trim() === form.name.trim());
      if (dup) { setErr('دستگاهی با نام «' + dup.name + '» قبلاً ثبت شده'); return; }
    }
    if (!form.name.trim()) { setErr('نام دستگاه را وارد کنید'); return; }
    const data = {
      name: form.name.trim(),
      code: '',
      capacity: null,
      capacityByBird: form.capacityByBird,
      mode: form.mode,
      status: form.status,
      temp: num(form.temp),
      humidity: num(form.humidity),
      purchasedAt: form.purchasedAt.trim(),
      price: num(form.price),
      warranty: int(form.warranty),
      racks: int(form.racks),
      trays: int(form.trays),
      fans: int(form.fans),
      tempSensors: int(form.tempSensors),
      humiditySensors: int(form.humiditySensors),
      motorPower: num(form.motorPower),
      extraCost: num(form.extraCost),
      estCurrent: num(form.estCurrent),
      co2Current: num(form.co2Current),
      o2Current: num(form.o2Current),
      turningCurrent: (form.turningCurrent as 'on' | 'off' | 'auto') || 'auto',
      maintenanceLogs: [],
      equipmentId: '',
      notes: form.notes.trim(),
    };
    if (form.id) {
      updateDevice(form.id, data);
      toastMsg.saved(form.name || 'دستگاه')
    } else {
      addDevice(data);
      toastMsg.added(data.name, 'دستگاه')
    }
    setForm(empty);
    setErr('');
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const undoDeleteDevice = () => {
    if (!undoDevice) return;
    try {
      const arr: any[] = Array.isArray(undoDevice.device) ? undoDevice.device : [undoDevice.device];
      for (const d of arr) addDevice(d);
      toastMsg.restoredBulk(arr.length, 'دستگاه')
    } catch {
      toastMsg.error('بازگردانی ناموفق بود')
    }
    setUndoDevice(null);
  };

  const addMaintenance = (deviceId: string) => {
    const dev = devices.find(d => d.id === deviceId);
    if (!dev) return;
    if (!maintForm.date || !maintForm.type) { setMaintErr('تاریخ و نوع تعمیر را وارد کنید'); return; }
    const log = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      date: maintForm.date,
      type: maintForm.type.trim(),
      cost: parseFloat(toEn(maintForm.cost).replace('٫', '.')) || null,
      description: maintForm.description.trim(),
    };
    const logs = [...((dev as any).maintenanceLogs || []), log];
    updateDevice(deviceId, { maintenanceLogs: logs } as any);
    setMaintForm({ date: '', type: '', cost: '', description: '' });
    setMaintErr('');
    setMaintDeviceId(null);
    toastMsg.success('تعمیر ثبت شد');
  };

  const removeMaintenance = async (deviceId: string, logId: string) => {
    const dev = devices.find(d => d.id === deviceId);
    if (!dev) return;
    if (!await showConfirmAsync('تأیید', 'حذف این رکورد تعمیر؟', { danger: true })) return;
    const logs = ((dev as any).maintenanceLogs || []).filter((l: any) => l.id !== logId);
    updateDevice(deviceId, { maintenanceLogs: logs } as any);
  };
  const warrantyForm = warrantyInfo(form.purchasedAt, parseInt(toEn(form.warranty)) || null);

  // ─── Multi-Select ───
  // فیلتر/مرتب
  const config = useMemo(() => getIncDevicesConfig(), []);
  const { filtered: list, filters, setFilter, clearFilter, sort, setSort, toggleSort,
          resetAll, hasActiveFilters, total, count } = useFilterSort<Device>({
    items: devices,
    filters: config.filterDefs,
    sorts: config.sortDefs,
    persistKey: config.persistKey,
    initialSort: config.initialSort,
  });

  const ms = useMultiSelect({
    items: list,
    getId: (d: any) => d.id,
    onDelete: async (ids: string[]) => {
      const ok = await showConfirmAsync('حذف گروهی', fmt.count(ids.length) + ' دستگاه حذف شوند؟', { danger: true });
      if (!ok) return;
      const backups: any[] = [];
      for (const id of ids) {
        const it = devices.find(d => d.id === id);
        if (!it) continue;
        backups.push(it);
        try { deleteDevice(id); } catch {}
      }
      if (backups.length > 0) {
        setUndoDevice({ device: backups });
        setTimeout(() => setUndoDevice((cur: any) => cur && Array.isArray(cur.device) && cur.device.length === backups.length ? null : cur), 8000);
      }
      toastMsg.deletedBulk(backups.length, 'دستگاه')
    },
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (ms.selectionMode) setExpandedId(null);
  }, [ms.selectionMode]);

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      {undoDevice && (
        <div style={{
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
          padding: '10px 14px', marginBottom: 8,
          background: 'var(--warn-soft, var(--input-bg))',
          border: '1px solid var(--warn)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
        }}>
          <span>دستگاه «{undoDevice.device.name}» حذف شد</span>
          <button type="button" onClick={undoDeleteDevice} style={{
            background: 'none', border: 'none',
            color: 'var(--warn)', fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer',
            fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: '4px 10px',
          }}>بازگردانی</button>
        </div>
      )}
      <HelpBanner
        id="inc-devices-intro"
        icon="🏭"
        title="راهنمای دستگاه‌های جوجه‌کشی"
        description="دستگاه‌های ستر (انکوباسیون) و هچر را با ظرفیت، مشخصات و وضعیت کاری ثبت کنید تا برنامه‌ریزی چیدمان تخم و هچ دقیق انجام شود."
        tone="info"
      />
      <FilterBar
        filterDefs={config.filterDefs}
        sortDefs={config.sortDefs}
        filterState={filters}
        sortState={sort}
        setFilter={setFilter}
        clearFilter={clearFilter}
        setSort={setSort}
        toggleSort={toggleSort}
        resetAll={resetAll}
        hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
        total={total}
        count={count}
      />

      {!ms.selectionMode && list.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: 'var(--dim)', textAlign: 'center', paddingBottom: 2 }}>
          برای انتخاب چندتایی، روی یک کارت نگه دارید
        </div>
      )}

      {ms.selectionMode && list.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 6 }}>
          <button type="button"
            onClick={ms.selectedIds.size === list.length ? ms.clearSelection : ms.selectAll}
            style={{ padding: '4px 10px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: '10px', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
            {ms.selectedIds.size === list.length ? 'لغو انتخاب همه' : 'انتخاب همه'}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {devices.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, padding: '0 4px' }}>
          🏭 {fmt.count(devices.length)} دستگاه
        </div>
      )}
      {list.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty icon={<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7"><rect x="4" y="2" width="16" height="20" rx="2"/></svg>}
          title="هنوز دستگاهی نساخته‌اید" desc="اولین دستگاه جوجه‌کشی خود را اضافه کنید."
          action={<Btn variant="primary" onClick={openNew}>+ افزودن دستگاه</Btn>} />
      ) : (
        <>
          {list.map((d, i) => (
                <DeviceCard
                  key={d.id}
                  d={d}
                  index={i}
                  stats={deviceStats[d.id] || { totalEggs: 0, activeCount: 0 }}
                  isOpen={!ms.selectionMode && expandedId === d.id}
                  onToggle={() => setExpandedId(!ms.selectionMode && expandedId === d.id ? null : d.id)}
                  ms={ms}
                  chartMetric={chartMetric}
                  setChartMetric={setChartMetric}
                  onEdit={() => openEdit(d)}
                  onDelete={() => {
                    if (!d.id) return;
                    const dev = devices.find(x => x.id === d.id);
                    if (dev) {
                      setUndoDevice({ device: dev });
                      setTimeout(() => setUndoDevice(cur => cur && cur.device.id === dev.id ? null : cur), 6000);
                    }
                    deleteDevice(d.id);
                    toastMsg.deleted('دستگاه');
                  }}
                  onRecordReading={() => recordReading(d)}
                  onRemoveMaintenance={(logId) => removeMaintenance(d.id, logId)}
                  onAddMaintenance={() => {
                    setMaintDeviceId(d.id);
                    setMaintForm({ date: '', type: '', cost: '', description: '' });
                  }}
                />
              ))}
          
        </>
      )}

      <MultiSelectBar ms={ms} deleteLabel="حذف" />

      {ms.selectionMode && <div style={{ height: 90 }} />}

      <DeviceFormModal
        open={open}
        setOpen={setOpen}
        form={form}
        setForm={setForm}
        err={err}
        vErrors={vErrors}
        devices={devices}
        birds={birds}
        save={save}
      />

      <MaintenanceModal
        open={!!maintDeviceId}
        form={maintForm}
        err={maintErr}
        setForm={setMaintForm}
        onSave={() => { if (maintDeviceId) addMaintenance(maintDeviceId); }}
        onClose={() => setMaintDeviceId(null)}
      />
    </PageContainer>
  );
}

/**
 * EggEntriesPage — ورودی تخم به دستگاه‌های انکوباسیون (Multi-row + Draft Auto-Save)
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  useInc, DEAL_LABEL, addDaysJalali,
  daysAgo, daysToHatch, daysFromProfiles, type EggEntry
} from './store';
import { useBrd } from '../brd/store';
import { useBreedStandard } from '../../shr/hooks/useBreedStandard';
import { useFlk } from '../flk/store';
import { useCtc } from '../ctc/store';
import { useTra } from '../tra/store';
import { Btn, Empty, PageContainer } from '../../shr/components/ui';
import { toFa, toEn } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../cor/store/dialog';
import { useFilterSort, FilterBar, getIncEntriesConfig } from '../../shr/filter';
import { todayJalali } from './helpers';
import EggEntryModal from './components/EggEntryModal';
import { makeRow, type DraftRow } from './types-eggentries';
import { nowTime } from './api/eggEntriesCalc';
import EggEntryCard from './components/EggEntryCard';
import { useEggEntriesForm } from './hooks/useEggEntriesForm';
import { useSet } from '../set/store';
import HelpBanner from '../../shr/components/HelpBanner';


export default function EggEntriesPage({ initialDevice = '', onGoTo, active = true }: { initialDevice?: string; onGoTo?: (t: any, payload?: { entry?: string }) => void; active?: boolean } = {}) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { devices, eggEntries, candlings, hatches, addEntry, updateEntry, deleteEntry } = useInc();
  const { birds, breeds } = useBrd();
  const breedStd = useBreedStandard();
  const { flocks } = useFlk();
  const { contacts } = useCtc();
  const { addInvoice, deleteInvoice } = useTra();

  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const _profiles = useSet((s: any) => s.incubationProfiles) || [];
  const _birdsById = useMemo(() => {
    const m: Record<string, any> = {};
    (birds || []).forEach((b) => { m[b.id] = b; });
    return m;
  }, [birds]);

  const _contactsById = useMemo(() => {
    const m: Record<string, any> = {};
    (contacts || []).forEach((cc) => { m[cc.id] = cc; });
    return m;
  }, [contacts]);

  const daysByName = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, number>();
    birds.forEach((b) => map.set(b.name, daysFromProfiles(b.name, _profiles)));
    return map;
  }, [birds, _profiles]);
  const _daysLookup = (name: string | undefined): number => {
    if (!name) return 21;
    return daysByName.get(name) || daysFromProfiles(name, _profiles);
  };


  // ⭐ hook فرم ورودی تخم
  const {
    open, setOpen,
    multiDeviceId, setMultiDeviceId,
    hideHatchTip, setHideHatchTip,
    draftRows, setDraftRows,
    undoRow, setUndoRow,
    currentRow, setCurrentRow,
    editingRowId, setEditingRowId,
    setD, openMulti, addRowToList, editRow, removeRow, undoRemoveRow,
    saveAll, openEdit, deleteEntryWithCascade,
    rowErr,
    num, int,
  } = useEggEntriesForm({
    devices, birds, eggEntries, flocks, initialDevice,
    addEntry, updateEntry, deleteEntry,
    addInvoice, deleteInvoice,
    onGoTo,
  });


  const suppliers = useMemo(() => (contacts || []).filter((p) => (p.roles || []).includes('supplier')), [contacts]);
  const allPersons = contacts || [];


  const breedsForBird = useMemo(
    () => breeds.filter(b => b.birdId === currentRow.birdId),
    [breeds, currentRow.birdId]
  );

  // ═══ محاسبه استفاده دستگاه در فرم ═══
  const draftUsage = useMemo(() => {
    const device = devices.find(d => d.id === multiDeviceId);
    if (!device) return { used: 0, total: 0, percent: 0 };
    const allEntries = eggEntries.map(x => ({ ...x, __birdName: (birds.find(b => b.id === x.birdId)?.name) || '' }));
    let used = 0;
    const refCap = Math.max(...(device.capacityByBird || []).map((c) => c.capacity || 0));
    if (refCap === 0) return { used: 0, total: 0, percent: 0 };
    // فعلی
    allEntries.forEach(e => {
      if (e.status === 'failed') return;
      const cap = (device.capacityByBird || []).find((c) => c.birdName === e.__birdName);
      if (!cap?.capacity) return;
      used += (e.count || 0) * (refCap / cap.capacity);
    });
    // draft
    draftRows.forEach(r => {
      const bird = birds.find(b => b.id === r.birdId);
      if (!bird) return;
      const cap = (device.capacityByBird || []).find((c) => c.birdName === bird.name);
      if (!cap?.capacity) return;
      used += (parseInt(toEn(r.count)) || 0) * (refCap / cap.capacity);
    });
    return {
      used: Math.round(used * 10) / 10,
      total: refCap,
      percent: Math.round((used / refCap) * 100),
    };
  }, [multiDeviceId, draftRows, eggEntries, birds, devices]);

  // ═══ Live Usage — شامل ردیف در حال تایپ ═══
  const liveUsage = useMemo(() => {
    const device = devices.find(d => d.id === multiDeviceId);
    if (!device) return null;
    const refCap = Math.max(...(device.capacityByBird || []).map((c) => c.capacity || 0));
    if (refCap === 0) return null;

    let used = 0;
    // ورودی‌های ثبت‌شده
    eggEntries.forEach(e => {
      if (e.status === 'failed') return;
      const birdName = (birds.find(b => b.id === e.birdId)?.name) || '';
      const cap = (device.capacityByBird || []).find((c) => c.birdName === birdName);
      if (!cap?.capacity) return;
      used += (e.count || 0) * (refCap / cap.capacity);
    });
    // ردیف‌های draft (به جز ردیفی که الان ویرایش می‌شه)
    draftRows.forEach(r => {
      if (editingRowId && r._id === editingRowId) return;
      const b = birds.find(x => x.id === r.birdId);
      if (!b) return;
      const cap = (device.capacityByBird || []).find((c) => c.birdName === b.name);
      if (!cap?.capacity) return;
      used += (parseInt(toEn(r.count)) || 0) * (refCap / cap.capacity);
    });
    // ردیف در حال ویرایش/تایپ
    const curCnt = parseInt(toEn(currentRow.count)) || 0;
    const curBird = birds.find(b => b.id === currentRow.birdId);
    if (curBird && curCnt > 0) {
      const cap = (device.capacityByBird || []).find((c) => c.birdName === curBird.name);
      if (cap?.capacity) {
        used += curCnt * (refCap / cap.capacity);
      }
    }

    return {
      used: Math.round(used * 10) / 10,
      total: refCap,
      percent: Math.round((used / refCap) * 100),
      remaining: Math.round((refCap - used) * 10) / 10,
    };
  }, [multiDeviceId, draftRows, eggEntries, birds, devices, currentRow.birdId, currentRow.count, editingRowId]);

  // ═══ فیلتر لیست ═══
  // فیلتر/مرتب (FilterBar)
  const config = useMemo(
    () => getIncEntriesConfig({
      devices: devices.map(d => ({ id: d.id, name: d.name })),
      birds: birds.map(b => ({ id: b.id, name: b.name })),
    }),
    [devices, birds]
  );
  const { filtered: list, filters, setFilter, clearFilter, sort, setSort, toggleSort,
          resetAll, hasActiveFilters, total, count } = useFilterSort<EggEntry>({
    items: eggEntries,
    filters: config.filterDefs,
    sorts: config.sortDefs,
    persistKey: config.persistKey,
    initialSort: config.initialSort,
  });
  const multiDevice = devices.find(d => d.id === multiDeviceId);

  const renderRowSummary = (row: DraftRow, idx: number) => {
    const bird = birds.find(b => b.id === row.birdId);
    const sellerName = (row.dealData.sellerId && (contacts.find((c) => c.id === row.dealData.sellerId) as any)?.name) || '';
    const partnerName = (row.dealData.partnerId && (contacts.find((c) => c.id === row.dealData.partnerId) as any)?.name) || '';
    const flockName = row.flockId ? flocks.find((f) => f.id === row.flockId)?.name : '';
    const consigneeName = (row.dealData.consigneeId && (contacts.find((c) => c.id === row.dealData.consigneeId) as any)?.name) || '';
    const lessorName = (row.dealData.lessorId && (contacts.find((c) => c.id === row.dealData.lessorId) as any)?.name) || '';
    const party = sellerName || partnerName || flockName || consigneeName || lessorName || '—';

    return (
      <div key={row._id} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', marginBottom: 4 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 600, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
            {fmt.count(idx + 1)}. {DEAL_LABEL[row.dealType]} • {bird?.name || '—'} • {fmt.count(Number(row.count) || 0)} تخم
          </span>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
            {party} • {fmt.date(row.entryDate)}
          </span>
        </div>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => editRow(row)} aria-label="ویرایش ردیف" style={{ background: 'none', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', color: 'var(--text)', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: '6px 10px', minWidth: 36, minHeight: 36, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>✏️</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => removeRow(row._id)} aria-label="حذف ردیف" style={{ background: 'none', border: '1px solid var(--danger)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', color: 'var(--danger)', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: '6px 10px', minWidth: 36, minHeight: 36, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>✕</button>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      <HelpBanner
        id="inc-entries-guide"
        icon="🥚"
        title="راهنمای ورود تخم به دستگاه"
        description="تعداد و مشخصات تخم‌های چیده‌شده در دستگاه‌های جوجه‌کشی را ثبت کنید تا زمان کندلینگ و هچ دقیق محاسبه شود."
        tone="info"
      />
      {undoRow && (
        <div style={{
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
          padding: '10px 14px', marginBottom: 8,
          background: 'var(--warn-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--warn)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
        }}>
          <span>ردیف حذف شد</span>
          <button type="button" onClick={undoRemoveRow} aria-label="بازگردانی ردیف" style={{
            background: 'none', border: 'none', color: 'var(--warn)',
            fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit',
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: '4px 10px',
          }}>بازگردانی</button>
        </div>
      )}
      <FilterBar
        filterDefs={config.filterDefs}
        sortDefs={config.sortDefs}
        filterState={filters}
        sortState={sort}
        setFilter={setFilter}
        clearFilter={clearFilter}
        setSort={setSort}
        toggleSort={toggleSort}
        resetAll={resetAll}
        hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
        total={total}
        count={count}
      />

      {list.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty icon={<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7"><ellipse cx="12" cy="14" rx="7" ry="9"/></svg>}
          title={eggEntries.length === 0 ? 'هنوز تخمی وارد دستگاه نشده' : 'ورودی مطابق فیلتر نیست'}
          desc={devices.length === 0 ? 'اول یک دستگاه بسازید.' : 'اولین بچ خود را ثبت کنید.'}
          action={<Btn variant="primary" onClick={openMulti}>+ ورود تخم</Btn>} />
      ) : (
        <>
          {list.map((e, i) => {
            const dev = devices.find(d => d.id === e.deviceId);
            const bird = birds.find(b => b.id === e.birdId);
            const breed = breeds.find(b => b.id === e.breedId);
            const age = daysAgo(e.entryDate);
            const std = breedStd.byBreedId(e.breedId || null);
            const totalDays = (_daysLookup(bird?.name) || 21);
            const expHatch = addDaysJalali(e.entryDate, totalDays);
            const remain = daysToHatch(expHatch);
            const isOpen = expandedId === e.id;
            return (
              <EggEntryCard
                key={e.id}
                entry={e}
                index={i}
                device={dev}
                bird={bird}
                breed={breed}
                flocks={flocks}
                contacts={contacts}
                hatches={hatches}
                standard={std}
                age={age}
                expectedHatch={expHatch}
                remain={remain}
                totalDays={totalDays}
                isOpen={isOpen}
                onToggle={() => setExpandedId(isOpen ? null : e.id)}
                onEdit={() => openEdit(e)}
                onDelete={async () => {
                  const ok = await showConfirmAsync('تأیید حذف', 'این ورودی تخم حذف شود؟', { danger: true });
                  if (!ok) return;
                  deleteEntryWithCascade(e.id);
                }}
              />
            );
          })}
          <Btn variant="primary" full onClick={openMulti}>+ ورود تخم</Btn>
        </>
      )}

      <EggEntryModal
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        editingRowId={editingRowId}
        hideHatchTip={hideHatchTip}
        setHideHatchTip={setHideHatchTip}
        multiDeviceId={multiDeviceId}
        setMultiDeviceId={setMultiDeviceId}
        draftRows={draftRows}
        currentRow={currentRow}
        setCurrentRow={setCurrentRow}
        devices={devices}
        birds={birds}
        breeds={breeds}
        flocks={flocks}
        contacts={contacts}
        suppliers={suppliers}
        allPersons={allPersons}
        breedsForBird={breedsForBird}
        liveUsage={liveUsage}
        setD={setD}
        addRowToList={addRowToList}
        err={rowErr}
        editRow={editRow}
        removeRow={removeRow}
        saveAll={saveAll}
        resetCurrentRow={() => { setEditingRowId(null); setCurrentRow({ ...makeRow(), birdId: birds[0]?.id || '', entryDate: todayJalali(), entryTime: nowTime() }); }}
      />
    </PageContainer>
  );
}

/**
 * HatchesPage — هچ، تفکیک، ساخت گله، فروش، validation
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';
