import type { FlockForm } from './components/FlockCreateModal';
import SellModal from './components/SellModal';
import HatchFormModal from './components/HatchFormModal';
import HatchCard from './components/HatchCard';
import { logAction } from '../../cor/logger/auditLog';
import { useBreedStandard } from '../../shr/hooks/useBreedStandard';

const emptyRow = () => ({ hatched:'', unhatched:'', deadInShell:'', pipped:'', other:'', gradeA:'', gradeB:'', maleCount:'', femaleCount:'', unknownCount:'', avgWeight:'', notes:'' });

export default function HatchesPage({ initialEntry = '', onGoTo, active = true }: { initialEntry?: string; onGoTo?: (t: any, payload?: { entry?: string }) => void; active?: boolean } = {}) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { devices, eggEntries, hatches, candlings, addHatch, updateHatch, deleteHatch } = useInc();
  const { birds } = useBrd();
  const { add: addFlock, remove: removeFlock } = useFlk();
  const { halls, zones } = useHal();
  const { contacts } = useCtc();
  const { addInvoice, deleteInvoice } = useTra();
  const nav = useNavigate();

  const [undoData, setUndoData] = useState<{ hatch: any | any[] } | null>(null);
  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deviceFilter, setDeviceFilter] = useState('');

  const [flockErr, setFlockErr] = useState('');
  const [sellErr, setSellErr] = useState('');
  const [flockModal, setFlockModal] = useState<{ hatchId: string; count: number } | null>(null);
  const [flockForm, setFlockForm] = useState<FlockForm>({ name:'', type:'layer', hallId:'', zoneId:'' });
  const breedStd = useBreedStandard();
  const [sellModal, setSellModal] = useState<{ hatchId: string; count: number } | null>(null);
  const [sellForm, setSellForm] = useState({ buyerId:'', count:'', unitPrice:'', date:'' });

  // ═══ Performance: lookup maps ═══
  const _entriesById = useMemo(() => {
    const m: Record<string, any> = {};
    (eggEntries || []).forEach(e => { m[e.id] = e; });
    return m;
  }, [eggEntries]);

  const _birdsById = useMemo(() => {
    const m: Record<string, any> = {};
    (birds || []).forEach(b => { m[b.id] = b; });
    return m;
  }, [birds]);

  const _devicesById = useMemo(() => {
    const m: Record<string, any> = {};
    (devices || []).forEach(d => { m[d.id] = d; });
    return m;
  }, [devices]);

  // ═══ Performance: index candlings by entry, sorted desc ═══
  const _candlingsByEntry = useMemo(() => {
    const m: Record<string, any[]> = {};
    (candlings || []).forEach(cc => {
      if (!m[cc.eggEntryId]) m[cc.eggEntryId] = [];
      m[cc.eggEntryId].push(cc);
    });
    Object.values(m).forEach(arr => arr.sort((a, b) => b.stage - a.stage));
    return m;
  }, [candlings]);

  const _latestCandByEntry = useMemo(() => {
    const m: Record<string, any> = {};
    Object.entries(_candlingsByEntry).forEach(([k, arr]) => {
      if (arr.length > 0) m[k] = arr[0];
    });
    return m;
  }, [_candlingsByEntry]);

  const int = (s: string) => s ? parseInt(toEn(s)) || null : null;
  const num = (s: string) => s ? parseFloat(toEn(s).replace('٫', '.')) || null : null;
  const todayJ = () => { const d = new Date(); return formatJ(d, 'yyyy/MM/dd'); };

  const {
    open, setOpen, editingId, setEditingId, formDate, setFormDate,
    formEntryId, setFormEntryId, selectedIds, setSelectedIds,
    entriesData, setEntriesData, err, setErr,
    dataFor, updateData, toggleEntry, openNew, openEdit, vErrors, save,
  } = useHatchForm({ eggEntries, candlings, hatches, entriesById: _entriesById, addHatch, updateHatch });

  useFab(active && hatches.length > 0 ? { label: 'ثبت هچ', onClick: () => openNew() } : null);

  const undoDeleteHatch = () => {
    if (!undoData) return;
    try {
      const arr: any[] = Array.isArray(undoData.hatch) ? undoData.hatch : [undoData.hatch];
      for (const h of arr) addHatch(h);
      toastMsg.restoredBulk(arr.length, 'هچ')
    } catch {}
    setUndoData(null);
  };


  const doDelete = async (id: string) => {
    const h = hatches.find(x => x.id === id) as any;
    if (!h) return;
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync('تأیید حذف', 'این هچ حذف شود؟', { danger: true });
    if (!ok) return;
    if (h.generatedFlockId && await showConfirmAsync('تأیید', 'این هچ یک گله ساخته. گله هم حذف شود؟', { danger: true })) { try { removeFlock(h.generatedFlockId); } catch {} }
    if (h.generatedInvoiceId && await showConfirmAsync('تأیید', 'این هچ یک فاکتور ساخته. فاکتور هم حذف شود؟', { danger: true })) { try { deleteInvoice(h.generatedInvoiceId); } catch {} }
    deleteHatch(id);
  };

  const createFlock = () => {
    if (!flockModal) return;
    if (!flockForm.name.trim()) { setFlockErr('نام گله را وارد کنید'); return; }
    const h = hatches.find(x => x.id === flockModal.hatchId);
    if (!h) return;
    const entry = _entriesById[h.eggEntryId];
    const bird = entry ? _birdsById[entry.birdId] : null;
    if (!bird) { setFlockErr('پرنده پیدا نشد'); return; }
    const std = entry?.breedId ? breedStd.byBreedId(entry.breedId) : null;
    // 🆕 محاسبه از form (کاربر ممکنه ویرایش کرده باشه)
    const eggCount = entry?.count || 0;
    const hatched = flockModal.count || 0;
    const uPrice = parseFloat(flockForm.unitPrice || '0') || 0;
    const shipCost = parseFloat(flockForm.shippingCost || '0') || 0;
    const purchasePricePerChick = hatched > 0 && uPrice > 0 ? Math.round((uPrice * eggCount) / hatched) : null;

    const data = buildFlockFromHatch({
      formName: flockForm.name.trim(),
      formType: flockForm.type,
      formHallId: flockForm.hallId,
      formZoneId: flockForm.zoneId,
      hatch: {
        ...h,
        hatched: flockModal.count,
        maleCount: flockForm.maleCount ? parseInt(flockForm.maleCount) || null : h.maleCount,
        femaleCount: flockForm.femaleCount ? parseInt(flockForm.femaleCount) || null : h.femaleCount,
        unknownCount: flockForm.unknownCount ? parseInt(flockForm.unknownCount) || null : h.unknownCount,
      },
      bird,
      breedId: entry?.breedId || '',
      entryUnitPrice: purchasePricePerChick,
      entryShippingCost: shipCost > 0 ? shipCost : null,
      layingStartDayFromStd: flockForm.layingStartDay ? parseInt(flockForm.layingStartDay) || null : (std?.biology?.layingStartDay ?? null),
    });
    const newFlockId = addFlock(data as any);
    if (newFlockId) {
      try { updateHatch(h.id, { generatedFlockId: newFlockId } as any); } catch {}
    }
    setFlockModal(null);
    toastMsg.success('گله ساخته شد');
    setTimeout(() => nav('/flk'), 500);
  };

  const doSell = () => {
    if (!sellModal) return;
    if (!sellForm.buyerId) { setSellErr('خریدار را انتخاب کنید'); return; }
    const count = parseInt(toEn(sellForm.count)) || 0;
    const unitPrice = parseFloat(toEn(sellForm.unitPrice).replace('٫','.')) || 0;
    if (count <= 0 || unitPrice <= 0) { setSellErr('مقادیر باید بیشتر از صفر'); return; }
    const h = hatches.find(x => x.id === sellModal.hatchId);
    if (!h) return;
    const data = buildSaleInvoiceFromHatch({
      buyerId: sellForm.buyerId,
      count,
      unitPrice,
      date: sellForm.date || h.date,
      hatch: h as any,
    });
    const invId = addInvoice(data as any);
    if (invId) updateHatch(h.id, { generatedInvoiceId: invId } as any);
    setSellModal(null);
    toastMsg.success('فاکتور ثبت شد');
  };

  // فیلتر/مرتب
  const config = useMemo(
    () => getIncHatchesConfig({
      devices: devices.map(d => ({ id: d.id, name: d.name })),
      eggEntriesById: _entriesById,
    }),
    [devices, _entriesById]
  );
  const { filtered, filters, setFilter, clearFilter, sort, setSort, toggleSort,
          resetAll, hasActiveFilters, total, count } = useFilterSort<HatchResult>({
    items: hatches,
    filters: config.filterDefs,
    sorts: config.sortDefs,
    persistKey: config.persistKey,
    initialSort: config.initialSort,
  });

  // ─── Multi-Select ───
  const ms = useMultiSelect({
    items: filtered,
    getId: (h: any) => h.id,
    onDelete: async (ids: string[]) => {
      const ok = await showConfirmAsync('حذف گروهی', fmt.count(ids.length) + ' هچ حذف شوند؟', { danger: true });
      if (!ok) return;
      const backups: any[] = [];
      for (const id of ids) {
        const it = hatches.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (!it) continue;
        backups.push(it);
        try { deleteHatch(id); } catch {}
      }
      if (backups.length > 0) {
        setUndoData({ hatch: backups });
        setTimeout(() => setUndoData((cur: any) => cur && Array.isArray(cur.hatch) && cur.hatch.length === backups.length ? null : cur), 8000);
      }
      toastMsg.deletedBulk(backups.length, 'هچ')
      logAction('delete', 'inc', 'حذف گروهی هچ: ' + backups.length);
    },
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (ms.selectionMode) setExpandedId(null);
  }, [ms.selectionMode]);

  const availableEntries = eggEntries
    .filter(e => !deviceFilter || e.deviceId === deviceFilter)
    .filter(e => {
      // در حالت ویرایش، ورودی خودمون رو نشون بده
      if (editingId) return e.id === formEntryId;
      // ورودی که قبلاً هچ شده رو نشون نده
      const hasHatch = hatches.some(h => h.eggEntryId === e.id);
      return !hasHatch;
    })
    .sort((a, b) => String(b.entryDate).localeCompare(String(a.entryDate)));

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      {undoData && (
        <div style={{
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
          padding: '10px 14px', marginBottom: 8,
          background: 'var(--warn-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--warn)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
        }}>
          <span>هچ حذف شد</span>
          <button type="button" onClick={undoDeleteHatch} aria-label="بازگردانی هچ" style={{
            background: 'none', border: 'none', color: 'var(--warn)',
            fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit',
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: '4px 10px',
          }}>بازگردانی</button>
        </div>
      )}
      <HelpBanner
        id="inc-hatch-intro"
        icon="🐣"
        title="راهنمای هچ و نتیجه نهایی"
        description="نتیجهٔ پایانی هر دوره شامل تعداد جوجه‌های هچ‌شده، تلفات جنینی، تفکیک جنسیت و انتقال جوجه به گله یا فروش را ثبت کنید."
        tone="info"
      />

      {!ms.selectionMode && filtered.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: 'var(--dim)', textAlign: 'center', paddingBottom: 2 }}>
          برای انتخاب چندتایی، روی یک کارت نگه دارید
        </div>
      )}

      {ms.selectionMode && filtered.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 6 }}>
          <button type="button"
            onClick={ms.selectedIds.size === filtered.length ? ms.clearSelection : ms.selectAll}
            style={{ padding: '4px 10px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: '10px', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
            {ms.selectedIds.size === filtered.length ? 'لغو انتخاب همه' : 'انتخاب همه'}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      <FilterBar
        filterDefs={config.filterDefs}
        sortDefs={config.sortDefs}
        filterState={filters}
        sortState={sort}
        setFilter={setFilter}
        clearFilter={clearFilter}
        setSort={setSort}
        toggleSort={toggleSort}
        resetAll={resetAll}
        hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
        total={total}
        count={count}
      />

      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty icon={<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7"><ellipse cx="12" cy="14" rx="7" ry="9"/></svg>}
          title="هچی ثبت نشده" desc="نتیجه‌ی نهایی را ثبت کنید."
          action={<Btn variant="primary" onClick={() => openNew()}>+ ثبت هچ</Btn>} />
      ) : (
        <>
          {filtered.map((h, i) => {
            const entry = _entriesById[h.eggEntryId];
            const bird = entry ? _birdsById[entry.birdId] : null;
            const dev = entry ? _devicesById[entry.deviceId] : null;
            const isOpen = !ms.selectionMode && expandedId === h.id;
            const total = entry?.count || 0;
            const hr = hatchRate(h.hatched || 0, total);
            const myCand = _latestCandByEntry[h.eggEntryId];
            const aliveAfter = myCand?.alive || total;
            const realRate = aliveAfter ? ((h.hatched || 0) / aliveAfter * 100) : 0;
            const tone = hr >= 70 ? 'green' : hr >= 50 ? 'amber' : 'red';
            const sumH = (h.hatched||0) + (h.unhatched||0) + (h.deadInShell||0) + (h.pipped||0) + (h.other||0);
              return (
              <HatchCard
                key={h.id}
                hatch={h}
                index={i}
                bird={bird}
                dev={dev}
                entry={entry}
                isOpen={isOpen}
                ms={ms}
                hr={hr}
                realRate={realRate}
                aliveAfter={aliveAfter}
                total={total}
                isComplete={(h.hatched||0)+(h.unhatched||0)+(h.deadInShell||0)+(h.pipped||0)+(h.other||0) >= total}
                tone={tone}
                onToggle={() => setExpandedId(isOpen ? null : h.id)}
                onEdit={() => openEdit(h)}
                onDelete={() => doDelete(h.id)}
                onOpenFlock={() => {
  const _e = _entriesById[h.eggEntryId];
  const _s = _e?.breedId ? breedStd.byBreedId(_e.breedId) : null;
  setFlockErr(''); setFlockModal({ hatchId: h.id, count: h.hatched || 0 });
  setFlockForm({
    name: 'گله ' + (bird?.name || '') + ' ' + fmt.code(formatJ(new Date(), 'yyyy')),
    type: 'layer',
    hallId: '',
    zoneId: '',
    maleCount: h.maleCount ? String(h.maleCount) : '',
    femaleCount: h.femaleCount ? String(h.femaleCount) : '',
    unknownCount: h.unknownCount ? String(h.unknownCount) : '',
    unitPrice: _e?.unitPrice ? String(_e.unitPrice) : '',
    shippingCost: _e?.shippingCost ? String(_e.shippingCost) : '',
    layingStartDay: _s?.biology?.layingStartDay ? String(_s.biology.layingStartDay) : '',
  });
}}
                onOpenSell={() => { setSellErr(''); setSellModal({ hatchId: h.id, count: h.hatched || 0 }); setSellForm({ buyerId:'', count: String(h.hatched || 0), unitPrice:'', date: h.date }); }}
              />
            );
          })}
          
        </>
      )}

      <HatchFormModal
        open={open}
        editingId={editingId}
        formDate={formDate}
        setFormDate={setFormDate}
        formEntryId={formEntryId}
        setFormEntryId={setFormEntryId}
        deviceFilter={deviceFilter}
        setDeviceFilter={setDeviceFilter}
        selectedIds={selectedIds}
        entriesData={entriesData}
        err={err}
        vErrors={vErrors}
        eggEntries={eggEntries}
        devices={devices}
        availableEntries={availableEntries}
        birdsById={_birdsById}
        devicesById={_devicesById}
        candlings={candlings}
        latestCandByEntry={_latestCandByEntry}
        daysAgo={daysAgo}
        isLockdown={isLockdown}
        toggleEntry={toggleEntry}
        updateData={updateData}
        dataFor={dataFor}
        onSave={save}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
      />

      <MultiSelectBar ms={ms} deleteLabel="حذف" />

      {ms.selectionMode && <div style={{ height: 90 }} />}

      {/* ═══ Modal گله ═══ */}
      {flockModal && (() => {
        const _h = hatches.find(x => x.id === flockModal.hatchId);
        const _e = _h ? _entriesById[_h.eggEntryId] : null;
        const _s = _e?.breedId ? breedStd.byBreedId(_e.breedId) : null;
        return (
          <FlockCreateModal
            open={!!flockModal}
            count={flockModal?.count || 0}
            form={flockForm}
            setForm={setFlockForm}
            halls={halls}
            zones={zones}
            sourceData={{
              maleCount: _h?.maleCount,
              femaleCount: _h?.femaleCount,
              unknownCount: _h?.unknownCount,
              unitPrice: _e?.unitPrice,
              shippingCost: _e?.shippingCost,
              layingStartDay: _s?.biology?.layingStartDay,
              eggCount: _e?.count,
            }}
            onCreate={createFlock}
            err={flockErr}
            onClose={() => setFlockModal(null)}

        );
      })()}

      {/* ═══ Modal فروش ═══ */}
      <SellModal
        open={!!sellModal}
        maxCount={sellModal?.count || 0}
        form={sellForm}
        setForm={setSellForm}
        contacts={contacts}
        onSell={doSell}
          err={sellErr}
        onClose={() => setSellModal(null)}
      />

    </PageContainer>
  );
}

/**
 * api/calc.ts — توابع محاسباتی خالص ماژول جوجه‌کشی
 *
 * همه تابع‌ها pure هستن. هیچ وابستگی به React یا store ندارن.
 */

export interface CandlingLike {
  id: string;
  eggEntryId: string;
  stage: number;
  date: string;
  alive: number | null;
  infertile: number | null;
  dead: number | null;
  broken: number | null;
  infertileReason: string;
  deadReason: string;
  notes: string;
  createdAt: string;
  deadEarly?: number | null;
  deadMid?: number | null;
  deadLate?: number | null;
}

export interface AvailableBase {
  base: number;
  source: string;
}

/** مبنای تعداد تخم برای این مرحله (از مرحله قبل یا کل ورودی) */
export function calcAvailableBase(
  entryId: string,
  currentStage: number,
  excludeCandlingId: string | null,
  allCandlings: CandlingLike[],
  entryTotal: number,
): AvailableBase {
  const myCandlings = allCandlings
    .filter(c => c.eggEntryId === entryId)
    .filter(c => !excludeCandlingId || c.id !== excludeCandlingId)
    .sort((a, b) => a.stage - b.stage);

  const prevs = myCandlings.filter(c => c.stage < currentStage);
  if (prevs.length === 0) {
    return { base: entryTotal, source: 'کل ورودی' };
  }
  const prev = prevs[prevs.length - 1];
  return { base: prev.alive || 0, source: 'مرحله ' + prev.stage };
}

export interface Aggregate {
  alive: number;
  infertile: number;
  dead: number;
  broken: number;
}

/** تجمیع مجموع کندلینگ‌ها */
export function aggregateCandlings(list: CandlingLike[]): Aggregate {
  return list.reduce(
    (acc, c) => ({
      alive: acc.alive + (c.alive || 0),
      infertile: acc.infertile + (c.infertile || 0),
      dead: acc.dead + (c.dead || 0),
      broken: acc.broken + (c.broken || 0),
    }),
    { alive: 0, infertile: 0, dead: 0, broken: 0 },
  );
}

export interface CandlingSummary {
  totalAlive: number;
  totalInfertile: number;
  totalDead: number;
  totalBroken: number;
  grandTotal: number;
  fertilePercent: number;
  lossPercent: number;
}

/** خلاصه‌ی کل کندلینگ‌ها — با محاسبه‌ی مبنای هر مرحله */
export function calcSummary(
  candlings: CandlingLike[],
  entryTotalMap: Record<string, number>,
): CandlingSummary {
  const allData = candlings.map(c => {
    const entryTotal = entryTotalMap[c.eggEntryId] || 0;
    const baseInfo = calcAvailableBase(c.eggEntryId, c.stage, c.id, candlings, entryTotal);
    const inf = c.infertile || 0;
    const dead = c.dead || 0;
    const brk = c.broken || 0;
    const alive = Math.max(0, (baseInfo.base || 0) - inf - dead - brk);
    return { alive, inf, dead, brk };
  });

  const totalAlive = allData.reduce((a, x) => a + x.alive, 0);
  const totalInfertile = allData.reduce((a, x) => a + x.inf, 0);
  const totalDead = allData.reduce((a, x) => a + x.dead, 0);
  const totalBroken = allData.reduce((a, x) => a + x.brk, 0);
  const grandTotal = totalAlive + totalInfertile + totalDead + totalBroken;
  const fertilePercent = grandTotal > 0 ? (totalAlive / grandTotal * 100) : 0;
  const lossPercent = grandTotal > 0 ? ((totalInfertile + totalDead + totalBroken) / grandTotal * 100) : 0;

  return {
    totalAlive, totalInfertile, totalDead, totalBroken,
    grandTotal, fertilePercent, lossPercent,
  };
}

/**
 * api/eggEntriesCalc.ts — توابع خالص EggEntriesPage
 */
import { addDaysJalali, jalaliToDate } from '../store';

/** ساعت فعلی به صورت HH:MM */
export function nowTime(): string {
  const d = new Date();
  return String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
}

export interface FlockReadyResult {
  ready: boolean;
  ageDays: number;
  minAge: number;
  daysLeft: number;
}

/** چک آماده بودن گله برای تخم‌گذاری */
export function flockReadyForEggs(flock: any, _bird: any): FlockReadyResult {
  const startDate = flock?.hatchDate || flock?.purchaseDate || flock?.startDate || '';
  if (!startDate) return { ready: true, ageDays: 0, minAge: 0, daysLeft: 0 };
  try {
    const start = jalaliToDate(startDate);
    if (!start) return { ready: true, ageDays: 0, minAge: 0, daysLeft: 0 };
    const today = new Date();
    const ageDays = Math.max(0, Math.floor((today.getTime() - start.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)));
    const minAge = flock?.layingStartDay || 140;
    return {
      ready: ageDays >= minAge,
      ageDays,
      minAge,
      daysLeft: Math.max(0, minAge - ageDays),
    };
  } catch { return { ready: true, ageDays: 0, minAge: 0, daysLeft: 0 }; }
}

/** محاسبه تاریخ ورود برای هچ همزمان */
export function calcEntryDateForSyncHatch(targetHatchDate: string, totalDays: number): string {
  if (!targetHatchDate || !totalDays) return '';
  return addDaysJalali(targetHatchDate, -totalDays);
}

/** کلید localStorage برای draft هر دستگاه */
export const DRAFT_KEY = (devId: string) => 'pm-inc-egg-draft-' + devId;

/** محاسبه استفاده‌ی دستگاه (بر اساس ظرفیت‌های مختلف پرنده‌ها) */
export function calcDeviceUsage(
  device: any,
  entries: any[],
  newEntry?: { birdName: string; count: number }
): { used: number; total: number; percent: number } {
  const caps: any[] = device?.capacityByBird || [];
  if (caps.length === 0) return { used: 0, total: 0, percent: 0 };
  const refCap = Math.max(...caps.map(c => c.capacity || 0));
  if (refCap === 0) return { used: 0, total: 0, percent: 0 };
  const byBird: Record<string, number> = {};
  caps.forEach(c => {
    if (!c.birdName) return;
    const factor = (c.capacity && c.capacity > 0) ? (refCap / c.capacity) : 1;
    byBird[c.birdName] = factor;
  });
  let used = 0;
  entries.forEach(e => {
    if (e.status === 'failed') return;
    const factor = byBird[e.__birdName || ''];
    if (!factor) return;
    used += (e.count || 0) * factor;
  });
  if (newEntry) {
    const factor = byBird[newEntry.birdName];
    if (factor) used += newEntry.count * factor;
  }
  return {
    used: Math.round(used * 10) / 10,
    total: refCap,
    percent: Math.round((used / refCap) * 100),
  };
}

/**
 * api/hatchCalc.ts — توابع محاسباتی خالص ماژول هچ
 */

export interface CandlingLike {
  eggEntryId: string;
  stage: number;
  alive: number | null;
  infertile: number | null;
  dead: number | null;
  broken: number | null;
}

export interface FertileResult {
  fertile: number;
  totalLoss: number;
  byStage: { stage: number; alive: number; infertile: number; dead: number; broken: number }[];
}

/**
 * نطفه‌دار فعلی = کل تخم − مجموع همه تلفات کندلینگ‌ها
 */
export function calcCurrentFertile(
  entryId: string,
  entryTotal: number,
  allCandlings: CandlingLike[],
): FertileResult {
  const myCandlings = allCandlings
    .filter(c => c.eggEntryId === entryId)
    .sort((a, b) => a.stage - b.stage);

  let totalInfertile = 0;
  let totalDead = 0;
  let totalBroken = 0;

  const byStage = myCandlings.map(c => {
    totalInfertile += c.infertile || 0;
    totalDead += c.dead || 0;
    totalBroken += c.broken || 0;
    return {
      stage: c.stage,
      alive: c.alive || 0,
      infertile: c.infertile || 0,
      dead: c.dead || 0,
      broken: c.broken || 0,
    };
  });

  const totalLoss = totalInfertile + totalDead + totalBroken;

  return {
    fertile: Math.max(0, entryTotal - totalLoss),
    totalLoss,
    byStage,
  };
}

/**
 * نرخ هچ بر اساس نطفه‌داری — اگه نطفه‌داری پایین باشه، نرخ هچ هم کمتر
 */
export function smartHatchRate(fertilityRate: number): number {
  if (fertilityRate >= 92) return 0.94;
  if (fertilityRate >= 85) return 0.92;
  if (fertilityRate >= 75) return 0.88;
  if (fertilityRate >= 65) return 0.83;
  return 0.78;
}

/**
 * محاسبه هچ‌شده تخمینی از کندلینگ
 */
export function estimateHatched(
  aliveAfter: number,
  entryTotal: number,
  losses: { ds: number; pp: number; uh: number; ot: number },
): number {
  const fertility = entryTotal > 0 ? (aliveAfter / entryTotal * 100) : 0;
  const rate = smartHatchRate(fertility);
  const fromAlive = Math.round(aliveAfter * rate);
  const lossesSum = losses.ds + losses.pp + losses.uh + losses.ot;
  return Math.max(0, fromAlive - lossesSum);
}

/** 🆕 محاسبه درصد کاهش وزن تخم (استاندارد Ross: ۱۱-۱۳٪ تا روز ۱۸) */
export function calcWeightLossPct(
  initial: number | null | undefined,
  current: number | null | undefined,
): number | null {
  if (!initial || initial <= 0 || !current || current <= 0) return null;
  const pct = ((initial - current) / initial) * 100;
  return Math.round(pct * 10) / 10;
}

/** 🆕 چک در بازه بودن کاهش وزن */
export function isWeightLossInRange(
  pct: number | null,
  min = 11,
  max = 13,
): boolean {
  if (pct === null) return true;
  return pct >= min && pct <= max;
}

/** 🆕 پیدا کردن فاز انکوباسیون برای سن خاص (روز) */
export function getIncubationPhase(
  std: { incubation?: { tempProfile?: Array<{ dayFrom: number; dayTo: number; temp: number; humidity: number; label?: string }> } } | null | undefined,
  ageDays: number,
): { dayFrom: number; dayTo: number; temp: number; humidity: number; label?: string } | null {
  const profile = std?.incubation?.tempProfile;
  if (!profile || profile.length === 0) return null;
  for (const phase of profile) {
    if (ageDays >= phase.dayFrom && ageDays <= phase.dayTo) return phase;
  }
  return profile[profile.length - 1] ?? null;
}

/** 🆕 دما و رطوبت مورد انتظار برای سن خاص */
export function getExpectedTempHumidity(
  std: { incubation?: { tempProfile?: Array<{ dayFrom: number; dayTo: number; temp: number; humidity: number }> } } | null | undefined,
  ageDays: number,
): { temp: number; humidity: number } | null {
  const phase = getIncubationPhase(std, ageDays);
  if (!phase) return null;
  return { temp: phase.temp, humidity: phase.humidity };
}

/** 🆕 محدوده EST (دمای پوسته تخم) */
export function getEstRange(
  std: { incubation?: { estMinTemp?: number; estMaxTemp?: number } } | null | undefined,
): { min: number; max: number } | null {
  const inc = std?.incubation;
  if (!inc?.estMinTemp || !inc?.estMaxTemp) return null;
  return { min: inc.estMinTemp, max: inc.estMaxTemp };
}

/** 🆕 چک EST در محدوده */
export function isEstInRange(
  value: number | null | undefined,
  std: Parameters<typeof getEstRange>[0],
): boolean {
  if (value == null) return true;
  const range = getEstRange(std);
  if (!range) return true;
  return value >= range.min && value <= range.max;
}

/** 🆕 چک CO₂ زیر حد */
export function isCo2InRange(
  value: number | null | undefined,
  std: { incubation?: { co2MaxPct?: number } } | null | undefined,
): boolean {
  if (value == null) return true;
  const max = std?.incubation?.co2MaxPct;
  if (max == null) return true;
  return value <= max;
}

/** 🆕 چک O₂ بالای حد */
export function isO2InRange(
  value: number | null | undefined,
  std: { incubation?: { o2MinPct?: number } } | null | undefined,
): boolean {
  if (value == null) return true;
  const min = std?.incubation?.o2MinPct;
  if (min == null) return true;
  return value >= min;
}

/**
 * needs.ts — محاسبه نیازهای انکوباسیون (مشابه hal/needs.ts)
 *
 * همه توابع pure هستن — بدون React یا store.
 * مرجع: Ross 308 / Cobb / Aviagen Handbooks
 */
import type { IncubationStandard, BirdStandard } from '../../set/standards/types';

// ═══ Input Types ═══

export interface AirExchangeInput {
  eggCount: number;
  standard: BirdStandard | null;
}

export interface TurningInput {
  ageDays: number;
  standard: BirdStandard | null;
}

// ═══ Output Type ═══

export interface NeedResult {
  value: number;
  unit: string;
  formula: string;
  /** 🆕 آستانه هشدار (اگه خارج بازه باشه) */
  level?: 'ok' | 'warn' | 'critical';
}

// ═══ Helpers ═══

// ═══ ۱. نیاز تهویه (m³/h) ═══

/**
 * نیاز تهویه بر اساس airExchangePer1000Eggs
 * فرمول: (eggCount / 1000) × airExchangePer1000Eggs
 * پیش‌فرض: 0.14 m³/h به ازای هر ۱۰۰۰ تخم (Ross 308)
 */
export function needAirExchange(inp: AirExchangeInput): NeedResult | null {
  if (inp.eggCount <= 0) return null;
  const coef = inp.standard?.incubation?.airExchangePer1000Eggs ?? 0.14;
  const value = Math.round(((inp.eggCount / 1000) * coef) * 100) / 100;
  return {
    value,
    unit: 'm³/h',
    formula: `(${inp.eggCount} ÷ 1000) × ${coef} m³/h`,
  };
}

// ═══ ۲. نیاز چرخش ═══

/**
 * تعداد چرخش در روز + جمع کل تا امروز
 * استاندارد: ۲۴ بار در روز (هر ۱ ساعت) یا حداقل ۱۲ بار
 */
export function needTurningCount(inp: TurningInput): NeedResult | null {
  const std: IncubationStandard | undefined = inp.standard?.incubation;
  if (!std) return null;
  const perDay = std.turningPerDay ?? 24;
  const totalSoFar = perDay * Math.max(0, inp.ageDays);
  return {
    value: perDay,
    unit: 'بار/روز',
    formula: `${perDay} بار × ${inp.ageDays} روز = ${totalSoFar} چرخش`,
    level: perDay >= 24 ? 'ok' : perDay >= 12 ? 'warn' : 'critical',
  };
}

// ═══ ۳. نیاز ذخیره‌سازی تخم ═══

/**
 * تعداد روزهای ذخیره‌سازی تخم قبل از انکوباسیون
 * استاندارد: حداکثر ۷ روز (کاهش نرخ هچ بعد از ۷ روز)
 */
export function needEggStorageDays(ageDays: number, maxDays = 7): NeedResult | null {
  if (ageDays < 0) return null;
  return {
    value: ageDays,
    unit: 'روز',
    formula: `${ageDays} روز از ورود`,
    level: ageDays <= maxDays ? 'ok' : ageDays <= maxDays + 2 ? 'warn' : 'critical',
  };
}

// ═══ ۴. نرخ هچ کل (Hatchability) ═══

/**
 * نرخ هچ کل = hatched / totalEggs × 100
 * پیش‌فرض استاندارد: 80-85٪ از کل
 */
export function calcHatchability(
  hatched: number | null | undefined,
  totalEggs: number | null | undefined,
): NeedResult | null {
  if (!hatched || !totalEggs || totalEggs <= 0) return null;
  const pct = Math.round((hatched / totalEggs) * 1000) / 10;
  return {
    value: pct,
    unit: '٪',
    formula: `(${hatched} ÷ ${totalEggs}) × 100`,
    level: pct >= 80 ? 'ok' : pct >= 70 ? 'warn' : 'critical',
  };
}

// ═══ ۵. نرخ هچ واقعی (Real Hatchability) ═══

/**
 * نرخ هچ واقعی = hatched / fertileEggs × 100
 * پیش‌فرض استاندارد: 90-95٪ از نطفه‌دار
 */
export function calcRealHatchability(
  hatched: number | null | undefined,
  fertileEggs: number | null | undefined,
): NeedResult | null {
  if (!hatched || !fertileEggs || fertileEggs <= 0) return null;
  const pct = Math.round((hatched / fertileEggs) * 1000) / 10;
  return {
    value: pct,
    unit: '٪',
    formula: `(${hatched} ÷ ${fertileEggs}) × 100`,
    level: pct >= 90 ? 'ok' : pct >= 80 ? 'warn' : 'critical',
  };
}

// ═══ ۶. Chick Yield ═══

/**
 * Chick Yield = avgChickWeight / avgEggWeight × 100
 * استاندارد Ross: 64-71٪ (بهینه: 67-68٪)
 */
export function calcChickYield(
  avgChickWeightG: number | null | undefined,
  avgEggWeightG: number | null | undefined,
): NeedResult | null {
  if (!avgChickWeightG || !avgEggWeightG || avgEggWeightG <= 0) return null;
  const pct = Math.round((avgChickWeightG / avgEggWeightG) * 1000) / 10;
  const inRange = pct >= 64 && pct <= 71;
  return {
    value: pct,
    unit: '٪',
    formula: `(${avgChickWeightG} ÷ ${avgEggWeightG}) × 100`,
    level: inRange ? 'ok' : pct >= 60 && pct <= 75 ? 'warn' : 'critical',
  };
}

// ═══ Record (مشابه NEED_CALCULATORS در hal) ═══

export const INC_NEEDS: Record<string, string> = {
  airExchange: 'تهویه',
  turningCount: 'چرخش',
  eggStorage: 'ذخیره‌سازی تخم',
  hatchability: 'نرخ هچ کل',
  realHatchability: 'نرخ هچ واقعی',
  chickYield: 'Chick Yield',
};

/**
 * api/warranty.ts — محاسبه گارانتی دستگاه
 */
import { toEn } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { parse as parseJ, addMonths, format as formatJ } from 'date-fns-jalali';

export interface WarrantyInfo {
  end: string;
  expired: boolean;
}

export function warrantyInfo(purchasedAt: string, months: number | null): WarrantyInfo | null {
  if (!purchasedAt || !months) return null;
  try {
    const d = parseJ(toEn(purchasedAt), 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
    const end = formatJ(addMonths(d, months), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
    const t = new Date();
    const today = formatJ(t, 'yyyy/MM/dd');
    return { end, expired: end < today };
  } catch { return null; }
}

FILE: ./src/mod/inc/archivePolicy.ts

import type { EggEntry } from './store';

export interface IncSplitResult {
  toArchive: EggEntry[];
  keep: EggEntry[];
  skipped: EggEntry[];
}

export interface IncArchiveOptions {
  cutoffIso?: string;
}

const ARCHIVABLE_STATUSES = new Set<EggEntry['status']>(['hatched', 'done', 'failed']);

/**
 * تفکیک خالص بچ‌های جوجه‌کشی پیش از انتقال به مخزن inc_batches:
 * دوره‌های فعال (incubating/candled/locked) در keep می‌مانند و فقط دوره‌های
 * خاتمه‌یافته (hatched/done/failed) که قبل از cutoffIso باشند به toArchive می‌روند.
 */
export function splitIncEntriesForArchive(
  entries: EggEntry[],
  opts: IncArchiveOptions = {}
): IncSplitResult {
  const toArchive: EggEntry[] = [];
  const keep: EggEntry[] = [];
  const skipped: EggEntry[] = [];

  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (!entry || !entry.id) {
      skipped.push(entry);
      continue;
    }
    if (!ARCHIVABLE_STATUSES.has(entry.status)) {
      keep.push(entry);
      continue;
    }
    if (opts.cutoffIso) {
      const marker = entry.expectedHatchDate || entry.entryDate || entry.createdAt || '';
      if (!marker || marker > opts.cutoffIso) {
        keep.push(entry);
        continue;
      }
    }
    toArchive.push(entry);
  }

  return { toArchive, keep, skipped };
}

      </div>

      {/* تجمیع با درصد */}
      <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📊</span>
        {' '}تجمیع ({fmt.count(list.length)} کندلینگ)
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>
          <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>🧬 نطفه‌داری</span>
          <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--accent)' }}>{fmt.code(fertilePercent.toFixed(1))}٪</span>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>
          <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>📉 تلفات کل</span>
          <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: lossPercent > 10 ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.code(lossPercent.toFixed(1))}٪</span>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 4 }}>
          <StatCell label="✅ سالم" value={agg.alive} />
          <StatCell label="⚪ بی‌نطفه" value={agg.infertile} />
          <StatCell label="💀 مرده" value={agg.dead} />
          <StatCell label="🥚 شکسته" value={agg.broken} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* نوار پیشرفت بصری */}
      {total > 0 && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', height: 36, borderRadius: 4, overflow: 'hidden', background: 'var(--input-bg)' }}>
          <div style={{ width: (agg.alive / total * 100) + '%', background: 'var(--accent)' }} />
          <div style={{ width: (agg.infertile / total * 100) + '%', background: 'var(--warn)' }} />
          <div style={{ width: (agg.dead / total * 100) + '%', background: 'var(--danger)' }} />
          <div style={{ width: (agg.broken / total * 100) + '%', background: 'var(--muted)' }} />
        </div>
      )}
    </ExpandableCard>
  );
}

function StatCell({ label, value }: { label: string; value: number }) {
  return (
    <div style={{
      padding: 'var(--pad-tight)',
      background: 'var(--input-bg)',
      borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
      fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
      display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between',
    }}>
      <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{label}</span>
      <span style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{getGlobalFormat().num(value)}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * CandlingEntryRow.tsx — ردیف انتخاب یک ورودی تخم در فرم کندلینگ
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { toFa, toEn } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { Field, Grid2, NumField, Select } from '../../../shr/components/ui';

export interface EntryData {
  alive: string;
  infertile: string;
  dead: string;
  broken: string;
  infertileReason: string;
  deadReason: string;
  notes: string;
}

export const INFERTILE_REASONS: [string, string][] = [
  ['', '—'], ['season', 'فصل'], ['rooster_age', 'سن خروس'],
  ['nutrition', 'تغذیه'], ['genetics', 'ژنتیک'], ['storage', 'نگهداری تخم'],
];

export const DEAD_REASONS: [string, string][] = [
  ['', '—'], ['temp_fluctuation', 'نوسان دما'], ['humidity', 'رطوبت نامناسب'],
  ['ventilation', 'تهویه ضعیف'], ['genetics', 'ژنتیک'], ['infection', 'عفونت'],
];

export interface CandlingEntryRowProps {
  entryId: string;
  birdName?: string;
  count: number;
  entryDate: string;
  isSelected: boolean;
  data: EntryData;
  baseInfo: { base: number; source: string };
  alreadyAgg: { alive: number; infertile: number; dead: number; broken: number };
  onToggle: () => void;
  onUpdate: (patch: Partial<EntryData>) => void;
}

export default function CandlingEntryRow(props: CandlingEntryRowProps) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const {
    birdName, count, entryDate, isSelected, data: d,
    baseInfo, alreadyAgg, onToggle, onUpdate,
  } = props;

  const _inf = parseInt(toEn(d.infertile)) || 0;
  const _dead = parseInt(toEn(d.dead)) || 0;
  const _brk = parseInt(toEn(d.broken)) || 0;
  const _base = baseInfo.base || 0;
  const sum = _inf + _dead + _brk;
  const _alive = Math.max(0, _base - sum);
  const _over = sum > _base;
  const remaining = _base - sum;

  return (
    <div style={{
      border: '1px solid ' + (isSelected ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'),
      background: isSelected ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--card)',
      borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
      padding: 10,
      display: 'flex',
      flexDirection: 'column',
      gap: 8,
    }}>
      <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          checked={isSelected}
          onChange={onToggle}
          aria-label="انتخاب این ورودی"
          style={{
            width: 20, height: 20,
            accentColor: 'var(--accent)',
            cursor: 'pointer', flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        />
        <span style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
          {birdName || '—'} • {fmt.count(count)} تخم
        </span>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{fmt.date(entryDate)}</span>
      </label>

      {alreadyAgg.alive + alreadyAgg.infertile + alreadyAgg.dead + alreadyAgg.broken > 0 && (
        <div style={{
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)',
          padding: '4px 8px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
        }}>
          تجمیع قبلی: سالم {fmt.count(alreadyAgg.alive)} • بی‌نطفه {fmt.count(alreadyAgg.infertile)} • مرده {fmt.count(alreadyAgg.dead)}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* مبنا */}
      <div style={{
        fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
        padding: 'var(--pad-tight)',
        background: 'var(--accent-soft)',
        border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)',
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
        color: 'var(--accent)',
        fontWeight: 700,
        display: 'flex',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
      }}>
        <span>🎯 مبنای این کندلینگ:</span>
        <span>{fmt.count(baseInfo.base)} تخم ({baseInfo.source})</span>
      </div>

      {isSelected && (
        <>
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="بی‌نطفه">
              <NumField
                placeholder="۰"
                value={d.infertile}
                onChange={ev => onUpdate({ infertile: ev.target.value })}
                max={count || 0} min={0} unit="عدد"
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label="سالم" hint="خودکار">
              <div style={{
                height: 38, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'flex-end',
                padding: '0 12px',
                background: _over ? 'var(--danger-soft)' : 'var(--accent-soft)',
                border: '1px solid ' + (_over ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--accent-border)'),
                borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700,
                color: _over ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--accent)',
              }}>{fmt.count(_alive)} عدد</div>
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="مرده">
              <NumField
                placeholder="۰" value={d.dead}
                onChange={ev => onUpdate({ dead: ev.target.value })}
                max={count || 0} min={0} unit="عدد"
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label="شکسته">
              <NumField
                placeholder="۰" value={d.broken}
                onChange={ev => onUpdate({ broken: ev.target.value })}
                max={count || 0} min={0} unit="عدد"
              />
            </Field>
          </Grid2>

          <div style={{
            padding: 'var(--pad-tight)',
            background: remaining < 0 ? 'var(--danger-soft)' : remaining === 0 ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--input-bg)',
            border: '1px solid ' + (remaining < 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : remaining === 0 ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'),
            borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
            color: remaining < 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : remaining === 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)',
            fontWeight: 700,
            textAlign: 'center',
          }}>
            مجموع تلفات: {fmt.count(sum)} از {fmt.count(baseInfo.base)}
            {remaining > 0 && ' • باقی — ' + fmt.count(remaining)}
            {remaining < 0 && ' — بیشتر از مبنای مرحله قبل!'}
            {remaining === 0 && ' ✅ کامل'}
          </div>

          <Grid2>
            <Field label="دلیل بی‌نطفه">
              <Select
                value={d.infertileReason}
                onChange={ev => onUpdate({ infertileReason: ev.target.value })}
              >
                {INFERTILE_REASONS.map(([v, l]) => <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>)}
              </Select>
            </Field>
            <Field label="دلیل مرگ">
              <Select
                value={d.deadReason}
                onChange={ev => onUpdate({ deadReason: ev.target.value })}
              >
                {DEAD_REASONS.map(([v, l]) => <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>)}
              </Select>
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * CandlingFormModal.tsx — فرم ثبت/ویرایش کندلینگ
 *
 * شامل: زمان‌بندی + انتخاب ورودی‌ها + فرم هر ورودی
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import {
  Btn, BtnRow, Field, Grid2, Modal, NumField,
  SectionTitle, Select, ErrorBox,
} from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import DatePicker from '../../../shr/components/DatePicker';
import CandlingEntryRow, { type EntryData } from './CandlingEntryRow';
import type { CandlingLike, AvailableBase } from '../api/calc';
import SmartSelect from '../../../shr/components/SmartSelect';

export interface AvailableEntry {
  id: string;
  birdId: string;
  count: number | null;
  entryDate: string;
  deviceId: string;
  status: string;
}

export interface CandlingFormModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  editingId: string | null;
  // زمان‌بندی
  modalDay: string;
  setModalDay: (v: string) => void;
  modalDate: string;
  setModalDate: (v: string) => void;
  modalDevice: string;
  setModalDevice: (v: string) => void;
  // انتخاب ورودی
  selectedIds: Set<string>;
  setSelectedIds: (v: Set<string>) => void;
  setEntriesData: (fn: (prev: Record<string, EntryData>) => Record<string, EntryData>) => void;
  toggleEntry: (id: string) => void;
  updateEntryData: (id: string, patch: Partial<EntryData>) => void;
  entriesData: Record<string, EntryData>;
  // داده
  devices: { id: string; name: string }[];
  availableEntries: AvailableEntry[];
  birdsById: Record<string, any>;
  candlings: CandlingLike[];
  // profile
  firstSelectedBirdName?: string;
  profile: { totalDays: number; lockdownDay: number };
  // اکشن‌ها
  onSave: () => void;
  saving: boolean;
  err: string;
  vErrors: Record<string, string>;
}

export default function CandlingFormModal(props: CandlingFormModalProps) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const {
    open, onClose, editingId,
    modalDay, setModalDay, modalDate, setModalDate, modalDevice, setModalDevice,
    selectedIds, setSelectedIds, setEntriesData,
    toggleEntry, updateEntryData, entriesData,
    devices, availableEntries, birdsById, candlings,
    firstSelectedBirdName, profile,
    onSave, err, vErrors,
  } = props;

  const dataFor = (id: string): EntryData =>
    entriesData[id] || {
      alive: '', infertile: '', dead: '', broken: '',
      infertileReason: '', deadReason: '', notes: '',
    };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={editingId ? '✏️ ویرایش کندلینگ' : '🔍 ثبت کندلینگ'}
      footer={
        <BtnRow>
          <Btn
            variant="primary"
            onClick={onSave}
            disabled={Object.keys(vErrors).length > 0}
          >
            ذخیره ({fmt.count(editingId ? 1 : selectedIds.size)})
          </Btn>
          <Btn onClick={onClose}>لغو</Btn>
        </BtnRow>
      }
    >
      <SectionTitle>
        <span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📅</span>
        {' '}زمان‌بندی
      </SectionTitle>

      {firstSelectedBirdName && profile.totalDays ? (
        <div style={{
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', padding: '6px 10px',
          background: 'var(--accent-soft)',
          border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
          color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700,
          display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between',
        }}>
          <span>🐣 {firstSelectedBirdName}</span>
          <span>مدت {fmt.day(profile.totalDays)} روز • قفل {fmt.day(profile.lockdownDay)}</span>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <Grid2>
        <Field label="روز انکوباسیون" required hint="۷، ۱۰، ۱۵...">
          <NumField
            value={modalDay}
            onChange={e => setModalDay(e.target.value)}
            unit="روز" min={1} max={30}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label="تاریخ" required>
          <DatePicker
            value={modalDate}
            onChange={v => setModalDate(v)}
            placeholder="انتخاب"
            autoToday
          />
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      <SectionTitle>
        <span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📦</span>
        {' '}انتخاب ورودی‌ها
      </SectionTitle>

      <Field label="فیلتر دستگاه">
        <SmartSelect
          value={modalDevice}
          placeholder="— همه دستگاه‌ها —"
          modalTitle="انتخاب دستگاه"
          options={devices.map((d) => ({ value: String(d.id), label: String(d.name) }))}
          onChange={(val: string) => {
            setModalDevice(val);
            setSelectedIds(new Set());
            setEntriesData(() => ({}));
          }}
        />
      </Field>

      {availableEntries.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)',
          padding: 10, textAlign: 'center',
          background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
        }}>
          ورودی‌ای برای این دستگاه نیست
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
          {availableEntries.map(e => {
            const bird = birdsById[e.birdId];
            const isSelected = selectedIds.has(e.id);
            const d = dataFor(e.id);
            const sum = (parseInt(d.infertile) || 0) + (parseInt(d.dead) || 0) + (parseInt(d.broken) || 0);
            const dayNum = parseInt(modalDay) || 0;

            // محاسبه‌ی مبنا از داخل — بدون import مجدد
            const myCandlings = candlings
              .filter((c) => c.eggEntryId === e.id)
              .sort((a, b) => a.stage - b.stage);
            const prevs = myCandlings.filter(c => c.stage < dayNum);
            const baseInfo: AvailableBase = prevs.length === 0
              ? { base: e.count || 0, source: 'کل ورودی' }
              : { base: prevs[prevs.length - 1].alive || 0, source: 'مرحله ' + prevs[prevs.length - 1].stage };

            const existingCandlings = candlings.filter(c => c.eggEntryId === e.id);
            const alreadyAgg = existingCandlings.reduce(
              (acc, c) => ({
                alive: acc.alive + (c.alive || 0),
                infertile: acc.infertile + (c.infertile || 0),
                dead: acc.dead + (c.dead || 0),
                broken: acc.broken + (c.broken || 0),
              }),
              { alive: 0, infertile: 0, dead: 0, broken: 0 }
            );

            return (
              <CandlingEntryRow
                key={e.id}
                entryId={e.id}
                birdName={bird?.name}
                count={e.count || 0}
                entryDate={e.entryDate}
                isSelected={isSelected}
                data={d}
                baseInfo={baseInfo}
                alreadyAgg={alreadyAgg}
                onToggle={() => toggleEntry(e.id)}
                onUpdate={(patch) => updateEntryData(e.id, patch)}
              />
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      <ErrorBox>{err}</ErrorBox>
    </Modal>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/inc/components/CapacityEditor.tsx

/**
 * CapacityEditor.tsx — ویرایش ظرفیت و مشخصات هر پرنده در دستگاه
 *
 * بخش «ظرفیت بر اساس پرنده» در فرم DevicesPage.
 */
import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { toFa, toEn } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { Field, Grid2, NumField } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { normalizeBird } from '../helpers';
import { fillCapacityFromProfile, type DeviceCapacity } from '../store';
import OvNumField from './OvNumField';
import { toastMsg } from '../../../cor/store/toast';

export interface CapacityEditorProps {
  birds: { id: string; name: string }[];
  capacityByBird: DeviceCapacity[];
  onChange: (next: DeviceCapacity[]) => void;
}

export default function CapacityEditor(props: CapacityEditorProps) {
  const { birds, capacityByBird, onChange } = props;
  const [expandedBird, setExpandedBird] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [undoData, setUndoData] = useState<{ birdName: string; data: any } | null>(null);

  const addCapacity = (birdName: string) => {
    if (!birdName.trim()) return;
    if (capacityByBird.some(c => normalizeBird(c.birdName) === normalizeBird(birdName))) return;
    const defaults = fillCapacityFromProfile(birdName);
    const newCap: any = { birdName, capacity: null, ...(defaults || {}) };
    onChange([...capacityByBird, newCap]);
    toastMsg.added(birdName);
  };

  const removeCapacity = (birdName: string) => {
    const removed = capacityByBird.find(c => normalizeBird(c.birdName) === normalizeBird(birdName));
    if (!removed) return;
    onChange(capacityByBird.filter(c => normalizeBird(c.birdName) !== normalizeBird(birdName)));
    setUndoData({ birdName, data: removed });
    setTimeout(() => setUndoData(cur => cur && cur.birdName === birdName ? null : cur), 5000);
  };

  const undoRemove = () => {
    if (!undoData) return;
    onChange([...capacityByBird, undoData.data]);
    setUndoData(null);
  };

  const updateCapacity = (birdName: string, capacity: number | null) => {
    onChange(capacityByBird.map(c =>
      normalizeBird(c.birdName) === normalizeBird(birdName) ? { ...c, capacity } : c
    ));
  };

  const updateCapacityFull = (birdName: string, patch: Partial<DeviceCapacity>) => {
    onChange(capacityByBird.map(c =>
      normalizeBird(c.birdName) === normalizeBird(birdName) ? { ...c, ...patch } : c
    ));
  };

  const fillProfile = (birdName: string) => {
    const p = fillCapacityFromProfile(birdName);
    if (!p) return;
    updateCapacityFull(birdName, p);
  };

  const resetSection = (birdName: string, section: 'setter' | 'hatcher' | 'time') => {
    const prof: any = fillCapacityFromProfile(birdName);
    if (!prof) return;
    if (section === 'setter') {
      updateCapacityFull(birdName, { setterTemp: prof.setterTemp, setterHumidity: prof.setterHumidity });
    } else if (section === 'hatcher') {
      updateCapacityFull(birdName, { hatcherTemp: prof.hatcherTemp, hatcherHumidity: prof.hatcherHumidity });
    } else {
      updateCapacityFull(birdName, { totalDays: prof.totalDays, lockdownDay: prof.lockdownDay });
    }
  };

  const fmt = (v: any) => (v != null && v !== '') ? getGlobalFormat().code(String(v)) : '—';
  const resetBtnStyle = {
    background: 'none', border: 'none', color: 'var(--warn)',
    cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontFamily: 'inherit',
    fontWeight: 600, padding: 0,
  } as any;

  if (birds.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', padding: 10, textAlign: 'center', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)' }}>
        هنوز پرنده‌ای در ماژول «پرنده و نژاد» ثبت نشده
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      {/* انتخاب پرنده‌ها */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 6 }}>
        {birds.map(b => {
          const isSelected = capacityByBird.some(c => normalizeBird(c.birdName) === normalizeBird(b.name));
          return (
            <button
              key={b.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => isSelected ? removeCapacity(b.name) : addCapacity(b.name)}
              aria-pressed={isSelected}
              style={{
                padding: '6px 12px',
                background: isSelected ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--btn-bg)',
                border: isSelected ? '1.5px solid var(--accent)' : '1px solid var(--border)',
                borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                color: isSelected ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                fontFamily: 'inherit',
                fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                fontWeight: isSelected ? 700 : 600,
                boxShadow: isSelected ? '0 0 0 2px var(--accent-soft)' : 'none',
                transition: 'all .15s',
              }}
            >+ {b.name}</button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Undo bar */}
      {undoData && (
        <div style={{
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
          padding: '8px 12px', background: 'var(--input-bg)',
          border: '1px solid var(--warn)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
          marginTop: 6, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
        }}>
          <span>«{undoData.birdName}» حذف شد</span>
          <button type="button" onClick={undoRemove} style={{
            background: 'none', border: 'none',
            color: 'var(--warn)', fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer',
            fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: '2px 8px',
          }}>بازگردانی</button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* بخش ویرایش هر پرنده */}
      {capacityByBird.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--sp-1)' as any, marginTop: 6 }}>
          {capacityByBird.map(c => {
            const prof: any = fillCapacityFromProfile(c.birdName);
            const d: any = prof || {};
            const setterOv = (d.setterTemp != null && c.setterTemp != null && Number(c.setterTemp) !== Number(d.setterTemp))
                          || (d.setterHumidity != null && c.setterHumidity != null && Number(c.setterHumidity) !== Number(d.setterHumidity));
            const hatcherOv = (d.hatcherTemp != null && c.hatcherTemp != null && Number(c.hatcherTemp) !== Number(d.hatcherTemp))
                           || (d.hatcherHumidity != null && c.hatcherHumidity != null && Number(c.hatcherHumidity) !== Number(d.hatcherHumidity));
            const timeOv = (d.totalDays != null && c.totalDays != null && Number(c.totalDays) !== Number(d.totalDays))
                        || (d.lockdownDay != null && c.lockdownDay != null && Number(c.lockdownDay) !== Number(d.lockdownDay));
            const isExpanded = expandedBird === c.birdName;
            return (
              <div key={c.birdName} style={{
                borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                background: isExpanded ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--input-bg)',
                transition: 'background .15s',
              }}>
                <div
                  onClick={() => setExpandedBird(isExpanded ? null : c.birdName)}
                  role="button" tabIndex={0}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); setExpandedBird(isExpanded ? null : c.birdName); } }}
                  aria-expanded={isExpanded}
                  style={{ padding: '10px 12px', cursor: 'pointer', userSelect: 'none' }}
                >
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', fontWeight: 700, flex: 1 }}>
                      {c.birdName}
                      {prof ? (
                        <span title="از پروفایل انکوباسیون" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--accent)', marginRight: 4 }}>🪄</span>
                      ) : null}
                    </span>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--muted)', transform: isExpanded ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'none', transition: 'transform .2s', flexShrink: 0 }}>▼</span>
                    <button type="button" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); removeCapacity(c.birdName); }} aria-label={`حذف ${c.birdName}`} style={{
                      background: 'var(--danger-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--danger)', color: 'var(--danger)',
                      cursor: 'pointer', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                      width: 26, height: 26, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                      fontSize: 12, padding: 0, fontFamily: 'inherit', fontWeight: 700, flexShrink: 0,
                    }}>✕</button>
                  </div>

                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--sp-3)' as any, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginTop: 6, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
                    <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                      <span style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>🌡 ستر</span>
                      <span style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{fmt(c.setterTemp)}°</span>
                      <span style={{ color: 'var(--dim)', fontWeight: 600 }}>{fmt(c.setterHumidity)}٪</span>
                    </span>
                    <span style={{ color: 'var(--dim)', fontSize: 14 }}>→</span>
                    <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                      <span style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>🐣 هچر</span>
                      <span style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{fmt(c.hatcherTemp)}°</span>
                      <span style={{ color: 'var(--dim)', fontWeight: 600 }}>{fmt(c.hatcherHumidity)}٪</span>
                    </span>
                    <span style={{ color: 'var(--dim)', fontSize: 14 }}>·</span>
                    <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                      <span style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>⏱</span>
                      <span style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{fmt(c.totalDays)}/{fmt(c.lockdownDay)}</span>
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {isExpanded && (
                  <div style={{ padding: 'var(--sp-3)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--sp-2)' as any, background: 'var(--card)' }}>
                    <Field label="ظرفیت" hint="حداکثر تعداد تخم">
                      <NumField value={String(c.capacity || '')} onChange={e => updateCapacity(c.birdName, parseInt(toEn(e.target.value)) || null)} unit="تخم" min={0} placeholder="۰" />
                    </Field>

                    <button type="button" onClick={() => fillProfile(c.birdName)} style={{
                      padding: '6px 10px',
                      background: 'var(--accent-soft)',
                      border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)',
                      color: 'var(--accent)',
                      borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                      cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit',
                      fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 600,
                    }}>🔄 پر کردن از پروفایل</button>

                    <SectionHeader label="🌡 ستر" showReset={setterOv && !!prof} onReset={() => resetSection(c.birdName, 'setter')} />
                    <Grid2>
                      <OvNumField label="دما" hint="°C" isTemp={true} defValue={d.setterTemp}
                        value={c.setterTemp} onChange={(e: any) => updateCapacityFull(c.birdName, { setterTemp: parseFloat(toEn(e.target.value)) || 0 })}
                        unit="°C" min={20} max={45} placeholder="۳۷٫۷" />
                      <OvNumField label="رطوبت" hint="٪" defValue={d.setterHumidity}
                        value={c.setterHumidity} onChange={(e: any) => updateCapacityFull(c.birdName, { setterHumidity: parseFloat(toEn(e.target.value)) || 0 })}
                        unit="٪" min={0} max={100} placeholder="۵۰" />
                    </Grid2>

                    <SectionHeader label="🐣 هچر" showReset={hatcherOv && !!prof} onReset={() => resetSection(c.birdName, 'hatcher')} />
                    <Grid2>
                      <OvNumField label="دما" hint="°C" isTemp={true} defValue={d.hatcherTemp}
                        value={c.hatcherTemp} onChange={(e: any) => updateCapacityFull(c.birdName, { hatcherTemp: parseFloat(toEn(e.target.value)) || 0 })}
                        unit="°C" min={20} max={45} placeholder="۳۷٫۲" />
                      <OvNumField label="رطوبت" hint="٪" defValue={d.hatcherHumidity}
                        value={c.hatcherHumidity} onChange={(e: any) => updateCapacityFull(c.birdName, { hatcherHumidity: parseFloat(toEn(e.target.value)) || 0 })}
                        unit="٪" min={0} max={100} placeholder="۶۲" />
                    </Grid2>

                    <SectionHeader label="⏱ زمان" showReset={timeOv && !!prof} onReset={() => resetSection(c.birdName, 'time')} />
                    <Grid2>
                      <OvNumField label="مدت کل" hint="از ورود تا هچ" defValue={d.totalDays}
                        value={c.totalDays} onChange={(e: any) => updateCapacityFull(c.birdName, { totalDays: parseInt(toEn(e.target.value)) || 0 })}
                        unit="روز" min={0} max={60} placeholder="۲۱" />
                      <OvNumField label="روز قفل" hint="Lockdown" defValue={d.lockdownDay}
                        value={c.lockdownDay} onChange={(e: any) => updateCapacityFull(c.birdName, { lockdownDay: parseInt(toEn(e.target.value)) || 0 })}
                        unit="روز" min={0} max={60} placeholder="۱۸" />
                    </Grid2>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

function SectionHeader({ label, showReset, onReset }: { label: string; showReset: boolean; onReset: () => void }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', paddingTop: 4, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)' }}>
      <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>{label}</span>
      {showReset ? (
        <button type="button" onClick={onReset} style={{
          background: 'none', border: 'none', color: 'var(--warn)',
          cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontFamily: 'inherit',
          fontWeight: 600, padding: 0,
        }}>↩️ پیش‌فرض</button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { Btn, Select, Tag } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import ExpandableCard, { StatBox, Dot } from '../../../shr/components/ExpandableCard';
import { LineChart } from '../../../shr/components/Charts';
import type { Device, DeviceStatus } from '../store';
import { STATUS_FA, MODE_FA } from '../types-devices';
import { Row } from '../helpers';
import { warrantyInfo } from '../api/warranty';
import { CardActions } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { ACTION_PRESETS } from '../../../shr/constants/cardActions';

interface Props {
  d: Device;
  index: number;
  stats: { totalEggs: number; activeCount: number };
  isOpen: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
  ms: any;
  chartMetric: 'temp' | 'humidity' | 'est' | 'co2' | 'o2';
  setChartMetric: (m: 'temp' | 'humidity' | 'est' | 'co2' | 'o2') => void;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
  onRecordReading: () => void;
  onRemoveMaintenance: (logId: string) => void;
  onAddMaintenance: () => void;
}

const accentFor = (s: DeviceStatus): any => s === 'active' ? 'accent' : s === 'idle' ? 'dim' : 'warn';

export default function DeviceCard({
  d, index, stats, isOpen, onToggle, ms, chartMetric, setChartMetric,
  onEdit, onDelete, onRecordReading, onRemoveMaintenance, onAddMaintenance,
}: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const totalEggs = stats.totalEggs;
  const activeEntries = stats.activeCount;
  const caps = d.capacityByBird || [];
  const logs: any[] = (d as any).maintenanceLogs || [];
  const totalCap = caps.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.capacity || 0), 0);
  const usagePercent = totalCap > 0 ? Math.round((totalEggs / totalCap) * 100) : 0;
  const w = warrantyInfo(d.purchasedAt, d.warranty);

  return (
    <ExpandableCard key={d.id} id={d.id} ms={ms} accent={accentFor(d.status)} index={fmt.count(index + 1)} iconEmoji="🥚"
                title={d.name} subtitle={MODE_FA[d.mode] + ' • ' + STATUS_FA[d.status]}
                isOpen={isOpen} onToggle={onToggle}
                badge={activeEntries > 0 ? <Tag tone="green">{fmt.count(activeEntries)} ورودی فعال</Tag> : undefined}
                stats={<>
                  <StatBox icon="📊" label="استفاده" value={fmt.count(totalEggs) + '/' + fmt.count(totalCap)} tone={usagePercent > 90 ? 'warn' : 'accent'} />
                  <Dot />
                  <StatBox icon="🔄" label="ورودی" value={fmt.count(activeEntries)} />
                  <Dot />
                  <StatBox icon="🛠" label="تعمیر" value={fmt.count(logs.length)} />
                </>}
              >
                {caps.length > 0 && (
                  <>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📊</span> ظرفیت</div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 6 }}>
                      {caps.map(c => (
                        <div key={c.birdName} style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-tight)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
                          <span>{c.birdName}</span>
                          <span style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{c.capacity ? fmt.count(c.capacity) : '—'}</span>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </>
                )}

                {(d.purchasedAt || d.price || d.warranty) && (
                  <>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>💰</span> مالی</div>
                    {d.price && <Row l="قیمت" v={fmt.money(d.price)} />}
                    {d.purchasedAt && <Row l="تاریخ خرید" v={fmt.date(d.purchasedAt)} />}
                    {d.warranty && <Row l="گارانتی" v={fmt.int(d.warranty) + ' ماه'} />}
                    {w && w.expired && (
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--danger)', fontWeight: 700, padding: '4px 8px', background: 'var(--danger-soft)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                        ⏰ اتمام گارانتی شده ({fmt.date(w.end)})
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </>
                )}

                {(d.temp != null || d.humidity != null || d.estCurrent != null || d.co2Current != null || d.o2Current != null) && (
                <>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>🌡 پایش زنده</div>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
                    {d.temp != null && <Row l="دما محیط" v={fmt.num(d.temp) + '°C'} />}
                    {d.humidity != null && <Row l="رطوبت" v={fmt.num(d.humidity) + '٪'} />}
                    {d.estCurrent != null && <Row l="EST (پوسته تخم)" v={fmt.num(d.estCurrent) + '°C'} />}
                    {d.co2Current != null && <Row l="CO₂" v={fmt.num(d.co2Current) + '٪'} />}
                    {d.o2Current != null && <Row l="O₂" v={fmt.num(d.o2Current) + '٪'} />}
                    {d.turningCurrent && <Row l="چرخش" v={d.turningCurrent === 'on' ? '🔄 روشن' : d.turningCurrent === 'off' ? '⏸ قطع' : '🤖 خودکار'} />}
                  </div>
                  <Btn size="sm" full onClick={onRecordReading}>📊 ثبت قرائت</Btn>

                  {(d.readings || []).length > 0 && (
                    <>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px', marginTop: 4 }}>
                        📈 روند ({(d.readings || []).length} قرائت)
                      </div>
                      <Select value={chartMetric} onChange={(e: any) => setChartMetric(e.target.value as 'temp' | 'humidity' | 'est' | 'co2' | 'o2')}>
                        <option value="temp">دما محیط (°C)</option>
                        <option value="humidity">رطوبت (٪)</option>
                        <option value="est">EST (°C)</option>
                        <option value="co2">CO₂ (٪)</option>
                        <option value="o2">O₂ (٪)</option>
                      </Select>
                      <LineChart
                        data={(d.readings || []).slice(-30).map((r: { date: string; temp?: number | null; humidity?: number | null; est?: number | null; co2?: number | null; o2?: number | null }) => ({
                          label: r.date.slice(5),
                          value: r[chartMetric] ?? 0,
                        }))}
                        color="var(--accent)"
                        height={140}
                      />
                    </>
                  )}
                </>
              )}

              <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>🛠 تعمیرات</div>
                {logs.length === 0 ? (
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', padding: 8, textAlign: 'center' }}>تعمیری ثبت نشده</div>
                ) : (
                  <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr', gap: 4 }}>
                    {logs.slice().reverse().slice(0, 6).map((m: any) => (
                      <div key={m.id} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--sp-1)' as any, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: '8px 24px 8px 8px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', position: 'relative' }}>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => onRemoveMaintenance(m.id)}
                          title="حذف"
                          aria-label="حذف"
                          style={{
                            position: 'absolute',
                            top: 3,
                            left: 3,
                            background: 'var(--danger-soft)',
                            border: '1px solid var(--danger)',
                            color: 'var(--danger)',
                            cursor: 'pointer',
                            borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                            fontSize: 12,
                            lineHeight: 1,
                            padding: '2px 5px',
                            fontWeight: 700,
                            minWidth: 18,
                            height: 36,
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            justifyContent: 'center',
                            fontFamily: 'inherit',
                          }}
                        >✕</button>
                        <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{m.type}</span>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{fmt.date(m.date)}</span>
                        {m.cost ? <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 600 }}>{fmt.money(m.cost)}</span> : null}
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
                <Btn size="sm" full onClick={onAddMaintenance}>+ ثبت تعمیر</Btn>

                {d.notes && (
                  <>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📝</span> یادداشت</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', lineHeight: 1.7, padding: 8, background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>{d.notes}</div>
                  </>
                )}

                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--sp-2)' as any, paddingTop: 4 }}>
                  <CardActions actions={[
                    { ...ACTION_PRESETS.EDIT, onClick: onEdit },
                    { ...ACTION_PRESETS.DELETE, onClick: onDelete }
                  ]} />
                </div>
              </ExpandableCard>
  );
}

  form: F;
  setForm: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<F>>;

  birds: any[];

  save: () => void;
}

  const fmt = useFormat();

  return (
