        <SectionTitle><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📋</span> مشخصات اصلی</SectionTitle>
        <Field label="نام دستگاه" required hint={
          form.name && devices.some(x => x.id !== form.id && x.name.trim() === form.name.trim())
            ? 'این نام قبلاً استفاده شده'
            : undefined
        }>
          <Input
            placeholder="مثلاً — دستگاه ۱"
            value={form.name}
            onChange={e => setForm({...form, name: e.target.value})}
            error={form.name && devices.some(x => x.id !== form.id && x.name.trim() === form.name.trim()) ? ' ' : undefined}
          />
        </Field>
        <Grid2>
          <Field label="حالت" required>
            <Select value={form.mode} onChange={e => setForm({...form, mode: e.target.value as DeviceMode})}>
              <option value="setter">ستر</option>
              <option value="hatcher">هچر</option>
              <option value="setter+hatcher">ستر + هچر</option>
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="وضعیت" required>
            <Select value={form.status} onChange={e => setForm({...form, status: e.target.value as DeviceStatus})}>
              <option value="active">✅ فعال</option>
              <option value="idle">غیرفعال</option>
              <option value="maintenance"><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>🔧</span> تعمیر</option>
              <option value="broken">❌ خراب</option>
            </Select>
          </Field>
        </Grid2>

        <SectionTitle><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📊</span> ظرفیت بر اساس پرنده</SectionTitle>
        <CapacityEditor
          birds={birds}
          capacityByBird={form.capacityByBird}
          onChange={(next: any) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, capacityByBird: next }))}
        />

        <SectionTitle>⚙ مشخصات فنی</SectionTitle>
        <Grid2>
          <Field label="تعداد راگ" hint="قفسه">
            <NumField placeholder="۰" value={form.racks} onChange={e => setForm({...form, racks: e.target.value})} unit="عدد" min={0} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="تعداد سبد" hint="Tray">
            <NumField placeholder="۰" value={form.trays} onChange={e => setForm({...form, trays: e.target.value})} unit="عدد" min={0} />
          </Field>
        </Grid2>
        <Grid2>
          <Field label="تعداد فن">
            <NumField placeholder="۰" value={form.fans} onChange={e => setForm({...form, fans: e.target.value})} unit="عدد" min={0} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="توان موتور">
            <NumField placeholder="۰" value={form.motorPower} onChange={e => setForm({...form, motorPower: e.target.value})} unit="W" min={0} />
          </Field>
        </Grid2>
        <Grid2>
          <Field label="سنسور دما">
            <NumField placeholder="۰" value={form.tempSensors} onChange={e => setForm({...form, tempSensors: e.target.value})} unit="عدد" min={0} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="سنسور رطوبت">
            <NumField placeholder="۰" value={form.humiditySensors} onChange={e => setForm({...form, humiditySensors: e.target.value})} unit="عدد" min={0} />
          </Field>
        </Grid2>

        <SectionTitle>🌡 پایش زنده</SectionTitle>
        <Grid2>
          <Field label="EST فعلی" hint="دمای پوسته تخم">
            <NumField placeholder="۳۷.۸" value={form.estCurrent} onChange={e => setForm({...form, estCurrent: e.target.value})} unit="°C" min={30} max={45} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="CO₂ فعلی">
            <NumField placeholder="۰.۴" value={form.co2Current} onChange={e => setForm({...form, co2Current: e.target.value})} unit="٪" min={0} max={5} />
          </Field>
        </Grid2>
        <Grid2>
          <Field label="O₂ فعلی">
            <NumField placeholder="۲۰.۹" value={form.o2Current} onChange={e => setForm({...form, o2Current: e.target.value})} unit="٪" min={15} max={25} />
          </Field>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Field label="دما محیط">
              <NumField placeholder="۳۷.۵" value={form.temp} onChange={e => setForm({...form, temp: e.target.value})} unit="°C" min={30} max={45} />
            </Field>
            <FieldHint fieldPath="inc.temperature" value={form.temp} />
          </div>
        </Grid2>
        <Grid2>
          <Field label="وضعیت چرخش">
            <Select value={form.turningCurrent} onChange={e => setForm({...form, turningCurrent: e.target.value})}>
              <option value="auto">🤖 خودکار</option>
              <option value="on">🔄 روشن</option>
              <option value="off">⏸ قطع</option>
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="رطوبت فعلی">
            <NumField placeholder="۵۵" value={form.humidity} onChange={e => setForm({...form, humidity: e.target.value})} unit="٪" min={30} max={90} />
          </Field>
        </Grid2>

        <SectionTitle><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>💰</span> مالی</SectionTitle>
        <Grid2>
          <Field label="قیمت خرید">
            <MoneyField placeholder="۰" value={form.price} onChange={e => setForm({...form, price: e.target.value})} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="تاریخ خرید">
            <DatePicker value={form.purchasedAt} onChange={v => setForm({...form, purchasedAt: v})}  autoToday />
          </Field>
        </Grid2>
        <Grid2>
          <Field label="گارانتی (ماه)">
            <NumField placeholder="۲۴" value={form.warranty} onChange={e => setForm({...form, warranty: e.target.value})} unit="ماه" min={0} max={120} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="هزینه جانبی" hint="نصب، حمل">
            <MoneyField placeholder="۰" value={form.extraCost} onChange={e => setForm({...form, extraCost: e.target.value})} />
          </Field>
        </Grid2>
        {warrantyForm && (
          <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: warrantyForm.expired ? 'var(--danger-soft)' : 'var(--accent-soft)', border: '1px solid ' + (warrantyForm.expired ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--accent-border)'), borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: warrantyForm.expired ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700, textAlign: 'center' }}>
            {warrantyForm.expired ? '⏰ اتمام گارانتی شده — ' : '✅ گارانتی تا — '}{fmt.date(warrantyForm.end)}
          </div>
        )}

        <SectionTitle><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📝</span> یادداشت</SectionTitle>
        <Input placeholder="..." value={form.notes} onChange={e => setForm({...form, notes: e.target.value})} />

        <ErrorBox>{err}</ErrorBox>
      </Modal>
  );
}

/**
 * EggEntryCard.tsx — کارت نمایش یک ورودی تخم
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { Btn, Tag } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import ExpandableCard, { StatBox, Dot } from '../../../shr/components/ExpandableCard';
import { Row } from '../helpers';
import EntityLink from '../../../shr/components/EntityLink';
import ProgressTracker from '../../../shr/components/ProgressTracker';
import { DEAL_LABEL, ENTRY_STATUS_LABEL, isLockdown, isHatchWindow } from '../store';
import { calcWeightLossPct, getExpectedTempHumidity } from '../api/hatchCalc';
import { needEggStorageDays } from '../api/needs';
import type { EggEntry } from '../store';
import type { Bird } from '../../brd/store';
import type { Flock } from '../../flk/store';
import type { Person } from '../../ctc/store';
import { CardActions } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { ACTION_PRESETS } from '../../../shr/constants/cardActions';

export interface EggEntryCardProps {
  entry: EggEntry;
  index: number;
  device: any;
  bird?: Bird;
  breed: any;
  flocks: Flock[];
  contacts: Person[];
  hatches: any[];
  age: number;
  expectedHatch: string;
  remain: number;
  totalDays: number;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
  standard?: Parameters<typeof getExpectedTempHumidity>[0];
}

export default function EggEntryCard(props: EggEntryCardProps) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const {
    entry: e, index: i, device: dev, bird, breed,
    flocks, contacts, hatches, age, expectedHatch, remain, totalDays,
    isOpen, onToggle, onEdit, onDelete, standard,
  } = props;

  const locked = isLockdown({ ...e, expectedHatchDate: expectedHatch });
  const hatchWindow = isHatchWindow({ ...e, expectedHatchDate: expectedHatch });
  const myHatch = hatches.find(h => h.eggEntryId === e.id);

  let accent: any = 'accent';
  if (hatchWindow) accent = 'purple';
  else if (locked) accent = 'warn';

  let statusLabel = '';
  let statusTone: any = 'muted';
  if (myHatch) { statusLabel = '✅ هچ‌شده'; statusTone = 'green'; }
  else if (hatchWindow) { statusLabel = '🐣 پنجره هچ'; statusTone = 'purple'; }
  else if (locked) { statusLabel = '🔒 Lock-down'; statusTone = 'amber'; }
  else if (remain > 0) { statusLabel = fmt.day(remain) + ' روز مانده'; statusTone = 'accent'; }
  else if (remain === 0) { statusLabel = '🎯 امروز هچ'; statusTone = 'purple'; }
  else { statusLabel = '⚠️ گذشته از موعد هچ'; statusTone = 'amber'; }

  const partnerName = (e.dealData?.partnerId && (contacts.find((c) => c.id === e.dealData.partnerId) as any)?.name) || e.dealData?.partnerName || '';
  const sellerName = (e.dealData?.sellerId && (contacts.find((c) => c.id === e.dealData.sellerId) as any)?.name) || e.dealData?.sellerName || '';
  const consigneeName = (e.dealData?.consigneeId && (contacts.find((c) => c.id === e.dealData.consigneeId) as any)?.name) || e.dealData?.consigneeName || '';
  const lessorName = (e.dealData?.lessorId && (contacts.find((c) => c.id === e.dealData.lessorId) as any)?.name) || '';

  return (
    <ExpandableCard
      accent={accent}
      index={fmt.count(i + 1)}
      iconEmoji="🥚"
      title={fmt.count(e.count || 0) + ' تخم • ' + (bird?.name || '—') + (breed ? ' (' + breed.name + ')' : '')}
      subtitle={dev?.name || '—'}
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onToggle={onToggle}
      badge={<Tag tone={statusTone}>{statusLabel}</Tag>}
      stats={<>
        <StatBox icon="⏳" label="مانده" value={fmt.day(remain) + ' روز'} tone={remain <= 3 ? 'warn' : 'default'} />
        <Dot />
        <StatBox icon="📊" label="پیشرفت" value={fmt.int(Math.min(100, Math.round(age / Math.max(1, totalDays) * 100))) + '٪'} tone="accent" />
      </>}
    >
      {(() => {
        const lbl = hatchWindow ? 'پنجره هچ باز است' : locked ? 'در Lock-down' : ('روز ' + fmt.day(age) + ' از ' + fmt.day(totalDays));
        return <ProgressTracker current={age} target={totalDays} label={lbl} unit="روز" color={hatchWindow ? 'purple' : locked ? 'warn' : 'accent'} />;
      })()}

      <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>📋 مشخصات</div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
        <Row l="دستگاه" v={dev?.name || '—'} />
        <Row l="پرنده" v={(bird?.name || '—') + (breed ? ' • ' + breed.name : '')} />
        <Row l="تعداد" v={fmt.count(e.count || 0) + ' تخم'} />
        {e.sampleWeightInitial && e.sampleWeightCurrent && (() => {
          const pct = calcWeightLossPct(e.sampleWeightInitial, e.sampleWeightCurrent);
          if (pct === null) return null;
          const inRange = pct >= 11 && pct <= 13;
          return <Row l="کاهش وزن نمونه" v={(inRange ? '✅ ' : '⚠️ ') + fmt.num(pct) + '٪'} />;
        })()}
        <Row l="تاریخ ورود" v={fmt.date(e.entryDate)} />
        {e.sourceInvoiceId && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', padding: 'var(--pad-tight)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
            <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 600 }}>فاکتور خرید</span>
            <EntityLink type="invoice" id={e.sourceInvoiceId} label="مشاهده" />
          </div>
        )}
        {(() => {
          const st = needEggStorageDays(age);
          if (!st) return null;
          const icon = st.level === 'ok' ? '✅' : st.level === 'warn' ? '⚠️' : '🔴';
          return <Row l="ذخیره در انبار" v={`${icon} ${fmt.day(st.value)} روز`} />;
        })()}
        <Row l="هچ پیش‌بینی" v={fmt.date(expectedHatch)} />
        {(() => {
          const std = standard;
          const exp = std ? getExpectedTempHumidity(std, age) : null;
          if (!exp) return null;
          return <Row l={`🌡 هدف امروز (روز ${fmt.day(age)})`} v={`${fmt.num(exp.temp)}°C / ${fmt.num(exp.humidity)}٪`} />;
        })()}
        {e.trayNumbers && <Row l="طبقات" v={e.trayNumbers} />}
        <Row l="وضعیت" v={(ENTRY_STATUS_LABEL as any)[e.status]} />
      </div>

      <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>🤝 منبع</div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
        <Row l="نوع" v={(DEAL_LABEL as any)[e.dealType]} />
        {e.dealType === 'own' && (e as any).flockId && <Row l="گله" v={(flocks.find((f) => f.id === (e as any).flockId)?.name) || '—'} />}
        {e.dealType === 'purchase' && sellerName && <Row l="فروشنده" v={String(sellerName)} />}
        {e.dealType === 'partnership' && partnerName && <Row l="شریک" v={String(partnerName)} />}
        {e.dealType === 'partnership' && e.dealData.partnerPercent && <Row l="درصد شریک" v={fmt.num(e.dealData.partnerPercent) + '٪'} />}
        {e.dealType === 'rent' && lessorName && <Row l="اجاره‌دهنده" v={String(lessorName)} />}
        {e.dealType === 'rent' && e.dealData.rentAmount && <Row l="اجاره" v={fmt.money(Number(e.dealData.rentAmount))} />}
        {e.dealType === 'consignment' && consigneeName && <Row l="امانت‌دار" v={String(consigneeName)} />}
        {(e as any).dealStatus === 'withdrawn' && (
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--danger)', fontWeight: 700, padding: '4px 8px', background: 'var(--danger-soft)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>
            ⚠️ کنار کشیده {((e as any).dealWithdrawnAt ? ' (' + fmt.date((e as any).dealWithdrawnAt) + ')' : '')}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {(e.unitPrice || e.totalPrice || (e as any).shippingCost) && (
        <>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>💰 مالی</div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
            {e.unitPrice && <Row l="قیمت هر تخم" v={fmt.money(e.unitPrice)} />}
            {(e as any).shippingCost && <Row l="هزینه حمل" v={fmt.money((e as any).shippingCost)} />}
            {e.totalPrice && (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', color: 'var(--text)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                <span>جمع تخم:</span><span>{fmt.money(e.totalPrice)}</span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {e.notes && (
        <>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>📝 یادداشت</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', lineHeight: 1.7, padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>{e.notes}</div>
        </>
      )}

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, paddingTop: 4 }}>
        <CardActions actions={[
          { ...ACTION_PRESETS.EDIT, onClick: onEdit },
          { ...ACTION_PRESETS.DELETE, onClick: onDelete }
        ]} />
      </div>
    </ExpandableCard>
  );
}

import { AlertBox } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
/**
 * EggEntryModal.tsx — Modal ورود تخم به دستگاه
 *
 * شامل: بنر راهنما + انتخاب دستگاه + ظرفیت + لیست ردیف‌ها + فرم ردیف جدید
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { toFa, toEn } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { clampPercent, complement } from '../../../shr/utils/smart';
import {
  Btn, BtnRow, ErrorBox, Field, Grid2, Input, Modal, MoneyField,
  NumField, Select, Textarea,
} from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import DatePicker from '../../../shr/components/DatePicker';
import TimePicker from '../../../shr/components/TimePicker';
import SmartSelect from '../../../shr/components/SmartSelect';
import { DEAL_LABEL, type DealType, useInc } from '../store';
import type { DraftRow } from '../types-eggentries';
import { flockReadyForEggs } from '../api/eggEntriesCalc';
import { FieldHint } from '../../../shr/intelligence';
import type { Bird } from '../../brd/store';
import type { Flock } from '../../flk/store';
import type { Person } from '../../ctc/store';

export interface EggEntryModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  editingRowId: string | null;
  hideHatchTip: boolean;
  setHideHatchTip: (v: boolean) => void;
  multiDeviceId: string;
  setMultiDeviceId: (v: string) => void;
  err?: string;
  draftRows: DraftRow[];
  currentRow: DraftRow;
  setCurrentRow: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<DraftRow>>;
  // داده
  devices: { id: string; name: string }[];
  birds: Bird[];
  breeds: any[];
  flocks: Flock[];
  contacts: Person[];
  suppliers: Person[];
  allPersons: any[];
  breedsForBird: any[];
  liveUsage: { used: number; total: number; percent: number; remaining: number } | null;
  // actions
  setD: (k: string, v: string) => void;
  addRowToList: () => void;
  editRow: (row: DraftRow) => void;
  removeRow: (id: string) => void;
  saveAll: () => void;
  resetCurrentRow: () => void;
}

export default function EggEntryModal(props: EggEntryModalProps) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const err = props.err;
  const {
    open, onClose, editingRowId,
    hideHatchTip, setHideHatchTip,
    multiDeviceId, setMultiDeviceId,
    draftRows, currentRow, setCurrentRow,
    devices, birds, breeds, flocks, contacts, suppliers, allPersons,
    breedsForBird, liveUsage,
    setD, addRowToList, editRow, removeRow, saveAll, resetCurrentRow,
  } = props;

  // 🆕 چک: آیا این ردیف از فاکتور خرید اومده؟
  const sourceLinked = useInc((s) => {
    if (!editingRowId) return false;
    const entry = s.eggEntries.find((e: any) => e.id === editingRowId);
    return !!entry?.sourceInvoiceId;
  });

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={editingRowId ? '✏️ ویرایش ردیف' : '📥 ورود تخم به دستگاه'}
      footer={
        <BtnRow>
          <Btn onClick={saveAll} disabled={draftRows.length === 0}>💾 ذخیره همه ({fmt.count(draftRows.length)})</Btn>
          <Btn onClick={onClose}>لغو</Btn>
        </BtnRow>
      }
    >
      {err && <ErrorBox>{err}</ErrorBox>}
      {/* بنر راهنما */}
      {!hideHatchTip && (
        <div style={{ position: 'relative', padding: 'var(--pad-normal) 32px var(--pad-normal) var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--accent-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 600, lineHeight: 1.8 }}>
          <button type="button" aria-label="بستن راهنما" onClick={() => { setHideHatchTip(true); try { localStorage.setItem('pm-inc-hide-hatch-tip', '1'); } catch {} }} style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 4, left: 4, background: 'none', border: 'none', color: 'var(--muted)', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 14, padding: 4, lineHeight: 1, fontFamily: 'inherit' }}>✕</button>
          🎯 <b>هچ همزمان:</b> پرنده‌های دوره‌بلندتر رو اول وارد کن<br />
          <span style={{ opacity: 0.85 }}>ترتیب: غاز (۳۰) → بوقلمون (۲۸) → مرغ (۲۱)</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* دستگاه + ظرفیت */}
      <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-comfy)', background: 'var(--card)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>
          <span>📦</span><span>انتخاب دستگاه</span>
        </div>
        <SmartSelect value={multiDeviceId} onChange={v => setMultiDeviceId(v)} options={devices.map(c => ({ value: c.id, label: c.name }))} placeholder="— انتخاب —" modalTitle="انتخاب دستگاه" />
        {liveUsage && liveUsage.total > 0 && (
          <div style={{
            padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
            background: liveUsage.percent > 100 ? 'var(--danger-soft)' : liveUsage.percent > 90 ? 'var(--warn-soft)' : 'var(--accent-soft)',
            border: '1px solid ' + (liveUsage.percent > 100 ? 'var(--danger)' : liveUsage.percent > 90 ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--accent)'),
            borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
            color: liveUsage.percent > 100 ? 'var(--danger)' : liveUsage.percent > 90 ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--accent)',
            fontWeight: 700,
          }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
              <span>📊 استفاده کل</span>
              <span>{fmt.count(liveUsage.used)} / {fmt.count(liveUsage.total)} ({fmt.num(liveUsage.percent)}٪)</span>
            </div>
            {liveUsage.percent > 100 && <div style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>{fmt.count(Math.abs(liveUsage.remaining))} واحد اضافی</div>}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ردیف‌های اضافه‌شده */}
      {draftRows.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px', paddingTop: 4 }}>
            <span>📋</span><span>ردیف‌های ثبت‌شده ({fmt.count(draftRows.length)})</span>
          </div>
          {draftRows.map((r, i) => {
            const bird = birds.find(b => b.id === r.birdId);
            const sellerName = (r.dealData.sellerId && (contacts.find((c) => c.id === r.dealData.sellerId) as any)?.name) || '';
            const partnerName = (r.dealData.partnerId && (contacts.find((c) => c.id === r.dealData.partnerId) as any)?.name) || '';
            const flockName = r.flockId ? flocks.find((f) => f.id === r.flockId)?.name : '';
            const consigneeName = (r.dealData.consigneeId && (contacts.find((c) => c.id === r.dealData.consigneeId) as any)?.name) || '';
            const lessorName = (r.dealData.lessorId && (contacts.find((c) => c.id === r.dealData.lessorId) as any)?.name) || '';
            const party = sellerName || partnerName || flockName || consigneeName || lessorName || '—';
            const accentColor = r.dealType === 'own' ? 'accent' : r.dealType === 'purchase' ? 'info' : r.dealType === 'partnership' ? 'purple' : r.dealType === 'rent' ? 'warn' : 'dim';
            return (
              <div key={r._id} style={{
                position: 'relative',
                padding: '10px 34px 10px 12px',
                background: 'var(--card)',
                border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4,
              }}>
                <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, width: 4, background: 'var(--' + accentColor + ')' }} />
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                    {fmt.count(i + 1)}. {DEAL_LABEL[r.dealType]} • {bird?.name || '—'}
                  </span>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--' + accentColor + ')', direction: 'ltr' }}>
                    {fmt.count(Number(r.count) || 0)} تخم
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                  <span>{party}</span>
                  <span>{fmt.date(r.entryDate)}{r.entryTime ? ' • ' + fmt.code(r.entryTime) : ''}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 6, right: 6, display: 'flex', gap: 2 }}>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => editRow(r)} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: 'var(--text)', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', padding: 3 }}>✏️</button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => removeRow(r._id)}
                    title="حذف"
                    aria-label="حذف"
                    style={{
                      background: 'var(--danger-soft)',
                      border: '1px solid var(--danger)',
                      color: 'var(--danger)',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                      fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 1,
                      padding: 0, fontWeight: 700,
                      width: 40, height: 40,
                      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                      fontFamily: 'inherit',
                    }}
                  >✕</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* فرم ردیف جدید */}
      <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-comfy)', background: editingRowId ? 'var(--warn-soft)' : 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px dashed ' + (editingRowId ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--border)'), borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10, marginTop: 6 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: editingRowId ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
          <span>{editingRowId ? '✏️' : '➕'}</span>
          <span>{editingRowId ? 'ویرایش ردیف انتخاب‌شده' : 'ردیف جدید'}</span>
        </div>

        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px', paddingTop: 4 }}>🏠 منبع و طرف مقابل</div>

        <Field label="نوع منبع" required>
          <Select value={currentRow.dealType} onChange={e => setCurrentRow(f => ({ ...f, dealType: e.target.value as DealType, dealData: {}, flockId: '' }))}>
            <option value="own">🏠 گله خودم</option>
            <option value="partnership">🤝 شراکتی</option>
            <option value="purchase">📥 خریداری</option>
            <option value="rent">🏢 اجاره‌ای</option>
            <option value="consignment">📦 امانی</option>
          </Select>
        </Field>

        {currentRow.dealType === 'own' && (
          <Field label="انتخاب گله" required>
            {(() => {
              const activeFlocks = flocks.filter((fl) => fl.status === 'active' && !fl.paused);
              const readyFlocks = activeFlocks.filter((fl) => {
                const brd = birds.find(b => b.id === fl.birdId);
                const r = flockReadyForEggs(fl, brd);
                return r.ready;
              });
              if (activeFlocks.length === 0) return <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', padding: 10, textAlign: 'center' }}>گله فعالی نیست</div>;
              if (readyFlocks.length === 0) return <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--warn)', padding: 10, background: 'var(--warn-soft)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', textAlign: 'center' }}>⛔ هیچ گله آماده‌ای نیست</div>;
              return (
                <SmartSelect
                  value={currentRow.flockId}
                  placeholder="— انتخاب گله —"
                  modalTitle="انتخاب گله"
                  options={readyFlocks.map((fl) => {
                    const brd = birds.find((b) => b.id === fl.birdId);
                    const r = flockReadyForEggs(fl, brd);
                    return { value: String(fl.id), label: String(fl.name), subtitle: fmt.day(r.ageDays) + " روز" };
                  })}
                  onChange={(val: string) => {
                    const fl = flocks.find((x) => x.id === val);
                    setCurrentRow((f) => ({ ...f, flockId: val, birdId: fl?.birdId || f.birdId, breedId: fl?.breedId || f.breedId }));
                  }}
                />
              );
            })()}
          </Field>
        )}

        {currentRow.dealType === 'purchase' && (
          <Field label="فروشنده" required>
            {suppliers.length === 0 ? (
              <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', padding: 10, textAlign: 'center' }}>فروشنده‌ای نیست</div>
            ) : (
              <SmartSelect
                  value={currentRow.dealData.sellerId || ''}
                  placeholder="— انتخاب —"
                  modalTitle="انتخاب فروشنده"
                  options={suppliers.map((p) => ({ value: String(p.id), label: String(p.name) }))}
                  onChange={(val: string) => setD("sellerId", val)}
                />
            )}
          </Field>
        )}

        {currentRow.dealType === 'partnership' && (
          <Field label="شریک" required>
            <Select value={currentRow.dealData.partnerId || ''} onChange={e => setD('partnerId', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">— انتخاب —</option>
              {allPersons.map((p) => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name}</option>)}
            </Select>
          </Field>
        )}

        {currentRow.dealType === 'rent' && (
          <Field label="اجاره‌دهنده" required>
            <Select value={currentRow.dealData.lessorId || ''} onChange={e => setD('lessorId', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">— انتخاب —</option>
              {allPersons.map((p) => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name}</option>)}
            </Select>
          </Field>
        )}

        {currentRow.dealType === 'consignment' && (
          <Field label="امانت‌دار" required>
            <Select value={currentRow.dealData.consigneeId || ''} onChange={e => setD('consigneeId', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">— انتخاب —</option>
              {allPersons.map((p) => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name}</option>)}
            </Select>
          </Field>
        )}

        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px', paddingTop: 6, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)' }}>📅 زمان</div>
        <Grid2>
          <Field label="تاریخ ورود" required>
            <DatePicker value={currentRow.entryDate} onChange={v => setCurrentRow(f => ({ ...f, entryDate: v }))} placeholder="تاریخ" autoToday />
          </Field>
          <Field label="ساعت ورود">
            <TimePicker value={currentRow.entryTime} onChange={v => setCurrentRow(f => ({ ...f, entryTime: v }))} placeholder="انتخاب ساعت" />
          </Field>
        </Grid2>

        {currentRow.dealType === 'partnership' && (
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="درصد شریک" hint="٪">
              <NumField value={currentRow.dealData.partnerPercent || ''} onChange={e => { const v = clampPercent(parseInt(toEn(e.target.value)) || 0); setD('partnerPercent', v === null ? '' : String(v)); }} unit="٪" min={0} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="درصد من" hint="خودکار">
              <div style={{ height: 38, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'flex-end', padding: '0 12px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{fmt.int(complement(parseInt(toEn(currentRow.dealData.partnerPercent || '0')) || 0) ?? 100)}٪</div>
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
        )}

        {currentRow.dealType === 'consignment' && (
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="درصد امانت‌دار" hint="٪">
              <NumField value={currentRow.dealData.consigneePercent || ''} onChange={e => { const v = clampPercent(parseInt(toEn(e.target.value)) || 0); setD('consigneePercent', v === null ? '' : String(v)); }} unit="٪" min={0} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="درصد من" hint="خودکار">
              <div style={{ height: 38, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'flex-end', padding: '0 12px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{fmt.int(complement(parseInt(toEn(currentRow.dealData.consigneePercent || '0')) || 0) ?? 100)}٪</div>
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
        )}

        {currentRow.dealType === 'rent' && (
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="مبلغ اجاره"><MoneyField value={currentRow.dealData.rentAmount || ''} onChange={e => setD('rentAmount', e.target.value)} /></Field>
            <Field label="سرسید"><Input value={currentRow.dealData.rentDueDate || ''} onChange={e => setD('rentDueDate', e.target.value)} /></Field>
          </Grid2>
        )}

        {(currentRow.dealType === 'partnership' || currentRow.dealType === 'consignment') && (
          <div style={{ padding: 8, background: currentRow.dealStatus === 'withdrawn' ? 'var(--danger-soft)' : 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid ' + (currentRow.dealStatus === 'withdrawn' ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--border)'), borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
            <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
              <input type="checkbox" checked={currentRow.dealStatus === 'withdrawn'} onChange={e => setCurrentRow(f => ({ ...f, dealStatus: e.target.checked ? 'withdrawn' : 'active' }))} style={{ width: 18, height: 18, accentColor: 'var(--muted)' }} />
              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 600, color: currentRow.dealStatus === 'withdrawn' ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--text)' }}>کنار کشید</span>
            </label>
            {currentRow.dealStatus === 'withdrawn' && (
              <Grid2>
                <Field label="تاریخ"><DatePicker value={currentRow.dealWithdrawnAt} onChange={v => setCurrentRow(f => ({ ...f, dealWithdrawnAt: v }))} autoToday /></Field>
                <Field label="دلیل"><Input value={currentRow.dealWithdrawnReason} onChange={e => setCurrentRow(f => ({ ...f, dealWithdrawnReason: e.target.value }))} /></Field>
              </Grid2>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        <div style={{ borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)', paddingTop: 8, marginTop: 4 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px', marginBottom: 8 }}>🥚 مشخصات تخم</div>
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="پرنده" required>
              <SmartSelect value={currentRow.birdId} onChange={v => setCurrentRow(f => ({ ...f, birdId: v, breedId: '' }))} options={birds.map(c => ({ value: c.id, label: c.name }))} placeholder="—" modalTitle="انتخاب پرنده" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="نژاد">
              <Select value={currentRow.breedId} onChange={e => setCurrentRow(f => ({ ...f, breedId: e.target.value }))}>
                <option value="">—</option>
                {breedsForBird.map(b => {
                  const purposeMap: Record<string, string> = { layer: '🥚 تخم‌گذار', breeder: '🐣 مادر', broiler: '🍗 گوشتی', ornamental: '🌸 زینتی' };
                  const purposeLabels = (b.purposes || []).map((p: string) => purposeMap[p] || p);
                  const label = purposeLabels.length > 0 ? `${b.name} — ${purposeLabels.join('، ')}` : b.name;
                  return <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>{label}</option>;
                })}
              </Select>
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
          <Grid2>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0, minWidth: 0 }}>
  {sourceLinked && (
    <div style={{ padding: '6px 10px', background: 'var(--warn-soft)', border: '1px dashed var(--warn)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--warn)', fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: 6 }}>
      🔒 این ردیف از فاکتور خرید اومده — برای تغییر، فاکتور را ویرایش کنید
    </div>
  )}
  <Field label={sourceLinked ? <span>تعداد تخم <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--warn)' }}>🔒</span></span> : 'تعداد تخم'} required>
                <NumField value={currentRow.count} onChange={e => !sourceLinked && setCurrentRow(f => ({ ...f, count: e.target.value }))} unit="عدد" min={0} max={999999} disabled={sourceLinked} />
              </Field>
              <FieldHint
                fieldPath="inc.count"
                value={currentRow.count}
                context={liveUsage && liveUsage.total > 0 ? { capacity: liveUsage.total } : {}}
              />
            </div>
            <Field label="طبقات (Tray)">
              <Input placeholder="۱-۲-۳" dir="ltr" value={currentRow.trayNumbers} onChange={e => setCurrentRow(f => ({ ...f, trayNumbers: e.target.value }))} />
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="وزن نمونه اولیه" hint="گرم">
              <NumField placeholder="۶۵" value={currentRow.sampleWeightInitial} onChange={e => setCurrentRow(f => ({ ...f, sampleWeightInitial: e.target.value }))} unit="گرم" min={20} max={100} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="وزن نمونه فعلی" hint="گرم">
              <NumField placeholder="۵۷" value={currentRow.sampleWeightCurrent} onChange={e => setCurrentRow(f => ({ ...f, sampleWeightCurrent: e.target.value }))} unit="گرم" min={20} max={100} />
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
          {(() => {
            const init = parseFloat(toEn(currentRow.sampleWeightInitial).replace('٫', '.')) || 0;
            const cur = parseFloat(toEn(currentRow.sampleWeightCurrent).replace('٫', '.')) || 0;
            if (init <= 0 || cur <= 0) return null;
            const pct = Math.round(((init - cur) / init) * 1000) / 10;
            const inRange = pct >= 11 && pct <= 13;
            return (
              <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-tight)', background: inRange ? 'var(--input-bg)' : 'var(--warn-soft)', border: '1px solid ' + (inRange ? 'var(--border)' : 'var(--warn)'), borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 700, color: inRange ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--warn)' }}>
                {inRange ? '✅' : '⚠️'} کاهش وزن: {fmt.num(pct)}٪ (هدف استاندارد: ۱۱-۱۳٪)
              </div>
            );
          })()}
          {(() => {
            if (!currentRow.count.trim()) return null;
            const cnt = parseInt(toEn(currentRow.count)) || 0;
            if (cnt <= 0) {
              return <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-tight)', background: 'var(--danger-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--danger)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--danger)', fontWeight: 700 }}>❌ تعداد باید بیشتر از صفر باشد</div>;
            }
            if (!liveUsage) return null;
            if (liveUsage.percent > 100) {
              return <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-tight)', background: 'var(--danger-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--danger)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--danger)', fontWeight: 700 }}>🔴 بیشتر از ظرفیت — {fmt.count(Math.abs(liveUsage.remaining))} واحد اضافی</div>;
            }
            if (liveUsage.percent > 90) {
              return <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-tight)', background: 'var(--warn-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--warn)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--warn)', fontWeight: 700 }}>🟡 نزدیک به ظرفیت — باقی: {fmt.count(liveUsage.remaining)} ({fmt.num(liveUsage.percent)}٪)</div>;
            }
            return <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-tight)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700 }}>✅ قابل قبول — باقی: {fmt.count(liveUsage.remaining)} ({fmt.num(liveUsage.percent)}٪)</div>;
          })()}
        </div>

        {(currentRow.dealType === 'purchase' || currentRow.dealType === 'partnership') && (
          <div style={{ borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)', paddingTop: 8, marginTop: 4 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px', marginBottom: 8 }}>💰 مالی</div>
            <Grid2>
              <Field label="قیمت هر تخم">
                <MoneyField placeholder="مثلاً — ۲٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰" value={currentRow.unitPrice} onChange={e => setCurrentRow(f => ({ ...f, unitPrice: e.target.value }))} />
              </Field>
              <Field label="هزینه حمل">
                <MoneyField placeholder="مثلاً — ۵۰۰٬۰۰۰" value={currentRow.shippingCost} onChange={e => setCurrentRow(f => ({ ...f, shippingCost: e.target.value }))} />
              </Field>
            </Grid2>
            {(() => {
              const cnt = parseInt(toEn(currentRow.count)) || 0;
              const up = parseFloat(toEn(currentRow.unitPrice).replace('٫', '.')) || 0;
              const sh = parseFloat(toEn(currentRow.shippingCost).replace('٫', '.')) || 0;
              const total = (cnt * up) + sh;
              if (total > 0) {
                return <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: 'var(--pad-tight)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', color: 'var(--text)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontWeight: 700 }}><span>💰 جمع ردیف:</span><span>{fmt.money(total)}</span></div>;
              }
              return null;
            })()}
          </div>
        )}

        <Field label="یادداشت">
          <Textarea placeholder="..." value={currentRow.notes} onChange={e => setCurrentRow(f => ({ ...f, notes: e.target.value }))} />
        </Field>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
          <Btn full onClick={addRowToList}>
            {editingRowId ? '💾 به‌روزرسانی ردیف' : '➕ افزودن به لیست'}
          </Btn>
          {editingRowId && <Btn onClick={resetCurrentRow}>لغو</Btn>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

/**
 * FlockCreateModal.tsx — ساخت گله‌ی جدید از نتیجه‌ی هچ
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { Btn, BtnRow, Field, Grid2, Input, Modal, Select, ErrorBox } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';

export interface FlockForm {
  name: string;
  type: string;
  hallId: string;
  zoneId: string;
  // 🆕 editable overrides (پیش‌فرض از هچ/تخم)
  maleCount?: string;
  femaleCount?: string;
  unknownCount?: string;
  unitPrice?: string;
  shippingCost?: string;
  layingStartDay?: string;
}

/** 🆕 داده‌های منبع (هچ + تخم) */
export interface FlockSourceData {
  maleCount?: number | null;
  femaleCount?: number | null;
  unknownCount?: number | null;
  unitPrice?: number | null;
  shippingCost?: number | null;
  layingStartDay?: number | null;
  eggCount?: number | null;
}

export interface FlockCreateModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  count: number;
  form: FlockForm;
  setForm: (f: FlockForm) => void;
  halls: { id: string; name: string }[];
  zones: { id: string; name: string; hallId: string }[];
  /** 🆕 داده‌های منبع برای نمایش + محاسبه */
  sourceData?: FlockSourceData;
  onCreate: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  err?: string;
}

export default function FlockCreateModal(props: FlockCreateModalProps) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { open, count, form, setForm, halls, zones, sourceData, onCreate, onClose, err } = props;

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="🐔 ساخت گله جدید"
      footer={
        <BtnRow>
          <Btn variant="primary" onClick={onCreate}>ساخت گله</Btn>
          <Btn onClick={onClose}>لغو</Btn>
        </BtnRow>
      }
    >
      {err && <ErrorBox>{err}</ErrorBox>}
      <Field label="نام گله" required>
        <Input
          placeholder="مثلاً — گله بهار ۱۴۰۵"
          value={form.name}
          onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })}
        />
      </Field>
      <Grid2>
        <Field label="نوع" required>
          <Select value={form.type} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, type: e.target.value })}>
            <option value="layer">تخم‌گذار</option>
            <option value="broiler">گوشتی</option>
            <option value="breeder">مادر</option>
          </Select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="تعداد">
          <Input placeholder="مثلاً — ۱۰۰" value={String(count || 0)} readOnly dir="ltr" unit="پرنده" />
        </Field>
      </Grid2>
      <Grid2>
        <Field label="سالن">
          <Select
            value={form.hallId}
            onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, hallId: e.target.value, zoneId: '' })}
          >
            <option value="">—</option>
            {halls.map(h => <option key={h.id} value={h.id}>{h.name}</option>)}
          </Select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="بخش">
          <Select
            value={form.zoneId}
            onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, zoneId: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="">—</option>
            {zones.filter(z => !form.hallId || z.hallId === form.hallId)
              .map(z => <option key={z.id} value={z.id}>{z.name}</option>)}
          </Select>
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      {sourceData && (sourceData.maleCount || sourceData.femaleCount || sourceData.unknownCount) ? (
        <>
          <div style={{ padding: 8, background: 'var(--accent-soft)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 600, marginTop: 4, marginBottom: 6 }}>
            🔹 جنسیت از نتیجه هچ — در صورت نیاز اصلاح کنید
          </div>
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="نر">
              <Input type="text" inputMode="numeric" placeholder="۰" value={form.maleCount ?? ''} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, maleCount: e.target.value })} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="ماده">
              <Input type="text" inputMode="numeric" placeholder="۰" value={form.femaleCount ?? ''} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, femaleCount: e.target.value })} />
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
          <Field label="نامشخص" hint="پرنده‌هایی که جنسیتشان معلوم نیست">
            <Input type="text" inputMode="numeric" placeholder="۰" value={form.unknownCount ?? ''} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, unknownCount: e.target.value })} />
          </Field>
        </>
      ) : null}

      {sourceData && sourceData.unitPrice ? (
        <>
          <div style={{ padding: 8, background: 'var(--warn-soft)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--warn)', fontWeight: 600, marginTop: 4, marginBottom: 6 }}>
            💰 هزینه‌های تخم خریداری‌شده
          </div>
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="قیمت هر تخم (تومان)">
              <Input type="text" inputMode="numeric" dir="ltr" placeholder="۰" value={form.unitPrice ?? ''} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, unitPrice: e.target.value })} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="هزینه حمل (تومان)">
              <Input type="text" inputMode="numeric" dir="ltr" placeholder="۰" value={form.shippingCost ?? ''} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, shippingCost: e.target.value })} />
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
          {(() => {
            const eggCount = sourceData.eggCount || 0;
            const hatched = count || 0;
            const uPrice = parseFloat(form.unitPrice || '0') || 0;
            const shipCost = parseFloat(form.shippingCost || '0') || 0;
            const totalCost = uPrice * eggCount + shipCost;
            const perChick = hatched > 0 ? Math.round(totalCost / hatched) : 0;
            return (
              <div style={{ padding: 10, background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', lineHeight: 1.8 }}>
                <div>🧮 محاسبه: ({fmt.count(eggCount)} تخم × {fmt.money(uPrice)}) + {fmt.money(shipCost)} حمل</div>
                <div style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 4 }}>
                  ➜ میانگین قیمت هر جوجه: {fmt.money(perChick, { withUnit: false })} تومان
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })()}
        </>
      ) : null}

      {sourceData && sourceData.layingStartDay ? (
        <Field label="سن شروع تخم‌گذاری (روز)" hint="🔹 از استاندارد نژاد — قابل ویرایش">
          <Input type="text" inputMode="numeric" placeholder="۰" value={form.layingStartDay ?? ''} onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, layingStartDay: e.target.value })} />
        </Field>
      ) : null}
    </Modal>
  );
}

/**
 * HatchCard.tsx — کارت نتیجه‌ی یک هچ

import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { Btn, Tag } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import ExpandableCard, { StatBox, Dot } from '../../../shr/components/ExpandableCard';
import { Row } from '../helpers';
import { costPerChick, type HatchResult } from '../store';
import { calcChickYield } from '../api/needs';
import type { Bird } from '../../brd/store';
import type { EggEntry } from '../store';
import { CardActions } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { ACTION_PRESETS } from '../../../shr/constants/cardActions';

export interface HatchCardProps {
  hatch: HatchResult;
  index: number;
  bird: Bird;
  dev: any;
  entry: EggEntry;
  isOpen: boolean;
  ms: any;
  hr: number;
  realRate: number;
  aliveAfter: number;
  total: number;
  isComplete: boolean;
  tone: any;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
  onOpenFlock: () => void;
  onOpenSell: () => void;
}

export default function HatchCard(props: HatchCardProps) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { hatch: h, index: i, bird, dev, entry, isOpen, ms, hr, realRate, aliveAfter, total, isComplete, tone, onToggle, onEdit, onDelete, onOpenFlock, onOpenSell } = props;

            return (
              <ExpandableCard key={h.id} id={h.id} ms={ms} accent="accent" index={fmt.count(i + 1)} iconEmoji="🐣"
                title={fmt.count(h.hatched || 0) + ' جوجه • ' + (bird?.name || '—')}
                subtitle={(dev?.name || '—') + ' • ' + fmt.date(h.date)}
                isOpen={isOpen} onToggle={() => onToggle()}
                badge={<Tag tone={tone}>{fmt.code(hr.toFixed(1))}٪</Tag>}
                stats={<>
                  <StatBox icon="📊" label="نرخ" value={fmt.code(hr.toFixed(0)) + '٪'} tone={hr >= 70 ? 'accent' : 'warn'} />
                  <Dot />
                  <StatBox icon="🥚" label="تخم" value={fmt.count(total)} />
                </>}
              >
                {isComplete && <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700, padding: 'var(--pad-tight)', background: 'var(--accent-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', textAlign: 'center' }}>✅ تکمیل — همه تخم‌ها شمارش شدن</div>}

                {total > 0 && (h.hatched || 0) > 0 && (
                  <>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📊</span> توزیع</div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', height: 36, borderRadius: 4, overflow: 'hidden', background: 'var(--input-bg)' }}>
                      {(h.hatched||0) > 0 && <div style={{ width: ((h.hatched||0)/total*100)+'%', background: 'var(--accent)' }} />}
                      {(h.deadInShell||0) > 0 && <div style={{ width: ((h.deadInShell||0)/total*100)+'%', background: 'var(--danger)' }} />}
                      {(h.pipped||0) > 0 && <div style={{ width: ((h.pipped||0)/total*100)+'%', background: 'var(--warn)' }} />}
                      {(h.unhatched||0) > 0 && <div style={{ width: ((h.unhatched||0)/total*100)+'%', background: 'var(--muted)' }} />}
                    </div>
                  </>
                )}

                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📊</span> نتیجه هچ</div>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
                  <Row l="جوجه هچ‌شده" v={fmt.count(h.hatched || 0)} />
                  <Row l="هچ‌نشده" v={fmt.count(h.unhatched || 0)} />
                  {h.deadInShell ? <Row l="مرده در پوسته" v={fmt.count(h.deadInShell)} /> : null}
                  {h.pipped ? <Row l="نوک‌زده" v={fmt.count(h.pipped)} /> : null}
                  {h.other ? <Row l="سایر" v={fmt.count(h.other)} /> : null}
                </div>

                {(h.gradeA || h.gradeB) && (
                  <>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>🏅</span> تفکیک کیفی</div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
                      {h.gradeA ? <Row l="درجه A" v={fmt.count(h.gradeA)} /> : null}
                      {h.gradeB ? <Row l="درجه B" v={fmt.count(h.gradeB)} /> : null}
                    </div>
                  </>
                )}

                {(h.maleCount || h.femaleCount || h.unknownCount) && (
                  <>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>⚖️</span> جنسیت</div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
                      {h.maleCount ? <Row l="♂ نر" v={fmt.count(h.maleCount)} /> : null}
                      {h.femaleCount ? <Row l="♀ ماده" v={fmt.count(h.femaleCount)} /> : null}
                      {h.unknownCount ? <Row l="? نامعلوم" v={fmt.count(h.unknownCount)} /> : null}
                    </div>
                  </>
                )}

                {h.avgWeight ? <><div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>⚖️</span> وزن</div><Row l="وزن متوسط" v={fmt.num(h.avgWeight) + ' گرم'} /></> : null}

                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📈</span> نرخ‌ها</div>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
                  <Row l="نرخ هچ کل" v={fmt.code(hr.toFixed(1)) + '٪'} />
                  {aliveAfter !== total && <Row l="نرخ از نطفه‌دار" v={fmt.code(realRate.toFixed(1)) + '٪'} />}
                  {entry?.sampleWeightInitial && h.avgWeight && (() => {
                    const cy = calcChickYield(h.avgWeight, entry.sampleWeightInitial);
                    if (!cy) return null;
                    const icon = cy.level === 'ok' ? '✅' : cy.level === 'warn' ? '⚠️' : '🔴';
                    return <Row l="Chick Yield" v={`${icon} ${fmt.num(cy.value)}٪`} />;
                  })()}
                </div>

                {entry?.totalPrice && h.hatched ? (
                  <>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>💰</span> هزینه</div>
                    <Row l="💰 هزینه هر جوجه" v={fmt.money(Math.round(costPerChick(entry.totalPrice, h.hatched)))} />
                  </>
                ) : null}

                {h.notes && (
                  <>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📝</span> یادداشت</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', lineHeight: 1.7, padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>{h.notes}</div>
                  </>
                )}

                {isComplete && (h.hatched || 0) > 0 && (
                  <div style={{ padding: 10, background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px dashed var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px', textAlign: 'center' }}>مرحله بعد:</div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 6 }}>
                      <Btn size="sm" onClick={onOpenFlock}><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>🐔</span> گله</Btn>
                      <Btn size="sm" onClick={onOpenSell}><span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📥</span> فروش</Btn>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                <CardActions actions={[
                  { ...ACTION_PRESETS.EDIT, onClick: onEdit },
                  { ...ACTION_PRESETS.DELETE, onClick: onDelete }
                ]} />
              </ExpandableCard>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/inc/components/HatchEntryRow.tsx

/**
 * HatchEntryRow.tsx — ردیف ورودی تخم در فرم ثبت هچ
 */
import { useFormat, getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { toFa, toEn } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { Field, Grid2, NumField, Textarea } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { calcCurrentFertile } from '../api/hatchCalc';

export interface HatchRowData {
  hatched: string;
  unhatched: string;
  deadInShell: string;
  pipped: string;
  other: string;
  gradeA: string;
  gradeB: string;
  maleCount: string;
  femaleCount: string;
  unknownCount: string;
  avgWeight: string;
  notes: string;
}

export const emptyRow = (): HatchRowData => ({
  hatched: '', unhatched: '', deadInShell: '', pipped: '', other: '',
  gradeA: '', gradeB: '', maleCount: '', femaleCount: '',
  unknownCount: '', avgWeight: '', notes: '',
});

export interface HatchEntryRowProps {
  entry: { id: string; count: number | null; entryDate: string };
  birdName?: string;
  deviceName?: string;
  candlings: any[];
  latestCand: any;
  data: HatchRowData;
  isSelected: boolean;
  daysAgo: (date: string) => number;
  isLockdown: (e: any) => boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onUpdate: (patch: Partial<HatchRowData>) => void;
}

export default function HatchEntryRow(props: HatchEntryRowProps) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const {
    entry: e, birdName, deviceName, candlings, latestCand,
    data: d, isSelected, daysAgo, isLockdown, onToggle, onUpdate,
  } = props;

  const int = (s: string) => s ? parseInt(toEn(s)) || 0 : 0;

  const calc = calcCurrentFertile(e.id, e.count || 0, candlings);
  const aliveAfter = calc.fertile;

  const h = int(d.hatched);
  const uh = int(d.unhatched);
  const ds = int(d.deadInShell);
  const pp = int(d.pipped);
  const ot = int(d.other);
  const sumE = h + uh + ds + pp + ot;
  const rem = (e.count || 0) - sumE;

  const base = aliveAfter;
  const sum = h + uh + ds + pp + ot;
  const remaining = base - sum;
  const ok = remaining >= 0;

  const hatchedNum = h;

  // Quality
  const gA = int(d.gradeA);
  const gB = int(d.gradeB);
  const gradesUsed = gA + gB;
  const gradesRem = hatchedNum - gradesUsed;
  const gradesOk = gradesRem >= 0;

  // Gender
  const m = int(d.maleCount);
  const f_ = int(d.femaleCount);
  const u = int(d.unknownCount);
  const genderUsed = m + f_ + u;
  const genderRem = hatchedNum - genderUsed;
  const genderOk = genderRem >= 0;

  return (
    <div style={{
      border: '1px solid ' + (isSelected ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'),
      background: isSelected ? 'var(--card-solid, var(--card))' : 'var(--card)',
      borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
      padding: 10,
      display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8,
    }}>
      {/* header row */}
      <div role="button" tabIndex={0} onClick={onToggle} style={{
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,
        cursor: 'pointer', userSelect: 'none',
        padding: 4, margin: -4, borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
      }}>
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          checked={isSelected}
          onChange={() => {}}
          onClick={(ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); onToggle(); }}
          aria-label="انتخاب ورودی"
          style={{ width: 20, height: 20, accentColor: 'var(--accent)', cursor: 'pointer', flexShrink: 0 }}
        />
        <span style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
          {birdName || '—'} • {fmt.count(e.count || 0)} تخم
        </span>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{deviceName || ''}</span>
        <span style={{
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700,
          transform: isSelected ? 'rotate(90deg)' : 'rotate(0)',
          transition: 'transform .2s',
        }}>▶</span>
      </div>

      {/* کندلینگ‌های این ورودی */}
      {calc.byStage.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)',
          padding: 'var(--pad-tight)',
          background: 'var(--input-bg)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', lineHeight: 1.7,
        }}>
          {calc.byStage.map((st, i) => (
            <div key={i} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
              <span>کندلینگ روز {fmt.day(st.stage)}:</span>
              <span>بی‌نطفه {fmt.count(st.infertile)} • مرده {fmt.count(st.dead)} • شکسته {fmt.count(st.broken)}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
          <div style={{
            paddingTop: 4, marginTop: 4, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)',
            display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between',
            color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700,
          }}>
            <span>📊 مجموع تلفات کندلینگ:</span>
            <span>{fmt.count(calc.totalLoss)}</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
            <span>🧬 نطفه‌دار فعلی:</span>
            <span>{fmt.count(calc.fertile)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {isSelected && (
        <>
          {/* کارت اطلاعات ورودی */}
          <div style={{
            padding: 'var(--pad-tight)', background: 'var(--input-bg)',
            border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
            display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4, fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
          }}>
            <InfoRow l="🐦 پرنده" v={birdName || '—'} />
            <InfoRow l="🥚 تعداد کل" v={`${fmt.count(e.count || 0)} تخم`} />
            <InfoRow l="📅 تاریخ ورود" v={fmt.date(e.entryDate)} />
            <InfoRow l="🔢 روز انکوباسیون" v={`روز ${fmt.day(daysAgo(e.entryDate))}`} accent />
            <InfoRow l="📊 نطفه‌دار فعلی" v={`${fmt.count(aliveAfter)} تخم`} />
            {isLockdown(e) && (
              <div style={{
                padding: '3px 6px',
                background: 'var(--warn-soft)',
                border: '1px solid var(--warn)',
                borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                color: 'var(--warn)', fontWeight: 700, textAlign: 'center', marginTop: 2,
              }}>
                🔒 Lock-down (روز {fmt.day(daysAgo(e.entryDate))} از ۱۸)
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div style={{
            padding: 'var(--pad-tight)',
            background: 'var(--input-bg)',
            border: '1px dashed ' + (latestCand ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--warn)'),
            borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
            color: latestCand ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--warn)',
            fontWeight: 700, textAlign: 'center',
          }}>
            {calc.byStage.length > 0
              ? '🧬 سقف این هچ: ' + fmt.count(base) + ' تخم نطفه‌دار'
              : '⚠️ بدون کندلینگ — سقف: ' + fmt.count(base) + ' تخم'}
          </div>

          <Grid2>
            <Field label="جوجه هچ‌شده" required>
              <NumField placeholder="مثلاً — ۴۵۰" value={d.hatched}
                onChange={ev => onUpdate({ hatched: ev.target.value })}
                max={Math.max(0, base - uh - ds - pp - ot)} min={0} unit="عدد" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="هچ‌نشده">
              <NumField placeholder="مثلاً — ۲۰" value={d.unhatched}
                onChange={ev => onUpdate({ unhatched: ev.target.value })}
                max={Math.max(0, base - h - ds - pp - ot)} min={0} unit="عدد" />
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="مرده در پوسته">
              <NumField placeholder="مثلاً — ۱۰" value={d.deadInShell}
                onChange={ev => onUpdate({ deadInShell: ev.target.value })}
                max={Math.max(0, base - h - uh - pp - ot)} min={0} unit="عدد" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="نوک‌زده">
              <NumField placeholder="مثلاً — ۵" value={d.pipped}
                onChange={ev => onUpdate({ pipped: ev.target.value })}
                max={Math.max(0, base - h - uh - ds - ot)} min={0} unit="عدد" />
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="سایر">
              <NumField value={d.other}
                onChange={ev => onUpdate({ other: ev.target.value })}
                max={Math.max(0, base - h - uh - ds - pp)} min={0} unit="عدد" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="وزن متوسط" hint="۲۰-۶۰ گرم">
              <NumField placeholder="مثلاً — ۱.۵" value={d.avgWeight}
                onChange={ev => onUpdate({ avgWeight: ev.target.value })}
                min={0} max={60} unit="گرم" />
            </Field>
          </Grid2>

          <div style={{
            padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
            background: 'var(--input-bg)',
            border: '1px solid ' + (!ok ? 'var(--danger)' : remaining === 0 ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'),
            borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
            color: !ok ? 'var(--danger)' : remaining === 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)',
            fontWeight: 700, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between',
          }}>
            <span>📊 مجموع: {fmt.count(sum)} / {fmt.count(base)}</span>
            <span>
              {ok && remaining > 0 && '⏳ ' + getGlobalFormat().count(remaining) + ' باقی'}
              {ok && remaining === 0 && '✅ کامل'}
              {!ok && '🔴 ' + getGlobalFormat().count(Math.abs(remaining)) + ' اضافی'}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* تفکیک کیفی */}
          {hatchedNum === 0 ? (
            <div style={{
              padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
              background: 'var(--warn-soft)',
              border: '1px dashed var(--warn)',
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--warn)',
              fontWeight: 700, textAlign: 'center',
            }}>
              ⬆️ اول «جوجه هچ‌شده» را وارد کن — سپس می‌توانی کیفیت، جنسیت و وزن را تکمیل کنی
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <SectionLabel label="🏅 تفکیک کیفی (اختیاری)" suffix={`از ${fmt.count(hatchedNum)} هچ‌شده`} />
              <Grid2>
                <Field label="درجه A">
                  <NumField value={d.gradeA}
                    onChange={ev => onUpdate({ gradeA: ev.target.value })}
                    max={hatchedNum - gB} min={0} unit="عدد" />
                </Field>
                <Field label="درجه B">
                  <NumField value={d.gradeB}
                    onChange={ev => onUpdate({ gradeB: ev.target.value })}
                    max={hatchedNum - gA} min={0} unit="عدد" />
                </Field>
              </Grid2>
              <ProgressBar
                label={`A + B: ${fmt.count(gradesUsed)} / ${fmt.count(hatchedNum)}`}
                remaining={gradesRem}
                ok={gradesOk}
              />

              <SectionLabel label="⚖️ جنسیت (اختیاری)" />
              <Grid2>
                <Field label="♂ نر">
                  <NumField value={d.maleCount}
                    onChange={ev => onUpdate({ maleCount: ev.target.value })}
                    max={hatchedNum - f_ - u} min={0} unit="عدد" />
                </Field>
                <Field label="♀ ماده">
                  <NumField value={d.femaleCount}
                    onChange={ev => onUpdate({ femaleCount: ev.target.value })}
                    max={hatchedNum - m - u} min={0} unit="عدد" />
                </Field>
              </Grid2>
              <Grid2>
                <Field label="? نامعلوم">
                  <NumField value={d.unknownCount}
                    onChange={ev => onUpdate({ unknownCount: ev.target.value })}
                    max={hatchedNum - m - f_} min={0} unit="عدد" />
                </Field>
                <Field label="وزن متوسط" hint="۲۰-۶۰ گرم">
                  <NumField value={d.avgWeight}
                    onChange={ev => onUpdate({ avgWeight: ev.target.value })}
                    min={0} max={60} unit="گرم" />
                </Field>
              </Grid2>
              <ProgressBar
                label={`♂ + ♀ + ?: ${fmt.count(genderUsed)} / ${fmt.count(hatchedNum)}`}
                remaining={genderRem}
                ok={genderOk}
              />
            </>
          )}

          <Field label="یادداشت">
            <Textarea
              value={d.notes || ''}
              onChange={ev => onUpdate({ notes: ev.target.value })}
              placeholder="..."
            />
          </Field>

          <div style={{
            padding: 'var(--pad-tight)',
            background: 'var(--input-bg)',
            border: '1px solid ' + (rem < 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : rem === 0 ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'),
            borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
            color: rem < 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : rem === 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)',
            fontWeight: 700, textAlign: 'center',
          }}>
            این هچ: {fmt.count(sumE)} از {fmt.count(e.count || 0)}
            {rem > 0 && ' • باقی — ' + fmt.count(rem)}
            {rem < 0 && ' — بیشتر!'}
            {rem === 0 && ' ✅'}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function InfoRow({ l, v, accent }: { l: string; v: string; accent?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
      <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{l}:</span>
      <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: accent ? 'var(--accent)' : undefined }}>{v}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

function SectionLabel({ label, suffix }: { label: string; suffix?: string }) {
  return (
    <div style={{
      fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)',
      fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px',
    }}>
      {label}{suffix ? ` — ${suffix}` : ''}
    </div>
  );
}

function ProgressBar({ label, remaining, ok }: { label: string; remaining: number; ok: boolean }) {
  const color = !ok ? 'var(--danger)' : remaining === 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)';
  const bg = !ok ? 'var(--danger-soft)' : remaining === 0 ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--input-bg)';
  const border = !ok ? 'var(--danger)' : remaining === 0 ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)';
  return (
    <div style={{
      padding: 'var(--pad-tight)',
      background: bg,
      border: '1px solid ' + border,
      borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
      fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
      color,
      fontWeight: 700, textAlign: 'center',
    }}>
      {label}{!ok ? ' 🔴 ' + getGlobalFormat().count(Math.abs(remaining)) + ' اضافی' : remaining === 0 ? ' ✅ کامل' : ' • ⏳ ' + getGlobalFormat().count(remaining) + ' باقی'}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useFormat, getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import {
  Btn, BtnRow, ErrorBox, Field, Grid2, Modal, NumField,
  SectionTitle, Select, Textarea,
} from '../../../shr/components/ui';

export interface HatchFormModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  editingId: string | null;

  setFormEntryId: (v: string) => void;

          <Btn onClick={onClose}>لغو</Btn>
        </BtnRow>

        <span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📦</span>
        {' '}انتخاب ورودی‌ها
      </SectionTitle>

      {editingId ? (

// ===== بخش ویرایش (فقط وقتی editingId داریم) =====
function EditFields({ data: d, update }: { data: HatchRowData; update: (p: Partial<HatchRowData>) => void }) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const int = (s: string) => parseInt(s || '0') || 0;
  const h = int(d.hatched);
  const uh = int(d.unhatched);
  const ds = int(d.deadInShell);
  const pp = int(d.pipped);
  const ot = int(d.other);
  const hatchedNum = h;

  const gA = int(d.gradeA);
  const gB = int(d.gradeB);
  const gradesUsed = gA + gB;
  const gradesRem = hatchedNum - gradesUsed;
  const gradesOk = gradesRem >= 0;

  const m = int(d.maleCount);
  const f_ = int(d.femaleCount);
  const u = int(d.unknownCount);
  const genderUsed = m + f_ + u;
  const genderRem = hatchedNum - genderUsed;
  const genderOk = genderRem >= 0;

  return (
    <>
      <Grid2>
        <Field label="جوجه هچ‌شده" required>
          <NumField value={d.hatched} onChange={ev => update({ hatched: ev.target.value })} min={0} unit="عدد" />
        </Field>
        <Field label="هچ‌نشده">
          <NumField value={d.unhatched} onChange={ev => update({ unhatched: ev.target.value })} min={0} unit="عدد" />
        </Field>
      </Grid2>
      <Grid2>
        <Field label="مرده در پوسته">
          <NumField value={d.deadInShell} onChange={ev => update({ deadInShell: ev.target.value })} min={0} unit="عدد" />
        </Field>
        <Field label="نوک‌زده">
          <NumField value={d.pipped} onChange={ev => update({ pipped: ev.target.value })} min={0} unit="عدد" />
        </Field>
      </Grid2>
      <Grid2>
        <Field label="سایر">
          <NumField value={d.other} onChange={ev => update({ other: ev.target.value })} min={0} unit="عدد" />
        </Field>
        <Field label="وزن متوسط">
          <NumField value={d.avgWeight} onChange={ev => update({ avgWeight: ev.target.value })} min={0} unit="گرم" />
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      {hatchedNum === 0 ? (
        <div style={{
          padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
          background: 'var(--warn-soft)',
          border: '1px dashed var(--warn)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--warn)',
          fontWeight: 700, textAlign: 'center',
        }}>
          ⬆️ اول «جوجه هچ‌شده» را وارد کن
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>
            🏅 تفکیک کیفی — از {fmt.count(hatchedNum)} هچ‌شده
          </div>
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="درجه A">
              <NumField value={d.gradeA} onChange={ev => update({ gradeA: ev.target.value })} max={hatchedNum - gB} min={0} unit="عدد" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="درجه B">
              <NumField value={d.gradeB} onChange={ev => update({ gradeB: ev.target.value })} max={hatchedNum - gA} min={0} unit="عدد" />
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
          <StatusBar
            label={`A + B: ${fmt.count(gradesUsed)} / ${fmt.count(hatchedNum)}`}
            remaining={gradesRem}
            ok={gradesOk}
          />

          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>
            ⚖️ جنسیت و وزن
          </div>
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="♂ نر">
              <NumField value={d.maleCount} onChange={ev => update({ maleCount: ev.target.value })} max={hatchedNum - f_ - u} min={0} unit="عدد" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="♀ ماده">
              <NumField value={d.femaleCount} onChange={ev => update({ femaleCount: ev.target.value })} max={hatchedNum - m - u} min={0} unit="عدد" />
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="? نامعلوم">
              <NumField value={d.unknownCount} onChange={ev => update({ unknownCount: ev.target.value })} max={hatchedNum - m - f_} min={0} unit="عدد" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="وزن متوسط" hint="۲۰-۶۰ گرم">
              <NumField value={d.avgWeight} onChange={ev => update({ avgWeight: ev.target.value })} min={0} max={60} unit="گرم" />
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
          <StatusBar
            label={`♂ + ♀ + ?: ${fmt.count(genderUsed)} / ${fmt.count(hatchedNum)}`}
            remaining={genderRem}
            ok={genderOk}
          />
        </>
      )}

      <Field label="یادداشت">
        <Textarea value={d.notes || ''} onChange={ev => update({ notes: ev.target.value })} placeholder="..." />
      </Field>
    </>
  );
}

function StatusBar({ label, remaining, ok }: { label: string; remaining: number; ok: boolean }) {
  const color = !ok ? 'var(--danger)' : remaining === 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)';
  const bg = !ok ? 'var(--danger-soft)' : remaining === 0 ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--input-bg)';
  const border = !ok ? 'var(--danger)' : remaining === 0 ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)';
  return (
    <div style={{
      padding: 'var(--pad-tight)',
      background: bg, border: '1px solid ' + border,
      borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
      fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color,
      fontWeight: 700, textAlign: 'center',
    }}>
      {label}{!ok ? ' 🔴 اضافی' : remaining === 0 ? ' ✅ کامل' : ' • ⏳ ' + getGlobalFormat().count(remaining) + ' باقی'}
    </div>
  );
}
