import { create } from 'zustand';
import type { BirdStandard } from './standards';
import type { StandardOverrides } from './standards/_override';
import { setByPath, unsetByPath } from './standards/_override';
import { persist } from 'zustand/middleware';
import { DEFAULT_UNITS, type Units } from '../../shr/units';




/** 🆕 قیمت‌های بازار (دستی) */
export interface MarketPrices {
  liveChicken: number;
  liveTurkey: number;
  liveGoose: number;
  liveDuck: number;
  liveQuail: number;
  chickDay1: number;
  eggTable: number;
  eggFertile: number;
  culledBird: number;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export const DEFAULT_MARKET_PRICES: MarketPrices = {
  liveChicken: 0, liveTurkey: 0, liveGoose: 0, liveDuck: 0, liveQuail: 0,
  chickDay1: 0, eggTable: 0, eggFertile: 0, culledBird: 0,
  updatedAt: '',
};

export interface Settings {
  schemaVersion: number;
  // پروفایل کاربر
  user: { name: string; phone: string; email: string; role: string; avatar: string; };
  // مرغداری
  farm: {
    name: string; type: string; province: string; city: string;
    address: string; postalCode: string; phone: string;
    licenseNo: string; establishedAt: string; logo: string;
  };
  // بانکی
  bank: { cardNo: string; sheba: string; bankName: string; accountHolder: string; };
  // واحدها و قالب‌بندی
  units: Units;
  // امنیت
  security: { pinEnabled: boolean; pin: string; recoveryHash?: string; autoLockMin: number; };

  // ظاهر
  theme: 'light' | 'dark';
  accentColor: 'green' | 'blue' | 'turquoise' | 'olive';
  fontSize: 'small' | 'medium' | 'large' | 'xlarge' | 'xxlarge' | 'huge' | 'xhuge' | 'max';
  fontSizePercent: number;
  density: 'compact' | 'comfortable';
  animations: boolean;
  highContrast: boolean;
  lowPowerMode: boolean;
  printPaper: 'A4' | 'A5';

  // ماژول‌ها
  modules: Record<string, boolean>;

  // ویژگی‌های داخلی (زیرماژول‌ها)
  features: {
    vaccine: boolean;         // واکسن و برنامه واکسن
    medicine: boolean;        // دارو (گیاهی + شیمیایی)
    withdrawal: boolean;      // دوره پرهیز دارو (اختیاری)
  };

  // منوی پایین — ۵ ماژول انتخابی
  bottomNav: string[];

  // اعلان‌ها
  channels: { inApp: boolean; sound: boolean; vibration: boolean; sms: boolean; email: boolean; telegram: boolean; };
  alerts: { critical: boolean; important: boolean; info: boolean; };
  quietHours: { enabled: boolean; from: string; to: string; weekends: boolean; };
  /** 🆕 حذف شد — همه از standards میان */

  dueDateReminders: number[];

  /** استانداردهای سفارشی (ویرایش‌شده توسط کاربر) — legacy */
  customStandards?: Record<string, BirdStandard>;
  /** 🆕 گونه‌های سفارشی (کبک، شترمرغ، ...) */
  customSpecies?: Array<{ kind: string; nameFa: string; nameEn?: string; icon: string; builtIn: boolean }>;
  marketPrices?: MarketPrices;

  /** 🆕 تغییرات کاربر بر پایه Diff — سبک‌تر */
  customOverrides?: Record<string, StandardOverrides>;

  // پشتیبان
  autoBackup: { enabled: boolean; intervalHours: number; maxVersions: number; };
  encryption: { enabled: boolean; password: string; };
  auditLog: { enabled: boolean; maxEntries: number; };
}

const defaultSettings: Settings = {
  schemaVersion: 1,
  user: { name: '', phone: '', email: '', role: 'owner', avatar: '' },
  farm: { name: '', type: 'layer', province: '', city: '', address: '', postalCode: '', phone: '', licenseNo: '', establishedAt: '', logo: '' },
  bank: { cardNo: '', sheba: '', bankName: '', accountHolder: '' },
  units: DEFAULT_UNITS,

  bottomNav: ['dsh', 'dlg', 'inc', 'rep', 'set'],

  channels: { inApp: true, sound: true, vibration: true, sms: false, email: false, telegram: false },
  alerts: { critical: true, important: true, info: true },
  quietHours: { enabled: false, from: '22:00', to: '07:00', weekends: true },

  dueDateReminders: [7, 3, 1],
  security: { pinEnabled: false, pin: '', autoLockMin: 0 },
  theme: 'light',
  accentColor: 'green',
  fontSize: 'medium',
  fontSizePercent: 100,
  density: 'comfortable',
  animations: true,
  highContrast: false,
  lowPowerMode: false,
  printPaper: 'A4',
  modules: {},
  features: { vaccine: true, medicine: true, withdrawal: false },
  customStandards: {},
  customSpecies: [],
  marketPrices: { ...DEFAULT_MARKET_PRICES },
  customOverrides: {},

  autoBackup: { enabled: true, intervalHours: 24, maxVersions: 5 },
  encryption: { enabled: false, password: '' },
  auditLog: { enabled: true, maxEntries: 100 },
};

interface State extends Settings {
  update: (patch: Partial<Settings>) => void;
  updateSection: <K extends keyof Settings>(key: K, patch: Partial<Settings[K]>) => void;
  reset: () => void;
  updateStandard: (key: string, std: BirdStandard) => void;
  setMarketPrice: (key: keyof Omit<MarketPrices, 'updatedAt'>, value: number) => void;
  setAllMarketPrices: (prices: Partial<MarketPrices>) => void;
  addSpecies: (species: { kind: string; nameFa: string; nameEn?: string; icon: string }) => void;
  removeSpecies: (kind: string) => void;
  resetStandard: (key: string) => void;
  /** 🆕 ذخیره یک override فیلد خاص */
  setOverride: (key: string, path: string, value: any) => void;
  /** 🆕 حذف override یک فیلد (بازگشت به استاندارد) */
  clearOverride: (key: string, path: string) => void;
  /** 🆕 حذف همه overrideهای یه نژاد */
  clearAllOverrides: (key: string) => void;
  toggleModule: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useSet = create<State>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      ...defaultSettings,
      update: (patch) => set((state: any) => ({ ...state, ...patch })),
      updateSection: (key, patch) => set((state: any) => ({ ...state, [key]: { ...state[key], ...patch } })),
      reset: () => set(defaultSettings as any),
      addSpecies: (species) => set((state: any) => {
        const existing = state.customSpecies || [];
        if (existing.some((s: any) => s.kind === species.kind)) return state;
        return { ...state, customSpecies: [...existing, { ...species, builtIn: false }] };
      }),
      removeSpecies: (kind) => set((state: any) => ({
        ...state,
        customSpecies: (state.customSpecies || []).filter((s: any) => s.kind !== kind),
      })),
      updateStandard: (key: string, std: BirdStandard) => set((state: any) => ({
        ...state,
        customStandards: { ...(state.customStandards || {}), [key]: std }
      })),
      setMarketPrice: (key, value) => set((state: any) => ({
        marketPrices: {
          ...(state.marketPrices || DEFAULT_MARKET_PRICES),
          [key]: Number(value) || 0,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        },
      })),
      setAllMarketPrices: (prices) => set((state: any) => ({
        marketPrices: {
          ...(state.marketPrices || DEFAULT_MARKET_PRICES),
          ...prices,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        },
      })),
      resetStandard: (key: string) => set((state: any) => {
        const next = { ...(state.customStandards || {}) };
        delete next[key];
        return { ...state, customStandards: next };
      }),
      setOverride: (key: string, path: string, value: any) => set((state: any) => {
        const overrides = { ...(state.customOverrides || {}) };
        const current = overrides[key] || {};
        overrides[key] = setByPath(current, path, value);
        return { ...state, customOverrides: overrides };
      }),
      clearOverride: (key: string, path: string) => set((state: any) => {
        const overrides = { ...(state.customOverrides || {}) };
        if (!overrides[key]) return state;
        overrides[key] = unsetByPath(overrides[key], path);
        // اگه خالی شد، حذفش کن
        if (Object.keys(overrides[key]).length === 0) delete overrides[key];
        return { ...state, customOverrides: overrides };
      }),
      clearAllOverrides: (key: string) => set((state: any) => {
        const overrides = { ...(state.customOverrides || {}) };
        delete overrides[key];
        return { ...state, customOverrides: overrides };
      }),
      toggleModule: (id) => set({
        modules: { ...get().modules, [id]: !get().modules[id] }
      })
    }),
    {
      name: 'pm-settings',
      merge: (persisted, current) => {
        const p: any = persisted || {};

        // 🆕 Migration (۱۴۰۴/۰۷/۲۱): حذف litter.kgPerM2 قدیمی (ساختار جدید: kgPerM2ByMaterial)
        const migrateLitter = (obj: any): any => {
          if (!obj?.litter || obj.litter.kgPerM2 === undefined) return obj;
          const { kgPerM2: _old, ...litterRest } = obj.litter;
          if (Object.keys(litterRest).length === 0) {
            const { litter: _l, ...objRest } = obj;
            return objRest;
          }
          return { ...obj, litter: litterRest };
        };

        const cleanedOverrides: Record<string, any> = {};
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(p.customOverrides || {})) {
          cleanedOverrides[k] = migrateLitter(v);
        }
        const cleanedStandards: Record<string, any> = {};
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(p.customStandards || {})) {
          cleanedStandards[k] = migrateLitter(v);
        }

        return {
          ...current,
          ...p,
          modules: { ...current.modules, ...(p.modules || {}) },
          bottomNav: Array.isArray(p.bottomNav) && p.bottomNav.length === 5
            ? p.bottomNav
            : current.bottomNav,
          units: { ...DEFAULT_UNITS, ...(p.units || {}) },
          channels: { ...current.channels, ...(p.channels || {}) },
          alerts: { ...current.alerts, ...(p.alerts || {}) },
          quietHours: { ...current.quietHours, ...(p.quietHours || {}) },
          features: { ...current.features, ...(p.features || {}) },
          customOverrides: cleanedOverrides,
          customStandards: cleanedStandards,
        };
      }
    }
  )
);

export const MODULE_LABELS: Record<string, { name: string; desc: string; icon: string }> = {
  dsh: { name: 'داشبورد', desc: 'نمای کلی و شاخص‌ها', icon: '🏠' },
  brd: { name: 'پرنده و نژاد', desc: 'مدیریت پرنده‌ها و نژادها', icon: '🐔' },

} from '../../../shr/units/types';

const SEP_OPTIONS: ThousandSep[] = ['fa', 'en', 'space', 'dot', 'slash', 'none'];
const DEC_OPTIONS = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4];

const SAMPLE = {
  money: 5000000,
  temp: 32,
  weight: 2500,
  volume: 5000,
  length: 12,
  area: 100,
  number: 12500000,

// ═══ کارت واحد ═══
function UnitCard({
  icon, label, value, onChange, options, preview,
}: {
  icon: string;
  label: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  options: readonly { v: string; l: string }[];
  preview: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div style={{
      display: 'flex',
      flexDirection: 'column',
      gap: 6,
      padding: '10px 12px',
      background: 'var(--input-bg)',
      border: '1px solid var(--border)',
      borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
      minWidth: 0,
    }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 16, lineHeight: 1, flexShrink: 0 }} aria-hidden="true">{icon}</span>
        <span style={{
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
          fontWeight: 600,
          color: 'var(--muted)',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
          whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
        }}>{label}</span>
      </div>

      <div style={{
        fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)',
        fontWeight: 700,
        color: 'var(--accent)',
        fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums',
        direction: 'rtl',
        textAlign: 'right',
        whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
      }}>{preview}</div>

      <select
        value={value}
        onChange={e => onChange(e.target.value)}
        style={{
          width: '100%',
          height: 32,
          padding: '0 6px',
          background: 'var(--card)',
          border: '1px solid var(--border)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
          color: 'var(--text)',
          fontFamily: 'inherit',
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
          fontWeight: 600,
          cursor: 'pointer',
          textAlign: 'right',
          boxSizing: 'border-box',
        }}
      >
        {options.map(o => (
          <option key={o.v} value={o.v}>{o.l}</option>
        ))}
      </select>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/tra/ChecksPage.tsx

import { useFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { Tag } from '../../shr/components/ui';
/**
 * ChecksPage.tsx — مدیریت چک‌ها
 */
import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  useTra, DEAL_LABEL,
  type PartyPayment, type Invoice, type Deal, type CheckStatus,
} from './store';
import { useCtc } from '../ctc/store';
import { toFa } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { daysUntilJalali } from './helpers';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../cor/store/dialog';
import { toastMsg } from '../../cor/store/toast';
import { Btn, Empty, PageContainer } from '../../shr/components/ui';
import HelpBanner from '../../shr/components/HelpBanner';

const CAT_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  chick: 'جوجه', egg: 'تخم', fertile_egg: 'تخم نطفه‌دار',
  adult: 'پرنده بالغ', feed: 'دان', medicine: 'دارو',
  vaccine: 'واکسن', herbal: 'داروی گیاهی', equipment: 'تجهیزات',
  manure: 'کود', broken: 'تخم شکسته', other: 'سایر',
};

const STATUS_INFO: Record<CheckStatus, { label: string; bg: string; color: string; icon: string }> = {
  pending:    { label: 'در دست',   bg: 'var(--warn-soft)',   color: 'var(--warn)',   icon: '⏳' },
  in_transit: { label: 'در جریان', bg: 'var(--info-soft, rgba(2,132,199,.12))', color: 'var(--info, #0284c7)', icon: '↑' },
  cleared:    { label: 'وصول شده', bg: 'var(--accent-soft)', color: 'var(--accent)', icon: '✓' },
  bounced:    { label: 'برگشتی',   bg: 'var(--danger-soft)', color: 'var(--danger)', icon: '✗' },
};

type FilterKey = 'all' | 'pending' | 'in_transit' | 'cleared' | 'bounced' | 'soon';

interface CheckRow {
  pp: PartyPayment;
  status: CheckStatus;
  partyName: string;
  roleLabel: string;
  subjectLabel: string;
  docNumber: string;
  daysUntilDue: number | null;
}

export default function ChecksPage({ active = true }: { active?: boolean } = {}) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  void active;
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { partyPayments, invoices, deals, depositPartyPayment, clearPartyPayment, bouncePartyPayment } = useTra();
  const { contacts } = useCtc();
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<FilterKey>('all');

  const rows = useMemo<CheckRow[]>(() => {
    const partyMap = new Map(contacts.map(c => [c.id, c]));
    const ppToInv = new Map<string, Invoice>();
    for (const inv of invoices) {
      for (const p of inv.payments || []) {
        if (p.partyPaymentId) ppToInv.set(p.partyPaymentId, inv);
      }
    }
    const ppToDeal = new Map<string, Deal>();
    for (const deal of deals) {
      for (const p of deal.payments || []) {
        if (p.partyPaymentId) ppToDeal.set(p.partyPaymentId, deal);
      }
    }
    return partyPayments
      .filter(pp => pp.method === 'check')
      .map(pp => {
        const status: CheckStatus = pp.status || 'pending';
        const party = partyMap.get(pp.partyId);
        const inv = ppToInv.get(pp.id);
        const deal = ppToDeal.get(pp.id);
        const days = pp.dueDate ? daysUntilJalali(pp.dueDate) : null;
        let roleLabel = '—';
        let subjectLabel = pp.notes || '—';
        let docNumber = '';
        if (inv) {
          roleLabel = inv.type === 'sale' ? 'خریدار' : 'فروشنده';
          subjectLabel = inv.items?.[0]?.description || CAT_LABEL[inv.category] || inv.category || '—';
          docNumber = inv.number || '';
        } else if (deal) {
          roleLabel = 'معامله';
          subjectLabel = deal.description || DEAL_LABEL[deal.type];
          docNumber = deal.dealNumber || '';
        }
        return { pp, status, partyName: party?.name || '—', roleLabel, subjectLabel, docNumber, daysUntilDue: days };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        const order: Record<CheckStatus, number> = { pending: 0, in_transit: 1, cleared: 2, bounced: 3 };
        if (order[a.status] !== order[b.status]) return order[a.status] - order[b.status];
        return (a.daysUntilDue ?? 999) - (b.daysUntilDue ?? 999);
      });
  }, [partyPayments, invoices, deals, contacts]);

  const counts = useMemo(() => {
    const c = { all: rows.length, pending: 0, in_transit: 0, cleared: 0, bounced: 0, soon: 0 };
    for (const r of rows) {
      c[r.status]++;
      if (r.status === 'pending' && r.daysUntilDue !== null && r.daysUntilDue >= 0 && r.daysUntilDue <= 7) c.soon++;
    }
    return c;
  }, [rows]);

  const summary = useMemo(() => {
    let hand = 0, transit = 0, cleared = 0, bounced = 0;
    for (const r of rows) {
      if (r.status === 'pending') hand += r.pp.amount;
      else if (r.status === 'in_transit') transit += r.pp.amount;
      else if (r.status === 'cleared') cleared += r.pp.amount;
      else if (r.status === 'bounced') bounced += r.pp.amount;
    }
    return { hand, transit, cleared, bounced, total: hand + transit };
  }, [rows]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (filter === 'all') return rows;
    if (filter === 'soon') return rows.filter(r => r.status === 'pending' && r.daysUntilDue !== null && r.daysUntilDue >= 0 && r.daysUntilDue <= 7);
    return rows.filter(r => r.status === filter);
  }, [rows, filter]);

  const groups = useMemo(() => {
    const urgent: CheckRow[] = [];
    const open: CheckRow[] = [];
    const closed: CheckRow[] = [];
    for (const r of filtered) {
      if (r.status === 'cleared' || r.status === 'bounced') closed.push(r);
      else if (r.status === 'pending' && r.daysUntilDue !== null && r.daysUntilDue >= 0 && r.daysUntilDue <= 7) urgent.push(r);
      else open.push(r);
    }
    return { urgent, open, closed };
  }, [filtered]);

  const handleAction = async (row: CheckRow, action: 'deposit' | 'clear' | 'bounce') => {
    const { pp } = row;
    const amountFa = fmt.money(pp.amount, { withUnit: false });
    const checkLabel = pp.checkNo ? `چک #${pp.checkNo}` : 'چک';
    let title = '', msg = '', confirmText = '', danger = false;
    if (action === 'deposit') {
      title = 'واریز به بانک';
      msg = `${checkLabel} به مبلغ ${amountFa} تومان را به بانک واریز می‌کنید؟`;
      confirmText = 'بله، واریز شد';
    } else if (action === 'clear') {
      title = 'تایید وصول';
      msg = `${checkLabel} به مبلغ ${amountFa} تومان وصول شد؟`;
      confirmText = 'بله، وصول شد';
    } else {
      title = 'تایید برگشت';
      msg = `${checkLabel} به مبلغ ${amountFa} تومان برگشت خورد؟ این عمل اثر مالی دارد.`;
      confirmText = 'بله، برگشت خورد';
      danger = true;
    }
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync(title, msg, { danger, confirmText });
    if (!ok) return;
    try {
      if (action === 'deposit') depositPartyPayment(pp.id);
      else if (action === 'clear') clearPartyPayment(pp.id);
      else bouncePartyPayment(pp.id);
      toastMsg.success('وضعیت چک به‌روز شد');
    } catch (e) {
      toastMsg.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'خطا در ثبت');
    }
  };

  const filters: { key: FilterKey; label: string; count: number }[] = [
    { key: 'all', label: 'همه', count: counts.all },
    { key: 'pending', label: 'در دست', count: counts.pending },
    { key: 'in_transit', label: 'در جریان', count: counts.in_transit },
    { key: 'soon', label: 'نزدیک سرسید', count: counts.soon },
    { key: 'cleared', label: 'وصول شده', count: counts.cleared },
    { key: 'bounced', label: 'برگشتی', count: counts.bounced },
  ];

  const renderCard = (row: CheckRow) => {
    const info = STATUS_INFO[row.status];
    const dueLabel = row.daysUntilDue === null ? null
      : row.daysUntilDue < 0 ? `${fmt.day(Math.abs(row.daysUntilDue))} روز گذشته`
      : row.daysUntilDue === 0 ? 'امروز'
      : `${fmt.day(row.daysUntilDue)} روز مانده`;
    const dueTone = row.daysUntilDue !== null && row.daysUntilDue <= 3 ? 'var(--danger)'
      : row.daysUntilDue !== null && row.daysUntilDue <= 7 ? 'var(--warn)'
      : 'var(--muted)';
    const isUrgent = row.status === 'pending' && row.daysUntilDue !== null && row.daysUntilDue >= 0 && row.daysUntilDue <= 7;
    const rightBorder = row.status === 'bounced'
      ? '3px solid var(--danger)'
      : isUrgent ? '3px solid var(--warn)' : '1px solid var(--border)';
    return (
      <div key={row.pp.id} style={{
        background: 'var(--card)',
        borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',
        borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
        borderLeft: '1px solid var(--border)',
        borderRight: rightBorder,
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)', padding: 12, marginBottom: 8,
      }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 8 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 800, color: 'var(--text)' }}>{row.partyName}</span>
            {row.roleLabel !== '—' && (
              <span style={{ fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 600, padding: '1px 6px', borderRadius: 4, background: 'var(--input-bg)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{row.roleLabel}</span>
            )}
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 4, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', fontWeight: 800, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' }}>{fmt.money(row.pp.amount, { withUnit: false })}</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 500 }}>تومان</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 8 }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 500 }}>{row.subjectLabel}</span>
          {dueLabel && <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: dueTone, fontWeight: 600, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{dueLabel}</span>}
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 10 }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--dim)', fontWeight: 400 }}>
            چک {row.pp.checkNo || '—'}{row.pp.bank ? ` • ${row.pp.bank}` : ''}
          </span>
          {row.docNumber && <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--dim)', fontWeight: 400 }}>{row.docNumber}</span>}
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)', paddingTop: 8 }}>
          <Tag style={{ background: info.bg, color: info.color }}>{info.label}</Tag>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center' }}>
            {row.status === 'pending' && <Btn size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => void handleAction(row, 'deposit')}>↑ واریز به بانک</Btn>}
            {row.status === 'in_transit' && <Btn size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => void handleAction(row, 'clear')}>✓ وصول شد</Btn>}
            {(row.status === 'pending' || row.status === 'in_transit') && <Btn size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => void handleAction(row, 'bounce')}>✗</Btn>}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      <HelpBanner
        id="tra-checks-guide"
        icon="🧾"
        title="راهنمای چک‌ها"
        description="چک‌های ثبت‌شده در فاکتورها و تسویه‌ها را بر اساس وضعیت (در دست، در جریان، وصول‌شده، برگشتی) و تاریخ سررسید بررسی و مدیریت کنید."
        tone="info"
      />
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 10 }}>
        <div>

            </span>
          </div>

              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 800, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', color: 'var(--info, #0284c7)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{fmt.money(summary.transit, { withUnit: false })}</span>

              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 500 }}>وصول شده</span>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 800, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', color: 'var(--accent)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{fmt.money(summary.cleared, { withUnit: false })}</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', padding: 8, borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)' }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 500 }}>برگشتی</span>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 800, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', color: 'var(--danger)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{fmt.money(summary.bounced, { withUnit: false })}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {rows.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, marginBottom: 12, overflowX: 'auto', scrollbarWidth: 'none', paddingBottom: 2 }}>
          {filters.map(f => (
            <button key={f.key} type="button" onClick={() => setFilter(f.key)} style={{
              padding: '6px 11px', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
              background: filter === f.key ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--btn-bg)',
              border: `1px solid ${filter === f.key ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'}`,
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
              color: filter === f.key ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
              fontWeight: filter === f.key ? 600 : 500,
              fontFamily: 'inherit', cursor: 'pointer', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', flexShrink: 0,
            }}>{f.label} ({fmt.count(f.count)})</button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {groups.urgent.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--danger)', padding: '8px 0', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
            ⚠ نیاز به اقدام فوری — سرسید تا ۷ روز
            <div style={{ flex: 1, height: 1, background: 'var(--border)' }} />
          </div>
          {groups.urgent.map(renderCard)}
        </>
      )}

      {groups.open.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--muted)', padding: '8px 0', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
            سایر چک‌های باز
            <div style={{ flex: 1, height: 1, background: 'var(--border)' }} />
          </div>
          {groups.open.map(renderCard)}
        </>
      )}

      {groups.closed.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--muted)', padding: '8px 0', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
            بسته‌شده
            <div style={{ flex: 1, height: 1, background: 'var(--border)' }} />
          </div>
          {groups.closed.map(renderCard)}
        </>
      )}

      {rows.length === 0 && (
        <Empty icon={<span style={{ fontSize: 24 }}>📋</span>} title="هنوز چکی ثبت نشده" desc="برای ثبت چک، از طریق فاکتور یا معامله اقدام کنید" />
      )}

      {rows.length > 0 && filtered.length === 0 && (
        <div style={{ padding: 32, textAlign: 'center', background: 'var(--card)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)' }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 24, marginBottom: 8 }}>📋</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 4 }}>چکی با این فیلتر پیدا نشد</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>فیلتر را تغییر دهید</div>
        </div>
      )}
    </PageContainer>
  );
}

function resolveUnitLabel(unit: unknown): string {
  if (typeof unit !== "string") return "";
  const validKeys = Object.keys(UNIT_LABEL) as Array<keyof typeof UNIT_LABEL>;
  const matched = validKeys.find((k) => k === unit);
  return matched ? UNIT_LABEL[matched] : unit;
}

          }
        }
      }
    }
    deleteDeal(id);
  };
