  } = useInvoiceForm({ kind, invoices, contacts, flocks, whsItems, allocations, addInvoice, updateInvoice });

  // 🆕 باز کردن فرم ویرایش از URL (از Aging در ReceivablesPage)
  // ⚠️ روش dedupe: nonce `_t` در URL + sessionStorage
  //   - هر بار EntityLink یک `_t` جدید می‌دهد → click موفق
  //   - refresh همان `_t` را می‌آورد → sessionStorage می‌گوید «قبلاً پردازش شده» → باز نمی‌شود
  const processedEditRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) return;
    const editId = searchParams.get('edit');
    if (!editId) {
      processedEditRef.current = null;
      // پاکسازی session keys — URL دیگر edit ندارد
      try {
        Object.keys(sessionStorage).forEach(k => {
          if (k.startsWith('tra-edit-')) sessionStorage.removeItem(k);
        });
      } catch { /* silent */ }
      return;
    }

    const nonce = searchParams.get('_t') || '';
    const key = `${editId}:${nonce}`;
    if (processedEditRef.current === key) return;  // double-processing (StrictMode)

    // refresh detection: همان URL قبلاً در این session پردازش شده
    const sessionKey = `tra-edit-${key}`;
    try {
      if (sessionStorage.getItem(sessionKey)) {
        // قبلاً پردازش شد (refresh) → پاک URL، باز نکن
        const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
        next.delete('edit');
        next.delete('_t');
        setSearchParams(next, { replace: true });
        return;
      }
    } catch { /* silent */ }

    const inv = _allInvoices.find(i => i.id === editId);
    if (!inv) return;
    if (inv.type !== kind) return;

    processedEditRef.current = key;
    try { sessionStorage.setItem(sessionKey, '1'); } catch { /* silent */ }
    openEdit(inv);
    const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
    next.delete('edit');
    next.delete('_t');
    setSearchParams(next, { replace: true });
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [searchParams, active, kind]);

  // آبشار: اگه partyId دیگه در لیست فیلترشده نیست، پاک شه
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !form.partyId) return;
    if (!parties.some(p => p.id === form.partyId)) {
      setForm(f => ({ ...f, partyId: '' }));
    }
  }, [parties, form.partyId, open]);

  // بازکردن خودکار از URL (از EquipmentPage) — خواندن کامل تمام فیلدهای تجهیز از useHal
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPurchase) return;
    const flag = searchParams.get('_tra');
    if (flag !== 'equip') return;

    const equipmentId = searchParams.get('equipmentId') || '';
    if (!equipmentId) return;

    const eq = useHal.getState().equipment.find(x => x.id === equipmentId);
    const name = eq?.name || searchParams.get('name') || 'تجهیز';
    const qty = eq?.count || parseInt(searchParams.get('qty') || '1') || 1;
    const price = eq?.unitPrice || parseInt(searchParams.get('price') || '0') || 0;
    const invoiceDate = eq?.purchasedAt || getTodayJalali();

    setForm({
      ...empty(true),
      date: invoiceDate,
      dueDate: invoiceDate,
      partyId: eq?.supplierId || '',
      category: 'equipment',
      notes: eq?.notes || '',
      items: [{
        id: crypto.randomUUID(),
        category: 'equipment',
        description: name,
        unit: eq?.unit || 'pcs',
        quantity: qty,
        unitPrice: price,
        total: qty * price,
        equipmentId,
        equipmentKind: (() => {
          const raw = eq?.kind || (eq ? kindForType(eq.type) : undefined);
          return raw === 'consumable' ? 'consumable' : 'asset';
        })(),
        equipmentType: (() => {
          const raw = eq?.kind || (eq ? kindForType(eq.type) : undefined);
          return raw === 'consumable' ? 'consumable' : 'asset';
        })(),
        equipmentCategory: (() => {
          const validCats = ['ventilation', 'feeding', 'watering', 'lighting', 'cage', 'other'];
          if (eq?.category && validCats.includes(eq.category)) return eq.category;
          if (eq?.category === 'drinking') return 'watering';
          return 'other';
        })(),
        hallId: eq?.hallId || '',
        zoneId: eq?.zoneId || '',
        brand: eq?.brand || '',
        model: eq?.model || '',
        warrantyMonths: eq?.warranty ?? null,
      } as any],
    });
    setErr('');
    setOpen(true);

    try {
      const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
      next.delete('_tra');
      next.delete('equipmentId');
      setSearchParams(next, { replace: true });
    } catch {}
  }, [searchParams, isPurchase]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    setForm(f => {
      if (!f.date) return f;
      let newDue = f.dueDate;
      if (f.paymentTerms === 'cash') newDue = f.date;
      else if (f.paymentTerms === 'custom') newDue = f.customDueDate || f.date;
      else if (f.paymentTerms === 'installment') {
        const gap = parseInt(toEn(f.installmentGapDays)) || 30;
        newDue = calcDueDate('installment', f.date, '', gap);
      }
      return newDue !== f.dueDate ? { ...f, dueDate: newDue } : f;
    });
  }, [open, form.date, form.paymentTerms, form.customDueDate, form.installmentGapDays]);
  const kindFiltered = useMemo(() => invoices.filter(i => i.type === kind), [invoices, kind]);

  const config = useMemo(() => {
    const partyNames: Record<string, string> = {};
    kindFiltered.forEach(i => {
      if (i.partyId && !partyNames[i.partyId]) {
        const c = parties.find(x => x.id === i.partyId);
        if (c) partyNames[i.partyId] = c.name;
      }
    });
    const cats = isPurchase
      ? (CATEGORIES.purchase as Array<[string, string]>)
      : (CATEGORIES.sale as Array<[string, string]>);
    return getTraInvoicesConfig({ partyNames, categories: cats });
  }, [kindFiltered, parties, isPurchase]);
  const fsResult = useFilterSort<Invoice>({
    items: kindFiltered,
    filters: config.filterDefs,
    sorts: config.sortDefs,
    persistKey: config.persistKey,
    initialSort: config.initialSort,
  });
  const { filtered: list, filters, setFilter, clearFilter, sort, setSort, toggleSort,

  const grouped = useGroupedList({

    groupDefs: config.groupDefs,

      partyNames: Object.fromEntries(parties.map(p => [p.id, p.name])),
      categories: CATEGORIES[isPurchase ? 'purchase' : 'sale'],
    },
  });
  const groupedList = useMemo(
    () => grouped ? [...grouped].sort((a, b) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title, 'fa')) : null,
    [grouped],

    catch { toastMsg.error('بازگردانی ناموفق'); }
    setUndoData(null);

  const ms = useInvoiceSelection({

    flocks,

  // 🆕 Filter empty items/payments to match save() behavior in useInvoiceForm.ts
  const _cleanItemsForValidation = form.items.filter(it =>
    !((Number(it.quantity) || 0) === 0 && (Number(it.unitPrice) || 0) === 0 && !String(it.description || '').trim())
  );
  const _cleanPaymentsForValidation = form.payments.filter(pp => (Number(pp.amount) || 0) > 0);

  const { errors: vErrors } = useValidation(
    createInvoiceSchema({ flocks, whsItems, contacts, invoices, allocations, isEdit: !!form.id }),
    {
      type: kind,
      date: form.date || '',
      partyId: form.partyId || '',
      category: form.category || '',
      items: _cleanItemsForValidation.map(it => ({
        ...it,
        category: it.category || form.category,
      })),
      discount: 0,
      shipping: 0,
      total: Number(total) || 0,
      payments: _cleanPaymentsForValidation.map(pp => ({
        date: pp.date || '',
        amount: Number(pp.amount) || 0,
        method: pp.method,

        dueDate: pp.dueDate || '',
        notes: pp.notes || '',
        status: pp.status || 'pending',
      })),
      dueDate: form.dueDate || '',
      deliveryDate: form.deliveryDate || '',
      isPreorder: form.isPreorder ?? false,
      relatedFlockId: '',
      relatedEntryId: '',
      relatedDealId: '',
      notes: form.notes || '',
      paymentTerms: form.paymentTerms,

  const [saveAttempted, setSaveAttempted] = useState(false);
  const [touchedFields, setTouchedFields] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const markTouched = (f: string) => setTouchedFields((prev) => { const n = new Set(prev); n.add(f); return n; });
  const isRequiredError = (msg: string) =>
    msg.includes('اجباری') ||
    msg.includes('را وارد کنید') ||
    msg.includes('را انتخاب کنید') ||
    msg.includes('لطفاً');
  const showError = (f: string) => {
    if (!saveAttempted && !touchedFields.has(f)) return undefined;
    const err = vErrors[f];
    if (!err) return undefined;
    if (!saveAttempted && isRequiredError(err)) return undefined;
    return err;
  };

  // 🆕 ریست خطاها هنگام تغییر دسته (تا ذخیره زده نشده، فرم تمیز است)
  useEffect(() => {
    setSaveAttempted(false);
    setTouchedFields(new Set());
  }, [form.category]);

  const doTransfer = async () => {
    if (!transferModal) return;
    const inv = invoices.find(i => i.id === transferModal.id);
    if (!inv) return;

    setTransferDateError('');
    const rawDate = transferDate.trim();
    if (!rawDate) {
      setTransferDateError('لطفاً تاریخ را انتخاب کنید.');
      return;
    }

    const parsedTransfer = parseJalali(rawDate);
    if (!parsedTransfer) {
      setTransferDateError('فرمت تاریخ واردشده معتبر نیست.');
      return;
    }

    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const diffFromToday = differenceInCalendarDays(parsedTransfer, today);

    if (diffFromToday > 0) {
      setTransferDateError(`تاریخ نمی‌تواند در آینده (${fmt.date(rawDate)}) باشد.`);
      return;
    }

    if (inv.date) {
      const parsedInvDate = parseJalali(inv.date.trim());
      if (parsedInvDate && differenceInCalendarDays(parsedTransfer, parsedInvDate) < 0) {
        setTransferDateError(`تاریخ نمی‌تواند قبل از تاریخ ثبت فاکتور (${fmt.date(inv.date)}) باشد.`);
        return;
      }
    }

    if (diffFromToday < -90) {
      const pastDays = Math.abs(diffFromToday);
      const okOld = await showConfirmAsync(
        '⚠️ هشدار تاریخ قدیمی',
        `تاریخ انتخاب‌شده (${fmt.date(rawDate)}) مربوط به ${fmt.count(pastDays)} روز قبل است.\nآیا از ثبت با این تاریخ مطمئن هستید؟`,
        { confirmText: 'بله، تأیید' }
      );
      if (!okOld) return;
    }
    const patch: Partial<Invoice> = { workflowStatus: transferModal.to };
    if (transferModal.to === 'confirmed') patch.confirmedAt = transferDate || new Date().toISOString();
    else if (transferModal.to === 'received') {
      patch.receivedAt = transferDate || new Date().toISOString();
      patch.receivedNote = transferNote;
    } else if (transferModal.to === 'paid') {
      if (inv.disputeStatus === 'open') {
        toastMsg.error('این فاکتور دارای اختلاف باز است — ابتدا اختلاف را حل کنید');
        setTransferModal(null);
        return;
      }
      // 🆕 فیکس: اگه باقی‌مانده داره، اجازه نده
      const rem = remaining(inv, allocations);
      if (rem > 0) {
        toastMsg.error('فاکتور هنوز تسویه نشده — ابتدا پرداخت را کامل کنید');
        setTransferModal(null);
        return;
      }
      patch.paidAt = transferDate || new Date().toISOString();
      patch.paidNote = transferNote;
    }
    updateInvoice(inv.id, patch);
    setTransferModal(null); setTransferNote(''); setTransferDate(''); setTransferDateError('');
  };

  
  const handleReopen = async (inv: Invoice) => {
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
      'بازگشایی فاکتور',
      'این فاکتور پرداخت شده است.\n\nبا بازگشایی:\n• وضعیت به «تایید شده» برمی‌گردد\n• می‌توانید فیلدها را ویرایش کنید\n• پس از ویرایش باید دوباره پرداخت ثبت کنید\n\nادامه می‌دهید؟',
      { confirmText: 'بازگشایی' }
    );
    if (!ok) return;
    reopenInvoice(inv.id);
    try { logAction('update', 'tra', 'بازگشایی فاکتور ' + (inv.number || inv.id)); } catch {}
    setTimeout(() => {
      const fresh = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === inv.id);
      if (fresh) openEdit(fresh);
      else openEdit(inv);
    }, 100);
  };

return (
    <PageContainer bottomPad={100}>
      {undoData && (
        <UndoBar
          label="حذف شد"
          onUndo={undoDelete}
          onDismiss={() => setUndoData(null)}
        />
      )}
      <HelpBanner
        id={isPurchase ? 'purchases-intro' : 'sales-intro'}
        icon={isPurchase ? '📥' : '📤'}
        title={isPurchase ? 'راهنمای خرید' : 'راهنمای فروش'}
        description={isPurchase
          ? 'فاکتورهای خرید خوراک، دارو، تجهیزات و سایر اقلام را ثبت و وضعیت پرداخت و مانده بدهی به فروشنده را پیگیری کنید؛ در صورت نیاز، خرید را به انبار یا هزینهٔ گله متصل کنید.'
          : 'فاکتورهای فروش محصول (تخم، مرغ، جوجه و...) را ثبت، وضعیت تسویه و مانده طلب از مشتری را پیگیری و در صورت مرتبط بودن، درآمد را به گله وصل کنید.'}
        tone="info"
      />


      {/* 🆕 Deep Link banner */}
      {relatedDealIdFilter && (
        <div style={{
          padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', marginBottom: 8,
          background: 'var(--accent-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center',
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 600,
        }}>
          <span>🔍 فیلتر: فاکتورهای مربوط به معامله</span>
          <button type="button" onClick={clearRelatedDealId}
            style={{ background: 'transparent', border: 'none', color: 'var(--accent)', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, padding: '4px 8px' }}>
            ✕ پاک کردن
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {/* FilterBar */}
      <FilterBar
        filterDefs={config.filterDefs}
        sortDefs={config.sortDefs}
        filterState={filters}
        sortState={sort}
        setFilter={setFilter}
        clearFilter={clearFilter}
        setSort={setSort}
        toggleSort={toggleSort} sortStack={sortStack} appendSort={appendSort} groupBy={groupBy} setGroupBy={setGroupBy} recycleCount={recycleCount} onOpenRecycleBin={() => setRecycleOpen(true)}
        resetAll={resetAll}
        hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
        total={totalFiltered}
        count={count}
      />

      {!ms.selectionMode && list.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--dim)', textAlign: 'center', paddingBottom: 2 }}>
          برای انتخاب چندتایی، روی یک کارت نگه دارید
        </div>
      )}

      {ms.selectionMode && list.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 6 }}>
          <button type="button"
            onClick={ms.selectedIds.size === list.length ? ms.clearSelection : ms.selectAll}
            style={{ padding: '4px 10px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
            {ms.selectedIds.size === list.length ? 'لغو انتخاب همه' : 'انتخاب همه'}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {list.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty
          icon={<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round"><path d="M12 2v20M5 8h14M5 16h14"/></svg>}
          title={isPurchase ? 'خریدی ثبت نشده' : 'فروشی ثبت نشده'}
          desc={isPurchase ? 'اولین خرید خود را ثبت کنید.' : 'اولین فروش خود را ثبت کنید.'}
          action={<Btn variant="primary" onClick={openNew}>{isPurchase ? '+ ثبت خرید' : '+ ثبت فروش'}</Btn>}
        />
      ) : groupedList ? (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
          {groupedList.map(group => (
            <AccordionSection 
              key={group.title} 
              title={group.title} 
              icon="📁" 
              summary={`${fmt.count(group.items.length)} مورد`}
              defaultOpen={true}
            >
              {group.items.map((inv, i) => {
                const party = parties.find(c => c.id === inv.partyId);
                const isOpen = !ms.selectionMode && expandedId === inv.id;
                return (
                  <InvoiceCard
                    key={inv.id}
                    inv={inv}
                    partyName={party?.name}
                    isOpen={isOpen}
                    ms={ms}
                    onToggle={() => setExpandedId(isOpen ? null : inv.id)}
                    onTransferClick={() => setTransferModal({ id: inv.id, to: nextWorkflowStatus(inv.workflowStatus)! })}
                    onReopen={remaining(inv, allocations) <= 0 ? () => handleReopen(inv) : undefined}
                    onEdit={remaining(inv, allocations) > 0 && !inv.paidAt && inv.disputeStatus !== 'open' ? () => openEdit(inv) : undefined}
          onDispute={inv.disputeStatus !== 'open' && remaining(inv, allocations) > 0 ? () => setDisputeTarget(inv) : undefined}
          onResolveDispute={inv.disputeStatus === 'open' ? () => resolveDispute(inv.id) : undefined}
          onWriteOff={!inv.writtenOff && !inv.isPreorder && inv.disputeStatus !== 'open' && remaining(inv, allocations) > 0 ? async () => {
            const pendingChecks = (inv.payments || []).filter(p => p.method === 'check' && (p as any).checkStatus === 'pending');
            if (pendingChecks.length > 0) {
              toastMsg.error('این فاکتور چک پاس‌نشده دارد — ابتدا وضعیت چک را مشخص یا برگشت بزنید');
              return;
            }
            const rem = remaining(inv, allocations);
            const reason = await showPromptAsync(
              isPurchase ? 'بخشش مانده' : 'حذف بدحساب',
              isPurchase
                ? `مبلغ ${fmt.money(rem, { withUnit: false })} تومان بخشیده می‌شود و فاکتور تسویه می‌شود.`
                : `مبلغ ${fmt.money(rem, { withUnit: false })} تومان از طلب مشتری کسر شده و فاکتور بسته می‌شود.`,
              {
                label: 'علت',
                placeholder: isPurchase
                  ? 'شرح تخفیف یا توافق با فروشنده برای تسویه مانده...'
                  : 'توضیح دلیل عدم وصول یا توافق با مشتری...',
                required: true,
                multiline: true,
                rows: 2,
                danger: !isPurchase,
                confirmText: isPurchase ? 'ثبت بخشش' : 'حذف کن',
              },
            );
            if (!reason || !reason.trim()) return;
            writeOffInvoice(inv.id, rem, reason.trim());
            toastMsg.success(isPurchase ? 'بخشش مانده ثبت شد' : 'مبلغ به عنوان بدحساب حذف شد');
          } : undefined}
                    index={i}
                  />
                );
              })}
            </AccordionSection>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {list.map((inv, i) => {
            const party = parties.find(c => c.id === inv.partyId);
            const isOpen = !ms.selectionMode && expandedId === inv.id;
            return (
              <InvoiceCard
                key={inv.id}
                inv={inv}
                partyName={party?.name}
                isOpen={isOpen}
                ms={ms}
                onToggle={() => setExpandedId(isOpen ? null : inv.id)}
                onTransferClick={() => setTransferModal({ id: inv.id, to: nextWorkflowStatus(inv.workflowStatus)! })}
                onReopen={remaining(inv, allocations) <= 0 ? () => handleReopen(inv) : undefined}
                onEdit={remaining(inv, allocations) > 0 && !inv.paidAt && inv.disputeStatus !== 'open' ? () => openEdit(inv) : undefined}
          onDispute={inv.disputeStatus !== 'open' && remaining(inv, allocations) > 0 ? () => setDisputeTarget(inv) : undefined}
          onResolveDispute={inv.disputeStatus === 'open' ? () => resolveDispute(inv.id) : undefined}
          onWriteOff={!inv.writtenOff && !inv.isPreorder && inv.disputeStatus !== 'open' && remaining(inv, allocations) > 0 ? async () => {
            const pendingChecks = (inv.payments || []).filter(p => p.method === 'check' && (p as any).checkStatus === 'pending');
            if (pendingChecks.length > 0) {
              toastMsg.error('این فاکتور چک پاس‌نشده دارد — ابتدا وضعیت چک را مشخص یا برگشت بزنید');
              return;
            }
            const rem = remaining(inv, allocations);
            const reason = await showPromptAsync(
              isPurchase ? 'بخشش مانده' : 'حذف بدحساب',
              isPurchase
                ? `مبلغ ${fmt.money(rem, { withUnit: false })} تومان بخشیده می‌شود و فاکتور تسویه می‌شود.`
                : `مبلغ ${fmt.money(rem, { withUnit: false })} تومان از طلب مشتری کسر شده و فاکتور بسته می‌شود.`,
              {
                label: 'علت',
                placeholder: isPurchase
                  ? 'شرح تخفیف یا توافق با فروشنده برای تسویه مانده...'
                  : 'توضیح دلیل عدم وصول یا توافق با مشتری...',
                required: true,
                multiline: true,
                rows: 2,
                danger: !isPurchase,
                confirmText: isPurchase ? 'ثبت بخشش' : 'حذف کن',
              },
            );
            if (!reason || !reason.trim()) return;
            writeOffInvoice(inv.id, rem, reason.trim());
            toastMsg.success(isPurchase ? 'بخشش مانده ثبت شد' : 'مبلغ به عنوان بدحساب حذف شد');
          } : undefined}
                index={i}
              />
            );
          })}
        </>
      )}

      {/* ============ Modal اصلی فرم ============ */}
      <MultiSelectBar ms={ms} deleteLabel="حذف" />

      {ms.selectionMode && <div style={{ height: 90 }} />}

      <InvoiceFormModal
        open={open}
        setOpen={(v: boolean) => { if (!v) { setSaveAttempted(false); setTouchedFields(new Set()); } setOpen(v); }}
        form={form}
        setForm={setForm}
        onNewFlock={() => setNewFlockModalOpen(true)}
        isPurchase={isPurchase}
        parties={parties}
        flocks={flocks}
        whsItems={whsItems}
        deals={deals || []}
        vErrors={{ ...(saveAttempted ? vErrors : {}) }}
        err={err}
        total={total}
        paid={paid}
        rem={rem}
        save={async () => {
          setSaveAttempted(true);
          if (Object.keys(vErrors).length > 0) return;
          try {
            await save();
          } catch (e) {
            const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
            toastMsg.error('❌ ' + msg);
            setErr(msg);
          }
        }}
        addItem={addItem}
        updateItem={updateItem}
        removeItem={removeItem}
        addPayment={addPayment}
        updatePayment={updatePayment}
        removePayment={removePayment}
      />
      <DisputeModal open={!!disputeTarget} onClose={() => setDisputeTarget(null)} invoice={disputeTarget} />


      <FlockCreateStandalone
        open={newFlockModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setNewFlockModalOpen(false)}
        onSaved={(id) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, relatedFlockId: id }))}
      />

      {/* Modal انتقال workflow */}
      <TransferModal
        transferModal={transferModal}
        transferNote={transferNote}
        transferDate={transferDate}
        setTransferNote={setTransferNote}
        setTransferDate={v => { setTransferDate(v); if (transferDateError) setTransferDateError(''); }}
        dateError={transferDateError}
        onClose={() => { setTransferModal(null); setTransferNote(''); setTransferDate(''); setTransferDateError(''); }}
        onConfirm={doTransfer}
      />

      {/* چاپ */}
      {printId && (() => {
        const inv = invoices.find(i => i.id === printId);
        if (!inv) return null;
        return <InvoicePrint invoice={inv} onClose={() => setPrintId(null)} />;
      })()}
      <RecycleBinModal open={recycleOpen} onClose={() => setRecycleOpen(false)} />
    </PageContainer>
  );
}

/**
 * InvoicePrint.tsx — بخش tra

import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useSet } from '../set/store';
import { useCtc } from '../ctc/store';
import { PAYMENT_LABEL, remaining, paidSumAllocated, invoiceStatus, useTra, type Invoice } from './store';
import { toFa } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { printHTML, printTemplate } from '../../shr/utils/export';
import { formatInvoiceNumber } from './calc';

interface Props {
  invoice: Invoice;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export default function InvoicePrint({ invoice, onClose }: Props) {
  const allocations = useTra(s => s.allocations);
  const settings = useSet();
  const { contacts } = useCtc();
  const party = contacts.find(c => c.id === invoice.partyId);
  const status = invoiceStatus(invoice, allocations);
  const rem = remaining(invoice, allocations);
  const paid = paidSumAllocated(invoice, allocations);

  const isSale = invoice.type === 'sale';
  const title = isSale ? 'فاکتور فروش' : 'فاکتور خرید';

  const catLabel = (() => {
    const list = isSale
      ? [['chick','جوجه'],['egg','تخم خوراکی'],['fertile_egg','تخم نطفه‌دار'],['adult','پرنده بالغ'],['manure','کود'],['feed','دان'],['equipment','وسایل'],['broken','تخم شکسته'],['other','سایر']]
      : [['egg','تخم نطفه‌دار'],['chick','جوجه یک‌روزه'],['adult','پرنده بالغ'],['feed','دان'],['medicine','دارو'],['equipment','تجهیزات'],['other','سایر']];
    return (list.find(x => x[0] === invoice.category) || ['', invoice.category])[1];
  })();

  const buildHtml = () => {
    const farmName = settings.farm.name || 'مرغداری';
    const farmAddr = settings.farm.address || '';
    const farmPhone = settings.farm.phone || '';
    const bankInfo = settings.bank.bankName ? 'بانک ' + settings.bank.bankName : '';

    const itemsRows = invoice.items.map(it => (
      '<tr>' +
        '<td>' + (it.description || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + (it.unit || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + getGlobalFormat().count(it.quantity) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + getGlobalFormat().money(it.unitPrice, { withUnit: false }) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + getGlobalFormat().money(it.total, { withUnit: false }) + '</td>' +
      '</tr>'
    )).join('');

    const paymentsRows = (invoice.payments || []).map(p => (
      '<tr>' +
        '<td>' + PAYMENT_LABEL[p.method] + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + (p.date ? getGlobalFormat().date(p.date) : '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + (p.checkNo ? p.checkNo : '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + (p.bank ? p.bank : '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + getGlobalFormat().money(p.amount, { withUnit: false }) + '</td>' +
      '</tr>'
    )).join('');

    const statusBadge = status === 'paid'
      ? '<span class="badge badge-green">پرداخت‌شده</span>'
      : status === 'partial'
      ? '<span class="badge badge-amber">نیمه‌پرداخت</span>'
      : '<span class="badge badge-red">پرداخت‌نشده</span>';

    const body = `
      <div class="header">
        <div>
          <h1>${farmName}</h1>
          <div class="farm-info">
            ${farmAddr ? farmAddr + '<br>' : ''}
            ${farmPhone ? 'تلفن — ' + farmPhone : ''}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="text-align: left;">
          <h2>${title}</h2>
          <div class="farm-info">
            شماره: ${formatInvoiceNumber(invoice.number)}<br>
            تاریخ: ${getGlobalFormat().date(invoice.date)}<br>
            ${invoice.dueDate ? 'سرسید — ' + getGlobalFormat().date(invoice.dueDate) : ''}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="meta">
        <div>
          <b>${isSale ? 'مشتری:' : 'فروشنده:'}</b> ${party?.name || '—'}<br>
          ${party?.phone ? 'تلفن — ' + party.phone : ''}<br>
          ${party?.address ? party.address : ''}
        </div>
        <div style="text-align: left;">
          ${statusBadge}<br>
          <span style="font-size: 11px; color: #475569;">دسته: ${catLabel}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <table>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th style="width: 40%;">شرح</th>
            <th style="width: 12%;">واحد</th>
            <th style="width: 12%;">تعداد</th>
            <th style="width: 18%;">قیمت واحد (ت)</th>
            <th style="width: 18%;">جمع (ت)</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          ${itemsRows || '<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center;color:#94a3b8;">موردی نیست</td></tr>'}
        </tbody>
      </table>

      <table style="width: 60%; margin-right: auto; margin-left: auto;">
        <tr><td>جمع کل اقلام:</td><td style="text-align: left;">${getGlobalFormat().money(invoice.items.reduce((a, x) => a + x.total, 0))}</td></tr>
        ${(invoice.discount ||
          0) > 0 ? '<tr><td>تخفیف:</td><td style="text-align: left;">' + getGlobalFormat().money(invoice.discount || 0) + '</td></tr>' : ''}
        ${(invoice.shipping ||
          0) > 0 ? '<tr><td>حمل:</td><td style="text-align: left;">' + getGlobalFormat().money(invoice.shipping || 0) + '</td></tr>' : ''}
        <tr class="total-row"><td>قیمت نهایی:</td><td style="text-align: left;">${getGlobalFormat().money(invoice.total)}</td></tr>
        <tr><td>پرداخت‌شده:</td><td style="text-align: left;">${getGlobalFormat().money(paid)}</td></tr>
        ${rem > 0 ? '<tr class="total-row"><td>مانده:</td><td style="text-align: left; color: #d97706;">' + getGlobalFormat().money(rem) + '</td></tr>' : ''}
      </table>

      ${(invoice.payments || []).length > 0 ? `
        <h3 style="margin-top: 14px;">پرداخت‌ها</h3>
        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>روش</th>
              <th>تاریخ</th>
              <th>شماره چک</th>
              <th>بانک</th>
              <th>مبلغ (ت)</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>${paymentsRows}</tbody>
        </table>
      ` : ''}

      ${bankInfo ? '<div style="margin-top: 10px; font-size: 11px; color: #475569;">' + bankInfo + (settings.bank.cardNo ? ' — کارت: ' + getGlobalFormat().code(settings.bank.cardNo) : '') + (settings.bank.sheba ? ' — شبا: ' + settings.bank.sheba : '') + '</div>' : ''}

      ${invoice.notes ? '<div style="margin-top: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; background: #f8fafc; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 11px; line-height: 36.8;"><b>یادداشت:</b> ' + invoice.notes + '</div>' : ''}

      <div class="signature">
        <div class="sig-box">مهر و امضای ${isSale ? 'فروشنده' : 'خریدار'}</div>
        <div class="sig-box">مهر و امضای ${isSale ? 'خریدار' : 'فروشنده'}</div>
      </div>

      <div class="footer">
        ${farmName} — این فاکتور از نرم‌افزار مدیریت مرغداری صادر شده است
      </div>
    `;

    return printTemplate(title + ' — ' + formatInvoiceNumber(invoice.number), body);
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    printHTML(buildHtml());
  };

  return (
    <div role="button" tabIndex={0}
      onClick={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }}
      style={{
        position: 'fixed', inset: 0,
        background: 'var(--overlay)',
        zIndex: 110,
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-end', justifyContent: 'center'
      }}
    >
      <div style={{
        background: 'var(--card-solid)',
        width: '100%', maxWidth: 480, maxHeight: '85vh',
        borderTopLeftRadius: 'var(--r-2xl)',
        borderTopRightRadius: 'var(--r-2xl)',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column'
      }}>
        <div style={{
          padding: '14px 20px',
          borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10
        }}>
          <div style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 'var(--fs-lg)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
            پیش‌نمایش {title}
          </div>
          <button aria-label="حذف"
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{
              width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
              background: 'var(--btn-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)',
              color: 'var(--muted)', cursor: 'pointer',
              display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
              fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)'
            }}
          >✕</button>
        </div>

        <div style={{
          flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto',
          padding: '16px 20px',
          background: 'var(--input-bg)'
        }}>
          {/* پیش‌نمایش A4 در موبایل */}
          <div style={{
            background: '#fff', color: '#0f172a',
            padding: '20px',
            borderRadius: 8,
            boxShadow: '0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.15)',
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)'
          }}>
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 10 }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', fontWeight: 700 }}>{settings.farm.name || 'مرغداری'}</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#64748b', marginTop: 4 }}>{title} — {formatInvoiceNumber(invoice.number)}</div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 10, paddingBottom: 8, borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0' }}>
              <span>{party?.name || '—'}</span>
              <span>{getGlobalFormat().date(invoice.date)}</span>
            </div>

            <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', fontSize: 12 }}>
              <thead>
                <tr style={{ background: '#f1f5f9' }}>
                  <th style={{ padding: 4, border: '1px solid #cbd5e1', textAlign: 'right' }}>شرح</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: 4, border: '1px solid #cbd5e1', textAlign: 'right' }}>تعداد</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: 4, border: '1px solid #cbd5e1', textAlign: 'right' }}>جمع</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {invoice.items.map(it => (
                  <tr key={it.id}>
                    <td style={{ padding: 4, border: '1px solid #cbd5e1' }}>{it.description}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: 4, border: '1px solid #cbd5e1' }}>{getGlobalFormat().num(it.quantity)}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: 4, border: '1px solid #cbd5e1' }}>{getGlobalFormat().money(it.total, { withUnit: false })}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginTop: 10, padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: '#f1f5f9', borderRadius: 6, fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
              <span>قیمت نهایی:</span>
              <span>{getGlobalFormat().money(invoice.total, { withUnit: false })} تومان</span>
            </div>

            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#94a3b8', textAlign: 'center', marginTop: 10 }}>
              پیش‌نمایش — برای مشاهده کامل، چاپ کنید
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{
          padding: '12px 20px 20px',
          borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',
          display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'row-reverse', gap: 8
        }}>
          <button
            onClick={handlePrint}
            style={{
              flex: 1, height: 40,
              background: 'var(--accent)', color: 'var(--avatar-text)',
              border: 'none', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
              fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 600,
              cursor: 'pointer'
            }}
          >🖨 چاپ / ذخیره PDF</button>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{
              flex: 1, height: 40,
              background: 'var(--btn-bg)', color: 'var(--muted)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
              fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 600,
              cursor: 'pointer'
            }}
          >لغو</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { Tag } from '../../shr/components/ui';
/**
 * ReceivablesPage — مطالبات/بدهی با aging
 */
import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { daysUntilDue, dueLabel, computeUpcoming, computeUpcomingDeals, dueTone } from './helpers';
import DeferModal from './components/DeferModal';
import InvoicePayModal from './components/InvoicePayModal';
import DeferHistoryModal from './components/DeferHistoryModal';
import ReminderModal from './components/ReminderModal';
import { useTra, remaining, paidSumAllocated, WORKFLOW_LABEL, DEAL_LABEL, computeDealBalance, dealDaysUntilDue, isDealOpen, computeUnappliedAdvances, type Invoice, type Deal, type Deferral } from './store';
import { useCtc } from '../ctc/store';
import { Btn, Empty, PageContainer } from '../../shr/components/ui';
import EntityLink from '../../shr/components/EntityLink';
import { toFa } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { showSuccess, showConfirmAsync } from '../../cor/store/dialog';
import { toastMsg } from '../../cor/store/toast';
import { Line, Row, tab, CAT_LABEL } from './helpers';
import { useFilterSort, FilterBar, getTraReceivablesConfig, getTraDealsConfig } from '../../shr/filter';
import MultiPayModal from './components/MultiPayModal';
import DealPayModal from './components/DealPayModal';
import SummaryBox from './components/SummaryBox';
import StatementModal from './components/StatementModal';
import ApplyAdvanceModal from './components/ApplyAdvanceModal';
import AgingBuckets from './components/AgingBuckets';
import ChecksModal from './components/ChecksModal';
import { agingBucketFromDue } from './formulas';
import { agingBucketFromDeal, computeOverpayment , getTodayJalali} from './calc';
import HelpBanner from '../../shr/components/HelpBanner';


export default function ReceivablesPage({ active = true }: { active?: boolean } = {}) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { invoices, deals, updateInvoice, updateDeal, allocations, addReminder } = useTra();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { contacts } = useCtc();
  const [multiPayOpen, setMultiPayOpen] = useState(false);
  const [multiPayPrefill, setMultiPayPrefill] = useState<{ partyId: string; invoiceId: string } | null>(null);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<'sale' | 'purchase' | 'deal'>('sale');
  const [deferModal, setDeferModal] = useState<{ kind: 'invoice' | 'deal'; id: string; oldDate: string } | null>(null);
  const [deferDate, setDeferDate] = useState('');
  const [deferReason, setDeferReason] = useState('');
  const [showUpcoming, setShowUpcoming] = useState(false);
  const [dealPayTarget, setDealPayTarget] = useState<Deal | null>(null);
  const [invoicePayTarget, setInvoicePayTarget] = useState<Invoice | null>(null);
  const [applyAdvanceTarget, setApplyAdvanceTarget] = useState<Invoice | null>(null);
  const [statementOpen, setStatementOpen] = useState(false);
  const [checksOpen, setChecksOpen] = useState(false);
  const [reminderInvoiceId, setReminderInvoiceId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [reminderDealId, setReminderDealId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [historyTarget, setHistoryTarget] = useState<{ kind: 'invoice' | 'deal'; id: string; label: string; deferrals: Deferral[] | undefined } | null>(null);

  const openInvoices = useMemo(
    () => invoices.filter(i => i.type === kind && remaining(i, allocations) > 0 && i.disputeStatus !== 'open'),
    [invoices, allocations, kind]
  );

  const openDeals = useMemo(
    () => deals.filter(d => isDealOpen(d, invoices)),
    [deals, invoices]
  );




  // فیلتر/مرتب
  const config = useMemo(() => {
    const partyNames: Record<string, string> = {};
    openInvoices.forEach(i => {
      if (i.partyId && !partyNames[i.partyId]) {
        const c = contacts.find(x => x.id === i.partyId);
        if (c) partyNames[i.partyId] = c.name;
      }
    });
    return getTraReceivablesConfig({ partyNames });
  }, [openInvoices, contacts]);

  // 🆕 B7: config معاملات — برای تب «معاملات»
  const dealConfig = useMemo(() => {
    const partyNames: Record<string, string> = {};
    openDeals.forEach(d => {
      if (d.partyId && !partyNames[d.partyId]) {
        const c = contacts.find(x => x.id === d.partyId);
        if (c) partyNames[d.partyId] = c.name;
      }
    });
    return getTraDealsConfig({ partyNames });
  }, [openDeals, contacts]);
  const { filtered, filters, setFilter, clearFilter, sort, setSort, toggleSort,
          resetAll, hasActiveFilters, total: totalFiltered, count, sortStack, appendSort } = useFilterSort<Invoice>({
    items: openInvoices,
    filters: config.filterDefs,
    sorts: config.sortDefs,
    persistKey: config.persistKey,
    initialSort: config.initialSort,
  });

  // 🆕 B7: filter/sort موازی برای معاملات
  const dealFS = useFilterSort<Deal>({
    items: openDeals,
    filters: dealConfig.filterDefs,
    sorts: dealConfig.sortDefs,
    persistKey: dealConfig.persistKey,
    initialSort: dealConfig.initialSort,
  });

  const upcoming = useMemo(() => computeUpcoming(openInvoices), [openInvoices]);
  const upcomingDeals = useMemo(() => computeUpcomingDeals(openDeals), [openDeals]);



  // 🆕 Deal aging buckets (Phase B3) — same pattern as invoice

  const totalOpen = filtered.reduce((a, inv) => a + remaining(inv, allocations), 0);
  const totalInvoiced = filtered.reduce((a, inv) => a + (inv.total || 0), 0);
  const settledAmount = Math.max(0, totalInvoiced - totalOpen);
  const dueSoonAmount = upcoming.reduce((a, u) => a + remaining(u.inv, allocations), 0);
  const overdueCount = openInvoices.filter(i => {
    const d = daysUntilDue(i);
    return d !== null && d < 0;
  }).length;
  const soonCount = openInvoices.filter(i => {
    const d = daysUntilDue(i);
    return d !== null && d >= 0 && d <= 7;
  }).length;

  // Deal computations (Phase 1)
  const dealTotalOpen = openDeals.reduce((s, d) => s + computeDealBalance(d).balance, 0);
  // 🆕 «کل معاملات» = Σ myShare (سهم طرف)، نه مانده — استاندارد Odoo/SAP FI-AR
  const dealTotalMyShare = openDeals.reduce((s, d) => s + computeDealBalance(d).myShare, 0);
  // 🆕 Stage 3-4: پرداخت‌های خالص‌شده معاملات (settledAmount)
  const dealSettledAmount = openDeals.reduce((s, d) => {
    const bal = computeDealBalance(d);
    return s + Math.max(0, bal.paidIn - bal.paidOut);
  }, 0);
  // 🆕 Stage 3-4: معاملات نزدیک سرسید (۰-۷ روز)
  const dealDueSoonAmount = openDeals.reduce((s, d) => {
    const days = dealDaysUntilDue(d);
    if (days === null || days < 0 || days > 7) return s;
    return s + Math.abs(computeDealBalance(d).balance);
  }, 0);
  const dealOverdueCount = openDeals.filter(d => {
    const days = dealDaysUntilDue(d);
    return days !== null && days < 0;
  }).length;
  const dealSoonCount = openDeals.filter(d => {
    const days = dealDaysUntilDue(d);
    return days !== null && days >= 0 && days <= 7;
  }).length;
  const effectiveTotal = kind === 'deal' ? dealTotalOpen : totalOpen;
  const effectiveOverdueCount = kind === 'deal' ? dealOverdueCount : overdueCount;
  const effectiveSoonCount = kind === 'deal' ? dealSoonCount : soonCount;


  const openDefer = (inv: Invoice) => {
    const old = inv.dueDate || inv.date || getTodayJalali();
    setDeferModal({ kind: 'invoice', id: inv.id, oldDate: old });
    setDeferDate(old);
    setDeferReason('');
  };

  const openDealDefer = (d: Deal) => {
    const old = d.dueDate || d.date || getTodayJalali();
    setDeferModal({ kind: 'deal', id: d.id, oldDate: old });
    setDeferDate(old);
    setDeferReason('');
  };

  const doDefer = () => {
    if (!deferModal || !deferDate) return;
    const newDeferral: Deferral = {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      fromDate: deferModal.oldDate,
      toDate: deferDate,
      reason: deferReason,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    if (deferModal.kind === 'invoice') {
      const inv = invoices.find(i => i.id === deferModal.id);
      if (!inv) return;
      updateInvoice(inv.id, {
        dueDate: deferDate,
        deferrals: [...(inv.deferrals || []), newDeferral],
        remindersMuted: false,
      });
    } else {
      const d = deals.find(x => x.id === deferModal.id);
      if (!d) return;
      updateDeal(d.id, {
        dueDate: deferDate,
        deferrals: [...(d.deferrals || []), newDeferral],
      });
    }
    showSuccess('سرسید به تعویق افتاد');
    setDeferModal(null);
  };

  const handleVoidLatestDeferral = async () => {
    if (!historyTarget) return;
    const defs = historyTarget.deferrals || [];
    if (defs.length === 0) return;

    const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
      'حذف آخرین تعویق',
      'آخرین تعویق حذف شود؟ تاریخ سرسید به تعویق قبلی بازخواهد گشت.',
      { danger: true, confirmText: 'حذف' }
    );
    if (!ok) return;

    const remaining = defs.slice(0, -1);
    const newDueDate = remaining.length > 0
      ? remaining[remaining.length - 1].toDate
      : defs[0].fromDate;

    try {
      if (historyTarget.kind === 'invoice') {
        updateInvoice(historyTarget.id, { deferrals: remaining, dueDate: newDueDate });
      } else {
        updateDeal(historyTarget.id, { deferrals: remaining, dueDate: newDueDate });
      }
      toastMsg.success('آخرین تعویق حذف شد');
      setHistoryTarget(null);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[void-deferral]', e);
      toastMsg.error('خطا در حذف تعویق');
    }
  };

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      {/* سوییچ نوع — فشرده */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, marginBottom: 4 }}>
        <button onClick={() => setKind('sale')} style={tab(kind === 'sale')}>
          📥 مطالبات
        </button>
        <button onClick={() => setKind('purchase')} style={tab(kind === 'purchase')}>
          📤 بدهی
        </button>
        <button onClick={() => setKind('deal')} style={tab(kind === 'deal')}>
          🤝 معاملات
        </button>
      </div>

                {/* Actions — به سبک tab */}
                <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: kind === 'deal' ? '1fr 1fr' : 'repeat(3, 1fr)', gap: 6, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                  {kind !== 'deal' && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => { setMultiPayPrefill(null); setMultiPayOpen(true); }}
                      style={tab(multiPayOpen)}
                    >
                      {kind === 'sale' ? 'دریافت گروهی' : 'پرداخت گروهی'}
                    </button>
                  )}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setStatementOpen(true)}
                    style={tab(statementOpen)}
                  >
                    صورت‌حساب
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setChecksOpen(true)}
                    style={tab(checksOpen)}
                  >
                    چک‌ها
                  </button>
                </div>

      {/* خلاصه — یه خط */}
      <SummaryBox kind={kind} totalInvoiced={kind === 'deal' ? dealTotalMyShare : totalInvoiced} totalOpen={effectiveTotal} settledAmount={kind === 'deal' ? dealSettledAmount : settledAmount} dueSoonAmount={kind === 'deal' ? dealDueSoonAmount : dueSoonAmount} openCount={kind === 'deal' ? openDeals.length : openInvoices.length} />

      {/* FilterBar */}
      {kind === 'deal' ? (
        <FilterBar
          filterDefs={dealConfig.filterDefs}
          sortDefs={dealConfig.sortDefs}
          filterState={dealFS.filters}
          sortState={dealFS.sort}
          setFilter={dealFS.setFilter}
          clearFilter={dealFS.clearFilter}
          setSort={dealFS.setSort}
          toggleSort={dealFS.toggleSort}
          sortStack={dealFS.sortStack}
          appendSort={dealFS.appendSort}
          resetAll={dealFS.resetAll}
          hasActiveFilters={dealFS.hasActiveFilters}
          total={dealFS.total}
          count={dealFS.count}
        />
      ) : (
        <FilterBar
          filterDefs={config.filterDefs}
          sortDefs={config.sortDefs}
          filterState={filters}
          sortState={sort}
          setFilter={setFilter}
          clearFilter={clearFilter}
          setSort={setSort}
          toggleSort={toggleSort}
          sortStack={sortStack}
          appendSort={appendSort}
          resetAll={resetAll}
          hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
          total={totalFiltered}
          count={count}
        />
      )}

      {/* خالی */}
      {effectiveTotal === 0 ? (
        <Empty
          icon={<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round"><path d="M3 3v18h18"/><path d="m19 9-5 5-4-4-3 3"/></svg>}
          title={kind === 'sale' ? 'طلبی وجود ندارد' : kind === 'deal' ? 'معامله باز وجود ندارد' : 'بدهی وجود ندارد'}
          desc={kind === 'deal' ? 'همه‌ی معاملات تسویه شده‌اند.' : 'همه‌ی فاکتورها تسویه شده‌اند.'}
        />
      ) : null}

          {/* Deal buckets (Phase B3) */}
      {kind === 'deal' && effectiveTotal !== 0 ? (
        <>
          <AgingBuckets
            items={dealFS.filtered}
            bucketOf={(d) => agingBucketFromDeal(d)}
            sumOf={(d) => computeDealBalance(d).balance}
renderSummary={(d) => {
              const bal = computeDealBalance(d);
              const party = contacts.find(c => c.id === d.partyId);
              const days = dealDaysUntilDue(d);
              const tone = dueTone(days);
              const dueColor = tone === 'green' ? 'var(--accent)' : tone === 'red' ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--warn)';
              return (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 800, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                        {party?.name || '—'}
                      </span>
                      {(() => {
                        const _c = Number(party?.creditBalance) || 0;
                        if (_c <= 0.5) return null;
                        return (
                          <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', fontWeight: 700, padding: '2px 6px', borderRadius: 4, color: 'var(--accent)', background: 'var(--accent-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                            ⚡ {fmt.count(_c)}
                          </span>
                        );
                      })()}
                    </div>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 800, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', flexShrink: 0, color: bal.balance > 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : bal.balance < 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)' }}>
                      {fmt.money(Math.abs(bal.balance))}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 8 }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4, flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--muted)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>
                        {d.description || '—'}
                      </span>
                      {days !== null && (
                        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 600, color: dueColor }}>
                          {dueLabel(days)}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--dim)', fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                      {d.dealNumber || ''}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            }}
renderDetails={(d) => {
                  const bal = computeDealBalance(d);
                  const balColor = bal.balance > 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : bal.balance < 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)';
                  return (
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0 }}>
                      <div>
                        <Line l="فروش کل" v={fmt.money(bal.totalSales)} />
                        <Line l="کمیسیون" v={fmt.money(bal.commission)} />
                        <Line l="سهم شما" v={fmt.money(bal.myShare)} />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <Line l="دریافت‌شده" v={fmt.money(bal.paidIn)} />
                        <Line l="باقی‌مانده" v={<span style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: balColor }}>{fmt.money(Math.abs(bal.balance))}ومان</span>} />
                      </div>
                      {(d.dueDate || (d.deferrals && d.deferrals.length > 0) || d.nextReminderAt || (d.reminderLog && d.reminderLog.length > 0)) && (
                        <div>
                          {d.dueDate && <Line l="سرسید" v={fmt.date(d.dueDate)} />}
                          {d.deferrals && d.deferrals.length > 0 && (
                            <Line l="⏰ تعویق‌ها" v={
                              <button type="button" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setHistoryTarget({ kind: 'deal', id: d.id, label: d.dealNumber || d.id.slice(0,6), deferrals: d.deferrals }); }} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: 'none', color: 'var(--accent)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer', textDecoration: 'underline', fontFamily: 'inherit', padding: 0 }}>
                                {fmt.count(d.deferrals.length)} بار (مشاهده تاریخچه)
                              </button>
                            } />
                          )}
                          {d.reminderLog && d.reminderLog.length > 0 && (
                            <Line l="آخرین یادآوری" v={`${fmt.date(d.reminderLog[d.reminderLog.length - 1].date)}${d.reminderLog[d.reminderLog.length - 1].methodLabel ? ' — ' + d.reminderLog[d.reminderLog.length - 1].methodLabel : ''}`} />
                          )}
                          {d.nextReminderAt && <Line l="یادآوری بعدی" v={fmt.date(d.nextReminderAt)} />}
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)', paddingTop: 12, marginTop: 8 }}>
                        {bal.balance > 0 ? <Btn size="sm" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setDealPayTarget(d); }}>📥 ثبت دریافت</Btn> : <Btn size="sm" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setDealPayTarget(d); }}>📤 ثبت پرداخت</Btn>}
                        <Btn size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setReminderDealId(d.id); }}>📨 یادآوری</Btn>
                        <Btn size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); openDealDefer(d); }}>⏰ تعویق</Btn>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                }}
          />
        </>
      ) : null}


      {/* Buckets — فقط اگه پر باشن */}
      {kind !== 'deal' && effectiveTotal > 0 ? (
        <AgingBuckets
          items={filtered}
          bucketOf={(inv) => agingBucketFromDue(inv)}
          sumOf={(inv) => remaining(inv, allocations)}
renderSummary={(inv) => {
            const party = contacts.find(c => c.id === inv.partyId);
            const dUntil = daysUntilDue(inv);
            const subject = inv.items?.[0]?.description || CAT_LABEL[inv.category] || inv.category || '—';
            const verb = inv.type === 'sale' ? 'فروش' : 'خرید';
            const rem = remaining(inv, allocations);
            const balColor = rem > 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : rem < 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)';
            const tone = dueTone(dUntil);
            const dueColor = tone === 'green' ? 'var(--accent)' : tone === 'red' ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--warn)';

            return (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 800, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                      {party?.name || '—'}
                    </span>
                    {(() => {
                      const _c = Number(party?.creditBalance) || 0;
                      if (_c <= 0.5) return null;
                      return (
                        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', fontWeight: 700, padding: '2px 6px', borderRadius: 4, color: 'var(--accent)', background: 'var(--accent-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                          ⚡ {fmt.count(_c)}
                        </span>
                      );
                    })()}
                  </div>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 800, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', flexShrink: 0, color: balColor }}>
                    {fmt.money(rem)}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 8 }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4, flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--muted)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>
                      {verb} {subject}
                    </span>
                    {dUntil !== null && (
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 600, color: dueColor }}>
                        {dueLabel(dUntil)}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                    <EntityLink
                      type="invoice"
                      id={inv.id}
                      label={inv.number || '—'}
                      tab={inv.type === 'sale' ? 'sales' : 'purchases'}
                      edit
                    />
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          }}
renderDetails={(inv) => {
            const checkPending = (inv.payments || []).filter(p => p.method === 'check' && (p.status === 'pending' || p.status === 'in_transit'));
            const relatedDeal = inv.relatedDealId ? deals.find(d => d.id === inv.relatedDealId) : null;
            const isLockedFromSettlement = !!inv.relatedSettlementId;
            const op = computeOverpayment(inv, allocations);
            const rem = remaining(inv, allocations);
            const balColor = rem > 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : rem < 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)';
            return (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0 }}>
                {isLockedFromSettlement && (
                  <div style={{ padding: '6px 8px', background: 'var(--warn-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--warn-border, rgba(234,88,12,.35))', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--warn)', fontWeight: 600, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>از تسویه <span style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>🔒</span></span>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>برای تغییر، تسویه را ویرایش کنید</span>
                  </div>
                )}
                <div>
                  <Line l="جمع فاکتور" v={fmt.money(inv.total, { withUnit: false }) + ' تومان'} />
                  {op > 0.5 && <Line l="پیش‌پرداخت" v={fmt.money(op, { withUnit: false }) + ' تومان'} />}
                </div>
                <div>
                  <Line l="پرداخت‌شده" v={fmt.money(paidSumAllocated(inv, allocations), { withUnit: false }) + ' تومان'} />
                  <Line l="باقی‌مانده" v={<span style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: balColor }}>{fmt.money(rem, { withUnit: false })} تومان</span>} />
                </div>
                {(inv.dueDate || (inv.deferrals && inv.deferrals.length > 0) || inv.nextReminderAt || (inv.reminderLog && inv.reminderLog.length > 0)) && (
                  <div>
                    {inv.dueDate && <Line l="سرسید" v={fmt.date(inv.dueDate)} />}
                    {inv.deferrals && inv.deferrals.length > 0 && (
                      <Line l="⏰ تعویق‌ها" v={<button type="button" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setHistoryTarget({ kind: 'invoice', id: inv.id, label: inv.number || inv.id.slice(0,6), deferrals: inv.deferrals }); }} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: 'none', color: 'var(--accent)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer', textDecoration: 'underline', fontFamily: 'inherit', padding: 0 }}>{fmt.count(inv.deferrals.length)} بار (مشاهده تاریخچه)</button>} />
                    )}
                    {inv.reminderLog && inv.reminderLog.length > 0 && <Line l="آخرین یادآوری" v={`${fmt.date(inv.reminderLog[inv.reminderLog.length - 1].date)}${inv.reminderLog[inv.reminderLog.length - 1].methodLabel ? ' — ' + inv.reminderLog[inv.reminderLog.length - 1].methodLabel : ''}`} />}
                    {inv.nextReminderAt && <Line l="یادآوری بعدی" v={fmt.date(inv.nextReminderAt)} />}
                  </div>
                )}
                {(inv.workflowStatus || relatedDeal || inv.relatedFlockId || checkPending.length > 0) && (
                  <div>
                    {inv.workflowStatus && <Line l="وضعیت" v={WORKFLOW_LABEL[inv.workflowStatus].replace(/^[^؀-ۿA-Za-z0-9]+/u, '')} />}
                    {relatedDeal && <Line l="معامله" v={relatedDeal.dealNumber || relatedDeal.id.slice(0, 6)} />}
                    {inv.relatedFlockId && <Line l="گله" v={inv.items?.[0]?.flockName || 'مشاهده'} />}
                    {checkPending.length > 0 && <Line l="چک‌ها" v={`${fmt.count(checkPending.length)} در جریان (${fmt.money(checkPending.reduce((acc, p) => acc + (p.amount || 0), 0))})`} />}
                  </div>
                )}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)', paddingTop: 12, marginTop: 8 }}>
                  
                  {!isLockedFromSettlement && rem > 0 && (
                    <Btn size="sm" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setInvoicePayTarget(inv); }}>
                      {inv.type === 'sale' ? '📥 ثبت دریافت' : '📤 ثبت پرداخت'}
                    </Btn>
                  )}
                  {!isLockedFromSettlement && rem > 0 && inv.partyId && computeUnappliedAdvances(inv.partyId) > 0.5 && (
                    <Btn size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setApplyAdvanceTarget(inv); }}>⚡ پیش‌پرداخت</Btn>
                  )}
                  <Btn size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setReminderInvoiceId(inv.id); }}>📨 یادآوری</Btn>
                  <Btn size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); openDefer(inv); }}>⏰ تعویق</Btn>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          }}
        />
      ) : null}

      {/* Modal تعویق */}
      <ReminderModal
        open={!!reminderInvoiceId || !!reminderDealId}
        onClose={() => { setReminderInvoiceId(null); setReminderDealId(null); }}
        invoiceId={reminderInvoiceId}
        dealId={reminderDealId}
      />
      <DeferHistoryModal
        open={!!historyTarget}
        onClose={() => setHistoryTarget(null)}
        deferrals={historyTarget?.deferrals}
        invoiceNumber={historyTarget?.label || '—'}
        kind={historyTarget?.kind}
        onVoidLatest={handleVoidLatestDeferral}
      />
      <DeferModal
        deferModal={deferModal}
        onClose={() => setDeferModal(null)}
        deferDate={deferDate}
        setDeferDate={setDeferDate}
        deferReason={deferReason}
        setDeferReason={setDeferReason}
        onConfirm={doDefer}
      />
      <InvoicePayModal
        open={!!invoicePayTarget}
        onClose={() => setInvoicePayTarget(null)}
        invoice={invoicePayTarget}
      />
      <ApplyAdvanceModal
        open={!!applyAdvanceTarget}
        onClose={() => setApplyAdvanceTarget(null)}
        invoice={applyAdvanceTarget}
      />
      <DealPayModal
        open={!!dealPayTarget}
        onClose={() => setDealPayTarget(null)}
        deal={dealPayTarget}
      />
          {kind !== 'deal' && (
            <MultiPayModal
              open={multiPayOpen}
              onClose={() => { setMultiPayOpen(false); setMultiPayPrefill(null); }}
              kind={kind}
              prefillPartyId={multiPayPrefill?.partyId}
              prefillInvoiceId={multiPayPrefill?.invoiceId}
            />
          )}
      <StatementModal
        open={statementOpen}
        onClose={() => setStatementOpen(false)}
        kind={kind}
      />
      <ChecksModal
        open={checksOpen}
        onClose={() => setChecksOpen(false)}
      />
    </PageContainer>
  );
}

/**
 * applyDeal.ts — منطق اعمال حرکات معامله (whs + flock)
 * جدا شده از DealsPage برای تست‌پذیری
 */
import { useWhs } from '../whs/store';
import { useFlk } from '../flk/store';
import { useInc } from '../inc/store';
import type { Deal, DealGood, DealDelivery } from './types';
import { getUOMUnit } from '../../shr/units/uom';
import type { Item } from '../whs/store';

/** فقط فیلدهای موردنیاز از فرم معامله */
export interface DealFormState {
  partyId: string;
  dealNumber: string;
  date: string;
  goods: DealGood[];
  deliveries: DealDelivery[];
}


  function getBaseQuantity(good: DealGood, qty: number, whsItems: Item[]): number {
    const item = whsItems.find(i => i.id === good.linkedItemId);
    const cat = good.category || item?.category;
    if (!cat) return qty;
    const uom = getUOMUnit(cat, good.unit);
    if (uom && uom.factor !== null) {
      return qty * uom.factor;
    }
    return qty;
  }

  export function applyDealMovements(formState: DealFormState, oldDeal?: Deal): void {
  const whs = useWhs.getState();
  const oldDeliveries = oldDeal?.deliveries || [];
  const partyId = formState.partyId || '';
  const consignmentLoc = partyId ? `consignment:${partyId}` : 'stock';

  const getOwnership = (dv: DealDelivery): 'none' | 'mine' | 'theirs' => {
    if (dv.type === 'in') return 'theirs';
    if (dv.ownership) return dv.ownership;
    return dv.whsEnabled === true ? 'theirs' : 'none';
  };

  // 1. Delete movements for removed/disabled deliveries
  for (const old of oldDeliveries) {
    const cur = formState.deliveries.find(d => d.id === old.id);
    const shouldRemove = !cur || getOwnership(cur) === 'none';
    if (shouldRemove) {
      if (old.whsMovementId) {
        try { whs.deleteMovement(old.whsMovementId); } catch (e) { console.error('[deals->whs] delete out failed:', e); }
      }
      if (old.whsMovementIdIn) {
        try { whs.deleteMovement(old.whsMovementIdIn); } catch (e) { console.error('[deals->whs] delete in failed:', e); }
      }
      if (old.flockDeductedQuantity && old.flockSourceId) {
        const flock = useFlk.getState().flocks.find(f => f.id === old.flockSourceId);
        if (flock) {
          try { useFlk.getState().update(flock.id, { currentCount: (flock.currentCount || 0) - old.flockDeductedQuantity }); } catch (e) { console.error('[deals->flk] reverse failed:', e); }
        }
      }
      if (cur) { cur.whsMovementId = undefined; cur.whsMovementIdIn = undefined; cur.flockDeductedQuantity = undefined; cur.flockSourceId = undefined; }
    }
  }

  // 2. Delete movements for changed deliveries (will be re-added below)
  for (const dv of formState.deliveries) {
    const old = oldDeliveries.find(d => d.id === dv.id);
    if (!old) continue;
    const ownChanged = getOwnership(old) !== getOwnership(dv);
    const fieldsChanged = old.quantity !== dv.quantity || old.type !== dv.type || old.date !== dv.date || (old.time || '') !== (dv.time || '');
    if (!ownChanged && !fieldsChanged) continue;
    if (old.whsMovementId) {
      try { whs.deleteMovement(old.whsMovementId); } catch (e) { console.error('[deals->whs] delete out failed:', e); }
      dv.whsMovementId = undefined;
    }
    if (old.whsMovementIdIn) {
      try { whs.deleteMovement(old.whsMovementIdIn); } catch (e) { console.error('[deals->whs] delete in failed:', e); }
      dv.whsMovementIdIn = undefined;
    }
      
      // 🆕 Phase 1.6: reverse flock for changed
      if (old.flockDeductedQuantity && old.flockSourceId) {
        const flock = useFlk.getState().flocks.find(f => f.id === old.flockSourceId);
        if (flock) {
          try { useFlk.getState().update(flock.id, { currentCount: (flock.currentCount || 0) - old.flockDeductedQuantity }); } catch (e) { console.error('[deals->flk] reverse failed:', e); }
        }
      }
      dv.flockDeductedQuantity = undefined;
      dv.flockSourceId = undefined;

  }

  // 3. Pre-flight: چک موجودی برای همه movementها (atomic — قبل از هر حرکتی)
  for (const dv of formState.deliveries) {
    const own = getOwnership(dv);
    if (own === 'none') continue;
    if (dv.type === 'loss') continue;
    const good = formState.goods.find(g => g.id === dv.goodId);
    const hasFlockSource = !!(good?.existingFlockId || good?.hatchId);
    if (own === 'mine' && !good?.linkedItemId && !hasFlockSource) {
      throw new Error('برای امانت، کالا باید منبع مشخص داشته باشد (گله، هچری یا انبار): «' + (good?.name || '—') + '»');
    }
    if (good?.linkedItemId && (own === 'mine' || dv.type === 'out')) {
      const item = whs.items.find(i => i.id === good.linkedItemId);
      if (item) {
        const available = item.stockByLocation?.['stock'] ?? item.currentStock ?? 0;
        const reqBase = getBaseQuantity(good, dv.quantity, whs.items);
        if (available < reqBase) {
          throw new Error('موجودی «' + good.name + '» کافی نیست — موجودی: ' + available + '، درخواستی: ' + reqBase);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 4. Add movements for enabled deliveries
  for (const dv of formState.deliveries) {
    const own = getOwnership(dv);
    if (own === 'none') continue;
    if (dv.type === 'loss') continue;
    const good = formState.goods.find(g => g.id === dv.goodId);
    if (!good?.linkedItemId) continue;

    try {
      if (own === 'mine') {
        // Internal Transfer: stock -X + consignment +X
        if (!dv.whsMovementId) {
          const midOut = whs.addMovement({
            itemId: good.linkedItemId,
            type: 'out',
            quantity: getBaseQuantity(good, dv.quantity, whs.items),
            unitPrice: 0,
            reason: dv.type === 'out' ? 'consumption' : 'return',
            date: dv.date || formState.date || '',
            locationId: 'stock',
            partyId,
            notes: `Deal ${formState.dealNumber || ''} - ${good.name} → امانت`,
            sourceModule: 'deal',
            sourceId: dv.id,
          });
          if (midOut) dv.whsMovementId = midOut;
        }
        if (!dv.whsMovementIdIn) {
          const midIn = whs.addMovement({
            itemId: good.linkedItemId,
            type: 'in',
            quantity: getBaseQuantity(good, dv.quantity, whs.items),
            unitPrice: 0,
            reason: 'adjustment',
            date: dv.date || formState.date || '',
            locationId: consignmentLoc,
            partyId,
            notes: `Deal ${formState.dealNumber || ''} - ${good.name} ← امانت`,
            sourceModule: 'deal',
            sourceId: dv.id,
          });
          if (midIn) dv.whsMovementIdIn = midIn;
        }
      } else {
        // ownership === 'theirs': Move out (stock -X) or in (return)
        if (!dv.whsMovementId) {
          const mid = whs.addMovement({
            itemId: good.linkedItemId,
            type: dv.type === 'out' ? 'out' : 'in',
            quantity: getBaseQuantity(good, dv.quantity, whs.items),
            unitPrice: 0,
            reason: dv.type === 'out' ? 'consumption' : 'return',
            date: dv.date || formState.date || '',
            locationId: 'stock',
            partyId,
            notes: `Deal ${formState.dealNumber || ''} - ${good.name}`,
            sourceModule: 'deal',
            sourceId: dv.id,
          });
          if (mid) dv.whsMovementId = mid;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[deals->whs] addMovement failed:', e);
    }
  }

    // 🆕 Phase 1.6: Apply flock/hatch deductions
    for (const dv of formState.deliveries) {
      const own = getOwnership(dv);
      if (own === 'none') continue;
      if (dv.type === 'loss') continue;
      if (dv.flockDeductedQuantity !== undefined) continue;
      const good = formState.goods.find(g => g.id === dv.goodId);
      if (!good) continue;

      let targetFlockId: string | null = null;
      if (good.existingFlockId) {
        targetFlockId = good.existingFlockId;
      } else if (good.hatchId) {
        const hatch = useInc.getState().hatches.find(h => h.id === good.hatchId);
        if (hatch?.generatedFlockId) targetFlockId = hatch.generatedFlockId;
        else throw new Error('هچ «' + good.name + '» هنوز گله ندارد — ابتدا هچ را نهایی کنید');
      }
      if (!targetFlockId) continue;

      const flock = useFlk.getState().flocks.find(f => f.id === targetFlockId);
      if (!flock) throw new Error('گله «' + good.name + '» یافت نشد');

      if (dv.type === 'out') {
        const current = flock.currentCount || 0;
        if (current < dv.quantity) {
          throw new Error('موجودی گله «' + flock.name + '» کافی نیست — موجودی: ' + current + '، درخواستی: ' + dv.quantity);
        }
      }

      const delta = dv.type === 'out' ? -dv.quantity : dv.quantity;
      const current = flock.currentCount || 0;
      const newCount = current + delta;

      if (delta < 0) {
        const m = flock.maleCount ?? 0;
        const fe = flock.femaleCount ?? 0;
        const u = flock.unknownCount ?? 0;
        const reduceBy = Math.abs(delta);
        const newU = Math.max(0, u - reduceBy);
        const remaining = Math.max(0, reduceBy - u);
        let newM = m, newFe = fe;
        if (remaining > 0 && (m + fe) > 0) {
          const reduceM = Math.min(m, Math.round(remaining * m / (m + fe)));
          const reduceFe = Math.min(fe, remaining - reduceM);
          newM = m - reduceM;
          newFe = fe - reduceFe;
        }
        useFlk.getState().update(flock.id, { currentCount: Math.max(0, newCount), maleCount: newM, femaleCount: newFe, unknownCount: newU });
      } else {
        useFlk.getState().update(flock.id, { currentCount: newCount, unknownCount: (flock.unknownCount ?? 0) + delta });
      }

      dv.flockDeductedQuantity = delta;
      dv.flockSourceId = flock.id;
    }
}
