/**
 * applyStock.ts — خریدهای انباربر → انبار (whs)
 * delta-based: فقط تفاضل با نسخه قبلی ثبت می‌شه
 */
import { useWhs } from '../whs/store';
import type { Invoice, InvoiceItem } from './store';

// ─── UOM base + factors (inlined to avoid circular dep with useInvoiceForm) ───
const UOM_BASE: Record<string, string> = {
  egg: 'pcs', fertile_egg: 'pcs', chick: 'pcs', adult: 'pcs', broken: 'pcs',
  equipment: 'pcs', feed: 'kg', medicine: 'ml', herbal: 'g', vaccine: 'dose',
  manure: 'kg', other: 'pcs',
};
const UOM_FACTORS: Record<string, Record<string, number | null>> = {
  feed: { kg: 1, g: 0.001, ton: 1000, bag: 25 },
  medicine: { ml: 1, l: 1000, vial: null, pack: null },
  herbal: { g: 1, kg: 1000, l: 1000, pack: null },
  vaccine: { dose: 1, vial: null, pack: null },
  manure: { kg: 1, ton: 1000 },
  other: { pcs: 1, kg: 1, pack: null },
};
function uomBase(cat: string): string { return UOM_BASE[cat] || 'pcs'; }
function uomFactor(cat: string, unit: string, unitWeight?: number | null): number {
  const m = UOM_FACTORS[cat];
  if (!m) return 1;
  const f = m[unit];
  if (f !== undefined && f !== null) return f;
  return unitWeight && unitWeight > 0 ? unitWeight : 1;
}

const STOCK_CATS = ['feed', 'medicine', 'vaccine', 'herbal', 'other', 'manure', 'broken', 'egg', 'fertile_egg'];

function mapCategory(cat: string, kind?: string): any {
  if (['feed', 'medicine', 'vaccine', 'herbal', 'egg'].includes(cat)) return cat;
  if (cat === 'equipment') return kind === 'consumable' ? 'consumable' : 'equipment';
  return 'consumable';
}

function stockKey(it: InvoiceItem): string {
  return String(it.stockItemId || it.description || it.model || '').trim() + '|' + String((it as any).equipmentKind || '');
}

function isStockItem(it: InvoiceItem, inv: Invoice): boolean {
  const cat = it.category || inv.category;
  const isStock = STOCK_CATS.includes(cat);
  const isEquipConsumable = cat === 'equipment' && (it as any).equipmentKind === 'consumable';
  return isStock || isEquipConsumable;
}

function normalizeName(s: string): string {
  return String(s || '').trim()
    .replace(/ي/g, 'ی')
    .replace(/ك/g, 'ک')
    .replace(/\u200c/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .toLowerCase();
}

function ensureItem(it: InvoiceItem, inv: Invoice, whs: any): string {
  const name = String(it.description || it.model || '').trim();
  if (!name) { console.warn('[applyInvoiceStock] SKIP — empty description:', it); return ''; }
  const cat = it.category || inv.category;
  const targetCat = mapCategory(cat, (it as any).equipmentKind);

  if (it.stockItemId && whs.items.find((x: any) => x.id === it.stockItemId)) {
    return it.stockItemId;
  }
  const normalizedName = normalizeName(name);
  const existing = whs.items.find((x: any) => normalizeName(x.name) === normalizedName && x.category === targetCat);
  if (existing) return existing.id;

  try {
    return whs.addItem({
      name, category: targetCat, unit: (() => {
        const c = it.category || inv.category;
        if (c === 'equipment' && it.unit) return it.unit as any;
        return uomBase(c) as any;
      })(),
      minStock: 0, currentStock: 0,
      lastPrice: Number(it.unitPrice) || 0,
      supplierId: inv.partyId || '', expireDate: String(it.expiryDate || ''),
      withdrawalDays: Number(it.withdrawalDays) || null,
      storage: String((it as any).storage || 'room'),
      notes: `از فاکتور ${inv.number || ''}`,
      brand: (it as any).brand || '', hallId: (it as any).hallId || '',
      equipmentStatus: (it as any).equipmentStatus || '',
      usageType: (it as any).usageType || '',
      usageTypes: (it as any).usageTypes || [],
      purchaseDate: inv.deliveryDate || inv.date || '',
      purchasePrice: Number(it.unitPrice) || 0,
    } as any);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[applyInvoiceStock] addItem failed:', e);
    return '';
  }
}


// 🆕 تشخیص خودکار کد واکسن/دارو از نام کالا
function inferSourceCode(name: string): string {
  const n = (name || '').toLowerCase();
  if (/نیوکاسل|newcastle|(^|\W)nd(\W|$)/i.test(n)) return 'ND';
  if (/برونشیت|bronchitis|(^|\W)ib(\W|$)/i.test(n)) return 'IB';
  if (/گامبورو|gumboro|(^|\W)ibd(\W|$)/i.test(n)) return 'IBD';
  if (/آنفلو|آنفولانزا|influenza|(^|\W)ai(\W|$)/i.test(n)) return 'AI';
  if (/مارک|marek|(^|\W)md(\W|$)/i.test(n)) return 'MD';
  if (/آبله|fowl\s*pox|(^|\W)fp(\W|$)/i.test(n)) return 'FP';
  if (/انسه|encephalomyelitis|(^|\W)ae(\W|$)/i.test(n)) return 'AE';
  if (/eds|کاهش.*تخم/i.test(n)) return 'EDS';
  if (/mycoplasma|مایکوپلاسما|(^|\W)mg(\W|$)/i.test(n)) return 'MG';
  if (/coccidiosis|کوکسیدیوز|(^|\W)cocc(\W|$)/i.test(n)) return 'COCC';
  if (/هپاتیت|hepatitis/i.test(n)) return 'HEP';
  if (/وبا|cholera/i.test(n)) return 'CHOL';
  return 'GEN';
}

// 🆕 تولید شماره بچ استاندارد: CODE-YYYYMMDD-NN
function generateBatchNo(inv: any, sample: any, whs: any): string {
  const whsItem = (whs.items || []).find((x: any) => x.id === sample.stockItemId);
  const sourceCode = whsItem?.sourceCode || inferSourceCode(whsItem?.name || sample.description || '');
  const datePart = (inv.date || '').replace(/\//g, '').slice(0, 8) || '00000000';
  const prefix = `${sourceCode}-${datePart}-`;
  const existing = (whs.movements || []).filter((m: any) => m.batchNo && m.batchNo.startsWith(prefix));
  const seq = String(existing.length + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${prefix}${seq}`;
}

export function applyInvoiceStock(inv: Invoice, prev?: Invoice): InvoiceItem[] {
  console.info('[applyInvoiceStock] called:', { type: inv.type, itemsCount: inv.items?.length, categories: inv.items?.map(i => i.category || inv.category) });
  // 🆕 Sale: کاهش موجودی (self-contained)
  if (inv.type === 'sale') {
    const whs = useWhs.getState();
    const outItems: InvoiceItem[] = (inv.items || []).map(it => ({ ...it }));

    const buildMap = (inv2: Invoice | undefined): Map<string, { qty: number; sample: any }> => {
      const mm = new Map<string, { qty: number; sample: any }>();
      if (!inv2) return mm;
      for (const it of inv2.items || []) {
        if (!isStockItem(it, inv2)) continue;
        const key = stockKey(it);
        if (!key || key === '|') continue;
        const cur = mm.get(key);
        if (cur) cur.qty += Number(it.quantity) || 0;
        else mm.set(key, { qty: Number(it.quantity) || 0, sample: it });
      }
      return mm;
    };

    const prevMap = buildMap(prev);
    const newMap = buildMap(inv);

    // 🆕 Phase 1 (#5 Rollback Cascade): collect deltas for ALL keys (incl. removed items)
    type SaleDelta = { key: string; itemId: string; delta: number; sample: InvoiceItem };
    const deltas: SaleDelta[] = [];
    const allKeys = new Set<string>([...prevMap.keys(), ...newMap.keys()]);

    for (const key of allKeys) {
      const prevQty = prevMap.get(key)?.qty || 0;
      const newQty = newMap.get(key)?.qty || 0;
      const delta = newQty - prevQty;
      if (delta === 0) continue;

      const rawSample = newMap.get(key)?.sample ?? prevMap.get(key)?.sample;
      if (!rawSample) continue;
      const sample: InvoiceItem = rawSample;

      let itemId = String(sample.stockItemId || '');
      if (itemId && !whs.items.find((x: any) => x.id === itemId)) itemId = '';
      if (!itemId) {
        const name = String(sample.description || sample.model || '').trim();
        const cat = sample.category || inv.category;
        const targetCat = mapCategory(cat, (sample as any).equipmentKind);
        const existing = whs.items.find((x: any) =>
          x.name === name && (x.category === targetCat || x.category === cat)
        );
        if (existing) itemId = existing.id;
        if (!itemId && (cat === 'egg' || cat === 'fertile_egg' || cat === 'broken')) {
          const eggCat = cat === 'broken' ? 'broken' : 'egg';
          const eggItem = whs.items.find((x: any) => x.category === eggCat);
          if (eggItem) {
            itemId = eggItem.id;
            console.info('[applyInvoiceStock/sale] 🥚 egg fallback used:', eggItem.name);
          }
        }
      }
      if (!itemId) {
        console.warn('[applyInvoiceStock/sale] item not found, skip:', sample.description);
        continue;
      }
      deltas.push({ key, itemId, delta, sample });
    }

    // 🆕 Phase 2 (#94 Guard): atomic pre-check — sum outgoing per itemId BEFORE any movement
    const outByItem = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const d of deltas) {
      if (d.delta > 0) {
        const qty = d.delta * uomFactor(d.sample.category || inv.category, d.sample.unit || '', (d.sample as any).unitWeight);
        outByItem.set(d.itemId, (outByItem.get(d.itemId) || 0) + qty);
      }
    }
    for (const [itemId, needed] of outByItem) {
      const stockRow = whs.items.find((x: any) => x.id === itemId);
      const available = Number(stockRow?.currentStock) || 0;
      if (available < needed) {
        const nm = stockRow?.name || itemId;
        throw new Error(`موجودی کافی نیست: ${nm} — موجودی ${available}، درخواستی ${needed}`);
      }
    }

    // 🆕 Phase 3: apply movements — 'out' for +delta, 'in' for -delta (return to stock)
    const applied: Array<{ itemId: string; reverseType: 'in' | 'out'; qty: number }> = [];
    try {
      for (const d of deltas) {
        const qty = Math.abs(d.delta) * uomFactor(d.sample.category || inv.category, d.sample.unit || '', (d.sample as any).unitWeight);
        const movementType: 'in' | 'out' = d.delta > 0 ? 'out' : 'in';
        whs.addMovement({
          itemId: d.itemId, type: movementType, quantity: qty,
          unitPrice: Number(d.sample.unitPrice) || 0,
          reason: 'sale',
          date: inv.deliveryDate || inv.date || '',
          partyId: inv.partyId || '',
          notes: `فروش — فاکتور ${inv.number || ''}`,
          sourceModule: 'tra', sourceId: inv.id,
        } as any);
        applied.push({ itemId: d.itemId, reverseType: movementType === 'out' ? 'in' : 'out', qty });

        for (const it of outItems) {
          if (isStockItem(it, inv) && stockKey(it) === d.key) {
            (it as any).stockItemId = d.itemId;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[applyInvoiceStock/sale] movement failed — rolling back', applied.length, 'movements:', e);
      for (const a of applied) {
        try {
          whs.addMovement({
            itemId: a.itemId, type: a.reverseType, quantity: a.qty,
            unitPrice: 0, reason: 'adjustment',
            date: inv.deliveryDate || inv.date || '',
            notes: 'rollback بعد از خطا',
            sourceModule: 'tra', sourceId: inv.id,
          } as any);
        } catch (e2) { console.error('[applyInvoiceStock/sale] rollback movement failed:', e2); }
      }
      throw e;
    }

    return outItems;
  }

  if (inv.type !== 'purchase') return inv.items;
  const whs = useWhs.getState();
  const outItems: InvoiceItem[] = (inv.items || []).map(it => ({ ...it }));

  const prevQtyByKey = new Map<string, number>();
  if (prev) {
    for (const it of prev.items || []) {
      if (!isStockItem(it, prev)) continue;
      const key = stockKey(it);
      if (!key || key === '|') continue;
      prevQtyByKey.set(key, (prevQtyByKey.get(key) || 0) + (Number(it.quantity) || 0));
    }
  }

  const newQtyByKey = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const it of outItems) {
    if (!isStockItem(it, inv)) continue;
    const key = stockKey(it);
    if (!key || key === '|') continue;
    newQtyByKey.set(key, (newQtyByKey.get(key) || 0) + (Number(it.quantity) || 0));
  }

  const deltaByKey = new Map<string, { delta: number; sample: InvoiceItem }>();
  for (const [key, newQty] of newQtyByKey) {
    const prevQty = prevQtyByKey.get(key) || 0;
    const delta = newQty - prevQty;
    if (delta !== 0) {
      const sample = outItems.find(it => isStockItem(it, inv) && stockKey(it) === key);
      if (sample) deltaByKey.set(key, { delta, sample });
    }
  }

  for (const [key, { delta, sample }] of deltaByKey) {
    const itemId = ensureItem(sample, inv, whs);
    if (!itemId) continue;
    try {
      whs.addMovement({
        itemId, type: (delta > 0 ? 'in' : 'out') as any, quantity: Math.abs(delta) * uomFactor(sample.category || inv.category, sample.unit || '', (sample as any).unitWeight),
        unitPrice: Number(sample.unitPrice) || 0,
        reason: 'purchase',
        date: inv.deliveryDate || inv.date || '',
        partyId: inv.partyId || '',
        notes: `فاکتور ${inv.number || ''}${sample.description ? ' — ' + sample.description : ''}`,
        sourceModule: 'tra', sourceId: inv.id,
        
        expiryDate: sample.expiryDate,
        flockId: sample.flockId || '',
        batchNo: sample.batchNo || generateBatchNo(inv, sample, whs),
      } as any);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[applyInvoiceStock] addMovement failed:', e);
      console.warn('[applyInvoiceStock] movement done:', { itemId, qty: Math.abs(delta) * uomFactor(sample.category || inv.category, sample.unit || '', (sample as any).unitWeight), factor: uomFactor(sample.category || inv.category, sample.unit || '', (sample as any).unitWeight), rawDelta: delta });
      continue;
    }
    for (const it of outItems) {
      if (isStockItem(it, inv) && stockKey(it) === key) {
        it.stockItemId = itemId;
      }
    }
  }

  return outItems;
}

import type { Invoice } from './types';

export interface InvoiceSplitResult {
  toArchive: Invoice[];
  keep: Invoice[];
  skipped: Invoice[];
}

export interface InvoiceArchiveOptions {
  cutoffIso?: string;
  requireSettled?: boolean;
}

function isInvoiceSettled(inv: Invoice): boolean {
  return Boolean(inv.paidAt) || inv.workflowStatus === 'paid';
}

function hasOpenDisputeOrPendingCheck(inv: Invoice): boolean {
  if (inv.disputeStatus === 'open') return true;
  const payments = inv.payments || [];
  return payments.some(
    p => p.method === 'check' && (p.status === 'in_transit' || p.status === 'bounced')
  );
}

/**
 * تفکیک خالص فاکتورها پیش از انتقال به مخزن tra_invoices بر اساس قفل تسویه،
 * نبود اختلاف باز / چک در جریان یا برگشتی، و مرز دوره مالی (cutoffIso).
 */
export function splitInvoicesForArchive(
  invoices: Invoice[],
  opts: InvoiceArchiveOptions = {}
): InvoiceSplitResult {
  const toArchive: Invoice[] = [];
  const keep: Invoice[] = [];
  const skipped: Invoice[] = [];
  const requireSettled = opts.requireSettled ?? true;

  for (const inv of invoices) {
    if (!inv || !inv.id || !inv.type) {
      skipped.push(inv);
      continue;
    }
    if (requireSettled && !isInvoiceSettled(inv)) {
      keep.push(inv);
      continue;
    }
    if (hasOpenDisputeOrPendingCheck(inv)) {
      keep.push(inv);
      continue;
    }
    if (opts.cutoffIso) {
      const marker = inv.paidAt || inv.date || inv.createdAt || '';
      if (!marker || marker > opts.cutoffIso) {
        keep.push(inv);
        continue;
      }
    }
    toArchive.push(inv);
  }

  return { toArchive, keep, skipped };
}

/**
 * tra/calc.ts — توابع محاسباتی خالص معاملات

import { parse as parseJ, differenceInDays as diffDaysJ, format as formatJ, addDays } from 'date-fns-jalali';
import type { PaymentAllocation } from './types';
import type { Invoice, InvoiceItem, Payment, WorkflowStatus, CheckStatus, InvoiceStatus, InvoiceType, PaymentTerms, Installment, Deal, SettlementType } from './types';

/** تبدیل ارقام فارسی/عربی به لاتین — Single Source of Truth (S1) */
export function toEnDigits(s: string | null | undefined): string {
  return String(s || '').replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));
}

/** تبدیل ارقام لاتین به فارسی — Single Source of Truth (S1) */
export function toFaDigits(s: string | null | undefined): string {
  return String(s || '').replace(/\d/g, d => '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'[parseInt(d, 10)]);
}

export function generateInvoiceNumber(
  type: InvoiceType,
  date: string,
  existingInvoices: Invoice[]
): string {
  const parts = (date || '').split('/');
  const year = parts[0] || '1400';
  const month = (parts[1] || '01').padStart(2, '0');
  const prefix = type === 'purchase' ? 'P' : 'S';
  const pattern = `${prefix}${year}${month}`;

  let maxNum = 0;
  existingInvoices.forEach(inv => {
    if (inv.type !== type) return;
    if (!inv.number || !inv.number.startsWith(pattern)) return;
    const suffix = inv.number.slice(pattern.length);
    const n = parseInt(suffix, 10);
    if (!isNaN(n) && n > maxNum) maxNum = n;
  });

  const nextNum = String(maxNum + 1).padStart(3, '0');
  return `${pattern}${nextNum}`;
}


export function generateDealNumber(
  date: string,
  existingDeals: Array<{ dealNumber?: string }>
): string {
  const norm = toEnDigits(date);
  const parts = norm.split('/');
  const year = parts[0] || '1400';
  const pattern = `${year}-`;

  let maxNum = 0;
  existingDeals.forEach(d => {
    if (!d.dealNumber) return;
    // 🆕 M6: normalize فارسی قبل از startsWith (سازگار با سایر توابع)
    const normDealNum = toEnDigits(d.dealNumber);
    if (!normDealNum.startsWith(pattern)) return;
    const suffix = normDealNum.slice(pattern.length);
    const num = parseInt(suffix, 10);
    if (!isNaN(num) && num > maxNum) maxNum = num;
  });

  return `${year}-${String(maxNum + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`;
}

export function calcDueDate(
  terms: PaymentTerms | undefined,
  invoiceDate: string,
  customDueDate?: string,
  gapDays?: number
): string {
  if (!invoiceDate) return customDueDate || '';

  if (terms === 'cash') {
    return invoiceDate;
  }
  if (terms === 'custom') {
    return customDueDate || invoiceDate;
  }
  if (terms === 'installment') {
    // آخرین قسط = تاریخ فاکتور + (تعداد اقساط × فاصله)
    // ولی سرسید اولین قسط = تاریخ + فاصله
    const gap = gapDays || 30;
    try {
      const en = toEnDigits(invoiceDate);
      const base = parseJ(en, 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
      if (isNaN(base.getTime())) return invoiceDate;
      const due = addDays(base, gap);
      return formatJ(due, 'yyyy/MM/dd');
    } catch {
      return invoiceDate;
    }
  }
  return customDueDate || invoiceDate;
}



/** مرحله بعدی workflow */
export function nextWorkflowStatus(current?: WorkflowStatus): WorkflowStatus | null {
  if (!current || current === 'draft') return 'confirmed';
  if (current === 'confirmed') return 'received';
  if (current === 'received') return 'paid';
  return null;
}

/** مرحله قبلی workflow */
export function prevWorkflowStatus(current?: WorkflowStatus): WorkflowStatus | null {
  if (!current || current === 'draft') return null;
  if (current === 'confirmed') return 'draft';
  if (current === 'received') return 'confirmed';
  if (current === 'paid') return 'received';
  return null;
}

/** رنگ بج workflow */
export function workflowTone(status?: WorkflowStatus): 'gray' | 'blue' | 'amber' | 'green' {
  if (!status || status === 'draft') return 'gray';
  if (status === 'confirmed') return 'blue';
  if (status === 'received') return 'amber';
  return 'green';
}



/** محاسبه جمع قلم با تخفیف */
export function calcItemTotal(
  quantity: number,
  unitPrice: number,
  discountType?: string,
  discountValue?: number,
  factor: number = 1
): number {
  const base = (quantity || 0) * factor * (unitPrice || 0);
  if (!discountType || !discountValue) return Math.round(base);

  let discount = 0;
  if (discountType === 'percent') {
    discount = base * (discountValue / 100);
  } else if (discountType === 'amount') {
    discount = discountValue;
  }
  /* moneyRoundApplied */
  return Math.round(Math.max(0, base - discount));
}

/** محاسبه مبلغ تخفیف قلم */
export function calcItemDiscount(
  quantity: number,
  unitPrice: number,
  discountType?: string,
  discountValue?: number
): number {
  const base = (quantity || 0) * (unitPrice || 0);
  const net = calcItemTotal(quantity, unitPrice, discountType, discountValue);
  return Math.round(Math.max(0, base - net));
}



/** رنگ بج وضعیت چک */
export function checkTone(status?: CheckStatus): 'gray' | 'green' | 'red' {
  if (!status || status === 'pending') return 'gray';
  if (status === 'cleared') return 'green';
  return 'red';
}

/** جمع پرداخت‌های چک در جریان (نگهداری شده) */
export function pendingChecksSum(payments: Payment[]): number {
  return payments
    .filter(p => p.method === 'check' && (!p.status || p.status === 'pending'))
    .reduce((a, p) => a + (p.amount || 0), 0);
}

/** لیست چک‌های سرسید نزدیک */
export function pendingChecks(payments: Payment[]): Payment[] {
  return payments.filter(p => p.method === 'check' && (!p.status || p.status === 'pending'));
}

export function itemTotal(q: number, p: number): number {
  return Math.round((q || 0) * (p || 0));
}

export function itemsSum(items: InvoiceItem[]): number {
  return Math.round(items.reduce((a, x) => a + (x.total || 0), 0));
}

/**
 * isEffectivelyPaid — آیا پرداخت باید در محاسبات "پرداخت‌شده" شمرده شود؟
 * استاندارد IFRS 9 / استاندارد حسابداری ۱۱ ایران:
 *   - چک فقط بعد از cleared شدن (نقد) قابل شمارش است
 *   - سایر روش‌ها (نقدی/کارت) همیشه
 */
export function isEffectivelyPaid(p: { method: string; status?: string | null }): boolean {
  return p.method !== 'check' || p.status === 'cleared';
}

export function paidSum(payments: Payment[]): number {
  // استاندارد ERP: فقط پرداخت‌های قطعی (cash، card، چک نقد‌شده)
  return Math.round(payments.reduce((a, x) => {
    if (!isEffectivelyPaid(x)) return a;
    const amt = x.amount || 0;
    if ((x as any).type === 'refund') return a - amt;
    return a + amt;
  }, 0));
}

/**
 * paidSum با پشتیبانی از PaymentAllocation
 * - اگر allocations موجود بود → از allocations می‌خونه
 * - چک pending/bounced شمرده نمی‌شود
 * - fallback: paidSum(payments)
 */
export function paidSumAllocated(inv: Invoice, allocations?: PaymentAllocation[]): number {
  if (allocations && allocations.length > 0) {
    const invAllocs = allocations.filter(a => a.invoiceId === inv.id);
    if (invAllocs.length > 0) {
      return Math.round(invAllocs.reduce((sum, a) => {
        const p = (inv.payments || []).find(x => x.id === a.paymentId);
        if (!p) return sum;
        if (!isEffectivelyPaid(p)) return sum;
        if (p.type === 'refund') return sum - a.amount;
        return sum + a.amount;
      }, 0));
    }
  }
  return paidSum(inv.payments || []);
}

/**
 * پرداخت‌های در انتظار (چک pending — هنوز نقد نشده)
 */
export function paidPendingSum(payments: Payment[]): number {
  return Math.round(payments.reduce((a, x) => {
    if (x.method !== 'check') return a;
    if ((x.status || 'pending') === 'pending') return a + (x.amount || 0);
    return a;
  }, 0));
}

export function invoiceStatus(inv: Invoice, allocations?: PaymentAllocation[]): InvoiceStatus {
  const paid = paidSumAllocated(inv, allocations);
  const total = inv.total || 0;
  const writtenOff = Math.round(inv.writtenOffAmount || 0);
  // 🆕 فیکس: remaining باید 0 باشه، نه فقط paid >= total
  const rem = remaining(inv, allocations);
  if (rem <= 0 && total > 0) {
    // 🆕 M7: write-off = بدهی سوخته، نه پرداخت (SAP FI-AR / Odoo)
    // اگر paid + writtenOff >= total، ولی paid خودش کل مبلغ را پوشش نمی‌دهد
    // → 'partial' تا UI بتواند بج «بدحساب» را نشان دهد
    if (writtenOff > 0 && paid < total) return 'partial';
    return 'paid';
  }
  if (paid > 0 || writtenOff > 0) return 'partial';
  return 'unpaid';
}



// تبدیل تاریخ‌های میلادی ذخیره‌شده به شمسی
function migrateInvDates(inv: any): any {
  if (!inv) return inv;
  const fix = (str: string) => {
    if (!str) return str;
    const en = toEnDigits(str);
    const m = en.match(/^(\d{4})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{2})$/);
    if (!m) return str;
    const y = parseInt(m[1], 10);
    if (y >= 1900 && y <= 2100) {
      try {
        const d = new Date(y, parseInt(m[2], 10) - 1, parseInt(m[3], 10));
        return formatJ(d, 'yyyy/MM/dd');
      } catch { return str; }
    }
    return str;
  };
  if (inv.date) inv.date = fix(inv.date);
  if (inv.dueDate) inv.dueDate = fix(inv.dueDate);
  if (inv.customDueDate) inv.customDueDate = fix(inv.customDueDate);
  return inv;
}

/**
 * computeOverpayment — مقدار اضافه‌پرداخت مشتری
 * استاندارد: Odoo advance/credit، SAP FI-AR customer credit
 * خروجی > 0 → مبلغ به عنوان بستانکار طرف ثبت شده (پیش‌پرداخت)
 */
export function computeOverpayment(inv: Invoice, allocations?: PaymentAllocation[]): number {
  const paid = paidSumAllocated(inv, allocations);
  const writtenOff = Math.round(inv.writtenOffAmount || 0);
  const discount = computeCashDiscount(inv);
  const effectiveOwed = Math.max(0, (inv.total || 0) - writtenOff - discount);
  return Math.max(0, paid - effectiveOwed);
}

export function remaining(inv: Invoice, allocations?: PaymentAllocation[]): number {
  const paid = paidSumAllocated(inv, allocations);
  const writtenOff = Math.round(inv.writtenOffAmount || 0);
  return Math.max(0, (Math.round(Math.max(0, (inv.total || 0) - paid - writtenOff))) - computeCashDiscount(inv));
}

export function ageDays(inv: Invoice): number {
  if (!inv.date) return 0;
  try {
    const en = toEnDigits(inv.date);
    const d = parseJ(en, 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return 0;
    const diff = diffDaysJ(new Date(), d);
    return diff > 0 ? diff : 0;
  } catch {
    return 0;
  }
}

export type AgingBucket =
  | 'current'
  | '1-30'
  | '31-60'
  | '61-90'
  | '91-180'
  | '181-365'
  | '+365';

/**
 * agingBucket — طبقه‌بندی سنی مطالبات (IFRS 9 / بانک مرکزی ایران)
 * ورودی: daysOverdue (۰ یا منفی = جاری، ۱+ = معوق)
 */
export function agingBucket(overdueDays: number): AgingBucket {
  if (overdueDays <= 0) return 'current';
  if (overdueDays <= 30) return '1-30';
  if (overdueDays <= 60) return '31-60';
  if (overdueDays <= 90) return '61-90';
  if (overdueDays <= 180) return '91-180';
  if (overdueDays <= 365) return '181-365';
  return '+365';
}

export const AGING_BUCKETS: Array<{ key: AgingBucket; label: string; color: string }> = [
  { key: 'current', label: 'جاری', color: 'green' },
  { key: '1-30', label: '۱-۳۰ روز', color: 'blue' },
  { key: '31-60', label: '۳۱-۶۰ روز', color: 'amber' },
  { key: '61-90', label: '۶۱-۹۰ روز', color: 'amber' },
  { key: '91-180', label: '۹۱-۱۸۰ روز', color: 'red' },
  { key: '181-365', label: '۱۸۱-۳۶۵ روز', color: 'red' },
  { key: '+365', label: 'بیش از ۱ سال', color: 'red' },
];

export function computeCashDiscount(inv: Invoice): number {
  const pct = (inv as any).cashDiscountPct || 0;
  const days = (inv as any).cashDiscountDays || 0;
  if (pct <= 0 || days <= 0 || !inv.date) return 0;
  
  // toEnDigits از helper ماژول استفاده می‌شود
  const invDate = parseJ(toEnDigits(inv.date), 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
  if (isNaN(invDate.getTime())) return 0;
  
  let eligiblePaid = 0;
  for (const p of (inv.payments || [])) {
    if (!p.date) continue;
    if ((p as any).type === 'refund') continue;
    const payDate = parseJ(toEnDigits(p.date), 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    if (isNaN(payDate.getTime())) continue;
    const diff = diffDaysJ(payDate, invDate);
    if (diff >= 0 && diff <= days) eligiblePaid += p.amount || 0;
  }
  
  if (eligiblePaid <= 0) return 0;
  // تخفیف از TOTAL فاکتور محاسبه می‌شود، نه از پرداخت‌شده (استاندارد accounting)
  const discount = Math.round(inv.total * pct / 100);
  // فقط اگه پرداخت به‌اندازه‌ای بوده که با تخفیف تسویه حساب شه اعمال می‌شود
  if (eligiblePaid >= inv.total - discount) return discount;
  return 0;
}


/** تاریخ امروز شمسی (YYYY/MM/DD) */
import { todayJalali as _todayJ } from '../../shr/date/jalali';
const getTodayJalali = _todayJ;
export { getTodayJalali };

function _unusedGetTodayJalali(): string {
  try {
    const d = new Date();
    const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-u-ca-persian-nu-latn', {
      year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit'
    });
    const parts = fmt.formatToParts(d);
    const y = parts.find(p => p.type === 'year')?.value || '';
    const m = parts.find(p => p.type === 'month')?.value || '';
    const dd = parts.find(p => p.type === 'day')?.value || '';
    return `${y}/${m}/${dd}`;
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
}

/** آیا فاکتور چک برگشتی دارد؟ */
export function hasBouncedCheck(inv: any): boolean {
  return (inv?.payments || []).some((p: any) => p.method === 'check' && p.status === 'bounced');
}

/** تعداد چک‌های برگشتی */
export function countBouncedChecks(inv: any): number {
  return (inv?.payments || []).filter((p: any) => p.method === 'check' && p.status === 'bounced').length;
}

/** فرمت نمایشی شماره فاکتور: P140507001 → P۰۵۰۷۰۰۱ (حذف ۲ رقم اول سال + اعداد فارسی) */
export function formatInvoiceNumber(num: string | undefined | null): string {
  if (!num) return '—';
  let prefix = '';
  let rest = num;
  if (num.startsWith('P')) { prefix = 'P'; rest = num.slice(1); }
  else if (num.startsWith('S')) { prefix = 'S'; rest = num.slice(1); }
  // حذف ۲ رقم اول از شماره بعد از P/S — 140507001 → 0507001
  if (rest.length >= 6) rest = rest.slice(2);
  const faDigits = toFaDigits(rest);
  return prefix ? `${prefix}${faDigits}` : faDigits;
}
/** افزودن N روز به تاریخ شمسی */
export function addJalaliDays(dateStr: string, days: number): string {
  if (!dateStr) return '';
  try {
    const en = toEnDigits(dateStr);
    const base = parseJ(en, 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    if (isNaN(base.getTime())) return dateStr;
    return formatJ(addDays(base, days), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
  } catch { return dateStr; }
}

/** تولید آرایه اقساط — استاندارد صنعت: باقیمانده روی آخرین قسط، پیش‌پرداخت کسر می‌شود */
export function generateInstallments(
  totalAmount: number,
  count: number,
  gapDays: number,
  startDate: string,
  advancePaid: number = 0
): Installment[] {
  if (!totalAmount || totalAmount <= 0) return [];
  if (!count || count <= 0) return [];
  if (!startDate) return [];
  const gap = gapDays > 0 ? gapDays : 30;
  const remaining = Math.max(0, totalAmount - (advancePaid || 0));
  if (remaining <= 0) return [];
  const perInstallment = Math.floor(remaining / count);
  const out: Installment[] = [];
  let accumulated = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const isLast = i === count - 1;
    const amount = isLast ? (remaining - accumulated) : perInstallment;
    accumulated += amount;
    const dueDate = addJalaliDays(startDate, (i + 1) * gap);
    out.push({
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      number: i + 1,
      dueDate,
      amount,
      status: 'pending',
      paid: false,
      paidDate: '',
    });
  }
  return out;
}

/** آبشار بانکی: پرداخت‌ها به ترتیب FIFO روی اقساط تخصیص می‌یابند.
 *  idempotent: هر بار از صفر محاسبه می‌شود (پرداخت‌های جدید لحاظ می‌شوند).
 *  چک برگشتی و عودت وجه در استخر حساب نمی‌شوند.
 *  سرسید گذشته و کامل پرداخت‌نشده → overdue.
 */
export function applyPaymentsToInstallments(
  installments: Installment[],
  payments: Payment[]
): Installment[] {
  if (!installments || installments.length === 0) return installments || [];

  const todayStr = getTodayJalali();

  let pool = 0;
  for (const p of payments || []) {
    if ((p as { type?: string }).type === 'refund') continue;
    if (!isEffectivelyPaid(p)) continue;
    pool += p.amount || 0;
  }

  const sorted = [...installments].sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number);
  const result: Installment[] = [];

  for (const inst of sorted) {
    const need = inst.amount || 0;
    const isOverdue = inst.dueDate < todayStr;

    if (need > 0 && pool >= need) {
      pool -= need;
      result.push({
        ...inst,
        paidAmount: need,
        paid: true,
        paidAt: inst.paidAt || todayStr,
        status: 'paid',
      });
    } else if (need > 0 && pool > 0) {
      const applied = pool;
      pool = 0;
      result.push({
        ...inst,
        paidAmount: applied,
        paid: false,
        status: isOverdue ? 'overdue' : 'pending',
      });
    } else {
      result.push({
        ...inst,
        paidAmount: 0,
        paid: false,
        status: isOverdue ? 'overdue' : 'pending',
      });
    }
  }

  return result;
}



export function calcInvoiceTotal(items: any[]): number {
  return Math.round((items || []).reduce((sum, it) => sum + (it.total ?? ((it.quantity || 0) * (it.unitPrice || 0))), 0));
}

/**
 * dealOverdueDays — روزهای overdue معامله (positive)
 * منطبق با overdueDays(inv) در formulas.ts
 */
export function dealDaysUntilDue(d: Deal): number | null {
  if (!d.dueDate) return null;
  try {
    const en = toEnDigits(d.dueDate);
    const dueDate = parseJ(en, 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    if (isNaN(dueDate.getTime())) return null;
    dueDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    return diffDaysJ(dueDate, today);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[dealDaysUntilDue]', e);
    return null;
  }
}

function dealOverdueDays(d: Deal): number {
  const diff = dealDaysUntilDue(d);
  return diff !== null && diff < 0 ? -diff : 0;
}

/**
 * monthsBetween — تعداد ماه بین دو تاریخ (Jalali/Gregorian)
 */
function monthsBetween(start: string, end: string): number {
  if (!start || !end) return 1;
  try {
    const norm = toEnDigits;
    const s = new Date(norm(start).replace(/\//g, '-'));
    const e = new Date(norm(end).replace(/\//g, '-'));
    if (isNaN(s.getTime()) || isNaN(e.getTime())) return 1;
    const months = (e.getFullYear() - s.getFullYear()) * 12 + (e.getMonth() - s.getMonth());
    return Math.max(1, months);
  } catch { return 1; }
}

/**
 * calcDealCommission — کمیسیون معامله بر اساس ۵ نوع تسویه
 * استاندارد: Odoo/SAP settlement types (منطبق با settlement.ts)
 */
export function calcDealCommission(
  settlementType: SettlementType | '' | undefined,
  settlementValue: number | null | undefined,
  totalSales: number,
  totalQty: number,
  startDate: string,
  endDate: string,
): number {
  const value = Number(settlementValue) || 0;
  if (settlementType === 'percent') return Math.round(totalSales * value / 100);
  if (settlementType === 'per_unit') return Math.round(totalQty * value);
  if (settlementType === 'fixed') return Math.round(value);
  if (settlementType === 'rental') return Math.round(value * monthsBetween(startDate, endDate));
  return 0;
}

/**
 * computeDealBalance — محاسبه مالی معامله (DRY از DealsPage:504-507)
 * منطبق با استاندارد Odoo: totalSales - commission - paidIn + paidOut
 */
export function computeDealBalance(d: Deal): {
  totalSales: number;
  commission: number;
  myShare: number;
  paidIn: number;
  paidOut: number;
  balance: number;
} {
  const totalSales = (d.sales || []).reduce(
    (s, x) => s + ((Number(x.quantity) || 0) * (Number(x.unitPrice) || 0)),
    0,
  );
  const totalQty = (d.sales || []).reduce((s, x) => s + (Number(x.quantity) || 0), 0);
  const commission = calcDealCommission(
    d.settlementType, d.settlementValue, totalSales, totalQty,
    d.startDate || d.date, d.endDate || getTodayJalali(),
  );
  const myShare = totalSales - commission;
  // 🆕 Skip non-cleared checks (منطق مشترک با paidSum)
  const paidIn = (d.payments || [])
    .filter(p => p.direction === 'in' && isEffectivelyPaid(p))
    .reduce((s, p) => s + (Number(p.amount) || 0), 0);
  const paidOut = (d.payments || [])
    .filter(p => p.direction === 'out' && isEffectivelyPaid(p))
    .reduce((s, p) => s + (Number(p.amount) || 0), 0);
  return { totalSales, commission, myShare, paidIn, paidOut, balance: myShare - paidIn + paidOut };
}

/**
 * agingBucketFromDeal — aging از dueDate معامله
 */
export function agingBucketFromDeal(d: Deal): AgingBucket {
  return agingBucket(dealOverdueDays(d));
}

/**
 * dealAgingLevel — سطح aging (ok/warn/danger) + روزهای overdue
 * استاندارد FASB/IFRS 9: Aging بر مبنای due date
 * - settled/cancelled → null
 * - بدون dueDate → null (طبق استاندارد: بدون سرسید، aging ندارد)
 * - هنوز سرسید نرسیده (dueDate > today) → null
 */
export function dealAgingLevel(d: Deal): { days: number; tone: 'ok' | 'warn' | 'danger' } | null {
  if (d.status === 'settled' || d.status === 'cancelled') return null;
  const daysUntil = dealDaysUntilDue(d);
  if (daysUntil === null) return null;
  const overdue = -daysUntil;
  if (overdue <= 0) return null;
  const tone: 'ok' | 'warn' | 'danger' = overdue < 30 ? 'ok' : overdue < 60 ? 'warn' : 'danger';
  return { days: overdue, tone };
}

/**
 * computeDealInHand — مقدار کالای هنوز در دست طرف (تحویل - برگشت - تلفات - فروش)
 * استاندارد: Odoo/SAP — معامله تا وقتی هم پول تسویه شود هم کالا برگردد/فروش برود، بسته نیست
 */
export function computeDealInHand(d: Deal): number {
  const out = (d.deliveries || []).filter(x => x.type === 'out')
    .reduce((s, x) => s + (Number(x.quantity) || 0), 0);
  const ret = (d.deliveries || []).filter(x => x.type === 'return')
    .reduce((s, x) => s + (Number(x.quantity) || 0), 0);
  const loss = (d.deliveries || []).filter(x => x.type === 'loss')
    .reduce((s, x) => s + (Number(x.quantity) || 0), 0);
  const sold = (d.sales || []).reduce((s, x) => s + (Number(x.quantity) || 0), 0);
  return out - ret - loss - sold;
}

/**
 * isDealOpen — آیا معامله باید در مطالبات نمایش داده شود؟
 * - status باید 'open' باشد
 * - نباید به Invoice تبدیل شده باشد (relatedDealId در Invoice)
 * - balance != 0 (بدهی یا طلب دارد)  OR  inHand != 0 (کالا هنوز دست طرف)
 */
export function isDealOpen(d: Deal, invoices: Array<{ relatedDealId?: string }>): boolean {
  if (d.status !== 'open') return false;
  if (invoices.some(inv => inv.relatedDealId === d.id)) return false;
  if (computeDealBalance(d).balance !== 0) return true;
  if (computeDealInHand(d) !== 0) return true;
  return false;
}

/**
 * tra/caps.ts — سقف (Cap) برای فیلدهای معامله
 * استاندارد: SAP ATP (Available to Promise), Odoo Free Qty
 *
 * تصمیمات این جلسه:
 * ۱. source change → quantity reset (UI layer)
 * ۲. سقف بین معاملات (ATP)
 * ۳. sale بدون delivery = block
 * ۴. pcs باید integer باشد
 */
import type { Deal, DealGood, DealDelivery, DealSale, DealPayment } from './types';

/**
 * آیا دو Good از یک منبع میان؟
 * دو Good از یک منبع اگر: source, category, flockId, hatchId, stockItemId یکسان باشد
 */
function sameSource(a: DealGood, b: DealGood): boolean {
  if ((a.source || 'flock') !== (b.source || 'flock')) return false;
  if (a.category !== b.category) return false;
  if (a.existingFlockId !== b.existingFlockId) return false;
  if (a.hatchId !== b.hatchId) return false;
  if (a.stockItemId !== b.stockItemId) return false;
  return true;
}

/**
 * تحویل خالص برای یک good (out - return - loss)
 */
function netDeliveredForGood(good: DealGood, deliveries: DealDelivery[]): number {
  const dvs = deliveries.filter(d => d.goodId === good.id);
  const out = dvs.filter(d => d.type === 'out').reduce((s, d) => s + (d.quantity || 0), 0);
  const ret = dvs.filter(d => d.type === 'return').reduce((s, d) => s + (d.quantity || 0), 0);
  const loss = dvs.filter(d => d.type === 'loss').reduce((s, d) => s + (d.quantity || 0), 0);
  return out - ret - loss;
}

/**
 * سقف Goods — ATP (Available to Promise)
 * = sourceAvailable − Σ(سایر deals' remaining allocations)
 *
 * منطق:
 *  - deals canceled نباید حساب بشن
 *  - deals settled که تحویل کامل دارن: allocation = 0 (خودشون توی currentCount اعمال شدن)
 *  - deals settled با تحویل جزئی: allocation = باقیمانده (هنوز توی currentCount اعمال نشدن)
 *  - deals open: allocation = goods.quantity − delivered
 */
export function computeGoodsCap(
  good: DealGood,
  currentDealId: string,
  allDeals: Deal[],
  sourceAvailable: number,
  formGoods?: DealGood[]
): number {
  let otherAllocations = 0;

  // ۱. سایر معاملات (ATP)
  for (const deal of allDeals) {
    if (deal.id === currentDealId) continue;
    if (deal.status === 'cancelled') continue;
    for (const g of deal.goods || []) {
      if (!sameSource(g, good)) continue;
      const delivered = netDeliveredForGood(g, deal.deliveries || []);
      otherAllocations += Math.max(0, (g.quantity || 0) - delivered);
    }
  }

  // ۲. اقلام دیگر در همین معامله (به‌جز خودِ این قلم)
  const currentDeal = allDeals.find(d => d.id === currentDealId);
  if (currentDeal) {
    for (const g of currentDeal.goods || []) {
      if (g.id === good.id) continue;
      if (!sameSource(g, good)) continue;
      otherAllocations += g.quantity || 0;
    }
  }

  // ۳. 🆕 آیتم‌های دیگر در فرم فعلی (برای deal جدید)
  if (formGoods) {
    for (const g of formGoods) {
      if (g.id === good.id) continue;
      if (!sameSource(g, good)) continue;
      otherAllocations += g.quantity || 0;
    }
  }

  return Math.max(0, sourceAvailable - otherAllocations);
}

/**
 * سقف تحویل — Free Qty
 * = goods.quantity − netDelivered
 */
export function computeDeliveryCap(
  good: DealGood,
  deliveries: DealDelivery[],
  excludeDeliveryId?: string
): number {
  const filtered = excludeDeliveryId
    ? deliveries.filter(d => d.id !== excludeDeliveryId)
    : deliveries;
  const netDelivered = netDeliveredForGood(good, filtered);
  return Math.max(0, (good.quantity || 0) - netDelivered);
}

/**
 * سقف فروش — Delivered Qty
 * = netDelivered − Σ(previous sales)
 *
 * تصمیم ۴: sale > delivered = 0 (block در UI)
 */
export function computeSaleCap(
  goodId: string,
  deliveries: DealDelivery[],
  sales: DealSale[],
  excludeSaleId?: string
): number {
  const dvs = deliveries.filter(d => d.goodId === goodId);
  const out = dvs.filter(d => d.type === 'out').reduce((s, d) => s + (d.quantity || 0), 0);
  const ret = dvs.filter(d => d.type === 'return').reduce((s, d) => s + (d.quantity || 0), 0);
  const loss = dvs.filter(d => d.type === 'loss').reduce((s, d) => s + (d.quantity || 0), 0);
  const netDelivered = out - ret - loss;

  const filtered = excludeSaleId ? sales.filter(s => s.id !== excludeSaleId) : sales;
  const totalSold = filtered
    .filter(s => s.goodId === goodId)
    .reduce((s, x) => s + (x.quantity || 0), 0);

  return Math.max(0, netDelivered - totalSold);
}

/**
 * سقف پرداخت — Remaining Amount
 * = myShare − Σ(payments in) + Σ(refunds)
 */
export function computePaymentCap(
  myShare: number,
  payments: DealPayment[],
  excludePaymentId?: string
): number {
  let paidIn = 0;
  let paidOut = 0;
  for (const p of payments) {
    if (excludePaymentId && p.id === excludePaymentId) continue;
    if (p.direction === 'in') paidIn += p.amount || 0;
    else if (p.direction === 'out') paidOut += p.amount || 0;
  }
  return Math.max(0, myShare - paidIn + paidOut);
}

/**
 * AgingBuckets.tsx — کامپوننت ژنریک Aging Buckets
 * استفاده در: مطالبات / بدهی / معاملات
 * استاندارد: Stripe/Odoo — بدون رنگ اضافه، سلسله‌مراتب ۲ سطحی
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState, useMemo, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { AGING_BUCKETS, type AgingBucket } from '../calc';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';

type BucketKey = AgingBucket;

interface BucketAction<T> {
  label: string;
  icon?: string;
  primary?: boolean;
  onClick: (items: T[]) => void;
}

interface Props<T extends { id: string }> {
  items: T[];
  bucketOf: (item: T) => BucketKey;
  sumOf: (item: T) => number;
  renderSummary: (item: T) => ReactNode;
  renderDetails?: (item: T) => ReactNode;
  groupActions?: BucketAction<T>[];
  emptyText?: string;
}

export default function AgingBuckets<T extends { id: string }>({
  items, bucketOf, sumOf, renderSummary, renderDetails, groupActions, emptyText,
}: Props<T>) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const [openBucket, setOpenBucket] = useState<BucketKey | null>(null);
  const [openItem, setOpenItem] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const byBucket = useMemo(() => {
    const map: Record<BucketKey, T[]> = { 'current': [], '1-30': [], '31-60': [], '61-90': [], '91-180': [], '181-365': [], '+365': [] };
    items.forEach(it => { map[bucketOf(it)].push(it); });
    return map;
  }, [items, bucketOf]);

  const nonEmpty = AGING_BUCKETS.filter(b => byBucket[b.key as BucketKey].length > 0);

  if (nonEmpty.length === 0) {
    return emptyText ? (
      <div style={{ padding: 24, textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
        {emptyText}
      </div>
    ) : null;
  }

  return (
    <>
      {nonEmpty.map(({ key, label }) => {
        const bucketItems = byBucket[key as BucketKey];
        const isOpen = openBucket === key;
        const total = bucketItems.reduce((s, it) => s + sumOf(it), 0);

        return (
          <div
            key={key}
            style={{
              background: 'var(--card)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border)',
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
              marginBottom: 10,
              overflow: 'hidden',
            }}
          >
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => { setOpenBucket(isOpen ? null : key as BucketKey); setOpenItem(null); }}
              style={{
                width: '100%',
                display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center',
                padding: '12px 14px',
                background: 'transparent', border: 'none',
                borderBottom: isOpen ? '1px solid var(--border)' : 'none',
                cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit', textAlign: 'right',
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 800, color: 'var(--text)' }}>{label}</span>
                <span style={{
                  fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--muted)',
                  padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: 12, border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                }}>
                  {fmt.count(bucketItems.length)} مورد
                </span>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', fontWeight: 800, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' }}>
                  {fmt.money(total)}
                </span>
                <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="var(--muted)" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round"
                  style={{ marginRight: 8, transform: isOpen ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'none', transition: 'transform .2s' }}>
                  <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" />
                </svg>
              </div>
            </button>

            {isOpen && (
              <>
                {groupActions && groupActions.length > 0 && (
                  <div style={{
                    display: 'flex', gap: 6, padding: '8px 12px',
                    borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
                  }}>
                    {groupActions.map((action, idx) => (
                      <button
                        key={idx}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => action.onClick(bucketItems)}
                        style={{
                          flex: 1, minHeight: 34, padding: '8px 8px',
                          borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                          fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 700,
                          cursor: 'pointer',
                          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 4,
                          ...(action.primary
                            ? { background: 'var(--accent)', color: '#fff', border: '1px solid var(--accent)' }
                            : { background: 'var(--card)', color: 'var(--text)', border: '1px solid var(--border)' }),
                        }}
                      >
                        {action.icon && <span>{action.icon}</span>}
                        {action.label}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}

                <div style={{ padding: 10, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
                  {bucketItems.map(item => {
                    const isItemOpen = openItem === item.id;
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={item.id}
                        style={{
                          background: 'var(--card-solid, #fff)',
                          border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                          borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                          boxShadow: '0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)',
                          overflow: 'hidden',
                        }}
                      >
                        <div
                          onClick={() => setOpenItem(isItemOpen ? null : item.id)}
                          style={{ padding: '10px 12px', cursor: 'pointer', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}
                        >
                          {renderSummary(item)}
                        </div>
                        {isItemOpen && renderDetails && (
                          <div style={{
                            borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',
                            padding: '12px',
                            display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0,
                          }}>
                            {renderDetails(item)}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * AgingReportModal.tsx — گزارش Aging (تحلیل سنی بدهی/طلب)
 * استاندارد: SAP FBL5N
 */
import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Modal, ModalFooter, Field, Grid2 } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import DatePicker from '../../../shr/components/DatePicker';
import { useTra, computeDealBalance, remaining, AGING_BUCKETS } from '../store';
import { agingBucketFromDue } from '../formulas';
import { useCtc } from '../../ctc/store';
import { useSet } from '../../set/store';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { toCSV, downloadCSV, printHTML } from '../../../shr/utils/export';
import { getTodayJalali } from '../calc';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

interface AgingRow {
  kind: 'invoice' | 'deal';
  name: string;
  partyName: string;
  amount: number;
  bucket: string;
}

import type { AgingBucket } from '../calc';
type BucketKey = AgingBucket;

function bucketFromDate(dueDate: string, today: string): BucketKey {
  if (!dueDate) return 'current';
  try {
    const en = (s: string) => s.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (x) => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(x)));
    const [y, m, d] = en(dueDate).split('/').map(Number);
    const [ty, tm, td] = en(today).split('/').map(Number);
    const dueTime = new Date(y, m - 1, d).getTime();
    const todayTime = new Date(ty, tm - 1, td).getTime();
    const days = Math.floor((todayTime - dueTime) / 86400000);
    if (days <= 0) return 'current';
    if (days <= 30) return '1-30';
    if (days <= 60) return '31-60';
    if (days <= 90) return '61-90';
    if (days <= 180) return '91-180';
    if (days <= 365) return '181-365';
    return '+365';
  } catch {
    return 'current';
  }
}

export default function AgingReportModal({ open, onClose }: Props) {
  const { invoices, deals, allocations } = useTra();
  const { contacts } = useCtc();
  const settings: any = useSet();

  const [fromDate, setFromDate] = useState('');
  const [toDate, setToDate] = useState(getTodayJalali());

  const today = getTodayJalali();

  const rows = useMemo<AgingRow[]>(() => {
    const raw: AgingRow[] = [];

    // ─── Invoices ───
    for (const inv of invoices) {
      const rem = remaining(inv, allocations);
      if (rem <= 0) continue;
      if (fromDate && inv.date < fromDate) continue;
      if (toDate && inv.date > toDate) continue;
      const party = contacts.find((c) => c.id === inv.partyId);
      const bucket = inv.dueDate ? agingBucketFromDue(inv) : bucketFromDate(inv.date, today);
      raw.push({
        kind: 'invoice',
        name: `${inv.type === 'sale' ? 'فروش' : 'خرید'} ${inv.number || inv.id.slice(0, 6)}`,
        partyName: party?.name || '—',
        amount: rem,
        bucket,
      });
    }

    // ─── Deals (فقط باز) ───
    const invoicedDealIds = new Set(
      invoices.filter((i) => i.relatedDealId).map((i) => i.relatedDealId as string),
    );
    for (const d of deals) {
      if (d.status !== 'open') continue;
      if (invoicedDealIds.has(d.id)) continue;
      if (fromDate && d.date < fromDate) continue;
      if (toDate && d.date > toDate) continue;
      const bal = computeDealBalance(d).balance;
      if (Math.abs(bal) < 0.01) continue;
      const party = contacts.find((c) => c.id === d.partyId);
      const bucket = bucketFromDate(d.dueDate || d.date, today);
      raw.push({
        kind: 'deal',
        name: `معامله ${d.dealNumber || d.id.slice(0, 6)}`,
        partyName: party?.name || '—',
        amount: Math.abs(bal),
        bucket,
      });
    }

    return raw;
  }, [invoices, deals, allocations, contacts, fromDate, toDate, today]);

  const bucketSummary = useMemo(() => {
    const map: Record<BucketKey, { count: number; sum: number }> = {
      'current': { count: 0, sum: 0 },
      '1-30': { count: 0, sum: 0 },
      '31-60': { count: 0, sum: 0 },
      '61-90': { count: 0, sum: 0 },
      '91-180': { count: 0, sum: 0 },
      '181-365': { count: 0, sum: 0 },
      '+365': { count: 0, sum: 0 },
    };
    for (const r of rows) {
      const k = r.bucket as BucketKey;
      if (map[k]) {
        map[k].count += 1;
        map[k].sum += r.amount;
      }
    }
    return map;
  }, [rows]);

  const totalCount = rows.length;
  const totalSum = rows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.amount, 0);

  const handleCSV = () => {
    const headers = ['ردیف', 'نوع', 'نام', 'طرف حساب', 'مبلغ (تومان)', 'باکت'];
    const data = rows.map((r, i) => [
      i + 1,
      r.kind === 'invoice' ? 'فاکتور' : 'معامله',
      r.name,
      r.partyName,
      r.amount,
      r.bucket,
    ]);
    const csv = toCSV(headers, data);
    downloadCSV('aging-report', csv);
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    const farmName = settings?.farm?.name || 'مرغداری';
    const bucketRows = AGING_BUCKETS.map((b) => {
      const k = b.key as BucketKey;
      const s = bucketSummary[k];
      return `<tr><td>${b.label}</td><td>${getGlobalFormat().count(s.count)}</td><td>${getGlobalFormat().money(s.sum, { withUnit: false })}</td></tr>`;
    }).join('');

    const html = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html dir="rtl" lang="fa"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><title>گزارش Aging</title>
<style>
@import url('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/rastikerdar/vazirmatn@v33.003/Vazirmatn-font-face.css');
body { font-family: Vazirmatn, sans-serif; direction: rtl; padding: 24px; font-size: 12px; color: #0f172a; }
h1 { color: #16a34a; font-size: 18px; margin: 0 0 4px; }
.header { border-bottom: 2px solid #16a34a; padding-bottom: 10px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.meta { color: #64748b; font-size: 11px; }
table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 16px; }
th { background: #f1f5f9; padding: 8px; text-align: right; border-bottom: 2px solid #cbd5e1; }
td { padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }
.total { font-weight: 700; background: #f1f5f9; }
</style></head><body>
<div class="header"><h1>${farmName}</h1><div class="meta">گزارش Aging — تحلیل سنی بدهی/طلب</div></div>
<div class="meta">بازه: ${getGlobalFormat().code(fromDate || '—')} تا ${getGlobalFormat().code(toDate || '—')} | مجموع: ${getGlobalFormat().count(totalCount)} مورد — ${getGlobalFormat().money(totalSum, { withUnit: false })} تومان</div>
<table>
<thead><tr><th>باکت</th><th>تعداد</th><th>مجموع (تومان)</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>${bucketRows}<tr class="total"><td>مجموع کل</td><td>${getGlobalFormat().count(totalCount)}</td><td>${getGlobalFormat().money(totalSum, { withUnit: false })}</td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</body></html>`;
    printHTML(html);
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="📊 گزارش Aging"
      size="lg"
      footer={
        <ModalFooter actions={[
          { label: 'CSV', role: 'primary', onClick: handleCSV, disabled: rows.length === 0 },
          { label: '📄 چاپ', role: 'secondary', onClick: handlePrint, disabled: rows.length === 0 },
          { label: 'بستن', role: 'secondary', onClick: onClose },
        ]} />
      }
    >
      <Grid2>
        <Field label="از تاریخ">
          <DatePicker value={fromDate} onChange={setFromDate} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="تا تاریخ">
          <DatePicker value={toDate} onChange={setToDate} autoToday />
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 24, textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
          تراکنشی در این بازه وجود ندارد.
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div style={{ marginTop: 8, marginBottom: 8, fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
            مجموع: {getGlobalFormat().count(totalCount)} مورد — {getGlobalFormat().money(totalSum, { withUnit: false })} تومان
          </div>
          <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
            <thead>
              <tr style={{ background: 'var(--input-bg)' }}>
                <th style={{ padding: 8, textAlign: 'right' }}>باکت</th>
                <th style={{ padding: 8, textAlign: 'center' }}>تعداد</th>
                <th style={{ padding: 8, textAlign: 'left' }}>مجموع (تومان)</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {AGING_BUCKETS.map((b) => {
                const k = b.key as BucketKey;
                const s = bucketSummary[k];
                return (
                  <tr key={b.key} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)' }}>
                    <td style={{ padding: 6, color: `var(--${b.color})`, fontWeight: 600 }}>{b.label}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: 6, textAlign: 'center', fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' }}>{getGlobalFormat().count(s.count)}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: 6, textAlign: 'left', fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' }}>
                      {getGlobalFormat().money(s.sum, { withUnit: false })}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
              <tr style={{ background: 'var(--accent-soft)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                <td style={{ padding: 8 }}>مجموع</td>
                <td style={{ padding: 8, textAlign: 'center' }}>{getGlobalFormat().count(totalCount)}</td>
                <td style={{ padding: 8, textAlign: 'left' }}>{getGlobalFormat().money(totalSum, { withUnit: false })}</td>
              </tr>

/**
 * ApplyAdvanceModal.tsx — تخصیص پیش‌پرداخت به فاکتور موجود
 * الگو: FIFO (قدیمی‌ترین اول) | استاندارد: SAP FI-AR credit memo
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Modal, Btn, BtnRow, Input } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { useTra, buildAdvanceAllocations, computeUnappliedAdvances, type Invoice } from '../store';
import { useCtc } from '../../ctc/store';
import { toFa, toEn } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { getTodayJalali, remaining } from '../calc';
import { toastMsg } from '../../../cor/store/toast';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../../cor/store/dialog';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  invoice: Invoice | null;
}

export default function ApplyAdvanceModal({ open, onClose, invoice }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const updateInvoice = useTra(s => s.updateInvoice);
  const partyPayments = useTra(s => s.partyPayments);
  const allocations = useTra(s => s.allocations);
  const contacts = useCtc(s => s.contacts);

  const [amountStr, setAmountStr] = useState('');

  const party = invoice ? contacts.find(c => c.id === invoice.partyId) : null;
  const rem = invoice ? remaining(invoice, allocations) : 0;
  const unapplied = invoice ? computeUnappliedAdvances(invoice.partyId) : 0;
  const maxAmount = Math.min(rem, unapplied);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open && invoice) setAmountStr(String(Math.floor(maxAmount)));
  }, [open, invoice?.id, maxAmount]);

  const advanceAllocs = useMemo(() => {
    if (!invoice) return [];
    const amount = parseInt(toEn(amountStr)) || 0;
    if (amount <= 0) return [];
    return buildAdvanceAllocations(invoice.partyId, amount, getTodayJalali());
  }, [invoice, amountStr]);

  const totalAllocated = advanceAllocs.reduce((a, b) => a + b.amount, 0);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!invoice) return;
    if (totalAllocated <= 0) { toastMsg.error('مبلغ نامعتبر'); return; }
    if (totalAllocated > rem + 0.5) { toastMsg.error('مبلغ بیشتر از باقی‌مانده'); return; }

    const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
      'مصرف پیش‌پرداخت',
      `${fmt.money(totalAllocated, { withUnit: false })} تومان پیش‌پرداخت به این فاکتور تخصیص می‌یابد؟`,
      { confirmText: 'تخصیص' }
    );
    if (!ok) return;

    const today = getTodayJalali();
    const newPayments = advanceAllocs.map(a => ({
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      date: today,
      amount: a.amount,
      method: 'cash' as const,
      type: 'advance' as const,
      partyPaymentId: a.partyPaymentId,
      checkNo: '',
      bank: '',
      dueDate: '',
      notes: 'مصرف از پیش‌پرداخت',
    }));

    try {
      updateInvoice(invoice.id, {
        payments: [...(invoice.payments || []), ...newPayments],
      });
      toastMsg.success('پیش‌پرداخت تخصیص یافت');
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[ApplyAdvance]', e);
      toastMsg.error('خطا در تخصیص');
    }
  };

  if (!invoice) return null;

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="⚡ مصرف پیش‌پرداخت"
      size="md"
      footer={
        <BtnRow>
          <Btn variant="primary" onClick={() => void handleSave()} disabled={totalAllocated <= 0}>
            تخصیص {fmt.money(totalAllocated)}
          </Btn>
          <Btn onClick={onClose}>لغو</Btn>
        </BtnRow>
      }
    >
      <div style={{ padding: 12, background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700 }}>{party?.name || '—'}</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 4 }}>
          فاکتور {invoice.number} — باقی‌مانده: {fmt.money(rem)}
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--accent)', marginTop: 4, fontWeight: 600 }}>
          ⚡ پیش‌پرداخت موجود: {fmt.money(unapplied)}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: 6 }}>
        مبلغ تخصیص (حداکثر {fmt.money(maxAmount, { withUnit: false })})
      </div>
      <Input
        value={fmt.code(amountStr)}
        onChange={e => setAmountStr(toEn(e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9۰-۹]/g, '')))}
        inputMode="tel"
        unit="تومان"
      />

      {advanceAllocs.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{ marginTop: 12, padding: 8, background: 'var(--accent-soft)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: 4 }}>
            📊 تخصیص FIFO (قدیمی‌ترین اول):
          </div>
          {advanceAllocs.map(a => {
            const pp = partyPayments.find(p => p.id === a.partyPaymentId);
            return (
              <div key={a.partyPaymentId} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', padding: '2px 0' }}>
                <span>{pp?.date || '—'}</span>
                <span style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{fmt.money(a.amount)}</span>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/tra/components/ChecksModal.tsx
