import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { Tag } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
/**
 * ChecksModal.tsx — مدیریت چک‌ها (modal)
 */
import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useTra, DEAL_LABEL } from '../store';
import type { PartyPayment, Invoice, Deal, CheckStatus } from '../store';
import { useCtc } from '../../ctc/store';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { daysUntilJalali } from '../helpers';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../../cor/store/dialog';
import { toastMsg } from '../../../cor/store/toast';
import { Modal, Btn, Empty } from '../../../shr/components/ui';

const CAT_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  chick: 'جوجه', egg: 'تخم', fertile_egg: 'تخم نطفه‌دار',
  adult: 'پرنده بالغ', feed: 'دان', medicine: 'دارو',
  vaccine: 'واکسن', herbal: 'داروی گیاهی', equipment: 'تجهیزات',
  manure: 'کود', broken: 'تخم شکسته', other: 'سایر',
};

const STATUS_INFO: Record<CheckStatus, { label: string; bg: string; color: string; icon: string }> = {
  pending:    { label: 'در دست',   bg: 'var(--warn-soft)',   color: 'var(--warn)',   icon: '⏳' },
  in_transit: { label: 'در جریان', bg: 'var(--info-soft, rgba(2,132,199,.12))', color: 'var(--info, #0284c7)', icon: '↑' },
  cleared:    { label: 'وصول شده', bg: 'var(--accent-soft)', color: 'var(--accent)', icon: '✓' },
  bounced:    { label: 'برگشتی',   bg: 'var(--danger-soft)', color: 'var(--danger)', icon: '✗' },
};

type FilterKey = 'all' | 'pending' | 'in_transit' | 'cleared' | 'bounced' | 'soon';

interface CheckRow {
  pp: PartyPayment;
  status: CheckStatus;
  partyName: string;
  roleLabel: string;
  subjectLabel: string;
  docNumber: string;
  daysUntilDue: number | null;
}

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export default function ChecksModal({ open, onClose }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { partyPayments, invoices, deals, depositPartyPayment, clearPartyPayment, bouncePartyPayment } = useTra();
  const { contacts } = useCtc();
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<FilterKey>('all');

  const rows = useMemo<CheckRow[]>(() => {
    const partyMap = new Map(contacts.map(c => [c.id, c]));
    const ppToInv = new Map<string, Invoice>();
    for (const inv of invoices) {
      for (const p of inv.payments || []) {
        if (p.partyPaymentId) ppToInv.set(p.partyPaymentId, inv);
      }
    }
    const ppToDeal = new Map<string, Deal>();
    for (const deal of deals) {
      for (const p of deal.payments || []) {
        if (p.partyPaymentId) ppToDeal.set(p.partyPaymentId, deal);
      }
    }
    return partyPayments
      .filter(pp => pp.method === 'check')
      .map(pp => {
        const status: CheckStatus = pp.status || 'pending';
        const party = partyMap.get(pp.partyId);
        const inv = ppToInv.get(pp.id);
        const deal = ppToDeal.get(pp.id);
        const days = pp.dueDate ? daysUntilJalali(pp.dueDate) : null;
        let roleLabel = '—';
        let subjectLabel = pp.notes || '—';
        let docNumber = '';
        if (inv) {
          roleLabel = inv.type === 'sale' ? 'خریدار' : 'فروشنده';
          subjectLabel = inv.items?.[0]?.description || CAT_LABEL[inv.category] || inv.category || '—';
          docNumber = inv.number || '';
        } else if (deal) {
          roleLabel = 'معامله';
          subjectLabel = deal.description || DEAL_LABEL[deal.type];
          docNumber = deal.dealNumber || '';
        }
        return { pp, status, partyName: party?.name || '—', roleLabel, subjectLabel, docNumber, daysUntilDue: days };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        const order: Record<CheckStatus, number> = { pending: 0, in_transit: 1, cleared: 2, bounced: 3 };
        if (order[a.status] !== order[b.status]) return order[a.status] - order[b.status];
        return (a.daysUntilDue ?? 999) - (b.daysUntilDue ?? 999);
      });
  }, [partyPayments, invoices, deals, contacts]);

  const counts = useMemo(() => {
    const c = { all: rows.length, pending: 0, in_transit: 0, cleared: 0, bounced: 0, soon: 0 };
    for (const r of rows) {
      c[r.status]++;
      if (r.status === 'pending' && r.daysUntilDue !== null && r.daysUntilDue >= 0 && r.daysUntilDue <= 7) c.soon++;
    }
    return c;
  }, [rows]);

  const summary = useMemo(() => {
    let hand = 0, transit = 0, cleared = 0, bounced = 0;
    for (const r of rows) {
      if (r.status === 'pending') hand += r.pp.amount;
      else if (r.status === 'in_transit') transit += r.pp.amount;
      else if (r.status === 'cleared') cleared += r.pp.amount;
      else if (r.status === 'bounced') bounced += r.pp.amount;
    }
    return { hand, transit, cleared, bounced, total: hand + transit };
  }, [rows]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (filter === 'all') return rows;
    if (filter === 'soon') return rows.filter(r => r.status === 'pending' && r.daysUntilDue !== null && r.daysUntilDue >= 0 && r.daysUntilDue <= 7);
    return rows.filter(r => r.status === filter);
  }, [rows, filter]);

  const groups = useMemo(() => {
    const urgent: CheckRow[] = [];
    const openRows: CheckRow[] = [];
    const closed: CheckRow[] = [];
    for (const r of filtered) {
      if (r.status === 'cleared' || r.status === 'bounced') closed.push(r);
      else if (r.status === 'pending' && r.daysUntilDue !== null && r.daysUntilDue >= 0 && r.daysUntilDue <= 7) urgent.push(r);
      else openRows.push(r);
    }
    return { urgent, open: openRows, closed };
  }, [filtered]);

  const handleAction = async (row: CheckRow, action: 'deposit' | 'clear' | 'bounce') => {
    const { pp } = row;
    const amountFa = fmt.money(pp.amount, { withUnit: false });
    const checkLabel = pp.checkNo ? `چک #${pp.checkNo}` : 'چک';
    let title = '', msg = '', confirmText = '', danger = false;
    if (action === 'deposit') {
      title = 'واریز به بانک';
      msg = `${checkLabel} به مبلغ ${amountFa} تومان را به بانک واریز می‌کنید؟`;
      confirmText = 'بله، واریز شد';
    } else if (action === 'clear') {
      title = 'تایید وصول';
      msg = `${checkLabel} به مبلغ ${amountFa} تومان وصول شد؟`;
      confirmText = 'بله، وصول شد';
    } else {
      title = 'تایید برگشت';
      msg = `${checkLabel} به مبلغ ${amountFa} تومان برگشت خورد؟ این عمل اثر مالی دارد.`;
      confirmText = 'بله، برگشت خورد';
      danger = true;
    }
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync(title, msg, { danger, confirmText });
    if (!ok) return;
    try {
      if (action === 'deposit') depositPartyPayment(pp.id);
      else if (action === 'clear') clearPartyPayment(pp.id);
      else bouncePartyPayment(pp.id);
      toastMsg.success('وضعیت چک به‌روز شد');
    } catch (e) {
      toastMsg.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'خطا در ثبت');
    }
  };

  const filters: { key: FilterKey; label: string; count: number }[] = [
    { key: 'all', label: 'همه', count: counts.all },
    { key: 'pending', label: 'در دست', count: counts.pending },
    { key: 'in_transit', label: 'در جریان', count: counts.in_transit },
    { key: 'soon', label: 'نزدیک سرسید', count: counts.soon },
    { key: 'cleared', label: 'وصول شده', count: counts.cleared },
    { key: 'bounced', label: 'برگشتی', count: counts.bounced },
  ];

  const renderCard = (row: CheckRow) => {
    const info = STATUS_INFO[row.status];
    const dueLabel = row.daysUntilDue === null ? null
      : row.daysUntilDue < 0 ? `${fmt.day(Math.abs(row.daysUntilDue))} روز گذشته`
      : row.daysUntilDue === 0 ? 'امروز'
      : `${fmt.day(row.daysUntilDue)} روز مانده`;
    const dueTone = row.daysUntilDue !== null && row.daysUntilDue <= 3 ? 'var(--danger)'
      : row.daysUntilDue !== null && row.daysUntilDue <= 7 ? 'var(--warn)'
      : 'var(--muted)';
    const isUrgent = row.status === 'pending' && row.daysUntilDue !== null && row.daysUntilDue >= 0 && row.daysUntilDue <= 7;
    const rightBorder = row.status === 'bounced'
      ? '3px solid var(--danger)'
      : isUrgent ? '3px solid var(--warn)' : '1px solid var(--border)';
    return (
      <div key={row.pp.id} style={{
        background: 'var(--card)',
        borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',
        borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
        borderLeft: '1px solid var(--border)',
        borderRight: rightBorder,
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)', padding: '10px 12px', marginBottom: 6,
      }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 4 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 800, color: 'var(--text)' }}>{row.partyName}</span>
            {row.roleLabel !== '—' && (
              <span style={{ fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 600, padding: '1px 6px', borderRadius: 4, background: 'var(--input-bg)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{row.roleLabel}</span>
            )}
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 4, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', fontWeight: 800, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' }}>{fmt.money(row.pp.amount, { withUnit: false })}</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 500 }}>تومان</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 4 }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 500 }}>{row.subjectLabel}</span>
          {dueLabel && <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: dueTone, fontWeight: 600, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{dueLabel}</span>}
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 6 }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--dim)', fontWeight: 400 }}>
            چک شماره {row.pp.checkNo || '—'}{row.pp.bank ? ` • ${row.pp.bank}` : ''}
          </span>
          {row.docNumber && <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--dim)', fontWeight: 400 }}>فاکتور {row.docNumber}</span>}
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)', paddingTop: 6 }}>
          <Tag style={{ background: info.bg, color: info.color }}>{info.label}</Tag>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center' }}>
            {row.status === 'pending' && <Btn size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => void handleAction(row, 'deposit')}>↑ واریز به بانک</Btn>}
            {row.status === 'in_transit' && <Btn size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => void handleAction(row, 'clear')}>✓ وصول شد</Btn>}
            {(row.status === 'pending' || row.status === 'in_transit') && (
              <Btn size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => void handleAction(row, 'bounce')} style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', border: '1px solid var(--danger-border)' }}>✗ برگشت</Btn>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title="🧾 مدیریت چک‌ها" size="lg">
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8, paddingTop: 8 }}>

        {rows.length > 0 && (
          <div style={{ background: 'var(--card)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', padding: '12px' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 12 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>کل چک‌های باز</span>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-lg)', fontWeight: 800, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                {fmt.money(summary.total, { withUnit: false })}
                <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--muted)', marginRight: 4 }}>تومان</span>
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 8 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', padding: '8px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 500 }}>در دست</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', fontWeight: 800, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', color: summary.hand > 0 ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--muted)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{fmt.money(summary.hand, { withUnit: false })}</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', padding: '8px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 500 }}>در جریان</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', fontWeight: 800, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', color: summary.transit > 0 ? 'var(--info, #0284c7)' : 'var(--muted)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{fmt.money(summary.transit, { withUnit: false })}</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', padding: '8px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 500 }}>وصول شده</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', fontWeight: 800, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', color: summary.cleared > 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{fmt.money(summary.cleared, { withUnit: false })}</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', padding: '8px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 500 }}>برگشتی</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', fontWeight: 800, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', color: summary.bounced > 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--muted)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{fmt.money(summary.bounced, { withUnit: false })}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {rows.length > 0 && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, overflowX: 'auto', scrollbarWidth: 'none', paddingBottom: 2 }}>
            {filters.map(f => (
              <button key={f.key} type="button" onClick={() => setFilter(f.key)} style={{
                padding: '6px 11px', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                background: filter === f.key ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--btn-bg)',
                border: `1px solid ${filter === f.key ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'}`,
                borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                color: filter === f.key ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
                fontWeight: filter === f.key ? 600 : 500,
                fontFamily: 'inherit', cursor: 'pointer', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', flexShrink: 0,
              }}>{f.label} ({fmt.count(f.count)})</button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {groups.urgent.length > 0 && (
          <>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--danger)', padding: '4px 0', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              ⚠ نیاز به اقدام فوری
              <div style={{ flex: 1, height: 1, background: 'var(--border)' }} />
            </div>
            {groups.urgent.map(renderCard)}
          </>
        )}

        {groups.open.length > 0 && (
          <>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--muted)', padding: '4px 0', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              سایر چک‌های باز
              <div style={{ flex: 1, height: 1, background: 'var(--border)' }} />
            </div>
            {groups.open.map(renderCard)}
          </>
        )}

        {groups.closed.length > 0 && (
          <>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--muted)', padding: '4px 0', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              بسته‌شده
              <div style={{ flex: 1, height: 1, background: 'var(--border)' }} />
            </div>
            {groups.closed.map(renderCard)}
          </>
        )}

        {rows.length === 0 && (
          <Empty icon={<span style={{ fontSize: 24 }}>📋</span>} title="هنوز چکی ثبت نشده" desc="برای ثبت چک، از طریق فاکتور یا معامله اقدام کنید" />
        )}

        {rows.length > 0 && filtered.length === 0 && (
          <div style={{ padding: 32, textAlign: 'center', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)' }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 24, marginBottom: 8 }}>📋</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 4 }}>چکی با این فیلتر پیدا نشد</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>فیلتر را تغییر دهید</div>
          </div>
        )}

      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/tra/components/DealPayModal.tsx

/**
 * DealPayModal.tsx v2 — ثبت پرداخت/دریافت برای یک معامله
 * استاندارد Odoo/SAP: quick amounts + partial hint + check details
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Modal, Btn, BtnRow, Field, Grid2, MoneyField, Select, Textarea } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import DatePicker from '../../../shr/components/DatePicker';
import { toEn, toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { getTodayJalali, computeDealBalance } from '../calc';
import { toastMsg } from '../../../cor/store/toast';
import { getDealPaymentFormSchema } from '../../../shr/validation/rules/tra';
import { useValidation } from '../../../shr/validation/useValidation';
import { useFormErrors } from '../../../shr/hooks/useFormErrors';
import { FieldHint, recordHistory } from '../../../shr/intelligence';
import { useTra } from '../store';
import type { Deal, DealPayment } from '../types';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  deal: Deal | null;
}

export default function DealPayModal({ open, onClose, deal }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { deals, updateDeal, addPartyPayment } = useTra();
  const liveDeal = deal ? deals.find(d => d.id === deal.id) : null;
  const effectiveDeal = liveDeal || deal;
  const [date, setDate] = useState(getTodayJalali());
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState('');
  const [method, setMethod] = useState<'cash' | 'card' | 'check'>('cash');
  const [direction, setDirection] = useState<'in' | 'out'>('in');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
  const [checkNo, setCheckNo] = useState('');
  const [bank, setBank] = useState('');
  const [checkDue, setCheckDue] = useState('');

  const bal = useMemo(() => (effectiveDeal ? Math.abs(computeDealBalance(effectiveDeal).balance) : 0), [effectiveDeal]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!effectiveDeal || !open) return;
    const balance = computeDealBalance(effectiveDeal).balance;
    setAmount(String(Math.abs(balance)));
    setDirection(balance >= 0 ? 'in' : 'out');
    setDate(getTodayJalali());
    setMethod('cash');
    setNotes('');
    setCheckNo('');
    setBank('');
    setCheckDue('');
  }, [effectiveDeal, open]);

  const entered = parseFloat(toEn(amount)) || 0;
  const remaining = bal - entered;
  const quickSet = (pct: number) => setAmount(String(Math.round(bal * pct)));

  const schema = useMemo(() => getDealPaymentFormSchema(bal), [bal]);
  const { errors: vErrors } = useValidation(schema, {
    date,
    amount: entered,
    direction,
    method,
    notes: notes.trim(),
    checkNo: checkNo.trim(),
    bank: bank.trim(),
    dueDate: checkDue,
  });
  const { showError, markTouched, attemptSave, reset: resetErrors } = useFormErrors(vErrors);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) resetErrors();
  }, [open, resetErrors]);

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!effectiveDeal) return;
    attemptSave();
    if (Object.keys(vErrors).length > 0) return;
    try {
      // ۱. ساخت PartyPayment (برای computePartyCredit + Statement + audit)
      let ppId: string | undefined;
      if (entered > 0) {
        ppId = addPartyPayment({
          partyId: effectiveDeal.partyId,
          date,
          amount: entered,
          method,
          type: 'regular',
          checkNo: method === 'check' ? checkNo.trim() : '',
          bank: method === 'check' ? bank.trim() : '',
          dueDate: method === 'check' ? checkDue : '',
          notes: notes.trim() || `پرداخت معامله ${effectiveDeal.dealNumber || ''}`,
          status: method === 'check' ? 'pending' : undefined,
        } as any);
      }

      // ۲. ساخت DealPayment (متصل به PartyPayment)
      const newPayment: DealPayment = {
        id: crypto.randomUUID(),
        date,
        amount: entered,
        direction,
        method,
        notes: notes.trim() || undefined,
        checkNo: method === 'check' ? checkNo.trim() : undefined,
        bank: method === 'check' ? bank.trim() : undefined,
        dueDate: method === 'check' ? checkDue : undefined,
        status: method === 'check' ? 'pending' : undefined,
        partyPaymentId: ppId,
      };
      updateDeal(effectiveDeal.id, { payments: [...(effectiveDeal.payments || []), newPayment] });
      if (entered > 0) recordHistory('tra.deal.payment', entered, {});
      toastMsg.saved();
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[DealPay]', e);
      toastMsg.error('خطا در ثبت پرداخت');
    }
  };

  if (!effectiveDeal) return null;

  const isIn = direction === 'in';
  const title = isIn ? '💳 ثبت دریافت' : '💳 ثبت پرداخت';

  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title={title} size="md">
      <div style={{
        padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
        background: 'var(--input-bg)',
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
        marginBottom: 'var(--sp-3)',
        fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
        display: 'flex',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        alignItems: 'center',
      }}>
        <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>بدهی فعلی</span>
        <b style={{ fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' }}>{fmt.money(bal)}</b>
      </div>

      <Grid2>
        <Field label="تاریخ" required error={showError('date')} onTouch={() => markTouched('date')}>
          <DatePicker value={date} onChange={setDate} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="مبلغ" required error={showError('amount')} onTouch={() => markTouched('amount')}>
          <MoneyField value={amount} onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)} />
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      {entered > 0 && <FieldHint fieldPath="tra.deal.payment" value={entered} />}

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, marginTop: 6, marginBottom: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
        {[25, 50, 75, 100].map(pct => (
          <button
            key={pct}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => quickSet(pct / 100)}
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              minWidth: 56,
              padding: '6px 4px',
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
              background: 'var(--input-bg)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border)',
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
              color: 'var(--text)',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              fontFamily: 'inherit',
            }}
          >
            {pct === 100 ? 'کل' : `${fmt.num(pct)}٪`}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {entered > 0 && entered < bal && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--warn)', marginBottom: 8 }}>
          ↳ باقی‌مانده: <b>{fmt.money(remaining)}</b>
        </div>
      )}
      {entered > bal && bal > 0 && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--danger)', marginBottom: 8 }}>
          ⚠ مبلغ وارد شده بیشتر از بدهی است
        </div>
      )}
      {entered === bal && bal > 0 && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--accent)', marginBottom: 8 }}>
          ✓ این پرداخت کل بدهی را تسویه می‌کند
        </div>
      )}

      <Grid2>
        <Field label="جهت">
          <Select value={direction} onChange={e => setDirection(e.target.value as 'in' | 'out')}>
            <option value="in">📥 دریافت از طرف</option>
            <option value="out">📤 پرداخت به طرف</option>
          </Select>
        </Field>
        <Field label="روش">
          <Select value={method} onChange={e => setMethod(e.target.value as 'cash' | 'card' | 'check')}>
            <option value="cash">نقدی</option>
            <option value="card">کارت</option>
            <option value="check">چک</option>
          </Select>
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      {method === 'check' && (
        <>
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="شماره چک" required error={showError('checkNo')} onTouch={() => markTouched('checkNo')}>
              <input
                value={checkNo}
                onChange={e => setCheckNo(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="۱۲۳۴۵۶"
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
                  background: 'var(--input-bg)',
                  border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                  borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                  fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                  fontFamily: 'inherit',
                  boxSizing: 'border-box',
                }}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label="بانک">
              <input
                value={bank}
                onChange={e => setBank(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="ملی، صادرات..."
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
                  background: 'var(--input-bg)',
                  border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                  borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                  fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                  fontFamily: 'inherit',
                  boxSizing: 'border-box',
                }}
              />
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
          <Field label="سرسید چک">
            <DatePicker value={checkDue} onChange={setCheckDue} />
          </Field>
        </>
      )}

      <Field label="توضیحات">
        <Textarea value={notes} onChange={e => setNotes(e.target.value)} />
      </Field>

      <BtnRow>
        <Btn variant="outline" onClick={onClose}>انصراف</Btn>
        <Btn variant="primary" onClick={handleSave}>ثبت</Btn>
      </BtnRow>
    </Modal>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/tra/components/DealPrint.tsx

/**
 * DealPrint.tsx — سند چاپ قرارداد معامله
 */
import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useSet } from '../../set/store';
import { useCtc } from '../../ctc/store';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { printHTML } from '../../../shr/utils/export';
import { DEAL_LABEL, computeDealBalance } from '../store';
import type { Deal } from '../types';

interface Props {
  deal: Deal;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export default function DealPrint({ deal, onClose }: Props) {
  const settings: any = useSet();
  const { contacts } = useCtc();
  const party = contacts.find(c => c.id === deal.partyId);

  const buildHtml = () => {
    const farmName = settings?.farm?.name || 'مرغداری';
    const farmAddr = settings?.farm?.address || '';
    const farmPhone = settings?.farm?.phone || '';
    const bal = computeDealBalance(deal);

    const goodsRows = (deal.goods || []).map(g => {
      const out = (deal.deliveries || []).filter(dv => dv.goodId === g.id && dv.type === 'out').reduce((s, dv) => s + (Number(dv.quantity) || 0), 0);
      const ret = (deal.deliveries || []).filter(dv => dv.goodId === g.id && dv.type === 'return').reduce((s, dv) => s + (Number(dv.quantity) || 0), 0);
      const loss = (deal.deliveries || []).filter(dv => dv.goodId === g.id && dv.type === 'loss').reduce((s, dv) => s + (Number(dv.quantity) || 0), 0);
      const sold = (deal.sales || []).filter(s => s.goodId === g.id).reduce((s, x) => s + (Number(x.quantity) || 0), 0);
      const delivered = out - ret - loss;
      const inHand = delivered - sold;
      return '<tr>' +
        '<td>' + g.name + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + g.unit + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + getGlobalFormat().num(g.quantity) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + getGlobalFormat().num(delivered) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + getGlobalFormat().num(sold) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + getGlobalFormat().num(inHand) + '</td>' +
        '</tr>';
    }).join('');

    const paymentsRows = (deal.payments || []).map(p => {
      const dirLabel = p.direction === 'in' ? 'دریافت' : 'پرداخت';
      const methodLabel = p.method === 'cash' ? 'نقدی' : p.method === 'card' ? 'کارت' : 'چک';
      const statusLabel = p.method === 'check' ? (
        p.status === 'cleared' ? ' (پاس‌شده)' :
        p.status === 'bounced' ? ' (برگشتی)' :
        p.status === 'in_transit' ? ' (در جریان)' : ' (در انتظار)'
      ) : '';
      return '<tr>' +
        '<td>' + getGlobalFormat().date(p.date) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + dirLabel + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + methodLabel + statusLabel + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + getGlobalFormat().money(p.amount || 0, { withUnit: false }) + '</td>' +
        '</tr>';
    }).join('');

    return '<!DOCTYPE html>' +
      '<html dir="rtl" lang="fa"><head><meta charset="UTF-8">' +
      '<title>قرارداد معامله ' + (deal.dealNumber || '') + '</title>' +
      '<style>' +
      'body { font-family: Vazirmatn, Tahoma, sans-serif; padding: 20px; direction: rtl; color: #0f172a; font-size: 12px; }' +
      'h1 { font-size: 18px; text-align: center; margin: 8px 0; }' +
      'h2 { font-size: 13px; margin: 16px 0 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding-bottom: 4px; }' +
      '.header { text-align: center; border-bottom: 2px solid #0284c7; padding-bottom: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; }' +
      '.info-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed #e2e8f0; }' +
      'table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 16px; }' +
      'th, td { border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding: 6px 8px; font-size: 11px; text-align: center; }' +
      'th { background: #f1f5f9; font-weight: 700; }' +
      '.summary { background: #f8fafc; padding: 12px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }' +
      '.summary-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 3px 0; }' +
      '.total { font-weight: 700; border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1; padding-top: 6px; margin-top: 4px; }' +
      '.footer { text-align: center; margin-top: 24px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1; font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; }' +
      '.signatures { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 40px; }' +
      '.sign-box { text-align: center; font-size: 11px; width: 45%; }' +
      '.sign-line { border-top: 1px solid #64748b; margin-top: 40px; padding-top: 6px; }' +
      '</style></head><body>' +
      '<div class="header">' +
      '<div style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700;">' + farmName + '</div>' +
      (farmAddr ? '<div style="font-size: 11px; color: #64748b;">' + farmAddr + '</div>' : '') +
      (farmPhone ? '<div style="font-size: 11px; color: #64748b;">تلفن: ' + getGlobalFormat().code(farmPhone) + '</div>' : '') +
      '<h1>قرارداد معامله</h1>' +
      '</div>' +

      '<h2>اطلاعات قرارداد</h2>' +
      '<div class="info-row"><span>شماره قرارداد:</span><strong>' + (deal.dealNumber || '—') + '</strong></div>' +
      '<div class="info-row"><span>نوع معامله:</span><strong>' + DEAL_LABEL[deal.type] + '</strong></div>' +
      '<div class="info-row"><span>طرف حساب:</span><strong>' + (party?.name || '—') + '</strong></div>' +
      (party?.phone ? '<div class="info-row"><span>تلفن طرف:</span><strong>' + getGlobalFormat().code(party.phone) + '</strong></div>' : '') +
      '<div class="info-row"><span>تاریخ قرارداد:</span><strong>' + getGlobalFormat().date(deal.date) + '</strong></div>' +
      (deal.startDate ? '<div class="info-row"><span>دوره:</span><strong>' + getGlobalFormat().date(deal.startDate) + (deal.endDate ? ' تا ' + getGlobalFormat().date(deal.endDate) : '') + '</strong></div>' : '') +
      (deal.dueDate ? '<div class="info-row"><span>سرسید:</span><strong>' + getGlobalFormat().date(deal.dueDate) + '</strong></div>' : '') +

      (deal.description ? '<h2>توضیحات</h2><div style="padding: 8px; background: #f8fafc; border-radius: 4px;">' + deal.description + '</div>' : '') +

      ((deal.goods || []).length > 0 ?
        '<h2>کالاها و تحویل‌ها</h2>' +
        '<table><thead><tr>' +
        '<th>کالا</th><th>واحد</th><th>مقدار اولیه</th><th>تحویل‌شده</th><th>فروش‌رفته</th><th>مانده</th>' +
        '</tr></thead><tbody>' + goodsRows + '</tbody></table>'
        : '') +

      '<h2>خلاصه مالی</h2>' +
      '<div class="summary">' +
      '<div class="summary-row"><span>فروش کل:</span><span>' + getGlobalFormat().money(bal.totalSales, { withUnit: false }) + ' تومان</span></div>' +
      '<div class="summary-row"><span>کمیسیون:</span><span>' + getGlobalFormat().money(bal.commission, { withUnit: false }) + ' تومان</span></div>' +
      '<div class="summary-row"><span>سهم طرف:</span><span>' + getGlobalFormat().money(bal.myShare, { withUnit: false }) + ' تومان</span></div>' +
      '<div class="summary-row"><span>دریافت‌شده:</span><span>' + getGlobalFormat().money(bal.paidIn, { withUnit: false }) + ' تومان</span></div>' +
      (bal.paidOut > 0 ? '<div class="summary-row"><span>پرداخت‌شده:</span><span>' + getGlobalFormat().money(bal.paidOut, { withUnit: false }) + ' تومان</span></div>' : '') +
      '<div class="summary-row total"><span>مانده:</span><span>' + getGlobalFormat().money(Math.abs(bal.balance), { withUnit: false }) + ' تومان' + (bal.balance < 0 ? ' (بستانکار)' : '') + '</span></div>' +
      '</div>' +

      ((deal.payments || []).length > 0 ?
        '<h2>پرداخت‌ها</h2>' +
        '<table><thead><tr>' +
        '<th>تاریخ</th><th>جهت</th><th>روش</th><th>مبلغ (تومان)</th>' +
        '</tr></thead><tbody>' + paymentsRows + '</tbody></table>'
        : '') +

      (deal.notes ? '<h2>یادداشت</h2><div style="padding: 8px; background: #f8fafc; border-radius: 4px;">' + deal.notes + '</div>' : '') +

      '<div class="signatures">' +
      '<div class="sign-box"><div class="sign-line">امضای ' + farmName + '</div></div>' +
      '<div class="sign-box"><div class="sign-line">امضای ' + (party?.name || 'طرف حساب') + '</div></div>' +
      '</div>' +

      '<div class="footer">' +
      'تاریخ چاپ: ' + getGlobalFormat().code(new Date().toLocaleDateString('fa-IR')) +
      '</div>' +
      '</body></html>';
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    printHTML(buildHtml());
  };

  const bal = computeDealBalance(deal);

  return (
    <div role="button" tabIndex={0}
      onClick={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }}
      style={{
        position: 'fixed', inset: 0,
        background: 'var(--overlay)',
        zIndex: 500,
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
        padding: 16,
      }}>
      <div style={{
        background: 'var(--card-solid)',
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)',
        maxWidth: 480, width: '100%',
        maxHeight: '90vh',
        display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column',
        overflow: 'hidden',
      }}>
        <div style={{
          padding: '14px 20px',
          borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)',
          fontWeight: 700,
        }}>🖨️ پیش‌نمایش قرارداد معامله</div>

        <div style={{ padding: 20, overflow: 'auto' }}>
          <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 700 }}>{settings?.farm?.name || 'مرغداری'}</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 8 }}>قرارداد معامله</div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ padding: 12, background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 12 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 2 }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>شماره قرارداد:</span>
              <strong>{deal.dealNumber || '—'}</strong>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 2 }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>طرف حساب:</span>
              <strong>{party?.name || '—'}</strong>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 2 }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>نوع:</span>
              <strong>{DEAL_LABEL[deal.type]}</strong>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 2 }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>تاریخ:</span>
              <strong>{getGlobalFormat().date(deal.date)}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ padding: 12, background: 'var(--accent-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)', borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 12 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 2 }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>فروش کل:</span>
              <span>{getGlobalFormat().money(bal.totalSales)}</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 2 }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>کمیسیون:</span>
              <span>{getGlobalFormat().money(bal.commission)}</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 2 }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>دریافت‌شده:</span>
              <span>{getGlobalFormat().money(bal.paidIn)}</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 2, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--accent-border)', marginTop: 4, paddingTop: 6 }}>
              <strong>مانده:</strong>
              <strong style={{ color: bal.balance > 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--accent)' }}>{getGlobalFormat().money(Math.abs(bal.balance))}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{
          padding: '12px 20px 20px',
          borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',
          display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'row-reverse', gap: 8,
        }}>
          <button onClick={handlePrint}
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              padding: '10px 16px',
              background: 'var(--accent)',
              color: '#fff',
              border: 'none',
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
              fontFamily: 'inherit',
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
              fontWeight: 700,
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}>چاپ / PDF</button>
          <button onClick={onClose}
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              padding: '10px 16px',
              background: 'var(--btn-bg)',
              color: 'var(--text)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border)',
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
              fontFamily: 'inherit',
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
              fontWeight: 600,
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}>بستن</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { Tag } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
/**
 * DealRecycleBinModal.tsx — سبد بازیافت معاملات
 * دقیقاً مطابق RecycleBinModal (فاکتورها)
 */
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Modal, Btn } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../../cor/store/dialog';
import { clearRecycleBin, removeFromRecycleBin, listRecycleBin, type RecycleBinEntry } from '../../../shr/utils/recycleBin';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { useTra, DEAL_LABEL } from '../store';
import { useCtc } from '../../ctc/store';
import { toastMsg } from '../../../cor/store/toast';
import { logAction } from '../../../cor/logger/auditLog';
import type { DeletedDealSnapshot } from '../types';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

function daysLeft(expiresAt: string): number {
  const ms = new Date(expiresAt).getTime() - Date.now();
  return Math.max(0, Math.ceil(ms / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)));
}

export default function DealRecycleBinModal({ open, onClose }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { restoreDealFromBin } = useTra();
  const { contacts } = useCtc();
  const [entries, setEntries] = useState<RecycleBinEntry<DeletedDealSnapshot>[]>([]);
  const [visibleCount, setVisibleCount] = useState(20);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      const list = listRecycleBin<DeletedDealSnapshot>('tra-deals');
      setEntries(list.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.expiresAt).getTime() - new Date(b.expiresAt).getTime()));
      setVisibleCount(20);
    } else {
      setEntries([]);
    }
  }, [open]);

  const handleDeleteSingle = async (id: string) => {
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
      'حذف دائمی',
      'این معامله برای همیشه حذف شود؟ این عمل غیرقابل بازگشت است.',
      { danger: true, confirmText: 'حذف کن', cancelText: 'انصراف' }
    );
    if (!ok) return;
    removeFromRecycleBin<DeletedDealSnapshot>('tra-deals', (e) => e.deal.id === id);
    setEntries(prev => prev.filter(e => e.item.deal.id !== id));
    toastMsg.success('معامله برای همیشه حذف شد');
  };

  const handleClearAll = async () => {
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
      '⛔ حذف دائمی همه',
      'با این کار:\n• ارتباط معاملات با گله، هچری و انبار برای همیشه قطع می‌شود.\n• موجودی گله و انبار اصلاح‌شده باقی می‌ماند.\n• گزارشات مالی/آماری ناقص می‌شوند.\n\nآیا مطمئنید؟',
      { danger: true, confirmText: 'بله، همه را حذف کن', cancelText: 'انصراف' }
    );
    if (!ok) return;
    clearRecycleBin('tra-deals');
    setEntries([]);
    toastMsg.success('سبد بازیابی برای همیشه خالی شد');
  };

  const handleRestore = (id: string) => {
    const ok = restoreDealFromBin(id);
    if (ok) {
      toastMsg.restored('معامله');
      try { logAction('restore', 'tra', 'بازیابی معامله از سبد: ' + id); } catch { /* silent */ }
      setEntries(prev => prev.filter(e => e.item.deal.id !== id));
      onClose();
    } else {
      toastMsg.error('بازیابی ناموفق');
    }
  };

  const title = entries.length > 0
    ? '🗑️ سبد بازیافت (' + fmt.count(entries.length) + ')'
    : '🗑️ سبد بازیافت';

  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title={title} size="md">
      {entries.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 24, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 32, marginBottom: 8 }}>🗑️</div>
          <div style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>سبد بازیابی خالی است</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', marginTop: 4 }}>
            معاملات حذف‌شده تا ۳۰ روز اینجا می‌مانند
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8, paddingBottom: 12, borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)', position: 'sticky', top: 0, background: 'var(--card-solid)', zIndex: 10 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                <span>🔄</span> مرتب‌سازی: نزدیک‌ترین به انقضا
              </span>
              <Btn size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={handleClearAll} style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', borderColor: 'var(--danger)', fontSize: 11, padding: '2px 8px', minHeight: 28 }}>
                🗑️ خالی کردن سبد
              </Btn>
            </div>
          </div>

          {entries.slice(0, visibleCount).map((entry) => {
            const deal = entry.item.deal;
            const party = contacts.find(c => c.id === deal.partyId);
            const partyName = party?.name || 'ناشناس';
            const days = daysLeft(entry.expiresAt);
            const isUrgent = days <= 7;
            const badgeBg = isUrgent ? 'var(--danger-soft)' : 'var(--warn-soft)';
            const badgeColor = isUrgent ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--warn)';
            const goodsText = (deal.goods || []).map(g => g.name).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 2).join('، ') || '—';
            const typeLabel = DEAL_LABEL[deal.type] || deal.type;
            const typeEmoji = deal.type === 'consignment' ? '📦' : deal.type === 'partnership' ? '🤝' : deal.type === 'barter' ? '🔄' : '📋';
            const statusLabel = deal.status === 'settled' ? '✓ تسویه‌شده' : deal.status === 'cancelled' ? '✕ لغو‌شده' : '● باز';

            return (
              <div key={deal.id} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8, padding: 12, border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)', background: 'var(--card-solid)', boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)' }}>
                {/* ردیف ۱: تیتر + بج */}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>{typeEmoji}</span>
                    <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                      {partyName} — {typeLabel}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 10, padding: '1px 6px', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    {statusLabel}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* ردیف ۲: اقلام + مبلغ + روزها */}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 4 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', flex: 1, minWidth: '50%' }}>
                    اقلام: {goodsText}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                    <span style={{ color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
                      {fmt.money(deal.value || 0, { withUnit: false })} تومان
                    </span>
                    <Tag style={{ background: badgeBg, color: badgeColor }}>{fmt.day(days)} روز مونده</Tag>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* ردیف ۳: متادیتا + دکمه‌ها */}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-end', marginTop: 2, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)', paddingTop: 6 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--dim)', lineHeight: 1.4 }}>
                    <div>معامله: {deal.dealNumber || 'بدون شماره'} • {fmt.date(deal.date)}</div>
                    <div>🗑️ حذف: {(() => { const _d = new Date(entry.deletedAt); return fmt.code(`${String(_d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}/${String(_d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')} ${String(_d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(_d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`); })()}</div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>
                    <Btn size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => handleDeleteSingle(deal.id)} style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', borderColor: 'var(--danger)', minHeight: 28, height: 28, padding: '0 8px', fontSize: 11 }}>
                      🗑️ حذف
                    </Btn>
                    <Btn size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => handleRestore(deal.id)} style={{ minHeight: 28, height: 28, padding: '0 8px', fontSize: 11 }}>
                      ↩️ بازیابی
                    </Btn>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}

          {entries.length > visibleCount && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', marginTop: 12, marginBottom: 8 }}>
              <Btn size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setVisibleCount(c => c + 20)}>
                نمایش ۲۰ مورد بعدی (از {fmt.count(entries.length - visibleCount)} مورد باقی‌مانده)
              </Btn>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}

/**
 * DeferHistoryModal — تاریخچه تعویق‌ها (UI Final)
 */
import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { Empty } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { HistoryModalShell } from '../../../shr/components/history/HistoryModalShell';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import type { Deferral } from '../types';
import { format as formatJ, parse as parseJ, differenceInCalendarDays } from 'date-fns-jalali';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  deferrals: Deferral[] | undefined;
  invoiceNumber: string;
  kind?: 'invoice' | 'deal';
  onVoidLatest?: () => void;
}

function daysBetween(from: string, to: string): number | null {
  try {
    const en = (s: string) => s.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));
    const fromD = parseJ(en(from), 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    const toD = parseJ(en(to), 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    if (isNaN(fromD.getTime()) || isNaN(toD.getTime())) return null;
    return differenceInCalendarDays(toD, fromD);
  } catch { return null; }
}

function toJalaliDate(iso: string | undefined): string {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  try {
    const d = new Date(iso);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return getGlobalFormat().code(iso);
    return getGlobalFormat().code(formatJ(d, 'yyyy/MM/dd'));
  } catch { return getGlobalFormat().code(iso || '—'); }
}

export default function DeferHistoryModal({ open, onClose, deferrals, invoiceNumber, kind = 'invoice', onVoidLatest }: Props) {
  if (!open) return null;
  const list = deferrals || [];
  const label = kind === 'deal' ? 'معامله' : 'فاکتور';

  return (
    <HistoryModalShell
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="📋 تاریخچه تعویق‌ها"
      size="md"
    >
      <div style={{
        marginBottom: 12,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'baseline',
        gap: 6,
        fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
      }}>
        <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 500 }}>{label}:</span>
        <span style={{ color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 800, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' }}>{invoiceNumber}</span>
      </div>

      {list.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty icon="📭" title="تاریخچه‌ای وجود ندارد" desc="تاکنون تعویقی ثبت نشده است." />
      ) : (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
          {list.slice().reverse().map((d, idx) => {
            const isLatest = idx === 0;
            const delta = daysBetween(d.fromDate, d.toDate);
            const hasReason = d.reason && d.reason.trim() !== '' && d.reason !== '—';

            return (
              <div key={d.id} style={{ padding: '8px 12px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 8 }}>
                {/* بخش راست: اطلاعات */}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 3, flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                    از {getGlobalFormat().date(d.fromDate)} به {getGlobalFormat().date(d.toDate)}
                  </div>
                  {delta !== null && (
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 600, color: delta < 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--accent)' }}>
                      {delta < 0 ? '⚠️ ' : ''}{getGlobalFormat().day(Math.abs(delta))} روز
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {hasReason && (
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--text)' }}>📝 {d.reason}</div>
                  )}
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--dim)' }}>🕒 ثبت: {toJalaliDate(d.createdAt)}</div>
                </div>

                {/* بخش چپ: دکمه حذف (سطل زباله) */}
                {isLatest && onVoidLatest && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={onVoidLatest}
                    title="حذف آخرین تعویق"
                    style={{ background: 'transparent', border: 'none', color: 'var(--danger)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit', padding: 2, flexShrink: 0, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginTop: 2 }}
                  >
                    🗑️
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </HistoryModalShell>
  );
}

/**
 * DeferModal — تعویق سرسید (فاکتور/معامله)
 * استاندارد: Zod + useFormErrors (الگوی Reward Early, Punish Late)
 */
import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Btn, BtnRow, Field, Input, Modal } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import DatePicker from '../../../shr/components/DatePicker';
import { useValidation } from '../../../shr/validation/useValidation';
import { getDeferSchema } from '../../../shr/validation/rules/tra';
import { useFormErrors } from '../../../shr/hooks/useFormErrors';

interface Props {
  deferModal: any;
  onClose: () => void;
  deferDate: string;
  setDeferDate: (v: string) => void;
  deferReason: string;
  setDeferReason: (v: string) => void;
  onConfirm: () => void;
}

export default function DeferModal({ deferModal, onClose, deferDate, setDeferDate, deferReason, setDeferReason, onConfirm }: Props) {
  const schema = useMemo(() => getDeferSchema(deferModal?.oldDate || ''), [deferModal?.oldDate]);
  const { errors: vErrors } = useValidation(schema, { deferDate, deferReason });
  const { showError, markTouched, attemptSave } = useFormErrors(vErrors);

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    attemptSave();
    if (Object.keys(vErrors).length > 0) return;
    onConfirm();
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={!!deferModal}
      onClose={() => onClose()}
      title="⏰ تعویق سرسید"
      footer={
        <BtnRow>
          <Btn variant="primary" onClick={handleConfirm}>تأیید</Btn>
          <Btn onClick={() => onClose()}>لغو</Btn>
        </BtnRow>
      }
    >
      {deferModal ? (
        <>
          <div style={{ marginBottom: 12, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', padding: '8px 12px', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>
            سرسید فعلی: <b>{deferModal.oldDate || '—'}</b>
          </div>
          
          <Field 
            label="سرسید جدید" 
            required 
            error={showError('deferDate')} 
            onTouch={() => markTouched('deferDate')}
          >
            <DatePicker 
              value={deferDate} 
              onChange={v => setDeferDate(v)} 
              min={deferModal.oldDate} 
              autoToday 
            />
          </Field>
          
          <Field 
            label="دلیل تعویق" required 
            error={showError('deferReason')} 
            onTouch={() => markTouched('deferReason')}
          >
            <Input 
              placeholder="..." 
              value={deferReason} 
              onChange={e => setDeferReason(e.target.value)} 
            />
          </Field>
        </>
      ) : null}
    </Modal>
  );
}

/**
 * DisputeModal.tsx — ثبت اختلاف روی فاکتور
 */
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Modal, Btn, BtnRow, Field, Textarea, AlertBox } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { useTra } from '../store';
import { toastMsg } from '../../../cor/store/toast';
import type { Invoice } from '../types';

type DisputeReason = 'price' | 'quantity' | 'quality' | 'other';

const REASON_LABEL: Record<DisputeReason, string> = {
  price: 'قیمت',
  quantity: 'تعداد',
  quality: 'کیفیت',
  other: 'سایر',
};

function getReasonPlaceholder(reason: DisputeReason, isPurchase: boolean): string {
  switch (reason) {
    case 'price':
      return isPurchase
        ? 'مغایرت قیمت توافقی با نرخ درج‌شده در فاکتور'
        : 'مغایرت قیمت توافقی و مبلغ فاکتور (مثلاً ۵ میلیون تومان اختلاف)';
    case 'quantity':
      return isPurchase
        ? 'کسری یا مغایرت تعداد تحویلی نسبت به فاکتور'
        : 'مغایرت تعداد ارسالی با تعداد ثبت‌شده در فاکتور';
    case 'quality':
      return 'توضیح مشکل کیفی (مثلاً تلفات، شکستگی یا ضعف گله)';
    case 'other':
      return 'شرح مختصر دلیل اختلاف روی این فاکتور...';
  }
}

const chipStyle = (active: boolean) => ({
  padding: '6px 12px',
  fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
  background: active ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--btn-bg)',
  border: `1px solid ${active ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'}`,
  borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
  color: active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
  fontWeight: active ? 600 : 500,
  cursor: 'pointer',
  fontFamily: 'inherit',
});

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  invoice: Invoice | null;
}

export default function DisputeModal({ open, onClose, invoice }: Props) {
  const markDispute = useTra(s => s.markDispute);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState<DisputeReason>('price');
  const [note, setNote] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setReason('price');
      setNote('');
    }
  }, [open, invoice?.id]);

  if (!invoice) return null;

  const isPurchase = invoice.type === 'purchase';

  const handleSave = () => {
    markDispute(invoice.id, reason, note.trim());
    toastMsg.success('اختلاف ثبت شد — فاکتور از لیست طلبی خارج شد');
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="ثبت اختلاف"
      size="md"
      footer={
        <BtnRow>
          <Btn variant="primary" onClick={handleSave}>ثبت اختلاف</Btn>
          <Btn onClick={onClose}>لغو</Btn>
        </BtnRow>
      }
    >
      <Field label="دلیل اختلاف">
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {(['price', 'quantity', 'quality', 'other'] as const).map(r => (
            <button key={r} type="button" onClick={() => setReason(r)} style={chipStyle(reason === r)}>
              {REASON_LABEL[r]}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </Field>

      <Field label="یادداشت (اختیاری)">
        <Textarea
          value={note}
          onChange={e => setNote(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={getReasonPlaceholder(reason, isPurchase)}
          rows={3}
          maxHeight={120}
        />
      </Field>

      <AlertBox tone="warn" style={{ marginTop: -4 }}>
        {isPurchase
          ? 'با ثبت اختلاف، این فاکتور تا زمان رفع مشکل از فهرست بدهی‌ها و یادآوری سررسید خارج می‌شود.'
          : 'با ثبت اختلاف، این فاکتور تا زمان رفع مشکل از فهرست مطالبات و یادآوری سررسید خارج می‌شود.'}
      </AlertBox>
    </Modal>
  );
}

import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { Tag, Btn, CardActions } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { ACTION_PRESETS } from '../../../shr/constants/cardActions';
import ExpandableCard from '../../../shr/components/ExpandableCard';
import { toFa , formatQty } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import {
  WORKFLOW_LABEL, STATUS_LABEL, remaining, paidSumAllocated, workflowTone, nextWorkflowStatus, CHECK_STATUS_LABEL, type Invoice
} from '../store';
import { Row, RowGrid, SectionTitle } from '../helpers';
import type { MultiSelectState } from '../../../shr/multiSelect/useMultiSelect';
import { formatInvoiceNumber } from '../calc';
import { useTra } from '../store';
import PickFlockModal from './PickFlockModal';
import { useFlk, type Flock } from '../../flk/store';
import { useState, createElement } from 'react';
import { toastMsg } from '../../../cor/store/toast';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../../cor/store/dialog';
import EntityLink from '../../../shr/components/EntityLink';

interface Props {
  inv: Invoice;
  partyName?: string;
  isOpen: boolean;
  ms: MultiSelectState<Invoice>;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onTransferClick: () => void;
  onReopen?: () => void;
  onEdit?: () => void;
  onDispute?: () => void;
  onResolveDispute?: () => void;
  onWriteOff?: () => void;
  index: number;
}

export default function InvoiceCard({ inv, partyName, isOpen, ms, onToggle, onTransferClick, onReopen, onEdit, onDispute, onResolveDispute, onWriteOff, index }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { updateInvoice, allocations } = useTra();
  const { flocks, restore, update: updateFlock } = useFlk();
  const [flockPickerOpen, setFlockPickerOpen] = useState(false);
  // 🆕 استاندارد ERP: خواندن شناسه یکتا از خود سند (بدون حدس زدن)
  const invFlockId = inv.relatedFlockId || inv.items?.find((it: any) => it.flockId)?.flockId;
  const linkedFlock = flocks?.find((f: any) => 
    (invFlockId && f.id === invFlockId) || f.sourceInvoiceId === inv.id
  );
  const rem2 = remaining(inv, allocations);

  // 🆕 اتصال دستی هوشمند برای داده‌های قدیمی و گله‌های بدون فاکتور
  const liveBirdItems = (inv.items || []).filter(it => {
    const cat = it.category || inv.category;
    return (cat === 'chick' || cat === 'adult') && !!it.birdId;
  });
  const invoiceBirdIds = Array.from(new Set(liveBirdItems.map(it => it.birdId).filter(Boolean) as string[]));

  const handleManualLink = async (flock: Flock) => {
    if (flock.sourceInvoiceId && flock.sourceInvoiceId !== inv.id) {
      const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
        'تغییر فاکتور متصل به گله',
        `گله «${flock.name}» قبلاً به فاکتور دیگری متصل است. آیا اتصال قبلی جایگزین این فاکتور شود؟`,
        { confirmText: 'بله، جایگزین شود' }
      );
      if (!ok) return;
      // پاک کردن اتصال از فاکتور قبلی
      useTra.setState(state => ({
        invoices: state.invoices.map(i =>
          i.id === flock.sourceInvoiceId
            ? {
                ...i,
                relatedFlockId: '',
                items: i.items.map((it: any) => (it.flockId === flock.id || it.existingFlockId === flock.id) ? { ...it, flockId: '', existingFlockId: '' } : it),
              }
            : i
        ),
      }));
    }

    const firstBirdItem = liveBirdItems[0];
    const wasLinkedToOther = Boolean(flock.sourceInvoiceId && flock.sourceInvoiceId !== inv.id);
    const flockPatch: Partial<Flock> = {
      sourceInvoiceId: inv.id,
      sourceCategory: (firstBirdItem?.category || inv.category) as any,
    };
    if (!flock.birdId && firstBirdItem?.birdId) flockPatch.birdId = firstBirdItem.birdId;
    if (!flock.breedId && firstBirdItem?.breedId) flockPatch.breedId = firstBirdItem.breedId;
    if ((!flock.purchaseDate || wasLinkedToOther) && inv.date) flockPatch.purchaseDate = inv.date;
    if ((flock.purchasePrice == null || wasLinkedToOther) && firstBirdItem?.unitPrice) {
      flockPatch.purchasePrice = firstBirdItem.unitPrice;
    }

    // ۱. به‌روزرسانی گله
    updateFlock(flock.id, flockPatch);

    // ۲. به‌روزرسانی فاکتور (ذخیره شناسه گله در relatedFlockId، flockId و existingFlockId بدون اجرای cascade مجدد)
    useTra.setState(state => ({
      invoices: state.invoices.map(i =>
        i.id === inv.id
          ? {
              ...i,
              relatedFlockId: flock.id,
              items: i.items.map(it => {
                const cat = it.category || inv.category;
                return (cat === 'chick' || cat === 'adult') && it.birdId
                  ? { ...it, flockId: flock.id, existingFlockId: flock.id }
                  : it;
              }),
            }
          : i
      ),
    }));

    toastMsg.success(`فاکتور با موفقیت به گله «${flock.name}» متصل شد`);
  };

  const handleManualUnlink = async () => {
    if (!linkedFlock) return;
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
      'قطع اتصال فاکتور و گله',
      `آیا اتصال این فاکتور از گله «${linkedFlock.name}» قطع شود؟ (اطلاعات و موجودی گله حذف نمی‌شود)`,
      { confirmText: 'قطع اتصال' }
    );
    if (!ok) return;

    if (linkedFlock.sourceInvoiceId === inv.id) {
      updateFlock(linkedFlock.id, {
        sourceInvoiceId: '',
        sourceCategory: '',
      });
    }
    useTra.setState(state => ({
      invoices: state.invoices.map(i =>
        i.id === inv.id
          ? {
              ...i,
              relatedFlockId: i.relatedFlockId === linkedFlock.id ? '' : i.relatedFlockId,
              items: i.items.map((it: any) =>
                it.flockId === linkedFlock.id || it.existingFlockId === linkedFlock.id
                  ? { ...it, flockId: '', existingFlockId: '' }
                  : it
              ),
            }
          : i
      ),
    }));
    toastMsg.success('اتصال فاکتور از گله قطع شد');
  };
  const st = rem2 === 0 ? 'paid' : paidSumAllocated(inv, allocations) > 0 ? 'partial' : 'unpaid';

  return (
    <ExpandableCard
      id={inv.id}
      ms={ms}
      accent={rem2 === 0 ? 'accent' : 'warn'}
      index={fmt.count(index + 1)}
      iconEmoji="🛒"
      title={partyName || '—'}
      subtitle={`${fmt.date(inv.date)}${inv.number ? ` • ${formatInvoiceNumber(inv.number)}` : ''}`}
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onToggle={onToggle}
      badge={
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
          {/* اگر workflowStatus=paid، اون با STATUS_LABEL تکراری ئه — نشون نده */}
          {inv.workflowStatus && inv.workflowStatus !== 'paid' && (
            <Tag tone={workflowTone(inv.workflowStatus)}>
              {WORKFLOW_LABEL[inv.workflowStatus]}
            </Tag>
          )}
          {inv.disputeStatus === 'open' && (
              <Tag tone="amber">در اختلاف</Tag>
            )}
            {inv.writtenOff && (inv.writtenOffAmount || 0) > 0 && (
              <Tag tone={inv.type === 'purchase' ? 'amber' : 'red'}>
                {inv.type === 'purchase' ? 'بخشش مانده' : 'حذف بدحساب'}
              </Tag>
            )}
            <Tag tone={st === 'paid' ? 'green' : st === 'partial' ? 'amber' : 'red'}>
            {STATUS_LABEL[st as keyof typeof STATUS_LABEL] || '—'}
          </Tag>
        </div>
      }
      stats={
        <>
          <span>کل: <b>{fmt.money(inv.total, { withUnit: false })} تومان</b></span>
          {rem2 > 0 && <span style={{ color: 'var(--warn)' }}>مانده: <b>{fmt.money(rem2, { withUnit: false })}</b></span>}
          {inv.items.length > 0 && (
            <span>
              {fmt.count(inv.items.length)} قلم
              {(() => {
                const catSet = new Set((inv.items || []).map((it: any) => it.category || inv.category));
                const labels: Record<string, string> = {
                  egg: 'تخم نطفه‌دار', fertile_egg: 'تخم نطفه‌دار',
                  chick: 'جوجه', adult: 'پرنده بالغ', feed: 'دان',
                  medicine: 'دارو', herbal: 'داروی گیاهی', vaccine: 'واکسن',
                  equipment: 'تجهیزات', manure: 'کود', broken: 'شکسته', other: 'سایر',
                };
                const catNames = Array.from(catSet).map((c: any) => labels[c] || c);
                
                if (catNames.length === 1) {
                  return <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700 }}> • {catNames[0]}</span>;
                }
                
                if (catNames.length === 2) {
                  return <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700 }}> • {catNames.join('، ')}</span>;
                }
                
                // اگه بیشتر از ۲ دسته بود
                return (
                  <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    {' • '}{catNames.slice(0, 2).join('، ')} و {fmt.count(catNames.length - 2)} دسته دیگر
                  </span>
                );
              })()}
            </span>
          )}
        </>
      }
    >
      <SectionTitle><span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📋</span> اطلاعات</SectionTitle>
      <RowGrid>
        <Row l="فروشنده" v={partyName || '—'} />
        <Row l="تاریخ" v={fmt.date(inv.date)} />
        {inv.number ? <Row l="شماره" v={formatInvoiceNumber(inv.number)} /> : null}
        {inv.dueDate ? <Row l="سرسید" v={fmt.date(inv.dueDate)} /> : null}
            {linkedFlock ? (
              <Row
                l="گله متصل"
                v={createElement(EntityLink, { type: 'flock', id: linkedFlock.id, label: linkedFlock.name })}
              />
            ) : null}
        {inv.isPreorder && inv.deliveryDate ? <Row l="📅 تحویل" v={fmt.date(inv.deliveryDate)} /> : null}
          {inv.writtenOff && (inv.writtenOffAmount || 0) > 0 ? (
            <Row
              l={inv.type === 'purchase' ? 'بخشش مانده' : 'حذف بدحساب'}
              v={`${fmt.money(inv.writtenOffAmount || 0, { withUnit: false })} تومان${inv.writtenOffReason ? ` (${inv.writtenOffReason})` : ''}${inv.writtenOffAt ? ` • ${fmt.date(inv.writtenOffAt)}` : ''}`}
            />
          ) : null}
      </RowGrid>

      <SectionTitle><span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📦</span> اقلام</SectionTitle>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
        {inv.items.map(it => (
          <Row key={it.id} l={`${it.description || '—'} • ${formatQty(it.quantity, it.unit || 'pcs')} × ${fmt.money(it.unitPrice || 0, { withUnit: false })} تومان`} v={`${fmt.money(it.total, { withUnit: false })} تومان`} />
        ))}
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--accent-soft)', color: 'var(--accent)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
        <span>جمع کل:</span>
        <span>{fmt.money(inv.total, { withUnit: false })} تومان</span>
      </div>

      {inv.installments && inv.installments.length > 0 && (() => {
        const totalCount = inv.installments.length;
        const paidCount = inv.installments.filter(x => x.status === 'paid').length;
        const overdueCount = inv.installments.filter(x => x.status === 'overdue').length;
        return (
          <>
            <SectionTitle>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', lineHeight: 1, display: 'inline-block', marginLeft: 4 }}>📅</span>
              اقساط — {fmt.count(paidCount)} از {fmt.count(totalCount)} پرداخت شده
            </SectionTitle>
            {overdueCount > 0 && (
              <div style={{
                padding: 'var(--pad-tight)', background: 'var(--danger-soft)',
                color: 'var(--danger)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 600, textAlign: 'center',
                marginBottom: 'var(--sp-1)',
              }}>
                ⚠️ {fmt.count(overdueCount)} قسط معوق
              </div>
            )}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
              {inv.installments.map(inst => {
                const tone = inst.status === 'paid' ? 'green' : inst.status === 'overdue' ? 'red' : 'amber';
                const label = inst.status === 'paid' ? 'پرداخت شده' : inst.status === 'overdue' ? 'معوق' : 'در انتظار';
                const isPartial = inst.paidAmount !== undefined && inst.paidAmount > 0 && inst.paidAmount < (inst.amount || 0);
                return (
                  <div key={inst.id} style={{
                    display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center',
                    padding: 'var(--pad-tight) var(--pad-normal)',
                    background: 'var(--input-bg)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                    borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                    gap: 'var(--sp-2)',
                  }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2, flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                        قسط {fmt.count(inst.number)}
                      </span>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                        سرسید: {fmt.date(inst.dueDate)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 4 }}>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                        {fmt.money(inst.amount || 0, { withUnit: false })} تومان
                      </span>
                      {isPartial && (
                        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', color: 'var(--accent)' }}>
                          پرداخت: {fmt.money(inst.paidAmount || 0, { withUnit: false })} تومان
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <Tag tone={tone}>{label}</Tag>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </>
        );
      })()}

      {inv.payments && inv.payments.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <SectionTitle>💳 پرداخت‌ها</SectionTitle>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--sp-1)' }}>
            {inv.payments.map(p => (
              <div key={p.id}>
                <Row
                  l={`${p.method === 'cash' ? '💵 نقدی' : p.method === 'card' ? '💳 کارت' : '📄 چک'} • ${fmt.date(p.date)}`}
                  v={fmt.money(p.amount, { withUnit: false }) + ' تومان'}
                />
                {p.method === 'check' && (
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', padding: '2px 8px' }}>
                    چک {p.checkNo} • {p.bank} • {CHECK_STATUS_LABEL[p.status || 'pending']}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {inv.isPreorder && (
        <Btn
          variant="primary"
          size="sm"
          full
          onClick={() => {
            updateInvoice(inv.id, { 
              isPreorder: false, 
              workflowStatus: 'received',
              receivedAt: new Date().toISOString()
            });
          }}
          style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
        >
          📦 تحویل گرفتم (ایجاد گله و موجودی)
        </Btn>
      )}
{inv.disputeStatus === 'open' && (
        <>
          <SectionTitle>یادداشت اختلاف</SectionTitle>
          <RowGrid>
            <Row
              l="علت اختلاف"
              v={inv.disputeReason === 'price' ? 'قیمت' : inv.disputeReason === 'quantity' ? 'تعداد' : inv.disputeReason === 'quality' ? 'کیفیت' : 'سایر'}
            />
            {inv.disputeOpenedAt ? <Row l="تاریخ ثبت" v={fmt.date(inv.disputeOpenedAt)} /> : null}
          </RowGrid>
          {inv.disputeNote ? <Row l="توضیحات" v={inv.disputeNote} /> : null}
        </>
      )}

      {(onEdit || nextWorkflowStatus(inv.workflowStatus) || onReopen || linkedFlock || onDispute || onResolveDispute || onWriteOff) && (() => {
        const nextWs = nextWorkflowStatus(inv.workflowStatus);
        const skipCashReceived = (String(inv.paymentTerms) === 'cash' || String(inv.paymentTerms) === 'card') && nextWs === 'received';
        const hasBirdItems = inv.type === 'purchase' && !inv.isPreorder && liveBirdItems.length > 0;
        const isFlockArchived = !!(linkedFlock && (linkedFlock.status === 'archived' || linkedFlock.status === 'sold'));

        return (
          <CardActions actions={[
            { label: nextWs === 'confirmed' ? 'ثبت نهایی' : nextWs === 'received' ? 'کالا رسید' : 'پرداخت کردم', onClick: onTransferClick, variant: 'primary', hidden: !nextWs || skipCashReceived },
            { label: 'حل شد', onClick: onResolveDispute || (() => {}), variant: 'primary', hidden: !onResolveDispute },
            { ...ACTION_PRESETS.RESTORE, onClick: () => { if (linkedFlock) { restore(linkedFlock.id); toastMsg.success('گله با موفقیت بازیابی شد'); } }, hidden: !isFlockArchived },
            { ...ACTION_PRESETS.EDIT, onClick: onEdit || (() => {}), hidden: !onEdit },
            { label: 'اتصال دستی', onClick: () => setFlockPickerOpen(true), variant: 'outline', hidden: !(!linkedFlock && hasBirdItems) },
            { label: 'قطع اتصال', onClick: handleManualUnlink, variant: 'outline', hidden: !(inv.type === 'purchase' && linkedFlock && inv.disputeStatus !== 'open') },
            { label: 'اختلاف', onClick: onDispute || (() => {}), variant: 'outline', hidden: !onDispute },
            { label: 'بازگشایی', onClick: onReopen || (() => {}), variant: 'outline', hidden: !onReopen },
            { label: inv.type === 'purchase' ? 'بخشش مانده' : 'حذف بدحساب', onClick: onWriteOff || (() => {}), variant: 'danger-outline', hidden: !onWriteOff },
          ]} />
        );
      })()}

      <PickFlockModal 
        open={flockPickerOpen} 
        onClose={() => setFlockPickerOpen(false)} 
        onSelect={handleManualLink} 
      />
    </ExpandableCard>
  );
}

const getDescriptionPlaceholder = (cat: string): string => {
  switch (cat) {
    case 'chick':       return 'نژاد و سن';
    case 'adult':       return 'نژاد و مشخصات';
    case 'egg':         return 'نژاد و درجه';
    case 'fertile_egg': return 'نژاد و کیفیت';
    case 'feed':        return 'برند و نوع';
    case 'medicine':    return 'نام و دوز';
    case 'equipment':   return 'نوع و مدل';
    case 'broken':      return 'دلیل و مقدار';
    case 'manure':      return 'نوع و کیفیت';
    case 'other':       return 'مشخصات';
    default:            return 'توضیح';
  }
};

const getPricePlaceholder = (_cat: string): string => 'مبلغ';

const getUnitForCategory = (cat: string): string => {
  switch (cat) {
    case 'chick': return 'pcs';
    case 'adult': return 'pcs';
    case 'egg': return 'pcs';
    case 'fertile_egg': return 'pcs';
    case 'broken': return 'pcs';
    case 'feed': return 'kg';
    case 'medicine': return 'ml';
    case 'equipment': return 'pcs';
    case 'manure': return 'kg';
    default: return 'pcs';
  }
};

const getQuantityMax = (cat: string): number | undefined => {
  switch (cat) {
    case 'chick': return 50000;
    case 'adult': return 100000;
    case 'egg':
    case 'fertile_egg': return 150000;
    case 'feed': return 20000;
    case 'medicine': return 5000;
    case 'equipment': return 500;
    default: return undefined;
  }
};

  const fmt = useFormat();

    open, setOpen, form, setForm, isPurchase,
    parties, flocks, whsItems, vErrors, err, onNewFlock,
