import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { Tag } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Modal, Btn } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { useCtc } from '../../ctc/store';
import { BtnRow } from '../../../shr/components/ui/Btn';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../../cor/store/dialog';
import { clearRecycleBin, removeFromRecycleBin } from '../../../shr/utils/recycleBin';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { useTra, CATEGORIES } from '../store';
import { toastMsg } from '../../../cor/store/toast';
import { logAction } from '../../../cor/logger/auditLog';
import { listRecycleBin, type RecycleBinEntry } from '../../../shr/utils/recycleBin';
import type { DeletedInvoiceSnapshot } from '../types';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

function daysLeft(expiresAt: string): number {
  const ms = new Date(expiresAt).getTime() - Date.now();
  return Math.max(0, Math.ceil(ms / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)));
}

export default function RecycleBinModal({ open, onClose }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { restoreInvoice } = useTra();
  const { contacts } = useCtc();
  const [entries, setEntries] = useState<RecycleBinEntry<DeletedInvoiceSnapshot>[]>([]);
  const [visibleCount, setVisibleCount] = useState(20); // 🆕 نمایش ۲۰ کارت در ابتدا

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      const list = listRecycleBin<DeletedInvoiceSnapshot>('tra');
      setEntries(list.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.expiresAt).getTime() - new Date(b.expiresAt).getTime()));
      setVisibleCount(20); // 🆕 ریست به ۲۰
    } else {
      setEntries([]);
    }
  }, [open]);

  const handleDeleteSingle = async (id: string) => {
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync('حذف دائمی', 'این فاکتور برای همیشه حذف شود؟ این عمل غیرقابل بازگشت است.', { danger: true, confirmText: 'حذف کن', cancelText: 'انصراف' });
    if (!ok) return;
    removeFromRecycleBin<DeletedInvoiceSnapshot>('tra', (snap) => snap.invoice.id === id);
    setEntries(prev => prev.filter(e => e.item.invoice.id !== id));
    toastMsg.success('فاکتور برای همیشه حذف شد');
  };

  const handleClearAll = async () => {
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
      '⛔ حذف دائمی همه',
      'با این کار:\n• ارتباط فاکتورها با گله و انبار برای همیشه قطع می‌شود.\n• بدهی طرف حساب و گزارشات مالی/آماری ناقص می‌شوند.\n• امکان بازگشت وجود ندارد.\n\nآیا مطمئنید؟',
      { danger: true, confirmText: 'بله، همه را حذف کن', cancelText: 'انصراف' }
    );
    if (!ok) return;
    clearRecycleBin('tra');
    setEntries([]);
    toastMsg.success('سبد بازیابی برای همیشه خالی شد');
  };

  const handleRestore = (id: string) => {
    const ok = restoreInvoice(id);
    if (ok) {
      toastMsg.restored('فاکتور');
      try { logAction('restore', 'tra', 'بازیابی فاکتور از سبد: ' + id); } catch { /* silent */ }
      
      // 🆕 ۱. حذف فوری آیتم از لیست سبد بازیابی (تا کاربر ببیند از سبد خارج شد)
      setEntries(prev => prev.filter(e => e.item.invoice.id !== id));
      
      // 🆕 ۲. بستن خودکار پنجره سبد بازیابی (استاندارد ERP)
      onClose();
    } else {
      toastMsg.error('بازیابی ناموفق');
    }
  };

  const title =
    entries.length > 0
      ? '🗑️ سبد بازیابی (' + fmt.count(entries.length) + ')'
      : '🗑️ سبد بازیابی';

  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title={title} size="md">
      {entries.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 24, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 32, marginBottom: 8 }}>🗑️</div>
          <div style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>سبد بازیابی خالی است</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', marginTop: 4 }}>
            فاکتورهای حذف‌شده تا ۳۰ روز اینجا می‌مانند
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8, paddingBottom: 12, borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)', position: 'sticky', top: 0, background: 'var(--card-solid)', zIndex: 10 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                <span>🔄</span> مرتب‌سازی: نزدیک‌ترین به انقضا
              </span>
              <Btn size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={handleClearAll} style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', borderColor: 'var(--danger)', fontSize: 11, padding: '2px 8px', minHeight: 28 }}>🗑️ خالی کردن سبد</Btn>
            </div>
          </div>
          {entries.slice(0, visibleCount).map((e) => {
            const inv = e.item.invoice;
            const days = daysLeft(e.expiresAt);
            const isSale = inv.type === 'sale';

            const catList = CATEGORIES[inv.type] || [];
            const catLabel = catList.find((c: [string, string]) => c[0] === inv.category)?.[1] || inv.category;
            const party = contacts.find(c => c.id === inv.partyId);
            const partyName = party?.name || 'ناشناس';
            const itemsText = inv.items.map(it => it.description).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 2).join('، ');
            const linkedFlocks = e.item.linkedFlocks || [];
            const hasFlock = linkedFlocks.length > 0;
            
            // 🆕 استاندارد ERP: فقط پرنده‌ها (جوجه و بالغ) باید به گله وصل شوند
            const isBirdCategory = ['chick', 'adult'].includes(inv.category);

            const isUrgent = days <= 7;
            const badgeBg = isUrgent ? 'var(--danger-soft)' : 'var(--warn-soft)';
            const badgeColor = isUrgent ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--warn)';

            return (
              <div key={inv.id} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8, padding: 12, border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)', background: 'var(--card-solid)', boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)' }}>
                {/* ردیف اول: تیتر (نام و وضعیت) */}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>{isSale ? '📤' : '📥'}</span>
                    <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                      {partyName} — {catLabel}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {isBirdCategory ? (
                    hasFlock ? (
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 10, padding: '1px 6px', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', background: 'var(--accent-soft)', color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700 }}>🔗 متصل به گله</span>
                    ) : (
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 10, padding: '1px 6px', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', background: 'var(--warn-soft)', color: 'var(--warn)', fontWeight: 700 }}>بدون گله</span>
                    )
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 10, padding: '1px 6px', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 700 }}>📦 کالای انباری</span>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* ردیف دوم: جزئیات کالا و قیمت */}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 4 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', flex: 1, minWidth: '50%' }}>
                    اقلام: {itemsText || '—'}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                    <span style={{ color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>{fmt.money(inv.total, { withUnit: false })} تومان</span>
                    <Tag style={{ background: badgeBg, color: badgeColor }}>{fmt.day(days)} روز مونده</Tag>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* ردیف سوم: متادیتا و دکمه‌ها */}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-end', marginTop: 2, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)', paddingTop: 6 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--dim)', lineHeight: 1.4 }}>
                    <div>فاکتور: {inv.number} • {fmt.date(inv.date)}</div>
                    <div>🗑️ حذف: {(() => { const _d = new Date(e.deletedAt); return fmt.code(`${String(_d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}/${String(_d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')} ${String(_d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(_d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`); })()}</div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>
                    <Btn size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => handleDeleteSingle(inv.id)} style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', borderColor: 'var(--danger)', minHeight: 28, height: 28, padding: '0 8px', fontSize: 11 }}>
                      🗑️ حذف
                    </Btn>
                    <Btn size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => handleRestore(inv.id)} style={{ minHeight: 28, height: 28, padding: '0 8px', fontSize: 11 }}>
                      ↩️ بازیابی
                    </Btn>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
          
          {/* 🆕 دکمه نمایش بیشتر برای لیست‌های طولانی */}
          {entries.length > visibleCount && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', marginTop: 12, marginBottom: 8 }}>
              <Btn size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setVisibleCount(c => c + 20)}>
                نمایش ۲۰ مورد بعدی (از {fmt.count(entries.length - visibleCount)} مورد باقی‌مانده)
              </Btn>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/tra/components/ReminderModal.tsx

/**
 * ReminderModal.tsx — ثبت یادآوری برای فاکتور
 *
 * ۳ روش: تلفنی / حضوری / سایر (با کانال آزاد)
 * پیام قابل ویرایش با لحن صمیمی و محترمانه
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Btn, BtnRow, Field, Grid2, Input, Modal, SectionTitle, Textarea } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { toFa, toEn } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { daysUntilDue, daysUntilJalali } from '../helpers';
import { useSet } from '../../set/store';
import { useCtc } from '../../ctc/store';
import { useTra } from '../store';
import { getTodayJalali, addJalaliDays } from '../calc';
import { remaining } from '../calc';
import { copyText, shareText } from '../../../shr/utils/clipboard';
import { toastMsg } from '../../../cor/store/toast';
import DatePicker from '../../../shr/components/DatePicker';
import type { Invoice } from '../types';
import { computeDealBalance, dealDaysUntilDue } from '../calc';

const CAT_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  chick: 'جوجه یک‌روزه',
  adult: 'پرنده بالغ',
  egg: 'تخم',
  fertile_egg: 'تخم نطفه‌دار',
  broken: 'تخم شکسته',
  feed: 'دان',
  medicine: 'دارو',
  vaccine: 'واکسن',
  herbal: 'داروی گیاهی',
  equipment: 'تجهیزات',
  manure: 'کود',
  other: 'سایر',
};

function getFarmName(state: unknown): string {
  if (!state || typeof state !== 'object') return 'مرغداری';
  if (!('farm' in state)) return 'مرغداری';
  const farm = state.farm;
  if (!farm || typeof farm !== 'object') return 'مرغداری';
  if (!('name' in farm)) return 'مرغداری';
  const name = farm.name;
  return typeof name === 'string' && name.trim() ? name : 'مرغداری';
}

const CHANNEL_PRESETS = ['واتس‌اپ', 'پیامک', 'تلگرام', 'اینستاگرام', 'ایمیل'];

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  invoiceId: string | null;
  dealId?: string | null;
}

export default function ReminderModal({ open, onClose, invoiceId, dealId = null }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const invoice = useTra(s => invoiceId ? s.invoices.find(i => i.id === invoiceId) ?? null : null);
  const deal = useTra(s => dealId ? s.deals.find(d => d.id === dealId) ?? null : null);
  const addReminder = useTra(s => s.addReminder);
  const addDealReminder = useTra(s => s.addDealReminder);
  const allocations = useTra(s => s.allocations);
  const contacts = useCtc(s => s.contacts);
  const settingsState = useSet();

  const [channel, setChannel] = useState('واتس‌اپ');
  const [note, setNote] = useState('');
  const [intervalDaysStr, setIntervalDaysStr] = useState('');
  const [promisedDate, setPromisedDate] = useState('');
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const [isMessageExpanded, setIsMessageExpanded] = useState(false);

  const partyId = (invoice?.partyId ?? deal?.partyId) ?? null;
  const party = partyId ? contacts.find(c => c.id === partyId) : null;
  const salutation = party?.gender === 'male' ? 'جناب آقای' : party?.gender === 'female' ? 'سرکار خانم' : 'جناب';
  const lastName = party?.name?.trim().split(/\s+/).slice(-1)[0] || party?.name || '';
  const farmName = getFarmName(settingsState);
  const amount = invoice ? remaining(invoice, allocations) : deal ? Math.abs(computeDealBalance(deal).balance) : 0;
  const days = invoice ? daysUntilDue(invoice) : deal ? dealDaysUntilDue(deal) : null;
  const itemName = invoice
    ? (invoice.items?.[0]?.description || CAT_LABEL[invoice.category] || invoice.category || '—')
    : deal
      ? `معامله ${deal.dealNumber || deal.id.slice(0, 6)}`
      : '';
  const lastRemindedAt = invoice?.lastRemindedAt ?? deal?.lastRemindedAt;
  const nextReminderAt = invoice?.nextReminderAt ?? deal?.nextReminderAt;
  const amountFa = fmt.money(amount, { withUnit: false });
  const daysPhrase = days === null
    ? ''
    : days < 0
      ? `${fmt.day(Math.abs(days))} روز از سررسید گذشته`
      : days === 0
        ? 'سرسید امروز است'
        : `${fmt.day(days)} روز تا سررسید مانده`;

  const generateMessage = (): string => {
    if (!(invoice || deal) || !party) return '';
    return `سلام ${salutation} ${lastName} عزیز 🌹
امیدوارم حالتون خوب باشه

یادآوری دوستانه:
📦 خرید «${itemName}»
💰 مبلغ: ${amountFa} تومان
📅 ${daysPhrase}

ان‌شاءالله فرصتی داشتید، لطف می‌کنید تسویه بفرمایید.
از همراهی و اعتمادتون صمیمانه سپاسگزارم 🙏

با احترام،
${farmName} 🐔`;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open && (invoice || deal) && party) {
      setMessage(generateMessage());
      if (nextReminderAt) {
        setPromisedDate(nextReminderAt);
        const days = daysUntilJalali(nextReminderAt);
        if (days !== null && days >= 0) { setIntervalDaysStr(String(days)); }
        else { setIntervalDaysStr(''); }
      } else {
        setPromisedDate('');
        setIntervalDaysStr('');
      }
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [open, invoice?.id, deal?.id, lastRemindedAt, nextReminderAt]);

  // 🆕 scroll reset on open
  const modalContentRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const id = setTimeout(() => {
      let el: HTMLElement | null = modalContentRef.current;
      while (el && el !== document.body) {
        if (el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 10) {
          el.scrollTop = 0;
          break;
        }
        el = el.parentElement;
      }
    }, 100);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [open]);

  const handleDateChange = (newDate: string) => {
    setPromisedDate(newDate);
    if (!newDate) { setIntervalDaysStr(''); return; }
    const days = daysUntilJalali(newDate);
    if (days !== null && days >= 0) setIntervalDaysStr(String(days));
    else setIntervalDaysStr('');
  };

  const handleDaysChange = (rawVal: string) => {
    const cleaned = toEn(rawVal.replace(/[^0-9۰-۹]/g, ''));
    setIntervalDaysStr(cleaned);
    if (cleaned && parseInt(cleaned) > 0) {
      setPromisedDate(addJalaliDays(getTodayJalali(), parseInt(cleaned)));
    } else {
      setPromisedDate('');
    }
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!invoice && !deal) return;
    const intervalDays = Math.max(1, Math.min(365, parseInt(toEn(intervalDaysStr)) || 7));
    const params = {
      method: 'other' as const,
      methodLabel: channel.trim() || undefined,
      note: note.trim(),
      intervalDays,
      ...(promisedDate ? { promisedDate } : {}),
    };
    if (invoice) addReminder(invoice.id, params);
    else if (deal) addDealReminder(deal.id, params);
    else return;
    toastMsg.saved();
    onClose();
  };

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    const ok = await copyText(message);
    if (ok) toastMsg.success('کپی شد');
    else toastMsg.error('کپی نشد');
  };

  const handleShare = async () => {
    const result = await shareText({ title: `یادآوری ${party?.name || ''}`, text: message });
    if (result.status === 'shared') toastMsg.success('ارسال شد');
    else if (result.status === 'copied') toastMsg.info('کپی شد — در اپ دیگر paste کنید');
    else if (result.status === 'failed') toastMsg.error('اشتراک ناموفق');
  };

  if (!invoice && !deal) return null;

  const chipStyle = (active: boolean) => ({
    padding: '6px 12px',
    fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
    background: active ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--btn-bg)',
    border: `1px solid ${active ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'}`,
    borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
    color: active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
    fontWeight: active ? 600 : 500,
    cursor: 'pointer',
    fontFamily: 'inherit',
  });

  const isCustomChannel = !CHANNEL_PRESETS.includes(channel);

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="ثبت یادآوری"
      size="md"
      footer={
        <BtnRow>
          <Btn variant="primary" onClick={handleSave}>ثبت یادآوری</Btn>
          <Btn onClick={onClose}>لغو</Btn>
        </BtnRow>
      }
    >
      {/* Context box */}
      <div style={{ background: 'var(--accent-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', padding: '10px 12px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 3 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 800 }}>{salutation} {party?.name || '—'}</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>📦 {itemName} • <strong style={{ color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700 }}>{amountFa} تومان</strong></div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>📅 {daysPhrase}</div>
      </div>

      {/* کانال */}
      <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: 6 }}>کانال</div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 4, width: '100%' }}>
        {CHANNEL_PRESETS.map(c => (
          <button key={c} type="button" onClick={() => setChannel(c)} style={{ ...chipStyle(channel === c), flex: '1 1 auto', padding: '6px 8px', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', minWidth: '70px', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
            {c}
          </button>
        ))}
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setChannel('')} style={{ ...chipStyle(isCustomChannel), flex: '1 1 auto', padding: '6px 8px', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', minWidth: '70px', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
          سایر
        </button>
      </div>
      {isCustomChannel && (
        <Input value={channel} onChange={e => setChannel(e.target.value)} placeholder="نام کانال..." style={{ marginTop: 8 }} />
      )}

      {/* پیام */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginTop: 16, paddingTop: 12, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)', marginBottom: 6 }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>پیام</span>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
          <button type="button" onClick={handleShare} title="ارسال" style={{ width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', background: 'var(--btn-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 16, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>📤</button>
          <button type="button" onClick={handleCopy} title="کپی" style={{ width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', background: 'var(--btn-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 16, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>📋</button>
        </div>
      </div>
        <Textarea value={message} onChange={e => setMessage(e.target.value)} rows={isMessageExpanded ? 8 : 4} maxHeight={isMessageExpanded ? 240 : 120} />
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-start', marginTop: 4 }}>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setIsMessageExpanded(v => !v)} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: 'none', color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit', textDecoration: 'underline', textUnderlineOffset: 2, padding: 0 }}>
            {isMessageExpanded ? 'بستن' : 'باز کردن'}
          </button>
      </div>

      {/* زمان‌بندی */}
      <div style={{ marginTop: 16, paddingTop: 12, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 8 }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>یادآوری بعدی</span>
          {(promisedDate || intervalDaysStr) && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => { setPromisedDate(''); setIntervalDaysStr(''); }}
              title="پاک کردن یادآوری"
              style={{
                background: 'transparent', border: 'none',
                color: 'var(--muted)', cursor: 'pointer',
                fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', padding: '2px 4px', fontFamily: 'inherit',
                fontWeight: 500, textDecoration: 'underline', textUnderlineOffset: 2,
              }}
            >پاک کردن</button>
          )}
        </div>
        <Grid2>
          <DatePicker value={promisedDate} onChange={handleDateChange} />
          <Input
            value={fmt.code(intervalDaysStr)}
            onChange={e => handleDaysChange(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="دستی"
            unit="روز"
            inputMode="tel"
            style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}
          />
        </Grid2>
        {lastRemindedAt && (() => {
                      const d = daysUntilJalali(lastRemindedAt);
          const ago = d === null ? null : Math.abs(d);
          const agoLabel = ago === null ? '' : ago === 0 ? 'امروز' : `${fmt.day(ago)} روز پیش`;
          return (
            <div style={{
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
              color: 'var(--muted)',
              marginTop: 8,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 4,
              flexWrap: 'wrap',
            }}>
              <span>آخرین ثبت:</span>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 600 }}>{fmt.date(lastRemindedAt!)}</span>
              {agoLabel && <span>— {agoLabel}</span>}
            </div>
          );
        })()}
      </div>


      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginTop: 16, paddingTop: 12, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)', marginBottom: 6 }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>یادداشت داخلی (اختیاری)</span>
      </div>
      <div>
        <Input value={note} onChange={e => setNote(e.target.value)} placeholder="توضیح دلخواه" />
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

/**
 * SettlementDetailModal.tsx — نمایش جزئیات تسویه دوره‌ای
 * الگو: FlockHistoryModal (modal با KPI + جزئیات + BtnRow اکشن‌ها)
 * محتوا: از SettlementPrint.tsx (بدون اختراع)
 * مرجع: docs/modules/tra-deals.md
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { Btn, BtnRow, Modal, Tag } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { Row, SectionTitle } from '../helpers';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { useCtc } from '../../ctc/store';
import { DEAL_LABEL } from '../store';
import type { Deal, Settlement } from '../types';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  settlement: Settlement | null;
  deal: Deal | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onPrint: () => void;
  onConvert: () => void;
  onUndo: () => void;
  onReopen: () => void;
  onViewInvoice: () => void;
  onDelete?: () => void;
}

export default function SettlementDetailModal({
  open,
  settlement,
  deal,
  onClose,
  onPrint,
  onConvert,
  onUndo,
  onReopen,
  onViewInvoice,
  onDelete,
}: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { contacts } = useCtc();

  if (!settlement || !deal) return null;

  const party = contacts.find(c => c.id === deal.partyId);

  const statusLabel =
    settlement.status === 'draft' ? 'پیش‌نویس'
    : settlement.status === 'confirmed' ? 'تأییدشده'
    : 'فاکتورشده';

  const statusTone: 'amber' | 'info' | 'green' =
    settlement.status === 'draft' ? 'amber'
    : settlement.status === 'confirmed' ? 'info'
    : 'green';

  const balance = (settlement.netPayable || 0) - (settlement.paidAmount || 0);
  const salesSnapshot = settlement.salesSnapshot || [];

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={`تسویه دوره‌ای — ${fmt.date(settlement.periodStart)} تا ${fmt.date(settlement.periodEnd)}`}
    >
      {/* KPI بالای modal (الگو: FlockHistoryModal) */}
      <div style={{
        padding: 'var(--sp-3) var(--sp-4)',
        background: 'var(--accent-soft)',
        border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)',
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
        marginBottom: 12,
        display: 'flex',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        alignItems: 'center',
        flexWrap: 'wrap',
        gap: 8,
        fontSize: 13,
      }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
          <Tag tone={statusTone}>{statusLabel}</Tag>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--accent)', marginTop: 4 }}>
            خالص: {fmt.money(settlement.netPayable || 0)}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
          کمیسیون: {fmt.money(settlement.commission || 0)}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 📋 اطلاعات */}
      <SectionTitle>📋 اطلاعات</SectionTitle>
      <Row l="شماره قرارداد" v={deal.dealNumber || '—'} />
      <Row l="نوع معامله" v={DEAL_LABEL[deal.type] || deal.type} />
      <Row l="طرف حساب" v={party?.name || '—'} />
      <Row l="از تاریخ" v={fmt.date(settlement.periodStart)} />
      <Row l="تا تاریخ" v={fmt.date(settlement.periodEnd)} />

      {/* 📦 فروش‌های دوره */}
      <SectionTitle>📦 فروش‌های دوره ({fmt.count(salesSnapshot.length)})</SectionTitle>
      {salesSnapshot.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 'var(--sp-4)', textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
          فروشی در این دوره ثبت نشده است
        </div>
      ) : (
        salesSnapshot.map(s => {
          const good = (deal.goods || []).find(g => g.id === s.goodId);
          const qty = Number(s.quantity) || 0;
          const price = Number(s.unitPrice) || 0;
          const total = qty * price;
          return (
            <Row
              key={s.id}
              l={`${good?.name || '—'} • ${fmt.num(qty)} × ${fmt.money(price, { withUnit: false })}`}
              v={`${fmt.money(total)}`}
            />
          );
        })
      )}

      {/* 💰 خلاصه مالی */}
      <SectionTitle>💰 خلاصه مالی</SectionTitle>
      <Row l="فروش کل" v={`${fmt.money(settlement.grossSales || 0)}`} />
      <Row l="کمیسیون" v={`${fmt.money(settlement.commission || 0)}`} />
      <Row l="خالص قابل پرداخت" v={`${fmt.money(settlement.netPayable || 0)}`} />
      <Row l="دریافت‌شده" v={`${fmt.money(settlement.paidAmount || 0)}`} />
      <Row
        l="مانده"
        v={
          <span style={{ color: balance > 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--accent)' }}>
            {fmt.money(Math.abs(balance))}
          </span>
        }
      />

      {/* اکشن‌ها بر اساس وضعیت */}
      {settlement.status === 'draft' && (
        <>
          <BtnRow>
            <Btn variant="outline" onClick={onPrint}>🖨️ چاپ</Btn>
            <Btn variant="primary" onClick={onConvert}>🧾 تبدیل به فاکتور</Btn>
          </BtnRow>
          {onDelete && (
            <BtnRow>
              <Btn variant="danger" onClick={onDelete}>🗑 حذف تسویه</Btn>
            </BtnRow>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {settlement.status === 'confirmed' && (
        <>
          <BtnRow>
            <Btn variant="outline" onClick={onPrint}>🖨️ چاپ</Btn>
            <Btn variant="primary" onClick={onConvert}>🧾 تبدیل به فاکتور</Btn>
          </BtnRow>
          <BtnRow>
            <Btn variant="outline" onClick={onReopen}>✏️ بازگشت به پیش‌نویس</Btn>
          </BtnRow>
        </>
      )}

      {settlement.status === 'invoiced' && (
        <>
          <BtnRow>
            <Btn variant="outline" onClick={onPrint}>🖨️ چاپ</Btn>
            <Btn variant="outline" onClick={onViewInvoice}>📄 مشاهده فاکتور</Btn>
          </BtnRow>
          <BtnRow>
            <Btn variant="danger" onClick={onUndo}>↩️ لغو تبدیل</Btn>
          </BtnRow>
        </>
      )}

      <BtnRow>
        <Btn variant="primary" onClick={onClose}>بستن</Btn>
      </BtnRow>
    </Modal>
  );
}

/**
 * SettlementModal.tsx — Phase E.2b
 * مودال تسویه دوره‌ای — انتخاب بازه + پیش‌نمایش زنده
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { format as formatJ } from 'date-fns-jalali';
import { Btn, BtnRow, Modal, Field, ErrorBox } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import DatePicker from '../../../shr/components/DatePicker';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { computeSettlement } from '../settlement';
import type { Deal, Settlement } from '../types';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  deal: Deal | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSave: (s: Omit<Settlement, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>) => void;
}

function todayJ(): string {
  return formatJ(new Date(), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
}

export default function SettlementModal({ open, deal, onClose, onSave }: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const [periodStart, setPeriodStart] = useState<string>(() => deal?.startDate || deal?.date || todayJ());
  const [periodEnd, setPeriodEnd] = useState<string>(() => deal?.endDate || todayJ());
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open && deal) {
      const start = deal.startDate || deal.date || todayJ();
      let end = deal.endDate || todayJ();
      if (end < start) end = start;
      console.log('[SettlementModal] deal:', deal.id, 'startDate:', deal.startDate, '→ using:', start, '| endDate:', deal.endDate, '→ using:', end);
      setPeriodStart(start);
      setPeriodEnd(end);
      setErr('');
    }
  }, [open, deal?.id, deal?.startDate, deal?.endDate, deal?.date]);

  // 🆕 Effective values — fallback اگر state خالی بود
  const effectiveStart = periodStart || deal?.startDate || deal?.date || todayJ();
  const effectiveEnd = periodEnd || deal?.endDate || todayJ();

  const computed = useMemo(() => {
    if (!deal || !effectiveStart || !effectiveEnd) return null;
    return computeSettlement(deal, effectiveStart, effectiveEnd);
  }, [deal, effectiveStart, effectiveEnd]);

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!computed) {
      setErr('در این بازه داده‌ای برای تسویه وجود ندارد');
      return;
    }
    onSave(computed);
    // بستن مودال در DealsPage.onSave انجام می‌شه (بعد از موفقیت)
  };

  if (!deal) return null;

  const titleText = deal.dealNumber || deal.description || 'معامله';

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={'تسویه دوره‌ای — ' + titleText}
      footer={
        <BtnRow>
          <Btn variant="primary" onClick={handleSave}>ایجاد تسویه</Btn>
          <Btn onClick={onClose}>لغو</Btn>
        </BtnRow>
      }
    >
      <div style={{ paddingTop: 8, marginTop: 4, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)', letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>
        📅 بازه‌ی تسویه
      </div>

      <Field label="از تاریخ" required>
        <DatePicker value={effectiveStart} onChange={v => { setPeriodStart(v); setErr(''); if (periodEnd && v > periodEnd) setPeriodEnd(v); }} max={effectiveEnd} autoToday />
      </Field>
      <Field label="تا تاریخ" required>
        <DatePicker value={effectiveEnd} onChange={v => { setPeriodEnd(v); setErr(''); }} min={effectiveStart} autoToday />
      </Field>

      <div style={{ paddingTop: 12, marginTop: 4, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--border)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)', letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>
        🧮 پیش‌نمایش تسویه
      </div>

      {computed === null ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-comfy)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px dashed var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', textAlign: 'center' }}>
          داده‌ای برای پیش‌نمایش نیست
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--accent-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)' }}>
          
          {/* KPI: تعداد عملیات */}
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(3, 1fr)', gap: 6, paddingBottom: 8, borderBottom: '1px dashed var(--accent-border)' }}>
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: 2 }}>تحویل</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.count(computed.deliveriesSnapshot.length)}</div>
            </div>
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', borderRight: '1px dashed var(--accent-border)', borderLeft: '1px dashed var(--accent-border)' }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: 2 }}>فروش</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.count(computed.salesSnapshot.length)}</div>
            </div>
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: 2 }}>پرداخت</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.count(computed.paymentsSnapshot.length)}</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* خلاصه مالی */}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>فروش کل</span>
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.money(computed.grossSales)}</span>
            </div>
            {computed.commission > 0 && (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>کمیسیون</span>
                <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--warn)' }}>{fmt.money(computed.commission)}</span>
              </div>
            )}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>دریافت‌شده</span>
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.money(computed.paidAmount)}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* جمع‌بندی نهایی */}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4, paddingTop: 8, marginTop: 2, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--accent-border)' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'baseline' }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--accent)' }}>خالص قابل پرداخت</span>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-lg)', fontWeight: 800, color: 'var(--accent)', lineHeight: 1 }}>
                {fmt.money(computed.netPayable, { withUnit: false })} <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 600 }}>ت</span>
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'baseline' }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>مانده نهایی</span>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', fontWeight: 800, color: (computed.netPayable - computed.paidAmount) > 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--accent)' }}>
                {fmt.money(Math.abs(computed.netPayable - computed.paidAmount))}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {err && <ErrorBox>{err}</ErrorBox>}
    </Modal>
  );
}

/**
 * SettlementPrint.tsx — سند چاپ تسویه دوره‌ای
 * استاندارد SAP MRKO
 */
import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useSet } from '../../set/store';
import { useCtc } from '../../ctc/store';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { printHTML } from '../../../shr/utils/export';
import { DEAL_LABEL } from '../store';
import type { Deal, Settlement } from '../types';

interface Props {
  settlement: Settlement;
  deal: Deal;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export default function SettlementPrint({ settlement, deal, onClose }: Props) {
  const settings: any = useSet();
  const { contacts } = useCtc();
  const party = contacts.find(c => c.id === deal.partyId);

  const buildHtml = () => {
    const farmName = settings?.farm?.name || 'مرغداری';
    const farmAddr = settings?.farm?.address || '';
    const farmPhone = settings?.farm?.phone || '';

    const salesRows = (settlement.salesSnapshot || []).map(s => {
      const good = (deal.goods || []).find(g => g.id === s.goodId);
      const qty = Number(s.quantity) || 0;
      const price = Number(s.unitPrice) || 0;
      const total = qty * price;
      return '<tr>' +
        '<td>' + (s.date ? getGlobalFormat().date(s.date) : '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + (good?.name || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + getGlobalFormat().num(qty) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + getGlobalFormat().money(price, { withUnit: false }) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + getGlobalFormat().money(total, { withUnit: false }) + '</td>' +
        '</tr>';
    }).join('');

    const balance = (settlement.netPayable || 0) - (settlement.paidAmount || 0);
    const statusLabel = settlement.status === 'draft' ? 'پیش‌نویس' : settlement.status === 'confirmed' ? 'تأییدشده' : 'فاکتورشده';

    return '<!DOCTYPE html>' +
      '<html dir="rtl" lang="fa"><head><meta charset="UTF-8">' +
      '<title>سند تسویه ' + (deal.dealNumber || '') + '</title>' +
      '<style>' +
      'body { font-family: Vazirmatn, Tahoma, sans-serif; padding: 20px; direction: rtl; color: #0f172a; }' +
      'h1 { font-size: 18px; text-align: center; margin: 8px 0; }' +
      'h2 { font-size: 13px; margin: 14px 0 6px; }' +
      '.header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 20px; }' +
      '.header .farm { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }' +
      '.header .meta { font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 4px; }' +
      '.info { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 16px; padding: 12px; background: #f1f5f9; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12px; }' +
      '.info div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }' +
      '.info span:first-child { color: #64748b; }' +
      'table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 16px; font-size: 12px; }' +
      'th { background: #f1f5f9; padding: 8px; text-align: right; border-bottom: 2px solid #cbd5e1; font-size: 11px; }' +
      'td { padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }' +
      '.summary { padding: 12px; background: rgba(22,163,74,.12); border: 1px solid rgba(22,163,74,.35); border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 16px; }' +
      '.summary-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 4px 0; font-size: 12px; }' +
      '.summary-row.total { border-top: 1px dashed rgba(22,163,74,.35); padding-top: 8px; margin-top: 4px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; }' +
      '.footer { text-align: center; font-size: 10px; color: #94a3b8; margin-top: 24px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px dashed #e2e8f0; }' +
      '</style></head><body>' +
      '<div class="header">' +
      '<div class="farm">' + farmName + '</div>' +
      (farmAddr ? '<div class="meta">' + farmAddr + '</div>' : '') +
      (farmPhone ? '<div class="meta">تلفن: ' + farmPhone + '</div>' : '') +
      '<h1>سند تسویه دوره‌ای</h1>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="info">' +
      '<div><span>شماره قرارداد:</span><strong>' + (deal.dealNumber || '—') + '</strong></div>' +
      '<div><span>نوع معامله:</span><strong>' + (DEAL_LABEL[deal.type] || deal.type) + '</strong></div>' +
      '<div><span>طرف حساب:</span><strong>' + (party?.name || '—') + '</strong></div>' +
      '<div><span>وضعیت:</span><strong>' + statusLabel + '</strong></div>' +
      '<div><span>از تاریخ:</span><strong>' + getGlobalFormat().date(settlement.periodStart) + '</strong></div>' +
      '<div><span>تا تاریخ:</span><strong>' + getGlobalFormat().date(settlement.periodEnd) + '</strong></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      (salesRows
        ? '<h2>فروش‌های دوره</h2>' +
          '<table><thead><tr><th>تاریخ</th><th>کالا</th><th>مقدار</th><th>قیمت واحد</th><th>جمع</th></tr></thead><tbody>' + salesRows + '</tbody></table>'
        : '<p style="text-align:center;color:#64748b;font-size:12px;">فروشی در این دوره ثبت نشده است</p>') +
      '<div class="summary">' +
      '<div class="summary-row"><span>فروش کل:</span><span>' + getGlobalFormat().money(settlement.grossSales || 0) + '</span></div>' +
      '<div class="summary-row"><span>کمیسیون:</span><span>' + getGlobalFormat().money(settlement.commission || 0) + '</span></div>' +
      '<div class="summary-row"><span>خالص قابل پرداخت:</span><span>' + getGlobalFormat().money(settlement.netPayable || 0) + '</span></div>' +
      '<div class="summary-row"><span>دریافت‌شده:</span><span>' + getGlobalFormat().money(settlement.paidAmount || 0) + '</span></div>' +
      '<div class="summary-row total"><span>مانده:</span><span>' + getGlobalFormat().money(Math.abs(balance)) + '</span></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="footer">' +
      'تاریخ چاپ: ' + getGlobalFormat().code(new Date().toLocaleDateString('fa-IR')) +
      (settlement.notes ? '<br>' + settlement.notes : '') +
      '</div>' +
      '</body></html>';
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    printHTML(buildHtml());
  };

  const balance = (settlement.netPayable || 0) - (settlement.paidAmount || 0);

  return (
    <div role="button" tabIndex={0}
      onClick={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }}
      style={{
        position: 'fixed', inset: 0,
        background: 'var(--overlay)',
        zIndex: 500,
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
        padding: 16,
      }}
    >
      <div style={{
        background: 'var(--card-solid)',
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)',
        maxWidth: 480, width: '100%',
        maxHeight: '90vh',
        display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column',
        overflow: 'hidden',
      }}>
        <div style={{
          padding: '14px 20px',
          borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)',
          fontWeight: 700,
        }}>🖨️ پیش‌نمایش سند تسویه</div>
        
        <div style={{ padding: 20, overflow: 'auto' }}>
          <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 700 }}>{settings?.farm?.name || 'مرغداری'}</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 8 }}>سند تسویه دوره‌ای</div>
          </div>
          
          <div style={{ padding: 12, background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 12 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 2 }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>شماره قرارداد:</span>
              <strong>{deal.dealNumber || '—'}</strong>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 2 }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>طرف حساب:</span>
              <strong>{party?.name || '—'}</strong>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 2 }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>دوره:</span>
              <strong>{getGlobalFormat().date(settlement.periodStart)} تا {getGlobalFormat().date(settlement.periodEnd)}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
          
          <div style={{ padding: 12, background: 'var(--accent-soft)', border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)', borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 12 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 2 }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>فروش کل:</span>
              <span>{getGlobalFormat().money(settlement.grossSales || 0)}</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 2 }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>کمیسیون:</span>
              <span>{getGlobalFormat().money(settlement.commission || 0)}</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 2 }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>دریافت‌شده:</span>
              <span>{getGlobalFormat().money(settlement.paidAmount || 0)}</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 2, borderTop: '1px dashed var(--accent-border)', marginTop: 4, paddingTop: 6 }}>
              <strong>خالص:</strong>
              <strong style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }}>{getGlobalFormat().money(settlement.netPayable || 0)}</strong>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 2 }}>
              <strong>مانده:</strong>
              <strong style={{ color: balance > 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--accent)' }}>{getGlobalFormat().money(Math.abs(balance))}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div style={{
          padding: '12px 20px 20px',
          borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',
          display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'row-reverse', gap: 8,
        }}>
          <button onClick={handlePrint}
            style={{ flex: 1, height: 40, background: 'var(--accent)', color: 'var(--avatar-text)', border: 'none', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer' }}
          >🖨 چاپ / ذخیره PDF</button>
          <button onClick={onClose}
            style={{ flex: 1, height: 40, background: 'var(--btn-bg)', color: 'var(--muted)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer' }}
          >لغو</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * StatementModal.tsx — صورت‌حساب طرف حساب
 * استاندارد: SAP FBL5N | Layout: 3-line mobile-friendly
 */
import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Modal, Btn, BtnRow, ModalFooter, Field, Grid2, Select } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import DatePicker from '../../../shr/components/DatePicker';
import { useTra, computeDealBalance, DEAL_LABEL } from '../store';
import type { CheckStatus } from '../types';
import { useCtc, ROLE_LABEL } from '../../ctc/store';
import { useSet } from '../../set/store';
import { toFa, numberToWords } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { printHTML } from '../../../shr/utils/export';
import { getTodayJalali } from '../calc';
import SmartSelect from '../../../shr/components/SmartSelect';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  kind?: 'sale' | 'purchase' | 'deal';
}

type LineKind = 'invoice_sale' | 'invoice_purchase' | 'deal' | 'payment_cash' | 'payment_card' | 'payment_check' | 'advance' | 'refund';

interface StatementLine {
  date: string;
  kind: LineKind;
  docNumber?: string;
  checkNo?: string;
  bank?: string;
  dueDate?: string;
  checkStatus?: CheckStatus;
  description: string;
  debit: number;
  credit: number;
  balance: number;
}

const KIND_INFO: Record<LineKind, { icon: string; label: string; color: string }> = {
  invoice_sale: { icon: '📄', label: 'فاکتور فروش', color: 'var(--info)' },
  invoice_purchase: { icon: '🛒', label: 'فاکتور خرید', color: 'var(--info)' },
  deal: { icon: '🤝', label: 'معامله خاص', color: 'var(--purple)' },
  payment_cash: { icon: '💰', label: 'دریافت نقدی', color: 'var(--accent)' },
  payment_card: { icon: '💳', label: 'دریافت کارت', color: 'var(--accent)' },
  payment_check: { icon: '📝', label: 'دریافت چک', color: 'var(--accent)' },
  advance: { icon: '⚡', label: 'پیش‌پرداخت', color: 'var(--accent)' },
  refund: { icon: '↩️', label: 'عودت وجه', color: 'var(--danger)' },
};

const CHECK_INFO: Record<CheckStatus, { label: string; bg: string; color: string }> = {
  pending: { label: 'در انتظار', bg: 'var(--warn-soft)', color: 'var(--warn)' },
  in_transit: { label: 'در جریان', bg: 'var(--info-soft, rgba(2,132,199,.12))', color: 'var(--info, #0284c7)' },
  cleared: { label: 'پاس شده', bg: 'var(--accent-soft)', color: 'var(--accent)' },
  bounced: { label: 'برگشتی', bg: 'var(--danger-soft)', color: 'var(--danger)' },
};

export default function StatementModal({ open, onClose, kind }: Props) {
  const { invoices, deals, partyPayments } = useTra();
  const { contacts } = useCtc();
  const settings: any = useSet();

  const [partyId, setPartyId] = useState('');
  const [fromDate, setFromDate] = useState('');
  const [toDate, setToDate] = useState(getTodayJalali());

  const parties = useMemo(
    () => contacts.filter(c => {
      if (kind === 'sale') return c.roles.includes('customer');
      if (kind === 'purchase') return c.roles.includes('supplier');
      return c.roles.includes('customer') || c.roles.includes('supplier');
    }),
    [contacts, kind],
  );

  const party = contacts.find(c => c.id === partyId);

  const lines = useMemo<StatementLine[]>(() => {
    if (!partyId) return [];
    const raw: Omit<StatementLine, 'balance'>[] = [];

    for (const inv of invoices) {
      if (inv.partyId !== partyId) continue;
      if (fromDate && inv.date < fromDate) continue;
      if (toDate && inv.date > toDate) continue;

      raw.push({
        date: inv.date,
        kind: inv.type === 'sale' ? 'invoice_sale' : 'invoice_purchase',
        docNumber: inv.number || inv.id.slice(0, 6),
        description: inv.notes || '',
        debit: inv.total,
        credit: 0,
      });

      for (const p of (inv.payments || [])) {
        const pType = (p as any).type;
        if (pType === 'advance') {
          raw.push({
            date: p.date,
            kind: 'advance',
            docNumber: inv.number || '',
            checkNo: p.method === 'check' ? p.checkNo : undefined,
            bank: p.method === 'check' ? p.bank : undefined,
            dueDate: p.method === 'check' ? p.dueDate : undefined,
            checkStatus: p.method === 'check' ? (p.status || 'pending') : undefined,
            description: p.notes || 'مصرف از پیش‌پرداخت',
            debit: 0,
            credit: p.amount,
          });
          continue;
        }
        if (pType === 'refund') {
          raw.push({
            date: p.date,
            kind: 'refund',
            docNumber: inv.number || '',
            description: p.notes || 'عودت وجه',
            debit: p.amount,
            credit: 0,
          });
          continue;
        }
        const kind: LineKind = p.method === 'cash' ? 'payment_cash' : p.method === 'card' ? 'payment_card' : 'payment_check';
        raw.push({
          date: p.date,
          kind,
          docNumber: inv.number || '',
          checkNo: p.method === 'check' ? p.checkNo : undefined,
          bank: p.method === 'check' ? p.bank : undefined,
          dueDate: p.method === 'check' ? p.dueDate : undefined,
          checkStatus: p.method === 'check' ? (p.status || 'pending') : undefined,
          description: p.notes || '',
          debit: 0,
          credit: p.amount,
        });
      }
    }

    const invoicedDealIds = new Set(
      invoices.filter(i => i.relatedDealId).map(i => i.relatedDealId as string),
    );

    for (const deal of deals) {
      if (deal.partyId !== partyId) continue;
      if (invoicedDealIds.has(deal.id)) continue;
      if (fromDate && deal.date < fromDate) continue;
      if (toDate && deal.date > toDate) continue;

      const bal = computeDealBalance(deal);
      if (bal.totalSales > 0) {
        raw.push({
          date: deal.date,
          kind: 'deal',
          docNumber: deal.dealNumber || '',
          description: deal.description || DEAL_LABEL[deal.type],
          debit: bal.totalSales,
          credit: 0,
        });
      }

      for (const p of (deal.payments || [])) {
        const kind: LineKind = p.method === 'cash' ? 'payment_cash' : p.method === 'card' ? 'payment_card' : 'payment_check';
        raw.push({
          date: p.date,
          kind,
          docNumber: deal.dealNumber || '',
          checkNo: p.method === 'check' ? p.checkNo : undefined,
          bank: p.method === 'check' ? p.bank : undefined,
          dueDate: p.method === 'check' ? p.dueDate : undefined,
          checkStatus: p.method === 'check' ? (p.status || 'pending') : undefined,
          description: p.notes || (p.direction === 'in' ? 'دریافت از طرف' : 'پرداخت به طرف'),
          debit: p.direction === 'out' ? p.amount : 0,
          credit: p.direction === 'in' ? p.amount : 0,
        });
      }
    }

    const usedByPp = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const inv2 of invoices) {
      for (const p of (inv2.payments || [])) {
        const ppid = (p as any).partyPaymentId;
        if (ppid) usedByPp.set(ppid, (usedByPp.get(ppid) || 0) + (p.amount || 0));
      }
    }
    for (const deal2 of deals) {
      for (const p of (deal2.payments || [])) {
        const ppid = (p as any).partyPaymentId;
        if (ppid) usedByPp.set(ppid, (usedByPp.get(ppid) || 0) + (p.amount || 0));
      }
    }
    for (const pp of (partyPayments || [])) {
      if (pp.partyId !== partyId) continue;
      if ((pp as any).type !== 'advance') continue;
      if (fromDate && pp.date < fromDate) continue;
      if (toDate && pp.date > toDate) continue;
      if ((pp as any).method === 'check' && (pp as any).status !== 'cleared') continue;
      const usedAmt = usedByPp.get(pp.id) || 0;
      const unappliedAmt = (pp.amount || 0) - usedAmt;
      if (unappliedAmt > 0.5) {
        raw.push({
          date: pp.date,
          kind: 'advance',
          docNumber: '',
          description: 'پیش‌پرداخت موجود (استفاده‌نشده)',
          debit: 0,
          credit: unappliedAmt,
        });
      }
    }

    raw.sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
    let running = 0;
    return raw.map(l => {
      const isPendingCheck = (l.kind === 'payment_check' || l.kind === 'advance')
        && l.checkStatus !== undefined
        && l.checkStatus !== 'cleared';
      const effectiveCredit = isPendingCheck ? 0 : l.credit;
      running += l.debit - effectiveCredit;
      return { ...l, balance: running };
    });
  }, [invoices, deals, partyPayments, partyId, fromDate, toDate]);

  const totalDebit = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.debit, 0);
  const totalCredit = lines.reduce((s, l) => {
    const isPendingCheck = (l.kind === 'payment_check' || l.kind === 'advance')
      && l.checkStatus !== undefined
      && l.checkStatus !== 'cleared';
    if (isPendingCheck) return s;
    return s + l.credit;
  }, 0);
  const netBalance = totalDebit - totalCredit;

  const groupedLines = useMemo(() => {
    const days: Record<string, StatementLine[]> = {};
    lines.forEach(l => {
      if (!days[l.date]) days[l.date] = [];
      days[l.date].push(l);
    });
    return Object.entries(days).map(([date, dayLines]) => {
      const lastLine = dayLines[dayLines.length - 1];
      return {
        date,
        lines: dayLines,
        endBalance: lastLine.balance
      };
    }).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
  }, [lines]);


  const buildHTML = (): string => {
    const farmName = settings?.farm?.name || 'مرغداری';
    const farmAddr = settings?.farm?.address || '';
    const farmCity = settings?.farm?.city || '';
    const farmPhone = settings?.farm?.phone || '';
    const farmPostal = settings?.farm?.postalCode || '';

    const rows = lines.map((l, index) => {
      const isDebit = l.debit > 0;
      const isOutP = isDebit && (l.kind === 'payment_cash' || l.kind === 'payment_card' || l.kind === 'payment_check');
      const info = isOutP ? { label: 'پرداخت' } : KIND_INFO[l.kind];
      
      const metaParts = [info.label];
      if (l.docNumber && !isOutP) metaParts.push(l.docNumber);
      if (l.kind === 'payment_check' && l.checkNo) metaParts.push('#' + l.checkNo);
      
      return `
        <tr>
          <td class="td-center">${getGlobalFormat().count(index + 1)}</td>
          <td class="td-center">${getGlobalFormat().date(l.date)}</td>
          <td class="td-right">
            <div style="font-weight: 600;">${metaParts.join(' - ')}</div>
            ${l.description ? `<div style="font-size: 10px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 2px; font-weight: 400;">${l.description}</div>` : ''}
          </td>
          <td class="td-left" style="color: #dc2626;">${l.debit > 0 ? getGlobalFormat().money(l.debit, { withUnit: false }) : '—'}</td>
          <td class="td-left" style="color: #16a34a;">${l.credit > 0 ? getGlobalFormat().money(l.credit, { withUnit: false }) : '—'}</td>
          <td class="td-left" style="font-weight: 700;">${getGlobalFormat().money(Math.abs(l.balance), { withUnit: false })}</td>
        </tr>
      `;
    }).join('');

    return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html dir="rtl" lang="fa">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>صورت‌حساب ${party?.name || ''}</title>
  <style>
    @import url('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/rastikerdar/vazirmatn@v33.003/Vazirmatn-font-face.css');
    @page { size: A4; margin: 10mm; }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    body { font-family: Vazirmatn, sans-serif; background: #fff; color: #0f172a; padding: 10px; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; }
    
    .invoice-box { max-width: 800px; margin: auto; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding: 16px; border-radius: 4px; }
    
    .header { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; border-bottom: 2px solid #0284c7; padding-bottom: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .header .brand { text-align: right; }
    .header .brand h1 { font-size: 14px; color: #0f172a; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 2px; }
    .header .center-title { text-align: center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
    .header .center-title .arq { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; color: #0f172a; }
    .header .center-title .desc { font-size: 9px; color: #64748b; font-weight: 600; }
    .header .doc-info { text-align: left; }
    .header .doc-info .meta { font-size: 10px; color: #64748b; font-weight: 600; }
    
    .parties { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .party-box { border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 10px; background: #f8fafc; }
    .party-box .title { font-size: 10px; color: #334155; font-weight: 700; border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding-bottom: 4px; margin-bottom: 6px; text-align: right; }
    .info-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 50px 1fr; gap: 4px 8px; }
    .info-lbl { color: #64748b; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; text-align: right; }
    .info-val { color: #0f172a; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; text-align: right; word-break: break-word; }
    
    /* تنظیمات قفل شده جدول */
    table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 16px; table-layout: fixed; }
    th, td { border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding: 8px 6px; font-size: 11px; }
    th { background: #f1f5f9; font-weight: 700; color: #334155; font-size: 11px; text-align: center; white-space: nowrap; }
    td { vertical-align: middle; }
    
    /* کلاس‌های ترازبندی */
    .td-center { text-align: center; }
    .td-right { text-align: right; }
    .td-left { text-align: left; direction: ltr; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    
    .summary-container { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; margin-bottom: 24px; }
    .summary-table { width: 330px; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .summary-table td { border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 11px; }
    .summary-table .col-lbl { text-align: right; color: #334155; font-weight: 600; }
    .summary-table .col-val { text-align: left; direction: ltr; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .summary-table .total-row { background: #f1f5f9; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; }
    
    .amount-words { width: 330px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 10px; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px dashed #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; text-align: right; color: #0f172a; line-height: 1.6; box-sizing: border-box; }
    .footer { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; margin-top: 30px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1; }
    .sign-box { text-align: center; font-size: 10px; color: #64748b; }
    .sign-space { height: 60px; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="invoice-box">
  
  <div class="header">
    <div class="brand">
      <h1>${farmName}</h1>
    </div>
    
    <div class="center-title">
      <div class="arq">هو الرزاق</div>
      <div class="desc">او روزی‌دهنده است</div>
    </div>

    <div class="doc-info">
      <div class="meta">تاریخ چاپ: ${getGlobalFormat().date(getTodayJalali())}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="parties">
    <div class="party-box">
      <div class="title">مشخصات فروشنده</div>
      <div class="info-grid">
        <div class="info-lbl">نام:</div><div class="info-val">${farmName}</div>
        <div class="info-lbl">نشانی:</div><div class="info-val">${farmAddr || '—'} ${farmCity ? `(${farmCity})` : ''}</div>
        <div class="info-lbl">کد پستی:</div><div class="info-val">${farmPostal ? getGlobalFormat().code(farmPostal) : '—'}</div>
        <div class="info-lbl">تلفن:</div><div class="info-val">${farmPhone ? getGlobalFormat().code(farmPhone) : '—'}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="party-box">
      <div class="title">مشخصات خریدار</div>
      <div class="info-grid">
        <div class="info-lbl">نام:</div><div class="info-val">${party?.name || '—'}</div>
        <div class="info-lbl">نشانی:</div><div class="info-val">${party?.address || '—'} ${party?.city ? `(${party.city})` : ''}</div>
        <div class="info-lbl">کد ملی:</div><div class="info-val">${party?.nationalId ? getGlobalFormat().code(party.nationalId) : '—'}</div>
        <div class="info-lbl">تلفن:</div><div class="info-val">${party?.phone ? getGlobalFormat().code(party.phone) : '—'}</div>

      <tr class="total-row"><td class="col-lbl">مانده نهایی:</td><td class="col-val" style="color: ${netBalance > 0 ? '#dc2626' : '#16a34a'}">${getGlobalFormat().money(Math.abs(netBalance), { withUnit: false })} ${netBalance < 0 ? '(بستانکار)' : ''}</td></tr>
    </table>
    <div class="amount-words">
      <strong>مانده نهایی به حروف:</strong> ${numberToWords(Math.abs(netBalance))} تومان ${netBalance < 0 ? '(بستانکار)' : ''}
    </div>
  </div>

import type { DealType, SettlementType, DealGood, DealDelivery, DealSale, DealPayment } from '../store';
export interface F {
  id?: string; type: DealType; date: string; partyId: string;
  description: string; value: string; percent: string; dueDate: string;
  status: 'open' | 'settled' | 'cancelled'; notes: string;
  dealNumber: string; startDate: string; endDate: string;
  settlementType: SettlementType | ''; settlementValue: string; cancelReason: string;
  goods: DealGood[]; deliveries: DealDelivery[]; sales: DealSale[]; payments: DealPayment[];
}
export const empty = (): F => ({
  type: 'consignment', date: '', partyId: '',
  description: '', value: '', percent: '', dueDate: '',
  status: 'open', notes: '',
  dealNumber: '', startDate: '', endDate: '',
  settlementType: 'percent', settlementValue: '', cancelReason: '',
  goods: [], deliveries: [], sales: [], payments: [],
});
export const STATUS_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { open: 'باز', settled: 'تسویه‌شده', cancelled: 'لغوشده' };
export function isSameIdentity(a: DealGood, b: DealGood): boolean {
  return (
    (a.category || '') === (b.category || '') &&
    (a.source || 'flock') === (b.source || 'flock') &&
    (a.existingFlockId || '') === (b.existingFlockId || '') &&
    (a.hatchId || '') === (b.hatchId || '') &&
    (a.stockItemId || '') === (b.stockItemId || '') &&
    (a.unit || '') === (b.unit || '') &&
    Number(a.estimatedPrice || 0) === Number(b.estimatedPrice || 0)
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/tra/deals/useDealCalc.ts

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { calcDealCommission, getTodayJalali } from '../calc';
import type { F } from './types';
import type { Deal } from '../store';

export function useDealCalc(form: F) {
  return useMemo(() => {
    const out = form.deliveries.filter(d => d.type === 'out').reduce((s, d) => s + (Number(d.quantity) || 0), 0);
    const ret = form.deliveries.filter(d => d.type === 'return').reduce((s, d) => s + (Number(d.quantity) || 0), 0);
    const loss = form.deliveries.filter(d => d.type === 'loss').reduce((s, d) => s + (Number(d.quantity) || 0), 0);
    const totalDelivered = out - ret - loss;
    const totalSold = form.sales.reduce((s, x) => s + (Number(x.quantity) || 0), 0);
    const inHand = totalDelivered - totalSold;
    const totalSales = form.sales.reduce((s, x) => s + ((Number(x.quantity) || 0) * (Number(x.unitPrice) || 0)), 0);
    const commission = calcDealCommission(form.settlementType, Number(form.settlementValue) || 0, totalSales, totalSold, form.startDate || form.date, form.endDate || getTodayJalali());
    const myShare = totalSales - commission;
    const paidIn = form.payments.filter(p => p.direction === 'in').reduce((s, p) => s + (Number(p.amount) || 0), 0);
    const paidOut = form.payments.filter(p => p.direction === 'out').reduce((s, p) => s + (Number(p.amount) || 0), 0);
    const balance = myShare - paidIn + paidOut;
    const perGood: Record<string, { name: string; delivered: number; sold: number; inHand: number }> = {};
    for (const g of form.goods) {
      const gOut = form.deliveries.filter(d => d.goodId === g.id && d.type === 'out').reduce((s, d) => s + (Number(d.quantity) || 0), 0);
      const gRet = form.deliveries.filter(d => d.goodId === g.id && d.type === 'return').reduce((s, d) => s + (Number(d.quantity) || 0), 0);
      const gLoss = form.deliveries.filter(d => d.goodId === g.id && d.type === 'loss').reduce((s, d) => s + (Number(d.quantity) || 0), 0);
      const gSold = form.sales.filter(x => x.goodId === g.id).reduce((s, x) => s + (Number(x.quantity) || 0), 0);
      const gDelivered = gOut - gRet - gLoss;
      perGood[g.id] = { name: g.name || '—', delivered: gDelivered, sold: gSold, inHand: gDelivered - gSold };
    }
    return { totalDelivered, totalSold, inHand, totalSales, commission, myShare, paidIn, paidOut, balance, perGood };
  }, [form.deliveries, form.sales, form.payments, form.settlementType, form.settlementValue, form.goods]);
}

export function useDealStats(deals: Deal[]) {
  return useMemo(() => {
    let active = 0, settled = 0, cancelled = 0, totalBalance = 0;
    for (const d of deals) {
      if (d.status === 'cancelled') { cancelled++; continue; }
      if (d.status === 'settled') { settled++; continue; }
      active++;
      const sales = (d.sales || []).reduce((s, x) => s + ((Number(x.quantity) || 0) * (Number(x.unitPrice) || 0)), 0);
      const totalQty = (d.sales || []).reduce((s, x) => s + (Number(x.quantity) || 0), 0);
      const comm = calcDealCommission(d.settlementType, d.settlementValue, sales, totalQty, d.startDate || d.date, d.endDate || getTodayJalali());
      const myShare = sales - comm;
      const paidIn = (d.payments || []).filter(p => p.direction === 'in').reduce((s, p) => s + (Number(p.amount) || 0), 0);
      const paidOut = (d.payments || []).filter(p => p.direction === 'out').reduce((s, p) => s + (Number(p.amount) || 0), 0);
      totalBalance += myShare - paidIn + paidOut;
    }
    return { active, settled, cancelled, totalBalance };
  }, [deals]);
}

/**
 * formulas.ts — تنها منبع حقیقت برای محاسبات business tra
 * ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * هرجا محاسبه‌ای لازم شد، از اینجا بگیر.
 * duplicate logic = باگ آینده.
 * ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 */
import { remaining, paidSumAllocated, computeCashDiscount, agingBucket, type AgingBucket } from './calc';
import { daysUntilDue } from './helpers';
import type { Invoice } from './types';

/**
 * اعتبار طرف‌حساب — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH
 * مثبت = پیش‌پرداخت (customer paid extra)
 * منفی = بدهی به ما
 *
 * این تابع، فرمول canonical هست که computePartyCredit هم ازش استفاده می‌کنه.
 */
export function partyBalance(
  partyId: string,
  invoices: Invoice[],
  allocations?: any[]
): number {
  if (!partyId) return 0;
  return invoices
    .filter(inv => inv.partyId === partyId)
    .reduce((acc, inv) => {
      const total = inv.total || 0;
      const paid = paidSumAllocated(inv, allocations);
      const writtenOff = inv.writtenOffAmount || 0;
      const cashDiscount = computeCashDiscount(inv);
      return acc + ((paid + writtenOff) - (total - cashDiscount));
    }, 0);
}

/**
 * Aging bucket از dueDate — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH
 * استاندارد Accounting (FASB): aging of receivables از dueDate، نه invoice date
 */
export function agingBucketFromDue(inv: Invoice): AgingBucket {
  return agingBucket(overdueDays(inv));
}

/** آیا فاکتور overdue است؟ */
export function isOverdue(inv: Invoice): boolean {
  const d = daysUntilDue(inv);
  return d !== null && d < 0;
}

/** روزهای overdue (positive) — ۰ اگه هنوز سرسید نرسیده */
export function overdueDays(inv: Invoice): number {
  const d = daysUntilDue(inv);
  return d !== null && d < 0 ? -d : 0;
}

// ═══ توابع کمکی ReceivablesPage ═══
import type { Invoice } from './store';

export function daysUntilJalali(dateStr: string | null | undefined): number | null {
  if (!dateStr) return null;
  try {
    const en = dateStr.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d: string) => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));
    const d = parseJ(en, 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
    d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    return diffDaysJ(d, today);
  } catch { return null; }
}

export function daysUntilDue(inv: Invoice): number | null {
  return daysUntilJalali(inv.dueDate);
}

export function computeUpcoming(
  invoices: Invoice[],
): Array<{ inv: Invoice; days: number | null }> {
  return invoices
    .filter(i => i.dueDate && !i.remindersMuted)
    .filter(i => {
      if (i.nextReminderAt) {
        const nrDays = daysUntilJalali(i.nextReminderAt);
        if (nrDays !== null && nrDays > 0) return false;
      }
      return true;
    })
    .map(i => ({ inv: i, days: daysUntilDue(i) }))
    .filter(x => x.days !== null && x.days <= 7)
    .sort((a, b) => (a.days ?? 0) - (b.days ?? 0));
}

export function dueTone(days: number | null): 'green' | 'amber' | 'orange' | 'red' {
  if (days === null) return 'green';
  if (days < 0) return 'red';
  if (days <= 3) return 'red';
  if (days <= 7) return 'orange';
  if (days <= 14) return 'amber';
  return 'green';
}

export function dueLabel(days: number | null): string {
  if (days === null) return '—';
  if (days < 0) return `${Math.abs(days)} روز گذشته`;
  if (days === 0) return 'امروز';
  return `${days} روز مانده`;
}

/**
 * computeUpcomingDeals — معاملات با سرسید نزدیک (۰ تا ۷ روز آینده)
 * استاندارد: Odoo Aged Receivable — upcoming receivables شامل deals هم می‌شود
 */
export function computeUpcomingDeals(
  deals: Deal[],
): Array<{ deal: Deal; days: number | null }> {
  return deals
    .filter(d => {
      if (d.nextReminderAt) {
        const nrDays = daysUntilJalali(d.nextReminderAt);
        if (nrDays !== null && nrDays > 0) return false;
      }
      return true;
    })
    .map(d => ({ deal: d, days: dealDaysUntilDue(d) }))
    .filter(x => x.days !== null && x.days >= 0 && x.days <= 7)
    .sort((a, b) => (a.days ?? 0) - (b.days ?? 0));
}

function isSameInvoiceIdentity(a: Partial<InvoiceItem>, b: Partial<InvoiceItem>, defaultCat: string): boolean {
  const catA = a.category || defaultCat;
  const catB = b.category || defaultCat;
  return (
    catA === catB &&
    (a.unit || '') === (b.unit || '') &&
    (a.unitPrice || 0) === (b.unitPrice || 0) &&
    (a.priceUnit || '') === (b.priceUnit || '') &&
    (a.flockId || '') === (b.flockId || '') &&
    (a.hatchId || '') === (b.hatchId || '') &&
    (a.stockItemId || '') === (b.stockItemId || '') &&
    (a.birdId || '') === (b.birdId || '') &&
    (a.breedId || '') === (b.breedId || '') &&
    (a.description || '').trim() === (b.description || '').trim()
  );
}
