// ═══ نقشه استاندارد واحدها (UoM) بر اساس دسته‌بندی ═══
import { UOM_RULES, getDefaultUnit as _getDefaultUnit } from '../../../shr/units/uom';
export type { UOMUnit } from '../../../shr/units/uom';

// 🆕 منبع یکتای UOM — alias به shr/units/uom.ts
export const UOM_CATEGORIES = UOM_RULES;

/** آیا واحد انتخابی نیاز به ضریب دستی (unitWeight) دارد؟ */
export function unitNeedsWeight(cat: string, unit: string): boolean {
  const uom = UOM_CATEGORIES[cat];
  if (!uom) return false;
  const u = uom.units.find(x => x.value === unit);
  return !!u && u.factor === null;
}

/** ضریب تبدیل نهایی: از factor یا unitWeight */
export function resolveUomFactor(cat: string, unit: string, unitWeight?: number | null): number {
  const uom = UOM_CATEGORIES[cat];
  if (!uom) return 1;
  const u = uom.units.find(x => x.value === unit);
  if (!u) return 1;
  if (u.factor !== null) return u.factor;
  return unitWeight && unitWeight > 0 ? unitWeight : 1;
}


/** محاسبه ضریب تبدیل مقدار به واحد مبنای قیمت (priceUnit) */
export function resolveItemPriceFactor(
  cat: string,
  unit: string,
  unitWeight?: number | null,
  priceUnit?: string,
  liveWeight?: number | null,
  quantity?: number | null
): number {
  const catRule = UOM_CATEGORIES[cat];
  const units: any[] = catRule?.units || [];
  const unitDef = units.find((u: any) => u.value === unit);

  const qtyToBase = (() => {
    if (unitDef && unitDef.factor !== null && unitDef.factor !== undefined) return Number(unitDef.factor) || 1;
    if (unitWeight && Number(unitWeight) > 0) return Number(unitWeight);
    if ((priceUnit === 'perKg' || priceUnit === 'per_kg') && liveWeight && liveWeight > 0 && quantity && quantity > 0) {
      return liveWeight / quantity;
    }
    return 1;
  })();

  const targetPriceUnit = priceUnit || unit;
  if (!targetPriceUnit || targetPriceUnit === unit) {
    return 1;
  }

  if (targetPriceUnit === 'perKg' || targetPriceUnit === 'per_kg') {
    if (liveWeight && liveWeight > 0 && quantity && quantity > 0) {
      return liveWeight / quantity;
    }
    return qtyToBase;
  }

  const priceUnitDef = units.find((u: any) => u.value === targetPriceUnit);
  if (!priceUnitDef) return 1;

  if (priceUnitDef.factor !== null && priceUnitDef.factor !== undefined && Number(priceUnitDef.factor) > 0) {
    return qtyToBase / Number(priceUnitDef.factor);
  }

  if (unitWeight && Number(unitWeight) > 0) {
    return qtyToBase / Number(unitWeight);
  }

  return 1;
}

export function getUnitForCategory(cat: string): string {
  return UOM_CATEGORIES[cat]?.default || 'pcs';
}

export function useInvoiceForm(params: {
  kind: 'purchase' | 'sale';
  invoices: Invoice[];
  contacts: any[];
  flocks?: any[];
  whsItems?: any[];
  allocations?: any[];
  addInvoice: (i: any) => string | undefined;
  updateInvoice: (id: string, patch: any) => void;
}) {
  // invoices از پارامترها گرفته می‌شود اما در openNew استفاده نمی‌شود
  // (جلوگیری از کپی داده‌ی قبلی در فرم جدید)
  const { kind, contacts, flocks = [], whsItems = [], allocations = [], invoices = [], addInvoice, updateInvoice } = params;
  const isPurchase = kind === 'purchase';

  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<F>(empty(isPurchase));
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');


  // محاسبه‌ی parties بر اساس form.category
  const parties = (() => {
    if (!isPurchase) return contacts.filter((c) => c.roles.includes('customer'));
    const allSuppliers = contacts.filter((c) => c.roles.includes('supplier'));
    const cat = form?.category || '';
    if (!cat || cat === 'other') return allSuppliers;
    const matching = allSuppliers.filter((c) =>
      Array.isArray(c.supplierTypes) && c.supplierTypes.includes(cat)
    );
    return matching.length > 0 ? matching : allSuppliers;
  })();

  const num = (s: string) => s ? parseFloat(toEn(s).replace('٫','.')) || 0 : 0;

  // محاسبات
  useEffect(() => {
    let changed = false;
    const newItems = form.items.map(it => {
      const cat = it.category || form.category;
      const unit = it.unit || 'pcs';
      const unitDef = UOM_CATEGORIES[cat]?.units.find((u: any) => u.value === unit);
      const factor = resolveItemPriceFactor(cat, unit, it.unitWeight, it.priceUnit, it.liveWeight, it.quantity);
      const expected = calcItemTotal(it.quantity || 0, it.unitPrice || 0, it.discountType, it.discountValue, factor) + (it.shipping || 0);
      if (Math.abs(expected - (it.total || 0)) > 0.1) {
        changed = true;
        return { ...it, total: expected };
      }
      return it;
    });
    if (changed) {
      setForm(f => ({ ...f, items: newItems }));
    }
  }, [form.items, form.category]);

  const total = useMemo(
    () => form.items.reduce((acc, it) => {
      const cat = it.category || form.category;
      const unit = it.unit || 'pcs';
      const unitDef = UOM_CATEGORIES[cat]?.units.find((u: any) => u.value === unit);
      const factor = resolveItemPriceFactor(cat, unit, it.unitWeight, it.priceUnit, it.liveWeight, it.quantity);
      return acc + calcItemTotal(it.quantity || 0, it.unitPrice || 0, it.discountType, it.discountValue, factor) + (it.shipping || 0);
    }, 0),
    [form.items, form.category]
  );
  const paid = useMemo(() => paidSum(form.payments), [form.payments]);

  // 🆕 Hoisted: must be top-level (was inside async save → Invalid hook call)
  const breedStd = useBreedStandard();
  const rem = Math.max(0, total - paid);

  // اقلام
  const addItem = () => setForm(f => {
    const cat = f.category || (isPurchase ? 'chick' : 'egg');
    const defaultUnit = getUnitForCategory(cat);
    return { ...f, items: [...f.items, {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(), description: '', unit: defaultUnit,
      quantity: 0, unitPrice: 0, total: 0, itemId: '', movementId: '',
      discountType: '', discountValue: 0, shipping: 0,
    }] };
  });
  const updateItem = (id: string, patch: Partial<InvoiceItem>) => {
    setForm(f => {
      const target = f.items.find(x => x.id === id);
      if (!target) return f;

      const nx = { ...target, ...patch };
      const cat = nx.category || f.category;
      const unit = nx.unit || 'pcs';
      const catUnits: any[] = UOM_CATEGORIES[cat]?.units || [];
      const unitDef = catUnits.find((u: any) => u.value === unit);
      if (patch.unit !== undefined && patch.priceUnit === undefined) {
        const curPriceDef = catUnits.find((u: any) => u.value === nx.priceUnit);
        const sameDim = curPriceDef && unitDef && curPriceDef.dimension === unitDef.dimension && curPriceDef.factor !== null && unitDef.factor !== null;
        if (!sameDim && nx.priceUnit !== 'perKg' && nx.priceUnit !== 'per_kg') {
          nx.priceUnit = unit as any;
        }
      }
      const factor = resolveItemPriceFactor(cat, unit, nx.unitWeight, nx.priceUnit, nx.liveWeight, nx.quantity);
      nx.total = calcItemTotal(nx.quantity, nx.unitPrice, nx.discountType, nx.discountValue, factor) + (nx.shipping || 0);

      // auto-calc gender counts intelligently for chick/adult
      if ((cat === 'chick' || cat === 'adult') && (patch.quantity !== undefined || patch.maleCount !== undefined || patch.femaleCount !== undefined || patch.flockId !== undefined)) {
        const m = Number(nx.maleCount) || 0;
        const fe = Number(nx.femaleCount) || 0;
        const q = Number(nx.quantity) || 0;
        const rem = Math.max(0, q - m - fe);

        if (kind === 'purchase') {
          nx.unknownCount = rem;
        } else {
          const flkObj = nx.flockId ? useFlk.getState().flocks.find(x => x.id === nx.flockId) : undefined;
          const availU = flkObj?.unknownCount ?? 0;
          const availM = flkObj?.maleCount ?? 0;
          const availF = flkObj?.femaleCount ?? 0;

          if (!flkObj || availU > 0) {
            nx.unknownCount = flkObj ? Math.min(rem, availU) : rem;
          } else {
            // گله تعیین‌جنسیت شده (unknownCount === 0): هرگز نامشخص را پر نکن
            nx.unknownCount = 0;

              if (availM > 0 && availF === 0) nx.maleCount = Math.min(q, availM);
              else if (availF > 0 && availM === 0) nx.femaleCount = Math.min(q, availF);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      const identityFields = ['flockId', 'hatchId', 'stockItemId', 'unit', 'unitPrice', 'birdId', 'breedId', 'description'];
      const isIdentityChange = Object.keys(patch).some(k => identityFields.includes(k));

      if (isIdentityChange) {
        const duplicate = f.items.find(y => y.id !== id && isSameInvoiceIdentity(y, nx, f.category || ''));
        if (duplicate) {
          const dupUnitDef = UOM_CATEGORIES[cat]?.units.find((u: any) => u.value === (duplicate.unit || 'pcs'));
          const dupFactor = (() => {
            if (dupUnitDef && dupUnitDef.factor !== null) return dupUnitDef.factor;
            if (duplicate.unitWeight) return duplicate.unitWeight;
            if ((duplicate.priceUnit === 'perKg' || duplicate.priceUnit === 'per_kg') && duplicate.liveWeight && duplicate.liveWeight > 0 && duplicate.quantity && duplicate.quantity > 0) {
              return duplicate.liveWeight / duplicate.quantity;
            }
            return 1;
          })();

          const mergedQty = (duplicate.quantity || 0) + (nx.quantity || 0);
          const mergedLiveWeight = (duplicate.liveWeight || 0) + (nx.liveWeight || 0);
          const mergedFactor = (() => {
            if ((duplicate.priceUnit === 'perKg' || duplicate.priceUnit === 'per_kg') && mergedLiveWeight > 0 && mergedQty > 0) {
              return mergedLiveWeight / mergedQty;
            }
            return dupFactor;
          })();

          const mergedObj = {
            ...duplicate,
            quantity: mergedQty,
            healthyCount: (duplicate.healthyCount != null || nx.healthyCount != null) ? ((duplicate.healthyCount || 0) + (nx.healthyCount || 0)) : null,
            maleCount: (duplicate.maleCount != null || nx.maleCount != null) ? ((duplicate.maleCount || 0) + (nx.maleCount || 0)) : null,
            femaleCount: (duplicate.femaleCount != null || nx.femaleCount != null) ? ((duplicate.femaleCount || 0) + (nx.femaleCount || 0)) : null,
            unknownCount: (duplicate.unknownCount != null || nx.unknownCount != null) ? ((duplicate.unknownCount || 0) + (nx.unknownCount || 0)) : null,
            liveWeight: (duplicate.liveWeight != null || nx.liveWeight != null) ? mergedLiveWeight : null,
            total: calcItemTotal(mergedQty, duplicate.unitPrice, duplicate.discountType, duplicate.discountValue, mergedFactor) + (duplicate.shipping || 0)
          };

          setTimeout(() => toastMsg.info('قلم تکراری ادغام شد — مقدار جمع شد'), 0);
          return { ...f, items: f.items.filter(y => y.id !== id).map(y => y.id === duplicate.id ? mergedObj : y) };
        }
      }

      return { ...f, items: f.items.map(x => x.id === id ? nx : x) };
    });
  };
  const removeItem = (id: string) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, items: f.items.filter(x => x.id !== id) }));

  // پرداخت‌ها
  const addPayment = () => setForm(f => ({ ...f, payments: [...f.payments, {
    id: crypto.randomUUID(), date: f.date, amount: 0, method: 'cash' as const,
    checkNo: '', bank: '', dueDate: '', notes: '',
  }] }));
  const updatePayment = (id: string, patch: Partial<Payment>) =>
    setForm(f => ({ ...f, payments: f.payments.map(x => x.id === id ? { ...x, ...patch } : x) }));
  const removePayment = (id: string) =>
    setForm(f => ({ ...f, payments: f.payments.filter(x => x.id !== id) }));

  // باز کردن فرم جدید — همیشه خالی (فقط تاریخ امروز)
  // ⚠️ هرگز داده‌ی فاکتور قبلی کپی نمی‌شود (جلوگیری از ساخت تصادفی رکورد تکراری)
  const openNew = () => {
    if (parties.length === 0) { toastMsg.error(isPurchase ? 'اول یک فروشنده تعریف کنید' : 'اول یک مشتری تعریف کنید'); return; }
    const today = formatJ(new Date(), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
    setForm({
      ...empty(isPurchase),
      date: today,
    });
    setErr(''); setOpen(true);
  };

  // ویرایش
  const openEdit = (inv: Invoice) => {
    if (inv.paidAt) {
      // 🆕 فیکس: اگر paidAt دارد ولی remaining > 0 → داده ناسازگار
      // Aging این را نشان می‌دهد (چون remaining > 0)، پس ویرایش باید باز شود
      // ⚠️ مهم: باید با allocations حساب شود (مثل Aging) — نه فقط از inv.payments
      const rem = remaining(inv, allocations);
      if (rem > 0.5) {
        console.warn('[openEdit] paidAt set but remaining > 0, allowing edit:', inv.id, rem);
      } else {
        toastMsg.error('فاکتور تسویه‌شده — ابتدا Reopen کنید');
        return;
      }
    }
    setForm({
      id: inv.id, date: inv.date, partyId: inv.partyId, category: inv.category,
      items: (inv.items || []).map((it: any) => {
        const linkedId = it.existingFlockId || it.flockId || (inv as any).relatedFlockId || '';
        return linkedId ? { ...it, existingFlockId: linkedId, flockId: it.flockId || linkedId } : it;
      }),
      paymentTerms: inv.paymentTerms || 'cash',
      installmentCount: inv.installmentCount ? getGlobalFormat().code(inv.installmentCount) : '1',
      installmentGapDays: inv.installmentGapDays ? getGlobalFormat().code(inv.installmentGapDays) : '30',
      customDueDate: inv.customDueDate || '',
      cashDiscountPct: inv.cashDiscountPct ? String(inv.cashDiscountPct) : '',
      cashDiscountDays: inv.cashDiscountDays ? String(inv.cashDiscountDays) : '',
      isPreorder: inv.isPreorder ?? false,
      deliveryDate: inv.deliveryDate || '',
      advanceType: (inv.advancePercent && inv.advancePercent > 0) ? 'percent' : 'amount',
      advanceValue: (inv.advancePercent && inv.advancePercent > 0)
        ? getGlobalFormat().code(inv.advancePercent)
        : (inv.advancePayment ? getGlobalFormat().code(inv.advancePayment) : ''),
      dueDate: inv.dueDate || '',
      payments: inv.payments || [],
      relatedFlockId: (inv as any).relatedFlockId || '',
      relatedDealId: (inv as any).relatedDealId || '',
      relatedSettlementId: (inv as any).relatedSettlementId,
      sourceType: (inv as any).sourceType,
      notes: inv.notes || '',
      installments: inv.installments || [],
    });
    setErr(''); setOpen(true);
  };

  // ذخیره
  const save = async () => {
    // ═══ فیلتر اقلام کاملاً خالی ═══
    const isEmptyItem = (it: any) =>
      (Number(it.quantity) || 0) === 0 &&
      (Number(it.unitPrice) || 0) === 0 &&
      !String(it.description || '').trim();

    const cleanedItems = (form.items || []).filter((it: any) => !isEmptyItem(it));
    if (cleanedItems.length === 0) {
      setErr('حداقل یک قلم با تعداد یا قیمت وارد کنید');
      return;
    }

    // ═══ فیلتر پرداخت‌های خالی ═══
    const cleanPayments = (form.payments || []).filter((p: any) => (Number(p.amount) || 0) > 0);

    // ═══ اعتبارسنجی Zod (منبع حقیقت) ═══
    const validationData = {
      type: kind,
      date: form.date || '',
      partyId: form.partyId || '',
      category: form.category || '',
      items: cleanedItems.map(it => ({
        ...it,
        category: it.category || form.category,
      })),
      discount: 0,
      shipping: 0,
      total,
      payments: cleanPayments,
      dueDate: form.dueDate || '',
      relatedFlockId: form.relatedFlockId || '',
      relatedEntryId: '',
      relatedDealId: (form as any).relatedDealId || '',
      relatedSettlementId: (form as any).relatedSettlementId,
      sourceType: (form as any).sourceType,
      notes: form.notes?.trim() || '',
      paymentTerms: form.paymentTerms,
      isPreorder: form.isPreorder,
      deliveryDate: form.deliveryDate || '',
    };
    const zodResult = createInvoiceSchema({ flocks, whsItems, contacts, invoices, allocations, isEdit: !!form.id, prevInvoice: form.id ? invoices.find((i: any) => i.id === form.id) : undefined } as any).safeParse(validationData);
    if (!zodResult.success) {
      const firstErr = zodResult.error.issues[0];
      const path = firstErr.path.join('.');
      const itemMatch = path.match(/^items\.(\d+)\./);
      // inline errors shown by useFormErrors (showError)
      void itemMatch; void firstErr;
      return;
    }
    // ═══ پایان اعتبارسنجی Zod ═══
    
    // inline errors shown by useFormErrors (showError)
    if (!form.partyId) return;
    if (!form.date.trim()) return;

    // ─── اعتبارسنجی منطقی تاریخ فاکتور (جلوگیری از اشتباه تایپی سال/آینده) ───
    const parsedInvoiceDate = parseJalali(form.date.trim());
    if (parsedInvoiceDate) {
      const todayDate = new Date();
      todayDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      const diffFromToday = differenceInCalendarDays(parsedInvoiceDate, todayDate);

      if (!form.isPreorder && diffFromToday > 0) {
        setErr(
          `تاریخ فاکتور قطعی نمی‌تواند در آینده (${getGlobalFormat().date(form.date)}) باشد. ` +
          `برای ثبت سفارش آینده از گزینه «پیش‌خرید / پیش‌فروش» استفاده کنید.`
        );
        return;
      }

      if (diffFromToday < -90) {
        const pastDays = Math.abs(diffFromToday);
        const confirmOldDate = await showConfirmAsync(
          '⚠️ هشدار تاریخ قدیمی فاکتور',
          `تاریخ انتخاب‌شده (${getGlobalFormat().date(form.date)}) مربوط به ${getGlobalFormat().count(pastDays)} روز قبل است.\n` +
          `ثبت فاکتور با تاریخ قدیمی ممکن است تراز صورت‌حساب‌های گذشته و سن گله را تغییر دهد.\n\nآیا از صحت این تاریخ مطمئن هستید؟`,
          {}
        );
        if (!confirmOldDate) return;
      }
    }


    // ─── اعتبارسنجی نرم (Soft Validation) ───
    const unlinkedStockLabels: string[] = [];
    const missingBreedLabels: string[] = [];
    const missingFlockLabels: string[] = [];

    cleanedItems.forEach((it, idx) => {
      const itemAny = it as any;
      const cat = itemAny.category || form.category;
      const numLabel = `قلم ${getGlobalFormat().count(idx + 1)}`;
      const rawName = itemAny.name || itemAny.itemName || itemAny.title || '';
      const itemTitle = String(rawName).trim() ? `${numLabel} (${String(rawName).trim()})` : numLabel;

      if (kind === 'purchase') {
        if ((cat === 'chick' || cat === 'adult') && !itemAny.breedId && !itemAny.birdId) {
          missingBreedLabels.push(itemTitle);
        }
        if (['feed', 'medicine', 'vaccine', 'herbal'].includes(cat) && !itemAny.itemId && !itemAny.stockItemId) {
          unlinkedStockLabels.push(itemTitle);
        }
      } else {
        if ((cat === 'chick' || cat === 'adult') && !itemAny.flockId) {
          missingFlockLabels.push(itemTitle);
        }
      }
    });

    const warnings: string[] = [];
    if (unlinkedStockLabels.length > 0) {
      warnings.push(`${unlinkedStockLabels.join(' و ')} به انبار وصل نیست — کالای جدید به صورت خودکار ثبت و لینک می‌شود.`);
    }
    if (missingBreedLabels.length > 0) {
      warnings.push(`${missingBreedLabels.join(' و ')}: نژاد یا پرنده انتخاب نشده و گله جدید ساخته نمی‌شود.`);
    }
    if (missingFlockLabels.length > 0) {
      warnings.push(`${missingFlockLabels.join(' و ')}: گله مبدا انتخاب نشده و از موجودی گله کم نمی‌شود.`);
    }

    if (warnings.length > 0) {
      const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
        '⚠️ تأیید ذخیره فاکتور',
        warnings.join('\n') + '\n\nادامه می‌دهید؟',
        {}
      );
      if (!ok) return;
    }
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // ═══ چک گله تکراری + دیالوگ تأیید (Odoo/SAP standard) ═══
    // 🆕 فیکس: اگر کاربر از قبل گله موجود را انتخاب کرده، پیام تکراری نده
    const hasExistingLink = cleanedItems.some((it: any) => it.existingFlockId);
    if (kind === 'purchase' && !hasExistingLink) {
      const flkState = useFlk.getState();
      const duplicates: Array<{ item: any; dup: any }> = [];
      const prevInvForDup = form.id ? invoices.find((i: any) => i.id === form.id) : undefined;
      for (const it of cleanedItems as any[]) {
        const cat = it.category || form.category;
        if (cat !== 'chick' && cat !== 'adult') continue;
        if (it.existingFlockId) continue;
        const prevSameFlock = prevInvForDup && (prevInvForDup.items || []).find((pit: any) => pit.id === it.id && (pit.flockId || pit.existingFlockId));
        if (prevSameFlock) continue;
        if (!it.birdId || !it.breedId) continue;
        const incomingHall = String(it.hallId || '');
        const dup = flkState.flocks.find((f: any) =>
          f.status === 'active' &&
          (f.birdId || '') === it.birdId &&
          (f.breedId || '') === it.breedId &&
          String(f.hallId || '') === incomingHall
        );
        if (dup) duplicates.push({ item: it, dup });
      }

      if (duplicates.length > 0) {
        const dup = duplicates[0].dup;
        const hallHint = dup.hallId ? '' : ' (بدون سالن)';
        const count = duplicates.length;
        const msg =
          `گله مشابه موجود است:\n«${dup.name}»${hallHint}\n` +
          `${getGlobalFormat().count(dup.currentCount || 0)} پرنده\n\n` +
          (count > 1 ? `(${getGlobalFormat().count(count)} مورد مشابه یافت شد)\n\n` : '') +
          `با تأیید، گله جدید ساخته می‌شود.\n` +
          `برای اتصال به گله موجود، «لغو» را بزنید و از «اتصال به گله» استفاده کنید.`;

        const ok = await showConfirmAsync('⚠️ گله تکراری', msg, {
          confirmText: 'ادامه بده',
          cancelText: 'لغو',
        });
        if (!ok) {
          return;
        }
        try {
          logAction('other', 'tra', `تایید ساخت گله تکراری — ${count} مورد: ${dup.name}`);
        } catch {}
      }
    }

    // ═══ VALIDATION: چک ظرفیت سالن/بخش با پشتیبانی از ویرایش، تغییر گله و چند قلم هم‌زمان ═══
    if (kind === 'purchase') {
      const flkState = useFlk.getState();
      const halState = useHal.getState();
      const prevInv = form.id ? invoices.find((i: any) => i.id === form.id) : undefined;
      const prevItems = prevInv ? (prevInv.items || []) : [];

      let virtualFlocks = flkState.flocks.map((f: any) => ({ ...f }));

      if (prevInv) {
        for (const pit of prevItems as any[]) {
          const pCat = pit.category || prevInv.category;
          if (pCat !== 'chick' && pCat !== 'adult') continue;
          const pCount = Number(pit.healthyCount ?? pit.quantity) || 0;
          const pFlockId = (prevInv as any).relatedFlockId || pit.flockId || pit.existingFlockId || '';
          if (pFlockId && pCount > 0) {
            virtualFlocks = virtualFlocks.map((vf: any) =>
              vf.id === pFlockId
                ? { ...vf, currentCount: Math.max(0, (vf.currentCount || 0) - pCount) }
                : vf
            );
          }
        }
      }

      for (let idx = 0; idx < cleanedItems.length; idx++) {
        const it: any = cleanedItems[idx];
        const cat = it.category || form.category;
        if (cat !== 'chick' && cat !== 'adult') continue;

        const newCount = Number(it.healthyCount ?? it.quantity) || 0;
        if (newCount <= 0) continue;

        if (it.existingFlockId) {
          const f = virtualFlocks.find((x: any) => x.id === it.existingFlockId);
          if (!f) continue;

          const targetHallId = it.hallId || f.hallId;
          const targetZoneId = it.zoneId !== undefined ? it.zoneId : f.zoneId;

          if (targetHallId) {
            const totalFutureCount = (f.currentCount || 0) + newCount;
            const capCheck = checkHallCapacity(
              targetHallId, targetZoneId, totalFutureCount,
              virtualFlocks, halState.halls, halState.zones,
              breedStd, it.existingFlockId, it.breedId || f.breedId
            );

            if (capCheck && !capCheck.ok) {
              const scope = capCheck.scope === 'zone' ? `بخش ${capCheck.scopeName}` : `سالن ${capCheck.scopeName}`;
              const msg = `انتقال/افزایش گله به ${scope} ممکن نیست: ظرفیت تکمیل است.\n` +
                          `ظرفیت کل: ${getGlobalFormat().count(capCheck.capacity)}\n` +
                          `استفاده شده (با احتساب انتقال): ${getGlobalFormat().count(capCheck.current)}\n` +
                          `بیشبود: ${getGlobalFormat().count(capCheck.over)} پرنده`;
              setErr(msg);
              return;
            }
          }

          virtualFlocks = virtualFlocks.map((vf: any) =>
            vf.id === it.existingFlockId
              ? {
                  ...vf,
                  currentCount: (vf.currentCount || 0) + newCount,
                  hallId: targetHallId || vf.hallId,
                  zoneId: targetZoneId !== undefined ? targetZoneId : vf.zoneId,
                }
              : vf
          );
        } else {
          const hallId = it.hallId || '';
          const zoneId = it.zoneId || '';

          if (hallId) {
            const capCheck = checkHallCapacity(
              hallId, zoneId, newCount,
              virtualFlocks, halState.halls, halState.zones,
              breedStd, undefined, it.breedId
            );

            if (capCheck && !capCheck.ok) {
              const scope = capCheck.scope === 'zone' ? `بخش ${capCheck.scopeName}` : `سالن ${capCheck.scopeName}`;
              const msg = `ظرفیت ${scope} تکمیل است.\n` +
                          `ظرفیت کل: ${getGlobalFormat().count(capCheck.capacity)}\n` +
                          `استفاده شده: ${getGlobalFormat().count(capCheck.current)}\n` +
                          `بیشبود: ${getGlobalFormat().count(capCheck.over)} پرنده`;
              setErr(msg);
              return;
            }
          }

          virtualFlocks.push({
            id: `__virtual_${idx}`,
            status: 'active',
            hallId,
            zoneId,
            breedId: it.breedId || '',
            currentCount: newCount,
          });
        }
      }
    }

    const normalizedItems = cleanedItems.map((it: any) => {
      const cat = it.category || form.category;
      const unit = it.unit || getUnitForCategory(cat);
      const pUnit = it.priceUnit || unit;
      if (pUnit !== unit && it.unitPrice && Number(it.unitPrice) > 0) {
        const catUnits: any[] = UOM_CATEGORIES[cat]?.units || [];
        const uDef = catUnits.find((u: any) => u.value === unit);
        const pDef = catUnits.find((u: any) => u.value === pUnit);
        if (uDef && pDef && uDef.factor !== null && pDef.factor !== null && Number(pDef.factor) > 0) {
          const ratioToUnit = Number(uDef.factor) / Number(pDef.factor);
          return {
            ...it,
            unitPrice: Number((Number(it.unitPrice) * ratioToUnit).toFixed(4)),
            priceUnit: unit,
          };
        }
      }
      return { ...it, priceUnit: pUnit };
    });
    const data: any = {
      type: kind, date: form.date, partyId: form.partyId, category: form.category,
      items: normalizedItems, discount: 0, shipping: 0, total, payments: cleanPayments,
      dueDate: form.dueDate, relatedFlockId: form.relatedFlockId || '',
      relatedEntryId: '', notes: form.notes.trim(),
      paymentTerms: form.paymentTerms,
      installmentCount: form.paymentTerms === 'installment' ? (parseInt(toEn(form.installmentCount)) || 1) : undefined,
      installmentGapDays: form.paymentTerms === 'installment' ? (parseInt(toEn(form.installmentGapDays)) || 30) : undefined,
      customDueDate: form.paymentTerms === 'custom' ? form.customDueDate : '',
      cashDiscountPct: form.cashDiscountPct ? parseFloat(toEn(form.cashDiscountPct)) : undefined,
      cashDiscountDays: form.cashDiscountDays ? parseInt(toEn(form.cashDiscountDays)) : undefined,
      isPreorder: form.category === 'other' ? false : form.isPreorder,
      deliveryDate: (form.category !== 'other' && form.isPreorder) ? form.deliveryDate : '',
      advancePercent: form.isPreorder && form.advanceType === 'percent' ? num(form.advanceValue) : 0,
      advancePayment: form.isPreorder ? (
        form.advanceType === 'percent' 
          ? (total * (num(form.advanceValue) / 100)) 
          : num(form.advanceValue)
      ) : 0,
    };
    if (form.paymentTerms === 'installment') {
      const cnt = parseInt(toEn(form.installmentCount)) || 0;
      const gap = parseInt(toEn(form.installmentGapDays)) || 30;
      const advance = form.isPreorder ? (
        form.advanceType === 'percent' 
          ? (total * (num(form.advanceValue) / 100)) 
          : num(form.advanceValue)
      ) : 0;
      const savedInst = form.installments || [];
      const savedSum = savedInst.reduce((a: number, x: any) => a + (x.amount || 0), 0);
      const expectedSum = Math.max(0, total - advance);
      const isStale = savedInst.length !== cnt || Math.abs(savedSum - expectedSum) > 100;
      if (savedInst.length > 0 && !isStale) {
        data.installments = savedInst;
      } else {
        data.installments = generateInstallments(total, cnt, gap, form.date, advance);
      }
    } else {
      data.installments = [];
    }
    // 🆕 فاز ۱: چک سقف اعتبار
    if (form.partyId && total > 0) {
      const _contact = contacts.find((c: any) => c.id === form.partyId);
      const _limit = Number(_contact?.creditLimit) || 0;
      if (_limit > 0) {
        const _currentCredit = computePartyCredit(form.partyId, invoices, allocations);
        const _oldTotal = form.id ? (invoices.find((i: any) => i.id === form.id)?.total || 0) : 0;
        const _newCredit = _currentCredit - total + _oldTotal;
        const _newDebt = Math.max(0, -_newCredit);
        if (_newDebt > _limit) {
          const _over = _newDebt - _limit;
          const _ok = await showConfirmAsync(
            'عبور از سقف اعتبار',
            `بدهی این طرف پس از این فاکتور ${getGlobalFormat().money(_newDebt, { withUnit: false })} تومان می‌شود که ${getGlobalFormat().money(_over, { withUnit: false })} تومان از سقف اعتبار (${getGlobalFormat().money(_limit, { withUnit: false })} تومان) بیشتر است. ادامه می‌دهید؟`,
            { confirmText: 'ادامه', cancelText: 'لغو' }
          );
          if (!_ok) return;
        }
      }
    }
        // 🆕 فاز ۳: استفاده از پیش‌پرداخت (unapplied advances)
    if (form.useAdvance && form.partyId && total > 0) {
      const _advAllocs = buildAdvanceAllocations(form.partyId, total, form.date);
      for (const _a of _advAllocs) {
        data.payments = [
          ...(data.payments || []),
          {
            id: crypto.randomUUID(),
            date: _a.date,
            amount: _a.amount,
            method: 'cash',
            type: 'advance',
            partyPaymentId: _a.partyPaymentId,
            checkNo: '',
            bank: '',
            dueDate: '',
            notes: 'مصرف از پیش‌پرداخت',
          },
        ];
      }
    }

if (form.id) {
      updateInvoice(form.id, data);
      verifyInvariantsIfDev();
    } else {
      try {
        addInvoice(data);
      } catch (e) {
        const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
        setErr('ذخیره ناموفق: ' + msg);
        return;
      }
      verifyInvariantsIfDev();
      verifyInvariantsIfDev();
    }

    // ثبت تاریخچه برای سیستم هوشمند
    try {
      for (const it of form.items) {
        const cat = it.category || form.category;
        // 🆕 Gap 8: normalize to baseUnit price (was: raw unitPrice)
        if (it.unitPrice && it.unitPrice > 0) {
          const uom = UOM_CATEGORIES[cat];
          const unitValue = it.unit || (uom as any)?.default || 'pcs';
          const unitDef = uom?.units.find((u: any) => u.value === unitValue);
          const effFactor = (() => {
            if (unitDef && unitDef.factor !== null && unitDef.factor > 0) return unitDef.factor;
            if (it.unitWeight && it.unitWeight > 0) return it.unitWeight;
            if ((it.priceUnit === 'perKg' || it.priceUnit === 'per_kg') && it.liveWeight && it.liveWeight > 0 && it.quantity && it.quantity > 0) {
              return it.liveWeight / it.quantity;
            }
            return 1;
          })();
          const priceRel = resolveItemPriceFactor(cat, unitValue, it.unitWeight, it.priceUnit, it.liveWeight, it.quantity);
            const pricePerBase = (it.unitPrice / priceRel) / effFactor;
            void pricePerBase;
            const basePrice = it.unitPrice / effFactor;
          recordHistory(`tra.price_${cat}`, basePrice, {});
        }
        if (it.quantity && it.quantity > 0) recordHistory('tra.quantity', it.quantity, {});
        if (it.discountValue && it.discountValue > 0) recordHistory('tra.discountValue', it.discountValue, {});
        if (it.shipping && it.shipping > 0) recordHistory('tra.shipping', it.shipping, {});
      }
    } catch { /* silent */ }

    // پاک کردن draft بعد از ذخیره موفق
    setOpen(false);
  };

  return {
    open, setOpen, form, setForm, err, setErr, parties,
    total, paid, rem, num,
    addItem, updateItem, removeItem,
    addPayment, updatePayment, removePayment,
    openNew, openEdit, save,
  };
}

/**
 * useInvoiceSelection — مدیریت Multi-Select فاکتورها
 */
import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useMultiSelect } from '../../../shr/multiSelect/useMultiSelect';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../../cor/store/dialog';
import { toastMsg } from '../../../cor/store/toast';

interface Params {
  list: any[];
  invoices: any[];
  deleteInvoice: (id: string) => void;
  setUndoData: (v: any) => void;
  flocks?: any[];
  settlements?: any[];
}

export function useInvoiceSelection({ list, invoices, deleteInvoice, setUndoData, flocks = [], settlements = [] }: Params) {
  return useMultiSelect({
    items: list,
    getId: (x: any) => x.id,
    onDelete: async (ids: string[]) => {
      // 🆕 چک لینک‌ها (گله/تسویه)
      const linked: Array<{ id: string; flocks: number; settlements: number }> = [];
      for (const id of ids) {
        const fl = flocks.filter((f: any) => f.sourceInvoiceId === id).length;
        const st = settlements.filter((s: any) => s.invoiceId === id).length;
        if (fl > 0 || st > 0) {
          linked.push({ id, flocks: fl, settlements: st });
        }
      }
      if (linked.length > 0) {
        const totalFlocks = linked.reduce((s, x) => s + x.flocks, 0);
        const totalSettlements = linked.reduce((s, x) => s + x.settlements, 0);
        const linkedOk = await showConfirmAsync(
          '⚠️ فاکتورهای متصل',
          linked.length + ' فاکتور به ' + totalFlocks + ' گله و ' + totalSettlements + ' تسویه وصل است. حذف آن‌ها باعث قطع ارتباط می‌شود. ادامه؟',
          { danger: true, confirmText: 'حذف' }
        );
        if (!linkedOk) return;
      }
      const ok = await showConfirmAsync('حذف گروهی', getGlobalFormat().count(ids.length) + ' فاکتور حذف شوند؟', { danger: true });
      if (!ok) return;
      const backups: any[] = [];
      for (const id of ids) {
        const item = invoices.find(c => c.id === id);
        if (!item) continue;
        backups.push(item);
        try { deleteInvoice(id); } catch {}
      }
      if (backups.length > 0) {
        setUndoData({ item: backups });
        setTimeout(() => setUndoData((cur: any) => cur && Array.isArray(cur.item) && cur.item.length === backups.length ? null : cur), 8000);
      }
      toastMsg.deletedBulk(backups.length, 'فاکتور');
    },
  });
}

import { useInc } from '../../mod/inc/store';
/**
 * tra/invoiceHelpers.ts — اعمال اثر فاکتور روی انبار و گله

import { parse as parseJ, format as formatJ, addDays } from 'date-fns-jalali';
import { useFlk } from '../flk/store';
import { deriveSaleEvents, buildSaleAudit } from '../flk/helpers-sex';
import { useBrd } from '../brd/store';
import { getBiology, getStandardFor } from '../set/standards/resolve';
import { showToast } from '../../cor/store/toast';

/** اعمال اثر فاکتور روی گله‌ها — خرید جوجه/پرنده → افزودن، فروش → کاهش */
/** محاسبه تاریخ هچ از تاریخ فاکتور منهای سن */
function computeHatchDate(invDate: string, ageDays: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (!ageDays || ageDays <= 0) return '';
  try {
    const en = invDate.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d: string) => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));
    const d = parseJ(en, 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
    return formatJ(addDays(d, -ageDays), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
  } catch { return ''; }
}

export const BIRD_CATS = ['chick', 'adult'];

/* EGG_LINK */
/** اتصال فاکتور فروش تخم → EggSale خودکار */
/** ⏱ دوره جوجه‌کشی بر اساس گونه پرنده (روز) */
function getIncubationDays(birdKind: string | undefined): number {
  const days: Record<string, number> = {
    chicken: 21, duck: 28, turkey: 28, goose: 30, quail: 18,
    pigeon: 18, ostrich: 42,
  };
  return days[(birdKind || 'chicken').toLowerCase()] || 21;
}

/** افزودن N روز به تاریخ جلالی (برای محاسبه تاریخ هچ تخم) */
function addJalaliDays(dateStr: string, days: number): string {
  if (!dateStr) return '';
  const parts = dateStr.split('/').map(Number);
  if (parts.length !== 3 || parts.some(isNaN)) return '';
  
  let [y, m, d] = parts;
  d += days;
  
  const monthDays = (month: number) => {
    if (month >= 1 && month <= 6) return 31;
    if (month >= 7 && month <= 11) return 30;
    return 29;
  };
  
  while (d > monthDays(m)) {
    d -= monthDays(m);
    m++;
    if (m > 12) { m = 1; y++; }
  }
  
  return `${y}/${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}/${String(d).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export function applyInvoiceEgg(inv: Invoice, prev?: Invoice): InvoiceItem[] {
  const outItems: InvoiceItem[] = (inv.items || []).map(it => ({ ...it }));

  // ─── فروش تخم (خوراکی یا نطفه‌دار) — برای هر قلم جداگانه ───
  if (inv.type === 'sale') {
    const egg = useEgg.getState();
    // 🆕 rebuild: پاک‌سازی sales قبلی این فاکتور، سپس افزودن مجدد
    const oldSales = egg.sales.filter((x: any) => x.sourceInvoiceId === inv.id);
    for (const s of oldSales) {
      try { egg.deleteSale(s.id); } catch (e) { console.error('[applyInvoiceEgg] deleteSale failed:', e); }
    }
    for (const it of outItems) {
      const cat = it.category || inv.category;
      if (cat !== 'egg' && cat !== 'fertile_egg') continue;
      if (!it.quantity || it.quantity <= 0) continue;
      const saleType = cat === 'fertile_egg' ? 'fertile' : 'eating';
      try {
        egg.addSale({
          date: it.eggDate || inv.date, type: saleType, count: it.quantity,
          unit: 'piece', unitPrice: it.unitPrice || 0,
          totalPrice: it.total || (it.quantity * (it.unitPrice || 0)),
          customerId: inv.partyId || '', paymentType: 'cash',
          notes: `فاکتور ${inv.number || ''}`,
          sourceInvoiceId: inv.id,
        } as any);
      } catch (e) { console.error('[TRA→EGG sale]', e); }
    }
    return outItems;
  }

  // ─── خرید تخم نطفه‌دار → ثبت در جوجه‌کشی ───
  if (inv.type === 'purchase') {
    const inc = useInc.getState();
    const brd = useBrd.getState();

    const findExisting = (it: any) =>
      (inc.eggEntries || []).find((e: any) =>
        e.sourceInvoiceId === inv.id &&
        e.birdId === (it.birdId || '') &&
        e.breedId === (it.breedId || '')
      );

    for (let i = 0; i < outItems.length; i++) {
      const it = outItems[i] as any;
      const cat = it.category || inv.category;
      // 🆕 fertile_egg هم به عنوان ورودی تخم‌گذاری ثبت می‌شه (نه flock)
      if (cat !== 'egg' && cat !== 'fertile_egg') continue;
      if (!it.quantity || it.quantity <= 0) continue;

      const broken = it.brokenEggCount || 0;
      const nonIncubable = it.nonIncubableCount || 0;
      const healthyCount = Math.max(0, it.quantity - broken - nonIncubable);
      if (healthyCount <= 0) continue;

      const bird = brd.birds.find((b: any) => b.id === it.birdId);
      const days = getIncubationDays(bird?.birdKind);
      const entryDate = inv.deliveryDate || it.eggDate || inv.date || '';
      const expectedHatchDate = addJalaliDays(entryDate, days);

        const existing = findExisting(it);

      if (existing) {
        try {
          inc.updateEntry(existing.id, {
            count: healthyCount,
            expectedHatchDate,
            entryDate,
            unitPrice: it.unitPrice || null,
            totalPrice: it.total || null,
            shippingCost: it.transportCost || it.shipping || null,
            nonIncubableCount: it.nonIncubableCount ?? 0,
            brokenEggCount: it.brokenEggCount ?? null,
          } as any);
          it.entryId = existing.id;
        } catch (e) { console.error('[TRA→INC update]', e); }
        continue;
      }

      try {
        const entryId = inc.addEntry({
          deviceId: it.deviceId || '', hatchGroupId: '',
          birdId: it.birdId || '', breedId: it.breedId || '',
          count: healthyCount, entryDate, expectedHatchDate,
          source: 'purchase',
          dealType: ((inv as any).dealType || 'own') as any,
          dealStatus: 'active' as any,
          dealWithdrawnAt: '', dealWithdrawnReason: '', dealData: {},
          trayNumbers: '',
          unitPrice: it.unitPrice || null,
          totalPrice: it.total || null,
          shippingCost: it.transportCost || it.shipping || null,
          status: 'incubating' as any,
          generatedInvoiceId: '', generatedProductionId: '',
          notes: `از فاکتور خرید ${inv.number || ''}`,
          sampleWeightInitial: it.eggWeight || null,
          sampleWeightCurrent: null,
          sourceInvoiceId: inv.id,
          nonIncubableCount: it.nonIncubableCount ?? 0,
          brokenEggCount: it.brokenEggCount ?? null,
        });
        it.entryId = entryId;
      } catch (e) { console.error('[TRA→INC create]', e); }
    }

    // پاک‌سازی رکوردهای یتیم
    if (prev) {
      const newBB = new Set(
        outItems
          .filter((it: any) => {
            const c = it.category || inv.category;
            return (c === 'egg' || c === 'fertile_egg') && (it.quantity || 0) > 0;
          })
          .map((it: any) => `${it.birdId || ''}|${it.breedId || ''}`)
      );
      const orphans = (inc.eggEntries || []).filter((e: any) => {
        if (e.sourceInvoiceId !== inv.id) return false;
        const key = `${e.birdId || ''}|${e.breedId || ''}`;
        return !newBB.has(key);
      });
      for (const entry of orphans) {
        try { inc.deleteEntry(entry.id); } catch (e) { console.error('[TRA→INC cleanup]', e); }
      }
    }

    return outItems;
  }

  return inv.items;
}

/* EQUIP_LINK */
/** اتصال فاکتور تجهیزات → Equipment.sourceInvoiceId (خرید) */
function ensureWhsItem(it: any, inv: Invoice, whs: any): string {
  const name = String(it.description || it.model || '').trim();
  if (!name) return '';
  const qty = Number(it.quantity) || 1;

  const addMovement = (itemId: string) => {
    try {
      whs.addMovement({
        itemId, type: 'in', quantity: qty,
        unitPrice: Number(it.unitPrice) || 0,
        reason: 'purchase',
        date: inv.deliveryDate || inv.date || '',
        partyId: inv.partyId || '',
        notes: `فاکتور ${inv.number || ''}${it.description ? ' — ' + it.description : ''}`,
        sourceModule: 'tra', sourceId: inv.id,
      } as any);
    } catch (e) { console.error('[TRA→WHS movement]', e); }
  };

  if (it.stockItemId && whs.items.find((x: any) => x.id === it.stockItemId)) {
    addMovement(it.stockItemId);
    return it.stockItemId;
  }

  const existing = whs.items.find((x: any) => x.name === name && x.category === 'equipment');
  if (existing) {
    addMovement(existing.id);
    return existing.id;
  }

  try {
    const id = whs.addItem({
      name, category: 'equipment', unit: (it.unit || 'pcs') as any,
      minStock: 0, currentStock: 0,
      lastPrice: Number(it.unitPrice) || 0,
      supplierId: inv.partyId || '', expireDate: '',
      withdrawalDays: null, storage: 'room',
      notes: `از فاکتور ${inv.number || ''}`,
      brand: it.brand || '', hallId: it.hallId || '',
      equipmentStatus: it.equipmentStatus || '',
      purchaseDate: inv.deliveryDate || inv.date || '',
      purchasePrice: Number(it.unitPrice) || 0,
    } as any);
    addMovement(id);
    return id;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[TRA→WHS equipment addItem]', e);
    return '';
  }
}

export function applyInvoiceEquipment(inv: Invoice, prev?: Invoice): InvoiceItem[] {

  // ✅ SALE: کاهش از hal + whs (متقارن با purchase)
  if (inv.type === 'sale') {
    const hal = useHal.getState();
    const whs = useWhs.getState();
    const outItems: InvoiceItem[] = (inv.items || []).map(it => ({ ...it }));

    for (let i = 0; i < outItems.length; i++) {
      const it = outItems[i] as any;
      const itemCat = it.category || inv.category;
      if (itemCat !== 'equipment') continue;
      if (it.equipmentKind === 'consumable') continue;  // consumable توسط applyStock

      const qty = Number(it.quantity) || 1;

      // ۱. کاهش از hal.equipment
      if (it.equipmentId) {
        const eq = hal.equipment.find(e => e.id === it.equipmentId);
        if (eq) {
          const newCount = Math.max(0, (eq.count || 0) - qty);
          try {
            if (newCount === 0) {
              hal.deleteEquip(it.equipmentId);
            } else {
              hal.updateEquip(it.equipmentId, { count: newCount } as any);
            }

            // ۲. کاهش از whs (via warehouseItemId)
            if (eq.warehouseItemId) {
              try {
                whs.addMovement({
                  itemId: eq.warehouseItemId,
                  type: 'out',
                  quantity: qty,
                  unitPrice: Number(it.unitPrice) || 0,
                  reason: 'sale',
                  date: inv.deliveryDate || inv.date || '',
                  partyId: inv.partyId || '',
                  notes: `فروش تجهیزات — فاکتور ${inv.number || ''}` ,
                  sourceModule: 'tra', sourceId: inv.id,
                } as any);
              } catch (e) { console.error('[TRA→WHS sale equip]', e); }
            }
          } catch (e) { console.error('[TRA→HAL sale]', e); }
        }
      }
    }

    // Orphan cleanup (update case)
    if (prev) {
      const activeEqIds = new Set(outItems.map((it: any) => it.equipmentId).filter(Boolean));
      const orphans = hal.equipment.filter((e: any) =>
        e.sourceInvoiceId === inv.id && !activeEqIds.has(e.id)
      );
      for (const orphan of orphans) {
        try { hal.deleteEquip(orphan.id); } catch (e) { console.error('[applyInvoiceEquipment] hal.deleteEquip (orphan) failed:', e); }
      }
    }

    return outItems;
  }

  if (inv.type !== 'purchase') return inv.items;
  
  const hal = useHal.getState();
  const whs = useWhs.getState();
  const outItems: InvoiceItem[] = (inv.items || []).map(it => ({ ...it }));
  
  for (let i = 0; i < outItems.length; i++) {
    const it = outItems[i] as any;
    console.log('[applyInvoiceEquipment] بررسی قلم:', it.description, '| دسته:', it.category, '| نوع:', it.equipmentKind, '| سالن:', it.hallId);
    
    // ۱. اگر equipmentId از قبل ست شده → لینک به تجهیز موجود
const eqId = it.equipmentId;
      if (eqId) {
        const eq = hal.equipment.find(e => e.id === eqId);
        if (eq) {
          if (!eq.sourceInvoiceId) {
            const whsId = eq.warehouseItemId || ensureWhsItem(it, inv, whs);
            try { hal.updateEquip(eqId, { sourceInvoiceId: inv.id, warehouseItemId: whsId || undefined } as any); } catch (e) { console.error('[applyInvoiceEquipment] hal.updateEquip failed:', e); }
          } else if (eq.sourceInvoiceId === inv.id) {
            const whsId = eq.warehouseItemId || ensureWhsItem(it, inv, whs);
            try {
              hal.updateEquip(eqId, {
                hallId: it.hallId || eq.hallId,
                zoneId: it.zoneId || '',
                count: it.quantity || 1,
                unitPrice: it.unitPrice || null,
                warranty: it.warrantyMonths || null,
                brand: it.brand || '',
                        model: it.model || '',
                name: it.description || it.model || eq.name,
                warehouseItemId: whsId || undefined,
              } as any);
            } catch (e) { console.error('[TRA→HAL own-update]', e); }
          }
        }
        continue;
      }
    
    // ۳. اگر دسته تجهیزات نیست → رد شو
    const itemCat = it.category || inv.category;
    if (itemCat !== 'equipment') continue;
    if (it.equipmentKind === 'consumable') continue;
    // asset بدون سالن → equipment ساخته نشه (تست: asset without hall)
    if (!it.hallId) continue;
    
    // ۴. بررسی تکراری: آیا قبلاً برای همین فاکتور ساخته شده؟
    const existing = hal.equipment.find(
      (e: any) => e.sourceInvoiceId === inv.id && e.name === (it.description || it.model || '')
    );
    
    const whsIdExisting = ensureWhsItem(it, inv, whs);

    if (existing) {
      // آپدیت تجهیز موجود
      try {
        hal.updateEquip(existing.id, {
            warehouseItemId: whsIdExisting || undefined,
          hallId: it.hallId,
          zoneId: it.zoneId || '',
          count: it.quantity || 1,
          unitPrice: it.unitPrice || null,
          warranty: it.warrantyMonths || null,
          brand: it.brand || '',
                                    model: it.model || '',
                      status: (it.equipmentStatus as any) || undefined,
        } as any);
        it.equipmentId = existing.id;
      } catch (e) { console.error('[TRA→HAL update]', e); }
      continue;
    }
    
    // ۵. ساخت تجهیز جدید
    try {
      const newId = hal.addEquip({
        hallId: it.hallId,
        zoneId: it.zoneId || '',
        category: (it.equipmentCategory || 'other') as any,
        type: it.equipmentType || 'other',
        name: it.description || it.model || 'تجهیز',
        count: it.quantity || 1,
        unit: (it.unit || 'pcs') as any,
        unitPrice: it.unitPrice || null,
        purchasedAt: inv.deliveryDate || inv.date || '',
        warranty: it.warrantyMonths || null,
        notes: `از فاکتور ${inv.number || ''}`,
        brand: it.brand || '',
        supplierId: inv.partyId || '',
        sourceInvoiceId: inv.id,
        warehouseItemId: whsIdExisting || undefined,
        model: it.model || '',
        status: (it.equipmentStatus as any) || 'active',
      } as any);
      it.equipmentId = newId;
      it.stockItemId = whsIdExisting || it.stockItemId;
    } catch (e) { console.error('[TRA→HAL create]', e); }
  }
  
  // 🆕 Orphan cleanup — remove Equipment no longer matched
  if (prev) {
    const activeEqIds = new Set(
      outItems.map((it: any) => it.equipmentId).filter(Boolean)
    );
    const orphans = hal.equipment.filter(
      (e: any) => e.sourceInvoiceId === inv.id && !activeEqIds.has(e.id)
    );
    for (const orphan of orphans) {
      try { hal.deleteEquip(orphan.id); } catch (e) { console.error('[TRA→HAL orphan]', e); }
    }
  }

  return outItems;
}


/* ITEMS_RETURNED */
export function applyInvoiceFlocks(inv: Invoice, prev?: Invoice): InvoiceItem[] {
  const flk = useFlk.getState();
  const brd = useBrd.getState();
  const outItems: InvoiceItem[] = (inv.items || []).map(it => ({ ...it }));

  const keyOf = (cat: string, it: InvoiceItem) =>
    `${cat}|${it.birdId || ''}|${it.breedId || ''}|${it.flockId || ''}`;

  type G = { item: InvoiceItem; cat: string; qty: number; type: InvoiceType };

  const buildMap = (inv2: Invoice | undefined): Map<string, G> => {
    const m = new Map<string, G>();
    if (!inv2) return m;
    for (const it of inv2.items || []) {
      if (!it.birdId) continue;
      const cat = it.category || inv2.category;
      if (!BIRD_CATS.includes(cat)) continue;
      const k = keyOf(cat, it);
      const qty = (it.healthyCount ?? it.quantity) || 0;
      const cur = m.get(k);
      if (cur) cur.qty += qty;
      else m.set(k, { item: it, cat, qty, type: inv2.type });
    }
    return m;
  };

  // 🆕 لینک کردن به گله‌های موجود بدون تغییر در تعداد
  if (inv.type === 'purchase') {
    for (let i = 0; i < outItems.length; i++) {
      const it = outItems[i];
      if (it.existingFlockId) {
        const f = flk.flocks.find(x => x.id === it.existingFlockId);
        if (f) {
          const patch: any = { sourceInvoiceId: inv.id };
          if (it.unitPrice) patch.purchasePrice = it.unitPrice;
          const transport = it.transportCost ?? it.shipping;
          if (transport) patch.deliveryCost = transport;
          const effDate = (inv as any).deliveryDate || inv.date || '';
          if (effDate && !f.purchaseDate) patch.purchaseDate = effDate;
          if (it.hallId && it.hallId !== f.hallId) {
            patch.hallId = it.hallId;
            patch.zoneId = it.zoneId || '';
          } else if (it.zoneId !== undefined && it.zoneId !== (f.zoneId || '')) {
            patch.zoneId = it.zoneId;
          }
          // 🆕 hatchDate sync (existingFlockId)
          if (it.hatchDate && it.hatchDate !== f.hatchDate) {
            patch.hatchDate = it.hatchDate;
          }
          // 🆕 hatchDate sync (existingFlockId)
          if (it.hatchDate && it.hatchDate !== f.hatchDate) {
            patch.hatchDate = it.hatchDate;
          }
          flk.update(it.existingFlockId, patch);
          it.flockId = it.existingFlockId;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 🆕 sync hatchDate/chickWeight حتی وقتی delta=0 (update case)
  if (inv.type === 'purchase') {
    for (const it2 of inv.items || []) {
      if (!it2.flockId) continue;
      if (!BIRD_CATS.includes(it2.category || inv.category)) continue;
      const f2 = flk.flocks.find(x => x.id === it2.flockId);
      if (!f2) continue;
      const patch2: any = {};
      if (it2.hatchDate && it2.hatchDate !== f2.hatchDate) patch2.hatchDate = it2.hatchDate;
      if (it2.chickWeight != null && it2.chickWeight !== f2.chickWeight) patch2.chickWeight = it2.chickWeight;
      if (Object.keys(patch2).length > 0) flk.update(it2.flockId, patch2);
    }
  }

  // 🆕 sync hatchDate/chickWeight حتی وقتی delta=0 (update case)
  if (inv.type === 'purchase') {
    for (const it2 of inv.items || []) {
      if (!it2.flockId) continue;
      if (!BIRD_CATS.includes(it2.category || inv.category)) continue;
      const f2 = flk.flocks.find(x => x.id === it2.flockId);
      if (!f2) continue;
      const patch2: any = {};
      if (it2.hatchDate && it2.hatchDate !== f2.hatchDate) patch2.hatchDate = it2.hatchDate;
      if (it2.chickWeight != null && it2.chickWeight !== f2.chickWeight) patch2.chickWeight = it2.chickWeight;
      if (Object.keys(patch2).length > 0) flk.update(it2.flockId, patch2);
    }
  }

  const prevMap = buildMap(prev);
  const newMap = buildMap(inv);
  const allKeys = new Set<string>([...prevMap.keys(), ...newMap.keys()]);
  const updatedFlockIds = new Set<string>(); // 🆕 فیکس Double Counting

  // 🆕 Pre-flight: sales — over-sale check BEFORE mutation
  if (inv.type === 'sale') {
    for (const k of allKeys) {
      const p0 = prevMap.get(k);
      const n0 = newMap.get(k);
      const delta = (n0?.qty || 0) - (p0?.qty || 0);
      if (delta <= 0) continue;
      const ref = n0 || p0;
      if (!ref) continue;
      const explicitFlockId = (inv as any).relatedFlockId || ref.item.flockId || '';
      if (!explicitFlockId) continue;
      const f = flk.flocks.find(x => x.id === explicitFlockId);
      if (!f) continue;
      if ((f.currentCount ?? 0) < delta) {
        throw new Error(`موجودی کافی نیست: ${f.name} — موجودی ${f.currentCount}، درخواستی ${delta}`);
      }
      // 🆕 B1 fix: sex-aware pre-flight — shortage جنسیتی → throw (نه clamp)
      const _mDelta = Number(ref.item.maleCount || 0);
      const _fDelta = Number(ref.item.femaleCount || 0);
      const _uDelta = Number(ref.item.unknownCount || 0);
      const _gSum = _mDelta + _fDelta + _uDelta;
      if (_gSum > 0) {
        const _safeM = Math.min(_mDelta, delta);
        const _safeF = Math.min(_fDelta, delta - _safeM);
        const _safeU = Math.min(_uDelta, delta - _safeM - _safeF);
        const _rem = delta - _safeM - _safeF - _safeU;
        const _nextM = Math.max(0, (f.maleCount ?? 0) - _safeM);
        const _nextF = Math.max(0, (f.femaleCount ?? 0) - _safeF);
        const _nextU = Math.max(0, (f.unknownCount ?? 0) - _safeU - _rem);
        const _expectedNext = Math.max(0, (f.currentCount ?? 0) - delta);
        if (_nextM + _nextF + _nextU !== _expectedNext) {
          if (_safeM > (f.maleCount ?? 0)) {
            throw new Error(`موجودی نر کافی نیست: ${f.name} — نر ${f.maleCount ?? 0}، درخواستی ${_safeM}`);
          }
          if (_safeF > (f.femaleCount ?? 0)) {
            throw new Error(`موجودی ماده کافی نیست: ${f.name} — ماده ${f.femaleCount ?? 0}، درخواستی ${_safeF}`);
          }
          if (_safeU > (f.unknownCount ?? 0)) {
            throw new Error(`موجودی نامشخص کافی نیست: ${f.name} — نامشخص ${f.unknownCount ?? 0}، درخواستی ${_safeU}`);
          }
          throw new Error(`موجودی برای فروش ${delta} کافی نیست: ${f.name}`);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // جابه‌جایی گله در ویرایش فاکتور خرید: اگر کاربر گله متصل‌شده را به گله دیگری تغییر داد
  for (const k of allKeys) {
    const p0 = prevMap.get(k);
    const n0 = newMap.get(k);
    if (!p0 || !n0 || n0.type !== 'purchase') continue;
    const prevFlockId = (prev as any)?.relatedFlockId || p0.item.flockId || p0.item.existingFlockId || '';
    const nextFlockId = (inv as any).relatedFlockId || n0.item.existingFlockId || n0.item.flockId || '';
    if (prevFlockId && prevFlockId !== nextFlockId) {
      const oldFlock = flk.flocks.find(x => x.id === prevFlockId);
      const pq = p0.qty || 0;
      if (oldFlock && pq > 0) {
        if ((oldFlock.currentCount ?? 0) < pq) {
          throw new Error(`امکان تغییر گله نیست: از «${oldFlock.name}» قبلاً مصرف/تلفات ثبت شده و موجودی فعلی (${oldFlock.currentCount}) کمتر از تعداد فاکتور (${pq}) است`);
        }
        const nextOldCount = Math.max(0, (oldFlock.currentCount ?? 0) - pq);
        const oldPatch: any = {
          currentCount: nextOldCount,
          initialCount: Math.max(0, (oldFlock.initialCount ?? 0) - pq),
        };
        const pm = Number(p0.item.maleCount || 0);
        const pf = Number(p0.item.femaleCount || 0);
        const pu = Number(p0.item.unknownCount || 0);
        if (pm + pf + pu > 0) {
          if (pm > 0) oldPatch.maleCount = Math.max(0, (oldFlock.maleCount ?? 0) - pm);
          if (pf > 0) oldPatch.femaleCount = Math.max(0, (oldFlock.femaleCount ?? 0) - pf);
          if (pu > 0) oldPatch.unknownCount = Math.max(0, (oldFlock.unknownCount ?? 0) - pu);
        } else if (!oldFlock.genderSplitAt) {
          oldPatch.unknownCount = nextOldCount;
        } else {
          oldPatch.unknownCount = Math.max(0, (oldFlock.unknownCount ?? 0) - pq);
        }
        flk.update(prevFlockId, oldPatch);
        updatedFlockIds.add(prevFlockId);
      }
      prevMap.delete(k);
    }
  }

  for (const k of allKeys) {
    const p0 = prevMap.get(k);
    const n0 = newMap.get(k);
    const pq = p0?.qty || 0;
    const nq = n0?.qty || 0;
    const delta = nq - pq;
    if (delta === 0) continue;
    const ref = n0 || p0;
    if (!ref) continue;
    const it = ref.item;
    // 🆕 اولویت: relatedFlockId فاکتور → flockId آیتم
    const explicitFlockId = (inv as any).relatedFlockId || it.flockId || '';
    const type = ref.type;
    const sign = type === 'purchase' ? +1 : -1;
    const effectiveDate = (inv as any).deliveryDate || inv.date || '';

    if (explicitFlockId) {
      const f = flk.flocks.find(x => x.id === explicitFlockId);
      if (!f) continue;
      const next = Math.max(0, (f.currentCount ?? 0) + sign * delta);
      const patch: any = { currentCount: next };

      // 🆕 فاز ۱: تفکیک جنسیت
      const mDelta = Number(it.maleCount || 0);
      const fDelta = Number(it.femaleCount || 0);
      const uDelta = Number(it.unknownCount || 0);
      const gSum = mDelta + fDelta + uDelta;
      if (gSum > 0) {
        // 🆕 Normalize delta to prevent invariant break (gSum > delta)
        const safeM = Math.min(mDelta, delta);
        const safeF = Math.min(fDelta, Math.max(0, delta - safeM));
        const safeU = Math.min(uDelta, Math.max(0, delta - safeM - safeF));
        if (safeM > 0) patch.maleCount = Math.max(0, (f.maleCount ?? 0) + sign * safeM);
        if (safeF > 0) patch.femaleCount = Math.max(0, (f.femaleCount ?? 0) + sign * safeF);
        if (safeU > 0) patch.unknownCount = Math.max(0, (f.unknownCount ?? 0) + sign * safeU);
        let rem = delta - safeM - safeF - safeU;
        if (rem > 0) {
          if (sign > 0) {
            const base = (safeU > 0) ? (patch.unknownCount ?? f.unknownCount ?? 0) : (f.unknownCount ?? 0);
            patch.unknownCount = Math.max(0, base + rem);
          } else {
            const curU = patch.unknownCount ?? f.unknownCount ?? 0;
            const takeU = Math.min(curU, rem);
            if (takeU > 0) { patch.unknownCount = curU - takeU; rem -= takeU; }
            if (rem > 0) {
              const curF = patch.femaleCount ?? f.femaleCount ?? 0;
              const curM = patch.maleCount ?? f.maleCount ?? 0;
              if (curF >= curM) {
                const takeF = Math.min(curF, rem); patch.femaleCount = curF - takeF; rem -= takeF;
                if (rem > 0) patch.maleCount = Math.max(0, curM - rem);
              } else {
                const takeM = Math.min(curM, rem); patch.maleCount = curM - takeM; rem -= takeM;
                if (rem > 0) patch.femaleCount = Math.max(0, curF - rem);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      } else {
        // 🆕 قدم ۵: unsplit — همه در unknown
        if (!f.genderSplitAt) {
          // گله unsplit → sync
          patch.unknownCount = next;
        } else {
          // گله split → از unknown با fallback
          const nextU = (f.unknownCount ?? 0) + sign * delta;
          if (nextU >= 0) {
            patch.unknownCount = nextU;
          } else {
            let rem = -nextU;
            patch.unknownCount = 0;
            const mF = f.maleCount ?? 0;
            const fF = f.femaleCount ?? 0;
            if (fF >= mF) {
              const takeF = Math.min(fF, rem);
              patch.femaleCount = fF - takeF;
              rem -= takeF;
              if (rem > 0) patch.maleCount = Math.max(0, mF - rem);
            } else {
              const takeM = Math.min(mF, rem);
              patch.maleCount = mF - takeM;
              rem -= takeM;
              if (rem > 0) patch.femaleCount = Math.max(0, fF - rem);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // 🆕 قدم ۵: set genderSplitAt اگه item جنس داره
      if (gSum > 0 && !f.genderSplitAt) {
        patch.genderSplitAt = new Date().toISOString();
      }
      // 🆕 قدم ۵: un-split اگه male و female صفر شدن
      if (f.genderSplitAt) {
        const finalM = patch.maleCount ?? f.maleCount ?? 0;
        const finalF = patch.femaleCount ?? f.femaleCount ?? 0;
        if (finalM === 0 && finalF === 0) {
          patch.genderSplitAt = null;
          patch.unknownCount = next;
        }
      }

      if (type === 'purchase') {
        patch.initialCount = Math.max(0, (f.initialCount ?? 0) + delta);
        if (delta > 0) {
          patch.sourceInvoiceId = inv.id;
          patch.sourceCategory = ref.cat;
          if (it.unitPrice) patch.purchasePrice = it.unitPrice;
          const transport = it.transportCost ?? it.shipping;
          if (transport) patch.deliveryCost = transport;
        }
        const nextHatch = it.hatchDate || f.hatchDate || '';
        const nextPurchase = effectiveDate && (!f.purchaseDate || delta > 0) ? effectiveDate : (f.purchaseDate || effectiveDate || '');
        const safePurchase = (nextHatch && nextPurchase && nextHatch > nextPurchase) ? nextHatch : nextPurchase;
        if (safePurchase && safePurchase !== f.purchaseDate) {
          patch.purchaseDate = safePurchase;
        }
        if (nextHatch && nextHatch !== f.hatchDate) {
          patch.hatchDate = nextHatch;
        }
        const minValidStart = [nextHatch, safePurchase].filter(Boolean).sort().pop() || '';
        if (minValidStart && (!f.startDate || f.startDate < minValidStart || f.startDate === f.purchaseDate)) {
          patch.startDate = minValidStart;
        }
      }
      flk.update(explicitFlockId, patch);
      updatedFlockIds.add(explicitFlockId);

      // 🆕 فیکس ۱: ثبت FlockEvent فروش در تاریخچه گله
      if (type === 'sale' && delta > 0) {
        try {
          // 🆕 B2 fix: sex-aware eventها (۱ تا ۳ event جدا)
          const evts = deriveSaleEvents({
            delta,
            maleCount: it.maleCount,
            femaleCount: it.femaleCount,
            unknownCount: it.unknownCount,
            flockId: explicitFlockId,
            invoiceId: inv.id,
            invoiceNumber: inv.number,
            partyId: inv.partyId,
            date: effectiveDate,
            unitPrice: it.unitPrice,
            totalPrice: it.total,
          });
          // 🆕 B3 fix: audit trail (sexBalanceEvents)
          const st = useFlk.getState();
          const fAfter = st.flocks.find((x: any) => x.id === explicitFlockId);
          const audit = fAfter ? buildSaleAudit({
            flockBefore: {
              male: f.maleCount ?? 0,
              female: f.femaleCount ?? 0,
              unknown: f.unknownCount ?? 0,
            },
            flockAfter: {
              male: fAfter.maleCount ?? 0,
              female: fAfter.femaleCount ?? 0,
              unknown: fAfter.unknownCount ?? 0,
            },
            date: effectiveDate,
            note: `فروش ${delta} از فاکتور ${inv.number || ''}`,
          }) : null;
          useFlk.setState({
            flocks: st.flocks.map((ff: any) =>
              ff.id === explicitFlockId
                ? {
                    ...ff,
                    events: [...(ff.events || []), ...evts],
                    sexBalanceEvents: audit
                      ? [...(ff.sexBalanceEvents || []), audit]
                      : (ff.sexBalanceEvents || []),
                    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                  }
                : ff
            ),
          } as any);
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('[applyInvoiceFlocks] sell event failed:', e);
        }
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < inv.items.length; i++) {
        if (keyOf(inv.items[i].category || inv.category, inv.items[i]) === k) outItems[i].flockId = explicitFlockId;
      }
    } else if (type === 'purchase') {
      const birdId = it.birdId || '';
      const breedId = it.breedId || '';
      const existing = flk.flocks.find(f =>
        f.sourceInvoiceId === inv.id &&
        f.sourceCategory === ref.cat &&
        f.birdId === birdId &&
        (f.breedId || '') === breedId
      );
      if (existing) {
        const next = (existing.currentCount ?? 0) + delta;
        const patchEx: any = { currentCount: Math.max(0, next) };
        const mD = Number(it.maleCount || 0);
        const fD = Number(it.femaleCount || 0);
        const uD = Number(it.unknownCount || 0);
        const gS = mD + fD + uD;
        if (gS > 0) {
          if (mD > 0) patchEx.maleCount = Math.max(0, (existing.maleCount ?? 0) + mD);
          if (fD > 0) patchEx.femaleCount = Math.max(0, (existing.femaleCount ?? 0) + fD);
          if (uD > 0) patchEx.unknownCount = Math.max(0, (existing.unknownCount ?? 0) + uD);
          const rem = delta - gS;
          if (rem > 0) {
            const base = (uD > 0) ? (patchEx.unknownCount ?? existing.unknownCount ?? 0) : (existing.unknownCount ?? 0);
            patchEx.unknownCount = Math.max(0, base + rem);
          }
        } else {
          // 🆕 قدم ۵
          if (!existing.genderSplitAt) {
            patchEx.unknownCount = next;
          } else {
            const nextU = (existing.unknownCount ?? 0) + delta;
            if (nextU >= 0) {
              patchEx.unknownCount = nextU;
            } else {
              const rem = -nextU;
              patchEx.unknownCount = 0;
              const mE = existing.maleCount ?? 0;
              const fE = existing.femaleCount ?? 0;
              if (fE >= mE) {
                patchEx.femaleCount = Math.max(0, fE - rem);
              } else {
                patchEx.maleCount = Math.max(0, mE - rem);
              }
            }
          }
        }
        // 🆕 قدم ۵: set genderSplitAt
        if (gS > 0 && !existing.genderSplitAt) {
          patchEx.genderSplitAt = new Date().toISOString();
        }
        if (existing.genderSplitAt) {
          const fm = patchEx.maleCount ?? existing.maleCount ?? 0;
          const ff = patchEx.femaleCount ?? existing.femaleCount ?? 0;
          if (fm === 0 && ff === 0) {
            patchEx.genderSplitAt = null;
            patchEx.unknownCount = Math.max(0, next);
          }
        }
        flk.update(existing.id, patchEx);
        for (let i = 0; i < inv.items.length; i++) {
          if (keyOf(inv.items[i].category || inv.category, inv.items[i]) === k) outItems[i].flockId = existing.id;
        }
      } else if (delta > 0) {
        const breed = brd.breeds.find(b => b.id === it.breedId);
        const bird = brd.birds.find(b => b.id === it.birdId);
        const name = `گله ${breed?.name || bird?.name || '?'} — ${effectiveDate}`;
        // type و layingStartDay از استاندارد نژاد
        let standard: any = null;
        let biology: any = null;
        try {
          standard = breed ? getStandardFor(breed.name || bird?.name || '', {}) : (bird ? getStandardFor(bird.name, {}) : null);
          biology = standard?.biology || null;
        } catch(e) {
          console.warn('[applyInvoiceFlocks] getStandardFor failed, using defaults:', e);
        }
        const inferredType: 'layer' | 'broiler' | 'breeder' =
          ref.cat === 'broiler' ? 'broiler' :
          ref.cat === 'breeder' ? 'breeder' :
          ref.cat === 'layer' ? 'layer' :
          (standard?.purposes?.includes('broiler') ? 'broiler' :
           standard?.purposes?.includes('breeder') ? 'breeder' : 'layer');

        const hasGenderSplit = ((it.maleCount || 0) + (it.femaleCount || 0) + (it.unknownCount || 0)) > 0;
        const newFlockId = flk.add({
          name: it.flockName || it.description || name,
          type: inferredType,
          birdId: birdId,
          breedId: breedId,
          hallId: it.hallId || '',
          zoneId: it.zoneId || '',
          initialCount: delta,
          currentCount: delta,
          maleCount: hasGenderSplit ? (it.maleCount ?? null) : null,
          femaleCount: hasGenderSplit ? (it.femaleCount ?? null) : null,
          unknownCount: hasGenderSplit ? (it.unknownCount ?? null) : delta,
          layingStartDay: biology?.layingStartDay ?? 0,
          endOfCycleDay: biology?.endOfCycleDay ?? null,
          vaccineScheduleId: '',
          hatchDate: it.hatchDate || computeHatchDate(formatJ(new Date(), 'yyyy/MM/dd'), it.ageDays),
          purchaseDate: (() => {
            const hd = it.hatchDate || computeHatchDate(formatJ(new Date(), 'yyyy/MM/dd'), it.ageDays);
            return (hd && effectiveDate && hd > effectiveDate) ? hd : effectiveDate;
          })(),
          startDate: (() => {
            const hd = it.hatchDate || computeHatchDate(formatJ(new Date(), 'yyyy/MM/dd'), it.ageDays);
            return (hd && effectiveDate && hd > effectiveDate) ? hd : effectiveDate;
          })(),
          source: 'purchase',
          dealType: 'own',
          purchasePrice: it.unitPrice || 0,
          deliveryCost: (typeof it.transportCost === 'number' && it.transportCost > 0) ? it.transportCost : (typeof it.shipping === 'number' && it.shipping > 0 ? it.shipping : 0),
          otherCosts: 0,
          status: 'active',
          notes: `از فاکتور ${inv.number || ''}`,
          sourceInvoiceId: inv.id,
          sourceCategory: ref.cat,
          chickWeight: it.chickWeight ?? null,
        });

        for (let i = 0; i < inv.items.length; i++) {
          if (keyOf(inv.items[i].category || inv.category, inv.items[i]) === k) outItems[i].flockId = newFlockId;
        }
      }
    }
  }


  // 🆕 محاسبه delta برای گله‌های موجود (existingFlockId)
  if (inv.type === 'purchase') {
    const buildExistingMap = (inv2: Invoice | undefined): Map<string, number> => {
      const mm = new Map<string, number>();
      if (!inv2) return mm;
      for (const it of inv2.items || []) {
        // 🆕 فیکس Double Counting: هر دو فیلد را چک کن
        const targetFlockId = it.existingFlockId || it.flockId;
        if (!targetFlockId) continue;
        const cat = it.category || inv2.category;
        if (!BIRD_CATS.includes(cat)) continue;
        // 🆕 اگر فاکتور قبلی flockId خودکار داشته، فقط اگر گله هنوز به همین فاکتور وصل است آن را حساب کن
        if (!it.existingFlockId && it.flockId) {
          const flock = useFlk.getState().flocks.find(f => f.id === it.flockId);
          if (flock && flock.sourceInvoiceId !== inv2.id) continue;
        }
        const qty = (it.healthyCount ?? it.quantity) || 0;
        mm.set(targetFlockId, (mm.get(targetFlockId) || 0) + qty);
      }
      return mm;
    };
    const prevEx = buildExistingMap(prev);
    const newEx = buildExistingMap(inv);
    const allExIds = new Set<string>([...prevEx.keys(), ...newEx.keys()]);
    for (const flockId of allExIds) {
      const pq = prevEx.get(flockId) || 0;
      const nq = newEx.get(flockId) || 0;
      const delta = nq - pq;
      if (delta === 0) continue;
      const f = flk.flocks.find((x: any) => x.id === flockId);
      if (!f) continue;
      const patch4: any = {
        initialCount: Math.max(0, (f.initialCount ?? 0) + delta),
      };
      // 🆕 فیکس Double Counting: currentCount فقط اگه قبلاً آپدیت نشده
      if (!updatedFlockIds.has(flockId)) {
        patch4.currentCount = Math.max(0, (f.currentCount ?? 0) + delta);
      }
      const sampleItem = (inv.items || []).find((it2: any) => it2.existingFlockId === flockId);
      if (sampleItem) {
        const mD = Number(sampleItem.maleCount || 0);
        const fD = Number(sampleItem.femaleCount || 0);
        const uD = Number(sampleItem.unknownCount || 0);
        const gS = mD + fD + uD;
        if (gS > 0) {
          if (mD > 0) patch4.maleCount = Math.max(0, (f.maleCount ?? 0) + mD);
          if (fD > 0) patch4.femaleCount = Math.max(0, (f.femaleCount ?? 0) + fD);
          if (uD > 0) patch4.unknownCount = Math.max(0, (f.unknownCount ?? 0) + uD);
          const rem = delta - gS;
          if (rem > 0) {
            const base = (uD > 0) ? (patch4.unknownCount ?? f.unknownCount ?? 0) : (f.unknownCount ?? 0);
            patch4.unknownCount = Math.max(0, base + rem);
          }
        } else {
          patch4.unknownCount = Math.max(0, (f.unknownCount ?? 0) + delta);
        }
      }
      flk.update(flockId, patch4);
    }
  }

  return outItems;
}


export function repairDoubleCountedFlocks(invoices: Invoice[]) {
  try {
    const flk = useFlk.getState();
    if (!flk?.flocks?.length) return;
    const purchaseTotalsByFlock = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const inv of invoices || []) {
      if (inv.type !== 'purchase' || inv.isPreorder) continue;
      for (const it of inv.items || []) {
        const cat = it.category || inv.category;
        if (!BIRD_CATS.includes(cat)) continue;
        const fid = (inv as any).relatedFlockId || it.flockId || it.existingFlockId || '';
        if (!fid) continue;
        const qty = Number(it.healthyCount ?? it.quantity) || 0;
        if (qty > 0) {
          purchaseTotalsByFlock.set(fid, (purchaseTotalsByFlock.get(fid) || 0) + qty);
        }
      }
    }
    for (const f of flk.flocks) {
      if (!f.sourceInvoiceId) continue;
      const expectedTotal = purchaseTotalsByFlock.get(f.id);
      if (!expectedTotal || expectedTotal <= 0) continue;
      if ((f.initialCount ?? 0) === expectedTotal * 2) {
        const consumed = Math.max(0, (f.initialCount ?? 0) - (f.currentCount ?? 0));
        const fixedInitial = expectedTotal;
        const fixedCurrent = Math.max(0, fixedInitial - consumed);
        const patch: any = {
          initialCount: fixedInitial,
          currentCount: fixedCurrent,
        };
        if (!f.genderSplitAt) {
          patch.unknownCount = fixedCurrent;
        }
        flk.update(f.id, patch);
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[repairDoubleCountedFlocks]', e);
  }
}
