/**
 * settlement.ts — Phase E.2a
 * محاسبه‌ی سند تسویه از یک Deal در بازه‌ی زمانی مشخص
 * طبق الگوی SAP MRKO: snapshot از داده‌های دوره
 */
import type { Deal, Settlement, DealDelivery, DealSale, DealPayment, Invoice, InvoiceItem, Payment } from './types';
import { useFlk } from '../flk/store';

function inPeriod(date: string, start: string, end: string): boolean {
  if (!date) return false;
  // مقایسه رشته‌ای — فرض: همه‌ی تاریخ‌ها با فرمت یکسان (yyyy/MM/dd)
  return date >= start && date <= end;
}

function monthsBetween(start: string, end: string): number {
  if (!start || !end) return 1;
  try {
    const norm = (s: string) => s.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));
    const s = new Date(norm(start).replace(/\//g, '-'));
    const e = new Date(norm(end).replace(/\//g, '-'));
    if (isNaN(s.getTime()) || isNaN(e.getTime())) return 1;
    const months = (e.getFullYear() - s.getFullYear()) * 12 + (e.getMonth() - s.getMonth());
    return Math.max(1, months);
  } catch { return 1; }
}

export function computeSettlement(
  deal: Deal,
  periodStart: string,
  periodEnd: string
): Omit<Settlement, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'> | null {
  if (!periodStart || !periodEnd) return null;
  if (periodEnd < periodStart) return null;

  const deliveries = (deal.deliveries || []).filter(d => inPeriod(d.date, periodStart, periodEnd));
  const sales = (deal.sales || []).filter(s => inPeriod(s.date, periodStart, periodEnd));
  const payments = (deal.payments || []).filter(p => inPeriod(p.date, periodStart, periodEnd));

  if (deliveries.length === 0 && sales.length === 0 && payments.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  const grossSales = sales.reduce((sum, s) =>
    sum + (Number(s.quantity) || 0) * (Number(s.unitPrice) || 0), 0
  );

  const settlementValue = Number(deal.settlementValue) || 0;
  const totalQty = sales.reduce((s, x) => s + (Number(x.quantity) || 0), 0);
  let commission = 0;
  if (deal.settlementType === 'percent') {
    commission = Math.round(grossSales * settlementValue / 100);
  } else if (deal.settlementType === 'per_unit') {
    commission = Math.round(totalQty * settlementValue);
  } else if (deal.settlementType === 'fixed') {
    commission = Math.round(settlementValue);
  } else if (deal.settlementType === 'rental') {
    const months = monthsBetween(periodStart, periodEnd);
    commission = Math.round(settlementValue * months);
  }

  const netPayable = grossSales - commission;
  const paidAmount = payments
    .filter(p => p.direction === 'in')
    .reduce((s, p) => s + (Number(p.amount) || 0), 0);

  return {
    dealId: deal.id,
    periodStart,
    periodEnd,
    deliveriesSnapshot: deliveries,
    salesSnapshot: sales,
    paymentsSnapshot: payments,
    grossSales,
    commission,
    netPayable,
    paidAmount,
    status: 'draft',
  };
}


export function createInvoiceFromSettlement(
  deal: Deal,
  settlement: Settlement
): Omit<Invoice, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'> {
  const flkState = useFlk.getState();
  const items: InvoiceItem[] = settlement.salesSnapshot.map((s) => {
    const good = (deal.goods || []).find(g => g.id === s.goodId);
    const qty = Number(s.quantity) || 0;
    const price = Number(s.unitPrice) || 0;
    // 🆕 استخراج فیلدهای گله (chick/adult)
    const flock = good?.existingFlockId
      ? flkState.flocks.find(f => f.id === good.existingFlockId)
      : null;
    const cat = good?.category;
    return {
      id: s.id,
      description: good?.name || 'کالا',
      unit: good?.unit || 'pcs',
      quantity: qty,
      unitPrice: price,
      total: qty * price,
      category: cat,
      // 🆕 پرندگان — از گله
      birdId: flock?.birdId || '',
      breedId: flock?.breedId || '',
      flockId: good?.existingFlockId || '',
      flockName: flock?.name || '',
      // 🆕 توزیع تعداد — همه نامشخص (کاربر بعداً ویرایش می‌کنه)
      unknownCount: (cat === 'chick' || cat === 'adult') ? qty : null,
    };
  });
  
  const payments: Payment[] = settlement.paidAmount > 0
    ? [{
        id: 'inv-pay-' + settlement.id,
        date: settlement.periodEnd,
        amount: settlement.paidAmount,
        method: 'cash',
        checkNo: '',
        bank: '',
        dueDate: '',
        notes: 'از تسویه دوره‌ای',
        type: 'settlement',
      }]
    : [];
  
  // 🆕 اگر کمیسیون وجود دارد، به عنوان یک آیتم منفی اضافه می‌کنیم
  if (settlement.commission > 0) {
    items.push({
      id: 'comm-' + settlement.id,
      description: 'کمیسیون تسویه دوره‌ای',
      unit: 'service',
      quantity: 1,
      unitPrice: -settlement.commission,
      total: -settlement.commission,
    });
  }

  // 🆕 محاسبه category از items (نه hardcode)
  const itemCats = items.map(it => it.category).filter(Boolean) as string[];
  const uniqueCats = [...new Set(itemCats)];
  const primaryCategory = uniqueCats.length === 1 ? uniqueCats[0] : 'other';

  return {
    type: 'sale',
    date: settlement.periodEnd,
    partyId: deal.partyId || '',
    category: primaryCategory,
    items,
    discount: 0,
    shipping: 0,
    total: settlement.netPayable,
    payments,
    dueDate: settlement.periodEnd,
    relatedFlockId: '',
    relatedEntryId: '',
    relatedDealId: deal.id,
    relatedSettlementId: settlement.id,
    sourceType: 'settlement',
    notes: 'تسویه دوره‌ای ' + settlement.periodStart + ' تا ' + settlement.periodEnd + ' — کمیسیون: ' + settlement.commission + ' ت',
    workflowStatus: 'draft',
  };
}

function createPartyPaymentFor(
  get: () => any,
  p: any,
  partyId: string,
  logLabel: string,
): any {
  if (p.partyPaymentId) return p;
  try {
    const ppId = get().addPartyPayment({
      partyId, date: p.date, amount: p.amount,
      method: p.method, type: p.type || 'regular',
      checkNo: p.checkNo || '', bank: p.bank || '', dueDate: p.dueDate || '',
      notes: p.notes || '', status: p.status,
      clearedDate: p.clearedDate, bouncedDate: p.bouncedDate,
    });
    return { ...p, partyPaymentId: ppId };
  } catch (e) { console.error(logLabel, e); return p; }
}

function syncAllocations(
  get: () => any,
  invoiceId: string,
  payments: any[],
  prevAllocations: any[],
  logLabel: string,
): void {
  try {
    const newIds = new Set(payments.map(p => p.id));
    const oldByPaymentId = new Map(prevAllocations.map((a: any) => [a.paymentId, a]));
    for (const a of prevAllocations) {
      if (!newIds.has(a.paymentId)) get().deleteAllocation(a.id);
    }
    for (const p of payments) {
      const existing = oldByPaymentId.get(p.id);
      if (!existing) {
        get().addAllocation({
          paymentId: p.id, invoiceId,
          amount: p.amount, date: p.date,
          notes: 'auto',
        });
      } else if ((existing as any).amount !== p.amount || (existing as any).date !== p.date) {
        get().updateAllocation((existing as any).id, { amount: p.amount, date: p.date });
      }
    }
  } catch(e) { console.error(logLabel, e); }
}

        }
      },
      markDispute: (invoiceId, reason, note) => {
        const prev = get().invoices.find(i => i.id === invoiceId);
        if (!prev) return;
        if (prev.writtenOff) {
          showToast('فاکتور حذف بدحساب شده امکان ثبت اختلاف ندارد', 'error');
          return;
        }
        if (remaining(prev, get().allocations) <= 0) {
          showToast('فاکتور تسویه‌شده امکان ثبت اختلاف ندارد', 'error');
          return;
        }
        const today = getTodayJalali();
        set({
          invoices: get().invoices.map(i => i.id === invoiceId ? {
            ...i,
            disputeStatus: 'open' as const,
            disputeReason: reason,
            disputeNote: note,
            disputeOpenedAt: today,
            disputeResolvedAt: undefined,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          } : i),
        });
        const hasPendingCheck = (prev.payments || []).some(p => p.method === 'check' && (!p.status || p.status === 'pending'));
        if (hasPendingCheck) {
          showToast('توجه: این فاکتور چک پاس‌نشده دارد؛ وضعیت چک را نیز پیگیری کنید', 'warn');
        }
      },
      resolveDispute: (invoiceId, note) => {
        const prev = get().invoices.find(i => i.id === invoiceId);
        if (!prev || prev.disputeStatus !== 'open') return;
        const today = getTodayJalali();
        set({
          invoices: get().invoices.map(i => i.id === invoiceId ? {
            ...i,
            disputeStatus: 'resolved' as const,
            disputeResolvedAt: today,
            disputeNote: note ? (i.disputeNote ? i.disputeNote + ' | ' + note : note) : i.disputeNote,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          } : i),
        });
        showToast('اختلاف حل شد — فاکتور به لیست طلبی بازگشت', 'success');
      },
      writeOffInvoice: (invoiceId, amount, reason) => {
        const prev = get().invoices.find(i => i.id === invoiceId);
        if (!prev) return;
        if (prev.disputeStatus === 'open') {
          showToast('این فاکتور دارای اختلاف باز است — ابتدا اختلاف را حل کنید', 'error');
          return;
        }
        if (prev.isPreorder) {
          showToast('فاکتور پیش‌خرید تحویل‌نشده امکان بخشش یا بستن مانده ندارد', 'error');
          return;
        }
        const pendingChecks = (prev.payments || []).filter(p => p.method === 'check' && (p as any).checkStatus === 'pending');
        if (pendingChecks.length > 0) {
          showToast('این فاکتور چک پاس‌نشده دارد — ابتدا وضعیت چک را مشخص یا برگشت بزنید', 'error');
          return;
        }
        const currentRem = remaining(prev, get().allocations);
        const safeAmount = Math.max(0, Math.min(amount, currentRem));
        if (safeAmount <= 0) return;
        const today = getTodayJalali();
        const isFullySettled = (currentRem - safeAmount) <= 0;
        const nextInvoices = get().invoices.map(i => i.id === invoiceId ? {
          ...i,
          writtenOff: true,
          writtenOffAmount: (i.writtenOffAmount || 0) + safeAmount,
          writtenOffReason: reason,
          writtenOffAt: today,
          ...(isFullySettled ? {
            workflowStatus: 'paid' as const,
            paidAt: i.paidAt || new Date().toISOString(),
          } : {}),
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        } : i);
        set({ invoices: nextInvoices });
        if (prev.partyId) {
          try {
            setPartyCredit(prev.partyId, computePartyCredit(prev.partyId, nextInvoices, get().allocations));
          } catch {}
        }
      },
      restoreInvoice: (id) => {
        // 🆕 Atomic: peek first، pre-flight ALL (simulation)، سپس mutate
        const allEntries = listRecycleBin<DeletedInvoiceSnapshot>('tra');
        const entry = allEntries.find(e => e.item.invoice.id === id);
        if (!entry) {
          console.error('[restoreInvoice] not found in recycle bin:', id);
          return false;
        }
        const snapshot = entry.item;
        if (get().invoices.some((x) => x.id === id)) {
          console.warn('[restoreInvoice] invoice already exists:', id);
          return false;
        }

        // 🆕 Atomic pre-flight: simulate ALL items با stacking روی یک flock
        const flkSt0 = useFlk.getState();
        const inv = snapshot.invoice;
        const simulated = new Map<string, { currentCount: number; maleCount: number; femaleCount: number; unknownCount: number }>();
        if (inv.items) {
          for (const it of inv.items) {
            const item = it as any;
            if (!item.birdId || !item.flockId) continue;
            if (!BIRD_CATS.includes(item.category || inv.category)) continue;
            const qty = (item.healthyCount ?? item.quantity) || 0;
            if (qty <= 0) continue;
            const f = flkSt0.flocks.find(x => x.id === item.flockId);
            if (!f) continue;
            const base = simulated.get(item.flockId) || {
              currentCount: f.currentCount ?? 0,
              maleCount: f.maleCount ?? 0,
              femaleCount: f.femaleCount ?? 0,
              unknownCount: f.unknownCount ?? 0,
            };
            const sign = inv.type === 'purchase' ? 1 : -1;
            const _mD0 = Number(item.maleCount || 0);
            const _fD0 = Number(item.femaleCount || 0);
            const _uD0 = Number(item.unknownCount || 0);
            const _gS0 = _mD0 + _fD0 + _uD0;
            const _expectedCur = inv.type === 'purchase' ? base.currentCount + qty : Math.max(0, base.currentCount - qty);
            let nextM = base.maleCount, nextF = base.femaleCount, nextU = base.unknownCount;
            if (_gS0 > 0) {
              const _nextM = inv.type === 'purchase' ? base.maleCount + _mD0 : Math.max(0, base.maleCount - _mD0);
              const _nextF = inv.type === 'purchase' ? base.femaleCount + _fD0 : Math.max(0, base.femaleCount - _fD0);
              const _nextU = inv.type === 'purchase' ? base.unknownCount + _uD0 : Math.max(0, base.unknownCount - _uD0);
              if (_nextM + _nextF + _nextU !== _expectedCur) {
                if (inv.type === 'sale' && _mD0 > base.maleCount) {
                  throw new Error(`restore: موجودی نر کافی نیست: ${f.name} — نر ${base.maleCount}، درخواستی ${_mD0}`);
                }
                if (inv.type === 'sale' && _fD0 > base.femaleCount) {
                  throw new Error(`restore: موجودی ماده کافی نیست: ${f.name} — ماده ${base.femaleCount}، درخواستی ${_fD0}`);
                }
                throw new Error(`restore: invariant نقض می‌شود برای ${f.name}`);
              }
              if (_mD0 > 0) nextM = Math.max(0, base.maleCount + sign * _mD0);
              if (_fD0 > 0) nextF = Math.max(0, base.femaleCount + sign * _fD0);
              if (_uD0 > 0) nextU = Math.max(0, base.unknownCount + sign * _uD0);
              const rem = qty - _gS0;
              if (rem > 0) nextU = Math.max(0, nextU + sign * rem);
            } else {
              nextU = Math.max(0, base.unknownCount + sign * qty);
            }
            simulated.set(item.flockId, {
              currentCount: _expectedCur,
              maleCount: nextM,
              femaleCount: nextF,
              unknownCount: nextU,
            });
          }
        }

        // ✓ همه چیز معتبر — حالا mutate
        const confirmed = removeFromRecycleBin<DeletedInvoiceSnapshot>(
          'tra',
          (existing) => existing.invoice.id === id,
        );
        if (!confirmed) {
          console.error('[restoreInvoice] race: already removed:', id);
          return false;
        }
        set((s) => ({ invoices: [...s.invoices, confirmed.invoice] }));

        const flk = useFlk.getState();
        for (const flock of confirmed.linkedFlocks) {
          try {
            const firstItem = confirmed.invoice.items.find(it => it.category === 'chick' || it.category === 'adult');
            const birdId = flock.birdId || firstItem?.birdId || '';
            const breedId = flock.breedId || firstItem?.breedId || '';
            flk.update(flock.id, {
              sourceInvoiceId: id,
              sourceCategory: flock.sourceCategory,
              birdId,
              breedId,
            });
            console.info('[restoreInvoice] flock relinked with breed:', flock.id, breedId);
          } catch (e) {
            console.error('[restoreInvoice] relink flock:', flock.id, e);
          }
        }
        console.info('[restoreInvoice] ♻️ restored:', id, '| flocks:', confirmed.linkedFlocks.length);

        // اعمال simulated final states
        const flkState = useFlk.getState();
        for (const [flockId, finalState] of simulated) {
          try {
            flkState.update(flockId, finalState);
            console.info('[restoreInvoice] flock counts restored:', flockId, 'currentCount:', finalState.currentCount);
          } catch (e) {
            console.error('[restoreInvoice] apply patch:', flockId, e);
          }
        }

        // Cascade restore: settlement
        if (confirmed.linkedSettlement) {
          const _st = get().settlements.find(x => x.id === confirmed.linkedSettlement!.id);
          if (_st) {
            set({
              settlements: get().settlements.map(x =>
                x.id === _st.id
                  ? { ...x, status: 'invoiced', invoiceId: id, updatedAt: now() }
                  : x
              ),
            });
            try { console.info('[restoreInvoice] settlement re-linked:', _st.id); } catch (e) { console.error('[restoreInvoice] settlement relink:', e); }
          }
        }

        // 🆕 B7 fix: un-revoke sell events
        try {
          const flkSt = useFlk.getState();
          const needsRevoke = flkSt.flocks.some((ff: any) =>
            (ff.events || []).some((e: any) => e.invoiceId === id && e.type === 'sell' && e.revoked === true)
          );
          if (needsRevoke) {
            useFlk.setState({
              flocks: flkSt.flocks.map((ff: any) => ({
                ...ff,
                events: (ff.events || []).map((e: any) =>
                  e.invoiceId === id && e.type === 'sell' && e.revoked === true
                    ? { ...e, revoked: false }
                    : e
                ),
                updatedAt: now(),
              })),
            } as any);
            console.info('[restoreInvoice] ♻️ sell events un-revoked:', id);
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('[restoreInvoice] un-revoke sell events failed:', e);
        }

        console.warn('[restoreInvoice] ⚠️ موجودی گله/انبار را دستی بررسی کنید');
        return true;
      },
      listDeletedInvoices: () => listRecycleBin<DeletedInvoiceSnapshot>('tra').map((e) => e.item),
      deleteInvoice: (id) => {
        const __snaps = ALL_STORES.map(s => ({ store: s, snap: s.getSnapshot() }));
        try {
        const inv = get().invoices.find(x => x.id === id);
        // 🆕 Backup Before Mutation (recycle bin)
        // D6-D2: Capture recycle-bin data BEFORE mutations
        const _recycleFlocks = inv ? useFlk.getState().flocks
          .filter((f) => f.sourceInvoiceId === id)
          .map((f) => ({
            id: f.id,
            sourceCategory: f.sourceCategory || '',
            birdId: f.birdId || null,
            breedId: f.breedId || null,
          })) : [];
        const _recycleSettlement = inv?.relatedSettlementId
          ? (() => {
              const _st = get().settlements.find(x => x.id === inv.relatedSettlementId);
              return _st ? { id: _st.id, periodStart: _st.periodStart, periodEnd: _st.periodEnd } : undefined;
            })()
          : undefined;
        // Cascade: reset settlement if linked
        if (inv?.relatedSettlementId) {
          const st = get().settlements.find(x => x.id === inv.relatedSettlementId);
          if (st) {
            set({
              settlements: get().settlements.map(x =>
                x.id === st.id
                  ? { ...x, status: 'confirmed', invoiceId: undefined, updatedAt: now() }
                  : x
              ),
            });
            try { console.info('[deleteInvoice] settlement reset to confirmed:', st.id); } catch {}
          }
        }
        // 🆕 auto-unlink: گله‌های متصل بدون سند می‌شن (حذف نمی‌شن)
        if (inv) {
          const flkState = useFlk.getState();
          const linked = flkState.flocks.filter((f: any) => f.sourceInvoiceId === id);
          linked.forEach((f: any) => {
            try { flkState.update(f.id, { sourceInvoiceId: '', sourceCategory: '' }); } catch (e) { console.error('[tra delete] flock unlink failed:', e); throw e; }
          });
          if (linked.length > 0) {
            // Merge info — no separate toast (single notification policy)
            try { console.info(`[deleteInvoice] ${linked.length} گله از فاکتور ${inv.number || id} جدا شد`); } catch {}
          }
        }
        if (inv) {
          // revert flock effect
          const flk = useFlk.getState();
          for (const it of inv.items || []) {
            if (!it.birdId || !it.flockId) continue;
            if (!BIRD_CATS.includes(it.category || inv.category)) continue;
            const qty = (it.healthyCount ?? it.quantity) || 0;
            if (qty <= 0) continue;
            const f = flk.flocks.find(x => x.id === it.flockId);
            if (!f) continue;
            const cur = f.currentCount ?? 0;
            const sign = inv.type === 'purchase' ? -1 : 1;
            const patchRevert: any = {
              currentCount: inv.type === 'purchase' ? Math.max(0, cur - qty) : cur + qty,
            };
            const mDelta = Number(it.maleCount || 0);
            const fDelta = Number(it.femaleCount || 0);
            const uDelta = Number(it.unknownCount || 0);
            const gSum = mDelta + fDelta + uDelta;
            if (gSum > 0) {
              if (mDelta > 0) patchRevert.maleCount = Math.max(0, (f.maleCount ?? 0) + sign * mDelta);
              if (fDelta > 0) patchRevert.femaleCount = Math.max(0, (f.femaleCount ?? 0) + sign * fDelta);
              if (uDelta > 0) patchRevert.unknownCount = Math.max(0, (f.unknownCount ?? 0) + sign * uDelta);
              const rem = qty - gSum;
              if (rem > 0) {
                const base = (uDelta > 0) ? (patchRevert.unknownCount ?? f.unknownCount ?? 0) : (f.unknownCount ?? 0);
                patchRevert.unknownCount = Math.max(0, base + sign * rem);
              }
            } else {
              patchRevert.unknownCount = Math.max(0, (f.unknownCount ?? 0) + sign * qty);
            }
            flk.update(it.flockId, patchRevert);
          }

          // 🆕 قدم ۶: un-split + consistency check after reversal
          try {
            const st6 = useFlk.getState();
            const affectedIds6 = new Set<string>();
            for (const it of inv.items || []) {
              const fid = it.flockId;
              if (fid) affectedIds6.add(fid);
            }
            if (affectedIds6.size > 0) {
              useFlk.setState({
                flocks: st6.flocks.map((f: any) => {
                  if (!affectedIds6.has(f.id)) return f;
                  const m = f.maleCount ?? 0;
                  const fe = f.femaleCount ?? 0;
                  const u = f.unknownCount ?? 0;
                  const cc = f.currentCount ?? 0;

                  // Un-split: male=female=0 ولی genderSplitAt ست بود
                  if (m === 0 && fe === 0 && f.genderSplitAt) {
                    return { ...f, genderSplitAt: null, unknownCount: cc };
                  }

                  // Consistency: male + female + unknown = current
                  if (m + fe + u !== cc) {
                    if (m + fe <= cc) {
                      return { ...f, unknownCount: cc - m - fe };
                    }
                    // داده خراب‌تر از این نشه — فقط log
                    console.warn('[deleteInvoice] inconsistent flock:', { id: f.id, name: f.name, m, fe, u, cc });
                  }
                  return f;
                }),
              });
            }
          } catch (e) { console.error('[deleteInvoice] post-loop fix failed:', e); throw e; }

      // 🆕 فیکس ۳: Revoke sell events این فاکتور
      try {
        const st3 = useFlk.getState();
        const hasAny3 = st3.flocks.some((f: any) => (f.events || []).some((e: any) => e.invoiceId === id && e.type === 'sell' && !e.revoked));
        if (hasAny3) {
          useFlk.setState({
            flocks: st3.flocks.map((f: any) => {
              const hasRev = (f.events || []).some((e: any) => e.invoiceId === id && e.type === 'sell' && !e.revoked);
              if (!hasRev) return f;
              return {
                ...f,
                events: (f.events || []).map((e: any) =>
                  e.invoiceId === id && e.type === 'sell' && !e.revoked
                    ? { ...e, revoked: true }
                    : e
                ),
              };
            }),
          });
        }
      } catch (e) { console.error('[deleteInvoice] sell events revoke failed:', e); throw e; }
          // 🎯 rollback حرکات انبار از طریق Event Bus
          // ⚠️ Event Bus حذف شد — manual reversal کافی است (پایین‌تر انجام می‌شه)
      // 🎯 rollback فروش تخم (egg.sales) — جلوگیری از orphan
      try {
        const eggState = useEgg.getState();
        const linkedSales = (eggState.sales || []).filter((s: any) => s.sourceInvoiceId === id);
        for (const sale of linkedSales) {
          try { eggState.deleteSale(sale.id); } catch (e) { console.error('[tra delete] egg.deleteSale failed:', e); throw e; }
        }
      } catch (e) { console.error('[tra delete] egg sales reversal:', e); throw e; }

      // 🎯 rollback تجهیزات فروش — برگرداندن به hal
      try {
        const halState = useHal.getState();
        for (const it of inv.items || []) {
          const cat = it.category || inv.category;
          if (cat !== 'equipment') continue;
          if (it.equipmentKind === 'consumable') continue;
          const eqId = it.equipmentId;
          const qty = Number(it.quantity) || 1;
          if (!eqId) continue;
          const eq = halState.equipment.find((e: any) => e.id === eqId);
          if (eq) {
            // تجهیز هنوز هست → تعداد رو برگردون
            try { halState.updateEquip(eqId, { count: (eq.count || 0) + qty }); } catch (e) { console.error('[tra delete] hal.updateEquip failed:', e); throw e; }
          } else {
            // تجهیز حذف شده بود → بازسازی
            try {
              halState.addEquip({
                hallId: it.hallId || '',
                zoneId: it.zoneId || '',
                category: (it.equipmentCategory || 'other') as EquipmentCategory,
                type: it.equipmentType || 'other',
                name: it.description || 'تجهیز',
                count: qty,
                unit: (it.unit || 'pcs') as EquipmentUnit,
                unitPrice: it.unitPrice || null,
                purchasedAt: '',
                warranty: null,
                notes: `بازگشت از حذف فاکتور ${inv.number || ''}`,
                brand: it.brand || '',
                supplierId: '',
                sourceInvoiceId: '',
                model: it.model || '',
                status: 'active',
              });
            } catch (e) { console.error('[tra delete] equip restore:', e); throw e; }
          }
        }
      } catch (e) { console.error('[tra delete] hal equip reversal:', e); throw e; }

          // 🎯 rollback ورودی‌های تخم در جوجه‌کشی
          try {
            const incState = useInc.getState();
            const linkedEntries = (incState.eggEntries || []).filter((e: any) => e.sourceInvoiceId === id);
            for (const entry of linkedEntries) {
              try { incState.deleteEntry(entry.id); } catch (e) { console.error('[tra delete] inc.deleteEntry failed:', e); throw e; }
            }
          } catch (e) { console.error('[tra delete] inc entries reversal failed:', e); throw e; }
      // 🆕 حذف Equipmentهای ساخته‌شده از این فاکتور
      try {
        const halState = useHal.getState();
        const linkedEq = halState.equipment.filter((e: any) => e.sourceInvoiceId === id);
        for (const eq of linkedEq) {
          try { halState.deleteEquip(eq.id); } catch (e) { console.error('[tra delete] hal.deleteEquip failed:', e); throw e; }
        }
      } catch (e) { console.error('[tra delete] equipment cleanup:', e); throw e; }
        }
        // 🆕 برگشت موجودی انبار (out movement)
    if (inv) {
      try {
        const whsState = useWhs.getState();
        for (const it of inv.items || []) {
          const cat = it.category || inv.category;
          const isStock = ['feed', 'medicine', 'vaccine', 'herbal', 'other', 'manure', 'broken', 'egg', 'fertile_egg'].includes(cat);
          const isEquipConsumable = cat === 'equipment' && it.equipmentKind === 'consumable';
          if (!isStock && !isEquipConsumable) continue;
          const qty = Number(it.quantity) || 0;
          if (qty <= 0) continue;
          const stockItemId = it.stockItemId;
          if (!stockItemId) continue;
          const wItem = whsState.items.find((i: any) => i.id === stockItemId);
          if (!wItem) continue;
          try {
            whsState.addMovement({
              itemId: stockItemId,
              type: inv.type === 'sale' ? 'in' : 'out',
              quantity: qty,
              unitPrice: Number(it.unitPrice) || 0,
              reason: 'adjustment',
              date: inv.date || '',
              partyId: '',
              notes: `حذف فاکتور ${inv.number || ''}`,
              sourceModule: 'tra',
              sourceId: inv.id,
            });
          } catch (e) { console.error('[tra delete] whs reversal:', e); throw e; }
        }
      } catch (e) { console.error('[tra delete] whs state:', e); throw e; }
    }

    if (inv) {
          const paymentIds = new Set((inv.payments || []).map((p: any) => p.partyPaymentId).filter(Boolean));
          for (const ppId of paymentIds) {
            try { get().deletePartyPayment(ppId as string); } catch(e) { console.error('[tra delete] deletePartyPayment failed:', e); throw e; }
          }
        }
        set({ invoices: get().invoices.filter(x => x.id !== id) });

        // D6-D2: Recycle bin AFTER successful removal (prevents orphan bin)
        if (inv && !get().invoices.some(x => x.id === id)) {
          try {
            saveToRecycleBin<DeletedInvoiceSnapshot>(
              'tra',
              { invoice: inv, linkedFlocks: _recycleFlocks, linkedSettlement: _recycleSettlement },
              (existing) => existing.invoice.id === id,
            );
            console.info('[deleteInvoice] 🗑️ saved to recycle bin:', id);
          } catch (e) {
            console.error('[deleteInvoice] recycle bin failed:', e);
          }
        }
    try { verifyInvariantsIfDev(); } catch(e) { console.error('[tra delete] verifyInvariantsIfDev failed:', e); }
        try { if (inv) setPartyCredit(inv.partyId, computePartyCredit(inv.partyId, get().invoices, get().allocations)); } catch(e) { console.error('[tra delete] setPartyCredit failed:', e); throw e; }
              } catch (__err) {
          for (const { store, snap } of __snaps) {
            try { store.restore(snap); } catch (e) { console.error('[atomic rollback]', store.name, e); }
          }
          showToast('خطا در حذف — همه تغییرات لغو شد: ' + (__err instanceof Error ? __err.message : String(__err)), 'error');
          throw __err;
        }
      },

      // ═══ Phase 6: پرداخت‌های طرف حساب ═══
      addPartyPayment: (p: any) => {
        const id = uuid();
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        const pp = { ...p, id, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now };
        set({ partyPayments: [...get().partyPayments, pp] });
        return id;
      },
      updatePartyPayment: (id: string, patch: any) => {
        set({ partyPayments: get().partyPayments.map((x: any) => x.id === id ? { ...x, ...patch, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : x) });
      },
      deletePartyPayment: (id: string) => {
        set({ partyPayments: get().partyPayments.filter((x: any) => x.id !== id) });
      },
      bouncePartyPayment: (ppId: string) => {
        const pp = get().partyPayments.find(x => x.id === ppId);
        if (!pp) return;
        const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        set({
          partyPayments: get().partyPayments.map(x => x.id === ppId
            ? { ...x, status: 'bounced' as const, bouncedDate: today, clearedDate: '' }
            : x),
        });
        set({
          invoices: get().invoices.map(inv => {
            const payments = inv.payments || [];
            if (!payments.some((p: any) => p.partyPaymentId === ppId)) return inv;
            return {
              ...inv,
              payments: payments.map((p: any) => p.partyPaymentId === ppId
                ? { ...p, status: 'bounced' as const, bouncedDate: today, clearedDate: '' }
                : p),
              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            };
          }),
        });
      set({
        deals: get().deals.map(deal => {
          const payments = deal.payments || [];
          if (!payments.some((p: any) => p.partyPaymentId === ppId)) return deal;
          return {
            ...deal,
            payments: payments.map((p: any) => p.partyPaymentId === ppId
              ? { ...p, status: 'bounced' as const, bouncedDate: today, clearedDate: '' }
              : p),
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          };
        }),
      });
        // 🆕 sync creditBalance پس از تغییر وضعیت چک
        try {
          setPartyCredit(pp.partyId, computePartyCredit(pp.partyId, get().invoices, get().allocations));
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('[bouncePartyPayment] setPartyCredit failed:', e);
        }

      },
      depositPartyPayment: (ppId: string) => {
        const pp = get().partyPayments.find(x => x.id === ppId);
        if (!pp) return;
        set({
          partyPayments: get().partyPayments.map(x => x.id === ppId
            ? { ...x, status: 'in_transit' as const }
            : x),
        });
        set({
          invoices: get().invoices.map(inv => {
            const payments = inv.payments || [];
            if (!payments.some((p: any) => p.partyPaymentId === ppId)) return inv;
            return {
              ...inv,
              payments: payments.map((p: any) => p.partyPaymentId === ppId
                ? { ...p, status: 'in_transit' as const }
                : p),
              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            };
          }),
        });
        set({
          deals: get().deals.map(deal => {
            const payments = deal.payments || [];
            if (!payments.some((p: any) => p.partyPaymentId === ppId)) return deal;
            return {
              ...deal,
              payments: payments.map((p: any) => p.partyPaymentId === ppId
                ? { ...p, status: 'in_transit' as const }
                : p),
              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            };
          }),
        });
        // 🆕 sync deals[].payments[] status (هماهنگی با clear/bounce)
        set({
          deals: get().deals.map(deal => {
            const payments = deal.payments || [];
            if (!payments.some((p: any) => p.partyPaymentId === ppId)) return deal;
            return {
              ...deal,
              payments: payments.map((p: any) => p.partyPaymentId === ppId
                ? { ...p, status: 'in_transit' as const }
                : p),
              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            };
          }),
        });
        // 🆕 sync creditBalance
        try {
          setPartyCredit(pp.partyId, computePartyCredit(pp.partyId, get().invoices, get().allocations));
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('[depositPartyPayment] setPartyCredit failed:', e);
        }

      },
      clearPartyPayment: (ppId: string) => {
        const pp = get().partyPayments.find(x => x.id === ppId);
        if (!pp) return;
        const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        set({
          partyPayments: get().partyPayments.map(x => x.id === ppId
            ? { ...x, status: 'cleared' as const, clearedDate: today, bouncedDate: '' }
            : x),
        });
        const targetInvoiceIds: string[] = [];
        set({
          invoices: get().invoices.map(inv => {
            const payments = inv.payments || [];
            if (!payments.some((p: any) => p.partyPaymentId === ppId)) return inv;
            targetInvoiceIds.push(inv.id);
            return {
              ...inv,
              payments: payments.map((p: any) => p.partyPaymentId === ppId
                ? { ...p, status: 'cleared' as const, clearedDate: today, bouncedDate: '' }
                : p),
              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            };
          }),
        });
      set({
        deals: get().deals.map(deal => {
          const payments = deal.payments || [];
          if (!payments.some((p: any) => p.partyPaymentId === ppId)) return deal;
          return {
            ...deal,
            payments: payments.map((p: any) => p.partyPaymentId === ppId
              ? { ...p, status: 'cleared' as const, clearedDate: today, bouncedDate: '' }
              : p),
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          };
        }),
      });
        // 🆕 dunning C5 gap: auto-cancel reminders on invoices now fully paid
        try {
          const st = get();
          let changed = false;
          const updatedInvoices = st.invoices.map(inv => {
            if (!targetInvoiceIds.includes(inv.id)) return inv;
            if (!inv.nextReminderAt) return inv;
            const invAllocs = st.allocations.filter(al => al.invoiceId === inv.id);
            let paid = 0;
            for (const al of invAllocs) {
              const p = (inv.payments || []).find(pp2 => pp2.id === al.paymentId);
              if (!p) continue;
              if (!isEffectivelyPaid(p)) continue;
              if (p.type === 'refund') paid -= al.amount;
              else paid += al.amount;
            }
            if (paid >= (inv.total || 0)) {
              changed = true;
              return { ...inv, nextReminderAt: undefined, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
            }
            return inv;
          });
          if (changed) set({ invoices: updatedInvoices });
        } catch(e) { console.error('[clearPartyPayment] auto-cancel reminder:', e); }
        // 🆕 sync creditBalance پس از تغییر وضعیت چک
        try {
          setPartyCredit(pp.partyId, computePartyCredit(pp.partyId, get().invoices, get().allocations));
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('[clearPartyPayment] setPartyCredit failed:', e);
        }

      },

      addDeal: (d) => set({ deals: [...get().deals, {...d, id: uuid(), createdAt: now(), updatedAt: now()}] }),
      updateDeal: (id, patch) => {
        const prev = get().deals.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (!prev) return;
        const merged = { ...prev, ...patch, updatedAt: now() };
        if (patch.status && patch.status !== prev.status) {
          if (patch.status === 'settled') merged.settledAt = now();
          else if (patch.status === 'cancelled') merged.cancelledAt = now();
          else if (patch.status === 'open') { merged.settledAt = undefined; merged.cancelledAt = undefined; }
        }
        set({ deals: get().deals.map(x => x.id === id ? merged : x) });
      },
      deleteDeal: (id) => {
        const deal = get().deals.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (!deal) return;

        // Backup به سبد زباله قبل از هر تغییر
        saveToRecycleBin<DeletedDealSnapshot>('tra-deals', { deal }, (existing) => existing.deal.id === id);

        // 🆕 Reverse تمام movements (flock + whs)
        // formState خالی + oldDeal = deal → reverse همه
        try {
          applyDealMovements(
            { partyId: '', goods: [], deliveries: [], sales: [], payments: [] } as any,
            deal
          );
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('[deleteDeal] reverse movements failed:', e);
        }

        set({ deals: get().deals.filter(x => x.id !== id) });
      },
      restoreDealFromBin: (id: string) => {
        const snapshot = removeFromRecycleBin<DeletedDealSnapshot>(
          'tra-deals',
          (existing) => existing.deal.id === id,
        );
        if (!snapshot) return false;
        if (get().deals.some(x => x.id === id)) return false;

        // پاک‌سازی tracking fields قدیمی (که به movement های حذف‌شده اشاره می‌کنن)
        const cleanDeal: Deal = {
          ...snapshot.deal,
          deliveries: (snapshot.deal.deliveries || []).map(dv => ({
            ...dv,
            whsMovementId: undefined,
            whsMovementIdIn: undefined,
            flockDeductedQuantity: undefined,
            flockSourceId: undefined,
          })),
        };

        // 🆕 Re-apply movements (creates new whs.Movement + updates flock.currentCount)
        try {
          applyDealMovements(cleanDeal as any, undefined);
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('[restoreDealFromBin] re-apply movements failed:', e);
        }

        set({ deals: [...get().deals, cleanDeal] });
        return true;
      },
      listDeletedDeals: () => listRecycleBin<DeletedDealSnapshot>('tra-deals').map(e => e.item),
      reopenDeal: (id, reason) => {
        const prev = get().deals.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (!prev) return false;
        if (prev.status === 'open') return false;
        if (!reason || !reason.trim()) return false;
        const history = [...(prev.reopenHistory || []), {
          from: prev.status as 'settled' | 'cancelled',
          to: 'open' as const,
          reason: reason.trim(),
          at: now(),
        }];
        set({
          deals: get().deals.map(x => x.id === id
            ? { ...x, status: 'open' as const, settledAt: undefined, cancelledAt: undefined, reopenHistory: history, updatedAt: now() }
            : x),
        });
        try {
          void import('../../cor/logger/auditLog').then(m => {
            m.logAction('update', 'tra', 'بازگشایی معامله ' + (prev.dealNumber || id) + ' — دلیل: ' + reason.trim());
          }).catch(() => {});
        } catch (e) { console.error('[reopenDeal] audit failed:', e); }
        return true;
      },
      restoreDeal: (deal) => {
        if (get().deals.some(x => x.id === deal.id)) return false;
        set({ deals: [...get().deals, deal] });
        return true;
      },
      addSettlement: (s) => {
        const dup = get().settlements.find(x =>
          x.dealId === s.dealId &&
          x.periodStart === s.periodStart &&
          x.periodEnd === s.periodEnd
        );
        if (dup) {
          throw new Error('برای این بازه در این معامله قبلاً تسویه‌ای (پیش‌نویس یا تأییدشده) ثبت شده است.');
        }
        const id = uuid();
        set({ settlements: [...get().settlements, { ...s, id, createdAt: now(), updatedAt: now() }] });
        return id;
      },
      updateSettlement: (id, patch) => {
        set({ settlements: get().settlements.map(x => x.id === id ? { ...x, ...patch, updatedAt: now() } : x) });
      },
      deleteSettlement: (id) => {
        const st = get().settlements.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (st?.invoiceId) {
          throw new Error('این تسویه دارای فاکتور است. ابتدا فاکتور را حذف کنید.');
        }
        set({ settlements: get().settlements.filter(x => x.id !== id) });
      },
      undoSettlement: (id) => {
        const st = get().settlements.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (!st) throw new Error('تسویه یافت نشد');
        if (st.status !== 'invoiced') {
          throw new Error('فقط تسویه‌های فاکتور‌شده قابل لغو هستند');
        }
        if (st.invoiceId) {
          get().deleteInvoice(st.invoiceId);
        }
        return true;
      },
      reopenSettlement: (id) => {
        const st = get().settlements.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (!st) return false;
        if (st.status === 'invoiced') {
          throw new Error('این تسویه دارای فاکتور است. ابتدا فاکتور را لغو کنید');
        }
        if (st.status !== 'confirmed') return false;
        set({
          settlements: get().settlements.map(x =>
            x.id === id ? { ...x, status: 'draft', updatedAt: now() } : x
          ),
        });
        return true;
      },
      addAllocation: (a) => {
        const id = uuid();
        set({ allocations: [...get().allocations, { ...a, id }] });
        // 🆕 dunning C5 gap: auto-cancel reminder if invoice fully paid
        try {
          const st = get();
          const inv = st.invoices.find(x => x.id === a.invoiceId);
          if (inv && inv.nextReminderAt) {
            const invAllocs = st.allocations.filter(al => al.invoiceId === a.invoiceId);
            let paid = 0;
            for (const al of invAllocs) {
              const p = (inv.payments || []).find(pp => pp.id === al.paymentId);
              if (!p) continue;
              if (p.method === 'check' && p.status !== 'cleared') continue;
              if (p.type === 'refund') paid -= al.amount;
              else paid += al.amount;
            }
            if (paid >= (inv.total || 0)) {
              set({ invoices: get().invoices.map(x => x.id === a.invoiceId ? { ...x, nextReminderAt: undefined, updatedAt: now() } : x) });
            }
          }
        } catch(e) { console.error('[addAllocation] auto-cancel reminder:', e); }
        return id;
      },
      addReminder: (invoiceId, params) => {
        const inv = get().invoices.find(i => i.id === invoiceId);
        if (!inv) return;
        const today = getTodayJalali();
        const nextDate = params.promisedDate || addJalaliDays(today, params.intervalDays);
        const logEntry = {
          date: today,
          method: params.method,
          methodLabel: params.methodLabel,
          note: params.note,
          intervalDays: params.intervalDays,
          ...(params.promisedDate ? { promisedDate: params.promisedDate } : {}),
          ...(params.promisedAmount !== undefined ? { promisedAmount: params.promisedAmount } : {}),
        };
        set({
          invoices: get().invoices.map(i => i.id === invoiceId ? {
            ...i,
            lastRemindedAt: today,
            nextReminderAt: nextDate,
            reminderLog: [...(i.reminderLog || []), logEntry],
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          } : i),
        });
      },
      addDealReminder: (dealId, params) => {
        const d = get().deals.find(x => x.id === dealId);
        if (!d) return;
        const today = getTodayJalali();
        const nextDate = params.promisedDate || addJalaliDays(today, params.intervalDays);
        const logEntry = {
          date: today,
          method: params.method,
          methodLabel: params.methodLabel,
          note: params.note,
          intervalDays: params.intervalDays,
          ...(params.promisedDate ? { promisedDate: params.promisedDate } : {}),
          ...(params.promisedAmount !== undefined ? { promisedAmount: params.promisedAmount } : {}),
        };
        set({
          deals: get().deals.map(x => x.id === dealId ? {
            ...x,
            lastRemindedAt: today,
            nextReminderAt: nextDate,
            reminderLog: [...(x.reminderLog || []), logEntry],
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          } : x),
        });
      },
      updateAllocation: (id, patch) => {
        set({ allocations: get().allocations.map(x => x.id === id ? { ...x, ...patch } : x) });
      },
      deleteAllocation: (id) => {
        set({ allocations: get().allocations.filter(x => x.id !== id) });
      }
    }),
    {
      name: 'pm-tra',
      storage: createJSONStorage(() => zustandHybridStorage),
      partialize: (state) => {
        const { isLoading, ...rest } = state;
        return rest as any;
      },
      onRehydrateStorage: () => {
        return (state, error) => {
          if (error) {
            console.error('[tra] Hydration failed:', error);
          }
          useTra.setState({ isLoading: false });
        };
      },
      version: 8,
      migrate: (persisted: any, version: number) => {
        if (!persisted?.invoices) return persisted;

        // v5 → v6: build allocations from existing payments
      // v7 → v8: merge settlement types (7 → 5)
      if (version < 8) {
        const typeMap: Record<string, string> = {
          commission_pct: 'percent',
          profit_sharing: 'percent',
          commission_per_unit: 'per_unit',
          grower_fee_per_unit: 'per_unit',
          fixed_amount: 'fixed',
          rental_monthly: 'rental',
          barter_direct: 'barter',
        };
        for (const deal of (persisted.deals || [])) {
          if (deal.settlementType && typeMap[deal.settlementType]) {
            deal.settlementType = typeMap[deal.settlementType];
          }
        }
      }
            if (version < 7) {
          persisted.settlements = persisted.settlements || [];
        }
        if (version < 6) {
        persisted.allocations = [];
        for (const inv of (persisted.invoices || [])) {
          for (const p of (inv.payments || [])) {
            persisted.allocations.push({
              id: uuid(),
              paymentId: p.id,
              invoiceId: inv.id,
              amount: p.amount || 0,
              date: p.date || '',
              notes: 'migrated',
            });
          }
        }
      }
      persisted.invoices = persisted.invoices.map((inv: any) => {
          // مقادیر پیش‌فرض بر اساس وضعیت فعلی
          const payments = inv.payments || [];
          const total = inv.total || 0;
          const paidSumVal = paidSum(payments);
          const isPaid = total > 0 && paidSumVal >= total;

          // وضعیت workflow خودکار
          let workflowStatus = 'confirmed';
          if (isPaid) workflowStatus = 'paid';
          else if (payments.length > 0) workflowStatus = 'confirmed';

          return {
            ...inv,
            // فاز A
            paymentTerms: inv.paymentTerms || (inv.dueDate === inv.date ? 'cash' : 'custom'),
            installmentCount: inv.installmentCount ?? 1,
            installmentGapDays: inv.installmentGapDays ?? 30,
            customDueDate: inv.customDueDate || inv.dueDate || '',
            paymentNote: inv.paymentNote || '',
            // فاز B
            workflowStatus,
            confirmedAt: inv.confirmedAt || inv.createdAt,
            receivedAt: inv.receivedAt || '',
            receivedNote: inv.receivedNote || '',
            paidAt: inv.paidAt || '',
            paidNote: inv.paidNote || '',
            // فاز C
            isPreorder: inv.isPreorder ?? false,
            deliveryDate: inv.deliveryDate || '',
            advancePayment: inv.advancePayment ?? 0,
            advancePercent: inv.advancePercent ?? 0,
            // فاز D
            deferrals: inv.deferrals || [],
            remindersMuted: inv.remindersMuted ?? false,
            // اقساط
            installments: inv.installments || [],
            // گسترش Payment
            payments: (inv.payments || []).map((p: any) => ({
              ...p,
              status: p.status || 'pending',
              clearedDate: p.clearedDate || '',
              bouncedDate: p.bouncedDate || '',
              bouncedInvoiceId: p.bouncedInvoiceId || '',
            })),
            // گسترش InvoiceItem
            items: (inv.items || []).map((it: any) => ({
              ...it,
              discountType: it.discountType || '',
              discountValue: it.discountValue ?? 0,
            })),
          };
        });

        return persisted;
      }
    }
  )
);



/**
 * buildAdvanceAllocations — ساخت تخصیص پیش‌پرداخت به فاکتور جدید (FIFO)
 */
export function buildAdvanceAllocations(
  partyId: string,
  maxAmount: number,
  date: string,
): Array<{ partyPaymentId: string; amount: number; date: string }> {
  const st = useTra.getState();
  const advances = (st.partyPayments || [])
    .filter((p: any) => p.partyId === partyId && p.type === 'advance')
    .sort((a: any, b: any) => (a.date || '').localeCompare(b.date || ''));
  if (advances.length === 0) return [];
  const usedMap = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const inv of st.invoices) {
    for (const pay of (inv.payments || [])) {
      if (pay.partyPaymentId) {
        usedMap.set(pay.partyPaymentId, (usedMap.get(pay.partyPaymentId) || 0) + (Number(pay.amount) || 0));
      }
    }
  }
  const result: Array<{ partyPaymentId: string; amount: number; date: string }> = [];
  let remaining = maxAmount;
  for (const adv of advances) {
    if (remaining <= 0) break;
    const available = Math.max(0, (Number(adv.amount) || 0) - (usedMap.get(adv.id) || 0));
    if (available <= 0) continue;
    const amt = Math.min(remaining, available);
    result.push({ partyPaymentId: adv.id, amount: amt, date });
    remaining -= amt;
  }
  return result;
}

/**
 * computeUnappliedAdvances — مجموع پیش‌پرداخت‌های استفاده‌نشده
 */
export function computeUnappliedAdvances(partyId: string): number {
  const st = useTra.getState();
  const advances = (st.partyPayments || []).filter(
    (p: any) => p.partyId === partyId && p.type === 'advance'
  );
  if (advances.length === 0) return 0;
  const usedMap = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const inv of st.invoices) {
    for (const pay of (inv.payments || [])) {
      if (pay.partyPaymentId) {
        usedMap.set(pay.partyPaymentId, (usedMap.get(pay.partyPaymentId) || 0) + (Number(pay.amount) || 0));
      }
    }
  }
  return advances.reduce((s: number, a: any) => {
    const used = usedMap.get(a.id) || 0;
    return s + Math.max(0, (Number(a.amount) || 0) - used);
  }, 0);
}

export function computePartyCredit(partyId: string, invoices: Invoice[], allocations?: any[]): number {
  // SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — partyBalance (formulas.ts)
  const base = partyBalance(partyId, invoices, allocations);
  if (!partyId) return base;

  // 🆕 فاز ۳.۵: اضافه کردن پیش‌پرداخت‌های استفاده‌نشده (type: 'advance')
  // base فقط inv.payments را می‌شمارد → advance های unapplied را نمی‌بیند
  const allPps = useTra.getState().partyPayments;
  const advances = (allPps || []).filter(
    (p: any) => p.partyId === partyId && p.type === 'advance'
  );
  if (advances.length === 0) return base;

  // محاسبه مجموع استفاده‌شده از هر partyPaymentId (از طریق inv.payments)
  const usedMap = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const inv of invoices) {
    for (const pay of (inv.payments || [])) {
      if (pay.partyPaymentId) {
        const amt = Number(pay.amount) || 0;
        usedMap.set(pay.partyPaymentId, (usedMap.get(pay.partyPaymentId) || 0) + amt);
      }
    }
  }

  // unapplied = Σ max(0, advance.amount - used)
  const unapplied = advances.reduce((s: number, a: any) => {
    const used = usedMap.get(a.id) || 0;
    const amt = Number(a.amount) || 0;
    return s + Math.max(0, amt - used);
  }, 0);

  return base + unapplied;
}

export async function archiveTraInvoices(invoiceIds: string[]): Promise<number> {
  if (!invoiceIds.length) return 0;
  const idSet = new Set(invoiceIds);
  const st = useTra.getState();
  const toArc = st.invoices.filter(inv => idSet.has(inv.id));
  if (!toArc.length) return 0;

  const { ARCHIVE_STORES, putArchiveRecord } = await import('../../cor/storage/historyArchive');

  for (const inv of toArc) {
    await putArchiveRecord({
      id: inv.id,
      flockId: inv.relatedFlockId || inv.partyId || inv.id,
      date: inv.date || inv.createdAt,
      archivedAt: Date.now(),
      reason: 'manual' as const,
      log: inv as any,
    });
  }

  const remaining = st.invoices.filter(inv => !idSet.has(inv.id));
  useTra.setState({ invoices: remaining });

  const affectedParties = new Set(toArc.map(inv => inv.partyId).filter(Boolean));
  const allocs = useTra.getState().allocations;
  for (const pid of affectedParties) {
    try {
      setPartyCredit(pid, computePartyCredit(pid, remaining, allocs));
    } catch {}
  }

  return toArc.length;
}

export async function restoreTraInvoices(invoiceIds: string[]): Promise<number> {
  if (!invoiceIds.length) return 0;
  const { ARCHIVE_STORES, getArchived, purgeArchiveIds } = await import('../../cor/storage/historyArchive');
  const restored: Invoice[] = [];
  const restoredIds: string[] = [];

  for (const id of invoiceIds) {
    const rec = await getArchived(id, ARCHIVE_STORES.tra) as { log?: Invoice } | null;
    if (rec?.log) {
      restored.push(rec.log);
      restoredIds.push(id);
    }
  }
  if (!restored.length) return 0;

  const st = useTra.getState();
  const existing = new Set(st.invoices.map(inv => inv.id));
  const merged = [...st.invoices, ...restored.filter(inv => !existing.has(inv.id))];
  useTra.setState({ invoices: merged });
  await purgeArchiveIds(restoredIds, ARCHIVE_STORES.tra);

  const affectedParties = new Set(restored.map(inv => inv.partyId).filter(Boolean));
  const allocs = useTra.getState().allocations;
  for (const pid of affectedParties) {
    try {
      setPartyCredit(pid, computePartyCredit(pid, merged, allocs));
    } catch {}
  }

  return restored.length;
}

import ItemsFormModal from './components/ItemsFormModal';
import { useFab } from '../../shr/hooks/useFab';
import { useFocusParam } from '../../shr/hooks/useFocusParam';
import {
  useWhs, CATEGORY_DEFAULTS,
  UNIT_LABEL, type Item, type ItemCategory, type ItemUnit
} from './store';
import { useCtc } from '../ctc/store';
import { useHal } from '../hal/store';
import { Btn, Empty, PageContainer } from '../../shr/components/ui';
import { exportTableToCSV } from '../../shr/utils/export';
import { useMultiSelect } from '../../shr/multiSelect/useMultiSelect';
import MultiSelectBar from '../../shr/multiSelect/MultiSelectBar';
import { toFa, toEn } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { format as formatJ } from 'date-fns-jalali';
const todayJalali = () => formatJ(new Date(), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
import { showConfirmAsync, showPromptAsync } from '../../cor/store/dialog';
import UndoBar from '../../cor/ui/UndoBar';
import { toastMsg } from '../../cor/store/toast';
import HelpBanner from '../../shr/components/HelpBanner';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useFilterSort, FilterBar, getWhsItemsConfig } from '../../shr/filter';
import {
  IconEgg, IconWheat, IconPill, IconSyringe, IconLeaf, IconTool, IconBox,
} from '../../shr/icons';

// map دسته به SVG
const CATEGORY_SVG: Record<string, (props: { size?: number }) => React.ReactElement> = {
  egg: IconEgg,
  feed: IconWheat,
  medicine: IconPill,
  vaccine: IconSyringe,
  herbal: IconLeaf,
  equipment: IconTool,
  consumable: IconBox,
};
import { useValidation } from '../../shr/validation/useValidation';
import { createItemSchema } from '../../shr/validation/rules/whs';
import { useFormErrors } from '../../shr/hooks/useFormErrors';

interface F {
  id?: string;
  name: string;
  category: ItemCategory;
  unit: ItemUnit;
  subUnits?: { name: string; factor: number }[];
  minStock: string;
  initialStock: string;
  supplierId: string;
  expireDate: string;
  withdrawalDays: string;
  storage: string;
  notes: string;
  // ─── تجهیزات ───
  purchaseDate: string;
  purchasePrice: string;
  hallId: string;
  equipmentStatus: string;
  warrantyUntil: string;
  initialPrice: string;
  // ─── آنالیز دان ───
  feedType: string;
  brand: string;
  protein: string;
  energy: string;
  fat: string;
  fiber: string;
  calcium: string;
  phosphorus: string;
  methionine: string;
  lysine: string;
  // ─── دارو/واکسن ───
  usageTypes: string[];
  productionDate: string;
  dosePerBird: string;
  dosePerLiter: string;
  dosePerKgFeed: string;
}

const empty = (): F => ({
  name: '', category: 'feed', unit: 'kg', subUnits: [],
  minStock: '', initialStock: '',
  supplierId: '', expireDate: '',
  withdrawalDays: '', storage: 'room',
  notes: '',
  purchaseDate: '', purchasePrice: '', hallId: '', equipmentStatus: 'active', warrantyUntil: '', initialPrice: '',
  usageTypes: [], productionDate: '', dosePerBird: '',
    dosePerLiter: '',
    dosePerKgFeed: '',
    feedType: '', brand: '',
    protein: '', energy: '', fat: '', fiber: '',
    calcium: '', phosphorus: '', methionine: '', lysine: ''
});

const EQUIP_STATUS: Record<string, string> = { active: 'فعال', repair: 'در تعمیر', scrapped: 'اسقاط' };

export default function ItemsPage({ active = true }: { active?: boolean } = {}) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  useFocusParam();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { items, movements, addItem, updateItem, deleteItem, archiveItem, unarchiveItem } = useWhs();
  const { contacts } = useCtc();
  const { halls } = useHal();
  const suppliers = contacts.filter(c => c.roles.includes('supplier'));

  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<F>(empty());
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [undoData, setUndoData] = useState<{ item: any | any[] } | null>(null);
  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showArchived, setShowArchived] = useState(false);

  // ─── تعریف مشترک فیلترها و مرتب‌سازی ───
  // ─── فیلتر / جستجو / مرتب‌سازی (از config مرکزی) ───
  const config = useMemo(
    () => getWhsItemsConfig({ suppliers }),
    [suppliers]
  );

  const { filtered: list, filters, setFilter, clearFilter,
          sort, setSort, toggleSort, resetAll, hasActiveFilters,
          total, count } = useFilterSort<Item>({
    items,
    filters: config.filterDefs,
    sorts: config.sortDefs,
    persistKey: config.persistKey,
    initialSort: config.initialSort,
  });

  // ─── Multi-Select ───
  const ms = useMultiSelect({
    items: list,
    getId: (x: any) => x.id,
    onDelete: async (ids: string[]) => {
      // 🆕 تشخیص خودکار: کالاهای دارای تاریخچه → آرشیو، بقیه → حذف کامل
      const withMovements = ids.filter(id => movements.some(m => m.itemId === id));
      const withoutMovements = ids.filter(id => !movements.some(m => m.itemId === id));

      const parts: string[] = [];
      if (withoutMovements.length > 0) parts.push(`${fmt.count(withoutMovements.length)} کالا حذف کامل`);
      if (withMovements.length > 0) parts.push(`${fmt.count(withMovements.length)} کالا آرشیو (تاریخچه حفظ می‌شود)`);
      const msg = parts.join(' و ') + '. ادامه می‌دهید؟';

      const ok = await showConfirmAsync('تأیید عملیات گروهی', msg, { danger: true });
      if (!ok) return;

      const backups: any[] = [];
      for (const id of withoutMovements) {
        const it = items.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (!it) continue;
        backups.push(it);
        try { deleteItem(id); } catch {}
      }
      for (const id of withMovements) {
        try { archiveItem(id); } catch {}
      }

      if (backups.length > 0) {
        setUndoData({ item: backups });
        setTimeout(() => setUndoData((cur: any) => cur && Array.isArray(cur.item) && cur.item.length === backups.length ? null : cur), 8000);
      }
      toastMsg.deletedBulk(withoutMovements.length + withMovements.length, 'کالا');
    },
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (ms.selectionMode) setExpandedId(null);
  }, [ms.selectionMode]);

  const undoDelete = () => {
    if (!undoData) return;
    const raw = (undoData as any).item;
    const arr: any[] = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : [raw];
    try {
      for (const it of arr) {
        try { addItem(it); } catch {}
      }
      toastMsg.restoredBulk(arr.length, 'مورد')
    } catch { toastMsg.error('بازگردانی ناموفق') }
    setUndoData(null);
  };

  const openNew = () => {
    const lastR = items.filter(x => x.category).slice().reverse()[0];
    setForm({ ...empty(), ...(lastR?.category ? { category: lastR.category } : {}) }); setErr(''); reset(); setOpen(true);
  };
  useFab(active && items.length > 0 ? { label: 'افزودن کالا', onClick: openNew } : null);

  /** اصلاح موجودی — از prompt می‌گیره، adjust می‌سازه */
  const adjustStock = async (it: Item) => {
    const current = it.currentStock || 0;
    const input = await showPromptAsync(
      'اصلاح موجودی',
      `موجودی فعلی: ${fmt.num(current)} ${UNIT_LABEL[it.unit]}\n\nموجودی واقعی چقدر است؟`,
      {
        placeholder: 'مثلاً — ۱۵۰',
        confirmText: 'ثبت اصلاح',
        defaultValue: String(current),
      }
    );
    if (input === null || input === undefined) return;
    const val = parseFloat(toEn(String(input)).replace('٫', '.')) || 0;
    if (val === current) { toastMsg.info('موجودی تغییری نکرد'); return; }
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
      'تأیید اصلاح',
      `موجودی از ${fmt.num(current)} به ${fmt.num(val)} ${UNIT_LABEL[it.unit]} تغییر کند؟\n(در تاریخچه ثبت می‌شود)`,
      { danger: false }
    );
    if (!ok) return;
    try {
      const { addMovement } = useWhs.getState();
      const newId = addMovement({
        itemId: it.id,
        type: 'adjust',
        quantity: val,
        unitPrice: 0,
        reason: 'adjustment',
        date: todayJalali(),
        partyId: '',
        notes: 'اصلاح موجودی از کارت قلم',
      });
      if (newId) toastMsg.saved('اصلاح موجودی');
    } catch (e: any) {
      toastMsg.error(e.message || 'خطا در اصلاح موجودی');
    }
  };

  const openEdit = (it: Item) => {
    setForm({
      id: it.id, name: it.name, category: it.category, unit: it.unit, subUnits: it.subUnits || [],
      minStock: it.minStock ? fmt.code(it.minStock) : '',
      initialStock: '',
      supplierId: it.supplierId || '',
      expireDate: it.expireDate || '',
      withdrawalDays: it.withdrawalDays === null || it.withdrawalDays === undefined ? '' : fmt.code(it.withdrawalDays),
      storage: it.storage || 'room',
      notes: it.notes || '',
      purchaseDate: it.purchaseDate || '',
      purchasePrice: it.purchasePrice ? fmt.code(it.purchasePrice) : '',
      hallId: it.hallId || '',
      equipmentStatus: it.equipmentStatus || 'active',
      warrantyUntil: it.warrantyUntil || '',
      initialPrice: '',
      usageTypes: (() => { const raw: string[] = (it as any).usageTypes || ((it as any).usageType ? [(it as any).usageType] : []); return raw.map((t: string) => t === 'water' ? 'drinking_water' : t === 'injectable' ? 'injection' : t); })(),
      productionDate: it.productionDate || '',
      dosePerBird: it.dosePerBird ? fmt.code(it.dosePerBird) : '',
      dosePerLiter: it.dosePerLiter !== null && it.dosePerLiter !== undefined ? fmt.code(it.dosePerLiter) : '',
      dosePerKgFeed: it.dosePerKgFeed !== null && it.dosePerKgFeed !== undefined ? fmt.code(it.dosePerKgFeed) : '',
      feedType: it.feedType || '',
      brand: it.brand || '',
      protein: it.protein ? fmt.code(it.protein) : '',
      energy: it.energy ? fmt.code(it.energy) : '',
      fat: it.fat ? fmt.code(it.fat) : '',
      fiber: it.fiber ? fmt.code(it.fiber) : '',
      calcium: it.calcium ? fmt.code(it.calcium) : '',
      phosphorus: it.phosphorus ? fmt.code(it.phosphorus) : '',
      methionine: it.methionine ? fmt.code(it.methionine) : '',
      lysine: it.lysine ? fmt.code(it.lysine) : ''
    });
    setErr(''); reset(); setOpen(true);
  };

  const num = (s: string) => s ? parseFloat(toEn(s).replace('٫','.')) || 0 : 0;
  const int = (s: string) => s ? parseInt(toEn(s)) || 0 : 0;

  // ═══ اعتبارسنجی زنده ═══
  const { errors: vErrors } = useValidation(
    createItemSchema(),
    {
      name: form.name || '',
      category: form.category,
      unit: form.unit,
      minStock: num(form.minStock),
      currentStock: form.id ? 0 : num(form.initialStock),
      lastPrice: 0,
      supplierId: form.supplierId || '',
      expireDate: form.expireDate || '',
      withdrawalDays: form.withdrawalDays ? int(form.withdrawalDays) : null,
      storage: form.storage || 'room',
      notes: form.notes || '',
    },
  );

  const { showError, markTouched, attemptSave, reset } = useFormErrors(vErrors);

  const save = () => {
    attemptSave();
    if (Object.keys(vErrors).length > 0) return;

    // 🔒 جلوگیری قاطع از نام تکراری کالا
    if (!form.id) {
      const _trimmed = form.name.trim();
      const _dup = items.find((x) => x.name.trim() === _trimmed);
      if (_dup) {
        setErr(`کالایی با نام «${_dup.name}» قبلاً ثبت شده. لطفاً نام دیگری انتخاب کنید یا همان را ویرایش کنید.`);
        return;
      }
    }
    const isMed = form.category === 'medicine' || form.category === 'vaccine';
    const hasExpiry = ['medicine', 'vaccine', 'herbal', 'egg'].includes(form.category);

    if (form.id === undefined) {
      // ایجاد جدید: موجودی اولیه از فرم + قیمت صفر
      addItem({
        name: form.name.trim(),
        category: form.category,
        unit: form.unit,
        subUnits: form.subUnits || [],
        minStock: num(form.minStock),
        currentStock: num(form.initialStock),   // ← موجودی اولیه
        lastPrice: 0,                            // ← صفر (بعد از خرید پر میشه)
        supplierId: form.supplierId,
        expireDate: hasExpiry ? form.expireDate : '',
        withdrawalDays: isMed && form.withdrawalDays.trim() !== '' ? int(form.withdrawalDays) : null,
        storage: form.storage,
        notes: form.notes.trim(),
        purchaseDate: form.category === 'equipment' ? form.purchaseDate : '',
        purchasePrice: form.category === 'equipment' ? num(form.purchasePrice) : 0,
        hallId: form.category === 'equipment' ? form.hallId : '',
        equipmentStatus: form.category === 'equipment' ? form.equipmentStatus : '',
        warrantyUntil: form.category === 'equipment' ? form.warrantyUntil : '',
        initialPrice: num(form.initialPrice),
        usageTypes: isMed ? form.usageTypes : [],
        productionDate: isMed ? form.productionDate : '',
        dosePerBird: isMed && form.dosePerBird.trim() !== '' ? num(form.dosePerBird) : 0,
        dosePerLiter: isMed && form.dosePerLiter.trim() !== '' ? num(form.dosePerLiter) : null,
        dosePerKgFeed: isMed && form.dosePerKgFeed.trim() !== '' ? num(form.dosePerKgFeed) : null,
        feedType: form.feedType || '',
        brand: form.brand || '',
        protein: num(form.protein),
        energy: num(form.energy),
        fat: num(form.fat),
        fiber: num(form.fiber),
        calcium: num(form.calcium),
        phosphorus: num(form.phosphorus),
        methionine: num(form.methionine),
        lysine: num(form.lysine)
      });
    } else {
      // ویرایش: currentStock و lastPrice نباید تغییر کنن
      updateItem(form.id, {
        name: form.name.trim(),
        category: form.category,
        unit: form.unit,
        subUnits: form.subUnits || [],
        minStock: num(form.minStock),
        supplierId: form.supplierId,
        expireDate: hasExpiry ? form.expireDate : '',
        withdrawalDays: isMed && form.withdrawalDays.trim() !== '' ? int(form.withdrawalDays) : null,
        storage: form.storage,
        notes: form.notes.trim(),
        purchaseDate: form.category === 'equipment' ? form.purchaseDate : '',
        purchasePrice: form.category === 'equipment' ? num(form.purchasePrice) : 0,
        hallId: form.category === 'equipment' ? form.hallId : '',
        equipmentStatus: form.category === 'equipment' ? form.equipmentStatus : '',
        warrantyUntil: form.category === 'equipment' ? form.warrantyUntil : '',
        usageTypes: isMed ? form.usageTypes : [],
        productionDate: isMed ? form.productionDate : '',
        dosePerBird: isMed && form.dosePerBird.trim() !== '' ? num(form.dosePerBird) : 0,
        dosePerLiter: isMed && form.dosePerLiter.trim() !== '' ? num(form.dosePerLiter) : null,
        dosePerKgFeed: isMed && form.dosePerKgFeed.trim() !== '' ? num(form.dosePerKgFeed) : null,
        feedType: form.feedType || '',
        brand: form.brand || '',
        protein: num(form.protein),
        energy: num(form.energy),
        fat: num(form.fat),
        fiber: num(form.fiber),
        calcium: num(form.calcium),
        phosphorus: num(form.phosphorus),
        methionine: num(form.methionine),
        lysine: num(form.lysine)
      });
    // 🆕 Intelligence — ثبت تاریخچه
    try {
      if (form.category === 'feed') {
        const rn = (p: string, v: number | null) => {
          if (v !== null && Number.isFinite(v) && v > 0) recordHistory(p, v, {});
        };
        rn('feed.protein', num(form.protein));
        rn('feed.energy', num(form.energy));
        rn('feed.fat', num(form.fat));
        rn('feed.fiber', num(form.fiber));
        rn('feed.calcium', num(form.calcium));
        rn('feed.phosphorus', num(form.phosphorus));
        rn('feed.methionine', num(form.methionine));
        rn('feed.lysine', num(form.lysine));
      }
      if (form.category === 'medicine' || form.category === 'vaccine') {
        const dose = form.dosePerBird.trim() !== '' ? num(form.dosePerBird) : null;
        const wd = form.withdrawalDays.trim() !== '' ? int(form.withdrawalDays) : null;
        if (dose !== null && Number.isFinite(dose) && dose > 0) recordHistory('whs.dosePerBird', dose, {});
        if (wd !== null && Number.isFinite(wd) && wd > 0) recordHistory('whs.withdrawalDays', wd, {});
      }
    } catch { /* silent */ }
    }
    setOpen(false);
  };

  // آبشاری: فیلدهای اضافی مستقیماً از CATEGORY_DEFAULTS (منبع واحد حقیقت)
  const currentStockForEdit = form.id ? (items.find(x => x.id === form.id)?.currentStock || 0) : 0;
  const extras = CATEGORY_DEFAULTS[form.category];
  const hasExtras = !!(extras && (extras.needsExpiry || extras.needsBatch || extras.needsWithdrawal || extras.needsStorage));
  const isMedicine = form.category === 'medicine' || form.category === 'vaccine';

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      {undoData && (
        <UndoBar
          label="حذف شد"
          onUndo={undoDelete}
          onDismiss={() => setUndoData(null)}
        />
      )}
        <HelpBanner
          id="items-intro"
          icon="📦"
          title="اینجا فقط کالاها تعریف می‌شوند"
          description="موجودی و قیمت از اینجا مدیریت می‌شود. برای ثبت خرید از فروشنده به بخش «معاملات → خرید» بروید. برای ضایعات یا اصلاح دستی به «انبار → ورود/خروج» بروید."
          tone="info"
        />
        <FilterBar
          filterDefs={config.filterDefs}
          sortDefs={config.sortDefs}
          filterState={filters}
          sortState={sort}
          setFilter={setFilter}
          clearFilter={clearFilter}
          setSort={setSort}
          toggleSort={toggleSort}
          resetAll={resetAll}
          hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
          total={total}
          count={count}
        />
      {!ms.selectionMode && list.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: 'var(--dim)', textAlign: 'center', paddingBottom: 2 }}>
          برای انتخاب چندتایی، روی یک کارت نگه دارید
        </div>
      )}

      {ms.selectionMode && list.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 6 }}>
          <button type="button"
            onClick={ms.selectedIds.size === list.length ? ms.clearSelection : ms.selectAll}
            style={{ padding: '4px 10px', background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: '10px', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
            {ms.selectedIds.size === list.length ? 'لغو انتخاب همه' : 'انتخاب همه'}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginBottom: 8 }}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setShowArchived(s => !s)}
        style={{
          padding: '6px 12px',
          background: showArchived ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--input-bg)',
          border: `1px solid ${showArchived ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--border)'}`,
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
          color: showArchived ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
          fontFamily: 'inherit',
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
          fontWeight: 600,
          cursor: 'pointer',
        }}
      >
        {showArchived ? '📦 مخفی کردن آرشیو' : '📦 نمایش آرشیو'}
      </button>
    </div>
    {list.filter(it => showArchived || !it.archived).length === 0 ? (
        items.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty
            icon={<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round"><path d="M21 8v13H3V8M1 3h22v5H1zM10 12h4"/></svg>}
            title="انبار خالی است"
            desc="اولین قلم انبار خود را اضافه کنید — دان، دارو، واکسن، تجهیزات."
            action={<Btn variant="primary" onClick={openNew}>+ افزودن قلم</Btn>}
          />
        ) : (
          <Empty
            icon={<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><polygon points="22 3 2 3 10 12.46 10 19 14 21 14 12.46 22 3"/></svg>}
            title="نتیجه‌ای پیدا نشد"
            desc="هیچ کالایی با فیلترهای فعلی هم‌خوانی ندارد. فیلترها را تغییر دهید یا پاک کنید."
          />
        )
      ) : (
        <>
          {list.filter(it => showArchived || !it.archived).map((it, i) => {
            const sup = contacts.find(c => c.id === it.supplierId);
            const hall = it.hallId ? halls.find(h => h.id === it.hallId) : null;
            const myMovements = movements.filter(m => m.itemId === it.id);
            const isOpen = !ms.selectionMode && expandedId === it.id;
            return (
              <ItemCard
                key={it.id}
                it={it}
                i={i}
                hall={hall}
                sup={sup}
                myMovements={myMovements}
                isOpen={isOpen}
                ms={ms}
                onToggle={() => setExpandedId(isOpen ? null : it.id)}
                onEdit={() => openEdit(it)}
                onAdjust={() => adjustStock(it)}
                onDelete={deleteItem}
                        onArchive={() => archiveItem(it.id)}
                        onUnarchive={() => unarchiveItem(it.id)}
                onUndo={(item: any) => {
                  setUndoData({ item });
                  setTimeout(() => setUndoData((cur: any) => cur && cur.item.id === item.id ? null : cur), 6000);
                }}
              />
            );
          })}
        </>
      )}

      <MultiSelectBar ms={ms} deleteLabel="حذف" />

      {ms.selectionMode && <div style={{ height: 90 }} />}

      <ItemsFormModal
        open={open}
        setOpen={setOpen}
        form={form}
        setForm={setForm}
        vErrors={vErrors}
        showError={showError}
        markTouched={markTouched}
        err={err}
        suppliers={suppliers}
        halls={halls}
        currentStockForEdit={currentStockForEdit}
        save={save}
      />
          <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
        <Btn full variant="primary" onClick={() => {
          const headers = ['نام', 'دسته', 'واحد', 'موجودی', 'حداقل', 'قیمت'];
          const rows = list.map(it => [
            it.name,
            it.category,
            it.unit,
            it.currentStock || 0,
            it.minStock || 0,
            it.lastPrice || 0,
          ]);
          exportTableToCSV('انبار', headers, rows);
        }}>دانلود CSV</Btn>
      </div>
</PageContainer>
  );
}
