import { useFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import MoveFormModal from './components/MoveFormModal';
import { useFab } from '../../shr/hooks/useFab';
import { useWhs, UNIT_LABEL, MOVEMENT_REASON, CATEGORY_ICON, type Movement, type MovementType, type MovementReason } from './store';
import { formatQty } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { useCtc } from '../ctc/store';
import { Btn, Empty, PageContainer, Tag } from '../../shr/components/ui';;
import ExpandableCard from '../../shr/components/ExpandableCard';
import { useMultiSelect } from '../../shr/multiSelect/useMultiSelect';
import MultiSelectBar from '../../shr/multiSelect/MultiSelectBar';
import { toFa, toEn } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { recordHistory } from '../../shr/intelligence';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../cor/store/dialog';
import UndoBar from '../../cor/ui/UndoBar';
import { toastMsg } from '../../cor/store/toast';
import HelpBanner from '../../shr/components/HelpBanner';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Row, SectionTitle } from './helpers';
import { logAction } from '../../cor/logger/auditLog';
import { useValidation } from '../../shr/validation/useValidation';
import { useFilterSort, FilterBar, getWhsMovesConfig } from '../../shr/filter';
import { createMovementSchema } from '../../shr/validation/rules/whs';
import { useFormErrors } from '../../shr/hooks/useFormErrors';

export interface F {
  id?: string;
  itemId: string;
  type: MovementType;
  quantity: string;
  unitPrice: string;
  reason: MovementReason;
  date: string;
  partyId: string;
  notes: string;
}

const REASONS_BY_TYPE: Record<MovementType, MovementReason[]> = {
  in:  ['purchase', 'gift', 'return', 'adjustment'],
  out: ['consumption', 'gift', 'loss', 'return', 'adjustment'],
  adjust: ['adjustment'],
};

export default function MovesPage({ active = true }: { active?: boolean } = {}) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { items, movements, addMovement, deleteMovement } = useWhs();
  const { contacts } = useCtc();

  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<F>({
    itemId: '', type: 'in', quantity: '', unitPrice: '',
    reason: 'purchase', date: '', partyId: '', notes: ''
  });
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [undoData, setUndoData] = useState<{ item: Movement | Movement[] } | null>(null);
  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // ─── فیلتر / مرتب‌سازی (از config مرکزی) ───
  const config = useMemo(
    () => getWhsMovesConfig({ items }),
    [items]
  );

  const { filtered: list, filters, setFilter, clearFilter,
          sort, setSort, toggleSort, resetAll, hasActiveFilters,
          total, count } = useFilterSort<Movement>({
    items: movements,
    filters: config.filterDefs,
    sorts: config.sortDefs,
    persistKey: config.persistKey,
    initialSort: config.initialSort,
  });

  // ─── Multi-Select ───
  const ms = useMultiSelect({
    items: list,
    getId: (x: Movement) => x.id,
    onDelete: async (ids: string[]) => {
      const ok = await showConfirmAsync('حذف گروهی', fmt.count(ids.length) + ' تراکنش حذف شوند؟', { danger: true });
      if (!ok) return;
      const backups: Movement[] = [];
      for (const id of ids) {
        const it = movements.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (!it) continue;
        backups.push(it);
        try { deleteMovement(id); } catch {}
      }
      if (backups.length > 0) {
        setUndoData({ item: backups });
        setTimeout(() => setUndoData((cur) => cur && Array.isArray(cur.item) && cur.item.length === backups.length ? null : cur), 8000);
      }
      toastMsg.deletedBulk(backups.length, 'تراکنش')
    },
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (ms.selectionMode) setExpandedId(null);
  }, [ms.selectionMode]);

  const undoDelete = () => {
    if (!undoData) return;
    const raw = undoData?.item;
    const arr: Movement[] = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : raw ? [raw] : [];
    try {
      for (const it of arr) {
        try { addMovement(it); } catch {}
      }
      toastMsg.restoredBulk(arr.length, 'مورد')
    } catch { toastMsg.error('بازگردانی ناموفق') }
    setUndoData(null);
  };

  const openNew = () => {
    if (items.length === 0) { toastMsg.error('اول یک قلم در انبار بسازید'); return; }
    setForm({
      itemId: items[0].id, type: 'in', quantity: '', unitPrice: '',
      reason: 'purchase', date: '', partyId: '', notes: ''
    });
    setErr(''); reset(); setOpen(true);
  };
  useFab(active && movements.length > 0 ? { label: 'ثبت تراکنش', onClick: openNew } : null);

  const openEdit = (m: Movement) => {
    setForm({
      id: m.id, itemId: m.itemId, type: m.type,
      quantity: m.quantity ? fmt.code(m.quantity) : '',
      unitPrice: m.unitPrice ? fmt.code(m.unitPrice) : '',
      reason: m.reason, date: m.date,
      partyId: m.partyId || '', notes: m.notes || ''
    });
    setErr(''); reset(); setOpen(true);
  };

  const num = (s: string) => s ? parseFloat(toEn(s).replace('٫','.')) || 0 : 0;

  // ═══ اعتبارسنجی زنده ═══
  const { errors: vErrors } = useValidation(
    createMovementSchema(),
    {
      itemId: form.itemId || '',
      type: form.type,
      quantity: num(form.quantity),
      unitPrice: num(form.unitPrice),
      reason: form.reason,
      date: form.date || '',
      partyId: form.partyId || '',
      notes: form.notes || '',
      flockId: '',
      sourceModule: 'manual',
      sourceId: '',
      batchNo: '',
    },
  );

  const selectedItem = items.find(i => i.id === form.itemId);
  const currentStock = selectedItem ? selectedItem.currentStock : 0;

  const { showError, markTouched, attemptSave, reset } = useFormErrors(vErrors);

  const save = async () => {
    attemptSave();
    if (Object.keys(vErrors).length > 0) return;

    const qty = num(form.quantity);
    if (form.type === 'out' && qty > currentStock) {
      const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
        '⚠️ موجودی کافی نیست',
        `موجودی فعلی: ${selectedItem ? formatQty(currentStock, selectedItem.unit) : ''}\n` +
        `مقدار خروج: ${fmt.num(qty)}\n\n` +
        `با ثبت این گردش، موجودی منفی می‌شود. ادامه می‌دهید؟`,
        { danger: true }
      );
      if (!ok) return;
    }

    const data = {
      itemId: form.itemId,
      type: form.type,
      quantity: qty,
      unitPrice: num(form.unitPrice),
      reason: form.reason,
      date: form.date.trim(),
      partyId: form.partyId,
      notes: form.notes.trim()
    };

    addMovement(data);
    // 🆕 ثبت تاریخچه برای Intelligence
    try {
      const qty = num(form.quantity);
      if (selectedItem && qty !== null && Number.isFinite(qty) && qty > 0) {
        recordHistory(`whs.qty_${selectedItem.unit}`, qty, { itemId: form.itemId });
      }
    } catch { /* silent */ }
    setOpen(false);
  };

    // فیلتر مخاطبین بر اساس دلیل
  const isPurchase = form.reason === 'purchase';
  const isSale = form.reason === 'sale';
  const isAdjustment = form.reason === 'adjustment';
  const filteredContacts = isPurchase
    ? contacts.filter(c => c.roles.includes('supplier'))
    : isSale
      ? contacts.filter(c => c.roles.includes('customer'))
      : contacts.filter(c => c.roles.includes('customer') || c.roles.includes('supplier'));
  const partyRequired = isPurchase || isSale;
  const partyLabel = isPurchase
    ? 'فروشنده'
    : isSale
      ? 'مشتری'
      : 'طرف معامله';

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      {undoData && (
        <UndoBar
          label={(() => {
            const raw = undoData?.item;
            const arr: Movement[] = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : raw ? [raw] : [];
            if (arr.length === 1) {
              const it = arr[0];
              const name = it?.itemId ? (items.find(x => x.id === it.itemId)?.name || 'گردش') : 'گردش';
              return `«${name}» حذف شد`;
            }
            return `${fmt.count(arr.length)} گردش حذف شد`;
          })()}
          onUndo={undoDelete}
          onDismiss={() => setUndoData(null)}
        />
      )}
        <HelpBanner
          id="moves-intro"
          icon="⚠️"
          title="این صفحه فقط برای اصلاح دستی است"
          description="موارد استفاده — ضایعات (دان خراب شد)، شمارش دستی، هدیه، مرجوعی. برای خرید از فروشنده یا فروش به مشتری، از بخش «معاملات» استفاده کنید."
          tone="info"
        />
        <FilterBar
          filterDefs={config.filterDefs}

          sortState={sort}

import { useFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useFilterSort, FilterBar, getWhsWarningsConfig } from '../../shr/filter';
import { useWhs, UNIT_LABEL, stockWarning, expiryWarning, daysToExpiry, type Item } from './store';
import { Empty, PageContainer } from '../../shr/components/ui';
import { StatBox, Dot } from '../../shr/components/ExpandableCard';
import { toFa } from '../../shr/utils/fa';
import { WarningGroup } from './helpers';
import HelpBanner from '../../shr/components/HelpBanner';

export default function WarningsPage() {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { items } = useWhs();

  // ─── فیلتر/مرتب (از config مرکزی) ───
  const config = useMemo(() => getWhsWarningsConfig(), []);
  const { filtered, filters, setFilter, clearFilter, sort, setSort, toggleSort,
          resetAll, hasActiveFilters, total, count } = useFilterSort<Item>({
    items,
    filters: config.filterDefs,
    sorts: config.sortDefs,
    persistKey: config.persistKey,
    initialSort: config.initialSort,
  });

  // آیتم‌های هشدار دار (از filtered)
  const lowStock = useMemo(() => filtered.filter(i => stockWarning(i) === 'low'), [filtered]);
  const criticalStock = useMemo(() => filtered.filter(i => stockWarning(i) === 'critical'), [filtered]);
  const expiringSoon = useMemo(() => filtered.filter(i => expiryWarning(i) === 'soon'), [filtered]);
  const expired = useMemo(() => filtered.filter(i => expiryWarning(i) === 'expired'), [filtered]);

  const totalWarnings = lowStock.length + criticalStock.length + expiringSoon.length + expired.length;
  const noRawWarnings = items.filter(i => stockWarning(i) !== 'ok' || expiryWarning(i) !== 'ok').length === 0;

  if (noRawWarnings) {
    return (
      <PageContainer>
      <HelpBanner
        id="whs-warnings-guide"
        icon="⚠️"
        title="راهنمای هشدارهای انبار"
        description="اقلامی که موجودی‌شان به حد هشدار رسیده یا تاریخ انقضایشان نزدیک است اینجا نمایش داده می‌شوند تا پیش از کمبود یا فاسد شدن اقدام کنید."
        tone="info"
      />
        <Empty
          icon={<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg>}
          title="همه‌چیز مرتب است"
          desc="هیچ هشداری در انبار وجود ندارد."
        />
      </PageContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      <FilterBar
        filterDefs={config.filterDefs}
        sortDefs={config.sortDefs}
        filterState={filters}
        sortState={sort}
        setFilter={setFilter}
        clearFilter={clearFilter}
        setSort={setSort}
        toggleSort={toggleSort}
        resetAll={resetAll}
        hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
        total={total}
        count={count}
      />

      {totalWarnings === 0 ? (
        <Empty
          icon={<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><polygon points="22 3 2 3 10 12.46 10 19 14 21 14 12.46 22 3"/></svg>}
          title="نتیجه‌ای پیدا نشد"
          desc="هیچ هشداری با فیلترهای فعلی هم‌خوانی ندارد."
        />
      ) : (
      <>
      <div style={{
        padding: '14px 16px',
        background: 'var(--warn-soft)',
        border: '1px solid var(--warn)',
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)',
      }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', color: 'var(--warn)', fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 10 }}>
          ⚠ {fmt.count(totalWarnings)} هشدار
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 4 }}>
          <StatBox icon="⛔" label="منقضی" value={fmt.count(expired.length)} tone={expired.length > 0 ? 'danger' : 'default'} />
          <Dot />
          <StatBox icon="🔴" label="تمام‌شده" value={fmt.count(criticalStock.length)} tone={criticalStock.length > 0 ? 'danger' : 'default'} />
          <Dot />
          <StatBox icon="⏰" label="نزدیک انقضا" value={fmt.count(expiringSoon.length)} tone={expiringSoon.length > 0 ? 'warn' : 'default'} />
          <Dot />
          <StatBox icon="⚠" label="کم" value={fmt.count(lowStock.length)} tone={lowStock.length > 0 ? 'warn' : 'default'} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {expired.length > 0 ? (
        <WarningGroup
          title="منقضی‌شده"
          icon="⛔"
          color="red"
          items={expired}
          renderLine={(it) => `تاریخ انقضا گذشته — ${fmt.day(Math.abs(daysToExpiry(it.expireDate) || 0))} روز پیش`}
        />
      ) : null}

      {criticalStock.length > 0 ? (
        <WarningGroup
          title="موجودی تمام‌شده"
          icon="🔴"
          color="red"
          items={criticalStock}
          renderLine={(it) => `موجودی صفر — حداقل ${fmt.num(it.minStock)} ${UNIT_LABEL[it.unit]}`}
        />
      ) : null}

      {expiringSoon.length > 0 ? (
        <WarningGroup
          title="نزدیک انقضا"
          icon="⏰"
          color="amber"
          items={expiringSoon}
          renderLine={(it) => `${fmt.day(daysToExpiry(it.expireDate) || 0)} روز تا انقضا`}
        />
      ) : null}

      {lowStock.length > 0 ? (
        <WarningGroup
          title="موجودی کم"
          icon="⚠"
          color="amber"
          items={lowStock}
          renderLine={(it) => `${fmt.num(it.currentStock)} ${UNIT_LABEL[it.unit]} — حداقل ${fmt.num(it.minStock)}`}
        />
      ) : null}
      </>
      )}
    </PageContainer>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/mod/whs/archivePolicy.ts

import type { Item, Movement } from './store';

export interface MovementSplitResult {
  toArchive: Movement[];
  keep: Movement[];
  skipped: Movement[];
}

export interface MovementArchiveOptions {
  cutoffIso?: string;
  keepReasons?: Movement['reason'][];
}

const DEFAULT_KEEP_REASONS: Movement['reason'][] = [];

/**
 * تفکیک خالص حرکات انبار پیش از انتقال به مخزن whs_moves بر اساس مرز نقطه تراز (cutoffIso).
 * حرکات جدیدتر از cutoffIso (یا بدون تاریخ مشخص وقتی cutoffIso تنظیم شده) در keep می‌مانند
 * تا ترتیب زمانی محاسبه موجودی و میانگین موزون در hot مخدوش نشود.
 */
export function splitMovementsForArchive(
  movements: Movement[],
  _items: Item[],
  opts: MovementArchiveOptions = {}
): MovementSplitResult {
  const toArchive: Movement[] = [];
  const keep: Movement[] = [];
  const skipped: Movement[] = [];
  const keepReasons = new Set<Movement['reason']>(opts.keepReasons ?? DEFAULT_KEEP_REASONS);

  for (const mv of movements) {
    if (!mv || !mv.id || !mv.itemId) {
      skipped.push(mv);
      continue;
    }
    if (keepReasons.has(mv.reason)) {
      keep.push(mv);
      continue;
    }
    if (opts.cutoffIso) {
      const marker = mv.createdAt || mv.date || '';
      if (!marker || marker > opts.cutoffIso) {
        keep.push(mv);
        continue;
      }
    }
    toArchive.push(mv);
  }

  return { toArchive, keep, skipped };
}

/**
 * محاسبه نقطه تراز (Balance Checkpoint) پس از انتقال حرکات آرشیوشده به مخزن سرد.
 * اثر حرکات منتقل‌شده به ترتیب زمانی روی initialStock و initialStockByLocation تثبیت می‌شود
 * تا بازمحاسبه از روی حرکات باقی‌مانده در hot موجودی و میانگین یکسان تولید کند.
 */
export function applyMovementCheckpoint(item: Item, archivedMoves: Movement[]): Item {
  if (!archivedMoves.length) return item;

  const sorted = [...archivedMoves].sort((a, b) =>
    (a.createdAt || a.date || '').localeCompare(b.createdAt || b.date || '')
  );

  let stock = item.initialStock ?? 0;
  let avg = item.avgPrice ?? item.lastPrice ?? 0;
  let lastPrice = item.lastPrice ?? 0;
  const byLoc: Record<string, number> = {
    ...(item.initialStockByLocation ?? { stock: item.initialStock ?? 0 }),
  };

  for (const m of sorted) {
    const loc = m.locationId || 'stock';
    const curLoc = byLoc[loc] ?? 0;
    if (m.type === 'in') {
      if (m.unitPrice > 0 && stock + m.quantity > 0) {
        avg = (stock * avg + m.quantity * m.unitPrice) / (stock + m.quantity);
      }
      stock += m.quantity;
      byLoc[loc] = curLoc + m.quantity;
      if (m.unitPrice > 0) lastPrice = m.unitPrice;
    } else if (m.type === 'out') {
      stock -= m.quantity;
      byLoc[loc] = curLoc - m.quantity;
    } else {
      stock = m.quantity;
      byLoc[loc] = m.quantity;
    }
  }

  const totalLocStock = Object.values(byLoc).reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0);
  const nextInitialStock = Math.round(stock * 1000) / 1000;
  const nextByLoc: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(byLoc)) {
    nextByLoc[k] = Math.round(v * 1000) / 1000;
  }

  return {
    ...item,
    initialStock: nextInitialStock,
    initialStockByLocation: nextByLoc,
    currentStock: item.currentStock ?? Math.round(totalLocStock * 1000) / 1000,
    avgPrice: Math.round(avg * 100) / 100,
    lastPrice,
  };
}

/**
 * ItemCard — کارت نمایش قلم انبار
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { VET_METHOD_LABEL } from '../../../shr/constants/vetMethods';
import { Btn, Tag } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import ExpandableCard from '../../../shr/components/ExpandableCard';
import { Row, SectionTitle } from '../helpers';
import { CATEGORY_ICON, CATEGORY_LABEL, UNIT_LABEL, STORAGE_LABEL, stockWarning, expiryWarning, daysToExpiry, getAvgPrice } from '../store';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../../cor/store/dialog';
import { toastMsg } from '../../../cor/store/toast';
import { logAction } from '../../../cor/logger/auditLog';
import { formatQty } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { CardActions } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import { ACTION_PRESETS } from '../../../shr/constants/cardActions';

const EQUIP_STATUS: Record<string, string> = {
  active: 'فعال', repair: 'در تعمیر', scrapped: 'اسقاط',
};

export interface ItemCardProps {
  it: any;
  i: number;
  hall: any;
  sup: any;
  myMovements: any[];
  isOpen: boolean;
  ms: any;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onAdjust: () => void;
  onDelete: (id: string) => void;
  onUndo: (item: any) => void;
  onArchive?: () => void;
  onUnarchive?: () => void;
}

export default function ItemCard(props: ItemCardProps) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { it, i, hall, sup, myMovements, isOpen, ms, onToggle, onEdit, onAdjust, onDelete, onUndo, onArchive, onUnarchive } = props;

  const stock = stockWarning(it);
  const exp = expiryWarning(it);
  const days = daysToExpiry(it.expireDate);

  let accent: 'accent' | 'warn' | 'dim' = 'accent';
  if (stock === 'critical' || exp === 'expired') accent = 'warn';
  else if (stock === 'low' || exp === 'soon') accent = 'warn';
  else if (it.currentStock === 0) accent = 'dim';

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync('تأیید حذف', 'این مورد حذف شود؟', { danger: true });
    if (!ok) return;
    onUndo(it);
    onDelete(it.id);
    logAction('delete', 'whs', 'حذف از انبار');
    toastMsg.deleted(it.name);
  };

  const handleArchive = async () => {
    const movementCount = myMovements?.length || 0;
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync(
      '⚠️ آرشیو کالا',
      `این کالا ${fmt.count(movementCount)} گردش انبار دارد و قابل حذف کامل نیست.\n\nبا آرشیو، از لیست پنهان می‌شود ولی تمام تاریخچه حفظ می‌شود.`,
      { confirmText: 'آرشیو کن', cancelText: 'انصراف', danger: false }
    );
    if (!ok) return;
    onArchive?.();
    logAction('update', 'whs', 'آرشیو کالا');
    toastMsg.deleted(it.name);
  };

  return (
    <ExpandableCard key={it.id} id={it.id} ms={ms} accent={accent} index={fmt.count(i + 1)}
      iconEmoji={(CATEGORY_ICON as any)[it.category]} title={it.name}
      subtitle={`${(CATEGORY_LABEL as any)[it.category]} • ${formatQty(it.currentStock, it.unit)}`}
      isOpen={isOpen} onToggle={onToggle}
      badge={
        it.currentStock < 0 ? <Tag tone="red">منفی</Tag> :
        stock === 'critical' ? <Tag tone="red">تمام شد</Tag> :
        stock === 'low' ? <Tag tone="amber">کم</Tag> :
        exp === 'expired' ? <Tag tone="red">منقضی</Tag> :
        exp === 'soon' ? <Tag tone="amber">نزدیک انقضا</Tag> :
        <Tag tone="green">موجود</Tag>
      }
      stats={<>
        <span>موجودی: <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{formatQty(it.currentStock, it.unit)}</b></span>
        {it.minStock > 0 ? <span>حد: <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.num(it.minStock)}</b></span> : null}
        {it.lastPrice > 0 ? <span>ارزش: <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.money(it.currentStock * getAvgPrice(it))}</b></span> : null}
      </>}
    >
      <SectionTitle>📦 مشخصات قلم</SectionTitle>
      <Row l="دسته" v={(CATEGORY_LABEL as any)[it.category]} />
      <Row l="واحد" v={(UNIT_LABEL as any)[it.unit]} />
      <Row l="موجودی فعلی" v={formatQty(it.currentStock, it.unit)} />
      {it.minStock > 0 ? <Row l="حداقل موجودی" v={`${fmt.num(it.minStock)} ${(UNIT_LABEL as any)[it.unit]}`} /> : null}
      {it.avgPrice && it.avgPrice > 0 ? <Row l="💰 قیمت میانگین" v={fmt.money(getAvgPrice(it))} /> : null}
      {it.lastPrice > 0 ? <Row l="آخرین قیمت خرید" v={fmt.money(it.lastPrice)} /> : null}
      {sup ? <Row l="تأمین‌کننده" v={sup.name} /> : null}

      {it.currentStock > 0 && it.lastPrice > 0 ? (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--accent-soft)', color: 'var(--accent)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
          <span>ارزش موجودی:</span>
          <span>{fmt.money(it.currentStock * getAvgPrice(it))}</span>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {(it.category === 'medicine' || it.category === 'vaccine') ? (
        <>
          <SectionTitle>💊 اطلاعات دارویی</SectionTitle>
          {it.expireDate ? <Row l="تاریخ انقضا" v={fmt.date(it.expireDate)} /> : null}
          {days !== null ? (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: days < 0 ? 'var(--danger-soft)' : days <= 30 ? 'var(--warn-soft)' : 'var(--input-bg)', color: days < 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : days <= 30 ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--muted)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
              <span>وضعیت انقضا:</span>
              <span>{days < 0 ? `${fmt.day(Math.abs(days))} روز گذشته` : `${fmt.day(days)} روز مانده`}</span>
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {it.withdrawalDays !== null && it.withdrawalDays !== undefined ? <Row l="دوره منع مصرف" v={`${fmt.day(it.withdrawalDays)} روز`} /> : null}
          {it.storage ? <Row l="نگهداری" v={(STORAGE_LABEL as any)[it.storage] || it.storage} /> : null}
          {(() => {
    const arr: string[] = (it as any).usageTypes || ((it as any).usageType ? [(it as any).usageType] : []);
    if (arr.length === 0) return null;
    return <Row l="نوع مصرف" v={arr.map((t: string) => VET_METHOD_LABEL[t] || t).join(' • ')} />;
  })()}
          {it.dosePerBird ? <Row l="دوز هر پرنده" v={`${fmt.num(it.dosePerBird)} ml`} /> : null}
          {it.productionDate ? <Row l="تاریخ تولید" v={fmt.date(it.productionDate)} /> : null}
        </>
      ) : null}

      {it.category === 'equipment' ? (
        <>
          <SectionTitle>🔧 اطلاعات تجهیزات</SectionTitle>
          {it.purchaseDate ? <Row l="تاریخ خرید" v={fmt.date(it.purchaseDate)} /> : null}
          {it.purchasePrice ? <Row l="قیمت خرید" v={fmt.money(it.purchasePrice)} /> : null}
          {hall ? <Row l="سالن" v={hall.name} /> : null}
          {it.equipmentStatus ? <Row l="وضعیت" v={EQUIP_STATUS[it.equipmentStatus] || it.equipmentStatus} /> : null}
          {it.warrantyUntil ? <Row l="گارانتی تا" v={fmt.date(it.warrantyUntil)} /> : null}
        </>
      ) : null}

      {myMovements.length > 0 ? (
        <>
          <SectionTitle>📋 آخرین گردش‌ها ({fmt.count(myMovements.length)})</SectionTitle>
          {myMovements.slice(-3).reverse().map((m) => (
            <div key={m.id} style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', padding: 'var(--pad-tight)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
              <span>{m.type === 'in' ? '📥' : '📤'} {formatQty(m.quantity, it.unit)}</span>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)' }}>{fmt.date(m.date)}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </>
      ) : null}

      {it.notes ? (
        <>
          <SectionTitle>📝 یادداشت</SectionTitle>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', lineHeight: 1.7, padding: 'var(--pad-normal)', background: 'var(--input-bg)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}>{it.notes}</div>
        </>
      ) : null}

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, paddingTop: 4 }}>
        <CardActions actions={(() => {
          const hasMovements = myMovements && myMovements.length > 0;
          const baseActions = [
            { ...ACTION_PRESETS.CORRECT, onClick: onAdjust },
            { ...ACTION_PRESETS.EDIT, onClick: onEdit },
          ];
          if (it.archived) {
            return [...baseActions, { ...ACTION_PRESETS.RESTORE, onClick: () => onUnarchive?.() }];
          }
          if (hasMovements) {
            return [...baseActions, { ...ACTION_PRESETS.ARCHIVE, onClick: handleArchive }];
          }
          return [...baseActions, { ...ACTION_PRESETS.DELETE, onClick: handleDelete }];
        })()} />
      </div>
    </ExpandableCard>
  );
}

          <Grid2>

/**
 * MoveFormModal — فرم افزودن/ویرایش حرکت انبار
 */
import { useFormat } from '../../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { Btn, BtnRow, Field, Grid2, Modal, MoneyField, NumField, Select, Textarea, ErrorBox } from '../../../shr/components/ui';
import DatePicker from '../../../shr/components/DatePicker';
import SmartSelect from '../../../shr/components/SmartSelect';
import { toFa } from '../../../shr/utils/fa';
import { FieldHint } from '../../../shr/intelligence';
import { MOVEMENT_REASON, UNIT_LABEL, CATEGORY_ICON, CATEGORY_LABEL, type MovementType, type MovementReason, type Item } from '../store';
import type { Person } from '../../ctc/store';
import type { F } from '../MovesPage';
import type React from 'react';

const REASONS_BY_TYPE: Record<MovementType, MovementReason[]> = {
  in: ['purchase', 'gift', 'return', 'adjustment'],
  out: ['consumption', 'sale', 'loss', 'gift', 'adjustment'],
  adjust: ['adjustment'],
};

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (v: boolean) => void;
  form: F;
  setForm: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<F>>;
  err: string;
  vErrors: Record<string, string>;
  showError?: (field: string) => string | undefined;
  markTouched?: (field: string) => void;
  items: Item[];
  filteredContacts: Person[];
  onSave: () => void;
}

export default function MoveFormModal(props: Props) {
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const { open, setOpen, form, setForm, err, vErrors, showError, markTouched, items, filteredContacts, onSave } = props;

  const selectedItem = items.find((i) => i.id === form.itemId);
  const currentStock = selectedItem?.currentStock || 0;
  const isAdjustment = form.type === 'adjust';
  const isPurchase = form.reason === 'purchase';
  const isSale = form.reason === 'sale';
  const partyRequired = form.reason === 'purchase' || form.reason === 'sale';
  const partyLabel = form.reason === 'purchase' ? 'تأمین‌کننده' : form.reason === 'sale' ? 'مشتری' : 'طرف';

  return (
      <Modal
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        title="ثبت گردش انبار"
        footer={<BtnRow><Btn variant="primary" onClick={onSave}>ذخیره</Btn><Btn onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>لغو</Btn></BtnRow>}
      >
        <Grid2>
          <Field label="نوع گردش" required error={showError?.('type')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('type')}>
            <Select value={form.type} onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
              const newType = e.target.value as MovementType;
              const validReasons = REASONS_BY_TYPE[newType];
              const newReason = validReasons.includes(form.reason) ? form.reason : validReasons[0];
              setForm({ ...form, type: newType, reason: newReason });
            }}>
              <option value="in">📥 ورود به انبار</option>
              <option value="out">📤 خروج از انبار</option>
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="دلیل" required error={showError?.('reason')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('reason')}>
            <Select value={form.reason} onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => setForm({ ...form, reason: e.target.value as MovementReason })}>
              {REASONS_BY_TYPE[form.type].map((r) =>
                <option key={r} value={r}>{MOVEMENT_REASON[r]}</option>
              )}
            </Select>
          </Field>
        </Grid2>

        <Field label="کالا" required hint={selectedItem ? `موجودی فعلی — ${fmt.num(currentStock)} ${UNIT_LABEL[selectedItem.unit]}` : undefined} error={showError?.('itemId')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('itemId')}>
          <SmartSelect
            value={form.itemId}
            onChange={v => setForm({ ...form, itemId: v })}
            options={items.map(it => ({
              value: it.id,
              label: it.name,
              subtitle: `${fmt.num(it.currentStock)} ${UNIT_LABEL[it.unit]}`,
              group: it.category,
            }))}
            groupLabels={Object.fromEntries(
              Object.entries(CATEGORY_LABEL).map(([k, v]) => [k, v])
            ) as Record<string, string>}
            groupIcons={Object.fromEntries(
              Object.entries(CATEGORY_ICON).map(([k, v]) => [k, v])
            ) as Record<string, string>}
            placeholder="— انتخاب کالا —"
            modalTitle="انتخاب کالای انبار"
          />
        </Field>

        <Grid2>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Field label="تعداد" required error={showError?.('quantity')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('quantity')}>
              <NumField placeholder="مثلاً — ۱۰۰"
                value={form.quantity}
                onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => setForm({ ...form, quantity: e.target.value })}
                unit={selectedItem ? UNIT_LABEL[selectedItem.unit] : ''}
                max={form.type === 'out' ? currentStock : undefined} min={0} />
            </Field>
            {!showError?.('quantity') && <FieldHint fieldPath={selectedItem ? `whs.qty_${selectedItem.unit}` : ''} value={form.quantity} context={{ itemId: form.itemId }} />}
          </div>
          <Field label="قیمت واحد">
            <MoneyField placeholder="مثلاً — ۵۰٬۰۰۰" value={form.unitPrice} onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => setForm({ ...form, unitPrice: e.target.value })} />
          </Field>
        </Grid2>

        {!isAdjustment ? (
          <Grid2>
            <Field label="تاریخ" required error={showError?.('date')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('date')}>
              <DatePicker value={form.date} onChange={v => setForm({ ...form, date: v })}  autoToday />
            </Field>
            <Field
              label={partyLabel}
              required={partyRequired}
              hint={partyRequired ? undefined : 'اختیاری'}
              error={partyRequired ? showError?.('partyId') : undefined}
              onTouch={() => partyRequired && markTouched?.('partyId')}
            >
              {filteredContacts.length === 0 ? (
                <div style={{
                  padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
                  background: 'var(--warn-soft)',
                  border: '1px dashed var(--warn)',
                  borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
                  fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
                  color: 'var(--warn)',
                  fontWeight: 600,
                }}>
                  {isPurchase ? 'هیچ فروشنده‌ای تعریف نشده' : isSale ? 'هیچ مشتری‌ای تعریف نشده' : 'مخاطبی تعریف نشده'}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <SmartSelect
                  value={form.partyId}
                  onChange={v => setForm({ ...form, partyId: v })}
                  options={filteredContacts.map(c => ({
                    value: c.id,
                    label: c.name,
                    subtitle: c.roles.length > 0
                      ? c.roles.map((r) => r === 'customer' ? 'مشتری' : r === 'supplier' ? 'فروشنده' : 'کارگر').join('، ')
                      : undefined,
                  }))}
                  placeholder={partyRequired ? `— انتخاب ${partyLabel} —` : '— بدون مخاطب —'}
                  modalTitle={`انتخاب ${partyLabel}`}
                />
              )}
            </Field>
          </Grid2>
        ) : (
          <Field label="تاریخ" required error={showError?.('date')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('date')}>
            <DatePicker value={form.date} onChange={v => setForm({ ...form, date: v })}  autoToday />
          </Field>
        )}

        <Field label="یادداشت" error={showError?.('notes')} onTouch={() => markTouched?.('notes')}>
            <Textarea placeholder="..." value={form.notes} onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => setForm({ ...form, notes: e.target.value })} />
          </Field>

        {err && <ErrorBox>{err}</ErrorBox>}
      </Modal>
  );
}

import { bus } from '../../cor/events';
import { useWhs } from './store';
import type { TraInvoiceItemRef } from '../../cor/events/events';

/**
 * applyInvoiceMovements — اثر فاکتور روی انبار
 * movementId روی رفرنس items ست می‌شود (mutable ref).
 */
function applyInvoiceMovements(
  invoice: any,
  items: TraInvoiceItemRef[],
  prevItems?: TraInvoiceItemRef[],
): void {
  const whs = useWhs.getState();

  if (prevItems) {
    prevItems.forEach(it => {
      if (it.movementId) {
        try { whs.deleteMovement(it.movementId); } catch (e) {}
      }
    });
  }

  items.forEach(it => {
    // UoM: اگر baseQuantity مثبت باشد، از آن استفاده کن (مثلاً 1000 کیسه × 50kg = 50000 kg)
    const qty = (it.baseQuantity && it.baseQuantity > 0) ? it.baseQuantity : it.quantity;
    if (!it.itemId || !qty || qty <= 0) {
      it.movementId = '';
      return;
    }
    try {
      const mid = whs.addMovement({
        itemId: it.itemId,
        type: invoice.type === 'purchase' ? 'in' : 'out',
        quantity: qty,
        unitPrice: it.unitPrice || 0,
        reason: invoice.type === 'purchase' ? 'purchase' : 'sale',
        date: invoice.deliveryDate || invoice.date,
        partyId: invoice.partyId || '',
        notes: `فاکتور ${invoice.number || ''} — ${it.description || ''}`,
        expiryDate: it.expiryDate || undefined,
        flockId: it.flockId || undefined,
        sourceModule: 'tra',
        sourceId: invoice.id,
      });
      it.movementId = mid;
    } catch (e) {
      it.movementId = '';
      try { console.error('[whs] addMovement failed:', e); } catch {}
    }
  });
}

function deleteInvoiceMovements(items: TraInvoiceItemRef[]): void {
  const whs = useWhs.getState();
  items.forEach(it => {
    if (it.movementId) {
      try { whs.deleteMovement(it.movementId); } catch (e) {}
    }
  });
}

// ⚠️ Note: tra:invoice:* handlers حذف شدن — cascade از طریق applyInvoiceStock مستقیم انجام می‌شه.
// اگه روزی Event Bus واقعی لازم شد، اول تست کامل بنویس تا double application رخ نده.
export function registerWhsHandlers(): () => void {
  // No-op — هم‌اکنون هیچ event ای از tra گوش نمی‌دیم.
  // registerEggWhsHandlers برای egg:production:* استفاده می‌شه.
  return () => {};
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// egg:production:* — cascade تخم به انبار
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════

const EGG_NAME_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  eating: 'تخم مرغ',
  fertile: 'تخم نطفه‌دار',
  consumption: 'تخم شکسته',
};

function ensureEggItem(kind: 'eating' | 'fertile' | 'consumption'): string {
  const name = EGG_NAME_MAP[kind];
  const whs = useWhs.getState();
  const targetCat = kind === 'consumption' ? 'broken' : 'egg';
  const found = whs.items.find((i: any) => i.category === targetCat && i.name === name);
  if (found) return found.id;
  const newId = whs.addItem({
    name,
    category: targetCat as any,
    unit: 'pcs',
    minStock: 0,
    currentStock: 0,
    lastPrice: 0,
    supplierId: '',
    expireDate: '',
    withdrawalDays: null,
    batchNo: '',
    storage: 'room',
    notes: 'ساخته‌شده خودکار توسط ماژول تخم',
  } as any);
  return newId || '';
}

function eggApplyCascade(productionId: string, p: any): void {
  const consumptionCount = (p.brokenCount || 0) + (p.softCount || 0) + (p.dirtyCount || 0);
  const whs = useWhs.getState();

  if (p.eatingCount > 0) {
    const itemId = ensureEggItem('eating');
    if (itemId) {
      const mid = useWhs.getState().addMovement({
        itemId, type: 'in', quantity: p.eatingCount, unitPrice: 0,
        reason: 'adjustment', date: p.date, partyId: '',
        notes: 'تولید تخم — خوراکی',
        flockId: p.flockId, sourceModule: 'egg', sourceId: productionId,
      });
      p.eatingMovementId = mid || '';
    }
  }
  if (p.fertileCount > 0) {
    const itemId = ensureEggItem('fertile');
    if (itemId) {
      const mid = useWhs.getState().addMovement({
        itemId, type: 'in', quantity: p.fertileCount, unitPrice: 0,
        reason: 'adjustment', date: p.date, partyId: '',
        notes: 'تولید تخم — نطفه‌دار',
        flockId: p.flockId, sourceModule: 'egg', sourceId: productionId,
      });
      p.fertileMovementId = mid || '';
    }
  }
  if (consumptionCount > 0) {
    const itemId = ensureEggItem('consumption');
    if (itemId) {
      const mid = useWhs.getState().addMovement({
        itemId, type: 'in', quantity: consumptionCount, unitPrice: 0,
        reason: 'adjustment', date: p.date, partyId: '',
        notes: 'تخم مصرفی',
        flockId: p.flockId, sourceModule: 'egg', sourceId: productionId,
      });
      p.consumptionMovementId = mid || '';
    }
  }
}

function eggDeleteCascade(prev: any): void {
  const whs = useWhs.getState();
  if (prev.eatingMovementId) { try { whs.deleteMovement(prev.eatingMovementId); } catch (e) { throw e; } }
  if (prev.fertileMovementId) { try { whs.deleteMovement(prev.fertileMovementId); } catch (e) { throw e; } }
  if (prev.consumptionMovementId) { try { whs.deleteMovement(prev.consumptionMovementId); } catch (e) { throw e; } }
}

export function registerEggWhsHandlers(): () => void {
  const off1 = bus.on('egg:production:created', (data) => {
    try {
      if (!data.production) return;
      eggApplyCascade(data.prodId, data.production);
    } catch (e) { console.error('[whs] egg created failed:', e); throw e; }
  });
  const off2 = bus.on('egg:production:updated', (data) => {
    try {
      if (data.prevProduction) eggDeleteCascade(data.prevProduction);
      if (data.production) eggApplyCascade(data.prodId, data.production);
    } catch (e) { console.error('[whs] egg updated failed:', e); throw e; }
  });
  const off3 = bus.on('egg:production:deleted', (data) => {
    try {
      if (data.production) eggDeleteCascade(data.production);
    } catch (e) { console.error('[whs] egg deleted failed:', e); throw e; }
  });
  return () => { off1(); off2(); off3(); };
}

import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';

import type { ReactNode, CSSProperties } from 'react';

import { CATEGORY_ICON, type Item } from './store';
export { Row } from '../../shr/components/ui';


export { SectionTitle } from '../../shr/components/ui';

export { chipStyle as chip } from '../../shr/utils/chipStyle';

export function WarningGroup({ title, icon, color, items, renderLine }: {
  title: string;
  icon: string;
  color: 'red' | 'amber';
  items: Item[];
  renderLine: (it: Item) => string;
}) {
  const tone: 'red' | 'amber' = color;

  return (
    <div style={{
      background: 'var(--card)',
      border: '1px solid var(--border)',
      borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)',
    }}>
      <div style={{
        padding: '12px 16px',
        borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10
      }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-lg)' }}>{icon}</span>
        <div style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700 }}>{title}</div>
        <Tag tone={tone}>{getGlobalFormat().count(items.length)}</Tag>
      </div>

      {items.map(it => (
        <div
          key={it.id}
          style={{
            padding: '10px 16px',
            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10,
            borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)'
          }}
        >
          <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', flexShrink: 0 }}>{CATEGORY_ICON[it.category]}</span>
          <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <div style={{
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 600,
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            }}>
              {it.name}
            </div>
            <div style={{
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 2,
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            }}>
              {renderLine(it)}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/**

import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../shr/units/useFormat';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useCarousel } from '../../shr/hooks/useCarousel';
import ItemsPage from './ItemsPage';
import MovesPage from './MovesPage';
import WarningsPage from './WarningsPage';
import { useWhs, stockWarning, expiryWarning } from './store';
import { toFa } from '../../shr/utils/fa';

const tabs = [
  { id: 'items', label: 'اقلام' },
  { id: 'moves', label: 'ورود/خروج' },
  { id: 'warnings', label: 'هشدارها' },
] as const;

type TabId = typeof tabs[number]['id'];

const TAB_IDS = ['items', 'moves', 'warnings'];

export default function Whs() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<TabId>('items');
  const tabsBarRef = useAutoCenterTab(tab);
  const { items } = useWhs();
  const warnCount = items.filter(i =>
    stockWarning(i) !== 'ok' || expiryWarning(i) !== 'ok'
  ).length;

  const { containerRef, trackRef, setInstant } = useCarousel(
    TAB_IDS,
    tab,
    (id) => setTab(id as TabId)
  );

  return (
    <div>
      <div ref={tabsBarRef} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 0, borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
        padding: '0 8px',
        background: 'var(--header-bg)',
        position: 'sticky', top: 52, zIndex: 11,
        overflowX: 'auto', scrollbarWidth: 'none',
      }}>
        {tabs.map(t => (
          <div
            key={t.id}
            data-tab-id={t.id}
            onClick={() => { setInstant(); setTab(t.id); }}
            style={{
              padding: '11px 12px',
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)',
              fontWeight: 600,
              color: tab === t.id ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              position: 'relative',
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5,
            }}
          >
            <span>{t.label}</span>
            {t.id === 'warnings' && warnCount > 0 ? (
              <span style={{
                fontSize: 12,
                background: 'var(--danger)',
                color: '#fff',
                padding: '1px 6px',
                borderRadius: 8,
                fontWeight: 700,
              }}>{getGlobalFormat().count(warnCount)}</span>
            ) : null}
            {tab === t.id ? (
              <div style={{
                position: 'absolute', bottom: 0,
                right: 12, left: 12, height: 3,
                background: 'var(--accent)',
                borderRadius: '3px 3px 0 0',
              }} />
            ) : null}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div
        ref={containerRef}
        style={{
          overflow: 'hidden',
          overflowX: 'hidden',
          width: '100%',
                    isolation: 'isolate',
          touchAction: 'pan-y',
        }}
      >
        <div
          ref={trackRef}
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            direction: 'ltr',
            willChange: 'transform',
            touchAction: 'pan-y',
            width: '100%',
            minWidth: 0,
          }}
        >
          <div key="items" style={{ flex: '0 0 100%', width: '100%', minWidth: 0, maxWidth: '100%', direction: 'rtl', overflow: 'hidden', boxSizing: 'border-box', isolation: 'isolate' }}>
            <ItemsPage active={tab === 'items'} />
          </div>
          <div key="moves" style={{ flex: '0 0 100%', width: '100%', minWidth: 0, maxWidth: '100%', direction: 'rtl', overflow: 'hidden', boxSizing: 'border-box', isolation: 'isolate' }}>
            <MovesPage active={tab === 'moves'} />
          </div>
          <div key="warnings" style={{ flex: '0 0 100%', width: '100%', minWidth: 0, maxWidth: '100%', direction: 'rtl', overflow: 'hidden', boxSizing: 'border-box', isolation: 'isolate' }}>
            <WarningsPage />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { parse as parseJ, differenceInCalendarDays as diffCalDays, startOfDay } from 'date-fns-jalali';
import { persist, createJSONStorage } from 'zustand/middleware';
import { zustandHybridStorage } from '../../cor/storage/hybridStorage';
import { v4 as uuid } from 'uuid';
import { validate } from '../../shr/validation/helpers';
import { createItemSchema, createMovementSchema } from '../../shr/validation/rules/whs';
import { getBaseUnit } from '../../shr/units/uom';

export type ItemCategory = 'feed' | 'medicine' | 'vaccine' | 'herbal' | 'equipment' | 'consumable' | 'egg' | 'manure' | 'broken';
export type ItemUnit = 'kg' | 'g' | 'L' | 'l' | 'ml' | 'pcs' | 'vial' | 'pack' | 'ton' | 'bag' | 'dose';
export type MovementType = 'in' | 'out' | 'adjust';
export type MovementReason = 'purchase' | 'consumption' | 'sale' | 'gift' | 'loss' | 'adjustment' | 'return';

export interface Item {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: ItemCategory;
  feedType?: string;
  brand?: string;
  protein?: number | null;
  energy?: number | null;
  fat?: number | null;
  fiber?: number | null;
  calcium?: number | null;
  phosphorus?: number | null;
  methionine?: number | null;
  lysine?: number | null;
  unit: ItemUnit;
  /** 🆕 واحدهای فرعی اختصاصی (مثلاً کیسه ۱۰ کیلویی برای یک آیتم خاص) */
  subUnits?: { name: string; factor: number }[];
  minStock: number;
  currentStock: number;
  lastPrice: number;
  /** میانگین موزون قیمت (fallback: lastPrice) */
  avgPrice?: number;
  supplierId: string;
  expireDate: string;
  withdrawalDays: number | null;  // فقط برای دارو
  /** کد منبع برای شماره بچ خودکار (مثلاً ND برای نیوکاسل) */
  sourceCode?: string;
  storage: string;                 // fridge | freezer | room
  notes: string;
  // ─── فیلدهای تجهیزات (اختیاری) ───
  purchaseDate?: string;           // تاریخ خرید
  purchasePrice?: number;          // قیمت خرید کل
  hallId?: string;                 // سالن محل استقرار
  equipmentStatus?: string;        // active | repair | scrapped
  warrantyUntil?: string;          // گارانتی تا
  // ─── فیلدهای دارو/واکسن ───
  usageType?: string;              // deprecated
  usageTypes?: string[];           // آرایه
  archived?: boolean;              // آرشیو شده (از لیست پنهان، تاریخچه حفظ)
  productionDate?: string;         // تاریخ تولید
  dosePerBird?: number;            // دوز مصرفی هر پرنده
  dosePerLiter?: number | null;    // دوز در هر لیتر آب (آشامیدنی)
  dosePerKgFeed?: number | null;   // دوز در هر کیلوگرم دان (مخلوط با دان)
  /** موجودی اولیه هنگام ایجاد — پایه راستی‌آزمایی */
  initialStock?: number;
  /** قیمت موجودی اولیه (برای میانگین موزون) */
  initialPrice?: number;
  /** 🆕 Phase G-1: موجودی جاری به تفکیک موقعیت */
  stockByLocation?: Record<string, number>;
  /** 🆕 Phase G-1: موجودی اولیه به تفکیک موقعیت */
  initialStockByLocation?: Record<string, number>;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export interface Movement {
  id: string;
  itemId: string;
  type: MovementType;
  quantity: number;
  unitPrice: number;
  reason: MovementReason;
  date: string;
  partyId: string;
  notes: string;
  createdAt: string;
  /** 🆕 رهگیری: کدوم گله */
  flockId?: string;
  /** 🆕 رهگیری: از کدوم ماژول اومده */
  sourceModule?: 'egg' | 'dlg' | 'tra' | 'inc' | 'fed' | 'manual' | 'deal';
  /** 🆕 رهگیری: ID رکورد مبدأ */
  sourceId?: string;
  /** 🆕 Phase G-1: موقعیت انبار (پیش‌فرض 'stock', برای امانی 'consignment:partyId') */
  locationId?: string;
  /** 🆕 تاریخ انقضا (برای دارو) */
  expiryDate?: string;
  /** 🆕 ردیابی جیره: کدوم جیره */
  formulaId?: string;
  /** 🆕 ردیابی جیره: کدوم نسخهٔ جیره */
  formulaVersion?: number;
}

interface State {
  items: Item[];
  movements: Movement[];
  addItem: (i: Omit<Item, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>) => string;
  updateItem: (id: string, patch: Partial<Item>) => void;
  deleteItem: (id: string) => void;
  /** آرشیو کالا — از لیست پنهان، حرکات حفظ */
  archiveItem: (id: string) => void;
  /** بازگردانی از آرشیو */
  unarchiveItem: (id: string) => void;
  /** دریافت حرکات انبار مرتبط با یک کالا */
  getItemMovements: (id: string) => Movement[];
  addMovement: (m: Omit<Movement, 'id' | 'createdAt'>) => string;
  deleteMovement: (id: string) => void;
  archiveMovements: (movementIds: string[]) => Promise<number>;
  restoreMovements: (movementIds: string[]) => Promise<number>;

  /** 🆕 وضعیت لود داده‌ها از IndexedDB */
  isLoading: boolean;
}


/** تولید شماره دسته — B-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN */

const now = () => new Date().toISOString();

/** میانگین موزون قیمت یک قلم (با fallback) */
export function getAvgPrice(item: Item): number {
  return item.avgPrice ?? item.lastPrice ?? 0;
}

/**
 * recalcAvgPrice — بازمحاسبه میانگین موزون از تاریخچه
 * startAvg: میانگین شروع (fallback: lastPrice)
 */
export function recalcAvgPrice(
  item: Item,
  movements: Movement[]
): { avg: number; stock: number } {
  let stock = item.initialStock ?? 0;
  let avg = item.lastPrice || 0;
  const sorted = movements
    .filter(m => m.itemId === item.id)
    .sort((a, b) => (a.createdAt || '').localeCompare(b.createdAt || ''));
  for (const m of sorted) {
    if (m.type === 'in') {
      if (m.unitPrice > 0 && stock + m.quantity > 0) {
        avg = (stock * avg + m.quantity * m.unitPrice) / (stock + m.quantity);
      }
      stock += m.quantity;
    } else if (m.type === 'out') {
      stock -= m.quantity;
    } else {
      stock = m.quantity;
    }
  }
  return { avg: Math.round(avg * 100) / 100, stock };
}

/** اعتبارسنجی Item — پرتاب خطا در صورت نامعتبر */
function assertItem(data: any): void {
  const r = validate(createItemSchema({}), data);
  if (!r.ok) {
    const msgs = Object.values(r.errors).join(' • ');
    throw new Error('اعتبارسنجی کالا: ' + msgs);
  }
}

/** اعتبارسنجی Movement */
function assertMovement(data: any): void {
  const r = validate(createMovementSchema({}), data);
  if (!r.ok) {
    const msgs = Object.values(r.errors).join(' • ');
    throw new Error('اعتبارسنجی گردش: ' + msgs);
  }
}

/**
 * recalcStock — محاسبه موجودی از تاریخچه تراکنش‌ها
 * expected = initialStock + Σ(in) − Σ(out) + Σ(adjust net)
 */
export function recalcStock(
  item: Item,
  movements: Movement[]
): { expected: number; actual: number; drift: number; totalIn: number; totalOut: number; totalAdjust: number } {
  const itemMovements = movements.filter(m => m.itemId === item.id);
  let totalIn = 0, totalOut = 0, totalAdjust = 0;

  // برای محاسبه دقیق adjust، ترتیب زمانی مهمه
  const sorted = [...itemMovements].sort((a, b) => (a.createdAt || '').localeCompare(b.createdAt || ''));
  let running = item.initialStock ?? 0;
  for (const m of sorted) {
    if (m.type === 'in') { running += m.quantity; totalIn += m.quantity; }
    else if (m.type === 'out') { running -= m.quantity; totalOut += m.quantity; }
    else { // adjust: تنظیم روی مقدار جدید
      totalAdjust += (m.quantity - running);
      running = m.quantity;
    }
  }
  const expected = Math.round(running * 1000) / 1000;
  const actual = Math.round((item.currentStock || 0) * 1000) / 1000;
  const drift = Math.round((actual - expected) * 1000) / 1000;
  return { expected, actual, drift, totalIn, totalOut, totalAdjust };
}

/**
 * 🆕 Phase G-1: recalcStockByLocation — بازمحاسبه موجودی به تفکیک موقعیت از تاریخچه
 */
export function recalcStockByLocation(
  item: Item,
  movements: Movement[]
): { byLoc: Record<string, number>; total: number } {
  const sorted = movements
    .filter(m => m.itemId === item.id)
    .sort((a, b) => (a.createdAt || '').localeCompare(b.createdAt || ''));
  const byLoc: Record<string, number> = {
    ...(item.initialStockByLocation ?? { stock: item.initialStock ?? 0 })
  };
  for (const m of sorted) {
    const loc = m.locationId || 'stock';
    const cur = byLoc[loc] ?? 0;
    if (m.type === 'in') byLoc[loc] = cur + m.quantity;
    else if (m.type === 'out') byLoc[loc] = cur - m.quantity;
    else byLoc[loc] = m.quantity;
  }
  const total = Object.values(byLoc).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  return { byLoc, total };
}

/**
 * 🆕 Phase G-1: getStockAt — موجودی یک قلم در یک موقعیت
 */
export function getStockAt(item: Item, locationId: string = 'stock'): number {
  if (item.stockByLocation) return item.stockByLocation[locationId] ?? 0;
  return locationId === 'stock' ? (item.currentStock ?? 0) : 0;
}

/**
 * checkIntegrity — چک همه اقلام برای مغایرت
 */
export function checkIntegrity(
  items: Item[],
  movements: Movement[]
): Array<{ item: Item; expected: number; actual: number; drift: number }> {
  const drift: Array<{ item: Item; expected: number; actual: number; drift: number }> = [];
  for (const it of items) {
    const r = recalcStock(it, movements);
    if (Math.abs(r.drift) >= 0.001) {
      drift.push({ item: it, expected: r.expected, actual: r.actual, drift: r.drift });
    }
  }
  return drift;
}

export const useWhs = create<State>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      isLoading: true,
      items: [],
      movements: [],

      addItem: (i) => {
        assertItem(i);
        const id = uuid();
        set({ items: [...get().items, {
          ...i,
          id,
          initialStock: i.currentStock ?? 0,
          initialPrice: i.initialPrice ?? 0,
          avgPrice: i.avgPrice ?? i.lastPrice ?? 0,
          stockByLocation: i.stockByLocation ?? { stock: i.currentStock ?? 0 },
          initialStockByLocation: i.initialStockByLocation ?? { stock: i.currentStock ?? 0 },
          createdAt: now(),
          updatedAt: now()
        }] });
        return id;
      },
      updateItem: (id, patch) => {
        const current = get().items.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (current) assertItem({ ...current, ...patch });
        set({ items: get().items.map(x => x.id === id ? { ...x, ...patch, updatedAt: now() } : x) });
      },
      deleteItem: (id) => set({
        items: get().items.filter(x => x.id !== id)
        // ⚠️ حرکات انبار حفظ می‌شوند — تاریخچه نباید پاک شود
      }),
      archiveItem: (id) => set({
        items: get().items.map(x => x.id === id ? { ...x, archived: true } : x),
      }),
      unarchiveItem: (id) => set({
        items: get().items.map(x => x.id === id ? { ...x, archived: false } : x),
      }),
      getItemMovements: (id) => get().movements.filter(m => m.itemId === id),

      addMovement: (m) => {
        assertMovement(m);
        const item = get().items.find(x => x.id === m.itemId);
        if (item === undefined) return '';
        // 🆕 Phase G-1: per-location update
        const loc = m.locationId || 'stock';
        const byLoc = item.stockByLocation ?? { stock: item.currentStock ?? 0 };
        const locStock = byLoc[loc] ?? 0;
        let newLocStock = locStock;
        if (m.type === 'in') newLocStock += m.quantity;
        else if (m.type === 'out') newLocStock -= m.quantity;
        else newLocStock = m.quantity;
        const newByLoc = { ...byLoc, [loc]: newLocStock };
        const newStock = Object.values(newByLoc).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
        // میانگین موزون: فقط برای in با قیمت > 0
        let newAvg = getAvgPrice(item);
        if (m.type === 'in' && m.unitPrice > 0) {
          const stockBefore = item.currentStock;
          const stockAfter = stockBefore + m.quantity;
          if (stockAfter > 0) {
            newAvg = (stockBefore * newAvg + m.quantity * m.unitPrice) / stockAfter;
          } else {
            newAvg = m.unitPrice;
          }
          newAvg = Math.round(newAvg * 100) / 100;
        }
        const newId = uuid();
        set({
          movements: [...get().movements, { ...m, locationId: loc, id: newId, createdAt: now() }],
          items: get().items.map(x => x.id === m.itemId ? {
            ...x,
            stockByLocation: newByLoc,
            currentStock: newStock,
            lastPrice: m.unitPrice > 0 ? m.unitPrice : x.lastPrice,
            avgPrice: newAvg,
            updatedAt: now()
          } : x)
        });
        return newId;
      },

      deleteMovement: (id) => {
        const mv = get().movements.find(x => x.id === id);
        if (mv === undefined) return;
        const item = get().items.find(x => x.id === mv.itemId);
        if (item === undefined) return;

        // 🎯 محاسبه مجدد از تاریخچه بعد از حذف — درست برای همه انواع (in/out/adjust)
        const remaining = get().movements.filter(x => x.id !== id);
        const recalc = recalcStockByLocation(item, remaining);
        const newStock = recalc.total;  // soft: اجازه منفی
        const recalcAvg = recalcAvgPrice({ ...item, currentStock: newStock }, remaining);

        set({
          movements: remaining,
          items: get().items.map(x => x.id === mv.itemId ? {
            ...x,
            stockByLocation: recalc.byLoc,
            currentStock: newStock,
            avgPrice: recalcAvg.avg,
            updatedAt: now()
          } : x)
        });
      } ,
      archiveMovements: async (movementIds) => {
        if (!movementIds.length) return 0;
        const idSet = new Set(movementIds);
        const state = get();
        const toArc = state.movements.filter(m => idSet.has(m.id));
        if (!toArc.length) return 0;

        const { ARCHIVE_STORES, putArchiveRecord } = await import('../../cor/storage/historyArchive');
        const { applyMovementCheckpoint } = await import('./archivePolicy');

        for (const mv of toArc) {
          await putArchiveRecord({
            id: mv.id,
            flockId: mv.flockId || mv.itemId,
            date: mv.date || mv.createdAt,
            archivedAt: Date.now(),
            reason: 'age' as const,
            log: mv as any,
          });
        }

        const remaining = state.movements.filter(m => !idSet.has(m.id));
        const nextItems = state.items.map(it => {
          const itemArc = toArc.filter(m => m.itemId === it.id);
          if (!itemArc.length) return it;
          const checkpointed = applyMovementCheckpoint(it, itemArc);
          const recalc = recalcStockByLocation(checkpointed, remaining);
          const recalcAvg = recalcAvgPrice({ ...checkpointed, currentStock: recalc.total }, remaining);
          return {
            ...checkpointed,
            stockByLocation: recalc.byLoc,
            currentStock: recalc.total,
            avgPrice: recalcAvg.avg,
            updatedAt: now(),
          };
        });

        set({ movements: remaining, items: nextItems });
        return toArc.length;
      },
      restoreMovements: async (movementIds) => {
        if (!movementIds.length) return 0;
        const { ARCHIVE_STORES, getArchived, purgeArchiveIds } = await import('../../cor/storage/historyArchive');
        const restoredMoves: Movement[] = [];
        const restoredIds: string[] = [];

        for (const id of movementIds) {
          const rec = await getArchived(id, ARCHIVE_STORES.whs) as { log?: Movement } | null;
          if (rec?.log) {
            restoredMoves.push(rec.log);
            restoredIds.push(id);
          }
        }
        if (!restoredMoves.length) return 0;

        const state = get();
        const existingIds = new Set(state.movements.map(m => m.id));
        const mergedMoves = [
          ...state.movements,
          ...restoredMoves.filter(m => !existingIds.has(m.id)),
        ];

        const nextItems = state.items.map(it => {
          const itemMoves = restoredMoves.filter(m => m.itemId === it.id);
          if (!itemMoves.length) return it;
          const recalc = recalcStockByLocation(it, mergedMoves);
          const recalcAvg = recalcAvgPrice({ ...it, currentStock: recalc.total }, mergedMoves);
          return {
            ...it,
            stockByLocation: recalc.byLoc,
            currentStock: recalc.total,
            avgPrice: recalcAvg.avg,
            updatedAt: now(),
          };
        });

        set({ movements: mergedMoves, items: nextItems });
        await purgeArchiveIds(restoredIds, ARCHIVE_STORES.whs);
        return restoredMoves.length;
      }
    }),
    {
      name: 'pm-whs',
      storage: createJSONStorage(() => zustandHybridStorage),
      partialize: (state) => {
        const { isLoading, ...rest } = state;
        return rest as any;
      },
      onRehydrateStorage: () => {
        return (state, error) => {
          if (error) {
            console.error('[whs] Hydration failed:', error);
          }
          useWhs.setState({ isLoading: false });
        };
      },
      version: 1,
      migrate: (persisted: unknown, version: number) => {
        if (version >= 1) return persisted;
        if (!persisted || typeof persisted !== 'object') return persisted;
        const p = persisted as { items?: unknown; movements?: unknown };
        if (Array.isArray(p.items)) {
          p.items = p.items.map((raw) => {
            const it = raw as Item;
            return {
              ...it,
              stockByLocation: it.stockByLocation ?? { stock: it.currentStock ?? 0 },
              initialStockByLocation: it.initialStockByLocation ?? { stock: it.initialStock ?? it.currentStock ?? 0 },
            };
          });
        }
        if (Array.isArray(p.movements)) {
          p.movements = p.movements.map((raw) => {
            const mv = raw as Movement;
            return { ...mv, locationId: mv.locationId ?? 'stock' };
          });
        }
        return persisted;
      },
    }
  )
);

export const CATEGORY_LABEL: Record<ItemCategory, string> = {
  egg: '🥚 تخم مرغ',

/** هشدار موجودی */
export function stockWarning(item: Item): 'ok' | 'low' | 'critical' {
  if (item.currentStock <= 0) return 'critical';
  if (item.currentStock <= item.minStock) return 'low';
  return 'ok';
}

/** روزهای مانده تا انقضا */
export function daysToExpiry(expireDate: string): number | null {
  if (expireDate === '' || expireDate == null) return null;
  try {
    const en = String(expireDate).replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));
    const d = parseJ(en, 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
    return diffCalDays(startOfDay(d), startOfDay(new Date()));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** هشدار انقضا */
export function expiryWarning(item: Item): 'ok' | 'soon' | 'expired' {
  const days = daysToExpiry(item.expireDate);
  if (days === null) return 'ok';
  if (days < 0) return 'expired';
  if (days <= 30) return 'soon';
  return 'ok';
}

/** ارزش کل انبار */
export function totalInventoryValue(items: Item[]): number {
  return items.reduce((a, x) => a + (x.currentStock * getAvgPrice(x)), 0);
}

/**
 * economics/_shared.ts — helperهای مشترک محاسبات اقتصادی
 */
import type {
  InputMovement,
  InputItem,
  CostFilter,
  CostResult,
} from '../types';

export function sumMovementsByCategory(
  movements: InputMovement[],
  items: InputItem[],
  filter: CostFilter,
  aliveCount: number,
): CostResult {
  const categorySet = filter.category
    ? new Set([filter.category])
    : filter.categories
      ? new Set(filter.categories)
      : null;

  const itemMap = new Map<string, InputItem>();
  items.forEach((i) => itemMap.set(i.id, i));

  let totalCost = 0;
  let count = 0;

  for (const m of movements) {
    if (filter.reason && m.reason !== filter.reason) continue;
    if (filter.flockId && m.flockId !== filter.flockId) continue;
    if (filter.fromDate && m.date < filter.fromDate) continue;
    if (filter.toDate && m.date > filter.toDate) continue;

    if (categorySet) {
      const item = itemMap.get(m.itemId);
      if (!item) continue;
      if (!categorySet.has(item.category)) continue;
    }

    totalCost += m.quantity * m.unitPrice;
    count++;
  }

  const costPerBird =
    aliveCount > 0 ? Math.round((totalCost / aliveCount) * 100) / 100 : 0;

  return {
    totalCost: Math.round(totalCost * 100) / 100,
    costPerBird,
    count,
    hasData: count > 0,
  };
}


==========================================
FILE: ./src/shr/calc/economics/averages.ts
==========================================
/**
 * economics/averages.ts — میانگین مصرف روزانه و per-bird
 *
 * منابع:
 *   - logs: دان و آب روزانه (InputLog با feedConsumedKg و waterAmountL)
 *   - movements: واکسن، دارو، بستر (بر اساس quantity)
 *
 * محاسبات:
 *   avgFeedPerDayKg       = totalFeed / daysCount
 *   avgWaterPerDayL       = totalWater / daysCount
 *   avgVaccinesPerBird    = totalVaccineDoses / aliveCount
 *   avgMedicationsPerBird = totalChemicalQuantity / aliveCount
 *   avgHerbalPerBird      = totalHerbalQuantity / aliveCount
 *   avgLitterPerBirdKg    = totalLitterKg / aliveCount
 */
import type {
  AveragesParams,
  AveragesResult,
  InputItem,
} from '../types';

export function calculateAverages(params: AveragesParams): AveragesResult {
  const { logs, movements, items, flockId, aliveCount, fromDate, toDate } =
    params;

  // ═══ Filter logs
  const filteredLogs = logs.filter((l) => {
    if (fromDate && l.date < fromDate) return false;
    if (toDate && l.date > toDate) return false;
    return true;
  });

  // ═══ Totals from logs
  const totalFeed = filteredLogs.reduce((s, l) => s + l.feedConsumedKg, 0);
  const totalWater = filteredLogs.reduce((s, l) => s + l.waterAmountL, 0);
  const daysCount = new Set(filteredLogs.map((l) => l.date)).size;

  const avgFeedPerDayKg =
    daysCount > 0 ? Math.round((totalFeed / daysCount) * 100) / 100 : 0;
  const avgWaterPerDayL =
    daysCount > 0 ? Math.round((totalWater / daysCount) * 100) / 100 : 0;

  // ═══ Totals from movements
  const itemMap = new Map<string, InputItem>();
  items.forEach((i) => itemMap.set(i.id, i));

  let totalVaccines = 0;
  let totalMedications = 0;
  let totalHerbal = 0;
  let totalLitterKg = 0;
  let movementCount = 0;

  for (const m of movements) {
    if (m.reason !== 'consumption') continue;
    if (flockId && m.flockId !== flockId) continue;
    if (fromDate && m.date < fromDate) continue;
    if (toDate && m.date > toDate) continue;

    const item = itemMap.get(m.itemId);
    if (!item) continue;

    switch (item.category) {
      case 'vaccine':
        totalVaccines += m.quantity;
        break;
      case 'medicine':
        totalMedications += m.quantity;
        break;
      case 'herbal':
        totalHerbal += m.quantity;
        break;
      case 'consumable':
        totalLitterKg += m.quantity;
        break;
    }
    movementCount++;
  }

  // ═══ Per-bird
  const divisor = aliveCount > 0 ? aliveCount : 1;
  const avgVaccinesPerBird = Math.round((totalVaccines / divisor) * 100) / 100;
  const avgMedicationsPerBird =
    Math.round((totalMedications / divisor) * 100) / 100;
  const avgHerbalPerBird = Math.round((totalHerbal / divisor) * 100) / 100;
  const avgLitterPerBirdKg =
    Math.round((totalLitterKg / divisor) * 100) / 100;

  return {
    avgFeedPerDayKg,
    avgWaterPerDayL,
    totalVaccines: Math.round(totalVaccines * 100) / 100,
    totalMedications: Math.round(totalMedications * 100) / 100,
    totalHerbal: Math.round(totalHerbal * 100) / 100,
    totalLitterKg: Math.round(totalLitterKg * 100) / 100,
    avgVaccinesPerBird,
    avgMedicationsPerBird,
    avgHerbalPerBird,
    avgLitterPerBirdKg,
    daysCount,
    hasData: filteredLogs.length > 0 || movementCount > 0,
  };
}

FILE: ./src/shr/calc/economics/medicationCost.ts

/**
 * economics/medicationCost.ts — هزینه دارو (شیمیایی + گیاهی جدا)
 */
import type {
  InputMovement,
  InputItem,
  CostResult,
  MedicationCostResult,
} from '../types';
import { sumMovementsByCategory } from './_shared';

export interface MedicationCostParams {
  movements: InputMovement[];
  items: InputItem[];
  flockId?: string;
  aliveCount: number;
  fromDate?: string;
  toDate?: string;
}

export function calculateMedicationCost(
  params: MedicationCostParams,
): MedicationCostResult {
  const baseFilter = {
    flockId: params.flockId,
    reason: 'consumption' as const,
    fromDate: params.fromDate,
    toDate: params.toDate,
  };

  const chemical = sumMovementsByCategory(
    params.movements,
    params.items,
    { ...baseFilter, category: 'medicine' },
    params.aliveCount,
  );

  const herbal = sumMovementsByCategory(
    params.movements,
    params.items,
    { ...baseFilter, category: 'herbal' },
    params.aliveCount,
  );

  const total: CostResult = {
    totalCost: Math.round((chemical.totalCost + herbal.totalCost) * 100) / 100,
    costPerBird:
      Math.round((chemical.costPerBird + herbal.costPerBird) * 100) / 100,
    count: chemical.count + herbal.count,
    hasData: chemical.hasData || herbal.hasData,
  };

  return { chemical, herbal, total };
}

export function calculatePerEggCost(
  params: PerEggCostParams,
): PerEggCostResult {
  const { totalCost, totalEggs } = params;
  if (totalEggs <= 0) return { costPerEgg: null };
  return { costPerEgg: Math.round((totalCost / totalEggs) * 100) / 100 };
}

export function calculatePerKgCost(

      : null;

FILE: ./src/shr/calc/economics/profit.ts

/**
 * economics/profit.ts — سود + نسبت سود/هزینه + حاشیه سود
 *
 *   profit           = revenue - totalCost
 *   profitPerBird    = profit / aliveCount
 *   revenueToCost    = revenue / totalCost   (markup ratio)
 *   marginPct        = (profit / revenue) * 100
 */
import type { ProfitParams, ProfitResult } from '../types';

export function calculateProfit(params: ProfitParams): ProfitResult {
  const { revenue, totalCost, aliveCount } = params;

  if (revenue <= 0 && totalCost <= 0) {
    return {
      profit: 0,
      profitPerBird: 0,
      revenueToCostRatio: 0,
      marginPct: 0,
      hasData: false,
    };
  }

  const profit = revenue - totalCost;
  const profitPerBird =
    aliveCount > 0 ? Math.round((profit / aliveCount) * 100) / 100 : 0;
  const revenueToCostRatio =
    totalCost > 0 ? Math.round((revenue / totalCost) * 100) / 100 : 0;
  const marginPct =
    revenue > 0 ? Math.round((profit / revenue) * 1000) / 10 : 0;

  return {
    profit: Math.round(profit * 100) / 100,
    profitPerBird,
    revenueToCostRatio,
    marginPct,
    hasData: true,
  };
}

FILE: ./src/shr/calc/economics/revenue.ts

/**
 * economics/revenue.ts — درآمد
 *
 * دو منبع:
 *   - invoices: فاکتورهای فروش واقعی (دقیق)
 *   - prices: تخمین از قیمت بازار
 */
import type {
  InputInvoice,
  RevenueFromInvoicesParams,
  RevenueFromPricesParams,
  RevenueResult,
} from '../types';

export function calculateRevenueFromInvoices(
  params: RevenueFromInvoicesParams,
  aliveCount: number,
): RevenueResult {
  const { invoices, flockId, includeDraft = false } = params;

  let totalRevenue = 0;
  let count = 0;

  for (const inv of invoices) {
    if (inv.type !== 'sale') continue;
    if (inv.relatedFlockId !== flockId) continue;
    if (!includeDraft && inv.workflowStatus === 'draft') continue;
    totalRevenue += inv.total;
    count++;
  }

  const revenuePerBird =
    aliveCount > 0 ? Math.round((totalRevenue / aliveCount) * 100) / 100 : 0;

  return {
    totalRevenue: Math.round(totalRevenue * 100) / 100,
    revenuePerBird,
    source: count > 0 ? 'invoices' : 'none',
    count,
    hasData: count > 0,
  };
}

export function calculateRevenueFromPrices(
  params: RevenueFromPricesParams,
  aliveCount: number,
): RevenueResult {
  const {
    liveWeightKg = 0,
    pricePerKg = 0,
    eggsCount = 0,
    pricePerEgg = 0,
    culledCount = 0,
    culledPrice = 0,
  } = params;

  const meatRevenue = liveWeightKg * pricePerKg;
  const eggRevenue = eggsCount * pricePerEgg;
  const culledRevenue = culledCount * culledPrice;
  const totalRevenue = meatRevenue + eggRevenue + culledRevenue;

  const revenuePerBird =
    aliveCount > 0 ? Math.round((totalRevenue / aliveCount) * 100) / 100 : 0;

  return {
    totalRevenue: Math.round(totalRevenue * 100) / 100,
    revenuePerBird,
    source: totalRevenue > 0 ? 'prices' : 'none',
    count: 0,
    hasData: totalRevenue > 0,
  };
}

/**
 * Hybrid: اگر فاکتورها داده شدند، از آن‌ها استفاده کن؛ در غیر این صورت از prices.
 */
export function calculateRevenue(
  invoiceParams: RevenueFromInvoicesParams | null,
  priceParams: RevenueFromPricesParams | null,
  aliveCount: number,
): RevenueResult {
  if (invoiceParams) {
    const fromInv = calculateRevenueFromInvoices(invoiceParams, aliveCount);
    if (fromInv.hasData) return fromInv;
  }
  if (priceParams) {
    return calculateRevenueFromPrices(priceParams, aliveCount);
  }
  return {
    totalRevenue: 0,
    revenuePerBird: 0,
    source: 'none',
    count: 0,
    hasData: false,
  };
}

/**
 * economics/totalCost.ts — جمع همه هزینه‌ها

import type { TotalCostParams, TotalCostResult } from '../types';

export function calculateTotalCost(params: TotalCostParams): TotalCostResult {
  const {
    feedTotal,
    vaccineTotal,
    medicationTotal,
    litterTotal,
    utilitiesTotal = 0,
    laborTotal = 0,
    aliveCount,
  } = params;

  const totalCost =
    feedTotal + vaccineTotal + medicationTotal + litterTotal + utilitiesTotal + laborTotal;

  const costPerBird =
    aliveCount > 0 ? Math.round((totalCost / aliveCount) * 100) / 100 : 0;

  return {
    totalCost: Math.round(totalCost * 100) / 100,
    costPerBird,
    breakdown: {
      feed: feedTotal,
      vaccine: vaccineTotal,
      medication: medicationTotal,
      litter: litterTotal,
      utilities: utilitiesTotal,
      labor: laborTotal,
    },
  };
}

FILE: ./src/shr/calc/formulas/egg.ts

/**
 * egg.ts — شاخص‌های تولید تخم
 *
 * استاندارد: Hy-Line W-36 Management Guide
 *
 *   henDayPct      = تخم سالم امروز ÷ مرغ زنده امروز × 100
 *   henHousedPct   = تخم سالم امروز ÷ مرغ اولیه × 100
 *   brokenRatePct  = تخم شکسته ÷ کل جمع‌آوری × 100
 *   dirtyRatePct   = تخم کثیف ÷ کل جمع‌آوری × 100
 *
 * tone (hen-day و hen-housed):
 *   - ≥ استاندارد → accent
 *   - ۰.۹ تا ۱.۰ × استاندارد → warn
 *   - < ۰.۹ × استاندارد → danger
 *
 * tone (broken و dirty):
 *   - broken: < ۲٪ accent | ۲-۴٪ warn | > ۴٪ danger
 *   - dirty:  < ۲٪ accent | ۲-۵٪ warn | > ۵٪ danger
 */
import type { EggParams, EggResult, Tone } from '../types';

function rateTone(pct: number, standard: number | null): Tone {
  if (standard === null || standard <= 0) return 'info';
  if (pct >= standard) return 'accent';
  if (pct >= standard * 0.9) return 'warn';
  return 'danger';
}

export function calculateEggMetrics(params: EggParams): EggResult {
  const {
    eggsToday,
    eggsBroken,
    eggsDirty,
    aliveToday,
    initialCount,
    standardHenDayPct,
    standardHenHousedPct,
  } = params;

  const totalToday = eggsToday + eggsBroken + eggsDirty;

  // hen-day
  const henDayPct = aliveToday > 0 ? (eggsToday / aliveToday) * 100 : 0;
  const henDayR = Math.round(henDayPct * 10) / 10;

  // hen-housed
  const henHousedPct = initialCount > 0 ? (eggsToday / initialCount) * 100 : 0;
  const henHousedR = Math.round(henHousedPct * 10) / 10;

  // broken rate
  const brokenRate = totalToday > 0 ? (eggsBroken / totalToday) * 100 : 0;
  const brokenR = Math.round(brokenRate * 10) / 10;

  // dirty rate
  const dirtyRate = totalToday > 0 ? (eggsDirty / totalToday) * 100 : 0;
  const dirtyR = Math.round(dirtyRate * 10) / 10;

  // hen-day diff
  const henDayDiffPct =
    standardHenDayPct !== null && standardHenDayPct > 0
      ? Math.round(((henDayR - standardHenDayPct) / standardHenDayPct) * 1000) / 10
      : null;

  return {
    henDayPct: henDayR,
    henDayTone: rateTone(henDayR, standardHenDayPct),
    henDayDiffPct,
    henHousedPct: henHousedR,
    henHousedTone: rateTone(henHousedR, standardHenHousedPct),
    brokenRatePct: brokenR,
    brokenTone: brokenR < 2 ? 'accent' : brokenR < 4 ? 'warn' : 'danger',
    dirtyRatePct: dirtyR,
    dirtyTone: dirtyR < 2 ? 'accent' : dirtyR < 5 ? 'warn' : 'danger',
  };
}


/**
 * aggregateEggMetrics — تجمیع metrics تخم برای N روز
 *
 * calculateEggMetrics برای یک روز طراحی شده. برای ۷ روز اخیر،
 * مجموع healthy/broken/dirty را می‌گیریم و بر N تقسیم می‌کنیم،
 * بعد calculateEggMetrics را صدا می‌زنیم.
 */
export function aggregateEggMetrics(
  days: number,
  eggsHealthyTotal: number,
  eggsBrokenTotal: number,
  eggsDirtyTotal: number,
  aliveToday: number,
  initialCount: number,
  standardHenDayPct: number | null,
  standardHenHousedPct: number | null,
): EggResult {
  const n = days > 0 ? days : 1;
  return calculateEggMetrics({
    eggsToday: eggsHealthyTotal / n,
    eggsBroken: eggsBrokenTotal / n,
    eggsDirty: eggsDirtyTotal / n,
    eggsCumulative: 0,
    aliveToday,
    initialCount,
    standardHenDayPct,
    standardHenHousedPct,
  });
}

FILE: ./src/shr/calc/formulas/environment.ts

/**
 * environment.ts — هشدارهای محیطی (دما، رطوبت)
 *
 * منطق: حفظ رفتار قبلی (tempWarning / humidityWarning) — بدون تغییر
 *
 * Tone:
 *   accent   → در محدوده یا بدون داده
 *   warn     → کمی خارج
 *   danger   → خارج از محدوده مجاز
 */
import type { Tone } from '../types';

export interface EnvironmentWarningParams {
  tempC: number | null;
  tempMin: number | null;
  tempMax: number | null;
  tempTarget: number | null;
  humidityPct: number | null;
  humidityMin: number | null;
  humidityMax: number | null;
}

export interface EnvironmentWarningResult {
  tempTone: Tone;
  humidityTone: Tone;
}

function tempToneFrom(
  temp: number | null,
  min: number | null,
  max: number | null,
  target: number | null,
): Tone {
  if (temp == null || temp === 0) return 'accent';
  if (min != null && max != null) {
    if (temp < min || temp > max) return 'danger';
    if (target != null) {
      const range = max - min;
      const tolerance = Math.max(1, range * 0.15);
      if (Math.abs(temp - target) > tolerance) return 'warn';
    }
    return 'accent';
  }
  if (temp < 15 || temp > 30) return 'danger';
  if (temp < 18 || temp > 26) return 'warn';
  return 'accent';
}

function humidityToneFrom(
  h: number | null,
  min: number | null,
  max: number | null,
): Tone {
  if (h == null || h === 0) return 'accent';
  if (min != null && max != null) {
    const range = max - min;
    const tolerance = Math.max(5, range * 0.3);
    if (h < min - tolerance || h > max + tolerance) return 'danger';
    if (h < min || h > max) return 'warn';
    return 'accent';
  }
  if (h < 30 || h > 80) return 'danger';
  if (h < 40 || h > 70) return 'warn';
  return 'accent';
}

export function calculateEnvironmentWarnings(
  params: EnvironmentWarningParams,
): EnvironmentWarningResult {
  return {
    tempTone: tempToneFrom(
      params.tempC,
      params.tempMin,
      params.tempMax,
      params.tempTarget,
    ),
    humidityTone: humidityToneFrom(
      params.humidityPct,
      params.humidityMin,
      params.humidityMax,
    ),
  };
}
