FILE: ./src/shr/calc/formulas/epef.ts
==========================================
/**
 * epef.ts — European Production Efficiency Factor
 *
 * فرمول: EPEF = (livability٪ × weight kg × 100) / (age × FCR)
 *
 * فقط برای گله گوشتی معنی دارد (برای layer/breeder، epef = 0 و tone = info)
 *
 * tone:
 *   > 400 → accent (عالی)
 *   350-400 → accent (خوب)
 *   300-350 → warn (متوسط)
 *   < 300 → danger (ضعیف)
 */
import type { EpefParams, EpefResult, Tone } from '../types';

export function calculateEPEF(params: EpefParams): EpefResult {
  const { livabilityPct, finalWeightKg, ageDays, fcr } = params;

  // guard: denominator صفر
  if (ageDays <= 0 || fcr <= 0 || finalWeightKg <= 0) {
    return { epef: 0, tone: 'info' };
  }

  const epef =
    (livabilityPct * finalWeightKg * 100) / (ageDays * fcr);
  const epefR = Math.round(epef * 10) / 10;

  let tone: Tone = 'info';
  if (epefR > 400) tone = 'accent';
  else if (epefR >= 350) tone = 'accent';
  else if (epefR >= 300) tone = 'warn';
  else tone = 'danger';

  return { epef: epefR, tone };
}


==========================================
FILE: ./src/shr/calc/formulas/fcr.ts
==========================================
/**
 * fcr.ts — محاسبه FCR (ضریب تبدیل غذایی)
 *
 * استاندارد: Aviagen Ross 308 / Cobb 500
 *   FCR = کل دان مصرفی ÷ کل افزایش وزن
 *
 *   کل افزایش وزن = (وزن نهایی − وزن اولیه) × تعداد زنده
 *
 * آستانه‌ها (Aviagen):
 *   - اگر FCR > ۱۰٪ بدتر از استاندارد → danger
 *   - اگر FCR ۵-۱۰٪ بدتر → warn
 *   - اگر FCR بین -۱۰٪ تا +۵٪ نسبت به استاندارد → accent
 *   - اگر FCR ۱۰-۲۰٪ بهتر (غیرعادی) → warn
 *   - اگر FCR بیش از ۲۰٪ بهتر (غیرممکن بیولوژیک) → danger
 */
import type { FcrParams, FcrResult, Tone } from '../types';

export function calculateFCR(params: FcrParams): FcrResult {
  const {
    feedConsumedKg,
    initialWeightKg,
    finalWeightKg,
    aliveCount,
    standardFCR,
  } = params;

  // ═══ محاسبه پایه
  let fcr: number | null = null;
  let totalGainKg = 0;
  let confidence: 'exact' | 'approximate' | 'insufficient' = 'insufficient';
  let reason = '';

  if (feedConsumedKg <= 0) {
    reason = 'دان مصرفی صفر یا منفی است — FCR قابل محاسبه نیست';
  } else if (finalWeightKg <= 0) {
    reason = 'وزن نهایی موجود نیست — ابتدا وزن‌گیری کنید';
  } else if (aliveCount <= 0) {
    reason = 'تعداد زنده صفر است';
  } else if (finalWeightKg <= initialWeightKg) {
    reason = 'وزن نهایی کمتر یا مساوی وزن اولیه — افزایش وزن منفی';
  } else {
    totalGainKg = (finalWeightKg - initialWeightKg) * aliveCount;
    fcr = feedConsumedKg / totalGainKg;
    confidence = 'exact';
  }

  // ═══ diffPct نسبت به استاندارد
  let diffPct: number | null = null;
  if (fcr !== null && standardFCR !== null && standardFCR > 0) {
    diffPct = ((fcr - standardFCR) / standardFCR) * 100;
  }

  // ═══ tone
  let tone: Tone = 'info';
  if (fcr !== null && standardFCR !== null && standardFCR > 0) {
    const diff = (fcr - standardFCR) / standardFCR;

    if (diff < -0.20) {
      // بیش از ۲۰٪ بهتر — غیرممکن بیولوژیک، احتمالاً داده غلط
      tone = 'danger';
    } else if (diff < -0.10) {
      // ۱۰-۲۰٪ بهتر — غیرعادی
      tone = 'warn';
    } else if (diff <= 0.05) {
      // -۱۰٪ تا +۵٪ — خوب یا بهتر
      tone = 'accent';
    } else if (diff <= 0.10) {
      // ۵-۱۰٪ بدتر
      tone = 'warn';
    } else {
      // بیش از ۱۰٪ بدتر
      tone = 'danger';
    }
  }

  return {
    fcr: fcr !== null ? Math.round(fcr * 100) / 100 : null,
    confidence,
    totalFeedKg: Math.round(feedConsumedKg * 100) / 100,
    totalGainKg: Math.round(totalGainKg * 100) / 100,
    standardFCR,
    diffPct: diffPct !== null ? Math.round(diffPct * 10) / 10 : null,
    tone,
    reason,
  };
}

FILE: ./src/shr/calc/formulas/feed.ts
==========================================
/**
 * feed.ts — مصرف دان (simple / precision / auto)
 *
 * روش‌های دان‌دهی:
 *   scoop / bag / semi_auto → precision اگر remaining باشد، else simple
 *   auto_sensor              → همیشه precision (سنسور خودش مصرف را می‌دهد)
 *   auto_chain               → همیشه simple (هر چه داده = مصرف)
 *
 *   precision: feedConsumed = feedDelivered - (feedRemaining - previousRemaining)
 *   simple:    feedConsumed = feedDelivered
 *
 * هشدار:
 *   - consumed < 0 → danger
 *   - perBirdG > 300 → warn
 *   - perBirdG < 5 → warn
 */
import type { FeedParams, FeedResult } from '../types';

export function calculateFeedMetrics(params: FeedParams): FeedResult {
  const {
    feedMethod,
    feedDeliveredKg,
    feedRemainingKg,
    previousRemainingKg,
    feedWasteKg,
    aliveCount,
  } = params;

  let feedConsumedKg = 0;
  let mode: 'simple' | 'precision' = 'simple';
  let warning: string | null = null;

  if (feedMethod === 'auto_sensor') {
    // سنسور خودش مصرف را می‌دهد
    mode = 'precision';
    feedConsumedKg = feedDeliveredKg;
  } else if (feedMethod === 'auto_chain') {
    // زنجیری: delivered ≈ consumed
    mode = 'simple';
    feedConsumedKg = feedDeliveredKg;
  } else {
    // scoop / bag / semi_auto
    if (feedRemainingKg !== null && previousRemainingKg !== null) {
      mode = 'precision';
      const delta = feedRemainingKg - previousRemainingKg;
      feedConsumedKg = feedDeliveredKg - delta;
    } else {
      mode = 'simple';
      feedConsumedKg = feedDeliveredKg;
    }
  }

  // 🆕 کسر هدر رفته (اگر داده شده)
  if (feedWasteKg != null && feedWasteKg > 0) {
    feedConsumedKg = Math.max(0, feedConsumedKg - feedWasteKg);
  }

  if (feedConsumedKg < 0) {
    warning = 'مصرف دان منفی — داده را بررسی کنید';
    feedConsumedKg = 0;
  }

  const feedPerBirdG =
    aliveCount > 0 ? (feedConsumedKg * 1000) / aliveCount : 0;
  const feedPerBirdR = Math.round(feedPerBirdG * 10) / 10;

  if (!warning && feedPerBirdR > 300) {
    warning = 'مصرف دان غیرعادی بالا — داده را بررسی کنید';
  } else if (!warning && feedPerBirdR < 5 && feedConsumedKg > 0) {
    warning = 'مصرف دان غیرعادی پایین — داده را بررسی کنید';
  }

  return {
    feedConsumedKg: Math.round(feedConsumedKg * 100) / 100,
    feedPerBirdG: feedPerBirdR,
    mode,
    warning,
  };
}

FILE: ./src/shr/calc/formulas/health.ts

/**
 * health.ts — محاسبه دوز دارو/واکسن
 *
 * منطق:
 *   - water:         requiredMl = dosePerLiter × waterAmountL
 *   - oral/injectable: requiredMl = dosePerBirdMl × aliveCount
 *   - feed:           requiredMl = dosePerKgFeed × feedAmountKg
 *   - spray/other:    insufficient (نیاز به داده اختصاصی)
 *
 * اگر داده کافی نبود، hasData=false و requiredMl=null برمی‌گردد.
 */
import type { HealthParams, HealthResult } from '../types';

export function calculateHealthDose(params: HealthParams): HealthResult {
  const { route, waterAmountL, aliveCount, dosePerBirdMl, dosePerLiter, feedAmountKg, dosePerKgFeed } = params;

  // ═══ روش آشامیدنی ═══
  if (route === 'water') {
    if (!dosePerLiter || dosePerLiter <= 0) {
      return {
        requiredMl: null,
        mode: 'insufficient',
        reason: 'دوز در هر لیتر آب در انبار تعریف نشده است.',
        hasData: false,
      };
    }
    if (!waterAmountL || waterAmountL <= 0) {
      return {
        requiredMl: null,
        mode: 'insufficient',
        reason: 'مقدار آب مصرفی امروز ثبت نشده است.',
        hasData: false,
      };
    }
    return {
      requiredMl: Math.round(dosePerLiter * waterAmountL * 10) / 10,
      mode: 'water',
      reason: `بر اساس ${waterAmountL} لیتر آب مصرفی امروز`,
      hasData: true,
    };
  }

  // ═══ روش تزریقی/خوراکی ═══
  if (route === 'oral' || route === 'injectable') {
    if (!dosePerBirdMl || dosePerBirdMl <= 0) {
      return {
        requiredMl: null,
        mode: 'insufficient',
        reason: 'دوز هر پرنده در انبار تعریف نشده است.',
        hasData: false,
      };
    }
    if (!aliveCount || aliveCount <= 0) {
      return {
        requiredMl: null,
        mode: 'insufficient',
        reason: 'تعداد پرنده زنده در دسترس نیست.',
        hasData: false,
      };
    }
    return {
      requiredMl: Math.round(dosePerBirdMl * aliveCount * 10) / 10,
      mode: 'per_bird',
      reason: `بر اساس ${aliveCount} پرنده زنده`,
      hasData: true,
    };
  }

  // ═══ روش مخلوط با دان ═══
  if (route === 'feed') {
    if (!dosePerKgFeed || dosePerKgFeed <= 0) {
      return {
        requiredMl: null,
        mode: 'insufficient',
        reason: 'دوز در هر کیلوگرم دان در انبار تعریف نشده است.',
        hasData: false,
      };
    }
    if (!feedAmountKg || feedAmountKg <= 0) {
      return {
        requiredMl: null,
        mode: 'insufficient',
        reason: 'مقدار دان مصرفی امروز ثبت نشده است.',
        hasData: false,
      };
    }
    return {
      requiredMl: Math.round(dosePerKgFeed * feedAmountKg * 10) / 10,
      mode: 'feed',
      reason: `بر اساس ${feedAmountKg} کیلوگرم دان مصرفی امروز`,
      hasData: true,
    };
  }

  // ═══ روش‌های دیگر (spray/other) ═══
  return {
    requiredMl: null,
    mode: 'insufficient',
    reason: 'برای این روش مصرف، محاسبه خودکار تعریف نشده است.',
    hasData: false,
  };
}

FILE: ./src/shr/calc/formulas/mortality.ts
==========================================
/**
 * mortality.ts — محاسبه نرخ تلفات
 *
 * استاندارد: Aviagen Ross 308 / Hy-Line W-36
 *
 * فرمول‌ها:
 *   dailyPct      = deathsToday / (aliveToday + deathsToday) × 100
 *   weeklyPct     = deathsThisWeek / (aliveToday + deathsToday) × 100
 *   cumulativePct = deathsCumulative / initialCount × 100
 *
 * آستانه‌ها:
 *   - pct ≤ standard × 0.8 → accent
 *   - pct ≤ standard × 1.0 → accent
 *   - pct ≤ standard × 1.5 → warn
 *   - pct > standard × 1.5 → danger
 */
import type { MortalityParams, MortalityResult, Tone } from '../types';

function computeTone(pct: number, standard: number | null): Tone {
  if (standard === null || standard <= 0) return 'info';
  const ratio = pct / standard;
  if (ratio <= 0.8) return 'accent';
  if (ratio <= 1.0) return 'accent';
  if (ratio <= 1.5) return 'warn';
  return 'danger';
}

function computeDiff(pct: number, standard: number | null): number | null {
  if (standard === null || standard <= 0) return null;
  return Math.round(((pct - standard) / standard) * 1000) / 10;
}

export function calculateMortality(params: MortalityParams): MortalityResult {
  const {
    deathsToday,
    deathsThisWeek,
    deathsCumulative,
    aliveToday,
    initialCount,
    standardDailyPct,
    standardWeeklyPct,
    standardTotalPct,
  } = params;

  // ═══ موجودی قبل از تلفات امروز
  const beforeToday = aliveToday + deathsToday;

  // ═══ نرخ‌ها
  const dailyPct =
    beforeToday > 0 ? (deathsToday / beforeToday) * 100 : 0;

  // weeklyPct: تلفات هفته ÷ (زنده فعلی + تلفات امروز)
  // نکته: weekly شامل تلفات امروز است، پس مخرج هم beforeToday است
  const weeklyPct =
    beforeToday > 0 ? (deathsThisWeek / beforeToday) * 100 : 0;

  const cumulativePct =
    initialCount > 0 ? (deathsCumulative / initialCount) * 100 : 0;

  // ═══ گرد کردن
  const dailyR = Math.round(dailyPct * 1000) / 1000;
  const weeklyR = Math.round(weeklyPct * 1000) / 1000;
  const cumulativeR = Math.round(cumulativePct * 1000) / 1000;

  return {
    dailyPct: dailyR,
    weeklyPct: weeklyR,
    cumulativePct: cumulativeR,
    dailyTone: computeTone(dailyR, standardDailyPct),
    weeklyTone: computeTone(weeklyR, standardWeeklyPct),
    cumulativeTone: computeTone(cumulativeR, standardTotalPct),
    dailyDiffPct: computeDiff(dailyR, standardDailyPct),
    weeklyDiffPct: computeDiff(weeklyR, standardWeeklyPct),
    cumulativeDiffPct: computeDiff(cumulativeR, standardTotalPct),
  };
}


==========================================
FILE: ./src/shr/calc/formulas/stocking.ts
==========================================
/**
 * stocking.ts — تراکم
 *
 *   densityBirdPerSqM = aliveCount / hallAreaSqM
 *
 * tone:
 *   hallArea = 0 یا density = 0 → info (داده کافی نیست)
 *   ratio ≤ 0.9  → accent
 *   ratio ≤ 1.0  → accent
 *   ratio ≤ 1.1  → warn
 *   ratio > 1.1  → danger
 *
 * warning:
 *   ratio > 1.5  → «تراکم خطرناک»
 *   ratio > 1.0  → «تراکم بیش از حد مجاز»
 */
import type { StockingParams, StockingResult, Tone } from '../types';

export function calculateStockingDensity(
  params: StockingParams,
): StockingResult {
  const { aliveCount, hallAreaSqM, standardDensityMax } = params;

  // guard: بدون مساحت یا بدون پرنده → info
  if (hallAreaSqM <= 0 || aliveCount <= 0) {
    return {
      densityBirdPerSqM: 0,
      standardDensityMax,
      tone: 'info',
      warning: null,
    };
  }

  const density = aliveCount / hallAreaSqM;
  const densityR = Math.round(density * 10) / 10;

  let tone: Tone = 'info';
  let warning: string | null = null;

  if (standardDensityMax !== null && standardDensityMax > 0) {
    const ratio = density / standardDensityMax;
    if (ratio <= 0.9) tone = 'accent';
    else if (ratio <= 1.0) tone = 'accent';
    else if (ratio <= 1.1) tone = 'warn';
    else tone = 'danger';

    if (ratio > 1.5) {
      warning = 'تراکم خطرناک — خطر رفاه و کاهش شدید FCR';
    } else if (ratio > 1.0) {
      warning = 'تراکم بیش از حد مجاز — بررسی تهویه';
    }
  }

  return {
    densityBirdPerSqM: densityR,
    standardDensityMax,
    tone,
    warning,
  };
}


==========================================
FILE: ./src/shr/calc/formulas/water.ts
==========================================
/**
 * water.ts — مصرف آب
 *
 *   waterPerBirdMl = waterAmountL × 1000 / aliveCount
 *   waterFeedRatio = waterAmountL / feedConsumedKg
 *
 * tone (با استاندارد):
 *   |diff| ≤ 10٪ → accent | 10-20٪ → warn | > 20٪ → danger
 *
 * tone (بدون استاندارد، پیش‌فرض گوشتی):
 *   1.5-2.5 → accent | 1.2-3.0 → warn | خارج → danger
 *
 * هشدار:
 *   - ratio > 2.5 → «احتمال بیماری یا گرما»
 *   - ratio < 1.5 → «احتمال مشکل آبخوری»
 */
import type { WaterParams, WaterResult, Tone } from '../types';

export function calculateWaterMetrics(params: WaterParams): WaterResult {
  const {
    waterAmountL,
    feedConsumedKg,
    aliveCount,
    standardWaterFeedRatio,
  } = params;

  const waterPerBirdMl =
    aliveCount > 0 ? (waterAmountL * 1000) / aliveCount : 0;

  const waterFeedRatio =
    feedConsumedKg > 0 ? waterAmountL / feedConsumedKg : 0;

  // tone
  let waterFeedTone: Tone = 'info';
  if (waterFeedRatio > 0) {
    if (
      standardWaterFeedRatio !== null &&
      standardWaterFeedRatio > 0
    ) {
      const diff =
        (waterFeedRatio - standardWaterFeedRatio) / standardWaterFeedRatio;
      const absDiff = Math.abs(diff);
      waterFeedTone =
        absDiff <= 0.1 ? 'accent' : absDiff <= 0.2 ? 'warn' : 'danger';
    } else {
      waterFeedTone =
        waterFeedRatio >= 1.5 && waterFeedRatio <= 2.5
          ? 'accent'
          : waterFeedRatio >= 1.2 && waterFeedRatio <= 3.0
            ? 'warn'
            : 'danger';
    }
  }

  // warning
  let warning: string | null = null;
  if (waterFeedRatio > 2.5) {
    warning = 'مصرف آب بالا — احتمال بیماری یا گرما';
  } else if (waterFeedRatio > 0 && waterFeedRatio < 1.5) {
    warning = 'مصرف آب پایین — احتمال مشکل آبخوری';
  }

  return {
    waterPerBirdMl: Math.round(waterPerBirdMl * 10) / 10,
    waterFeedRatio: Math.round(waterFeedRatio * 100) / 100,
    waterFeedTone,
    warning,
  };
}


==========================================
FILE: ./src/shr/calc/formulas/weight.ts
==========================================
/**
 * weight.ts — وزن و یکنواختی
 *
 * استاندارد: Aviagen Ross 308
 *
 *   avgWeightG     = میانگین نمونه‌ها × 1000 (گرم)
 *   cvPct          = (انحراف معیار ÷ میانگین) × 100
 *   uniformityPct  = درصد نمونه‌ها در بازه ±۱۰٪ میانگین
 *   adgG           = افزایش وزن روزانه (فرض ۱ روز از لاگ قبلی)
 *
 * tone (CV):
 *   < ۸٪ → accent | ۸-۱۰٪ → accent | ۱۰-۱۲٪ → warn | > ۱۲٪ → danger
 *
 * tone (uniformity):
 *   > ۸۰٪ → accent | ۷۰-۸۰٪ → warn | < ۷۰٪ → danger
 *
 * tone (weight vs standard):
 *   |diff| ≤ ۵٪ → accent | ۵-۱۰٪ → warn | > ۱۰٪ → danger
 */
import type { WeightParams, WeightResult, Tone } from '../types';

const MIN_SAMPLES = 3;

export function calculateWeightMetrics(params: WeightParams): WeightResult {
  const { samples, previousAvgWeightG, standardWeightG } = params;

  if (samples.length < MIN_SAMPLES) {
    return {
      avgWeightG: 0,
      cvPct: 0,
      uniformityPct: 0,
      adgG: 0,
      standardWeightG,
      weightDiffPct: null,
      cvTone: 'info',
      uniformityTone: 'info',
      weightTone: 'info',
      hasData: false,
    };
  }

  const weights = samples.map((s) => s.weight);
  const sum = weights.reduce((a, w) => a + w, 0);
  const mean = sum / weights.length;

  // avgWeightG: mean در kg → × 1000 = گرم
  const avgWeightG = Math.round(mean * 1000 * 10) / 10;

  // CV
  const variance =
    weights.reduce((a, w) => a + (w - mean) ** 2, 0) / weights.length;
  const std = Math.sqrt(variance);
  const cvPct = mean > 0 ? (std / mean) * 100 : 0;
  const cvR = Math.round(cvPct * 10) / 10;

  // Uniformity: درصد نمونه‌ها در بازه ±۱۰٪ میانگین
  const low = mean * 0.9;
  const high = mean * 1.1;
  const within = weights.filter((w) => w >= low && w <= high).length;
  const uniformityPct = (within / weights.length) * 100;
  const uniformityR = Math.round(uniformityPct * 10) / 10;

  // ADG — فرض ۱ روز از لاگ قبلی
  let adgG = 0;
  if (previousAvgWeightG !== null && previousAvgWeightG > 0) {
    adgG = avgWeightG - previousAvgWeightG;
  }

  // diff vs standard
  let weightDiffPct: number | null = null;
  if (standardWeightG !== null && standardWeightG > 0) {
    weightDiffPct =
      ((avgWeightG - standardWeightG) / standardWeightG) * 100;
  }

  // tones
  const cvTone: Tone =
    cvR < 8 ? 'accent' : cvR < 10 ? 'accent' : cvR < 12 ? 'warn' : 'danger';

  const uniformityTone: Tone =
    uniformityR > 80 ? 'accent' : uniformityR > 70 ? 'warn' : 'danger';

  let weightTone: Tone = 'info';
  if (weightDiffPct !== null) {
    const absDiff = Math.abs(weightDiffPct);
    weightTone = absDiff <= 5 ? 'accent' : absDiff <= 10 ? 'warn' : 'danger';
  }

  return {
    avgWeightG,
    cvPct: cvR,
    uniformityPct: uniformityR,
    adgG: Math.round(adgG * 10) / 10,
    standardWeightG,
    weightDiffPct:
      weightDiffPct !== null ? Math.round(weightDiffPct * 10) / 10 : null,
    cvTone,
    uniformityTone,
    weightTone,
    hasData: true,
  };
}

/**
 * species-expected.ts — آستانه‌های species-aware از standards
 *
 * وقتی context.breedKey و ageDays موجود است، تابع expected/min/max
 * را از set/standards می‌خواند و برمی‌گرداند.
 */
import type { CalcContext } from './types';
import { getThresholds } from './thresholds';
import { getStandardFor, getEffectiveGrowth, findInRange } from '../../mod/set/standards';

export interface SpeciesExpected {
  target: number | null;
  min: number | null;
  max: number | null;
  source: string;
}

export function getSpeciesExpected(
  fieldPath: string,
  ctx: CalcContext,
): SpeciesExpected | null {
  const std = getStandardFor(ctx.breedId);
  if (!std) return null;
  const source = std.nameFa || std.key;

  // ═══ FCR ═══
  if (fieldPath === 'flk.fcr' || fieldPath === 'brd.fcr') {
    const th = getThresholds(ctx);
    if (th.fcr == null || th.fcr <= 0) return null;
    return { target: th.fcr, min: th.fcr * 0.85, max: th.fcr * 1.15, source };
  }

  // ═══ ADG ═══
  if (fieldPath === 'flk.adg') {
    const th = getThresholds(ctx);
    if (th.adgG == null || th.adgG <= 0) return null;
    return { target: th.adgG, min: th.adgG * 0.85, max: th.adgG * 1.15, source };
  }

  // ═══ Humidity ═══
  if (fieldPath === 'dlg.humidity' || fieldPath === 'hal.targetHumidity') {
    const th = getThresholds(ctx);
    if (!th.humidity) return null;
    return { target: th.humidity.target, min: th.humidity.min, max: th.humidity.max, source };
  }
  if (fieldPath === 'dlg.humidityMin') {
    const th = getThresholds(ctx);
    if (!th.humidity) return null;
    return { target: th.humidity.min, min: th.humidity.min, max: th.humidity.max, source };
  }
  if (fieldPath === 'dlg.humidityMax') {
    const th = getThresholds(ctx);
    if (!th.humidity) return null;
    return { target: th.humidity.max, min: th.humidity.min, max: th.humidity.max, source };
  }

  // ═══ Feed per bird ═══
  if (fieldPath === 'feed.perBirdGramsPerDay') {
    const th = getThresholds(ctx);
    if (!th.feedPerBirdG) return null;
    return {
      target: (th.feedPerBirdG.min + th.feedPerBirdG.max) / 2,
      min: th.feedPerBirdG.min,
      max: th.feedPerBirdG.max,
      source,
    };
  }

  // ═══ Feed nutrients (from FeedRange at age) ═══
  const feedRange = findInRange(std.feed, ctx.ageDays);
  if (feedRange) {
    const nutrientMap: Record<string, number | undefined> = {
      'feed.protein': feedRange.proteinPct,
      'feed.calcium': feedRange.calciumPct,
      'feed.phosphorus': feedRange.availablePhosphorusPct,
      'feed.methionine': feedRange.methioninePct,
      'feed.lysine': feedRange.lysinePct,
      'feed.energy': feedRange.energyKcal,
    };
    const nutrient = nutrientMap[fieldPath];
    if (nutrient != null && nutrient > 0) {
      return { target: nutrient, min: nutrient * 0.9, max: nutrient * 1.1, source };
    }
    if (fieldPath === 'feed.fat' || fieldPath === 'feed.fiber' || fieldPath === 'feed.sodium') {
      return null;
    }
  }

  // ═══ Space ═══
  if (fieldPath === 'hal.density') {
    if (!std.space) return null;
    return { target: std.space.densityMax, min: std.space.densityMax * 0.7, max: std.space.densityMax, source };
  }
  if (fieldPath === 'hal.feederSpaceCm') {
    if (!std.space) return null;
    return { target: std.space.feederSpaceCm, min: std.space.feederSpaceCm * 0.9, max: std.space.feederSpaceCm * 1.1, source };
  }
  if (fieldPath === 'hal.drinkerSpaceCm') {
    if (!std.space) return null;
    return { target: std.space.drinkerSpaceCm, min: std.space.drinkerSpaceCm * 0.9, max: std.space.drinkerSpaceCm * 1.1, source };
  }

  // ═══ Production ═══
  if (fieldPath === 'flk.layingStartDay') {
    if (!std.production) return null;
    return {
      target: std.production.layingStartDay,
      min: std.production.layingStartDay * 0.9,
      max: std.production.layingStartDay * 1.15,
      source,
    };
  }
  if (fieldPath === 'flk.endOfCycleDay') {
    if (!std.production) return null;
    return {
      target: std.production.cycleDays,
      min: std.production.cycleDays * 0.9,
      max: std.production.cycleDays * 1.1,
      source,
    };
  }

  // ═══ Egg weight ═══
  if (fieldPath === 'egg.avgWeight' || fieldPath === 'inc.avgWeight') {
    if (!std.production) return null;
    const w = std.production.eggWeightG;
    return { target: w, min: w * 0.85, max: w * 1.15, source };
  }

  // ═══ Weight curve ═══
  if (fieldPath === 'dlg.weightSamples' || fieldPath === 'flk.weightGram') {
    const g = getEffectiveGrowth(ctx.breedId, ctx.ageDays);
    if (g.source === 'fallback' || g.weightG <= 0) return null;
    const isKg = fieldPath === 'dlg.weightSamples';
    const target = isKg ? g.weightG / 1000 : g.weightG;
    return { target, min: target * 0.9, max: target * 1.1, source };
  }

  // ═══ Incubation humidity ═══
  if (fieldPath === 'inc.humidity') {
    if (!std.incubation) return null;
    return {
      target: std.incubation.setterHumidity,
      min: std.incubation.setterHumidity - 5,
      max: std.incubation.setterHumidity + 10,
      source,
    };
  }

  return null;
}

FILE: ./src/shr/calc/thresholds/index.ts
==========================================
/**
 * thresholds/index.ts — استخراج آستانه‌های استاندارد از set/standards
 *
 * آستانه‌های عمومی (hardcoded، بین همه نژادها یکسان):
 *   - cvPct: ۱۲٪
 *   - uniformityPct: ۷۰٪
 *   - waterFeedRatio: ۱.۵ تا ۲.۵
 *
 * آستانه‌های نژاد-محور (از standards):
 *   - temp، humidity، light → از std.env
 *   - feedPerBirdG → از std.feed با تحمل ±۱۰٪
 *   - fcr، adgG → از getEffectiveGrowth
 *   - mortality → از getMortalityRange + std.mortalityTotalPct
 *   - henDayPct، eggWeightG → از getProduction
 *   - henHousedPct → hen-day × livability (تخمین)
 *   - densityBirdPerSqM → از getSpace
 */
import type { Thresholds, CalcContext } from '../types';
import {
  getStandardFor,
  getEffectiveGrowth,
  getSpace,
  getProduction,
  getMortalityRange,
  findInRange,
} from '../../../mod/set/standards';

// ═══ آستانه‌های عمومی (بین همه نژادها یکسان)
const GENERAL_CV_PCT = 12;
const GENERAL_UNIFORMITY_PCT = 70;
const GENERAL_WATER_FEED_RATIO = { min: 1.5, max: 2.5 };
const FEED_TOLERANCE = 0.1;

export function getThresholds(ctx: CalcContext): Thresholds {
  const std = getStandardFor(ctx.breedId);

  if (!std) {
    return emptyThresholds();
  }

  // ═══ محیط
  const envRange = findInRange(std.env, ctx.ageDays);
  const temp = envRange?.temp
    ? {
        min: envRange.temp.min,
        max: envRange.temp.max,
        target: envRange.temp.target,
      }
    : null;

  const humidity = envRange?.humidity
    ? {
        min: envRange.humidity.min,
        max: envRange.humidity.max,
        target:
          envRange.humidity.target ??
          (envRange.humidity.min + envRange.humidity.max) / 2,
      }
    : null;

  const lightHours =
    envRange?.light?.hours != null
      ? {
          min: Math.max(0, envRange.light.hours - 1),
          max: envRange.light.hours + 1,
        }
      : null;

  // ═══ تغذیه
  const feedRange = findInRange(std.feed, ctx.ageDays);
  const feedPerBirdG =
    feedRange?.feedG != null
      ? {
          min: Math.round(feedRange.feedG * (1 - FEED_TOLERANCE)),
          max: Math.round(feedRange.feedG * (1 + FEED_TOLERANCE)),
        }
      : null;

  // ═══ رشد
  const growth = getEffectiveGrowth(ctx.breedId, ctx.ageDays);
  const hasGrowthData = growth.source !== 'fallback';
  const fcr = hasGrowthData ? growth.fcr : null;
  const adgG = hasGrowthData ? growth.adgG : null;

  // ═══ تلفات
  const mortalityRange = getMortalityRange(ctx.breedId, ctx.ageDays);
  const mortality =
    mortalityRange != null && std.mortalityTotalPct != null
      ? {
          dailyPct: mortalityRange.maxPct,
          weeklyPct: Math.round(mortalityRange.maxPct * 5 * 100) / 100,
          totalPct: std.mortalityTotalPct,
        }
      : null;

  // ═══ تولید
  const production = getProduction(ctx.breedId);
  const henDayPct = production?.peakLayingPct ?? null;
  const eggWeightG = production?.eggWeightG ?? null;

  const henHousedPct =
    henDayPct != null && std.mortalityTotalPct != null
      ? Math.round(henDayPct * (1 - std.mortalityTotalPct / 100) * 10) / 10
      : null;

  // ═══ فضا
  const space = getSpace(ctx.breedId);
  const densityBirdPerSqM = space?.densityMax ?? null;

  return {
    temp,
    humidity,
    lightHours,
    feedPerBirdG,
    waterFeedRatio: GENERAL_WATER_FEED_RATIO,
    fcr,
    adgG,
    cvPct: GENERAL_CV_PCT,
    uniformityPct: GENERAL_UNIFORMITY_PCT,
    mortality,
    henDayPct,
    henHousedPct,
    eggWeightG,
    densityBirdPerSqM,
  };
}

function emptyThresholds(): Thresholds {
  return {
    temp: null,
    humidity: null,
    lightHours: null,
    feedPerBirdG: null,
    waterFeedRatio: null,
    fcr: null,
    adgG: null,
    cvPct: null,
    uniformityPct: null,
    mortality: null,
    henDayPct: null,
    henHousedPct: null,
    eggWeightG: null,
    densityBirdPerSqM: null,
  };
}

/**
 * AccordionSection — بخش قابل باز/بسته در فرم‌ها
 */
import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';

export function AccordionSection({
  title, icon, defaultOpen = true, summary, children,
}: {
  title: string;
  icon?: string;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  summary?: string;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(defaultOpen);
  return (
    <div style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen(o => !o)}
        style={{
          width: '100%', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,
          padding: '10px 4px', marginTop: 4,
          background: 'none', border: 'none', borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',
          cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit', textAlign: 'right',
        }}
      >
        <span style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text)', letterSpacing: '.3px' }}>
          {icon && <span style={{ fontSize: '1.05em', lineHeight: 1 }}>{icon}</span>}
          {title}
        </span>
        {!open && summary && (
          <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 600 }}>{summary}</span>
        )}
        <span style={{
          fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--muted)',
          transform: open ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'rotate(0)',
          transition: 'transform 180ms',
          display: 'inline-block',
        }}>▼</span>
      </button>
      {open && <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8, paddingTop: 4 }}>{children}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}


==========================================
FILE: ./src/shr/components/AutocompleteSheet.tsx

/**
 * AutocompleteSheet.tsx — فیلد ورودی با Bottom Sheet (استاندارد SelectSheetShell)
 *
 * طبق docs/STANDARDS.md بخش ۷.۵:
 *   - Bottom Sheet از پایین (SelectSheetShell)
 *   - ۵ مورد اول + «نمایش N مورد دیگر»
 *   - جستجو اختیاری (بدون focus خودکار)
 *   - گروه‌بندی بر اساس category
 *   - حداکثر ۷۰vh
 */
import { getGlobalFormat } from '../units/useFormat';

import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import SelectSheetShell, { SheetGroup, SheetItem } from './SelectSheetShell';

export interface AutoOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: string;
  group?: string;
  groupLabel?: string;
  groupIcon?: string;
}

interface Props {
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  onSelect: (opt: AutoOption) => void;
  onSubmit: (text: string) => void;
  options: AutoOption[];
  placeholder?: string;
  customLabel?: string;
  error?: string;
  title?: string;
  emptyMessage?: string;
  emptyHint?: string;
  /** 🆕 مقادیری که انتخاب می‌شن ولی value رو ست نمی‌کنن (اکشن) */
  actionValues?: string[];
  /** 🆕 مخفی کردن بخش «افزودن دلخواه» */
  hideCustom?: boolean;
  /** 🆕 مخفی کردن متن خطای داخلی — وقتی داخل <Field> است */
  hideInternalError?: boolean;
}

const INITIAL_COUNT = 5;
const SEARCH_MAX = 5;
const STEP = 5;

export default function AutocompleteSheet({
  value, onChange, onSelect, onSubmit,
  options, placeholder, customLabel = 'افزودن مورد دلخواه',
  error, title = 'انتخاب کنید', emptyMessage, emptyHint, actionValues = [], hideCustom = false,
  hideInternalError = false,
}: Props) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState('');
  const [visibleCount, setVisibleCount] = useState(INITIAL_COUNT);
  const [typedError, setTypedError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [matched, setMatched] = useState(false);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const matchTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const query = draft.trim().toLowerCase();
  const isSearching = query.length > 0;

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (!isSearching) return options;
    return options.filter(o =>
      o.label.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      o.groupLabel?.toLowerCase().includes(query)
    );
  }, [options, query, isSearching]);

  const showCount = isSearching
    ? Math.min(SEARCH_MAX, filtered.length)
    : Math.min(visibleCount, filtered.length);
  const toShow = filtered.slice(0, showCount);
  const remaining = filtered.length - showCount;

  const grouped = useMemo(() => {
    const groups: Record<string, { label: string; icon?: string; items: AutoOption[] }> = {};
    toShow.forEach(o => {
      const key = o.group || 'other';
      if (!groups[key]) groups[key] = { label: o.groupLabel || '', icon: o.groupIcon, items: [] };
      groups[key].items.push(o);
    });
    return groups;
  }, [toShow]);

  const hasExactMatch = useMemo(() => {
    return options.some(o => o.label.trim().toLowerCase() === query);
  }, [options, query]);

  const showCustom = isSearching && !hasExactMatch;

  const handleOpen = () => {
    setDraft('');
    setVisibleCount(INITIAL_COUNT);
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const handlePick = (opt: AutoOption) => {
    if (actionValues.includes(opt.value)) {
      onSelect(opt);
      setOpen(false);
      return;
    }
    onChange(opt.label);
    onSelect(opt);
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const handleCustom = () => {
    if (!draft.trim()) return;
    onChange(draft.trim());
    onSubmit(draft.trim());
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const handleShowMore = () => setVisibleCount(c => c + STEP);

  return (
    <>
      {/* فیلد اصلی: input + دکمه ▼ */}
      <div style={{
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'stretch', width: '100%', minWidth: 0, maxWidth: '100%',
        position: 'relative',
        background: 'var(--input-bg)',
        border: `1px solid ${typedError ? 'var(--warn)' : error ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--border)'}`,
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-md, 8px)',
        transition: 'border-color .15s ease',
      }}>
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          type="text"
          value={value}
          onChange={e => {
            const v = e.target.value;
            onChange(v);
            setTypedError(null);
            setMatched(false);
            if (matchTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(matchTimerRef.current);
            matchTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
              const v2 = v.trim().toLowerCase();
              if (!v2) return;
              const exact = options.find(o => o.label.trim().toLowerCase() === v2);
              if (exact) { setMatched(true); onSelect(exact); }
            }, 200);
          }}
          onKeyDown={e => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
              e.preventDefault();
              const v2 = value.trim().toLowerCase();
              const exact = options.find(o => o.label.trim().toLowerCase() === v2);
              if (exact) {
                onSelect(exact);
                setMatched(true);
                setTypedError(null);
                inputRef.current?.blur();
              } else {
                setTypedError(hideCustom ? 'در لیست نیست — از ▼ انتخاب کن' : 'در لیست نیست — از ▼ بزن یا «افزودن دلخواه»');
                setTimeout(() => setTypedError(null), 3000);
              }
            }
          }}
          placeholder={placeholder || 'تایپ کن یا ▼ بزن'}
          autoComplete="off"
          style={{
            flex: '1 1 0%', minWidth: 0, height: 36, padding: matched ? '0 12px 0 28px' : '0 12px',
            background: 'transparent',
            border: 'none',
            color: 'var(--text)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)',
            textAlign: 'right', direction: 'rtl', outline: 'none',
          }}
        />
        {matched && (
          <span style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            left: 8,
            top: '50%',
            transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
            width: 16,
            height: 16,
            borderRadius: '50%',
            background: 'var(--accent)',
            color: '#fff',
            display: 'inline-flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            fontSize: 11,
            fontWeight: 900,
            pointerEvents: 'none',
            lineHeight: 1,
          }}>✓</span>
        )}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleOpen}
          aria-label="باز کردن لیست"
          style={{
            height: 36, minWidth: 38, padding: '0 12px',
            background: 'transparent',
            border: 'none',
            color: 'var(--muted)', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 12,
            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          <svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none" stroke="var(--muted)" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
            <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" />
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>

      {typedError && (
        <div style={{ marginTop: 4, fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--warn)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
          <span>⚠️</span> {typedError}
        </div>
      )}
      {!hideInternalError && error && !typedError && (
        <div style={{ marginTop: 4, fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--danger)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
          <span>✕</span> {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Sheet */}
      <SelectSheetShell
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        title={title}
        subtitle={options.length ? `${getGlobalFormat().count(options.length)} مورد` : undefined}
        searchable={options.length > 5}
        searchNode={
          <input
            type="text"
            value={draft}
            onChange={e => { setDraft(e.target.value); setVisibleCount(INITIAL_COUNT); }}
            placeholder="جستجو... (اختیاری)"
            autoComplete="off"
            style={{
              width: '100%', padding: '9px 12px',
              background: 'var(--input-bg)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 8,
              color: 'var(--text)', fontFamily: 'inherit',
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', outline: 'none',
              direction: 'rtl', textAlign: 'right',
            }}
          />
        }
      >
        {filtered.length === 0 ? (
          <div style={{ padding: '30px 20px', textAlign: 'center' }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '2em', marginBottom: 8 }}>🔍</div>
            <div style={{ color: 'var(--text)', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', marginBottom: 4 }}>
              {emptyMessage || 'موردی یافت نشد'}
            </div>
            {emptyHint && (
              <div style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', lineHeight: 1.7 }}>
                {emptyHint}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {Object.entries(grouped).map(([key, g]) => (
              <SheetGroup key={key} title={g.label || '—'} icon={g.icon} count={g.items.length}>
                {g.items.map(opt => (
                  <SheetItem
                    key={opt.value}
                    icon={opt.icon}
                    title={opt.label}
                    selected={opt.label.trim().toLowerCase() === value.trim().toLowerCase()}
                    onClick={() => handlePick(opt)}
                  />
                ))}
              </SheetGroup>
            ))}

            {!isSearching && remaining > 0 && (
              <button type="button" onClick={handleShowMore} style={BTN_MORE}>
                ↓ نمایش {getGlobalFormat().count(remaining)} مورد دیگر
              </button>
            )}

            {showCustom && !hideCustom && (
              <button type="button" onClick={handleCustom} style={BTN_CUSTOM}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 16, flexShrink: 0 }}>➕</span>
                <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>{customLabel} «{draft.trim()}»</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </SelectSheetShell>
    </>
  );
}

const BTN_MORE: React.CSSProperties = {
  width: '100%', padding: 12,
  background: 'var(--input-bg)',
  border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 10,
  color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700,
  fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', cursor: 'pointer',
  fontFamily: 'inherit', textAlign: 'center',
};

const BTN_CUSTOM: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12,
  width: '100%', minHeight: 48, padding: '11px 16px',
  background: 'var(--accent-soft)',
  border: '2px dashed var(--accent-border)', borderRadius: 10,
  color: 'var(--accent)', fontFamily: 'inherit',
  fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700,
  cursor: 'pointer', textAlign: 'right', direction: 'rtl',
};

// ═══ helper ═══

      <nav style={{

        WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(24px) saturate(1.5)',
        borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',

      }}>

                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center'
                  }}>
                    {/* پس‌زمینه pill فعال */}
                    {isActive ? (
                      <div style={{

                        boxShadow: '0 4px 12px var(--accent-border)',
                        animation: 'pmPillPop 0.35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)'
                      }} />
                    ) : null}

                    {/* آیکون */}
                    <svg
                      width="22"
                      height="22"
                      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                      fill="none"
                      stroke="currentColor"
                      strokeWidth={isActive ? 2.4 : 1.9}
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      style={{
                        position: 'relative',
                        zIndex: 1,
                        color: isActive ? '#ffffff' : 'var(--muted)',
                        animation: isPressed
                          ? 'pmNavBounce 0.4s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)'
                          : 'none',
                        transition: 'color .25s, stroke-width .25s',
                        filter: isActive ? 'drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.15))' : 'none'
                      }}
                    >
                      {icon.split(' M').map((seg, i) => (
                        <path key={i} d={(i === 0 ? '' : 'M') + seg} />
                      ))}
                    </svg>
                  </div>

                  {/* متن */}
                  <span style={{
                    fontSize: isActive ? 'calc(var(--fs-xs) + 0.5px)' : 'var(--fs-xs)',
                    fontWeight: isActive ? 800 : 500,
                    color: isActive ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
                    letterSpacing: isActive ? '-.2px' : '0',
                    transition: 'background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease',
                    lineHeight: 1,
                    animation: isActive ? 'pmLabelFade 0.3s ease-out' : 'none'
                  }}>
                    {label}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </NavLink>
          );
        })}
      </nav>
    </>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useSet } from '../../mod/set/store';

// hook مشترک برای lowPowerMode + prefers-reduced-motion
function useNoAnim() {
  const lowPower = useSet((st: any) => st.lowPowerMode);
  const [prefersReduced, setPrefersReduced] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
      setPrefersReduced(mq.matches);
      const handler = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setPrefersReduced(e.matches);
      mq.addEventListener('change', handler);
      return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', handler);
    } catch {
      /* silent */
    }
  }, []);
  return !!(lowPower || prefersReduced);
}

interface BarChartProps {
  data: { label: string; value: number }[];
  color?: string;
  height?: number;
  formatValue?: (n: number) => string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
}

export function BarChart({
  data,
  color = 'var(--accent)',
  height = 160,
  formatValue,
  ariaLabel,
}: BarChartProps) {
  const noAnim = useNoAnim();
  const max = Math.max(...data.map(d => d.value), 1);
  const total = data.reduce((a, d) => a + d.value, 0);
  const label = ariaLabel || `نمودار میلهای — ${data.length} میله، مجموع ${shortNumFa(total)}`;

  return (
    <div
      role="img"
      aria-label={label}
      style={{ width: '100%', padding: '12px 0' }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'flex-end',
          gap: 4,
          height,
          padding: '0 4px',
        }}
      >
        {data.map((d, i) => {
          const h = (d.value / max) * (height - 40);
          return (
            <div
              key={i}
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 4,
              }}
            >
              <div
                style={{
                  fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
                  color: 'var(--muted)',
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums',
                }}
              >
                {d.value > 0
                  ? formatValue
                    ? formatValue(d.value)
                    : shortNumFa(d.value)
                  : ''}
              </div>
              <div
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  maxWidth: 32,
                  height: Math.max(h, 2),
                  background: color,
                  borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm) var(--r-sm) 0 0',
                  transition: noAnim ? 'none' : 'height var(--dur-base)',

          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          gap: 4,
          padding: '6px 4px 0',
          borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',
        }}
      >
        {data.map((d, i) => (
          <div
            key={i}
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              textAlign: 'center',
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
              color: 'var(--muted)',
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              textOverflow: 'ellipsis',

          >
            {d.label}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// LineChart
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
interface LineChartProps {
  data: { label: string; value: number }[];
  color?: string;
  height?: number;
  ariaLabel?: string;
}

export function LineChart({
  data,
  color = 'var(--accent)',
  height = 140,
  ariaLabel,
}: LineChartProps) {
  const noAnim = useNoAnim();

  if (data.length < 2) {
    return (
      <div
        role="status"
        style={{
          padding: 40,
          textAlign: 'center',
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
          color: 'var(--muted)',
        }}
      >
        برای نمایش نمودار، حداقل ۲ نقطه داده لازم است
      </div>
    );
  }

  const max = Math.max(...data.map(d => d.value), 1);
  const min = Math.min(...data.map(d => d.value), 0);
  const range = max - min || 1;
  const w = 100;
  const h = 60;
  const total = data.reduce((a, d) => a + d.value, 0);
  const label = ariaLabel || `نمودار خطی — ${data.length} نقطه، مجموع ${shortNumFa(total)}`;

  const points = data.map((d, i) => {
    const x = (i / (data.length - 1)) * w;
    const y = h - ((d.value - min) / range) * h;
    return { x, y };
  });

  const pathD = points.map((p, i) => (i === 0 ? 'M' : 'L') + p.x + ',' + p.y).join(' ');
  const areaD = pathD + ' L' + w + ',' + h + ' L0,' + h + ' Z';

  // شناسه یکتا برای gradient (چند LineChart تو یه صفحه)
  const gradId = 'pmLineGrad-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);

  return (
    <div
      role="img"
      aria-label={label}
      style={{ width: '100%', padding: '12px 0' }}
    >
      <svg
        viewBox={'0 0 ' + w + ' ' + h}
        preserveAspectRatio="none"
        style={{ width: '100%', height, display: 'block' }}
      >
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id={gradId} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor={color} stopOpacity="0.3" />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor={color} stopOpacity="0" />
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>
        <path d={areaD} fill={`url(#${gradId})`} />
        <path
          d={pathD}
          fill="none"
          stroke={color}
          strokeWidth="0.8"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          strokeLinecap="round"
          vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke"
        />
        {points.map((p, i) => (
          <circle
            key={i}
            cx={p.x}
            cy={p.y}
            r="1"
            fill={color}
            vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke"
          />
        ))}
      </svg>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, padding: '6px 4px 0' }}>
        {data.map((d, i) => (
          <div
            key={i}
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              textAlign: 'center',
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
              color: 'var(--muted)',
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
            }}
          >
            {d.label}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// PieChart
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
interface PieProps {
  data: { label: string; value: number; color: string }[];
  size?: number;
  ariaLabel?: string;
}

export function PieChart({ data, size = 140, ariaLabel }: PieProps) {
  const total = data.reduce((a, d) => a + d.value, 0);

  if (total === 0) {
    return (
      <div
        role="status"
        style={{
          padding: 30,
          textAlign: 'center',
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
          color: 'var(--muted)',
        }}
      >
        داده‌ای برای نمایش نیست
      </div>
    );
  }

  const label =
    ariaLabel ||
    `نمودار دایره‌ای — ${data.filter(d => d.value > 0).length} بخش، مجموع ${shortNumFa(total)}`;

  let acc = 0;
  const radius = 50;
  const cx = 60;
  const cy = 60;
  const arcs = data.map(d => {
    const start = (acc / total) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
    acc += d.value;
    const end = (acc / total) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
    const x1 = cx + radius * Math.cos(start);
    const y1 = cy + radius * Math.sin(start);
    const x2 = cx + radius * Math.cos(end);
    const y2 = cy + radius * Math.sin(end);
    const largeArc = end - start > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;
    const pathD =
      'M' + cx + ',' + cy + ' L' + x1 + ',' + y1 +
      ' A' + radius + ',' + radius + ' 0 ' + largeArc + ' 1 ' + x2 + ',' + y2 + ' Z';
    return { pathD, color: d.color };
  });

  return (
    <div
      role="img"
      aria-label={label}
      style={{
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 16,
        padding: '12px 0',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        flexWrap: 'wrap',
      }}
    >
      <svg viewBox="0 0 120 120" style={{ width: size, height: size }}>
        {arcs.map((a, i) => (
          <path key={i} d={a.pathD} fill={a.color} />
        ))}
        <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r="28" fill="var(--card-solid)" />
      </svg>
      <div
        role="list"
        style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}
      >
        {data
          .filter(d => d.value > 0)
          .map((d, i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              role="listitem"
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
              }}
            >
              <div
                aria-hidden="true"
                style={{ width: 12, height: 12, background: d.color, borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)' }}
              />
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{d.label}</span>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                ({toFaNum(Math.round((d.value / total) * 1000) / 10)}٪)
              </span>
            </div>
          ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Utilities
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function shortNumFa(n: number): string {
  const abs = Math.abs(n);
  if (abs >= 1_000_000_000) return toFaNum((n / 1_000_000_000).toFixed(1)) + 'B';
  if (abs >= 1_000_000) return toFaNum((n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)) + 'M';
  if (abs >= 1_000) return toFaNum((n / 1_000).toFixed(0)) + 'k';
  return toFaNum(String(Math.round(n)));
}

function toFaNum(s: string | number): string {
  return String(s).replace(/[0-9]/g, d => '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'[+d]);
}

} from 'date-fns-jalali';

const JALALI_MONTHS = ['فروردین', 'اردیبهشت', 'خرداد', 'تیر', 'مرداد', 'شهریور', 'مهر', 'آبان', 'آذر', 'دی', 'بهمن', 'اسفند'];
const GREG_MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
const JALALI_WEEKDAYS = ['ش', 'ی', 'د', 'س', 'چ', 'پ', 'ج'];
const GREG_WEEKDAYS = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'];

const toLatin = (s: string) =>
  s.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d) => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));

interface Props {
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  required?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  warn?: string;
  compact?: boolean;
  min?: string;
  max?: string;
  autoToday?: boolean;
}

export default function DatePicker({
  value,
  onChange,
  placeholder = 'انتخاب تاریخ',
  disabled = false,
  required = false,
  error,
  warn,
  compact = false,
  min,
  max,
  autoToday = false,
}: Props) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(value || '');
  const fmt = useFormat();
  const isGregorian = fmt.units.dateFormat === 'gregorian';
  const lowPower = useSet((st: any) => st.lowPowerMode);
  const [prefersReduced, setPrefersReduced] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
      setPrefersReduced(mq.matches);
      const handler = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setPrefersReduced(e.matches);
      mq.addEventListener('change', handler);
      return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', handler);
    } catch { /* silent */ }
  }, []);
  const noAnim = !!(lowPower || prefersReduced);

  const today = new Date();
  const todayStr = format(today, 'yyyy/MM/dd');

  const parseValueToDate = (val?: string): Date | null => {
    if (!val) return null;
    try {
      const p = parse(toLatin(val), 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
      return isNaN(p.getTime()) ? null : p;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  };

  const [cursor, setCursor] = useState<Date>(() => parseValueToDate(value) || today);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (autoToday && !value && !disabled) {
      onChange(todayStr);
    }
  }, [autoToday, disabled]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    setCursor(parseValueToDate(value) || new Date());
  }, [open]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) setPending(value || '');
  }, [open, value]);

  const isInRange = (dateStr: string) => {
    if (min && dateStr < min) return false;
    if (max && dateStr > max) return false;
    return true;
  };

  const borderColor = error ? 'var(--danger)' : warn ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--border)';
  const height = compact ? 32 : 38;

  // محاسبات ماه در حالت شمسی یا میلادی
  const months = isGregorian ? GREG_MONTHS : JALALI_MONTHS;
  const weekdays = isGregorian ? GREG_WEEKDAYS : JALALI_WEEKDAYS;

  const { year, month, daysInMonth, firstCol, years } = useMemo(() => {
    if (!isGregorian) {
      const cy = getYear(new Date());
      const yrList = Array.from({ length: 31 }, (_, i) => cy - 15 + i);
      const y = getYear(cursor);
      const m = getMonth(cursor);
      const mStart = startOfMonth(cursor);
      const mEnd = endOfMonth(cursor);
      return {
        year: y,
        month: m,
        daysInMonth: getDate(mEnd),
        firstCol: (mStart.getDay() + 1) % 7,
        years: yrList,
      };
    }
    const cy = new Date().getFullYear();
    const yrList = Array.from({ length: 31 }, (_, i) => cy - 15 + i);
    const y = cursor.getFullYear();
    const m = cursor.getMonth();
    const first = new Date(y, m, 1);
    const last = new Date(y, m + 1, 0);
    return {
      year: y,
      month: m,
      daysInMonth: last.getDate(),
      firstCol: first.getDay(),
      years: yrList,
    };
  }, [cursor, isGregorian]);

  const stepMonth = (delta: number) => {
    if (!isGregorian) {
      setCursor(delta > 0 ? addMonths(cursor, 1) : subMonths(cursor, 1));
    } else {
      setCursor(new Date(cursor.getFullYear(), cursor.getMonth() + delta, 1));
    }
  };

  const changeMonth = (mIdx: number) => {
    if (!isGregorian) setCursor(setMonth(cursor, mIdx));
    else setCursor(new Date(cursor.getFullYear(), mIdx, 1));
  };

  const changeYear = (yr: number) => {
    if (!isGregorian) setCursor(setYear(cursor, yr));
    else setCursor(new Date(yr, cursor.getMonth(), 1));
  };

  const buildDateObj = (day: number): Date => {
    if (!isGregorian) return setDate(cursor, day);
    return new Date(cursor.getFullYear(), cursor.getMonth(), day);
  };

  const handleSelect = (day: number) => {
    const d = buildDateObj(day);
    const dStr = format(d, 'yyyy/MM/dd');
    if (!isInRange(dStr)) return;
    setPending(dStr);
  };

  const formatCellDay = (d: Date, dayNum: number) => {
    if (!isGregorian) return fmt.count(dayNum);
    return fmt.raw.digits(String(dayNum), fmt.units.numberFormat);
  };

  const formatYearOption = (yr: number) => {
    return fmt.raw.digits(String(yr), fmt.units.numberFormat);
  };

  const displayTriggerText = value ? fmt.date(value) : placeholder;

  return (
    <>
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => !disabled && setOpen(true)}
        aria-haspopup="dialog"
        aria-label={required ? `${placeholder} (اجباری)` : placeholder}
        aria-invalid={!!error}
        style={{
          width: '100%',
          height, boxSizing: 'border-box',
          background: 'var(--input-bg)',
          border: `1px solid ${borderColor}`,
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
          padding: compact ? '0 10px' : '0 12px',
          color: value ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--dim)',
          fontFamily: 'inherit',
          fontSize: compact ? 'var(--fs-sm)' : 'var(--fs-base)',
          cursor: disabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
          opacity: disabled ? 0.55 : 1,
          textAlign: 'right',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          gap: 8,
          minWidth: 0,
          outline: 'none',
        }}
      >
        <span style={{ overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
          {displayTriggerText}
          {required && !value ? <span style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', marginRight: 4 }}>*</span> : null}
        </span>
        <svg width={compact ? 13 : 15} height={compact ? 13 : 15} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" style={{ flexShrink: 0, color: 'var(--dim)' }} aria-hidden="true">
          <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2" />
          <path d="M16 2v4M8 2v4M3 10h18" />
        </svg>
      </button>

      <Modal
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        title="انتخاب تاریخ"
        size="md"
        fullWidth
        z={10050}
        footer={
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
            <Btn
              variant="primary"
              full
              disabled={!pending}
              onClick={() => { if (pending && isInRange(pending)) { onChange(pending); setOpen(false); } }}
              style={{ height: 38 }}
            >✓ تأیید</Btn>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
              <Btn
                onClick={() => { if (isInRange(todayStr)) { setPending(todayStr); setCursor(new Date()); } }}
                style={{ flex: 1, height: 34 }}
              >امروز</Btn>
              <Btn
                onClick={() => { setPending(''); }}
                style={{ flex: 1, height: 34 }}
              >پاک</Btn>
            </div>
          </div>
        }
      >
        {/* ═══ هدر: فلش چپ | ماه | سال | فلش راست ═══ */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, paddingBottom: 8 }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => stepMonth(-1)}
            aria-label="ماه قبل"
            style={{ width: 34, height: 34, background: 'var(--btn-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', color: 'var(--muted)', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 16, fontFamily: 'inherit', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}
          >›</button>
          <select
            value={String(month)}
            onChange={(e) => changeMonth(+e.target.value)}
            aria-label="ماه"
            style={{ flex: 1.5, height: 34, background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', padding: '0 6px', color: 'var(--text)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, minWidth: 0 }}
          >
            {months.map((m, i) => <option key={i} value={i}>{m}</option>)}
          </select>
          <select
            value={String(year)}
            onChange={(e) => changeYear(+e.target.value)}
            aria-label="سال"
            style={{ flex: 1, height: 34, background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', padding: '0 6px', color: 'var(--text)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)', fontWeight: 700, minWidth: 0 }}
          >
            {years.map((y) => <option key={y} value={y}>{formatYearOption(y)}</option>)}
          </select>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => stepMonth(1)}
            aria-label="ماه بعد"
            style={{ width: 34, height: 34, background: 'var(--btn-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)', color: 'var(--muted)', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 16, fontFamily: 'inherit', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}
          >‹</button>
        </div>

        {/* ═══ روزهای هفته ═══ */}
        <div role="row" style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(7, 1fr)', gap: 2, marginTop: 2 }}>
          {weekdays.map((w, i) => (
            <div key={i} role="columnheader" style={{ textAlign: 'center', fontSize: 10, color: (!isGregorian && i === 6) || (isGregorian && i === 0) ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--dim)', padding: '2px 0', fontWeight: 700 }}>
              {w}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* ═══ روزها ═══ */}
        <div role="grid" style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(7, 1fr)', gap: 2 }}>
          {Array.from({ length: firstCol }).map((_, i) => (
            <div key={`e-${i}`} aria-hidden="true" />
          ))}
          {Array.from({ length: daysInMonth }).map((_, i) => {
            const day = i + 1;
            const d = buildDateObj(day);
            const dayStr = format(d, 'yyyy/MM/dd');
            const isSelected = dayStr === pending;
            const isToday = dayStr === todayStr;
            const isFriday = d.getDay() === 5;
            const isDisabled = !isInRange(dayStr);

            return (
              <button
                key={day}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleSelect(day)}
                disabled={isDisabled}
                aria-label={`${formatCellDay(d, day)} ${months[month]} ${formatYearOption(year)}`}
                aria-selected={isSelected}
                aria-current={isToday ? 'date' : undefined}
                style={{
                  height: 34,
                  padding: 0,
                  background: isSelected ? 'var(--accent)' : 'transparent',
                  color: isSelected
                    ? '#fff'
                    : isDisabled
                      ? 'var(--dim)'
                      : isFriday
                        ? 'var(--danger)'
                        : 'var(--text)',
                  border: isToday && !isSelected ? '1px solid var(--accent)' : '1px solid transparent',
                  borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                  fontFamily: 'inherit',
                  fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                  fontWeight: isSelected || isToday ? 700 : 500,
                  cursor: isDisabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                  opacity: isDisabled ? 0.35 : 1,
                  transition: noAnim ? 'none' : 'background 0.12s ease',
                }}
              >
                {formatCellDay(d, day)}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* پیش‌نمایش تاریخ انتخاب‌شده */}
        {pending && (
          <div style={{
            marginTop: 10,
            padding: '6px 10px',
            background: 'var(--input-bg)',
            borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
            color: 'var(--muted)',
            textAlign: 'center',
          }}>
            انتخاب‌شده: <b style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{fmt.date(pending)}</b>
            {isGregorian && (
              <span style={{ marginRight: 8, color: 'var(--dim)' }}>
                ({fmt.raw.digits(pending, fmt.units.numberFormat)} شمسی)
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}

import { Select } from './ui';
import SmartSelect from './SmartSelect';

interface Opt {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  group?: string;
}

interface Props {
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  parentValue: string;
  parentLabel: string;
  options: Opt[];
  emptyListMessage?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  modalTitle?: string;
  autoThreshold?: number;
  // جدید
  disabled?: boolean;
  required?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  /** 🆕 مخفی کردن متن خطای داخلی وقتی داخل <Field> است */
  hideInternalError?: boolean;
  warn?: string;
  compact?: boolean;
  groupLabels?: Record<string, string>;
  groupIcons?: Record<string, string>;
  emptyMode?: 'warning' | 'select';
}

export default function DependentSelect({
  value,
  onChange,
  parentValue,
  parentLabel,
  options,
  emptyListMessage,
  placeholder = '— انتخاب کنید —',
  modalTitle,
  autoThreshold = 4,
  disabled = false,
  required = false,
  error,
  hideInternalError = false,
  warn,
  compact = false,
  groupLabels = {},
  groupIcons = {},
  emptyMode = 'warning',
}: Props) {
  const height = compact ? 32 : 38;
  const fontSize = compact ? 'var(--fs-sm)' : 'var(--fs-base)';
  const borderColor = error
    ? 'var(--danger)'
    : warn
    ? 'var(--warn)'
    : 'var(--border)';

  // حالت ۱: والد انتخاب نشده
  if (!parentValue) {
    // 🆕 حالت select: یه Select غیرفعال ساده
    if (emptyMode === 'select') {
      return (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <Select
            value=""
            onChange={() => {}}
            disabled
            style={{ height, fontSize, opacity: 0.6, borderColor }}
          >
            <option value="">— ابتدا {parentLabel} را انتخاب کنید —</option>
          </Select>
          {!hideInternalError && error && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--danger)', fontWeight: 600, textAlign: 'right', paddingRight: 2 }} dir="rtl">
              ⚠️ {error}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    }
    return (
      <div
        role="status"
        aria-live="polite"
        title={emptyListMessage || `موردی برای «${parentLabel}» انتخاب‌شده وجود ندارد`}
        style={{
          height: 38, boxSizing: 'border-box',
          padding: '0 12px',
          background: 'var(--warn-soft)',
          border: '1px dashed var(--warn)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
          fontSize: 11,
          color: 'var(--warn)',
          fontWeight: 600,
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center',
          overflow: 'hidden',
        }}
      >
        <span style={{ overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
          ⚠️ {emptyListMessage || `موردی برای «${parentLabel}» انتخاب‌شده وجود ندارد`}
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // حالت ۳: لیست کوتاه → Select
  if (options.length <= autoThreshold) {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4, minWidth: 0 }}>
        <Select
          value={value}
          onChange={e => onChange(e.target.value)}
          disabled={disabled}
          aria-label={placeholder}
          aria-invalid={!!error}
          aria-required={required}
          style={{
            height,
            fontSize,
            borderColor,
            opacity: disabled ? 0.55 : 1,
          }}
        >
          <option value="">{placeholder}</option>
          {options.map(o => (
            <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>
              {o.label}
              {o.subtitle ? ` — ${o.subtitle}` : ''}
            </option>
          ))}
        </Select>
        {!hideInternalError && (error || warn) && (
          <div
            style={{
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
              color: error ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--warn)',
            }}
          >
            {error ? `✕ ${error}` : `⚠ ${warn}`}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // حالت ۴: لیست بلند → SmartSelect
  return (
    <SmartSelect
      value={value}
      onChange={onChange}
      options={options}
      placeholder={placeholder}
      modalTitle={modalTitle || `انتخاب ${parentLabel}`}
      autoThreshold={autoThreshold}
      disabled={disabled}
      required={required}
      error={error}
      warn={warn}
      compact={compact}
      groupLabels={groupLabels}
      groupIcons={groupIcons}
    />
  );
}
