import { useEffect, useRef, useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import { useDialog, type DialogType } from '../../cor/store/dialog';
import { Btn } from './ui';
import { useSet } from '../../mod/set/store';
import { playBeep, vibrate } from '../../shr/utils/audio';

const TYPE_CONFIG: Record<DialogType, { icon: string; color: string }> = {
  alert: { icon: '⚠', color: 'warn' },
  confirm: { icon: '❓', color: 'accent' },
  success: { icon: '✅', color: 'accent' },
  error: { icon: '✕', color: 'danger' },
  danger: { icon: '🚨', color: 'danger' },
  info: { icon: 'ℹ️', color: 'info' },
};

function useNoAnim() {
  const lowPower = useSet((st: any) => st.lowPowerMode);
  const [prefersReduced, setPrefersReduced] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
      setPrefersReduced(mq.matches);
      const handler = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setPrefersReduced(e.matches);
      mq.addEventListener('change', handler);
      return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', handler);
    } catch {
      /* silent */
    }
  }, []);
  return !!(lowPower || prefersReduced);
}



/** چک ساعت سکوت */
function isQuietHour(): boolean {
  try {
    const s = useSet.getState();
    if (!s.quietHours?.enabled) return false;
    const now = new Date();
    const hh = String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
    const mm = String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
    const current = `${hh}:${mm}`;
    const from = s.quietHours.from || '22:00';
    const to = s.quietHours.to || '07:00';
    // اگه from > to (مثل 22 تا 7)
    if (from > to) {
      return current >= from || current <= to;
    }
    return current >= from && current <= to;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

const toFaDigits = (str: string) =>
  str.replace(/[0-9]/g, (d) => "۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹"[Number(d)]);

const stripEmojis = (str: string) =>
  str.replace(/[\u{1F300}-\u{1FAFF}\u{2600}-\u{27BF}\uFE0F\u200D]/gu, "");

const formatDialogText = (raw?: string) => {
  if (!raw) return "";
  return raw
    .split("\n")
    .map((line) => {
      let out = stripEmojis(line).replace(/\s{2,}/g, " ").trim();
      out = out.replace(/\.+(?=\s*$)/, "");
      return toFaDigits(out);
    })
    .join("\n");
};

export default function DialogHost() {
  const { open, config, close } = useDialog();
  const noAnim = useNoAnim();
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState('');

  // sync ورودی با config
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open && config?.input) {
      setInputValue(config.input.defaultValue || '');
    }
  }, [open, config]);

  const modalRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const previousFocus = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const confirmBtnId = useRef('dialog-confirm-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9));
  const titleId = useRef('dialog-title-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9));
  const messageId = useRef('dialog-msg-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9));

  const handleConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    try {
      if (config?.input?.required && !inputValue.trim()) return;
      config?.onConfirm?.(config?.input ? inputValue : undefined);
    } catch {
      /* silent */
    }
    close();
  }, [config, close, inputValue]);

  const handleCancel = useCallback(() => {
    try {
      config?.onCancel?.();
    } catch {
      /* silent */
    }
    close();
  }, [config, close]);

  // Focus + Esc + scroll lock
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;

    previousFocus.current = document.activeElement as HTMLElement;

    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleCancel();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

    setTimeout(() => {
      // برای danger، focus روی cancel (امن‌ترین)
      if (type === 'danger' || type === 'confirm') {
        const cancelBtn = modalRef.current?.querySelector('button:not([id])') as HTMLElement;
        if (cancelBtn) { cancelBtn.focus(); return; }
      }
      const btn = document.getElementById(confirmBtnId.current);
      btn?.focus();
    }, 100);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      try {
        previousFocus.current?.focus();
      } catch {
        /* silent */
      }
    };
  }, [open, handleCancel]);

  // Focus trap
  const handleKeyDown = useCallback((e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key !== 'Tab') return;
    const focusables = modalRef.current?.querySelectorAll(
      'button:not([disabled]), [href], input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
    );
    if (!focusables || focusables.length === 0) return;

    const first = focusables[0] as HTMLElement;
    const last = focusables[focusables.length - 1] as HTMLElement;
    const active = document.activeElement;

    if (e.shiftKey) {
      if (active === first) {
        e.preventDefault();
        last.focus();
      }
    } else {
      if (active === last) {
        e.preventDefault();
        first.focus();
      }
    }
  }, []);

  // صدای بوق + لرزش هنگام باز شدن دیالوگ
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !config) return;
    try {
      const s = useSet.getState();
      if (s.channels?.sound !== false) playBeep(config.type);
      if (s.channels?.vibration !== false) vibrate(config.type);
    } catch {}
  }, [open, config?.type]);

  if (!open || !config) return null;

  // چک کانال in-app
  try {
    const s = useSet.getState();
    if (s.channels && s.channels.inApp === false) return null;
    if (isQuietHour() && (config.type === 'info' || config.type === 'success')) {
      return null; // ساعات سکوت فقط info/success رو بلاک می‌کنه
    }
  } catch {}

  const type: DialogType = config.type || 'info';
  const cfg = TYPE_CONFIG[type] || TYPE_CONFIG.info;

  const color = `var(--${cfg.color})`;
  const soft = `var(--${cfg.color}-soft)`;

  const isConfirm = type === 'confirm' || type === 'danger';

  return (
    <div
      role="presentation"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) {
          handleCancel();
        }
      }}
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        background: 'var(--overlay)',
        zIndex: 50000,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        padding: 16,
      }}
    >
      <div
        ref={modalRef}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby={titleId.current}
        aria-describedby={config.message ? messageId.current : undefined}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        style={{
          background: 'var(--card-solid)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-2xl)',
          width: '100%',
          maxWidth: 320,
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          alignItems: 'center',
          padding: '20px',
          gap: 10,
          animation: noAnim
            ? 'none'
            : 'pmScaleIn var(--dur-enter) var(--ease-out)',
          boxShadow: 'var(--shadow)',
        }}
      >
                  <div
            aria-hidden="true"
            style={{
              width: 36,
              height: 36,
              borderRadius: '50%',
              background: soft,
              color: color,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              fontSize: 18,
              fontWeight: 600,
              flexShrink: 0,
            }}
          >
            {cfg.icon}
          </div>

{config.title && (
          <div
            id={titleId.current}
            style={{
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)',
              fontWeight: 600,
              textAlign: 'center',
              color: 'var(--text)',
              lineHeight: 1.4,
            }}
          >
            {formatDialogText(config.title)}
          </div>
        )}

        {config.message && (
          <div
            id={messageId.current}
            style={{
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
              color: 'var(--muted)',
              textAlign: 'center',
              lineHeight: 1.5,
              whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap',
            }}
          >
            {formatDialogText(config.message)}
          </div>
        )}

        {config.input && (
          <div style={{ width: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
            {config.input.label && (
              <label style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 600, textAlign: 'right' }}>
                {config.input.label}
                {config.input.required && <span style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', marginRight: 4 }}>*</span>}
              </label>
            )}
            {config.input.multiline ? (
              <textarea
                rows={config.input.rows || 3}
                placeholder={config.input.placeholder}
                value={inputValue}
                onChange={e => setInputValue(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.ctrlKey) { e.preventDefault(); handleConfirm(); } }}
                style={{
                  width: '100%', minHeight: 60, padding: '8px 10px',
                  background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                  borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', color: 'var(--text)',
                  fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                  resize: 'vertical', boxSizing: 'border-box',
                }}
              />
            ) : (
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder={config.input.placeholder}
                value={inputValue}
                onChange={e => setInputValue(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); handleConfirm(); } }}
                style={{
                  width: '100%', padding: '8px 10px',
                  background: 'var(--input-bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                  borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', color: 'var(--text)',
                  fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
                  textAlign: 'right', boxSizing: 'border-box',
                }}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            gap: 8,
            width: '100%',
            marginTop: 6,
            direction: 'rtl',
          }}
        >
          <Btn
            id={confirmBtnId.current}
            variant={type === 'danger' ? 'danger' : 'primary'}
            onClick={handleConfirm}
            disabled={!!(config.input?.required && !inputValue.trim())}
            style={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 44 }}
          >
            {config.confirmText || 'تأیید'}
          </Btn>
          {isConfirm && (
            <Btn onClick={handleCancel} style={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 44 }}>
              {config.cancelText || 'لغو'}
            </Btn>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


==========================================
FILE: ./src/shr/components/EditableSelect.tsx
==========================================
/**
 * EditableSelect.tsx — انتخاب‌گر با قابلیت افزودن/ویرایش/حذف
 *
 * از SelectSheetShell استفاده می‌کند (استاندارد مشترک):
 *   - هدر RTL: [عنوان] [+] [🔍] [✕]
 *   - سرگروه متمایز (سبز ملایم)
 *   - آیتم‌های مینیمال (بدون border، خط جداکننده)
 *   - اسکرول ایندیکیتور ۳ نقطه پالسی
 *   - ویرایش/حذف داخل آیتم‌های سفارشی
 *   - جستجو فقط اگه > ۵ آیتم
 */
import { getGlobalFormat } from '../units/useFormat';


import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Btn, Field, Input } from './ui';
import { useCustomOptions, type CustomOption } from '../store/customOptions';
import { showConfirmAsync } from '../../cor/store/dialog';
import UndoBar from '../../cor/ui/UndoBar';
import SelectSheetShell, { SheetGroup, SheetItem } from './SelectSheetShell';
import { Package, Sparkles, Trash2, Pencil } from 'lucide-react';
import { EMOJI_GROUPS } from '../data/emojis';

export interface EditableOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: string | React.ReactNode;
  /** 🆕 اگه پر شه، آیکون از EquipmentIcon میاد */
  equipType?: string;
  /** 🆕 دسته برای رنگ IconBadge */
  category?: string;
}

interface Props {
  label?: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  options: EditableOption[];
  customKey?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  usageCheck?: (name: string) => number;
}

const ACTION_BTN: React.CSSProperties = {
  width: 34, height: 34, borderRadius: 8,
  border: 'none', background: 'transparent',
  color: 'var(--muted)', cursor: 'pointer',
  display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
  padding: 0,
  transition: 'background .12s, color .12s',
};

export default function EditableSelect({
  label, value, onChange, options, customKey, placeholder, required, error, usageCheck,
}: Props) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [view, setView] = useState<'list' | 'form'>('list');
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [formName, setFormName] = useState('');
  const [formIcon, setFormIcon] = useState('🔧');
  const [emojiOpen, setEmojiOpen] = useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [undoData, setUndoData] = useState<{ id: string; name: string } | null>(null);

  const { getByKey, addOption, updateOption, hideOption, unhideOption } = useCustomOptions();
  const customs = customKey ? getByKey(customKey) : [];

  const all: EditableOption[] = [
    ...options,
    ...customs.map(c => ({ value: c.name, label: c.name, icon: c.icon })),
  ];
  const current = all.find(o => o.value === value);
  const isOrphan = !!value && !current;

  // فیلتر جستجو
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const filteredOptions = useMemo(
    () => q ? options.filter(o => o.label.toLowerCase().includes(q)) : options,
    [options, q],
  );
  const filteredCustoms = useMemo(
    () => q ? customs.filter(c => c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) : customs,
    [customs, q],
  );

  const totalItems = options.length + customs.length;
  /** آستانه: ۵ آیتم — کمتر = ساده، بیشتر = کامل */
  const useEnhancedUI = totalItems > 5;
  const searchable = useEnhancedUI;

  const resetForm = () => {
    setEditId(null);
    setFormName('');
    setFormIcon('🔧');
    setEmojiOpen(false);
  };

  const openAdd = () => { resetForm(); setView('form'); };

  const openEdit = (id: string) => {
    const c = customs.find(x => x.id === id);
    if (!c) return;
    setEditId(id);
    setFormName(c.name);
    setFormIcon(c.icon);
    setEmojiOpen(false);
    setView('form');
  };

  const backToList = () => { resetForm(); setView('list'); };

  const closeAll = () => {
    resetForm();
    setView('list');
    setQuery('');
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const saveItem = () => {
    const name = formName.trim();
    if (!name) return;
    if (editId) {
      updateOption(editId, { name, icon: formIcon });
    } else if (customKey) {
      addOption(customKey, name, formIcon);
    }
    resetForm();
    setView('list');
  };

  const removeItem = async (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string, name: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const count = usageCheck ? usageCheck(name) : 0;
    const message = count > 0
      ? `«${name}» در ${count} مورد استفاده شده.\n\nاگه حذف کنی، از لیست غیب می‌شه ولی داده‌های قبلی دست‌نخورده می‌مونن.`
      : `«${name}» جای دیگه‌ای استفاده نشده.\n\nحذف بشه؟`;
    const ok = await showConfirmAsync('حذف آیتم', message, { danger: true });
    if (!ok) return;
    hideOption(id);
    setUndoData({ id, name });
    setTimeout(() => {
      setUndoData(cur => cur && cur.id === id ? null : cur);
    }, 5000);
  };

  // ═══ Trigger ═══
  const trigger = (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
      style={{
        width: '100%', height: 38, textAlign: 'right', padding: '0 12px',
        background: 'var(--input-bg)',
        border: '1px solid ' + (isOrphan ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--border)'),
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
        color: isOrphan ? 'var(--warn)' : (current ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--muted)'),
        fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit',
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
      }}
    >
      <span style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: 'right', fontWeight: isOrphan ? 700 : 400, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, minWidth: 0 }}>
        {isOrphan ? (
          <span style={{ overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
            {'⚠ ' + value + ' (حذف‌شده)'}
          </span>
        ) : current ? (
          <>
            {current.icon && <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', flexShrink: 0 }}>{current.icon}</span>}
            <span style={{ overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{current.label}</span>
          </>
        ) : (
          <span style={{ overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
            {placeholder || '— انتخاب کنید —'}
          </span>
        )}
      </span>
      <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', flexShrink: 0, display: 'inline-flex' }}>
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"
          stroke="var(--muted)" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
          <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" />
        </svg>
      </span>
    </button>
  );

  // ═══ List view ═══
  // حالت ≤ ۵: لیست تخت • حالت > ۵: گروه‌بندی‌شده
  const renderItems = (
    opts: EditableOption[],
    customsList: CustomOption[],
  ) => {
    if (!useEnhancedUI) {
      // لیست تخت
      return (
        <>
          {opts.map(o => (
            <SheetItem
              key={o.value}
              icon={o.icon}
              equipType={o.equipType}
              category={o.category}
              title={o.label}
              selected={value === o.value}
              onClick={() => { onChange(o.value); closeAll(); }}
            />
          ))}
          {customsList.map(c => (
            <SheetItem
              key={c.id}
              icon={c.icon}
              title={c.name}
              selected={value === c.name}
              onClick={() => { onChange(c.name); closeAll(); }}
              actions={renderActions(c)}
            />
          ))}
        </>
      );
    }
    // گروه‌بندی‌شده
    return (
      <>
        {opts.length > 0 && (
          <SheetGroup title="پیش‌فرض‌ها" icon={<Package size={14} />} count={opts.length}>
            {opts.map(o => (
              <SheetItem
                key={o.value}
                icon={o.icon}
                equipType={o.equipType}
                category={o.category}
                title={o.label}
                selected={value === o.value}
                onClick={() => { onChange(o.value); closeAll(); }}
              />
            ))}
          </SheetGroup>
        )}
        {customsList.length > 0 && (
          <SheetGroup title="سفارشی" icon={<Sparkles size={14} />} count={customsList.length}>
            {customsList.map(c => (
              <SheetItem
                key={c.id}
                icon={c.icon}
                title={c.name}
                selected={value === c.name}
                onClick={() => { onChange(c.name); closeAll(); }}
                actions={renderActions(c)}
              />
            ))}
          </SheetGroup>
        )}
      </>
    );
  };

  const renderActions = (c: CustomOption) => (
    <>
      <button type="button" aria-label="حذف" title="حذف"
        onClick={(e) => removeItem(e, c.id, c.name)}
        style={{
          width: 34, height: 34, borderRadius: 10,
          border: 'none',
          background: 'var(--danger-soft)',
          color: 'var(--danger)',
          cursor: 'pointer',
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
          padding: 0, flexShrink: 0,
        }}
      >
        <Trash2 size={17} strokeWidth={2.2} />
      </button>
      <button type="button" aria-label="ویرایش" title="ویرایش"
        onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); openEdit(c.id); }}
        style={{
          width: 34, height: 34, borderRadius: 10,
          border: 'none',
          background: 'var(--accent-soft)',
          color: 'var(--accent)',
          cursor: 'pointer',
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
          padding: 0, flexShrink: 0,
        }}
      >
        <Pencil size={17} strokeWidth={2.2} />
      </button>
    </>
  );

  const listView = (
    <>
      {filteredOptions.length === 0 && filteredCustoms.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{
          padding: '32px 12px', textAlign: 'center',
          color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)',
        }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 28, marginBottom: 6, opacity: 0.5 }}>🔍</div>
          <div>چیزی پیدا نشد</div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        renderItems(filteredOptions, filteredCustoms)
      )}
    </>
  );

  // ═══ Form view ═══
  const formView = (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
      <Field label="نام">
        <Input
          placeholder="مثلاً — آبخوری نیپل استیل"
          value={formName}
          onChange={e => setFormName(e.target.value)}
        />
      </Field>
      <Field label="آیکن">
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <div style={{
            width: 54, height: 54, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
            fontSize: 28, background: 'var(--input-bg)',
            borderRadius: 14, border: '1px solid var(--border)',
          }}>{formIcon}</div>
          <Btn onClick={() => setEmojiOpen(o => !o)} style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            {emojiOpen ? 'بستن ایموجی‌ها' : 'انتخاب از ایموجی‌ها'}
          </Btn>
        </div>
      </Field>
      {emojiOpen && (
        <div style={{
          padding: 10, background: 'var(--input-bg)',
          border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
        }}>
          <EmojiPickerInline value={formIcon} onPick={setFormIcon} />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  // ═══ عنوان و زیرعنوان ═══
  const sheetTitle = view === 'form'
    ? (editId ? 'ویرایش مورد' : 'افزودن مورد جدید')
    : (label || 'انتخاب');

  const subtitle = view === 'list' && searchable
    ? `${getGlobalFormat().count(all.length)} مورد`
    : undefined;

  return (
    <>
      {undoData && (
        <UndoBar
          label={`«${undoData.name}» مخفی شد`}
          onUndo={() => { unhideOption(undoData.id); setUndoData(null); }}
          onDismiss={() => setUndoData(null)}
        />
      )}
      {label ? <Field label={label} required={required} error={error}>{trigger}</Field> : trigger}
      <SelectSheetShell
        open={open}
        onClose={view === 'form' ? backToList : closeAll}
        title={sheetTitle}
        subtitle={subtitle}
        onAdd={customKey && view === 'list' ? openAdd : undefined}
        searchable={view === 'list' && searchable}
        searchNode={
          <Input
            placeholder="جستجو..."
            value={query}
            onChange={e => setQuery(e.target.value)}
          />
        }
        footer={view === 'form' ? (
          <>
            <Btn variant="primary" onClick={saveItem} disabled={!formName.trim()} style={{ flex: 1 }}>ذخیره</Btn>
            <Btn onClick={backToList} style={{ flex: 1 }}>لغو</Btn>
          </>
        ) : undefined}
      >
        {view === 'form' ? formView : listView}
      </SelectSheetShell>
    </>
  );
}

// ═══ helper ═══

// ═══ Emoji Picker Inline ═══
function EmojiPickerInline({ onPick, value }: { onPick: (e: string) => void; value?: string }) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState(EMOJI_GROUPS[0].id);
  const g = EMOJI_GROUPS.find(x => x.id === tab) || EMOJI_GROUPS[0];
  return (
    <>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, overflowX: 'auto', paddingBottom: 8 }}>
        {EMOJI_GROUPS.map(x => (
          <button key={x.id} type="button" onClick={() => setTab(x.id)} title={x.name}
            style={{
              padding: '6px 10px', fontSize: 18,
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
              border: '1px solid ' + (tab === x.id ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'),
              background: tab === x.id ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'transparent',
              cursor: 'pointer', flexShrink: 0,
            }}>
            {x.icon}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(42px, 1fr))', gap: 4 }}>
        {g.emojis.map(em => {
          const sel = value === em;
          return (
            <button key={em} type="button" onClick={() => onPick(em)}
              style={{
                padding: 8, fontSize: 22, lineHeight: 1,
                background: sel ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--card-solid)',
                border: '1px solid ' + (sel ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'),
                borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', cursor: 'pointer',
              }}>
              {em}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

export default function EmojiPicker({ open, onClose, onPick, title }: Props) {

  return (

            style={{
              padding: '6px 10px',
              fontSize: 18,
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',

              background: tab === x.id ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'transparent',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              flexShrink: 0,
            }}
          >
            {x.icon}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div style={{
        display: 'grid',
        gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(44px, 1fr))',
        gap: 4,
        maxHeight: '50vh',
        overflowY: 'auto',
      }}>
        {g.emojis.map(em => (
          <button
            key={em}
            onClick={() => { onPick(em); onClose(); }}
            style={{
              padding: 8,
              fontSize: 22,
              lineHeight: 1,
              background: 'var(--input-bg)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border)',
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            {em}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/shr/components/EntityLink.tsx

import { getGlobalFormat } from '../units/useFormat';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

export type EntityType =
  | 'flock'
  | 'bird'
  | 'breed'
  | 'hall'
  | 'zone'
  | 'party'
  | 'invoice'
  | 'item'
  | 'device'
  | 'log';

const MAP: Record<EntityType, { path: string; icon: string; tab?: string }> = {
  flock:   { path: '/flk', icon: '🐔' },
  bird:    { path: '/brd', icon: '🐣', tab: 'birds' },
  breed:   { path: '/brd', icon: '🧬', tab: 'breeds' },
  hall:    { path: '/hal', icon: '🏠' },
  zone:    { path: '/hal', icon: '📦', tab: 'zones' },
  party:   { path: '/ctc', icon: '👤' },
  invoice: { path: '/tra', icon: '📄' },
  item:    { path: '/whs', icon: '📦' },
  device:  { path: '/inc', icon: '🥚' },
  log:     { path: '/dlg', icon: '📋' },
};

export function getEntityUrl(
  type: EntityType,
  id: string,
  opts?: { tab?: string; edit?: boolean },
): string {
  const conf = MAP[type];
  if (!conf || !id) return '/';
  const finalTab = opts?.tab || conf.tab;
  const param = opts?.edit ? 'edit' : 'focus';
  return `${conf.path}?${finalTab ? `tab=${finalTab}&` : ''}${param}=${id}${opts?.edit ? `&_t=${Date.now()}` : ''}`;
}

export function useEntityNav() {
  const nav = useNavigate();
  return (type: EntityType, id: string, opts?: { tab?: string; edit?: boolean }) => {
    if (!id) return;
    nav(getEntityUrl(type, id, opts));
  };
}

interface Props {
  type: EntityType;
  id: string;
  label: string;
  sub?: string;
  /** حفظ سازگاری با فراخوانی‌های قبلی — ظاهر همیشه یکپارچه و استاندارد است */
  badge?: boolean;
  badgeBg?: string;
  badgeColor?: string;
  /** بازنویسی تب (برای invoice: sales/purchases) */
  tab?: string;
  /** برای invoice: باز کردن فرم ویرایش (به جای focus) */
  edit?: boolean;
}

export default function EntityLink({
  type,
  id,
  label,
  sub,
  tab,
  edit,
}: Props) {
  const entityNav = useEntityNav();
  const conf = MAP[type];
  if (!conf || !id) return <span>{label}</span>;

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className="pm-entity-link"
      onClick={(e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        entityNav(type, id, { tab, edit });
      }}
      aria-label={`برو به ${label}`}
      style={{
        display: 'inline-flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 4,
        background: 'transparent',
        color: 'var(--accent)',
        border: 'none',
        padding: 0,
        marginInline: 2,
        fontFamily: 'inherit',
        fontSize: 'inherit',
        fontWeight: 600,
        lineHeight: 1.4,
        textDecoration: 'underline dotted',
        textUnderlineOffset: 3,
        cursor: 'pointer',
        verticalAlign: 'baseline',
        maxWidth: '100%',
      }}
    >
      <span style={{ overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{label}</span>
      {sub && (

          · {getGlobalFormat().code(sub)}
        </span>
      )}
    </button>
  );

import { Component, type ReactNode, type ErrorInfo } from 'react';
import ErrorFallback from './ErrorFallback';
import { logError } from '../../cor/logger/logger';

interface Props {
  children: ReactNode;
  fallback?: (error: Error, errorInfo: { componentStack?: string }, reset: () => void) => ReactNode;
}

interface State {
  hasError: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
  errorInfo: { componentStack?: string };
}

export default class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  constructor(props: Props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: {} };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): Partial<State> {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    // لاگ خطا
    logError({
      type: 'React Error Boundary',
      message: error.message,
      stack: error.stack || '',
      componentStack: errorInfo.componentStack || ''
    });

    // ذخیره در state
    this.setState({
      errorInfo: { componentStack: errorInfo.componentStack || undefined }
    });

    // لاگ در console
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error('ErrorBoundary caught:', error, errorInfo);
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }

  handleReset = () => {
    this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: {} });
  };

  handleReload = () => {
    window.location.reload();
  };

  handleGoHome = () => {
    window.location.href = '/';
  };

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError && this.state.error !== null) {
      // اگر fallback سفارشی داده شده
      if (this.props.fallback) {
        return this.props.fallback(this.state.error, this.state.errorInfo, this.handleReset);
      }

      return (
        <ErrorFallback
          error={this.state.error}
          errorInfo={this.state.errorInfo}
          onReset={this.handleReset}
          onReload={this.handleReload}
          onGoHome={this.handleGoHome}
        />
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useSet } from '../../mod/set/store';

type AccentKey = 'accent' | 'warn' | 'dim' | 'purple' | 'info' | 'green' | 'amber' | 'blue' | 'gray';

interface Props {
  accent?: AccentKey;
  index?: number | string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  iconEmoji?: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  badge?: React.ReactNode;
  summary?: React.ReactNode;
  stats?: React.ReactNode;
  compact?: boolean;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  /** 🆕 شناسه آیتم برای Multi-Select */
  id?: string;
  /** 🆕 دستگیره Multi-Select (اگه پاس بشه، long-press و چک‌باکس فعال می‌شن) */
  ms?: any;
  /** 🆕 اکشن کلیک روی کارت وقتی selectionMode نیست (اختیاری) */
  onTap?: () => void;
  /** 🆕 دکمه/آیکون اضافه در هدر کارت (مثلاً ⋯ برای منو) */
  headerAction?: React.ReactNode;
  /** 🆕 شناسه برای scroll خودکار از URL ?focus=xxx */
  'data-focus-id'?: string;
  /** 🆕 حالت کارت: outer (پیش‌فرض، بیرونی) یا inner (داخلی — بدون آیکون بزرگ/شورون/نوار رنگی، با دکمه حذف) */
  variant?: 'outer' | 'inner';
  /** 🆕 تابع حذف — دکمه X قرمز (فقط در حالت inner) */
  onDelete?: () => void;
}

const COLORS: Record<AccentKey, { c: string; s: string }> = {
  accent: { c: 'var(--accent)', s: 'var(--accent-soft)' },
  green:  { c: 'var(--success)', s: 'var(--success-soft)' },
  warn:   { c: 'var(--warn)',   s: 'var(--warn-soft)' },
  amber:  { c: 'var(--warn)',   s: 'var(--warn-soft)' },
  dim:    { c: 'var(--dim)',    s: 'var(--input-bg)' },
  gray:   { c: 'var(--dim)',    s: 'var(--input-bg)' },
  purple: { c: 'var(--purple)', s: 'var(--purple-soft)' },
  info:   { c: 'var(--info)',   s: 'var(--info-soft)' },
  blue:   { c: 'var(--info)',   s: 'var(--info-soft)' },
};

export default function ExpandableCard({

  'data-focus-id': focusId = id,
  variant = 'outer',
  onDelete,
}: Props) {
  const lowPower = useSet((st: any) => st.lowPowerMode);
  const [prefersReduced, setPrefersReduced] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
      setPrefersReduced(mq.matches);
      const handler = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setPrefersReduced(e.matches);
      mq.addEventListener('change', handler);
      return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', handler);
    } catch { /* silent */ }
  }, []);
  const noAnim = !!(lowPower || prefersReduced);

  // ─── Inner variant: کارت‌های داخلی (بدون آیکون بزرگ، بدون شورون، با دکمه حذف) ───
  if (variant === 'inner') {
    const innerColor = (COLORS[accent] || COLORS.accent).c;
    return (
      <div
        data-focus-id={focusId}
        style={{
          position: 'relative',
          background: 'var(--card-solid)',
          border: '1px solid ' + (isOpen ? innerColor : 'var(--border)'),
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',

          transition: 'border-color var(--dur-base)',
        }}

          onClick={() => { if (onTap) onTap(); else onToggle(); }}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
              e.preventDefault();
              if (onTap) onTap(); else onToggle();
            }

          style={{
            padding: 'var(--pad-normal)',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            outline: 'none',
            userSelect: 'none',
            WebkitUserSelect: 'none',
            touchAction: 'manipulation',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>

              {subtitle && (
                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 2 }}>{subtitle}</div>
              )}
            </div>
            {headerAction && (

  );

/** آیتم کوچیک برای ردیف summary — بدون ارتفاع اضافی */
export function InfoItem({ icon, value, tone = 'default' }: { icon?: string; value: string; tone?: 'default' | 'accent' | 'warn' | 'danger' | 'info' | 'purple' }) {
  const colorMap: Record<string, string> = {
    default: 'var(--muted)',
    accent: 'var(--accent)',
    warn: 'var(--warn)',
    danger: 'var(--danger)',
    info: 'var(--info)',
    purple: 'var(--purple)',
  };
  const fg = colorMap[tone] || colorMap.default;
  return (
    <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 3, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', maxWidth: '35%', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      {icon && <span style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>{icon}</span>}
      <b style={{ color: fg, fontWeight: 700, direction: 'ltr', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>{value}</b>
    </span>
  );
}

  const [name, setName] = useState('');

  const save = () => {
    if (!name.trim() || !currentParams) return;
    const next = [...views.filter(v => v.name !== name), { name: name.trim(), params: currentParams }];
    safeStorage.setJSON(KEY, next);
    setViews(next);
    setName('');
    setNaming(false);
  };

  const remove = (n: string) => {
    const next = views.filter(v => v.name !== n);
    safeStorage.setJSON(KEY, next);
    setViews(next);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{
      display: 'flex',
      gap: 6,
      padding: '6px 12px',
      overflowX: 'auto',
      scrollbarWidth: 'none',
      alignItems: 'center',
      borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
      background: 'var(--bg)',
    }}>
      <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 700, flexShrink: 0 }}>
        نمای ذخیره‌شده:
      </span>

      {views.map(v => (
        <button
          key={v.name}
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onLoad(v.params)}
          onContextMenu={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); remove(v.name); }}
          style={{
            padding: '4px 8px',
            background: 'var(--btn-bg)',
            border: '1px solid var(--border)',
            borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
            color: 'var(--text)',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            fontFamily: 'inherit',
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
            fontWeight: 600,
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
          }}
        >{v.name}</button>
      ))}

      {naming ? (
        <>
          <input
            value={name}
            onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') save(); if (e.key === 'Escape') setNaming(false); }}
            placeholder="نام..."
            style={{
              width: 90,
              padding: '4px 8px',
              background: 'var(--input-bg)',
              border: '1px solid var(--accent-border)',
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
              color: 'var(--text)',
              fontFamily: 'inherit',
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
              outline: 'none',
            }}
          />
          <button type="button" onClick={save} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: 'var(--accent)', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 700 }}>✓</button>
        </>
      ) : (
        currentParams && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setNaming(true)}
            style={{
              padding: '4px 8px',
              background: 'none',
              border: '1px dashed var(--border)',
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
              color: 'var(--muted)',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              fontFamily: 'inherit',
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            }}
          >+ ذخیره</button>
        )
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { getGlobalFormat } from '../units/useFormat';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useTheme } from '../../cor/store/theme';
import { useUI } from '../../cor/store/ui';
import { useAlt, countByLevel } from '../../mod/alt/store';
import { useTra } from '../../mod/tra/store';
import { useSet } from '../../mod/set/store';
import { toFa } from '../utils/fa';
import { GlobalSearch } from '../search';

export default function Header({ title }: { title: string }) {
  const { theme, toggle } = useTheme();
  const { openMenu, openHelp } = useUI();
  const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = useState(false);
  const nav = useNavigate();
  const alerts = useAlt(s => s.alerts);
  const invoices = useTra(s => s.invoices);
  const reminders = useSet(s => s.dueDateReminders) || [7, 3, 1];
  const counts = countByLevel(alerts);

  // میان‌بر Ctrl+K / Cmd+K
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSearchOpen(v => !v);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, []);

  const today = new Date();
  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const in7Days = new Date(today);
  in7Days.setDate(in7Days.getDate() + 7);

  const dueSoon = (invoices || []).filter(inv => {
    if (!inv.dueDate) return false;
    if (inv.workflowStatus === 'paid') return false;
    try {
      const [y, m, d] = inv.dueDate.split('/').map(Number);
      const due = new Date(y, m - 1, d);
      due.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      const daysDiff = Math.round((due.getTime() - today.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
      // اگه daysDiff یکی از reminderها باشه → هشدار
      return reminders.includes(daysDiff);
    } catch { return false; }
  }).length;

  const IconBtn = ({ onClick, children, badge, badgeColor }: any) => (
    <button
      onClick={onClick}
      style={{
        width: 34, height: 34,
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
        background: 'var(--btn-bg)',
        border: '1px solid var(--border)',
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
        color: 'var(--muted)', cursor: 'pointer',
        position: 'relative', flexShrink: 0,
        padding: 0
      }}
    >
      {children}
      {badge ? (
        <span style={{
          position: 'absolute', top: -3, left: -3,
          background: badgeColor || 'var(--danger)', color: '#fff',
          fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 700,
          minWidth: 15, height: 15, borderRadius: 8,
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
          padding: '0 3px',
          border: '2px solid var(--bg)'
        }}>{badge}</span>
      ) : null}
    </button>
  );

  return (
    <header style={{
      position: 'sticky', top: 0,
      background: 'var(--card-solid, #fff)',
      WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(14px)',
      borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
      padding: '9px 12px',
      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,
      zIndex: 12
    }}>
      <IconBtn onClick={openMenu}>
        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round">
          <path d="M3 12h18M3 6h18M3 18h18" />
        </svg>
      </IconBtn>

      <h1 style={{
        fontSize: 'var(--fs-lg)', fontWeight: 700,
        flex: 1, margin: 0,
        whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis'
      }}>{title}</h1>

      <IconBtn onClick={() => setSearchOpen(true)}>
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round">
          <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8" />
          <path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3" />
        </svg>
      </IconBtn>

      <IconBtn onClick={openHelp}>
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round">
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
          <path d="M9.09 9a3 3 0 0 1 5.83 1c0 2-3 3-3 3" />
          <path d="M12 17h.01" />
        </svg>
      </IconBtn>

      <IconBtn onClick={toggle}>
        {theme === 'light' ? (
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round">
            <path d="M12 3a6 6 0 0 0 9 9 9 9 0 1 1-9-9Z" />
          </svg>
        ) : (
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4" />
            <path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4.93 4.93l1.41 1.41M17.66 17.66l1.41 1.41M2 12h2M20 12h2M6.34 17.66l-1.41 1.41M19.07 4.93l-1.41 1.41" />
          </svg>
        )}
      </IconBtn>

      <IconBtn
        onClick={() => nav('/alt')}
        badge={(counts.total + dueSoon) > 0 ? getGlobalFormat().count(counts.total + dueSoon) : null}
        badgeColor={counts.critical > 0 ? 'var(--danger)' : dueSoon > 0 ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--info)'}
      >
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round">
          <path d="M6 8a6 6 0 0 1 12 0c0 7 3 9 3 9H3s3-2 3-9" />
          <path d="M10.3 21a1.94 1.94 0 0 0 3.4 0" />
        </svg>
      </IconBtn>

      <GlobalSearch open={searchOpen} onClose={() => setSearchOpen(false)} />
    </header>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useSet } from '../../mod/set/store';

interface Props {
  id: string;
  icon?: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  tone?: 'info' | 'warn' | 'success' | 'danger';
  actionLabel?: string;
  onAction?: () => void;
}

const TONE_COLORS: Record<string, { bg: string; border: string; fg: string; icon: string }> = {
  info: { bg: 'var(--info-soft)', border: 'var(--info)', fg: 'var(--info)', icon: 'ℹ️' },
  warn: { bg: 'var(--warn-soft)', border: 'var(--warn)', fg: 'var(--warn)', icon: '⚠️' },
  success: { bg: 'var(--accent-soft)', border: 'var(--accent-border)', fg: 'var(--accent)', icon: '✅' },
  danger: { bg: 'var(--danger-soft)', border: 'var(--danger)', fg: 'var(--danger)', icon: '❌' },
};

function useNoAnim() {
  const lowPower = useSet((st: any) => st.lowPowerMode);
  const [prefersReduced, setPrefersReduced] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
      setPrefersReduced(mq.matches);
      const handler = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setPrefersReduced(e.matches);
      mq.addEventListener('change', handler);
      return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', handler);
    } catch {
      /* silent */
    }
  }, []);
  return !!(lowPower || prefersReduced);
}

export default function HelpBanner({
  id, icon, title, description, tone = 'info', actionLabel, onAction,
}: Props) {
  const noAnim = useNoAnim();
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(false);
  const storageKey = 'help-banner-' + id;

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      if (localStorage.getItem(storageKey) === 'hidden') setHidden(true);
    } catch {
      /* silent */
    }
  }, [storageKey]);

  const dismiss = () => {
    setHidden(true);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, 'hidden');
    } catch {
      /* silent */
    }
  };

  if (hidden) return null;

  const c = TONE_COLORS[tone] || TONE_COLORS.info;

  return (
    <div data-help-banner="true"
      role="region"
      aria-label={title}
      style={{
        padding: '10px 12px',
        background: c.bg,
        border: `1px solid ${c.border}`,
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
        marginBottom: 10,
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: 6,
        position: 'relative',
        transition: noAnim ? 'none' : 'opacity var(--dur-base)',
      }}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={dismiss}
        aria-label="بستن راهنما"
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          top: 6,
          left: 6,
          background: 'transparent',
          border: 'none',
          color: c.fg,
          cursor: 'pointer',
          fontFamily: 'inherit',
          fontSize: 14,
          opacity: 0.6,
          padding: 4,
          outline: 'none',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
          width: 24,
          height: 24,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
        }}
        onFocus={e => {
          e.currentTarget.style.opacity = '1';
          e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 0 0 2px var(--accent-soft)';
        }}
        onBlur={e => {
          e.currentTarget.style.opacity = '0.6';
          e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = 'none';
        }}
      >
        ✕
      </button>

      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: 6,
          paddingLeft: 20,
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
          fontWeight: 700,
          color: c.fg,
        }}
      >
        <span aria-hidden="true">{icon || c.icon}</span>
        <span>{title}</span>
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
          lineHeight: 1.7,
          color: c.fg,
          paddingLeft: 20,
        }}
      >
        {description}
      </div>

      {actionLabel && onAction && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onAction}
          style={{
            alignSelf: 'flex-start',
            marginLeft: 20,
            marginTop: 2,
            padding: '5px 12px',
            background: c.fg,
            color: 'var(--avatar-text)',
            border: 'none',
            borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
            fontWeight: 700,
            cursor: 'pointer',
            fontFamily: 'inherit',
            outline: 'none',
          }}
          onFocus={e => {
            e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 0 0 2px var(--accent-soft)';
          }}
          onBlur={e => {
            e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = 'none';
          }}
        >
          {actionLabel}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

  try {

    return null;

const removeStorage = (k: string): void => {

const FA_DIGITS = ['۰', '۱', '۲', '۳', '۴', '۵', '۶', '۷', '۸', '۹'];
const toFaStep = (n: number) => String(n).replace(/[0-9]/g, d => FA_DIGITS[+d]);

export default function HelpModal() {
  const { helpOpen, closeHelp } = useUI();
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [dontShowAgain, setDontShowAgain] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (helpOpen) {
      setStep(0);
      setDontShowAgain(readStorage(DONT_SHOW_KEY) === '1');
    }
  }, [helpOpen]);

  const handleClose = () => {
    if (dontShowAgain) {
      writeStorage(DONT_SHOW_KEY, '1');
    } else {
      removeStorage(DONT_SHOW_KEY);
    }
    closeHelp();
  };

  const current = STEPS[step];
  const isLast = step === STEPS.length - 1;
  const isFirst = step === 0;

  return (
    <Modal
      open={helpOpen}
      onClose={handleClose}
      title="راهنمای سریع"
      footer={
        <div
          className="help-modal-footer"
          onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
          onFocus={(e) => {
            const el = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
            if (el && el.tagName === 'BUTTON') {
              el.blur();
            }
          }}
          style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'row-reverse', gap: 8, width: '100%' }}
        >
          <style>{`
            .help-modal-footer button,
            .help-modal-footer button:focus,
            .help-modal-footer button:focus-visible,
            .help-modal-footer button:active {
              outline: none !important;
              box-shadow: none !important;
            }
            .help-modal-footer button {
              flex: 1 1 0 !important;
              min-width: 0 !important;
            }
          `}</style>
          {isLast ? (
            <Btn variant="primary" onClick={handleClose}>شروع کار</Btn>
          ) : (
            <Btn variant="primary" onClick={() => setStep(s => s + 1)}>بعدی</Btn>
          )}
          {!isFirst ? (
            <Btn onClick={() => setStep(s => s - 1)}>قبلی</Btn>
          ) : null}
          {!isLast ? (
            <Btn onClick={handleClose}>رد کردن</Btn>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      }
    >
      {/* نشانگر مراحل */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, justifyContent: 'center', marginBottom: 10 }}>
        {STEPS.map((_, i) => (
          <div key={i} style={{
            width: i === step ? 20 : 6,
            height: 6,
            borderRadius: 3,
            background: i === step ? 'var(--' + current.accent + ')' : 'var(--border)',
            transition: 'background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease'
          }} />
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* آیکون و عنوان */}
      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '10px 0 4px' }}>
        <div style={{
          width: 72, height: 72, margin: '0 auto',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-2xl)',
          background: 'var(--' + current.accent + '-soft)',
          border: '2px solid var(--' + current.accent + ')',
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
          fontSize: 36
        }}>{current.icon}</div>

        <div style={{
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-lg)', fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 14,
          color: 'var(--' + current.accent + ')'
        }}>
          {current.title}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* متن */}
      <div style={{
        fontSize: '13px',
        lineHeight: 2.05,
        color: 'var(--text)',
        textAlign: 'right',
        whiteSpace: 'pre-line',
        padding: '14px 16px',
        background: 'var(--input-bg)',
        borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)'
      }}>
        {current.desc}
      </div>

      {/* شماره‌ی مرحله */}
      <div style={{
        textAlign: 'center', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--muted)'
      }}>
        مرحله {toFaStep(step + 1)} از {toFaStep(STEPS.length)}
      </div>

      {/* تیک عدم نمایش مجدد - پایین و سمت راست بدون کادر */}
      <div dir="rtl" style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "flex-start", marginTop: 4 }}>
        <label
          style={{
            display: "inline-flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 8,
            cursor: "pointer",
            userSelect: "none",
            fontSize: "var(--fs-sm)",
            color: "var(--text)",
          }}
        >
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={dontShowAgain}
            onChange={(e) => setDontShowAgain(e.target.checked)}
            style={{ width: 16, height: 16, accentColor: "var(--accent)", cursor: "pointer", margin: 0 }}
          />
          <span>دیگر نمایش داده نشود</span>
        </label>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

import { Field, Grid2, Grid3, Input, Select, HelpIcon } from './ui';
import SmartSelect from './SmartSelect';
import { FORM_DESC, USE_METHOD_DESC } from '../constants/herbal';
import { parseFaNum } from '../utils/fa';
import {
  TEMPERAMENT_LABEL, PROPERTY_LABEL, FORM_LABEL, USE_METHOD_LABEL, TIME_LABEL, SALE_REASON_LABEL,
  type MedicineTemperament, type MedicineProperty, type MedicineForm, type MedicineUseMethod,
  type MedicineTime, type SaleReason, type HerbalDetails,
} from '../utils/itemDetails';
import { ToggleChip } from './itemFormHelpers';

export default function HerbalForm({ item, updateItem }: { item: any; updateItem: (p: any) => void }) {
  const h: HerbalDetails = item.herbalDetails || {
    name: '', temperament: '', properties: [], form: '',
    doseValue: null, doseUnit: 'گرم', useMethod: '', durationDays: null, times: [],
  };

  const setH = (patch: Partial<HerbalDetails>) => {
    updateItem({ herbalDetails: { ...h, ...patch } });
  };

  const toggleProp = (p: MedicineProperty) => {
    const cur = h.properties || [];
    setH({ properties: cur.includes(p) ? cur.filter(x => x !== p) : [...cur, p] });
  };

  const toggleTime = (t: MedicineTime) => {
    const cur = h.times || [];
    setH({ times: cur.includes(t) ? cur.filter(x => x !== t) : [...cur, t] });
  };

  return (
    <div style={{
      padding: '10px 12px', background: 'var(--accent-soft)',
      border: '1px dashed var(--accent-border)', borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
      display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8,
    }}>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 700 }}>
        🌿 داروی سنتی (گیاهی)
      </div>

      <Field label="نام دوا" required>
        <Input value={h.name} onChange={e => setH({ name: e.target.value })} placeholder="مثلاً: گل گاوزبان" />
      </Field>

      <Grid2>
        <Field label="طبع">
          <Select value={h.temperament} onChange={e => setH({ temperament: e.target.value as MedicineTemperament })}>
            <option value="">— انتخاب کنید —</option>
            {Object.entries(TEMPERAMENT_LABEL).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}
          </Select>
        </Field>
        <Field label={<>نوع دوا <HelpIcon text={h.form ? FORM_DESC[h.form] : "ابتدا نوع دوا را انتخاب کنید"} /></>}>
          <SmartSelect
            value={h.form}
            onChange={v => setH({ form: v as MedicineForm })}
            options={Object.entries(FORM_LABEL).map(([k, v]) => ({ value: k, label: v }))}
            placeholder="— انتخاب کنید —"
            modalTitle="انتخاب نوع دوا"
          />
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      {h.form === 'other' && (
        <Field label="توضیح نوع دارو">
          <Input
            value={h.customForm || ''}
            onChange={e => setH({ customForm: e.target.value })}
            placeholder="مثلاً چوب دارچین یا مخلوط گیاهان"
          />
        </Field>
      )}

      <Field label="خواص" hint="چند مورد قابل انتخاب">
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 5, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {(Object.keys(PROPERTY_LABEL) as MedicineProperty[]).map(p => (
            <ToggleChip key={p} label={PROPERTY_LABEL[p]} active={h.properties.includes(p)} onClick={() => toggleProp(p)} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Field>

      <Grid2>
        <Field label="مقدار مصرف">
          <Input
            mode="number"
            value={h.doseValue !== null ? String(h.doseValue) : ''}
            onChange={e => setH({ doseValue: parseFaNum(e.target.value) || null })}
            unit={h.doseUnit} min={0} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="واحد">
          <Select value={h.doseUnit} onChange={e => setH({ doseUnit: e.target.value })}>
            <option value="گرم">گرم</option>
            <option value="میلی‌لیتر">میلی‌لیتر</option>
            <option value="عدد">عدد</option>
            <option value="قطره">قطره</option>
          </Select>
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      <Grid2>
        <Field label={<>نحوه مصرف <HelpIcon text={h.useMethod ? USE_METHOD_DESC[h.useMethod] : "ابتدا نحوه مصرف را انتخاب کنید"} /></>}>
          <SmartSelect
            value={h.useMethod}
            onChange={v => setH({ useMethod: v as MedicineUseMethod })}
            options={Object.entries(USE_METHOD_LABEL).map(([k, v]) => ({ value: k, label: v }))}
            placeholder="— انتخاب کنید —"
            modalTitle="انتخاب نحوه مصرف"
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label="مدت دوره (روز)">
          <Input
            mode="number"
            value={h.durationDays !== null ? String(h.durationDays) : ''}
            onChange={e => setH({ durationDays: Math.round(parseFaNum(e.target.value)) || null })}
            unit="روز" min={0} />
        </Field>
      </Grid2>

      <Field label="زمان مصرف" hint="چند مورد">
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 5, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {(Object.keys(TIME_LABEL) as MedicineTime[]).map(t => (
            <ToggleChip key={t} label={TIME_LABEL[t]} active={h.times.includes(t)} onClick={() => toggleTime(t)} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}

import { getGlobalFormat } from '../units/useFormat';
import { Field, LockedValue, AlertBox, Grid2, Grid3, Input, Select, NumField } from './ui';
import { isBreedAllowedForCategory, getRequiredPurposeHint } from '../../mod/brd/categoryBreedRules';
import SmartSelect from './SmartSelect';
import EntityLink from './EntityLink';
import { useBrd } from '../../mod/brd/store';
import { useHal } from '../../mod/hal/store';
import { useFlk, getAgeDays } from '../../mod/flk/store';
import { useEgg } from '../../mod/egg/store';
import { useWhs } from '../../mod/whs/store';
import { useInc, type HatchResult } from '../../mod/inc/store';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { parseFaNum, toEn, toFa, formatQty } from '../utils/fa';
import { differenceInCalendarDays, parse as parseJ, format as formatJ, subDays, isValid } from 'date-fns-jalali';
import DatePicker from './DatePicker';
import { typesForCategory } from '../../mod/hal/_equipHelpers';
import { kindForType } from '../../mod/hal/api/equipmentCalc';

export interface ItemDetailFormData {
  id?: string;
  description?: string;
  unit?: string;
  quantity?: number;
  unitPrice?: number;
  total?: number;
  discountType?: string;
  discountValue?: number;
  shipping?: number;
  flockId?: string;
  hallId?: string;
  zoneId?: string;
  birdId?: string;
  breedId?: string;
  ageDays?: number | null;
  maleCount?: number | null;
  femaleCount?: number | null;
  unknownCount?: number | null;
  hatchDate?: string;
  chickWeight?: number | null;
  healthyCount?: number | null;
  transportCost?: number | null;
  flockName?: string;
  eggDate?: string;
  brokenEggCount?: number | null;
  nonIncubableCount?: number | null;

  batchNo?: string;
  model?: string;
  warrantyMonths?: number | null;

  // 🆕 فیلدهای فروش
