/** components/ui/Modal.tsx */
import React, { useRef, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';

interface ModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title: React.ReactNode;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  footer?: React.ReactNode;
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  preventClose?: boolean;
  contentGap?: number;
  headerAction?: React.ReactNode;
  /** اگه true، وسط صفحه باز می‌شه (نه از پایین) */
  center?: boolean;
  /** لایهٔ سفارشی (برای باز شدن روی Sheet) */
  z?: number;
  /** تمام‌عرض (بدون محدودیت maxWidth) */
  fullWidth?: boolean;
}
const MODAL_SIZES: Record<'sm' | 'md' | 'lg', number> = {
  sm: 320,
  md: 480,
  lg: 640,
};
export function Modal({
  open, onClose, title, children, footer,
  size = 'md', preventClose = false, contentGap, headerAction,
  center = false,
  z,
  fullWidth = false,
}: ModalProps) {
  const modalRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const previousFocus = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const focusedRef = useRef(false);
  const onCloseRef = useRef(onClose);
  onCloseRef.current = onClose;
  const preventCloseRef = useRef(preventClose);
  preventCloseRef.current = preventClose;
  const titleId = useRef<string>('modal-title-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9));
  const [zDepth, setZDepth] = React.useState(0);

  // ─── Snap / drag (mobile bottom-sheet) ───
  const [snap, setSnap] = React.useState<'partial' | 'full'>('partial');
  const [dragY, setDragY] = React.useState(0);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = React.useState(false);
  const dragActive = useRef(false);
  const dragStartY = useRef(0);
  const dragLastY = useRef(0);
  const dragStartT = useRef(0);
  const rafRef = useRef(0);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (open) { setSnap('partial'); setDragY(0); setDragging(false); if (modalRef.current) modalRef.current.style.transform = ''; }
  }, [open]);

  const onDragStart = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    dragActive.current = true;
    dragStartY.current = e.touches[0].clientY;
    dragLastY.current = 0;
    dragStartT.current = Date.now();
    if (modalRef.current) modalRef.current.style.transition = 'none';
  };
  const onDragMove = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    if (!dragActive.current) return;
    const touchY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    const min = snap === 'full' ? 0 : -240;
    const dy = Math.max(min, Math.min(560, touchY - dragStartY.current));
    dragLastY.current = dy;
    if (rafRef.current) return;
    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      rafRef.current = 0;
      if (modalRef.current) {
        modalRef.current.style.transform = `translateY(${dragLastY.current}px)`;
      }
    });
  };
  const onDragEnd = () => {
    if (!dragActive.current) return;
    dragActive.current = false;
    if (rafRef.current) { cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current); rafRef.current = 0; }
    const dy = dragLastY.current;
    const dt = Math.max(1, Date.now() - dragStartT.current);
    const v = dy / dt;
    const fast = Math.abs(v) > 0.5;
    const el = modalRef.current;
    if (!el) return;

    if (snap === 'partial') {
      if (dy < -60 || (fast && v < -0.4)) {
        setSnap('full');
        el.style.transition = 'transform 300ms cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1)';
        el.style.transform = '';
        return;
      }
      if (dy > 110 || (fast && v > 0.5)) {
        el.style.transition = 'transform 240ms ease-out';
        el.style.transform = `translateY(${window.innerHeight}px)`;
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (!preventCloseRef.current) onCloseRef.current();
        }, 240);
        return;
      }
    } else {
      if (dy > 60 || (fast && v > 0.4)) {
        setSnap('partial');
        el.style.transition = 'transform 300ms cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1)';
        el.style.transform = '';
        return;
      }
    }
    el.style.transition = 'transform 300ms cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1)';
    el.style.transform = '';
  };

  // Esc + body scroll lock + focus return
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    // 🆕 M-fix: local timer برای cleanup تمیز (React docs: useEffect cleanup)
    let focusTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    const myDepth = (window.__modalDepth || 0);
    window.__modalDepth = myDepth + 1;
    setZDepth(myDepth);

    previousFocus.current = document.activeElement as HTMLElement;

    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && !preventCloseRef.current) {
        onCloseRef.current();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

    // autofocus فقط بار اول — فقط روی دکمه‌ها (کیبورد خودکار باز نشود)
    if (!focusedRef.current) {
      focusedRef.current = true;
      focusTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        // اگه کاربر خودش چیزی focus کرده، دست نزن
        const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
        if (active && modalRef.current?.contains(active)) return;
        let target: HTMLElement | null = null;
        const btns = modalRef.current?.querySelectorAll('button:not([disabled])');
        if (btns && btns.length > 0) {
          for (let i = btns.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const btn = btns[i] as HTMLElement;
            const text = (btn.textContent || '').trim();
            const aria = btn.getAttribute('aria-label') || '';
            const isClose = /^[✕×xX]$/.test(text)
              || aria.includes('بستن')
              || aria.includes('close')
              || aria.includes('Close');
            if (!isClose) { target = btn; break; }
          }
        }
        if (target) {
          try { target.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch { /* silent */ }
        }
      }, 250);
    }

    return () => {
      window.__modalDepth = Math.max(0, (window.__modalDepth || 0) - 1);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      if (window.__modalDepth === 0) {
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      }
      // 🆕 M-fix: clear timer در unmount — جلوگیری از ReferenceError
      if (focusTimer !== null) {
        clearTimeout(focusTimer);
        focusTimer = null;
      }
      // برگشت focus
      try {
        const pf = previousFocus.current;
        if (pf && document.contains(pf) && typeof pf.focus === 'function') {
          pf.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        }
      } catch {
        /* silent */
      }
    };
  }, [open]);

  // Focus trap: Tab / Shift+Tab
  const handleKeyDown = useCallback((e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key !== 'Tab') return;
    const focusables = modalRef.current?.querySelectorAll(
      'button:not([disabled]), [href], input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
    );
    if (!focusables || focusables.length === 0) return;

    const first = focusables[0] as HTMLElement;
    const last = focusables[focusables.length - 1] as HTMLElement;
    const active = document.activeElement;

    if (e.shiftKey) {
      if (active === first) {
        e.preventDefault();
        last.focus();
      }
    } else {
      if (active === last) {
        e.preventDefault();
        first.focus();
      }
    }
  }, []);

  // تشخیص prefers-reduced-motion
  const [prefersReduced, setPrefersReduced] = React.useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
      setPrefersReduced(mq.matches);
      const handler = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setPrefersReduced(e.matches);
      mq.addEventListener('change', handler);
      return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', handler);
    } catch {
      /* silent */
    }
  }, []);
  const noAnim = prefersReduced;

  if (!open) return null;

  const maxWidth = fullWidth ? '100%' : (MODAL_SIZES[size] || MODAL_SIZES.md);
  const isFull = snap === 'full';

  return createPortal(

    <div
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !preventClose && document.activeElement?.tagName !== "SELECT") onClose();
      }}
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        background: 'var(--overlay)',
        zIndex: z ?? (100 + zDepth * 100),
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: center ? 'center' : 'flex-end',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        padding: center ? '16px' : 0,
      }}
    >
      <div
        ref={modalRef}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby={titleId.current}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        style={{
          background: 'var(--card-solid)',
          borderTopLeftRadius: isFull ? 0 : 'var(--r-2xl)',
          borderTopRightRadius: isFull ? 0 : 'var(--r-2xl)',
          borderBottomLeftRadius: center && !isFull ? 'var(--r-2xl)' : 0,
          borderBottomRightRadius: center && !isFull ? 'var(--r-2xl)' : 0,
          boxSizing: 'border-box',
          paddingTop: 'env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)',
          width: '100%',
          maxWidth,
          maxHeight: isFull ? '100%' : '85vh',
          height: isFull ? '100%' : undefined,
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          transition: 'max-height 320ms cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1), height 320ms cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1), border-radius 220ms ease, transform 300ms cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1)',
        }}
      >
        {/* Drag handle (فقط موبایل و نه در حالت center) */}
        {!center && (
        <div
          onTouchStart={onDragStart}
          onTouchMove={onDragMove}
          onTouchEnd={onDragEnd}
          onTouchCancel={onDragEnd}
          style={{
            padding: '14px 0 10px',
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            alignItems: 'center',
            cursor: 'grab',
            touchAction: 'none',
            userSelect: 'none',
            WebkitUserSelect: 'none',
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          <div style={{
            width: 48, height: 5, borderRadius: 3,
            background: 'var(--border)',
          }} />
        </div>
        )}
        {/* Header */}
        <div
          style={{
            padding: 'calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 14px 10px',
            borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 10,
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          <div
            id={titleId.current}
            style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 'var(--fs-lg)', fontWeight: 700 }}
          >
            {title}
          </div>
          {headerAction}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="بستن"
            style={{
              width: 32,
              height: 32,
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
              background: 'var(--btn-bg)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border)',
              color: 'var(--muted)',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              fontFamily: 'inherit',
              fontSize: 14,
              outline: 'none',
            }}
            onFocus={(e) => {
              e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 0 0 2px var(--accent-soft)';
            }}
            onBlur={(e) => {
              e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = 'none';
            }}
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Body */}
        <div
          style={{
            padding: '8px 14px 14px 14px',
            overflowY: 'auto',
            overscrollBehavior: 'contain',
            WebkitOverflowScrolling: 'touch',
            flex: 1,
            minHeight: 0,
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            gap: contentGap ?? 12,
          }}
        >
          {children}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        {footer && (
          <div
            style={{
              padding: '10px 14px 18px',
              borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)',
              flexShrink: 0,
            }}
          >
            {footer}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body
  )
}

/**
 * ModalFooter.tsx — دکمه‌های footer modal با API واضح
 * استاندارد RTL: primary راست، danger وسط، secondary چپ
 */
import { Btn } from './Btn';

export interface FooterAction {
  label: string;
  role: 'primary' | 'danger' | 'secondary';
  onClick: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

interface Props {
  actions: FooterAction[];
}

export function ModalFooter({ actions }: Props) {
  if (actions.length === 0) return null;

  // Sort: primary first (right in RTL), danger middle, secondary last (left)
  const rank = (r: FooterAction['role']) => (r === 'primary' ? 0 : r === 'danger' ? 1 : 2);
  const sorted = [...actions].sort((a, b) => rank(a.role) - rank(b.role));

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--sp-2)', width: '100%' }}>
      {sorted.map((a, i) => (
        <div key={i} style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <Btn
            variant={a.role === 'secondary' ? 'outline' : a.role}
            onClick={a.onClick}
            disabled={a.disabled}
            style={{ width: '100%' }}
          >
            {a.label}
          </Btn>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../units/useFormat';
import { NumField } from './Input';
import { Select } from './Select';
import { Field } from './Field';
import { toFa, toEn } from '../../utils/fa';

export interface UnitOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  factor: number;
}

interface Props {
  value: string | number;
  onChange: (val: string) => void;
  unit: string;
  onUnitChange: (unit: string) => void;
  options: UnitOption[];
  error?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  onTouch?: () => void;
  label?: string;
  layout?: 'stack' | 'grid';
}

export function QuantityUnitInput({ value, onChange, unit, onUnitChange, options, error, placeholder, onTouch, label, layout = 'stack' }: Props) {
  const currentUnit = options.find(o => o.value === unit);
  const baseUnitOpt = options.find(o => o.factor === 1) || options[0];

  const numStr = String(value);
  const numVal = parseFloat(toEn(numStr));
  const isValidNum = !isNaN(numVal) && numVal > 0;
  const showPreview = isValidNum && currentUnit && currentUnit.factor !== 1 && baseUnitOpt;

  if (layout === 'grid') {
    return (
      <>
        <div style={{ minWidth: 0, gridColumn: options.length === 1 ? 'span 2' : undefined }}>
          <Field label={label || "مقدار"} error={error} onTouch={onTouch}>
            <NumField
              placeholder={placeholder || '۰'}
              value={value}
              onChange={e => onChange(e.target.value)}
              min={0}
              unit={options.length === 1 ? options[0].label : undefined}
            />
          </Field>
        </div>
        {options.length > 1 && (
          <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Field label="واحد">
              <Select value={unit} onChange={e => onUnitChange(e.target.value)}>
                {options.map(o => (
                  <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </Field>
          </div>
        )}
        {showPreview && (
          <div style={{ gridColumn: '1 / -1', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 600, marginTop: 2, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>
            💡 {getGlobalFormat().num(numVal)} {currentUnit?.label} = {getGlobalFormat().num(numVal * (currentUnit?.factor || 1))} {baseUnitOpt?.label}
          </div>
        )}
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6, minWidth: 0 }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
        <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <Field label={label || "مقدار مصرفی"} error={error} onTouch={onTouch}>
            <NumField
              placeholder={placeholder || '۰'}
              value={value}
              onChange={e => onChange(e.target.value)}
              min={0}
            />
          </Field>
        </div>
        {options.length > 1 && (
          <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Field label="واحد">
              <Select value={unit} onChange={e => onUnitChange(e.target.value)}>
                {options.map(o => (
                  <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </Field>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      {showPreview && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 600, marginTop: 2, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>
          💡 {getGlobalFormat().num(numVal)} {currentUnit?.label} = {getGlobalFormat().num(numVal * (currentUnit?.factor || 1))} {baseUnitOpt?.label}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** components/ui/Select.tsx */
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

interface SelectProps extends React.SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement> {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  error?: string;
  warn?: string;
}

export function Select({ children, style, error, warn, onChange, value, ...rest }: SelectProps) {
  const borderColor = error ? "var(--danger)" : warn ? "var(--warn)" : "var(--border)";
  const selectRef = useRef<HTMLSelectElement>(null);
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;
  const lastValRef = useRef(value);
  lastValRef.current = value;

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = selectRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const handleNative = (ev: Event) => {
      const target = ev.target as HTMLSelectElement;
      if (target.value !== String(lastValRef.current ?? "")) {
        onChangeRef.current?.({
          ...ev,
          target,
          currentTarget: target,
        } as unknown as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>);
      }
    };
    el.addEventListener("change", handleNative);
    el.addEventListener("input", handleNative);
    return () => {
      el.removeEventListener("change", handleNative);
      el.removeEventListener("input", handleNative);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div style={{
      width: "100%", height: 38, background: "var(--input-bg)",
      border: `1px solid ${borderColor}`, borderRadius: "var(--r-md)",
      padding: "0 12px", display: "flex", alignItems: "center",
      overflow: "hidden", boxSizing: "border-box",
      ...style,
    }}>
      <select
        ref={selectRef}
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => {
          lastValRef.current = e.target.value;
          onChange?.(e);
        }}
        {...rest}
        style={{
          flex: 1, width: "100%", minWidth: 0, background: "none", border: "none",
          outline: "none", color: "var(--text)", fontFamily: "inherit",
          fontSize: (style as any)?.fontSize || "var(--fs-base)",
        }}
      >
        {children}
      </select>
    </div>
  );
}

/** components/ui/Sheet.tsx */
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';

export function Sheet({
  open, onClose, title, footer, children, noScroll = false,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title?: string;
  footer?: React.ReactNode;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  /** اگه true، بدنه اسکرول نمی‌شه و ارتفاع به محتوا میاد */
  noScroll?: boolean;
}) {
  // انیمیشن ورود: اول mount با translateY(100%)، بعد به translateY(0)
  const [mounted, setMounted] = React.useState(false);
  const [animating, setAnimating] = React.useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setMounted(true);
      setAnimating(true);
    } else {
      setAnimating(false);
      setMounted(false);
    }
  }, [open]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose(); };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    const prevOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      document.body.style.overflow = prevOverflow;
    };
  }, [open, onClose]);

  if (!mounted) return null;

  return createPortal(
    <div
      data-sheet-open="true"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      onClick={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }}
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        zIndex: 9999,
        background: 'rgba(15,23,42,.45)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'flex-end',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        touchAction: 'none',
        opacity: 1,
      }}
    >
      <div
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        style={{
          width: '100%',
          maxWidth: '100%',
          background: 'var(--card-solid, #fff)',
          borderTopLeftRadius: 20,
          borderTopRightRadius: 20,
          padding: '10px 14px 18px',
          boxShadow: '0 -8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25)',
          maxHeight: noScroll ? 'calc(100dvh - 80px)' : '85vh',
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          gap: 8,
          transform: 'translateY(0)',
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', padding: '2px 0 4px' }}>
          <div style={{ width: 40, height: 4, borderRadius: 2, background: 'var(--dim)', opacity: 0.5 }} />
        </div>
        <div style={{
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          paddingBottom: 10, marginBottom: 8, gap: 8,
          borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
        }}>
          {title ? (
            <div style={{
              fontSize: 'var(--fs-md)', fontWeight: 700,
              textAlign: 'right', flex: 1, minWidth: 0,
            }}>{title}</div>
          ) : <div style={{ flex: 1 }} />}
          {/* Close button — چپ */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="بستن"
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
              width: 32, height: 32, flexShrink: 0,
              background: 'var(--btn-bg)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border)',
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
              color: 'var(--muted)',
              cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0,
              fontFamily: 'inherit',
              fontSize: 14,
              outline: 'none',
              transition: 'background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out)',
            }}
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>
        <div style={{
          overflowY: 'auto',
          overscrollBehavior: 'contain',
          WebkitOverflowScrolling: 'touch',
          flex: 1,
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          gap: 6,
          minHeight: 0,
        }}>
          {children}
        </div>
        {footer ? <div style={{ paddingTop: 4 }}>{footer}</div> : null}
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body
  );
}

/** StatBox — نمایش آمار کوچک و inline (مثلاً: 🧬 تعداد نژاد: ۵) */
export function StatBox({ icon, value, label, tone = 'default' }: { icon?: string; value: string; label: string; tone?: 'default' | 'accent' | 'warn' | 'danger' | 'info' | 'purple' }) {
  const colorMap: Record<string, string> = {
    default: 'var(--text)',
    accent: 'var(--accent)',
    warn: 'var(--warn)',
    danger: 'var(--danger)',
    info: 'var(--info)',
    purple: 'var(--purple)',
  };
  const fg = colorMap[tone] || colorMap.default;
  return (
    <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 3, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', maxWidth: '40%', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      {icon && <span style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>{icon}</span>}
      <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>{label}:</span>
      <b style={{ color: fg, fontWeight: 700, direction: 'ltr', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>{value}</b>
    </span>
  );
}

    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Tabs.tsx — نوار تب مشترک (استاندارد پروژه)
 * الگو: flk/FlocksTabs.jsx
 * پشتیبانی: count badge، dot پالس (آیتم جدید)، rightAction
 */
import { getGlobalFormat } from '../../units/useFormat';

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import type React from 'react';
import { toFa } from '../../utils/fa';

export interface Tab<T extends string = string> {
  id: T;
  label: string;
  count?: number;
}

interface Props<T extends string> {
  tabs: Tab<T>[];
  activeTab: T;
  onTabChange: (id: T) => void;
  newTabBadge?: T | null;
  rightAction?: React.ReactNode;
}

export function Tabs<T extends string = string>({
  tabs, activeTab, onTabChange, newTabBadge, rightAction,
}: Props<T>) {
  const barRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const bar = barRef.current;
    if (!bar) return;
    const el = bar.querySelector(`[data-tab-id="${activeTab}"]`) as HTMLElement | null;
    if (!el) return;
    const barRect = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
    const elRect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const offset = (elRect.left + elRect.width / 2) - (barRect.left + barRect.width / 2);
    if (Math.abs(offset) > 2) {
      bar.scrollBy({ left: offset, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  }, [activeTab, tabs.length]);
  return (
    <>
      <style>{`
        @keyframes tabDotPulse {
          0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
          50% { transform: scale(1.25); opacity: 0.75; }
        }
      `}</style>
      <div style={{
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'stretch',
        borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
        background: 'var(--header-bg)',
        position: 'sticky', top: 52, zIndex: 11,
      }}>
        <div
          ref={barRef}
          style={{
          flex: 1, minWidth: 0,
          display: 'flex', gap: 0,
          padding: '0 12px',
          overflowX: 'auto', scrollbarWidth: 'none',
        }}>
          {tabs.map(t => (
            <div
              key={t.id}
              data-tab-id={t.id}
              onClick={() => onTabChange(t.id)}
              style={{
                padding: '11px 14px',
                fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)',
                fontWeight: 600,
                color: activeTab === t.id ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                position: 'relative',
                whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 5,
              }}
            >
              {t.label}
              {t.count !== undefined && (
                <span style={{
                  fontSize: 12,
                  background: activeTab === t.id ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--input-bg)',
                  color: activeTab === t.id ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
                  padding: '1px 5px',
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  fontWeight: 700,
                }}>{getGlobalFormat().count(t.count)}</span>
              )}
              {newTabBadge === t.id && (
                <span
                  aria-label="آیتم جدید"
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute', top: 4, left: 4,
                    width: 9, height: 9, borderRadius: '50%',
                    background: 'var(--danger)',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px var(--bg)',
                    animation: 'tabDotPulse 1s ease-in-out infinite',
                  }}
                />
              )}
              {activeTab === t.id && (
                <div style={{
                  position: 'absolute', bottom: 0, right: 14, left: 14, height: 3,
                  background: 'var(--accent)', borderRadius: '3px 3px 0 0',
                }} />
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        {rightAction && (
          <div style={{
            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center',
            padding: '0 8px',
            borderRight: '1px solid var(--border)',
          }}>
            {rightAction}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

/** components/ui/Temp.tsx */
import React from 'react';

export function TempInput({
  value,
  onChange,
  unit,
  disabled,
  height = 32,
  fontSize = 13,
}: {
  value: number | null;
  onChange: (celsius: number | null) => void;
  unit: 'c' | 'f';
  disabled?: boolean;
  height?: number;
  fontSize?: number;
}) {
  const displayed = value == null ? '' : (
    unit === 'c' ? value : Math.round((value * 9 / 5 + 32) * 10) / 10
  );

  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    let v = e.target.value;
    v = v.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d: string) => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));
    v = v.replace(/[٫،]/g, '.');
    v = v.replace(/[^\d.-]/g, '');
    if (v === '' || v === '-' || v === '.') { onChange(null); return; }
    const n = Number(v);
    if (isNaN(n)) return;
    const celsius = unit === 'c' ? n : (n - 32) * 5 / 9;
    onChange(Math.round(celsius * 10) / 10);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, minWidth: 0 }}>
      <input
        type="text"
        inputMode="decimal"
        disabled={disabled}
        value={String(displayed)}
        onChange={handleChange}
        onFocus={(e) => e.target.select()}
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          height,
          padding: '0 6px',
          background: 'var(--input-bg)',
          border: '1px solid var(--border)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
          color: 'var(--text)',
          fontFamily: 'inherit',
          fontSize,
          fontWeight: 600,
          textAlign: 'center',
          outline: 'none',
          fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums',
          direction: 'ltr',
          minWidth: 0,
        }}
      />
      <span style={{
        fontSize: fontSize - 2,
        color: 'var(--muted)',
        flexShrink: 0,
        minWidth: 26,
        textAlign: 'left',
      }}>{unit === 'c' ? '°C' : '°F'}</span>
    </div>
  );
}
export function TempDisplay({
  value,
  unit,
  toFaFn,
  prefix = '',
  suffix = '',
}: {
  value: number | null;
  unit: 'c' | 'f';
  toFaFn: (v: any) => string;
  prefix?: string;
  suffix?: string;
}) {
  if (value == null) return <>{prefix}—{suffix}</>;
  const v = unit === 'c' ? value : Math.round((value * 9 / 5 + 32) * 10) / 10;
  return <>{prefix}{toFaFn(v)}{unit === 'c' ? '°C' : '°F'}{suffix}</>;
}

FILE: ./src/shr/date/jalali.ts
==========================================
import { format, parse, addDays, differenceInCalendarDays } from 'date-fns-jalali';

const FA = '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹';

export function normalizeDigits(s: string): string {
  return String(s ?? '')
    .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String(FA.indexOf(d)))
    .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, d => String('٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(d)));
}

export function todayJalali(): string {
  try { return format(new Date(), 'yyyy/MM/dd'); } catch { return ''; }
}

export function currentMonth(): string {
  try { return format(new Date(), 'yyyy/MM'); } catch { return ''; }
}

export function parseJalali(s: string): Date | null {
  if (!s) return null;
  try {
    const d = parse(normalizeDigits(s), 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
  } catch { return null; }
}

export function formatJalali(d: Date): string {
  try { return format(d, 'yyyy/MM/dd'); } catch { return ''; }
}

export function addJalaliDays(dateStr: string, days: number): string {
  const b = parseJalali(dateStr);
  if (!b) return '';
  return formatJalali(addDays(b, days));
}

export function daysBetweenJalali(from: string, to: string): number | null {
  const a = parseJalali(from), b = parseJalali(to);
  if (!a || !b) return null;
  return differenceInCalendarDays(b, a);
}

export function normalizeDate(s: string): string {
  const d = parseJalali(s);
  return d ? formatJalali(d) : '';
}

export function isValidJalali(s: string): boolean {
  return parseJalali(s) !== null;
}

export function formatGregorianFromDate(d: Date): string {
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}/${m}/${day}`;
}

/**
 * اضافه کردن ماه به تاریخ شمسی با قانون Month-End Clamping
 * مثال: ۱۴۰۴/۰۶/۳۱ + ۱ ماه => ۱۴۰۴/۰۷/۳۰ (نه سرریز به آبان)
 */
export function addCalendarMonths(jalaliStr: string, months: number): string {
  const base = parseJalali(jalaliStr);
  if (!base) return '';
  const parts = normalizeDigits(jalaliStr).split('/').map(Number);
  const targetYear = parts[0];
  const targetMonthIndex = (parts[1] - 1) + months;
  const y = targetYear + Math.floor(targetMonthIndex / 12);
  const m = ((targetMonthIndex % 12) + 12) % 12; // 0..11
  // اولین روز ماه هدف سپس رفتن به آخرین روز همان ماه شمسی
  const firstOfTarget = parse(`${y}/${String(m + 1).padStart(2, '0')}/01`, 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
  if (isNaN(firstOfTarget.getTime())) return '';
  const lastDayOfTarget = new Date(firstOfTarget);
  // حرکت روز به روز تا زمانی که ماه شمسی تغییر نکند
  let maxDay = 29;
  for (let d = 29; d <= 31; d++) {
    const testStr = `${y}/${String(m + 1).padStart(2, '0')}/${String(d).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    if (parseJalali(testStr)) maxDay = d;
  }
  const clampedDay = Math.min(parts[2] || 1, maxDay);
  return `${y}/${String(m + 1).padStart(2, '0')}/${String(clampedDay).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

/**
 * invariants.ts — Dev-only sanity checks (silent in production)
 */
import { useTra } from '../../mod/tra/store';
import { useWhs } from '../../mod/whs/store';
import { useFlk } from '../../mod/flk/store';
import { useHal } from '../../mod/hal/store';
import { useInc } from '../../mod/inc/store';

export function verifyInvariants(): string[] {
  const issues: string[] = [];
  const invoices = useTra.getState().invoices;
  const whs = useWhs.getState();
  const flk = useFlk.getState();
  const hal = useHal.getState();
  const inc = useInc.getState();

  // ۱. whs: sum(in) - sum(out) per itemId ≈ currentStock
  const movementsByItem = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const m of whs.movements) {
    const cur = movementsByItem.get(m.itemId) || 0;
    if (m.type === 'in') movementsByItem.set(m.itemId, cur + m.quantity);
    else if (m.type === 'out') movementsByItem.set(m.itemId, cur - m.quantity);
    else if (m.type === 'adjust') movementsByItem.set(m.itemId, m.quantity);
  }
  for (const item of whs.items) {
    const computed = movementsByItem.get(item.id) || 0;
    const actual = item.currentStock || 0;
    if (Math.abs(computed - actual) > 0.5) {
      issues.push(`whs: "${item.name}" computed=${computed} actual=${actual}`);
    }
  }

  // ۲. flk: sourceInvoiceId → invoice exists
  const invoiceIds = new Set(invoices.map(i => i.id));
  for (const f of flk.flocks) {
    if (f.sourceInvoiceId && !invoiceIds.has(f.sourceInvoiceId)) {
      issues.push(`flk: "${f.name}" references missing invoice`);
    }
  }

  // ۳. hal
  for (const e of hal.equipment) {
    if (e.sourceInvoiceId && !invoiceIds.has(e.sourceInvoiceId)) {
      issues.push(`hal: "${e.name}" references missing invoice`);
    }
  }

  // ۴. inc
  for (const e of inc.eggEntries) {
    if (e.sourceInvoiceId && !invoiceIds.has(e.sourceInvoiceId)) {
      issues.push(`inc: eggEntry references missing invoice`);
    }
  }

  // ۵. tra: payments غیرمنفی
  for (const inv of invoices) {
    for (const p of inv.payments || []) {
      if ((p.amount || 0) < 0 && p.type !== 'refund') {
        issues.push(`tra: invoice ${inv.number || inv.id} has negative payment`);
      }
    }
  }

  if (issues.length > 0) {
    console.error('🚨 Invariants failed:', issues);
  }
  return issues;
}

export function verifyInvariantsIfDev(): void {
  try {
    if ((import.meta as any)?.env?.DEV) {
      verifyInvariants();
    }
  } catch {}
}

/**
 * filter/FilterBar.tsx — نوار فیلتر و مرتب‌سازی مرکزی
 * طراحی: Tabs بین گروه‌ها + ردیف‌های بلند + بدون گرادیانت

import { getGlobalFormat } from '../units/useFormat';

import { useState, useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Sheet, Input, Btn } from '../components/ui';
import {
  IconFilter, IconSort, IconX, IconArrowUp, IconArrowDown, IconCheck,
} from '../icons';
import type { FilterDef, SortDef, FilterState, SortState } from './types';
import { summarizeChip, isEmptyVal } from './filterHelpers';
import { FilterGroupBody } from './FilterGroupBody';
import { toFa } from '../utils/fa';

interface Props<T> {
  filterDefs: FilterDef<T>[];
  sortDefs: SortDef<T>[];
  filterState: FilterState;
  sortState: SortState | null;
  setFilter: (key: string, value: any) => void;
  clearFilter: (key: string) => void;
  setSort: (s: SortState | null) => void;
  toggleSort: (key: string) => void;
  resetAll: () => void;
  sortStack?: SortState[];
  appendSort?: (key: string) => void;
  groupBy?: string;
  setGroupBy?: (val: string) => void;
  groupDefs?: { key: string; label: string }[];
  recycleCount?: number;
  onOpenRecycleBin?: () => void;
  recycleLabel?: string;
  hasActiveFilters: boolean;
  total: number;
  count: number;
}


export function FilterBar<T>({
  filterDefs, sortDefs, filterState, sortState,
  setFilter, clearFilter, setSort: _setSort, toggleSort, resetAll,
  hasActiveFilters: _hasActiveFilters, total, count,
  sortStack = sortState ? [sortState] : [],
  appendSort,
  groupBy = 'none',
  setGroupBy,
  groupDefs,
  recycleCount = 0,
  onOpenRecycleBin,
  recycleLabel = 'فاکتور',
}: Props<T>) {
  const [openFilters, setOpenFilters] = useState(false);
  const [openSort, setOpenSort] = useState(false);
  const [openGroup, setOpenGroup] = useState(false);

  const getGroupLabel = (val: string): string => {
    if (val === 'none') return 'گروه';
    if (groupDefs) return groupDefs.find(g => g.key === val)?.label || 'گروه';
    const fallback: Record<string, string> = {
      partyId: 'طرف حساب',
      date: 'تاریخ',
      category: 'دسته کالا',
      workflow: 'وضعیت پرداخت',
    };
    return fallback[val] || 'گروه';
  };

  // 🆕 الگوی useTabBadge: پالس ۵ ثانیه‌ای فقط وقتی تعداد زیاد می‌شود
  const [isPulsing, setIsPulsing] = useState(false);
  const [isAcknowledged, setIsAcknowledged] = useState(false);
  const prevRecycleCount = useRef(recycleCount);
  const pulseTimer = useRef<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (recycleCount > prevRecycleCount.current) {
      setIsAcknowledged(false); // 🆕 ریست وقتی فاکتور جدیدی حذف می‌شود
      if (pulseTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(pulseTimer.current);
      setIsPulsing(true);
      pulseTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setIsPulsing(false), 5000);
    } else if (recycleCount === 0) {
      setIsPulsing(false);
    }
    prevRecycleCount.current = recycleCount;
  }, [recycleCount]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (pulseTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(pulseTimer.current);
    };
  }, []);


  const activeCount = Object.keys(filterState).filter(k => !isEmptyVal(filterState[k])).length;

  const chips = filterDefs
    .map(def => {
      const v = filterState[def.key];
      const sum = summarizeChip(def, v);
      if (!sum) return null;
      return { key: def.key, label: def.label, ...sum };
    })
    .filter(Boolean) as Array<{ key: string; label: string; text: string; icon?: ReactNode }>;

  const sortLabel = sortState
    ? (sortDefs.find(s => s.key === sortState.key)?.label || '')
    : null;

  const countActiveInGroup = (def: FilterDef<T>): number => {
    const v = filterState[def.key];
    if (isEmptyVal(v)) return 0;
    if (def.kind === 'enum') {
      if (Array.isArray(v)) return (v as string[]).filter(x => x !== '').length;
      return 1;
    }
    if (def.kind === 'dateRange' || def.kind === 'numberRange') {
      const [a, b] = v as [unknown, unknown];
      return (a != null && a !== '') || (b != null && b !== '') ? 1 : 0;
    }
    if (def.kind === 'boolean') return 1;
    return 0;
  };

  const topBtn = (active: boolean): React.CSSProperties => ({
    display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
    gap: 'var(--sp-1)',
    height: 32, padding: '0 var(--sp-3)',

    border: '1px solid ' + (active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--border)'),
    borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',

    fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', fontWeight: 700,
    cursor: 'pointer', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', flexShrink: 0,
    transition: 'all var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out)',
  });



  return (

        display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--sp-2)',
        padding: 'var(--sp-2) var(--sp-3)',
        alignItems: 'center', overflowX: 'auto', scrollbarWidth: 'none',

          {activeCount > 0 && (
            <span style={{

              minWidth: 16, height: 16, padding: '0 4px',

              marginRight: -2,
            }}>{getGlobalFormat().count(activeCount)}</span>
          )}
        </button>

        {sortDefs.length > 0 && (
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpenSort(true)}
            aria-label="مرتب‌سازی" style={topBtn(!!sortState)}>
            <IconSort size={13} />
            <span>{sortLabel || 'مرتب'}</span>
            {sortState && (
              <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', marginRight: -2 }}>
                {sortState.dir === 'asc' ? <IconArrowUp size={11} /> : <IconArrowDown size={11} />}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        )}
        
        {setGroupBy && (
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpenGroup(true)}
            aria-label="گروه‌بندی" style={topBtn(groupBy !== 'none')}>
            <span>📁</span>
            <span>{getGroupLabel(groupBy)}</span>
          </button>
        )}
        
        {onOpenRecycleBin && recycleCount > 0 && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setIsAcknowledged(true);
              setIsPulsing(false);
              if (pulseTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(pulseTimer.current);
              onOpenRecycleBin();
            }}
            style={{
              ...topBtn(false),
              position: 'relative',
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
            title={`${getGlobalFormat().count(recycleCount)} ${recycleLabel} در سبد بازیابی`}
          >
            <span>🗑️</span>
            <span>بازیابی ({getGlobalFormat().count(recycleCount)})</span>
            {!isAcknowledged && (
              <span
                aria-label="آیتم جدید"

        {activeCount > 0 && (
          <button type="button" onClick={resetAll}
            aria-label="پاک کردن فیلترها"
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
              width: 32, height: 32, padding: 0,

              border: '1px solid var(--border)',
              borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
              color: 'var(--muted)',

              transition: 'all var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out)',

        <div style={{

      <Sheet open={openSort} onClose={() => setOpenSort(false)} title="مرتب‌سازی">
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
          {sortDefs.map(def => {
            const stackIdx = sortStack.findIndex(s => s.key === def.key);
            const isActive = stackIdx !== -1;
            const isPrimary = sortStack[0]?.key === def.key;
            const dir = isActive ? sortStack[stackIdx].dir : 'asc';
            const levelLabel = isActive && sortStack.length > 1 ? getGlobalFormat().count(stackIdx + 1) : '';
            
            return (
              <div key={def.key} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => toggleSort(def.key)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--sp-2)',
                    width: '100%', padding: '6px 8px', minHeight: 36,
                    background: isActive ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--card-solid, #fff)',
                    border: '1px solid ' + (isActive ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'),
                    borderRadius: 'var(--r-lg)',
                    color: 'var(--text)',
                    fontFamily: 'inherit', cursor: 'pointer',
                    textAlign: 'right',
                    transition: 'all var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out)',
                  }}>
                  {def.icon && (
                    <span style={{
                      width: 30, height: 30, borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
                      background: isActive ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--input-bg)',
                      color: isActive ? 'var(--avatar-text)' : 'var(--muted)',
                      display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                      flexShrink: 0,
                    }}>{def.icon}</span>
                  )}
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <div style={{
                      fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)', fontWeight: 700,
                      color: isActive ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)',
                      lineHeight: 1.2, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6
                    }}>
                      {def.label}
                      {levelLabel && (
                        <span style={{
                          display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                          minWidth: 18, height: 18, padding: '0 5px',

                          borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', fontWeight: 800,
                        }}>{levelLabel}</span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{
                      fontSize: 10.5, color: 'var(--muted)',
                      marginTop: 2, fontWeight: 500,
                    }}>
                      {isActive
                        ? (dir === 'asc' ? 'صعودی — از کوچک به بزرگ' : 'نزولی — از بزرگ به کوچک')
                        : (def.hint || 'برای مرتب‌سازی لمس کن')}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </button>
                {isPrimary && appendSort && (
                  <button type="button" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); appendSort(def.key); }}
                    title="افزودن به عنوان معیار بعدی"
                    style={{
                      position: 'absolute', left: 8, top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                      width: 24, height: 24, borderRadius: '50%',
                      background: 'var(--accent)', color: 'var(--avatar-text)',
                      border: 'none', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                      fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer', zIndex: 2,
                    }}>+</button>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}

        </div>
      </Sheet>
    </>
  );
}

import type { ReactNode, CSSProperties } from 'react';
import { Input } from '../components/ui';
import DatePicker from '../components/DatePicker';
import { RowItem } from './RowItem';
import type { FilterDef, FilterState } from './types';
import { parseFaNum } from '../utils/fa';

function chipIn(active: boolean): CSSProperties {
  return {
    display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5,
    height: 28, padding: '0 8px',
    background: active ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--card-solid, #fff)',
    border: '1px solid ' + (active ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'),
    borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
    color: active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)',
    fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
    fontWeight: active ? 700 : 600, cursor: 'pointer',
    whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
    transition: 'all var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out)',
  };
}

export function FilterGroupBody<T>({ def, value, setFilter, clearFilter, filterState }: {
  def: FilterDef<T>;
  value: string | string[] | [string, string] | [number, number] | boolean | null | undefined;
  setFilter: (key: string, value: any) => void;
  clearFilter: (key: string) => void;
  filterState: FilterState;
}): ReactNode {
  const v = value;
  const displayOptions = def.dynamicOptions ? def.dynamicOptions(filterState) : (def.options || []);

    if (def.kind === 'enum') {
      const isMulti = !!def.multi;
      const layout = def.layout || 'grid';

      // ─── حالت grid دوستونه ───
      if (layout === 'grid') {
        const arr = isMulti ? (Array.isArray(v) ? (v as string[]) : []) : [];
        const noneActive = isMulti ? arr.length === 0 : !v;
        return (
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr 1fr', gap: 4 }}>
            <button type="button"
              onClick={() => { isMulti ? setFilter(def.key, []) : clearFilter(def.key); }}
              style={{
                display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                minHeight: 38, padding: '6px 8px',
                background: noneActive ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--card-solid, #fff)',
                border: '1px solid ' + (noneActive ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'),
                borderRadius: 9,
                color: noneActive ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)',
                fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
                fontWeight: noneActive ? 700 : 600, cursor: 'pointer',
                textAlign: 'center',
                transition: 'all var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out)',
              }}>
              همه
            </button>
            {displayOptions.map(o => {
              const active = isMulti ? arr.includes(o.value) : v === o.value;
              return (
                <button key={o.value} type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (isMulti) {
                      const next = active ? arr.filter(x => x !== o.value) : [...arr, o.value];
                      setFilter(def.key, next);
                    } else {
                      setFilter(def.key, active ? '' : o.value);
                    }
                  }}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 4,
                    minHeight: 38, padding: '6px 8px',
                    background: active ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--card-solid, #fff)',
                    border: '1px solid ' + (active ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'),
                    borderRadius: 9,
                    color: active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)',
                    fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)',
                    fontWeight: active ? 700 : 600, cursor: 'pointer',
                    textAlign: 'center',
                    whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                    overflow: 'hidden',
                    transition: 'all var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out)',
                  }}>
                  {o.icon && (
                    <span style={{
                      display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                      flexShrink: 0,
                      fontSize: typeof o.icon === 'string' ? 'var(--fs-md)' : undefined,
                    }}>{o.icon}</span>
                  )}
                  <span style={{
                    overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                  }}>{o.label}</span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        );
      }

      if (layout === 'rows') {
        const arr = isMulti ? (Array.isArray(v) ? (v as string[]) : []) : [];
        const noneActive = isMulti ? arr.length === 0 : !v;
        return (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
            <RowItem
              active={noneActive}
              multi={isMulti}
              label="همه"
              onClick={() => { isMulti ? setFilter(def.key, []) : clearFilter(def.key); }}
            />
            {displayOptions.map(o => {
              const active = isMulti ? arr.includes(o.value) : v === o.value;
              return (
                <RowItem
                  key={o.value}
                  active={active}
                  multi={isMulti}
                  icon={o.icon}
                  label={o.label}
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (isMulti) {
                      const next = active ? arr.filter(x => x !== o.value) : [...arr, o.value];
                      setFilter(def.key, next);
                    } else {
                      setFilter(def.key, active ? '' : o.value);
                    }
                  }}
                />
              );
            })}
          </div>
        );
      }

      const arr = isMulti ? (Array.isArray(v) ? (v as string[]) : []) : [];
      const noneActive = isMulti ? arr.length === 0 : !v;
      return (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 4 }}>
          <button type="button"
            onClick={() => { isMulti ? setFilter(def.key, []) : clearFilter(def.key); }}
            style={chipIn(noneActive)}>همه</button>
          {displayOptions.map(o => {
            const active = isMulti ? arr.includes(o.value) : v === o.value;
            return (
              <button key={o.value} type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (isMulti) {
                    const next = active ? arr.filter(x => x !== o.value) : [...arr, o.value];
                    setFilter(def.key, next);
                  } else {
                    setFilter(def.key, active ? '' : o.value);
                  }
                }}
                style={chipIn(active)}>
                {o.icon && <span style={{
                  display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                  fontSize: typeof o.icon === 'string' ? 'var(--fs-base)' : undefined,
                }}>{o.icon}</span>}
                <span>{o.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (def.kind === 'boolean') {
      return (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
          <RowItem active={v === undefined || v === null} multi={false}
            label="همه" onClick={() => clearFilter(def.key)} />
          <RowItem active={v === true} multi={false}
            label="بله" onClick={() => setFilter(def.key, true)} />
          <RowItem active={v === false} multi={false}
            label="خیر" onClick={() => setFilter(def.key, false)} />
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (def.kind === 'dateRange') {
      const [a, b] = (v as [string, string]) || ['', ''];
      return (
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr auto 1fr', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center', width: '100%' }}>
          <DatePicker
            value={a || ''}
            placeholder="از تاریخ"
            onChange={v2 => {
              const nextEnd = b && v2 && v2 > b ? v2 : (b || '');
              setFilter(def.key, [v2, nextEnd]);
            }}
          />
          <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)' }}>—</span>
          <DatePicker
            value={b || ''}
            placeholder="تا تاریخ"
            onChange={v2 => {
              const nextStart = a && v2 && v2 < a ? v2 : (a || '');
              setFilter(def.key, [nextStart, v2]);
            }}
          />
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (def.kind === 'numberRange') {
      const [a, b] = (v as [number, number]) || [null, null];
      return (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <Input inputMode="numeric" placeholder="از" value={a ?? ''}
            onChange={e => setFilter(def.key, [e.target.value ? parseFaNum(e.target.value) : null, b ?? null])} />
          <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 'var(--fs-xs)', flexShrink: 0 }}>—</span>
          <Input inputMode="numeric" placeholder="تا" value={b ?? ''}
            onChange={e => setFilter(def.key, [a ?? null, e.target.value ? parseFaNum(e.target.value) : null])} />
        </div>
      );
    }

    return null;
  }

import { getGlobalFormat } from '../units/useFormat';
import { type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { IconCheck } from '../icons';
import { toFa } from '../utils/fa';

export function RowItem({
  active, multi, icon, label, count: cnt, onClick,
}: {
  active: boolean; multi: boolean;
  icon?: ReactNode; label: string; count?: number;
  onClick: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <button type="button" onClick={onClick} style={{
      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6,
      padding: '6px 10px', minHeight: 38, width: '100%',
      background: active ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--card-solid, #fff)',
      border: '1px solid ' + (active ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'),
      borderRadius: 'var(--r-md)',
      cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit',
      textAlign: 'right',
      transition: 'all var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out)',
    }}>
      {icon && (
        <span style={{
          width: 22, height: 22, borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
          background: active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--input-bg)',
          color: active ? 'var(--avatar-text)' : 'var(--muted)',
          display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
          flexShrink: 0,
          transition: 'all var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out)',
        }}>{icon}</span>
      )}
      <span style={{
        flex: 1, fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
        fontWeight: active ? 700 : 600,
        color: active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)',
      }}>{label}</span>
      {cnt !== undefined && (
        <span style={{
          fontSize: 'var(--fs-2xs)', fontWeight: 700,
          color: active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
          background: active ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--input-bg)',
          border: '1px solid ' + (active ? 'var(--accent-border)' : 'var(--border)'),
          padding: '1px 5px', borderRadius: 'var(--r-sm)',
          fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums',
          flexShrink: 0,
        }}>{getGlobalFormat().count(cnt)}</span>
      )}
      <span style={{
        width: 18, height: 18, flexShrink: 0,
        borderRadius: multi ? 5 : 9,
        background: active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--input-bg)',
        border: '2px solid ' + (active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--border)'),
        display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
        color: '#fff',
        transition: 'all var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out)',
      }}>
        {active && (multi
          ? <IconCheck size={10} />
          : <span style={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: '50%', background: 'currentColor' }} />
        )}
      </span>
    </button>
  );
}

/** انواع مشترک فیلتر */
import type { FilterDef, SortDef, SortState } from '../types';
import type React from 'react';

export type { FilterDef, SortDef, SortState } from '../types';

/** گروه‌بندی داینامیک */
export interface GroupDef<T> {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  getKey: (item: T) => string;
  getLabel: (key: string, ctx: any) => string;
}

/** خروجی مشترک همه کانفیگ‌ها */
export interface FilterConfig<T> {
  filterDefs: FilterDef<T>[];
  sortDefs: SortDef<T>[];
  groupDefs?: GroupDef<T>[];
  persistKey: string;
  initialSort?: SortState;
}

/** filter/configs/arc.tsx */
import { IconFolder, IconActivity, IconTag, IconChart, IconClock, IconUser, IconCalendar } from '../../icons';
import { type Flock, getAgeDays as flkGetAgeDays } from '../../../mod/flk/store';
import type { ArchiveRecord } from '../../../cor/storage/historyArchive';
import type { FilterConfig } from './_types';
import { format as formatJalali } from 'date-fns-jalali';

export interface ArcStoreEntry {
  storeKey: 'flk' | 'tra' | 'whs' | 'inc';
  storeLabel: string;
  record: ArchiveRecord;
}

function toComparableJalaliDate(raw?: string | number): string {
  if (raw === undefined || raw === null || raw === '') return '';
  if (typeof raw === 'number') {
    if (!Number.isFinite(raw) || raw <= 0) return '';
    const d = new Date(raw);
    return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? '' : formatJalali(d, 'yyyy/MM/dd');
  }
  const trimmed = raw.trim();
  if (/^1[34]\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{2}/.test(trimmed)) {
    return trimmed.slice(0, 10);
  }
  const d = new Date(trimmed);
  if (!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
    return formatJalali(d, 'yyyy/MM/dd');
  }
  return trimmed.slice(0, 10);
}

      },
      {
        key: 'status', label: 'وضعیت', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconActivity size={18} />,
        options: [
          { value: 'archived', label: 'آرشیو' },
          { value: 'sold', label: 'فروخته شده' },
        ],
        getValue: (f: Flock) => f.status || 'archived',
        multi: true,
      },
      {
        key: 'type', label: 'نوع گله', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconTag size={18} />,
        options: [
          { value: 'layer', label: '🥚 تخم‌گذار' },
          { value: 'broiler', label: '🍗 گوشتی' },
          { value: 'breeder', label: '🧬 مادر' },
        ],
        getValue: (f: Flock) => f.type || '',
        multi: true,
      },

        getValue: (f: Flock) => f.birdId || '',
        multi: true,
      },
      {
        key: 'hallId', label: 'سالن', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconFolder size={18} />,
        options: ctx.halls.map(h => ({ value: h.id, label: h.name })),
        getValue: (f: Flock) => f.hallId || '',
      },
    ],
    sortDefs: [
      {
        key: 'updatedAt', label: 'تاریخ آرشیو', icon: <IconCalendar size={18} />,
        hint: 'جدیدترین آرشیو اول',

      },
      {

        hint: 'از الف به ی',
        compare: (a: Flock, b: Flock) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || '', 'fa'),
      },
      {
        key: 'age', label: 'سن نهایی', icon: <IconClock size={18} />,
        hint: 'بر اساس روز',
        compare: (a: Flock, b: Flock) => flkGetAgeDays(a) - flkGetAgeDays(b),
      },
      {
        key: 'count', label: 'تعداد نهایی', icon: <IconChart size={18} />,
        hint: 'بر اساس تعداد پرنده',
        compare: (a: Flock, b: Flock) => (a.currentCount || 0) - (b.currentCount || 0),
      },
    ],
    persistKey: 'arc-archive',
    initialSort: { key: 'updatedAt', dir: 'desc' },
  };
}

export function getArcLogsConfig(ctx: {
  flocks: Array<{ id: string; name: string }>;
}): FilterConfig<ArchiveRecord> {
  return {
    filterDefs: [
      {
        key: 'archivedDate', label: 'تاریخ آرشیو', kind: 'dateRange',
        icon: <IconCalendar size={18} />,
        getValue: (r: ArchiveRecord) => toComparableJalaliDate(r.archivedAt || r.date || ''),
      },
      {
        key: 'dateRange', label: 'بازه تاریخ ثبت', kind: 'dateRange',
        icon: <IconCalendar size={18} />,
        getValue: (r: ArchiveRecord) => toComparableJalaliDate(r.date || ''),
      },
      {
        key: 'flockId', label: 'گله', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconUser size={18} />,
        options: ctx.flocks.map(f => ({ value: f.id, label: f.name })),
        getValue: (r: ArchiveRecord) => r.flockId || '',
        multi: true,
      },
      {
        key: 'reason', label: 'دلیل آرشیو', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconTag size={18} />,
        options: ARCHIVE_REASON_OPTIONS,
        getValue: (r: ArchiveRecord) => r.reason || '',
        multi: true,
      },
      {
        key: 'hasDeaths', label: 'تلفات', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconActivity size={18} />,
        options: [
          { value: 'yes', label: 'دارد' },
          { value: 'no', label: 'ندارد' },
        ],
        getValue: (r: ArchiveRecord) => {
          const deaths = r.log?.deaths || [];
          return deaths.some(d => (d.count || 0) > 0) ? 'yes' : 'no';
        },
      },
    ],
    sortDefs: [
      {
        key: 'archivedAt', label: 'تاریخ آرشیو', icon: <IconClock size={18} />,
        hint: 'جدیدترین بایگانی اول',
        compare: (a: ArchiveRecord, b: ArchiveRecord) => (a.archivedAt || 0) - (b.archivedAt || 0),
      },
      {
        key: 'date', label: 'تاریخ ثبت', icon: <IconCalendar size={18} />,
        hint: 'جدیدترین ثبت اول',
        compare: (a: ArchiveRecord, b: ArchiveRecord) => (a.date || '').localeCompare(b.date || ''),
      },
      {
        key: 'deaths', label: 'تعداد تلفات', icon: <IconChart size={18} />,
        hint: 'بر اساس تلفات ثبت‌شده',
        compare: (a: ArchiveRecord, b: ArchiveRecord) => {
          const aSum = (a.log?.deaths || []).reduce((s, d) => s + (d.count || 0), 0);
          const bSum = (b.log?.deaths || []).reduce((s, d) => s + (d.count || 0), 0);
          return aSum - bSum;
        },
      },
    ],
    persistKey: 'arc-logs',
    initialSort: { key: 'archivedAt', dir: 'desc' },
  };
}

/** filter/configs/dlg.tsx */
import { IconActivity, IconChart, IconClock, IconUser, IconCalendar, IconPackage } from '../../icons';
import type { DailyLog } from '../../../mod/dlg/store';
import type { FilterConfig } from './_types';

export function getDlgLogsConfig(ctx: {
  flocks: Array<{ id: string; name: string }>;
}): FilterConfig<DailyLog> {
  return {
    filterDefs: [
      {
        key: 'dateRange', label: 'بازه تاریخ', kind: 'dateRange',
        icon: <IconCalendar size={18} />,
        // تاریخ‌ها جلالی و با صفر پیشوندی‌اند (مثل 1405/08/27) → مقایسه رشته‌ای درست است
        getValue: (l: DailyLog) => l.date || '',
      },
      {
        key: 'flockId', label: 'گله', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconUser size={18} />,
        options: ctx.flocks.map(f => ({ value: f.id, label: f.name })),
        getValue: (l: DailyLog) => l.flockId || '',
        multi: true,
      },
      {
        key: 'hasDeaths', label: 'تلفات', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconActivity size={18} />,
        options: [
          { value: 'yes', label: 'دارد' },
          { value: 'no', label: 'ندارد' },
        ],
        getValue: (l: DailyLog) => (l.deaths && l.deaths.length > 0 && l.deaths.some((d) => (d.count || 0) > 0)) ? 'yes' : 'no',
      },
      {
        key: 'hasVaccine', label: 'واکسن', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconPackage size={18} />,
        options: [
          { value: 'yes', label: 'دارد' },
          { value: 'no', label: 'ندارد' },
        ],
        getValue: (l: DailyLog) => (l.vaccines && l.vaccines.length > 0) ? 'yes' : 'no',
      },
      {
        key: 'hasMed', label: 'دارو', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconPackage size={18} />,
        options: [
          { value: 'yes', label: 'دارد' },
          { value: 'no', label: 'ندارد' },
        ],
        getValue: (l: DailyLog) => (l.medications && l.medications.length > 0) ? 'yes' : 'no',
      },
      {
        key: 'hasWeight', label: 'وزن‌کشی', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconChart size={18} />,
        options: [
          { value: 'yes', label: 'دارد' },
          { value: 'no', label: 'ندارد' },
        ],
        getValue: (l: DailyLog) => (l.weightSamples && l.weightSamples.length > 0) ? 'yes' : 'no',
      },
    ],
    sortDefs: [
      {
        key: 'date', label: 'تاریخ', icon: <IconCalendar size={18} />,
        hint: 'جدیدترین اول',
        compare: (a: DailyLog, b: DailyLog) => (a.date || '').localeCompare(b.date || ''),
      },
      {
        key: 'temperature', label: 'دما', icon: <IconChart size={18} />,
        hint: 'بر اساس دما',
        compare: (a: DailyLog, b: DailyLog) => (a.temperature || 0) - (b.temperature || 0),
      },
      {
        key: 'feedDelivered', label: 'دان مصرفی', icon: <IconChart size={18} />,
        hint: 'بر اساس مقدار دان',
        compare: (a: DailyLog, b: DailyLog) => (a.feedConsumed ?? a.feedDelivered ?? 0) - (b.feedConsumed ?? b.feedDelivered ?? 0),
      },
      {
        key: 'createdAt', label: 'جدیدترین ثبت', icon: <IconClock size={18} />,
        hint: 'بر اساس تاریخ ایجاد',
        compare: (a: DailyLog, b: DailyLog) => (a.createdAt || '').localeCompare(b.createdAt || ''),
      },
    ],
    groupDefs: [
      {
        key: 'flockId', label: 'گله',
        getKey: (l: DailyLog) => l.flockId || 'unknown',
        getLabel: (key: string, ctx: any) => {
          const f = ctx?.flocks?.find((x: any) => x.id === key);
          return f?.name || 'نامشخص';
        },
      },
      {
        key: 'date', label: 'تاریخ',
        getKey: (l: DailyLog) => l.date || 'unknown',
        getLabel: (key: string) => key,
      },
    ],
    persistKey: 'dlg-logs',
    initialSort: { key: 'date', dir: 'desc' },
  };
}

/** filter/configs/flk.tsx */
import { IconFolder, IconActivity, IconTag, IconChart, IconClock, IconUser } from '../../icons';
import { type Flock, isLayingReady, daysUntilLaying } from '../../../mod/flk/store';
import type { FilterConfig } from './_types';

export function getFlkFlocksConfig(ctx: {
  birds: Array<{ id: string; name: string }>;
  breeds: Array<{ id: string; name: string; birdId: string }>;
  halls: Array<{ id: string; name: string }>;
  zones: Array<{ id: string; name: string; hallId: string }>;
  groups?: Array<{ id: string; name: string; type: string }>;
  getGroupsForFlock?: (flockId: string) => Array<{ id: string }>;
}): FilterConfig<Flock> {
  return {
    filterDefs: [
      // ═══ ۱. وضعیت ═══
      {
        key: 'status', label: 'وضعیت', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconActivity size={18} />,
        options: [
          { value: 'active', label: 'فعال' },
          { value: 'hidden', label: 'پنهان' },
          { value: 'archived', label: 'آرشیو' },
          { value: 'sold', label: 'فروخته شده' },
        ],
        getValue: (f: Flock) => {
          if (f.status === 'archived' || f.status === 'sold') return f.status;
          if (f.hidden) return 'hidden';
          return 'active';
        },
        multi: true,
      },
      // 🆕 گروه‌ها
      ...(ctx.groups && ctx.groups.length > 0 && ctx.getGroupsForFlock ? [{
        key: 'group',
        label: 'گروه',
        kind: 'enum' as const,
        icon: <IconFolder size={18} />,
        options: ctx.groups.map(g => ({ value: g.id, label: g.name })),
        getValue: (f: Flock) => {
          const gs = ctx.getGroupsForFlock!(f.id);
          return gs[0]?.id || '';
        },
        getValues: (f: Flock) => ctx.getGroupsForFlock!(f.id).map(g => g.id),
        multi: true,
      }] : []),
      // ═══ ۲. آماده تخم‌گذاری (۳ حالت) ═══
      {
        key: 'ready', label: 'آماده تخم‌گذاری', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconChart size={18} />,
        options: [
          { value: 'ready', label: '✅ آماده' },
          { value: 'near',  label: '⏳ نزدیک' },
          { value: 'far',   label: '○ دور' },
        ],
        getValue: (f: Flock) => {
          if (f.type !== 'layer' && f.type !== 'breeder') return 'far';
          if (isLayingReady(f)) return 'ready';
          const remaining = daysUntilLaying(f);
          return remaining <= 60 ? 'near' : 'far';
        },
        multi: true,
      },
      // ═══ ۳. نوع گله ═══
      {
        key: 'type', label: 'نوع گله', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconTag size={18} />,
        options: [
          { value: 'layer', label: '🥚 تخم‌گذار' },
          { value: 'broiler', label: '🍗 گوشتی' },
          { value: 'breeder', label: '🧬 مادر' },
        ],
        getValue: (f: Flock) => f.type || '',
        multi: true,
      },
      // ═══ ۴. نژاد ═══
      {
        key: 'breedId', label: 'نژاد', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconTag size={18} />,
        options: ctx.breeds.map(b => ({ value: b.id, label: b.name })),
        getValue: (f: Flock) => f.breedId || '',
        multi: true,
      },
      // ═══ ۵. پرنده ═══
      {
        key: 'birdId', label: 'پرنده', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconUser size={18} />,
        options: ctx.birds.map(b => ({ value: b.id, label: b.name })),
        getValue: (f: Flock) => f.birdId || '',
        multi: true,
      },
      // ═══ ۶. سالن (multi) ═══
      {
        key: 'hallId', label: 'سالن', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconFolder size={18} />,
        options: ctx.halls.map(h => ({ value: h.id, label: h.name })),
        getValue: (f: Flock) => f.hallId || '',
        multi: true,
      },
      // ═══ ۷. بخش (multi) ═══
      {
        key: 'zoneId', label: 'بخش', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconFolder size={18} />,
        options: ctx.zones.map(z => ({ value: z.id, label: z.name })),
        getValue: (f: Flock) => f.zoneId || '',
        multi: true,
      },
    ],
    sortDefs: [
      {
        key: 'name', label: 'نام گله', icon: <IconTag size={18} />,
        hint: 'از الف به ی',
        compare: (a: Flock, b: Flock) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || '', 'fa'),
      },
      {
        key: 'age', label: 'سن', icon: <IconClock size={18} />,
        hint: 'بر اساس سن گله',
        compare: (a: Flock, b: Flock) => {
          const ageA = a.startDate ? new Date(a.startDate).getTime() : 0;
          const ageB = b.startDate ? new Date(b.startDate).getTime() : 0;
          return ageB - ageA;
        },
      },
      {
        key: 'count', label: 'تعداد فعلی', icon: <IconChart size={18} />,
        hint: 'بر اساس تعداد پرنده',
        compare: (a: Flock, b: Flock) => (a.currentCount || 0) - (b.currentCount || 0),
      },
      {
        key: 'initialCount', label: 'تعداد اولیه', icon: <IconChart size={18} />,
        hint: 'بر اساس تعداد اولیه',
        compare: (a: Flock, b: Flock) => (a.initialCount || 0) - (b.initialCount || 0),
      },
      {
        key: 'createdAt', label: 'جدیدترین', icon: <IconClock size={18} />,
        hint: 'بر اساس تاریخ ایجاد',
        compare: (a: Flock, b: Flock) => (a.createdAt || '').localeCompare(b.createdAt || ''),
      },
    ],
    persistKey: 'flk-flocks',
    initialSort: { key: 'createdAt', dir: 'desc' },
  };
}

/** filter/configs/hal.tsx */
import { IconFolder, IconActivity, IconTag, IconChart, IconDollar, IconClock, IconUser, IconCalendar, IconPackage } from '../../icons';
import { type Zone, type Hall, type Equipment, EQUIP_LABELS, STATUS_LABELS, CATEGORY_LABELS } from '../../../mod/hal/store';
import { kindForType } from '../../../mod/hal/api/equipmentCalc';
import type { FilterConfig } from './_types';

export function getHalZonesConfig(ctx: { halls: Hall[] }): FilterConfig<Zone> {
  return {
    filterDefs: [
      {
        key: 'hallId', label: 'سالن', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconUser size={18} />,
        options: ctx.halls.map(h => ({ value: h.id, label: h.name })),
        getValue: (z: Zone) => z.hallId || '',
      },
      {
        key: 'hasCapacity', label: 'ظرفیت', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconChart size={18} />,
        options: [
          { value: 'yes', label: 'تعریف شده' },
          { value: 'no', label: 'تعریف نشده' },
        ],
        getValue: (z: Zone) => (z.capacity && z.capacity > 0) ? 'yes' : 'no',
      },
    ],
    sortDefs: [
      {
        key: 'name', label: 'نام', icon: <IconTag size={18} />,
        hint: 'از الف به ی',
        compare: (a: Zone, b: Zone) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || '', 'fa'),
      },
      {
        key: 'capacity', label: 'ظرفیت', icon: <IconChart size={18} />,
        hint: 'بر اساس تعداد',
        compare: (a: Zone, b: Zone) => (a.capacity || 0) - (b.capacity || 0),
      },
      {
        key: 'createdAt', label: 'جدیدترین', icon: <IconClock size={18} />,
        hint: 'بر اساس تاریخ ایجاد',
        compare: (a: Zone, b: Zone) => (a.createdAt || '').localeCompare(b.createdAt || ''),
      },
    ],
    persistKey: 'hal-zones',
    initialSort: { key: 'name', dir: 'asc' },
  };
}

// hal/HallsPage — سالن‌ها
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function getHalHallsConfig(ctx: {
  birdNames: Array<{ id: string; name: string }>;
  breeds: Array<{ id: string; name: string; birdId: string }>;
  zones: Zone[];
  equipment: Array<{ id: string; hallId?: string }>;
  flocks: Array<{ id: string; hallId?: string; status: string }>;
}): FilterConfig<Hall> {
  return {
    filterDefs: [
      {
        key: 'birdId', label: 'پرنده', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconUser size={18} />,
        options: ctx.birdNames.map(b => ({ value: b.id, label: b.name })),
        getValue: (h: Hall) => h.birdId || '',
      },
      {
        key: 'breedId', label: 'نژاد', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconTag size={18} />,
        options: ctx.breeds.map(b => ({ value: b.id, label: b.name })),
        getValue: (h: Hall) => h.breedId || '',
      },
      {
        key: 'hasZone', label: 'بخش', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconActivity size={18} />,
        options: [
          { value: 'yes', label: 'دارد' },
          { value: 'no', label: 'ندارد' },
        ],
        getValue: (h: Hall) => ctx.zones.some(z => z.hallId === h.id) ? 'yes' : 'no',
      },
      {
        key: 'hasEquip', label: 'تجهیزات', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconPackage size={18} />,
        options: [
          { value: 'yes', label: 'دارد' },
          { value: 'no', label: 'ندارد' },
        ],
        getValue: (h: Hall) => ctx.equipment.some(e => e.hallId === h.id) ? 'yes' : 'no',
      },
      {
        key: 'hasFlock', label: 'گله فعال', kind: 'enum',
        icon: <IconActivity size={18} />,
        options: [
          { value: 'yes', label: 'دارد' },
          { value: 'no', label: 'ندارد' },
        ],
        getValue: (h: Hall) => ctx.flocks.some(f => f.hallId === h.id && f.status === 'active') ? 'yes' : 'no',
      },
    ],
    sortDefs: [
      {
        key: 'name', label: 'نام سالن', icon: <IconTag size={18} />,
        hint: 'از الف به ی',
        compare: (a: Hall, b: Hall) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || '', 'fa'),
      },
      {
        key: 'area', label: 'مساحت', icon: <IconChart size={18} />,
        hint: 'طول × عرض',
        compare: (a: Hall, b: Hall) => ((a.length || 0) * (a.width || 0)) - ((b.length || 0) * (b.width || 0)),
      },
      {
        key: 'capacity', label: 'ظرفیت', icon: <IconChart size={18} />,
        hint: 'بر اساس تعداد پرنده',
        compare: (a: Hall, b: Hall) => (a.capacity || 0) - (b.capacity || 0),
      },
      {
        key: 'createdAt', label: 'جدیدترین', icon: <IconClock size={18} />,
        hint: 'بر اساس تاریخ ایجاد',
        compare: (a: Hall, b: Hall) => (a.createdAt || '').localeCompare(b.createdAt || ''),
      },
    ],
    persistKey: 'hal-halls',
    initialSort: { key: 'name', dir: 'asc' },
  };
}
