/**
 * intelligence/anomalyDetector.ts — هسته‌ی تشخیص ناهنجاری
 *
 * Pure function: از external stores فقط از طریق context و options.
 * ۵ سیگنال موازی + رأی‌گیری محافظه‌کار (≥ ۲ سیگنال برای هر سطح).
 */
import type {
  FieldProfile, AnalysisContext, Warning, Signal, AlertLevel,
} from './types';
import { getProfile } from './fieldProfiles';
import { getTempIdeal } from '../validation/biological-constants';
import { getThresholds } from '../calc/thresholds';
import { getSpeciesExpected } from '../calc/species-expected';
import type { CalcContext } from '../calc/types';
import { getHistory, HistoryOptions, getUserPattern } from './historyStore';

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Helper: resolve hard limit (number or template string)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function resolveLimit(limit: number | string, ctx: AnalysisContext): number | null {
  if (typeof limit === 'number') return limit;
  // string template: '${currentCount}' یا '-730d' یا '+30d'
  const trimmed = limit.trim();
  // date offsets — برای state فعلی نادیده می‌گیریم (لایه date جدا)
  if (/^[+-]\d+d$/.test(trimmed)) return null;
  // ${var}
  const m = trimmed.match(/^\$\{(\w+)\}$/);
  if (m) {
    const v = ctx[m[1]];
    if (typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v) && v > 0) return v;
    return null;
  }
  return null;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Helper: cross-field expected
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function getCrossFieldExpected(
  rule: string | undefined,
  ctx: AnalysisContext,
): number | null {
  if (!rule) return null;
  switch (rule) {
    case 'feed_vs_flock':
      // expected = flock × perBirdGramsPerDay / 1000 (kg)
      if (ctx.flockSize && typeof ctx.perBirdGramsPerDay === 'number') {
        return (ctx.flockSize * ctx.perBirdGramsPerDay) / 1000;
      }
      return null;
    case 'water_vs_flock':
      // expected = flock × 0.5 L
      if (ctx.flockSize) return ctx.flockSize * 0.5;
      return null;
    case 'remaining_vs_feed':
      if (typeof ctx.feedDelivered === 'number') return ctx.feedDelivered * 0.5;
      return null;
    case 'lte_female':
      return ctx.femaleCount ?? ctx.flockSize ?? null;
    case 'lte_current':
      return ctx.currentCount ?? null;
    case 'lte_initial':
      return ctx.initialCount as number ?? null;
    case 'lte_egg_count':
      return (ctx.eggCount as number) ?? null;
    case 'lte_hall':
      return (ctx.hallCapacity as number) ?? null;
    case 'lte_initial_sum':
      return (ctx.initialCount as number) ?? null;
    case 'dose_vs_flock':
      if (ctx.flockSize && typeof ctx.dose === 'number') {
        return ctx.flockSize * ctx.dose;
      }
      return null;
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// رأی‌گیری
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function decideLevel(signals: Signal[], cv?: number | null): AlertLevel | null {
  if (signals.length === 0) return null;
  // تک سیگنال: بر اساس وزن تصمیم بگیر
  if (signals.length === 1) {
    const w = signals[0].weight;
    if (w >= 5) return 'red';   // cross-field سخت (مثلاً تلفات > موجودی)
    if (w >= 3) return 'yellow'; // ratio قوی (مثلاً 10x)
    return null;
  }
  if (signals.length < 2) return null;
  // CV بالا (>0.5) = کاربر متغیر → آستانه‌ها سخت‌تر (کاهش false positive)
  const variable = cv !== null && cv !== undefined && cv > 0.5;
  const total = signals.reduce((s, x) => s + x.weight, 0);
  const redMin = variable ? 6 : 5;
  const orangeMin = variable ? 5 : 3;
  const yellowMin = variable ? 4 : 2;
  if (total >= redMin) return 'red';
  if (total >= orangeMin) return 'orange';
  if (total >= yellowMin) return 'yellow';
  return null;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// API اصلی
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export interface AnalyzeOptions extends HistoryOptions {
  /** آستانه تأیید/رد — بعد از ۵ رد، آستانه بازتر می‌شود */
  dismissalCount?: number;
}

export function analyzeAnomaly(
  fieldPath: string,
  value: number,
  context: AnalysisContext = {},
  opts: AnalyzeOptions = {},
): Warning | null {
  const profile: FieldProfile | null = getProfile(fieldPath);
  if (!profile) return null;  // فیلد بدون profile → بدون هشدار

  // ═══ ۱. Hard limits (همیشه) ═══
  const hMin = resolveLimit(profile.hardMin, context);
  const hMax = resolveLimit(profile.hardMax, context);
  if (hMin !== null && value < hMin) {
    return {
      level: 'red', field: fieldPath, value,
      reason: `کمتر از حداقل مجاز (${hMin})`,
      signals: [{ type: 'hard_min', weight: 10, detail: `value<${hMin}` }],
    };
  }
  if (hMax !== null && value > hMax) {
    return {
      level: 'red', field: fieldPath, value,
      reason: `بیشتر از حداکثر مجاز (${hMax})`,
      signals: [{ type: 'hard_max', weight: 10, detail: `value>${hMax}` }],
    };
  }

  // ═══ ۲. اگر hard_only → بدون هشدار نرم ═══
  if (profile.expectedFrom === 'hard_only') return null;

  // ═══ ۲.۵ Rule mode (n>=2): last vs prev (برای تجهیزات/اجاره با خرید نادر) ═══
  if (profile.mode === 'rule') {
    const hist = getHistory(profile.fieldPath, opts);
    const values = hist?.values ?? [];
    if (values.length < 2) return null;
    const last = values[values.length - 1].v;
    const prev = values[values.length - 2].v;
    if (!prev || prev <= 0) return null;
    const ratio = last / prev;
    if (ratio >= 1.5) {
      const pct = Math.round((ratio - 1) * 100);
      return {
        level: 'orange',
        field: profile.fieldPath,
        value,
        reason: `قیمت ${pct}٪ افزایش نسبت به خرید قبلی`,
        signals: [{ type: 'rule_ratio', weight: 3, detail: `${ratio.toFixed(2)}x` }],
      };
    }
    if (ratio <= 0.66) {
      const pct = Math.round((1 - ratio) * 100);
      return {
        level: 'yellow',
        field: profile.fieldPath,
        value,
        reason: `قیمت ${pct}٪ کاهش نسبت به خرید قبلی`,
        signals: [{ type: 'rule_ratio', weight: 2, detail: `${ratio.toFixed(2)}x` }],
      };
    }
    return null;
  }

  // ═══ ۳. جمع‌آوری سیگنال‌ها ═══
  const signals: Signal[] = [];

  // ─── سیگنال ۱: نسبت به expected ───
  let expected: number | null = null;

  if (typeof context.expected === 'number' && Number.isFinite(context.expected)) {
    expected = context.expected;
  }
  let _rangeMin: number | null = null;
  let _rangeMax: number | null = null;

  if (expected === null && profile.expectedFrom === 'species_temp') {
    if (context.breedKey && context.ageDays != null) {
      try {
        const calcCtx: CalcContext = {
          breedId: context.breedKey,
          flockType: ((context as any).flockType as 'broiler' | 'layer' | 'breeder' | 'ornamental') ?? 'broiler',
          ageDays: context.ageDays,
          aliveCount: context.flockSize ?? context.currentCount ?? 0,
          initialCount: context.flockSize ?? 0,
        };
        const th = getThresholds(calcCtx);
        if (profile.kind === 'temperature' && th.temp) {
          const suffix = profile.fieldPath.slice(-3);
          expected = suffix === 'Min' ? th.temp.min
                   : suffix === 'Max' ? th.temp.max
                   : th.temp.target;
          _rangeMin = th.temp.min;
          _rangeMax = th.temp.max;
        } else if (profile.kind === 'humidity' && th.humidity) {
          const suffix = profile.fieldPath.slice(-3);
          expected = suffix === 'Min' ? th.humidity.min
                   : suffix === 'Max' ? th.humidity.max
                   : th.humidity.target;
          _rangeMin = th.humidity.min;
          _rangeMax = th.humidity.max;
        }
      } catch { /* silent — fallback to biological */ }
    }
    if (expected === null) {
      expected = getTempIdeal(context.species, profile.fieldPath);
    }
  }

  // ═══ species / species_curve — dynamic standards-aware ═══
  if (expected === null && (profile.expectedFrom === 'species' || profile.expectedFrom === 'species_curve')) {
    if (context.breedKey && context.ageDays != null) {
      try {
        const calcCtx: CalcContext = {
          breedId: context.breedKey,
          flockType: (context.flockType as 'broiler' | 'layer' | 'breeder' | 'ornamental') ?? 'broiler',
          ageDays: context.ageDays,
          aliveCount: context.flockSize ?? context.currentCount ?? 0,
          initialCount: context.flockSize ?? 0,
        };
        const sp = getSpeciesExpected(profile.fieldPath, calcCtx);
        if (sp && sp.target != null) {
          expected = sp.target;
          _rangeMin = sp.min;
          _rangeMax = sp.max;
          if (!context.expectedLabel) {
            (context as any).expectedLabel = 'استاندارد ' + sp.source;
          }
        }
      } catch { /* silent */ }
    }
  }

  if (expected === null && profile.expectedFrom === 'cross_field' && profile.crossFieldRule) {
    expected = getCrossFieldExpected(profile.crossFieldRule, context);
  }
  if (expected === null && profile.expectedFrom === 'user_pattern') {
    const pattern = getUserPattern(fieldPath, opts);
    if (pattern) expected = pattern.mean;
  }
  if (expected === null) {
    const histFb = getHistory(fieldPath, opts);
    if (histFb?.stats) {
      expected = histFb.stats.structuralBreak && histFb.stats.recentMean
        ? histFb.stats.recentMean
        : histFb.stats.mean;
    }
  }

  // برای comparison='absolute' (cross-field سخت مثل deaths≤alive), ratio معنی ندارد
  if (profile.comparison !== 'absolute' && expected !== null && expected > 0) {
    const isMin = profile.fieldPath.endsWith('Min');
    const isMax = profile.fieldPath.endsWith('Max');
    const targetVal = context.expected ?? expected;

    // ─── دما: آستانه بر اساس اختلاف مطلق از target (برای کاربر تازه هم حساس) ───
    if (profile.kind === 'temperature' && typeof targetVal === 'number') {
      let diff = 0;
      if (_rangeMin != null && _rangeMax != null && !isMin && !isMax) {
        if (value < _rangeMin) diff = _rangeMin - value;
        else if (value > _rangeMax) diff = value - _rangeMax;
      } else if (isMin) {
        diff = Math.max(0, targetVal - value);
      } else if (isMax) {
        diff = Math.max(0, value - targetVal);
      } else {
        diff = Math.abs(value - targetVal);
      }
      if (diff > 12) signals.push({ type: 'ratio', weight: 5, detail: `${diff.toFixed(1)}°C خارج از هدف` });
      else if (diff > 8) signals.push({ type: 'ratio', weight: 4, detail: `${diff.toFixed(1)}°C خارج از هدف` });
      else if (diff > 5) signals.push({ type: 'ratio', weight: 3, detail: `${diff.toFixed(1)}°C خارج از هدف` });
      else if (diff > 3) signals.push({ type: 'ratio', weight: 2, detail: `${diff.toFixed(1)}°C خارج از هدف` });
    }
    // ─── رطوبت: آستانه اختصاصی (٪) ───
    else if (profile.kind === 'humidity' && typeof targetVal === 'number') {
      let diff = 0;
      if (_rangeMin != null && _rangeMax != null && !isMin && !isMax) {
        if (value < _rangeMin) diff = _rangeMin - value;
        else if (value > _rangeMax) diff = value - _rangeMax;
      } else if (isMin) {
        diff = Math.max(0, targetVal - value);
      } else if (isMax) {
        diff = Math.max(0, value - targetVal);
      } else {
        diff = Math.abs(value - targetVal);
      }
      if (diff > 30) signals.push({ type: 'ratio', weight: 5, detail: `${diff.toFixed(0)}٪ خارج از هدف` });
      else if (diff > 20) signals.push({ type: 'ratio', weight: 4, detail: `${diff.toFixed(0)}٪ خارج از هدف` });
      else if (diff > 12) signals.push({ type: 'ratio', weight: 3, detail: `${diff.toFixed(0)}٪ خارج از هدف` });
      else if (diff > 8) signals.push({ type: 'ratio', weight: 2, detail: `${diff.toFixed(0)}٪ خارج از هدف` });
    }
    // ─── Range check (species-aware) ───
    else if (_rangeMin != null && _rangeMax != null && typeof value === 'number') {
      const below = value < _rangeMin ? (_rangeMin - value) / Math.max(Math.abs(_rangeMin), 1) : 0;
      const above = value > _rangeMax ? (value - _rangeMax) / Math.max(Math.abs(_rangeMax), 1) : 0;
      const relOut = Math.max(below, above);
      if (relOut > 0.5) {
        signals.push({ type: 'range', weight: 5, detail: `${Math.round(relOut * 100)}% خارج از محدوده` });
      } else if (relOut > 0.2) {
        signals.push({ type: 'range', weight: 3, detail: `${Math.round(relOut * 100)}% خارج از محدوده` });
      } else if (relOut > 0.1) {
        signals.push({ type: 'range', weight: 2, detail: `${Math.round(relOut * 100)}% خارج از محدوده` });
      }
    }
    // ─── بقیه (price, count, weight, ...): آستانه‌های ratio فعلی ───
    else {
      const ratio = value / expected;
      if (ratio > 5) signals.push({ type: 'ratio', weight: 3, detail: `${ratio.toFixed(1)}x (خیلی بالا)` });
      else if (ratio > 3) signals.push({ type: 'ratio', weight: 2, detail: `${ratio.toFixed(1)}x (بالا)` });
      else if (ratio > 1.5) signals.push({ type: 'ratio', weight: 1, detail: `${ratio.toFixed(1)}x` });
      else if (ratio < 0.3) signals.push({ type: 'ratio', weight: 2, detail: `${ratio.toFixed(2)}x (پایین)` });
      else if (ratio < 0.5) signals.push({ type: 'ratio', weight: 1, detail: `${ratio.toFixed(2)}x (پایین)` });
    }
  }

  // ─── سیگنال ۲: Z-Score ───
  const hist = getHistory(fieldPath, opts);
  if (hist?.stats && hist.stats.count >= 3) {
    const effectiveStd = Math.max(hist.stats.std, hist.stats.mean * 0.10);
    const z = Math.abs(value - hist.stats.mean) / effectiveStd;
    if (z > 4) signals.push({ type: 'zscore', weight: 3, detail: `z=${z.toFixed(1)}` });
    else if (z > 3) signals.push({ type: 'zscore', weight: 2, detail: `z=${z.toFixed(1)}` });
    else if (z > 2) signals.push({ type: 'zscore', weight: 1, detail: `z=${z.toFixed(1)}` });
  }

  // ─── سیگنال ۳: IQR ───
  if (hist?.stats && hist.stats.count >= 5) {
    const iqr = hist.stats.p75 - hist.stats.p25;
    if (iqr > 0 && (value > hist.stats.p75 + 3 * iqr || value < hist.stats.p25 - 3 * iqr)) {
      signals.push({ type: 'iqr', weight: 2, detail: 'خارج IQR' });
    }
  }

  // ─── سیگنال ۴: خارج از محدوده زیستی ───
  if (profile.biologicalRange) {
    const br = profile.biologicalRange;
    if (value < br.min || value > br.max) {
      signals.push({ type: 'biological', weight: 1, detail: `${value} خارج ${br.min}-${br.max}` });
    }
  }

  // ─── سیگنال ۵: Cross-field سخت ───
  if (profile.crossFieldRule && profile.comparison === 'absolute') {
    const max = getCrossFieldExpected(profile.crossFieldRule, context);
    if (max !== null && value > max) {
      signals.push({ type: 'cross_absolute', weight: 5, detail: `${value} > ${max}` });
    }
  }

  // ─── سیگنال ۶: کاربر pattern (برای درصد) ───
  if (profile.expectedFrom === 'user_pattern') {
    const pattern = getUserPattern(fieldPath, opts);
    if (pattern && pattern.count >= 3) {
      let warnPct: number, critPct: number;
      if (pattern.cv < 0.10) { warnPct = 0.30; critPct = 0.50; }
      else if (pattern.cv < 0.30) { warnPct = 0.50; critPct = 0.80; }
      else { warnPct = 0.80; critPct = 1.20; }
      const dev = Math.abs(value - pattern.mean) / (pattern.mean || 1);
      if (dev > critPct) signals.push({ type: 'pattern', weight: 3, detail: `${(dev * 100).toFixed(0)}% انحراف` });
      else if (dev > warnPct) signals.push({ type: 'pattern', weight: 2, detail: `${(dev * 100).toFixed(0)}% انحراف` });
    }
  }

  // ═══ ۴. Structural Break (تورم) — استاندارد SAP ═══
  // استاندارد (expected) در بلوک بالاتر به recentMean به‌روز شده است.
  // نیازی به کاهش وزن سیگنال‌ها نیست — هشدارها با استاندارد جدید سنجیده می‌شوند.
  // (کاهش × ۰.۳ باعث over-suppression و رفتار ناهماهنگ می‌شد)

  // ═══ ۵. تصمیم نهایی ═══
  const level = decideLevel(signals, hist?.stats?.cv ?? null);
  if (!level) return null;

  // 🆕 تشخیص منبع expected (برای متن دقیق در formatWarning)
  let expectedSource: 'context' | 'cross_field' | 'pattern' | 'history' = 'history';
  if (context.expectedSource) {
    expectedSource = context.expectedSource;
  } else if (typeof context.expected === 'number' && Number.isFinite(context.expected)) {
    expectedSource = 'context';
  } else if (profile.expectedFrom === 'cross_field' && profile.crossFieldRule) {
    expectedSource = 'cross_field';
  } else if (profile.expectedFrom === 'user_pattern') {
    expectedSource = 'pattern';
  }

  return {
    level,
    field: fieldPath,
    value,
    reason: signals[0]?.detail ?? 'ناهنجاری تشخیص داده شد',
    expected: expected ?? undefined,
    expectedSource,
    expectedLabel: context.expectedLabel,
    signals,
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// wrapper برای ذخیره خودکار بعد از تحلیل
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
import { recordHistory } from './historyStore';

export function analyzeAndRecord(
  fieldPath: string,
  value: number,
  context: AnalysisContext = {},
  opts: AnalyzeOptions = {},
): Warning | null {
  const warning = analyzeAnomaly(fieldPath, value, context, opts);
  try {
    recordHistory(fieldPath, value, context, opts);
  } catch { /* silent */ }
  return warning;
}

export { getCrossFieldExpected };

/**
 * intelligence/fieldProfiles.ts — تنظیمات خودکار برای ۱۰۰+ فیلد
 *
 * این profileها از تصمیمات Q1-Q12 استخراج شده‌اند.
 * هر فیلد می‌دونه چطور بررسی بشه، بدون نیاز به تنظیم دستی.
 */
import type { FieldProfile, FieldKind } from './types';

function P(
  fieldPath: string,
  kind: FieldKind,
  hardMin: number | string,
  hardMax: number | string,
  overrides: Partial<FieldProfile> = {},
): FieldProfile {
  return {
    fieldPath,
    kind,
    hardMin,
    hardMax,
    expectedFrom: 'history_refbook',
    comparison: 'ratio',
    ...overrides,
  };
}

const FALLBACK_FA: Record<string, string> = {
  quantity: 'مقدار', count: 'تعداد', amount: 'مقدار', total: 'مجموع',

  date: 'تاریخ', dueDate: 'مهلت', notes: 'یادداشت',

function getLabel(fieldPath: string): string {
  if (FIELD_LABELS[fieldPath]) return FIELD_LABELS[fieldPath];
  const parts = fieldPath.split('.');
  const last = parts[parts.length - 1];
  if (last.startsWith('price_')) {
    const cat = last.slice(6);
    return FIELD_LABELS[`tra.price_${cat}`] ?? cat;
  }
  return FALLBACK_FA[last] ?? last;
}

function toFaDigit(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/\d/g, d => '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'[+d]);
}

function fmtNum(n: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return '—';
  const rounded = Math.round(n * 100) / 100;
  try {
    return getGlobalFormat().num(rounded);
  } catch {
    return toFaDigit(String(rounded));
  }
}

function fmtMult(n: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return '—';
  const rounded = n >= 10 ? Math.round(n) : Math.round(n * 10) / 10;
  const str = Number.isInteger(rounded) ? String(rounded) : rounded.toFixed(1);
  return toFaDigit(str);
}

function crossFieldLabel(rule?: string): string {
  switch (rule) {
    case 'lte_current':      return 'موجودی گله';
    case 'lte_female':       return 'تعداد مرغ ماده';
    case 'lte_initial':      return 'تعداد اولیه گله';
    case 'lte_initial_sum':  return 'تعداد کل گله';
    case 'lte_egg_count':    return 'تعداد تخم ورودی';
    case 'lte_hall':         return 'ظرفیت سالن';
    case 'lte_rent':         return 'مبلغ کل اجاره';
    default:                 return 'حد منطقی';
  }
}

export function formatWarningDetail(w: Warning): string {
  const parts: string[] = [`مقدار: ${fmtNum(w.value)}`];
  if (w.expected !== undefined) parts.push(`مرجع: ${fmtNum(w.expected)}`);
  const profile = getProfile(w.field);
  if (profile) {
    if (typeof profile.hardMin === 'number') parts.push(`حداقل: ${fmtNum(profile.hardMin)}`);
    if (typeof profile.hardMax === 'number') parts.push(`سقف: ${fmtNum(profile.hardMax)}`);
  }
  return parts.join(' · ');
}

export function formatWarning(w: Warning): string {
  const { value, expected, signals, field } = w;
  const label = getLabel(field);
  const profile = getProfile(field);
  const kind = profile?.kind ?? 'count';

  // ═══ ۱. سقف و کف سخت ═══
  if (signals.some(s => s.type === 'hard_min')) {
    const minVal = typeof profile?.hardMin === 'number' ? ` (${fmtNum(profile.hardMin)})` : '';
    return `${label} از حداقل مجاز${minVal} کمتر است`;
  }
  if (signals.some(s => s.type === 'hard_max')) {
    const maxVal = typeof profile?.hardMax === 'number' ? ` (${fmtNum(profile.hardMax)})` : '';
    return `${label} از سقف مجاز${maxVal} بیشتر است`;
  }

  // ═══ ۲. بیش از موجودی/ظرفیت ═══
  if (signals.some(s => s.type === 'cross_absolute') && expected !== undefined) {
    return `${label} از ${crossFieldLabel(profile?.crossFieldRule)} (${fmtNum(expected)}) بیشتر است`;
  }

  // ═══ ۳. الگوی نامعمول (pattern) ═══
  if (signals.some(s => s.type === 'pattern')) {
    return `${label} با الگوی همیشگی شما تفاوت دارد`;
  }

  // ═══ ۴. مقایسه با expected (ratio) ═══
  if (expected !== undefined && expected > 0) {
    if (kind === 'temperature') {
      const diff = Math.round(value - expected);
      return diff > 0
        ? `${label} ${fmtNum(diff)} درجه از هدف (${fmtNum(expected)}) بالاتر است`
        : `${label} ${fmtNum(-diff)} درجه از هدف (${fmtNum(expected)}) پایین‌تر است`;
    }
    if (kind === 'humidity') {
      const diff = Math.round(value - expected);
      return diff > 0
        ? `${label} ${fmtNum(diff)}٪ از هدف (${fmtNum(expected)}٪) بالاتر است`
        : `${label} ${fmtNum(-diff)}٪ از هدف (${fmtNum(expected)}٪) پایین‌تر است`;
    }
    if (kind === 'weight') {
      const pct = Math.round(Math.abs(1 - value / expected) * 100);
      return value > expected
        ? `${label} ${fmtNum(pct)}٪ بیشتر از استاندارد نژاد است`
        : `${label} ${fmtNum(pct)}٪ کمتر از استاندارد نژاد است`;
    }
    // 🆕 تشخیص منبع برای متن دقیق (استاندارد نژاد / تاریخچه / cross-field / ...)
    const sourceLabel = w.expectedLabel
      ?? (w.expectedSource === 'context' ? 'مقدار مرجع'
        : w.expectedSource === 'cross_field' ? crossFieldLabel(profile?.crossFieldRule)
        : w.expectedSource === 'pattern' ? 'الگوی همیشگی شما'
        : 'میانگین قبلی شما');
    
    const ratio = value / expected;
    if (ratio >= 1) {
      if (ratio >= 1.5) return `${label} ${fmtMult(ratio)} برابر ${sourceLabel} است`;
      return `${label} ${fmtNum(Math.round((ratio - 1) * 100))}٪ بیشتر از ${sourceLabel} است`;
    }
    const pctDown = Math.round((1 - ratio) * 100);
    return `${label} ${fmtNum(pctDown)}٪ کمتر از ${sourceLabel} است`;
  }

  // ═══ ۵. محدوده زیستی ═══
  if (signals.some(s => s.type === 'biological') && profile?.biologicalRange) {
    return `${label} خارج از محدوده طبیعی است`;
  }

  // ═══ ۶. Z-Score ═══
  if (signals.some(s => s.type === 'zscore')) {
    return `این مقدار با ثبت‌های قبلی شما تفاوت چشمگیری دارد`;
  }

  // ═══ ۷. IQR ═══
  if (signals.some(s => s.type === 'iqr')) {
    return `این مقدار خارج از محدوده معمول شماست`;
  }

  // ═══ ۸. Fallback ═══
  return `${label} نیاز به بررسی دارد`;
}

/**
 * intelligence/historyStore.ts — ذخیره و تحلیل تاریخچه
 *
 * تاریخچه در localStorage نگهداری می‌شود (TTL=180 روز).
 * برای تست، از in-memory fallback استفاده می‌شود.
 */
import type {
  FieldHistory, FieldHistoryEntry, FieldStats,
  AnalysisContext, HistoryStorage,
} from './types';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'bird-intel-history-v1';
const HISTORY_LIMIT = 100;  // حداکثر ۱۰۰ رکورد per field
const TTL_DAYS = 180;

// 🆕 Migration: version marker for breaking data changes
const HISTORY_VERSION_KEY = 'bird-intel-history-version';
const CURRENT_HISTORY_VERSION = 2;

function runHistoryMigration(): void {
  try {
    if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return;
    const v = localStorage.getItem(HISTORY_VERSION_KEY);
    if (v === String(CURRENT_HISTORY_VERSION)) return;
    // v1 → v2: clear tra.price_* (mixed units before normalization; Gap 8)
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      const all = JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, unknown>;
      for (const key of Object.keys(all)) {
        if (key.startsWith('tra.price_')) delete all[key];
      }
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(all));
    }
    localStorage.setItem(HISTORY_VERSION_KEY, String(CURRENT_HISTORY_VERSION));
  } catch { /* silent */ }
}

runHistoryMigration();

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// In-memory fallback (برای تست و محیط‌های بدون localStorage)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const memStore: Record<string, FieldHistory> = {};

function getLocalStorage(): Storage | null {
  try {
    if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') return localStorage;
  } catch { /* silent */ }
  return null;
}

export const localHistoryStore: HistoryStorage = {
  get(fieldPath) {
    const ls = getLocalStorage();
    if (!ls) return memStore[fieldPath] ?? null;
    try {
      const raw = ls.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (!raw) return null;
      const all = JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, FieldHistory>;
      return all[fieldPath] ?? null;
    } catch { return null; }
  },
  set(fieldPath, h) {
    const ls = getLocalStorage();
    if (!ls) { memStore[fieldPath] = h; return; }
    try {
      const raw = ls.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const all = raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, FieldHistory>) : {};
      all[fieldPath] = h;
      ls.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(all));
    } catch { memStore[fieldPath] = h; }
  },
  clear() {
    const ls = getLocalStorage();
    if (ls) { try { ls.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY); } catch { /* silent */ } }
    Object.keys(memStore).forEach(k => delete memStore[k]);
  },
};

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// محاسبه آمار
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function percentile(sorted: number[], p: number): number {
  if (sorted.length === 0) return 0;
  const idx = (sorted.length - 1) * p;
  const lo = Math.floor(idx), hi = Math.ceil(idx);
  if (lo === hi) return sorted[lo];
  return sorted[lo] + (sorted[hi] - sorted[lo]) * (idx - lo);
}

export function computeStats(values: number[]): FieldStats | null {
  if (values.length === 0) return null;
  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const n = sorted.length;
  const mean = values.reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0) / n;
  const median = percentile(sorted, 0.5);
  const variance = values.reduce((s, x) => s + (x - mean) ** 2, 0) / n;
  const std = Math.sqrt(variance);
  const cv = mean > 0 ? std / mean : 0;

  // Structural break: ۳ داده آخر > ۳۰٪ بالاتر از میانگین قبلی
  let structuralBreak = false;
  let recentMean: number | undefined;
  if (n >= 6) {
    const older = values.slice(0, n - 3);
    const recent = values.slice(-3);
    const olderMean = older.reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0) / older.length;
    const rMean = recent.reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0) / recent.length;
    if (olderMean > 0 && rMean > olderMean * 1.3 && recent.every(v => v > olderMean * 1.1)) {
      structuralBreak = true;
      recentMean = rMean;
    }
  }

  return {
    count: n,
    mean,
    median,
    std,
    cv,
    p25: percentile(sorted, 0.25),
    p75: percentile(sorted, 0.75),
    min: sorted[0],
    max: sorted[n - 1],
    lastApproach: values.length > 0 ? values[values.length - 1] : null,
    structuralBreak,
    recentMean,
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// API اصلی
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export interface HistoryOptions {
  store?: HistoryStorage;
  today?: string;  // برای تست
}

function isExpired(dateStr: string, todayStr: string): boolean {
  // پشتیبانی از ISO میلادی "2026-10-20" و شمسی "1404/07/29"
  if (!dateStr || !todayStr) return false;
  const parse = (s: string): [number, number, number] | null => {
    const m = s.trim().match(/^(\d{4})[-\/](\d{1,2})[-\/](\d{1,2})/);
    return m ? [+m[1], +m[2], +m[3]] : null;
  };
  const a = parse(dateStr);
  const b = parse(todayStr);
  if (!a || !b) return false;
  const aGregorian = a[0] >= 1900;
  const bGregorian = b[0] >= 1900;
  if (aGregorian !== bGregorian) return false;
  if (aGregorian) {
    const ta = Date.UTC(a[0], a[1] - 1, a[2]);
    const tb = Date.UTC(b[0], b[1] - 1, b[2]);
    return (tb - ta) / 86400000 > TTL_DAYS;
  }
  const days = (b[0] - a[0]) * 365 + (b[1] - a[1]) * 30 + (b[2] - a[2]);
  return days > TTL_DAYS;
}

function daysBetween(dateA: string, dateB: string): number {
  const parse = (s: string): [number, number, number] | null => {
    const m = s.trim().match(/^(\d{4})[-\/](\d{1,2})[-\/](\d{1,2})/);
    return m ? [+m[1], +m[2], +m[3]] : null;
  };
  const a = parse(dateA);
  const b = parse(dateB);
  if (!a || !b) return 0;
  const aG = a[0] >= 1900;
  const bG = b[0] >= 1900;
  if (aG !== bG) return 0;
  if (aG) {
    return Math.round(Math.abs(Date.UTC(b[0], b[1] - 1, b[2]) - Date.UTC(a[0], a[1] - 1, a[2])) / 86400000);
  }
  // Jalali approximation (365.25 days/year, 30.4 days/month)
  const daysA = a[0] * 365.25 + a[1] * 30.4 + a[2];
  const daysB = b[0] * 365.25 + b[1] * 30.4 + b[2];
  return Math.round(Math.abs(daysB - daysA));
}

export function recordHistory(
  fieldPath: string,
  value: number,
  ctx: AnalysisContext,
  opts: HistoryOptions = {},
): void {
  const store = opts.store ?? localHistoryStore;
  const today = opts.today ?? new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const existing = store.get(fieldPath);

  // حذف مقادیر منقضی
  const freshValues: FieldHistoryEntry[] = (existing?.values ?? [])
    .filter(e => !isExpired(e.date, today));

  // Dedup: same day + same value → no-op (avoid pollution from repeated saves)
  const lastEntry = freshValues[freshValues.length - 1];
  if (lastEntry && lastEntry.date === today && lastEntry.v === value) {
    return;
  }

  freshValues.push({
    v: value,
    ctx: { ...ctx },
    date: today,
    confirmed: false,
    outlier: false,
  });

  // محدود به HISTORY_LIMIT
  const trimmed = freshValues.slice(-HISTORY_LIMIT);

  // محاسبه stats جدید
  const stats = computeStats(trimmed.map(e => e.v));

  // Time-span guard: structural break requires >= 7 days between first/last
  if (stats && stats.structuralBreak && trimmed.length >= 2) {
    const firstDate = trimmed[0].date;
    const lastDate = trimmed[trimmed.length - 1].date;
    if (daysBetween(firstDate, lastDate) < 7) {
      stats.structuralBreak = false;
      stats.recentMean = undefined;
    }
  }

  store.set(fieldPath, {
    values: trimmed,
    stats,
    lastUpdate: today,
  });
}

export function getHistory(fieldPath: string, opts: HistoryOptions = {}): FieldHistory | null {
  const store = opts.store ?? localHistoryStore;
  const h = store.get(fieldPath);
  if (!h) return null;
  const today = opts.today ?? new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const fresh = h.values.filter(e => !isExpired(e.date, today));
  if (fresh.length === 0) return null;
  return {
    ...h,
    values: fresh,
    stats: computeStats(fresh.map(e => e.v)),
  };
}

export function markConfirmed(
  fieldPath: string,
  value: number,
  opts: HistoryOptions = {},
): void {
  const store = opts.store ?? localHistoryStore;
  const h = store.get(fieldPath);
  if (!h) return;
  // آخرین رکورد با همون مقدار رو confirmed کن
  const idx = [...h.values].reverse().findIndex(e => e.v === value);
  if (idx !== -1) {
    h.values[h.values.length - 1 - idx].confirmed = true;
    store.set(fieldPath, h);
  }
}

export function clearHistory(opts: HistoryOptions = {}): void {
  (opts.store ?? localHistoryStore).clear();
}

/** کاربر الگوی مشخصی داره؟ (برای percent ها) */
export function getUserPattern(
  fieldPath: string,
  opts: HistoryOptions = {},
): { mean: number; std: number; cv: number; count: number } | null {
  const h = getHistory(fieldPath, opts);
  if (!h?.stats) return null;
  return {
    mean: h.stats.mean,
    std: h.stats.std,
    cv: h.stats.cv,
    count: h.stats.count,
  };
}

export { HISTORY_LIMIT, TTL_DAYS };

  | 'species_temp'

  mode?: 'statistical' | 'rule';
}

/**
 * intelligence/useAnomalyHint.ts — hook نمایش هشدار
 */
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import type { AnalysisContext, Warning } from './types';
import { analyzeAnomaly } from './anomalyDetector';

/** تبدیل مقدار به عدد (پشتیبانی از ارقام فارسی و جداکننده) */
export function parseNumericValue(v: number | string | null | undefined): number | null {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return null;
  if (typeof v === 'number') return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : null;
  const s = String(v).trim();
  if (!s) return null;
  const en = s.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));
  const n = parseFloat(en.replace('٫', '.'));
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
}

export function useAnomalyHint(
  fieldPath: string | undefined,
  value: number | string | null | undefined,
  context: AnalysisContext = {},
): Warning | null {
  const [warning, setWarning] = useState<Warning | null>(null);
  const ctxKey = JSON.stringify(context);
  const valueKey = typeof value === 'number' ? value : String(value ?? '');

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (!fieldPath) { setWarning(null); return; }
      const n = parseNumericValue(value);
      if (n === null) { setWarning(null); return; }
      try {
        setWarning(analyzeAnomaly(fieldPath, n, context));
      } catch {
        setWarning(null);
      }
    }, 800);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [fieldPath, valueKey, ctxKey]);

  return warning;
}

/**
 * MultiSelectBar — نوار شناور پایین صفحه برای Multi-Select
 *
 * الگو: اولویت + منوی سرریز (Material Design 3 + Carbon IBM)
 * - حذف و آرشیو (پرتکرارترین): همیشه در bar
 * - customAction + customActions: در منوی ⋯
 * - لغو: آیکون ✕ در انتها
 */
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { MultiSelectState } from './useMultiSelect';

interface Props<T> {
  ms: MultiSelectState<T>;
  deleteLabel?: string;
  archiveLabel?: string;
}

export default function MultiSelectBar<T>({
  ms,
  deleteLabel = 'حذف',
  archiveLabel = 'آرشیو',
}: Props<T>) {
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const wrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // بستن منو با کلیک بیرون یا Escape
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!menuOpen) return;
    const onDocClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (wrapRef.current && !wrapRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setMenuOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDocClick);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDocClick);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    };
  }, [menuOpen]);

  // وقتی انتخاب کاملاً لغو شد، منو هم بسته شود
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ms.selectionMode || ms.count === 0) setMenuOpen(false);
  }, [ms.selectionMode, ms.count]);

  if (!ms.selectionMode || ms.count === 0) return null;

  const hasOverflow = !!ms.customAction || (ms.customActions && ms.customActions.length > 0);

  const btnBase: React.CSSProperties = {
    flexShrink: 0,
    padding: '10px 14px',
    background: 'var(--input-bg)',
    border: '1px solid var(--border)',
    borderRadius: 12,
    color: 'var(--text)',
    fontFamily: 'inherit',
    fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
    fontWeight: 600,
    cursor: 'pointer',
    display: 'inline-flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    gap: 4,
    minHeight: 44,
    whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
  };

  const iconBtn: React.CSSProperties = {
    flexShrink: 0,
    padding: 0,
    width: 44,
    height: 44,
    minWidth: 44,
    minHeight: 44,
    background: 'var(--input-bg)',
    border: '1px solid var(--border)',
    borderRadius: 22,
    color: 'var(--text)',
    fontFamily: 'inherit',
    cursor: 'pointer',
    display: 'inline-flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  };

  const menuItemStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    width: '100%',
    padding: '12px 14px',
    background: 'transparent',
    border: 'none',
    borderRadius: 10,
    color: 'var(--text)',
    fontFamily: 'inherit',
    fontSize: 'var(--fs-base)',
    fontWeight: 600,
    textAlign: 'right',
    display: 'flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: 10,
    cursor: 'pointer',
    transition: 'background .12s',
  };

  const runMenuAction = (fn: () => void | Promise<void>) => {
    setMenuOpen(false);
    Promise.resolve().then(fn);
  };

  const bar = (
    <div
      ref={wrapRef}
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: 90,
        left: 10,
        right: 10,
        zIndex: 90, // زیر Modal (100+) — تا روی دیالوگ‌ها نیاد
        maxWidth: 480,
        margin: '0 auto',
        direction: 'rtl',
      }}
    >
      {/* منوی سرریز */}
      {menuOpen && hasOverflow && (
        <div
          role="menu"
          aria-label="عملیات بیشتر"
          style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            bottom: 'calc(100% + 8px)',
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            background: 'var(--card-solid)',
            border: '1px solid var(--border)',
            borderRadius: 16,
            boxShadow: '0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)',
            padding: 6,
            animation: 'msMenuIn .15s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)',
          }}
        >
          {ms.customAction && (
            <button
              type="button"
              role="menuitem"
              onClick={() => runMenuAction(ms.doCustom)}
              style={{
                ...menuItemStyle,
                color: ms.customAction.danger ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--text)',
              }}
              onMouseEnter={e => (e.currentTarget.style.background = 'var(--input-bg)')}
              onMouseLeave={e => (e.currentTarget.style.background = 'transparent')}
            >
              {ms.customAction.icon && (
                <span style={{ fontSize: 18, width: 24, textAlign: 'center' }}>{ms.customAction.icon}</span>
              )}
              <span>{ms.customAction.label}</span>
            </button>
          )}
          {ms.customActions && ms.customActions.map(a => (
            <button
              key={a.key}
              type="button"
              role="menuitem"
              onClick={() => runMenuAction(() => ms.doCustomByKey(a.key))}
              style={{
                ...menuItemStyle,
                color: a.danger ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--text)',
              }}
              onMouseEnter={e => (e.currentTarget.style.background = 'var(--input-bg)')}
              onMouseLeave={e => (e.currentTarget.style.background = 'transparent')}
            >
              {a.icon && (
                <span style={{ fontSize: 18, width: 24, textAlign: 'center' }}>{a.icon}</span>
              )}
              <span>{a.label}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* نوار اصلی */}
      <div
        role="toolbar"
        aria-label="اکشن‌های گروهی"
        style={{
          background: 'var(--card-solid)',
          border: '1px solid ' + (ms.customAction?.danger ? 'var(--danger)' : 'rgba(59,130,246,0.4)'),
          borderRadius: 22,
          boxShadow: '0 16px 44px rgba(0,0,0,0.22), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)',
          padding: '10px 12px',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: 6,
          direction: 'rtl',
        }}
      >
        <span
          style={{
            fontSize: 'var(--fs-sm)',
            fontWeight: 700,
            color: 'var(--info)',
            paddingLeft: 4,
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
          }}
        >
          {ms.count} انتخاب
        </span>

        <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />

        {ms.hasDelete && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={ms.doDelete}
            style={{
              ...btnBase,
              background: 'rgba(220,38,38,0.1)',
              border: '1px solid var(--danger)',
              color: 'var(--danger)',
              fontWeight: 700,
            }}
          >
            🗑 {deleteLabel}
          </button>
        )}

        {ms.hasArchive && (
          <button type="button" onClick={ms.doArchive} style={btnBase}>
            📦 {archiveLabel}
          </button>
        )}

        {hasOverflow && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setMenuOpen(v => !v)}
            aria-haspopup="menu"
            aria-expanded={menuOpen}
            aria-label="عملیات بیشتر"
            title="عملیات بیشتر"
            style={{
              ...iconBtn,
              background: menuOpen ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : 'var(--input-bg)',
              borderColor: menuOpen ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--border)',
              color: menuOpen ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)',
            }}
          >
            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
              <circle cx="4" cy="10" r="1.7" />
              <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="1.7" />
              <circle cx="16" cy="10" r="1.7" />
            </svg>
          </button>
        )}

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={ms.exitSelection}
          aria-label="لغو انتخاب"
          title="لغو"
          style={{
            ...iconBtn,
            background: 'transparent',
            borderColor: 'transparent',
            color: 'var(--muted)',
          }}
        >
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.2" strokeLinecap="round" aria-hidden="true">
            <line x1="4" y1="4" x2="12" y2="12" />
            <line x1="12" y1="4" x2="4" y2="12" />
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return createPortal(
    <>
      <style>{`
        @keyframes msMenuIn {
          from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
          to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }
      `}</style>
      {bar}
    </>,
    document.body
  );
}

/**
 * useMultiSelect — هوک عمومی Multi-Select با Long-Press
 *
 * استفاده:
 *   const ms = useMultiSelect({
 *     items: list,
 *     getId: (e) => e.id,
 *     onDelete: async (ids) => { ... },
 *     onArchive: async (ids) => { ... },  // اختیاری
 *   });
 */
import { useState, useRef, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';

export interface CustomAction<T> {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: string;
  danger?: boolean;
  action: (ids: string[]) => void | Promise<void>;
}

export interface MultiSelectConfig<T> {
  items: T[];
  getId: (item: T) => string;
  onDelete?: (ids: string[]) => void | Promise<void>;
  onArchive?: (ids: string[]) => void | Promise<void>;
  onCustomAction?: {
    label: string;
    icon?: string;
    danger?: boolean;
    action: (ids: string[]) => void | Promise<void>;
  };
  /** 🆕 چند اکشن سفارشی */
  onCustomActions?: CustomAction<T>[];
  /** زمان نگه‌داشتن (میلی‌ثانیه) — پیش‌فرض ۵۰۰ */
  longPressMs?: number;
}

export interface MultiSelectState<T> {
  /** آیا حالت انتخاب فعاله؟ */
  selectionMode: boolean;
  /** آی‌دی‌های انتخاب‌شده */
  selectedIds: Set<string>;
  /** لیست آیتم‌های انتخاب‌شده */
  selectedItems: T[];
  /** تعداد انتخاب */
  count: number;
  /** اگه آیتم انتخاب شده؟ */
  isSelected: (id: string) => boolean;
  /** toggle یه آیتم */
  toggleSelect: (id: string) => void;
  /** لغو همه انتخاب */
  clearSelection: () => void;
  /** خروج از حالت انتخاب */
  exitSelection: () => void;
  /** انتخاب همه */
  selectAll: () => void;
  /** حذف گروهی */
  doDelete: () => Promise<void>;
  /** آرشیو گروهی */
  doArchive: () => Promise<void>;
  /** اکشن سفارشی */
  doCustom: () => Promise<void>;
  doCustomByKey: (key: string) => Promise<void>;
  /** دستگیره‌های Long-Press */
  startLongPress: (id: string) => void;
  cancelLongPress: () => void;
  /** آیا Long-Press fire شد؟ */
  didLongPressFire: () => boolean;
  /** reset fire flag */
  resetLongPressFire: () => void;
  /** آیا دکمه‌ی آرشیو موجوده؟ */
  hasArchive: boolean;
  /** آیا دکمه‌ی حذف موجوده؟ */
  hasDelete: boolean;
  /** اکشن سفارشی */
  customAction?: MultiSelectConfig<T>['onCustomAction'];
  customActions?: CustomAction<T>[];
}

export function useMultiSelect<T>(config: MultiSelectConfig<T>): MultiSelectState<T> {
  const {
    items, getId, onDelete, onArchive, onCustomAction, onCustomActions,
    longPressMs = 800,
  } = config;

  const [selectionMode, setSelectionMode] = useState(false);
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const longPressTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const longPressFiredRef = useRef<boolean>(false);

  const toggleSelect = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setSelectedIds(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const startLongPress = useCallback((id: string) => {
    if (selectionMode) return;
    longPressFiredRef.current = false;
    if (longPressTimerRef.current) window.clearTimeout(longPressTimerRef.current);
    longPressTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      longPressFiredRef.current = true;
      setSelectionMode(true);
      setSelectedIds(new Set([id]));
      try { (navigator as any).vibrate?.([15]); } catch { /* silent */ }
      longPressTimerRef.current = null;
    }, longPressMs);
  }, [selectionMode, longPressMs]);

  const cancelLongPress = useCallback(() => {
    if (longPressTimerRef.current) {
      window.clearTimeout(longPressTimerRef.current);
      longPressTimerRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  const exitSelection = useCallback(() => {
    setSelectionMode(false);
    setSelectedIds(new Set());
  }, []);

  const clearSelection = useCallback(() => {
    setSelectedIds(new Set());
  }, []);

  const selectAll = useCallback(() => {
    setSelectedIds(new Set(items.map(getId)));
  }, [items, getId]);

  const selectedItems = useMemo(() => {
    return items.filter(item => selectedIds.has(getId(item)));
  }, [items, selectedIds, getId]);

  const doDelete = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!onDelete) return;
    const ids = Array.from(selectedIds);
    if (ids.length === 0) return;
    await onDelete(ids);
    exitSelection();
  }, [onDelete, selectedIds, exitSelection]);

  const doArchive = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!onArchive) return;
    const ids = Array.from(selectedIds);
    if (ids.length === 0) return;
    await onArchive(ids);
    exitSelection();
  }, [onArchive, selectedIds, exitSelection]);

  const doCustom = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!onCustomAction) return;
    const ids = Array.from(selectedIds);
    if (ids.length === 0) return;
    await onCustomAction.action(ids);
    exitSelection();
  }, [onCustomAction, selectedIds, exitSelection]);

  const doCustomByKey = useCallback(async (key: string) => {
    if (!onCustomActions) return;
    const action = onCustomActions.find(a => a.key === key);
    if (!action) return;
    const ids = Array.from(selectedIds);
    if (ids.length === 0) return;
    await action.action(ids);
    // فقط اگه action خودش exitSelection رو صدا نزده
    exitSelection();
  }, [onCustomActions, selectedIds, exitSelection]);

  const isSelected = useCallback((id: string) => selectedIds.has(id), [selectedIds]);
  const didLongPressFire = useCallback(() => longPressFiredRef.current, []);
  const resetLongPressFire = useCallback(() => { longPressFiredRef.current = false; }, []);

  return {
    selectionMode,
    selectedIds,
    selectedItems,
    count: selectedIds.size,
    isSelected,

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useGlobalSearch } from './useGlobalSearch';
import { SOURCES } from './config';

interface Props { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; }

const INITIAL_LIMIT = 10;

export default function GlobalSearch({ open, onClose }: Props) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [scope, setScope] = useState<string>('all');
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false);
  const [placeholderIdx, setPlaceholderIdx] = useState(0);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const nav = useNavigate();
  const groups = useGlobalSearch(query);

  const placeholders = [
    'گله‌ها رو جستجو کن...',
    'سالن، مخاطب، انبار...',
    'کالا، فاکتور، واکسن...',
    'جوجه‌کشی، تخم‌مرغ...',
  ];
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const t = setInterval(() => setPlaceholderIdx(i => (i + 1) % placeholders.length), 3200);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [open]);

  const scopedGroups = useMemo(() => {
    if (scope === 'all') return groups;
    return groups.filter(g => g.source.id === scope);
  }, [groups, scope]);

  const totalHits = useMemo(
    () => scopedGroups.reduce((s, g) => s + g.hits.length, 0),
    [scopedGroups]
  );

  const availableScopes = useMemo(() => {
    const ids = new Set(groups.map(g => g.source.id));
    return SOURCES.filter(s => ids.has(s.id));
  }, [groups]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setQuery(''); setScope('all'); setExpanded({});
      const t1 = setTimeout(() => setMounted(true), 10);
      const t2 = setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 120);
      return () => { clearTimeout(t1); clearTimeout(t2); };
    } else setMounted(false);
  }, [open]);

  if (!open) return null;

  const isEmpty = query.trim().length < 2;

  const close = () => {
    setMounted(false);
    setTimeout(onClose, 140);
  };

  const go = (route: string) => {
    setMounted(false);
    setTimeout(() => { nav(route); onClose(); }, 140);
  };

  const onKey = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); close(); }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <style>{`
        @keyframes gsOverlayIn  { from { opacity: 0 } to { opacity: 1 } }
        @keyframes gsOverlayOut { from { opacity: 1 } to { opacity: 0 } }
        @keyframes gsPanelIn {
          from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px) scale(.97); }
          to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0)    scale(1);   }
        }
        @keyframes gsPanelOut {
          from { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0)    scale(1);   }
          to   { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px) scale(.97); }
        }
        @keyframes gsRowIn {
          from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-2px); }
          to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }
        @keyframes gsFadeUp {
          from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
          to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }
      `}</style>

      {/* بک‌دراپ — تقریباً نامرئی */}
      <div
        onClick={close}
        style={{
          position: 'fixed', inset: 0,
          background: 'rgba(0,0,0,.03)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(0.5px)',
          WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(0.5px)',
          zIndex: 199,
          animation: mounted ? 'gsOverlayIn .18s ease-out both' : 'gsOverlayOut .14s ease-in both',
        }}
      />

      {/* پنل */}
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        top: 56, left: 8, right: 8,
        zIndex: 200,
        background: 'var(--card-solid, var(--card))',
        backgroundImage: 'linear-gradient(var(--card-solid, var(--card)), var(--card-solid, var(--card)))',
        border: '1px solid var(--border)',
        borderRadius: 16,

        maxHeight: isEmpty ? 'auto' : '58vh',
        isolation: 'isolate',
        display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', overflow: 'hidden',
        animation: mounted
          ? 'gsPanelIn .24s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1) both'
          : 'gsPanelOut .14s ease-in both',
        transformOrigin: 'calc(100% - 42px) -6px',
        direction: 'rtl',
      }}>
        {/* نوار ورودی */}

          boxShadow: focused ? 'inset 0 -2px 0 0 var(--accent-soft)' : 'none',
          transition: 'border-color .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease',
          flexShrink: 0,

          }}>

                 stroke={focused ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)'}
                 strokeWidth="2.4" strokeLinecap="round"
                 style={{ transition: 'stroke .2s ease' }}>
              <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7.5" /><path d="m21 21-4-4" />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <input
            ref={inputRef}

            placeholder={placeholders[placeholderIdx]}

        {/* نوار scope */}

                        onMouseEnter={e => (e.currentTarget.style.background = 'var(--accent-soft)')}
                        onMouseLeave={e => (e.currentTarget.style.background = 'transparent')}
                      >
                        <div style={{
                          fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600,
                          color: 'var(--text)',
                          overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                          lineHeight: 1.4, textAlign: 'right', direction: 'rtl',
                        }}>{h.title}</div>
                        {h.sub && (
                          <div style={{

                            marginTop: 1, fontWeight: 500,

                    ))}
                    {remaining > 0 && (

          )}
        </div>

    </>
  );

/** تعریف منابع جستجوی سراسری — فقط این فایل رو برای اضافه/کم کردن ماژول دست بزن */

export interface SourceDef {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon: string;
  route: string;
}

export const SOURCES: SourceDef[] = [
  { id: 'flk', label: 'گله‌ها',     icon: '🐔', route: '/flk' },
  { id: 'hal', label: 'سالن‌ها',    icon: '🏠', route: '/hal' },
  { id: 'ctc', label: 'مخاطبین',    icon: '👥', route: '/ctc' },
  { id: 'whs', label: 'انبار',      icon: '📦', route: '/whs' },
  { id: 'tra', label: 'معاملات',    icon: '💰', route: '/tra' },
  { id: 'egg', label: 'تخم‌مرغ',    icon: '🥚', route: '/egg' },
  { id: 'inc', label: 'جوجه‌کشی',   icon: '🐣', route: '/inc' },
  { id: 'dlg', label: 'ثبت روزانه', icon: '📝', route: '/dlg' },
  { id: 'fed', label: 'جیره',       icon: '🌾', route: '/fed' },
  { id: 'alt', label: 'هشدارها',    icon: '🔔', route: '/alt' },
  { id: 'brd', label: 'پرندگان',    icon: '🐦', route: '/brd' },
  { id: 'arc', label: 'آرشیو',      icon: '🗄', route: '/arc' },
];

/** ترتیب نمایش — مهم‌ترها اول */
export const PRIORITY = ['flk','hal','ctc','whs','tra','egg','inc','dlg','fed','alt','brd','arc'];

export const MAX_PER_GROUP = 6;

/** نرمال‌سازی متن فارسی (ی/ک عربی، اعراب، نیم‌فاصله) */
export function normalize(s: string): string {
  if (!s) return '';
  return String(s)
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[\u064A\u0649]/g, 'ی')
    .replace(/\u0643/g, 'ک')
    .replace(/[\u0622\u0623\u0625]/g, 'ا')
    .replace(/\u0629/g, 'ه')
    .replace(/[\u064B-\u0652]/g, '')
    .replace(/\u200C/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

/** آیا needle توی هرکدوم از فیلدها هست؟ */
export function hit(fields: (string | number | undefined | null)[], needle: string): boolean {
  if (!needle) return false;
  for (const f of fields) {
    if (f == null) continue;
    if (normalize(String(f)).includes(needle)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** آیتم نتیجه */
export interface SearchHit {
  id: string;
  sourceId: string;
  title: string;
  sub?: string;
}

export interface GroupedResult {
  source: SourceDef;
  hits: SearchHit[];
}

import { useMemo, useDeferredValue } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useFlk } from '../../mod/flk/store';
import { useBrd } from '../../mod/brd/store';
import { useHal } from '../../mod/hal/store';
import { useWhs } from '../../mod/whs/store';
import { useTra } from '../../mod/tra/store';
import { useCtc } from '../../mod/ctc/store';
import { useAlt } from '../../mod/alt/store';
import { useFed } from '../../mod/fed/store';
import { useInc } from '../../mod/inc/store';
import { useEgg } from '../../mod/egg/store';
import { useDlg } from '../../mod/dlg/store';
import { SOURCES, PRIORITY, normalize, hit, type SearchHit, type GroupedResult } from './config';

interface InternalHit extends SearchHit { _fields: (string | number | undefined | null)[]; }

function mk(id: string, sid: string, title: string, sub: string | undefined,
           fields: (string | number | undefined | null)[]): InternalHit {
  return { id, sourceId: sid, title, sub: sub || undefined, _fields: fields };
}

function pick(hits: InternalHit[], q: string): InternalHit[] {
  return hits.filter(h => hit(h._fields, q));
}

export function useGlobalSearch(query: string): GroupedResult[] {
  // ⭐ Apple-style: تایپ آزاد، نتایج با تأخیر نرم
  const deferredQuery = useDeferredValue(query);
  const location = useLocation();

  const flocks      = useFlk(s => s.flocks);
  const birds       = useBrd(s => s.birds);
  const breeds      = useBrd(s => s.breeds);
  const halls       = useHal(s => s.halls);
  const items       = useWhs(s => s.items);
  const invoices    = useTra(s => s.invoices);
  const deals       = useTra(s => s.deals);
  const contacts    = useCtc(s => s.contacts);
  const alerts      = useAlt(s => s.alerts);
  const ingredients = useFed(s => s.ingredients);
  const formulas    = useFed(s => s.formulas);
  const devices     = useInc(s => s.devices);
  const productions = useEgg(s => s.productions);
  const eggSales    = useEgg(s => s.sales);
  const logs        = useDlg(s => s.logs);

  return useMemo(() => {
    // ⭐ مسیر رو تازه از window.location بخون — ناوبری سریع پشتیبانی می‌شه
    const path = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location?.pathname)
      ? window.location.pathname
      : location.pathname;
    const currentModule = (path.split('/')[1] || '').toLowerCase();

    const q = normalize(deferredQuery);
    if (q.length < 2) return [];

    // نگاشت‌های cross-reference
    const birdMap  = new Map((birds  || []).map(b => [b.id, b.name]));
    const breedMap = new Map((breeds || []).map(b => [b.id, b.name]));
    const hallMap  = new Map((halls  || []).map(h => [h.id, h.name]));
    const partyMap = new Map((contacts || []).map(p => [p.id, p.name]));
    const itemMap  = new Map((items  || []).map(i => [i.id, i.name]));

    const buckets: Record<string, InternalHit[]> = {
      flk: (flocks || []).filter(f => f.status !== 'archived' && f.status !== 'sold')
        .map(f => mk(f.id, 'flk', f.name,
          [birdMap.get(f.birdId), breedMap.get(f.breedId), hallMap.get(f.hallId)].filter(Boolean).join(' • '),
          [f.name, f.notes, f.source, birdMap.get(f.birdId), breedMap.get(f.breedId), hallMap.get(f.hallId),
           f.type === 'layer' ? 'تخم‌گذار' : f.type === 'broiler' ? 'گوشتی' : 'مادر',
           f.initialCount, f.currentCount, f.hatchDate, f.purchaseDate, f.startDate,
           f.archivedReason, f.purchasePrice])),

      arc: (flocks || []).filter(f => f.status === 'archived' || f.status === 'sold')
        .map(f => mk(f.id, 'arc', f.name, f.archivedReason || 'آرشیو',
          [f.name, f.notes, f.archivedReason])),

      hal: (halls || []).map(h => mk(h.id, 'hal', h.name, h.code || h.address || '',
        [h.name, h.code, h.address, h.notes, h.systemNotes, h.ventilationSystem,
         h.feederType, h.drinkerType, h.litterType, h.capacity, h.targetTemp, h.targetHumidity,
         h.builtAt, h.lastSanitizedAt])),

      ctc: (contacts || []).map(p => mk(p.id, 'ctc', p.name,
        [p.phone, p.city].filter(Boolean).join(' • '),
        [p.name, p.phone, p.phone2, p.city, p.nationalId, p.email, p.notes,
         p.position, p.address, ...(p.roles || []),
         p.roles?.includes('customer') ? 'مشتری' : '',
         p.roles?.includes('supplier') ? 'تأمین‌کننده' : '',
         p.roles?.includes('worker') ? 'کارمند' : '',
         ...(p.customerTypes || []), ...(p.supplierTypes || [])])),

      whs: (items || []).map(it => mk(it.id, 'whs', it.name,
        [it.storage].filter(Boolean).join(' • '),
        [it.name, it.notes, it.storage, it.category, it.unit,
         partyMap.get(it.supplierId), it.currentStock, it.lastPrice, it.minStock,
         it.expireDate, it.productionDate, it.purchaseDate, it.hallId])),

      tra: [
        ...(invoices || []).map(inv => mk(inv.id, 'tra',
          'فاکتور \u200F' + (inv.number || '—') + '\u200F',
          [partyMap.get(inv.partyId), inv.category].filter(Boolean).join(' • '),
          [inv.number, inv.notes, inv.category, partyMap.get(inv.partyId),
           inv.total, inv.date, inv.dueDate, inv.workflowStatus,
           ...(inv.items || []).map((x: any) => itemMap.get(x.itemId) || x.name || '')])),
        ...(deals || []).map(d => mk(d.id, 'tra', 'معامله ' + (partyMap.get(d.partyId) || ''),
          d.description,
          [d.description, d.notes, partyMap.get(d.partyId), d.type])),
      ],

      egg: [
        ...(productions || []).map(p => mk(p.id, 'egg', 'تولید ' + p.date, p.notes,
          [p.notes, p.date])),
        ...(eggSales || []).map(s => mk(s.id, 'egg', 'فروش ' + s.date,
          partyMap.get(s.customerId) || '', [s.notes, s.date, partyMap.get(s.customerId)])),
      ],

      inc: (devices || []).map(d => mk(d.id, 'inc', d.name, d.notes || d.code || '',
        [d.name, d.notes, d.code, d.mode, d.status])),

      dlg: (logs || []).map(l => mk(l.id, 'dlg', 'ثبت ' + l.date,
        [hallMap.get((flocks || []).find(f => f.id === l.flockId)?.hallId || ''),
         l.notes].filter(Boolean).join(' • '),
        [l.notes, l.feedType, l.ventilation, l.behavior, l.sound,
         ...(l.vaccines || []).map(v => v.name),
         ...(l.medications || []).map(m => m.name)])),

      fed: [
        ...(ingredients || []).map(i => mk(i.id, 'fed', i.name, 'ماده', [i.name, i.notes, i.category])),
        ...(formulas || []).map(f => mk(f.id, 'fed', f.name, 'فرمول', [f.name, f.notes, f.status])),
      ],

      alt: (alerts || []).map(a => mk(a.id, 'alt', a.title, a.message,
        [a.title, a.message, a.notes, a.category, a.source])),

      brd: [
        ...(birds || []).map(b => mk(b.id, 'brd', b.name, 'پرنده', [b.name])),
        ...(breeds || []).map(b => mk(b.id, 'brd', b.name, 'نژاد', [b.name])),
      ],
    };

    // اگر در ماژول خاصی هستیم، اولویتش رو جلو ببر
    let order = [...PRIORITY];
    if (currentModule && order.includes(currentModule)) {
      order = [currentModule, ...order.filter(x => x !== currentModule)];
    }

    const groups: GroupedResult[] = [];
    for (const sid of order) {
      const picked = pick(buckets[sid] || [], q);
      if (picked.length === 0) continue;
      const source = SOURCES.find(s => s.id === sid);
      if (!source) continue;
      groups.push({
        source,
        hits: picked.map(({ id, sourceId, title, sub }) => ({ id, sourceId, title, sub })),
      });
    }
    return groups;
  }, [deferredQuery, location.pathname, location.key,
      flocks, birds, breeds, halls, items, invoices, deals,
      contacts, alerts, ingredients, formulas, devices, productions, eggSales, logs]);
}


==========================================
FILE: ./src/shr/store/customOptions.ts

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { persist } from 'zustand/middleware';
import { v4 as uuid } from 'uuid';

export interface CustomOption {
  id: string;
  key: string;
  name: string;
  icon: string;
  hidden?: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
}

interface State {
  options: CustomOption[];
  addOption: (key: string, name: string, icon: string) => void;
  updateOption: (id: string, patch: Partial<Pick<CustomOption, 'name' | 'icon'>>) => void;
  removeOption: (id: string) => void;
  hideOption: (id: string) => void;
  unhideOption: (id: string) => void;
  deleteOption: (id: string) => void;
  getByKey: (key: string) => CustomOption[];
  getHidden: () => CustomOption[];
}

export const useCustomOptions = create<State>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      options: [],
      addOption: (key, name, icon) => set({
        options: [...get().options, { id: uuid(), key, name, icon, hidden: false, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() }],
      }),
      updateOption: (id, patch) => set({
        options: get().options.map(o => o.id === id ? { ...o, ...patch } : o),
      }),
      removeOption: (id) => set({
        options: get().options.filter(o => o.id !== id),
      }),
      hideOption: (id) => set({
        options: get().options.map(o => o.id === id ? { ...o, hidden: true } : o),
      }),
      unhideOption: (id) => set({
        options: get().options.map(o => o.id === id ? { ...o, hidden: false } : o),
      }),
      deleteOption: (id) => set({
        options: get().options.filter(o => o.id !== id),
      }),
      getByKey: (key) => get().options.filter(o => o.key === key && !o.hidden),
      getHidden: () => get().options.filter(o => o.hidden),
    }),
    {
      name: 'pm-custom-options',
      version: 2,
      migrate: (persisted: any, version: number) => {
        if (version < 2 && persisted?.options) {
          persisted.options = persisted.options.map((o: any) => ({ ...o, hidden: false }));
        }
        return persisted;
      },
    }
  )
);

/**
 * convert.ts — تبدیل دقیق واحدها به واحد پایه با decimal.js
 */
import Decimal from 'decimal.js';
import type {
  WeightUnit, VolumeUnit, LengthUnit, AreaUnit, TimeUnit,
  TempUnit, CurrencyUnit,
} from './types';

const d = (v: number) => new Decimal(Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0);

// ═══ وزن (پایه: گرم) ═══
const WEIGHT_TO_G: Record<WeightUnit, number> = {
  mg: 0.001, g: 1, kg: 1000, ton: 1_000_000,
};
export const weightToG = (value: number, unit: WeightUnit): number => d(value).times(WEIGHT_TO_G[unit]).toNumber();
export const gToWeight = (grams: number, unit: WeightUnit): number => d(grams).div(WEIGHT_TO_G[unit]).toNumber();

// ═══ حجم (پایه: میلی‌لیتر) ═══
const VOLUME_TO_ML: Record<VolumeUnit, number> = {
  cc: 1, ml: 1, L: 1000, gal: 3785.41,
};
export const volumeToMl = (value: number, unit: VolumeUnit): number => d(value).times(VOLUME_TO_ML[unit]).toNumber();
export const mlToVolume = (ml: number, unit: VolumeUnit): number => d(ml).div(VOLUME_TO_ML[unit]).toNumber();

// ═══ طول (پایه: سانتی‌متر) ═══
const LENGTH_TO_CM: Record<LengthUnit, number> = {
  mm: 0.1, cm: 1, m: 100, km: 100_000,
};
export const lengthToCm = (value: number, unit: LengthUnit): number => d(value).times(LENGTH_TO_CM[unit]).toNumber();
export const cmToLength = (cm: number, unit: LengthUnit): number => d(cm).div(LENGTH_TO_CM[unit]).toNumber();

// ═══ مساحت (پایه: مترمربع) ═══
const AREA_TO_M2: Record<AreaUnit, number> = {
  m2: 1, ha: 10_000, ft2: 0.09290304,
};
export const areaToM2 = (value: number, unit: AreaUnit): number => d(value).times(AREA_TO_M2[unit]).toNumber();
export const m2ToArea = (m2: number, unit: AreaUnit): number => d(m2).div(AREA_TO_M2[unit]).toNumber();

// ═══ زمان (پایه: ثانیه) ═══
const TIME_TO_S: Record<TimeUnit, number> = {
  s: 1, min: 60, h: 3600, day: 86400,
};
export const timeToS = (value: number, unit: TimeUnit): number => d(value).times(TIME_TO_S[unit]).toNumber();
export const sToTime = (s: number, unit: TimeUnit): number => d(s).div(TIME_TO_S[unit]).toNumber();

// ═══ دما (پایه: سلسیوس) ═══
export const cToF = (c: number): number => d(c).times(9).div(5).plus(32).toNumber();
export const fToC = (f: number): number => d(f).minus(32).times(5).div(9).toNumber();
export const tempToC = (value: number, unit: TempUnit): number => (unit === 'c' ? value : fToC(value));
export const cToTemp = (c: number, unit: TempUnit): number => (unit === 'c' ? c : cToF(c));

// ═══ پول (پایه: تومان) ═══
const TOMAN_TO_RIAL = 10;

export function currencyToToman(value: number, unit: CurrencyUnit, usdRate: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return 0;
  if (unit === 'toman') return value;
  if (unit === 'rial') return d(value).div(TOMAN_TO_RIAL).toNumber();
  if (unit === 'usd') {
    const rate = Number.isFinite(usdRate) && usdRate > 0 ? usdRate : 0;
    return rate > 0 ? d(value).times(rate).toNumber() : 0;
  }
  return value;
}

export function tomanToCurrency(toman: number, unit: CurrencyUnit, usdRate: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(toman)) return 0;
  if (unit === 'toman') return toman;
  if (unit === 'rial') return d(toman).times(TOMAN_TO_RIAL).toNumber();
  if (unit === 'usd') {
    const rate = Number.isFinite(usdRate) && usdRate > 0 ? usdRate : 0;
    return rate > 0 ? d(toman).div(rate).toNumber() : 0;
  }
  return toman;
}

// ═══ Helper ها ═══

export function getUOM(cat: string | undefined): UOMRule | null {
  if (!cat) return null;
  return UOM_RULES[cat as Category] ?? null;
}

export function getDefaultUnit(cat: string | undefined): string {
  if (!cat) return 'pcs';
  return UOM_RULES[cat as Category]?.default ?? 'pcs';
}

export function getBaseUnit(cat: string | undefined): ItemUnit {
  if (!cat) return 'pcs';
  return UOM_RULES[cat as Category]?.baseUnit ?? 'pcs';
}

export function needsUnitWeight(cat: string | undefined, unit: string): boolean {
  const u = getUOM(cat)?.units.find(x => x.value === unit);
  return !!u && u.factor === null;
}

export function getUOMUnit(cat: string | undefined, unit: string): UOMUnit | null {
  return getUOM(cat)?.units.find(x => x.value === unit) ?? null;
}

FILE: ./src/shr/units/useFormat.ts

/**
 * useFormat.ts — موتور مرکزی نمایش اعداد، واحدها، چندارزی و تقویم
 */
import Decimal from 'decimal.js';
import { useSet } from '../../mod/set/store';
import { parseJalali, formatGregorianFromDate } from '../date/jalali';
import {
  tomanToCurrency, gToWeight, mlToVolume, cmToLength, m2ToArea, sToTime, cToTemp,
} from './convert';
import { UNIT_SHORT } from './types';
import type { NumberFormat, ThousandSep, Units } from './types';

const FA_DIGITS = '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹';

const SEP_MAP: Record<ThousandSep, string> = {
  fa: '٬',
  en: ',',
  space: ' ',
  dot: '.',
  slash: '/',
  none: '',
};

function getDecimalSep(fmt: NumberFormat, thousandSep: ThousandSep): string {
  // جلوگیری از تداخل نقطه هزارگان با نقطه اعشار
  if (thousandSep === 'dot') return fmt === 'fa' ? '٫' : ',';
  return fmt === 'fa' ? '٫' : '.';
}

export function applyDigits(s: string, fmt: NumberFormat): string {
  if (fmt === 'fa') return s.replace(/[0-9]/g, d => FA_DIGITS[+d]);
  return s.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String(FA_DIGITS.indexOf(d)));
}

export function formatNumberRaw(
  n: number,
  fmt: NumberFormat,
  sep: ThousandSep,
  decimals: number,
  fixed = false,
): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return '—';
  const maxDec = Math.max(0, decimals);
  const dec = new Decimal(n).toDecimalPlaces(maxDec, Decimal.ROUND_HALF_UP);
  // نرمال‌سازی -0 به 0
  const isNeg = dec.isNegative() && !dec.isZero();
  const absFixed = dec.abs().toFixed(maxDec);
  let [intPart = '0', decPart = ''] = absFixed.split('.');
  if (!fixed && decPart) {
    decPart = decPart.replace(/0+$/, '');
  }
  const sepChar = SEP_MAP[sep] ?? '';
  const intWithSep = sepChar ? intPart.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, sepChar) : intPart;
  let result = (isNeg ? '-' : '') + intWithSep;
  if (maxDec > 0 && decPart) {
    result += getDecimalSep(fmt, sep) + decPart;
  }
  return applyDigits(result, fmt);
}

export function createFormatter(units: Units) {
  const sep = units.thousandSep;
  const nf = units.numberFormat;

  const num = (n: number | null | undefined, opts?: { decimals?: number }) => {
    if (n == null || isNaN(n as any)) return '—';
    const d = opts?.decimals ?? units.decimals;
    return formatNumberRaw(n as number, nf, sep, d);
  };

  // اعداد گسسته و شمارشی (تعداد مرغ، تخم، قطعه، روز) — همیشه صحیح
  const int = (n: number | null | undefined) => num(n, { decimals: 0 });
  const count = (n: number | null | undefined) => int(n);
  const day = (n: number | null | undefined) => int(n);

  // شناسه، کد، شماره فاکتور، سال — بدون جداکننده هزارگان
  const code = (v: string | number | null | undefined): string => {
    if (v == null || v === '') return '—';
    return applyDigits(String(v), nf);
  };

  // پول — تبدیل ارز + اعشار هوشمند (۲ رقم برای دلار، ۰ برای تومان/ریال)
  const money = (toman: number | null | undefined, opts?: { decimals?: number; withUnit?: boolean }): string => {
    if (toman == null || isNaN(toman as any)) return '—';
    const v = tomanToCurrency(toman as number, units.currency, units.usdRate);
    const defaultDec = units.currency === 'usd' ? 2 : 0;
    const d = opts?.decimals ?? defaultDec;
    const formatted = formatNumberRaw(v, nf, sep, d);
    if (opts?.withUnit === false) return formatted;
    const unit = UNIT_SHORT.currency[units.currency] || '';
    return `${formatted} ${unit}`;
  };

  const temp = (celsius: number | null | undefined): string => {
    if (celsius == null || isNaN(celsius as any)) return '—';
    const v = cToTemp(celsius as number, units.temperature);
    return `${formatNumberRaw(v, nf, sep, 1)}${UNIT_SHORT.temperature[units.temperature]}`;
  };

  const weight = (grams: number | null | undefined): string => {
    if (grams == null || isNaN(grams as any)) return '—';
    const v = gToWeight(grams as number, units.weight);
    return `${formatNumberRaw(v, nf, sep, units.decimals)} ${UNIT_SHORT.weight[units.weight]}`;
  };

  const volume = (ml: number | null | undefined): string => {
    if (ml == null || isNaN(ml as any)) return '—';
    const v = mlToVolume(ml as number, units.volume);
    return `${formatNumberRaw(v, nf, sep, units.decimals)} ${UNIT_SHORT.volume[units.volume]}`;
  };

  const length = (cm: number | null | undefined): string => {
    if (cm == null || isNaN(cm as any)) return '—';
    const v = cmToLength(cm as number, units.length);
    return `${formatNumberRaw(v, nf, sep, units.decimals)} ${UNIT_SHORT.length[units.length]}`;
  };

  const area = (m2: number | null | undefined): string => {
    if (m2 == null || isNaN(m2 as any)) return '—';
    const v = m2ToArea(m2 as number, units.area);
    return `${formatNumberRaw(v, nf, sep, units.decimals)} ${UNIT_SHORT.area[units.area]}`;
  };

  const time = (seconds: number | null | undefined): string => {
    if (seconds == null || isNaN(seconds as any)) return '—';
    const v = sToTime(seconds as number, units.time);
    return `${formatNumberRaw(v, nf, sep, 0)} ${UNIT_SHORT.time[units.time]}`;
  };

  // تاریخ — تبدیل خودکار شمسی/میلادی طبق تنظیمات
  const date = (jalaliStr: string | null | undefined): string => {
    if (!jalaliStr) return '—';
    if (units.dateFormat === 'gregorian') {
      const parsed = parseJalali(jalaliStr);
      if (parsed) {
        return applyDigits(formatGregorianFromDate(parsed), nf);
      }
    }
    return applyDigits(jalaliStr, nf);
  };

  return {
    num, int, count, day, code, money, temp, weight, volume, length, area, time, date,
    units,
    raw: { number: formatNumberRaw, digits: applyDigits },
  };
}

/** نسخه غیرهوکی برای استورها، چاپ و توابع کمکی */
export function getGlobalFormat() {
  return createFormatter(useSet.getState().units);
}

/** هوک مرکزی برای کامپوننت‌های React */
export function useFormat() {
  const units = useSet(s => s.units);
  return createFormatter(units);
}

/**
 * audio.ts — سیستم مشترک صدا و ویبره
 * AudioContext روی موبایل تا اولین تعامل کاربر در حالت suspended می‌مونه.
 * این ماژول یک context پایدار نگه می‌داره و روی اولین tap/touch بازش می‌کنه.
 */

let _ctx: any = null;
let _unlocked = false;

function getCtx(): any {
  try {
    if (_ctx && _ctx.state !== 'closed') return _ctx;
    const Ctx: any = (window as any).AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
    if (!Ctx) return null;
    _ctx = new Ctx();
    return _ctx;
  } catch { return null; }
}

export async function unlockAudio(): Promise<void> {
  const ctx = getCtx();
  if (!ctx) return;
  try {
    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') await ctx.resume();
    if (!_unlocked) {
      const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, 1, 22050);
      const src = ctx.createBufferSource();
      src.buffer = buf;
      src.connect(ctx.destination);
      src.start(0);
      _unlocked = true;
    }
  } catch {}
}

export function playBeep(type?: string): void {
  const ctx = getCtx();
  if (!ctx) return;
  try {
    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') { ctx.resume().catch(() => {}); }
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
    const isCritical = type === 'danger' || type === 'error';
    const dur = isCritical ? 0.25 : 0.15;
    osc.type = 'sine';
    osc.frequency.value = isCritical ? 880 : 660;
    const now = ctx.currentTime;
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.15, now + 0.01);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + dur);
    osc.start(now);
    osc.stop(now + dur + 0.02);
  } catch {}
}

export function vibrate(type?: string): boolean {
  try {
    if (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || !('vibrate' in navigator)) return false;
    const isCritical = type === 'danger' || type === 'error';
    return !!navigator.vibrate(isCritical ? [200, 80, 200] : 100);
  } catch { return false; }
}

export function hasVibration(): boolean {
  try { return typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && 'vibrate' in navigator; } catch { return false; }
}

if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  const unlock = () => {
    unlockAudio();
    window.removeEventListener('pointerdown', unlock);
    window.removeEventListener('touchstart', unlock);
    window.removeEventListener('click', unlock);
    window.removeEventListener('keydown', unlock);
  };
  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', unlock);
  window.addEventListener('touchstart', unlock);
  window.addEventListener('click', unlock);
  window.addEventListener('keydown', unlock);
}

/**
 * backup.ts — موتور پشتیبان‌گیری و بازیابی
 * استاندارد: ALCOA+ / 21 CFR Part 11
 * اصل: هر داده‌ای که در برنامه هست باید در پشتیبان باشد و برگردد.
 *
 * تغییرات:
 *  - خواندن/نوشتن از طریق rawStore (IDB + LS) — نه فقط localStorage
 *  - APIهای داده‌ای async شدند (IDB مسیر همگام ندارد)
 *  - حجم بر حسب بایت واقعی (UTF-8)
 *  - pm-recycle-tra-deals اضافه شد
 *  - clearAllData() برای پاک‌سازی کامل (LS + IDB)
 */
import { safeStorage } from './storage';

import {
  ARCHIVE_STORES,

/** کلیدهای پشتیبان‌گیری‌شده */
export const PM_KEYS = [

  'pm-recycle-tra-deals',

/** کلید IDB برای نسخه‌های پشتیبان خودکار */
export const AUTOBACKUP_IDB_KEY = 'pm-autobackup-list';

/** کلیدهای ویژه در BackupFile.data برای آرشیو سرد */
const BACKUP_KEY_ARCHIVE_LOGS = '__archive_logs';
const BACKUP_KEY_ARCHIVE_SUMMARIES = '__archive_summaries';

export const MODULE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {

  'pm-theme': 'تم',
