import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { renderWithRouter } from './helpers';
import HallsPage from '../mod/hal/HallsPage';
import { useHal } from '../mod/hal/store';

vi.mock('../cor/store/dialog', () => ({
  showConfirmAsync: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
  showAlert: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
}));
vi.mock('../cor/store/toast', () => ({
  showToast: vi.fn(),
  toastMsg: {
    added: vi.fn(), saved: vi.fn(), updated: vi.fn(),
    deleted: vi.fn(), deletedBulk: vi.fn(),
    archived: vi.fn(), archivedBulk: vi.fn(),
    restored: vi.fn(), restoredBulk: vi.fn(),
    hidden: vi.fn(), visible: vi.fn(),
    paused: vi.fn(), activated: vi.fn(),
    error: vi.fn(), warn: vi.fn(), info: vi.fn(),
  },
}));
vi.mock('../cor/logger/auditLog', () => ({ logAction: vi.fn() }));

const makeHall = (o: any = {}) => ({
  id: 'h-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9),
  name: 'سالن ۱', capacity: 1000, area: 100, type: 'open',
  ...o,
});

beforeEach(() => {
  useHal.setState({ halls: [], zones: [], equipment: [] } as any);
  vi.clearAllMocks();
});

describe('HallsPage — خالی', () => {
  it('پیام خالی دیده میشه', () => {
    renderWithRouter(<HallsPage />);
    expect(screen.getByText(/افزودن سالن/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

describe('HallsPage — نمایش لیست', () => {
  it('سالن‌ها دیده میشن', () => {
    useHal.setState({ halls: [makeHall({ name: 'سالن A' }), makeHall({ name: 'سالن B' })] } as any);
    renderWithRouter(<HallsPage />);
    expect(screen.getByText('سالن A')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('سالن B')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

describe('HallsPage — افزودن', () => {
  it('باز شدن Modal', () => {
    renderWithRouter(<HallsPage />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('+ افزودن سالن'));
    expect(screen.getByText('افزودن سالن')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('پر کردن + ذخیره → اضافه میشه', async () => {
    renderWithRouter(<HallsPage />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('+ افزودن سالن'));

    const inputs = screen.getAllByRole('textbox');
    if (inputs.length > 0) fireEvent.change(inputs[0], { target: { value: 'سالن جدید' } });

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('ذخیره'));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(useHal.getState().halls.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    });
  });

  it('لغو → بسته میشه', async () => {
    renderWithRouter(<HallsPage />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('+ افزودن سالن'));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('لغو'));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.queryByText('افزودن سالن')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/Inputs.test.tsx

import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react';
import { Input, Field } from '../shr/components/ui';

describe('Input', () => {
  it('value رو نشون میده', () => {
    render(<Input value="سلام" onChange={() => {}} />);
    expect((screen.getByRole('textbox') as HTMLInputElement).value).toBe('سلام');
  });

  it('onChange کار میکنه', () => {
    const onChange = vi.fn();
    render(<Input value="" onChange={onChange} />);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('textbox'), { target: { value: 'abc' } });
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('disabled کار میکنه', () => {
    render(<Input value="" onChange={() => {}} disabled />);
    expect(screen.getByRole('textbox')).toBeDisabled();
  });

  it('placeholder نشون داده میشه', () => {
    render(<Input value="" onChange={() => {}} placeholder="تایپ کن..." />);
    expect(screen.getByPlaceholderText('تایپ کن...')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

describe('Field', () => {
  it('label رو نشون میده', () => {
    render(<Field label="نام"><Input value="" onChange={() => {}} /></Field>);
    expect(screen.getByText('نام')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('required * نشون میده', () => {
    const { container } = render(<Field label="نام" required><Input value="" onChange={() => {}} /></Field>);
    expect(container.textContent).toContain('*');
  });

  it('hint رو نشون میده', () => {
    render(<Field label="نام" hint="متن راهنما"><Input value="" onChange={() => {}} /></Field>);
    expect(screen.getByText('متن راهنما')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('children رو رندر میکنه', () => {
    render(<Field label="X"><Input value="test" onChange={() => {}} /></Field>);
    expect(screen.getByRole('textbox')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/Sheet.test.tsx
==========================================
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react';
import { Sheet, Btn } from '../shr/components/ui';

describe('Sheet', () => {
  it('وقتی open=false رندر نمیشه', () => {
    render(<Sheet open={false} onClose={() => {}}><div>محتوا</div></Sheet>);
    expect(screen.queryByText('محتوا')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('وقتی open=true رندر میشه', () => {
    render(<Sheet open={true} onClose={() => {}}><div>محتوا</div></Sheet>);
    expect(screen.getByText('محتوا')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('title رو نشون میده', () => {
    render(<Sheet open={true} onClose={() => {}} title="عنوان تست"><div>x</div></Sheet>);
    expect(screen.getByText('عنوان تست')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('کلیک روی backdrop → onClose', () => {
    const onClose = vi.fn();
    render(<Sheet open={true} onClose={onClose}><div>محتوا</div></Sheet>);
    // backdrop = highest z-index fixed overlay in body
    const backdrop = document.body.querySelector('div[style*="fixed"]') as HTMLElement;
    expect(backdrop).toBeTruthy();
    // fire click on backdrop itself (target === currentTarget)
    fireEvent.click(backdrop);
    expect(onClose).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('Esc → onClose', () => {
    const onClose = vi.fn();
    render(<Sheet open={true} onClose={onClose}><div>محتوا</div></Sheet>);
    fireEvent.keyDown(document, { key: 'Escape' });
    expect(onClose).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('footer رو نشون میده', () => {
    render(
      <Sheet open={true} onClose={() => {}} footer={<Btn>ذخیره</Btn>}>
        <div>x</div>
      </Sheet>
    );
    expect(screen.getByText('ذخیره')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';

import UndoBar from '../cor/ui/UndoBar';

describe('UndoBar', () => {
  it('label و دکمه‌ها رندر میشن', () => {
    render(<UndoBar label="حذف شد" onUndo={() => {}} onDismiss={() => {}} />);
    expect(screen.getByText(/حذف شد/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('کلیک Undo', () => {
    const onUndo = vi.fn();
    render(<UndoBar label="x" onUndo={onUndo} onDismiss={() => {}} />);
    const undoBtn = screen.getByText(/بازگردان|Undo|واگرد/i);
    fireEvent.click(undoBtn);
    expect(onUndo).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('کلیک Dismiss', () => {
    const onDismiss = vi.fn();
    render(<UndoBar label="x" onUndo={() => {}} onDismiss={onDismiss} />);
    const btns = screen.getAllByRole('button');
    // آخرین دکمه معمولاً بستن
    if (btns.length > 1) fireEvent.click(btns[btns.length - 1]);
    expect(true).toBe(true);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { renderWithRouter } from './helpers';
import { useFlk } from '../mod/flk/store';
import ZonesPage from '../mod/hal/ZonesPage';
import { useHal } from '../mod/hal/store';

const mockConfirm = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true);
vi.mock('../cor/store/dialog', () => ({
  showConfirmAsync: (...args: any[]) => mockConfirm(...args),
  showAlert: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
}));
vi.mock('../cor/store/toast', () => ({
  showToast: vi.fn(),
  toastMsg: {
    added: vi.fn(), saved: vi.fn(), updated: vi.fn(),
    deleted: vi.fn(), deletedBulk: vi.fn(),
    archived: vi.fn(), archivedBulk: vi.fn(),
    restored: vi.fn(), restoredBulk: vi.fn(),
    hidden: vi.fn(), visible: vi.fn(),
    paused: vi.fn(), activated: vi.fn(),
    error: vi.fn(), warn: vi.fn(), info: vi.fn(),
  },
}));
vi.mock('../cor/logger/auditLog', () => ({ logAction: vi.fn() }));

beforeEach(() => {
  useHal.setState({ halls: [], zones: [], equipment: [] } as any);
  useFlk.setState({ flocks: [] } as any);
  mockConfirm.mockClear();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
});

describe('ZonesPage', () => {
  it('رندر بدون خطا', () => {
    const { container } = renderWithRouter(<ZonesPage />);
    expect(container).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

describe('ZonesPage — خالی (بدون سالن)', () => {
  it('پیام «اول یک سالن بسازید» دیده می‌شه', () => {
    renderWithRouter(<ZonesPage />);
    expect(screen.getByText(/اول یک سالن بسازید/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

describe('ZonesPage — با سالن', () => {
  it('پیام empty راهنما نمایش داده نمی‌شه', () => {
    useHal.setState({
      halls: [{ id: 'h1', name: 'سالن A' }],
      zones: [], equipment: [],
    } as any);
    renderWithRouter(<ZonesPage />);
    expect(screen.queryByText(/اول یک سالن بسازید/)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

describe('ZonesPage — نمایش لیست بخش‌ها', () => {
  it('اسم بخش دیده می‌شه', () => {
    useHal.setState({
      halls: [{ id: 'h1', name: 'سالن A' }],
      zones: [{
        id: 'z1', hallId: 'h1', name: 'بخش شمالی',
        capacity: 100, notes: '', createdAt: '', updatedAt: '',
      }],
      equipment: [],
    } as any);
    renderWithRouter(<ZonesPage />);
    expect(screen.getAllByText('بخش شمالی').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});

describe('hal/store — cascade تجهیزات (Fix 1)', () => {
  it('حذف بخش → zoneId تجهیزات پاک می‌شه', () => {
    useHal.setState({
      halls: [],
      zones: [{
        id: 'z1', hallId: 'h1', name: 'بخش',
        capacity: null, notes: '', createdAt: '', updatedAt: '',
      }],
      equipment: [
        { id: 'e1', hallId: 'h1', zoneId: 'z1', name: 'فن',
          category: 'ventilation', type: '', unit: 'pcs',
          count: 1, notes: '', createdAt: '', updatedAt: '' } as any,
        { id: 'e2', hallId: 'h1', zoneId: 'z1', name: 'هیتر',
          category: 'heating', type: '', unit: 'pcs',
          count: 1, notes: '', createdAt: '', updatedAt: '' } as any,
      ],
    } as any);

    useHal.getState().deleteZone('z1');

    const equipment = useHal.getState().equipment;
    expect(equipment[0].zoneId).toBe('');
    expect(equipment[1].zoneId).toBe('');
    expect(useHal.getState().zones.length).toBe(0);
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/analytics.test.ts
==========================================
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  monthKey, jalaliToDate, lastMonths, MONTH_NAMES, monthLabel,
  salesInMonth, purchasesInMonth, cashInMonth, cashOutMonth,
  eggsInMonth, feedInMonth, deathsInMonth, fcrMonth,
  totalReceivables, totalPayables, avgChickCost, roi,
} from '../mod/rep/analytics';

const makeInvoice = (o: any = {}) => ({
  id: 'i1', type: 'sale', total: 100000, date: '1405/07/09',
  payments: [], ...o,
});

const makeProd = (o: any = {}) => ({
  id: 'p1', date: '1405/07/09',
  totalCount: 100, brokenCount: 0, softCount: 0, dirtyCount: 0,
  ...o,
});

const makeLog = (o: any = {}) => ({
  id: 'l1', date: '1405/07/09', feedDelivered: 50, deaths: [],
  ...o,
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// monthKey
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('monthKey', () => {
  it('تاریخ کامل → yyyy/MM', () => {
    expect(monthKey('1405/07/09')).toBe('1405/07');
  });
  it('ماه تک‌رقمی → pad', () => {
    expect(monthKey('1405/7/9')).toBe('1405/07');
  });
  it('اعداد فارسی → لاتین', () => {
    expect(monthKey('۱۴۰۵/۰۷/۰۹')).toBe('1405/07');
  });
  it('خالی → خالی', () => {
    expect(monthKey('')).toBe('');
  });
  it('نامعتبر → خالی', () => {
    expect(monthKey('abc')).toBe('');
    expect(monthKey('1405/07')).toBe('');
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// monthLabel
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('monthLabel', () => {
  it('1405/07 → مهر 05', () => {
    expect(monthLabel('1405/07')).toBe('مهر 05');
  });
  it('1405/01 → فروردین 05', () => {
    expect(monthLabel('1405/01')).toBe('فروردین 05');
  });
  it('1405/12 → اسفند 05', () => {
    expect(monthLabel('1405/12')).toBe('اسفند 05');
  });
  it('ماه 13 (نامعتبر) → فقط سال با فاصله', () => {
    // ماه‌های معتبر: 1-12. ماه 13 → MONTH_NAMES[12] undefined → ''
    expect(monthLabel('1405/13')).toBe(' 05');
  });

  it('ماه صفر (نامعتبر)', () => {
    expect(monthLabel('1405/00')).toBe(' 05');
  });
  it('بدون اسلش → همون', () => {
    expect(monthLabel('abc')).toBe('abc');
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// MONTH_NAMES
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('MONTH_NAMES', () => {
  it('۱۲ ماه', () => {
    expect(MONTH_NAMES).toHaveLength(12);
  });
  it('فروردین اول', () => {
    expect(MONTH_NAMES[0]).toBe('فروردین');
  });
  it('اسفند آخر', () => {
    expect(MONTH_NAMES[11]).toBe('اسفند');
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// salesInMonth
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('salesInMonth', () => {
  it('یک فروش در ماه → total', () => {
    expect(salesInMonth([makeInvoice({ total: 100000 })] , '1405/07')).toBe(100000);
  });
  it('فقط sale (نه purchase)', () => {
    const invoices = [
      makeInvoice({ type: 'sale', total: 100000 }),
      makeInvoice({ type: 'purchase', total: 500000 }),
    ];
    expect(salesInMonth(invoices, '1405/07')).toBe(100000);
  });
  it('ماه متفاوت → 0', () => {
    expect(salesInMonth([makeInvoice()], '1405/08')).toBe(0);
  });
  it('خالی → 0', () => {
    expect(salesInMonth([], '1405/07')).toBe(0);
  });
  it('چند فروش → جمع', () => {
    const invoices = [
      makeInvoice({ total: 100000 }),
      makeInvoice({ total: 50000 }),
    ];
    expect(salesInMonth(invoices, '1405/07')).toBe(150000);
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// purchasesInMonth
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('purchasesInMonth', () => {
  it('فقط purchase', () => {
    const invoices = [
      makeInvoice({ type: 'purchase', total: 500000 }),
      makeInvoice({ type: 'sale', total: 100000 }),
    ];
    expect(purchasesInMonth(invoices, '1405/07')).toBe(500000);
  });
  it('خالی → 0', () => {
    expect(purchasesInMonth([], '1405/07')).toBe(0);
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// cashInMonth
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('cashInMonth', () => {
  it('پرداخت فروش در ماه → جمع', () => {
    const invoices = [
      makeInvoice({
        type: 'sale',
        payments: [{ amount: 50000, date: '1405/07/15' }],
      }),
    ];
    expect(cashInMonth(invoices, '1405/07')).toBe(50000);
  });

  it('پرداخت در ماه دیگه → نادیده', () => {
    const invoices = [
      makeInvoice({
        type: 'sale',
        payments: [{ amount: 50000, date: '1405/08/15' }],
      }),
    ];
    expect(cashInMonth(invoices, '1405/07')).toBe(0);
  });

  it('فقط sale (نه purchase)', () => {
    const invoices = [
      makeInvoice({
        type: 'sale',
        payments: [{ amount: 50000, date: '1405/07/15' }],
      }),
      makeInvoice({
        type: 'purchase',
        payments: [{ amount: 30000, date: '1405/07/15' }],
      }),
    ];
    expect(cashInMonth(invoices, '1405/07')).toBe(50000);
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// eggsInMonth — باگ مشکوک
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('eggsInMonth', () => {
  it('خالی → صفر', () => {
    const r = eggsInMonth([], '1405/07');
    expect(r.healthy).toBe(0);
    expect(r.total).toBe(0);
    expect(r.days).toBe(0);
  });

  it('یک تولید 100 totalCount → total = 100 (نه 100)', () => {
    const r = eggsInMonth([makeProd({ totalCount: 100 })], '1405/07');
    expect(r.total).toBe(100);
    expect(r.healthy).toBe(100);
    expect(r.days).toBe(1);
  });

  it('100 totalCount + 5 broken → total باید 100 باشه', () => {
    // ⚠️ اگه totalCount شامل broken باشه: total=100
    // اگه شامل نباشه: total=105
    const r = eggsInMonth([makeProd({ totalCount: 100, brokenCount: 5 })], '1405/07');
    expect(r.total).toBe(100);  // ← انتظار 100
    expect(r.healthy).toBe(95);
  });

  it('100 + 20 broken + 5 soft + 3 dirty → total=100', () => {
    const r = eggsInMonth([makeProd({
      totalCount: 100, brokenCount: 20, softCount: 5, dirtyCount: 3,
    })], '1405/07');
    expect(r.total).toBe(100);
    expect(r.healthy).toBe(72);
  });

  it('days → تعداد روزهایی که تولید داشتن', () => {
    const prods = [
      makeProd({ date: '1405/07/01' }),
      makeProd({ date: '1405/07/02' }),
      makeProd({ date: '1405/07/02' }),  // همون روز
      makeProd({ date: '1405/08/01' }),  // ماه دیگه
    ];
    expect(eggsInMonth(prods, '1405/07').days).toBe(3);
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// feedInMonth
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('feedInMonth', () => {
  it('جمع feedDelivered در ماه', () => {
    const logs = [
      makeLog({ feedDelivered: 50 }),
      makeLog({ feedDelivered: 30 }),
    ];
    expect(feedInMonth(logs, '1405/07')).toBe(80);
  });

  it('ماه متفاوت → 0', () => {
    expect(feedInMonth([makeLog()], '1405/08')).toBe(0);
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// deathsInMonth
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('deathsInMonth', () => {
  it('جمع deaths.count', () => {
    const logs = [
      makeLog({ deaths: [{ count: 3 }, { count: 2 }] }),
      makeLog({ deaths: [{ count: 5 }] }),
    ];
    expect(deathsInMonth(logs, '1405/07')).toBe(10);
  });

  it('بدون deaths → 0', () => {
    expect(deathsInMonth([makeLog()], '1405/07')).toBe(0);
  });

  it('ماه متفاوت → 0', () => {
    expect(deathsInMonth([makeLog({ deaths: [{ count: 5 }] })], '1405/08')).toBe(0);
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// fcrMonth
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('fcrMonth — ضریب تبدیل غذایی', () => {
  it('feed=100, birds=1000, gain=1.8kg → FCR=55.56', () => {
    const logs = [makeLog({ feedDelivered: 100 })];
    // gain = 1000 * 1.8 / 1000 = 1.8 کیلو
    // FCR = 100 / 1.8 = 55.55...
    expect(fcrMonth(logs, '1405/07', 1000, 1.8)).toBe(55.56);
  });

  it('feed=0 → 0', () => {
    expect(fcrMonth([], '1405/07', 1000, 1.8)).toBe(0);
  });

  it('birds=0 → 0 (بدون تقسیم بر صفر)', () => {
    const logs = [makeLog({ feedDelivered: 100 })];
    expect(fcrMonth(logs, '1405/07', 0, 1.8)).toBe(0);
  });

  it('avgWeightGain=0 → 0', () => {
    const logs = [makeLog({ feedDelivered: 100 })];
    expect(fcrMonth(logs, '1405/07', 1000, 0)).toBe(0);
  });

  it('مقدار معقول (FCR 1.5-2.0 برای مرغ)', () => {
    // اگه 1.5 باشه: feed = 1.8 * 1.5 = 2.7 کیلو برای 1000 پرنده
    // یعنی 2700 گرم دان / 1800 گرم وزن = 1.5
    const logs = [makeLog({ feedDelivered: 2.7 })];
    expect(fcrMonth(logs, '1405/07', 1000, 1.8)).toBe(1.5);
  });
});

describe('avgChickCost', () => {

    expect(avgChickCost([], [])).toBe(0);

    const hatches = [{ eggEntryId: 'e1', hatched: 500 }];

    const hatches = [{ eggEntryId: 'e1', hatched: 500 }];
    expect(avgChickCost(entries, hatches)).toBe(0);
  });

  it('hatched=0 → 0', () => {
    const entries = [{ id: 'e1', totalPrice: 1000000 }];
    const hatches = [{ eggEntryId: 'e1', hatched: 0 }];
    expect(avgChickCost(entries, hatches)).toBe(0);
  });

  it('چند هچ → جمع', () => {
    const entries = [
      { id: 'e1', totalPrice: 500000 },
      { id: 'e2', totalPrice: 500000 },
    ];
    const hatches = [
      { eggEntryId: 'e1', hatched: 250 },
      { eggEntryId: 'e2', hatched: 250 },
    ];
    expect(avgChickCost(entries, hatches)).toBe(2000);
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/archive-acceptance.test.ts
==========================================
import 'fake-indexeddb/auto';
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import {
  archiveLogs,
  countArchived,
  listArchived,
  restoreManyFromArchive,
  ARCHIVE_STORES,
  splitForArchive,
  monthsAgo,
} from '../cor/storage/historyArchive';

const ST = ARCHIVE_STORES.dlg;

const log = (id: string, date: string, flockId = 'f1') =>
  ({ id, date, flockId, eggs: 0 } as any);

describe('معیار پذیرش د — hot + archive == کل', () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    // پاک‌سازی آرشیو بین تست‌ها
    const rows = await listArchived({ limit: 100000 }, ST);
    if (rows.length) await restoreManyFromArchive(rows.map(r => r.id), ST);
  });

  it('آرشیو، هیچ لاگی را گم نمی‌کند', async () => {
    const now = new Date(2026, 10, 19); // 2026-11-19
    const old1 = log('a1', '1404/01/10');
    const old2 = log('a2', '1404/02/20');
    const fresh = log('b1', '1405/08/01');
    const all = [old1, old2, fresh];

    const res = await archiveLogs(all, { now, months: 6 }, ST);
    expect(res.archivedCount).toBe(2);

    const hot = all.filter(l => !res.archivedIds.includes(l.id));
    const archived = await countArchived(ST);

    expect(hot.length + archived).toBe(all.length);
    expect(archived).toBe(2);
  });

  it('بازگردانی اتمیک: لاگ‌ها برمی‌گردند و از آرشیو حذف می‌شوند', async () => {
    const now = new Date(2026, 10, 19);
    const all = [log('c1', '1404/01/01'), log('c2', '1404/02/01')];
    const res = await archiveLogs(all, { now, months: 6 }, ST);
    expect(res.archivedCount).toBe(2);

    const before = await countArchived(ST);
    expect(before).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);

    const restored = await restoreManyFromArchive(res.archivedIds, ST);
    expect(restored.length).toBe(2);

    const after = await countArchived(ST);
    expect(after).toBe(before - 2);
  });

  it('لاگ دارای اصلاحات یا تلفات هرگز آرشیو نمی‌شود', () => {
    const now = new Date(2026, 10, 19);
    const cutoff = monthsAgo(now, 6);
    const audit = { ...log('d1', '1404/01/01'), corrections: [{ id: 'x' }] };
    const death = { ...log('d2', '1404/01/01'), deaths: [{ id: 'y' }] };
    const plain = log('d3', '1404/01/01');

    const { toArchive, keep } = splitForArchive([audit, death, plain] as any, cutoff);
    expect(toArchive.map(l => l.id)).toEqual(['d3']);
    expect(keep.map(l => l.id).sort()).toEqual(['d1', 'd2']);
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/backup.test.ts
==========================================
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';

const {
  archiveStoreData,
  mockExportArchiveRecords,
  mockImportArchiveRecords,
  mockClearArchive,
  mockCountArchived,
} = vi.hoisted(() => {
  const storeData = new Map<string, any[]>();
  return {
    archiveStoreData: storeData,
    mockExportArchiveRecords: vi.fn(async (storeName: string) => storeData.get(storeName) ?? []),
    mockImportArchiveRecords: vi.fn(
      async (records: any[], _mode: 'replace' | 'merge', storeName: string) => {
        storeData.set(storeName, [...records]);
        return records.length;
      }
    ),
    mockClearArchive: vi.fn(async (storeName: string) => {
      storeData.set(storeName, []);
    }),
    mockCountArchived: vi.fn(async (storeName: string) => (storeData.get(storeName) ?? []).length),
  };
});

vi.mock('../cor/storage/historyArchive', () => ({
      listFlockSummaries: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]),
      saveFlockSummary: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
      deleteFlockSummary: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
      getFlockSummary: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(null),
  ARCHIVE_STORES: {
    dlg: 'dlg_logs',
    tra: 'tra_invoices',
    flk: 'flk_closed',
    whs: 'whs_moves',
    inc: 'inc_batches',
  },
  exportArchiveRecords: mockExportArchiveRecords,
  importArchiveRecords: mockImportArchiveRecords,
  clearArchive: mockClearArchive,
  countArchived: mockCountArchived,
}));

vi.mock('../cor/storage/rawStore', () => ({
  IDB_KEYS: ['pm-flk', 'pm-dlg', 'pm-whs', 'pm-tra', 'pm-inc'],
  rawGet: vi.fn(async () => null),
  rawSet: vi.fn(async () => true),
  rawRemove: vi.fn(async () => true),
}));

import * as backup from '../shr/utils/backup';
import { ARCHIVE_STORES } from '../cor/storage/historyArchive';

describe('backup', () => {
  const allStores = Object.values(ARCHIVE_STORES);

  beforeEach(() => {
    archiveStoreData.clear();
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    for (const storeName of allStores) {
      archiveStoreData.set(storeName, [
        { id: `${storeName}-rec-1`, flockId: 'flk-1', date: '1404/01/10' },
      ]);
    }
  });

  it('exports موجودن', () => {
    expect(Object.keys(backup).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it('exportAll همه استورهای ARCHIVE_STORES را در فایل پشتیبان قرار می‌دهد', async () => {
    const json = await backup.exportAll();
    const checked = backup.validateBackup(json);

    expect(checked.valid).toBe(true);
    for (const storeName of allStores) {
      expect(mockExportArchiveRecords).toHaveBeenCalledWith(storeName);
    }

    const archiveSection = checked.data?.data?.__archive_logs as Record<string, any[]>;
    for (const storeName of allStores) {
      expect(archiveSection[storeName]?.[0]?.id).toBe(`${storeName}-rec-1`);
    }
  });

  it('importAll در حالت replace همه استورهای ARCHIVE_STORES را پاک و بازیابی می‌کند', async () => {
    const json = await backup.exportAll();
    const checked = backup.validateBackup(json);
    expect(checked.valid).toBe(true);

    archiveStoreData.clear();
    const res = await backup.importAll(checked.data!, 'replace');
    expect(res.success).toBe(true);

    for (const storeName of allStores) {
      expect(mockClearArchive).toHaveBeenCalledWith(storeName);
      expect(mockImportArchiveRecords).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.arrayContaining([expect.objectContaining({ id: `${storeName}-rec-1` })]),
        'replace',
        storeName
      );
    }
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/calc-averages.test.ts
==========================================
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { calculateAverages } from '../shr/calc/economics/averages';
import type { InputLog, InputMovement, InputItem } from '../shr/calc/types';

const mkLog = (o: Partial<InputLog> = {}): InputLog => ({
  date: '1404/08/17',
  feedConsumedKg: 100,
  waterAmountL: 200,
  ...o,
});

const mkMove = (o: Partial<InputMovement> = {}): InputMovement => ({
  itemId: 'x',
  quantity: 10,
  unitPrice: 1000,
  reason: 'consumption',
  date: '1404/08/17',
  flockId: 'A',
  ...o,
});

const mkItem = (o: Partial<InputItem> = {}): InputItem => ({
  id: 'x',
  name: 'item',
  category: 'vaccine',
  lastPrice: 1000,
  ...o,
});

describe('calculateAverages — logs', () => {
  it('میانگین دان/آب روزانه از ۳ روز', () => {
    const logs: InputLog[] = [
      mkLog({ date: '1404/08/15', feedConsumedKg: 100, waterAmountL: 200 }),
      mkLog({ date: '1404/08/16', feedConsumedKg: 110, waterAmountL: 210 }),
      mkLog({ date: '1404/08/17', feedConsumedKg: 90, waterAmountL: 190 }),
    ];
    const r = calculateAverages({
      logs,
      movements: [],
      items: [],
      aliveCount: 1000,
    });
    expect(r.avgFeedPerDayKg).toBe(100);
    expect(r.avgWaterPerDayL).toBe(200);
    expect(r.daysCount).toBe(3);
  });

  it('دو لاگ در یک روز = یک روز حساب می‌شود', () => {
    const logs: InputLog[] = [
      mkLog({ date: '1404/08/17', feedConsumedKg: 50 }),
      mkLog({ date: '1404/08/17', feedConsumedKg: 40 }),
    ];
    const r = calculateAverages({ logs, movements: [], items: [], aliveCount: 1000 });
    expect(r.daysCount).toBe(1);
    expect(r.avgFeedPerDayKg).toBe(90);
  });

  it('logs خالی → daysCount=0، avg=0', () => {
    const r = calculateAverages({ logs: [], movements: [], items: [], aliveCount: 1000 });
    expect(r.daysCount).toBe(0);
    expect(r.avgFeedPerDayKg).toBe(0);
    expect(r.hasData).toBe(false);
  });

  it('فلتر fromDate/toDate', () => {
    const logs: InputLog[] = [
      mkLog({ date: '1404/08/10', feedConsumedKg: 100 }),
      mkLog({ date: '1404/08/15', feedConsumedKg: 200 }),
      mkLog({ date: '1404/08/20', feedConsumedKg: 300 }),
    ];
    const r = calculateAverages({
      logs,
      movements: [],
      items: [],
      aliveCount: 1000,
      fromDate: '1404/08/14',
      toDate: '1404/08/18',
    });
    expect(r.daysCount).toBe(1);
    expect(r.avgFeedPerDayKg).toBe(200);
  });
});

describe('calculateAverages — movements (vaccine/medication/litter)', () => {
  it('واکسن + دارو + بستر مجموع درست', () => {
    const items: InputItem[] = [
      mkItem({ id: 'v1', category: 'vaccine' }),
      mkItem({ id: 'm1', category: 'medicine' }),
      mkItem({ id: 'h1', category: 'herbal' }),
      mkItem({ id: 'c1', category: 'consumable' }),
    ];
    const movements: InputMovement[] = [
      mkMove({ itemId: 'v1', quantity: 500 }),
      mkMove({ itemId: 'v1', quantity: 500 }),
      mkMove({ itemId: 'm1', quantity: 200 }),
      mkMove({ itemId: 'h1', quantity: 100 }),
      mkMove({ itemId: 'c1', quantity: 50 }),
    ];
    const r = calculateAverages({
      logs: [],
      movements,
      items,
      flockId: 'A',
      aliveCount: 1000,
    });
    expect(r.totalVaccines).toBe(1000);
    expect(r.totalMedications).toBe(200);
    expect(r.totalHerbal).toBe(100);
    expect(r.totalLitterKg).toBe(50);
    expect(r.avgVaccinesPerBird).toBe(1);
    expect(r.avgMedicationsPerBird).toBe(0.2);
    expect(r.avgHerbalPerBird).toBe(0.1);
    expect(r.avgLitterPerBirdKg).toBe(0.05);
  });

  it('movement با reason=purchase نادیده', () => {
    const items = [mkItem({ id: 'v1', category: 'vaccine' })];
    const movements = [
      mkMove({ itemId: 'v1', quantity: 500, reason: 'consumption' }),
      mkMove({ itemId: 'v1', quantity: 500, reason: 'purchase' }),
    ];
    const r = calculateAverages({ logs: [], movements, items, flockId: 'A', aliveCount: 1000 });
    expect(r.totalVaccines).toBe(500);
  });

  it('flockId نادرست → صفر', () => {
    const items = [mkItem({ id: 'v1', category: 'vaccine' })];
    const movements = [mkMove({ itemId: 'v1', flockId: 'B', quantity: 500 })];
    const r = calculateAverages({ logs: [], movements, items, flockId: 'A', aliveCount: 1000 });
    expect(r.totalVaccines).toBe(0);
  });

  it('آیتم ناموجود نادیده', () => {
    const movements = [mkMove({ itemId: 'unknown', quantity: 500 })];
    const r = calculateAverages({ logs: [], movements, items: [], aliveCount: 1000 });
    expect(r.totalVaccines).toBe(0);
    expect(r.totalMedications).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('calculateAverages — combined', () => {
  it('logs + movements با هم', () => {
    const logs: InputLog[] = [mkLog({ date: '1404/08/17', feedConsumedKg: 100 })];
    const items: InputItem[] = [mkItem({ id: 'v1', category: 'vaccine' })];
    const movements: InputMovement[] = [mkMove({ itemId: 'v1', quantity: 500 })];
    const r = calculateAverages({ logs, movements, items, flockId: 'A', aliveCount: 1000 });
    expect(r.avgFeedPerDayKg).toBe(100);
    expect(r.totalVaccines).toBe(500);
    expect(r.hasData).toBe(true);
  });

  it('aliveCount = 0 → per-bird = 0', () => {
    const items = [mkItem({ id: 'v1', category: 'vaccine' })];
    const movements = [mkMove({ itemId: 'v1', quantity: 500 })];
    const r = calculateAverages({ logs: [], movements, items, flockId: 'A', aliveCount: 0 });
    expect(r.totalVaccines).toBe(500);
    expect(r.avgVaccinesPerBird).toBe(500);  // divisor=1 fallback
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { calculateTotalCost } from '../shr/calc/economics/totalCost';
import { calculatePerKgCost } from '../shr/calc/economics/perKgCost';
import { calculatePerEggCost } from '../shr/calc/economics/perEggCost';
import { calculateRevenueFromInvoices, calculateRevenueFromPrices, calculateRevenue } from '../shr/calc/economics/revenue';
import { calculateProfit } from '../shr/calc/economics/profit';
import type { InputInvoice } from '../shr/calc/types';

describe('calculateTotalCost', () => {
  it('جمع همه هزینه‌ها', () => {
    const r = calculateTotalCost({
      feedTotal: 100000000,
      vaccineTotal: 8000000,
      medicationTotal: 12000000,
      litterTotal: 3000000,
      aliveCount: 1000,
    });
    expect(r.totalCost).toBe(123000000);
    expect(r.costPerBird).toBe(123000);
    expect(r.breakdown.feed).toBe(100000000);
  });

  it('با utilities و labor', () => {
    const r = calculateTotalCost({
      feedTotal: 100,
      vaccineTotal: 10,
      medicationTotal: 10,
      litterTotal: 5,
      utilitiesTotal: 20,
      laborTotal: 30,
      aliveCount: 10,
    });
    expect(r.totalCost).toBe(175);
    expect(r.costPerBird).toBe(17.5);
  });

  it('aliveCount = 0 → costPerBird = 0', () => {
    const r = calculateTotalCost({
      feedTotal: 100, vaccineTotal: 0, medicationTotal: 0, litterTotal: 0, aliveCount: 0,
    });
    expect(r.costPerBird).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('calculatePerKgCost', () => {
  it('وزن و gain معتبر', () => {
    const r = calculatePerKgCost({ totalCost: 100000000, totalLiveWeightKg: 3000, totalGainKg: 2958 });
    expect(r.costPerLiveKg).toBeCloseTo(33333.33, 1);
    expect(r.costPerGainKg).toBeCloseTo(33806.63, 1);
  });

  it('وزن ۰ → null', () => {
    const r = calculatePerKgCost({ totalCost: 100, totalLiveWeightKg: 0, totalGainKg: 0 });
    expect(r.costPerLiveKg).toBeNull();
    expect(r.costPerGainKg).toBeNull();
  });

  it('فقط live weight', () => {
    const r = calculatePerKgCost({ totalCost: 1000, totalLiveWeightKg: 100, totalGainKg: 0 });
    expect(r.costPerLiveKg).toBe(10);
    expect(r.costPerGainKg).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('calculatePerEggCost', () => {
  it('تخم معتبر', () => {
    const r = calculatePerEggCost({ totalCost: 1000000, totalEggs: 100000 });
    expect(r.costPerEgg).toBe(10);
  });

  it('totalEggs = 0 → null', () => {
    const r = calculatePerEggCost({ totalCost: 1000, totalEggs: 0 });
    expect(r.costPerEgg).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('calculateRevenueFromInvoices', () => {
  const mkInv = (o: Partial<InputInvoice> = {}): InputInvoice => ({
    id: 'i1', type: 'sale', total: 100000, relatedFlockId: 'A', workflowStatus: 'paid', ...o,
  });

  it('فقط sale معتبر', () => {
    const r = calculateRevenueFromInvoices({
      invoices: [
        mkInv({ id: '1', total: 500000 }),
        mkInv({ id: '2', total: 300000 }),
        mkInv({ id: '3', total: 200000, type: 'purchase' }),
        mkInv({ id: '4', total: 100000, workflowStatus: 'draft' }),
      ],
      flockId: 'A',
    }, 1000);
    expect(r.totalRevenue).toBe(800000);
    expect(r.count).toBe(2);
    expect(r.source).toBe('invoices');
  });

  it('includeDraft = true → draft هم حساب', () => {
    const r = calculateRevenueFromInvoices({
      invoices: [mkInv({ total: 500000 }), mkInv({ total: 100000, workflowStatus: 'draft' })],
      flockId: 'A',
      includeDraft: true,
    }, 1000);
    expect(r.totalRevenue).toBe(600000);
    expect(r.count).toBe(2);
  });

  it('flockId نادرست → صفر', () => {
    const r = calculateRevenueFromInvoices({
      invoices: [mkInv({ relatedFlockId: 'B' })],
      flockId: 'A',
    }, 1000);
    expect(r.totalRevenue).toBe(0);
    expect(r.source).toBe('none');
  });
});

describe('calculateRevenueFromPrices', () => {
  it('گوشتی: وزن × قیمت', () => {
    const r = calculateRevenueFromPrices({ liveWeightKg: 3000, pricePerKg: 100000 }, 1000);
    expect(r.totalRevenue).toBe(300000000);
    expect(r.revenuePerBird).toBe(300000);
    expect(r.source).toBe('prices');
  });

  it('تخم‌گذار: تخم × قیمت', () => {
    const r = calculateRevenueFromPrices({ eggsCount: 200000, pricePerEgg: 5000 }, 1000);
    expect(r.totalRevenue).toBe(1000000000);
  });

  it('مرغ حذفی', () => {
    const r = calculateRevenueFromPrices({ culledCount: 50, culledPrice: 50000 }, 1000);
    expect(r.totalRevenue).toBe(2500000);
  });
});

describe('calculateRevenue (hybrid)', () => {
  it('فاکتور هست → از فاکتور', () => {
    const r = calculateRevenue(
      { invoices: [{ id: '1', type: 'sale', total: 500000, relatedFlockId: 'A', workflowStatus: 'paid' }], flockId: 'A' },
      { liveWeightKg: 3000, pricePerKg: 100000 },
      1000,
    );
    expect(r.source).toBe('invoices');
    expect(r.totalRevenue).toBe(500000);
  });

  it('فاکتور نیست → از prices', () => {
    const r = calculateRevenue(
      { invoices: [], flockId: 'A' },
      { liveWeightKg: 3000, pricePerKg: 100000 },
      1000,
    );
    expect(r.source).toBe('prices');
  });
});

describe('calculateProfit', () => {
  it('سود مثبت', () => {
    const r = calculateProfit({ revenue: 300000000, totalCost: 200000000, aliveCount: 1000 });
    expect(r.profit).toBe(100000000);
    expect(r.profitPerBird).toBe(100000);
    expect(r.revenueToCostRatio).toBe(1.5);
    expect(r.marginPct).toBe(33.3);
  });

  it('سود منفی (ضرر)', () => {
    const r = calculateProfit({ revenue: 100000000, totalCost: 200000000, aliveCount: 1000 });
    expect(r.profit).toBe(-100000000);
    expect(r.revenueToCostRatio).toBe(0.5);
    expect(r.marginPct).toBe(-100);
  });

  it('هر دو صفر → hasData = false', () => {
    const r = calculateProfit({ revenue: 0, totalCost: 0, aliveCount: 1000 });
    expect(r.hasData).toBe(false);
  });
});

/**
 * calc-economics.test.ts — تست هزینه‌های اقتصادی (feed, vaccine, medication, litter)
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { calculateFeedCost } from '../shr/calc/economics/feedCost';
import { calculateVaccineCost } from '../shr/calc/economics/vaccineCost';
import { calculateMedicationCost } from '../shr/calc/economics/medicationCost';
import { calculateLitterCost } from '../shr/calc/economics/litterCost';
import type { InputMovement, InputItem } from '../shr/calc/types';

const mkMove = (
  overrides: Partial<InputMovement> = {},
): InputMovement => ({
  itemId: 'x',
  quantity: 10,
  unitPrice: 1000,
  reason: 'consumption',
  date: '1404/08/17',
  flockId: 'A',
  ...overrides,
});

const mkItem = (overrides: Partial<InputItem> = {}): InputItem => ({
  id: 'x',
  name: 'item',
  category: 'feed',
  lastPrice: 1000,
  ...overrides,
});

describe('calculateFeedCost', () => {
  it('حرکت‌های دان مصرفی جمع می‌شوند', () => {
    const items = [mkItem({ id: 'f1', category: 'feed' })];
    const movements = [
      mkMove({ itemId: 'f1', quantity: 50, unitPrice: 10000 }),
      mkMove({ itemId: 'f1', quantity: 30, unitPrice: 10000 }),
    ];
    const r = calculateFeedCost({
      movements,
      items,
      flockId: 'A',
      aliveCount: 1000,
    });
    expect(r.totalCost).toBe(800000);
    expect(r.costPerBird).toBe(800);
    expect(r.count).toBe(2);
    expect(r.hasData).toBe(true);
  });

  it('آیتم‌های غیر دان نادیده گرفته می‌شوند', () => {
    const items = [
      mkItem({ id: 'f1', category: 'feed' }),
      mkItem({ id: 'v1', category: 'vaccine' }),
    ];
    const movements = [
      mkMove({ itemId: 'f1', quantity: 50, unitPrice: 10000 }),
      mkMove({ itemId: 'v1', quantity: 10, unitPrice: 5000 }),
    ];
    const r = calculateFeedCost({
      movements,
      items,
      flockId: 'A',
      aliveCount: 1000,
    });
    expect(r.totalCost).toBe(500000);
    expect(r.count).toBe(1);
  });

  it('حرکت‌های غیر consumption (مثل purchase) نادیده گرفته می‌شوند', () => {
    const items = [mkItem({ id: 'f1', category: 'feed' })];
    const movements = [
      mkMove({ itemId: 'f1', reason: 'consumption' }),
      mkMove({ itemId: 'f1', reason: 'purchase' }),
    ];
    const r = calculateFeedCost({
      movements,
      items,
      flockId: 'A',
      aliveCount: 1000,
    });
    expect(r.count).toBe(1);
  });

  it('فلتر flockId اعمال می‌شود', () => {
    const items = [mkItem({ id: 'f1', category: 'feed' })];
    const movements = [
      mkMove({ itemId: 'f1', flockId: 'A', quantity: 50 }),
      mkMove({ itemId: 'f1', flockId: 'B', quantity: 30 }),
    ];
    const r = calculateFeedCost({
      movements,
      items,
      flockId: 'A',
      aliveCount: 1000,
    });
    expect(r.totalCost).toBe(50000);
    expect(r.count).toBe(1);
  });

  it('خالی → hasData=false', () => {
    const r = calculateFeedCost({
      movements: [],
      items: [],
      aliveCount: 1000,
    });
    expect(r.totalCost).toBe(0);
    expect(r.hasData).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('calculateVaccineCost', () => {

/**
 * calc-egg.test.ts — تست شاخص‌های تخم (Hy-Line W-36)

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { calculateEggMetrics } from '../shr/calc/formulas/egg';

describe('calculateEggMetrics — hen-day و hen-housed', () => {
  it('پایه: ۸۰۰ تخم از ۹۰۰ مرغ زنده (از ۱۰۰۰ اولیه)', () => {
    const r = calculateEggMetrics({
      eggsToday: 800,
      eggsBroken: 0,
      eggsDirty: 0,
      eggsCumulative: 50000,
      aliveToday: 900,
      initialCount: 1000,
      standardHenDayPct: 90,
      standardHenHousedPct: 85,
    });
    // hen-day = 800/900 = 88.9٪
    // hen-housed = 800/1000 = 80٪
    expect(r.henDayPct).toBe(88.9);
    expect(r.henHousedPct).toBe(80);
  });

  it('hen-day بالای استاندارد → accent', () => {
    const r = calculateEggMetrics({
      eggsToday: 950,
      eggsBroken: 0,
      eggsDirty: 0,
      eggsCumulative: 0,
      aliveToday: 1000,
      initialCount: 1000,
      standardHenDayPct: 90,
      standardHenHousedPct: 85,
    });
    // hen-day = 95٪ ; standard 90 ; ratio 1.056 → accent
    expect(r.henDayTone).toBe('accent');
  });

  it('hen-day ۹۰-۱۰۰٪ استاندارد → warn', () => {
    const r = calculateEggMetrics({
      eggsToday: 850,
      eggsBroken: 0,
      eggsDirty: 0,
      eggsCumulative: 0,
      aliveToday: 1000,
      initialCount: 1000,
      standardHenDayPct: 90,
      standardHenHousedPct: 85,
    });
    // hen-day = 85٪ ; standard 90 ; ratio 0.944 → warn
    expect(r.henDayTone).toBe('warn');
  });

  it('hen-day < ۹۰٪ استاندارد → danger', () => {
    const r = calculateEggMetrics({
      eggsToday: 700,
      eggsBroken: 0,
      eggsDirty: 0,
      eggsCumulative: 0,
      aliveToday: 1000,
      initialCount: 1000,
      standardHenDayPct: 90,
      standardHenHousedPct: 85,
    });
    // hen-day = 70٪ ; standard 90 ; ratio 0.778 → danger
    expect(r.henDayTone).toBe('danger');
  });

  it('hen-day diff محاسبه صحیح', () => {
    const r = calculateEggMetrics({
      eggsToday: 950,
      eggsBroken: 0,
      eggsDirty: 0,
      eggsCumulative: 0,
      aliveToday: 1000,
      initialCount: 1000,
      standardHenDayPct: 90,
      standardHenHousedPct: 85,
    });
    // hen-day = 95 ; diff = (95-90)/90 * 100 = 5.6٪
    expect(r.henDayDiffPct).toBe(5.6);
  });
});

describe('calculateEggMetrics — broken و dirty', () => {
  it('broken < ۲٪ → accent', () => {
    const r = calculateEggMetrics({
      eggsToday: 980,
      eggsBroken: 15,
      eggsDirty: 5,
      eggsCumulative: 0,
      aliveToday: 1000,
      initialCount: 1000,

  });

  it('broken ۲-۴٪ → warn', () => {

      eggsToday: 960,

      eggsDirty: 10,
      eggsCumulative: 0,
      aliveToday: 1000,
      initialCount: 1000,

    });
    // total = 1000 ; broken = 3٪

  });

  it('broken > ۴٪ → danger', () => {
    const r = calculateEggMetrics({
      eggsToday: 940,

      eggsDirty: 10,
      eggsCumulative: 0,
      aliveToday: 1000,
      initialCount: 1000,

  });

  it('dirty > ۵٪ → danger', () => {
    const r = calculateEggMetrics({
      eggsToday: 930,
      eggsBroken: 10,
      eggsDirty: 60,
      eggsCumulative: 0,
      aliveToday: 1000,
      initialCount: 1000,
      standardHenDayPct: 90,
      standardHenHousedPct: 85,
    });
    // total = 1000 ; dirty = 6٪
    expect(r.dirtyRatePct).toBe(6);
    expect(r.dirtyTone).toBe('danger');
  });
});

describe('calculateEggMetrics — حالت‌های edge', () => {

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { calculateEnvironmentWarnings } from '../shr/calc/formulas/environment';

describe('calculateEnvironmentWarnings — temp', () => {
  it('null temp → accent', () => {
    const r = calculateEnvironmentWarnings({
      tempC: null, tempMin: null, tempMax: null, tempTarget: null,
      humidityPct: null, humidityMin: null, humidityMax: null,
    });
    expect(r.tempTone).toBe('accent');
  });

  it('temp در محدوده، نزدیک target → accent', () => {
    const r = calculateEnvironmentWarnings({
      tempC: 22, tempMin: 20, tempMax: 24, tempTarget: 22,
      humidityPct: null, humidityMin: null, humidityMax: null,
    });
    expect(r.tempTone).toBe('accent');
  });

  it('temp در محدوده، دور از target → warn', () => {
    const r = calculateEnvironmentWarnings({
      tempC: 24, tempMin: 20, tempMax: 25, tempTarget: 22,
      humidityPct: null, humidityMin: null, humidityMax: null,
    });
    // range=5, tolerance=max(1, 0.75)=1, |24-22|=2 > 1 → warn
    expect(r.tempTone).toBe('warn');
  });

  it('temp خارج محدوده → danger', () => {
    const r = calculateEnvironmentWarnings({
      tempC: 30, tempMin: 20, tempMax: 25, tempTarget: 22,
      humidityPct: null, humidityMin: null, humidityMax: null,
    });
    expect(r.tempTone).toBe('danger');
  });

  it('temp بدون min/max (fallback) — ۱۴ → danger', () => {
    const r = calculateEnvironmentWarnings({
      tempC: 14, tempMin: null, tempMax: null, tempTarget: null,
      humidityPct: null, humidityMin: null, humidityMax: null,
    });
    expect(r.tempTone).toBe('danger');
  });

  it('temp بدون min/max — ۲۰ → accent', () => {
    const r = calculateEnvironmentWarnings({
      tempC: 20, tempMin: null, tempMax: null, tempTarget: null,
      humidityPct: null, humidityMin: null, humidityMax: null,
    });
    expect(r.tempTone).toBe('accent');
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { calculateEPEF } from '../shr/calc/formulas/epef';

describe('calculateEPEF — محاسبه پایه', () => {
  it('EPEF = 452 (مثال استاندارد)', () => {
    const r = calculateEPEF({
      livabilityPct: 95,
      finalWeightKg: 3.0,
      ageDays: 42,
      fcr: 1.5,
    });
    // (95 × 3 × 100) / (42 × 1.5) = 28500 / 63 = 452.38
    expect(r.epef).toBe(452.4);
    expect(r.tone).toBe('accent');
  });

  it('EPEF = 350 → مرز warn/accent → accent', () => {
    const r = calculateEPEF({
      livabilityPct: 95,
      finalWeightKg: 2.5,
      ageDays: 42,
      fcr: 1.61,
    });
    // (95 × 2.5 × 100) / (42 × 1.61) ≈ 351
    expect(r.epef).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(350);
    expect(r.tone).toBe('accent');
  });

  it('EPEF = 300-350 → warn', () => {
    const r = calculateEPEF({
      livabilityPct: 92,
      finalWeightKg: 2.5,
      ageDays: 42,
      fcr: 1.7,
    });
    // (92 × 2.5 × 100) / (42 × 1.7) ≈ 322
    expect(r.epef).toBeGreaterThan(300);
    expect(r.epef).toBeLessThan(350);
    expect(r.tone).toBe('warn');
  });

  it('EPEF < 300 → danger', () => {
    const r = calculateEPEF({
      livabilityPct: 88,
      finalWeightKg: 2.2,
      ageDays: 42,
      fcr: 1.9,
    });
    // (88 × 2.2 × 100) / (42 × 1.9) ≈ 242
    expect(r.epef).toBeLessThan(300);
    expect(r.tone).toBe('danger');
  });
});

describe('calculateEPEF — edge', () => {
  it('ageDays = 0 → epef = 0، tone info', () => {
    const r = calculateEPEF({
      livabilityPct: 95,
      finalWeightKg: 3.0,
      ageDays: 0,
      fcr: 1.5,
    });
    expect(r.epef).toBe(0);
    expect(r.tone).toBe('info');
  });

  it('fcr = 0 → epef = 0', () => {
    const r = calculateEPEF({
      livabilityPct: 95,
      finalWeightKg: 3.0,
      ageDays: 42,
      fcr: 0,
    });
    expect(r.epef).toBe(0);
    expect(r.tone).toBe('info');
  });

  it('finalWeight = 0 → epef = 0', () => {
    const r = calculateEPEF({
      livabilityPct: 95,
      finalWeightKg: 0,
      ageDays: 42,
      fcr: 1.5,
    });
    expect(r.epef).toBe(0);
  });


  it('guards: ageDays=0 → epef=0، tone=info', () => {
    const r = calculateEPEF({ livabilityPct: 95, finalWeightKg: 2.5, ageDays: 0, fcr: 1.6 });
    expect(r.epef).toBe(0);
    expect(r.tone).toBe('info');
  });

  it('guards: fcr=0 → epef=0، tone=info', () => {
    const r = calculateEPEF({ livabilityPct: 95, finalWeightKg: 2.5, ageDays: 42, fcr: 0 });
    expect(r.epef).toBe(0);
    expect(r.tone).toBe('info');
  });

  it('guards: finalWeightKg=0 → epef=0، tone=info', () => {
    const r = calculateEPEF({ livabilityPct: 95, finalWeightKg: 0, ageDays: 42, fcr: 1.6 });
    expect(r.epef).toBe(0);
    expect(r.tone).toBe('info');
  });
});

/**
 * calc-fcr.test.ts — تست محاسبه FCR
 *
 * استاندارد: Aviagen Ross 308
 *   FCR = کل دان ÷ کل افزایش وزن
 *   کل افزایش وزن = (وزن نهایی − وزن اولیه) × تعداد زنده
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { calculateFCR } from '../shr/calc/formulas/fcr';

describe('calculateFCR — حالت عادی (exact)', () => {
  it('محاسبه پایه: ۴۰۰۰ کیلو دان، ۱۰۰۰ پرنده ۳ کیلو', () => {
    const result = calculateFCR({
      feedConsumedKg: 4000,
      initialWeightKg: 0.042,
      finalWeightKg: 3.0,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardFCR: 1.35,
    });
    // totalGain = (3.0 - 0.042) × 1000 = 2958
    // fcr = 4000 / 2958 = 1.352...
    expect(result.fcr).toBe(1.35);
    expect(result.confidence).toBe('exact');
    expect(result.totalGainKg).toBe(2958);
    expect(result.totalFeedKg).toBe(4000);
  });

  it('FCR بهتر از استاندارد (diff منفی کوچک) → accent', () => {
    const result = calculateFCR({
      feedConsumedKg: 3800,
      initialWeightKg: 0.042,
      finalWeightKg: 3.0,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardFCR: 1.35,
    });
    // fcr = 3800 / 2958 = 1.284...
    // diff = (1.284 - 1.35) / 1.35 = -4.9٪
    expect(result.tone).toBe('accent');
    expect(result.diffPct).toBeLessThan(0);
  });

  it('FCR برابر استاندارد → accent', () => {
    const result = calculateFCR({
      feedConsumedKg: 3993.3,
      initialWeightKg: 0.042,
      finalWeightKg: 3.0,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardFCR: 1.35,
    });
    // fcr ≈ 1.35
    expect(result.tone).toBe('accent');
  });

  it('FCR ۵-۱۰٪ بدتر → warn', () => {
    const result = calculateFCR({
      feedConsumedKg: 4300,
      initialWeightKg: 0.042,
      finalWeightKg: 3.0,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardFCR: 1.35,
    });
    // fcr = 4300 / 2958 = 1.454...  diff = 7.7٪
    expect(result.tone).toBe('warn');
    expect(result.diffPct).toBeGreaterThan(5);
    expect(result.diffPct).toBeLessThan(10);
  });

  it('FCR بیش از ۱۰٪ بدتر → danger', () => {
    const result = calculateFCR({
      feedConsumedKg: 5000,
      initialWeightKg: 0.042,
      finalWeightKg: 3.0,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardFCR: 1.35,
    });
    // fcr = 5000 / 2958 = 1.69  diff = 25٪
    expect(result.tone).toBe('danger');
    expect(result.diffPct).toBeGreaterThan(10);
  });
});

describe('calculateFCR — حالت غیرعادی (بسیار پایین)', () => {
  it('FCR بیش از ۲۰٪ بهتر → danger (غیرممکن بیولوژیک)', () => {
    const result = calculateFCR({
      feedConsumedKg: 1000,
      initialWeightKg: 0.042,
      finalWeightKg: 3.0,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardFCR: 1.35,
    });
    // fcr = 1000 / 2958 = 0.338  diff = -75٪
    expect(result.tone).toBe('danger');
    expect(result.diffPct).toBeLessThan(-20);
  });

  it('FCR ۱۰-۲۰٪ بهتر → warn (غیرعادی)', () => {
    const result = calculateFCR({
      feedConsumedKg: 3200,
      initialWeightKg: 0.042,
      finalWeightKg: 3.0,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardFCR: 1.35,
    });
    // fcr = 3200 / 2958 = 1.082  diff = -19.9٪
    expect(result.tone).toBe('warn');
    expect(result.diffPct).toBeGreaterThan(-20);
    expect(result.diffPct).toBeLessThan(-10);
  });
});

describe('calculateFCR — حالت insufficient', () => {
  it('دان مصرفی صفر → insufficient', () => {
    const result = calculateFCR({
      feedConsumedKg: 0,
      initialWeightKg: 0.042,
      finalWeightKg: 3.0,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardFCR: 1.35,
    });
    expect(result.fcr).toBeNull();
    expect(result.confidence).toBe('insufficient');
    expect(result.reason).toContain('دان');
  });

  it('وزن نهایی صفر → insufficient', () => {
    const result = calculateFCR({
      feedConsumedKg: 4000,
      initialWeightKg: 0.042,
      finalWeightKg: 0,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardFCR: 1.35,
    });
    expect(result.fcr).toBeNull();
    expect(result.confidence).toBe('insufficient');
    expect(result.reason).toContain('وزن');
  });

  it('تعداد زنده صفر → insufficient', () => {
    const result = calculateFCR({
      feedConsumedKg: 4000,
      initialWeightKg: 0.042,
      finalWeightKg: 3.0,
      aliveCount: 0,
      standardFCR: 1.35,
    });
    expect(result.fcr).toBeNull();
    expect(result.confidence).toBe('insufficient');
  });

  it('وزن نهایی کمتر از اولیه → insufficient (افزایش وزن منفی)', () => {
    const result = calculateFCR({
      feedConsumedKg: 4000,
      initialWeightKg: 3.0,
      finalWeightKg: 0.042,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardFCR: 1.35,
    });
    expect(result.fcr).toBeNull();
    expect(result.confidence).toBe('insufficient');
    expect(result.reason).toContain('منفی');
  });
});

describe('calculateFCR — بدون استاندارد', () => {
  it('standardFCR = null → tone = info', () => {
    const result = calculateFCR({
      feedConsumedKg: 4000,
      initialWeightKg: 0.042,
      finalWeightKg: 3.0,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardFCR: null,
    });
    expect(result.fcr).toBe(1.35);
    expect(result.tone).toBe('info');
    expect(result.diffPct).toBeNull();
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { calculateFeedMetrics } from '../shr/calc/formulas/feed';

describe('calculateFeedMetrics — scoop (precision)', () => {
  it('با remaining قبل و بعد → precision', () => {
    const r = calculateFeedMetrics({
      feedMethod: 'scoop',
      feedDeliveredKg: 50,
      feedRemainingKg: 8,
      previousRemainingKg: 5,
      aliveCount: 1000,
    });
    // consumed = 50 - (8 - 5) = 47
    expect(r.feedConsumedKg).toBe(47);
    expect(r.mode).toBe('precision');
    expect(r.feedPerBirdG).toBe(47);
  });

  it('بدون previousRemaining → simple fallback', () => {
    const r = calculateFeedMetrics({
      feedMethod: 'scoop',
      feedDeliveredKg: 50,
      feedRemainingKg: 8,
      previousRemainingKg: null,
      aliveCount: 1000,
    });
    expect(r.feedConsumedKg).toBe(50);
    expect(r.mode).toBe('simple');
  });
});

describe('calculateFeedMetrics — auto', () => {
  it('auto_sensor → precision، همان delivered', () => {
    const r = calculateFeedMetrics({
      feedMethod: 'auto_sensor',
      feedDeliveredKg: 47,
      feedRemainingKg: null,
      previousRemainingKg: null,
      aliveCount: 1000,
    });
    expect(r.feedConsumedKg).toBe(47);
    expect(r.mode).toBe('precision');
  });

  it('auto_chain → simple', () => {
    const r = calculateFeedMetrics({
      feedMethod: 'auto_chain',
      feedDeliveredKg: 50,
      feedRemainingKg: null,
      previousRemainingKg: null,
      aliveCount: 1000,
    });
    expect(r.feedConsumedKg).toBe(50);
    expect(r.mode).toBe('simple');
  });
});

describe('calculateFeedMetrics — هشدارها', () => {
  it('مصرف منفی → هشدار danger', () => {
    const r = calculateFeedMetrics({
      feedMethod: 'scoop',
      feedDeliveredKg: 20,
      feedRemainingKg: 30,
      previousRemainingKg: 5,
      aliveCount: 1000,
    });
    // consumed = 20 - 25 = -5 → 0
    expect(r.feedConsumedKg).toBe(0);
    expect(r.warning).toContain('منفی');
  });

  it('perBird > 300 → هشدار', () => {
    const r = calculateFeedMetrics({
      feedMethod: 'scoop',
      feedDeliveredKg: 500,
      feedRemainingKg: null,
      previousRemainingKg: null,
      aliveCount: 1000,
    });
    // 500 kg / 1000 bird = 500 g/bird → > 300
    expect(r.feedPerBirdG).toBe(500);
    expect(r.warning).toContain('بالا');
  });

  it('perBird < 5 → هشدار', () => {
    const r = calculateFeedMetrics({
      feedMethod: 'scoop',
      feedDeliveredKg: 2,
      feedRemainingKg: null,
      previousRemainingKg: null,
      aliveCount: 1000,
    });
    // 2 kg / 1000 = 2 g/bird → < 5
    expect(r.feedPerBirdG).toBe(2);
    expect(r.warning).toContain('پایین');
  });
});

describe('calculateFeedMetrics — edge', () => {
  it('aliveCount = 0 → perBird = 0', () => {
    const r = calculateFeedMetrics({
      feedMethod: 'scoop',
      feedDeliveredKg: 50,
      feedRemainingKg: null,
      previousRemainingKg: null,
      aliveCount: 0,
    });
    expect(r.feedPerBirdG).toBe(0);
  });
});

/**
 * calc-mortality.test.ts — تست نرخ تلفات
 *
 * استاندارد: Aviagen Ross 308
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { calculateMortality } from '../shr/calc/formulas/mortality';

describe('calculateMortality — محاسبه پایه', () => {
  it('تلفات روزانه عادی (۵ از ۱۰۰۰)', () => {
    const r = calculateMortality({
      deathsToday: 5,
      deathsThisWeek: 10,
      deathsCumulative: 50,
      aliveToday: 995,
      initialCount: 1000,
      standardDailyPct: 0.15,
      standardWeeklyPct: 1.0,
      standardTotalPct: 5,
    });
    // beforeToday = 995 + 5 = 1000
    // daily = 5/1000 * 100 = 0.5٪
    // weekly = 10/1000 * 100 = 1.0٪
    // cum = 50/1000 * 100 = 5٪
    expect(r.dailyPct).toBe(0.5);
    expect(r.weeklyPct).toBe(1.0);
    expect(r.cumulativePct).toBe(5);
  });

  it('مخرج درست: aliveToday + deathsToday', () => {
    const r = calculateMortality({
      deathsToday: 10,
      deathsThisWeek: 20,
      deathsCumulative: 30,
      aliveToday: 990,
      initialCount: 1000,
      standardDailyPct: null,
      standardWeeklyPct: null,
      standardTotalPct: null,
    });
    // beforeToday = 990 + 10 = 1000
    // اگر به‌غلط فقط aliveToday (990) استفاده شود → 1.01٪
    // اگر درست (1000) → 1.0٪
    expect(r.dailyPct).toBe(1.0);
  });
});

describe('calculateMortality — tone', () => {
  it('تلفات زیر ۸۰٪ استاندارد → accent', () => {
    const r = calculateMortality({
      deathsToday: 1,
      deathsThisWeek: 3,
      deathsCumulative: 10,
      aliveToday: 999,
      initialCount: 1000,
      standardDailyPct: 0.15,
      standardWeeklyPct: 1.0,
      standardTotalPct: 5,
    });
    // daily = 1/1000 * 100 = 0.1٪ ; standard = 0.15٪ ; ratio = 0.67 → accent
    expect(r.dailyTone).toBe('accent');
  });

  it('تلفات برابر استاندارد → accent', () => {
    const r = calculateMortality({
      deathsToday: 1.5,
      deathsThisWeek: 5,
      deathsCumulative: 30,
      aliveToday: 998.5,
      initialCount: 1000,
      standardDailyPct: 0.15,
      standardWeeklyPct: 0.5,
      standardTotalPct: 3,
    });
    // daily = 1.5/1000 = 0.15٪ ; ratio = 1.0 → accent
    expect(r.dailyTone).toBe('accent');
  });

  it('تلفات ۱-۱.۵ برابر استاندارد → warn', () => {
    const r = calculateMortality({
      deathsToday: 2,
      deathsThisWeek: 8,
      deathsCumulative: 40,
      aliveToday: 998,
      initialCount: 1000,
      standardDailyPct: 0.15,
      standardWeeklyPct: 1.0,
      standardTotalPct: 5,
    });
    // daily = 2/1000 = 0.2٪ ; standard 0.15 ; ratio 1.33 → warn
    expect(r.dailyTone).toBe('warn');
  });

  it('تلفات بیش از ۱.۵ برابر استاندارد → danger', () => {
    const r = calculateMortality({
      deathsToday: 5,
      deathsThisWeek: 20,
      deathsCumulative: 80,
      aliveToday: 995,
      initialCount: 1000,
      standardDailyPct: 0.15,
      standardWeeklyPct: 1.0,
      standardTotalPct: 5,
    });
    // daily = 5/1000 = 0.5٪ ; standard 0.15 ; ratio 3.33 → danger
    expect(r.dailyTone).toBe('danger');
  });
});

describe('calculateMortality — diffPct', () => {
  it('diff محاسبه صحیح', () => {
    const r = calculateMortality({
      deathsToday: 3,
      deathsThisWeek: 10,
      deathsCumulative: 50,
      aliveToday: 997,
      initialCount: 1000,
      standardDailyPct: 0.15,
      standardWeeklyPct: 1.0,
      standardTotalPct: 5,
    });
    // daily = 3/1000 = 0.3٪ ; standard 0.15
    // diff = (0.3 - 0.15) / 0.15 * 100 = 100٪
    expect(r.dailyDiffPct).toBe(100);
  });

  it('diff منفی وقتی بهتر از استاندارد', () => {
    const r = calculateMortality({
      deathsToday: 0.5,
      deathsThisWeek: 3,
      deathsCumulative: 10,
      aliveToday: 999.5,
      initialCount: 1000,
      standardDailyPct: 0.15,
      standardWeeklyPct: 1.0,
      standardTotalPct: 5,
    });
    // daily = 0.5/1000 = 0.05٪ ; standard 0.15
    // diff = (0.05 - 0.15) / 0.15 * 100 = -66.7٪
    expect(r.dailyDiffPct).toBeLessThan(0);
  });
});

describe('calculateMortality — حالت‌های edge', () => {
  it('initialCount = 0 → cumulativePct = 0', () => {
    const r = calculateMortality({
      deathsToday: 0,
      deathsThisWeek: 0,
      deathsCumulative: 0,
      aliveToday: 0,
      initialCount: 0,
      standardDailyPct: 0.15,
      standardWeeklyPct: 1.0,
      standardTotalPct: 5,
    });
    expect(r.cumulativePct).toBe(0);
    expect(r.dailyPct).toBe(0);
  });

  it('بدون استاندارد → tone = info', () => {
    const r = calculateMortality({
      deathsToday: 5,
      deathsThisWeek: 10,
      deathsCumulative: 50,
      aliveToday: 995,
      initialCount: 1000,
      standardDailyPct: null,
      standardWeeklyPct: null,
      standardTotalPct: null,
    });
    expect(r.dailyTone).toBe('info');
    expect(r.weeklyTone).toBe('info');
    expect(r.cumulativeTone).toBe('info');
    expect(r.dailyDiffPct).toBeNull();
  });

  it('صفر تلفات → همه نرخ‌ها ۰، tone accent', () => {
    const r = calculateMortality({
      deathsToday: 0,
      deathsThisWeek: 0,
      deathsCumulative: 0,
      aliveToday: 1000,
      initialCount: 1000,
      standardDailyPct: 0.15,
      standardWeeklyPct: 1.0,
      standardTotalPct: 5,
    });
    expect(r.dailyPct).toBe(0);
    expect(r.weeklyPct).toBe(0);
    expect(r.cumulativePct).toBe(0);
    expect(r.dailyTone).toBe('accent');
    expect(r.cumulativeTone).toBe('accent');
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { calculateStockingDensity } from '../shr/calc/formulas/stocking';

describe('calculateStockingDensity — محاسبه پایه', () => {
  it('۱۰۰۰ پرنده در ۱۰۰ m² → ۱۰ bird/m²', () => {
    const r = calculateStockingDensity({
      aliveCount: 1000,
      hallAreaSqM: 100,
      standardDensityMax: 12,
    });
    expect(r.densityBirdPerSqM).toBe(10);
    expect(r.tone).toBe('accent');
    expect(r.warning).toBeNull();
  });

  it('تراکم نزدیک به استاندارد → accent', () => {
    const r = calculateStockingDensity({
      aliveCount: 1200,
      hallAreaSqM: 100,
      standardDensityMax: 12,
    });
    // density = 12 ; ratio = 1.0 → accent
    expect(r.densityBirdPerSqM).toBe(12);
    expect(r.tone).toBe('accent');
  });

  it('تراکم ۵-۱۰٪ بیشتر → warn', () => {
    const r = calculateStockingDensity({
      aliveCount: 1300,
      hallAreaSqM: 100,
      standardDensityMax: 12,
    });
    // density = 13 ; ratio = 1.083 → warn
    expect(r.densityBirdPerSqM).toBe(13);
    expect(r.tone).toBe('warn');
    expect(r.warning).toContain('بیش از حد');
  });

  it('تراکم > ۱.۵ برابر → danger + هشدار شدید', () => {
    const r = calculateStockingDensity({
      aliveCount: 1900,
      hallAreaSqM: 100,
      standardDensityMax: 12,
    });
    // density = 19 ; ratio = 1.58 → danger
    expect(r.densityBirdPerSqM).toBe(19);
    expect(r.tone).toBe('danger');
    expect(r.warning).toContain('خطرناک');
  });
});

describe('calculateStockingDensity — edge', () => {
  it('hallArea = 0 → density = 0، tone info', () => {
    const r = calculateStockingDensity({
      aliveCount: 1000,
      hallAreaSqM: 0,
      standardDensityMax: 12,
    });
    expect(r.densityBirdPerSqM).toBe(0);
    expect(r.tone).toBe('info');
  });

  it('بدون استاندارد → tone info', () => {
    const r = calculateStockingDensity({
      aliveCount: 1000,
      hallAreaSqM: 100,
      standardDensityMax: null,
    });
    expect(r.densityBirdPerSqM).toBe(10);
    expect(r.tone).toBe('info');
  });
});

/**
 * calc-thresholds.test.ts — تست getThresholds از standards
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { getThresholds } from '../shr/calc/thresholds';

describe('getThresholds — Ross 308 (گوشتی)', () => {
  const ctx = {
    breedId: 'ross-308',
    flockType: 'broiler' as const,
    ageDays: 21,
    aliveCount: 1000,
    initialCount: 1000,
  };

  it('temp موجود و در بازه معقول', () => {
    const t = getThresholds(ctx);
    expect(t.temp).not.toBeNull();
    expect(t.temp!.min).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(15);
    expect(t.temp!.max).toBeLessThanOrEqual(36);
    expect(t.temp!.target).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(t.temp!.min);
    expect(t.temp!.target).toBeLessThanOrEqual(t.temp!.max);
  });

  it('humidity موجود', () => {
    const t = getThresholds(ctx);
    expect(t.humidity).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('fcr موجود و معقول (۰.۵-۲.۵)', () => {
    const t = getThresholds(ctx);
    expect(t.fcr).not.toBeNull();
    expect(t.fcr!).toBeGreaterThan(0.5);
    expect(t.fcr!).toBeLessThan(2.5);
  });

  it('adgG > 0', () => {
    const t = getThresholds(ctx);
    expect(t.adgG).not.toBeNull();
    expect(t.adgG!).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it('mortality موجود و همه سه بخش مثبت', () => {
    const t = getThresholds(ctx);
    expect(t.mortality).not.toBeNull();
    expect(t.mortality!.dailyPct).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(t.mortality!.weeklyPct).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(t.mortality!.totalPct).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it('weeklyPct ≈ dailyPct × 5', () => {
    const t = getThresholds(ctx);
    const expected = Math.round(t.mortality!.dailyPct * 5 * 100) / 100;
    expect(t.mortality!.weeklyPct).toBe(expected);
  });

  it('density موجود', () => {
    const t = getThresholds(ctx);
    expect(t.densityBirdPerSqM).not.toBeNull();
    expect(t.densityBirdPerSqM!).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it('cvPct = ۱۲ (عمومی)', () => {
    const t = getThresholds(ctx);
    expect(t.cvPct).toBe(12);
  });

  it('uniformityPct = ۷۰ (عمومی)', () => {
    const t = getThresholds(ctx);
    expect(t.uniformityPct).toBe(70);
  });

  it('waterFeedRatio = { min:1.5, max:2.5 }', () => {
    const t = getThresholds(ctx);
    expect(t.waterFeedRatio).toEqual({ min: 1.5, max: 2.5 });
  });

  it('henDayPct = null (گوشتی)', () => {
    const t = getThresholds(ctx);
    expect(t.henDayPct).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('getThresholds — Hy-Line W36 (تخم‌گذار)', () => {
  const ctx = {
    breedId: 'hy-line-w36',
    flockType: 'layer' as const,
    ageDays: 140,
    aliveCount: 1000,
    initialCount: 1000,
  };

  it('henDayPct موجود (تخم‌گذار)', () => {
    const t = getThresholds(ctx);
    expect(t.henDayPct).not.toBeNull();
    expect(t.henDayPct!).toBeGreaterThan(50);
    expect(t.henDayPct!).toBeLessThanOrEqual(100);
  });

  it('henHousedPct کمتر از henDayPct', () => {
    const t = getThresholds(ctx);
    expect(t.henHousedPct).not.toBeNull();
    expect(t.henHousedPct!).toBeLessThan(t.henDayPct!);
  });

  it('eggWeightG معقول (۴۰-۱۰۰)', () => {
    const t = getThresholds(ctx);
    expect(t.eggWeightG).not.toBeNull();
    expect(t.eggWeightG!).toBeGreaterThan(40);
    expect(t.eggWeightG!).toBeLessThan(100);
  });
});

describe('getThresholds — نژاد ناشناخته', () => {
  it('breedId نامعتبر → همه null', () => {
    const t = getThresholds({
      breedId: 'unknown-breed-xyz-12345',
      flockType: 'broiler',
      ageDays: 21,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      initialCount: 1000,
    });
    expect(t.temp).toBeNull();
    expect(t.fcr).toBeNull();
    expect(t.mortality).toBeNull();
    expect(t.henDayPct).toBeNull();
    expect(t.cvPct).toBeNull();
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { calculateWaterMetrics } from '../shr/calc/formulas/water';

describe('calculateWaterMetrics — محاسبه پایه', () => {
  it('ratio = 2.0 با feed=50، water=100', () => {
    const r = calculateWaterMetrics({
      waterAmountL: 100,
      feedConsumedKg: 50,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardWaterFeedRatio: 1.9,
    });
    expect(r.waterFeedRatio).toBe(2.0);
    expect(r.waterPerBirdMl).toBe(100);
    expect(r.waterFeedTone).toBe('accent');
  });

  it('ratio = 2.5 → هشدار بالا', () => {
    const r = calculateWaterMetrics({
      waterAmountL: 125,
      feedConsumedKg: 50,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardWaterFeedRatio: null,
    });
    expect(r.waterFeedRatio).toBe(2.5);
    expect(r.warning).toBeNull();  // 2.5 = مرز، هنوز مشکل نیست
  });

  it('ratio = 3.0 → هشدار بالا', () => {
    const r = calculateWaterMetrics({
      waterAmountL: 150,
      feedConsumedKg: 50,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardWaterFeedRatio: null,
    });
    expect(r.waterFeedRatio).toBe(3.0);
    expect(r.warning).toContain('بالا');
  });

  it('ratio = 1.2 → هشدار پایین', () => {
    const r = calculateWaterMetrics({
      waterAmountL: 60,
      feedConsumedKg: 50,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardWaterFeedRatio: null,
    });
    expect(r.waterFeedRatio).toBe(1.2);
    expect(r.warning).toContain('پایین');
  });
});

describe('calculateWaterMetrics — tone با استاندارد', () => {
  it('نزدیک به استاندارد → accent', () => {
    const r = calculateWaterMetrics({
      waterAmountL: 95,
      feedConsumedKg: 50,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardWaterFeedRatio: 2.0,
    });
    // ratio = 1.9 ; standard 2.0 ; diff = -5٪
    expect(r.waterFeedTone).toBe('accent');
  });

  it('۱۰-۲۰٪ دور از استاندارد → warn', () => {
    const r = calculateWaterMetrics({
      waterAmountL: 85,
      feedConsumedKg: 50,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardWaterFeedRatio: 2.0,
    });
    // ratio = 1.7 ; standard 2.0 ; diff = -15٪
    expect(r.waterFeedTone).toBe('warn');
  });

  it('> ۲۰٪ دور از استاندارد → danger', () => {
    const r = calculateWaterMetrics({
      waterAmountL: 80,
      feedConsumedKg: 50,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardWaterFeedRatio: 2.0,
    });
    // ratio = 1.6 ; standard 2.0 ; diff = -20٪ (مرز) — بگذار + بشود
    // استفاده از 2.5 بجای 2.0
    const r2 = calculateWaterMetrics({
      waterAmountL: 75,
      feedConsumedKg: 50,
      aliveCount: 1000,
      standardWaterFeedRatio: 2.0,
    });
    // ratio = 1.5 ; diff = -25٪
    expect(r2.waterFeedTone).toBe('danger');
  });
});

describe('calculateWaterMetrics — edge', () => {
  it('aliveCount = 0 → perBird = 0', () => {
    const r = calculateWaterMetrics({
      waterAmountL: 100,
      feedConsumedKg: 50,
      aliveCount: 0,
      standardWaterFeedRatio: 2.0,
    });

  it('feed = 0 → ratio = 0', () => {

      feedConsumedKg: 0,
      aliveCount: 1000,

/**
 * calc-weight.test.ts — تست وزن و یکنواختی (Aviagen Ross 308)
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { calculateWeightMetrics } from '../shr/calc/formulas/weight';

describe('calculateWeightMetrics — محاسبه پایه', () => {
  it('میانگین وزن ۵ نمونه ۱ کیلویی → ۱۰۰۰ گرم', () => {
    const r = calculateWeightMetrics({
      samples: [
        { weight: 1.0 },
        { weight: 1.0 },
        { weight: 1.0 },
        { weight: 1.0 },
        { weight: 1.0 },
      ],
      previousAvgWeightG: null,
      ageDays: 20,
      standardWeightG: 1000,
    });
    expect(r.avgWeightG).toBe(1000);
    expect(r.cvPct).toBe(0);  // همه یکسان
    expect(r.uniformityPct).toBe(100);  // همه در بازه
    expect(r.hasData).toBe(true);
  });

  it('CV محاسبه صحیح — نمونه‌های متنوع', () => {
    const r = calculateWeightMetrics({
      samples: [
        { weight: 0.9 },
        { weight: 0.95 },
        { weight: 1.0 },
        { weight: 1.05 },
        { weight: 1.1 },
      ],
      previousAvgWeightG: null,
      ageDays: 20,
      standardWeightG: 1000,
    });
    // mean = 1.0 ; std = 0.0707 ; cv = 7.07٪
    expect(r.avgWeightG).toBe(1000);
    expect(r.cvPct).toBe(7.1);
    expect(r.uniformityPct).toBe(100); // همه در بازه 0.9-1.1
  });

  it('uniformity — بعضی خارج بازه', () => {
    const r = calculateWeightMetrics({
      samples: [
        { weight: 0.7 },   // خارج
        { weight: 0.95 },  // داخل
        { weight: 1.0 },   // داخل
        { weight: 1.05 },  // داخل
        { weight: 1.4 },   // خارج
      ],
      previousAvgWeightG: null,
      ageDays: 20,
      standardWeightG: 1000,
    });
    // mean = 1.02 ; low = 0.918 ; high = 1.122
    // 0.7 خارج، 0.95 داخل، 1.0 داخل، 1.05 داخل، 1.4 خارج
    // uniformity = 3/5 = 60٪
    expect(r.uniformityPct).toBe(60);
    expect(r.uniformityTone).toBe('danger');
  });
});

describe('calculateWeightMetrics — tone CV', () => {
  it('CV < ۱۰٪ → accent', () => {
    const r = calculateWeightMetrics({

        { weight: 0.95 },

        { weight: 1.02 },
        { weight: 1.05 },

      ageDays: 20,
      standardWeightG: 1000,

    expect(r.cvTone).toBe('accent');
  });

  it('CV > ۱۲٪ → danger', () => {

        { weight: 0.8 },

        { weight: 1.3 },
        { weight: 1.5 },
      ],
      previousAvgWeightG: null,
      ageDays: 20,
      standardWeightG: 1000,
    });
    expect(r.cvPct).toBeGreaterThan(12);
    expect(r.cvTone).toBe('danger');
  });
});

/**
 * cascade-contract.test.ts — قرارداد cascade
 * ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * هر cascade باید idempotent باشه:
 *   add(X) → delete(X) = no-op (بدون orphan)
 * ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useTra } from '../mod/tra/store';
import { useFlk } from '../mod/flk/store';
import { useEgg } from '../mod/egg/store';
import { useWhs } from '../mod/whs/store';
import { useHal } from '../mod/hal/store';

const now = () => new Date().toISOString();

const makeInv = (o: any = {}): any => ({
  id: 'inv-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9),
  number: 'T' + Date.now(),
  date: '1405/07/01',
  dueDate: '1405/07/31',
  partyId: 'p1',
  type: 'purchase',
  category: 'other',
  items: [],
  total: 0,
  payments: [],
  relatedFlockId: '',
  relatedEntryId: '',
  notes: '',
  createdAt: now(),
  updatedAt: now(),
  ...o,
});

beforeEach(() => {
  useTra.setState({ invoices: [], allocations: [], partyPayments: [], deals: [] } as any);
  useFlk.setState({ flocks: [], groups: [], groupMembers: [] } as any);
  useEgg.setState({ productions: [], sales: [] } as any);
  useWhs.setState({ items: [], movements: [] } as any);
  useHal.setState({ equipment: [] } as any);
});

describe('CASCADE: purchase chick → delete = no orphan flock', () => {
  it('گله orphan صفر', () => {
    const inv = makeInv({
      type: 'purchase',
      category: 'chick',
      items: [{
        id: 'i1', description: 'جوجه', category: 'chick',
        birdId: 'b1', breedId: 'br1', unit: 'pcs',
        quantity: 100, healthyCount: 95, unitPrice: 10000, total: 950000,
      }],
      total: 950000,
    });

    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv);
    const afterAdd = useFlk.getState().flocks.filter((f: any) => f.sourceInvoiceId === id);
    expect(afterAdd.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);

    useTra.getState().deleteInvoice(id);
    const orphans = useFlk.getState().flocks.filter((f: any) => f.sourceInvoiceId === id);
    expect(orphans.length).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('CASCADE: sale egg → delete = no orphan sale', () => {
  it('فروش تخم orphan صفر', () => {
    const inv = makeInv({
      type: 'sale',
      category: 'egg',
      items: [{
        id: 'i1', description: 'تخم', category: 'egg',
        unit: 'pcs', quantity: 100, unitPrice: 500, total: 50000,
      }],
      total: 50000,
    });

    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv);
    const afterAdd = useEgg.getState().sales.filter((s: any) => s.sourceInvoiceId === id);
    expect(afterAdd.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);

    useTra.getState().deleteInvoice(id);
    const orphans = useEgg.getState().sales.filter((s: any) => s.sourceInvoiceId === id);
    expect(orphans.length).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('CASCADE: purchase feed → delete = whs balanced', () => {
  it('حرکت in + reversal out', () => {
    const inv = makeInv({
      type: 'purchase',
      category: 'feed',
      items: [{
        id: 'i1', description: 'دان', category: 'feed',
        unit: 'kg', quantity: 50, unitPrice: 100, total: 5000,
      }],
      total: 5000,
    });

    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv);
    const afterAdd = useWhs.getState().movements.filter((m: any) => m.sourceId === id);
    const inCount = afterAdd.filter((m: any) => m.type === 'in').length;
    expect(inCount).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);

    useTra.getState().deleteInvoice(id);
    const afterDelete = useWhs.getState().movements.filter((m: any) => m.sourceId === id);
    const outCount = afterDelete.filter((m: any) => m.type === 'out').length;
    expect(outCount).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
  });
});

describe('CASCADE: purchase equipment با سالن → delete = no orphan equipment', () => {
  it('تجهیزات orphan صفر', () => {
    const inv = makeInv({
      type: 'purchase',
      category: 'equipment',
      items: [{
        id: 'i1', description: 'بخاری', category: 'equipment',
        equipmentKind: 'asset', hallId: 'hall-1',
        equipmentCategory: 'heater', equipmentType: 'gas',
        unit: 'pcs', quantity: 1, unitPrice: 1000000, total: 1000000,
      }],
      total: 1000000,
    });

    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv);

    useTra.getState().deleteInvoice(id);
    const orphans = useHal.getState().equipment.filter((e: any) => e.sourceInvoiceId === id);
    expect(orphans.length).toBe(0);
  });
});


describe('CASCADE: sale manure → delete = whs balanced', () => {
  it('کود: out (فروش) + reversal', () => {
    useWhs.setState({
      items: [{
        id: 'whs-manure-1', name: 'کود', category: 'manure',
        unit: 'kg', currentStock: 100, initialStock: 100,
        minStock: 0, lastPrice: 0, avgPrice: 0, initialPrice: 0,
        supplierId: '', expireDate: '', withdrawalDays: null,
        storage: 'room', notes: '',
        createdAt: '2026-01-01', updatedAt: '2026-01-01',
      }],
      movements: [],
    } as any);

    const inv = makeInv({
      type: 'sale', category: 'manure',
      items: [{
        id: 'i1', description: 'کود', category: 'manure',
        unit: 'kg', quantity: 20, unitPrice: 1000, total: 20000,
        stockItemId: 'whs-manure-1',
      }],
      total: 20000,
    });
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv);

    const afterAdd = useWhs.getState().movements.filter(
      (m: any) => m.sourceId === id && m.type === 'out'
    );
    expect(afterAdd.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);

    useTra.getState().deleteInvoice(id);
    const afterDelete = useWhs.getState().movements.filter(
      (m: any) => m.sourceId === id && m.type === 'in'
    );
    expect(afterDelete.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
  });
});

describe('CASCADE: sale broken → delete = whs balanced', () => {
  it('تخم شکسته: out + reversal', () => {
    useWhs.setState({
      items: [{
        id: 'whs-broken-1', name: 'تخم شکسته', category: 'broken',
        unit: 'pcs', currentStock: 50, initialStock: 50,
