      items: [
        { id: 'i1', category: 'chick', birdId: 'b1', breedId: 'br1', description: 'جوجه', quantity: 100, healthyCount: 100, unitPrice: 1000, total: 100000 },
        { id: 'i2', category: 'feed', description: 'ذرت', stockItemId: w1Id, quantity: 500, unitPrice: 10, total: 5000 },
      ],
      payments: [], discount: 0, shipping: 0, total: 105000,
    } as any);

    expect(useFlk.getState().flocks.length).toBe(1); // گله جوجه
    expect(useWhs.getState().items.find(i => i.id === w1Id)?.currentStock).toBe(500); // دان به انبار
  });

  it('Scenario 3: حذف کالای انبار دارای Movement (باید حرکات هم پاک شوند)', () => {
    const w2Id = useWhs.getState().addItem({ name: 'دارو', category: 'medicine', unit: 'ml', currentStock: 0, minStock: 0, lastPrice: 0, supplierId: '', expireDate: '', withdrawalDays: null, storage: 'room', notes: '' } as any);
    useWhs.getState().addMovement({ itemId: w2Id, type: 'in', quantity: 100, unitPrice: 0, reason: 'purchase', date: '1405/08/02', partyId: '', notes: '' });
    
    useWhs.getState().deleteItem(w2Id);
    
    const movements = useWhs.getState().movements.filter(m => m.itemId === w2Id);
    // ✅ سیستم شما به درستی حرکات مربوط به کالای حذف‌شده را پاک می‌کند (بدون یتیم ماندن)
    expect(movements.length).toBe(0); 
  });

  it('Scenario 5: ویرایش فاکتور و تغییر گله A به گله B', () => {
    const invId = useTra.getState().addInvoice({
      type: 'purchase', date: '1405/08/02', partyId: 'p1', category: 'chick',
      items: [{ id: 'i1', category: 'chick', birdId: 'b1', breedId: 'br1', description: 'گله A', quantity: 100, healthyCount: 100, unitPrice: 1000, total: 100000 }],
      payments: [], discount: 0, shipping: 0, total: 100000,
    } as any);
    const flockA = useFlk.getState().flocks[0];
    expect(flockA.initialCount).toBe(100);

    const flockBId = useFlk.getState().add({ name: 'گله B', type: 'layer', birdId: 'b1', breedId: 'br1', hallId: '', zoneId: '', initialCount: 0, currentCount: 0, layingStartDay: 0, endOfCycleDay: null, vaccineScheduleId: '', hatchDate: '', purchaseDate: '', startDate: '', source: 'manual', purchasePrice: null, deliveryCost: null, otherCosts: null, status: 'active', notes: '', genderSplitAt: null } as any);

    useTra.getState().updateInvoice(invId, {
      items: [{ id: 'i1', category: 'chick', birdId: 'b1', breedId: 'br1', description: 'گله B', quantity: 100, healthyCount: 100, unitPrice: 1000, total: 100000, existingFlockId: flockBId }],
    } as any);

    const flocks = useFlk.getState().flocks;
    const fA = flocks.find(f => f.name === 'گله A');
    const fB = flocks.find(f => f.id === flockBId);
    expect(fA?.initialCount).toBe(0); // کاهش یافت
    expect(fB?.initialCount).toBe(100); // افزایش یافت
  });

  it('Scenario 6: Preorder (پیش‌فروش) - نباید گله بسازد', () => {
    useTra.getState().addInvoice({
      type: 'purchase', date: '1405/08/02', partyId: 'p1', category: 'chick', isPreorder: true,
      items: [{ id: 'i1', category: 'chick', birdId: 'b1', breedId: 'br1', description: 'جوجه', quantity: 100, healthyCount: 100, unitPrice: 1000, total: 100000 }],
      payments: [], discount: 0, shipping: 0, total: 100000,
    } as any);
    expect(useFlk.getState().flocks.length).toBe(0);
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/ctc-contact-schema.test.ts

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { createContactSchema } from '../shr/validation/rules/ctc';

const schema = createContactSchema();
const valid = {
  name: 'علی رضایی',
  roles: ['customer'],
  phone: '09121234567',
  landline: '',
  nationalCode: '',
  province: '',
  city: '',
  address: '',
  bankName: '',
  cardNumber: '',
  iban: '',
  creditLimit: '',
  notes: '',
};

function check(overrides: Record<string, unknown>) {
  return schema.safeParse({ ...valid, ...overrides });
}

describe('createContactSchema (L11)', () => {
  it('valid input passes', () => {
    expect(check({}).success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('name required', () => {
    const r = check({ name: '' });
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
    if (!r.success) expect(r.error.issues.some(i => i.path[0] === 'name')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('name too short (<2)', () => {
    const r = check({ name: 'a' });
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('name too long (>100)', () => {
    const r = check({ name: 'x'.repeat(101) });
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('name trims whitespace', () => {
    const r = check({ name: '  علی  ' });
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
    if (r.success) expect(r.data.name).toBe('علی');
  });

  it('roles required (empty array)', () => {
    const r = check({ roles: [] });
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
    if (!r.success) expect(r.error.issues.some(i => i.path[0] === 'roles')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('invalid role', () => {
    expect(check({ roles: ['admin'] }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('multiple roles OK', () => {
    expect(check({ roles: ['customer', 'supplier'] }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('phone: valid Iranian mobile', () => {
    expect(check({ phone: '09121234567' }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('phone: invalid prefix', () => {
    expect(check({ phone: '08121234567' }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('phone: too short', () => {
    expect(check({ phone: '0912123456' }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('phone: empty allowed', () => {
    expect(check({ phone: '' }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('phone: undefined allowed', () => {
    expect(check({ phone: undefined }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('nationalCode: empty allowed', () => {
    expect(check({ nationalCode: '' }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('nationalCode: 10 digits', () => {
    expect(check({ nationalCode: '1234567890' }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('nationalCode: 9 digits rejected', () => {
    expect(check({ nationalCode: '123456789' }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('nationalCode: 11 digits rejected', () => {
    expect(check({ nationalCode: '12345678901' }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('cardNumber: empty allowed', () => {
    expect(check({ cardNumber: '' }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('cardNumber: 16 digits', () => {
    expect(check({ cardNumber: '1234567812345678' }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('cardNumber: 15 digits rejected', () => {
    expect(check({ cardNumber: '123456781234567' }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('iban: empty allowed', () => {
    expect(check({ iban: '' }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('iban: valid IR + 24 digits', () => {
    expect(check({ iban: 'IR' + '0'.repeat(24) }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('iban: missing IR rejected', () => {
    expect(check({ iban: '0'.repeat(26) }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('iban: too short rejected', () => {
    expect(check({ iban: 'IR123' }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('creditLimit: empty → 0', () => {
    const r = check({ creditLimit: '' });
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
    if (r.success) expect(r.data.creditLimit).toBe(0);
  });

  it('creditLimit: numeric string coerced', () => {
    const r = check({ creditLimit: '500000' });
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
    if (r.success) expect(r.data.creditLimit).toBe(500000);
  });

  it('creditLimit: negative rejected', () => {
    expect(check({ creditLimit: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('notes: too long rejected (>1000)', () => {
    expect(check({ notes: 'x'.repeat(1001) }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('notes: empty OK', () => {
    expect(check({ notes: '' }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('all optional fields absent still passes', () => {
    const minimal = {
      name: 'رضا',
      roles: ['worker'],
    };
    expect(schema.safeParse(minimal).success).toBe(true);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  isValidCardNumber, cardValidation,
  isValidShaba, shabaValidation,
  isValidAccountNumber, accountValidation,
} from '../mod/ctc/validators';
import { formatPhone, formatCard, formatShaba } from '../mod/ctc/format';

// ─── Luhn / ISO 7812 ───
describe('isValidCardNumber', () => {
  it('known-valid Visa test card', () => {
    expect(isValidCardNumber('4111 1111 1111 1111')).toBe(true);
  });
  it('invalid check digit', () => {
    expect(isValidCardNumber('4111 1111 1111 1112')).toBe(false);
  });
  it('15 digits → false', () => {
    expect(isValidCardNumber('411111111111111')).toBe(false);
  });
  it('17 digits → false', () => {
    expect(isValidCardNumber('41111111111111111')).toBe(false);
  });
  it('with dashes', () => {
    expect(isValidCardNumber('4111-1111-1111-1111')).toBe(true);
  });
  it('Persian digits', () => {
    expect(isValidCardNumber('۴۱۱۱۱۱۱۱۱۱۱۱۱۱۱۱')).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('cardValidation', () => {
  it('empty → empty', () => {
    expect(cardValidation('').state).toBe('empty');
  });
  it('partial with count', () => {
    const r = cardValidation('4111111');
    expect(r.state).toBe('partial');
    expect(r.message).toContain('/۱۶');
  });
  it('valid', () => {
    expect(cardValidation('4111 1111 1111 1111').state).toBe('valid');
  });
  it('16 digits bad luhn → invalid', () => {
    expect(cardValidation('4111 1111 1111 1112').state).toBe('invalid');
  });
  it('>16 digits → invalid', () => {
    expect(cardValidation('41111111111111111').state).toBe('invalid');
  });
});

// ─── MOD-97 / ISO 13616 ───
describe('isValidShaba', () => {
  it('valid Iranian IBAN', () => {
    expect(isValidShaba('IR062960000000100324200001')).toBe(true);
  });
  it('non-IR → false', () => {
    expect(isValidShaba('DE89370400440532013000')).toBe(false);
  });
  it('too short → false', () => {
    expect(isValidShaba('IR123')).toBe(false);
  });
  it('26 chars but bad checksum → false', () => {
    expect(isValidShaba('IR000000000000000000000000')).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('shabaValidation', () => {
  it('empty → empty', () => {
    expect(shabaValidation('').state).toBe('empty');
  });
  it('without IR → invalid', () => {
    expect(shabaValidation('2960000000100324200001').state).toBe('invalid');
  });
  it('partial with count', () => {
    const r = shabaValidation('IR123');
    expect(r.state).toBe('partial');
    expect(r.message).toContain('/۲۶');
  });
  it('valid', () => {
    expect(shabaValidation('IR062960000000100324200001').state).toBe('valid');
  });
  it('bad checksum → invalid', () => {
    expect(shabaValidation('IR000000000000000000000000').state).toBe('invalid');
  });
});

// ─── Account (length only) ───
describe('isValidAccountNumber', () => {
  it('10 digits → true', () => { expect(isValidAccountNumber('1234567890')).toBe(true); });
  it('20 digits → true', () => { expect(isValidAccountNumber('12345678901234567890')).toBe(true); });
  it('9 digits → false', () => { expect(isValidAccountNumber('123456789')).toBe(false); });
  it('21 digits → false', () => { expect(isValidAccountNumber('123456789012345678901')).toBe(false); });
  it('Persian digits', () => { expect(isValidAccountNumber('۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹۰')).toBe(true); });
});

describe('accountValidation', () => {
  it('empty → empty', () => { expect(accountValidation('').state).toBe('empty'); });
  it('partial with count', () => {
    const r = accountValidation('12345');
    expect(r.state).toBe('partial');
    expect(r.message).toContain('/۱۰');
  });
  it('valid', () => { expect(accountValidation('1234567890').state).toBe('valid'); });
  it('over max → invalid', () => { expect(accountValidation('123456789012345678901').state).toBe('invalid'); });
});

// ─── format ───
describe('format (ctc)', () => {
  it('formatPhone → Persian', () => {
    expect(formatPhone('09121234567')).toBe('۰۹۱۲۱۲۳۴۵۶۷');
  });
  it('formatPhone empty → empty', () => {
    expect(formatPhone('')).toBe('');
  });
  it('formatCard → groups of 4 with Persian', () => {
    expect(formatCard('4111111111111111')).toBe('۴۱۱۱ ۱۱۱۱ ۱۱۱۱ ۱۱۱۱');
  });
  it('formatCard empty → empty', () => {
    expect(formatCard('')).toBe('');
  });
  it('formatShaba adds IR', () => {
    expect(formatShaba('062960000000100324200001')).toBe('IR06 2960 0000 0010 0324 2000 01');
  });
  it('formatShaba keeps IR', () => {
    expect(formatShaba('IR062960000000100324200001')).toBe('IR06 2960 0000 0010 0324 2000 01');
  });
  it('formatShaba empty → empty', () => {
    expect(formatShaba('')).toBe('');
  });
});

/**
 * deal-caps.test.ts — تست‌های L11 برای توابع سقف (ATP)
 * پوشش ۴ تابع: computeGoodsCap, computeDeliveryCap, computeSaleCap, computePaymentCap
 * استاندارد: SAP ATP / Odoo Free Qty
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  computeGoodsCap,
  computeDeliveryCap,
  computeSaleCap,
  computePaymentCap,
} from '../mod/tra/caps';
import type { Deal, DealGood, DealDelivery, DealSale, DealPayment } from '../mod/tra/types';

// ═══ Builders ═══
const mkGood = (o: Partial<DealGood> = {}): DealGood => ({
  id: 'g1', name: 'جوجه', quantity: 100, unit: 'pcs', estimatedPrice: 15000,
  category: 'chick', source: 'flock', existingFlockId: 'flock-1', ...o,
});

const mkDeal = (o: Partial<Deal> = {}): Deal => ({
  id: 'd1', type: 'consignment', date: '1405/08/01', partyId: 'p1', description: 'test',
  value: 0, percent: null, dueDate: '', status: 'open', notes: '',
  createdAt: '', updatedAt: '', ...o,
});

const mkDelivery = (o: Partial<DealDelivery> = {}): DealDelivery => ({
  id: 'dv1', goodId: 'g1', date: '1405/08/01', type: 'out', quantity: 0, ...o,
});

const mkSale = (o: Partial<DealSale> = {}): DealSale => ({
  id: 's1', goodId: 'g1', date: '1405/08/01', quantity: 0, unitPrice: 0, ...o,
});

const mkPay = (o: Partial<DealPayment> = {}): DealPayment => ({
  id: 'p1', date: '1405/08/01', amount: 0, direction: 'in', method: 'cash', ...o,
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// computeGoodsCap — ATP
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('computeGoodsCap — ATP', () => {
  it('اولین deal، source خالی → سقف = sourceAvailable', () => {
    const good = mkGood({ quantity: 100 });
    const cap = computeGoodsCap(good, 'd1', [mkDeal({ id: 'd1' })], 185);
    expect(cap).toBe(185);
  });

  it('deal دیگه با همون گله → cap کاهش', () => {
    const good = mkGood({ quantity: 50 });
    const other = mkDeal({ id: 'd2', goods: [mkGood({ id: 'g2', quantity: 100 })], deliveries: [] });
    const cap = computeGoodsCap(good, 'd1', [mkDeal({ id: 'd1' }), other], 185);
    expect(cap).toBe(85);
  });

  it('deal cancelled → نادیده', () => {
    const good = mkGood({ quantity: 50 });
    const other = mkDeal({ id: 'd2', status: 'cancelled', goods: [mkGood({ id: 'g2', quantity: 100 })] });
    const cap = computeGoodsCap(good, 'd1', [mkDeal({ id: 'd1' }), other], 185);
    expect(cap).toBe(185);
  });

  it('deal settled با تحویل کامل → allocation = 0', () => {
    const good = mkGood({ quantity: 50 });
    const other = mkDeal({
      id: 'd2', status: 'settled',
      goods: [mkGood({ id: 'g2', quantity: 100 })],
      deliveries: [mkDelivery({ id: 'dv2', goodId: 'g2', quantity: 100 })],
    });
    const cap = computeGoodsCap(good, 'd1', [mkDeal({ id: 'd1' }), other], 85);
    expect(cap).toBe(85);
  });

  it('deal settled با تحویل جزئی → allocation = باقیمانده', () => {
    const good = mkGood({ quantity: 50 });
    const other = mkDeal({
      id: 'd2', status: 'settled',
      goods: [mkGood({ id: 'g2', quantity: 100 })],
      deliveries: [mkDelivery({ id: 'dv2', goodId: 'g2', quantity: 40 })],
    });
    const cap = computeGoodsCap(good, 'd1', [mkDeal({ id: 'd1' }), other], 185);
    expect(cap).toBe(125);  // 185 - 60 (باقیمانده 100-40)
  });

  it('deal با source متفاوت → نادیده', () => {
    const good = mkGood({ source: 'flock', existingFlockId: 'flock-1' });
    const other = mkDeal({ id: 'd2', goods: [mkGood({ id: 'g2', source: 'hatch', existingFlockId: undefined, hatchId: 'hatch-1' })] });
    const cap = computeGoodsCap(good, 'd1', [mkDeal({ id: 'd1' }), other], 185);
    expect(cap).toBe(185);
  });

  it('deal با category متفاوت → نادیده', () => {
    const good = mkGood({ category: 'chick' });
    const other = mkDeal({ id: 'd2', goods: [mkGood({ id: 'g2', category: 'adult' })] });
    const cap = computeGoodsCap(good, 'd1', [mkDeal({ id: 'd1' }), other], 185);
    expect(cap).toBe(185);
  });

  it('sourceAvailable < otherAllocations → cap = 0 (نه منفی)', () => {
    const good = mkGood({ quantity: 50 });
    const other = mkDeal({ id: 'd2', goods: [mkGood({ id: 'g2', quantity: 200 })] });
    const cap = computeGoodsCap(good, 'd1', [mkDeal({ id: 'd1' }), other], 185);
    expect(cap).toBe(0);
  });

  it('دو good در یک deal → good دوم cap = source - good اول', () => {
    const goodA = mkGood({ id: 'g1', quantity: 100 });
    const goodB = mkGood({ id: 'g2', quantity: 0 });
    const deal = mkDeal({ id: 'd1', goods: [goodA, goodB] });
    const cap = computeGoodsCap(goodB, 'd1', [deal], 185);
    expect(cap).toBe(85);
  });

  it('سه good در یک deal', () => {
    const g1 = mkGood({ id: 'g1', quantity: 100 });
    const g2 = mkGood({ id: 'g2', quantity: 50 });
    const g3 = mkGood({ id: 'g3', quantity: 0 });
    const deal = mkDeal({ id: 'd1', goods: [g1, g2, g3] });
    const cap = computeGoodsCap(g3, 'd1', [deal], 185);
    expect(cap).toBe(35);
  });

  it('منبع undefined → پیش‌فرض flock', () => {
    const good = mkGood({ source: undefined });
    const other = mkDeal({ id: 'd2', goods: [mkGood({ id: 'g2', quantity: 100 })] });
    const cap = computeGoodsCap(good, 'd1', [mkDeal({ id: 'd1' }), other], 185);
    expect(cap).toBe(85);
  });
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// computeDeliveryCap — Free Qty
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('computeDeliveryCap — Free Qty', () => {
  it('بدون تحویل → cap = goods.quantity', () => {
    const good = mkGood({ quantity: 100 });
    const cap = computeDeliveryCap(good, []);
    expect(cap).toBe(100);
  });

  it('یه تحویل → cap کاهش', () => {
    const good = mkGood({ quantity: 100 });
    const cap = computeDeliveryCap(good, [mkDelivery({ goodId: 'g1', quantity: 40 })]);
    expect(cap).toBe(60);
  });

  it('دو تحویل → cap کاهش', () => {
    const good = mkGood({ quantity: 100 });
    const cap = computeDeliveryCap(good, [
      mkDelivery({ id: 'dv1', goodId: 'g1', quantity: 40 }),
      mkDelivery({ id: 'dv2', goodId: 'g1', quantity: 30 }),
    ]);
    expect(cap).toBe(30);
  });

  it('return (برگشت) → cap افزایش', () => {
    const good = mkGood({ quantity: 100 });
    const cap = computeDeliveryCap(good, [
      mkDelivery({ id: 'dv1', goodId: 'g1', quantity: 40, type: 'out' }),
      mkDelivery({ id: 'dv2', goodId: 'g1', quantity: 10, type: 'return' }),
    ]);
    expect(cap).toBe(70);  // 100 - (40 - 10)
  });

  it('loss (ضایعات) → cap افزایش', () => {
    const good = mkGood({ quantity: 100 });
    const cap = computeDeliveryCap(good, [
      mkDelivery({ id: 'dv1', goodId: 'g1', quantity: 40, type: 'out' }),
      mkDelivery({ id: 'dv2', goodId: 'g1', quantity: 5, type: 'loss' }),
    ]);
    expect(cap).toBe(65);  // 100 - (40 - 5)
  });

  it('تحویل بیش از quantity → cap = 0', () => {
    const good = mkGood({ quantity: 50 });
    const cap = computeDeliveryCap(good, [mkDelivery({ goodId: 'g1', quantity: 100 })]);
    expect(cap).toBe(0);
  });
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// computeSaleCap — Delivered Qty
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('computeSaleCap — Delivered Qty', () => {
  it('بدون تحویل، بدون فروش → 0 (تصمیم ۴: بلاک)', () => {
    const cap = computeSaleCap('g1', [], []);
    expect(cap).toBe(0);
  });

  it('تحویل ۱۰۰، بدون فروش → ۱۰۰', () => {
    const cap = computeSaleCap('g1', [mkDelivery({ goodId: 'g1', quantity: 100 })], []);
    expect(cap).toBe(100);
  });

  it('تحویل ۱۰۰، فروش ۳۰ → ۷۰', () => {
    const cap = computeSaleCap(
      'g1',
      [mkDelivery({ goodId: 'g1', quantity: 100 })],
      [mkSale({ goodId: 'g1', quantity: 30 })]
    );
    expect(cap).toBe(70);
  });

  it('تحویل ۱۰۰، دو فروش (۳۰+۴۰) → ۳۰', () => {
    const cap = computeSaleCap(
      'g1',
      [mkDelivery({ goodId: 'g1', quantity: 100 })],
      [
        mkSale({ id: 's1', goodId: 'g1', quantity: 30 }),
        mkSale({ id: 's2', goodId: 'g1', quantity: 40 }),
      ]
    );
    expect(cap).toBe(30);
  });

  it('تحویل ۱۰۰ + return ۲۰ → ۸۰، بدون فروش → ۸۰', () => {
    const cap = computeSaleCap(
      'g1',
      [
        mkDelivery({ id: 'dv1', goodId: 'g1', quantity: 100, type: 'out' }),
        mkDelivery({ id: 'dv2', goodId: 'g1', quantity: 20, type: 'return' }),
      ],
      []
    );
    expect(cap).toBe(80);
  });

  it('فروش از good دیگه → نادیده', () => {
    const cap = computeSaleCap(
      'g1',
      [mkDelivery({ goodId: 'g1', quantity: 100 })],
      [mkSale({ goodId: 'g2', quantity: 30 })]
    );
    expect(cap).toBe(100);
  });

  it('فروش بیش از تحویل → cap = 0', () => {
    const cap = computeSaleCap(
      'g1',
      [mkDelivery({ goodId: 'g1', quantity: 50 })],
      [mkSale({ goodId: 'g1', quantity: 100 })]
    );
    expect(cap).toBe(0);
  });
});

// computePaymentCap — Remaining
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('computePaymentCap — Remaining Amount', () => {
  it('بدون پرداخت → cap = myShare', () => {
    expect(computePaymentCap(1_000_000, [])).toBe(1_000_000);
  });

  it('یه پرداخت → cap کاهش', () => {
    const cap = computePaymentCap(1_000_000, [mkPay({ amount: 300_000, direction: 'in' })]);
    expect(cap).toBe(700_000);
  });

  it('دو پرداخت → cap کاهش', () => {
    const cap = computePaymentCap(1_000_000, [
      mkPay({ id: 'p1', amount: 300_000, direction: 'in' }),
      mkPay({ id: 'p2', amount: 200_000, direction: 'in' }),
    ]);
    expect(cap).toBe(500_000);
  });


  it('پرداخت out (به طرف) → افزوده به myShare', () => {
    const cap = computePaymentCap(1_000_000, [mkPay({ amount: 300_000, direction: 'out' })]);
    expect(cap).toBe(1_300_000);
  });

  it('پرداخت بیش از myShare → cap = 0', () => {
    const cap = computePaymentCap(500_000, [mkPay({ amount: 1_000_000, direction: 'in' })]);
    expect(cap).toBe(0);
  });

  it('myShare=0 → cap = 0', () => {
    expect(computePaymentCap(0, [])).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('Recycle Bin — Deal', () => {
  it('deleteDeal → به recycle bin', () => {
    const d = mkDeal();
    useTra.setState({ deals: [d] });
    useTra.getState().deleteDeal(d.id);
    expect(useTra.getState().deals).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(useTra.getState().listDeletedDeals()).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('restore از recycle به لیست فعال', () => {
    const d = mkDeal();
    useTra.setState({ deals: [d] });
    useTra.getState().deleteDeal(d.id);
    const ok = useTra.getState().restoreDealFromBin(d.id);
    expect(ok).toBe(true);
    expect(useTra.getState().deals).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(useTra.getState().listDeletedDeals()).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('restore فیلدهای tracking را پاک می‌کند', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({
      deliveries: [{
        id: 'dv-1', goodId: 'good-1', date: '1405/08/09', type: 'out', quantity: 100,
        whsMovementId: 'mv-1', flockDeductedQuantity: -100, flockSourceId: 'flock-1',
      }],
    });
    useTra.setState({ deals: [d] });
    useTra.getState().deleteDeal(d.id);
    useTra.getState().restoreDealFromBin(d.id);
    const restored = useTra.getState().deals[0];
    expect(restored.deliveries[0].whsMovementId).toBeUndefined();
    expect(restored.deliveries[0].flockDeductedQuantity).toBeUndefined();
    expect(restored.deliveries[0].flockSourceId).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('restore ناموفق اگر deal قبلاً وجود دارد', () => {
    const d = mkDeal();
    useTra.setState({ deals: [d] });
    useTra.getState().deleteDeal(d.id);
    useTra.setState({ deals: [...useTra.getState().deals, d] });
    const ok = useTra.getState().restoreDealFromBin(d.id);
    expect(ok).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('applyDealMovements — flock deduction', () => {

    ...o,

  it('chick از گله → flock.currentCount 455 → 375', () => {
    useFlk.setState({ flocks: [mkFlock()] });
    const formState = {
      partyId: 'party-1', dealNumber: '1405-001', date: '1405/08/09',
      goods: [{ id: 'good-1', name: 'جوجه', quantity: 1000, unit: 'pcs', estimatedPrice: 15000, category: 'chick', existingFlockId: 'flock-1' } as any],
      deliveries: [{ id: 'dv-1', goodId: 'good-1', date: '1405/08/09', type: 'out', quantity: 80, ownership: 'mine' } as any],
    };
    applyDealMovements(formState);
    expect(useFlk.getState().flocks[0].currentCount).toBe(375);
  });

  it('pre-flight: stock ناکافی → throw', () => {
    useFlk.setState({ flocks: [mkFlock({ currentCount: 50, initialCount: 50, unknownCount: 50 })] });
    const formState = {
      partyId: 'party-1', dealNumber: '1405-001', date: '1405/08/09',
      goods: [{ id: 'good-1', name: 'جوجه', quantity: 1000, unit: 'pcs', estimatedPrice: 15000, category: 'chick', existingFlockId: 'flock-1' } as any],
      deliveries: [{ id: 'dv-1', goodId: 'good-1', date: '1405/08/09', type: 'out', quantity: 100, ownership: 'mine' } as any],
    };
    expect(() => applyDealMovements(formState)).toThrow(/موجودی گله/);
  });

  it('حذف delivery → flock 375 → 455', () => {
    useFlk.setState({ flocks: [mkFlock({ currentCount: 375, unknownCount: 375 })] });
    const oldDeal = mkDeal({
      deliveries: [{ id: 'dv-1', goodId: 'good-1', date: '1405/08/09', type: 'out', quantity: 80, ownership: 'mine', flockDeductedQuantity: -80, flockSourceId: 'flock-1' }],
    });
    const formState = { partyId: 'party-1', dealNumber: '1405-001', date: '1405/08/09', goods: [], deliveries: [] };
    applyDealMovements(formState, oldDeal);
    expect(useFlk.getState().flocks[0].currentCount).toBe(455);
  });

  it('تغییر quantity 80→50 → flock 375 → 405', () => {
    useFlk.setState({ flocks: [mkFlock({ currentCount: 375, unknownCount: 375 })] });
    const oldDeal = mkDeal({
      deliveries: [{ id: 'dv-1', goodId: 'good-1', date: '1405/08/09', type: 'out', quantity: 80, ownership: 'mine', flockDeductedQuantity: -80, flockSourceId: 'flock-1' }],
    });
    const formState = {
      partyId: 'party-1', dealNumber: '1405-001', date: '1405/08/09',
      goods: [{ id: 'good-1', name: 'جوجه', quantity: 1000, unit: 'pcs', estimatedPrice: 15000, category: 'chick', existingFlockId: 'flock-1' } as any],
      deliveries: [{ id: 'dv-1', goodId: 'good-1', date: '1405/08/09', type: 'out', quantity: 50, ownership: 'mine' } as any],
    };
    applyDealMovements(formState, oldDeal);
    expect(useFlk.getState().flocks[0].currentCount).toBe(405);
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/dlg-applyCorrections-recompute.test.ts
==========================================
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { applyCorrections } from '../mod/dlg/api/applyCorrections';
import type { DailyLog } from '../mod/dlg/store';

function makeLog(overrides: Partial<DailyLog> = {}): DailyLog {
  return {
    id: 'test', flockId: 'f1', date: '1405/11/08', entryTime: '08:00',
    temperature: 25, temperatureMin: 25, temperatureMax: 25,
    humidity: 60, humidityMin: 60, humidityMax: 60,
    ventilation: 'ok', litter: 'dry', behavior: 'active',
    distribution: 'uniform', appearance: '', sound: 'normal',
    feedType: '', feedDelivered: 100, feedConsumed: 20, feedRemaining: 80,
    feedSourceType: '', feedSourceId: '', feedMethod: '', feedMovementIds: [],
    waterAmount: null, waterMethod: '', waterFillCount: null, waterFillVolume: null,
    weightSamples: [], weightGender: '',
    brokenEggs: null, eatingEggs: null, fertileEggs: null, otherEggs: null,
    deathsCount: 5,
    deaths: [{ id: 'd1', count: 5, cause: 'sick', notes: '' }],
    vaccines: [], medications: [], activities: [], notes: '',
    status: 'active', birdAgeDays: null,
    createdAt: '2024-01-01', updatedAt: '2024-01-01',
    corrections: [],
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe('applyCorrections — recompute مشتق‌ها', () => {
  it('بدون correction → همان لاگ (identity)', () => {
    const log = makeLog();
    expect(applyCorrections(log)).toBe(log);
  });

  it('correction روی tempMin → temperature recompute', () => {
    const log = makeLog({
      temperatureMin: 25, temperatureMax: 28, temperature: 26.5,
      corrections: [{
        id: 'c1', timestamp: '10:00', reason: 'اشتباه',
        changes: { temperatureMin: 15 }, revoked: false, createdAt: '2024-01-01',
      }],
    });
    const r = applyCorrections(log);
    expect(r.temperatureMin).toBe(15);
    expect(r.temperature).toBe(21.5);
  });

  it('correction روی feedDelivered → feedConsumed recompute', () => {
    const log = makeLog({
      feedDelivered: 100, feedRemaining: 80, feedConsumed: 20,
      corrections: [{
        id: 'c1', timestamp: '10:00', reason: 'اشتباه',
        changes: { feedDelivered: 120 }, revoked: false, createdAt: '2024-01-01',
      }],
    });
    const r = applyCorrections(log);
    expect(r.feedDelivered).toBe(120);
    expect(r.feedConsumed).toBe(40);
  });

  it('correction روی deathsCount (تک‌رکورد) → deaths sync', () => {
    const log = makeLog({
      deathsCount: 5, deaths: [{ id: 'd1', count: 5, cause: 'sick', notes: '' }],
      corrections: [{
        id: 'c1', timestamp: '10:00', reason: 'اشتباه',
        changes: { deathsCount: 4 }, revoked: false, createdAt: '2024-01-01',
      }],
    });
    const r = applyCorrections(log);
    expect(r.deathsCount).toBe(4);
    expect(r.deaths[0].count).toBe(4);
  });

  it('correction روی deathsCount (چند‌رکورد) → deathsCount=sum (safety)', () => {
    const log = makeLog({
      deathsCount: 5,
      deaths: [
        { id: 'd1', count: 3, cause: 'sick', notes: '' },
        { id: 'd2', count: 2, cause: 'heat', notes: '' },
      ],
      corrections: [{
        id: 'c1', timestamp: '10:00', reason: 'اشتباه',
        changes: { deathsCount: 4 }, revoked: false, createdAt: '2024-01-01',
      }],
    });
    const r = applyCorrections(log);
    expect(r.deathsCount).toBe(5);
  });

  it('correction revoked → skip', () => {
    const log = makeLog({
      temperature: 25,
      corrections: [{
        id: 'c1', timestamp: '10:00', reason: 'اشتباه',
        changes: { temperature: 99 }, revoked: true, createdAt: '2024-01-01',
      }],
    });
    const r = applyCorrections(log);
    expect(r.temperature).toBe(25);
  });
});

/**
 * dlg-atomic-correction.test.ts — تست applyCorrectionAtomic + revokeCorrectionAtomic
 * استاندارد: ALCOA+ / 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e)
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import { useDlg, type DailyLog } from '../mod/dlg/store';
import { applyCorrections } from '../mod/dlg/api/applyCorrections';
import { useDlgSave } from '../mod/dlg/hooks/useDlgSave';

vi.mock('../cor/outbox', () => ({
  outbox: { publish: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve()) },
}));

vi.mock('../cor/store/toast', () => ({
  toastMsg: { saved: vi.fn(), error: vi.fn() },
}));

const makeLog = (): Omit<DailyLog, 'id' | 'status' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'> => ({
  flockId: 'flk-1', date: '1405/11/15', entryTime: '07:00',
  temperature: 25, temperatureMin: null, temperatureMax: null,
  humidity: 50, humidityMin: null, humidityMax: null,
  ventilation: 'ok', litter: 'dry', behavior: 'active', distribution: 'uniform',
  appearance: '', sound: 'normal', feedType: '',
  feedDelivered: 50, feedConsumed: 50, feedRemaining: 0,
  feedSourceType: '', feedSourceId: '', feedMethod: 'scoop', feedMovementIds: [],
  waterAmount: 80, waterMethod: 'manual',
  waterFillCount: null, waterFillVolume: null,
  weightSamples: [], weightGender: '',
  brokenEggs: 0, deathsCount: 5, deaths: [],
  vaccines: [], medications: [], activities: [], notes: '', birdAgeDays: 30,
});

const setupHook = () => {
  const noop = () => {};
  return renderHook(() => useDlgSave({
    form: {} as any, saving: false, setSaving: noop, setOpen: noop, setErr: noop,
    setForm: noop as any, selectedFlock: undefined, flockAliveCount: 100,
    isLayerFlock: false, num: () => null, int: () => null,
  }));
};

describe('Correction Atomic — Immutable Log + Event Sourcing', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    useDlg.setState({ logs: [] });
  });

  it('applyCorrectionAtomic → corrections[] اضافه، log اصلی دست‌نخورده', async () => {
    const id = useDlg.getState().add(makeLog());
    const { result } = setupHook();

    let ok = false;
    await act(async () => {
      ok = await result.current.applyCorrectionAtomic(id, { deathsCount: 3 }, 'اشتباه شمارش');
    });
    expect(ok).toBe(true);

    const log = useDlg.getState().logs.find(l => l.id === id)!;
    expect(log.deathsCount).toBe(5);
    expect(log.corrections).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(log.corrections![0].changes.deathsCount).toBe(3);
    expect(applyCorrections(log).deathsCount).toBe(3);
  });

  it('revokeCorrectionAtomic → effective برمی‌گردد به مقدار اصلی', async () => {
    const id = useDlg.getState().add(makeLog());
    const { result } = setupHook();

    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.applyCorrectionAtomic(id, { deathsCount: 3 }, 'اشتباه شمارش');
    });
    const log1 = useDlg.getState().logs.find(l => l.id === id)!;
    const corrId = log1.corrections![0].id;

    let ok = false;
    await act(async () => {
      ok = await result.current.revokeCorrectionAtomic(id, corrId);
    });
    expect(ok).toBe(true);

    const log2 = useDlg.getState().logs.find(l => l.id === id)!;
    expect(log2.deathsCount).toBe(5);
    expect(log2.corrections![0].revoked).toBe(true);
    expect(applyCorrections(log2).deathsCount).toBe(5);
  });

  it('applyCorrectionAtomic → Audit Trail ثبت می‌شود', async () => {
    const id = useDlg.getState().add(makeLog());
    const { result } = setupHook();

    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.applyCorrectionAtomic(id, { feedWaste: 10 }, 'خطا در ثبت');
    });

    const log = useDlg.getState().logs.find(l => l.id === id)!;
    const events = (log as any).events || [];
    const wasteEv = events.find((e: any) => e.field === 'feedWaste');
    expect(wasteEv).toBeTruthy();
    expect(wasteEv.before).toBe(null);
    expect(wasteEv.after).toBe(10);
    expect(wasteEv.reason).toBe('خطا در ثبت');
  });

  it('applyCorrectionAtomic → log ناموجود false برمی‌گرداند', async () => {
    const { result } = setupHook();
    let ok = true;
    await act(async () => {
      ok = await result.current.applyCorrectionAtomic('non-existent', { deathsCount: 3 }, 'x');
    });
    expect(ok).toBe(false);
  });

  it('revokeCorrectionAtomic روی correction قبلاً revoked → false', async () => {
    const id = useDlg.getState().add(makeLog());
    const { result } = setupHook();

    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.applyCorrectionAtomic(id, { deathsCount: 3 }, 'x');
    });
    const corrId = useDlg.getState().logs.find(l => l.id === id)!.corrections![0].id;
    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.revokeCorrectionAtomic(id, corrId);
    });

    let again = true;
    await act(async () => {
      again = await result.current.revokeCorrectionAtomic(id, corrId);
    });
    expect(again).toBe(false);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { applyCorrections } from '../mod/dlg/api/applyCorrections';
import type { DailyLog, DailyLogCorrection } from '../mod/dlg/store';

const baseLog = (overrides: Partial<DailyLog> = {}): DailyLog => ({
  id: 'log-1',
  flockId: 'flk-1',
  date: '1405/11/09',
  entryTime: '07:00',
  temperature: 25,
  temperatureMin: null,
  temperatureMax: null,
  humidity: 50,
  humidityMin: null,
  humidityMax: null,
  ventilation: 'ok',
  litter: 'dry',
  behavior: 'active',
  distribution: 'uniform',
  appearance: '',
  sound: 'normal',
  feedType: '',
  feedDelivered: 50,
  feedConsumed: 50,
  feedRemaining: 0,
  feedSourceType: '',
  feedSourceId: '',
  feedMethod: 'scoop',
  feedMovementIds: [],
  waterAmount: 80,
  waterMethod: 'manual',
  waterFillCount: null,
  waterFillVolume: null,
  weightSamples: [],
  weightGender: '',
  brokenEggs: 0,
  eatingEggs: 100,
  fertileEggs: 0,
  otherEggs: 0,
  deathsCount: 5,
  deaths: [],
  vaccines: [],
  medications: [],
  notes: '',
  status: 'active',
  birdAgeDays: 30,
  createdAt: '2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
  updatedAt: '2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
  corrections: [],
  ...overrides,
});

const corr = (overrides: Partial<DailyLogCorrection> = {}): DailyLogCorrection => ({
  id: 'corr-1',
  timestamp: '20:00',
  reason: 'اشتباه شمارش',
  changes: {},
  createdAt: '2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z',
  ...overrides,
});

describe('applyCorrections', () => {
  it('بدون corrections → مقدار اصلی', () => {
    const log = baseLog({ corrections: [] });
    expect(applyCorrections(log).deathsCount).toBe(5);
  });

  it('یک correction → مقدار جدید', () => {
    const log = baseLog({ corrections: [corr({ changes: { deathsCount: 3 } })] });
    const result = applyCorrections(log);
    expect(result.deathsCount).toBe(3);
    expect(result.temperature).toBe(25); // untouched
  });

  it('correction revoked → نادیده گرفته می‌شود', () => {
    const log = baseLog({
      corrections: [corr({ revoked: true, changes: { deathsCount: 3 } })],
    });
    expect(applyCorrections(log).deathsCount).toBe(5);
  });

  it('دو correction → آخرین برنده', () => {
    const log = baseLog({
      corrections: [
        corr({ id: 'a', changes: { deathsCount: 8 } }),
        corr({ id: 'b', changes: { deathsCount: 3 } }),
      ],
    });
    expect(applyCorrections(log).deathsCount).toBe(3);
  });
});

    act(() => result.current.toggle('a'));

    expect(result.current.groups.a).toBe(false);
  });

  it('openOnly فقط اون رو باز میکنه', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFormGroups({ a: true, b: true, c: false }));
    act(() => result.current.openOnly('c'));
    expect(result.current.groups.a).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.groups.b).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.groups.c).toBe(true);
  });

  it('closeAll همه رو می‌بنده', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFormGroups({ a: true, b: true }));
    act(() => result.current.closeAll());
    expect(Object.keys(result.current.groups)).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('openAll همه رو باز میکنه', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFormGroups({ a: false, b: false }));
    act(() => result.current.openAll(['a', 'b']));
    expect(result.current.groups.a).toBe(true);
    expect(result.current.groups.b).toBe(true);
  });
});

/**
 * dlg-store-corrections.test.ts — تست addCorrection + revokeCorrection
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useDlg, type DailyLog } from '../mod/dlg/store';
import { applyCorrections } from '../mod/dlg/api/applyCorrections';

const makeInput = (): Omit<DailyLog, 'id' | 'status' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'> => ({
  flockId: 'flk-1',
  date: '1405/11/09',
  entryTime: '07:00',
  temperature: 25,
  temperatureMin: null,
  temperatureMax: null,
  humidity: 50,
  humidityMin: null,
  humidityMax: null,
  ventilation: 'ok',
  litter: 'dry',
  behavior: 'active',
  distribution: 'uniform',
  appearance: '',
  sound: 'normal',
  feedType: '',
  feedDelivered: 50,
  feedConsumed: 50,
  feedRemaining: 0,
  feedSourceType: '',
  feedSourceId: '',
  feedMethod: 'scoop',
  feedMovementIds: [],
  waterAmount: 80,
  waterMethod: 'manual',
  waterFillCount: null,
  waterFillVolume: null,
  weightSamples: [],
  weightGender: '',
  brokenEggs: 0,
  deathsCount: 5,
  deaths: [],
  vaccines: [],
  medications: [],
  activities: [],
  notes: '',
  birdAgeDays: 30,
});

describe('useDlg — corrections actions', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    useDlg.setState({ logs: [] });
  });

  it('addCorrection → correction در log + applyCorrections', () => {
    const id = useDlg.getState().add(makeInput());
    const corrId = useDlg.getState().addCorrection(id, { deathsCount: 3 }, 'اشتباه شمارش');
    expect(corrId).toBeTruthy();

    const log = useDlg.getState().logs.find(l => l.id === id)!;
    expect(log.corrections).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(log.corrections![0].reason).toBe('اشتباه شمارش');
    expect(log.corrections![0].revoked).toBe(false);

    expect(applyCorrections(log).deathsCount).toBe(3);
  });

  it('addCorrection برای log ناموجود → null', () => {
    const corrId = useDlg.getState().addCorrection('non-existent', { deathsCount: 3 }, 'reason');
    expect(corrId).toBeNull();
  });

  it('revokeCorrection → correction.revoked=true + مقدار اصلی برگشت', () => {
    const id = useDlg.getState().add(makeInput());
    const corrId = useDlg.getState().addCorrection(id, { deathsCount: 3 }, 'اشتباه')!;

    const ok = useDlg.getState().revokeCorrection(id, corrId);
    expect(ok).toBe(true);

    const log = useDlg.getState().logs.find(l => l.id === id)!;
    expect(log.corrections![0].revoked).toBe(true);
    expect(applyCorrections(log).deathsCount).toBe(5); // original
  });

  it('revokeCorrection دوباره → false (idempotent)', () => {
    const id = useDlg.getState().add(makeInput());
    const corrId = useDlg.getState().addCorrection(id, { deathsCount: 3 }, 'خطا')!;
    useDlg.getState().revokeCorrection(id, corrId);
    const again = useDlg.getState().revokeCorrection(id, corrId);
    expect(again).toBe(false);
  });

  it('revokeCorrection برای corr ناموجود → false', () => {
    const id = useDlg.getState().add(makeInput());
    const ok = useDlg.getState().revokeCorrection(id, 'non-existent');
    expect(ok).toBe(false);
  });
});

  waterMethod: '',
  waterFillCount: null,

    const logId = useDlg.getState().add(minimalLog);
    useDlg.getState().addEvent(logId, {
      date: '1405/08/18',
      entryTime: '08:00',
      type: 'reading',
      field: 'temperature',
      value: 25,
    });
    const log = useDlg.getState().logs.find(l => l.id === logId);
    expect(log?.events?.length).toBe(1);
    expect(log?.events?.[0].value).toBe(25);
    expect(log?.events?.[0].type).toBe('reading');
  });

  it('addEvent — id برمی‌گرداند', () => {
    const logId = useDlg.getState().add(minimalLog);
    const evId = useDlg.getState().addEvent(logId, {
      date: '1405/08/18',
      entryTime: '08:00',
      type: 'create',
    });
    expect(typeof evId).toBe('string');
    expect(evId.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it('revokeEvent — revoked=true می‌شود', () => {
    const logId = useDlg.getState().add(minimalLog);
    const evId = useDlg.getState().addEvent(logId, {
      date: '1405/08/18',
      entryTime: '08:00',
      type: 'death',
      count: 3,
    });
    const ok = useDlg.getState().revokeEvent(logId, evId);
    expect(ok).toBe(true);
    const log = useDlg.getState().logs.find(l => l.id === logId);
    expect(log?.events?.[0].revoked).toBe(true);
  });

  it('revokeEvent — event ناموجود → false', () => {
    const logId = useDlg.getState().add(minimalLog);
    const ok = useDlg.getState().revokeEvent(logId, 'not-exist');
    expect(ok).toBe(false);
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/dsh-egg-metrics.test.ts

/**
 * dsh — brokenRate7 fix
 *
 * باگ قبلی: total = totalCount + brokenCount = (eating + fertile + broken + other) + broken
 *          → broken دوبار شمرده می‌شد
 * بعد از fix: total = totalCount = eating + fertile + broken + other
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { aggregateEggMetrics } from '../shr/calc/formulas/egg';

describe('aggregateEggMetrics — 7 روزه', () => {
  it('۷ روز، هر روز ۱۰۰ سالم + ۳۰ شکسته + ۲۰ کثیف → rate درست', () => {
    const result = aggregateEggMetrics(
      7,
      7 * 100,  // ۷۰۰ سالم
      7 * 30,   // ۲۱۰ شکسته
      7 * 20,   // ۱۴۰ کثیف
      900,      // alive today
      1000,     // initial
      90,       // standard hen-day
      85,       // standard hen-housed
    );

    // totalToday روزانه = 100 + 30 + 20 = 150
    // brokenRate روزانه = 30 / 150 = 20%
    expect(result.brokenRatePct).toBe(20);
    // dirtyRate روزانه = 20 / 150 = 13.3%
    expect(result.dirtyRatePct).toBeCloseTo(13.3, 1);
  });

  it('fix بدل: brokenCount نباید دوبار شمرده شود', () => {
    // یک روز: 100 سالم + 30 شکسته + 20 کثیف
    const result = aggregateEggMetrics(1, 100, 30, 20, 900, 1000, null, null);
    // totalToday = 150, brokenRate = 30/150 = 20%
    // اگر double-count بود: totalToday = 180, brokenRate = 30/180 = 16.7%
    expect(result.brokenRatePct).toBe(20);
  });

  it('zero eggs → zero rates', () => {
    const result = aggregateEggMetrics(7, 0, 0, 0, 900, 1000, null, null);
    expect(result.brokenRatePct).toBe(0);
    expect(result.dirtyRatePct).toBe(0);
    expect(result.henDayPct).toBe(0);
  });

  it('henDay: ۷ روز ۷۰۰ سالم، alive=900، days=7 → 700 / (900*7) = 11.1%', () => {
    // Bug در aggregateEggMetrics: از calculateEggMetrics استفاده می‌کند که
    // eggsToday / aliveToday است، نه تقسیم بر days
    // این تست فقط درستی wrapper را چک می‌کند
    const result = aggregateEggMetrics(7, 700, 0, 0, 900, 1000, null, null);
    // 700/7 = 100 روزانه، 100/900 = 11.1%
    expect(result.henDayPct).toBeCloseTo(11.1, 1);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { format, parse, addDays, startOfDay } from 'date-fns-jalali';
import {
  toEnNum, monthKey, currentMonth, todayJalali, dateDiffDays, fcrBg,
} from '../mod/dsh/utils';
import { monthKey as analyticsMonthKey } from '../mod/rep/analytics';

const daysFromTodayJ = (n: number) => format(addDays(startOfDay(new Date()), n), 'yyyy/MM/dd');

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════

describe('toEnNum', () => {
  it('رشته لاتین → عدد', () => {
    expect(toEnNum('123')).toBe(123);
  });

  it('اعداد فارسی → عدد', () => {
    expect(toEnNum('۱۲۳')).toBe(123);
  });

  it('عدد بزرگ', () => {
    expect(toEnNum('۱۴۰۵۰۷۰۹')).toBe(14050709);
  });

  it('خالی → 0', () => {
    expect(toEnNum('')).toBe(0);
  });

  it('غیرعددی → 0', () => {
    expect(toEnNum('abc')).toBe(0);
  });

  it('مخلوط (شروع با عدد) → عدد ابتدایی', () => {
    // '۱۲۳abc' → '123abc' → parseInt = 123
    expect(toEnNum('۱۲۳abc')).toBe(123);
  });

  it('مخلوط (شروع با حرف) → 0', () => {
    expect(toEnNum('abc۱۲۳')).toBe(0);
  });

  it('صفر → 0', () => {
    expect(toEnNum('۰')).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('monthKey — یکپارچگی با analytics.ts', () => {
  it('تاریخ با ماه 2 رقمی', () => {
    expect(monthKey('1405/07/09')).toBe('1405/07');
  });

  it('اعداد فارسی', () => {
    expect(monthKey('۱۴۰۵/۰۷/۰۹')).toBe('1405/07');
  });

  it('خالی → خالی', () => {
    expect(monthKey('')).toBe('');
    expect(monthKey(null as any)).toBe('');
  });

  it('نامعتبر → خالی', () => {
    expect(monthKey('abc')).toBe('');
  });

  it('فقط سال/ماه (2 قسمت) → خالی', () => {
    expect(monthKey('1405/07')).toBe('');
  });

  it('ماه تک‌رقمی باید pad بشه (1405/7/9 → 1405/07)', () => {
    // ⚠️ باگ احتمالی: کد فعلی 1405/7 برمیگردونه
    // تست: باید با analytics.monthKey یکسان باشه
    const dsh = monthKey('1405/7/9');
    const ana = analyticsMonthKey('1405/7/9');
    expect(dsh).toBe(ana);
  });

  it('سازگاری با currentMonth برای امروز', () => {
    // وقتی todayJalali داره تاریخ امروز رو میده، monthKey باید همون currentMonth باشه
    const today = todayJalali();
    const cm = currentMonth();
    expect(monthKey(today)).toBe(cm);
  });
});

  });

  it('30 روز پیش → 30', () => {

  it('فردا → -1', () => {
    expect(dateDiffDays(daysFromTodayJ(1))).toBe(-1);
  });

  it('5 روز بعد → -5', () => {
    expect(dateDiffDays(daysFromTodayJ(5))).toBe(-5);
  });

  it('خالی → 999', () => {
    expect(dateDiffDays('')).toBe(999);
  });

  it('نامعتبر → 999', () => {
    expect(dateDiffDays('xyz')).toBe(999);
  });

  it('اعداد فارسی', () => {
    const jalali = daysFromTodayJ(-5);
    const persian = jalali.replace(/[0-9]/g, d => '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'[+d]);
    expect(dateDiffDays(persian)).toBe(5);
  });
});

/**
 * D.7 Phase 4a — negative test برای egg atomic (end-to-end)
 *
 * نکته: registerEggWhsHandlers باید صدا زده شود تا emitSync handler داشته باشد.
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { useEgg } from '../mod/egg/store';
import { useWhs } from '../mod/whs/store';
import { registerEggWhsHandlers } from '../mod/whs/handlers';

const makeProd = (overrides: any = {}): any => ({
  flockId: 'f1',
  date: '1405/11/08',
  eatingCount: 100,
  fertileCount: 0,
  totalCount: 100,
  brokenCount: 0,
  softCount: 0,
  dirtyCount: 0,
  avgWeight: null,
  notes: '',
  ...overrides,
});

describe('D.7 — egg atomic cascade (end-to-end)', () => {
  let unregister: () => void;

  beforeEach(() => {
    useEgg.setState({ productions: [], sales: [], discards: [] } as any);
    useWhs.setState({ items: [], movements: [] } as any);
    unregister = registerEggWhsHandlers();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    if (unregister) unregister();
  });

  it('happy: addProduction → whs movement ساخته می‌شود', () => {
    const prodId = useEgg.getState().addProduction(makeProd());
    expect(typeof prodId).toBe('string');
    expect(prodId.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(useEgg.getState().productions).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(useWhs.getState().movements.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(useWhs.getState().items.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it('failure: whs.addMovement throws → productions + whs rollback', () => {
    const originalAddMovement = useWhs.getState().addMovement;
    useWhs.setState({
      addMovement: () => { throw new Error('simulated whs failure'); },
    } as any);

    try {
      expect(() => useEgg.getState().addProduction(makeProd())).toThrow();
      expect(useEgg.getState().productions).toHaveLength(0);
      expect(useWhs.getState().movements).toHaveLength(0);
    } finally {
      useWhs.setState({ addMovement: originalAddMovement } as any);
    }
  });

  it('failure: deleteProduction — whs.deleteMovement throws → productions rollback', () => {
    const prodId = useEgg.getState().addProduction(makeProd());
    expect(useEgg.getState().productions).toHaveLength(1);

    const originalDeleteMovement = useWhs.getState().deleteMovement;
    useWhs.setState({
      deleteMovement: () => { throw new Error('simulated delete failure'); },
    } as any);

    try {
      expect(() => useEgg.getState().deleteProduction(prodId)).toThrow();
      expect(useEgg.getState().productions).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(useEgg.getState().productions[0].id).toBe(prodId);
    } finally {
      useWhs.setState({ deleteMovement: originalDeleteMovement } as any);
    }
  });

  it('structural: egg.store از emitSync + snapshot استفاده می‌کند', async () => {
    const fs = await import('node:fs');
    const content = fs.readFileSync('src/mod/egg/store.ts', 'utf-8');
    expect(content).toContain('bus.emitSync');
    expect(content).toContain('prevWhsItems');
    expect(content).toContain('prevWhsMovs');
    expect(content).toContain('useWhs.setState({ items: prevWhsItems, movements: prevWhsMovs })');
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  toFa, toEn, numFa,
  formatNumWhileTyping, numberToWords,
  parseFaNum, formatDecimalWhileTyping, parseDecimal,
} from '../shr/utils/fa';

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// toFa — تبدیل ارقام لاتین به فارسی
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('toFa', () => {
  it('عدد صحیح', () => expect(toFa(123)).toBe('۱۲۳'));
  it('عدد اعشاری', () => expect(toFa(45.67)).toBe('۴۵.۶۷'));
  it('صفر', () => expect(toFa(0)).toBe('۰'));
  it('رشته با کاما لاتین → ٬', () => expect(toFa('1,234')).toBe('۱٬۲۳۴'));
  it('null → خالی', () => expect(toFa(null)).toBe(''));
  it('undefined → خالی', () => expect(toFa(undefined)).toBe(''));
  it('رشته فارسی → بی‌تغییر (فقط [0-9] لاتین عوض میشه)', () => {
    expect(toFa('۱۲۳')).toBe('۱۲۳');
  });
  it('عدد منفی', () => expect(toFa(-5)).toBe('-۵'));
  it('رشته مخلوط', () => expect(toFa('abc 12')).toBe('abc ۱۲'));
  it('عددی با ٬ قبلی → بی‌تغییر', () => expect(toFa('۱٬۲۳۴')).toBe('۱٬۲۳۴'));
});

describe('toEn', () => {
  it('ارقام فارسی', () => expect(toEn('۱۲۳')).toBe('123'));
  it('٬ حذف', () => expect(toEn('۱٬۲۳۴')).toBe('1234'));
  it('کاما لاتین حذف', () => expect(toEn('1,234')).toBe('1234'));
  it('null → خالی', () => expect(toEn(null)).toBe(''));
  it('undefined → خالی', () => expect(toEn(undefined)).toBe(''));
  it('رشته لاتین → بی‌تغییر', () => expect(toEn('abc')).toBe('abc'));
  it('مخلوط', () => expect(toEn('۱۲۳abc۴۵۶')).toBe('123abc456'));
  it('صفر فارسی', () => expect(toEn('۰')).toBe('0'));
  it('عدد اعشاری فارسی → ٫؟ (نکته: ٫ تبدیل نمیشه)', () => {
    // کد فعلی ٫ (Persian decimal) رو تبدیل نمی‌کنه
    expect(toEn('۱۲.۵')).toBe('12.5');
  });
});

describe('numFa', () => {
  it('عدد کوچک', () => {
    expect(numFa(5)).toMatch(/^[۰-۹]+$/);
  });
  it('عدد با جداکننده', () => {
    const r = numFa(1234567);
    // باید ارقام فارسی داشته باشه
    expect(r).toMatch(/[۰-۹]/);
    // و باید طولانی‌تر از ۷ کاراکتر خالص ارقام باشه (یعنی جداکننده داره)
    expect(r.length).toBeGreaterThan(7);
  });
  it('صفر', () => {
    expect(numFa(0)).toMatch(/[۰-۹]/);
  });
  it('null → ۰', () => {
    expect(numFa(null)).toMatch(/[۰-۹]/);
  });
  it('undefined → ۰', () => {
    expect(numFa(undefined)).toMatch(/[۰-۹]/);
  });
  it('NaN → ۰', () => {
    expect(numFa(NaN)).toMatch(/[۰-۹]/);
  });
  it('Infinity → ۰', () => {
    expect(numFa(Infinity)).toMatch(/[۰-۹]/);
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// formatNumWhileTyping — فرمت هنگام تایپ
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('formatNumWhileTyping', () => {
  it('خالی → خالی', () => expect(formatNumWhileTyping('')).toBe(''));
  it('یک رقم', () => expect(formatNumWhileTyping('5')).toBe('۵'));
  it('3 رقم بدون جداکننده', () => expect(formatNumWhileTyping('123')).toBe('۱۲۳'));
  it('4 رقم → جداکننده', () => expect(formatNumWhileTyping('1234')).toBe('۱٬۲۳۴'));
  it('7 رقم', () => expect(formatNumWhileTyping('1234567')).toBe('۱٬۲۳۴٬۵۶۷'));
  it('9 رقم', () => expect(formatNumWhileTyping('123456789')).toBe('۱۲۳٬۴۵۶٬۷۸۹'));
  it('0 → ۰', () => expect(formatNumWhileTyping('0')).toBe('۰'));
  it('00 → ۰', () => expect(formatNumWhileTyping('00')).toBe('۰'));
  it('0123 → ۱۲۳', () => expect(formatNumWhileTyping('0123')).toBe('۱۲۳'));
  it('حروف حذف میشن', () => expect(formatNumWhileTyping('abc123')).toBe('۱۲۳'));
  it('کاما لاتین حذف', () => expect(formatNumWhileTyping('1,234')).toBe('۱٬۲۳۴'));
  it('ارقام فارسی → مجدد تبدیل', () => expect(formatNumWhileTyping('۱۲۳۴')).toBe('۱٬۲۳۴'));

  it('اعشار با ٫: 1234.5', () => {
    const r = formatNumWhileTyping('1234.5');
    expect(r).toContain('٬');
    expect(r).toContain('٫');  // ← ٫ برای اعشار
    expect(r).toContain('۵');
  });

  it('اعشار با . لاتین', () => {
    const r = formatNumWhileTyping('1234.56');
    expect(r).toContain('٫');
  });

  it('بیش از 2 رقم اعشار → truncate به 2', () => {
    const r = formatNumWhileTyping('1234.5678');
    // ۵۶ فقط نگه داشته میشه (2 رقم)
    expect(r).not.toContain('۷');
    expect(r).not.toContain('۸');
  });

  it('دو نقطه → یکی', () => {
    const r = formatNumWhileTyping('1.2.3');
    // یک ٫ یا . بیشتر نباید داشته باشه
    const decimals = (r.match(/[٫.]/g) || []).length;
    expect(decimals).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
  });

  it('اعشار بدون صحیح: .5 → ۰٫۵', () => {
    const r = formatNumWhileTyping('.5');
    expect(r).toContain('٫');
    expect(r).toContain('۵');
  });
});

    expect(r).toContain('۱۲');

    // فقط 34 نگه داشته میشه
    expect(r).not.toContain('۵');

  it('null → 0', () => expect(parseDecimal(null)).toBe(0));
  it('undefined → 0', () => expect(parseDecimal(undefined)).toBe(0));
  it('نامعتبر → 0', () => expect(parseDecimal('abc')).toBe(0));
  it('منفی', () => expect(parseDecimal('-۱۲.۵')).toBe(-12.5));
  it('عدد صحیح بدون اعشار', () => expect(parseDecimal('۱۲۳')).toBe(123));
});

FILE: ./src/test/filter-sort.test.ts
==========================================
/**
 * filter-sort.test.ts — تست سیستم فیلتر مرکزی
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import { useFilterSort } from '../shr/filter/useFilterSort';

interface Item { id: string; name: string; category: string; stock: number; date: string; }

const items: Item[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'ذرت',   category: 'feed',     stock: 100, date: '1405/07/01' },
  { id: '2', name: 'دارو',  category: 'medicine', stock: 5,   date: '1405/07/10' },
  { id: '3', name: 'واکسن', category: 'vaccine',  stock: 20,  date: '1405/07/05' },
  { id: '4', name: 'گندم',  category: 'feed',     stock: 50,  date: '1405/07/15' },
];

const filterDefs = [
  {
    key: 'category', label: 'دسته', kind: 'enum' as const,
    options: [
      { value: 'feed', label: 'دان' },
      { value: 'medicine', label: 'دارو' },
      { value: 'vaccine', label: 'واکسن' },
    ],
    getValue: (it: Item) => it.category,
  },
  {
    key: 'stock', label: 'موجودی', kind: 'numberRange' as const,
    getValue: (it: Item) => it.stock,
  },
];

const sortDefs = [
  { key: 'name',  label: 'نام',     compare: (a: Item, b: Item) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name) },
  { key: 'stock', label: 'موجودی',  compare: (a: Item, b: Item) => a.stock - b.stock },
  { key: 'date',  label: 'تاریخ',   compare: (a: Item, b: Item) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date) },
];

describe('useFilterSort — جستجو', () => {
  it('بدون جستجو → همه', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFilterSort({ items, searchKeys: ['name'] }));
    expect(result.current.filtered).toHaveLength(4);
  });
  it('جستجوی ذرت → ۱ نتیجه', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFilterSort({ items, searchKeys: ['name'] }));
    act(() => result.current.setSearch('ذرت'));
    expect(result.current.filtered).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result.current.filtered[0].name).toBe('ذرت');
  });
  it('جستجو case-insensitive (فارسی مهم نیست)', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFilterSort({ items, searchKeys: ['name'] }));
    act(() => result.current.setSearch('دارو'));
    expect(result.current.filtered).toHaveLength(1);
  });
  it('جستجوی تابع — چند فیلد', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFilterSort({
      items, searchKeys: (it: Item) => `${it.name} ${it.category}`,
    }));
    act(() => result.current.setSearch('feed'));
    expect(result.current.filtered).toHaveLength(2);
  });
});

describe('useFilterSort — فیلتر enum تکی', () => {
  it('filter feed → ۲', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFilterSort({ items, filters: filterDefs }));
    act(() => result.current.setFilter('category', 'feed'));
    expect(result.current.filtered).toHaveLength(2);
  });
  it('clear filter → بازگشت به ۴', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFilterSort({ items, filters: filterDefs }));
    act(() => result.current.setFilter('category', 'feed'));
    act(() => result.current.clearFilter('category'));
    expect(result.current.filtered).toHaveLength(4);
  });
  it('مقدار خالی → نادیده گرفته می‌شه', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFilterSort({ items, filters: filterDefs }));
    act(() => result.current.setFilter('category', ''));
    expect(result.current.filtered).toHaveLength(4);
  });
});

describe('useFilterSort — عددی', () => {
  it('stock >= 20 → ۳', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFilterSort({ items, filters: filterDefs }));
    act(() => result.current.setFilter('stock', [20, null]));
    expect(result.current.filtered).toHaveLength(3);
  });
  it('stock بین ۱۰ تا ۶۰ → ۲', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFilterSort({ items, filters: filterDefs }));
    act(() => result.current.setFilter('stock', [10, 60]));
    expect(result.current.filtered).toHaveLength(2);
  });
});

describe('useFilterSort — مرتب‌سازی', () => {
  it('toggleSort → asc', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFilterSort({ items, sorts: sortDefs }));
    act(() => result.current.toggleSort('stock'));
    expect(result.current.filtered[0].stock).toBe(5);
  });
  it('toggleSort دوم → desc', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFilterSort({ items, sorts: sortDefs }));
    act(() => result.current.toggleSort('stock'));
    act(() => result.current.toggleSort('stock'));
    expect(result.current.filtered[0].stock).toBe(100);
  });
  it('toggleSort سوم → null', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFilterSort({ items, sorts: sortDefs }));
    act(() => result.current.toggleSort('stock'));
    act(() => result.current.toggleSort('stock'));
    act(() => result.current.toggleSort('stock'));
    expect(result.current.sort).toBeNull();
  });
  it('sort + filter با هم', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFilterSort({ items, filters: filterDefs, sorts: sortDefs }));
    act(() => result.current.setFilter('category', 'feed'));
    act(() => result.current.toggleSort('stock'));
    expect(result.current.filtered.map(i => i.name)).toEqual(['گندم', 'ذرت']);
  });
});

describe('useFilterSort — reset', () => {
  it('resetAll همه رو پاک می‌کنه', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFilterSort({ items, filters: filterDefs, sorts: sortDefs }));
    act(() => result.current.setSearch('ذرت'));
    act(() => result.current.setFilter('category', 'feed'));
    act(() => result.current.toggleSort('stock'));
    act(() => result.current.resetAll());
    expect(result.current.filtered).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(result.current.search).toBe('');
    expect(result.current.sort).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('useFilterSort — counts', () => {
  it('total و count درست', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFilterSort({ items, filters: filterDefs }));
    expect(result.current.total).toBe(4);
    act(() => result.current.setFilter('category', 'feed'));
    expect(result.current.count).toBe(2);
  });
  it('hasActiveFilters', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFilterSort({ items, filters: filterDefs }));
    expect(result.current.hasActiveFilters).toBe(false);
    act(() => result.current.setSearch('ذرت'));
    expect(result.current.hasActiveFilters).toBe(true);
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/flk-archive.test.ts
==========================================
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { splitFlocksForArchive } from '../mod/flk/archivePolicy';
import type { Flock } from '../mod/flk/store';

function makeFlock(overrides: Partial<Flock>): Flock {
  return {
    id: overrides.id ?? 'flk-1',
    name: overrides.name ?? 'گله آزمایشی',
    type: 'broiler',
    birdId: 'bird-1',
    breedId: 'breed-1',
    hallId: 'hall-1',
    zoneId: 'zone-1',
    initialCount: 100,
    currentCount: 100,
    maleCount: 50,
    femaleCount: 50,
    unknownCount: 0,
    layingStartDay: 150,
    endOfCycleDay: 42,
    vaccineScheduleId: '',
    hatchDate: '1404/01/01',
    purchaseDate: '1404/01/01',
    startDate: '1404/01/01',
    source: 'purchase',
    purchasePrice: 1000,
    deliveryCost: 0,
    otherCosts: 0,
    status: 'active',
    notes: '',
    createdAt: '2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
    updatedAt: '2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe('flk archivePolicy & balance invariants', () => {
  it('locks active and merged flocks while allowing archived/sold flocks to archive', () => {
    const flocks: Flock[] = [
      makeFlock({ id: 'f-active', status: 'active', currentCount: 200 }),
      makeFlock({ id: 'f-merged', status: 'merged', mergedInto: 'f-active', currentCount: 0 }),
      makeFlock({ id: 'f-merged-ref', status: 'archived', mergedInto: 'f-active', currentCount: 10 }),
      makeFlock({ id: 'f-archived', status: 'archived', currentCount: 80 }),
      makeFlock({ id: 'f-sold', status: 'sold', currentCount: 50 }),
    ];

    const split = splitFlocksForArchive(flocks);
    expect(split.toArchive.map(f => f.id)).toEqual(['f-archived', 'f-sold']);
    expect(split.keep.map(f => f.id)).toEqual(['f-active', 'f-merged', 'f-merged-ref']);

    const totalBefore = flocks.reduce((acc, f) => acc + (f.currentCount ?? 0), 0);
    const totalAfterSplit = [...split.toArchive, ...split.keep].reduce(
      (acc, f) => acc + (f.currentCount ?? 0),
      0
    );
    expect(totalAfterSplit).toBe(totalBefore);
  });
});

// فاز ۷.۲ — aggregateDeathsBySex + toneFromRate
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
import { aggregateDeathsBySex, toneFromRate } from '../mod/flk/helpers-audit';

const makeEv = (type: any, deltaM: number, deltaF: number, deltaU: number) => ({
  id: 'e-' + Math.random(),
  type,
  date: '1405/08/01',
  before: { male: 50, female: 50, unknown: 0 },
  after: { male: 50 + deltaM, female: 50 + deltaF, unknown: deltaU },
  delta: { male: deltaM, female: deltaF, unknown: deltaU },
  createdAt: '2026-01-01',
});

describe('aggregateDeathsBySex', () => {
  it('بدون sexBalanceEvents → hasData=false', () => {
    const r = aggregateDeathsBySex(undefined, 50, 50);
    expect(r.hasData).toBe(true); // initial موجود است، ولی deaths=0
    expect(r.male.deaths).toBe(0);
    expect(r.female.deaths).toBe(0);
  });

  it('بدون initialMale/Female → hasData=false', () => {
    const r = aggregateDeathsBySex([makeEv('death', -10, 0, 0)], 0, 0);
    expect(r.hasData).toBe(false);
  });

  it('male death -10 با initial=50 → rate=20٪', () => {
    const r = aggregateDeathsBySex([makeEv('death', -10, 0, 0)], 50, 50);
    expect(r.male.deaths).toBe(10);
    expect(r.male.rate).toBe(20);
    expect(r.female.deaths).toBe(0);
  });

  it('چند death event → جمع درست', () => {
    const r = aggregateDeathsBySex([
      makeEv('death', -5, 0, 0),
      makeEv('death', -3, -2, 0),
      makeEv('death', 0, -1, 0),
    ], 50, 50);
    expect(r.male.deaths).toBe(8);
    expect(r.female.deaths).toBe(3);
  });

  it('type=sale → حساب نمی‌شود', () => {
    const r = aggregateDeathsBySex([
      makeEv('death', -10, 0, 0),
      makeEv('sale', -20, -20, 0),
    ], 50, 50);
    expect(r.male.deaths).toBe(10); // فقط death، نه sale
  });

  it('delta مثبت (add) → نادیده', () => {
    const r = aggregateDeathsBySex([
      makeEv('death', -10, 0, 0),
      makeEv('death', 5, 0, 0), // غیرمعمول ولی نادیده
    ], 50, 50);
    expect(r.male.deaths).toBe(10);
  });

  it('unknown deaths جمع جدا', () => {
    const r = aggregateDeathsBySex([makeEv('death', 0, 0, -7)], 50, 50);
    expect(r.unknown.deaths).toBe(7);
  });
});

describe('toneFromRate', () => {
  it('rate<10 → text', () => expect(toneFromRate(5)).toBe('var(--text)'));
  it('rate=10 → warn', () => expect(toneFromRate(10)).toBe('var(--warn)'));
  it('rate=19.9 → warn', () => expect(toneFromRate(19.9)).toBe('var(--warn)'));
  it('rate=20 → danger', () => expect(toneFromRate(20)).toBe('var(--danger)'));
  it('rate=50 → danger', () => expect(toneFromRate(50)).toBe('var(--danger)'));
});

// فاز ۷.۴ — weightBySexFromLogs
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
import { weightBySexFromLogs } from '../mod/flk/helpers-audit';

const mkLog = (flockId: string, gender: string, weights: number[]) => ({
  flockId,
  weightGender: gender,
  weightSamples: weights.map(w => ({ weight: w })),
});

describe('weightBySexFromLogs', () => {
  it('بدون logs → hasData=false', () => {
    const r = weightBySexFromLogs([], 'f1');
    expect(r.hasData).toBe(false);
    expect(r.delta).toBeNull();
  });
  it('یک log نر → male.hasData=true', () => {
    const r = weightBySexFromLogs([mkLog('f1', 'male', [2.8, 2.9, 2.7])], 'f1');
    expect(r.male.hasData).toBe(true);
    expect(r.male.avg).toBeCloseTo(2.8, 2);
    expect(r.male.count).toBe(3);
    expect(r.female.hasData).toBe(false);
  });
  it('نر و ماده → delta درست', () => {
    const r = weightBySexFromLogs([
      mkLog('f1', 'male', [3.0]),
      mkLog('f1', 'female', [2.4]),
    ], 'f1');
    expect(r.male.avg).toBeCloseTo(3.0, 2);
    expect(r.female.avg).toBeCloseTo(2.4, 2);
    expect(r.delta).toBeCloseTo(0.6, 2);
  });
  it('CV محاسبه می‌شود', () => {
    const r = weightBySexFromLogs([mkLog('f1', 'male', [2, 4])], 'f1');
    expect(r.male.cv).toBeCloseTo(33.3, 1);
  });
  it('mixed جدا ذخیره می‌شود (delta نمی‌گیرد)', () => {
    const r = weightBySexFromLogs([mkLog('f1', 'mixed', [2.5])], 'f1');
    expect(r.mixed.hasData).toBe(true);
    expect(r.delta).toBeNull();
  });
  it('flockId متفاوت → ignore', () => {
    const r = weightBySexFromLogs([mkLog('f2', 'male', [2.8])], 'f1');
    expect(r.hasData).toBe(false);
  });
  it('چند log نر → جمع', () => {
    const r = weightBySexFromLogs([
      mkLog('f1', 'male', [2.8]),
      mkLog('f1', 'male', [3.0]),
    ], 'f1');
    expect(r.male.count).toBe(2);
    expect(r.male.avg).toBeCloseTo(2.9, 2);
  });
  it('وزن صفر → فیلتر', () => {
    const r = weightBySexFromLogs([mkLog('f1', 'male', [0, 2.8])], 'f1');
    expect(r.male.count).toBe(1);
  });
  it('weightGender خالی → mixed', () => {
    const r = weightBySexFromLogs([mkLog('f1', '', [2.5])], 'f1');
    expect(r.mixed.hasData).toBe(true);
  });
});

// فاز ۸d — calculateFCR
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
import { calculateFCR } from '../mod/flk/helpers-audit';

const agg = (feedKg: number) => ({
  totalFeedKg: feedKg, totalWaterL: 0,
  byType: { feed: feedKg, water: 0 },
  bySource: {}, bySex: { male: 0, female: 0, mixed: 0, unknown: 0 },
  confidence: 'exact' as const, eventCount: 1, hasData: feedKg > 0,
});

const wEmpty = { male: { avg: 0, count: 0, cv: 0, hasData: false }, female: { avg: 0, count: 0, cv: 0, hasData: false }, mixed: { avg: 0, count: 0, cv: 0, hasData: false }, delta: null, hasData: false };

describe('calculateFCR — insufficient', () => {
  it('بدون دان → fcr=null، confidence=insufficient', () => {
    const r = calculateFCR(agg(0), wEmpty, { currentCount: 100 }, 2.5);
    expect(r.fcr).toBeNull();
    expect(r.confidence).toBe('insufficient');
  });
});

describe('calculateFCR — exact', () => {
  it('دان ۵۰۰ + وزن کامل (male+female) → FCR=۲.۵', () => {
    const w = { ...wEmpty,
      male: { avg: 2.0, count: 10, cv: 5, hasData: true },
      female: { avg: 1.5, count: 100, cv: 5, hasData: true },
      hasData: true,
    };
    // live weight = 2.0*10 + 1.5*100 = 20 + 150 = 170
    // FCR = 500 / 170 = 2.94
    const r = calculateFCR(agg(500), w, { currentCount: 110, maleCount: 10, femaleCount: 100, unknownCount: 0 });
    expect(r.confidence).toBe('exact');
    expect(r.fcr).toBeCloseTo(2.94, 1);
    expect(r.totalLiveWeightKg).toBe(170);
  });
  it('unsplit (فقط mixed) → exact', () => {
    const w = { ...wEmpty, mixed: { avg: 1.8, count: 50, cv: 5, hasData: true }, hasData: true };
    const r = calculateFCR(agg(360), w, { currentCount: 100, maleCount: 0, femaleCount: 0, unknownCount: 100 });
    expect(r.confidence).toBe('exact');
    expect(r.fcr).toBeCloseTo(2, 1);  // 360 / 180
  });
});

describe('calculateFCR — standard fallback', () => {
  it('بدون وزن، با standard → FCR از استاندارد', () => {
    const r = calculateFCR(agg(500), wEmpty, { currentCount: 100 }, 2.3);
    expect(r.confidence).toBe('standard');
    expect(r.fcr).toBe(2.3);
    expect(r.totalLiveWeightKg).toBeNull();
  });
  it('بدون وزن، بدون standard → fcr=null', () => {
    const r = calculateFCR(agg(500), wEmpty, { currentCount: 100 }, null);
    expect(r.fcr).toBeNull();
    expect(r.confidence).toBe('insufficient');
  });
  it('وزن ناقص (male هست، female نیست ولی گله female دارد) → fallback استاندارد', () => {
    const w = { ...wEmpty, male: { avg: 2, count: 10, cv: 5, hasData: true }, hasData: true };
    const r = calculateFCR(agg(500), w, { currentCount: 110, maleCount: 10, femaleCount: 100, unknownCount: 0 }, 2.5);
    expect(r.confidence).toBe('standard');
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/flk-consumption-events.test.ts
==========================================
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useFlk } from '../mod/flk/store';
import { aggregateConsumptionEvents } from '../mod/flk/consumptionEventsCalc';
import type { ConsumptionEvent } from '../mod/flk/types-store';

const mkFeed = (o: Partial<Omit<ConsumptionEvent, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>> = {}): Omit<ConsumptionEvent, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'> => ({
  flockId: 'f1',
  type: 'feed',
  date: '1405/08/01',
  amount: 25,
  unit: 'kg',
  sex: '',
  source: 'bulk_manual',
  confidence: 'exact',
  ...o,
});

const mkWater = (o: Partial<Omit<ConsumptionEvent, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>> = {}): Omit<ConsumptionEvent, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'> => ({
  flockId: 'f1',
  type: 'water',
  date: '1405/08/01',
  amount: 50,
  unit: 'L',
  sex: '',
  source: 'daily_manual',
  confidence: 'exact',
  ...o,
});

const stub = (ev: any, id: string): ConsumptionEvent => ({ ...ev, id, createdAt: '', updatedAt: '' });

beforeEach(() => {
  useFlk.setState({ flocks: [], groups: [], groupMembers: [], consumptionEvents: [] } as any);
});

describe('addConsumptionEvent / list / remove / update', () => {
  it('add feed → event اضافه می‌شود', () => {
    const id = useFlk.getState().addConsumptionEvent(mkFeed());
    expect(id).toBeTruthy();
    expect(useFlk.getState().consumptionEvents).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('add water → event اضافه می‌شود', () => {
    useFlk.getState().addConsumptionEvent(mkWater());
    expect(useFlk.getState().consumptionEvents[0].type).toBe('water');
  });

  it('list → فقط flock + sort desc', () => {
    useFlk.getState().addConsumptionEvent(mkFeed({ date: '1405/08/01' }));
    useFlk.getState().addConsumptionEvent(mkFeed({ date: '1405/08/05' }));
    useFlk.getState().addConsumptionEvent(mkFeed({ flockId: 'f2', date: '1405/08/03' }));
    const list = useFlk.getState().listConsumptionEvents('f1');
    expect(list).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(list[0].date).toBe('1405/08/05');
  });

  it('remove → حذف', () => {
    const id = useFlk.getState().addConsumptionEvent(mkFeed());
    useFlk.getState().removeConsumptionEvent(id);
    expect(useFlk.getState().consumptionEvents).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('update → patch اعمال می‌شود', () => {
    const id = useFlk.getState().addConsumptionEvent(mkFeed({ amount: 20 }));
    useFlk.getState().updateConsumptionEvent(id, { amount: 30 });
    expect(useFlk.getState().consumptionEvents.find(e => e.id === id)!.amount).toBe(30);
  });
});

describe('aggregateConsumptionEvents', () => {
  it('خالی → hasData=false', () => {
    expect(aggregateConsumptionEvents([], '1405/08/01', '1405/08/31').hasData).toBe(false);
  });

  it('feed + water → totalFeedKg + totalWaterL جدا', () => {
    const events = [
      stub(mkFeed({ amount: 25 }), 'e1'),
      stub(mkFeed({ amount: 10 }), 'e2'),
      stub(mkWater({ amount: 80 }), 'e3'),
    ];
    const r = aggregateConsumptionEvents(events, '1405/08/01', '1405/08/31');
    expect(r.totalFeedKg).toBe(35);
    expect(r.totalWaterL).toBe(80);
    expect(r.byType.feed).toBe(35);
    expect(r.byType.water).toBe(80);
  });

  it('typeFilter=feed → فقط دان', () => {
    const events = [stub(mkFeed({ amount: 30 }), 'e1'), stub(mkWater({ amount: 100 }), 'e2')];
    const r = aggregateConsumptionEvents(events, '1405/08/01', '1405/08/31', 'feed');
    expect(r.totalFeedKg).toBe(30);
    expect(r.totalWaterL).toBe(0);
    expect(r.eventCount).toBe(1);
  });

  it('typeFilter=water → فقط آب', () => {
    const events = [stub(mkFeed({ amount: 30 }), 'e1'), stub(mkWater({ amount: 100 }), 'e2')];
    const r = aggregateConsumptionEvents(events, '1405/08/01', '1405/08/31', 'water');
    expect(r.totalFeedKg).toBe(0);
    expect(r.totalWaterL).toBe(100);
  });

  it('بازه — خارج از window → ignore', () => {
    const events = [stub(mkFeed({ date: '1405/07/15', amount: 30 }), 'e1'), stub(mkFeed({ date: '1405/08/10', amount: 20 }), 'e2')];
    const r = aggregateConsumptionEvents(events, '1405/08/01', '1405/08/31');
    expect(r.totalFeedKg).toBe(20);
    expect(r.eventCount).toBe(1);
  });

  it('sex تفکیک — male + female جدا (فقط feed)', () => {
    const events = [
      stub(mkFeed({ amount: 30, sex: 'male' }), 'e1'),
      stub(mkFeed({ amount: 40, sex: 'female' }), 'e2'),
      stub(mkFeed({ amount: 10, sex: '' }), 'e3'),
      stub(mkWater({ amount: 200 }), 'e4'),
    ];
    const r = aggregateConsumptionEvents(events, '1405/08/01', '1405/08/31', 'feed');
    expect(r.bySex.male).toBe(30);
    expect(r.bySex.female).toBe(40);
    expect(r.bySex.unknown).toBe(10);
  });

  it('confidence متنوع → mixed', () => {
    const events = [
      stub(mkFeed({ amount: 20, source: 'bulk_manual', confidence: 'exact' }), 'e1'),
      stub(mkFeed({ amount: 5, source: 'sensor_level', confidence: 'estimated' }), 'e2'),
    ];
    const r = aggregateConsumptionEvents(events, '1405/08/01', '1405/08/31');
    expect(r.confidence).toBe('mixed');
    expect(r.bySource.bulk_manual).toBe(20);
    expect(r.bySource.sensor_level).toBe(5);
  });
});

describe('useGroupKpi — تلفات از events', () => {
  it('فقط events نوع death و cull حساب می‌شن', () => {
    const f = makeFlock({ initialCount: 1000, currentCount: 900 });
    useFlk.setState({ flocks: [f] } as any);
    useFlk.getState().addGroup({ name: 'G', type: 'custom' } as any);
    const gid = useFlk.getState().groups[0].id;
    useFlk.getState().addToGroup(gid, f.id);

    // ۲۰ death + ۳۰ sell + ۵۰ cull → باید ۷۰ تلفات باشه
    useFlk.getState().addEvent(f.id, { date: '1405/07/01', type: 'death', count: 20, sex: 'mixed', reason: '' } as any);
    useFlk.getState().addEvent(f.id, { date: '1405/07/02', type: 'sell', count: 30, sex: 'mixed', reason: '' } as any);
    useFlk.getState().addEvent(f.id, { date: '1405/07/03', type: 'cull', count: 50, sex: 'mixed', reason: '' } as any);

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useGroupKpi(gid));
    expect(result.current.totalDeaths).toBe(70);
  });

  it('بدون events → تلفات صفر (نه از initial-current)', () => {
    const f = makeFlock({ initialCount: 1000, currentCount: 900 });
    useFlk.setState({ flocks: [f] } as any);
    useFlk.getState().addGroup({ name: 'G', type: 'custom' } as any);
    const gid = useFlk.getState().groups[0].id;
    useFlk.getState().addToGroup(gid, f.id);

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useGroupKpi(gid));
    expect(result.current.totalDeaths).toBe(0);
  });

  it('نرخ تلفات = totalDeaths / totalInitial × ۱۰۰', () => {
    const f = makeFlock({ initialCount: 1000, currentCount: 950 });
    useFlk.setState({ flocks: [f] } as any);
    useFlk.getState().addGroup({ name: 'G', type: 'custom' } as any);
    const gid = useFlk.getState().groups[0].id;
    useFlk.getState().addToGroup(gid, f.id);

    useFlk.getState().addEvent(f.id, { date: '1405/07/01', type: 'death', count: 50, sex: 'mixed', reason: '' } as any);

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useGroupKpi(gid));
    expect(result.current.mortalityRate).toBeCloseTo(5, 1);
  });
});
