/**
 * invariants-extended.test.ts — قواعد همیشگی داده
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
 * هر تغییر در storeها → این تست‌ها باید پاس شن.
 * اگه fail داد → یه باگ واقعی برگشته.
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useTra, remaining, itemsSum, computePartyCredit } from '../mod/tra/store';
import { useFlk } from '../mod/flk/store';
import { useEgg } from '../mod/egg/store';
import { useWhs } from '../mod/whs/store';

const now = () => new Date().toISOString();

const makeInvoice = (o: any = {}): any => ({
  id: 'inv-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9),
  type: 'purchase',
  number: 'P' + Date.now(),
  date: '1405/07/01',
  partyId: 'p1',
  category: 'feed',
  items: [],
  total: 0,
  payments: [],
  dueDate: '1405/07/31',
  relatedFlockId: '',
  relatedEntryId: '',
  notes: '',
  createdAt: now(),
  updatedAt: now(),
  ...o,
});

beforeEach(() => {
  useTra.setState({ invoices: [], allocations: [], partyPayments: [], deals: [] } as any);
  useFlk.setState({ flocks: [], groups: [], groupMembers: [] } as any);
  useEgg.setState({ productions: [], sales: [] } as any);
  useWhs.setState({ items: [], movements: [] } as any);
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// INVARIANT 1: sum(items) === invoice.total
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('INVARIANT: sum(items) === total', () => {
  it('اقلام ساده → مجموع درست', () => {
    const items = [
      { id: 'i1', description: 'a', unit: 'kg', quantity: 10, unitPrice: 100, total: 1000 },
      { id: 'i2', description: 'b', unit: 'kg', quantity: 5, unitPrice: 200, total: 1000 },
    ];
    expect(itemsSum(items as any)).toBe(2000);
  });

  it('invoice با total اشتباه → itemsSum تشخیص می‌ده', () => {
    const inv = makeInvoice({
      items: [{ id: 'i1', description: 'a', unit: 'kg', quantity: 10, unitPrice: 100, total: 1000 }],
      total: 9999,
    });
    expect(itemsSum(inv.items)).not.toBe(inv.total);
    expect(itemsSum(inv.items)).toBe(1000);
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// INVARIANT 2: remaining=0 → partyCredit=0
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('INVARIANT: remaining=0 → partyCredit=0', () => {
  it('invoice تسویه با cash → credit صفر', () => {
    const inv = makeInvoice({
      total: 1000,
      payments: [
        { id: 'pay1', amount: 1000, method: 'cash', date: '1405/07/01', checkNo: '', bank: '', dueDate: '', notes: '' } as any,
      ],
    });
    useTra.setState({ invoices: [inv] } as any);

    expect(remaining(inv)).toBe(0);
    expect(computePartyCredit('p1', [inv])).toBe(0);
  });

  it('cash discount → remaining=0 و credit=0 (باگ قبلی: -50)', () => {
    const inv = makeInvoice({
      total: 1000,
      payments: [
        { id: 'pay1', amount: 950, method: 'cash', date: '1405/07/01', checkNo: '', bank: '', dueDate: '', notes: '' } as any,
      ],
      cashDiscountPct: 5,
      cashDiscountDays: 30,
    });
    useTra.setState({ invoices: [inv] } as any);

    expect(remaining(inv)).toBe(0);
    expect(computePartyCredit('p1', [inv])).toBe(0);
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// INVARIANT 3: delete(add(inv)) → no orphan
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('INVARIANT: delete(add(inv)) → no orphan', () => {
  it('فروش تخم → delete → egg.sales صفر (باگ قبلی: orphan)', () => {
    const inv = makeInvoice({
      type: 'sale',
      category: 'egg',
      items: [
        {
          id: 'i1', description: 'تخم', category: 'egg', unit: 'pcs',
          quantity: 100, unitPrice: 500, total: 50000,
        },
      ],
      total: 50000,
    });

    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv as any);
    expect(useEgg.getState().sales.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    useTra.getState().deleteInvoice(id);
    expect(useEgg.getState().sales.length).toBe(0);
  });

  it('خرید جوجه → delete → گله بدون sourceInvoiceId (باگ قبلی: orphan)', () => {
    const inv = makeInvoice({
      type: 'purchase',
      category: 'chick',
      items: [
        {
          id: 'i1', description: 'جوجه', category: 'chick',
          birdId: 'b1', breedId: 'br1', unit: 'pcs',
          quantity: 100, healthyCount: 95, unitPrice: 10000, total: 950000,
        },
      ],
      total: 950000,
    });

    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv as any);
    const flocksWithSource = useFlk.getState().flocks.filter((f: any) => f.sourceInvoiceId === id);
    expect(flocksWithSource.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    useTra.getState().deleteInvoice(id);
    const orphans = useFlk.getState().flocks.filter((f: any) => f.sourceInvoiceId === id);
    expect(orphans.length).toBe(0);
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// INVARIANT 4: currentCount >= 0
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('INVARIANT: currentCount >= 0', () => {
  it('پس از delete، گله منفی نیست', () => {
    const inv = makeInvoice({
      type: 'purchase',
      category: 'chick',
      items: [
        {
          id: 'i1', description: 'جوجه', category: 'chick',
          birdId: 'b1', breedId: 'br1', unit: 'pcs',
          quantity: 100, healthyCount: 95, unitPrice: 10000, total: 950000,
        },
      ],
      total: 950000,
    });

    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv as any);
    useTra.getState().deleteInvoice(id);

    const flocks = useFlk.getState().flocks;
    flocks.forEach((f: any) => {
      expect(f.currentCount ?? 0).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    });
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// INVARIANT 5: check bounced → paidSum نادیده
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('INVARIANT: check bounced → paidSum=0', () => {
  it('چک برگشتی در paidSum حساب نمی‌شه', async () => {
    const { paidSum } = await import('../mod/tra/calc');
    const inv = makeInvoice({
      total: 1000,
      payments: [
        {
          id: 'p1', amount: 1000, method: 'check', status: 'bounced',
          date: '1405/07/01', checkNo: '', bank: '', dueDate: '', notes: '',
        } as any,
      ],
    });
    expect(paidSum(inv.payments)).toBe(0);
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// INVARIANT 6: aging از dueDate نه date
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('INVARIANT: aging از dueDate (نه invoice age)', () => {
  it('invoice تازه با dueDate گذشته → overdue (نه age)', async () => {
    const { daysUntilDue } = await import('../mod/tra/helpers');
    const inv = makeInvoice({
      date: '1405/07/10',
      dueDate: '1405/07/01',
    });
    const d = daysUntilDue(inv);
    expect(d).not.toBeNull();
    expect(d!).toBeLessThan(0);
  });

  it('invoice قدیمی با dueDate آینده → not overdue', async () => {
    const { daysUntilDue } = await import('../mod/tra/helpers');
    const inv = makeInvoice({
      date: '1404/01/01',
      dueDate: '1405/12/29',
    });
    const d = daysUntilDue(inv);
    expect(d).not.toBeNull();
    expect(d!).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { jalaliToDate, toJalali } from '../mod/flk/helpers-store';

describe('jalaliToDate — پیش‌نیاز آرشیو سرد', () => {
  it('تاریخ استاندارد لاگ را می‌پارس می‌کند', () => {
    const d = jalaliToDate('1405/11/17');
    expect(d).not.toBeNull();
    expect(d!.getFullYear()).toBe(2027);   // ۱۴۰۵/۱۱/۱۷ ≈ ۲۰۲۷-۰۲-۰۶
  });

  it('ماه و روز یک‌رقمی را صفر-پد می‌کند', () => {
    const a = jalaliToDate('1405/1/5');
    const b = jalaliToDate('1405/01/05');
    expect(a).not.toBeNull();
    expect(b).not.toBeNull();
    expect(a!.getTime()).toBe(b!.getTime());
  });

  it('ارقام فارسی را می‌پذیرد', () => {
    const d = jalaliToDate('۱۴۰۵/۱۱/۱۷');
    expect(d).not.toBeNull();
    expect(d!.getTime()).toBe(jalaliToDate('1405/11/17')!.getTime());
  });

  it('ورودی خالی یا نامعتبر → null (بدون حدس)', () => {
    expect(jalaliToDate('')).toBeNull();
    expect(jalaliToDate('abc')).toBeNull();
    expect(jalaliToDate('1405/11')).toBeNull();
    expect(jalaliToDate('1405/11/17/1')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('ترتیب زمانی درست است (برای مقایسه با آستانه)', () => {
    const old = jalaliToDate('1404/01/01')!;
    const mid = jalaliToDate('1405/06/01')!;
    const now = jalaliToDate('1405/11/17')!;
    expect(old.getTime()).toBeLessThan(mid.getTime());
    expect(mid.getTime()).toBeLessThan(now.getTime());
  });

  it('رفت‌وبرگشت toJalali → jalaliToDate', () => {
    const iso = '2026-11-18T00:00:00.000Z';
    const j = toJalali(iso);
    const back = jalaliToDate(j);
    expect(back).not.toBeNull();
    expect(back!.getUTCFullYear()).toBe(2026);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  moneyAdd, moneySub, moneyMul, moneyDiv, moneyRound,
  moneyPercent, moneyApplyDiscount, moneySum, moneyEquals,
  moneyGreaterThan, moneyLessThan,
} from '../shr/utils/money';

describe('money utilities — دقت مالی', () => {
  describe('عملیات پایه', () => {
    it('moneyAdd: 0.1 + 0.2 = 0.3 (نه 0.30000000000000004)', () => {
      expect(moneyAdd(0.1, 0.2)).toBe(0.3);
    });

    it('moneyAdd: امن در برابر null/undefined/empty', () => {
      expect(moneyAdd(null, 5)).toBe(5);
      expect(moneyAdd(undefined, 5)).toBe(5);
      expect(moneyAdd('', 5)).toBe(5);
      expect(moneyAdd(null, null)).toBe(0);
    });

    it('moneyAdd: هندل کردن رشته‌های نامعتبر', () => {
      expect(moneyAdd('abc', 5)).toBe(5);
      expect(moneyAdd('100', '200')).toBe(300);
    });

    it('moneySub: 100 - 33.33 = 66.67', () => {
      expect(moneySub(100, 33.33)).toBe(66.67);
    });

    it('moneyMul: 100,000 × 0.02 = 2,000 دقیق', () => {
      expect(moneyMul(100000, 0.02)).toBe(2000);
    });

    it('moneyMul: 333,333 × 0.02 = 6,666.66', () => {
      expect(moneyMul(333333, 0.02)).toBe(6666.66);
    });

    it('moneyMul: اعداد بزرگ', () => {
      expect(moneyMul(1000000, 1000000)).toBe(1000000000000);
    });

    it('moneyDiv: تقسیم با دقت', () => {
      expect(moneyDiv(100, 3)).toBeCloseTo(33.333333, 5);
    });

    it('moneyDiv: تقسیم بر صفر → 0', () => {
      expect(moneyDiv(100, 0)).toBe(0);
    });
  });

  describe('گرد کردن', () => {
    it('moneyRound: 2.5 → 3 (half-up)', () => {
      expect(moneyRound(2.5, 0)).toBe(3);
    });

    it('moneyRound: 2.4 → 2', () => {
      expect(moneyRound(2.4, 0)).toBe(2);
    });

    it('moneyRound: با ۲ رقم اعشار', () => {
      expect(moneyRound(2.567, 2)).toBe(2.57);
    });
  });

  describe('درصدها', () => {
    it('moneyPercent: ۲٪ از ۱۰۰,۰۰۰ = ۲,۰۰۰', () => {
      expect(moneyPercent(100000, 2)).toBe(2000);
    });

    it('moneyApplyDiscount: ۱۰۰,۰۰۰ با ۲٪ تخفیف = ۹۸,۰۰۰', () => {
      expect(moneyApplyDiscount(100000, 2)).toBe(98000);
    });

    it('moneyApplyDiscount: تخفیف ۰٪ → همان مبلغ', () => {
      expect(moneyApplyDiscount(100000, 0)).toBe(100000);
    });
  });

  describe('جمع گروهی', () => {
    it('moneySum: 0.1 + 0.2 + 0.3 = 0.6', () => {
      expect(moneySum([0.1, 0.2, 0.3])).toBe(0.6);
    });

    it('moneySum: آرایه خالی → 0', () => {
      expect(moneySum([])).toBe(0);
    });

    it('moneySum: مقادیر null/undefined', () => {
      expect(moneySum([10, null, 20, undefined, 30])).toBe(60);
    });
  });

  describe('مقایسه‌ها', () => {
    it('moneyEquals: 0.3 == 0.1 + 0.2', () => {
      expect(moneyEquals(0.3, moneyAdd(0.1, 0.2))).toBe(true);
    });

    it('moneyGreaterThan: 10 > 5', () => {
      expect(moneyGreaterThan(10, 5)).toBe(true);
      expect(moneyGreaterThan(5, 10)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('moneyLessThan: 5 < 10', () => {
      expect(moneyLessThan(5, 10)).toBe(true);
      expect(moneyLessThan(10, 5)).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('سناریوهای واقعی فاکتور', () => {
    it('فاکتور خرید جوجه: ۱۰,۰۰۰ × ۱۵,۰۰۰ = ۱۵۰,۰۰۰,۰۰۰', () => {
      const qty = 10000;
      const price = 15000;
      expect(moneyMul(qty, price)).toBe(150000000);
    });

    it('تخفیف ۲٪ نقدی روی ۱۵۰ میلیون = ۳ میلیون تخفیف', () => {
      const total = 150000000;
      const afterDiscount = moneyApplyDiscount(total, 2);
      expect(afterDiscount).toBe(147000000);
    });

    it('پرداخت جزئی: ۱۰۰ میلیون - ۳۰ میلیون پیش‌پرداخت - ۵ میلیون بستانکاری = ۶۵ میلیون', () => {
      const total = 100000000;
      const paid = 30000000;
      const credit = 5000000;
      const remaining = moneySub(moneySub(total, paid), credit);
      expect(remaining).toBe(65000000);
    });

    it('جمع اقلام فاکتور با اعشار', () => {
      const items = [
        moneyMul(100, 1500.5),
        moneyMul(50, 2500.75),
        moneyMul(200, 3000.25),
      ];
      expect(moneySum(items)).toBe(150050 + 125037.5 + 600050);
    });
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/phase7-reopen.test.ts

/**
 * phase7-reopen.test.ts — تست integration برای reopen فاکتور + guard
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useTra } from '../mod/tra/store';

function resetStore() {
  useTra.setState({ invoices: [], partyPayments: [], deals: [] } as any);
}

function addBasicInvoice(): string {
  return useTra.getState().addInvoice({
    type: 'purchase',
    date: '1404/07/29',
    partyId: '',
    category: 'feed',
    items: [],
    total: 0,
    payments: [],
    dueDate: '',
    relatedFlockId: '',
    relatedEntryId: '',
    notes: 'initial',
  } as any);
}

function setPaid(id: string) {
  useTra.setState({
    invoices: useTra.getState().invoices.map(i =>
      i.id === id ? { ...i, paidAt: '2024-10-20', workflowStatus: 'paid' as any } : i
    ),
  } as any);
}

describe('Phase 7 — Invoice Reopen + Lock', () => {
  beforeEach(resetStore);

  it('reopenInvoice on non-paid → no-op', () => {
    const id = addBasicInvoice();
    const before = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
    expect(before.paidAt).toBeFalsy();
    useTra.getState().reopenInvoice(id);
    const after = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
    expect(after.paidAt).toBeFalsy();
  });

  it('reopenInvoice on paid → clears paidAt + workflowStatus confirmed', () => {
    const id = addBasicInvoice();
    setPaid(id);
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!.paidAt).toBe('2024-10-20');
    useTra.getState().reopenInvoice(id);
    const after = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
    expect(after.paidAt).toBe('');
    expect(after.workflowStatus).toBe('confirmed');
  });

  it('updateInvoice on paid → blocked (guard)', () => {
    const id = addBasicInvoice();
    setPaid(id);
    useTra.getState().updateInvoice(id, { notes: 'should not change' } as any);
    const after = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
    expect(after.notes).toBe('initial');
  });

  it('updateInvoice after reopen → allowed', () => {
    const id = addBasicInvoice();
    setPaid(id);
    useTra.getState().reopenInvoice(id);
    useTra.getState().updateInvoice(id, { notes: 'edited' } as any);
    const after = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
    expect(after.notes).toBe('edited');
  });
});

/**
 * preorder-lifecycle.test.ts
 *
 * تست چرخه کامل «پیش‌خرید» طبق استاندارد جهانی:
 * - پیش‌خرید فقط تعهد ثبت می‌کنه (گله/موجودی نمی‌سازه)
 * - بعد از تحویل (isPreorder: true -> false) گله/موجودی ساخته می‌شه
 * - تاریخ گله/موجودی = deliveryDate (نه تاریخ فاکتور)
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useTra } from '../mod/tra/store';
import { useFlk } from '../mod/flk/store';
import { useWhs } from '../mod/whs/store';
import { useBrd } from '../mod/brd/store';
import { useInc } from '../mod/inc/store';

function resetStores() {
  useTra.setState({ invoices: [], partyPayments: [], deals: [] });
  useFlk.setState({ flocks: [], groups: [], groupMembers: [] });
  useWhs.setState({ items: [], movements: [] });
  useBrd.setState({ birds: [], breeds: [] });
  useInc.setState({ devices: [], eggEntries: [], hatchGroups: [], candlings: [], results: [] } as any);
}

function seedBirdAndBreed() {
  useBrd.setState({
    birds: [{ id: 'bird-1', name: 'گوشتی' }] as any,
    breeds: [{ id: 'breed-1', name: 'راس ۳۰۸', birdId: 'bird-1' }] as any,
  });
}

function seedWarehouseItem() {
  useWhs.setState({
    items: [{
      id: 'item-feed', name: 'دان استارتر', category: 'feed',
      unit: 'kg', minStock: 0, currentStock: 0, lastPrice: 0,
      supplierId: '', expireDate: '', withdrawalDays: null,
      storage: 'room', notes: '',
      createdAt: '', updatedAt: '',
    }] as any,
    movements: [],
  });
}

const baseInvoice = (overrides: any) => ({
  type: 'purchase' as const,
  date: '1405/07/27',
  partyId: 'party-1',
  category: 'chick',
  total: 20_000_000,
  payments: [] as any[],
  dueDate: '1405/08/15',
  relatedFlockId: '',
  relatedEntryId: '',
  notes: '',
  items: [] as any[],
  ...overrides,
});

describe('Preorder lifecycle — chick', () => {
  beforeEach(() => { resetStores(); seedBirdAndBreed(); });

  it('preorder save: does NOT create flock', () => {
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(baseInvoice({
      isPreorder: true,
      deliveryDate: '1405/08/15',
      items: [{
        id: 'i1', description: 'جوجه راس', unit: 'pcs',
        quantity: 1000, unitPrice: 20000, total: 20_000_000,
        birdId: 'bird-1', breedId: 'breed-1',
      }],
    }) as any);

    expect(useFlk.getState().flocks).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices[0].isPreorder).toBe(true);
  });

  it('receiving preorder: creates flock using deliveryDate', () => {
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(baseInvoice({
      isPreorder: true,
      deliveryDate: '1405/08/15',
      items: [{
        id: 'i1', description: 'جوجه راس', unit: 'pcs',
        quantity: 1000, unitPrice: 20000, total: 20_000_000,
        birdId: 'bird-1', breedId: 'breed-1',
      }],
    }) as any);

    // Receive: isPreorder true -> false
    useTra.getState().updateInvoice(id, { isPreorder: false, workflowStatus: 'received' });

    const flocks = useFlk.getState().flocks;
    expect(flocks).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(flocks[0].initialCount).toBe(1000);
    // ✅ تاریخ خرید = تاریخ تحویل (نه تاریخ فاکتور)
    expect(flocks[0].purchaseDate).toBe('1405/08/15');
    expect(flocks[0].startDate).toBe('1405/08/15');
  });

it('receiving preorder: uses user hatchDate and transportCost', () => {
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(baseInvoice({
      isPreorder: true,
      deliveryDate: '1405/08/15',
      items: [{
        id: 'i1', description: 'جوجه راس', unit: 'pcs',
        quantity: 1000, unitPrice: 20000, total: 20_000_000,
        birdId: 'bird-1', breedId: 'breed-1',
        hatchDate: '1405/08/10',  // کاربر مستقیماً وارد کرد
        transportCost: 50000,      // هزینه حمل
        flockName: 'گله تست',
      }],
    }) as any);

    useTra.getState().updateInvoice(id, { isPreorder: false, workflowStatus: 'received' });

    const flocks = useFlk.getState().flocks;
    expect(flocks).toHaveLength(1);
    // ✅ تاریخ هچ باید ورودی کاربر باشد، نه محاسبه از ageDays
    expect(flocks[0].hatchDate).toBe('1405/08/10');
    // ✅ هزینه حمل باید منتقل شود
    expect(flocks[0].deliveryCost).toBe(50000);
    // ✅ نام گله باید ورودی کاربر باشد
    expect(flocks[0].name).toBe('گله تست');
  });
});

describe('Preorder lifecycle — feed (warehouse)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => { resetStores(); seedWarehouseItem(); });

  it('preorder save: does NOT create movement', () => {
    useTra.getState().addInvoice(baseInvoice({
      isPreorder: true,
      deliveryDate: '1405/08/15',
      category: 'feed',
      items: [{
        id: 'i1', description: 'دان', unit: 'kg',
        quantity: 500, unitPrice: 15000, total: 7_500_000,
        itemId: 'item-feed',
      }],
    }) as any);

    expect(useWhs.getState().movements).toHaveLength(0);
  });
});

describe('Stock (non-preorder) baseline', () => {
  beforeEach(() => { resetStores(); seedBirdAndBreed(); });

  it('stock purchase: creates flock immediately', () => {
    useTra.getState().addInvoice(baseInvoice({
      isPreorder: false,
      items: [{
        id: 'i1', description: 'جوجه راس', unit: 'pcs',
        quantity: 500, unitPrice: 20000, total: 10_000_000,
        birdId: 'bird-1', breedId: 'breed-1',
      }],
    }) as any);

    expect(useFlk.getState().flocks).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(useFlk.getState().flocks[0].purchaseDate).toBe('1405/07/27');
  

});
});

/**
 * receivables-deals.test.ts — تست‌های L11 برای منطق معاملات در مطالبات
 * پوشش: computeDealBalance + dealDaysUntilDue + agingBucketFromDeal + isDealOpen
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { computeDealBalance, computeDealInHand, dealDaysUntilDue, agingBucketFromDeal, isDealOpen } from '../mod/tra/calc';
import type { Deal } from '../mod/tra/types';

const mkDeal = (o: Partial<Deal> = {}): Deal => ({
  id: 'd1', type: 'consignment', date: '1405/08/01', partyId: 'p1',
  description: 'تست', value: 0, percent: null, dueDate: '', status: 'open',
  notes: '', sales: [], payments: [],
  createdAt: '', updatedAt: '',
  ...o,
} as Deal);

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// computeDealBalance
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('computeDealBalance', () => {
  it('کمیسیون درصدی درست محاسبه می‌شود', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({
      settlementType: 'percent', settlementValue: 15,
      sales: [{ id: 's1', goodId: 'g1', date: '', quantity: 100, unitPrice: 1000 }],
    });
    const b = computeDealBalance(d);
    expect(b.totalSales).toBe(100000);
    expect(b.commission).toBe(15000);
    expect(b.myShare).toBe(85000);
    expect(b.balance).toBe(85000);
  });

  it('تسویه مبلغ ثابت — کمیسیون = مقدار ثابت', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({
      settlementType: 'fixed', settlementValue: 5000,
      sales: [{ id: 's1', goodId: 'g1', date: '', quantity: 10, unitPrice: 1000 }],
    });
    const b = computeDealBalance(d);
    expect(b.commission).toBe(5000);
    expect(b.myShare).toBe(5000);
  });

  it('پرداخت‌های ورودی (دریافت) از مانده کم می‌کند', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({
      sales: [{ id: 's1', goodId: 'g1', date: '', quantity: 10, unitPrice: 1000 }],
      payments: [{ id: 'p1', date: '', amount: 3000, direction: 'in', method: 'cash' }],
    });
    const b = computeDealBalance(d);
    expect(b.paidIn).toBe(3000);
    expect(b.balance).toBe(7000); // 10000 - 3000
  });

  it('پرداخت‌های خروجی (پرداخت به طرف) به مانده اضافه می‌کند', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({
      sales: [{ id: 's1', goodId: 'g1', date: '', quantity: 10, unitPrice: 1000 }],
      payments: [{ id: 'p1', date: '', amount: 2000, direction: 'out', method: 'cash' }],
    });
    const b = computeDealBalance(d);
    expect(b.paidOut).toBe(2000);
    expect(b.balance).toBe(12000); // 10000 + 2000
  });

  it('فروش‌های چندگانه جمع می‌شوند', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({
      sales: [
        { id: 's1', goodId: 'g1', date: '', quantity: 5, unitPrice: 100 },
        { id: 's2', goodId: 'g2', date: '', quantity: 10, unitPrice: 200 },
      ],
    });
    expect(computeDealBalance(d).totalSales).toBe(2500);
  });
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// dealDaysUntilDue
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('dealDaysUntilDue', () => {
  it('بدون dueDate → null', () => {
    expect(dealDaysUntilDue(mkDeal({ dueDate: '' }))).toBeNull();
  });

  it('تاریخ نامعتبر → null', () => {
    expect(dealDaysUntilDue(mkDeal({ dueDate: 'invalid' }))).toBeNull();
  });
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// agingBucketFromDeal
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('agingBucketFromDeal', () => {
  it('بدون dueDate → current (پیش‌فرض)', () => {
    expect(agingBucketFromDeal(mkDeal())).toBe('current');
  });
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// isDealOpen
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('isDealOpen', () => {
  it('وضعیت settled → false', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({ status: 'settled' });
    expect(isDealOpen(d, [])).toBe(false);
  });

  it('وضعیت cancelled → false', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({ status: 'cancelled' });
    expect(isDealOpen(d, [])).toBe(false);
  });

  it('تبدیل به فاکتور شده (relatedDealId) → false', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({ status: 'open', sales: [{ id: 's1', goodId: 'g1', date: '', quantity: 1, unitPrice: 100 }] });
    expect(isDealOpen(d, [{ relatedDealId: d.id }])).toBe(false);
  });

  it('مانده صفر → false', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({ status: 'open', sales: [], payments: [] });
    expect(isDealOpen(d, [])).toBe(false);
  });

  it('باز + مانده غیرصفر → true', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({ status: 'open', sales: [{ id: 's1', goodId: 'g1', date: '', quantity: 1, unitPrice: 100 }] });
    expect(isDealOpen(d, [])).toBe(true);
  });
});describe('isDealOpen', () => {
  it('وضعیت settled → false', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({ status: 'settled' });
    expect(isDealOpen(d, [])).toBe(false);
  });

  it('وضعیت cancelled → false', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({ status: 'cancelled' });
    expect(isDealOpen(d, [])).toBe(false);
  });

  it('تبدیل به فاکتور شده (relatedDealId) → false', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({ status: 'open', sales: [{ id: 's1', goodId: 'g1', date: '', quantity: 1, unitPrice: 100 }] });
    expect(isDealOpen(d, [{ relatedDealId: d.id }])).toBe(false);
  });

  it('مانده صفر → false', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({ status: 'open', sales: [], payments: [] });
    expect(isDealOpen(d, [])).toBe(false);
  });

  it('باز + مانده غیرصفر → true', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({ status: 'open', sales: [{ id: 's1', goodId: 'g1', date: '', quantity: 1, unitPrice: 100 }] });
    expect(isDealOpen(d, [])).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('computeDealInHand', () => {
  it('inHand = out - return - loss - sold', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({
      deliveries: [
        { id: 'd1', goodId: 'g1', type: 'out', quantity: 100, date: '1405/08/15' } as any,
        { id: 'd2', goodId: 'g1', type: 'return', quantity: 5, date: '1405/08/20' } as any,
        { id: 'd3', goodId: 'g1', type: 'loss', quantity: 3, date: '1405/08/21' } as any,
      ],
      sales: [{ id: 's1', goodId: 'g1', date: '1405/08/22', quantity: 85, unitPrice: 100 }],
    });
    expect(computeDealInHand(d)).toBe(7);
  });

  it('بدون تحویل → 0', () => {
    expect(computeDealInHand(mkDeal())).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('isDealOpen — inHand', () => {
  it('balance=0 ولی inHand>0 → true', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({
      status: 'open',
      deliveries: [
        { id: 'd1', goodId: 'g1', type: 'out', quantity: 100, date: '1405/08/15' } as any,
      ],
      sales: [{ id: 's1', goodId: 'g1', date: '1405/08/22', quantity: 85, unitPrice: 100 }],
      payments: [{ id: 'p1', date: '1405/08/22', amount: 8500, direction: 'in', method: 'cash' } as any],
    });
    expect(isDealOpen(d, [])).toBe(true);
  });

  it('balance=0 AND inHand=0 → false', () => {
    const d = mkDeal({
      status: 'open',
      deliveries: [
        { id: 'd1', goodId: 'g1', type: 'out', quantity: 85, date: '1405/08/15' } as any,
      ],
      sales: [{ id: 's1', goodId: 'g1', date: '1405/08/22', quantity: 85, unitPrice: 100 }],
      payments: [{ id: 'p1', date: '1405/08/22', amount: 8500, direction: 'in', method: 'cash' } as any],
    });
    expect(isDealOpen(d, [])).toBe(false);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useWhs } from '../mod/whs/store';
import { useTra } from '../mod/tra/store';
import { clearRecycleBin, listRecycleBin } from '../shr/utils/recycleBin';
import type { DeletedInvoiceSnapshot } from '../mod/tra/types';

describe('Recycle Bin — Backup Before Mutation', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    useWhs.setState({ items: [], movements: [] });
    useTra.setState({ invoices: [] });
    clearRecycleBin('tra');
  });

  it('حذف فاکتور → ثبت در recycle bin → بازیابی موفق', () => {
    // ۱. ساخت فاکتور
    const invId = useTra.getState().addInvoice({
      type: 'sale',
      date: '1405/07/21',
      partyId: 'p1',
      category: 'other',
      items: [{
        id: 'item-1',
        category: 'other',
        description: 'کالای تست',
        quantity: 1,
        unitPrice: 100000,
        total: 100000,
      }],
      payments: [],
      discount: 0,
      shipping: 0,
      total: 100000,
    } as any);

    expect(useTra.getState().invoices).toHaveLength(1);

    // ۲. حذف
    useTra.getState().deleteInvoice(invId);
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices).toHaveLength(0);

    // ۳. چک کردن recycle bin
    const bin = useTra.getState().listDeletedInvoices();
    expect(bin).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(bin[0].invoice.id).toBe(invId);

    // ۴. بازیابی
    const ok = useTra.getState().restoreInvoice(invId);
    expect(ok).toBe(true);
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices[0].id).toBe(invId);

    // ۵. recycle bin خالی شد
    expect(listRecycleBin<DeletedInvoiceSnapshot>('tra')).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('بازیابی فاکتور ناموجود → false', () => {
    const ok = useTra.getState().restoreInvoice('nonexistent-id');
    expect(ok).toBe(false);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useFlk } from '../mod/flk/store';

const makeFlock = (o: any = {}): any => ({
  id: 'f-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9),
  name: 'گله', type: 'layer', status: 'active',
  birdId: 'b1', breedId: 'br1',
  hallId: '', zoneId: '',
  initialCount: 0, currentCount: 0,
  maleCount: 0, femaleCount: 0, unknownCount: 0,
  layingStartDay: 0, endOfCycleDay: null,
  vaccineScheduleId: '', hatchDate: '', purchaseDate: '', startDate: '',
  source: '', purchasePrice: 0, deliveryCost: 0, otherCosts: 0,
  notes: '', events: [], sexingEvents: [], sexBalanceEvents: [],
  genderSplitAt: null,
  createdAt: '2026-01-01', updatedAt: '2026-01-01',
  ...o,
});

const S = (g: any) => (g.maleCount ?? 0) + (g.femaleCount ?? 0) + (g.unknownCount ?? 0);

const makeInvoice = (o: any = {}): any => ({
  id: 'inv-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9),
  type: 'sale', number: 'S1', date: '1405/08/10',
  partyId: 'p1', category: 'adult',
  items: [], total: 0, payments: [], dueDate: '',
  relatedFlockId: '', relatedEntryId: '',
  notes: '', createdAt: '2026-01-01', updatedAt: '2026-01-01',
  ...o,
});

beforeEach(() => {
  useFlk.setState({ flocks: [], groups: [], groupMembers: [] } as any);
  useBrd.setState({ birds: [], breeds: [] } as any);
  useTra.setState({ invoices: [] } as any);
  clearRecycleBin('tra');
});

describe('B7 — sell events باید un-revoke شوند', () => {
  it('event فروش revoked پس از restore → un-revoke', () => {
    const flockId = 'f1';
    const invoiceId = 'inv-1';
    useFlk.setState({
      flocks: [makeFlock({
        id: flockId,
        initialCount: 100, currentCount: 100,
        maleCount: 50, femaleCount: 50, unknownCount: 0,
        genderSplitAt: '1405/08/01',
        events: [{
          id: 'sell-inv-1',
          flockId,
          date: '1405/08/10',
          type: 'sell',
          count: 10,
          sex: 'male',
          direction: -1,
          invoiceId,
          notes: 'فروش اصلی',
          revoked: true,
          createdAt: '2026-01-01',
        } as any],
      })],
      groups: [], groupMembers: [],
    } as any);

    // ← درست: از saveToRecycleBin واقعی استفاده کن
    saveToRecycleBin<any>(
      'tra',
      {
        invoice: makeInvoice({ id: invoiceId }),
        linkedFlocks: [{ id: flockId, sourceCategory: 'adult', birdId: 'b1', breedId: 'br1' }],
      },
      (existing) => existing.invoice.id === invoiceId,
    );

    const ok = useTra.getState().restoreInvoice(invoiceId);
    expect(ok).toBe(true);

    const g = useFlk.getState().flocks.find((f: any) => f.id === flockId)!;
    const sellEv = (g.events || []).find((e: any) => e.id === 'sell-inv-1');
    expect(sellEv).toBeDefined();
    expect(sellEv!.revoked).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('B1r atomic — روی throw هیچ mutation نباید انجام شود', () => {
  it('بعد از throw: invoices خالی، recycleBin سالم', async () => {
    const { listRecycleBin } = await import('../shr/utils/recycleBin');
    const flockId = 'f3';
    const invoiceId = 'inv-3';
    useFlk.setState({
      flocks: [makeFlock({
        id: flockId,

        maleCount: 2, femaleCount: 98, unknownCount: 0,

      })],
      groups: [], groupMembers: [],
    } as any);

    saveToRecycleBin<any>(
      'tra',
      {
        invoice: makeInvoice({
          id: invoiceId,
          items: [{
            id: 'i1', description: 'مرغ', category: 'adult',
            birdId: 'b1', breedId: 'br1', unit: 'pcs',

            flockId, maleCount: 10,
          }],
          total: 100000,
        }),
        linkedFlocks: [{ id: flockId, sourceCategory: 'adult', birdId: 'b1', breedId: 'br1' }],

      (existing) => existing.invoice.id === invoiceId,

    // Atomic: هیچ mutation نباید انجام شده باشد
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices.find((i: any) => i.id === invoiceId)).toBeUndefined();
    const binEntries = listRecycleBin<any>('tra');

  });

    useFlk.setState({
      flocks: [makeFlock({
        id: flockId,
        initialCount: 100, currentCount: 100,

        genderSplitAt: '1405/08/01',
      })],
      groups: [], groupMembers: [],
    } as any);

    saveToRecycleBin<any>(
      'tra',
      {
        invoice: makeInvoice({
          id: invoiceId,
          items: [
            {
              id: 'i1', description: 'مرغ', category: 'adult',
              birdId: 'b1', breedId: 'br1', unit: 'pcs',
              quantity: 10, unitPrice: 10000, total: 100000,
              flockId, maleCount: 10,
            },
            {
              id: 'i2', description: 'مرغ', category: 'adult',
              birdId: 'b1', breedId: 'br1', unit: 'pcs',
              quantity: 20, unitPrice: 10000, total: 200000,
              flockId, maleCount: 20,
            },
          ],

    expect(ok).toBe(true);

    const g = useFlk.getState().flocks.find((f: any) => f.id === flockId)!;
    // stacking: 100 - 10 - 20 = 70 (نه 80 از state اولیه)
    expect(g.currentCount).toBe(70);
    expect(g.maleCount).toBe(70);
    expect(S(g)).toBe(g.currentCount);
  });

FILE: ./src/test/rules-parse.test.ts
==========================================
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { format, parse, startOfDay, differenceInCalendarDays, addDays } from 'date-fns-jalali';

// تست ریاضی که ثابت کنه باگ رفع شده
describe('jalali date comparison — the fix logic', () => {
  const jalaliDate = (s: string): Date | null => {
    if (!s) return null;
    const en = s.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));
    const d = parse(en, 'yyyy/MM/dd', new Date());
    return startOfDay(d);
  };

  it('امروز → diff 0', () => {
    const today = format(new Date(), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
    const d = jalaliDate(today)!;
    const diff = differenceInCalendarDays(startOfDay(new Date()), d);
    expect(diff).toBe(0);
  });

  it('دیروز → diff 1', () => {
    const yesterday = format(addDays(startOfDay(new Date()), -1), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
    const d = jalaliDate(yesterday)!;
    const diff = differenceInCalendarDays(startOfDay(new Date()), d);
    expect(diff).toBe(1);
  });

  it('3 روز پیش → diff 3 (در بازه)', () => {
    const past = format(addDays(startOfDay(new Date()), -3), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
    const d = jalaliDate(past)!;
    const diff = differenceInCalendarDays(startOfDay(new Date()), d);
    expect(diff).toBe(3);
  });

  it('4 روز پیش → diff 4 (خارج از بازه)', () => {
    const past = format(addDays(startOfDay(new Date()), -4), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
    const d = jalaliDate(past)!;
    const diff = differenceInCalendarDays(startOfDay(new Date()), d);
    expect(diff).toBe(4);
  });

  it('باگ قدیم: new Date(1405, 6, 9) → diff عظیم منفی', () => {
    // اثبات که چرا قدیم کار نمیکرد
    const parts = [1405, 7, 9];
    const bad = new Date(parts[0], parts[1] - 1, parts[2]);
    const diff = Math.floor((Date.now() - bad.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    // سال 1405 میلادی → ~226,000 روز اختلاف
    expect(Math.abs(diff)).toBeGreaterThan(200000);
  });
});

describe('rules — stock warnings', () => {

    useWhs.setState({
      items: [{
        id: 'i1', name: 'دان', category: 'feed', unit: 'kg',

      }] as any,

    expect(stockAlert).toBeTruthy();

    expect(stockAlert!.category).toBe('stock');
  });

  it('stock < min → low alert', () => {
    useWhs.setState({
      items: [{
        id: 'i1', name: 'دان', category: 'feed', unit: 'kg',

/**
 * setup.ts — Global test setup
 */
import '@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest';
import { afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

afterEach(() => {
  cleanup();
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// 🆕 ResizeObserver — هوشمند (callback می‌زنه)
// useCarousel برای اندازه‌گیری از این استفاده می‌کنه
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
class ResizeObserverMock {
  private cb: ResizeObserverCallback;
  constructor(cb: ResizeObserverCallback) {
    this.cb = cb;
  }
  observe(target: Element) {
    const fakeEntry = {
      target,
      contentRect: {
        width: 400, height: 300, top: 0, left: 0, right: 400, bottom: 300, x: 0, y: 0,
        toJSON: () => ({}),
      },
      borderBoxSize: [{ inlineSize: 400, blockSize: 300 }],
      contentBoxSize: [{ inlineSize: 400, blockSize: 300 }],
      devicePixelContentBoxSize: [{ inlineSize: 400, blockSize: 300 }],
    } as unknown as ResizeObserverEntry;
    Promise.resolve().then(() => this.cb([fakeEntry], this as unknown as ResizeObserver));
  }
  unobserve() {}
  disconnect() {}
}

if (typeof globalThis.ResizeObserver === 'undefined') {
  globalThis.ResizeObserver = ResizeObserverMock as unknown as typeof ResizeObserver;
}

if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && !window.matchMedia) {
  Object.defineProperty(window, 'matchMedia', {
    writable: true,
    value: vi.fn().mockImplementation((query: string) => ({
      matches: false,
      media: query,
      onchange: null,
      addListener: vi.fn(),
      removeListener: vi.fn(),
      addEventListener: vi.fn(),
      removeEventListener: vi.fn(),
      dispatchEvent: vi.fn(),
    })),
  });
}

class IntersectionObserverMock {
  observe() {}
  unobserve() {}
  disconnect() {}
  takeRecords() { return []; }
}

if (typeof globalThis.IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {
  globalThis.IntersectionObserver = IntersectionObserverMock as unknown as typeof IntersectionObserver;
}

import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import { computeSexingStats } from '../mod/dsh/sexingWidgetLogic';

vi.mock('../mod/flk/store', () => ({
  getAgeDays: (f: any) => f.__ageDays ?? 0,
}));

const makeFlock = (o: any = {}) => ({
  id: 'f1', type: 'breeder', genderSplitAt: null, breedId: 'br1',
  sexingAgeOverride: null, __ageDays: 0, ...o,
});
const breeds = [{ id: 'br1', name: 'Marandi' }];
const stdOk = (name: string) => name === 'Marandi' ? 56 : null;
const stdNull = () => null;

describe('computeSexingStats', () => {
  it('age=60, std=56 → overdue=1', () => {
    expect(computeSexingStats([makeFlock({ __ageDays: 60 })], breeds, stdOk).overdue).toBe(1);
  });
  it('age=52, std=56 → thisWeek=1', () => {
    expect(computeSexingStats([makeFlock({ __ageDays: 52 })], breeds, stdOk).thisWeek).toBe(1);
  });
  it('age=45, std=56 → twoWeeks=1', () => {
    expect(computeSexingStats([makeFlock({ __ageDays: 45 })], breeds, stdOk).twoWeeks).toBe(1);
  });
  it('age=30 → total=0', () => {
    expect(computeSexingStats([makeFlock({ __ageDays: 30 })], breeds, stdOk).total).toBe(0);
  });
  it('sexed (genderSplitAt != null) → ignore', () => {
    expect(computeSexingStats([makeFlock({ __ageDays: 60, genderSplitAt: '1405/08/01' })], breeds, stdOk).total).toBe(0);
  });
  it('type=layer → ignore', () => {
    expect(computeSexingStats([makeFlock({ __ageDays: 60, type: 'layer' })], breeds, stdOk).total).toBe(0);
  });
  it('sexingAgeOverride=40 اولویت', () => {
    expect(computeSexingStats([makeFlock({ __ageDays: 45, sexingAgeOverride: 40 })], breeds, stdOk).overdue).toBe(1);
  });
  it('breed ناموجود → ignore', () => {
    expect(computeSexingStats([makeFlock({ __ageDays: 60, breedId: 'x' })], breeds, stdOk).total).toBe(0);
  });
  it('std null → ignore', () => {
    expect(computeSexingStats([makeFlock({ __ageDays: 60 })], breeds, stdNull).total).toBe(0);
  });
  it('چند گله → جمع درست', () => {
    const flocks = [
      makeFlock({ id: 'a', __ageDays: 60 }),
      makeFlock({ id: 'b', __ageDays: 52 }),
      makeFlock({ id: 'c', __ageDays: 45 }),
      makeFlock({ id: 'd', __ageDays: 30 }),
    ];
    const r = computeSexingStats(flocks, breeds, stdOk);
    expect(r.overdue).toBe(1);
    expect(r.thisWeek).toBe(1);
    expect(r.twoWeeks).toBe(1);
    expect(r.total).toBe(3);
  });
});

/**
 * standards-spec.test.ts
 * تست «رفتار مطلوب» — نه «رفتار فعلی».
 * هر fail = باگ واقعی.
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  resolveBirdType,
  getEffectiveEnv,
  getEffectiveFeed,
  getEffectiveGrowth,
} from '../mod/set/standards/resolve';
import { DEFAULT_STANDARDS, FALLBACK_FEED, FALLBACK_ENV } from '../mod/set/standards/data';

describe('resolveBirdType', () => {
  it('نام فارسی دقیق', () => {
    expect(resolveBirdType('مرندی')).toBe('marandi');
    expect(resolveBirdType('گوشتی')).toBe('broiler');
    expect(resolveBirdType('تخمگذار')).toBe('layer');
  });
  it('trim فاصله اضافه', () => {
    expect(resolveBirdType('  مرندی  ')).toBe('marandi');
  });
  it('null/undefined/خالی → null', () => {
    expect(resolveBirdType(null)).toBe(null);
    expect(resolveBirdType(undefined)).toBe(null);
    expect(resolveBirdType('')).toBe(null);
  });
  it('ناشناخته → null', () => {
    expect(resolveBirdType('نژاد_نامعلوم_xyz')).toBe(null);
  });
});

describe('getEffectiveEnv — سنین لبه‌ای', () => {
  it('سن 0 = روز 1', () => {
    expect(getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 0).temp.target)
      .toBe(getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 1).temp.target);
  });
  it('سن منفی = روز 1', () => {
    expect(getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', -5).temp.target)
      .toBe(getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 1).temp.target);
  });
  it('سن null = روز 1', () => {
    expect(getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', null).temp.target)
      .toBe(getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 1).temp.target);
  });
  it('سن 99999 → آخرین بازه', () => {
    const a = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 99999);
    const arr = DEFAULT_STANDARDS.marandi.env;
    expect(a.temp.target).toBe(arr[arr.length - 1].temp.target);
  });
});

describe('getEffectiveEnv — override', () => {
  it('override=30 → target=30, source=override', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 5, 30);
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(30);
    expect(env.source).toBe('override');
  });
  it('override=0 (صفر) → override بشه نه نادیده', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 5, 0);
    expect(env.source).toBe('override');
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(0);
  });
  it('override=NaN → نادیده', () => {
    expect(getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 5, NaN).source).not.toBe('override');
  });
  it('override=null → نادیده', () => {
    expect(getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 5, null).source).not.toBe('override');
  });
});

describe('getEffectiveEnv — ناشناخته', () => {
  it('ناشناخته → fallback + FALLBACK_ENV', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('نژاد_xyz_نامعلوم', 5);
    expect(env.source).toBe('fallback');
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(FALLBACK_ENV.temp.target);
  });
  it('null → fallback', () => {
    expect(getEffectiveEnv(null, 5).source).toBe('fallback');
  });
});

describe('getEffectiveFeed — override ترکیبی', () => {
  it('feed override + پرنده ناشناخته → آب از fallback', () => {
    const f = getEffectiveFeed('نژاد_xyz_نامعلوم', 5, 100, null);
    expect(f.feedG).toBe(100);
    expect(f.waterMl).toBe(FALLBACK_FEED.waterMl);
  });
  it('water override + ناشناخته → دان از fallback', () => {
    const f = getEffectiveFeed('نژاد_xyz_نامعلوم', 5, null, 200);
    expect(f.waterMl).toBe(200);
    expect(f.feedG).toBe(FALLBACK_FEED.feedG);
  });
  it('feed override=0 → override بشه', () => {
    expect(getEffectiveFeed('مرندی', 5, 0, null).feedG).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('getEffectiveGrowth', () => {
  it('ناشناخته → fallback', () => {
    expect(getEffectiveGrowth('نژاد_xyz_نامعلوم', 5).source).toBe('fallback');
  });
  it('مرندی روز 3 → default', () => {
    const g = getEffectiveGrowth('مرندی', 3);
    expect(g.weightG).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(g.source).toBe('default');
  });
});

/**
 * standards-spec2.test.ts — round 2
 * تست‌های عمیق‌تر: customStandards, findInRange, missing fields
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  getEffectiveEnv,
  getEffectiveFeed,
  getEffectiveGrowth,
  getMortalityRange,
  getIncubation,
  getStandardsGroupedByBird,
  getStandardFor,
} from '../mod/set/standards/resolve';
import { DEFAULT_STANDARDS, FALLBACK_ENV } from '../mod/set/standards/data';
import type { BirdStandard } from '../mod/set/standards/types';

// helper — یه استاندارد custom بساز
function makeCustom(overrides: Partial<BirdStandard> = {}): BirdStandard {
  return {
    ...DEFAULT_STANDARDS.marandi,
    ...overrides,
  } as BirdStandard;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// customStandards priority
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('customStandards — اولویت', () => {
  it('settings > default: وقتی custom هست، source=settings', () => {
    const custom = { marandi: makeCustom() };
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 5, null, { customStandards: custom });
    expect(env.source).toBe('settings');
  });

  it('override > settings: با هر دو، override برنده', () => {
    const custom = { marandi: makeCustom() };
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 5, 25, { customStandards: custom });
    expect(env.source).toBe('override');
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(25);
  });

  it('custom مقدار متفاوت → مقدار custom استفاده بشه', () => {
    const custom = {
      marandi: makeCustom({
        env: [{ dayFrom: 1, dayTo: 9999,
          temp: { min: 20, max: 25, target: 22 },
          humidity: { min: 50, max: 60 },
          light: { hours: 12 } }],
      }),
    };
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 100, null, { customStandards: custom });
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(22);
  });

  it('custom بدون بازه برای سن → مقدار undefined نده', () => {
    const custom = {
      marandi: makeCustom({
        env: [{ dayFrom: 100, dayTo: 200,
          temp: { min: 20, max: 25, target: 22 },
          humidity: { min: 50, max: 60 },
          light: { hours: 12 } }],
      }),
    };
    // سن 5 — هیچ بازه‌ای match نمیشه
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 5, null, { customStandards: custom });
    // باید یا اولین بازه، یا fallback باشه — نه undefined
    expect(env.temp).toBeTruthy();
    expect(env.temp.target).toBeDefined();
    expect(env.temp.target).not.toBe(undefined);
    expect(isNaN(env.temp.target)).toBe(false);
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// findInRange — آرایه نامرتب
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('findInRange — آرایه نامرتب (bug sus)', () => {
  it('بازه‌های نامرتب نباید نتیجه اشتباه بدن', () => {
    const custom = {
      marandi: makeCustom({
        env: [
          { dayFrom: 30, dayTo: 60, temp: { min: 18, max: 22, target: 20 }, humidity: { min: 50, max: 60 }, light: { hours: 12 } },
          { dayFrom: 1, dayTo: 15, temp: { min: 32, max: 35, target: 33 }, humidity: { min: 60, max: 70 }, light: { hours: 23 } },
          { dayFrom: 16, dayTo: 29, temp: { min: 25, max: 28, target: 26 }, humidity: { min: 55, max: 65 }, light: { hours: 18 } },
        ],
      }),
    };
    // سن 5 → باید بازه 1-15 رو بده (نه 30-60)
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 5, null, { customStandards: custom });
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(33);
  });
});

describe('getEffectiveEnv — priority chain', () => {
  it('مرندی روز 1 → temp 36 (brooding)', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 1);
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(36);
    expect(env.source).toBe('default');
  });

  it('مرندی روز 5 → temp 32', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 5);
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(32);
  });

  it('مرندی روز 10 → temp 28', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 10);
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(28);
  });

  it('مرندی روز 100 → temp 20 (بالغ)', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 100);
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(20);
  });

  it('گوشتی روز 1 → temp 33', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('گوشتی', 1);
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(33);
  });

  it('گوشتی روز 25 → temp 22', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('گوشتی', 25);
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(22);
  });

  it('گوشتی روز 40 → temp 21', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('گوشتی', 40);
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(21);
  });

  it('layer روز 200 (بالغ) → temp 21', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرغ تخمگذار', 200);
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(21);
  });

  it('override: temp=30 → source=override', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 100, 30);
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(30);
    expect(env.source).toBe('override');
  });

  it('override: temp=25 → min/max محاسبه میشن', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 100, 25);
    expect(env.temp.min).toBe(23);
    expect(env.temp.max).toBe(27);
  });

  it('override temp=null → از default استفاده', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 100, null);
    expect(env.source).toBe('default');
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(20);
  });

  it('override temp=undefined → default', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 100, undefined);
    expect(env.source).toBe('default');
  });

  it('پرنده ناشناخته → fallback', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('xyz', 5);
    expect(env.source).toBe('fallback');
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(22);
  });

  it('override + پرنده ناشناخته → override', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('xyz', 5, 30);
    expect(env.source).toBe('override');
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(30);
  });

  it('age null → روز 0', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', null);
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(36);  // brooding
  });

  it('age منفی → 0', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', -5);
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(36);
  });

  it('age خیلی زیاد → آخرین رنج', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('مرندی', 5000);
    expect(env.temp.target).toBe(20);
  });

  it('light hours درست', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('گوشتی', 2);
    expect(env.light.hours).toBe(23);
  });

  it('humidity درست', () => {
    const env = getEffectiveEnv('گوشتی', 2);
    expect(env.humidity.min).toBe(60);
    expect(env.humidity.max).toBe(70);
  });
});

describe('DEFAULT_STANDARDS integrity', () => {
  it('نژادهای کافی موجوده', () => {
    expect(Object.keys(DEFAULT_STANDARDS).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(20);
  });

  it('هر پرنده ساختار کامل داره', () => {
    Object.values(DEFAULT_STANDARDS).forEach(std => {
      expect(std.env.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(std.feed.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(std.mortality.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(std.space.densityMax).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(std.biology).toBeTruthy();
      expect(std.growth).toBeTruthy();
      expect(std.growth.weightByAge.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(std.equipment).toBeTruthy();
    });
  });

  it('تلفات کل مجاز داره', () => {
    Object.values(DEFAULT_STANDARDS).forEach(std => {
      expect(std.mortalityTotalPct).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
  });

  it('equipment feeder و drinker داره', () => {
    Object.values(DEFAULT_STANDARDS).forEach(std => {
      expect(std.equipment.feeder).toBeTruthy();
      expect(std.equipment.drinker).toBeTruthy();
      expect(std.equipment.lampWattPerM2).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(std.equipment.fanM3PerKg).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
  });

  it('biology برای همه پرنده‌ها پر شده', () => {
    Object.values(DEFAULT_STANDARDS).forEach(std => {
      expect(std.biology.incubationDays).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(std.biology.sexualMaturityDay).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
  });

  it('حداقل یه نژاد بومی production داره', () => {
    expect(DEFAULT_STANDARDS.marandi.production).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('layer تولید بالاترین', () => {
    const layer = DEFAULT_STANDARDS.layer;
    const marandi = DEFAULT_STANDARDS.marandi;
    expect(layer.production!.eggsPerYear).toBeGreaterThan(marandi.production!.eggsPerYear);
  });

  it('layer تولید بالاتر از بومی', () => {
    const layer = DEFAULT_STANDARDS.layer;
    const mar = DEFAULT_STANDARDS.marandi;
    if (layer.production && mar.production) {
      expect(layer.production.eggsPerYear).toBeGreaterThan(mar.production.eggsPerYear);
    }
  });

  it('هر پرنده env از روز 1 شروع میشه', () => {
    Object.values(DEFAULT_STANDARDS).forEach(std => {
      const first = std.env[0];
      expect(first.dayFrom).toBe(1);
    });
  });

  it('env رنج‌ها پیوسته (بدون gap)', () => {
    Object.values(DEFAULT_STANDARDS).forEach(std => {
      const env = std.env;
      for (let i = 0; i < env.length - 1; i++) {
        expect(env[i].dayTo + 1).toBe(env[i + 1].dayFrom);
      }
    });
  });

  it('آخرین env نژادهای محلی حداقل ۵ سال (1825 روز) را پوشش می‌دهد', () => {
    // نژادهای محلی/بومی (marandi, golpaygani, golin, lari) چرخه طبیعی ۵-۷ ساله دارن
    // فرض قدیمی 9999 (forever) غلط بود — برای هیچ نژاد زنده‌ای منطقی نیست
    const native = ['marandi', 'golpaygani', 'golin', 'lari'];
    native.forEach(key => {
      const std = DEFAULT_STANDARDS[key];
      if (!std) return;
      const last = std.env[std.env.length - 1];
      expect(last.dayTo, `${key} آخرین env`).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1825);
    });
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { safeStorage } from '../shr/utils/storage';

beforeEach(() => {
  try { localStorage.clear(); } catch { /* silent */ }
});

describe('safeStorage', () => {
  it('set + get', () => {
    safeStorage.set('k', 'v');
    expect(safeStorage.get('k')).toBe('v');
  });

  it('get ناموجود → null', () => {
    expect(safeStorage.get('nonexistent')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('remove', () => {
    safeStorage.set('k', 'v');
    safeStorage.remove('k');
    expect(safeStorage.get('k')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('setJSON + getJSON', () => {
    safeStorage.setJSON('obj', { a: 1, b: 'x' });
    expect(safeStorage.getJSON('obj', null)).toEqual({ a: 1, b: 'x' });
  });

  it('getJSON روی داده خراب → fallback', () => {
    safeStorage.set('bad', '{invalid json');
    expect(safeStorage.getJSON('bad', 'default')).toBe('default');
  });

  it('keys', () => {
    safeStorage.set('a', '1');
    safeStorage.set('b', '2');
    const keys = safeStorage.keys();
    expect(keys).toContain('a');
    expect(keys).toContain('b');
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import {
  useAlt, activeAlerts, countByLevel, LEVEL_LABEL, LEVEL_ICON, LEVEL_COLOR, CATEGORY_LABEL,
} from '../mod/alt/store';

const makeAlert = () => ({
  level: 'important' as const,
  category: 'stock' as const,
  title: 'کمبود دان',
  message: 'دان رو به اتمام است',
  source: 'whs',
  sourceId: 'item-1',
  date: '1405/07/09',
  notes: '',
});

beforeEach(() => {
  useAlt.setState({ alerts: [] });
});

describe('useAlt — store', () => {
  it('add → رکورد با status=active', () => {
    useAlt.getState().add(makeAlert());
    const alerts = useAlt.getState().alerts;
    expect(alerts).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(alerts[0].status).toBe('active');
    expect(alerts[0].id).toBeTruthy();
    expect(alerts[0].createdAt).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('findOrCreate → اگه نبود، اضافه میکنه', () => {
    useAlt.getState().findOrCreate(makeAlert());
    expect(useAlt.getState().alerts).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('findOrCreate → اگه بود (active)، دوباره اضافه نمیکنه', () => {
    const s = useAlt.getState();
    s.findOrCreate(makeAlert());
    s.findOrCreate(makeAlert());
    expect(useAlt.getState().alerts).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('findOrCreate → اگه dismissed بود، دوباره فعال میکنه', () => {
    const s = useAlt.getState();
    s.findOrCreate(makeAlert());
    const id = useAlt.getState().alerts[0].id;
    s.dismiss(id);

    s.findOrCreate(makeAlert());
    expect(useAlt.getState().alerts[0].status).toBe('active');
    expect(useAlt.getState().alerts).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('dismiss → status=dismissed', () => {
    const s = useAlt.getState();
    s.add(makeAlert());
    const id = useAlt.getState().alerts[0].id;
    s.dismiss(id);
    expect(useAlt.getState().alerts[0].status).toBe('dismissed');
  });

  it('snooze → status=snoozed + snoozeUntil', () => {
    const s = useAlt.getState();
    s.add(makeAlert());
    const id = useAlt.getState().alerts[0].id;
    s.snooze(id, '1405/10/01');
    expect(useAlt.getState().alerts[0].status).toBe('snoozed');
    expect(useAlt.getState().alerts[0].snoozeUntil).toBe('1405/10/01');
  });

  it('restore → status=active + snoozeUntil پاک', () => {
    const s = useAlt.getState();
    s.add(makeAlert());
    const id = useAlt.getState().alerts[0].id;
    s.snooze(id, '1405/10/01');
    s.restore(id);
    expect(useAlt.getState().alerts[0].status).toBe('active');
    expect(useAlt.getState().alerts[0].snoozeUntil).toBe('');
  });

  it('remove → فقط هدف', () => {
    const s = useAlt.getState();
    s.add({ ...makeAlert(), title: 'A' });
    s.add({ ...makeAlert(), title: 'B' });
    const id1 = useAlt.getState().alerts[0].id;
    s.remove(id1);
    expect(useAlt.getState().alerts).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(useAlt.getState().alerts[0].title).toBe('B');
  });

  it('clearAll → همه پاک میشن', () => {
    const s = useAlt.getState();
    s.add(makeAlert());
    s.add(makeAlert());
    s.clearAll();
    expect(useAlt.getState().alerts).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('activeAlerts', () => {
  it('فقط active رو برمیگردونه', () => {
    const alerts = [
      { id: '1', status: 'active', snoozeUntil: '', level: 'info' },
      { id: '2', status: 'dismissed', snoozeUntil: '', level: 'info' },

    expect(activeAlerts(alerts)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(activeAlerts(alerts)[0].id).toBe('1');
  });

  it('snoozed با تاریخ گذشته → فعال', () => {
    const past = '1400/01/01';
    const alerts = [
      { id: '1', status: 'snoozed', snoozeUntil: past, level: 'info' },
    ] as any;
    expect(activeAlerts(alerts)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('snoozed با تاریخ آینده → فعال نیست', () => {
    const future = '1500/01/01';
    const alerts = [
      { id: '1', status: 'snoozed', snoozeUntil: future, level: 'info' },
    ] as any;
    expect(activeAlerts(alerts)).toHaveLength(0);
  });
});

describe('countByLevel', () => {

    const alerts = [
      { id: '1', status: 'active', snoozeUntil: '', level: 'critical' },
      { id: '2', status: 'active', snoozeUntil: '', level: 'critical' },
      { id: '3', status: 'active', snoozeUntil: '', level: 'important' },

    expect(c.info).toBe(1);

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useBrd } from '../mod/brd/store';

const makeBird = (o: any = {}) => ({
  name: 'مرغ',
  nameEn: 'Chicken',
  cycleDays: 21,
  fcrStandard: 1.6,
  ...o,
});

const makeBreed = (o: any = {}) => ({
  birdId: 'bird-1',
  name: 'لگهورن',
  fcr: 1.5,
  ...o,
});

beforeEach(() => {
  useBrd.setState({ birds: [], breeds: [] });
});

describe('useBrd — birds', () => {
  it('addBird → id + timestamps', () => {
    useBrd.getState().addBird(makeBird() as any);
    const b = useBrd.getState().birds[0];
    expect(b.id).toBeTruthy();
    expect(b.createdAt).toBeTruthy();
    expect(b.name).toBe('مرغ');
  });

  it('updateBird → فقط هدف', () => {
    const s = useBrd.getState();
    s.addBird(makeBird({ name: 'A' }) as any);
    s.addBird(makeBird({ name: 'B' }) as any);
    const id = useBrd.getState().birds[0].id;
    s.updateBird(id, { name: 'A-edit', cycleDays: 25 });
    expect(useBrd.getState().birds[0].name).toBe('A-edit');
    expect(useBrd.getState().birds[0].cycleDays).toBe(25);
    expect(useBrd.getState().birds[1].name).toBe('B');
  });

  it('deleteBird → پرنده + نژادهای مربوطه پاک میشن', () => {
    const s = useBrd.getState();
    s.addBird(makeBird() as any);
    const birdId = useBrd.getState().birds[0].id;
    s.addBreed(makeBreed({ birdId }) as any);
    s.addBreed(makeBreed({ birdId, name: 'Breed-2' }) as any);
    s.addBreed(makeBreed({ birdId: 'other', name: 'Other' }) as any);

    s.deleteBird(birdId);
    expect(useBrd.getState().birds).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(useBrd.getState().breeds).toHaveLength(1); // فقط other
    expect(useBrd.getState().breeds[0].name).toBe('Other');
  });
});

describe('useBrd — breeds', () => {
  it('addBreed', () => {
    useBrd.getState().addBreed(makeBreed() as any);
    expect(useBrd.getState().breeds).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('updateBreed', () => {
    const s = useBrd.getState();
    s.addBreed(makeBreed() as any);
    const id = useBrd.getState().breeds[0].id;
    s.updateBreed(id, { name: 'Edit', fcr: 1.8 });
    expect(useBrd.getState().breeds[0].name).toBe('Edit');
    expect(useBrd.getState().breeds[0].fcr).toBe(1.8);
  });

  it('deleteBreed → فقط هدف', () => {
    const s = useBrd.getState();
    s.addBreed(makeBreed({ name: 'A' }) as any);
    s.addBreed(makeBreed({ name: 'B' }) as any);
    const id = useBrd.getState().breeds[0].id;
    s.deleteBreed(id);
    expect(useBrd.getState().breeds).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(useBrd.getState().breeds[0].name).toBe('B');
  });
});

describe('useBrd — dedupe', () => {
  it('dedupeBirds → حذف تکرار بر اساس name (case-insensitive)', () => {
    const s = useBrd.getState();
    s.addBird(makeBird({ name: 'مرغ' }) as any);
    s.addBird(makeBird({ name: 'مرغ' }) as any);
    s.addBird(makeBird({ name: '  مرغ  ' }) as any);  // با فاصله
    s.addBird(makeBird({ name: 'بوقلمون' }) as any);

    s.dedupeBirds();
    const names = useBrd.getState().birds.map(b => b.name);
    expect(useBrd.getState().birds).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(names).toContain('مرغ');
    expect(names).toContain('بوقلمون');
  });

  it('dedupeBreeds → حذف تکرار بر اساس birdId+name', () => {
    const s = useBrd.getState();
    s.addBreed(makeBreed({ birdId: 'b1', name: 'لگهورن' }) as any);
    s.addBreed(makeBreed({ birdId: 'b1', name: 'لگهورن' }) as any);
    s.addBreed(makeBreed({ birdId: 'b2', name: 'لگهورن' }) as any);  // birdId متفاوت
    s.dedupeBreeds();
    expect(useBrd.getState().breeds).toHaveLength(2);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { format, parse, addDays, startOfDay } from 'date-fns-jalali';
import {
  todayJalali, jalaliToDate, jalaliToKey, daysFromToday, statusOf,
  eventsOfDay,
  TYPE_COLORS, TYPE_LABELS,
} from '../mod/cal/store';

const daysFromTodayJ = (n: number) => format(addDays(startOfDay(new Date()), n), 'yyyy/MM/dd');

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// todayJalali
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('todayJalali', () => {
  it('فرمت yyyy/MM/dd', () => {
    const t = todayJalali();
    expect(t).toMatch(/^\d{4}\/\d{2}\/\d{2}$/);
  });

  it('با الان مطابقت داره', () => {
    expect(todayJalali()).toBe(format(new Date(), 'yyyy/MM/dd'));
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// jalaliToDate
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('jalaliToDate', () => {
  it('تاریخ معتبر → Date', () => {
    const d = jalaliToDate('1405/07/09');
    expect(d).toBeInstanceOf(Date);
  });

  it('خالی → null', () => {
    expect(jalaliToDate('')).toBeNull();
    expect(jalaliToDate(null as any)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('نامعتبر → null', () => {
    expect(jalaliToDate('xyz')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('اعداد فارسی', () => {
    const d = jalaliToDate('۱۴۰۵/۰۷/۰۹');
    expect(d).toBeInstanceOf(Date);
    expect(format(d!, 'yyyy/MM/dd')).toBe('1405/07/09');
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// jalaliToKey
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('jalaliToKey', () => {

    expect(jalaliToKey('1405/07/09')).toBe('14050709');
  });

  it('ماه/روز تک‌رقمی → pad', () => {
    expect(jalaliToKey('1405/7/9')).toBe('14050709');
  });

  it('اعداد فارسی', () => {
    expect(jalaliToKey('۱۴۰۵/۰۷/۰۹')).toBe('14050709');
  });

  it('خالی → خالی', () => {
    expect(jalaliToKey('')).toBe('');
    expect(jalaliToKey(null as any)).toBe('');
  });

  it('نامعتبر → خالی', () => {
    expect(jalaliToKey('abc')).toBe('');
    expect(jalaliToKey('1405/07')).toBe('');
  });
});

    expect(daysFromToday(daysFromTodayJ(-1))).toBe(-1);

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useCtc, ROLE_LABEL, ROLE_COLOR } from '../mod/ctc/store';

// helper
const makeContact = () => ({
  name: 'احمد رضایی',
  phone: '09123456789',
  phone2: '',
  email: 'a@b.com',
  address: 'تهران',
  city: 'تهران',
  nationalId: '1234567890',
  roles: ['customer'] as const,
  notes: '',
  customerType: '',
  customerTypes: ['wholesale'],
  trustScore: 8,
  defaultDiscount: 5,
  supplierTypes: [],
  position: '',
  startDate: '',
  salaryType: 'monthly',
  salaryAmount: null,
  insurance: false,
});

beforeEach(() => {
  // reset store
  useCtc.setState({ contacts: [] });
});

describe('useCtc — مخاطبین', () => {
  it('مقدار اولیه خالی', () => {
    expect(useCtc.getState().contacts).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('add → مخاطب جدید با id اضافه میکنه', () => {
    useCtc.getState().add(makeContact() as any);
    const c = useCtc.getState().contacts;
    expect(c).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(c[0].id).toBeTruthy();
    expect(c[0].name).toBe('احمد رضایی');
    expect(c[0].createdAt).toBeTruthy();
    expect(c[0].updatedAt).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('add چند تا → همه اضافه میشن', () => {
    const s = useCtc.getState();
    s.add({ ...makeContact(), name: 'A' } as any);
    s.add({ ...makeContact(), name: 'B' } as any);
    s.add({ ...makeContact(), name: 'C' } as any);
    expect(useCtc.getState().contacts).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(useCtc.getState().contacts.map(c => c.name)).toEqual(['A', 'B', 'C']);
  });

  it('add → id یکتا', () => {
    const s = useCtc.getState();
    s.add(makeContact() as any);
    s.add(makeContact() as any);
    const ids = useCtc.getState().contacts.map(c => c.id);
    expect(new Set(ids).size).toBe(2);
  });

  it('update → فقط هدف رو عوض میکنه', () => {
    const s = useCtc.getState();
    s.add({ ...makeContact(), name: 'A' } as any);
    s.add({ ...makeContact(), name: 'B' } as any);
    const idA = useCtc.getState().contacts[0].id;

    s.update(idA, { name: 'A-edit' });
    const c = useCtc.getState().contacts;
    expect(c[0].name).toBe('A-edit');
    expect(c[1].name).toBe('B');
  });

  it('update → updatedAt عوض میشه', async () => {
    const s = useCtc.getState();
    s.add(makeContact() as any);
    const id = useCtc.getState().contacts[0].id;
    const t1 = useCtc.getState().contacts[0].updatedAt;

    // تاخیر کوچیک
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 10));
    s.update(id, { name: 'X' });
    const t2 = useCtc.getState().contacts[0].updatedAt;
    expect(t2).not.toBe(t1);
  });

  it('update → id نامعتبر هیچ کاری نمیکنه', () => {
    const s = useCtc.getState();
    s.add(makeContact() as any);
    s.update('nonexistent-id', { name: 'X' });
    expect(useCtc.getState().contacts[0].name).toBe('احمد رضایی');
  });

  it('remove → فقط هدف رو حذف میکنه', () => {
    const s = useCtc.getState();
    s.add({ ...makeContact(), name: 'A' } as any);
    s.add({ ...makeContact(), name: 'B' } as any);
    const idA = useCtc.getState().contacts[0].id;

    s.remove(idA);
    const c = useCtc.getState().contacts;
    expect(c).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(c[0].name).toBe('B');
  });

  it('remove → id نامعتبر هیچ کاری نمیکنه', () => {
    const s = useCtc.getState();
    s.add(makeContact() as any);
    s.remove('nonexistent-id');
    expect(useCtc.getState().contacts).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('remove همه → خالی میشه', () => {
    const s = useCtc.getState();
    s.add(makeContact() as any);
    s.add(makeContact() as any);
    const ids = useCtc.getState().contacts.map(c => c.id);
    ids.forEach(id => s.remove(id));
    expect(useCtc.getState().contacts).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('ROLE_LABEL و ROLE_COLOR', () => {
  it('برچسب‌های فارسی درست', () => {
    expect(ROLE_LABEL.customer).toBe('مشتری');
    expect(ROLE_LABEL.supplier).toBe('فروشنده');
    expect(ROLE_LABEL.worker).toBe('کارگر');
  });

  it('رنگ‌های role تعریف شدن', () => {
    expect(ROLE_COLOR.customer).toBeTruthy();
    expect(ROLE_COLOR.supplier).toBeTruthy();
    expect(ROLE_COLOR.worker).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

/**
 * تست دیباگ: آیا updateStandard واقعاً state رو آپدیت می‌کنه؟
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useSet } from '../mod/set/store';
import { DEFAULT_STANDARDS } from '../mod/set/standards/data';

describe('useSet.updateStandard', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    useSet.setState({ customStandards: {} });
  });

  it('بعد از updateStandard، customStandards آپدیت میشه', () => {
    const before = useSet.getState().customStandards || {};
    expect(Object.keys(before).length).toBe(0);

    const custom = { ...DEFAULT_STANDARDS.marandi, key: 'برنز', nameFa: 'برنز' };
    useSet.getState().updateStandard('برنز', custom);

    const after = useSet.getState().customStandards || {};
    expect(Object.keys(after)).toContain('برنز');
    expect(after['برنز'].nameFa).toBe('برنز');
  });

  it('دو تا update پشت سر هم کار می‌کنه', () => {
    const c1 = { ...DEFAULT_STANDARDS.marandi, key: 'a', nameFa: 'A' };
    const c2 = { ...DEFAULT_STANDARDS.marandi, key: 'b', nameFa: 'B' };
    useSet.getState().updateStandard('a', c1);
    useSet.getState().updateStandard('b', c2);
    const after = useSet.getState().customStandards || {};
    expect(Object.keys(after).length).toBe(2);
  });
});

describe('useSet.resetStandard', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    useSet.setState({
      customStandards: {
        'برنز': { ...DEFAULT_STANDARDS.marandi, key: 'برنز' },
        'لاری': { ...DEFAULT_STANDARDS.marandi, key: 'لاری' },
      }
    });
  });

  it('resetStandard فقط یکی رو حذف می‌کنه', () => {
    useSet.getState().resetStandard('برنز');
    const after = useSet.getState().customStandards || {};
    expect(Object.keys(after)).toEqual(['لاری']);
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/store-dlg-migration-v11.test.ts

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { useDlg } from '../mod/dlg/store';

const migrateFn = (useDlg.persist as any).getOptions().migrate;

const oldLog = (overrides: any = {}) => ({
  id: 'log-1',
  flockId: 'flock-A',
  date: '1404/02/10',
  entryTime: '07:30',
  feedAmount: 50,
  feedRemaining: 8,
  ...overrides,
});

describe('migration — v10 → v11 (feedAmount → feedDelivered)', () => {
  it('feedDelivered از feedAmount منتقل می‌شود', () => {
    const persisted = { logs: [oldLog()] };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 10);
    expect(result.logs[0].feedDelivered).toBe(50);
  });

  it('feedConsumed = feedDelivered (simple fallback)', () => {
    const persisted = { logs: [oldLog()] };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 10);
    expect(result.logs[0].feedConsumed).toBe(50);
  });

  it('feedAmount حذف می‌شود', () => {
    const persisted = { logs: [oldLog()] };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 10);
    expect(result.logs[0].feedAmount).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('feedRemaining دست‌نخورده می‌ماند', () => {
    const persisted = { logs: [oldLog()] };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 10);
    expect(result.logs[0].feedRemaining).toBe(8);
  });

  it('اگر feedDelivered از قبل هست، استفاده می‌شود', () => {
    const persisted = {
      logs: [{
        id: 'log-1', flockId: 'f1', date: '1404/02/10', entryTime: '07:30',
        feedDelivered: 45,  // already migrated
        // no feedAmount
      }],
    };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 10);
    expect(result.logs[0].feedDelivered).toBe(45);
    expect(result.logs[0].feedConsumed).toBe(45);
  });

  it('اگر feedConsumed از قبل هست، دست‌نخورده', () => {
    const persisted = {
      logs: [{
        id: 'log-1', flockId: 'f1', date: '1404/02/10', entryTime: '07:30',
        feedDelivered: 50, feedConsumed: 42,  // precision mode
      }],
    };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 10);
    expect(result.logs[0].feedConsumed).toBe(42);  // not overwritten
  });
});

describe('migration — v5 → v11 (زنجیره‌ای)', () => {
  it('از v5 مستقیم به v11: همه تغییرات', () => {
    const v5Log = {
      id: 'log-1',
      flockId: 'flock-A',
      date: '1404/02/10',
      entryTime: '07:30',
      eggsCount: 350,
      dirtyEggs: 25,
      feedAmount: 50,
      feedRemaining: 8,
    };
    const persisted = { logs: [v5Log] };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 5);

    // v10 (A1)
    expect(result.logs[0].eatingEggs).toBe(350);
    expect(result.logs[0].otherEggs).toBe(25);

    // v11 (A2)
    expect(result.logs[0].feedDelivered).toBe(50);
    expect(result.logs[0].feedConsumed).toBe(50);

    // legacy removed
    expect(result.logs[0].eggsCount).toBeUndefined();
    expect(result.logs[0].feedAmount).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { useDlg } from '../mod/dlg/store';

const migrateFn = (useDlg.persist as any).getOptions().migrate;

const baseLog = (overrides: any = {}) => ({
  id: 'log-1',
  flockId: 'flock-A',
  date: '1404/02/10',
  entryTime: '07:30',
  feedDelivered: 50,
  feedConsumed: 50,
  ...overrides,
});

describe('migration — v11 → v12 (feedMethod: 2 → 5 مقدار)', () => {
  it("'manual' → 'scoop'", () => {
    const persisted = { logs: [baseLog({ feedMethod: 'manual' })] };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 11);
    expect(result.logs[0].feedMethod).toBe('scoop');
  });

  it("'auto' → 'auto_chain'", () => {
    const persisted = { logs: [baseLog({ feedMethod: 'auto' })] };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 11);
    expect(result.logs[0].feedMethod).toBe('auto_chain');
  });

  it("'' (خالی) → 'scoop'", () => {
    const persisted = { logs: [baseLog({ feedMethod: '' })] };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 11);
    expect(result.logs[0].feedMethod).toBe('scoop');
  });

  it('undefined → scoop', () => {
    const persisted = { logs: [baseLog({})] };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 11);
    expect(result.logs[0].feedMethod).toBe('scoop');
  });

  it("از قبل 'scoop' → دست‌نخورده", () => {
    const persisted = { logs: [baseLog({ feedMethod: 'scoop' })] };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 11);
    expect(result.logs[0].feedMethod).toBe('scoop');
  });

  it("از قبل 'auto_sensor' → دست‌نخورده", () => {
    const persisted = { logs: [baseLog({ feedMethod: 'auto_sensor' })] };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 11);
    expect(result.logs[0].feedMethod).toBe('auto_sensor');
  });

  it("از قبل 'bag' → دست‌نخورده", () => {
    const persisted = { logs: [baseLog({ feedMethod: 'bag' })] };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 11);
    expect(result.logs[0].feedMethod).toBe('bag');
  });
});

  it('از v10: rename + feedMethod', () => {
    const v10Log = {
      id: 'log-1', flockId: 'f1', date: '1404/02/10', entryTime: '07:30',
      feedAmount: 50,
      feedMethod: 'manual',
    };
    const persisted = { logs: [v10Log] };

    expect(result.logs[0].feedConsumed).toBe(50);

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { useDlg } from '../mod/dlg/store';

// دسترسی به migrate از Zustand persist
const migrateFn = (useDlg.persist as any).getOptions().migrate;

const oldLog = (overrides: any = {}) => ({
  id: 'log-1',
  flockId: 'flock-A',
  date: '1404/02/10',
  entryTime: '07:30',
  // v5 fields
  eggsCount: 350,
  dirtyEggs: 25,
  brokenEggs: 10,
  // legacy targets
  brokenTarget: 'consumption',
  otherTarget: 'consumption',
  ...overrides,
});

describe('migration — v5 → v10', () => {
  it('eatingEggs از eggsCount منتقل می‌شود', () => {
    const persisted = { logs: [oldLog()] };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 5);
    expect(result.logs[0].eatingEggs).toBe(350);
  });

  it('otherEggs از dirtyEggs منتقل می‌شود', () => {
    const persisted = { logs: [oldLog()] };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 5);
    expect(result.logs[0].otherEggs).toBe(25);
  });

  it('eggsCount و dirtyEggs حذف می‌شوند', () => {
    const persisted = { logs: [oldLog()] };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 5);
    expect(result.logs[0].eggsCount).toBeUndefined();
    expect(result.logs[0].dirtyEggs).toBeUndefined();
  });

  

  it('birdAgeDays پیش‌فرض null می‌گیرد', () => {
    const persisted = { logs: [oldLog()] };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 5);
    expect(result.logs[0].birdAgeDays).toBeNull();
  });
});



describe('migration — defensive v10 (v7 failed case)', () => {
  it('اگر v7 نتوانست eatingEggs را از eggsCount کپی کند، v10 آن را انجام می‌دهد', () => {
    // حالت: از v5 آمد ولی v7 به هر دلیل نتواست (مثلاً ترتیب معکوس در نسخه قدیمی)
    const brokenV7Log = {
      id: 'log-1',
      flockId: 'flock-A',
      date: '1404/02/10',
      entryTime: '07:30',
      eggsCount: 350,       // هنوز موجود
      eatingEggs: null,     // v7 نتوانست
      dirtyEggs: 25,
      otherEggs: null,
    };
    const persisted = { logs: [brokenV7Log] };
    const result = migrateFn(persisted, 7);
    expect(result.logs[0].eatingEggs).toBe(350);
    expect(result.logs[0].otherEggs).toBe(25);
    expect(result.logs[0].eggsCount).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/store-dlg.test.ts
