/**
 * D.6-F — negative test برای addInvoice atomic
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';

const { mockSetPartyCredit } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockSetPartyCredit: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../mod/ctc/store', async () => {
  const actual = await vi.importActual<any>('../mod/ctc/store');
  return { ...actual, setPartyCredit: mockSetPartyCredit };
});

import { useTra } from '../mod/tra/store';
import { useFlk } from '../mod/flk/store';
import { useWhs } from '../mod/whs/store';
import { useEgg } from '../mod/egg/store';

const makeInput = (): any => ({
  partyId: 'p1',
  type: 'purchase',
  category: 'feed',
  items: [],
  date: '1405/11/08',
  payments: [],
  allocations: [],
});

describe('D.6-F — atomic addInvoice', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockSetPartyCredit.mockReset();
    useTra.setState({ invoices: [], settlements: [], deals: [], allocations: [] } as any);
    useFlk.setState({ flocks: [], groups: [], groupMembers: [], consumptionEvents: [] } as any);
    useWhs.setState({ items: [], movements: [] } as any);
    useEgg.setState({ productions: [], sales: [], discards: [] } as any);
  });

  it('happy: addInvoice برمی‌گرداند id، بدون throw', () => {
    mockSetPartyCredit.mockImplementation(() => {});
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(makeInput());
    expect(typeof id).toBe('string');
    expect(id.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices[0].id).toBe(id);
    expect(mockSetPartyCredit).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('failure: setPartyCredit throws → rollback (فاکتور اضافه نمی‌شود)', () => {
    mockSetPartyCredit.mockImplementation(() => { throw new Error('simulated ctc failure'); });
    expect(() => useTra.getState().addInvoice(makeInput())).toThrow();
    expect(mockSetPartyCredit).toHaveBeenCalled();
    // ← rollback: هیچ فاکتوری نباید اضافه شده باشد
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('structural: atomic wrapper + throw count', async () => {
    const fs = await import('node:fs');
    const content = fs.readFileSync('src/mod/tra/store.ts', 'utf-8');
    expect(content).toContain('const __snaps = ALL_STORES.map');
    expect(content).toContain('store.restore(snap)');
    expect(content).toContain('خطا در ثبت فاکتور');
    const throwCount = (content.match(/throw e;/g) || []).length;
    expect(throwCount).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(28);
  });
});

    const factor = 25 / 10;
    expect(calcItemTotal(10, 100000, 'percent', 10, factor)).toBe(2_250_000);
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/tra-archive.test.ts
==========================================
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { splitInvoicesForArchive } from '../mod/tra/archivePolicy';
import type { Invoice } from '../mod/tra/types';

function makeInvoice(overrides: Partial<Invoice> = {}): Invoice {
  return {
    id: overrides.id ?? 'inv-1',
    type: overrides.type ?? 'sale',
    number: 'S140401001',
    date: '2025-01-10',
    partyId: 'party-1',
    category: 'egg',
    items: [],
    total: 100000,
    payments: [],
    dueDate: '2025-01-20',
    relatedFlockId: '',
    relatedEntryId: '',
    notes: '',
    createdAt: '2025-01-10T00:00:00.000Z',
    updatedAt: '2025-01-10T00:00:00.000Z',
    workflowStatus: 'paid',
    paidAt: '2025-01-12T00:00:00.000Z',
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe('tra archivePolicy', () => {
  it('keeps unsettled, disputed, or pending-check invoices and archives settled invoices before cutoffIso', () => {
    const invoices: Invoice[] = [
      makeInvoice({ id: 'old-settled', paidAt: '2025-01-05T00:00:00.000Z', date: '2025-01-04' }),
      makeInvoice({ id: 'unsettled', paidAt: '', workflowStatus: 'confirmed', date: '2025-01-02' }),
      makeInvoice({ id: 'disputed', disputeStatus: 'open', date: '2025-01-02' }),
      makeInvoice({
        id: 'bounced-check',
        date: '2025-01-02',
        payments: [
          {
            id: 'p1',
            date: '2025-01-02',
            amount: 100000,
            method: 'check',
            checkNo: '123',
            bank: 'mellat',
            dueDate: '2025-01-05',
            notes: '',
            status: 'bounced',
          },
        ],
      }),
      makeInvoice({ id: 'after-cutoff', paidAt: '2025-02-01T00:00:00.000Z', date: '2025-02-01' }),
    ];

    const res = splitInvoicesForArchive(invoices, { cutoffIso: '2025-01-15T00:00:00.000Z' });
    expect(res.toArchive.map(i => i.id)).toEqual(['old-settled']);
    expect(res.keep.map(i => i.id)).toEqual([
      'unsettled',
      'disputed',
      'bounced-check',
      'after-cutoff',
    ]);
  });

/**
 * traStore atomic — allocations باید در snapshot/restore باشد
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useTra } from '../mod/tra/store';
import { traStore } from '../cor/atomic';

describe('traStore atomic — allocations', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    useTra.setState({
      invoices: [],
      settlements: [],
      deals: [],
      allocations: [{ id: 'a1', invoiceId: 'inv1', amount: 1000 }],
    } as any);
  });

  it('snapshot شامل allocations', () => {
    const snap = traStore.getSnapshot() as any;
    expect(snap).toHaveProperty('allocations');
    expect(snap.allocations).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(snap.allocations[0].id).toBe('a1');
  });

  it('restore allocations را برمی‌گرداند', () => {
    const snap = traStore.getSnapshot() as any;
    useTra.setState({ allocations: [] } as any);
    expect(useTra.getState().allocations).toHaveLength(0);

    traStore.restore(snap);
    expect(useTra.getState().allocations).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(useTra.getState().allocations[0].id).toBe('a1');
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/tra-atomic-integration.test.ts

/**
 * D.6-G — integration: توالی add/update/delete + rollback
 *
 * هدف: verify که state بین ۳ عملیات متوالی leak نمی‌کند و
 * rollback در میانه، فاکتور را به حالت درست برمی‌گرداند.
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';

const { mockSetPartyCredit, mockState } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockSetPartyCredit: vi.fn(),
  mockState: { throwOnCall: -1, calls: 0 },
}));

vi.mock('../mod/ctc/store', async () => {
  const actual = await vi.importActual<any>('../mod/ctc/store');
  return {
    ...actual,
    setPartyCredit: (...args: any[]) => {
      mockState.calls++;
      if (mockState.throwOnCall >= 0 && mockState.calls === mockState.throwOnCall) {
        throw new Error('simulated ctc failure at call ' + mockState.calls);
      }
      return mockSetPartyCredit(...args);
    },
  };
});

import { useTra } from '../mod/tra/store';
import { useFlk } from '../mod/flk/store';
import { useWhs } from '../mod/whs/store';
import { useEgg } from '../mod/egg/store';

const makeInput = (notes = 'original'): any => ({
  partyId: 'p1',
  type: 'purchase',
  category: 'feed',
  items: [],
  date: '1405/11/08',
  payments: [],
  allocations: [],
  notes,
});

describe('D.6-G — integration: add/update/delete', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockSetPartyCredit.mockReset();
    mockSetPartyCredit.mockImplementation(() => {});
    mockState.throwOnCall = -1;
    mockState.calls = 0;
    useTra.setState({ invoices: [], settlements: [], deals: [], allocations: [] } as any);
    useFlk.setState({ flocks: [], groups: [], groupMembers: [], consumptionEvents: [] } as any);
    useWhs.setState({ items: [], movements: [] } as any);
    useEgg.setState({ productions: [], sales: [], discards: [] } as any);
  });

  it('توالی کامل: add → update → delete (همه موفق)', () => {
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(makeInput());
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices[0].id).toBe(id);
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices[0].notes).toBe('original');

    useTra.getState().updateInvoice(id, { notes: 'v2' });
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices[0].notes).toBe('v2');

    useTra.getState().deleteInvoice(id);
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(useTra.getState().allocations).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('Update fail → فاکتور به notes=original برمی‌گردد', () => {
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(makeInput());

    mockState.calls = 0;
    mockState.throwOnCall = 1;

    expect(() => useTra.getState().updateInvoice(id, { notes: 'v2' })).toThrow();
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices[0].notes).toBe('original');
  });

  it('Delete fail بعد از update → فاکتور با notes=v2 برمی‌گردد', () => {
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(makeInput());
    useTra.getState().updateInvoice(id, { notes: 'v2' });
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices[0].notes).toBe('v2');

    mockState.calls = 0;
    mockState.throwOnCall = 1;

    expect(() => useTra.getState().deleteInvoice(id)).toThrow();
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices[0].notes).toBe('v2');
  });

  it('Multi-invoice isolation: delete یکی fail، دومی سالم', () => {
    const id1 = useTra.getState().addInvoice(makeInput('inv1'));
    const id2 = useTra.getState().addInvoice(makeInput('inv2'));
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices).toHaveLength(2);

    mockState.calls = 0;
    mockState.throwOnCall = 1;

    expect(() => useTra.getState().deleteInvoice(id1)).toThrow();
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices).toHaveLength(2);
    const notes = useTra.getState().invoices.map((i: any) => i.notes).sort();
    expect(notes).toEqual(['inv1', 'inv2']);
  });
});

/**
 * tra-cascade-property.test.ts — property-based testing برای cascade
 * ۱۰۰۰+ سناریوی تصادفی → invariant sum = current
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import fc from 'fast-check';
import { useFlk } from '../mod/flk/store';
import { useBrd } from '../mod/brd/store';
import { applyInvoiceFlocks } from '../mod/tra/invoiceHelpers';

const makeInvoice = (o: any = {}): any => ({
  id: 'inv-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9),
  type: 'purchase', number: 'P' + Date.now(),
  date: '1405/08/02', partyId: 'p1', category: 'chick',
  items: [], total: 0, payments: [], dueDate: '',
  relatedFlockId: '', relatedEntryId: '',
  notes: '', createdAt: '2026-01-01', updatedAt: '2026-01-01',
  ...o,
});

const makeItem = (o: any = {}): any => ({
  id: 'i-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9),
  description: 'جوجه', category: 'chick',
  birdId: 'b1', breedId: 'br1', unit: 'pcs',
  quantity: 0, unitPrice: 10000, total: 0,
  ...o,
});

const makeFlock = (o: any = {}): any => ({
  id: 'f-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9),
  name: 'گله', type: 'layer', status: 'active',
  birdId: 'b1', breedId: 'br1', hallId: '', zoneId: '',
  initialCount: 0, currentCount: 0,
  maleCount: 0, femaleCount: 0, unknownCount: 0,
  layingStartDay: 0, endOfCycleDay: null,
  vaccineScheduleId: '', hatchDate: '', purchaseDate: '', startDate: '',
  source: '', purchasePrice: 0, deliveryCost: 0, otherCosts: 0,
  notes: '', events: [], genderSplitAt: null,
  createdAt: '2026-01-01', updatedAt: '2026-01-01',
  ...o,
});

beforeEach(() => {
  useFlk.setState({ flocks: [], groups: [], groupMembers: [] } as any);
  useBrd.setState({ birds: [], breeds: [] } as any);
});

const S = (g: any) => (g.maleCount ?? 0) + (g.femaleCount ?? 0) + (g.unknownCount ?? 0);

describe('PROPERTY: applyInvoiceFlocks — sum = current', () => {
  it('purchase unsplit → new flock', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 1000 }), (qty) => {
        useFlk.setState({ flocks: [], groups: [], groupMembers: [] } as any);
        applyInvoiceFlocks(makeInvoice({
          items: [makeItem({ quantity: qty, total: qty * 10000 })],
          total: qty * 10000,
        }));
        const flocks = useFlk.getState().flocks;
        expect(flocks.length).toBe(1);
        const g = flocks[0];
        expect(g.currentCount).toBe(qty);
        expect(S(g)).toBe(qty);
        expect(g.genderSplitAt).toBeFalsy();
      }),
      { numRuns: 200 }
    );
  });

  it('purchase with split → genderSplitAt set', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.integer({ min: 2, max: 1000 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 500 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 500 }),
        (total, male, female) => {
          if (male + female > total) return;
          if (male + female === 0) return;
          const unknown = total - male - female;
          useFlk.setState({ flocks: [], groups: [], groupMembers: [] } as any);
          applyInvoiceFlocks(makeInvoice({
            items: [makeItem({
              quantity: total, total: total * 10000,
              maleCount: male, femaleCount: female, unknownCount: unknown,
            })],
            total: total * 10000,
          }));
          const g = useFlk.getState().flocks[0];
          expect(g.currentCount).toBe(total);
          expect(g.genderSplitAt).toBeTruthy();
          expect(S(g)).toBe(total);
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 200 }
    );
  });

  it('sale from unsplit flock → sync', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.integer({ min: 2, max: 1000 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 999 }),
        (total, saleQty) => {
          if (saleQty >= total) return;
          useFlk.setState({
            flocks: [makeFlock({
              id: 'f1', initialCount: total, currentCount: total,
              maleCount: 0, femaleCount: 0, unknownCount: total,
              genderSplitAt: null,
            })],
            groups: [], groupMembers: [],
          } as any);
          applyInvoiceFlocks(makeInvoice({
            type: 'sale',
            items: [makeItem({ quantity: saleQty, total: saleQty * 10000, flockId: 'f1' })],
            total: saleQty * 10000,
          }));
          const g = useFlk.getState().flocks.find((f: any) => f.id === 'f1');
          expect(g).toBeDefined();
          expect(g!.currentCount).toBe(total - saleQty);
          expect(S(g)).toBe(g!.currentCount);
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 200 }
    );
  });

  it('sale with sex from split flock → invariant', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.integer({ min: 10, max: 1000 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 3 }),
        (total, saleMale) => {
          const male = Math.max(5, Math.floor(total / 2));
          const female = total - male;
          if (saleMale > male) return;
          useFlk.setState({
            flocks: [makeFlock({
              id: 'f1', initialCount: total, currentCount: total,
              maleCount: male, femaleCount: female, unknownCount: 0,
              genderSplitAt: '1405/08/02',
            })],
            groups: [], groupMembers: [],
          } as any);
          applyInvoiceFlocks(makeInvoice({
            type: 'sale',
            items: [makeItem({
              quantity: saleMale, total: saleMale * 10000,
              flockId: 'f1',
              maleCount: saleMale, femaleCount: 0, unknownCount: 0,
            })],
            total: saleMale * 10000,
          }));
          const g = useFlk.getState().flocks.find((f: any) => f.id === 'f1');
          expect(g).toBeDefined();
          expect(S(g)).toBe(g!.currentCount);
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 200 }
    );
  });

  it('idempotent: apply(inv, inv) → no change', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 500 }), (qty) => {
        useFlk.setState({ flocks: [], groups: [], groupMembers: [] } as any);
        const inv = makeInvoice({
          items: [makeItem({ quantity: qty, total: qty * 10000 })],
          total: qty * 10000,
        });
        applyInvoiceFlocks(inv);
        const before = useFlk.getState().flocks.map((f: any) => ({
          id: f.id, current: f.currentCount, unknown: f.unknownCount,
        }));
        applyInvoiceFlocks(inv, inv);
        const after = useFlk.getState().flocks.map((f: any) => ({
          id: f.id, current: f.currentCount, unknown: f.unknownCount,
        }));
        expect(JSON.stringify(before)).toBe(JSON.stringify(after));
      }),
      { numRuns: 100 }
    );
  });
});

/**
 * tra-cascade.test.ts — Integration tests for invoice → downstream stores
 * هر تست: reset همه storeها → ساخت فاکتور → انتظار در whs/flk/hal/inc
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { paidSum, paidSumAllocated, paidPendingSum, remaining } from '../mod/tra/calc';
import { useTra } from '../mod/tra/store';
import { useWhs } from '../mod/whs/store';
import { useFlk } from '../mod/flk/store';
import { useHal } from '../mod/hal/store';
import { useInc } from '../mod/inc/store';

// ─── Reset ───
function resetAll() {
  useTra.setState({ invoices: [], partyPayments: [], deals: [], allocations: [] } as any);
  useWhs.setState({ items: [], movements: [] } as any);
  useFlk.setState({ flocks: [] } as any);
  useHal.setState({ halls: [], zones: [], equipment: [] } as any);
  useInc.setState({ devices: [], eggEntries: [] } as any);
}

beforeEach(resetAll);

// ─── Helpers ───
const FA_DATE = '1405/07/29';

function baseItem(qty: number, price = 1000, extra: any = {}) {
  return {
    id: crypto.randomUUID(),
    description: 'کالای تست',
    unit: 'pcs',
    quantity: qty,
    unitPrice: price,
    total: qty * price,
    itemId: '',
    movementId: '',
    discountType: '',
    discountValue: 0,
    shipping: 0,
    ...extra,
  };
}

function feedInvoice(qty: number) {
  return {
    type: 'purchase' as const,
    date: FA_DATE, partyId: 'party-1', category: 'feed',
    items: [baseItem(qty, 1000, { category: 'feed', unit: 'kg', description: 'دان استارتر' })],
    total: qty * 1000, payments: [],
    dueDate: FA_DATE, relatedFlockId: '', relatedEntryId: '', notes: '',
  };
}

function equipInvoice(qty: number, hallId = 'hall-1') {
  return {
    type: 'purchase' as const,
    date: FA_DATE, partyId: 'party-1', category: 'equipment',
    items: [baseItem(qty, 5_000_000, {
      category: 'equipment', description: 'فن تونلی',
      equipmentKind: 'asset', equipmentCategory: 'cooling',
      equipmentType: 'fan', hallId,
    })],
    total: qty * 5_000_000, payments: [],
    dueDate: FA_DATE, relatedFlockId: '', relatedEntryId: '', notes: '',
  };
}

function chickInvoice(qty: number, hallId = 'hall-1', existingFlockId = '') {
  return {
    type: 'purchase' as const,
    date: FA_DATE, partyId: 'party-1', category: 'chick',
    items: [baseItem(qty, 20_000, {
      category: 'chick', description: 'جوجه یک‌روزه',
      birdId: 'bird-1', breedId: 'breed-1', hallId,
      existingFlockId: existingFlockId || undefined,
      maleCount: null, femaleCount: null, unknownCount: null,
      hatchDate: '1405/06/01',
    })],
    total: qty * 20_000, payments: [],
    dueDate: FA_DATE, relatedFlockId: '', relatedEntryId: '', notes: '',
  };
}

function eggInvoice(qty: number, broken = 0, nonInc = 0) {
  return {
    type: 'purchase' as const,
    date: FA_DATE, partyId: 'party-1', category: 'egg',
    items: [baseItem(qty, 30_000, {
      category: 'egg', description: 'تخم نطفه‌دار',
      birdId: 'bird-1', breedId: 'breed-1',
      brokenEggCount: broken, nonIncubableCount: nonInc,
      eggDate: '1405/07/20',
    })],
    total: qty * 30_000, payments: [],
    dueDate: FA_DATE, relatedFlockId: '', relatedEntryId: '', notes: '',
  };
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// GROUP 1: feed → whs
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('cascade: feed → whs', () => {
  it('purchase 100 kg creates whs item with stock=100', () => {
    useTra.getState().addInvoice(feedInvoice(100) as any);
    const items = useWhs.getState().items;
    expect(items.length).toBe(1);
    expect(items[0].currentStock).toBe(100);
    expect(items[0].category).toBe('feed');
  });

  it('edit 100 → 50 → whs=50 (delta, not 150)', () => {
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(feedInvoice(100) as any);
    const prev = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
    const newItems = prev.items.map(it => ({ ...it, quantity: 50, total: 50_000 }));
    useTra.getState().updateInvoice(id, { items: newItems, total: 50_000 });
    const items = useWhs.getState().items;
    expect(items.length).toBe(1);
    expect(items[0].currentStock).toBe(50);
  });

  it('edit 100 → 150 → whs=150 (delta, not 250)', () => {
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(feedInvoice(100) as any);
    const prev = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
    const newItems = prev.items.map(it => ({ ...it, quantity: 150, total: 150_000 }));
    useTra.getState().updateInvoice(id, { items: newItems, total: 150_000 });
    expect(useWhs.getState().items[0].currentStock).toBe(150);
  });

    expect(eqs.length).toBe(1);
    expect(eqs[0].count).toBe(3);
  });

// GROUP 6: Multiple items, same key

describe('complex: multiple items with same key', () => {
  it('two feed items same description → whs aggregates', () => {
    const inv = feedInvoice(100);
    inv.items.push({
      ...baseItem(50, 1000, { category: 'feed', unit: 'kg', description: 'دان استارتر' }),
    });
    (inv as any).total = 150_000;
    useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv as any);
    const items = useWhs.getState().items;
    expect(items.length).toBe(1);
    expect(items[0].currentStock).toBe(150);
  });

  it('edit one of two items: 100+50 → 30+50 = 80', () => {
    const inv = feedInvoice(100);
    inv.items.push({
      ...baseItem(50, 1000, { category: 'feed', unit: 'kg', description: 'دان استارتر' }),
    });
    (inv as any).total = 150_000;
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv as any);
    const prev = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
    const newItems = prev.items.map((it, i) => i === 0
      ? { ...it, quantity: 30, total: 30_000 }
      : it);
    useTra.getState().updateInvoice(id, { items: newItems, total: 80_000 });
    expect(useWhs.getState().items[0].currentStock).toBe(80);
  });
});

// GROUP 7: Sequential edits (drift detection)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('complex: sequential edits no drift', () => {
  it('100 → 150 → 50 → 200 → whs=200 (no drift)', () => {
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(feedInvoice(100) as any);
    const edits = [150, 50, 200];
    for (const qty of edits) {
      const prev = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
      const newItems = prev.items.map(it => ({ ...it, quantity: qty, total: qty * 1000 }));
      useTra.getState().updateInvoice(id, { items: newItems, total: qty * 1000 });
    }
    expect(useWhs.getState().items[0].currentStock).toBe(200);
  });

  it('flock 100 → 200 → 50 → 150 (no drift)', () => {
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(chickInvoice(100) as any);
    for (const qty of [200, 50, 150]) {
      const prev = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
      const newItems = prev.items.map(it => ({ ...it, quantity: qty, total: qty * 20_000 }));
      useTra.getState().updateInvoice(id, { items: newItems, total: qty * 20_000 });
    }
    expect(useFlk.getState().flocks[0].initialCount).toBe(150);
    expect(useFlk.getState().flocks[0].currentCount).toBe(150);
  });

  it('equipment 2→5→1 (count tracks last value)', () => {
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(equipInvoice(2) as any);
    for (const qty of [5, 1]) {
      const prev = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
      const newItems = prev.items.map(it => ({ ...it, quantity: qty, total: qty * 5_000_000 }));
      useTra.getState().updateInvoice(id, { items: newItems, total: qty * 5_000_000 });
    }
    expect(useHal.getState().equipment[0].count).toBe(1);
  });
});

// GROUP 18: payment lifecycle (paidSum invariants)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('payment: lifecycle', () => {
  it('pending check → paidSum=0', () => {
    const inv = feedInvoice(100);
    (inv as any).payments = [{
      id: 'p1', amount: 50_000, method: 'check', status: 'pending',
      date: FA_DATE, checkNo: '123', bank: 'ملی', dueDate: FA_DATE, notes: '',
    }];
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv as any);
    const saved = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
    // paidSum باید pending رو نشمره → remaining=total
    expect(paidSumAllocated(saved)).toBe(0);
    expect(remaining(saved)).toBe(100_000);
  });

  it('cleared check → paidSum=amount', () => {
    const inv = feedInvoice(100);
    (inv as any).payments = [{
      id: 'p1', amount: 50_000, method: 'check', status: 'cleared',
      date: FA_DATE, checkNo: '123', bank: 'ملی', dueDate: FA_DATE, notes: '',
      clearedDate: FA_DATE,
    }];
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv as any);
    const saved = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
    expect(paidSumAllocated(saved)).toBe(50_000);
    expect(remaining(saved)).toBe(50_000);
  });

  it('cash + pending check → only cash counted', () => {
    const inv = feedInvoice(100);
    (inv as any).payments = [
      { id: 'p1', amount: 30_000, method: 'cash', status: 'cleared', date: FA_DATE, checkNo: '', bank: '', dueDate: '', notes: '' },
      { id: 'p2', amount: 40_000, method: 'check', status: 'pending', date: FA_DATE, checkNo: '123', bank: 'ملی', dueDate: FA_DATE, notes: '' },
    ];
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv as any);
    const saved = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
    expect(paidSumAllocated(saved)).toBe(30_000);
    expect(paidPendingSum((saved as any).payments)).toBe(40_000);
  });

  it('refund subtracts', () => {
    const inv = feedInvoice(100);
    (inv as any).payments = [
      { id: 'p1', amount: 50_000, method: 'cash', type: 'regular', date: FA_DATE, checkNo: '', bank: '', dueDate: '', notes: '' },
      { id: 'p2', amount: 20_000, method: 'cash', type: 'refund', date: FA_DATE, checkNo: '', bank: '', dueDate: '', notes: '' },
    ];
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv as any);
    const saved = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
    expect(paidSumAllocated(saved)).toBe(30_000);
  });

  it('bounced check → paidSum ignores', () => {
    const inv = feedInvoice(100);
    (inv as any).payments = [{
      id: 'p1', amount: 50_000, method: 'check', status: 'bounced',
      date: FA_DATE, checkNo: '123', bank: 'ملی', dueDate: FA_DATE, notes: '',
      bouncedDate: FA_DATE,
    }];
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv as any);
    const saved = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
    expect(paidSumAllocated(saved)).toBe(0);
  });
});

// GROUP 20: allocation auto-creation
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
describe('allocation: auto-creation', () => {
  it('invoice with 2 payments → 2 allocations', () => {
    const inv = feedInvoice(100);
    (inv as any).payments = [
      { id: 'p1', amount: 50_000, method: 'cash', date: FA_DATE, checkNo: '', bank: '', dueDate: '', notes: '' },
      { id: 'p2', amount: 30_000, method: 'card', date: FA_DATE, checkNo: '', bank: '', dueDate: '', notes: '' },
    ];
    useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv as any);
    const allocs = useTra.getState().allocations;
    expect(allocs.length).toBe(2);
    expect(allocs[0].amount).toBe(50_000);
    expect(allocs[1].amount).toBe(30_000);
  });

  it('update payments → allocations synced', () => {
    const inv = feedInvoice(100);
    (inv as any).payments = [
      { id: 'p1', amount: 50_000, method: 'cash', date: FA_DATE, checkNo: '', bank: '', dueDate: '', notes: '' },
    ];
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv as any);
    expect(useTra.getState().allocations.length).toBe(1);

    // add a second payment
    const saved = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
    const newPayments = [...(saved.payments || []),
      { id: 'p2', amount: 30_000, method: 'card', date: FA_DATE, checkNo: '', bank: '', dueDate: '', notes: '' },
    ];
    useTra.getState().updateInvoice(id, { payments: newPayments } as any);
    expect(useTra.getState().allocations.length).toBe(2);
  });

  it('remove payment → allocation removed', () => {
    const inv = feedInvoice(100);
    (inv as any).payments = [
      { id: 'p1', amount: 50_000, method: 'cash', date: FA_DATE, checkNo: '', bank: '', dueDate: '', notes: '' },
      { id: 'p2', amount: 30_000, method: 'card', date: FA_DATE, checkNo: '', bank: '', dueDate: '', notes: '' },
    ];
    const id = useTra.getState().addInvoice(inv as any);
    const saved = useTra.getState().invoices.find(i => i.id === id)!;
    const newPayments = [(saved.payments || [])[0]];
    useTra.getState().updateInvoice(id, { payments: newPayments } as any);
    expect(useTra.getState().allocations.length).toBe(1);
  });
});

      consumptionEvents: [],
    } as any);
    useWhs.setState({ items: [], movements: [] } as any);
    useEgg.setState({ productions: [], sales: [], discards: [] } as any);
  });

  it('happy path: deleteInvoice کامل می‌شود', () => {
    mockSetPartyCredit.mockImplementation(() => {});
    useTra.setState({ invoices: [makeInvoice('inv1')] } as any);
    expect(() => useTra.getState().deleteInvoice('inv1')).not.toThrow();
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(mockSetPartyCredit).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('failure: setPartyCredit throws → rollback فاکتور', () => {
    mockSetPartyCredit.mockImplementation(() => {
      throw new Error('simulated ctc failure');
    });
    useTra.setState({ invoices: [makeInvoice('inv2')] } as any);

    expect(() => useTra.getState().deleteInvoice('inv2')).toThrow();

    // ← این خط مهم‌ترین است: mock واقعاً صدا زده شد؟
    expect(mockSetPartyCredit).toHaveBeenCalled();

    // ← rollback: فاکتور برگشته؟
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices[0].id).toBe('inv2');
  });

  it('non-existent: no-op', () => {
    mockSetPartyCredit.mockImplementation(() => {});
    expect(() => useTra.getState().deleteInvoice('nonexistent')).not.toThrow();
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('structural: کد atomic wrapper + 16 throw دارد', async () => {
    const fs = await import('node:fs');
    const content = fs.readFileSync('src/mod/tra/store.ts', 'utf-8');
    expect(content).toContain('const __snaps = ALL_STORES.map');
    expect(content).toContain('store.restore(snap)');
    expect(content).toContain('throw __err');
    const throwCount = (content.match(/throw e; }/g) || []).length;
    expect(throwCount).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(15);
  });
});

/**
 * tra-formulas.test.ts — تست single source of truth
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { format as formatJ } from 'date-fns-jalali';
import {
  partyBalance,
  agingBucketFromDue,
  isOverdue,
  overdueDays,
} from '../mod/tra/formulas';
import { computePartyCredit } from '../mod/tra/store';

const makeInv = (o: any = {}): any => ({
  id: 'inv-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9),
  type: 'sale',
  date: '1405/07/01',
  dueDate: '1405/07/31',
  partyId: 'p1',
  total: 1000,
  payments: [],
  category: 'feed',
  items: [],
  number: 'T001',
  relatedFlockId: '',
  relatedEntryId: '',
  notes: '',
  createdAt: '',
  updatedAt: '',
  ...o,
});

describe('partyBalance — single source of truth', () => {
  it('fully paid → 0', () => {
    const inv = makeInv({ total: 1000, payments: [{ id: 'p1', amount: 1000, method: 'cash', date: '1405/07/05' } as any] });
    expect(partyBalance('p1', [inv])).toBe(0);
  });

  it('unpaid → negative (بدهی)', () => {
    const inv = makeInv({ total: 1000 });
    expect(partyBalance('p1', [inv])).toBe(-1000);
  });

  it('overpaid → positive (پیش‌پرداخت)', () => {
    const inv = makeInv({ total: 1000, payments: [{ id: 'p1', amount: 1500, method: 'cash', date: '1405/07/05' } as any] });
    expect(partyBalance('p1', [inv])).toBe(500);
  });

  it('cash discount fully paid → 0', () => {
    const inv = makeInv({
      total: 1000,
      payments: [{ id: 'p1', amount: 950, method: 'cash', date: '1405/07/05' } as any],
      cashDiscountPct: 5, cashDiscountDays: 30,
    });
    expect(partyBalance('p1', [inv])).toBe(0);
  });

  it('filter by partyId', () => {
    const i1 = makeInv({ partyId: 'p1', total: 500 });
    const i2 = makeInv({ partyId: 'p2', total: 9999 });
    expect(partyBalance('p1', [i1, i2])).toBe(-500);
  });

  it('consistency با computePartyCredit', () => {
    const invs = [makeInv({ partyId: 'p1', total: 1000 })];
    expect(partyBalance('p1', invs)).toBe(computePartyCredit('p1', invs));
  });
});

describe('agingBucketFromDue — از dueDate (نه invoice date)', () => {
  const today = new Date();
  const fmtJ = (d: Date) => formatJ(d, 'yyyy/MM/dd');
  const daysAgo = (n: number) => {
    const d = new Date(today);
    d.setDate(d.getDate() - n);
    return fmtJ(d);
  };
  const daysAhead = (n: number) => {
    const d = new Date(today);
    d.setDate(d.getDate() + n);
    return fmtJ(d);
  };

  it('dueDate آینده → current', () => {
    const inv = makeInv({ dueDate: daysAhead(5) });
    expect(agingBucketFromDue(inv)).toBe('current');
    expect(isOverdue(inv)).toBe(false);
    expect(overdueDays(inv)).toBe(0);
  });

  it('overdue 10 روز → 1-30', () => {
    const inv = makeInv({ dueDate: daysAgo(10) });
    expect(agingBucketFromDue(inv)).toBe('1-30');
    expect(isOverdue(inv)).toBe(true);
    expect(overdueDays(inv)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(9);
  });

  it('overdue 25 روز → 1-30', () => {
    const inv = makeInv({ dueDate: daysAgo(25) });
    expect(agingBucketFromDue(inv)).toBe('1-30');
  });

  it('overdue 45 روز → 31-60', () => {
    const inv = makeInv({ dueDate: daysAgo(45) });
    expect(agingBucketFromDue(inv)).toBe('31-60');
  });

  it('overdue 70 روز → 61-90', () => {
    const inv = makeInv({ dueDate: daysAgo(70) });
    expect(agingBucketFromDue(inv)).toBe('61-90');
  });

  it('overdue 100 روز → 91-180', () => {
    const inv = makeInv({ dueDate: daysAgo(100) });
    expect(agingBucketFromDue(inv)).toBe('91-180');
  });

  it('invoice قدیمی با dueDate آینده → not overdue', () => {
    const inv = makeInv({ date: daysAgo(200), dueDate: daysAhead(10) });
    expect(isOverdue(inv)).toBe(false);
    expect(agingBucketFromDue(inv)).toBe('current');
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { format as formatJ, addDays as addDaysJ } from 'date-fns-jalali';
import { daysUntilJalali, daysUntilDue, computeUpcoming, computeUpcomingDeals } from '../mod/tra/helpers';
import type { Invoice, Deal } from '../mod/tra/types';

function makeInvoice(overrides: Partial<Invoice> = {}): Invoice {
  return {
    id: 'inv-' + Math.random(), type: 'sale', date: '1405/01/01',
    partyId: 'p1', category: 'chick', items: [], total: 100000,
    payments: [], dueDate: '1405/01/01', relatedFlockId: '',
    relatedEntryId: '', notes: '', createdAt: '', updatedAt: '', ...overrides,
  };
}

const today = formatJ(new Date(), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
const plus5 = formatJ(addDaysJ(new Date(), 5), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
const minus5 = formatJ(addDaysJ(new Date(), -5), 'yyyy/MM/dd');
const plus30 = formatJ(addDaysJ(new Date(), 30), 'yyyy/MM/dd');

describe('daysUntilJalali', () => {
  it('null/undefined/empty → null', () => {
    expect(daysUntilJalali(null)).toBeNull();
    expect(daysUntilJalali(undefined)).toBeNull();
    expect(daysUntilJalali('')).toBeNull();
  });
  it('invalid → null', () => { expect(daysUntilJalali('not-a-date')).toBeNull(); });
  it('today → 0', () => { expect(daysUntilJalali(today)).toBe(0); });
  it('Persian digits', () => {
    const persian = today.replace(/[0-9]/g, (d) => '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'[+d]);
    expect(daysUntilJalali(persian)).toBe(0);
  });
  it('future → positive', () => { expect(daysUntilJalali(plus5)).toBe(5); });
  it('past → negative', () => { expect(daysUntilJalali(minus5)).toBe(-5); });
});

describe('daysUntilDue', () => {
  it('delegates', () => {
    expect(daysUntilDue(makeInvoice({ dueDate: plus5 }))).toBe(5);
    expect(daysUntilDue(makeInvoice({ dueDate: '' }))).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('computeUpcoming (Dunning C4)', () => {
  it('no dueDate → excluded', () => {
    expect(computeUpcoming([makeInvoice({ dueDate: '' })])).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('remindersMuted → excluded', () => {
    expect(computeUpcoming([makeInvoice({ dueDate: plus5, remindersMuted: true })])).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('snoozed (nextReminderAt > today) → excluded', () => {
    expect(computeUpcoming([makeInvoice({ dueDate: plus5, nextReminderAt: plus30 })])).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('nextReminderAt past/today → included', () => {
    const a = makeInvoice({ id: 'a', dueDate: plus5, nextReminderAt: minus5 });
    const b = makeInvoice({ id: 'b', dueDate: plus5, nextReminderAt: today });
    expect(computeUpcoming([a, b]).map((r) => r.inv.id)).toEqual(['a', 'b']);
  });
  it('no nextReminderAt → included', () => {
    expect(computeUpcoming([makeInvoice({ dueDate: plus5 })])).toHaveLength(1);
  });
  it('dueDate > 7 days → excluded', () => {
    expect(computeUpcoming([makeInvoice({ dueDate: plus30 })])).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('overdue + future sorted', () => {
    const a = makeInvoice({ id: 'a', dueDate: minus5 });
    const b = makeInvoice({ id: 'b', dueDate: plus5 });
    expect(computeUpcoming([a, b]).map((r) => r.inv.id)).toEqual(['a', 'b']);
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// computeUpcomingDeals (regression: fix 74a5060c)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════

function makeDeal(overrides: Partial<Deal> = {}): Deal {
  return {
    id: 'deal-' + Math.random(),
    type: 'consignment',
    date: '1405/01/01',
    partyId: 'p1',
    description: 'test',
    value: 0,
    percent: null,
    dueDate: '1405/01/01',
    status: 'open',
    notes: '',
    createdAt: '',
    updatedAt: '',
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe('computeUpcomingDeals', () => {
  it('no dueDate → excluded', () => {
    expect(computeUpcomingDeals([makeDeal({ dueDate: '' })])).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('dueDate in future within 7 days → included', () => {
    expect(computeUpcomingDeals([makeDeal({ dueDate: plus5 })])).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('dueDate far future (>7 days) → excluded', () => {
    expect(computeUpcomingDeals([makeDeal({ dueDate: plus30 })])).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('snoozed (nextReminderAt > today) → excluded', () => {
    expect(computeUpcomingDeals([makeDeal({ dueDate: plus5, nextReminderAt: plus30 })])).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('nextReminderAt past → included', () => {
    expect(computeUpcomingDeals([makeDeal({ dueDate: plus5, nextReminderAt: minus5 })])).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('nextReminderAt today → included', () => {
    expect(computeUpcomingDeals([makeDeal({ dueDate: plus5, nextReminderAt: today })])).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('no nextReminderAt → included', () => {
    expect(computeUpcomingDeals([makeDeal({ dueDate: plus5 })])).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});

/**
 * tra-math.test.ts — تست‌های منطق عددی و ریاضی خرید
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  calcItemTotal, paidSum, remaining, computeCashDiscount, computeOverpayment, generateInstallments,
} from '../mod/tra/calc';

describe('calcItemTotal', () => {
  it('no discount: quantity × price', () => {
    expect(calcItemTotal(100, 1000)).toBe(100000);
  });
  it('zero quantity', () => {
    expect(calcItemTotal(0, 1000)).toBe(0);
  });
  it('percent discount 5%', () => {
    expect(calcItemTotal(100, 1000, 'percent', 5)).toBe(95000);
  });
  it('amount discount', () => {
    expect(calcItemTotal(100, 1000, 'amount', 10000)).toBe(90000);
  });
  it('discount larger than base → capped at 0', () => {
    expect(calcItemTotal(10, 100, 'amount', 5000)).toBe(0);
  });
  it('percent 100% → 0', () => {
    expect(calcItemTotal(100, 1000, 'percent', 100)).toBe(0);
  });
  it('fractional quantity', () => {
    expect(calcItemTotal(0.5, 1000)).toBe(500);
  });
});

describe('paidSum', () => {
  it('regular payments', () => {
    expect(paidSum([{ amount: 1000, method: 'cash' }, { amount: 2000, method: 'card' }] as any)).toBe(3000);
  });
  it('refund subtracts', () => {
    expect(paidSum([{ amount: 1000, method: 'cash', type: 'regular' }, { amount: 500, method: 'cash', type: 'refund' }] as any)).toBe(500);
  });
  it('bounced check ignored', () => {
    expect(paidSum([{ amount: 1000, method: 'cash' }, { amount: 5000, method: 'check', status: 'bounced' }] as any)).toBe(1000);
  });
  it('only cleared check counted (pending ignored)', () => {
    expect(paidSum([{ amount: 1000, method: 'check', status: 'pending' }, { amount: 2000, method: 'check', status: 'cleared' }] as any)).toBe(2000);
  });
});

describe('generateInstallments', () => {
  it('even split 1000/3 with remainder on last', () => {
    const inst = generateInstallments(1000, 3, 30, '1405/01/01', 0);
    expect(inst).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(inst[0].amount + inst[1].amount + inst[2].amount).toBe(1000);
  });
  it('single installment', () => {
    const inst = generateInstallments(5000, 1, 30, '1405/01/01', 0);
    expect(inst[0].amount).toBe(5000);
  });
  it('with advance', () => {
    const inst = generateInstallments(10000, 4, 30, '1405/01/01', 2000);
    expect(inst.reduce((a, i) => a + i.amount, 0)).toBe(8000);
  });
  it('advance >= total → empty', () => {
    expect(generateInstallments(1000, 3, 30, '1405/01/01', 1000)).toHaveLength(0);
  });
  it('count=0 → empty', () => {
    expect(generateInstallments(1000, 0, 30, '1405/01/01', 0)).toHaveLength(0);
  });
  it('total=0 → empty', () => {
    expect(generateInstallments(0, 3, 30, '1405/01/01', 0)).toHaveLength(0);
  });
  it('100/7 distributes remainder correctly', () => {
    const inst = generateInstallments(100, 7, 30, '1405/01/01', 0);
    expect(inst.reduce((a, i) => a + i.amount, 0)).toBe(100);
  });
});

describe('computeCashDiscount', () => {
  it('no discount config', () => {
    expect(computeCashDiscount({ total: 1000, date: '1405/01/01', payments: [{ date: '1405/01/05', amount: 500 }] } as any)).toBe(0);
  });
  it('partial payment within window → no discount (نیاز به تسویه کامل)', () => {
    // استاندارد accounting: تخفیف نقدی روی total فاکتور اعمال می‌شود
    // اما فقط وقتی که مشتری به اندازه total-discount پرداخت کند (تسویه)
    const d = computeCashDiscount({ total: 1000, date: '1405/01/01', cashDiscountPct: 5, cashDiscountDays: 10, payments: [{ date: '1405/01/05', amount: 500 }] } as any);
    expect(d).toBe(0);
  });

  it('full payment within window → discount روی total', () => {
    // مشتری ۹۵۰ پرداخت کرد (total - 5%) → تخفیف ۵۰ اعمال می‌شود
    const d = computeCashDiscount({ total: 1000, date: '1405/01/01', cashDiscountPct: 5, cashDiscountDays: 10, payments: [{ date: '1405/01/05', amount: 950 }] } as any);
    expect(d).toBe(50);
  });
  it('payment outside window', () => {
    expect(computeCashDiscount({ total: 1000, date: '1405/01/01', cashDiscountPct: 5, cashDiscountDays: 10, payments: [{ date: '1405/02/15', amount: 500 }] } as any)).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('computeOverpayment', () => {
  it('overpay با cash discount', () => {
    const inv = {
      total: 1000,
      date: '1405/01/01',
      cashDiscountPct: 2,
      cashDiscountDays: 10,
      payments: [{ date: '1405/01/05', amount: 985, method: 'cash' }],
    } as any;
    expect(computeOverpayment(inv)).toBe(5);
  });

  it('پرداخت دقیقاً به اندازه (بدون overpay)', () => {
    const inv = {
      total: 1000,
      payments: [{ date: '1405/01/01', amount: 1000, method: 'cash' }],
    } as any;
    expect(computeOverpayment(inv)).toBe(0);
  });

  it('پرداخت ناقص (بدون overpay)', () => {
    const inv = {
      total: 1000,
      payments: [{ date: '1405/01/01', amount: 500, method: 'cash' }],
    } as any;
    expect(computeOverpayment(inv)).toBe(0);
  });

  it('overpay با writeOff', () => {
    const inv = {
      total: 1000,
      writtenOffAmount: 100,
      payments: [{ date: '1405/01/01', amount: 950, method: 'cash' }],
    } as any;
    expect(computeOverpayment(inv)).toBe(50);
  });
});

describe('remaining', () => {
  it('total - paid', () => {
    expect(remaining({ total: 1000, payments: [{ amount: 300, method: 'cash' }] } as any)).toBe(700);
  });
  it('fully paid', () => {
    expect(remaining({ total: 1000, payments: [{ amount: 1000, method: 'cash' }] } as any)).toBe(0);
  });
  it('overpaid clamped to 0', () => {
    expect(remaining({ total: 1000, payments: [{ amount: 1500, method: 'cash' }] } as any)).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('Complex scenarios', () => {
  it('mixed invoice with different discounts', () => {
    const items = [
      { q: 100, p: 1000, dt: 'percent', dv: 5 },
      { q: 50, p: 2000, dt: 'amount', dv: 5000 },
      { q: 10, p: 500 },
    ];
    const sum = items.reduce((a, it: any) => a + calcItemTotal(it.q, it.p, it.dt, it.dv), 0);
    expect(sum).toBe(95000 + 95000 + 5000);
  });
  it('installments with advance 30%', () => {
    const total = 45000000;
    const advance = Math.round(total * 30 / 100);
    const inst = generateInstallments(total, 3, 30, '1405/01/01', advance);
    expect(inst.reduce((a, i) => a + i.amount, 0)).toBe(total - advance);
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/tra-over-sale-and-merge.test.ts
==========================================
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { createInvoiceSchema } from '../shr/validation/rules/tra';

describe('Zod: over-sale prevention (ATP)', () => {
  const makeCtx = (flocks: any[], prevInvoice?: any) => ({
    flocks,
    whsItems: [],
    contacts: [],
    invoices: prevInvoice ? [prevInvoice] : [],
    allocations: [],
    isEdit: !!prevInvoice,
    prevInvoice,
  });

  const makeItem = (overrides: any) => ({
    id: 'it-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),
    category: 'chick',
    flockId: 'f1',
    birdId: 'b1',
    breedId: 'br1',
    quantity: 10,
    unitPrice: 1000,
    description: 'X',
    hatchDate: '1405/08/01',
    total: 10000,
    unit: 'pcs',
    itemId: '',
    movementId: '',
    discountType: '',
    discountValue: 0,
    shipping: 0,
    ...overrides,
  });

  const makeSaleInvoice = (items: any[]) => ({
    type: 'sale',
    date: '1405/08/09',
    partyId: 'c1',
    category: 'chick',
    items,
    discount: 0,
    shipping: 0,
    total: items.reduce((s: number, it: any) => s + (Number(it.total) || 0), 0),
    payments: [],
    dueDate: '',
    relatedFlockId: '',
    relatedEntryId: '',
    relatedDealId: '',
    notes: '',
    isPreorder: false,
    deliveryDate: '',
  });

  it('new invoice: qty > currentCount → error', () => {
    const schema = createInvoiceSchema(makeCtx([{ id: 'f1', name: 'A', currentCount: 70 }]) as any);
    const data = makeSaleInvoice([makeItem({ quantity: 80, total: 80000 })]);
    const r = schema.safeParse(data);
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
    if (!r.success) {
      const msg = r.error.issues.find(i => i.message.includes('بیش از موجودی گله'))?.message;
      expect(msg).toBeTruthy();
      expect(msg).toContain('80');
      expect(msg).toContain('70');
    }
  });

  it('new invoice: qty = currentCount → no ATP error', () => {
    const schema = createInvoiceSchema(makeCtx([{ id: 'f1', name: 'A', currentCount: 70 }]) as any);
    const data = makeSaleInvoice([makeItem({ quantity: 70, total: 70000 })]);
    const r = schema.safeParse(data);
    const overErrors = r.success ? [] : r.error.issues.filter(i => i.message.includes('بیش از موجودی گله'));
    expect(overErrors).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('new invoice: qty < currentCount → no ATP error', () => {
    const schema = createInvoiceSchema(makeCtx([{ id: 'f1', name: 'A', currentCount: 70 }]) as any);
    const data = makeSaleInvoice([makeItem({ quantity: 50, total: 50000 })]);
    const r = schema.safeParse(data);
    const overErrors = r.success ? [] : r.error.issues.filter(i => i.message.includes('بیش از موجودی گله'));
    expect(overErrors).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('multi-item same flock: sum > currentCount → error', () => {
    const schema = createInvoiceSchema(makeCtx([{ id: 'f1', name: 'A', currentCount: 70 }]) as any);
    const data = makeSaleInvoice([
      makeItem({ quantity: 50, total: 50000 }),
      makeItem({ quantity: 30, total: 30000 }),
    ]);
    const r = schema.safeParse(data);
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
    if (!r.success) {
      const msg = r.error.issues.find(i => i.message.includes('بیش از موجودی گله'))?.message;
      expect(msg).toBeTruthy();
      expect(msg).toContain('80');
    }
  });

  it('edit invoice: 80 ≤ 70+10 → no ATP error', () => {
    const prevInv = { id: 'i1', type: 'sale', category: 'chick', items: [makeItem({ quantity: 10 })] };
    const schema = createInvoiceSchema(makeCtx([{ id: 'f1', name: 'A', currentCount: 70 }], prevInv) as any);
    const data = { ...makeSaleInvoice([makeItem({ quantity: 80, total: 80000 })]), id: 'i1' };
    const r = schema.safeParse(data);
    const overErrors = r.success ? [] : r.error.issues.filter(i => i.message.includes('بیش از موجودی گله'));
    expect(overErrors).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('edit invoice: 90 > 70+10 → error', () => {
    const prevInv = { id: 'i1', type: 'sale', category: 'chick', items: [makeItem({ quantity: 10 })] };
    const schema = createInvoiceSchema(makeCtx([{ id: 'f1', name: 'A', currentCount: 70 }], prevInv) as any);
    const data = { ...makeSaleInvoice([makeItem({ quantity: 90, total: 90000 })]), id: 'i1' };
    const r = schema.safeParse(data);
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
    if (!r.success) {
      const msg = r.error.issues.find(i => i.message.includes('بیش از موجودی گله'))?.message;
      expect(msg).toBeTruthy();
      expect(msg).toContain('90');
      expect(msg).toContain('80');
    }
  });

  it('stock: sum > currentStock → error', () => {
    const schema = createInvoiceSchema({
      flocks: [],
      whsItems: [{ id: 's1', name: 'Egg', currentStock: 100 }],
      contacts: [], invoices: [], allocations: [], isEdit: false,
    } as any);
    const data = {
      ...makeSaleInvoice([makeItem({
        category: 'egg', flockId: '', hatchId: '', birdId: '', breedId: '',
        stockItemId: 's1', quantity: 150, total: 75000, unit: 'pcs',
      })]),
      category: 'egg',
    };
    const r = schema.safeParse(data);
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
    if (!r.success) {
      const msg = r.error.issues.find(i => i.message.includes('بیش از موجودی انبار'))?.message;
      expect(msg).toBeTruthy();
      expect(msg).toContain('150');
      expect(msg).toContain('100');
    }
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/tra-update-invoice-atomic.test.ts

/**
 * D.6-E — negative test برای updateInvoice atomic
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';

const { mockSetPartyCredit } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockSetPartyCredit: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../mod/ctc/store', async () => {
  const actual = await vi.importActual<any>('../mod/ctc/store');
  return { ...actual, setPartyCredit: mockSetPartyCredit };
});

import { useTra } from '../mod/tra/store';
import { useFlk } from '../mod/flk/store';
import { useWhs } from '../mod/whs/store';
import { useEgg } from '../mod/egg/store';

const makeInvoice = (id: string, notes = 'original'): any => ({
  id, partyId: 'p1', type: 'purchase', category: 'feed',
  items: [], number: id, date: '1405/11/08',
  payments: [], paidAt: null, allocations: [], status: 'active', notes,
});

describe('D.6-E — atomic updateInvoice', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockSetPartyCredit.mockReset();
    useTra.setState({ invoices: [], settlements: [], deals: [], allocations: [] } as any);
    useFlk.setState({ flocks: [], groups: [], groupMembers: [], consumptionEvents: [] } as any);
    useWhs.setState({ items: [], movements: [] } as any);
    useEgg.setState({ productions: [], sales: [], discards: [] } as any);
  });

  it('happy: update notes، بدون throw', () => {
    mockSetPartyCredit.mockImplementation(() => {});
    useTra.setState({ invoices: [makeInvoice('inv1', 'orig')] } as any);
    expect(() => useTra.getState().updateInvoice('inv1', { notes: 'updated' })).not.toThrow();
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices[0].notes).toBe('updated');
    expect(mockSetPartyCredit).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('failure: setPartyCredit throws → rollback notes', () => {
    mockSetPartyCredit.mockImplementation(() => { throw new Error('simulated ctc failure'); });
    useTra.setState({ invoices: [makeInvoice('inv2', 'orig')] } as any);
    expect(() => useTra.getState().updateInvoice('inv2', { notes: 'updated' })).toThrow();
    expect(mockSetPartyCredit).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices[0].notes).toBe('orig');
  });

  it('non-existent: no-op', () => {
    mockSetPartyCredit.mockImplementation(() => {});
    expect(() => useTra.getState().updateInvoice('nonexistent', { notes: 'x' })).not.toThrow();
    expect(useTra.getState().invoices).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('structural: atomic wrapper + throw count', async () => {
    const fs = await import('node:fs');
    const content = fs.readFileSync('src/mod/tra/store.ts', 'utf-8');
    expect(content).toContain('const __snaps = ALL_STORES.map');
    expect(content).toContain('store.restore(snap)');
    expect(content).toContain('خطا در ویرایش');
    const throwCount = (content.match(/throw e;/g) || []).length;
    expect(throwCount).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(24);
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/units-convert.test.ts

/**
 * تست تبدیل‌های واحد
 * قاعده: رفت و برگشت باید همیشه همون عدد اولیه بده
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  weightToG, gToWeight,
  volumeToMl, mlToVolume,
  lengthToCm, cmToLength,
  areaToM2, m2ToArea,
  timeToS, sToTime,
  cToF, fToC, tempToC, cToTemp,
  currencyToToman, tomanToCurrency,
} from '../shr/units/convert';

const EPS = 1e-9;

describe('وزن (پایه: گرم)', () => {
  it('تبدیل به گرم', () => {
    expect(weightToG(1, 'g')).toBe(1);
    expect(weightToG(1, 'kg')).toBe(1000);
    expect(weightToG(1, 'mg')).toBe(0.001);
    expect(weightToG(1, 'ton')).toBe(1_000_000);
  });

  it('رفت و برگشت', () => {
    expect(Math.abs(gToWeight(weightToG(2.5, 'kg'), 'kg') - 2.5)).toBeLessThan(EPS);
    expect(Math.abs(gToWeight(weightToG(500, 'mg'), 'mg') - 500)).toBeLessThan(EPS);
  });
});

describe('حجم (پایه: میلی‌لیتر)', () => {
  it('سی‌سی = میلی‌لیتر دقیق', () => {
    expect(volumeToMl(1, 'cc')).toBe(volumeToMl(1, 'ml'));
    expect(volumeToMl(5, 'cc')).toBe(5);
    expect(volumeToMl(5, 'ml')).toBe(5);
  });

  it('لیتر → ml', () => {
    expect(volumeToMl(1, 'L')).toBe(1000);
    expect(volumeToMl(2.5, 'L')).toBe(2500);
  });

  it('رفت و برگشت', () => {
    expect(Math.abs(mlToVolume(volumeToMl(0.2, 'cc'), 'cc') - 0.2)).toBeLessThan(EPS);
  });
});

describe('طول (پایه: سانتی‌متر)', () => {
  it('تبدیل‌ها', () => {
    expect(lengthToCm(1, 'cm')).toBe(1);
    expect(lengthToCm(10, 'mm')).toBe(1);
    expect(lengthToCm(1, 'm')).toBe(100);
    expect(lengthToCm(1, 'km')).toBe(100_000);
  });

  it('رفت و برگشت', () => {
    expect(Math.abs(cmToLength(lengthToCm(2.5, 'm'), 'm') - 2.5)).toBeLessThan(EPS);
  });
});

describe('مساحت (پایه: مترمربع)', () => {
  it('هکتار', () => {
    expect(areaToM2(1, 'ha')).toBe(10_000);
    expect(areaToM2(0.5, 'ha')).toBe(5_000);
  });

  it('رفت و برگشت', () => {
    expect(Math.abs(m2ToArea(areaToM2(1, 'ha'), 'ha') - 1)).toBeLessThan(EPS);
  });
});

describe('زمان (پایه: ثانیه)', () => {
  it('تبدیل‌ها', () => {
    expect(timeToS(60, 'min')).toBe(3600);
    expect(timeToS(1, 'h')).toBe(3600);
    expect(timeToS(1, 'day')).toBe(86400);
  });

  it('رفت و برگشت', () => {
    expect(Math.abs(sToTime(timeToS(2.5, 'h'), 'h') - 2.5)).toBeLessThan(EPS);
  });
});

describe('دما', () => {
  it('نقاط شناخته‌شده', () => {
    expect(cToF(0)).toBe(32);       // آب یخ می‌زنه
    expect(cToF(100)).toBe(212);    // آب می‌جوشه
    expect(cToF(37)).toBeCloseTo(98.6, 1);  // بدن انسان
  });

  it('تبدیل معکوس', () => {
    expect(fToC(32)).toBe(0);
    expect(fToC(212)).toBe(100);
  });

  it('رفت و برگشت', () => {
    expect(Math.abs(fToC(cToF(32.5)) - 32.5)).toBeLessThan(EPS);
    expect(Math.abs(tempToC(cToTemp(25, 'f'), 'f') - 25)).toBeLessThan(EPS);
  });

  it('سلسیوس دست‌نخورده', () => {
    expect(tempToC(25, 'c')).toBe(25);
    expect(cToTemp(25, 'c')).toBe(25);
  });
});

describe('پول (پایه: تومان)', () => {
  it('تومان → ریال (×10)', () => {
    expect(tomanToCurrency(1000, 'rial', 200000)).toBe(10000);
  });

  it('ریال → تومان (÷10)', () => {
    expect(currencyToToman(10000, 'rial', 200000)).toBe(1000);
  });

  it('دلار با نرخ 200k', () => {
    expect(currencyToToman(25, 'usd', 200000)).toBe(5_000_000);
    expect(tomanToCurrency(5_000_000, 'usd', 200000)).toBe(25);
  });

  it('رفت و برگشت دلار', () => {
    const t = currencyToToman(25, 'usd', 200000);
    expect(Math.abs(tomanToCurrency(t, 'usd', 200000) - 25)).toBeLessThan(EPS);
  });
});

/**
 * تست useFormat — تغییر تنظیمات باید فوری نمایش رو عوض کنه
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import { useFormat } from '../shr/units/useFormat';
import { useSet } from '../mod/set/store';
import { DEFAULT_UNITS } from '../shr/units';

describe('useFormat — عدد', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    useSet.setState({ units: { ...DEFAULT_UNITS } });
  });

  it('عدد صحیح با جداکننده فارسی', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFormat());
    expect(result.current.int(12500000)).toBe('۱۲٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰');
  });

  it('عدد با اعشار ۲ رقم', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFormat());
    expect(result.current.num(1234.56)).toBe('۱٬۲۳۴٫۵۶');
  });

  it('تغییر به انگلیسی → فوری عوض میشه', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFormat());
    expect(result.current.int(1234)).toBe('۱٬۲۳۴');

    act(() => {
      useSet.setState({ units: { ...DEFAULT_UNITS, numberFormat: 'en' } });
    });

    expect(result.current.int(1234)).toBe('1,234');
  });

  it('تغییر اعشار → فوری', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFormat());
    expect(result.current.num(12.345)).toBe('۱۲٫۳۵'); // ۲ رقم

    act(() => {
      useSet.setState({ units: { ...DEFAULT_UNITS, decimals: 4 } });
    });

    expect(result.current.num(12.345)).toBe('۱۲٫۳۴۵۰');
  });

  it('جداکننده هزار = فاصله', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFormat());
    act(() => {
      useSet.setState({ units: { ...DEFAULT_UNITS, thousandSep: 'space' } });
    });
    expect(result.current.int(1234567)).toBe('۱ ۲۳۴ ۵۶۷');
  });

  it('null → —', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFormat());
    expect(result.current.num(null)).toBe('—');
    expect(result.current.num(undefined)).toBe('—');
    expect(result.current.num(NaN)).toBe('—');
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import { useCarousel } from '../shr/hooks/useCarousel';

describe('useCarousel — hook swipe', () => {
  it('ابتدایی برمیگردونه ref ها', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() =>
      useCarousel(['a', 'b', 'c'], 'a', () => {})
    );
    expect(result.current).toHaveProperty('containerRef');
    expect(result.current).toHaveProperty('trackRef');
    expect(result.current).toHaveProperty('setInstant');
    expect(typeof result.current.setInstant).toBe('function');
  });

  it('setInstant بدون خطا اجرا میشه', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() =>
      useCarousel(['a', 'b'], 'a', () => {})
    );
    act(() => {
      result.current.setInstant();
    });
    expect(true).toBe(true);
  });

  it('onChange در ابتدا صدا زده نمیشه', () => {
    const onChange = vi.fn();
    renderHook(() => useCarousel(['a', 'b'], 'a', onChange));
    expect(onChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('با ids خالی کرش نمیکنه', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() =>
      useCarousel([], '', () => {})
    );
    expect(result.current).toHaveProperty('containerRef');
  });

  it('با active نامعتبر کرش نمیکنه', () => {
    renderHook(() =>
      useCarousel(['a', 'b'], 'nonexistent', () => {})
    );
    expect(true).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('dlg — deleteLog/restoreLogFull negative', () => {
  let params: UseDlgSaveParams;

  beforeEach(() => {
    useDlg.setState({ logs: [makeLogWithCascades()] } as any);
    useWhs.setState({
      items: [makeItem('feed-1')],
      movements: [{
        id: 'mv-feed-1', itemId: 'feed-1', type: 'out', quantity: 50,
        unitPrice: 1000, reason: 'consumption', date: '1405/08/08',
        partyId: '', notes: '', flockId: 'flock-1',
        createdAt: '2026-01-01',
      }] as any,
    } as any);
    useEgg.setState({ productions: [], sales: [], discards: [] } as any);
    useFlk.setState({ flocks: [], groups: [], groupMembers: [], consumptionEvents: [] } as any);

    params = {
      form: emptyForm(),
      setForm: vi.fn(),
      saving: false,
      setSaving: vi.fn(),
      setErr: vi.fn(),
      setOpen: vi.fn(),
      selectedFlock: undefined,
      flockAliveCount: 0,
      isLayerFlock: false,
      num: () => null,
      int: () => null,
    };
  });

  it('deleteLog fail در whs.deleteMovement → rollback log', async () => {
    // ← mock قبل از renderHook (hook action رو در render time destructure می‌کنه)
    const originalDeleteMovement = useWhs.getState().deleteMovement;
    useWhs.setState({
      deleteMovement: () => { throw new Error('simulated whs delete failure'); },
    } as any);

    try {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useDlgSave(params));
      const log = useDlg.getState().logs[0];
      let res: any;
      await act(async () => {
        res = await result.current.deleteLog(log, { skipConfirm: true });
      });
      expect(res.ok).toBe(false);
      // rollback: log برگشت
      expect(useDlg.getState().logs).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(useDlg.getState().logs[0].id).toBe('log-1');
    } finally {
      useWhs.setState({ deleteMovement: originalDeleteMovement } as any);
    }
  });

  it('deleteLog happy → log حذف', async () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useDlgSave(params));
    const log = useDlg.getState().logs[0];
    let res: any;
    await act(async () => {
      res = await result.current.deleteLog(log, { skipConfirm: true });
    });
    expect(res.ok).toBe(true);
    expect(useDlg.getState().logs).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('restoreLogFull fail در whs.addMovement → rollback log', async () => {
    // ← mock قبل از renderHook
    const originalAddMovement = useWhs.getState().addMovement;
    useWhs.setState({
      addMovement: () => { throw new Error('simulated whs add failure'); },
    } as any);

    try {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useDlgSave(params));
      const snapshot = {
        feedMovements: [{
          id: 'mv-x', itemId: 'feed-1', type: 'out' as const, quantity: 50,
          unitPrice: 1000, reason: 'consumption' as const, date: '1405/08/08',
          partyId: '', notes: '', flockId: 'flock-1', createdAt: '2026-01-01',
        }],
        vaccineMovements: [],
        medicationMovements: [],
        production: null,
      };

      // پاک کردن log تا rollback قابل verify باشد
      useDlg.setState({ logs: [] } as any);

      let ok: boolean | undefined;
      await act(async () => {
        ok = await result.current.restoreLogFull(makeLogWithCascades(), snapshot as any);
      });
      expect(ok).toBe(false);
      // rollback: log اضافه نشد
      expect(useDlg.getState().logs).toHaveLength(0);
    } finally {
      useWhs.setState({ addMovement: originalAddMovement } as any);
    }
  });

  it('restoreLogFull happy → log بازگشت + movement جدید', async () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useDlgSave(params));

    const snapshot = {
      feedMovements: [{
        id: 'mv-x', itemId: 'feed-1', type: 'out' as const, quantity: 50,
        unitPrice: 1000, reason: 'consumption' as const, date: '1405/08/08',
        partyId: '', notes: '', flockId: 'flock-1', createdAt: '2026-01-01',
      }],
      vaccineMovements: [],
      medicationMovements: [],
      production: null,
    };

    useDlg.setState({ logs: [] } as any);

    let ok: boolean | undefined;
    await act(async () => {
      ok = await result.current.restoreLogFull(makeLogWithCascades(), snapshot as any);
    });
    expect(ok).toBe(true);
    expect(useDlg.getState().logs).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(useWhs.getState().movements.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});

/**
 * useDlgSave-atomic.test.ts — B4 / D5.5
 *
 * تست‌های atomic برای save() و deleteLog().
 *
 * Ref:
 * - useDlgSave.ts (B2 save atomic + B3 deleteLog atomic)
 * - cor/atomic/transaction.ts
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import { useDlgSave, type UseDlgSaveParams } from '../mod/dlg/hooks/useDlgSave';
import { useDlg, type DailyLog } from '../mod/dlg/store';
import { useWhs, type Item } from '../mod/whs/store';
import { useEgg } from '../mod/egg/store';
import { useFlk } from '../mod/flk/store';
import type { F } from '../mod/dlg/types';

// ═══ mocks ═══
vi.mock('../cor/store/dialog', () => ({
  showConfirmAsync: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
  showAlert: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
}));

vi.mock('../cor/store/toast', () => ({
  toastMsg: {
    saved: vi.fn(), deleted: vi.fn(), deletedBulk: vi.fn(),
    error: vi.fn(), info: vi.fn(), warn: vi.fn(),
    added: vi.fn(), updated: vi.fn(), archived: vi.fn(),
    archivedBulk: vi.fn(), restored: vi.fn(), restoredBulk: vi.fn(),
    hidden: vi.fn(), visible: vi.fn(),
    paused: vi.fn(), activated: vi.fn(),
  },
  showToast: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../cor/outbox', () => ({
  outbox: {
    publish: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue('mock-event-id'),
    subscribe: vi.fn(),
    processPending: vi.fn(),
    getState: () => ({ events: [] }),
    clearDone: vi.fn(),
  },
}));

vi.mock('../mod/dlg/api/checkStock', () => ({
  checkStock: vi.fn().mockReturnValue([]),
}));

vi.mock('../shr/intelligence', () => ({
  recordHistory: vi.fn(),
}));

// ═══ helpers ═══
const emptyForm = (): F => ({
  flockId: 'flock-1',
  date: '1405/08/08',
  entryTime: '08:00',
  temperature: '25', temperatureMin: '20', temperatureMax: '30',
  humidity: '', humidityMin: '', humidityMax: '',
  ventilation: 'ok', litter: 'dry', lightHours: '',
  behavior: 'active', distribution: 'uniform', appearance: '', sound: 'normal',
  feedType: '', feedDelivered: '', feedRemaining: '',
  feedSourceType: '', feedSourceId: '', feedMovementIds: [], feedMethod: '',
  waterMethod: '', waterAmount: '', waterFillCount: '', waterFillVolume: '',
  weightSamples: [], weightGender: '',
  eatingEggs: '', fertileEggs: '', brokenEggs: '', otherEggs: '',
  deaths: [], vaccines: [], medications: [], activities: [], notes: '',
});

const makeLogRecord = (overrides: Partial<Omit<DailyLog, 'id' | 'status' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>> = {}): Omit<DailyLog, 'id' | 'status' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'> => ({
  flockId: 'flock-1',
  date: '1405/08/08',
  entryTime: '08:00',
  temperature: null, temperatureMin: null, temperatureMax: null,
  humidity: null, humidityMin: null, humidityMax: null,
  ventilation: 'ok', litter: 'dry', lightHours: null,
  behavior: 'active', distribution: 'uniform', appearance: '', sound: 'normal',
  feedType: '', feedDelivered: null, feedConsumed: null, feedRemaining: null,
  feedSourceType: '', feedSourceId: '', feedMethod: '', feedMovementIds: [],
  waterMethod: '', waterAmount: null, waterFillCount: null, waterFillVolume: null,
  weightSamples: [], weightGender: '',
  brokenEggs: null,
  deathsCount: 0, deaths: [], vaccines: [], medications: [], activities: [], notes: '',
  birdAgeDays: null,
  ...overrides,

const makeParams = (overrides: Partial<UseDlgSaveParams> = {}): UseDlgSaveParams => ({
  form: emptyForm(),
  setForm: vi.fn(),
  saving: false,
  setSaving: vi.fn(),
  setErr: vi.fn(),
  setOpen: vi.fn(),
  selectedFlock: undefined,
  flockAliveCount: 1000,
  isLayerFlock: false,
  num: (s: string) => { const v = parseFloat(s); return isNaN(v) ? null : v; },
  int: (s: string) => { const v = parseInt(s); return isNaN(v) ? null : v; },
  ...overrides,
});

// ═══ setup ═══
type WhsState = ReturnType<typeof useWhs.getState>;
type DlgState = ReturnType<typeof useDlg.getState>;
let origAddMovement: WhsState['addMovement'] | undefined;
let origRemove: DlgState['remove'] | undefined;

beforeEach(() => {
  if (!origAddMovement) origAddMovement = useWhs.getState().addMovement;
  if (!origRemove) origRemove = useDlg.getState().remove;

  useDlg.setState({ logs: [], remove: origRemove });
  useWhs.setState({ items: [], movements: [], addMovement: origAddMovement });
  useEgg.setState({ productions: [], sales: [], discards: [] });
  useFlk.setState({ flocks: [], groups: [], groupMembers: [], consumptionEvents: [] });
  vi.clearAllMocks();
});

// ═══ tests ═══
describe('useDlgSave — B4 atomic', () => {
  it('1) save موفق → logId، log در dlg store', async () => {
    const params = makeParams();
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useDlgSave(params));
    let ok = false;
    await act(async () => {
      ok = await result.current.save();
    });
    expect(ok).toBe(true);
    const logs = useDlg.getState().logs;
    expect(logs).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(logs[0].flockId).toBe('flock-1');
    expect(logs[0].date).toBe('1405/08/08');
  });

  it('2) save shortage + reject → false، صفر mutation', async () => {
    const { checkStock } = await import('../mod/dlg/api/checkStock');
    vi.mocked(checkStock).mockReturnValueOnce([
      { name: 'test-item', need: 10, have: 5, unit: 'kg' },
    ]);
    const { showConfirmAsync } = await import('../cor/store/dialog');
    vi.mocked(showConfirmAsync).mockResolvedValueOnce(false);

    const params = makeParams();
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useDlgSave(params));
    let ok = true;
    await act(async () => {
      ok = await result.current.save();
    });
    expect(ok).toBe(false);
    expect(useDlg.getState().logs).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(useWhs.getState().movements).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('3) save fail در cascade → rollback کامل', async () => {
    // mock addMovement → '' → atomic throw
    useWhs.setState({ addMovement: () => '' });
    useWhs.setState({
      items: [{
        id: 'item-1', name: 'feed', category: 'feed',
        currentStock: 100, lastPrice: 1000, unit: 'kg',
        initialStock: 100, minStock: 0, supplierId: '',
        expireDate: '', storage: 'room', notes: '',
        withdrawalDays: null,
        createdAt: '', updatedAt: '',
      } as Item],
    });

    const params = makeParams({
      form: {
        ...emptyForm(),
        feedDelivered: '50',
        feedSourceType: 'item',
        feedSourceId: 'item-1',
      },
    });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useDlgSave(params));
    let ok = true;
    await act(async () => {
      ok = await result.current.save();
    });
    expect(ok).toBe(false);
    // rollback: dlg logs still empty
    expect(useDlg.getState().logs).toHaveLength(0);
    // rollback: whs movements still empty
    expect(useWhs.getState().movements).toHaveLength(0);
    // restore
    if (origAddMovement) useWhs.setState({ addMovement: origAddMovement });
  });

  it('6) second movement fails after first mutation → restore snapshots', async () => {
    useWhs.setState({
      items: [{
        id: 'item-1', name: 'feed', category: 'feed',
        currentStock: 100, lastPrice: 1000, unit: 'kg',
        initialStock: 100, minStock: 0, supplierId: '',
        expireDate: '', storage: 'room', notes: '',
        withdrawalDays: null, createdAt: '', updatedAt: '',
      } as Item],
    });

    const snapshot = () => {
      const dlg = useDlg.getState();
      const whs = useWhs.getState();
      const egg = useEgg.getState();
      const flk = useFlk.getState();
      return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({
        logs: dlg.logs,
        items: whs.items,
        movements: whs.movements,
        productions: egg.productions,
        sales: egg.sales,
        discards: egg.discards,
        flocks: flk.flocks,
        groups: flk.groups,
        groupMembers: flk.groupMembers,
        consumptionEvents: flk.consumptionEvents,
      }));
    };

    const before = snapshot();
    const realAddMovement = useWhs.getState().addMovement;
    let calls = 0;
    let firstId = '';
    let stockAfterFirst: number | undefined;
    let movementsAfterFirst = 0;

    useWhs.setState({
      addMovement: (...args: Parameters<WhsState['addMovement']>) => {
        calls++;
        if (calls === 2) return '';
        firstId = realAddMovement(...args);
        const state = useWhs.getState();
        stockAfterFirst = state.items.find(x => x.id === 'item-1')?.currentStock;
        movementsAfterFirst = state.movements.length;
        return firstId;
      },
    });

    let ok = true;
    try {
      const params = makeParams({
        form: {
          ...emptyForm(),
          feedDelivered: '30',
          feedSourceType: 'item',
          feedSourceId: 'item-1',
          feedSources: [
            { type: 'item', refId: 'item-1', quantity: 10 },
            { type: 'item', refId: 'item-1', quantity: 20 },
          ],
        },
      });
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useDlgSave(params));
      await act(async () => {
        ok = await result.current.save();
      });
    } finally {
      useWhs.setState({ addMovement: realAddMovement });
    }

    expect(calls).toBe(2);
    expect(firstId).toBeTruthy();
    expect(movementsAfterFirst).toBe(1);
    expect(stockAfterFirst).toBe(90);
    expect(ok).toBe(false);
    expect(snapshot()).toEqual(before);

    const { outbox } = await import('../cor/outbox');
    const { toastMsg } = await import('../cor/store/toast');
    expect(outbox.publish).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(toastMsg.saved).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('4) deleteLog موفق → log حذف شد', async () => {
    const logId = useDlg.getState().add(makeLogRecord());
    const log = useDlg.getState().logs.find(l => l.id === logId)!;
    expect(log).toBeTruthy();

    const params = makeParams();
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useDlgSave(params));
    let ok = false;
    await act(async () => {
      const r = await result.current.deleteLog(log);
      ok = r.ok;
    });
    expect(ok).toBe(true);
    expect(useDlg.getState().logs).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('5) deleteLog bulk (skipConfirm) → بدون prompt', async () => {
    const { showConfirmAsync } = await import('../cor/store/dialog');

    // 2 logs
    useDlg.getState().add(makeLogRecord({ entryTime: '08:00' }));
    useDlg.getState().add(makeLogRecord({ entryTime: '12:00' }));
    const logs = [...useDlg.getState().logs];
    expect(logs).toHaveLength(2);

    vi.mocked(showConfirmAsync).mockClear();

    const params = makeParams();
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useDlgSave(params));
    await act(async () => {
      for (const log of logs) {
        await result.current.deleteLog(log, { skipConfirm: true });
      }
    });

    expect(useDlg.getState().logs).toHaveLength(0);
    // skipConfirm → showConfirmAsync never called
    expect(showConfirmAsync).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});


// DLG_ZERO_AND_AUDIT_REGRESSION_V1
describe('dlg — zero values and atomic audit regression', () => {
  it('dailyLogToForm preserves zero numeric values', async () => {
    const { dailyLogToForm } = await import('../mod/dlg/hooks/useDlgForm');
    const { toEn } = await import('../shr/utils/fa');
    const log = {
      ...makeLogRecord(),
      id: 'zero-log', status: 'active',
      createdAt: '', updatedAt: '',
      temperature: 0, temperatureMin: 0, temperatureMax: 0,
      humidity: 0, humidityMin: 0, humidityMax: 0,
      eatingEggs: 0, fertileEggs: 0, brokenEggs: 0, otherEggs: 0,
    } as DailyLog;
    const form = dailyLogToForm(log);
    const fields = [
      'temperature', 'temperatureMin', 'temperatureMax',
      'humidity', 'humidityMin', 'humidityMax',
      'eatingEggs', 'fertileEggs', 'brokenEggs', 'otherEggs',
    ] as const;
    for (const field of fields) {
      expect(toEn(String(form[field]))).toBe('0');
    }
  });

  it('useDlgForm numeric parsers preserve Persian and English zero', async () => {
    const { useDlgForm } = await import('../mod/dlg/hooks/useDlgForm');
    const { result, unmount } = renderHook(() => useDlgForm({
      activeFlocks: [], halls: [], todayStr: '1405/08/08',
    }));
    try {
      expect(result.current.num('0')).toBe(0);
      expect(result.current.num('۰')).toBe(0);
      expect(result.current.int('0')).toBe(0);
      expect(result.current.int('۰')).toBe(0);
      expect(result.current.num('')).toBeNull();
      expect(result.current.int('')).toBeNull();
    } finally {
      unmount();
    }
  });

  it('initial audit failure rolls back the newly created log', async () => {
    const realAddEvent = useDlg.getState().addEvent;
    const { result, unmount } = renderHook(() => useDlgSave(makeParams()));
    let ok = true;
    try {
      act(() => {
        useDlg.setState({
          addEvent: () => { throw new Error('audit-test-failure'); },
        });
      });
      await act(async () => {
        ok = await result.current.save();
      });
      expect(ok).toBe(false);
      expect(useDlg.getState().logs).toHaveLength(0);
      const { outbox } = await import('../cor/outbox');
      expect(outbox.publish).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    } finally {
      act(() => { useDlg.setState({ addEvent: realAddEvent }); });
      unmount();
    }
  });

  it('edit audit failure restores the previous log value', async () => {
    const id = useDlg.getState().add(makeLogRecord({
      temperature: 10, temperatureMin: null, temperatureMax: null,
    }));
    const before = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(useDlg.getState().logs));
    const realAddEvent = useDlg.getState().addEvent;
    const params = makeParams({
      form: {
        ...emptyForm(), id,
        temperature: '20', temperatureMin: '', temperatureMax: '',
      },
    });
    const { result, unmount } = renderHook(() => useDlgSave(params));
    let ok = true;
    try {
      act(() => {
        useDlg.setState({
          addEvent: () => { throw new Error('audit-edit-test-failure'); },
        });
      });
      await act(async () => {
        ok = await result.current.save();
      });
      expect(ok).toBe(false);
      expect(useDlg.getState().logs).toEqual(before);
      const { outbox } = await import('../cor/outbox');
      expect(outbox.publish).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    } finally {
      act(() => { useDlg.setState({ addEvent: realAddEvent }); });
      unmount();
    }
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/validation-deal-payment.test.ts
