import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { getDealPaymentFormSchema } from '../shr/validation/rules/tra';

const MAX = 100_000;

describe('getDealPaymentFormSchema (L11)', () => {
  const valid = {
    date: '1405/08/01',
    amount: 50_000,
    direction: 'in' as const,
    method: 'cash' as const,
    notes: '',
    checkNo: '',
    bank: '',
    dueDate: '',
  };

  it('valid input → passes', () => {
    const r = getDealPaymentFormSchema(MAX).safeParse(valid);
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('amount = 0 → error', () => {
    const r = getDealPaymentFormSchema(MAX).safeParse({ ...valid, amount: 0 });
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
    if (!r.success) expect(r.error.issues.some(i => i.path[0] === 'amount')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('amount < 0 → error', () => {
    const r = getDealPaymentFormSchema(MAX).safeParse({ ...valid, amount: -1 });
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('amount > maxAmount → error', () => {
    const r = getDealPaymentFormSchema(MAX).safeParse({ ...valid, amount: MAX + 1 });
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
    if (!r.success) expect(r.error.issues.some(i => i.path[0] === 'amount')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('amount = maxAmount → OK (boundary)', () => {
    const r = getDealPaymentFormSchema(MAX).safeParse({ ...valid, amount: MAX });
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('empty date → error', () => {
    const r = getDealPaymentFormSchema(MAX).safeParse({ ...valid, date: '' });
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
    if (!r.success) expect(r.error.issues.some(i => i.path[0] === 'date')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('invalid direction → error', () => {
    const r = getDealPaymentFormSchema(MAX).safeParse({ ...valid, direction: 'sideways' });
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('invalid method → error', () => {
    const r = getDealPaymentFormSchema(MAX).safeParse({ ...valid, method: 'crypto' });
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('method=check without checkNo → error', () => {
    const r = getDealPaymentFormSchema(MAX).safeParse({ ...valid, method: 'check', checkNo: '' });
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
    if (!r.success) expect(r.error.issues.some(i => i.path[0] === 'checkNo')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('method=check with checkNo → OK', () => {
    const r = getDealPaymentFormSchema(MAX).safeParse({ ...valid, method: 'check', checkNo: '12345' });
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('method=cash without checkNo → OK', () => {
    const r = getDealPaymentFormSchema(MAX).safeParse({ ...valid, method: 'cash', checkNo: '' });
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('zero maxAmount (no debt) + amount>0 → error', () => {
    const r = getDealPaymentFormSchema(0).safeParse({ ...valid, amount: 1 });
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { createDlgSchema } from '../shr/validation/rules/dlg';

const mkBase = (overrides: any = {}) => ({
  flockId: 'flock-1',
  date: '1400/01/01',
  entryTime: '07:30',
  eatingEggs: 0, fertileEggs: 0, brokenEggs: 0, otherEggs: 0,
  deathsCount: 0, deaths: [], vaccines: [], medications: [],
  weightSamples: [], notes: '',
  ...overrides,
});

describe('Hen-day با femaleCount', () => {
  it('گله sexed: 450 تخم، 500 ماده → 90% → pass', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema({
      flockCurrentCount: 1000, flockFemaleCount: 500,
    });
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({ eatingEggs: 450 }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('گله sexed: 600 تخم، 500 ماده → 120% → error', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema({
      flockCurrentCount: 1000, flockFemaleCount: 500,
    });
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({ eatingEggs: 600 }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('مرز 102%: 510 تخم، 500 ماده → pass', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema({
      flockCurrentCount: 1000, flockFemaleCount: 500,
    });
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({ eatingEggs: 510 }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('مرز 102.2%: 511 تخم، 500 ماده → error', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema({
      flockCurrentCount: 1000, flockFemaleCount: 500,
    });
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({ eatingEggs: 511 }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('گله non-sexed: fallback به flockAlive', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema({
      flockCurrentCount: 1000, flockFemaleCount: 0,
    });
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({ eatingEggs: 500 }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('بدون context female → fallback', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema({ flockCurrentCount: 1000 });
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({ eatingEggs: 1000 }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { createDlgSchema } from '../shr/validation/rules/dlg';

const mkBase = (overrides: any = {}) => ({
  flockId: 'flock-1',
  date: '1400/01/01',
  entryTime: '07:30',
  eatingEggs: 0,
  fertileEggs: 0,
  brokenEggs: 0,
  otherEggs: 0,
  deathsCount: 0,
  deaths: [],
  vaccines: [],
  medications: [],
  weightSamples: [],
  notes: '',
  ...overrides,
});

describe('createDlgSchema — baseline', () => {
  it('فرم معتبر خالی → پاس', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema();
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase());
    if (!r.success) console.log(r.error.issues);
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('flockId خالی → error', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema();
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({ flockId: '' }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('tempMin > tempMax → error', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema();
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({ temperatureMin: 25, temperatureMax: 20 }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
    if (!r.success) {
      expect(r.error.issues.some(i => i.path.includes('temperatureMin'))).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it('humidityMin > humidityMax → error', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema();
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({ humidityMin: 80, humidityMax: 50 }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
    if (!r.success) {
      expect(r.error.issues.some(i => i.path.includes('humidityMin'))).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it('مجموع deaths ≠ deathsCount → error', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema();
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({
      deathsCount: 5,
      deaths: [{ id: 'd1', count: 3, cause: '', notes: '' }],
    }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('مجموع deaths = deathsCount → pass', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema();
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({
      deathsCount: 5,
      deaths: [
        { id: 'd1', count: 2, cause: '', notes: '' },
        { id: 'd2', count: 3, cause: '', notes: '' },
      ],
    }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('واکسن از انبار با quantity=0 → error', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema();
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({
      vaccines: [{ id: 'v1', itemId: 'item-1', quantity: 0, name: 'نیوکاسل' }],
    }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('واکسن از انبار با quantity>0 → pass', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema();
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({
      vaccines: [{ id: 'v1', itemId: 'item-1', quantity: 100, name: 'نیوکاسل' }],
    }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('دارو از انبار با quantity=0 → error', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema();
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({
      medications: [{ id: 'm1', itemId: 'item-2', quantity: 0 }],
    }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('وزن نمونه < 0.02 kg → error', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema();
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({
      weightSamples: [{ id: 'w1', weight: 0.01 }],
    }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('وزن نمونه > 5 kg → error', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema();
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({
      weightSamples: [{ id: 'w1', weight: 6 }],
    }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('وزن نمونه معتبر (1 kg) → pass', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema();
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({
      weightSamples: [{ id: 'w1', weight: 1 }],
    }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('createDlgSchema — با context', () => {
  it('deathsCount > flockAlive → error', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema({ flockCurrentCount: 100 });
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({
      deathsCount: 150,
      deaths: [{ id: 'd1', count: 150, cause: '', notes: '' }],
    }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('deathsCount ≤ flockAlive → pass', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema({ flockCurrentCount: 1000 });
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({
      deathsCount: 50,
      deaths: [{ id: 'd1', count: 50, cause: '', notes: '' }],
    }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('hen-day > 102% → error', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema({ flockCurrentCount: 100 });
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({ eatingEggs: 110 }));
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
    if (!r.success) {
      expect(r.error.issues.some(i => i.path.includes('eatingEggs'))).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it('hen-day ≤ 102% → pass', () => {
    const schema = createDlgSchema({ flockCurrentCount: 100 });
    const r = schema.safeParse(mkBase({ eatingEggs: 100 }));

  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/whs-archive.test.ts
==========================================
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { splitMovementsForArchive, applyMovementCheckpoint } from '../mod/whs/archivePolicy';
import { recalcStock, recalcAvgPrice, type Item, type Movement } from '../mod/whs/store';

function makeItem(overrides: Partial<Item> = {}): Item {
  return {
    id: 'item-1',
    name: 'دان استارتر',
    category: 'feed',
    unit: 'kg',
    minStock: 100,
    currentStock: 500,
    lastPrice: 20000,
    avgPrice: 20000,
    supplierId: '',
    expireDate: '',
    withdrawalDays: null,
    storage: 'room',
    notes: '',
    initialStock: 0,
    initialStockByLocation: { stock: 0 },
    createdAt: '2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
    updatedAt: '2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function makeMove(overrides: Partial<Movement>): Movement {
  return {
    id: overrides.id ?? 'mv-1',
    itemId: overrides.itemId ?? 'item-1',
    type: 'in',
    quantity: 100,
    unitPrice: 20000,
    reason: 'purchase',
    date: '1404/01/10',
    partyId: '',
    notes: '',
    createdAt: '2025-01-10T00:00:00.000Z',
    locationId: 'stock',
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe('whs archivePolicy & balance checkpoint', () => {
  it('archives movements up to cutoffIso and preserves stock & weighted average across archival', () => {
    const cutoffIso = '2025-01-02T23:59:59.000Z';
    const moves: Movement[] = [
      makeMove({ id: 'm1', type: 'in', quantity: 500, unitPrice: 20000, createdAt: '2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' }),
      makeMove({ id: 'm2', type: 'out', quantity: 200, unitPrice: 0, reason: 'consumption', createdAt: '2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z' }),
      makeMove({ id: 'm3', type: 'in', quantity: 100, unitPrice: 24000, createdAt: '2025-01-03T00:00:00.000Z' }),
      makeMove({ id: 'm4', type: 'adjust', quantity: 350, unitPrice: 0, reason: 'adjustment', createdAt: '2025-01-04T00:00:00.000Z' }),
    ];

    const baseItem = makeItem({ currentStock: 350 });
    const stockBefore = recalcStock(baseItem, moves);
    const avgBefore = recalcAvgPrice(baseItem, moves);

    const split = splitMovementsForArchive(moves, [baseItem], { cutoffIso });
    expect(split.toArchive.map(m => m.id)).toEqual(['m1', 'm2']);
    expect(split.keep.map(m => m.id)).toEqual(['m3', 'm4']);

    const checkpointItem = applyMovementCheckpoint(baseItem, split.toArchive);
    const stockAfter = recalcStock(checkpointItem, split.keep);
    const avgAfter = recalcAvgPrice(checkpointItem, split.keep);

    expect(stockAfter.expected).toBe(stockBefore.expected);
    expect(avgAfter.avg).toBe(avgBefore.avg);
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/whs-atomic-verify.test.ts
==========================================
/**
 * D10 — whs atomicity by design (verify + structural)
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useWhs } from '../mod/whs/store';

const makeItem = (id: string, stock = 100): any => ({
  id, name: 'item-' + id, category: 'feed', unit: 'kg',
  minStock: 0,
  currentStock: stock,
  initialStock: stock,  // ← recalcStockByLocation نیاز دارد
  lastPrice: 1000, avgPrice: 1000,
  supplierId: '', expireDate: '', withdrawalDays: null,
  batchNo: '', storage: 'room', notes: '',
  createdAt: '2026-01-01', updatedAt: '2026-01-01',
});

const makeMovement = (itemId: string, qty: number): any => ({
  itemId,
  type: 'in',
  quantity: qty,
  unitPrice: 1000,
  reason: 'purchase',
  date: '1405/11/08',
  partyId: 'p1',  // ← لازم برای reason: purchase
  notes: '',
});

describe('D10 — whs atomic by design', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    useWhs.setState({ items: [makeItem('i1')], movements: [] } as any);
  });

  it('addMovement: valid → stock + movement (single set)', () => {
    const mid = useWhs.getState().addMovement(makeMovement('i1', 50));
    expect(mid).toBeTruthy();
    expect(useWhs.getState().movements).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(useWhs.getState().items[0].currentStock).toBe(150);
  });

  it('addMovement preflight: item not found → return "" (صفر mutation)', () => {
    const before = useWhs.getState().items;
    const beforeMovs = useWhs.getState().movements;
    const mid = useWhs.getState().addMovement(makeMovement('nonexistent', 50));
    expect(mid).toBe('');
    expect(useWhs.getState().items).toBe(before);
    expect(useWhs.getState().movements).toBe(beforeMovs);
  });

  it('addMovement preflight: Zod invalid (negative qty) → throw', () => {
    const before = useWhs.getState().items;
    const beforeMovs = useWhs.getState().movements;
    expect(() => useWhs.getState().addMovement({ ...makeMovement('i1', -10) })).toThrow();
    expect(useWhs.getState().items).toBe(before);
    expect(useWhs.getState().movements).toBe(beforeMovs);
  });

  it('addMovement preflight: missing party for purchase → throw', () => {
    const before = useWhs.getState().items;
    expect(() => useWhs.getState().addMovement({ ...makeMovement('i1', 50), partyId: '' })).toThrow();
    expect(useWhs.getState().items).toBe(before);
    expect(useWhs.getState().movements).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('deleteMovement: موجودی برمی‌گردد', () => {
    useWhs.getState().addMovement(makeMovement('i1', 50));
    expect(useWhs.getState().items[0].currentStock).toBe(150);

    const mid = useWhs.getState().movements[0].id;
    useWhs.getState().deleteMovement(mid);
    expect(useWhs.getState().movements).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(useWhs.getState().items[0].currentStock).toBe(100);
  });

  it('deleteMovement: id ناموجود → silent no-op', () => {
    const before = useWhs.getState().items;
    useWhs.getState().deleteMovement('nonexistent-id');
    expect(useWhs.getState().items).toBe(before);
    expect(useWhs.getState().movements).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('addItem: single set + id برگشتی', () => {
    const id = useWhs.getState().addItem({
      name: 'new', category: 'vaccine', unit: 'pcs',
      minStock: 0, currentStock: 0, lastPrice: 0,
      supplierId: '', expireDate: '', withdrawalDays: null,
      batchNo: '', storage: 'fridge', notes: '',
    } as any);
    expect(id).toBeTruthy();
    expect(useWhs.getState().items).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it('structural: action ها = single set() each', async () => {
    const fs = await import('node:fs');
    const content = fs.readFileSync('src/mod/whs/store.ts', 'utf-8');

    const addItemIdx = content.indexOf('addItem: (i) =>');
    const deleteMovementIdx = content.indexOf('deleteMovement: (id) =>');
    expect(addItemIdx).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    expect(deleteMovementIdx).toBeGreaterThan(addItemIdx);

    const range = content.slice(addItemIdx, deleteMovementIdx);
    const setCounts = (range.match(/\bset\(/g) || []).length;
    expect(setCounts).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
    expect(setCounts).toBeLessThanOrEqual(6);
  });
});

      notes: 'تولید',
    });
    expect(useWhs.getState().items.find(x => x.id === eggId)!.currentStock).toBe(500);

    const invId = useTra.getState().addInvoice({
      type: 'sale',
      date: '1405/07/21',
      partyId: 'p1',
      category: 'egg',
      items: [{
        id: 'item-1',
        category: 'egg',
        description: 'تخم خوراکی - 1405/07/21',
        stockItemId: eggId,
        quantity: 200,
        unitPrice: 1000,
        total: 200000,
      }],
      payments: [],
      discount: 0,
      shipping: 0,
      total: 200000,
    });

    expect(useWhs.getState().items.find(x => x.id === eggId)!.currentStock).toBe(300);

    useTra.getState().deleteInvoice(invId);

    const final = useWhs.getState().items.find(x => x.id === eggId)!.currentStock;
    expect(final).toBe(500);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useWhs } from '../mod/whs/store';
import { useEgg } from '../mod/egg/store';
import { bus } from '../cor/events';
import { registerEggWhsHandlers } from '../mod/whs/handlers';

describe('whs egg production cascade (live)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    bus.reset();
    useWhs.setState({ items: [], movements: [] });
    useEgg.setState({ productions: [], sales: [] });
    registerEggWhsHandlers();
  });

  it('تولید تخم‌مرغ → موجودی انبار (خوراکی/نطفه‌دار/شکسته) اضافه می‌شود', async () => {
    const productionId = 'prod-1';
    const production = {
      id: productionId,
      date: '1405/07/20',
      flockId: 'flock-1',
      eatingCount: 300,
      fertileCount: 100,
      brokenCount: 20,
      softCount: 5,
      dirtyCount: 5,
    };

    await bus.emit('egg:production:created', {
      prodId: productionId,
      production,
    }, { source: 'test' });

    const items = useWhs.getState().items;

    const eatingItem = items.find(i => i.category === 'egg' && i.name === 'تخم مرغ');
    expect(eatingItem).toBeDefined();
    expect(eatingItem!.currentStock).toBe(300);

    const fertileItem = items.find(i => i.category === 'egg' && i.name === 'تخم نطفه‌دار');
    expect(fertileItem).toBeDefined();
    expect(fertileItem!.currentStock).toBe(100);

    const brokenItem = items.find(i => i.category === 'broken' && i.name === 'تخم شکسته');
    expect(brokenItem).toBeDefined();
    expect(brokenItem!.currentStock).toBe(30); // 20 + 5 + 5
  });
});

FILE: ./src/test/whs-migration.test.ts
==========================================
/**
 * تست migration v0→v1 برای Phase G-1 — stockByLocation
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useWhs, getStockAt } from '../mod/whs/store';

describe('Phase G-1 migration (v0 → v1)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    useWhs.setState({ items: [], movements: [] });
    localStorage.clear();
  });

  it('stockByLocation از currentStock پر می‌شه', async () => {
    const v0State = {
      state: {
        items: [{
          id: 'test-item',
          name: 'ذرت',
          category: 'feed',
          unit: 'kg',
          minStock: 0,
          currentStock: 150,
          initialStock: 100,
          lastPrice: 1000,
          avgPrice: 1000,
          supplierId: '',
          expireDate: '',
          withdrawalDays: null,
          storage: 'room',
          notes: '',
          createdAt: '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z',
          updatedAt: '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z',
        }],
        movements: [{
          id: 'test-mv',
          itemId: 'test-item',
          type: 'in',
          quantity: 50,
          unitPrice: 1000,
          reason: 'purchase',
          date: '2025-01-01',
          partyId: '',
          notes: '',
          createdAt: '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z',
        }],
      },
      version: 0,
    };
    localStorage.setItem('pm-whs', JSON.stringify(v0State));
    await useWhs.persist.rehydrate();

    const item = useWhs.getState().items[0];
    expect(item).toBeDefined();
    expect(item.stockByLocation).toEqual({ stock: 150 });
    expect(item.initialStockByLocation).toEqual({ stock: 100 });

    const mv = useWhs.getState().movements[0];
    expect(mv).toBeDefined();
    expect(mv.locationId).toBe('stock');
  });

  it('getStockAt برای آیتم قدیمی (fallback) کار می‌کند', () => {
    const oldItem = {
      id: 'legacy', name: 'قدیمی', category: 'feed' as const, unit: 'kg' as const,
      minStock: 0, currentStock: 200, lastPrice: 1000,
      supplierId: '', expireDate: '', withdrawalDays: null, storage: 'room', notes: '',
      createdAt: '2025-01-01', updatedAt: '2025-01-01',
    };
    expect(getStockAt(oldItem, 'stock')).toBe(200);
    expect(getStockAt(oldItem, 'consignment:party1')).toBe(0);
  });

  it('getStockAt با stockByLocation per-location می‌ده', () => {
    const item = {
      id: 'new', name: 'جدید', category: 'feed' as const, unit: 'kg' as const,
      minStock: 0, currentStock: 1300, lastPrice: 1000,
      supplierId: '', expireDate: '', withdrawalDays: null, storage: 'room', notes: '',
      stockByLocation: { stock: 1000, 'consignment:party1': 300 },
      createdAt: '2025-01-01', updatedAt: '2025-01-01',
    };
    expect(getStockAt(item, 'stock')).toBe(1000);
    expect(getStockAt(item, 'consignment:party1')).toBe(300);
    expect(getStockAt(item, 'unknown')).toBe(0);
  });
});
